This year, China’s game market revenue exceeded 325.7 billion yuan, a new high (China Game Industry Report 2024 by the Game Working Committee of the China Music and Digital Association). <https://www.nppa.gov.cn/xxfb/ywdt/202412/t20241216_877445.html>; Supreme People’s Court (2020). Guiding Opinions on Properly Trialing Certain Issues in Civil Cases Involving the New Coronavirus Epidemic in accordance with the Law (2) (Fafa [2020] No. 17, Article 9). <https://www.court.gov.cn/zixun/xiangqing/230181.html>; National Press and Publication Administration (2021). Notice on further strict management to effectively prevent minors from being addicted to online games (Guoxin Departure [2021] No. 14). <https://www.nppa.gov.cn/xxfb/tzgs/202108/t20210830_666285.html>

Remarks: It is designated as Level B because no one has directly measured "how much money can be saved by not tipping", only the total figures in the game industry. The two tricks of exempting security clearance and setting quotas are empirical methods, which alone are considered to be C level. The original text of Articles 19 and 145 of the Civil Code has been quoted verbatim in Article 9 (rewards for children to recharge their mobile phones). It does not constitute investment advice. If your spouse uses joint money to reward you with large amounts of money behind your back, see Section 10, Article 22 (Rewarding Hosts).

Case: Xiao Lin rewarded 600 yuan after watching the live broadcast one night. He wanted to withdraw but was told that adults cannot withdraw. The next day, he closed password-free payment, set a limit of 100 yuan per transaction, and did not place any more impulsive orders for a month.

items.title: Children who use their mobile phones to top up money can receive rewards. Large expenditures made by children over the age of eight can be claimed for refund without the parent’s approval.
items.core: If a child over eight years old spends money that is not commensurate with his age and intelligence, it will only be valid if the parent agrees or acknowledges the account afterwards. If the parents neither agree nor recognize the account, the transaction is invalid and they can request a refund. Children under the age of eight cannot spend their own money. After being urged by the other party, if the parents do not express their position within 30 days after receiving the notice, they will be deemed to have refused to ratify the case.
body: Cost: Nothing. It takes time to collect evidence and negotiate with the platform. The platform usually refuses first and then refunds. If you can't reach an agreement, you have no choice but to sue, which takes a few months, and you have to pay for the legal fees yourself. So prepare all the materials first, it is more cost-effective to go to the platform and 12315. The difficult thing is that the child refuses to tell, so you have to be patient and ask clearly.

Income: Minors over the age of eight are persons with limited capacity for civil conduct, which means that they can only do things commensurate with their age and intelligence. Civil legal actions that are not commensurate with his age and intelligence must be approved or ratified by the legal representative before they are valid: parents must nod in advance or admit their fault afterwards. A child under the age of eight is a person without capacity for civil conduct and cannot make decisions on his own. His legal agent will handle his affairs on his behalf. The counterparty may urge the legal representative to ratify the decision within 30 days from the date of receipt of the notice. After receiving the reminder, if no expression is made within these 30 days, it will be deemed as a refusal to ratify.
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress (2020). Civil Code. Full text reproduced by the Supreme People's Procuratorate. <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202006/t20200602_463888.shtml> Article 19: "Minors over the age of eight are persons with limited capacity for civil conduct. Civil legal acts shall be carried out by their legal agent or with the consent or ratification of their legal agent; however, they may independently carry out civil legal acts purely for profit or civil legal acts commensurate with their age and intelligence." Article 20: "Minors under the age of eight are persons without capacity for civil conduct and shall be represented by their legal agent in the execution of civil laws. Acts. "Article 145: "Civil legal acts performed by a person with limited capacity for civil conduct to obtain pure profits or civil legal acts commensurate with his or her age, intelligence, and mental health are valid; other civil legal acts performed shall be effective with the consent or ratification of the legal representative." "The counterparty may urge the legal agent to ratify the act within thirty days from the date of receipt of the notice. If the legal agent fails to express any indication, it shall be deemed to have refused ratification."

Note: The key is to provide evidence: you need to provide evidence to prove that the child is operating the mobile phone, not you. Useful materials include the following: recharge time is concentrated during school hours or when parents are at work, device usage records, children's chat records and game records, and instructions from the children themselves. There is no uniform amount line for "compatible with age and intelligence". Game skins worth tens of yuan are not the same thing as rewards worth tens of thousands of yuan. Preventing it in advance saves effort: set a password-free limit for payment methods, enable youth mode, and don’t tell your children your payment password. For your own impulsive tipping and recharging, please see Article 8 of this section (no tipping for anchors, no recharging for games).

Case: 10-year-old Xiaohang used his mother’s mobile phone to recharge a game worth 3,000 yuan. After his mother found out, he immediately contacted customer service to express her disapproval. She submitted her age and consumption records, and the platform refunded the full amount two weeks later.

items.title: Teach your children to remember a sentence: Anyone online who asks you to use your parent’s mobile phone to operate or submit a verification code is a liar.
items.core: The routines of these six types of scams are different. The last step of several types is to let the children use the parents’ mobile phones to transfer money. So let me teach you a lesson first: Anyone who asks you to touch your parent’s mobile phone or report a verification code is a liar. Add another sentence, "If you are cheated, tell me first, I won't scold you."
body: Cost: Nothing. Explain the following six categories to your child, and then make an agreement with him: "If you are cheated, tell me first, and I won't scold you." At the same time, set a password-free limit for payment, enable youth mode, and do not tell children the payment password. The hard thing is that you have to hold back your anger if you are really cheated.

Benefit: The Quanzhou Anti-Fraud Center teamed up with the Quanzhou Education Bureau to dismantle six types of scams specifically designed to defraud teenagers. Their routines are different. Categories 1, 2, and 3 state that the last step is to allow children to use their parents’ mobile phones or Alipay to transfer money, while the original text for Categories 4 and 6 does not mention parents’ mobile phones. The first category involves private transactions of game accounts and equipment at low prices. Xiao Wang transferred 260 yuan privately, but the other party said, "It is against the rules for minors to transfer money, and the account will be frozen." He clicked the "verification link" on his father's mobile phone, and more than 30,000 yuan was transferred from the account. The original article reminds that scammers will ask for parents' bank cards, passwords, and SMS verification codes, which "must never be given." The second category is "removing and preventing addiction". The other party threatened, "If you don't transfer the money and cancel it, your parents will go to jail." The child used his mother's mobile phone to transfer 7,000 yuan. The original text states that anti-addiction is an official setting and "there is no "private unlocking" channel at all." The third category is reward and refund. The scammer pretended to be "official customer service" and said that tips given by minors can be refunded, and asked to "use parents' Alipay to pay gifts to the designated live broadcast room to get a refund." 73,000 yuan was tipped out of the mother's account, and the person was blocked. The original article said, “Someone adds you and asks you to ‘refund gifts’, which is 100% a scam.” The fourth category is pretending to be a classmate or teacher. The scammer steals the number and sends a voice message announcing his name to borrow money. At the beginning of the school year, he also sneaked into the class group and pretended to be a teacher, and sent "pay tuition and miscellaneous fees 500 yuan." His avatar and nickname were the same as the real teacher, and he also arranged for "entrustment" to say "paid" in the group. The fifth category is star chasing. The scammer pulled the child into a "celebrity fan group and received a red envelope of 888 yuan." First let the child transfer 48.88 yuan for "verification". Then he threatened, "If minors participate in violations, the platform will freeze 80,000 yuan, and the parents will go to jail." A total of 16,000 yuan was defrauded. The original article said, "Real police officers and lawyers will never contact minors online to investigate, let alone ask parents to operate their mobile phones." The sixth category is using low-priced goods on second-hand platforms to lure people off the platform and transfer money privately. The same material also lists three red lines that children should not step on themselves. First, bank cards and phone cards are not borrowed, sold, or rented. Cards are used to transfer stolen money, which may constitute the crime of assisting information network criminal activities. Leaving a criminal record will affect the postgraduate and public examinations. Second, it is illegal and criminal to work part-time on a mobile phone. The third is "high-paying recruitment" overseas, and people may be controlled as soon as they arrive overseas (National News, October 2025)
Level of Evidence: B

Source: Quanzhou Anti-Fraud Center (2025). The first lesson of school | Anti-fraud is a required course for teenagers. These 6 traps must be avoided! <http://gat.fujian.gov.cn/ztzl/fjjffpzxrx/spjq/202510/t20251028_7026836.htm> (Reprinted by the Fujian Provincial Public Security Department)

Note: It is rated as Level B because the official information is a breakdown of scammers’ tactics and individual cases. There is no crime rate or statistics on prevention effectiveness. It should be clearly distinguished from Article 9 (children use mobile phones to recharge and reward): the money spent by children to recharge and reward themselves can be refunded in accordance with the requirements of the Civil Code. This article does not apply to the money defrauded by scammers, and you can only report to the police to stop the payment according to Section 8, Article 2. Whether you can recover it depends on whether the money is still in the account. The core tactic used by scammers to scare children is "If you break the rules, your parents will go to jail." Make it clear to your children in advance that this sentence itself is a sign of a scam, which is more effective than asking questions afterward. "Speak first if you are cheated, I won't scold you" should be true to this sentence. The original article reminds in the tip and refund category: "Don't hide it if you are cheated. Tell your parents immediately or call the police to reduce losses." The title sentence "Anyone on the Internet" is a statement that the author summarized from these six types of scams to make it easier for children to remember. The original article does not have such a sentence. The adult version of pretending to be an acquaintance, and AI face-changing, see Section 8, Articles 3 and 4 (hard anti-fraud rules, hang up before transferring money). The same goes for adults. Verification codes and facial recognition are not done for anyone. See Section 8, Item 45 (reading the verification code).

Case: A primary school student received a private message from "customer service" in the game, saying that he needed to use his mother's mobile phone to enter a verification code to receive skins. He remembered the agreement at home and immediately took a screenshot to tell his mother that his account number and bank card were not damaged.

items.title: Reject extended warranty (extended warranty) for electronic products
items.core: Extended warranties are generally sold for 10% to 50% of the original price. The profit from selling extended warranties is more than ten times that of ordinary products. The price difference is the extra money you pay. The state originally stipulates that major components such as washing machine motors and refrigerator compressors have a three-year warranty. If you encounter a very cheap extended warranty, divide the price of the extended warranty by the cost of repairing it, and you will get the estimate of how much it will take to pay back the cost if it breaks at least once in the past few years.
body: Cost: Nothing. The price is that after the warranty period, if you need to repair it, you will have to pay for it yourself, but the probability of this happening is unlikely.

Benefits: Extended warranties are typically priced from 10% to 50% of the original price of the item. Industry estimates cited in the study say the average gross profit margin on extended warranties is 50% to 60%: for every 100 yuan sold, 50 to 60 yuan is earned. That’s about 18 times the gross profit margin on regular merchandise. In 2003, extended warranties accounted for only 3% to 4% of Best Buy's revenue, but contributed more than 50% of profits (U.S., 2000s retail data). If you encounter an extended warranty with a price much lower than this range, you can calculate it yourself: extended warranty price ÷ cost of one repair = probability of failure required to recover the cost. You estimate that at least one failure during the extended warranty years may be greater than this number, so it is worth buying. For example, for an extended warranty of 25 yuan, assuming that a repair costs 300 yuan, if it breaks at least once, it may take more than about 8% to recover the cost. The 300 yuan here is just an example, not a statistic. Before calculating, deduct the portion already insured by the state. The three-guarantee period stipulated by the state is calculated from the day of invoice: 1 year for the complete washing machine and refrigerator, and 3 years for the main components. The main components of the washing machine are the motor, timer, program controller and capacitor, and the refrigerator is the compressor, thermostat, etc. The overlap between extended warranty and three guarantees is equivalent to spending money to buy something that you already have (National, since 1995)
Level of Evidence: B

Source: Chen T, Kalra A, Sun B (2009). Why Do Consumers Buy Extended Service Contracts? Journal of Consumer Research 36(4):611-623. <https://doi.org/10.1086/605298>; State Economic and Trade Commission et al. (1995). Regulations on liability for repair, replacement and return of some goods (State Economic and Trade [1995] 458 No. 8, the validity period of the three guarantees is calculated from the date of issuance of the invoice; the attachment is "Catalogue of Partial Commodities Subject to Three Guarantees (First Batch)" 1 year for complete machines of washing machines and household refrigerators, 3 years for main components). Administrative normative document of the State Administration for Market Regulation. <https://www.samr.gov.cn/zw/zfxxgk/zc/xzgfxwj/art/2019/art_f943e66de125437d92df701e1654c47c.html>

Note: The gross profit margin figure is based on industry estimates cited by others (Business Week 2004), not measured by the paper itself. The above algorithm is suitable for ordinary people who can afford a maintenance fee by themselves. People who rely on one device for a living and don’t have a backup machine have to calculate separately. Mobile phone screen breakage insurance also needs to be calculated separately: first estimate how often you drop it, and then see if the premium is worthwhile. You won’t lose tens of dollars if you buy a very cheap extended warranty. Before buying, check the day from which the calculation starts: it is calculated from the day of purchase, and the first few years overlap with the three packs. It depends on whether the merchant, brand or third-party company is insuring the product. Door-to-door fees and replacement fees are not charged separately. Also read the manual and warranty card. The warranty period promised by the brand itself may be longer than the three-pack warranty.

Case: When buying an air conditioner, the salesperson offered an extended warranty of 400 yuan. The buyer found out that the state stipulates a 10-year warranty for compressors. The warranty for his own brand of compressor is also 10 years, and a repair costs about 300 yuan. 400 divided by 300 is greater than 1, which means that the probability of failure exceeds 100% before the original investment is repaid, and you reject it on the spot.

items.title: Priority will be given to generic drugs and drugs selected from centralized procurement that have passed consistency evaluation
items.core: The average price of the second batch of centralized medicines was reduced by 53%, with the largest reduction being 93%. By April 2026, 11 batches have been made, covering 490 types of medicines. When prescribing and buying medicines, always ask "Are there any centralized or generic ones?" The ingredients are the same and you can save a lot of money.
body: Cost: No money. When the doctor prescribes medicine and you go to buy medicine, always ask, "Are there any medicines that are purchased in a centralized manner and have generic names?"

Benefit: For the centralized drug purchasing organized by the state, the price of the second batch will be reduced by an average of 53%, with a maximum reduction of 93%. As of April 2026, 11 batches have been carried out, covering 490 types of drugs. The number of drugs that passed or was deemed to have passed the consistency evaluation reached 1,695. This accounts for about 2/3 of commonly used clinical chemical drugs (China, official data from 2020 to 2026)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National Medical Insurance Administration (2020). The second batch of national organizations to organize the centralized procurement and use of drugs answers reporters’ questions. <https://www.nhsa.gov.cn/art/2020/1/17/art_38_2264.html>; National Medical Insurance Administration (2026). Regular policy briefing of the State Council: Improving the full-cycle and omni-channel drug price formation mechanism. <http://www.nhsa.gov.cn/art/2026/4/15/art_14_20221.html>; General Office of the State Council (2016). Opinions on carrying out consistency evaluation of generic drug quality and efficacy (Guobanfa [2016] No. 8). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2016-03/05/content_5049364.htm>; State Food and Drug Administration (2016). Announcement on the Release of Three Technical Guidelines for Selection and Determination of Common Oral Solid Dosage Reference Preparations (No. 61, 2016) Annex 1 and Annex 3, Reprinted by Hainan Provincial Food and Drug Administration. <https://amr.hainan.gov.cn/himpa/ztzl/fzy/201607/t20160720_1591587.html>; National Medical Insurance Administration (2024). Strict supervision on the quality of centralized procurement drugs, with "full coverage" of enterprise inspection and variety sampling. <https://www.nhsa.gov.cn/art/2024/12/30/art_52_15287.html>; National Medical Insurance Administration (2025). Relevant comrades from the medical insurance department and the drug regulatory department were interviewed by a reporter from the People's Daily Health Client on issues related to centralized drug procurement. <https://www.nhsa.gov.cn/art/2025/2/9/art_14_15647.html>

Note: Controversy: Some people often say that "consistency evaluation only compares ingredients, not efficacy." This is half true. The method of evaluation is to find healthy people to take the medicine, and draw blood to see the concentration curve of the medicine after it enters the blood. Then compare this curve with the original drug, if it falls between 80% and 125%, it is considered a pass. The requirements are stricter for drugs whose dosage is just a little bit dangerous. Excipients refer to fillings and coatings other than the active ingredients, which are allowed to be different from the original drug. Regulations only require that the active ingredients, dosage forms, consumption methods and therapeutic effects are the same. So it is really not about "looking for a patient to eat for a while and see if the patient is cured or not." The effect on patients is answered by another set of studies. The National Medical Insurance Administration organized hospitals to conduct real-world research. By December 2024, it will cover 63 types of centralized medicines, nearly a hundred tertiary hospitals, and more than 300,000 patients. The results are no different from the original drug. For example, with metformin, the glycated hemoglobin compliance rate was 83.4% in the generic group and 78.9% in the original research group. In turn, the fasting blood glucose compliance rate was 83.8% in the generic group and 87.6% in the original research group. The two groups have their own advantages and disadvantages. In January 2025, a doctor publicly stated that centralized medicine collection "does not lower blood pressure, anesthesia does not prevent sleep, and laxatives do not cause diarrhea." The National Medical Insurance and Drug Administration visited seven hospitals in Shanghai and concluded that most of these claims came from reports and personal feelings. The laxative named was not yet used in hospitals at that time. At the same time, he also admitted that he had indeed smoked problematic drugs. Among the first 9 batches of more than 1,600 selected products, 9 were disqualified due to quality risks. Among these 9, 6 are imported drugs (including 3 original drugs) and 3 are domestic drugs. There are two things you can do. First, if you want to continue using the original drug, it is usually still available. Centralized purchasing only accounts for 60% to 80% of hospital purchases, and the rest is determined by the hospital itself. The original drug is not banned, and the cost is to pay more. Second, after changing medicines for chronic diseases, don’t judge based on your feelings. Follow Section 16, Item 3 (mark each indicator on the same book) and keep an eye on blood pressure, blood sugar, and glycation. If it really gets worse, go to the doctor and ask the doctor to report adverse drug reactions. Don't stop taking the medicine yourself.

Case: Hypertensive medicine originally cost 120 yuan per month out of pocket. When prescribing the medicine, I asked if there was a generic name for centralized purchasing. After switching to a generic drug that passed the consistency evaluation, it only cost more than 8 yuan per month. The blood pressure is controlled stably. The medicine box has a different name but the same ingredients, saving more than 1,000 yuan a year.

items.title: Once you bind the family mutual aid on the medical insurance app, the money in your employee medical insurance personal account can be used to treat your spouse, parents, and children for medical treatment and medicine.
items.core: After binding once, the money in your personal employee medical insurance account can be used for medical treatment and medicine for your spouse, parents, and children. If you don't do it, the money can only be used by yourself and will remain in the account.
body: Cost: No money. Go to the medical insurance app in the insured area, or go to the agency to apply for family mutual aid binding.

Income: The money in your personal account can be used to pay for the medical expenses you and your spouse, parents, and children have to pay for medical treatment at designated medical institutions. It can also be used to pay for the money you have to pay when buying medicines, medical equipment, and medical consumables at designated retail pharmacies. The document also proposes to explore the use of personal accounts to pay personal contributions to urban and rural residents’ medical insurance for family members
Level of Evidence: A

Source: General Office of the State Council (2021). Guiding Opinions on Establishing and Improving the Outpatient Mutual Aid Security Mechanism for Employee Basic Medical Insurance (State Council Issued [2021] 14 No.) Item (5): "The personal account is mainly used to pay the out-of-pocket expenses incurred by the insured in designated medical institutions or designated retail pharmacies within the scope of the policy. It can be used to pay the personally borne medical expenses incurred by the insured and his/her spouse, parents, and children in designated medical institutions, as well as the personally borne expenses incurred in purchasing drugs, medical equipment, and medical consumables at designated retail pharmacies. Explore personal accounts for spouses, parents, and children to participate in basic medical care for urban and rural residents. Personal payments for insurance, etc. Personal accounts must not be used for expenditures such as public health expenses, sports fitness or health care consumption that are not covered by basic medical insurance. 》<https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2021-04/22/content_5601280.htm>

Note: Many people have thousands of dollars in their personal accounts, and at the same time, the elderly at home are paying for medicines at their own expense. Once bound, it will be valid for a long time. Most places call it "Family Mutual Aid", which can be done through the local medical insurance app. Pay attention to the opposite red line: personal accounts cannot be used for consumption such as fitness and health care. Using it to buy health products in pharmacies and cash out is considered insurance fraud.

Case: Ms. Wang’s employee medical insurance account has more than 2,000 yuan, and her father has been paying for antihypertensive drugs out of pocket. After she bound her father's information on the medical insurance app, she paid directly with her personal account balance when settling at the pharmacy.

items.title: Drink boiled tap water, do not order bottled water or buy bottled water for drinking fountains all year round
items.core: Bottled water for drinking fountains is calculated at 20 yuan per barrel, which is about 1 yuan per liter, which is more than 200 times more expensive than tap water in Beijing. A bucket of water a week for a family costs over 1,000 yuan a year, and the same amount of tap water costs less than 5 yuan. Tap water has mandatory national standards, and you can usually just boil it and drink it.
body: Cost: Buy a kettle. It takes a while to boil water each time, and there is also a small gas or electricity fee.

Income: The first-tier water price for Beijing residents is 5 yuan per cubic meter, equivalent to 0.005 yuan per liter. The bottled water used in home water dispensers is 18.9 liters per barrel. At 20 yuan per barrel, the price is about 1.06 yuan per liter, which is about 210 times that of tap water. A family drinks one barrel a week, 52 barrels a year, about 983 liters, bottled water costs about 1,040 yuan, and the same amount of tap water costs about 4.9 yuan. Small bottled water costs 1 yuan for 500 ml, which is 2 yuan per liter, which is 400 times that of tap water. Drinking water complies with the mandatory national standard GB 5749-2022. This standard will be released on March 15, 2022, and will come into effect on April 1, 2023. The competent authority is the National Administration of Disease Control and Prevention (China, 2015 Water Prices and 2022 Standards)
Evidence Level: C (Controversial)

Source: Beijing Municipal Development and Reform Commission. Residential Water Price List. <https://fgw.beijing.gov.cn/bmcx/djcx/jzldj/202003/t20200331_1752796.htm>; State Administration for Market Regulation National Standards Full Text Disclosure System. GB 5749-2022 Hygienic Standards for Drinking Water. <https://openstd.samr.gov.cn/bzgk/std/newGbInfo?hcno=99E9C17E3547A3C0CE2FD1FFD9F2F7BE>; Hangzhou Joint Investigation Team (2025). Report on the investigation of abnormal water supply in some residential areas in Yuhang District, Hangzhou (July 23, 2025), reproduced by Xinhuanet <http://www.news.cn/20250723/1be62dac3b0b4461a643791ff552e93d/c.html>; Hangzhou Yuhang District People’s Government. Yuhang District water source water quality monitoring data in April/May/June 2025 (published by Hangzhou Yuhang Water Holding Group, testing unit Hangzhou Jiashu Environmental Monitoring Co., Ltd., attachment PDF Table 1 No. 24 items "fecal coliform") <https://www.yuhang.gov.cn/art/2025/5/8/art_1229204072_59140140.html>, <https://www.yuhang.gov.cn/art/2025/6/5/ art_1229204072_59142885.html>, <https://www.yuhang.gov.cn/art/2025/7/3/art_1229204072_59146464.html>; Cyber Security Bureau of the Ministry of Public Security (2025). Shao Mouhao was criminally detained for fabricating false "police information reports" and rumors of "dung water" <http://www.news.cn/politics/20250722/3178b3bd189c4eb4b293982e92aab438/c.html>; Chongqing Municipal Administration for Market Regulation (2022). Bottled drinking water consumption tips (2022) October 25) <https://scjgj.cq.gov.cn/bkzs/spbk/202210/t20221025_11222964.html>

Note: The controversy is that the so-called "standard compliance" checks the water coming out of the water plant and the water at the end of the pipeline. When there is a problem with the water source or pipe network, it will be temporarily lost. On July 16, 2025, the raw water fed into Renhe Water Plant in Yuhang, Hangzhou smelled wrong, and the tap water in some residential areas in Renhe and Liangzhu stank. The official conclusion is that algae decompose under anaerobic conditions, producing sulfide-like substances. After changing the water source, the total coliforms and Escherichia coli in the factory water were not detected, and all items complied with the drinking water standard GB 5749-2022. After the incident, seven cadres were held accountable. The water bills for July were waived and the filter elements were replaced for free. But the fecal coliform bacteria in the same water source had been increasing for several months before the incident. The water intake of Tiaoxi Yongsheng was 10/L in April, 7,300/L in May, and 16,000/L in June. The surface water standard GB 3838 Class III limit is 10,000 units/L. In the same month, Siling Reservoir’s 28,000 units/L and Mantoushan Reservoir’s 24,000 units/L also exceeded. The following is the author's reminder. The official notification does not say this: boiling can only kill microorganisms, but cannot remove odorous substances or chemicals dissolved in the water. If you smell a strange smell or the water turns yellow and muddy, stop drinking and report it to the water supply company and 12345. If you temporarily switch to bottled water, don't expect to boil it for a few more minutes to overcome it. But this was a local accident, and the local government paid compensation on a case-by-case basis. It still does not constitute a reason to buy bottled water all year round. The "Wrong Sewer Pipe Connection" uploaded online is a fake police report, and the publisher has been criminally detained (see Section 9). Bottled water is 20 yuan per barrel and bottled water is 1 yuan for 500 ml. These are hypothetical prices set for calculation purposes. You can recalculate based on the actual price in your city. Bottled water is not necessarily cleaner: Chongqing Municipal Market Supervision Bureau reminds that the longer it is stored after opening, the higher the risk of microbial contamination. Water dispensers must be washed at least once every 2 to 3 months. If the secondary water supply facilities in old residential areas are not up to standard, you can install filtration, or you can only buy water for drinking under such circumstances. Water prices vary from place to place. The number in Beijing is only used to show the magnitude.

Case: Mr. Li’s family originally ordered a barrel of 20 yuan bottled water every week, which cost more than 1,000 yuan a year. After switching to using an electric kettle to boil tap water, the same amount of water costs less than 5 yuan, and there is no need to move a bucket.

items.title: Do not trade stocks frequently, and do it less often when the market rises and falls sharply.
items.core: American households that bought and sold most frequently in the 1990s only earned 11.4% per year, compared with 17.9% for the entire market during the same period. The difference was mainly due to the cost of buying and selling. During the domestic boom and bust from 2014 to 2015, 85% of households with the smallest accounts traded too frequently. They made 250 billion yuan less than if they had just held on, which is about 30% of their principal.
body: Cost: No money. The hard thing is to want to take action when you see the news. When others are making money and want to follow suit, you have to hold back.

Earnings: This study looked at 66,465 U.S. discount brokerage household accounts from 1991 to 1996. The group that trades most frequently has an annualized return of 11.4%, which means they earn an average of 11.4% per year. During the same period the market as a whole was 17.9% and the average household was 16.4%. The average turnover rate of a family in one year is 75%, and three-quarters of the stocks in their hands are exchanged in one year. The difference in gross income (money earned before handling fees) between the group that trades frequently and the group that trades infrequently is very small. So the gap mainly comes from transaction costs paid when buying and selling (United States, 1991 to 1996). Domestic data: The study uses daily account data from the Shanghai Stock Exchange, covering all approximately 40 million accounts. The sample period is from July 2014 to December 2015, a total of 18 months. In the past 18 months, the Shanghai Composite Index has risen by more than 150%. It peaked at 5166.35 on June 12, 2015, and fell another 40% by the end of December. Household accounts are divided into four levels based on the market value at the beginning of the period. The smallest tranche accounts for 85% of all household accounts and the largest 0.5%. The total market value of stocks at the beginning of the two tranches was almost the same, 880 billion yuan and 808 billion yuan respectively. The result is that the smallest 85% lost 250 billion yuan due to active trading, and the largest 0.5% earned 254 billion yuan. The "loss" here is compared to holding still and doing nothing during the same market period. The two numbers are each equivalent to approximately 30% of the market value of the stocks at the beginning of this group, with the former 28% and the latter 31%. For comparison, the two and a half years before June 2014 were quieter. Taking any 18 months of that period, the comparable difference is only 1% to 3% of the market capitalization at the beginning of the period. During this round of market conditions, household accounts exchanged their stocks every three weeks on average, nearly 18 times a year (Shanghai, China, 2014 to 2015; comparison period 2012 to 2014)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Barber BM, Odean T (2000). Trading Is Hazardous to Your Wealth: The Common Stock Investment Performance of Individual Investors. The Journal of Finance 55(2):773-806. <https://doi.org/10.1111/0022-1082.00226>; An L, Lou D, Shi D (2022). Wealth redistribution in bubbles and crashes. Journal of Monetary Economics 126:134-153. <https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jmoneco.2022.01.001>; Working paper draft published by the author of the same article (October 2021, domestic figures are verified verbatim). <https://personal.lse.ac.uk/loud/AnLouShi.pdf>

Note: The US data is from the 1990s, A The commission and stamp duty structure of stocks are different, but the principle of "the higher the turnover, the lower the return" is the same. This is not to advise you not to buy stocks, nor does the domestic research say so. It calculates that in the same market situation, the more actively families with small accounts trade, the more money flows to the hands of the other party who buys and sells with them. It was not the institutions that made the money, but the individuals with the largest accounts: During this period, about 90% of the trading volume of the Shanghai Stock Exchange came from retail accounts. Table 1 of the paper shows 87% of the daily trading volume. There is no verifiable official statistics for the "90% of retail investors losing money" circulating on the Internet, so this number is not used in this article. The turnover rate can be compared: in this round of market conditions, domestic household accounts have been changed nearly 18 times a year, while those in the United States have only changed three-quarters of their accounts a year. In calm years, the domestic gap is only one to three percent, so the best time to endure is when the market is at its hottest. It does not constitute investment advice.

Case: When the stock market fluctuated violently in 2015, Lao Zhou exchanged shares almost every day, dozens of times in half a year. After deducting commissions and stamp duties, I only made a small profit of 3%, while my colleagues who had been holding it during the same period earned nearly 20%.

items.title: Don’t borrow money to invest, don’t use leverage, and don’t buy things you don’t understand
items.core: Borrow money to buy stocks. Once it falls below the line and you can’t make up the money, you will be forced to sell. The losses on the books turned into real losses on the spot, without even a chance to "wait for them to rise back up." Regulations stipulate that those who have been trading securities for less than half a year and whose average daily assets in the last 20 trading days are less than 500,000 yuan cannot open a financing account. This threshold itself shows that it is not for ordinary people.
body: Cost: No money. The hard thing is that when the market is good, you have to resist thinking about "borrowing more money and making more money."

Profit: Leverage means borrowing money to buy, which will magnify losses. After you use financing to buy, the market value of the collateral may fall below the maintenance guarantee ratio line. This line is drawn by the brokerage, and it governs what you mortgage with it. If it falls below this line and you fail to add additional guarantees to make up for it, your position will be forced to be liquidated and the brokerage will sell it directly for you. The loss on the book turns into a real loss on the spot, and there is no chance of "waiting for it to rise back". Regulatory regulations stipulate that customers who "have been engaged in securities trading for less than half a year, lack risk-taking ability, and have average daily securities assets of less than 500,000 yuan in the last 20 trading days" are not allowed to open a credit account. This threshold itself shows that it is not a tool for ordinary people (China, 2015)
Level of Evidence: B

Source: China Securities Regulatory Commission (2015). Measures for the Administration of Margin and Securities Lending Business of Securities Companies (CSRC Order No. 117, Article 12). <https://www.csrc.gov.cn/csrc/c106256/c1654005/content.shtml>; Shanghai Stock Exchange. Interpretation of the "Shanghai Stock Exchange's Implementation Rules for Margin and Securities Lending Transactions" (Investor Education Materials). <https://www.sse.com.cn/services/tradingservice/margin/edu/c/10074042/files/a1f1c4833302451fb9130dbb94116c56.pdf>

Note: "Don't buy if you don't understand" has no direct literature support and is a consensus. It is counted alone. Class C. Using consumer loans or cashing out credit cards to invest is also a disguised form of leverage. For their interest rates, see Article 7 of this section (no minimum credit card repayments). It does not constitute investment advice.

Case: In 2021, Lao Wang was not satisfied with the profits from stock trading. He opened a financing account and raised 400,000 yuan to fully position securities stocks. Subsequently, the brokerage sector continued to fall, and the account fell below the liquidation line. Lao Wang was unable to replenish the margin and was forced to sell by the brokerage. Not only did he lose all his principal, but he also owed debt, and he did not even have a chance to wait for the stock price to rebound.

items.title: Use broad-based index funds to replace active management funds as long-term bottom positions (the part of money that cannot be held for a long time)
items.core: The pile of stocks purchased by active funds in the United States is already very close to the entire market. But the extra management fee they charge is actually deducted from the income you receive. Comparing fund performance with repeated recalculations of luck, there are very few funds that can earn back the fees they charge by relying on the excess earnings.
body: Cost: No money. The price is that you give up the possibility of "selecting a star fund manager". The difficult thing is that when the index falls, you have to bear it together and cannot run away midway.

Income: The overall portfolio of U.S. active equity funds is close to the market portfolio: the stocks held by these funds together are similar to the entire market. But the high cost of active management remains intact and translates into lower net returns for investors (income after fees). The study used a bootstrap simulation, where performance was repeatedly and randomly rearranged to see how far luck could go alone. The results show that few funds generate excess returns sufficient to cover their costs: the amount of money a fund earns more than the market does not cover the fees it charges (USA, published in 2010). S&P Dow Jones Indices calculates this annually: 65% of U.S. actively managed large-cap stock funds underperformed the S&P 500 in 2024. It measured 24 years, with an average annual underperformance of 64%. No single category outperforms most active funds over the 15 years to end-2024
Level of Evidence: B

Source: Fama EF, French KR (2010). Luck versus Skill in the Cross-Section of Mutual Fund Returns. The Journal of Finance 65(5):1915-1947. <https://doi.org/10.1111/j.1540-6261.2010.01598.x>; S&P Dow Jones Indices (2025). SPIVA U.S. Scorecard Year-End 2024. <https://www.spglobal.com/spdji/en/spiva/article/spiva-us/> (Official website refuses automatic crawling, numbers are Archived check for 2025-05-12: <https://web.archive.org/web/20250512071051/https://www.spglobal.com/spdji/en/spiva/article/spiva-us/>); S&P Dow Jones Indices (2025). SPIVA Asia Ex-Japan Scorecard Mid-Year 2025 (Report 1a, China Large-Cap Underperformed the S&P China A 300 by 60.5% in 1 year, 69.6% in 3 years, and 50.8% in 5 years). <https://web.archive.org/web/20251103165922/https://www.spglobal.com/spdji/en/documents/spiva/spiva-asia-ex-japan-mid-year-2025.pdf> (The official website refuses automatic crawling, check according to the archive); Harvey CR, Liu Y (2022). Luck versus Skill in the Cross Section of Mutual Fund Returns: Reexamining the Evidence. The Journal of Finance, 77(3). <https://doi.org/10.1111/jofi.13123> (disputing party)

Note: Dispute: There is an article that re-examines this conclusion. It pointed out that the Fama-French method of repeated resampling did not draw enough samples. According to its algorithm, even if a fund's extra profit is indeed obvious, it may be judged as "indistinguishable from luck." Therefore, the conclusion that "almost no funds have skills" may be too harsh. China’s numbers are less lopsided than those of the United States. According to S&P Dow Jones statistics as of June 2025, the proportion of A-share large-cap active funds underperforming the S&P China A-share 300 Index is 60.5% in 1 year, 69.6% in 3 years, and 50.8% in 5 years. This statistics only covers 5 years, and no longer figures can be obtained. Therefore, in China, it has not yet been determined whether active funds can outperform the index in the long term, but the low fee rate of index funds still holds true. It does not constitute investment advice.

Case: Lao Zhang has invested in two actively managed funds since 2015. In the past ten years, one has suffered losses and the other has made meager profits, but the management fees have still been collected. During the same period, the CSI 300 broad-based index fund he later allocated had good returns and extremely low fees. He regretted it and replaced all active funds with broad-based funds as a long-term position.

items.title: Prefer similar funds with low fee rates
items.core: For every 1 percentage point increase in the one-year fee rate, the money received will be about 18% less after 20 years and about 26% less after 30 years. If you choose a fund with a low fee within the same type of fund, fewer people will be eaten up by the fee.
body: Cost: No money. Before buying, take a closer look at how much the three items of "management fee + hosting fee + sales service fee" add up.

Income: The difference in interest rates will eat up the principal little by little according to compound interest, which means that the little bit deducted every year will be added up year by year. A 1 percentage point higher rate in one year is about 18.2% less (1 − 0.99^20 ≈ 0.182) in the terminal value after 20 years and about 26% less after 30 years. The future value is the money left in the account at that time. China will implement public fund fee rate reforms starting in 2023, lowering the fee ceiling for active equity funds (the kind that mainly buy stocks and have fund managers pick stocks). From July 7, 2023, the management fee for newly registered funds of this type will not exceed 1.2%, and the custody fee will not exceed 0.2%. 136 fund companies have also lowered these two items of their old products below this line
Evidence level: C

Source: China Securities Regulatory Commission (2023). The head of the relevant department of the China Securities Regulatory Commission answered reporters’ questions on the reform of public fund fee rates. <http://www.csrc.gov.cn/csrc/c100028/c7418692/content.shtml>; Xiamen Securities Regulatory Bureau (2024). "Newly registered active equity funds shall uniformly implement the upper limit standard of "the management fee rate shall not exceed 1.2% and the custody fee shall not exceed 0.2%". <http://www.csrc.gov.cn/xiamen/c105636/c7511608/content.shtml>; Fama EF, French KR (2010). See Article 17 (Broad-based Index Fund). <https://doi.org/10.1111/j.1540-6261.2010.01598.x>

Note: This calculation is only calculated according to the formula, provided that the two funds earn the same amount before deductions. In fact, subscription fees, redemption fees, and sales and service fees for Class C shares are also included. It does not constitute investment advice.

Case: Two investors each bought 100,000 yuan of the same type of CSI 300 index fund. The management fee for option A is 0.15%, and for option B is 1.2%, the income is calculated at 8%. After 20 years, Party A's account will be about 466,000 yuan, and Party B's account will be only about 376,000 yuan. Party B's overpayment will reduce the income by nearly 20%.

items.title: Don’t bet your money on one stock, one platform, or one house
items.core: As long as several things don’t rise and fall at the same time, and spread the money separately, the average earnings will remain the same, but the fluctuations in the account will be smaller. On the other hand, if your money is all invested in a stock, a platform, or a house, if something happens to it, it means everything will happen to you.
body: Cost: No money. The hard thing is to accept that you won't just hit the most profitable bet.

Income: As long as several assets do not rise and fall at the same time, the expected income (the average amount earned) will remain the same and the fluctuations (account ups and downs) will be smaller if the money is spread out. This is the basic conclusion of portfolio selection proposed by Markowitz in 1952 and has been used for decades since. On the other hand, if all your money is invested in a stock or a platform, its variance is your total variance. You will rise or fall as much as it rises or falls. There is no hedging, and no other assets can help you make up for it when something goes wrong
Level of Evidence: B
Source: Markowitz, H. (1952). Portfolio Selection. The Journal of Finance, 7(1), 77–91. <https://doi.org/10.1111/j.1540-6261.1952.tb01525.x>

Remarks: Set to B Level, because that classic document is a purely mathematical derivation and does not calculate the actual number of "how much less money can be lost by diversification." Diversification can only make the rise and fall of the account smaller, but it does not guarantee that you will not lose money. Buying broad-based index funds (see No. 17 of this section) is itself a hassle-free method of diversification. It does not constitute investment advice.

Case: Xiao Li used all his savings of 500,000 yuan to buy a chemical stock, lent another 100,000 yuan to a friend to do business, and also bought a house in his hometown for the full amount. Later, the chemical stocks were cut in half, his friend's business failed and he lost contact, and the house price dropped and it was difficult to sell. Problems occurred in the three places almost at the same time. He was instantly in debt and his life was in trouble.

items.title: Before opening a personal pension account, calculate the tax savings and check the conditions for receiving it; for those who do not pay personal income tax or whose tax rate is only 3%, don’t just pay for the tax deduction
items.core: If you save 12,000 yuan and the whole amount is in the same tax bracket, the 10%, 20%, and 30% brackets will save a net of 840, 2,040, and 3,240 yuan. This has deducted the 3% tax paid when receiving the money, and those who cross different brackets will have to be recalculated. People in the 3% bracket will pay back the money they save in taxes, which will be even at most. Don't save money that you need at any time. Early withdrawal is limited to medical treatment, unemployment, subsistence allowance and other prescribed situations.
body: Cost: There is no cost to open an account, and the money paid cannot be withdrawn at any time. In addition to reaching the basic pension age, people who meet the prescribed medical expenses, unemployment, subsistence allowance and other conditions can also receive it. Please see the notes for specific thresholds. When conditions are not sufficient, you may still have to wait many years.

Income: The money paid in, up to 12,000 yuan per year, can be deducted from comprehensive income or operating income. The investment income in the account is not subject to personal income tax for the time being. When it is received, it is not included in the comprehensive income and is taxed separately at 3%. The tax saved in the current year is calculated by subtracting the annual tax amount after deduction from the annual tax amount before deduction. Deductions may cross into lower tax brackets, and the current marginal tax rate cannot always be multiplied by the payment amount. The marginal tax rate is the tax rate for each additional dollar earned. For example, after all other deductions have been calculated and the taxable income for the whole year before contributions are paid, the taxable income is 40,000 yuan and the tax payable is 1,480 yuan. After paying and deducting 12,000 yuan, the taxable income becomes 28,000 yuan, and the tax amount is 840 yuan, which means that the tax amount is 640 yuan less for the year. Assuming that investment income and time value are not included, a tax of 360 yuan will be paid on receiving the principal of 12,000 yuan in the future, resulting in a net tax difference of 280 yuan. If the full amount of 12,000 yuan is paid, and the entire deduction is within the same tax bracket, only that tax rate can be used to calculate the tax savings for the year. Taking into account only the principal and excluding investment income and time value, the net tax differences for the 10%, 20%, and 30% tax brackets are 840, 2,040, and 3,240 yuan respectively. These are tax differences that occur at different times and cannot be regarded as investment return rates, let alone annualized returns directly divided by the number of years. People who did not pay personal income tax originally had no tax savings in the current period and still have to pay 3% when they receive it. For those who were originally only eligible for the 3% tax bracket, the current tax savings will not exceed 3% of the payment amount. The annual comprehensive income after deducting various items does not exceed 36,000 yuan, which falls into this bracket. When only the principal is counted and the time value is not taken into account, the tax savings will not exceed the tax on receiving the principal in the future, so it cannot be said to be a good deal just based on the tax deduction. A tax is deducted from the monthly salary, which does not mean that it is at the 10% level for the whole year. The annual payment limit is accumulated based on the calendar year, and the unused limit cannot be carried forward. The personal pension system will be implemented nationwide from December 15, 2024. From September 1, 2025, those who meet the prescribed medical expenses, unemployment benefits, and subsistence allowance conditions can also receive them in advance. It cannot be withdrawn at any time when the conditions for receiving it are not met, and it is not suitable for saving emergency funds that may be used at any time (nationwide).
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Ministry of Finance and State Administration of Taxation (2024). Announcement on the nationwide implementation of preferential personal income tax policies for personal pensions (Ministry of Finance and State Administration of Taxation Announcement 2024 No. 21, December 12, 2024). <https://fgk.chinatax.gov.cn/zcfgk/c102416/c5237110/content.html>; five departments including the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security (2022). Implementation Measures for Personal Pensions (Articles 7, 8, 9, 12, and 13). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2022-11/05/content_5724783.htm>; Standing Committee of the National People’s Congress (2018). Personal Income Tax Law of the People’s Republic of China (Seventh Amendment in 2018, Table 1 of Personal Income Tax Rates). <http://www.npc.gov.cn/zgrdw/npc/xinwen/2018-09/05/content_2060671.htm>; Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security and five other departments (2025). Notice on issues related to receiving personal pensions (Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security [2025] No. 39, items 1, 2, 3, and 7). <https://fgk.chinatax.gov.cn/zcfgk/c100013/c5242402/content.html>

Note: There are currently six conditions for receiving basic pension: reaching the age of receiving basic pension, completely losing the ability to work, settling abroad (border), and the following three. Medical expenses are based on the out-of-pocket expenses of the person, spouse, and minor children in the 12 months before application, after deducting medical insurance reimbursements. Only when the cumulative per capita disposable income of residents in the province exceeds the previous year is it eligible. Unemployment depends on whether you have received unemployment insurance benefits for a total of 12 months within the 2 years before applying. Dibao requires people to be receiving urban and rural minimum living allowances. If you meet any of the conditions, you can apply for verification from the bank where you opened your account, the National Social Security Service Platform and other channels. The funds for purchased products must also be handled according to product regulations. Don’t save an emergency fund (see No. 27 for emergency funds). Whether it is worth paying depends on how long the funds will be used, product benefits, expenses and risks. You cannot make a conclusion based on the tax savings alone. You have to choose the products to invest the money in your account, and you will lose money on some products. For product selection, please refer to Articles 17 and 18 of this section (broad-based index funds, those with low fees are preferred). The deduction voucher is issued by the personal pension information management service platform. Income such as wages and salaries that are subject to the cumulative withholding method can be withheld in the current year or deducted in the next year's settlement. Other income shall be deducted in the next year's calculation according to regulations (see Article 2 for calculation).

Case: Xiao Chen’s monthly salary was less than 5,000 and he did not pay personal tax. His colleagues persuaded him to open a personal pension account to deduct the tax. He calculated and found that his tax rate was 3%. If he saved 12,000, he would save 360 ​​yuan, but paying 3% when receiving it was enough to offset it, so he did not pay for the tax deduction. Another colleague calculated the net savings of 2040 at the 20% rate and opened an account.

items.title: The gym pays on a pay-per-use or short-term basis, unless there is a stable record for more than one year
items.core: In the three-year data in the United States, members who choose a contract with a monthly fee of more than US$70 only go 4.3 times a month on average, which is equivalent to more than US$17 each time. And buy the card 10 times for just $10 each time. These people paid an average of $600 more over the course of their membership. Unless you have a stable record of going for more than a year, it is more cost-effective to buy per transaction or buy short-term.
body: Cost: Buy per time, the single price is more expensive than the annual card. You have to honestly estimate how many times you will go there in a month.

Benefits: This study looked at 3 years of data from 7,752 members at 3 health clubs in the United States. Members who choose a contract with a monthly fee of more than US$70 only visit 4.3 times a month on average, which is equivalent to more than US$17 each time. And a 10-pass card is only $10 each. These people paid an average of $600 more over the course of their membership. In addition, the proportion of monthly paying members who have not returned their cards for more than one year is 17% higher than that of annual paying members (U.S., three-year panel data)
Level of Evidence: B
Source: DellaVigna S, Malmendier U (2006). Paying Not to Go to the Gym. American Economic Review 96(3):694-719. <https://doi.org/10.1257/aer.96.3.694>

Note: This is just one study, using U.S. data. But the reason behind it is very common: people overestimate their future self-control. If you have a record of going more than twice a week for a year, then the annual card is indeed cheaper.

Case: Xiao Wang applied for a fitness card with an annual fee of 1,800 yuan. He went there 10 times in the first two months. After that, he was busy with work and stopped going. He only went 15 times in the whole year, with a cost of 120 yuan each time. However, a colleague bought a 10-time card for only 100 yuan. Xiao Wang regretted it so much that he decided to buy a short-term card the next year and forced himself to go three times a week.

items.title: To pay an advance payment, you must sign a written contract; if the merchant encounters a risk, the payment will be stopped, and you have the right to claim back the unspent balance before running away
items.core: The merchant who accepts your advance payment must sign a written contract with you and specify how to refund it. If a business encounters a serious problem, it should stop collecting money. If it wants to close down or move out, it should tell you in advance. At this time, you can ask it to continue to provide services, or refund the unspent balance to you. Merchants who violate these regulations can be fined.
body: Cost: No money. The difficulty is to insist on a written contract on the spot and not accept "charge first and then talk about it".

Income: Regulations stipulate that merchants who receive advance payments must enter into a written contract and agree on the method of refund in the contract. If a merchant encounters major business risks, it should stop collecting advance payments. If a merchant decides to close down or relocate, it should notify consumers in advance. Consumers have the right to request that it continue to perform or refund the unused balance. Violators may be fined 1 to 10 times the illegal gains; if there are no illegal gains, a fine of not more than 500,000 yuan may be imposed
Level of Evidence: A

Source: State Council (2024). Regulations for the Implementation of the Consumer Rights Protection Law of the People's Republic of China (State Council Order No. 778, effective on July 1, 2024). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202403/content_6940159.htm> Article 22: "If an operator provides goods or services by collecting advance payments, it shall enter into a written contract with consumers to stipulate the specific content of the goods or services, price or fee, advance payment refund method, liability for breach of contract, etc." "If the operator fails to provide goods or services as agreed, it shall fulfill the agreement or refund the advance payment in accordance with the requirements of the consumer." "If an operator encounters major business risks that may affect the operator's normal provision of goods or services in accordance with the contract or trading practices, it shall stop collecting advance payments. The operator decides to suspend business or relocate. For service establishments, consumers shall be notified in advance...Consumers...have the right to require operators to continue to perform their obligations to provide goods or services, or to request the return of unconsumed advance payment balances." Paragraph 2 of Article 50: "If an operator violates the provisions of Article 22 of these Regulations, the relevant administrative authority shall be responsible. The department orders correction, and may issue a warning, confiscate the illegal income, or impose a fine of not less than 1 time but not more than 10 times the illegal income, depending on the circumstances. If there is no illegal income, a fine of not more than 500,000 yuan may be imposed.”

Note: The regulations provide a basis for litigation after the fact and cannot be prevented beforehand. If the merchant really runs away, the money is probably no longer in the account. So first charge less according to Article 21 of this section (gym pay-per-use or short-cycle payment), and then rely on this regulation to protect your rights if something goes wrong. Article 27 of the same regulation also stipulates that merchants collecting deposits must agree in advance on the method, procedure and time limit for refund, and must not set unreasonable conditions for refund.

Case: Ms. Liu paid a total of 5,000 yuan in personal training fees for two years at the gym in front of the community. She only signed a receipt but not a contract. Three months later, the gym suddenly closed its doors and ran away. Due to the lack of a written refund agreement, she had difficulty proving the specific terms even though she had payment records, so in the end she only recovered a small part of the money.

items.title: There is a 24-hour cooling-off period for large non-essential purchases, and take advantage of seven-day no-questions-asked returns when shopping online
items.core: What you save are those things you don’t want the next day. For items purchased online, you can return them without reason within seven days from the day you receive the goods. There are several categories that cannot be returned: items customized to your requirements, fresh and perishable items, digital items that have been opened, and newspapers and periodicals.
body: Cost: No money. What you want will be available a day later. You usually have to pay for the return shipping costs yourself. The hard thing is not to place an order that day.

Income: What you save is the part of the impulse purchase that you “won’t want the next day”. It is impossible to give a uniform proportion as to how much this part accounts for. Products purchased online can be returned without reason within seven days from the day of receipt. There are four exceptions: customized, fresh and perishable, opened digital goods, newspapers and periodicals (China, effective from 2017)
Evidence level: C

Source: State Administration for Market Regulation (revised in 2020). Interim Measures for Seven-Day Returns of Goods Purchased Online without Reason (SAMR Order No. 31). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2020-11/03/content_5557118.htm>

Note: The "cooling off period" itself is an empirical practice and has no direct literature support. If the cooling-off period is not stopped, there is also a seven-day no-reason return system available. Before returning the product, confirm two things: whether the product is on the non-returnable list and whether the packaging is intact.

Case: Xiao Li placed an order for a 3,000 yuan coffee machine during a late-night live broadcast. After calming down the next day, he found that there was insufficient space at home and the frequency of use was extremely low. On the seventh day after receiving the goods, he applied for a seven-day no-reason return, and the full amount was successfully refunded, saving this impulse purchase.

items.title: Don’t stock up on “crossed prices” and big sales
items.core: When people judge whether something is expensive or not, they will be fixed on the first number they see. Adjusting it later is usually not enough. So "originally priced at 999, now priced at 499" will make you systematically overestimate how cheap it is. According to regulations, the basis for discounts is only the lowest transaction price in the seven days before the store's promotion. The crossed-out price may not have actually been sold.
body: Cost: No money. The price is that you also let go of some real discounts. You have to remember the daily prices of the items you often buy. The hard thing is not to stock up on the day of the big sale.

Income: People's judgment will be fixed by the first number they see, and adjustments later are usually not enough. So "original price is 999, current price is 499" will systematically increase your estimate of "how much cheaper". Regulatory regulations stipulate that the basis for discounts should be the lowest transaction price in the same store within seven days before the promotion. To determine how much discount to apply, the lowest price actually sold in the store in the seven days before the promotion should be used as a reference. The crossed-out price may not have actually been sold (China, effective from 2020)
Evidence level: C

Source: Tversky A, Kahneman D (1974). Judgment under Uncertainty: Heuristics and Biases. Science 185(4157):1124-1131. <https://doi.org/10.1126/science.185.4157.1124>; State Administration for Market Regulation (2020). Interim Provisions on Regulating Promotional Behaviors (General Administration Order No. 32, Article 21). <https://www.samr.gov.cn/zw/zfxxgk/fdzdgknr/fgs/art/2023/art_cae53a080be2401e8f91c6d6291539f8.html>

Note: The anchoring effect is a conclusion drawn in the laboratory. No one has calculated how much money is actually lost by hoarding goods. There are several costs of stocking up that you won’t keep in your account: things expire, they take up space, and “you have them at home anyway, so use more of them.” Only stock up on things that satisfy these three conditions: they have a long shelf life, they will definitely be used up, and the unit price is indeed lower than before.

Case: Aunt Wang saw a brand of oatmeal at a big sale with an original price of 199 yuan and a current price of 99 yuan. She thought it was a 50% discount and bought ten boxes. After checking the price history, she found that the lowest transaction price in the seven days before the store's promotion was 99 yuan. The crossed-out price had never been sold. She actually didn't save money, and she even threw away half of the goods after they were overstocked.

items.title: Insurance gives priority to consumption-based insurance, and treats "returns" and "dividends" as non-guaranteed parts
items.core: The insurance company does not guarantee that the dividends and refunds will be given to you. The instructions must state in bold words "Future policy dividends are non-guaranteed benefits". The extra premium you pay to return the premium is equivalent to giving it to the insurance company to save it for you. The income is not guaranteed and it is not easy to withdraw it.
body: Cost: If consumer insurance does not return the money when it expires, you will feel like "the money was wasted." You have to make arrangements for saving money yourself. The hard part is accepting that you won’t get the money back.

Income: Regulatory rules require that the instructions for participating products must use bold font to indicate that "future policy dividends are non-guaranteed benefits, and their dividend distribution is uncertain." The dividend demonstration is the dividend calculation table shown to you by the insurance company. Its upper limit of interest rate spread is 4.5% minus the predetermined interest rate of the product. The predetermined interest rate is the rate of return fixed in the contract. The extra premium paid for the refund type and dividend type is equivalent to the savings handed over to the insurance company. Its returns are not guaranteed, its liquidity is poor, and it is not easy to withdraw it (China, effective from 2023)
Evidence level: C

Source: China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission (2022). Information disclosure rules for personal insurance products with a term of more than one year (Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission [2022] No. 24). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2023-01/04/content_5735014.htm>

Note: Controversy: For people who cannot save money at all, refundable insurance forces you to pay money on time, which has practical value. The above suggestions are for ordinary people who can control themselves. How much better "buying a consumer model and investing the saved premiums" is better than "buying a return model" depends on the specific product. There is no systematic data that can be quoted in this section. It does not constitute investment advice.

Case: Mr. Chen bought a "dividend return type" critical illness insurance and paid 8,000 yuan per year. The agent promised to return the capital and dividends when he retires. Twenty years later, he found that the cash value plus dividends over the years was far lower than the premiums paid, the income was extremely low, and the surrender loss was large. The prospectus had already stated in bold that "dividends are non-guaranteed benefits."

items.title: Buy enough of the three insurances: The limit of compulsory traffic insurance is uniform across the country and is not high, and the excess will be paid out of your own home
items.core: When you are responsible, compulsory traffic insurance will pay up to three items: death and disability of 180,000 yuan, medical expenses of 18,000 yuan, and property damage of 2,000 yuan. The three items are counted separately and cannot be misappropriated from each other. The compensation for injury to someone may exceed these limits, and you will have to pay the excess money out of your own pocket, so you must buy enough commercial three-party insurance.
body: Cost: Commercial third party liability insurance ranges from several hundred to thousands of dollars per year. The higher the insured amount is, the cheaper the premium will be spread out per dollar of insured amount.

Income: Compulsory traffic insurance implements a unified liability limit nationwide. The limit is divided into four calculations: death and disability, medical expenses, property damage, and compensation if you are not responsible. After the comprehensive reform of auto insurance in 2020, the current total liability limit is 200,000 yuan. Of the 200,000 yuan, death and disability costs were 180,000 yuan, medical expenses were 18,000 yuan, and property losses were 2,000 yuan. When you are not responsible, death and disability are 18,000 yuan, medical expenses are 1,800 yuan, and property losses are 100 yuan. The amount that exceeds the limit will be borne by the infringer, and the party who hit the person will have to pay out of his own pocket. If compulsory insurance is not paid, the vehicle will be impounded and a fine of 2 times the insurance premium payable
Level of Evidence: A

Source: State Council (2006, revised in 2012). Regulations on Compulsory Motor Vehicle Traffic Accident Liability Insurance (State Council Decree No. 462, No. 618 Order Amendment) Article 23: "Compulsory motor vehicle traffic accident liability insurance implements unified liability limits nationwide. The liability limits are divided into death and disability compensation limits, medical expense compensation limits, property damage compensation limits and the compensation limit for the insured who is not responsible for road traffic accidents." "Liability limits. It shall be stipulated by the China Insurance Regulatory Commission in conjunction with the public security department of the State Council, the health administrative department of the State Council, and the agricultural administrative department of the State Council. "Article 21 Compensation within the limit; Article 39 If the vehicle is not insured, "the traffic management department of the public security organ shall detain the motor vehicle... and impose a fine of twice the insurance premium payable in accordance with the minimum liability limit for insurance." <http://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2012/content_2131962.htm>; China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission (2020). Guiding Opinions on Implementing Comprehensive Reform of Auto Insurance (Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission [2020] 41 No. 4 (4): "Increase the total liability limit of compulsory traffic insurance from 122,000 yuan to 200,000 yuan, of which the death and disability compensation limit is increased from 110,000 yuan to 180,000 yuan, the medical expense compensation limit is increased from 10,000 yuan to 18,000 yuan, and the property damage compensation limit remains unchanged at 2,000 yuan"). <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2020/content_5567758.htm> (Official Gazette of the State Council)

Note: The limit is set by the financial regulatory department and will be adjusted. This set of figures is the current value after the comprehensive reform of auto insurance in September 2020. You can check it again before buying insurance. The key is its structure: Compulsory traffic insurance pays separately according to items. If one item is not fully compensated, the remaining amount cannot be transferred to make up for another item. The total amount of compensation for an injury can far exceed that, and no insurance will cover the difference for you. How much insurance coverage should be purchased for the third party insurance? This book does not give figures. But it is one of the few places in this book where "spend a few hundred dollars more to replace something that has a very small chance of actually crushing a family."

Case: Mr. Zhang accidentally hit a pedestrian while driving, and the other party claimed a total of 400,000 yuan for hospital surgery expenses, lost work expenses, etc. The medical limit of the compulsory traffic insurance is only 18,000 yuan and the disability limit is 180,000 yuan. He only bought 500,000 yuan of the three insurances, which was enough to pay the compensation. If you only buy compulsory traffic insurance, the excess of more than 200,000 yuan will need to be paid from your own savings, and your family's finances will be severely damaged.

items.title: Save 3 to 6 months of living expenses in an emergency fund first, and put it in a place that can be accessed at any time
items.core: Put 3 to 6 months of living expenses in a place that can be accessed at any time. In this way, when you lose your job or get sick, you don't have to borrow high-interest money such as minimum credit card payments, and you don't have to sell your investments at a loss. Money deposited in the bank is covered by deposit insurance, and the same bank will pay up to 500,000 yuan.
body: Cost: No money. The price is that this money has to give up higher returns and can only be placed in current funds, monetary funds, or deposits that can be withdrawn at any time. The hard part is not being able to move it while saving.

Benefits: With an emergency fund, you don’t have to borrow money when you lose your job or get sick, and you don’t have to sell investments at a loss. For interest rates calculated annually for consumer loans and credit card minimum payments, see Article 7 of this section (without credit card minimum payments). Money deposited in banks is protected by deposit insurance, with the same bank reimbursing up to 500,000 yuan (China, 2015)
Evidence level: C

Source: State Council (2015). Deposit Insurance Regulations (State Council Order No. 660, Article 5). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/content/2015-03/31/content_9562.htm>; People's Bank of China, State Financial Supervision and Administration Bureau, China Securities Regulatory Commission (2025). Measures for the Management of Customer Due Diligence and the Preservation of Customer Identity Information and Transaction Records of Financial Institutions (Order [2025] No. 11, Articles 7, 28, and 52, effective from January 1, 2026). <https://www.pbc.gov.cn/tiaofasi/144941/144957/5916164/index.html>; Office of the Financial Commission of Shanghai Municipal Committee of the Communist Party of China (2025-12-01). The central bank and three other departments issued new regulations. Banks no longer require a "one-size-fits-all" inquiry when withdrawing money: "The document deletes the requirement to register the source of funds for personal deposits and withdrawals of cash exceeding 50,000 yuan." <https://jrj.sh.gov.cn/ZXYW178/20251201/1da352ee5150414b8db1ce248f4e37c6.html>

Remarks: "3 to 6 months" is a common experience. No official or academic original source has been found, so it is marked as C level. The amount is calculated based on your own fixed monthly expenses, not based on income. In the new anti-money laundering measures that will be implemented on January 1, 2026, there is no longer a provision that "individual cash deposits and withdrawals exceeding 50,000 yuan need to register the source of funds."
