The new method requires banks to understand the source and use of funds when the risk of money laundering is high, instead of asking everyone one-size-fits-all. Even if banks want to restrict transactions, they must also protect basic and necessary financial services such as medical care and social security. You can pay your medical expenses by direct transfer or credit card without withdrawing cash first. It does not constitute investment advice.

Case: Xiao Zhou’s monthly salary is 8,000 yuan. He deposits 4,000 yuan into a current deposit every month, and saves an emergency fund of 24,000 yuan in half a year. The company laid off employees at the end of the year, and he relied on the money to cover three months of rent and living expenses. During this period, he did not need to use credit cards to withdraw cash, nor did he sell off losing funds, so he spent the window smoothly.

items.title: Before you pay off your mortgage loan early, do a comparison question. Don’t rely on your feelings
items.core: Paying off your mortgage loan early is equal to earning your mortgage interest rate steadily. So I just want to ask one thing: Can you get stable long-term after-tax income that is higher than the mortgage interest rate? If it is high, don’t be in a hurry to pay it back. If it is not high or you are unsure, just pay it back. The interest in the first few years of equal principal and interest accounts for more. The earlier you pay off, the more you will save. The "early repayment trial calculation" on the bank app can directly calculate the figures.
body: Cost: No money. Spend half an hour doing the math. You need to honestly estimate the stable rate of return you can get after tax is deducted.

Earnings: This is the algorithm. First, let the annual interest rate of the mortgage be r, according to your contract. The LPR for 5 years or more on August 20, 2026 is 3.5%, and the actual interest rate is to add or subtract points from the LPR. Let g be the annualized return after tax of another investment you can choose: the proportion of money you can earn every year on average if you invest it elsewhere. The certain rate of return for early repayment is r. Every time you repay an amount, you will earn r steadily. If g is steadily greater than r, it is better to keep the money in investments. If g is less than r, or if g is not known at all, then repaying it early is equivalent to locking in a risk-free amount of r. Of the money you paid back in the first few years with equal principal and interest, interest accounts for the most, so the earlier you pay off the loan, the more interest you save. Use the "Early Repayment Trial Calculation" of the bank app to directly look at the numbers (China, 2026 interest rate)
Evidence level: C

Source: National Interbank Funding Center is authorized by the People's Bank of China (2026). Announcement of the Loan Prime Rate (LPR) on August 20, 2026. <https://www.chinamoney.com.cn/chinese/rdgz/20260820/3399885.html>

Note: Only the algorithm is given here, no conclusion is drawn. There are only a few cases where investment income can stably exceed the mortgage interest rate. But no matter which side you choose, be sure to set aside enough emergency cash first. Also, pay attention to whether there is any early repayment penalty clause in the contract. Before repaying the loan, you can talk to the bank about lowering the interest rate. See Section 15, Article 15 (Negotiating an Interest Rate Lowering). It does not constitute investment advice.

Case: Xiao Chen’s mortgage interest rate is 5.2%, and he has 200,000 spare cash in hand. He originally wanted to repay the loan in advance, but after calculation, he found that the after-tax return of his low-risk financial management was only 3.5%, which could not beat the mortgage interest rate. So he repaid the loan in advance, and a trial calculation using a bank app showed that he could save about 80,000 yuan in future interest, and earn nearly 30,000 yuan more than with financial management.

items.title: When shopping online, follow the rules and regulations of the platform, but not the anchors and "good reviews"
items.core: If the merchant cheats you, you will be compensated three times the price you paid, and if the price is less than 500 yuan, it will be calculated as 500 yuan. The platform clearly knows that the seller is infringing the copyright but does not care about it, so it must pay compensation along with it. The deposit is subject to a maximum of 20% of the contract amount. If you breach the contract, the deposit will not be refunded. If the seller breaches the contract, you will be refunded double the amount. You must be held accountable for fake orders and positive reviews in the live broadcast room, and big data manipulation is expressly prohibited.
body: Cost: No money. Before placing an order, take a closer look at the after-sales terms and deposit rules. After receiving the goods, keep the order, live broadcast playback screenshots and chat records. The hard thing is not to be carried away by the atmosphere of the host.

Income: If the operator commits fraud, the compensation shall be three times the price. If the amount is less than 500 yuan, the compensation shall be 500 yuan. If the platform knows or should know that the seller infringes but does not deal with it, it will be jointly and severally liable. You can ask the platform directly for this compensation. Live broadcast rooms and anchors are not allowed to fabricate transactions, follow, browse, and like traffic, nor are they allowed to publish false information. Those who cause damage will bear civil liability. Those who organize false transactions and false evaluations to help others gain publicity will be fined up to 1 million yuan; in serious cases, they will be fined 1 million to 2 million yuan, and their licenses may also be revoked. The deposit shall not exceed 20% of the contract amount. If you don't fulfill the contract, the deposit will not be refunded; if the seller doesn't fulfill the contract, double the amount will be returned to you. Those who use personal information to make automated decisions must not engage in unreasonable differential treatment in terms of transaction prices and other conditions. This is commonly known as big data killing (national)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress Standing Committee (2013 revision). Consumer Rights Protection Law (Articles 44 and 55). <https://www.samr.gov.cn/zfjcj/tzgg/art/2023/art_615af9ed6bcd4974bf853dd2e02bc663.html> (Reprinted by the State Administration for Market Regulation); Seven departments including the Cyberspace Administration of China (2021). Online Live Marketing Management Measures (Trial) (Articles 18 and 28). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2021-04/23/content_5601682.htm>; National People’s Congress Standing Committee (2025 revision). Anti-Unfair Competition Law (Articles 9 and 25). <https://www.ssf.gov.cn/portal/rootfiles/2025/09/01/1758444945285569-1758444945303119.pdf> (Reprinted by the National Council for Social Security Fund); National People’s Congress (2020). Civil Code (Articles 586 and 587). <https://www.court.gov.cn/zixun/xiangqing/233181.html>; National People’s Congress Standing Committee (2021). Personal Information Protection Law (Article 24). <https://www.stats.gov.cn/gk/tjfg/xgfxfg/202503/t20250310_1958923.html> (Reprinted by the National Bureau of Statistics); Shandong Provincial Bureau of Market Regulation (2025). Six typical cases of unfair competition on the Internet. <https://www.samr.gov.cn/jjj/fbzdjz/art/2025/art_cbaed1c006584baeb6823a6b01325ba4.html>

Remarks: There is no official comparative data that can be quoted on the matter of "Which platform has the highest cost performance and is not easy to buy inferior products", so this book does not rank the platforms. Only the overall spot inspection results can be found (see Article 32, Check the National Spot Inspection Notification). After the Anti-Unfair Competition Law was revised in 2025, false propaganda was changed from the old Article 8 to Article 9. The penalty was changed from Article 20 to Article 25. The new law will come into effect on October 15, 2025. When writing materials, do not copy old receipt numbers. Among the cases in Shandong, one company organized a "brusher" to make 75 false transactions with a principal of more than 680,000 yuan. It was investigated and punished, and the fine figures were not included in the notification. For seven-day no-questions-asked returns, see Article 23 of this section (make good use of seven-day no-questions-asked returns when shopping online).

Case: Ms. Wang spent 180 yuan in the live broadcast room to buy a necklace that was claimed to be pure gold. After receiving it, it was tested to be gold plated. She saved the live broadcast recording and order, and based on the fraudulent claim, she refunded one and compensated three. Because three times was less than 500 yuan, she was finally compensated 500 yuan.

items.title: If there is something wrong with something you bought in the live broadcast room, you must first ask the platform for the information of the seller and the person who brought the goods. The platform must give
items.core: If there is something wrong with the thing you bought in the live broadcast room, the most common problem is that you can't find who to sue. At this time, you can directly request the platform to provide information about the live broadcast room operator and delivery person, as well as relevant business records. The platform must be given.
body: Cost: No money. Just make a request to the platform.

Income: When a consumer dispute occurs, the operator of the live broadcast marketing platform should provide relevant information about the live broadcast room operator and live broadcast marketers, as well as relevant business activity records, in accordance with the requirements of the consumer. The most common difficulty in live broadcast rights protection is that you can’t find who to sue. Once you get this information, you will know who to sue
Level of Evidence: A

Source: State Council (2024). Regulations for the Implementation of the Consumer Rights Protection Law of the People’s Republic of China (State Council Order No. 778, effective on July 1, 2024). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202403/content_6940159.htm>: "Operators who provide goods or services through online live broadcasting or other methods shall perform obligations related to the protection of consumer rights and interests in accordance with the law. Live broadcast marketing platform operators shall establish and improve consumer rights protection systems and clarify consumer dispute resolution mechanisms. In the event of consumer disputes, the live broadcast business shall Sales platform operators should provide necessary information such as information about live broadcast room operators and live broadcast marketers as well as relevant business activity records according to consumer requirements. ""If the live broadcast content released by live broadcast room operators and live broadcast marketers constitutes commercial advertising, they shall perform the obligations of advertising publishers, advertising operators or advertising spokespersons in accordance with the relevant provisions of the Advertising Law of the People's Republic of China."

Note: Record the live broadcast screen and the host's commitment before placing an order. If there is a problem, first ask the platform for the information of the seller and the person who brought the goods, and then decide whether to complain or sue. The same ordinance provides for three more things. First, merchants are not allowed to expand the scope of products that are “not applicable to seven-day no-reason returns”. Second, "return without reason" must not be set as the default option. Third, we shall not refuse your return without your confirmation.

Case: Mr. Zhang bought a water purifier in the live broadcast room and it leaked. He wanted to sue but only had an order. He submitted his complaint and order number to the platform, requesting the disclosure of the operator, delivery person and business records. After the platform provided it, he identified the defendant and got the repair money back.

items.title: If you buy unsafe food, you will be charged ten times the price in addition to a refund. If the additional compensation is less than 1,000 yuan, it will be calculated as 1,000 yuan.
items.core: If you buy expired or spoiled food, the food itself, the packaging and the receipt are your evidence. Don't throw it away in a hurry. You can ask for compensation of ten times the price or three times the loss. If the amount is less than one thousand yuan, it will be calculated as one thousand yuan. It's up to you to choose whether to find a seller or a manufacturer. The party you find must pay first, and you are not allowed to pass it on to the other party.
body: Cost: No money. Keep the food, packaging, and receipts, don't throw them away or wash them, and take photos on the spot. Find the merchant or platform first. If you can’t negotiate, call 12315. It will take several months to actually prosecute. The hard part is not to throw things away first.

Income: If food that does not meet food safety standards is damaged, you can ask for compensation from the operator or the producer. The party that receives your compensation request implements the first responsibility system and must pay the compensation first without shirk. This means that whoever you are looking for must pay the money first and cannot push you to the other party. In addition to asking for compensation for losses, you can also ask the other party to pay compensation ten times the price or three times the loss, and "if the amount of increased compensation is less than one thousand yuan, it will be one thousand yuan." But there is one exception: "Food labels and instructions contain defects that do not affect food safety and will not mislead consumers." There are also several judicial interpretations. First, three conditions must be met at the same time. The buyer buys it for personal or family life consumption. The food does not meet food safety standards. There is no evidence that he knew it when he bought it. If it is satisfied, "the punitive damages ten times the price will be calculated based on the actual price paid." Second, if you know that the product does not meet the standards but still buy it and then claim for compensation, the People's Court will only support it "within the scope of reasonable living consumption needs." In the case of continuous purchases and repeated prosecutions, the total number of multiple purchases will be determined within the same range. Third, there are several deficiencies that courts will not support punitive damages as long as it does not mislead consumers about food safety. These flaws are: irregular text sizes, typos, and missing characters. There is also an irregular way of marking the net content and specifications. There is also no labeling of storage conditions for foods that do not require special storage conditions (nationwide)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress Standing Committee (third amendment in 2025). Food Safety Law (Article 148). <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=7b5a76d0461745a08d3f964916b87ef3> (National Laws and Regulations Database, 2025 Effective from December 1); Supreme People's Court (2024). Interpretation of Several Issues Concerning the Application of Law in the Trial of Food and Drug Punitive Damage Dispute Cases (Fa Interpretation [2024] No. 9, Articles 1, 6, 7, 8, 12, 13, 14, 15, and 16, effective from August 22, 2024). <http://gongbao.court.gov.cn/Details/bf531a70471f10d377788f28d3d8f8.html> (Official Gazette of the Supreme People's Court)

Note: The order of evidence is more important than the amount. First take photos and videos, including the packaging, production date, foreign objects, and purchase records, and then contact the merchant or platform. Don’t throw things away or wash them before communicating. 12315 is a mediation, not a ruling. If the merchant refuses to admit it, the only way left is to sue. How to calculate a small claims lawsuit? See Section 8, Article 22 (Online shopping and second-hand transactions being defrauded). Also note: If you eat foreign objects such as hair or insects, whether you should classify it as "not meeting food safety standards" usually has to be determined or appraised by the market supervision department. It is not up to you. Therefore, the saying "if you eat a hair, you will get a thousand yuan for sure" is not true. Fraud on ordinary commodities will be compensated three times, and compensation for less than 500 yuan will be calculated as 500 yuan. See Article 29 of this section (online shopping platform rules and regulations). If you make your own food and sell it, there are different regulations on what certificates you need to apply for, how to write labels, and why you are not allowed to say it can cure diseases. Details are found in Section 12, Articles 8 to 11 (Licensing, Labeling, Efficacy Red Lines and Criminal Lines for Foods). On the other hand, there are clear red lines for turning claims into a business. One is to maliciously create the illusion that a business is operating illegally, and then use complaints or lawsuits to threaten compensation, which is suspected of extortion. The court must transfer clues and materials to the police. Second, they sued based on the false impression they created, but the court rejected the lawsuit. If a false lawsuit is constituted, a fine or detention will be imposed depending on the severity of the case. The merchant can also sue you for infringement of your reputation. The beneficiaries of this article are yourself and your family.

Case: Aunt Chen spent 12 yuan to buy yogurt at a convenience store. When she got home, she found that it had expired for three days and was unopened. She kept the receipt, packaging and payment records, and went directly to the store owner instead of the manufacturer. The store owner first compensated 1,000 yuan.

items.title: Check the national random inspection notification, 3C certification and energy efficiency labeling before buying large items
items.core: The state randomly inspected 25,250 batches of products in 2024, and 14.3% were unqualified. E-commerce channels are even worse: 7,297 batches were drawn, and 23.5% were unqualified; the figure for physical stores was 15.1%. Before buying a big item, take a few minutes to check the random inspection notice and check whether the 3C certificate is genuine. The energy efficiency label is indispensable.
body: Cost: No money. Take a few minutes to check on the official websites of the State Administration for Market Regulation and the Certification and Accreditation Administration.

Income: In 2024, national supervision and inspection randomly inspected 25,250 batches of products, with a failure rate of 14.3%. Among them, 7,297 batches were drawn from the e-commerce channel, with a failure rate of 23.5%, an increase of 1.8 percentage points from the previous year. The physical store sampled 8,055 batches, with a failure rate of 15.1%. The authenticity of the compulsory product certification (3C) certificate can be checked in the "Certification Results" column on the official website of the Certification and Accreditation Administration. Energy efficiency labels are compulsorily managed according to product catalogs, and the labels must have energy efficiency levels, energy efficiency indicators and energy efficiency information codes. Those who forge or falsely use energy efficiency labels, or those who do not use the labels, will be punished in accordance with the Energy Conservation Law (national)
Level of Evidence: B

Source: State Administration for Market Regulation (2025). Notice on the national supervision and spot inspection of product quality in 2024. <https://www.samr.gov.cn/zw/zfxxgk/fdzdgknr/zljds/art/2025/art_02676c16ac634fd9a48ec6ea10eb000d.html>; National Certification and Accreditation Administration. Official website "Certification Results" inquiry portal. <https://www.cnca.gov.cn/> ;National Development and Reform Commission, General Administration of Quality Supervision, Inspection and Quarantine (2016). Measures for the Management of Energy Efficiency Labeling (Order No. 35, Articles 3, 7, and 27). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/2021-11/30/content_5713245.htm>

Note: Spot inspection is when the regulatory department selects a part of the goods for inspection. The result is not equal to the pass rate of the entire market, nor can it be used to rank the platform. There is no research on the matter of "checking how many less inferior products we can buy", so it is rated as B grade. The query platform cx.cnca.cn of the Certification and Accreditation Administration cannot be opened during verification in this section. The entrance is based on the homepage of cnca.gov.cn. The numbers reported for spot checks are updated every year, so check the latest issue when using them.

Case: Mr. Zhao chose an electric water heater, and the e-commerce page said it sold well for 100,000 yuan. He did not place an order directly. He first checked the national random inspection notification and found that this model had been listed on the list due to unqualified grounding. He could not find the corresponding 3C certificate, so he finally changed to a brand with an energy efficiency label.

items.title: Bracelets, jade, luxury watches, and trendy toys are calculated based on "money spent" and not "money saved"
items.core: The price of such things includes consumption tax first, and value-added tax is calculated separately. The price is 20% for watches worth 10,000 yuan and above, 5% for gold, silver, platinum jewelry and diamonds, and 10% for other jewelry and jade. This tax cannot be recovered when the property is sold. If you really like it, treat it as consumption, don’t count it as financial management.
body: Cost: No money. Just don't include "it will appreciate in value in the future" as your reason for buying it. The hard thing is not to budget for "preservation".

Income: Let’s look at the buying end first. The tax rates set in the "Consumption Tax Item and Rate Table" are as follows. "Luxury watches" 20%. In "precious jewelry and jade jewelry", gold and silver jewelry, platinum jewelry, diamonds and diamond jewelry are 5%. Other precious jewelry and jade jewelry 10%. The caliber of "high-end watches" is "all kinds of watches with a sales price (excluding value-added tax) of more than 10,000 yuan (inclusive) each". Looking at the realization side, the basis is the "Pawn Management Measures". Article 36: The maximum period of pawn shall not exceed 6 months. Article 37 talks about the pawn interest rate, which refers to the interest rate on the money lent to you by the pawn shop. This interest is converted based on the 6-month legal loan interest rate and pawn period announced by the People's Bank of China. Interest cannot be withheld or taken from the money given to you. Article 38: The monthly comprehensive rate for pledge of movables (such as watches, jade, etc.) shall not exceed 42‰ of the pawn. The additional monthly comprehensive fees shall not exceed 4.2% of the borrowed amount. The real estate mortgage is 27‰ and the property rights pledge is 24‰. Article 40: If you neither redeem nor renew the pledge within 5 days after the time limit is up, it will be regarded as an absolute redemption and the thing will no longer wait for you to redeem it. Article 43: Unique items with an estimated value of more than 30,000 yuan can be entrusted for auction. The auction income must first deduct the auction fees and the principal and interest of the deposit. The remainder will be returned to the owner, and the remainder will be claimed from the owner (nationwide). The Interim Regulations on Consumption Tax only stipulate in Article 11 that exported taxable consumer goods are exempt from tax, and there is no provision for refunding consumption tax when an individual resells the purchased items
Level of Evidence: A

Source: State Council (2008). Interim Regulations on Consumption Tax of the People's Republic of China (State Council Order No. 539, attached "Consumption Tax Items and Rates Table"). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2008-11/14/content_1795.htm>; Ministry of Finance, State Administration of Taxation (2006). Notice on adjusting and improving consumption tax policies (Finance and Taxation [2006] No. 33). <http://www.mof.gov.cn/zhengwuxinxi/zhengcefabu/2006zcfb/200805/t20080524_34758.htm>; Ministry of Commerce and Ministry of Public Security (2005). Pawn Management Measures (Order No. 8 of 2005, Articles 36, 37, 38, 40, and 43). <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2005/content_93074.htm>

Note: You must calculate clearly when depositing money to a pawn shop: the upper limit of monthly comprehensive expenses is 42‰ of the loan amount, which is about 50% of the loan amount in one year, and the interest on the loan must be calculated separately. This "50% per year" is a rough account calculated by directly multiplying the monthly rate by 12. It is used to see the magnitude. It is not an accurate annual interest rate. Tax rates and rates are clearly written numbers. "You cannot get back this tax if you change hands" is derived from the fact that there is no tax refund provision in the regulations. There are no official statistics that can be quoted on "Can this type of thing appreciate in value in the long run?" This book does not make predictions, nor does it comment on any category. What needs to be stopped is only the part of the reason that treats consumption as investment. If you like it and wear it happily, it’s no problem to buy according to consumption. Adding money to your budget on the grounds of "preservation of value" and "can sell it at a higher price in the future" is where you lose money. Gold is also divided into two ends: investment gold bars bought and sold by grams, and jewelry sold by pieces are not the same thing. The price of jewelry includes design fees and labor costs, which are usually not included when recycling. The listing price on the second-hand platform is not the transaction price, so don’t treat it as the market price.

Case: Mr. Liu spent 12,000 yuan to buy a famous watch, and the sales claimed that the value would be preserved. He later found out that watches worth more than 10,000 yuan included a 20% consumption tax. When reselling them, the buyer lowered the price based on the second-hand market price. In the end, he lost 3,000 yuan, knowing that he would not be able to get back the tax.

items.title: Jewelry and jade only accept test reports with the CMA mark, and go to the official website of the issuing department to check the institution
items.core: Certificates can be forged, so you need to check the institution that issued the certificate. The testing agency must be qualified for outbound reports, and the CMA logo must be printed on the report. The licensing department will publish the list of institutions on the official website, and you can check by yourself whether this institution is on the list. In the cases investigated by the authorities, the "National Inspection Certificate" accompanying the goods was made by someone else.
body: Cost: No money. Before placing an order, it only takes a few minutes to check the qualifications of the issuing agency.

Benefits: Let’s look at the rules first, based on the “Measures for the Administration of Qualification Certification of Inspection and Testing Institutions”. Article 2: Qualification accreditation is the evaluation and approval of inspection and testing institutions that "issue proof data and results to the society": review it first, and then issue it with the qualification to issue a certificate. Article 15: The qualification accreditation mark consists of two parts: the CMA pattern and the qualification accreditation certificate number. Article 21: If an institution provides data and results that prove the effectiveness of outbound inspections, it shall mark the qualification certification mark on the inspection and testing report. Article 22: The qualification accreditation department shall publish the information of the institutions that have obtained the qualification accreditation on the official website and indicate the status of the certificate. Article 34: Anyone who provides proof of data and results without obtaining qualification certification in accordance with the law shall be fined 30,000 yuan. Article 37: Anyone who forges, alters or uses qualification certification certificates or signs illegally shall be fined not more than 30,000 yuan. Let’s look at the official case again, which comes from the typical case of “anti-counterfeiting and clearing up sources” in the traditional craft market announced by the State Administration for Market Regulation on June 4, 2026. First, a live broadcast room in Donghai, Jiangsu Province claimed that it sold "natural, no pickling, no optimization, Myanmar's A goods." The live broadcast room is also equipped with a "National Inspection Certificate". The results submitted for inspection were quartzite jade (dyed), jade (processed), glass and plastic. That certificate was made by the party's own contact person. Second, there was another case in the same county where 469 suspected counterfeit natural crystal products were seized, 210 of which were found to be natural crystals and 259 to be synthetic crystals. Third, a store in Zhenping, Henan Province privately made a display board for live broadcast. What is written on the display board is "GIA CMA Chinese Jade Jewelry and Jade Appraisal Center Certification Cooperation Unit". The store also bought 181 certificate marks from the "National Jewelry and Jade Quality Supervision and Inspection Center" online. These logos are sold with bracelets (nationwide)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: State Administration of Quality Supervision, Inspection and Quarantine (announced in 2015, revised in 2021). Measures for the Management of Qualification Accreditation of Inspection and Testing Institutions (Articles 2, 15, 21, 22, 34, and 37). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/2021-04/22/content_5723677.htm>; State Administration for Market Regulation (2026). The State Administration for Market Regulation announced a number of typical cases of "anti-counterfeiting and clearing up sources" in traditional craft markets. <https://www.samr.gov.cn/xw/zj/art/2026/art_1529399cfe874b8780c4496eb0158020.html>; National Standardization Administration Committee. GB/T 16552—2017 "Jewelry and Jade" Name" (current, implemented on May 1, 2018). <https://openstd.samr.gov.cn/bzgk/gb/newGbInfo?hcno=18FFB042811998A0309E05CF452B2438>

Note: There are national standards for the names of jewelry and jade. The test conclusion is written in brackets such as "quartzite jade (dyed)" and "jade (processed)". The two words in the brackets are the price difference. "A goods", "old pit" and "no optimization" are the seller's words, not the conclusion of the appraisal. The previous live broadcast room selling dyed quartzite jade used this set of words. There are other tricks in the same batch of cases: fake mining sites, arranging people to pretend to be "miners" to live broadcast, arranging trolls to heighten the atmosphere in the live broadcast room, and making up scripts about "urgent need of money" and "serious illness of a loved one". There are also products that claim to be able to "prevent and treat rheumatism, improve immunity, improve sleep quality, and clear blood vessels." This category will be investigated and punished as false propaganda. For general inspection methods for large purchases, please refer to Article 32 of this section (Inspection notification and 3C certification). Who should you contact if something goes wrong in the live broadcast room? Please see Articles 29 and 30 (Online shopping requires platform rules; if something goes wrong in the live broadcast room, go to the platform for information).

Case: When Ms. Zhou bought a jade bracelet, the merchant presented the national inspection certificate. She saw that the report did not have the CMA logo, and went to the official website of the issuing department to check the name of the organization. She found that it was not on the list, and immediately canceled the transaction.

items.title: Random sales such as blind boxes and card drawings are calculated as "the money will not be returned"
items.core: Merchants must place the drawing rules, drawing probabilities, and limited edition quantities in a conspicuous place, and are not allowed to manipulate the results in the background, and are not allowed to set up empty boxes. The document only encourages businesses to do minimum guarantees, money spent, and upper limits on the number of draws. For blind boxes purchased online, the merchant has made it clear and you have confirmed that they cannot be returned without reason within seven days after opening.
body: Cost: No money. Just set your budget before buying. The hard thing is to stop when you don't draw the one you want.

Income: Based on the "Guidelines for Blind Box Business Conduct Standards (Trial)". Article 9 lists a series of key information that should be disclosed in a conspicuous manner to ensure that consumers know it before buying. This information is: product name, type, style, extraction rules, product distribution, quantity of limited products, extraction probability, and product value range. The same article also states three things that are not allowed to be done. First, it is not allowed to induce consumption in a disguised manner through background manipulation to change the extraction results or arbitrarily adjust the extraction probability. Second, it is not allowed to refuse or deliberately delay the issuance of blind boxes through discounts, buybacks, exchanges, etc. Third, empty boxes are not allowed. Article 11 only "encourages" operators to establish a minimum guarantee mechanism to guide rational consumption by setting withdrawal time, upper limit of withdrawal amount and upper limit of number of withdrawals. Article 17 governs blind box products sold on the Internet. The operator has fully informed and the consumer has confirmed it during a single purchase. This kind of blind box can be returned without reason within seven days after being opened. Operators are not allowed to replace the consumer’s confirmation process with a default check. Article 21: Gambling activities shall not be engaged in the name of blind box or in disguised form. Article 23: Blind boxes are not allowed to be sold to minors under 8 years of age; sales to minors of 8 years of age and above must confirm that the consent of the relevant guardian has been obtained in accordance with the law (National)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: State Administration for Market Regulation (2023). Guidelines for Standardized Conduct of Blind Box Operations (Trial) (Guo Shi Jian Ji Fa [2023] No. 39, Articles 9, 11, 17, 21, and 23). <https://www.samr.gov.cn/zw/zfxxgk/fdzdgknr/zfjcs/art/2023/art_e2facd76a7fb4e90b03912cffb5e7d53.html>

Note: This document is a guideline and governs what operators should do. It is not itself a basis for punishment. If something does happen, it will be handled in accordance with the Product Quality Law, the Anti-Unfair Competition Law, and the Consumer Rights Protection Law. There are three specific reasons why you can complain: the probability is not announced, the announced probability does not match the actual situation, and you buy an empty box. Before making a complaint, please record the rules on the page and the unboxing process. There is a prerequisite for seven-day no-reason returns after opening the package: the merchant has fully informed you, and you have confirmed it during a single purchase, and you are not allowed to use the default check to confirm it for you. There are separate regulations for selling to minors: merchants are not allowed to sell to children under the age of 8, and those aged 8 and above must first confirm that they have obtained the consent of their guardian. How to get a refund for a child who recharges a mobile phone to tip, please see Article 9 of this section (a child recharges a mobile phone to tip). For a 24-hour cooling-off period for large non-essential purchases, see Article 23 (Cooling-off period for large non-essential purchases). For the cycle of "you lose it once you buy it, so you keep buying it", see Section 6, Item 23 (Don't expect buying things to improve your mood).

Case: Xiao Lin bought a blind box online. The page marked the probability of hidden items and a confirmation pop-up appeared. After he opened it, he found that it was a regular model. His application for a seven-day return without reason was rejected, and he finally recorded the expenditure as entertainment consumption.

items.title: If you care about what is added to the food, buy prepackaged ones: bulk counters do not require ingredient lists by law
items.core: The law only requires prepackaged foods to have ingredient lists, not bulk ones. The bulk counter only needs to be marked with the name, production date, shelf life, and the name, address, and contact information of the producer and operator. Therefore, "no additives are listed" does not mean "no additives are added", it only means that the law does not require them to be written. If you are concerned, buy the pre-packaged version, where the ingredient list and additive names are printed on it.
body: Cost: No money. For the same thing, prepackaged is usually a little more expensive than bulk. Take a look at the ingredient list for a few seconds.

Benefits: Article 67 of the Food Safety Law stipulates that prepackaged foods should be labeled. The label must indicate nine items. The second item is "composition or ingredient list", and the seventh item is "the common name of the food additive used in the national standard". Article 68 has far fewer requirements for bulk foods. The original text is: Food operators selling bulk food should indicate "the name of the food, production date or production batch number, shelf life, name, address, contact information, etc. of the food operator" on the containers and outer packaging of the bulk food. This article does not mention the ingredient list or additives. Frozen aquatic products are where this difference is most obvious. GB 2760-2024 allows the use of phosphoric acid and phosphates as moisture retaining agents in frozen aquatic products, commonly known as water retaining agents. The maximum use level is 5.0 g/kg based on phosphate. It is legal to use within this amount. The problem is excessive consumption and weight gain from packing ice. After the 2025 CCTV 3·15 Party exposed the "illegal excessive addition of water-retaining agent (complex phosphate) and ice-wrapped weight gain" in shrimps, the market supervision department required companies that "product labels should clearly indicate the ingredients of the water-retaining agent (such as phosphate), net content (excluding the weight of the ice coating), and ingredient list" (National Food Safety Law was revised for the third time in 2025, effective from December 1, 2025)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress Standing Committee (Third amendment in 2025). Food Safety Law of the People's Republic of China (Articles 67 and 68, promulgated on September 12, 2025, effective on December 1, 2025). <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=7b5a76d0461745a08d3f964916b87ef3>; National Health Commission, State Administration for Market Regulation (2024). National Food Safety Standards Standards for the Use of Food Additives (GB 2760—2024, Appendix A Table A.1 Food classification numbers under "Phosphoric acid and phosphates" 09.02.01 Frozen aquatic products; A.3 stipulates that the food additives listed in Table A.1 shall be used according to the specified scope of use and maximum usage). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202403/content_7001729.htm>; Lu'an Municipal Market Supervision and Administration Bureau (2025). Reminder and warning letter for relevant enterprises regarding aquatic products and the use of water-retaining agents (2025 March 24). <https://scjgj.luan.gov.cn/zwzx/tzgg/5414606.html>

Note: "No bid" does not mean "no addition", it only means that the law does not require a bid. If you want to know the ingredients, buy the prepackaged version. For frozen shrimps and frozen fish pieces, the net content on the pre-packaging is the weight after deducting the ice coating. Calculate the unit price according to it to be the real price. The bulk price is based on the listed price, and may shrink a lot after thawing. Water-retaining agents are legal within limits and are not a safety issue. Don’t treat them as poison. Excessive addition and weight gain through ice packs are a matter of money: you buy water at the price of aquatic products. Conversely, the four items that should be marked on the bulk counter may not be marked. Name, date of production, shelf life, name, address and telephone number of the producer and operator, any missing item will violate Article 68. You don’t have to buy it, or you can call 12315. How to label prepackaged food when you open your own store, see Section 12, Article 9 (Prepackaged Food Labeling). The beneficiaries of this are yourself and your family, which belong to the two highest brackets.

Case: Ms. Sun often buys nuts in bulk, and only the name, date and phone number are written on the counter. She wanted to know whether it contained sulfites, but the store clerk couldn't tell. After buying the same prepackaged product, she saw the name of the additive directly from the ingredient list.

items.title: Losing stocks must be sold according to predetermined rules, and the stock cannot be turned over by covering up positions to amortize costs
items.core: People tend to sell when they make a profit and carry on with it when they lose. In the seven-year record of 10,000 U.S. accounts, stocks that have risen may be sold at a rate that is more than 50% higher than stocks that have fallen. The same people are also more likely to add positions to losing stocks. But the money-losing stocks they kept were, on average, 3.4 percentage points worse than the money-making stocks they sold over the next year.
body: Cost: No money. The hard thing is to admit that you have lost money and then sell it.

Earnings: This study looked at all trading records from 1987 to 1993 for 10,000 accounts at a U.S. discount brokerage. The percentage of profitable stocks sold (PGR) is 0.148. The percentage of losing stocks sold (PLR) is 0.098. The difference is 0.050 and the t-value exceeds 35. On a daily basis, stocks that have risen are more than 50% more likely to be sold than stocks that have fallen. The same group of accounts are also more active in adding positions to losing stocks. The proportion of losing stocks being repurchased is 0.135 and that of profitable stocks is 0.094, giving a t-value of 19. The study also tested the idea that “what you keep will rise back in value.” The results are reversed: The excess returns of the winning stocks sold one year afterward are, on average, 3.4 percentage points higher than those of the losing stocks left unsold. Excess return refers to the excess return over the market index. The author also calculated an example based on average values. Selling the same $1,000 stock, selling the one that lost money, resulted in a one-year return of about 4.4% higher than selling the one that made a profit. This 4.4% includes the money saved by selling loss-making stocks and deducting taxes in advance. Tax deductions are based on the US tax system (United States, 1987 to 1993)
Level of Evidence: A
Source: Odean T (1998). Are Investors Reluctant to Realize Their Losses? The Journal of Finance 53(5):1775-1798. <https://doi.org/10.1111/0022-1082.00072>

Remarks: This article governs "whether to sell or not", and Article 15 (Infrequent trading of stocks) governs "don't do it too often". The two do not conflict. The author's experience is that if you set the rules in advance and then follow them, you will do fewer things. This has not been measured in research. The arithmetic is correct to cover the position down and amortize the cost. If you buy more, the average cost will be lower. The mistake is to regard it as a way to turn over. Its actual effect is to increase the amount of money you bet on this stock. See Article 19 (Don’t bet money on one stock). The tax deduction section is calculated according to the US tax system. China does not copy it, and the rest of the tax remains true. This is account data from the 1980s to the 1990s in the United States. The transaction costs and tax system of A-shares are different. It does not constitute investment advice.

Case: Lao Zhou set a stop loss of 8% for the stock. When the stock he held fell to the line, he did not cover the position to spread the cost, but sold it according to the rules; later, the stock fell by 20%, and he avoided a greater loss.

items.title: If you want to buy overseas assets such as U.S. stocks, use QDII funds or Southbound Stock Connect. Don't open an account at an overseas brokerage, and don't use your annual exchange quota to buy.
items.core: Overseas brokerages such as Tiger, Futu, and Changqiao will no longer be allowed to open accounts for domestic people starting from May 2026. If it has been opened, you can only sell it and transfer the money within two years, but you cannot buy it again. The exchange quota is also not allowed to be used to buy overseas stocks. This quota cannot be used again in the year of violation and in the following 2 years. If you want to buy overseas assets, use QDII funds or Hong Kong Stock Connect.
body: Cost: No money. You can buy QDII funds in your bank or securities app in a few minutes. The price is that there are fewer varieties available than overseas brokers.

Revenue: On May 22, 2026, eight departments including the China Securities Regulatory Commission, the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, the Ministry of Public Security, the People's Bank of China, the State Administration for Market Regulation, the State Administration of Financial Supervision, the Cyberspace Administration of China, and the State Administration of Foreign Exchange issued the "Implementation Plan for Comprehensive Rectification of Illegal Cross-Border Securities and Futures Fund Business Activities." The overall requirement is to "completely ban illegal cross-border business activities of overseas securities and futures fund operating institutions after two years of intensive rectification." Overseas institutions are not allowed to carry out marketing solicitation within the country, and are not allowed to "provide related transaction services such as account opening, processing of transaction instructions, and fund transfers." For those who have already opened an account, the plan states that "overseas institutions are prohibited from illegally providing buying transactions, fund transfers and other services within the country for existing investors, and only one-way selling transactions and fund transfers are allowed." After the two-year period expires, "domestic websites, trading software and supporting servers will be completely shut down." On the same day, the China Securities Regulatory Commission announced that it plans to confiscate all illegal gains of domestic and foreign entities related to Tiger, Futu, and Changqiao, and impose severe penalties in accordance with the law. The accompanying answer to a reporter’s question states that it is necessary to “guide domestic investors to conduct overseas investments through legal channels such as Southbound Trading, Qualified Domestic Institutional Investors (QDII) and Cross-border Wealth Management Connect.” On the exchange side, the State Administration of Foreign Exchange's "Personal Foreign Exchange Purchase Application" states that individual foreign exchange purchases "may not be used for overseas purchases of houses, securities investments, purchase of life insurance, investment return dividend insurance and other capital projects that have not yet been opened." Violators will be included in the "Watch List" and "will not enjoy the personal facilitation quota for the current year and for 2 consecutive years thereafter." They will also be subject to administrative penalties and transferred for anti-money laundering investigation, and the information will be included in personal credit records (nationwide, starting in May 2026)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: China Securities Regulatory Commission (2026-05-22). China Securities Regulatory Commission and other eight departments jointly issued the "Implementation Plan for Comprehensive Rectification of Illegal Cross-Border Securities and Futures Fund Business Activities". <https://www.csrc.gov.cn/csrc/c100028/c7634324/content.shtml>; China Securities Regulatory Commission (2026-05-22). Heads of relevant departments of the China Securities Regulatory Commission answered reporters’ questions on the “Implementation Plan for Comprehensive Rectification of Illegal Cross-Border Securities and Futures Fund Business Activities”. <https://www.csrc.gov.cn/csrc/c100028/c7634328/content.shtml>; China Securities Regulatory Commission (2026-05-22). The China Securities Regulatory Commission seriously investigates and handles illegal cross-border business expansion cases by Tiger and other institutions. <https://www.csrc.gov.cn/csrc/c100028/c7634330/content.shtml>; State Administration of Foreign Exchange (2021). Personal Foreign Exchange Purchase Application Form (Attachment 1). <https://www.safe.gov.cn/safe/file/file/20210402/30fab7a9646f417ca9d2f67ff4c1e5f0.pdf>

Note: The rectification plan governs overseas institutions and does not include penalties for investors who open accounts themselves. Using the exchange quota to buy overseas stocks will result in administrative penalties, see the income column above. If you already have an account with an overseas securities firm, you can just sell it within two years and transfer the money back. Each of the three legal channels has its opening conditions. Please ask your bank or securities firm first. U.S. stocks have risen much in the past, but that doesn’t mean they will in the future. When buying QDII, follow the same methods as Article 17 (Broad-Based Index Fund) and Article 19 (Don’t bet your money on one stock, one platform, or one house). Choose a broad-based index and don’t bet on a single market. There are additional quotas for overseas cash withdrawals, see Section 21, Article 6 (Overseas Cash Withdrawals). It does not constitute investment advice.

Case: Xiao Chen wants to open an account at an overseas brokerage firm to buy U.S. stocks, but the account opening page prompts that new domestic account openings are restricted. He gave up borrowing a family member's quota to exchange for foreign exchange and instead used QDII funds for fixed-term investment. The funds remained in his domestic account and saved him the trouble of subsequent transfers.

items.title: Only buy insurance for losses that you cannot bear, and use emergency funds for losses that you can bear
items.core: The premiums you pay will not be fully reimbursed, and part of it will have to pay the insurance company's fees and profits. Therefore, what is worth buying is a loss that rarely occurs and the family cannot afford to pay for it once it occurs, such as a serious illness, a car accident, or the loss of the family earner. Small losses that can be tolerated by the savings should be allocated to the emergency fund.
body: Cost: No money. What you need to do is to list the big losses that your family may encounter and see which ones your savings cannot bear. Half an hour at a time.

Income: Only part of the premium collected by the insurance company will be paid out as compensation. The rest goes to sales and operating expenses, as well as the company's profits. Regulations require companies that sell personal short-term health insurance to publish a "comprehensive loss ratio" on their official website every six months. It is roughly the ratio of money lost to premiums. If you want to know how much money a company loses, you can go to its official website to check. Therefore, for one loss, buying insurance means losing a little money on average in the long run. In exchange, a large expenditure that could crush the family at one time is spread into a small amount of money every year. The smaller the loss and the more you can afford, the less worthwhile the exchange is. According to this standard, several items already written in the book are worth buying. For one-year medical insurance, see Section 7, Article 20 (One-Year Medical Insurance). If you own a car, please refer to Article 26 of this section (three-party insurance). Persons traveling abroad shall refer to Section 21, Article 4 (Overseas Medical Treatment). If someone in your family relies on your income, see Article 40 of this section (term life insurance) (National, starting from 2021)
Evidence level: C

Source: General Office of the China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission (2021). Notice on issues related to regulating the short-term health insurance business (Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission [2021] No. 7, the comprehensive loss rate is disclosed on the company's official website on a semi-annual basis). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2021-01/12/content_5579193.htm>

Note: Level C is chosen because there are no official figures to calculate which kind of insurance is more cost-effective. What is given here is a way to choose. Broken screen insurance and flight delay insurance can cost you a few hundred yuan and you can afford it yourself. According to this standard, you don’t have to buy it. Critical illness insurance pays for your income during the years when you were sick and stopped working. People who have enough savings to cover one or two years of work stoppage may consider not buying it. Basic medical insurance is social insurance. If you do not choose according to this method, you still have to pay. See Section 7, Article 9 (Resident Medical Insurance). What to rely on to cover small losses, see Article 27 of this section (contingency fund). The beneficiaries of this are you and your family.

Case: Xiao Wang’s family has a mortgage and children, and a sudden serious illness will be very difficult. He bought millions of dollars in medical and term life insurance, and used emergency funds to pay for losses of several thousand dollars such as a broken mobile phone screen. The premiums did not affect daily cash flow.

items.title: If someone in your family relies on your income, buy term life insurance for the earner first, not your children first
items.core: Term life insurance only covers a fixed number of years. During these years, when the person passes away, the family gets a sum of money. It is reserved for family members who depend on your income, such as the mortgage that has not been paid off and the children who are still young. If no one depends on you for support, there is no need. The child does not earn any money, so the death insurance purchased for the child is limited by law as to how much compensation can be paid.
body: Cost: several hundred to several thousand yuan a year, depending on age, insured amount, and how many years of insurance (rough estimate by the author, no official figures). Before applying for insurance, you must truthfully inform your health status and spend half an hour at a time.

Income: The regulatory definition of life insurance is: personal insurance with human life as the insurance subject, divided into term life insurance, whole life insurance, endowment insurance, etc. Term life insurance pays insurance benefits based on the death of the insured, and the insurance period is a fixed number of years. Whole life insurance covers you for life. Accident insurance only pays out when an accident leads to death or disability. It does not pay out if you die due to illness and cannot replace life insurance. A contract that requires death as a condition for payment must have the consent of the insured and the amount insured, otherwise the contract will be invalid. Parents who purchase death insurance for their minor children are not subject to this restriction, but the total amount of insurance benefits paid due to the child's death must not exceed the limit prescribed by the regulatory agency. The insured amount of life insurance is usually in the hundreds of thousands of yuan, so the income is determined to be large. There is no official guideline on how much insurance should be purchased. The author's algorithm is: the unpaid mortgage, plus the expenses until the children grow up to adulthood, plus a few years of household expenses (National, revised in 2015)
Evidence level: C

Source: China Insurance Regulatory Commission (2011). Measures for the Management of Insurance Terms and Premium Rates of Personal Insurance Companies (CIRC Order No. 3, 2011, Articles 8 and 12). <http://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2012/content_2163594.htm>; National People’s Congress Standing Committee (2015 revision). Articles 33 and 34 of the Insurance Law of the People’s Republic of China. <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=2c909fdd678bf17901678bf7c4060811>

Remarks: Level C is because the official only has definitions and limits, and "protect adults first" is based on "whose income is cut off and the family cannot survive." If something happens to a child, the family will not lose an income. The breadwinner of the family is gone, but the mortgage and child expenses are still there. When money is limited, first buy term life insurance and one-year medical insurance for the earner, and then the child’s medical insurance. How to tell the truth and guarantee renewal, see Section 7, Article 20 (One-Year Medical Insurance). The beneficiaries of this article fall in the ② bracket, which are your spouse and children.

Case: Xiao Zhao is the only person in the family who pays off the mortgage, and his child has just entered kindergarten. She first bought a 20-year life insurance policy for herself, with the insurance amount covering mortgage and alimony; for her children, only medical care and accidents were arranged first.

items.title: I signed up for life insurance for more than one year and then regretted it. I canceled it during the hesitation period and the premium was basically refunded
items.core: There is a hesitation period for life insurance for more than one year. If you buy it from a bank, it will take 15 days after you receive the policy. During this period, a maximum cost of 10 yuan will be deducted for surrender. If you cancel after the hesitation period, you can only get back the refundable part of the policy, which is often less than what you paid. The insurance company will call you back to ask if you have clarification. If you don’t understand, don’t explain it clearly.
body: Cost: No money. Call the insurance company’s customer service number or go to the counter, which takes ten minutes. The hard part is to read the contract carefully within 15 days after signing it.

Income: For personal insurance with an insurance period of more than one year, regulatory requirements state the day from which the hesitation period is calculated and how many days it lasts. The rights of the policy holder during the hesitation period must also be clearly stated. The waiting period for long-term health insurance shall not be less than 15 days. For insurance purchased from a bank with an insurance period of more than one year, the contract will always stipulate a 15-day hesitation period. It is calculated on a calendar day basis from the day you receive the policy and sign for it in writing. This type of policy should have this reminder printed on the cover: "You have the right to cancel the policy in full (deducting a cost of not more than 10 yuan) within 15 days after receiving the insurance contract. If you cancel the policy more than 15 days, you will suffer a loss." After the hesitation period, you can still terminate the contract at any time. The insurance company must refund the cash value of the policy (the portion of the policy that can be refunded) within 30 days as stipulated in the contract. Risk warnings from the financial regulatory authorities say that if long-term life insurance is withdrawn after the hesitation period, the cash value is often lower than the total premium paid. For new personal insurance policies that are more than one year old, the insurance company must return to you during the hesitation period. A return visit should confirm whether you know the loss of surrender and the right to hesitate period (National, starting from 2010 and 2019)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: General Office of China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission (2019). Measures for the Administration of Agency Insurance Business of Commercial Banks (Chinese Banking Regulatory Commission [2019] No. 179, Articles 36, 67, and 68). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2019-12/03/content_5457853.htm>; China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission (2019). Health Insurance Management Measures (CBIRC Order 2019 No. 3, Article 15). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2019-12/04/content_5458542.htm>; China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission (2022). Information disclosure rules for personal insurance products with a term of more than one year (Chinese Banking Regulatory Commission [2022] No. 24, product instructions must list the starting time, number of days and rights of the hesitation period). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2023-01/04/content_5735014.htm>; China Insurance Regulatory Commission (2010). Provisions on basic services for personal insurance business (CIRC Order No. 4, 2010, Article 15). <http://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2010/content_1702219.htm>; Standing Committee of the National People's Congress (2015 revision). Articles 15 and 47 of the Insurance Law of the People's Republic of China. <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=2c909fdd678bf17901678bf7c4060811>; Ningxia Financial Supervision Bureau (2026-06-16). Risk tips on preventing illegal agency surrender. <https://www.nfra.gov.cn/branch/ningxia/view/pages/common/ItemDetail.html?docId=1261442&itemId=2188>

Note: The hesitation period is a rule set for personal insurance for more than one year. One-year medical insurance and accident insurance are not required by the regulations. Whether they are required depends on the terms. If you don’t buy it from a bank, the number of days will be based on what is written in the contract. When you get the policy, first read the “hesitation period” section. Savings-type and participating-type insurance pay more money, and are most worth using during the hesitation period. See Article 25 of this section (consumption type). The income is set as "medium" because what can be saved is the difference between the premium paid and the cash value, which is usually hundreds to thousands of yuan. There are no official statistics. The beneficiary of this is you.

Case: When Sister Zhang was depositing money in the bank, she was rated as a 5-year financial insurance company. Her daughter found out that it was insurance 10 days after returning home. She called customer service and asked to cancel the policy within 15 days of receiving it. She was only deducted 10 yuan in cost, and the tens of thousands of yuan in premiums were basically returned to her account in full.

items.title: Before signing at the bank counter, first check whether you have a deposit or insurance.
items.core: Banks are not allowed to refer to insurance as deposits. The policy cover must have "insurance contract" and the name of the insurance company printed in large characters, and "deposit" and "savings" are not allowed. The cover is an insurance company, not a deposit. If you surrender the policy after the hesitation period, you will lose money. If you are over 65 years old, or over 60 years old if you buy a fixed-term loan, or if your annual income is lower than the local per capita disposable income, in principle, banks can only buy properties with a guaranteed return.
body: Cost: Nothing. Look at the contract cover for two minutes before signing.

Income: Regulations state that banks are not allowed to mix insurance with savings deposits, funds, and bank financial management. Do not make a simple analogy between insurance income and deposits, and do not describe uncertain income as guaranteed income. Insurance documents and promotional materials are not allowed to use the name and logo of the bank, and the words "deposit", "savings" and "jointly launched with the bank" are not allowed to appear. The cover of the insurance policy must be printed with "Insurance Contract" in characters no smaller than 72 points, and the name of the insurance company in characters no smaller than 2 points. There are three types of people who buy insurance, and in principle they can only sell products with guaranteed policy benefits: those with policyholders over 65 years old; those who buy regular premium products with policyholders over 60 years old; and those whose annual income is lower than the per capita disposable income of local residents. The policies of these three types of people must be transferred to the insurance company for manual underwriting, and orders are not allowed to be automatically issued at the branch. People from insurance companies are not allowed to sell insurance in bank branches. Insurance sold by banks for more than one year has a 15-day hesitation period. After the hesitation period, you will suffer losses if you surrender the policy (National, starting from October 2019)
Level of Evidence: B

Source: General Office of the China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission (2019). Measures for the Administration of Agency Insurance Business of Commercial Banks (Chinese Banking Regulatory Commission [2019] No. 179, Articles 30, 31, 32, 36, 42, and 49). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2019-12/03/content_5457853.htm>

Note: Level B is given because the regulations are clearly written, but there is no official figure on "how much the misled people have lost." It is most likely to happen to the elderly at home when they are depositing money in the bank. When you go with them, help them take a look at the cover. If you have already signed, you can return it within 15 days according to Article 41 of this section (hesitation period). What employees recommend is financial management. You should check it on the bank’s own app or official website before buying it. See Article 51 of this section (fee-sale orders privately sold by employees). If you feel you have been misled, see Article 43 of this section (Agent surrender). The beneficiaries of this article are yourself and the elderly in your family.

Case: Lao Li went to the bank to deposit 200,000 yuan on a regular basis, and the manager recommended a product with "higher interest". Before signing, Lao Li put on his reading glasses and saw the "insurance contract" and the name of the insurance company printed on the cover. He immediately refused to sign and took out his passbook to settle the term honestly.

items.title: If you want to cancel the policy, go to the insurance company yourself. Don’t go to an “agent to cancel the policy.” If you feel you have been misled, call 12378 to complain.
items.core: People who say "full refund" on the internet are said to be false information by regulators. This type of agent will take 30% to 50% of the returned money when you surrender the policy, and will also collect your bank card, mobile phone card and home address. If you cancel the policy, the protection will be gone. If you feel you have been misled, please contact the customer service of the insurance company first. If you cannot reach an agreement, call 12378. The whole process is free.
body: Cost: Nothing. Calling the insurance company's customer service number yourself or going to the counter saves one or two more trips than leaving it to an agency.

Income: In February 2026, the State Administration of Financial Supervision, the Central Cyberspace Administration of China, the Ministry of Public Security, the People's Bank of China, and the China Securities Regulatory Commission jointly issued a risk warning. It said that statements such as "full refund" are false information and are inconsistent with laws and regulations such as the Insurance Law. People who use "rights protection agency" will charge high service fees. If you want to quit midway, you may be sued for "breach of contract". They will also collect information such as your mobile phone card, bank card, insurance policy, home address, and children's school. This information is resold, and you may encounter telecommunications fraud and fraud. The June 2026 reminder from the Ningxia Financial Supervision Bureau is written in more detail. This type of intermediary agrees that after the policy is successfully surrendered, it will charge an agency fee of 30% to 50% of the surrender amount. If you quit midway, you will have to pay a high penalty. They teach people to make up reasons such as misleading sales and signing on behalf of others to complain. Those who do so may violate the Public Security Administration Punishment Law, and in serious cases may be suspected of committing a common crime of false accusation, frame-up, or extortion. Insurance liability terminates immediately after surrender. If you buy similar insurance in the future, the price may increase or you may be denied coverage because of your age or physical problems. If you are really misled, first go to the insurance company’s official customer service to complain and negotiate. If you can’t reach an agreement, call the 12378 banking and insurance consumer complaint and rights hotline. The whole process is free. If you just can't afford to pay the premium for a while, you can first ask the insurance company if they can provide services such as reduced payment and policy loans. Paying off the reduced amount means no more payments will be made in the future, and the insured amount will be reduced proportionally (National, 2026)
Level of Evidence: B

Source: State Administration of Financial Supervision, Cyberspace Administration of China, Ministry of Public Security, People's Bank of China, China Securities Regulatory Commission (2026-02-06). Risk warning on being wary of illegal "agency rights protection" short videos and live broadcast traps (reprinted from the official website of the Cyberspace Administration of China). <https://www.cac.gov.cn/2026-02/06/c_1772110875635198.htm>; Ningxia Financial Supervision Bureau (2026-06-16). Risk tips on preventing illegal agency surrender. <https://www.nfra.gov.cn/branch/ningxia/view/pages/common/ItemDetail.html?docId=1261442&itemId=2188>; Hunan Financial Supervision Bureau (2025-07-23). Risk tips on preventing illegal "agency surrender" of black and gray products. <https://www.nfra.gov.cn/branch/hunan/view/pages/common/ItemDetail.html?docId=1218753&itemId=1480>

Note: Hunan Financial Supervision Bureau reported a case in 2025. A woman was persuaded by a "friend" to go to an agency to surrender her policy. She paid a "consultation fee", but in the end she surrendered the policy based on the cash value. Three months after surrendering the policy, she was diagnosed with breast cancer and the critical illness insurance was gone. You have to decide whether to refund or not: If you can still use the insurance, if you can't afford it, ask first to reduce the amount and pay in full. To withdraw during the hesitation period, see Article 41 of this section (hesitation period). The "interest suspension" and "anti-collection" intermediaries for credit cards and online loans are the same type of routine, see Section 7, Article 23 (credit cards and online loans have been repaid). The beneficiary of this is you.

Case: Xiao Wang credulously believed in the "full refund" advertisement online and handed over his ID card and insurance policy to the agent. After surrendering the policy, the other party took 40% of the handling fee and used his information to apply for a loan. Xiao Wang could only call 12378 to complain, but the protection was lost for life.

items.title: The beneficiary is listed as a specific person on the policy. If something happens, remember to claim the money: 5 years for life insurance and 2 years for other insurance.
items.core: If the beneficiary is not written, or the beneficiary passes away first, the insurance money is considered an inheritance and must be used to repay the debts owed by the deceased. The beneficiary wrote "wife so-and-so", and later got divorced, but did not write it down when the accident happened. Family members should be aware of this policy: for life insurance, claims must be made within 5 years from the date of the accident, and for other insurances, 2 years.
body: Cost: Nothing. Fill it out once when applying for insurance. If you change the beneficiary later, you must notify the insurance company in writing.

Income: Insurance Law stipulates that the beneficiary shall be designated by the insured or the policy holder. If designated by the policy holder, the consent of the insured must be obtained. There are three situations. The insurance money is considered as the insured's inheritance and is paid according to the inheritance rules. One is that the beneficiary is not designated, or the designation is unclear. The second is that the beneficiary dies before the insured, and there is no other beneficiary. Third, the beneficiary has lost or given up the beneficiary rights in accordance with the law, and there is no other beneficiary. If the beneficiary and the insured die in the same event and the order cannot be distinguished, the beneficiary is presumed to have died first. The money counted as inheritance must first pay off the taxes and debts owed by the deceased, and then divide the rest. The interpretation of the Supreme Court states: The beneficiary is written as "name plus identity relationship." If the identity relationship changes when the accident occurs, there is no designated beneficiary. If the beneficiary is changed without notifying the insurance company, it will not be effective for the insurance company. The statute of limitations for collecting money is 5 years for life insurance and 2 years for other insurances, both starting from the day when the person knew or should have known that something had happened. The insured amount of life insurance is usually in the hundreds of thousands of yuan, so the income is determined to be large (National, revised in 2015, starting from 2021)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Standing Committee of the National People's Congress (2015 revised). Articles 26, 39, 41, and 42 of the Insurance Law of the People's Republic of China. <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=2c909fdd678bf17901678bf7c4060811>; Supreme People's Court (2020 revised). Interpretation of Several Issues Concerning the Application of the Insurance Law of the People's Republic of China (3) Article 9, Paragraph 2, Item 3 and Article 10. <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=ff808181799df4000179ac03d7f21115>; National People's Congress (2020). Article 1159 of the Civil Code of the People's Republic of China. <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=ff808081729d1efe01729d50b5c500bf>

Note: After the statute of limitations has passed, the insurance company can refuse to pay, and it will be difficult to get it back if you file a lawsuit. So your family members should at least know which companies you have bought insurance from. After divorce, remarriage, or the birth of a child, go back and change the beneficiary. After the person leaves, go and collect the money one by one. See Section 25, Article 9 (Go and collect the money one by one). Death to repay debts is not an option, see Section 29, Article 13 (Repayment of Debts). The beneficiaries of this article fall in the ② bracket, which are your spouse and children.

Case: Lao Zhou only wrote “wife” as the beneficiary when he bought a life insurance policy, but the name was not changed after he remarried after divorce. After a car accident, his ex-wife and his current wife fought over the insurance money. The court held that writing "wife" was deemed unspecified, and the insurance money became an inheritance. It was first used to pay off the debts he owed during his lifetime.

items.title: Don’t use your money to buy virtual currencies such as Bitcoin and Tether, and don’t follow others who ask you to invest: transactions are not protected by law, and you won’t get your money back even if you file a lawsuit.
items.core: The country does not recognize virtual currency as money, and individual transactions to buy coins can be invalidated, and any losses will be borne by you. Someone spent about 448,000 yuan to buy Tether coins from others. Later, the platform was unable to withdraw cash, and the lawsuit for money was dismissed by the court. Being stolen is another matter. The person who stole the coins was sentenced to 7 years for theft.
body: Cost: Nothing. Don’t buy coins, don’t join the currency circle groups that “bring orders” and “guaranteed profits”. The price is that you cannot make money when the currency price rises.

Income: In February 2026, eight departments including the People's Bank of China issued Yinfa [2026] Notice No. 42. The notice stated that virtual currencies such as Bitcoin, Ethereum, and Tether "are not legally liquid and should not and cannot be used as currency in the market." RMB exchange, currency exchange, and currency issuance for financing are all illegal financial activities and are "strictly prohibited." Overseas institutions are also not allowed to provide such services to people within the country. On the individual investment side, the original words of the notice are: "Any unit or individual who invests in virtual currencies, real-world asset tokens and related financial products that violates public order and good customs will have the relevant civil and legal actions invalid, and the resulting losses will be borne by the individual themselves." The 2021 Silver Notice [2021] No. 237 was repealed at the same time, and this sentence is retained in the new notice. Court case: From February 2018 to July 2019, Tang bought TEDA coins from two people who claimed to be merchants on the platform and paid about 448,000 yuan (accurately worth 448,000 yuan). Later, the platform could not withdraw cash or log in. He sued to get the money back. The court held that the investment behavior of exchanging RMB for virtual currency was invalid and the loss would be borne by himself. The court dismissed the prosecution and upheld the second instance (Yixing, Jiangsu, released in March 2025). Being stolen is another matter. More than 4 million yuan worth of virtual coins in someone's account were stolen by "hackers". One of the thieves was sentenced to 7 years for theft and fined 20,000 yuan (Zhengzhou, Henan)
Level of Evidence: A
