Source: People's Bank of China, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Public Security, State Administration for Market Regulation, State Administration of Financial Supervision, China Securities Regulatory Commission, State Administration of Foreign Exchange (2026). Notice on further preventing and dealing with virtual currency and other related risks (Yinfa [2026] No. 42, Articles 1 and 19). <https://www.csrc.gov.cn/csrc/c100028/c7614318/content.shtml> (released by the China Securities Regulatory Commission); Yixing Municipal People’s Court (2025). You must bear the risk responsibility for any losses caused by investing in virtual currencies. <https://yx.wxfy.gov.cn/article/detail/2025/09/id/8970543.shtml>; [Good prosecutorial story in the new era] Stole virtual currency and was convicted of theft (2024). <https://www.yw.gov.cn/art/2024/2/2/art_1229143073_59471301.html> (Reprinted from Yiwu Municipal People’s Government Website); People’s Court Report (2024). The criminal nature of illegal theft of virtual currency. <http://www.sdcourt.gov.cn/jningzcfy/386500/386502/31441533/index.html> (Reprinted from Zoucheng People’s Court Website); Federal Bureau of Investigation (2022). Scammers Target and Exploit Owners of Cryptocurrencies in Liquidity Mining Scam (Alert Number I-072122-PSA). <https://www.ic3.gov/PSA/2022/PSA220721>

Note: "Bear the loss yourself" deals with the money dispute between you and the person who sold the currency or brought the order. The court will not help you get your investment money back, so don't expect to sue afterwards. Being stolen or defrauded is a criminal matter, so you should still report it to the police. People who already have coins need to prevent theft of coins by scanning the QR code. Someone in Lianshui, Jiangsu Province met the other party and scanned a QR code, and about 57,000 Tether coins were transferred from the wallet. These coins are worth about 394,000 yuan (accurately 393,665.461434 yuan), and the People's Court newspaper believes that they should be treated as theft. The FBI warned of a similar tactic in 2022. A list of permissions pops up in the wallet. If you click to agree, the other party can transfer your coins without any limit. The preventive measures it provides are: disconnect the wallet for uncertain websites, and regularly use third-party authorization query tools to see which websites the wallet has given permission to transfer coins. Using your own bank card to collect money, buy coins, or transfer coins for others is another matter that may result in a prison sentence. See Section 9, Article 5 ("Part-time job" requires you to use your own card to collect money). How to identify "financial management" that promises high returns, see Article 6 (just walk away when you see "high returns," "guaranteed capital," and "steady profits"). For legal channels to buy overseas assets, see Article 38 (Use QDII funds or Hong Kong Stock Connect to buy U.S. stocks). It does not constitute investment advice.

items.title: If you don't have an employer, you have to pay your own employee pension insurance. It's most cost-effective to pay at the lowest level and pay for the full number of years first. Don't think that you'll make money as soon as you pay. Even at the lowest level, you have to pay for 10 years to get your capital back.
items.core: People who don’t have an employer pay their own employee pension, and it’s calculated based on how quickly the cost is recovered. It’s most cost-effective to pay at the lowest level and pay for enough years. The majority of the money you receive will follow the local average salary in the year of retirement. Converted based on the salary level at that time, the minimum payment would take 15 years, and starting at the age of 60, the payback would take about 10 years, and those paying more at the higher end would take about 17 years. It’s worth paying, but you won’t make money as soon as you pay.
body: Cost: All the money is paid by yourself, and you pay 20% of the payment base. The lowest level costs several hundred to thousands of yuan per month. It must be paid on time for more than 15 years. Starting from 2030, this period will increase to 20 years every year. This money cannot be withdrawn before retirement.

Income: How to pay and how to receive it, the State Council’s decision in 2005 spelled it out. Those who do not have an employer and pay by themselves (formally referred to as those with flexible employment) pay 20% of the payment base, of which 8% is credited to their personal account. Starting from 2019, you can choose your own payment base. The range is 60% to 300% of the average salary of employees in all urban units in the province. The pension after retirement is divided into two parts. The first piece is called basic pension. Add the average monthly salary of local employees in the previous year and your own average contribution salary and divide it by 2. 1% will be paid for every year of payment. The second piece is called personal account pension, which is the money in the account divided by the number of months. The number of months counted for retirement at age 60 is 139, and at age 55 it is 170. The later the retirement age, the fewer months. The following is an example of calculation based on the formula, not an official figure. Assume that the local average monthly salary in the year of retirement is 8,000 yuan, and the two average salaries are calculated as the same number. The following amounts are calculated based on the salary level in the year of retirement, and the interest on the personal account is calculated as if it just keeps up with the salary increase. Pay at the lowest rate of 60%, the payment base is 4,800 yuan, and the monthly payment is 960 yuan. The total payment for 15 years is about 173,000 yuan (accurate value: 172,800 yuan). Starting from the age of 60, the monthly pension is about 1,457 yuan: the basic pension is 960 yuan, and the personal account pension is about 497 yuan. It is about 17,500 yuan a year (accurate value is about 17,487 yuan), and it takes about 9.9 years to get back the money, that is, around the age of 70. According to 100% payment, the total payment in 15 years is about 288,000 yuan (accurate value: 288,000 yuan), and the monthly payment is about 2,029 yuan. You pay about 115,000 yuan more than the lowest grade (accurate value: 115,200 yuan). You only get about 572 yuan more per month, and it takes about 16.8 years to pay back. The reason is that half of the basic pension is calculated based on the local average salary and has nothing to do with how much you pay. People who pay less take advantage. For every additional year of payment at the lowest level, the payback period is still about 9.9 years, which is more cost-effective than increasing the level. Pay at the lowest level, and the basic pension accounts for the majority of the money received. This payback period has nothing to do with local wages. Where wages are high, what you pay and what you receive increases in the same proportion, and the payback period remains the same. The denominations paid in the early years were small, but when you retired, you were paid according to the average salary at that time. So only looking at the denomination of the money paid and received, the return on capital is earlier than 9.9 years. The law stipulates that only when you retire and have paid for 15 years in total, you can receive monthly benefits. If you are not satisfied, you can continue to pay the amount. From January 1, 2030, this minimum age will increase by 6 months each year, gradually increasing to 20 years. When a person dies, the remaining money in the personal account can be inherited. The state will increase pensions in a timely manner based on the average wage growth of employees and rising prices. When the pension insurance fund is insufficient, the government will subsidize it (nationwide)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: State Council (2005). Decision on improving the basic pension insurance system for enterprise employees (Guofa [2005] No. 38, Articles 3 and 6 and the attachment "Monthly Calculation and Payment Table of Personal Account Pensions"). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2008-03/28/content_7376.htm>; General Office of the State Council (2019). Comprehensive plan to reduce social insurance premiums (Guobanfa [2019] No. 13, Parts 1 and 3). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2019-04/04/content_5379629.htm>; Standing Committee of the National People's Congress (2024). Decision on the implementation of a progressive extension of the statutory retirement age (Attachment "Article 2 of the Measures of the State Council on the Progressive Delay of the Statutory Retirement Age"). <https://www.gov.cn/yaowen/liebiao/202409/content_6974294.htm>; National People’s Congress Standing Committee (2010, 2018 revision). Social Insurance Law (Articles 10, 12, 13, 14, 16, 17, and 18). <https://www.gov.cn/guoqing/2021-10/29/content_5647616.htm>

Note: The calculation example is only used to see the magnitude. How much you can actually receive depends on the local average salary, the grade you pay, the interest on your personal account, and the year you retire. The pension will be increased after retirement, but this is not taken into account, so the actual return will be earlier. After delayed retirement, the number of months of payment will be fewer, and the personal account will receive more every month. If you work in an employer, the employer pays 16%, and you pay 8%. If you don’t have an employer, no one will pay for the 16% for you, and you have to pay the 20% yourself. If you die before receiving enough, your personal account balance can be inherited, and your survivors can also receive funeral benefits and pensions. Those who cannot afford the lowest monthly payment can first participate in the urban and rural residents’ pension insurance, see Section 31, Article 11 (flexible employment without joining an employer). Whether you can receive social security subsidies, please refer to Section 7, Article 12 (Identification of Persons with Employment Difficulties). Suspension of contributions and supplementary contributions are provided in Section 7, Article 18 (Cessation of Social Security Contributions). How to transfer the pension relationship after changing cities, see Section 19, Article 19 (The pension and medical insurance relationship is transferred to the new insured place).

Case: Ms. Liu, who was laid off at the age of 45, paid for her own pension at the lowest level for 15 years. She did the math: Based on the local average salary, a 60-year-old who earns about 1,200 yuan a month will pay back his capital in about 10 years. The additional payment of more than 100,000 yuan will take 17 years to pay back.

items.title: When you buy a new car and pick it up, inspect the car on the spot and keep the invoice and three-guarantee certificate; if something goes wrong in the first 7 days or 60 days, you can ask to exchange or return the car.
items.core: In the first 7 days of a new car, if major parts such as the engine and transmission break down and need to be replaced, you can directly request a replacement or return the car. In the first 60 days or 3,000 kilometers, if the brakes or steering fail, the car body cracks, oil leaks, or the battery catches fire, the energy can be replaced. If the same problem has been repaired several times during the validity period of the three-guarantee and still cannot be repaired, you can still exchange it, but you will have to pay a usage compensation fee based on the mileage you have driven.
body: Cost: Nothing. When picking up the car, spend half an hour with the salesperson to look at the exterior, interior, and check the documents that come with the car. Invoices and three-guarantee certificates must be kept. Every time you go into the shop to have your car repaired, you have to get a repair order. If you really want to exchange or return the car, you have to go to the store several times. If you can't reach an agreement, you have to file a complaint or sue.

Income: This set of rules is called Three Guarantees for Family Cars, which governs passenger cars and pickup trucks such as cars and SUVs purchased for daily consumption, and does not count those used for business purposes. The three-year warranty period is no less than 2 years or 50,000 kilometers, and the repair warranty period is no less than 3 years or 60,000 kilometers, whichever comes first. The time limit is calculated from the date of invoice issuance. If the delivery date and the invoice date are different, the time limit is calculated from the day of delivery. If quality problems occur within the warranty period, repairs will be free of charge, and no labor or material fees will be charged. Within the first 7 days, if the engine, transmission, power battery, drive motor or their main parts need to be replaced due to quality problems, you can choose to exchange or return the car with the invoice and three-guarantee voucher. Within the first 60 days or 3,000 kilometers, if steering failure, brake failure, body cracking, fuel leakage, or power battery fire occurs due to quality problems, you can also choose to exchange or return the vehicle. Within the validity period of the Three Guarantees, you can also exchange or return the car in the following four situations. The first type is that a serious safety fault has not been fixed after two repairs, or a new serious safety fault has occurred. Secondly, the four major parts of the engine have been replaced twice due to quality issues and are still not functioning properly. The third type is that the same main component has been replaced twice and still cannot be used normally. The fourth type is that the cumulative repair time exceeds 30 days, or the same quality problem is repaired more than 4 times. If you exchange or return according to these four situations, you will have to pay a usage compensation fee. The calculation is vehicle price × mileage ÷ 1000 × n. n is written on the Three Guarantees Certificate by the manufacturer and shall not be higher than 0.5%. If a single repair lasts more than 5 days, the store will have to give you a spare car from the 6th day onwards, or pay for transportation expenses. When you exchange and return your car, the store will also compensate you for the vehicle registration fee, additional decoration fees after deducting depreciation, and the service fee it charges you. After receiving the exchange request, the store must respond within 10 working days. If it disagrees, it must explain the reasons. The store may not refuse to cover the three guarantees just because you did not maintain the product there. Those who deliberately delay or refuse the Three Guarantees without justifiable reasons shall be punished in accordance with Article 56 of the Consumer Rights Protection Law (national, effective from January 1, 2022)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: State Administration for Market Regulation (2021). Regulations on responsibility for repair, replacement and return of household automobile products (General Administration Order No. 43, Articles 13, 18 to 24, 26 to 28, 30, 32, 38 and 40, effective January 1, 2022). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2021-07/27/content_5627788.htm>

Note: The cumulative number of days and times of repairs are all proved by the maintenance order, so each order must clearly indicate the fault, the time of entering and exiting the store. Calculate the compensation fee by yourself according to the formula: a car worth 200,000 yuan has been driven 10,000 kilometers, and n is calculated based on the upper limit of 0.5%, and you have to pay about 10,000 yuan. If the store refuses to admit the mistake, call 12315 to complain first, and the market supervision department will mediate. If mediation fails, you can only file a lawsuit. The ordinary procedure of first instance is to be completed within 6 months according to regulations, and can be extended. The lawyer's fees will be paid by yourself, and the other party will not bear the responsibility if the verdict is won. If the car is sold to someone else during the warranty period, the three-guarantee certificate will follow the car and the three-guarantee responsibilities will not change. You can ask the seller for it when buying a second-hand car. If you buy a second-hand car from a car dealer and the condition of the car is concealed, see Article 48 of this section (Accidents and water damage of second-hand cars are concealed). The beneficiaries are myself and my family.

Case: On the 5th day after Mr. Chen delivered his new car, the instrument panel showed a transmission failure. He took photos on the spot and kept them, and asked to return the car in accordance with the Three Guarantees Regulations. The 4S store pushed back at first, but after he issued the invoice and three-guarantee certificate, the car was successfully replaced with a new car on the third day.

items.title: When buying a second-hand car from a car dealer, first check the insurance and maintenance records. The contract states that "it is not an accident car or a damaged car." If it is concealed, you can ask to return the car and pay three times the car price.
items.core: If you buy a second-hand car from a car dealer, and the car dealer deliberately conceals the actual condition of the car, such as accidents and water damage, you can return the car and be compensated three times the price of the car. But only if you prove that the car dealer deliberately hid it from you, you can get triple the amount. The car dealer said he didn't know, and the court accepted it, and only refunded the car payment plus interest. Triple compensation is not applicable to purchases purchased from individuals.
body: Cost: You have to spend money to hire a third-party agency for testing, and the price varies from place to place. Spend an hour or two checking the vehicle's accident and repair records before buying it. When signing the contract, be more careful and include the vehicle condition promise. If you are really deceived and have to file a lawsuit, it may take two to three years.

Income: The seller of a second-hand car must provide the buyer with the real situation of the vehicle such as its use, repairs, accidents, inspections, whether it has a mortgage, whether it has paid taxes and fees, and its scrap date. If the transfer cannot be completed due to the seller's concealment or fraud, the seller must unconditionally return the car and refund the purchase price. Article 55 of the Consumer Rights Protection Law stipulates that if an operator commits fraud in providing goods, the compensation shall be increased at the request of the consumer. The amount is three times the purchase price, and if it is less than 500 yuan, it will be calculated as 500 yuan. This only applies to operators and cannot be used by individual car owners. There is a case in Rizhao, Shandong. Sun bought a car from a second-hand car dealer in May 2023 for a total price of 53,000 yuan. The dealer promised that there had been no major accidents. In October of the same year, the appraisal company detected that this was a vehicle that had been involved in a major accident. Search records showed that it had been involved in an accident in January of that year and was classified as a total loss. The contract was canceled in the first instance, and the dealer refunded 53,000 yuan and then paid three times the car price of 159,000 yuan. In April 2025, the Rizhao Intermediate People’s Court upheld the second instance. The two parties did not sign a written contract, and Sun won the battle with a receipt stamped by the car dealership. There are precedents on the other hand. Wang from Henan bought a car for 240,000 yuan in January 2018, and the contract promised that it would be free of accidents and water damage. It was later discovered that the car had been involved in an accident before delivery, and repairs had cost 5,100 yuan. Both the first instance and the retrial sentenced the case to be refunded and compensated three. The Zhengzhou Intermediate People's Court changed the verdict in the second instance and upheld the verdict in the second instance. The reason is that when the car dealer bought the car, the accident and repairs had already occurred. There is no evidence that the car dealer knew about it and deliberately concealed it. Therefore, it is only considered a breach of contract: the contract is terminated, the car payment of 240,000 yuan plus interest is refunded, and no triple compensation is required. The court reminded that buyers can check the insurance claims status of used cars through various channels, or they can entrust third-party professionals to appraise them (nationwide)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Ministry of Commerce, Ministry of Public Security, State Administration for Industry and Commerce, and State Administration of Taxation (2005). Measures for the Administration of Circulation of Used Cars (Order [2005] No. 2, formerly Article 17; Order No. 3 of the Ministry of Commerce in 2017 deleted Articles 9 to 11, and the order of the articles was adjusted accordingly, now Article 14). <http://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2006/content_327851.htm>; Ministry of Commerce (2017). Decision on the abolition and modification of some regulations (Ministry of Commerce Order No. 3 of 2017). <http://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2017/content_5244878.htm>; National People’s Congress Standing Committee (Amended in 2013). Consumer Rights Protection Law (Article 55). <https://www.samr.gov.cn/zfjcj/tzgg/art/2023/art_615af9ed6bcd4974bf853dd2e02bc663.html>; National People’s Congress (2020). Civil Code (Articles 148, 152). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202006/t20200602_463888.shtml>; Shandong Legal News (2025). A second-hand car dealer was sued for concealing the truth about the accident car, and the court ruled to terminate the contract and refund one and compensate three. <http://www.sdcourt.gov.cn/rzzy/404983/404968/41465920/index.html> (Reprinted from the official website of Rizhao Intermediate People’s Court); Suing for “refund one and three compensation” (2021) on the grounds that he was not informed that the used car had been involved in an accident. <https://www.mawei.gov.cn/xjwz/zwgk/ztzl/pfzl/yasf/202108/t20210802_4153847.htm> (Reprinted in the "Explanation of Laws with Cases" column on the Mawei District People's Government website of Fuzhou City, the original publication location is not indicated)

Note: Triple compensation is only applicable to operators, that is, car dealers and second-hand car dealers. If you buy it from an individual car owner and you are deceived, you can only ask the court to cancel the contract and refund the money according to the Civil Code. Revocation must be made within 1 year after knowing that you have been deceived, and no later than 5 years after the transaction is completed. Even if it says in the contract that "the condition of the car is subject to the current situation", it should also include a promise such as "it will not be an accident car, a car soaked in water, or a car burned down" so that it can be compared later. In both cases, it took about two years from the time the car was purchased to the time the judgment was made. The attorney fees were paid by oneself, so it was most cost-effective to check the records and do a test before filing a lawsuit. If the new car is still within the warranty period, the Three Guarantee Certificate will follow the car, see Article 47 of this section (Three Guarantees for New Cars). How to compare car loans? See Article 7 of this section (borrow money first converted into annualized interest rate). The beneficiaries are myself and my family.

Case: Xiao Zhao bought a second-hand car from a car dealer, and the contract stated that "the car was not damaged by accidents." After three months of inspection, it was discovered that the truck was damaged by water. He retrieved the maintenance records and sued. The court ruled that the car dealer had committed fraud and ordered that the car be returned and compensated three times the price of the car.

items.title: When you buy a car at a 4S store, you don’t have to pay a “financial service fee”, and you don’t have to deal with insurance, loans, and license plates in the store.
items.core: The store said that you need to pay an additional "financial service fee" when applying for a loan. According to regulations, dealers are not allowed to charge this. You can find insurance, loans, and license plates from other companies or do it yourself. The store can't force you to do it there, nor can it charge you any money in addition to the listed price. Before applying for a loan, ask the other party to write down the annualized interest rate and all costs for comparison.
body: Cost: Nothing. Take a few minutes before signing the contract to ask what each fee is, and ask the store to write it into the contract or issue an invoice. You need to do your own insurance and registration, which means you have to make more trips.

Revenue: The Automobile Sales Management Measures stipulate that dealers must clearly indicate the prices and charging standards of cars, accessories and various services in their stores. No mark-ups or additional fees are allowed beyond the listed price. Dealers may not limit your place of residence, nor may they limit which company you use for accessories, supplies, finance, insurance, rescue and after-sales services. Except for three guarantees and recalls, accessories and services paid for by the manufacturer are excluded. Dealers cannot force you to buy insurance when selling a car, or force you to get a license plate on your behalf. Anyone who violates these articles will be ordered to make corrections by the commerce department at or above the county level, and may be given a warning or a fine of up to 30,000 yuan. In 2022, the former China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission required financial institutions that provide car loans to control cooperative dealers. Dealers may not charge fees in the name of a financial institution or for providing you with financial services. It also tells you the annualized loan interest rate and fee rate. We are not allowed to use rhetoric that is inconsistent with reality, such as "loan fines are waived" or "vehicles are mortgage-free" to induce you, and we are not allowed to bundle products and services against your will. Financial institutions themselves do not charge fees for lending.消费者权益保护法实施条例规定，经营者不得强制或者变相强制你买东西，也不得排除、限制你选别的经营者（全国）
Level of Evidence: B

Source: Ministry of Commerce (2017). Measures for the Administration of Automobile Sales (Ministry of Commerce Order No. 1 of 2017, Articles 10, 14, and 32, effective from July 1, 2017). <http://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2017/content_5230275.htm>; China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission (2022). Notice on further regulating the auto finance business (Bank and Insurance Regulatory Commission [2022] No. 22, Items 5 and 11). <https://policy.mofcom.gov.cn/claw/clawContent.shtml?id=96380> (Reprinted from the Policy and Regulation Database of the Ministry of Commerce); State Council (2024). Regulations for the Implementation of the Consumer Rights Protection Law (State Council Order No. 778, Articles 11 and 50). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202403/content_6940159.htm>

Note: This amount of money is often called "service fee", "handling fee" and "loan service package". According to regulations, it must be clearly stated in advance and cannot be charged in addition to the listed price. If you have already handed it over, please go to the store first to get it back. If you don’t want to refund, call 12378 for loan-related complaints and 12315 for other complaints. If the amount is not large and you want to sue, how to proceed with the small claims lawsuit? Please refer to Section 8, Article 22 (Online shopping and second-hand transactions being defrauded). There is no official figure on how much this fee usually costs, and the magnitude of the income is determined based on judgment. The handling fee for a car loan must be calculated into the annualized interest rate. For the method, see Article 7 of this section (borrowing money must be converted into the annualized interest rate first). The beneficiaries are myself and my family.

Case: Xiao Sun took a loan from a 4S store to buy a car, and was asked to pay a "financial service fee" of 3,000 yuan during settlement. He pointed out on the spot that the regulations prohibited charging, and checked the official interest rate of the model on the mobile banking app. In the end, the store canceled the arbitrary charge.

items.title: When traveling in a group tour, the tour guide took me to an unscheduled shopping store and bought something. I asked the travel agency to return the goods within 30 days after returning, and the travel agency paid for the goods in advance.
items.core: It is illegal for a travel agency to take you to a shopping store without consulting you, or to use a ridiculously low tour fee to get you to go shopping. Within 30 days of your return, you can ask it to handle a return for you, and it will pay for the goods first. If you have signed the "Voluntary Purchase" supplementary agreement, even if you have agreed to it, it will be difficult to withdraw like this.
body: Cost: Nothing. Keep your contract and itinerary when you go out. When buying things, you need invoices and credit card receipts. Do not disassemble and use things. After coming back, I have to find a travel agency and send the goods back. If you can't reach an agreement and file a complaint, it may take a month or two.

Benefits: Article 35 of the Tourism Law has three paragraphs. The first paragraph states that travel agencies are not allowed to organize tours at unreasonably low prices, lure tourists, and then receive kickbacks by arranging shopping. The second paragraph says that travel agencies are not allowed to designate specific shopping venues. You can go only if both parties reach an agreement, or if the tourists themselves request it and it does not interfere with other people's itineraries. Signing the "Voluntary Purchase" supplementary agreement generally counts as consensus. The third paragraph states that for violations of the first two paragraphs, tourists have the right to request the travel agency to handle returns within 30 days after the end of the trip and advance the return payment. In addition, you can also request a refund for paid self-financed items. This one does not require you to prove that the item has quality problems first. Article 9 of the Tourism Law also stipulates that tourists have the right to refuse forced transactions. The Ministry of Culture and Tourism notified a case in 2025. A travel agency in Chengdu took 15 tourists to Jiuzhaigou, and the total group fee was only 6,015 yuan. In turn, it paid 8,220 yuan in "tour group fees" to the company that solicited tourists, and received 13,706 yuan in rebates from shopping stores. The travel agency was fined 80,000 yuan and suspended for 30 days. The Guangdong Provincial Department of Culture and Tourism announced a complaint in 2024. Two tourists took a tour from Hong Kong and Macao with a tour fee of NT$800 per person and bought jewelry and pillows worth more than NT$20,000 in a duty-free shop. The tourist complained to the district cultural and tourism department, and the two parties reconciled. The travel agency assisted in sending the goods back and refunded the full payment (nationwide)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress Standing Committee (2018 revision). Tourism Law (Articles 9, 35, 92, 93). <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=ff8080816f135f46016f1d08f6da12f6>; Ministry of Culture and Tourism (2026). Tourism Complaint Handling Measures (Ministry of Culture and Tourism Order No. 14 No. 11, 14 and 23, effective from March 15, 2026). <https://zwgk.mct.gov.cn/zfxxgkml/zcfg/bmgz/202602/t20260211_964700.html>; General Office of the Ministry of Culture and Tourism (2021). Notice on further optimizing the government service convenience hotline of the culture and tourism system. <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2021-11/19/content_5651873.htm>; Ministry of Culture and Tourism (2025). Typical cases of forced consumption in the tourism market (Third Batch, Case Fifteen). <https://www.mct.gov.cn/whzx/whyw/202509/t20250908_962084.htm>; Guangdong Provincial Department of Culture and Tourism (2024). Guangdong Provincial Department of Culture and Tourism released typical cases of tourism complaints in 2024 (Case 1). <https://whly.gd.gov.cn/service_newscgldt/content/post_4385141.html>

Note: What you are looking for is a travel agency, not a shopping store. The travel agency refused to handle it and called 12345 to complain. The original 12301 has been cancelled. Complaints must be filed within 90 days after the expiration of the travel contract, and mediation must be completed within 60 days after acceptance. Mediation must be voluntary by both parties. If mediation fails, the only options are arbitration or litigation. The ordinary procedure of first instance is stipulated to be completed within 6 months, which can be extended, and the lawyer's fees will be paid by himself. For small claims actions, see Section 8, Article 22 (Defrauded in Online Shopping and Second-Hand Transactions). For those who have signed a supplementary agreement, unless the tour fee is unreasonably low, they can only negotiate on the grounds that the quality and price do not match. If you buy it in an overseas store, it is difficult to protect your rights across the border yourself. You have to rely on a domestic travel agency. The elderly are often attracted by "zero tour fees". For pension scams, see Section 17, Article 5 (Investment for Retirement Care). The beneficiaries are myself and my family.

Case: Lao Zhou participated in a low-price tour group and was dragged by the tour guide to a jade shop to buy a bracelet worth 20,000 yuan. On the 10th day after returning, he went to the travel agency with his itinerary and shopping receipt and asked to return the goods within 30 days. The travel agency paid 20,000 yuan in advance.

items.title: For financial management products recommended by bank employees, first check them on the bank's own app or official website before buying them. If you can't find them, they may be "flying orders" sold privately by employees.
items.core: Bank employees privately sell products that are not issued by the bank and are not authorized to be sold on their behalf, which is called "flying orders." Products sold by banks can only be sold in the bank’s branches, official website and app. They can also be found in these places. If you can’t find them, don’t buy them yet. Being cheated by flying orders, some courts ordered banks to bear half of the losses. There are also cases involving securities business departments where no compensation was awarded in the first instance, but only part of the compensation was awarded in the second instance.
body: Cost: No money. Before buying, search the product name in the bank app or official website for a few minutes. The hard thing is to say to a familiar account manager, "I'll check it out myself first."

Income: Beijing No. 3 Intermediate People's Court said that "flying orders" for financial management are staff of financial institutions who use their work convenience to privately sell third-party products that are not issued by their own units and are not authorized to be sold on an agency basis. Regulations from the State Administration of Financial Supervision in 2025 state that banks that sell products from other institutions can only set up special sales areas in their own channels such as the bank’s business outlets, official websites and apps. The bank must provide an inquiry on consignment products through its own channels, indicating whether it is consigned, what type it is, and who issued it. Banks are not allowed to mix consignment products with deposits and the bank's own products. The homepage of the promotional materials for consignment products must state: "This product is issued and managed by XX institution (cooperating institution). XX Bank, as the consignment institution, does not bear the responsibility for the investment and redemption of the product." Which salesperson can sell which products must be authorized by the bank and announced at the branch. To sell at an outlet, audio and video recording is required. Banks and employees are not allowed to “privately promote or sell unapproved products under the guise of their institutions” (National, starting from October 1, 2025). Beijing No. 3 Intermediate People's Court reported a case in 2022. In 2013, a bank financial manager told a customer that a certain product was a hit for the bank and that the bank was the custodian bank. The client signed the "Joining Agreement" of a fund company and transferred 1.2 million yuan to the fund company's account. Later, the principal was not returned and the actual controller of the fund company was jailed. The court held that employees taking advantage of their positions to promote products during working hours and at the work place were regarded as official conduct. Customers are unilaterally pursuing high interest rates, and they are also at fault. In the first trial, the bank and the customer each shouldered half of the losses, and in the second trial, the decision was upheld. The Supreme People's Court, the People's Bank of China, the State Administration of Financial Supervision, and the China Securities Regulatory Commission jointly issued a typical case in October 2026. The person in charge of a securities sales department privately sold private equity funds that were not authorized by the sales department, and the customer invested 1 million yuan. The client sued in August 2023, but the first instance was dismissed. The second instance found that the sales department was at fault, and the customer himself was also at fault, and the judgment was changed to compensate the sales department 577,000 yuan (accurate value: 576,716.97 yuan). The case number was 2024 (National, 2022, 2026)
Level of Evidence: B

Source: State Financial Supervision and Administration (2025). Measures for the Management of Agency Sales Business of Commercial Banks (Golden Regulations [2025] 6 No. 32, 33, 34, 39, 41, 43, 54). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202503/content_7015054.htm>; Beijing No. 3 Intermediate People’s Court (2022-05-08). Case microcosm｜Who will compensate for my losses if I encounter financial management “flying orders”? . <https://bj3zy.bjcourt.gov.cn/article/detail/2022/05/id/6713358.shtml>; Supreme People’s Court, People’s Bank of China, State Financial Supervision and Administration, China Securities Regulatory Commission (2026-10-12). Typical cases on the protection of the legitimate rights and interests of financial consumers and investors (Case 3, (2024) Wan 05 Min Zhong No. 1088). <https://www.court.gov.cn/zixun/xiangqing/513941.html>; National People’s Congress (2020). Article 1191 of the Civil Code. <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=ff808081729d1efe01729d50b5c500bf>

Note: Article 1191 of the Civil Code stipulates that if a staff member causes damage to others due to the performance of work tasks, the employer shall bear tort liability. Therefore, the bank's statement that "this is an employee's personal behavior" does not mean that it will not have to pay compensation. How much you pay depends on how much fault the bank and you have. To get your money back you usually have to go to court. The ordinary procedure of first instance is stipulated to be completed within 6 months, which can be extended, and the lawyer's fees will be paid by himself. Complain to the bank first. If you cannot reach an agreement, call 12378. See Article 43 of this section (if you feel you have been misled, call 12378). Even if the product is actually sold by the bank, the bank is not responsible for the payment. For those with ridiculously high returns, see Article 6 of this section (just walk away when you see high returns). Whether the contract in hand is insurance or deposit, see Article 42 of this section (see clearly whether it is deposit or insurance). If there are elderly people in the family, make a rule of double confirmation for large expenditures. See Section 17, Article 3 (Set a rule of double confirmation for large expenditures). The beneficiaries are yourself and the elderly in your family. It does not constitute investment advice.

Case: The bank account manager privately recommended an "internal high-interest financial management" to Ms. Lin, promising an annual interest rate of 8%. Ms. Lin kept an eye out and couldn't find the product after repeated searches on the bank's official website and app, so she decisively refused. Later, the manager was investigated for flying orders.

items.title: Don’t take multivitamins to live longer or prevent cardiovascular disease
items.core: 14,000 male doctors took multivitamins for eleven years. There are just as many people who have serious problems with their hearts and blood vessels and die as those who don't eat. Looking at 9 trials and more than 50,000 people together, there is no effect on death. If you don't buy it, you can save two hundred to seven hundred yuan a year. People who are found to be deficient in certain nutrients and pregnant women should not take folic acid supplements.
body: Cost: About 0.5 to 2 yuan a day, 200 to 700 yuan a year. Eating it takes no time, just one grain. After eating for a long time, it is easy to become dependent. If you don't eat on a day, it will feel like you have done something less.

Benefits: The PHS II trial looked at 14,641 male doctors and followed them for 11.2 years (that's the median, half longer and half shorter). People who eat and people who don't eat have the same rate of cardiovascular problems. Major cardiovascular events HR 1.01 (HR is the hazard ratio, 1 means both sides are the same). The 95% CI 0.91–1.10 is the credible range for this number. The same was true for death, with HR for all-cause death 0.94 (0.88–1.02). The USPSTF, the U.S. agency that rates preventive measures, combined nine randomized controlled trials with 51,550 people in 2022 and found that there was no association between multidimensional tablets and total deaths. Rating I means insufficient evidence and unclear explanation. It seems cost-effective because "one tablet provides all the nutrients" sounds right, and it only costs a few cents a day
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Sesso HD et al. (2012). Multivitamins in the prevention of cardiovascular disease in men: the Physicians' Health Study II randomized controlled trial. JAMA. <https://doi.org/10.1001/jama.2012.14805>; US Preventive Services Task Force (2022). Vitamin, Mineral, and Multivitamin Supplementation to Prevent Cardiovascular Disease and Cancer. JAMA. <https://doi.org/10.1001/jama.2022.8970>; Gaziano JM et al (2012). Multivitamins in the Prevention of Cancer in Men. <https://doi.org/10.1001/jama.2012.14641>(The cancer result in the remarks)

Remarks: Controversy: The same group of male doctors also saw cancer. People who ate had about an 8% lower risk of cancer (0.86–0.998, P = 0.04, just barely above the “not like chance” line). The risk of dying from cancer is about 12% lower (0.77–1.01). The range spans 1, so it could just be chance. This benefit is small and has only been seen in male doctors. People who are found to be deficient in nutrients, pregnant women (folic acid supplements), and people who usually eat very eccentric foods are not included. They should supplement according to the doctor's advice

Case: Lao Wu listened to the sales pitch and took multivitamins every day, spending more than 500 yuan a year. Three years later, during the physical examination, my blood pressure and blood lipids were no different from those of my old friend who also took no medicine. He stopped taking supplements and saved the money to buy fresh vegetables.

items.title: Don't eat ordinary fish oil to prevent cardiovascular disease
items.core: Two large trials found 26,000 and 15,000 diabetic patients respectively. People who take 1 gram of fish oil a day have just as many cardiovascular and cerebrovascular accidents and deaths as those who don't. "Eating fish is good for you" does not mean "eating fish oil capsules is good for you". If you don't buy it, you can save 400 to 1,000 yuan a year.
body: Cost: About 1 to 3 yuan a day, 400 to 1,000 yuan a year. Eating it takes no time.

Benefits: The VITAL trial found 25,871 people who took 1 gram of fish oil per day and followed them for a median of 5.3 years. There is no difference between cardiovascular disease and death. The HR for major cardiovascular events was 0.92 (HR is the hazard ratio, 1 means both sides are the same). The 95% CI 0.80–1.06 is the credible range for this number. It crosses 1, indicating no difference is visible. HR for all-cause death 1.02 (0.90–1.15). The ASCEND trial looked at 15,480 diabetic patients, also taking 1 gram per day, and followed them for an average of 7.4 years, and again no difference was seen. Serious vascular events RR 0.97 (0.87–1.08). All-cause death RR 0.95 (0.86–1.05). It seems cost-effective because many people directly regard "eating fish is good" as "eating fish oil capsules is good"
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Manson JE et al. (2019). Marine n-3 Fatty Acids and Prevention of Cardiovascular Disease and Cancer. NEJM. <https://doi.org/10.1056/NEJMoa1811403>; ASC StudyEND Collaborative Group (2018). Effects of n-3 Fatty Acid Supplements in Diabetes Mellitus. NEJM. <https://doi.org/10.1056/NEJMoa1804989>; Bhatt DL et al. (2019). Cardiovascular Risk Reduction with Icosapent Ethyl for Hypertriglyceridemia. New England Journal of Medicine. <https://doi.org/10.1056/NEJMoa1812792> (The high-purity prescription fish oil test in the notes)

Note: Controversy: There is a trial that is effective. The REDUCE-IT trial looked at 8,179 people with pre-existing cardiovascular disease or diabetes who were taking statins and had elevated triglycerides (135–499 mg/dL). They took a prescription drug containing 4 g of pure EPA per day and had an incident 17.2% versus 22.0% of the time. The risk was about a quarter lower (HR 0.75, 0.68–0.83). But those are high-dose prescription drugs for high-risk patients, which does not mean that ordinary people take fish oil as a health product. This does not include eating fish itself

Case: Lao Wang has a relative who sells deep-sea fish oil, saying it can prevent strokes. He took it for two years and spent more than a thousand yuan. An annual physical examination showed that he had the same carotid artery plaque as his neighbor who never took fish oil. He stopped taking the medication and switched to eating steamed fish twice a week.

items.title: Don’t supplement vitamin D to people who are not deficient in vitamin D for longevity
items.core: If people who are not deficient in vitamin D are supplemented for 5 years, the number of cancers, cardiovascular diseases and deaths will be the same as those who do not supplement. Adults who rarely go out and don’t get much sunlight can take 400 IU a day, but no more than 2,000 IU a day. If you take it in large doses, you will lose more bone density and suffer more falls. Fatigue alone cannot be considered as vitamin D deficiency. If you are tired for a few weeks and cannot explain the reason, go see a doctor.
body: Cost: about 0.2 to 0.5 yuan a day, 100 to 200 yuan a year. The money is not much, the real price is thinking that you have taken precautions.

Benefits: The VITAL trial found 25,871 people eating 2000 IU per day and followed them for a median of 5.3 years. Cancer, cardiovascular disease, and death made no difference. The HR for the type of cancer that spreads is 0.96 (HR is the hazard ratio, where 1 means both sides are the same; 95% CI 0.88–1.06 is the confidence range). HR for major cardiovascular events 0.97 (0.85–1.12). HR for all-cause death 0.99 (0.87–1.12). The D-Health trial looked at 21,315 Australians aged over 60. They took 60,000 IU per month for 5 years and were followed for a median of 5.7 years. No difference was seen in this item, with HR for all-cause death 1.04 (0.93–1.18). The ratio of deaths was 5.3% to 5.1%. It seems cost-effective because some studies only track records without any intervention and find that people with low vitamin D levels die more. This has been misinterpreted as "supplementation will work." People who rarely leave the house have another set of suggestions. The British Ministry of Health recommends that adults who rarely go out, live in nursing homes, and whose clothes cover most of their skin when going out should take 10 micrograms of vitamin D every day throughout the year. The NHS states that 1 microgram equals 40 IU, so 10 micrograms is 400 IU. my country’s health industry standards recommend 10 micrograms per day for adults aged 18 to 64, and 15 micrograms for those over 65 years old. The tolerable maximum intake given by the same serving standard is 50 micrograms (2000 IU) per day, because eating too much can cause excessive blood calcium. The NHS limit for adults is a wider 100 micrograms (4000 IU). There are many causes of fatigue, the NHS lists them as not getting enough sleep, stress and depression, iron deficiency anemia, diabetes, hyperthyroidism and sleep apnea. It recommends seeing a doctor if you feel tired for a few weeks and cannot explain the cause, or if it affects your daily life. More is not better. VITAL also accounted for fractures, and those taking 2000 IU per day were the same as those taking no supplements (HR 0.98, 0.89–1.08). VITAL also looked at depression in 18,353 of those over 50 who were not depressed at the time. There were 12.9 cases of depression or relapse per 1,000 person-years among those who took supplements and 13.3 cases per 1,000 person-years among those who did not take supplements, with no difference (HR 0.97, 0.87–1.09). There was also no difference in sentiment scores. The authors state that the results do not support the use of vitamin D supplements to prevent depression in adults. A Canadian trial looked at 311 healthy people aged 55 to 70 without osteoporosis. They were divided into three groups and took 400, 4000, and 10,000 IU per day for 3 years. The higher the dose, the more the bone density of the radius bone in the wrist dropped, with the three groups decreasing by 1.2%, 2.4% and 3.5% respectively. No difference was seen in the compressive strength of the bones. The authors concluded that this does not support the benefit of high-dose vitamin D supplementation to bone. A Swiss experiment looked at 200 people over the age of 70 who had fallen. They took 24,000 IU or 60,000 IU per month for a year. The leg and foot function of the 60,000 IU group did not improve, but more people fell in a year (66.9% vs. 47.9%). An Australian trial looked at 2,256 women over the age of 70 who took 500,000 IU once every fall and winter. They had about 15% more falls (RR 1.15, 1.02–1.30) and about 26% more fractures (RR 1.26, 1.00–1.59)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Manson JE et al. (2019). Vitamin D Supplements and Prevention of Cancer and Cardiovascular Disease. NEJM. <https://doi.org/10.1056/NEJMoa1809944>; Neale RE et al. (2022). The D-Health Trial: a randomized controlled trial of the effect of vitamin D on mortality. Lancet Diabetes Endocrinol. <https://www.nhs.uk/conditions/vitamins-and-minerals/vitamin-d/>; NHS. Tiredness and fatigue. <https://www.nhs.uk/symptoms/tiredness-and-fatigue/>; National Health Commission. WS/T 578.4—2018 Reference intake of dietary nutrients for Chinese residents Part 4: Fat-soluble vitamins, Table 1. LeBoff MS et al. (2022). Supplemental Vitamin D and Incident Fractures in Midlife and Older Adults. NEJM. <https://doi.org/10.1056/NEJMoa2202106>; Burt LA et al. (2019). Effect of High-Dose Vitamin D Supplementation on Volumetric Bone Density and Bone Strength: A Randomized Clinical Trial. JAMA. <https://doi.org/10.1001/jama.2019.11889>; Bischoff-Ferrari HA et al. (2016). Monthly High-Dose Vitamin D Treatment for the Prevention of Functional Decline: A Randomized Clinical Trial. JAMA Intern Med. <https://doi.org/10.1001/jamainternmed.2015.7148>; Sanders KM et al. al. (2010). Annual high-dose oral vitamin D and falls and fractures in older women: a randomized controlled trial. JAMA. <https://doi.org/10.1210/jc.2015-2175>; Mondal K et al. (2014). A Randomized controlled trial on safety and efficacy of single intramuscular versus staggered oral dose of 600 000IU Vitamin D in treatment of nutritional rickets. J Trop Pediatr. <https://doi.org/10.1093/tropej/fmt105>; Okereke OI et al. (2020). Effect of Long-term Vitamin D3 Supplementation vs Placebo on Risk of Depression or Clinically Relevant Depressive Symptoms and on Change in Mood Scores: A Randomized Clinical Trial. JAMA. <https://doi.org/10.1001/jama.2020.10224>; Mikola T et al. (2023). The effect of vitamin D supplementation on depressive symptoms in adults: A systematic review and meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials. Crit Rev Food Sci Nutr. <https://doi.org/10.1080/10408398.2022.2096560>; Ghaemi S et al. (2024). The effect of vitamin D supplementation on depression: a systematic review and dose-response meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials. Psychol Med. <https://doi.org/10.1017/s0033291724001697>

Note: Controversy: Neither VITAL nor D-Health deliberately recruit people who are truly vitamin D deficient, so the conclusion only applies to "people who are not deficient in the first place." For those who are found to be deficient, those with osteoporosis, and infants and young children, it is better to supplement according to the doctor's instructions. Severe deficiencies do not require injections. The 2016 global consensus on rickets recommends oral administration because oral administration is faster than intramuscular injection. One trial looked at 61 children with rickets. One group received an injection of 600,000 IU once, and the other group received 60,000 IU orally every week for 10 weeks. After 12 weeks, there were no differences in laboratory tests or radiographs between the two groups. After taking the amount prescribed by the doctor, you should have a reexamination. If you still can't make up the amount, ask the doctor to check whether there is an absorption problem. People who don’t get enough sun should take 400 IU a day to prevent deficiency. Health industry standards state that vitamin D deficiency can lead to rickets, osteomalacia and osteoporosis. This does not mean that it can prevent cancer and heart disease, nor does it mean that it can cure fatigue. If the doctor prescribes a different dose for you, take it as the doctor says. There are different opinions on whether supplementation is useful for people who are already depressed. A 2023 analysis of 41 trials saw a small decrease in depression scores, but the results varied widely across studies, with the authors giving the lowest quality of evidence. If you break down the 2024 article by duration, you won’t be able to see the effect if you follow the experiment for more than a year. If you have depression, go to a psychiatrist or psychological department first. Do not take vitamin D as a substitute for treatment. Here I looked at total death, cancer, cardiovascular, bones, wrestling and depression, but nothing else. How to supplement infants, see Section 20, Item 16 (feed 400 IU of vitamin D daily).

Case: An office worker’s annual physical examination showed normal vitamin D levels. He heard from a friend that vitamin D supplementation can help him live longer, so he took 1,000IU supplements every day. Five years later, the physical examination showed that the calcium index was normal, the bone density had not improved, and I still often felt weak. The doctor recommended that I stop taking supplements and observe.

items.title: Don’t take antioxidant supplements (beta carotene, vitamin E, vitamin A) to prevent cancer
items.core: Antioxidant supplements are not just useless. A total of 78 trials and nearly 300,000 people were taken together. In the batch of trials with more rigorous design, the mortality rate of those who ate it was slightly higher. In two large trials specifically looking at smokers, beta carotene increased the risk of lung cancer by 18% to 28%. Deaths were also 8 to 17 percent higher. Smokers and people who have been exposed to asbestos should especially not eat it.
body: Cost: About 0.5 to 2 yuan a day. For smokers, the real cost is the increased risk of lung cancer.

Benefits: Cochrane combined 78 randomized controlled trials with 296,707 people. For people who took antioxidant supplements, the overall mortality RR was 1.02 (RR is the relative risk, 1 means both sides are the same; 95% CI 0.98–1.05 is the confidence range). Looking only at the batch of experiments with more rigorous design and less prone to deviation, the RR is 1.04 (1.01–1.07), which is slightly higher. Looking at β-carotene alone RR 1.05 (1.01–1.09), looking at vitamin E alone RR 1.03 (1.00–1.05). The ATBC trial found 29,133 male smokers who ate 20 mg per day and had an 18% higher risk of developing lung cancer (3%–36%) and an 8% higher risk of overall death (1%–16%). The CARET trial looked at 18,314 people who smoked or had been exposed to asbestos. Their risk of lung cancer was approximately 28% higher (RR 1.28, 1.04–1.57). The risk of death was approximately 17% higher (all-cause death RR 1.17, 1.03–1.33). It seems cost-effective because every step of the reasoning chain of "Anti-oxidation is anti-aging, and anti-aging can prevent cancer" sounds like common sense.
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Bjelakovic G et al. (2012). Antioxidant supplements for prevention of mortality in healthy participants and patients with various diseases. Cochrane Database Syst Rev. <https://doi.org/10.1002/14651858.CD007176.pub2>; The Alpha-Tocopherol, Beta Carotene Cancer Prevention Study Group (1994). The effect of vitamin E and beta carotene on the incidence of lung cancer and other cancers in male smokers. NEJM. Omenn GS et al. (1996). Effects of a combination of beta carotene and vitamin A on lung cancer and cardiovascular disease. NEJM. <https://doi.org/10.1056/NEJM199605023341802>

Note: The USPSTF, the official agency in the United States responsible for scoring preventive measures, gave beta carotene and vitamin E a D grade in 2022, which means it is recommended not to use them. Smokers and people exposed to asbestos have suffered from it. Antioxidants contained in fruits and vegetables are not included, so just eat them

Case: An old man with a 30-year history of smoking heard that beta carotene can prevent cancer and took supplements every day. Two years later, a physical examination revealed nodules in the lungs, and he was diagnosed with lung cancer. The doctor pointed out that his illness may be related to supplements that promote oxidation of lung cells.

items.title: Don’t expect glucosamine/chondroitin to cure knee arthritis
items.core: 60% of people with knee osteoarthritis took fake medicines for 24 weeks and said they were less painful. People who took glucosamine or chondroitin only had an increase of four or five percentage points, so small that it might just be a coincidence. Spending 700 to 1800 yuan a year, the effect is basically the same as taking fake medicine.
body: Cost: About 2 to 5 yuan a day, 700 to 1800 yuan a year.

Benefits: The GAIT trial looked at 1,583 patients with knee osteoarthritis for 24 weeks. Among those who took placebo (fake medicine), 60.1% said their pain was relieved. Glucosamine was only 3.9 percentage points higher (P=0.30). Chondroitin was 5.3 percentage points higher (P=0.17). Eating both together was 6.5 percentage points higher (P=0.09). These differences are too small to rule out that they are just coincidence. The real drug, celecoxib, used as a control in the same trial, was 10.0 percentage points higher (P=0.008). It looks like a good deal because the "cartilage-replenishing raw materials" sound just right for the symptoms, and 60% of people who take the fake medicine alone say it is effective
Level of Evidence: A
Source: Clegg DO et al. (2006). Glucosamine, chondroitin sulfate, and the two in combination for painful knee osteoarthritis. NEJM. <https://doi.org/10.1056/NEJMoa052771>

Note: Controversy: In the same experiment, the effective rate of the group of people who had severe pain at the beginning was 79.2%, and the effective rate of taking the two things together was 79.2%, and the control group was 54.3% (P=0.002). But the author said that this was dug out from the data afterwards and can only be used as a clue and not as a conclusion. The truly evidence-based approach to knee arthritis is to lose weight and build muscle. See Article 33 of this section (Arthroscopic Cleansing)

Case: A retired teacher with knee pain listened to the advertisement and bought amino sugar and ate it on time every day. After taking it for 24 weeks, the pain was only slightly relieved, almost the same as my neighbor who took a placebo. I spent 1,200 yuan a year and stopped taking the medicine because I felt it was not worth it.

items.title: Don’t rely on vitamin C to prevent colds
items.core: Eating vitamin C every day will basically not prevent you from catching a cold. If you start taking it when you have a cold, the effect will be inconsistent. Eating it every day can shorten a cold by about 8%. You have to decide whether it is worth three to five hundred dollars a year. Marathon runners and soldiers marching in cold areas are exceptions, and they can reduce the risk of catching colds by half.
body: Cost: One effervescent tablet costs about 1 to 2 yuan, 300 to 700 yuan per year.

Revenue: Cochrane combined 29 controlled trials, 11,306 people. Ordinary people taking vitamin C every day will hardly reduce the number of colds they get. The proportion of getting a cold is RR 0.97 (RR is the relative risk, 1 means both sides are the same). The 95% CI 0.94–1.00 is the confidence range. The original article said that "no consistent effect was found" in those trials where people started taking it after they had a cold: some trials were effective, and some were not. In the same review, long-term daily consumption can shorten the duration of cold discomfort by approximately 8% (adults, 95% CI 3%–12%) and 14% (7%–21%) in children. Marathon runners, skiers, and soldiers marching in cold areas are exceptions. Among 598 people in 5 trials, about half as many people got colds. Incidence rate RR 0.48 (95% CI 0.35–0.64). It seems cost-effective because it is cheap, sweet and sour, and the saying "Vitamin C prevents colds" has been spread for half a century
Level of Evidence: A
Source: Hemilä H, Chalker E (2013). Vitamin C for preventing and treating the common cold. Cochrane Database Syst Rev. <https://doi.org/10.1002/14651858.CD000980.pub4>

Note: Controversy: In the same review, eating it every day can indeed shorten the duration of cold discomfort. It is shortened by about 8% (3%–12%) in adults and 14% (7%–21%) in children. Calculating, one cold will save you about half a day. Marathon runners, skiers, and soldiers marching in cold areas are exceptions. Across 5 trials and 598 people, about half as many people got colds (RR 0.48, 0.35–0.64). The vast majority of people do not fall into these two categories

Case: An office worker who often catches colds takes vitamin C tablets every day and still catches colds 4 times a year, each time lasting a week. After stopping, I switched to drinking warm water and resting more. The number of colds did not increase, and I saved 360 yuan on supplements a year.

items.title: Don't do "whole-body PET-CT" or "tumor marker package" on yourself who are asymptomatic
items.core: Checking people who are asymptomatic, the most common findings are false alarms. More than 80% of people who undergo whole-body CT scans find at least one "abnormality" and nearly 40% are called back for review, but most of them are benign. When women check for ovarian cancer markers, there are many who die from ovarian cancer, and some people undergo surgery in vain because of a false alarm.
body: Cost: A full-body PET-CT costs about 7,000 to 10,000 yuan, and it also requires exposure to ionizing radiation. The tumor marker package costs several hundred yuan. The real cost is later: the detection of an "abnormality" is actually a false alarm (this is called a false positive). The subsequent re-examination, tissue testing, and surgery are all money and crime.

Benefit: The USPSTF, the US organization that rates preventive measures, gave CA-125 and ultrasound screening for ovarian cancer in asymptomatic women a grade of D, meaning it is recommended not to be done. Based on PLCO test. The proportion of deaths due to ovarian cancer was 0.34% in the screening group and 0.29% in the conventional group. RR 1.18 (95% CI 0.82–1.71). There is no benefit in checking. The proportion of unintended surgeries due to wrong tests (false positives) ranged from 0.2% to 3.25% in each trial, and up to 15% of these people suffered serious surgical complications. Another study gave 1,192 asymptomatic people a whole-body CT screening. 86% of them found at least one "anomaly" and 37% were recommended for further investigation. The original article states that "most findings are described as benign." It seems cost-effective because "one-time full body examination, early detection and early treatment" is so intuitive
Level of Evidence: A

Source: US Preventive Services Task Force (2018). Screening for Ovarian Cancer: US Preventive Services Task Force Recommendation Statement. JAMA (the same recommendation is also available on the USPSTF official page). Furtado CD et al. (2005). Whole-body CT screening: spectrum of findings and recommendations in 1192 patients. Radiology. <https://doi.org/10.1148/radiol.2372041741>

Note: The tumor marker part is supported by randomized controlled trials. For whole-body CT and PET-CT, there are only follow-up records such as "seeing what happened to the people who had it done." There is no group comparison, and the evidence is weaker, equivalent to level B. The few screenings for which there is real evidence, such as colorectal cancer, cervical cancer, breast cancer, and low-dose chest CT for high-risk people, are another matter, see Section 1. If people who already have symptoms or who have been diagnosed with cancer undergo PET-CT, it is a medical treatment and not a screening. It is a different matter.

Case: An asymptomatic woman paid for a whole-body PET-CT and found nodules in her lungs, which made her sleepless all night. After re-examination, it was confirmed that it was a benign calcification. The examination fee was 8,000 yuan in vain and I was shocked.

items.title: Don’t expect the exercise quantification of bracelets/watches to help you lose weight
items.core: Overweight people make the same diet and exercise arrangements. People who wear exercise bracelets lose 3.5 kilograms in two years, while people who don’t wear them lose 5.9 kilograms. If you want to lose weight, equipment is not something you have to spend money on.
body: Cost: Equipment 200 to 2,000 yuan. In addition, I have to distract myself from looking at the data every day.

Benefits: The IDEA trial followed 471 overweight or obese adults for 24 months. Everyone has the same diet and exercise schedule, the only difference is whether they wear wearable devices or not. The wearing group lost 3.5 kg (95% CI 2.6–4.5, which is the confidence range). The non-wearing group lost 5.9 kg (5.0–6.8), but more. The difference between the two groups was 2.4 kg (1.0–3.7, P=0.002). It seems cost-effective because the saying "Quantify can manage" sounds reasonable, and the equipment can be purchased once and done
Level of Evidence: B

Source: Jakicic JM et al. (2016). Effect of Wearable Technology Combined With a Lifestyle Intervention on Long-term Weight Loss: The IDEA Randomized Clinical Trial. JAMA. <https://doi.org/10.1001/jama.2016.12858>

Note: This is only one trial, and it used a device worn on the arm in the early 2010s. It cannot be said that "all wearable devices are useless." The movement itself is valid, see Section 2. There is only one conclusion: if you want to lose weight, you don’t have to spend money on equipment

Case: Two people with the same weight started to lose weight at the same time. They both controlled their diet and walked briskly every day. One person spent 1,500 yuan to buy a sports bracelet to record steps, while the other person did not buy it. After half a year, those who wore the bracelets lost 3 kilograms, and those who did not wear them lost 5 kilograms.

items.title: Don’t pay a premium to buy organic food just for the sake of being “healthier”
items.core: There is no strong evidence that organic food is more nutritious. There are only three studies that actually looked at people's health after eating it, and none of them found any difference. The proportion of pesticide residues detected in organic agricultural products is indeed 30 percentage points lower, but the detection does not mean that it exceeds the standard.
body: Cost: Generally 1 to 3 times the price of similar ordinary food.

Benefits: There was a systematic review that combined 17 studies in humans and 223 studies measuring food ingredients. The conclusion was that "there is a lack of strong evidence that organic foods are significantly more nutritious than conventional foods." Only 3 studies here looked at people's health after eating it (looking at allergies and symptomatic infections), and no difference was seen between the two. The proportion of pesticide residues detected in organic agricultural products is 30 percentage points lower, but the detection does not mean that it exceeds the standard. It seems cost-effective because "without pesticides, it is safer, and safer means healthier", and every step sounds like common sense
Level of Evidence: B

Source: Smith-Spangler C et al. (2012). Are organic foods safer or healthier than conventional alternatives?: a systematic review. Ann Intern Med. <https://doi.org/10.7326/0003-4819-157-5-201209040-00007>

Note: There are very few studies that directly look at people’s health after eating it. So the conclusion is "there is no evidence that it is better", not "it has been proven that it is not beneficial". The impact on the environment, animal welfare, and whether it tastes good or not are irrelevant here. Eating more fruits and vegetables is effective in itself, whether they are organic or not does not affect this

Case: A couple always choose expensive organic vegetables when shopping, thinking they are more nutritious. A year later, their physical examination showed that their blood routine and trace element indicators were the same as those of their friends who often ate ordinary vegetables. They spent an extra 3,000 yuan on psychological comfort.

items.title: Don’t spend a lot of money to buy health products, ointments, and tonics to "condition your body"
items.core: I have checked the first six items in this section for common ingredients such as multivitamins, fish oil, and vitamin D, but none of them are found to be effective. The sentence "Health foods are not medicines and cannot replace drugs to treat diseases" on the packaging is required by the regulations of the health food department. If the money is used to buy it for parents and bring it to their door, there is nothing wrong with their intention, but they just chose the wrong thing.
body: Cost: ranging from a few hundred yuan to tens of thousands of yuan. After being made into gift packages, the price often increases several times.

Income: What you get in exchange is the money saved. The reasons are in the first 6 of this section. The most common ingredients in health care products, including multivitamins, fish oil, vitamin D, antioxidants, aminoglycosides, and vitamin C, have not shown the expected benefits in randomized controlled trials. The respective numbers are in the income column of those 6 items. Regulations only describe what it claims and cannot be taken as evidence that it is useless. The State Administration for Market Regulation stipulates that no less than 20% of the front of health food packaging must be marked with a sentence: "Health food is not a drug and cannot replace drugs to treat diseases." The same regulations also limit the purpose of health foods to the scope of "supplementing dietary nutrients, maintaining and improving the body's health, or reducing risk factors for disease." It seems cost-effective because the saying "does not cure diseases, only regulates" is not wrong no matter how you say it, and no one can prove it to be false. Moreover, paying this amount of money when giving gifts relies on favors, not evidence
Evidence level: C

Source: State Administration for Market Regulation (2019). The State Administration for Market Regulation held a special press conference on the "Guidelines for Labeling and Warning Phrases of Health Foods" and the "Administrative Measures for the Catalog of Health Food Raw Materials and Health Function Catalogs". <https://www.samr.gov.cn/tssps/sjdt/tpxw/art/2023/art_4b658b824b1b4b0ba57c09a56cc93aad.html>

Note: The conclusion is "not supported by evidence", not "proven invalid", so it is only given a C grade. For products with clearly stated ingredients, follow the first few items to check the corresponding research. People who are found to be deficient in nutrients or who are undergoing medical treatment should follow the doctor's instructions. Or what is lost is the product, not the intention. If the old man bought something himself and is already taking it, as long as he does not use it to replace the medicine he is taking, and there is no problem with taking it, there is no need to come to the door to fight. It is more important to arrange the vaccines that should be administered and the screenings that should be done. The same money can be exchanged for the following items, each of which can be found in the book. Accompany an older person to get their annual flu shot, see Section 1, No. 20. See Section 1, Item 21 for shingles vaccine after age 50. Pneumococcal vaccine for those over 65 years of age, see Section 1, Article 22. Buy a blood pressure monitor and watch him take the antihypertensive medicine as prescribed by the doctor to lower his blood pressure to the target. See Section 1, Item 7. Modify the bathroom and stairs at home and work with him on balance and leg strength, see Section 1, Item 13. When he is older, go for a cancer screening with him. See Section 1, Items 17 to 19. For elderly people who have been bedridden for a long time, see Section 17, Items 7 and 8 for pressure ulcer protection and long-term care insurance. If you have to carry something to the door, replace it with fruits, rice noodles, or something he likes to eat, which is more practical than the ointment. What we really want to stop are two types: one is investment for retirement, and the other is that it will replace the medicine, see Section 17, Article 5

Case: An old man spent 2,000 yuan to buy protein powder, fish oil and other health products as gifts to his parents during the Spring Festival. The old man insisted on taking them for half a year. The physical examination showed that blood pressure and blood sugar were no different from six months ago. The doctor reminded that these are not as effective as eating a balanced diet and taking medicine on time.

items.title: Don’t take probiotics for a long time when there are no intestinal problems
items.core: 45 experiments on healthy adults. Taken together, taking probiotics cannot change the bacteria in the intestines in the long term, and it will return to the original state after stopping. Blood lipids also did not improve. There is other evidence for specific situations such as diarrhea caused by taking antibiotics, which is not included in this article.
body: Cost: About 2 to 5 yuan a day, 700 to 1800 yuan a year.

Benefits: A review of 45 trials in healthy adults concluded that they "failed to support the idea that probiotics can cause lasting changes in the gut microbiota or improve blood lipids in healthy adults." The bacteria in the intestines do change, but it is only temporary and will go back when it stops. It seems cost-effective because the term "gut health" is broad enough to apply to any application, and the unit price of one bottle per day is very low
Level of Evidence: B
Source: Khalesi S et al. (2019). A review of probiotic supplementation in healthy adults: helpful or hype? Eur J Clin Nutr. <https://doi.org/10.1038/s41430-018-0135-9>

Note: The same review also said that there were some small improvements in healthy people, such as the stools being more formed, soft and hard, and there were more lactobacilli in the vagina of women. Diarrhea caused by taking antibiotics and the use of a specific bacterial strain for a specific disease each have separate evidence and are discussed separately. This is only for healthy people to take as a health supplement every day

Case: My friend’s physical examination was fine, but I heard that probiotics are good, so I spent more than 2,000 to buy them for half a year. After I stopped, my fecal test returned to before, and my blood lipids did not change. The doctor told him that 45 trials concluded that long-term consumption by healthy adults would be a waste of money, and he then stopped.

items.title: Don’t force yourself to take cold showers to “enhance immunity”
items.core: In one experiment, people who took cold showers reported 29% fewer days of absence from work due to illness. But I feel that I get sick for the same number of days as others, so I can’t say that I get sick less often. Looking at 11 trials in 2025, after flushing with cold water, the body's inflammation indicators temporarily increased, but the immunity indicators did not change. Wash it as much as you like, just don’t think of it as a health investment.
body: Cost: No money. You have to be miserable for 30 to 90 seconds every day. It takes perseverance to persevere in winter. People with cardiovascular disease should also be careful as cold stimulation is risky for them.

Benefits: The Netherlands conducted a randomized controlled trial in which 3,018 people took a hot bath followed by cold water for 30 seconds, 60 seconds or 90 seconds. These individuals had 29% fewer self-reported days of sickness absence (IRR 0.71, incidence rate ratio). But there was no significant difference between the two groups in the total number of days they felt sick. The study did not count the number of sick days taken. No meaningful differences were seen in quality of life, work productivity, and anxiety. A 2025 systematic review combined 11 randomized trials and 3,177 people. Immediately and 1 hour after soaking in cold water, the body's inflammation indicators increased. Immune indicators remained unchanged. The pressure only decreases at that point of 12 hours. The author himself said that the evidence is "limited by the few RCTs and small samples." This means that the number of such randomized group trials is too small and there are not many people in each test.
