The Ministry of Civil Affairs and the Ministry of Finance have decided how to issue documents by the end of 2025. For emergencies such as sudden changes, accidental injuries, and serious illnesses, "small sum quick relief" is adopted. The family's financial situation is not checked or disclosed. The processing time limit is generally no more than 3 days, and the highest level does not exceed the local minimum living standard of 1 month. Families on the margins of subsistence allowances and families with rigid expenditure difficulties who are in difficulty due to a sudden increase in expenses such as medical treatment and schooling will receive assistance after the public announcement, in principle, "once approval and phased disbursement." For temporary assistance other than small-amount quick assistance, the highest level shall not exceed 6 times the local monthly subsistence allowance standard (nationwide, starting from 2026, specific standards will be determined locally)
Level of Evidence: B

Source: State Council (2014, revised in 2019). Interim Measures for Social Assistance (State Council Order No. 649, Articles 47, 48, and 49). <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2019/content_5468952.htm>; National People’s Congress Standing Committee (2026). Social Assistance Law (July 1, 2026) Article 29, Paragraph 2 of Article 37, Article 50; Article 29: "For persons who encounter sudden, urgent, catastrophic and other difficulties that cause temporary serious difficulties in basic life, the social assistance management department shall provide temporary assistance by issuing relief funds or distributing in-kind goods." Article 2 Paragraph 2 of Article 37: “Applications for temporary assistance shall be made by the individual or the family members living with him or her to the township people’s government or sub-district office where the emergency occurs.” Article 50: “For applications for temporary assistance, if the situation is urgent, the amount of assistance is small, and immediate assistance measures are required, assistance shall be provided first.”). <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=016c39ca7739492cab1fe3aef22941c7>; Ministry of Civil Affairs and Ministry of Finance (2025). Opinions on further improving the temporary assistance system (Minfa [2025] 68 No. 1, 2, and 5 of the second part: "The processing time limit for "small quick relief" is generally no more than 3 days" "The highest-level assistance standard does not exceed the local one-month minimum living security standard" "In principle, the method of "one-time approval and phased disbursement" is adopted" "The highest-level assistance standard does not exceed 6 times the local monthly minimum living security standard"). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202601/content_7056503.htm>

Note: You are not required to be a minimum living security holder. The specific amount varies greatly from place to place, and is subject to the local announcement of the year. After the implementation of the Social Assistance Law, the "Interim Measures for Social Assistance" have not been expressly repealed and are still marked as valid as of October 2026 in the national laws and regulations database. Where there is any inconsistency between the two statements, the provisions of the law shall prevail.

Case: A fire broke out in Wang’s home at night, and the house and furniture were burned down. The couple had no place to live for a short period of time and no money to buy daily necessities. They are not low-income households. After submitting the fire certificate and ID card to the sub-district office, they received temporary relief funds within two days and solved the problem of food and housing first.

items.title: If your income is lower than the local subsistence allowance line, apply for the subsistence allowance. If it is slightly higher than the subsistence allowance line or if you spend more on medical treatment and schooling, apply for medical, education, housing, and employment assistance.
items.core: If the per capita income of the whole family is lower than the local subsistence allowance line and the property meets the regulations, you can apply. At the end of 2024, the average monthly subsistence allowance per person in urban cities nationwide was 798.1 yuan, and in rural areas it was 593.9 yuan. The money is paid according to the difference, or it can be paid in fixed amounts in stages. If your income is higher than the subsistence allowance line, or if you spend too much money on medical treatment and schooling, you can still apply for medical treatment, schooling, and housing assistance if you are not able to meet the subsistence allowance.
body: Cost: Nothing. Family members who live together must submit a written application to the township government or street office where the household registration is located. If it is inconvenient to do it yourself, you can entrust the village committee or neighborhood committee to do it on your behalf. Subject to household income and property verification. It usually takes 2 to 3 trips and brings your ID card, household register and proof of income and property. The difficulty is that you have to open up your family assets to others for inspection, and you have to wait for public announcement. For those who cannot afford the subsistence allowance, if they apply for assistance such as medical treatment, housing, or employment, they must go to the township government or sub-district office where their registered permanent residence is located. Apply for educational assistance from the school your child attends.

Income: If the family income divided by the number of people is lower than the local subsistence allowance standard, and the family property is within the specified range, you can receive subsistence allowance. At the end of 2024, the national average subsistence allowance standard in urban areas is 798.1 yuan/person·month, and in rural areas it is 593.9 yuan/person·month. The urban subsistence allowance covers 6.250 million people and the rural subsistence allowance covers 33.615 million people. The subsistence allowance is paid monthly based on the difference: the local subsistence allowance standard minus the family's per capita income. For example, if the local standard is 798.1 yuan, and each person in the family earns 500 yuan per month, each person will receive 298.1 yuan per month, not 798.1 yuan. The Social Assistance Law, which will be implemented in July 2026, also allows for the payment of fixed amounts in different levels: subsistence allowances "can be paid according to the actual difference between the family's per capita income and the local minimum living security standard, or it can be paid in fixed amounts in different levels." The subsistence allowance standard is set like this: take the per capita consumption expenditure of local residents in the previous year, multiply it by a quantitative ratio, and adjust it again after a period of time. To put it bluntly, it is calculated by taking the average amount of money spent by each person in the local area in the previous year (the national average, which varies from place to place). There are still two levels for those who cannot meet the subsistence allowance. The first category is called marginalized households: the property meets the regulations and the income per person in the family is less than 1.5 times the local minimum living standards (2023 national documents). The social assistance law that will take effect in July 2026 will be changed to a certain percentage of the provincial minimum living allowance standard. The second group is called families with rigid expenditure difficulties. The conditions are that the income per person in the family is lower than the per capita disposable income of local residents in the previous year, and the property meets the regulations. The proportion of non-essential expenses such as medical treatment and schooling in the family's income exceeds local regulations. Families in these two groups can receive medical assistance, education assistance, and housing assistance. Educational assistance includes fee exemptions, scholarships and living allowances, and student loans. Housing assistance in cities gives priority to public rental housing or rental subsidies. Families on the edge of subsistence allowances and families with rigid expenditure difficulties who are unemployed and able to work can also receive employment assistance. Severely disabled people and seriously ill patients in families on the edge of the subsistence allowance can be included in the subsistence allowance separately and receive monthly subsistence allowance (nationally, starting from 2023, the proportion and identification method will be determined by each locality)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: State Council (revised in 2014, 2019). Interim Measures for Social Assistance (State Council Order No. 649, Articles 9, 10, and 11; Article 12: "The civil affairs department of the people's government at the county level shall issue minimum living allowances on a monthly basis based on the difference between the per capita income of family members living together below the local minimum living allowance standard"). <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2019/content_5468952.htm>; National Bureau of Statistics (2025). Social undertakings are developing well and people's livelihood and well-being are continuously improving - Social and people's livelihood statistical report since the "14th Five-Year Plan". <https://www.gov.cn/lianbo/bumen/202509/content_7042627.htm>; Four departments including the Ministry of Civil Affairs (2024). Guiding Opinions on Further Improving the Determination and Adjustment of Minimum Living Security Standards (Minfa [2024] No. 16). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202403/content_7007237.htm>; General Office of the State Council (2023). Notice of forwarding the "Opinions on Strengthening the Dynamic Monitoring of Low-income Population and Implementing Stratified and Classified Social Assistance Work" issued by the Ministry of Civil Affairs and other units (State Council Issued [2023] 39 No. 2, Part 2: "Families that do not meet the conditions for minimum living security, but whose per capita household income is less than 1.5 times the local minimum living security standard, and whose family property status meets relevant local regulations, are identified as families on the margins of minimum living security"; Part 4: "Severely ill patients, severely disabled people and other people with special difficulties in families on the edge of minimum living security can be separately included in the scope of minimum living security"). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202310/content_6911066.htm>; General Office of the Ministry of Civil Affairs (2024). Notice on strengthening the identification and dynamic monitoring of low-income populations (Private Affairs Letter [2024] No. 31). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202405/content_6948767.htm>; National People’s Congress Standing Committee (2026). Social Assistance Law (July 1, 2026 Effective from the date of this announcement, Articles 18, 19, 21, 22, 24 to 27, 37, and 38; Paragraph 2 of Article 18: "The minimum living security allowance can be paid according to the actual difference between the family's per capita income and the local minimum living security standard, or it can be paid in fixed amounts in batches." Paragraph 3 of Article 21: "On the basis of the local minimum living security standard or the minimum living security guidance standard, a certain percentage shall be raised to determine the minimum living security marginal family standard"). <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=016c39ca7739492cab1fe3aef22941c7>

Note: Dibao is the last line of protection, and you have to go back to your place of residence to apply. If your family's house, car, or savings exceed local standards, or your children are able to support you, you may not be approved. There are other benefits after being approved: you will be subsidized by residents’ medical insurance (for residents’ medical insurance, see Article 9), you can get medical assistance when you see a doctor (see Article 10 for medical assistance), and you will not need to check for financial difficulties when applying for legal aid (see Article 3 for legal aid).

Case: The monthly per capita income of Li's family is more than 100 yuan higher than the local subsistence allowance line, but most of the income is spent on schooling for the children and medical treatment for the wife. After the neighborhood committee assisted him in submitting his medical records and tuition receipts, the family received medical and educational assistance even though they were not included in the subsistence allowance.

items.title: If you hold a disability certificate, you can apply for two subsidies for people with disabilities.
items.core: Disabled people living in subsistence allowance families can receive living allowances. If the disability level is level one or level two and requires long-term care, you can receive nursing subsidies, and you can receive both at the same time. Each province sets its own standards, which vary greatly. Ask the street for details. Bring your second-generation disability certificate and go to the street or town to apply for one.
body: Cost: Nothing. Just bring your disability certificate and go to the street or town to submit an application.

Benefits: The State Council has set two subsidies. The first item is the living subsidy for people with disabilities in need, which the document states is for "disabled people in subsistence allowance families. Where conditions permit, it can be gradually extended to low-income disabled people and other people with disabilities in need." This means that the disabled people living in subsistence allowance families will be provided first, and the system can be expanded to other areas if local financial resources allow. The second item is the nursing subsidy for severely disabled people, which the document states is for "severely disabled people whose disability level is assessed as level one or level two and who require long-term care." These two items can be obtained at the same time
Level of Evidence: A

Source: State Council (2015). Opinions on the Comprehensive Establishment of a Living Subsidy System for Disabled Persons with Needs and a Nursing Subsidy System for Severely Disabled Persons (Guofa [2015] No. 52). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2015-09/25/content_10181.htm>

Note: Standards are set by provincial governments and vary widely from place to place. You must bring your second-generation disability certificate when applying. If it is inconvenient for you, you can entrust a family member to do it on your behalf.

Case: Aunt Zhang is a low-income household with a secondary physical disability and needs to be taken care of by her son. She took her second-generation disability certificate to the street to apply for two subsidies. After passing the review, both living allowance and nursing allowance began to be paid.

items.title: Residents’ medical insurance is NT$400 per year, and can be waived for needy households.
items.core: Individuals pay starting at 400 yuan a year, and in 2025 the financial subsidy will be no less than 700 yuan per capita. The extremely poor people are fully subsidized, and the subsistence allowance recipients are subsidized at a fixed amount. There is a price for stopping payment: If you do not participate in insurance during the concentration period, or do not pay continuously, you will not be reimbursed for medical treatment for 3 months after payment. In principle, one additional month will be added for each additional year of suspension.
body: Cost: The portion paid by yourself shall not be less than 400 yuan per person per year. This is the national standard for 2024 and 2025, and various places can be higher than this. It must be paid within a fixed centralized payment period each year. The extremely poor people are fully subsidized, and all the money comes from the government. The subsistence allowance is a fixed amount of subsidy, and the government contributes a fixed part.

Income: In addition to the part paid by yourself, the finance department will make up an amount per capita. Not less than 670 yuan in 2024. In 2025, it will increase by 30 yuan compared with the previous year, and will not be less than 700 yuan, and the individual payment will still be no less than 400 yuan (Medical Insurance Development [2025] No. 22, reproduced according to provincial documents). The 2026 government work report said it would be raised by another 24 yuan. For subsistence allowance recipients and extremely poor people, if the medical expenses that meet the prescribed requirements after the medical insurance is completed, the remainder can be reimbursed through medical assistance at a rate of no less than 70%. The price of discontinuing payment is the waiting period. If you do not participate in the insurance during the centralized payment period, or do not pay continuously, there will be a 3-month waiting period for fixed benefits after the payment is completed, and medical treatment will not be reimbursed during this period. For every additional year, an additional month will be added in principle (from 2025, nationwide)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National Medical Insurance Administration (2024). Policy Interpretation of "Notice on Carrying out Work on Basic Medical Security for Urban and Rural Residents in 2024" (Medical Insurance Issue [2024] No. 19). <https://www.nhsa.gov.cn/art/2024/8/26/art_105_13634.html>; Hebei Provincial Medical Security Bureau et al. (2025). Notice on completing the work related to basic medical security for urban and rural residents in 2025 (Ji Medical Insurance Fa [2025] No. 6, local document). <https://www.renqiu.gov.cn/renqiu/ybjbmwj/202510/6d90754638a248cba655e94ea518a3bb.shtml>; Anhui Provincial Medical Security Bureau et al. (2025). About doing a good job in 2025 Notice on the work related to the basic medical security for urban and rural residents in 2025 (reprinted by the Huaibei Municipal Medical Insurance Bureau): "In accordance with the requirements of the National Medical Insurance Administration, the Ministry of Finance, and the State Administration of Taxation's "Notice on Carrying out the Work Related to the Basic Medical Security for Urban and Rural Residents in 2025" (Medical Insurance Fa [2025] No. 22)" "The per capita financial subsidy standard for resident medical insurance has increased by 30 yuan compared with the previous year, reaching no less than 700 yuan per person per year." <https://ybj.huaibei.gov.cn/zcwj/zcwj/58004084.html>; General Office of the State Council (2021). Opinions on improving the medical insurance and assistance system for major and serious diseases (Guobanfa [2021] No. 42). <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2021/content_5659514.htm>; General Office of the State Council (2024). Guidance on improving the long-term mechanism for basic medical insurance participation (Guobanfa [2024] No. 38). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/content/202408/content_6965741.htm>; National Medical Insurance Administration (2026). The 2026 Government Work Report mentioned these medical insurance work. <https://www.nhsa.gov.cn/art/2026/3/5/art_14_19809.html>

Remarks: National Medical Insurance Administration 2025 The notice in 2025 (Medical Insurance Issue [2025] No. 22) was not publicly posted on the official website of the Medical Insurance Bureau and the Chinese government website. The two figures of 700 yuan and 400 yuan are consistent in the documents of Hebei and Anhui provinces, and the Anhui one stated that it was based on this notice. During the period when you are receiving unemployment insurance benefits, the employee medical insurance will be paid for by the unemployment insurance on your behalf, so you do not need to participate in insurance again.

Case: Xiao Chen thought the residents’ medical insurance was too expensive at 400 yuan, so he stopped paying last year. This year, he was hospitalized for acute appendicitis. After paying the supplementary payment, he still faced a 3-month waiting period. He had to pay extra for the surgery. He said he shouldn't have saved the 400 yuan.

items.title: If you get a serious illness, you should first apply for medical insurance, critical illness insurance, medical assistance and off-site registration, and do not touch online loans
items.core: The order is fixed: before being hospitalized across provinces, register in the "National Medical Insurance Administration" official account, and settle directly after discharge without having to advance the full amount. If you can't afford it after reimbursement, apply for medical assistance from the township or street. If you are currently employed, you will have a medical treatment period of 3 to 24 months depending on your length of service. During this period, the company cannot fire you. Don’t touch online loans and private high-interest loans.
body: Cost: No money. The order is fixed, step by step. The first step is to register using the "National Medical Treatment Registration in Other Places" applet on the WeChat official account of the "National Medical Insurance Administration" before hospitalization across provinces. The second step is to settle the payment directly upon discharge. The third step is that after reimbursement, the amount you have to pay is still too heavy, so apply for medical assistance from the township government or sub-district office. The fourth step is to take sick leave according to the medical period if you are still working. The medical period is the period of time when you are sick and stop working but cannot be dismissed; if it is a work-related injury, you will be covered by work-related injury insurance. Step 5: If your credit card cannot be repaid, take the initiative to negotiate with the bank for installment payment. The sixth step is that if it is really not enough, go to the personal help platform designated by the Ministry of Civil Affairs to raise funds. The materials are mainly diagnostic certificates, expense lists, and settlement forms, and it takes 2 to 4 trips. The difficulty is that when people are sick, they have to go through various procedures.

Benefits: The state combines basic medical insurance, critical illness insurance, and medical assistance into what is called the "triple system", which is implemented layer by layer. For subsistence allowance recipients and extremely poor people, no less than 70% of the medical expenses that meet the regulations will be provided. Seriously ill patients who are not poor but cannot afford medical treatment can apply for assistance themselves. If you prepare a record before being hospitalized across provinces, you can settle the bill directly after discharge, without having to advance the full amount first and then return to the insured place to report. There is a medical treatment period of 3 to 24 months for illness, and the specific length of time depends on the length of service. During this period, the company is not allowed to terminate the labor contract, and sick leave pay must not be less than 80% of the local minimum wage. Employees injured at work have a period of layoff with pay, which is the period of time during which they are not working to recuperate. The original wages and benefits are paid as usual by the employer on a monthly basis, generally not exceeding 12 months. If your credit card debt exceeds your repayment ability and you are willing to repay it, you can negotiate with the bank for personalized installments and rearrange the debt into a repayment plan for up to 5 years. After signing the agreement, the bank must stop collections. Personal help-seeking platforms that raise money for individuals online must be designated by the Civil Affairs Department of the State Council. The platform needs to verify whether the help information is genuine. The donated money can only be transferred to the person seeking help, or to the account he provided (nationwide)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: General Office of the State Council (2021). Opinions on improving the medical insurance and assistance system for serious and serious diseases (Guobanfa [2021] No. 42). <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2021/content_5659514.htm>; National Medical Insurance Administration (2025). How to directly reimburse for medical treatment across provinces and other places? . <https://www.nhsa.gov.cn/art/2025/3/16/art_14_16010.html>; Ministry of Labor (1994). Regulations on the medical treatment period for enterprise employees who are sick or injured not due to work (Ministry of Labor [1994] No. 479, Articles 2 and 3). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/2022-08/31/content_5711269.htm>; Ministry of Labor (1995). Opinions on Several Issues Concerning the Implementation of the Labor Law (Ministry of Labor [1995] No. 309, Article 59). <http://hrss.jl.gov.cn/ldgx/ldyggl/201608/t20160824_2401358.html> (Reprinted by Jilin Provincial Department of Human Resources and Social Security); State Council (revised in 2010). Work-related Injury Insurance Regulations (State Council Order No. 586, Articles 30 and 33). <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2011/content_1778064.htm>; China Banking Regulatory Commission (2011). Measures for the Supervision and Administration of Credit Card Business of Commercial Banks (CBRC Order 2011 No. 2, Article 70). <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2011/content_1893974.htm>; National People’s Congress Standing Committee (2023). Decision on amending the Charity Law (Article 124). <https://www.gov.cn/yaowen/liebiao/202312/content_6923390.htm>; Ministry of Civil Affairs and five other departments (2024). Measures for the Management of Personal Helpline Service Platforms (Order No. 75, Articles 3, 11, 13, and 17). <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/2024/issue_11646/202410/content_6980857.html>

Note: The proportion of medical assistance reimbursement and the maximum reimbursement per year are determined by the place where you participate in the insurance. The medical period is divided into six levels, depending on how many years you have worked in total and how many years you have worked in this unit. Once the medical period is over, the company may legally terminate your contract. Find out in advance which bracket you are in. Emergency rescue people are also on the list that need to be registered. The page of the Medical Insurance Bureau does not say whether emergency treatment counts as automatic registration, or whether it can be re-registered afterwards. Call the place where you are insured. Don’t touch online loans and private high-interest loans. The courts only protect up to a line of 4 times the one-year LPR (see Article 15 against usury). The portion beyond that line is not protected and the principal will still be returned. I don't have the energy to fight this kind of lawsuit even when I'm lying in the hospital bed. Urgent injuries and illnesses are another matter: you have to call 120 even if you don’t have money, and the hospital is not allowed to refuse, shirk or delay treatment. The first aid fee for that period is paid by the Sickness Emergency Relief Fund, see Section 24, Article 8 (Emergency treatment must also be given first). The original page of the Ministry of Labor Issue [1995] No. 309 cannot be opened on the official website of the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security. The content is taken from the reprint of the Provincial Department of Human Resources and Social Security. How to negotiate with the bank for installments if the credit card is not paid yet? See Article 23 (credit cards and online loans are already paid).

Case: Before Master Zhao’s father was hospitalized across provinces, he first registered on the official account of the National Medical Insurance Bureau. We settled the bill directly when we were discharged from the hospital. After reimbursement, we went to the street to apply for medical assistance. Our family did not take out online loans or borrow money with high interest rates.

items.title: If you lose your ID card, get it replaced immediately. If you need it urgently, you can get a temporary ID card first.
items.core: If you need a replacement ID card, it will be issued within 60 days from the day you submit the form. If you need it urgently, you can apply for a temporary ID card on the spot, which will be issued within 3 days and will be valid for 3 months.
body: Cost: There is a certificate production fee. This is a legal fee, and the amount charged is determined by the state and is subject to local publicity. Go to the police station where your permanent residence is to apply and make one trip.

Income: From the day you hand in the "Resident Identity Card Application Registration Form", the public security organ must issue the certificate within 60 days. During the period of new application, renewal, and reissue, if you are in a hurry to use your ID card, you can apply for a temporary resident ID card. The public security organ will issue the application within 3 days after receiving it, and it will be valid for 3 months (nationwide)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress Standing Committee (2003). Resident Identity Card Law (Presidential Order No. 4, Articles 12 and 20). <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2003/content_62254.htm>; Ministry of Public Security (2005). Measures for the Management of Temporary Resident Identity Cards (Ministry of Public Security Order No. 78) No. 2, 7, 9, 12, 17). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/2021-12/25/content_5712922.htm>

Note: Without an ID card, you cannot find a job, accommodation, open an account, or receive subsidies. This is a prerequisite for all procedures. The ID Card Law was revised in 2011. This article refers to the text published in 2003, and the current provisions shall prevail. Whether it can be handled in another place shall be subject to the announcement of the local public security.

Case: On the day of a business trip, Xiao Lin found that his ID card was lost. He first went to the police station to submit a form for a replacement, and then applied for a temporary ID card on the spot. Three days later, he received the temporary permit and successfully boarded the high-speed rail.

items.title: After registering as unemployed, strive to be recognized as a person with employment difficulties, and get social security subsidies or public welfare positions
items.core: After being recognized, you will pay social security yourself. The subsidy will not exceed two-thirds of the actual payment, usually for up to 3 years. If you are less than 5 years away from retirement when you are first recognized, you can receive retirement, but the maximum period is 5 years. Those who are recruited or assigned to public welfare positions by their units will also be subsidized by the unit's social security portion. Social security subsidies must be paid first and then repaid, and money must be advanced first.
body: Cost: No money. Go to the street or community public employment service agency to apply for recognition. The identification conditions vary from place to place. Common ones include older age, long-term unemployment, subsistence allowance families, disability, and zero-employment families. You must first register as unemployed before you can apply. The difficulty is to check one by one whether you have enough conditions, and you need to advance money for social security.

Benefits: After identification, those who do not have an employer and pay social security by themselves (this is called flexible employment) can receive social security subsidies. The subsidy standard does not exceed 2/3 of what you actually paid, and is usually available for up to 3 years. When the subsidy is first approved, if the statutory retirement age is less than 5 years, it can be extended until retirement, but the maximum period shall not exceed 5 years. For those who are recruited by an employer or assigned to a public welfare position, the employer will receive a certain subsidy based on the actual pension, medical, and unemployment insurance premiums paid. This subsidy does not include personal contributions. Public welfare positions are positions funded by the government, and their job subsidies are based on the local minimum wage. Public welfare job subsidies are usually available for up to 3 years. If the statutory retirement age is less than 5 years at the time of initial approval, it may be extended to retirement, but the maximum period shall not exceed 5 years. For public welfare positions developed by the government, priority will be given to people with employment difficulties. There is also a one-time job search subsidy, which is given to college graduates who actively seek jobs during their graduation year. The scope is graduates from subsistence allowance families, zero-employment families, and extremely poor people. Disabled graduates and graduates who have received national student loans are also counted (national framework, recognition conditions and amounts are determined locally)
Level of Evidence: B

Source: Ministry of Finance, Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security (2026). Measures for the Management of Employment Subsidy Funds (Caishe [2026] No. 1, Article 5, Item 3, Article 7, Article 26; issued on January 9, 2026, abolished Caishe [2023] No. 181). <http://sbs.mof.gov.cn/zxzyzf/jybzzj/202601/t20260119_3982161.htm>; Standing Committee of the National People's Congress (2007, 2015 revised). Employment Promotion Law (Articles 52 and 53). <https://www.gov.cn/guoqing/2021-10/29/content_5647636.htm>

Note: The salary of public welfare positions is not high, but social security is provided, which is suitable for transition. Social security subsidies must be paid first and then paid later, so you must advance money first. For specific conditions, ask 12333 or the street.

Case: 48-year-old Sister Zhou registered as unemployed after losing her job and was identified as a person with difficulty finding employment. She first paid social security herself, and then received about two-thirds of the subsidy based on the actual payment, and later worked in a community welfare position.

items.title: During unemployment, receive vocational training subsidies, employment apprenticeship subsidies and social security subsidies. Do not attend training classes at your own expense
items.core: Registered unemployed people, people with employment difficulties and other qualified people who obtain the required certificates after training can receive training subsidies, up to 3 times in total. College graduates who have not been employed within two years of leaving school and registered unemployed youth aged 16 to 24 can participate in employment internships and receive basic living expenses during the period. First check the "Vocational Training Subsidy Directory" on the official website of the local Social Security Bureau, and don't sign up for classes at your own expense.
body: Cost: No money. The training itself will take up a lot of your time. The difficulty is that you have to complete the courses and get the certificate in succession before you can get the subsidy.

Income: A number of employment subsidy fund projects are listed in the regulations of the Ministry of Finance and the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security, which is the money specially used by the finance to subsidize employment. Qualified people such as registered urban unemployed people and people with employment difficulties can participate in training and receive vocational training subsidies after obtaining the required certificates. The subsidy is paid in advance and paid by credit, and each person can enjoy it up to 3 times in total. People with employment difficulties pay social security (flexible employment) subsidies themselves, usually for up to 3 years. If the statutory retirement age is less than 5 years away at the time of initial approval, the period of retirement may be extended, but the maximum period shall not exceed 5 years. College graduates who have not been employed within 2 years of leaving school can flexibly pay social security after employment, and the subsidy can be for up to 2 years. When small and micro enterprises recruit college graduates who have not been employed in the year of graduation or two years after leaving school, they must sign a labor contract of more than one year and pay social security. In this way, the unit can receive social security subsidies for up to 1 year. College graduates who have not been employed within 2 years of leaving school and registered unemployed youth aged 16 to 24 can participate in job training. The trainee subsidy is issued to the unit and is used to pay the basic living expenses of trainees, apply for personal accident insurance and provide guidance and management
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Ministry of Finance, Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security (2026). Measures for the Management of Employment Subsidy Funds (Caishe [2026] No. 1, Article 5, 1 and 3, Article 6, Item 1, Article 7, Item 1, Article 26). <http://sbs.mof.gov.cn/zxzyzf/jybzzj/202601/t20260119_3982161.htm>

Note: The specific subsidy catalog and amount are determined by each province. First check the "Vocational Training Subsidy Catalog" on the official website of the local Social Security Bureau. There is also a one-time job search subsidy for college graduates from subsistence allowance families, zero-employment families, and extremely poor people who are actively looking for jobs during the graduation year. Disabled college graduates who have obtained national student loans are also considered

Case: Xiao He, who was registered as unemployed, wanted to learn e-commerce, but he didn’t apply when he saw that the training class would cost 3,000 yuan at his own expense. He checked the subsidy catalog of the Bureau of Human Resources and Social Security, participated in designated training and passed the certificate, and the training fees were later paid to his account according to regulations.

items.title: Don’t just submit resumes when applying for jobs, use a systematic approach: learn skills, set goals, and find help
items.core: People who have participated in job search counseling are obviously more likely to find a job than those who have not. Here's what works: learn specific job search skills, explain yourself clearly, set clear goals, take the initiative, and ask for help.
body: Cost: No money. Do this for 1 to 2 hours a day for several weeks. Paid courses can be skipped and replaced with free career guidance from public employment services. The difficulty lies in persisting every day when no one is watching, and also taking the initiative to ask for help.

Benefits: Combined 47 controlled studies of job coaching. These studies were experimental or quasi-experimental designs, and were divided into groups for comparison. The result is: the group that participated in counseling was more likely to find a job than the group that did not participate, with an odds ratio of OR 2.67. There are several effective ingredients in counseling. The first is to teach job hunting skills. The second is to improve self-presentation (make yourself clear). The third is to improve self-efficacy (belief that you can do it). The fourth is to encourage taking the initiative. The fifth is to set goals. Sixth, seek social support (ask for help). Tutoring that not only teaches skills but also stimulates motivation has the greatest effect
Level of Evidence: A
Source: Liu S, Huang JL, Wang M (2014). Effectiveness of job search interventions: a meta-analytic review. Psychological Bulletin 140(4): 1009–1041. <https://doi.org/10.1037/a0035923>

Note: Most of these studies are done in Europe and the United States, in the form of complete group courses. When I moved to China, I copied the results from elsewhere, not from the domestic test. The practical way to win social support is to ask acquaintances to help introduce and recommend people, and don't be embarrassed to speak up.

Case: Xiao Wu submitted two hundred resumes but received no response. Later, he participated in job search counseling and changed his resume according to the teacher's suggestions, locked in the position, and asked for referrals every week. Three weeks later, I got two interviews and finally joined a company.

items.title: No deposit, no documents, no "training loan", no pyramid schemes, no loan sharks
items.core: The employer cannot deduct your ID card, collect the deposit, or collect money under another name. If the agency fails to introduce you to a job, the agency fee must be refunded. Training loans where you pay training fees first and then get started, and pyramid schemes where money is calculated by recruiting people, are all officially named scams. If the interest on the borrowed money exceeds four times the one-year LPR, the court will not support it, but the principal will still be repaid.
body: Cost: No money. When faced with the three options of "paying money first and then taking up the job", "training first and then arranging work" and "recruiting people", I rejected them on the spot. Keep chat records and transfer receipts. The difficulty is that the less money you have, the more you want to take a gamble. It is not easy to say "no" on the spot.

Income: The company may not seize your ID card or other documents, ask you to find someone to guarantee it, or collect your money or property under another name. Violators will be ordered to return the goods and be fined not less than 500 yuan but not more than 2,000 yuan per person. Employment agencies are also not allowed to withhold certificates or collect deposits. If the job is not successfully introduced, the agency fee must be refunded to you. In the name of recruitment, they induce you to pay training fees or take out a loan first. This is a "recruitment-to-training" and "training loan" scam named by the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security and other five departments. Those who rely on attracting people to calculate commissions and pay money to join are considered pyramid schemes, and those who participate can be fined up to 2,000 yuan. The court will not support the interest on private loans that exceeds 4 times the one-year LPR when the contract is signed. This new rule replaces the old method of dividing three sections into two lines: 24% and 36% (nationwide, starting from August 2020)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People’s Congress Standing Committee (2007). Labor Contract Law (Presidential Order No. 65, Articles 9 and 84). <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2007/content_711013.htm>; Ministry of Labor and Social Security (2007). Employment services and employment management regulations (Ministry of Labor and Social Security Order No. 28, Articles 14, 55, and 58). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/2022-11/28/content_5711307.htm>; five departments including the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security (2026). Be wary of risk warnings such as "recruitment to training" and "training loans". <https://chinajob.mohrss.gov.cn/h5/c/2026-05-18/543038.shtml>; State Council (2005). Regulations on Prohibition of Pyramid Selling (State Council Order No. 444, Articles 2, 7, and 24). <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2005/content_80604.htm>; Supreme People’s Court (2020). Decision on amending the "Provisions on Several Issues Concerning the Application of Law in the Trial of Private Lending Cases" (Fa Interpretation [2020] No. 6, Article 26). <https://www.court.gov.cn/fabu/xiangqing/249031.html>; Supreme People's Court (2020). The upper limit of judicial protection of private lending interest rates is adjusted to "4 times the one-year LPR." <https://www.court.gov.cn/zixun/xiangqing/249051.html>

Note: 4 times LPR is the upper limit of interest that the court is willing to protect. It does not mean that "you can borrow without paying back" and the principal will still be repaid. This judicial interpretation was revised again in December 2020, and the article serial numbers have changed. The current text shall prevail. For how to convert the installment and online loan handling fees to the annualized interest rate, see Section 5, Item 7 (converting interest into the annualized interest rate). The more anxious you are to spend money, the easier it is to be targeted by these tricks. First go through the formal channels at the beginning of this section: unemployment insurance, labor inspection complaints, legal aid, rescue stations, and temporary assistance.

Case: Xiao Zhou was asked to keep her ID card and pay a training fee of 3,000 yuan after the interview. She took photos to keep the contract and chat records, then refused to sign and complained to the labor inspection. A few days later, the agency was inspected and the same batch of job seekers got their deposit back.

items.title: For housing difficulties, prioritize public rental housing
items.core: Three conditions must be met at the same time: there is no local house, or the housing area is below the standard; the income and property are below the standard; migrant workers must be stably employed locally for a specified number of years. The waiting period is announced locally. This is a distant water, so it won’t quench your immediate thirst, but it doesn’t cost anything to queue up, so sign up early and get your turn early.
body: Cost: There is no fee to apply. Submit the materials to the city or county housing security department, and give them written consent to verify the situation you reported. If the materials are missing, they will tell you what you need to make up at once. The period of waiting in line for a room is called the waiting period, which generally does not exceed 5 years.

Income: You can apply if you meet all three conditions. One is that there is no local housing, or the housing area is lower than the prescribed standard. Second, the income and property are lower than the prescribed standards. Third, migrant workers must be stably employed locally for a specified number of years. Specific conditions are determined and announced by the housing security departments of municipalities, cities and counties. People who are registered on the queue list are called waiting objects, and the housing security department should arrange housing for them during the waiting period (national framework, threshold and rent are determined locally, starting from 2012)
Level of Evidence: B

Source: Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development (2012). Measures for the Management of Public Rental Housing (Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development Order No. 11, Articles 7, 8, and 10). <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2012/content_2226147.htm>

Remarks: This is a distant water, which cannot quench our thirst, but it does not cost money to queue up. Register early and get your turn early. There are other types of affordable rental housing in various places, and the rules are different. Check the website of the local housing and construction department.

Case: Master Chen, who works out of town, rents a house, and his income and housing area meet the standards. He submitted an application for public rental housing through the app and completed the social security materials. After waiting for nine months, he got the house, and the monthly rent was half lower than the market price.

items.title: Minimize the pressure on housing and food: share monthly rent instead of daily rent, self-catering and elderly canteens instead of takeout
items.core: In 2025, food will account for 29.3% of the country's per capita consumption, and housing will account for 21.7%. The two items add up to more than half, so suppressing these two items is the most effective. According to the author's experience, daily rent and hourly rent, converted to one month, are more expensive than shared renting; cooking by yourself is cheaper than ordering takeout. When looking for a job, ask whether food and accommodation are included. A job that includes food and accommodation is tantamount to erasing these two major items.
body: Cost: House hunting takes 1 to 3 days. The deposit is usually 1 month’s rent (author’s rough estimate). Cooking your own meals should take up 30 to 60 minutes a day. The difficulty lies in making it yourself every day and resisting ordering takeout.

Income: In 2025, each national resident will spend an average of 29,476 yuan a year (this is called per capita consumption expenditure). Among them, food, tobacco and alcohol accounted for 8,631 yuan, accounting for 29.3%. Residential cost is 6,397 yuan, accounting for 21.7%. The two items add up to more than half, so it is most effective to suppress these two items. Meal assistance services for the elderly are provided to all elderly people in the form of senior canteens, senior dining tables, and meal assistance points. There are also differentiated subsidies for needy elderly people. For reference: As of January 1, 2026, the first-tier monthly minimum wage in each province is as low as 2,080 yuan in Qinghai and as high as 2,740 yuan in Shanghai (nationwide, 2025 to 2026)
Level of Evidence: B

Source: National Bureau of Statistics (2026). Residents’ income and consumption expenditures in 2025. <https://www.stats.gov.cn/sj/zxfbhjd/202601/t20260119_1962321.html>; Ministry of Civil Affairs and other eleven departments (2023). Action plan to actively develop meal assistance services for the elderly (Minfa [2023] No. 58). <https://www.gov.cn/govweb/zhengce/zhengceku/202310/content_6911233.htm>; Sichuan Provincial Department of Human Resources and Social Security (2026). Minimum wage standards in all provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities across the country (as of January 1, 2026, reproduced from the official website of the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security). <https://rst.sc.gov.cn/rst/ylbxjwjgzxx/2026/7/10/89a8ef06cc264d29b282d7c62f362a6b.shtml>

Note: Daily rental and part-time housing are much more expensive on a monthly basis than shared housing. This is an empirical judgment and there are no official figures. Whether senior meal assistance points are open to non-elderly people and how much they cost vary from place to place. When looking for a job, ask if it includes food and accommodation. A job that includes food and accommodation can directly eliminate these two major items. The original form page of the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security cannot be opened, and the numbers are taken from the reprint page of the Sichuan Provincial Department of Human Resources and Social Security.

Case: Before looking for a job, Xiao He gave up his daily rent and exchanged it for a shared bed with a monthly rent of 900 yuan. He also bought groceries and cooked for himself instead of takeout. When he joined the job, he chose a position that included food and accommodation, and saved nearly 5,000 yuan in three months.

items.title: Don’t panic if you stop paying social security: pensions are calculated based on accumulation, and medical insurance is replenished according to rules
items.core: Pension is calculated based on accumulated years, and it will not be cleared if it is stopped. You can receive it on a monthly basis after 15 years of retirement age, and the employee pension will be increased to 20 years every year starting from 2030. If employees have paid for medical insurance for a long period of time, they do not need to pay for it again after retirement. The number of years varies from place to place. The impact of suspension of payment is twofold: residents’ medical insurance will not be reimbursed for a period of time after repayment, and continuous payment is often required for buying a house, settling in, and earning points.
body: Cost: No money. Resident pension and resident medical insurance can be paid by yourself on an annual basis. If employees’ social security is cut off, they don’t have to spend money to find someone to support them in order to “prevent their employment from being cut off”.

Income: Basic pension insurance is calculated based on the accumulated payment years, and it will not be reset if there is any interruption in the period. At the statutory retirement age, you can receive a monthly pension after 15 years in total. If it is not enough, you can continue to pay until 15 years. Starting from January 1, 2030, the minimum payment period for employees to receive monthly pensions will be increased by 6 months each year, gradually increasing to 20 years. If you find employment in another place (formally speaking, across a coordinating area), the pension relationship will follow you, and the payment years will continue to accumulate. If the accumulated contributions to employee medical insurance reach the number of years specified by the state, they do not need to pay any more after retirement. The price of discontinuing payment of resident medical insurance is the waiting period: after repayment, there will be a period of time when medical treatment will not be reimbursed (resident medical insurance, see Article 9) (National)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People’s Congress Standing Committee (2010, 2018 revision). Social Insurance Law (Articles 16, 19, 27). <https://www.gov.cn/guoqing/2021-10/29/content_5647616.htm>; General Office of the State Council (2024). Guidance on improving the long-term mechanism for basic medical insurance participation (Guobanfa [2024] No. 38). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/content/202408/content_6965741.htm>; Standing Committee of the National People's Congress (2024). Decision on the Implementation of a Progressive Delay in the Statutory Retirement Age (Attachment "Article 2 of the Measures of the State Council on the Progressive Delay in the Statutory Retirement Age"). <https://www.gov.cn/yaowen/liebiao/202409/content_6974294.htm>

Note: The number of years that employees no longer have to pay for medical insurance after retirement is stated in the law as "the number of years prescribed by the state." The number implemented varies from place to place, and is often different for men and women. Call 12393 or ask the local medical insurance bureau. Suspension of payment mainly affects local qualifications that require continuous payment for several months, such as buying a house, settling in, and points. These rules are determined by each locality, so check locally. If you spend money to find someone to "affiliate" to pay on your behalf, the money may be wasted and there may be legal risks, so it is not recommended. How to transfer the pension and medical insurance relationship when you change jobs in another city? Don’t cancel the insurance. Please refer to Section 19, Article 19 (Transfer of pension and medical insurance relationship to the new insured place). The 15-year line will increase by 6 months every year starting from 2030, and gradually reach 20 years. How to settle the account for self-payment is shown in Section 5, Article 46 (self-payment of employee pension insurance).

Case: Chen moved to a city, and his employee pension was cut off for four months. After inquiries, it was confirmed that the previous 15 years were not cleared; reimbursement was limited during the period of suspension of medical insurance payments, and benefits would be restored according to local regulations after making up payments; because the qualification for house purchase required continuous social security, he could only postpone buying a house.

items.title: Those who have been in prison, bankrupt, or have been on the list of dishonest people have a way to start over legally. They must complete the procedures first
items.core: Those who have been released from prison shall not be discriminated against in employment, schooling, and social security according to law. Those who are in difficulty will be assisted by the government for resettlement. Those who were under 18 at the time of the crime and sentenced to less than 5 years will have their records sealed and do not have to report it when looking for a job in the military. Not all untrustworthy lists are counted for 2 years. Names will only be deleted if they meet the conditions for deletion. The criminal records of adults are not sealed, and they must be reported truthfully when serving in the military or in employment.
body: Cost: No handling fee. Those who have been released from prison must report to the judicial office or street in their place of registered residence or residence and apply for resettlement and education (government resettlement and assistance). If you are on the list of dishonest persons subject to execution, you should pay all you need and then apply to the enforcement court to have your name deleted. Individuals who have been insured in Shenzhen for three years or more can apply for personal bankruptcy. Each step involves preparation of materials, interviews, and a one to three year review period. The difficulty is that you have to tell people about the past over and over again, and you still have to endure the inspection period.

Benefits: Persons released from prison enjoy equal rights with other citizens in accordance with the law and are not discriminated against in employment, schooling and social security. For those who have difficulty living, the government of their place of residence or residence will help with resettlement and legal assistance (the Prison Law will be revised in 2026 and will come into effect on November 1). The central government's 2010 document requires that they be strengthened with vocational training, those who meet the conditions be included in subsistence allowances, and a transitional resettlement base be established. If you are under 18 years old when you commit a crime and are sentenced to less than 5 years in prison, your criminal record will be sealed and you do not need to report it when you join the army or look for a job. If you apply for a certificate of no criminal record in person, it will be issued within 3 working days. If the person is included due to the circumstances listed in Article 1 of the Dishonesty List of the Supreme People's Court, the period is 2 years. If the first item "refuses to perform despite having the ability to perform" is included, this time limit cannot be directly applied. If the debt is paid off, the settlement agreement is fulfilled, etc., and the conditions for deletion in Article 10 of the regulations are met, the court shall delete the name within 3 working days. If there is a time limit for inclusion, this set of deletion conditions does not apply, and the court shall delete the name within 3 working days after the expiration of the time limit. If the breach of trust is actively performed or corrected, the court may also decide to delete it in advance. The Personal Bankruptcy Regulations of the Shenzhen Special Economic Zone are currently the only personal bankruptcy regulations. After declaring bankruptcy and completing the 3-year review period, unpaid debts can be forgiven. If a corporate legal person cannot repay its due debts and owes more than it owes (this is called insolvency), it can apply for reorganization, reconciliation or bankruptcy liquidation. After the bankruptcy proceedings are completed, the enterprise shall apply for deregistration. However, those who provided guarantees to the enterprise and other joint debtors "continue to bear repayment liability in accordance with the law" for the unpaid portion. If the boss personally signs a guarantee for the company, he has to pay it back himself. The criminal records of adults are not sealed: Article 100 of the Criminal Law stipulates that those who have been criminally punished in accordance with the law must report truthfully when joining the army or getting employment, and must not conceal it (nationwide, personal bankruptcy only in Shenzhen)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress Standing Committee (2026). Prison Law (revised in 2026, Articles 59, 60, and 62). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202604/t20260430_726746.shtml>; General Office of the CPC Central Committee and General Office of the State Council (2010). Notice of forwarding the "Opinions of the Central Commission for Comprehensive Social Security Management on Further Strengthening the Placement and Education of Persons Released from Reeducation through Labor" (Zhongbanfa [2010] No. 5). <http://www.hnziyang.gov.cn/jc_zy/63/84/content_19460.html> (Reprinted by Ziyang District Government, Yiyang City); Standing Committee of the National People's Congress (2018). Criminal Procedure Law (Amended in 2018, Article 286). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/zdgz/201810/t20181027_396818.shtml>; Supreme People’s Court, Supreme People’s Procuratorate, Ministry of Public Security, and Ministry of Justice (2022). Implementation Measures for Sealing Juvenile Criminal Records (Articles 9 and 15). <https://gat.hunan.gov.cn/gat/jwgk/zfxxgk/xxgkml/zcfgjjd/zcfg/202205/t20220531_24795836.html> (Reprinted by the Hunan Provincial Public Security Department); Supreme People’s Court (2017 revision). Several regulations on the publication of information on the list of dishonest persons subject to execution (Articles 2 and 10). <https://www.court.gov.cn/fabu/xiangqing/37182.html>; Shenzhen Municipal People’s Congress Standing Committee (2020). Shenzhen Special Economic Zone Personal Bankruptcy Regulations (Articles 2, 23, 95, 97, 103). <https://sf.sz.gov.cn/xxgk/xxgkml/zcfg/content/post_8586018.html>; National People’s Congress Standing Committee (2006). Enterprise Bankruptcy Law (Chairman's Order No. 54, Articles 2, 7, 120, 121, and 124; Article 124: "The bankrupt's guarantor and other joint debtors shall, after the completion of the bankruptcy proceedings, continue to bear the liability for the unpaid claims of creditors in accordance with the bankruptcy liquidation procedures in accordance with the law."). <http://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2006/content_413952.htm>; National People's Congress (1997). Criminal Law (Article 100, Paragraph 1: "Persons who have received criminal punishment in accordance with the law shall truthfully report to the relevant units that they have received criminal punishment when joining the army or employment, and shall not conceal it." This page is the original text of 1997). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/201802/t20180206_364975.shtml>; Standing Committee of the National People's Congress (2011). Criminal Law Amendment (8) (Article 19: "Add a paragraph to Article 100 of the Criminal Law as the second paragraph: "Persons who were under the age of 18 at the time of the crime and were sentenced to a penalty of not more than five years in prison shall be exempted from the reporting obligations stipulated in the preceding paragraph."). <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=2c909fdd678bf17901678bf68be604a1>

Note: The records of adults are not sealed. Article 100 of the Criminal Law requires that when serving as a soldier or looking for a job, you must truthfully report that you have been criminally punished. There are legal restrictions on occupations such as civil servants, judges, lawyers, teachers, and political review, and the aforementioned lack of discrimination does not change this. The current text of the Prison Law before November 1, 2026 corresponds to Articles 37 and 38, and the article number shall be subject to the effective text. The original page of Zhongbanfa [2010] No. 5 could not be found on the central government website. It was reprinted from the district government. During the review period for personal bankruptcy, you are not allowed to fly first class, spend too much money, or buy a house. Eight types of debts, including compensation for intentional infringement of another person's person, will not be exempted. Exemptions obtained through fraud may also be revoked.

Case: Xiao Zhao made a mistake when he was 17 and was sentenced to 3 years. After serving his sentence, he went to the judicial office to issue a certificate of assistance and renewal of social security, and applied for the sealing of criminal records. Later, when he applied for a warehouse manager, he did not report the sealing records according to regulations, and successfully joined the job.

items.title: Before a serious illness, in addition to the basic medical insurance, get a one-year medical insurance or critical illness insurance. Look clearly at the words "guaranteed renewal"
items.core: This type of insurance covers the portion you have to pay after the medical insurance is completed, as well as the loss from work stoppage. Before buying, look for the words "Guaranteed Renewal": If the product does not have these four words, it may be discontinued or the price may increase next year. You must tell the truth about your health status, otherwise you may be denied compensation. Submit basic medical insurance first, and then consider this.
body: Cost: Young people buy one-year cost-compensation medical insurance for a few hundred yuan per year. Expense reimbursement is the type of reimbursement based on the actual money you spent. Critical illness insurance starts at a few thousand yuan per year (rough estimate by the author, no official figures available). Before applying for insurance, you must truthfully inform yourself of your health status and spend half an hour at a time.

Income: Officials divide this type of product into two types. Medical insurance reimburses you based on your actual medical expenses. Illness insurance means that as long as the diseases specified in the contract are diagnosed, a sum of money will be directly compensated according to the agreed amount. Both of them compensate for the portion that you have to pay after you have paid for the medical insurance, as well as the loss from work stoppage. If the insurance period is one year or less and there is no guarantee of renewal in the terms, it belongs to short-term health insurance. It is long-term health insurance that lasts for more than one year, or has written guarantee renewal. "Guaranteed renewal" means that when the policy expires, the company must continue the policy according to the original terms and agreed rates. Insurance companies are not allowed to induce the same person to repeatedly buy cost-compensation medical insurance with the same or similar protection functions. If you buy two copies, you can only claim the same amount once. The definition of diseases for critical illness insurance has unified industry standards, including 28 types of severe diseases and 3 types of mild diseases. Malignant tumors, acute myocardial infarction, and stroke sequelae are core diseases (nationally, starting from 2019 and 2020)
Level of Evidence: B

Source: China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission (2019). Health Insurance Management Measures (Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission Order No. 3, 2019, 2, 4, and 41). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2019-12/04/content_5458542.htm>; Insurance Association of China, Chinese Medical Doctor Association (2020). Standards for the use of disease definitions for critical illness insurance (2020 revised version) answers to reporters’ questions. <https://www.iachina.cn/art/2020/11/5/art_8616_104705.html>; China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission (2020). Notice on matters related to the use of the "Experiential Incidence Rate Table of Major Diseases in China's Personal Insurance Industry (2020)" (Chinese Banking Regulatory Commission [2020] No. 51). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2020-11/06/content_5557791.htm>; Standing Committee of the National People's Congress (2015 revision). Article 16 of the Insurance Law of the People's Republic of China (truthful notification and contract shall not be terminated after two years of establishment). <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=2c909fdd678bf17901678bf7c4060811>

Remarks: Level B is because the official only gives definitions and rules, and there is no number on "how much you can save by buying it." "Million-dollar medical insurance" is what it's called when it's sold. According to regulations, it's considered short-term health insurance. If the terms and conditions do not say "guaranteed renewal", the sale may be discontinued or the price may increase next year. Look for these four words in the terms before buying. Two medical insurances that are reimbursed based on actual expenses cannot claim the same amount twice, so don’t buy them on top of each other. If you are already sick and still take out insurance, but do not tell the truth truthfully, you will be denied compensation if something goes wrong. There is a two-year period for telling the truth: after two years of the contract, the insurance company can no longer terminate the contract on the grounds that you have not told the truth, and you will have to pay compensation if something goes wrong. If it is found that the employer intentionally failed to notify the employer within two years, no compensation will be paid for anything that happened before the contract was terminated, and the premium will not be refunded. Which losses are worthy of insurance, see Section 5, Article 39 (Unbearable losses). Submit your resident medical insurance (Article 9) first, and then consider this. Disease definition specifications are issued by industry associations and guided by the China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission, and are not government documents.

Case: After Ms. Liu participated in the basic medical insurance, she also chose a medical insurance that stated that the insurance was guaranteed to be renewed for 20 years. She truthfully filled in the thyroid nodules when applying for the insurance. She paid 28,000 yuan out-of-pocket for hospitalization the following year, and the insurance company paid compensation according to the contract.

items.title: There is really no place to sleep. The 24-hour business premises can only be used for emergencies for one night. Prioritize going to the rescue station
items.core: The waiting areas at airports and train stations can last for one night. There are toilets and power supplies, but there is no official data saying that they are so safe. There are people on duty at the rescue station 24 hours a day, and people who come to the rescue station at night will be the first to rescue. In winter, some places even open temporary cold shelters. If you don’t want to enter the station, the patrol staff will also give you food and warm clothes.
body: Cost: Waiting areas at airports and train stations usually cost nothing. You have to spend some money at fast food restaurants and Internet cafes. If you don’t sleep well, your belongings are at risk of being stolen. The difficulty is that I can't really sleep all night.

Benefits: Can last a night in a 24-hour place, has a toilet, and can be recharged. There are no official figures on whether it is safe or not. At the rescue station, the Ministry of Civil Affairs requires that the rescue hotline be open all day long and be on duty 24 hours a day. When people in trouble come to ask for help, they will be given first aid according to the policy. Those who are unable to find a job, have been stolen or robbed, or have suddenly lost their source of livelihood can receive emergency transitional living security. Where conditions permit, places such as community service centers will be opened as temporary shelters. In winter, trapped people will be guided to rescue stations or temporary cold shelters. For those who do not want to enter the station, the patrol staff will provide food, clothing and warm supplies, and leave ways to seek help. Patrols will be intensified at night, when the temperature drops and when it rains or snows freeze. Stations and wharves, underground passages, bridges and culverts, and construction sites under construction are key areas for inspection (across the country, civil affairs departments have carried out special winter rescue operations in consecutive years since 2013)
Level of Evidence: B

Source: Author’s experience (part of 24-hour business premises); General Office of the Ministry of Civil Affairs (2022). Notice on carrying out the special rescue operation of "Sending Warmth in Cold Winter" (Parts 2, 3, 4, and 5; Part 3: "Ensure that the rescue hotline is open all day long, respond to help clues in a timely manner, and provide first aid to those who come for help in accordance with policies and regulations"). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2022-12/11/content_5731351.htm>; Ministry of Civil Affairs, Central Political and Legal Affairs Commission, Ministry of Public Security and other 11 departments (2020). Notice on launching a special action to greatly improve the quality of rescue and management services for homeless vagrants and beggars (Minfa [2020] 14 No., Part 2, Item 3: "We must continue to do special relief work such as "providing warmth in cold winter" and "providing coolness in summer" under extreme weather conditions"). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2020-03/24/content_5494916.htm>; Ministry of Civil Affairs (2003). Detailed Implementation Rules for the Assistance and Management of Vagrants and Beggars in Urban Life (Order No. 24 of the Ministry of Civil Affairs) No. 2, 3 and 5). <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2003/content_62510.htm>

Note: Security risks are real. Keep your belongings close to you, do not accept drinks or food from strangers, and avoid remote corners. Do not sleep outdoors in bridges, rivers, or construction sites at night. Sleeping outdoors in extreme weather can kill people. The aid stations are in charge of food, accommodation, and tickets. See Article 4 (go to the aid station when you are desperate). The rescue center only accepts people who cannot provide food and accommodation by themselves, and who have no relatives or friends to rely on. When entering the station, you must tell the truth about your situation. If you refuse to tell, you will not be helped. The above requirements of the Ministry of Civil Affairs come from the notice issued in the winter of 2022. Each locality issues separate arrangements for that year, whichever is local. Some places will clear out at midnight, so don't conflict with security.

Case: Xiao Chen arrived at the train station late at night but could not find a place to stay. He stayed up until early morning in the 24-hour train hall. After the inspector found out, he took him to the rescue station. He had a hot meal and a quilt that night, and was assisted to contact his family the next day.

items.title: If you are owed wages, first identify who hired you: Unlicensed workshops and contractors can still go to the labor inspectorate, and you can go to court only when you do private work for families or individuals
items.core: Unlicensed workshops and shops, if you are owed wages, you can still complain to the labor inspectorate, apply for labor arbitration, and the boss himself can also be pursued. If the contractor owes money for the work on the subcontracted construction site, the general contractor or the construction unit will pay it. Only doing private work for a family or an individual, such as being a nanny, is not considered a labor dispute and requires litigation in court.
body: Cost: No money. First, clarify three things: whether the other party is opening a store or factory to do business, whether the work is subcontracted from the company or construction site, and whether you are working for their family. You can check whether the other party has a license on the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System.

Income: The employers mentioned in Article 2 of the Labor Contract Law are organizations such as enterprises, individual economic organizations, and private non-enterprise units, and individual individuals are not counted. The Supreme People’s Court’s Judicial Interpretation of Labor Disputes lists several types of disputes that are not labor disputes. The first is disputes between families or individuals and domestic service personnel. The second is the dispute between individual craftsmen and helpers and apprentices. The third is disputes between rural contract operators and employees. These types of cases need to be sued in court as ordinary civil disputes, and the statute of limitations is 3 years. Employers without a business license are not included in this exception. Article 93 of the Labor Contract Law governs units without legal business qualifications. If you have already done the work, your employer or its sponsor will have to pay you wages, financial compensation and compensation. The investor is the person who provides the money to open the unit. Article 29 of the interpretation governs three types of units: those without a business license, those whose licenses have been revoked, and those that are still operating after the business period has expired. If you have a dispute with such an entity, the entity or its investors must be listed as parties. Article 33 of the Labor and Social Security Supervision Regulations stipulates that if you do not have a business license or your license has been revoked, but you are hiring people to work, the human resources and social security department will still implement labor and social security supervision. If an individual contracting operation recruits workers illegally and causes damage to workers, the organization issuing the contract and the individual contracting shall be jointly and severally liable for compensation (Article 94 of the Labor Contract Law). Construction units or construction general contractors sometimes contract or subcontract projects to individuals or units without legal business qualifications. Therefore, any wages owed to migrant workers shall be paid off by the construction unit or general construction contractor (Article 36 of the Regulations on Guaranteeing the Payment of Wages to Migrant Workers) (National)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Standing Committee of the National People's Congress (2012 revision). Labor Contract Law (Articles 2, 93, and 94). <https://fgk.chinatax.gov.cn/zcfgk/c100009/c5193025/content.html> (Reprinted from the Policy and Regulations Database of the State Administration of Taxation); Supreme People's Court (2020). Interpretation on the Applicable Legal Issues in the Trial of Labor Dispute Cases (1) (Fa Interpretation [2020] No. 26, Articles 2 and 29). <https://www.court.gov.cn/fabu/xiangqing/282121.html>; State Council (2004). Regulations on Labor and Social Security Supervision (State Council Order No. 423, Article 33). <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2004/content_63042.htm>; State Council (2019). Regulations on Guaranteeing Wage Payment for Migrant Workers (State Council Order No. 724, Article 36). <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2020/content_5469641.htm>; National People’s Congress (2020). Civil Code (Article 188). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202006/t20200602_463888.shtml>; State Council (2006). Measures for the payment of litigation fees (State Council Order No. 481, Articles 6 and 29). <https://www.gov.cn/ziliao/flfg/2006-12/29/content_483682.htm>; National People’s Congress Standing Committee (2023 revision). Civil Procedure Law (Articles 152 and 225). <https://amr.guizhou.gov.cn/zwgk/xxgkml/jcxxgk/zcfg/fl/202401/t20240129_83645867.html> (Reprinted by Guizhou Provincial Market Supervision Bureau)

Note: Judge in this order. First check whether the work is transferred from the company or construction site. If so, go to the contracting company or general contractor.
