The special wage account on the construction site and the general contractor must be paid off first, see Article 2 (if you are owed wages, file a complaint with the labor inspection first). Next, check whether the other party is doing business: if you open a store, factory, or workshop, whether or not you have a license will be subject to supervision and arbitration. During the arbitration, the boss himself will be listed. Those who are left to do private work for families or individuals go to court. When you go to court, you have to prosecute and provide evidence by yourself. The ordinary procedure of first instance is completed within 6 months according to regulations, and can be extended. Lawyer fees are not included in the litigation costs awarded by the court to the loser. If you hire a lawyer, you must pay for it yourself. If you cannot afford it, you can apply for legal aid. See Article 3 (Legal Aid). If you have an IOU, you can first apply for a payment order, see Article 2 (Payment Order). For small claims, see Section 8, Article 22 (Second-hand transactions defrauded, small claims). The statute of limitations is 3 years, see Section 8, Article 19 (There is a time limit for rights protection). There is no guarantee that the money will arrive no matter which way you go, and if the other party has no property, you won’t get it even if you win.

Case: Xiao Wang worked in a small processing factory without a business license for two months and was owed 6,000 yuan. His boss wanted to file a lawsuit in court. He brought his attendance and WeChat records to the labor inspection department, and the department urged the boss to pay off the arrears.

items.title: If you have already paid off your credit card or online loan, call your bank or platform customer service to apply for personalized installments or extensions. Do not borrow new loans to repay old ones, and do not pay to find "interest suspension", "credit repair" or "anti-collection" intermediaries.
items.core: If you are still willing to repay your credit card, you can talk to the bank about personalized installments. The maximum period is 5 years. After signing the agreement, the bank will stop collecting the money. But the bank does not have to agree, and the overdue record will still remain on the credit report. Regulatory authorities have specifically warned you not to look for intermediaries that collect money to help you "stop pending debts" and "wash your credit."
body: Cost: Nothing. Use the official customer service number on the back of your card or in the app to make it clear that you can't pay it back, but are willing to pay it back. Having proof of income, unemployment or illness often requires several calls. Once negotiated, you will be able to repay the loan monthly according to the new plan. You cannot apply for another credit card until it is paid off. The difficulty lies in taking the initiative to answer the phone calls from the bank and telling them about their difficulties over and over again.

Earnings: There are clear regulations on credit cards. If the debt exceeds your repayment ability and you are still willing to repay it, the bank "can" negotiate with you on an equal footing and sign a personalized installment repayment agreement. The agreement is for a maximum period of 5 years. The agreement must state how much is owed, how much will be repaid in each installment, and whether annual fees and interest will be charged during the repayment period. The two parties signed an agreement, and the bank and the collection agency entrusted by it must stop collection. If you don't repay according to the agreement, you will not be subject to this restriction. The negotiation was a verbal agreement, and the bank must keep the recording, at least until the day the debt is paid off. Arrears that have already been installed cannot be rescheduled, and personalized installments are the only exception (2022 Regulatory Notice). When the People's Bank of China abolished the old bank card regulations in 2025, it stated that credit cards will continue to be managed according to these regulations. Online loans do not have unified regulations such as personalized installments. Whether it can be extended or installmentd depends on the contract and the lending institution. The loan is from a consumer finance company, and regulations prohibit it from using violence, threats, intimidation, or harassment to collect debt. Banks and consumer finance companies are not allowed to seek collection from people who have nothing to do with the debt. For fee-based intermediaries, five departments including the State Administration of Financial Supervision and Administration jointly issued a risk warning in 2026. Reminders such as "no need to repay loans/credit cards", "debt negotiation", "debt replacement" and "credit cleansing" are all false information. This type of "agency rights protection" will charge high service fees. If you want to quit midway, you may be accused of breach of contract. They will collect your bank cards, mobile phone cards, home address and children's schools. If you follow their instructions and provide false materials, maliciously evade debts, complain and apply pressure, you may be suspected of illegal crimes in serious cases. In 2022, the Beijing Banking and Insurance Regulatory Bureau also named advertisements such as "suspend interest-rate debt", "stop collection" and "full interest-free". It said that if these people delay repaying or contact the bank, they are likely to leave an overdue bad record on their credit report. The National Development and Reform Commission will launch a special project in 2022 to deal with “credit repair”. The notice stated that these people confused the concepts of credit objections and credit repair, and committed fraud in the name of "credit repair, whitewashing, and credit card removal." Bad information on credit reports will be kept for 5 years from the day when the bad behavior or incident ends, and will be deleted after 5 years. During the retention period, you can add a description to this record, and the credit reporting agency must write it down (nationwide)
Level of Evidence: B

Source: China Banking Regulatory Commission (2011). Measures for the Supervision and Administration of Credit Card Business of Commercial Banks (CBRC Order No. 2, 2011, Articles 68 and 70). <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2011/content_1893974.htm>; China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission, People's Bank of China (2022). Notice on further promoting the standardized and healthy development of credit card business (Yinbao Regulatory Regulations [2022] No. 13, Articles 19 and 30). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2022-07/07/content_5699827.htm>; People's Bank of China, State Administration of Financial Supervision (2025). Decision on the abolition of the "Bank Card Business Management Measures" (Order [2025] No. 6). <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/2025/issue_12206/202508/content_7035429.html>; State Administration of Financial Supervision (2024). Management Measures for Consumer Finance Companies (Order No. 4, 2024, Articles 53 and 56). <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/2024/issue_11346/202405/content_6951507.html>; State Administration of Financial Supervision, Cyberspace Administration of China, Ministry of Public Security, People's Bank of China, China Securities Regulatory Commission (2026-02-06). Risk warning on being wary of illegal "agency rights protection" short videos and live broadcast traps (reprinted from the official website of the Cyberspace Administration of China). <https://www.cac.gov.cn/2026-02/06/c_1772110875635198.htm>; Beijing Banking and Insurance Regulatory Bureau (2022-10-25). Be wary of illegal "agency handling of credit card debt" risk warning (reprinted by Credit Fuxin, sponsored by Fuxin Municipal Development and Reform Commission). <https://credit.fuxin.gov.cn/fxts/202210/t20221027_33939.html>; General Office of the National Development and Reform Commission (2022). Notice on focusing on special management of "credit repair" issues. <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2022-04/01/content_5682847.htm>; State Council (2013). Regulations on the Management of the Credit Reporting Industry (National Order No. 631, Article 16). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2013-01/29/content_2303.htm>; Supreme People’s Court, Supreme People’s Procuratorate (2018 revision). Interpretation of Several Issues Concerning the Specific Application of Laws in Handling Criminal Cases of Obstructing Credit Card Management (Legal Interpretation [2018] 19 No. 6 and 8). <https://www.court.gov.cn/fabu/xiangqing/132701.html>; Ningxia Financial Supervision Bureau (2026-06-16). Risk reminders on preventing illegal agency surrender (12378 hotline). <https://www.nfra.gov.cn/branch/ningxia/view/pages/common/ItemDetail.html?docId=1261442&itemId=2188>; National People’s Congress Standing Committee (2023 revision). Civil Procedure Law (Articles 152, 164). <https://amr.guizhou.gov.cn/zwgk/xxgkml/jcxxgk/zcfg/fl/202401/t20240129_83645867.html> (Reprinted by Guizhou Provincial Market Supervision Bureau); State Council (2006). Measures for the payment of litigation fees (State Council Order No. 481, Articles 6 and 29). <https://www.gov.cn/ziliao/flfg/2006-12/29/content_483682.htm>

Note: Personalized installments state that the bank "can" negotiate, but do not have to agree. The bank has the right to refuse. If you can't reach an agreement, the bank can go to court and sue you to pay back the money. The ordinary first-instance procedure is required to be completed within 6 months, which can be extended, and the simplified procedure is 3 months. You have to pay for the lawyer yourself; it is not included in the litigation costs awarded to the loser by the court. If the sentence is not paid, execution will be carried out, see Section 8, Article 20 (being prosecuted, being executed). For inclusion in the default list, see Section 8, Article 21 (Inclusion on the default list). It's not a crime simply. The judicial interpretations of the two top courts stated that you cannot be deemed to want to possess the money just because you failed to repay the loan on time. Only those who run away after overdrafting, change contact information to avoid collection, or transfer property may be considered malicious overdrafts. Malicious overdrafts are prosecuted as credit card fraud, and the unpaid principal of more than 50,000 yuan is considered to be a large amount. Therefore, you need to answer the bank's phone number, and you need to tell the bank if you change your number or address. Borrowing something new to repay an old one will only make the interest pile up. Look at the annualized interest rate first before taking out a loan. See Section 5, Item 7 (convert interest into annualized interest rate). For private high-interest loans, see Article 15 (No loan sharking). If debt collection calls come from your family or colleagues, or if you are insulted or threatened, complain to the lender first. If the bank cannot solve the problem, call the 12378 banking and insurance consumer complaint hotline, free of charge. If there is a threat to personal safety, please call 110 directly. If there is an error in the credit record, please refer to Section 8, Article 9 (Free Credit Check) for free checks and objections. If you are seriously ill but still unable to get medical insurance, please also read Article 10 (if you are seriously ill, go to medical insurance and medical assistance first). Looking for an "agency to surrender the policy" is the same type of routine, see Section 5, Article 43 (Don't look for an agent to surrender the policy). The main beneficiary is yourself.

Case: After owing 40,000 yuan on her credit card, Ms. Zhang did not find a charging agency. Instead, she sent the card bank’s customer service to explain her income and submit materials. They negotiated for 60 installments. Collection stopped after the agreement came into effect, and overdue credit records were still retained.

items.title: If there is a traffic accident, stop the car first, rescue people, call the police, don’t run
items.core: If you run away, you will be held solely responsible for the accident by default. Your driver's license will be revoked, and escaping is a crime and you won't be able to take the test again in your lifetime. There is also a more realistic layer: car damage insurance and three-party insurance will not compensate for escape, and the compensation of hundreds of thousands will have to be paid by yourself. Staying at the scene to rescue people and call the police would take up to an hour or two.
body: Cost: Nothing. Stopping the car, turning on the double flashers, rescuing people, calling the police, and waiting for the traffic police can take up to an hour or two. In a minor accident, if no one is injured and the facts are not disputed by both parties, take pictures first. Then write down the other person’s name, phone number, license plate, driver’s license number, insurance certificate number and the location of the collision. After both parties sign, they can evacuate the scene first and then negotiate on their own.

Benefit: The party who ran away will bear all the responsibility for the accident. Only if you can prove that the other party is also at fault can the responsibility be reduced. If you run away, your driver's license will be revoked. If escaping constitutes a crime, you will not be able to apply for a driver's license again in your life. If the accident constitutes a traffic accident, the penalty for running away is 3 to 7 years. If someone dies as a result of running away, the sentence will be more than 7 years. Insurance does not care: the car damage insurance and three-party insurance in commercial auto insurance will not compensate for "traffic hit-and-run" or "intentional damage, falsification of the scene, or destruction of evidence." You will have to pay hundreds of thousands of compensation yourself (nationwide)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress Standing Committee (2021). Road Traffic Safety Law (revised in 2021, 70, 101). <https://jtgl.beijing.gov.cn/jgj/jgxx/flfg/fl/205308/index.html> (Reprinted by Beijing Municipal Public Security and Transportation Bureau); State Council (2017). Regulations for the Implementation of the Road Traffic Safety Law (State Council Order No. 405, revised in 2017, Articles 86 and 92). <http://xzfg.moj.gov.cn/front/law/detail?LawID=75>; National People's Congress (1997). Criminal Law (Article 133). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/201802/t20180206_364975.shtml>; Insurance Association of China (2020). Model Clauses for Motor Vehicle Commercial Insurance (2020 Edition) (Articles 9 and 22). <https://www.iachina.cn/art/2020/9/4/art_24_104621.html>; Ministry of Public Security (2024). Regulations on Application and Use of Motor Vehicle Driving License (Revised by Ministry of Public Security Order No. 172, January 1, 2025 Effective on the same day, Article 15, Paragraph 3 ("Those who cause a traffic accident and then escape constitutes a crime" shall not apply for a motor vehicle driving license). <https://ga.tj.gov.cn/zwgk/zcwj/jg3/202501/t20250103_6824050.html> (Reprinted by Tianjin Public Security Bureau)

Note: If someone is injured, rescue them first and then call the police. If the scene must be moved to save people, first mark the original positions of the car and people. "I just drove away after being hit and didn't feel anything." It might be considered a hit-and-run afterwards. If you're not sure, call the police. The insurance article refers to the model clause, which is a unified template in the insurance industry. What you can actually compensate is based on the policy in your hand.

Case: Mr. Zhao rear-ended the car in front of him on a rainy day, and the other car was injured. He immediately stopped the car, flashed his car, called 120 and 110, and stayed at the scene. After the traffic police determined that the insurance would settle the claim normally, he would only bear the deductible part.

items.title: If you find out that you have been cheated, call 110 or 96110 immediately to ask for a stop payment. Don’t check it yourself first
items.core: The short period of time when the money is just transferred is the most important. The police can stop the payment urgently and freeze it quickly, and the bank must cooperate. Once the money has been transferred and dispersed, the chances of recovery are much slimmer. So call 110 or 96110 first. Don’t check or ask first. 96110 The call coming in is from the police trying to dissuade you and asking you to answer the call.
body: Cost: No money. Make a phone call and clarify the time, amount, and account number of the transfer. Keep transfer screenshots and chat records.

Income: The public security organs have the right to conduct immediate inquiries, emergency payment stops, and quick freezing of the funds involved. Banks and payment institutions must cooperate. The frozen money will be returned to the victim according to procedures. Once the money is transferred and dispersed, the probability of recovery is greatly reduced, so the earlier the payment is stopped, the more effective it will be. 96110 is the national unified anti-fraud early warning hotline. The police are trying to dissuade you, so be sure to answer the call (Nationwide, from December 2022)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People’s Congress Standing Committee (2022). Anti-Telecommunications Internet Fraud Law (Articles 20 and 34). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202209/t20220902_575631.shtml>; Fujian Provincial Public Security Department (2023). 96110 Incoming calls, please be sure to answer. <http://gat.fujian.gov.cn/ztzl/fjjffpzxrx/spjq/202303/t20230306_6126156.htm> (provincial public security agency page)

Note: Anyone who claims to be a public security bureau and asks you to transfer money to a "safe account" is a scam. The law only says "establish a payment stop and freeze system," which means that the bank will withhold the money. How much you can recover depends on whether the money is still in your account when you call the police. The introduction of the "National Anti-Fraud Center" App and 96110 is quoted from the page of the Fujian Provincial Public Security Department. The original page of the Ministry of Public Security website cannot be opened.

Case: Aunt Wu transferred 30,000 yuan according to the "customer service" instructions and realized something was wrong. She immediately called 110 to report the payment account number. The police initiated an emergency stop payment. The 26,000 yuan in the account was frozen and returned to her a few days later.

items.title: Remember the hard anti-fraud rules: don’t trust calls, don’t disclose information, don’t click on links, and verify when making transfers. The seven most common scams are all in this shape
items.core: Anyone who asks you to transfer money, share your screen, download an unfamiliar app, click on a link, or submit a verification code, hang up first, and then call back with the official number for verification. The seven categories of fraudulent orders, fake investment and financial management, online loans, impersonating customer service, impersonating public prosecutors, killing pigs, and seducing orders, all require you to transfer money first. It’s much cheaper to recognize it beforehand than to chase the money afterward.
body: Cost: No money. Remember "three, not one, and more", read through the following seven categories, and then install the "National Anti-Fraud Center" App, and 96110 calls will be answered. If you are asked to transfer money, share your screen, download an unfamiliar app, click on a link, or submit a verification code, hang up first and then call the official phone number for verification. The difficulty is that the other party is often urging you very urgently, so you have to resist the urge and hang up first.

Income: The law requires the government and relevant departments to tell everyone the techniques of various types of telecommunications network fraud. The public security organs, together with the finance, telecommunications, and Internet information departments, have established an early warning and dissuasion system to promptly dissuade those who may be deceived. 96110 is the national unified early warning and dissuasion hotline. You must answer all calls. The Ministry of Public Security reported in June 2026 that the 10 most common types of fraud accounted for 85% of all electronic fraud cases. Fraudulent rebates are the most common, accounting for 25%. Fake online investment and financial management losses are the largest, accounting for about 40% of all losses. The identification characteristics dismantled by category by the Fujian Provincial Public Security Department are as follows. Rebate for swiping orders: "The most likely reason for asking you to make money together is because I want to make money from you." If the task order cannot be completed, the principal will not be refunded. Fake investment and financial management: "Trollies" in the group show off their profits, giving you a small rebate first and then asking you to increase your investment, and you have to "pay taxes" on cash withdrawals. Online loans: "Loans do not require a deposit or bank statements. Once you encounter one, it must be fake." Impersonating customer service: Saying that you will be automatically deducted if you sign up as a member, affecting your credit report, and forcing you to cancel the transfer. This type of scammer often asks you to download a "XXX Meeting" app and then turn on screen sharing. After sharing, "message pop-ups, SMS verification codes, password input, etc. will be clearly visible" on your mobile phone. The reminder from the Shanghai Anti-Fraud Center is: "Anything that mentions 'conference number', 'screen sharing' and 'remote control' is a scam." Pretending to be a public prosecutor: "There are no so-called "safe accounts" in public security agencies. Any "public security agency" that handles cases and takes notes through phone calls, QQ, WeChat, the Internet, etc. is all fraud." Abroad, scammers will also pretend to be embassies and consulates abroad, saying that you are suspected of money laundering, have important documents, or have problems with your passport or visa. Then transfer the call to the domestic "public security". The Embassy in the United States specifically reminds international students: "Anyone who claims to be a staff member of a foreign embassy, ​​consulate, operator, customs, etc., and actively transfers the call to the public security agency on the grounds of being suspected of related crimes, is a fraud!" Killing Plate: "You should not trust "lovers" who have never met in person but only seen photos or videos." Never meet in person on video but often ask for money for urgent matters. Lure and swindle orders: "Do tasks" first before making an appointment, and the more money you pay, the more money you pay. It is much cheaper to recognize it beforehand than to stop paying afterward. How much money can be recovered from a stop payment depends on whether the money is still in the account when the police are called. See Article 2 for how to stop payment (call 110 or 96110 to request a stop payment) (Nationwide, starting from December 2022)
Level of Evidence: B

Source: National People’s Congress Standing Committee (2022). Anti-Telecommunications Internet Fraud Law (Articles 8, 20, and 34). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202209/t20220902_575631.shtml>; Ministry of Public Security (2026). Press release of the Ministry of Public Security: Informing the latest situation and characteristics of current telecommunications network fraud crimes and suggesting key points in preventing telecommunications network fraud (June 12, 2026 Japan): "The above 10 types of cases account for 85% of all electronic fraud cases. Among them, bill rebate fraud has the highest incidence, accounting for 25% of all electronic fraud cases; false online investment and financial management fraud has the highest losses, accounting for about 40% of all electronic fraud cases." <https://www.mps.gov.cn/n2254536/n2254544/n2254552/n10491781/index.html>; Fujian Provincial Public Security Department (2023). 96110 Incoming calls, please be sure to answer. <http://gat.fujian.gov.cn/ztzl/fjjffpzxrx/spjq/202303/t20230306_6126156.htm> (Provincial public security agency page, including "Do not trust calls, do not disclose information, do not click on links, and verify transfers" and "Beware of fraudulent calls starting with 192" tips); Fujian Provincial Public Security Department (2023 to 2024). Column on fraud detection skills: Order brushing <http://gat.fujian.gov.cn/ztzl/fjjffpzxrx/spjq/202307/t20230703_6196881.htm>; Investment and financial management <http://gat.fujian.gov.cn/ztzl/fjjffpzxrx/spjq/202312/t20231220_6362145.htm>; Loan <http://gat.fujian.gov.cn/ztzl/fjjffpzxrx/spjq/202312/t20231207_6326741.htm>; Pretending to be customer service <http://gat.fujian.gov.cn/ztzl/fjjffpzxrx/spjq/202310/t20231020_6279505.htm>; Share screen (August 18, 2022 Japan) <https://gat.fujian.gov.cn/ztzl/fjjffpzxrx/spjq/202208/t20220818_5977906.htm>; "Bank of China Conference" and other fraudulent apps (May 12, 2025 Day, reprinted by Shanghai Anti-Fraud Center) <https://gat.fujian.gov.cn/ztzl/fjjffpzxrx/spjq/202505/t20250512_6912823.htm>; impersonating the Public Security Bureau <http://gat.fujian.gov.cn/ztzl/fjjffpzxrx/spjq/202309/t20230913_6255863.htm>; Police Liaison Officer, Bilateral Section, Chinese Embassy in the United States (2025). First letter for the start of school (Part 3) (January 28, 2025). <https://us.china-embassy.gov.cn/chn/lsfw/lsxz/lstx/202503/t20250305_11568435.htm>; pig killing plate <http://gat.fujian.gov.cn/ztzl/fjjffpzxrx/spjq/202308/t20230818_6232030.htm>; seducing orders <http://gat.fujian.gov.cn/ztzl/fjjffpzxrx/spjq/202403/t20240307_6410612.htm>

Remarks: Those who claim to be public prosecutors, customer service, leaders, and platform risk control, and want you to "cooperate with investigations", "cancel memberships", "fake orders for rebates" and "investment insiders" are all in the same routine. A real loan does not require a deposit, and there is no "safety account" at the Public Security Bureau. Just remember these two sentences and you will be able to block most of them. The reason for the B rating is that this slogan is only an official propaganda slogan, and there is no number of "how many less people will be cheated after remembering it". The formula and seven categories of dismantling are taken from the page of the provincial public security department. The Ministry of Public Security notified 10 types of high-incidence fraud in 2026. The remaining categories include pretending to be reseller logistics customer service, loan credit reporting, fake transactions in online games, online dating and dating, pretending to be acquaintances of leaders and ticket refunds and changes. These types of routines are all the same, and in the end you have to transfer money. If you receive a call from someone claiming to be an embassy or consulate or domestic police officer abroad, saying that you are involved in a case, have documents required, or have a problem with your passport, hang up first. International students are the key targets of this type of scam. If an acquaintance asks you to "help you show your face" to apply for a loan in person, and won't let you transfer money, but makes you take on debt, see Article 45 (help you show your face). For agency operation scams encountered when doing business, see Section 12, Article 24 (Agency operation of online stores).

Case: Xiao Sun received a message from "customer service" that the order was abnormal and required a refund. The other party sent a link and asked to share the screen. He hung up first and then verified with the official customer service of the shopping app. It was confirmed that it was a scam and there was no loss of bank card.

items.title: Seeing a face in a video or hearing a voice on the phone does not count as verification. When it comes to transferring money, hang up first and call back using the old number in your address book
items.core: Seeing a face or hearing a voice does not count as verification. As long as it involves transferring money, hang up first, then call back using the old number saved in your address book, or ask someone you know in common. The other party said "the signal is not good" and "is in a meeting" and refused to video-record in person, so it was treated as a scam.
body: Cost: No money. Make that extra call, wait a few extra minutes. Usually, you rarely post full-face videos and long speeches on public accounts. The difficulty is that the other party is often very urgent, so you have to refrain from transferring money on the spot.

Benefits: The Cyber ​​Security Bureau of the Ministry of Public Security gave three methods. The first is action verification: ask the other person to make a coherent head turn, or completely cover their face with their palms and then move away quickly. The original article said, “Current AI technology is prone to lag, blur, or distortion when simulating these complex facial occlusions and light and shadow changes.” The second is to listen to the details of the sound: "The speech generated by AI sometimes lacks natural breathing pauses, emotional ups and downs, or has a slight mechanical feel and abnormal background noise." The third item is verification through multiple channels. The original text says this is "the most core trick": "After hanging up, call the other party's commonly used and familiar phone number directly (do not call back suspicious caller numbers), or conduct side verification through a third person you both know." The mantra is "Don't trust the video voice and verify the action verification more often." Legally, face-changing and voice-changing have long been prohibited from being used for fraud. Services such as face generation, face replacement, voice synthesis, and imitation must be clearly marked on the platform. No organization or individual may maliciously delete, tamper with, forge, or conceal this logo. But it is the platform that abides by the rules, and scammers will not join, so "not seeing the AI ​​logo" cannot be used as evidence that the other party is a real person. The Criminal Investigation Bureau of the Ministry of Public Security announced a case. The 14-member gang was found to have synthesized more than 50,000 videos of dynamic faces and more than 500,000 pieces of citizens’ personal information. The police also seized 60 cloud servers (nationwide, labeling obligation starts from September 1, 2025)
Level of Evidence: B

Source: Cyber ​​Security Bureau of the Ministry of Public Security (2025). Seeing is believing, beware of new AI fraud! <http://gat.fujian.gov.cn/ztzl/fjjffpzxrx/spjq/202509/t20250922_7013008.htm> (Reprinted by the Fujian Provincial Public Security Department); National Internet Information Office, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, and Ministry of Public Security (2022). Regulations on the Management of In-depth Synthesis of Internet Information Services (Articles 6, 16, and 17, 2023 1 Effective on September 10). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2022-12/12/content_5731431.htm>; Cyberspace Administration of China, Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, Ministry of Public Security, and State Administration of Radio and Television (2025). Measures for labeling synthetic content generated by artificial intelligence (Article 10, effective on September 1, 2025). <https://www.cac.gov.cn/2025-03/14/c_1743654684782215.htm>; Criminal Investigation Bureau of the Ministry of Public Security, CCTV News (2026). The police seized more than 50,000 synthetic dynamic face videos. Who is "copying" your face? <http://gat.fujian.gov.cn/ztzl/fjjffpzxrx/spjq/202603/t20260330_7117146.htm> (Reprinted by the Fujian Provincial Public Security Department)

Note: To call back, use the old number saved in your address book. Don't call back the number on the caller ID, and don't use the new number the person sent you in the chat. If the other party refuses to video-record in person or perform specified actions on the grounds of "poor signal" or "being in a meeting," it will be treated as a scam. The action verification method is only an auxiliary, AI is getting better all the time, and the only thing that is stable is the third verification. The money has been transferred, see Article 2 of this section (call 110 immediately to request a stop payment). To protect your face and voice from being collected, see Section 14. The reason for assigning B level is because the official provides identification methods and cases, and there is no figure on "how much the deception rate will decrease after verification according to this method." The official website of the Ministry of Public Security (mps.gov.cn) is still 521 unable to be opened this time. The original text of the Cyber ​​Security Bureau and Criminal Investigation Bureau of the Ministry of Public Security is taken from the reprint page of the Fujian Provincial Public Security Department.

Case: Lao Li received a video call from his "nephew", saying that he urgently needed to transfer 20,000 yuan to change his number; he hung up and called back using his old number in his address book. His nephew claimed that the account was stolen, and Lao Li did not transfer the money.

items.title: If you are accused or summoned, consult a lawyer first, and do not keep it private or delete records.
items.core: The first time you are called for questioning, you can hire a lawyer. The lawyer asks to see you, and the detention center will arrange it within 48 hours at the latest, and the interview will not be listened to. You don’t have to answer questions that are irrelevant to this case.
body: Cost: Attorney fees start in the thousands of dollars. Those with financial difficulties can apply for free lawyers from legal aid agencies. When questioned, only answer questions related to the case and leave the rest to the lawyer. It's hard to stay calm on the spot and not be in a hurry to explain yourself.

Benefits: You have the right to retain a lawyer from the first interrogation or from the time coercive measures are taken (restriction of personal freedom). During the period when the case is still under investigation by the police, you can only entrust a lawyer, and you cannot hire anyone other than a lawyer to serve as a defender. If the lawyer requests a meeting, the detention center will arrange it within 48 hours at the latest, and the meeting will not be monitored. No one may be forced to prove his or her guilt. You have the right to refuse to answer questions that are irrelevant to this case. The maximum time for a summons or arrest is 12 hours, and for particularly serious and complex cases, the maximum time is 24 hours. A summons is to notify you to go for questioning, while a summons is to force you to be taken for questioning. It is not allowed to summon people consecutively to imprison them. Those who fabricate facts to falsely accuse someone and want him to be held criminally responsible shall be sentenced to less than 3 years, and those who cause serious consequences will be sentenced to 3 to 10 years. If you are detained or arrested and then the case is dropped, no prosecution is instituted, or you are found not guilty, you may apply for state compensation. Compensation is calculated daily based on the national average daily wages of employees in the previous year (nationwide)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress Standing Committee (2018). Criminal Procedure Law (2018 amendment, Articles 34, 35, 39, 52, 119, 120). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/zdgz/201810/t20181027_396818.shtml>; National People's Congress (1997). Criminal Law (Article 243). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/201802/t20180206_364975.shtml>; National People’s Congress Standing Committee (2012). State Compensation Law (2012 amendment, Articles 17 and 33). <https://www.stats.gov.cn/gk/tjfg/xgfxfg/202503/t20250306_1958899.html> (Reprinted by the National Bureau of Statistics)

Note: Do not go to the other party in private or go to his family members. Any "private" may be interpreted as recognition by you. Chat records, call records, and itinerary records are materials used to prove your innocence. Deleting them is equivalent to deleting your own evidence. Misremembering or reporting something that is later found to be unfounded does not count as a crime of false accusation or frame-up. Regardless of whether the person accused is a man or a woman, the approach is the same. The three expanded articles can be found in Article 33 of this section (pursuing the party who fabricated the facts), Article 34 (Insufficient evidence should lead to acquittal and petition for retrial), and Article 35 (State compensation after detention is calculated on a daily basis).

Case: Worker Wang was summoned by the police station for questioning due to a neighborhood dispute, and his family immediately hired a lawyer. The lawyer met with Wang according to the formalities and informed him that he could refuse to answer questions about commercial disputes unrelated to this case, and Wang was not held accountable for the mistake in the future.

items.title: If something goes wrong, take the initiative to make it clear: Surrendering yourself can reduce your sentence by up to 40%, and those who commit minor crimes can get even more reductions or even be exempted from punishment. The road to "evading the prosecution period" is blocked.
items.core: Surrendering can reduce the sentence by up to 40%, and those with less severe circumstances may not be punished directly. If you tell the truth after being called to your door, you can usually get a reduction of up to 20%. Running away, refusing to admit it, these are not exchangeable. It is not feasible to expect that the case will expire after hiding for a few years: if you hide after the case is filed, you will no longer be subject to the time limit for prosecution, and you can pursue it no matter how many years you hide.
body: Cost: Nothing. Go to the police station and surrender yourself, or stay where you are and call the police, and tell the truth again. The hard thing is to resist the thought of "wait and see, maybe no one will check."

Profit: Article 67 of the Criminal Law: Anyone who voluntarily surrenders to the police after committing a crime and truthfully confesses his crime is surrender. Those who surrender may be given a lighter or reduced punishment, and those who commit relatively minor crimes may be exempted from punishment. Those who do not surrender but truthfully confess their crimes (confession) may be given a lighter punishment; those who truthfully confess to avoid particularly serious consequences may be given a lighter punishment. The sentencing guidelines of the two high authorities clearly stated the range. The base sentence is the sentence calculated based on the circumstances of the case, and the following percentages are reduced above it. Surrendering can reduce the base sentence by less than 40%, and for minor crimes, it can be reduced by more than 40% or be exempted from punishment in accordance with the law. In confessions, truthful confessions of one’s crimes are reduced by less than 20%. A reduction of 10% to 30% for truthful confessions of the same type of more serious crimes that are not yet available to the judicial authorities. If the truthful confession avoids particularly serious consequences, the penalty will be reduced by 30% to 50%. The penalty for pleading guilty is reduced by less than 30%. At the same time, if there are circumstances such as surrender, major confession, return of stolen goods and compensation, compensation and understanding, etc., the penalty will be reduced by less than 60%, and if the crime is relatively minor, the penalty will be reduced by more than 60% or exempted from punishment in accordance with the law. The prosecution period is divided into four levels according to the statutory maximum penalty: 5 years, 10 years, 15 years, and 20 years (Criminal Law Article 87). However, Article 88 of the Criminal Law stipulates exceptions. If the procuratorate, public security agency, or national security agency files a case for investigation, or if the court accepts the case and evades investigation or trial, it is not subject to the limitation of the prosecution period (nationally, the sentencing range will be effective from July 1, 2021)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress. Articles 67, 87, and 88 of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China (consolidated text as amended by the Eleventh Amendment to the Criminal Law). <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=ff808181796a636a0179822a19640c92>; Supreme People's Court, Supreme People's Procuratorate (2021). Sentencing Guidance Opinions on Common Crimes (Trial) (Fafa [2021] No. 21, effective on July 1, 2021) 3 (6) (7) (14). Full text reprinted by the People's Procuratorate of Zhangye City, Gansu Province. <http://www.zhangye.jcy.gov.cn/info/1039/2086.htm>; Supreme People's Court (2010). Opinions on Handling Several Specific Issues about Surrender and Meritorious Service (Fafa [2010] No. 60) 1. Bulletin of the Supreme People's Court. <http://gongbao.court.gov.cn/Details/f3089058d37e11cd16d801530934ae.html>

Note: The beneficiary of this article is yourself. Surrendering is only a mitigating circumstance, the crime must still be punished, and the amount of reduction shall be determined by the court. Sentencing opinions strictly control the leniency requirements for serious violent crimes and drug crimes. There is another algorithm for traffic accidents. Those who stay at the scene, rescue people, and report to the public security organs are considered to have voluntarily surrendered. However, these are legal obligations in the first place, so the leniency must be strictly controlled. Surrendering to the police after escaping is still considered surrendering, but the heavier statutory sentence will be used as the benchmark to decide whether or how much to reduce. For what to do at the accident scene, see Article 1 of this section (stop the car first, rescue people, and call the police if there is a traffic accident). Seeking a lawyer first does not conflict with making a truthful confession, see Article 5 of this section (see a lawyer first if accused). What the lawyer will help you check is whether the transcript is correct, not help you make up your explanation.

Case: A young man, Li, escaped after causing minor injuries in a fight. Two years later, under the persuasion of his family, he voluntarily surrendered and paid compensation. The court found the circumstances of the surrender, reduced the penalty by 40% from the base sentence, and sentenced him to probation.

items.title: Do not touch the steering wheel after drinking, including electric cars and "move the car", and do not lend your car to someone who is drunk or does not have a driver's license.
items.core: If you drive under the influence, your license will be suspended for 6 months, and you will be fined 1,000 to 2,000 yuan. If you commit the crime again, you will be detained and revoked. Drunk driving will be immediately suspended and you will not be able to retake the test within 5 years. Generally, you will be prosecuted for the crime of dangerous driving. If you get into an accident while driving while drunk, commercial auto insurance will not cover it. If you lend your car to someone knowing that he is drunk or does not have a driver's license, you will have to compensate for part of the accident.
body: Cost: A few dozen yuan for driving or taking a taxi. Before the party, decide who will not drink today. It is difficult to push back when being persuaded to drink alcohol in a scene.

Benefit: Drunk driving, driver's license suspended for 6 months, fined 1,000 to 2,000 yuan. If the offense occurs again, the offender will be detained for less than 10 days and the driver's license will be revoked. Drunk driving will directly revoke the driver's license, and the driver will not be allowed to retake the test within 5 years. The driver will be held criminally responsible for dangerous driving and sentenced to criminal detention and a fine. Criminal detention is short-term imprisonment. Driving a commercial vehicle is even more serious: 15 days of detention for drunk driving, a fine of 5,000 yuan, and a 5-year driving ban. A drunk driver will be banned from driving for 10 years and will not be able to drive a commercial vehicle again for the rest of his life. Anyone who causes a serious accident or commits a crime while under the influence of alcohol or while driving under the influence will be banned from driving for life. Commercial auto insurance will not cover driving after drinking alcohol or taking drugs. Short-distance drunk driving such as moving a car or parking in a residential area or parking lot will not be treated as a crime. However, the driver's license will still be revoked, and he will be fined and detained for drunk driving. When riding an electric bicycle, the State Council's implementation regulations also state that "drunk driving is not allowed". Violators will be given a warning or a fine of 5 to 50 yuan. Giving your car to someone who does not have a driver's license, or whose driver's license has been revoked or suspended will result in a fine of 200 to 2,000 yuan, and your own driver's license may also be revoked at the same time. If an accident occurs when a rented car is rented out, in principle the driver will be responsible for the compensation. But if you knew or should have known that he was drunk or did not have a driver's license, and you still gave him the car, the court would determine that you were at fault and you would have to compensate for a portion of the fault. In a case announced by the Supreme Court in May 2026, the car owner knew that his deskmate was drunk and still let him drive the car. The car owner was ordered to pay compensation to the extent of 40% with the driver (Nationwide)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Standing Committee of the National People's Congress (2021). Road Traffic Safety Law (revised in 2021, Articles 89, 91, and 99). <https://jtgl.beijing.gov.cn/jgj/jgxx/flfg/fl/205308/index.html> (Reprinted by Beijing Municipal Public Security and Transportation Bureau); State Council (2004). Regulations for the Implementation of the Road Traffic Safety Law (State Council Order No. 405) No. 72). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2008-03/28/content_3745.htm>; Supreme People’s Court, Supreme People’s Procuratorate, Ministry of Public Security, and Ministry of Justice (2023). Opinions on Handling Criminal Cases of Drunk and Dangerous Driving (Articles 12 and 20). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/xwfbh/wsfbt/202312/t20231218_637161.shtml>; National People’s Congress (2020). Civil Code (Article 1,209). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202006/t20200602_463888.shtml>; Supreme People’s Court (2020). Interpretation of Several Issues Concerning the Applicable Law in the Trial of Road Traffic Accident Damage Compensation Cases (2020 Amendment, Article 1). <https://gw.nscourt.gov.cn/nscourt/wzsy/swgk/sfwj/content/post_1473229.html> (Reprinted by Shenzhen Nanshan District People’s Court); Supreme People’s Court (2026). The Supreme People’s Court issued a typical case on road traffic accident damage compensation (Case 1). <https://www.court.gov.cn/zixun/xiangqing/499041.html>; Standing Committee of the National People's Congress (2015). Criminal Law Amendment (9) (Article 8, Article 133-1 of the Criminal Law). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/201802/t20180205_364562.shtml>; Insurance Association of China (2020). Motor Vehicle Commercial Insurance Model Clauses (2020 Edition) (Articles 9 and 22). <https://www.iachina.cn/art/2020/9/4/art_24_104621.html>

Note: Drunk driving is a criminal offense and will be kept on the record, affecting my political review and some professional qualifications. "Drinking" and "drunk" are drawn based on the alcohol content in the blood, and the specific boundaries are set by national standards. This section does not verify this value, so don't rely on your feelings to estimate which level you are in. There is no separate fine in the Road Traffic Safety Act for leaving your car to a drunk person. Article 99: Penalties are only imposed on those who do not have a driver's license, or whose driver's license has been revoked or suspended. The 2023 opinions on drunk driving by the two high authorities and the two ministries do not specifically mention the provision of vehicles. The consequences of this part mainly fall on civil compensation.

Case: After a dinner party, Zhang lent his car to a colleague who had no driver's license and was drinking. The colleague hit someone with the car. The court ruled that Zhang was jointly and severally liable for compensation, and the insurance company refused to settle the commercial insurance claim on the grounds that the car was at fault.

items.title: Do not lend bank cards, mobile phone cards, or payment accounts to anyone, "running scores" is not a part-time job
items.core: Leasing, lending, or selling bank cards, mobile phone cards, and payment accounts to others is illegal in itself. Illegal gains must be confiscated and fined 1 to 10 times. If there is no illegal income or the amount is less than 20,000 yuan, the maximum fine is 200,000 yuan, and in serious cases, the person may be detained for not more than 15 days. If you help the other party to collect and transfer money even though you know it is used to commit a crime, the serious case is a crime of aiding and trusting, and you will be sentenced to less than 3 years.
body: Cost: No money. Some people say, "I'll borrow a card and charge it, and I'll give you a few hundred yuan." Just refuse.

Income: Renting, lending, buying and selling phone cards, bank accounts, payment accounts, and Internet accounts is illegal in itself. The illegal income shall be confiscated and a fine of 1 to 10 times of the illegal income shall be imposed. If there is no illegal income or the illegal income is less than 20,000 yuan, the maximum fine is 200,000 yuan. If the circumstances are serious, he may be detained for up to 15 days. You may also be recorded in your credit record, account functions may be restricted, and non-counter services may be stopped (you can only go to the counter to do so). Knowing that someone else is using the Internet to commit a crime and still providing him with help such as payment and settlement is a serious crime. The crime is the crime of aiding information network criminal activities (referred to as the crime of aiding), sentenced to not more than 3 years and fined (nationally)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress Standing Committee (2022). Anti-Telecommunications Network Fraud Law (Articles 31 and 44). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202209/t20220902_575631.shtml>; National People's Congress Standing Committee (2015). Criminal Law Amendment (9) (Article 29, namely Criminal Law Article 287-2). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/201802/t20180205_364562.shtml>

Note: Saying "I don't know what he is doing with the card" cannot stop him. When handling a case, it will be inferred whether you knew or not based on the external circumstances: if you have received a favor fee or the flow of money is obviously abnormal, you may be considered to have known about it. If your card is used to collect stolen money, even if you do not commit a crime in the end, your account will be frozen and you will be punished. If you swipe someone else's face or read a verification code to pass the real-name verification, the penalty is the same as this one. See Article 45 (Help swipe someone's face).

Case: Xiao Chen, a college student, lent his Alipay account to netizens to “run scores” in order to earn commission. The police found that the account received fraud of 200,000 yuan. Xiao Chen was sentenced to one year in prison and fined for the crime of helping.

items.title: Check your credit report twice a year for free to see if there are any loans and cards that you did not apply for yourself
items.core: You can check your credit report online for free twice a year, and it can be completed in ten minutes. Use the official website of the Credit Reference Center of the People's Bank of China or mobile banking to check. Do not use a third-party "Credit Reference" app. Bad records will be kept for 5 years from the day the incident ends, and should be deleted after that time. If you have any objections, you can submit a written reply within 20 days.
body: Cost: No money. You can check it online in ten minutes.

Income: Administrative regulations state that "personal information subjects have the right to obtain their own credit reports for free twice a year." You can check yourself twice a year for free. The retention period of adverse information is "5 years from the date of termination of the adverse behavior or event; if it exceeds 5 years, it shall be deleted." If you have any objections to the report, you can raise them. The credit reporting agency or the agency that provides this information must respond to you in writing within 20 days from the date of receipt of the objection
Level of Evidence: A

Source: State Council (2013). Regulations on the Administration of the Credit Reporting Industry (National Order No. 631, Articles 16, 17, and 25). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2013-01/29/content_2303.htm>

Note: Identity cards are used fraudulently to obtain online loans and apply for cards. I often only find out when my house loan is rejected, and it has been delayed for several years. The entrance for inquiries is the official website of the Credit Reference Center of the People's Bank of China, or mobile banking. Don’t use third-party “credit check” apps, as those apps themselves collect your information. After helping an acquaintance to "clean their face and bear witness", you should check it out once more. See Article 45 (Help to brush your face). If your credit card is overdue and someone asks for money and says it can "clean your credit", please see Section 7, Article 23 (credit cards and online loans have been repaid). The debit cards and phone cards in your name are not visible in the credit report. You need to check separately. See Section 14, Article 11 (how many phone cards are in your name).

Case: Ms. Liu, a citizen, checked the report through the official website of the Credit Information Center of the People's Bank of China and found that she had an extra credit card from another place under her name. She immediately raised an objection, and the credit reporting center responded and deleted the false record within 20 days.

items.title: If there is a conflict, call the police first but don't take action. The one who strikes first will easily allow the other party to fight back and it will be regarded as self-defense.
items.core: Hit someone, detained for 5 to 10 days, and fined from 500 to 1,000. Those who gang up to beat, beat the elderly, pregnant women, children, disabled people, or repeatedly beat others will be detained for 10 to 15 days and fined one to two thousand. Those who injure someone enough to commit a crime will be sentenced to less than 3 years, and those who inflict serious injuries will be sentenced to 3 to 10 years. Fighting two people against each other does not count as self-defense, so they retreated first and called the police.
body: Cost: No money. Retreat to a crowded place and call the police, so that the other person's actions can be monitored. It's hard not to talk back or push.

Benefits: Those who assault others or intentionally injure others will be detained for 5 to 10 days and fined 500 to 1,000 yuan. Those who fight in groups, hit the elderly, pregnant women, children, disabled people, hit multiple times, or hit multiple people at once will be punished more severely. Detained for 10 to 15 days and fined 1,000 to 2,000 yuan. Fighting in groups will be treated as picking quarrels and provoking troubles, with a maximum detention of 15 days and a fine of 2,000 yuan. Picking quarrels and provoking troubles means causing trouble over nothing. Those who intentionally injure others physically and constitute a crime shall be sentenced to less than 3 years; those who severely injure others shall be sentenced to 3 to 10 years. When two people fight each other, it is legally called a fight and does not count as self-defense. However, if the opponent strikes first and the method is obviously excessive, or if you have tried hard to avoid it and the opponent continues to attack, your counterattack will generally be considered as defense. To be overly defensive is to retaliate too much, and two things must be met at the same time: it is obviously beyond the necessary limit, and it causes significant damage. Even if it is really excessive, the penalty should be reduced or exempted (National Security Management Punishment Law will take effect on January 1, 2026)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress Standing Committee (2025). Public Security Management Punishment Law (revised in 2025, Articles 30 and 51). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202506/t20250627_699863.shtml>; National People’s Congress (1997). Criminal Law (Articles 20 and 234). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/201802/t20180206_364975.shtml>; Supreme People’s Court, Supreme People’s Procuratorate, and Ministry of Public Security (2020). Guidance on the application of the legitimate defense system in accordance with the law (Fafa [2020] No. 31, Articles 6, 9, 11, and 14). <https://www.court.gov.cn/zixun/xiangqing/251611.html>

Note: After the 2025 revision of the Public Security Management Punishment Law, all clause numbers have changed. Assaulting others has been changed from Article 43 of the old law to Article 51, and the information citing the old article is outdated. The degree of injury that qualifies as a crime is determined by the injury appraisal standards and is not verified in this section. If the opponent has fallen to the ground or has run away, even if the aggression has stopped, if you catch up and fight again, it does not count as defense. For self-defense, carry a knife, stick, or electric shock device with you. If caught, you will be fined. See Section 9, Article 26 (Do not buy a stick or electric shock device for self-defense).

Case: A night market stall owner first pushed a customer due to an argument, and the customer retaliated, causing minor injuries. The police determined that the two parties had fought each other and detained the stall owner who struck first for ten days and fined him NT$1,000. The customer was not punished for self-defense.

items.title: If you can't avoid the damage, you can fight back, but only hit the person who is attacking you. Stop when he stops.
items.core: When the other party is harming you or others, if you stop him or injure him, you will not bear criminal responsibility as long as you do not go too far. The other party is committing murder, robbing, raping, kidnapping, and even injuring or killing them is not an exaggeration. But you can only hit the person who is making the move. Stop when he stops. In the end, if the case is decided on your side, you may also be put on file and locked up for a few days.
body: Cost: Lawyer fees start at a few thousand yuan, and those with financial difficulties can apply for legal aid. The price is mainly paid after the fact: they are often charged with intentional injury first, have to cooperate with the investigation, and are even imprisoned for more than ten days. It's hard to stay calm during these days.

Benefit: Criminal law stipulates what counts as self-defense. The country, public interests, one's own or others' personal, property and other rights are being illegally infringed upon. At this time, taking action to stop and injure the person who is intruding is considered self-defense and does not bear criminal responsibility. The same article also reads: "If legitimate defense clearly exceeds the necessary limit and causes serious damage, he shall bear criminal responsibility, but the punishment shall be reduced or exempted." There is another paragraph: "Anyone who takes defensive actions against ongoing assaults, murders, robberies, rapes, kidnappings, and other violent crimes that seriously endanger personal safety, causing casualties and injuries to unlawful infringers, does not constitute excessive defense and is not criminally responsible." The guidance of the two high schools and the first department spells out the boundaries in more detail. To determine that the defense was excessive, both "clearly exceeding necessary limits" and "causing significant damage" must be met, both of which are indispensable. "Causing serious damage" means beating the illegal offender to serious injury or death, and causing minor injuries or lighter injuries does not count. Only when the illegal intruder has truly lost the ability to infringe, or has truly given up the infringement, can the infringement be considered over. Defense must be directed against the unlawful offender himself. If the other party's infringement is obviously minor and you can see it, but you directly stop it in a way that can cause serious injury or death, it will not be considered a defensive act. There are official cases for process costs. Case No. 47, Yu Haiming case: On the night of August 27, 2018, the police opened a case for investigation as an "intentional injury case". On September 1, the Kunshan Municipal Public Security Bureau determined that the case was justified in accordance with Paragraph 3 of Article 20 of the Criminal Law and dismissed the case. Case No. 45 Chen: A student was surrounded by 9 people and fought back with a knife, causing 3 serious injuries. The police opened a case for investigation on suspicion of intentional injury and detained him criminally. The procuratorate determined that it was self-defense and refused to approve the arrest, so the police released the person. After being detained, if the police believe that an arrest is necessary, they should submit it to the procuratorate for review and approval within 3 days (report to the procuratorate for approval or not to approve the arrest). In exceptional circumstances, this may be extended by 1 to 4 days. For major suspects who commit crimes frequently, commit crimes repeatedly, or commit crimes in groups, the period can be extended to 30 days. The Procuratorate will make a decision within 7 days (nationwide)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress (1997). Criminal Law (Article 20). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/201802/t20180206_364975.shtml>; Supreme People's Court, Supreme People's Procuratorate, Ministry of Public Security (2020). Guiding Opinions on the Application of the Justifiable Defense System in accordance with the law (Fafa [2020] No. 31, No. 5, 6, 7, 10, 11, 13, 14, 19). <https://www.court.gov.cn/zixun/xiangqing/251611.html>; Supreme People’s Procuratorate (2018). Twelfth Batch of Guiding Cases (Prosecution Case No. 45 Chen’s Justifiable Defense Case, Case Case No. 47 Yu Haiming’s Justifiable Defense Case). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/jczdal/201812/t20181219_402920.shtml>; Standing Committee of the National People's Congress (2018). Criminal Procedure Law (Amended in 2018, Article 91). Full text reprinted by the People's Procuratorate of Ningxia Hui Autonomous Region <https://www.nx.jcy.gov.cn/zwsy/qwfb/202011/t20201119_608817.html>

Note: The default action is still to retreat and call the police as mentioned in Article 10 (if there is a conflict, call the police first but do not take action). Fighting two people against each other does not count as defense, nor does it count if you chase the other person down or runs away. Only consider fighting back when there is no way back. This is not an encouragement to fight back. There are three things to do afterwards. First, don’t leave the scene after calling the police. Second, quickly secure the surveillance and witnesses. The guidance requires the public security to immediately adjust the video and recording of the scene and question the witnesses as soon as possible. Third, seek a lawyer before being formally questioned by the police, see Article 5 (See a lawyer before being charged). If the case is eventually withdrawn, no prosecution is instituted, or the person is acquitted, he or she may apply for compensation on a daily basis for the days of detention, see Article 35 (State Compensation after Detention). It is also legally allowed to defend others. But if you intervene in a fight between strangers with nothing, you have to calculate the risk separately, see Section 13, Article 37 (Caught in a group of people fighting). The beneficiaries of this article are mainly yourself and your family.

Case: A woman was robbed by a gangster with a knife after get off work. She grabbed the knife and fought back, slightly injuring the gangster. She immediately stopped and called the police. The police determined that his behavior was self-defense and did not exceed the necessary limit, so the case was not filed and the criminal was held accountable.

items.title: Whoever you have a grudge against - being owed wages, being fired, being cheated of money - go to complaint, arbitration, or prosecution, don't go to someone to settle the score.
items.core: If you take the legal route, the worst result is that you won’t get your money back. If you go to take revenge, you still won't get your money back, and the heaviest penalty for killing someone is the death penalty. Xu Jiajin did not receive a diploma and was dissatisfied with the internship remuneration. He killed 8 people and injured 17 people with a knife. He has been executed. You can file a complaint with the labor inspectorate for wage arrears. In 2024, the national labor inspectorate recovered 8.65 billion yuan from 654,000 people.
body: Cost: There is no cost, and there are no fees for complaints and arbitration. It takes one or two trips and a wait of several months. It's hard not to take action in these months.

Earnings: Legal paths have official figures. In 2024, national labor inspections investigated and dealt with 137,000 cases, recovering 8.65 billion yuan in wages for 654,000 people. A further 998 people were sentenced for refusing to pay labor remuneration. For how to file a complaint against labor inspection and apply for labor arbitration due to wage arrears, see Section 7, Article 2. The price of the revenge path is written in Article 232 of the Criminal Law: "Whoever intentionally kills someone shall be sentenced to death, life imprisonment, or fixed-term imprisonment of not less than ten years; if the circumstances are relatively minor, he shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than ten years." Official case: Xu Jiajin failed the exam, did not get a diploma, and was dissatisfied with the internship remuneration. On November 16, 2024, he returned to Wuxi Polytechnic and committed a knife attack, killing 8 people and injuring 17 others. In the first instance, he was sentenced to death for intentional homicide and deprived of political rights for life. The sentence was approved by the Supreme People's Court on January 20, 2025. What he was dissatisfied with was the school and the remuneration, but the victims were his classmates, and he didn’t get any of the remuneration (Nationwide)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress (1997). Criminal Law (Article 232). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/201802/t20180206_364975.shtml>; Xinhua News Agency (2024). A stabbing incident occurred on a campus in Yixing, Jiangsu, resulting in 8 deaths and 17 injuries. <http://www.news.cn/20241117/65a18fddb453469ebe91c78eda669893/c.html> (Reposted from Yixing police report, including the number of casualties and the original motive); Supreme People's Procuratorate (2025). Xu Jiajin, the criminal in the Wuxi campus knife wounding case, was executed. <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/zdgz/202501/t20250120_680197.shtml>; Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security (2025). 2024 Statistical Bulletin on the Development of Human Resources and Social Security. <https://www.mohrss.gov.cn/SYrlzyhshbzb/zwgk/szrs/tjgb/202506/W020250616518526345602.pdf>; Supreme People's Court (2025). Work Report of the Supreme People's Court ("Sentencing Fan Weiqiu who drove into pedestrians and Xu Jiajin who committed a knife attack on campus to death"). <https://www.gov.cn/yaowen/liebiao/202503/content_7013680.htm>

Note: Interns who are still in school are generally not considered to have established a labor relationship with the unit. If you don’t get enough remuneration for your internship, you can only find coordination with the school or file a lawsuit in court. You can’t go through labor arbitration. If you are owed money for private work for a family or individual, you will also have to go to court, see Section 7, Article 22 (first find out who hired you). For details on how to file a complaint and arbitrate if you are owed wages, see Section 7, Article 2. The red line for debt collection is found in Section 9, Article 15 (Debt is collected without the person being charged or involved). If you take the legal route, the worst result is that the money will not be returned, because the settlement of the case does not mean that the money will be received. If you go to take revenge, you still won't get your money back, and the heaviest penalty for killing someone is the death penalty.

items.title: No matter how much you hate, don’t attack irrelevant people: driving into a crowd or committing murder in a public place will be punished by endangering public safety in a dangerous way, with a starting sentence of three years. If the person is dead, the starting sentence will be ten years, and the maximum penalty is death.
items.core: Driving into crowds and committing murders in public places are criminalized as endangering public safety in dangerous ways. No one was hurt, and it was three years ago. The death penalty is more than ten years, life imprisonment, or the death penalty. Fan Weiqiu was dissatisfied with the division of property in a divorce and drove into a group of people exercising at the Zhuhai Sports Center, killing 35 and injuring 43. He has been executed.
body: Cost: Nothing. It was difficult to suppress this idea out of anger.

Proceeds: Article 114 of the Criminal Law: "Anyone who sets fires, breaks water, explodes, releases poisonous, radioactive, infectious disease pathogens and other substances, or uses other dangerous methods to endanger public safety without causing serious consequences shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than ten years." No one was hurt, and it was three years ago. Article 115: Anyone who causes serious injury or death to others, or causes heavy losses to public or private property, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than ten years, life imprisonment, or death. Official case: Because her marriage broke up, her life was frustrated, and she was dissatisfied with the result of the divorce and property division, Fan Weiqiu "decided to vent his personal anger by driving into a crowd." On the evening of November 11, 2024, he drove into a crowd of people exercising at the Zhuhai Sports Center. This time 35 people were killed and 43 injured. In the first instance, he was sentenced to death and deprived of political rights for life for the crime of endangering public security by dangerous means. On January 20, 2025, it was approved and implemented by the Supreme People's Court. What he was dissatisfied with was the division of property in the divorce, but the person who was hit was a runner he didn’t know (National)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress (1997). Criminal Law (Articles 114 and 115). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/201802/t20180206_364975.shtml>; <http://www.news.cn/20241112/29c6af4f6ee4455b92832f3c2b13a93a/c.html> (Reported to the Zhuhai Municipal Public Security Bureau); Supreme People’s Procuratorate (2024). Fan Weiqiu was sentenced to death in the first instance of the case of endangering public safety by dangerous means, and was deprived of political rights for life. <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/zdgz/202412/t20241227_677757.shtml>; Supreme People’s Procuratorate (2025). Fan Weiqiu, the criminal in the Zhuhai driving collision case, was executed. <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/zdgz/202501/t20250120_680196.shtml>; National People’s Congress Standing Committee (2025). Public Security Management Punishment Law (revised in 2025, Articles 29 and 50). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202506/t20250627_699863.shtml>

Note: "I don't want to live anyway" is not a discount in sentencing. The Supreme People's Court's 2025 work report stated that "the heinous criminals who challenge the legal and moral bottom line will be resolutely punished severely, severely and expeditiously in accordance with the law." Just talking about it is already illegal. Anyone who threatens to set fire, explode or poison, thereby disrupting public order, will be detained for 5 to 10 days and fined up to 1,000 yuan. It is also illegal to write threatening letters or use other methods to threaten someone's personal safety. This kind of person will be detained for not more than 5 days, or fined not more than 1,000 yuan. These two items are calculated according to the public security management penalties that will be implemented on January 1, 2026. If your thoughts have reached this point, please see No. 14 (treating the thought of "putting someone on your back" as an emergency treatment).

items.title: If you have thoughts of "taking a back seat" or "die together", treat it as an emergency: leave the scene, give the car keys and knife to others, and call 12356
items.core: The window from when such an idea arises to when it comes to action is very short. Of the 82 people who attempted suicide, 47.6% said it took less than 10 minutes from the first thought to the act. So what we have to do is not to "figure it out", but to put a step away from the steering wheel, the knife, the gas valve, and the rope, and get through these ten minutes. Then dial 12356.
body: Cost: Nothing. It's hard to admit that something is wrong with you at the moment, and it's also hard to put things in someone else's hands.

Benefits: The window from such an idea to action is very short. Researchers interviewed 82 suicide attempters within three days of admission. 47.6% of them said that it took no more than 10 minutes from the first idea to implementation. A 10-year systematic review, which combines research from a decade, concluded that the evidence for limiting lethal methods continues to grow. After painkillers were controlled, suicides related to them dropped by 43%. Suicides dropped by 86% (79% to 91%) after jump hotspots were protected. Keep the steering wheel, knife, gas valve, and rope one step away, and wait for these ten minutes to pass. 12356 is the national unified psychological assistance hotline, which is available for no less than 18 hours a day (nationwide, starting from May 1, 2025)
Level of Evidence: B

Source: Deisenhammer EA et al (2009). The duration of the suicidal process: how much time is left for intervention between consideration and accomplishment of a suicide attempt? Journal of Clinical Psychiatry. <https://doi.org/10.1016/S2215-0366(16)30030-X>; National Health Commission (2024). Notice on the application of "12356" national unified psychological assistance hotline number (National Health Medical Administration Letter [2024] No. 259). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202412/content_6994470.htm>

Note: The reason for rating B is that both pieces of evidence come from literature on suicide, and are not directly studied when applied to the "impulse to harm others". The Deisenhammer project only had 82 people doing it in one hospital. Don't drive when you're not in good condition, and don't go on duty where you are responsible for the safety of others. Hand over your shift first. If you want to harm yourself, see Section 1, Article 25 (call 12356 if you have suicidal thoughts). What to do first when you feel depressed, see Section 3, Item 18.

Case: Ms. Zhao, who was suffering from postpartum depression, suddenly had the idea of ​​​​"taking advantage of her family" and immediately gave the fruit knife at home to a neighbor for temporary storage and called the 12356 hotline. The psychiatrist intervened urgently and successfully resolved the crisis.

items.title: Don’t take it seriously when people around you say, “No one should have a better time” or “Take the kids with you.” Close relatives can be sent to the hospital directly, but the police must also take care of them when they receive the alarm.
items.core: The family members said, "No one should have a better time" and "Take the child with you." Like if someone has a mental problem, close relatives can send him to the hospital for diagnosis. If you are diagnosed with a severe mental disorder, have been violent, or are about to get into trouble, you do not need your consent to be hospitalized. If you can't tell whether it's an angry comment or the truth, call 12356 first to ask, or call 110 to have the police arrive. Hiding something for him doesn't count as helping him.
body: Cost: Registration and examination fees range from tens to hundreds of yuan. A trip to the hospital with her would take half a day to a day. The hard part is to ask him to go with you.

Benefits: Paragraph 1 of Article 28 of the Mental Health Law reads: "In addition to individuals going to medical institutions for mental disorder diagnosis on their own, close relatives of patients with suspected mental disorders may send them to medical institutions for mental disorder diagnosis." Paragraph 2 of Article 28 of the Mental Health Law reads: “If a patient with a suspected mental disorder engages in behavior that harms himself or endangers the safety of others, or is in danger of harming himself or endangering the safety of others, his close relatives, his employer, and the local public security agency shall immediately take measures to stop him and send him to a medical institution for mental disorder diagnosis.” The same article also stipulates: "Medical institutions shall not refuse to diagnose patients suspected of having mental disorders when they receive treatment." Article 29 requires the hospital to keep such people in the hospital, immediately assign a psychiatric practitioner to make a diagnosis, and issue a conclusion in a timely manner. Article 30 stipulates that hospitalization treatment is voluntary. But there is an exception: the diagnosis shows that the patient is a person with a severe mental disorder, and "has committed behavior that endangers the safety of others, or is in danger of endangering the safety of others." In this category, he should be hospitalized without his consent. Threatening to hurt someone can be directly reported to 110. Anyone who writes threatening letters or uses other methods to threaten the personal safety of others shall be detained for not more than 5 days or fined not more than 1,000 yuan.
