Anyone who threatens to set fire, explode, or drop dangerous substances and disrupts public order will be detained for 5 to 10 days and may be fined up to 1,000 yuan (National Public Security Administration Punishment Law will take effect on January 1, 2026)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress Standing Committee (2025). Public Security Management Punishment Law (revised in 2025, Articles 29 and 50). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202506/t20250627_699863.shtml>; National People's Congress Standing Committee (2012, revised in 2018). Mental Health Law (Articles 28, 29, 30, 35). <https://www.gov.cn/guoqing/2021-10/29/content_5647635.htm>; French Air Accident Investigation Bureau BEA (2016). Final Report BEA2015-0125.en: Accident on 24 March 2015 at Prads-Haute-Bléone to the Airbus A320-211 registered D-AIPX operated by Germanwings. <https://bea.aero/uploads/tx_elydbrapports/BEA2015-0125.en-LR.pdf>

Note: According to the size of the beneficiary, this item counts spouses, parents, and children living together. "No one should have a good time" usually includes you, and the law gives the right to seek medical treatment to close relatives. Outsiders can't control it if they want to, and they can only call the police. Hospital referral is only used for real danger signs. Angry words during an argument do not count, nor can they be used to send a disobedient family member to the hospital. The same law also states: If a person is found not to have a serious mental disorder after another examination or appraisal, the hospital shall not keep him in hospital (Article 35). If you can't tell, call 12356 first, or call 110 to have the police arrive. If you are not sure whether he is seeking death, you can ask him directly. Asking will not make him think more, see Section 1, Item 43 (directly ask the person around you who is not in the right mood). The investigation into Germanwings Flight 9525 concluded that the authorities and employer were unable to do anything to prevent the co-pilot from flying that day. The reason was that "neither he nor anyone else - doctors, colleagues or family members - informed them." All 150 people on board were killed, including 2 pilots, 4 flight attendants, and 144 passengers.

Case: A mentally disturbed father claimed to "take the child with him". The daughter noticed something was wrong and immediately contacted her relatives to send her to the hospital. The doctor diagnosed him with a severe mental disorder and violent tendencies, and arranged for hospitalization in accordance with the law.

items.title: Do not curse people online, spread rumors, or forward unverified things; if you are raped by the Internet, please leave a certificate first and then call the police.
items.core: Those who publicly curse others or spread rumors and defamation shall be detained for not more than 5 days, or fined not more than 1,000 yuan. If the circumstances are more serious, they may be detained for 5 to 10 days. If the circumstances are serious, it constitutes the crime of insult or defamation, and the sentence is not more than 3 years. On the other hand, when you are abused online, in principle you have to go to court to sue for insult or defamation yourself, so you have to take screenshots, record the screen, and save the link yourself.
body: Cost: Nothing. Think for ten seconds before posting. When attacked, take screenshots or record the screen, save the link and account ID, and complain to the platform before calling the police. It's hard not to scold you back when you're scolded.

Benefits: Anyone who openly insults others or fabricates facts to slander others shall be detained for not more than 5 days or fined not more than 1,000 yuan. If the circumstances are serious, he will be detained for 5 to 10 days. Those who repeatedly send insulting and threatening messages, harass, stalk, secretly photograph and spread other people's privacy will also be punished in the same way. Anyone who deliberately spreads rumors and disrupts public order shall be detained for 5 to 10 days. If the circumstances are serious, it constitutes the crime of insult or slander, and the sentence is not more than 3 years. If you are defamed online and have difficulty obtaining evidence, you can ask the court to request public security assistance (National Security Management Punishment Law will take effect on January 1, 2026)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress Standing Committee (2025). Public Security Management Punishment Law (revised in 2025, Articles 29 and 50). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202506/t20250627_699863.shtml>; National People's Congress (1997). Criminal Law (Article 246). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/201802/t20180206_364975.shtml>; Standing Committee of the National People's Congress (2015). Criminal Law Amendment (9) (Article 16, adding the third paragraph of Article 246 of the Criminal Law). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/201802/t20180205_364562.shtml>; Standing Committee of the National People's Congress (2015). Criminal Law Amendment (9) (Added third paragraph to Article 246). Full text reproduced by the National Bureau of Letters and Calls <https://www.gjxfj.gov.cn/gjxfj/fgwj/flfg/webinfo/2017/03/1601761496614423.htm>; Supreme People’s Court and Supreme People’s Procuratorate (2013). Interpretation of several issues concerning the application of law in handling criminal cases such as using information networks to commit defamation (Fa Interpretation [2013] No. 21, Article 1). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/zdgz/201309/t20130910_62417.shtml>

Note: In principle, the two crimes of insult and slander are handled by those who complain. That means you have to go to court yourself. The police generally do not take the initiative to file a case, and they have to rely on themselves to collect evidence. There are two exceptions. The first is "except for those that seriously endanger social order and national interests." Such cases can be handled directly by the police (Criminal Law Article 246, Paragraph 2). Second, if someone is defamed online and it is really difficult to collect evidence on their own, the court can ask the public security to help with the investigation (paragraph 3 of the same article, newly added in the ninth amendment to the Criminal Law). You will still be held responsible if you forward it. The 2013 interpretation of Internet defamation by the two top universities stated: If you knowingly post something online that is fabricated and damaging to others' reputation, and the circumstances are egregious, it will be considered as "fabricating facts to slander others." For how to deal with yourself after being bullied online, see Article 37 of this section (if you are bullied online, first consolidate the evidence and then find a way out). The prohibition on insult and defamation was changed from Article 42 of the old law to Article 50 of the new law.

Case: The shop owner found out that he was rumored to be "selling expired food", so he immediately recorded the screen to collect evidence and saved the original link. After filing a lawsuit in court, the rumor monger was convicted of defamation and sentenced to a public apology and compensation for emotional distress.

items.title: Read the paper before signing. Do not sign for others or sign on blank paper.
items.core: If you sign, it will count, and if you press your fingerprint, it will count just like your signature. "I didn't see it clearly" and "I thought it was something else" are difficult to establish in court. So take a few extra minutes to read from cover to cover, ask questions on the spot if you don’t understand, and take photos to keep the notes. Do not sign for others, do not sign on blank paper, and clearly indicate the purpose of the ID copy.
body: Cost: Nothing. Take a few more minutes to read the contract, IOU, letter of guarantee, and employment documents from cover to cover. If you don’t understand, ask on the spot and take photos to keep the record. The difficulty lies in reading it slowly in front of the other person.

Benefits: A contract established in accordance with the law is protected by law and is binding on both parties who sign it. Once signed, the agreement must be fully fulfilled. Article 490 of the Civil Code states that when a contract is concluded with a written contract, the contract is established when both parties "sign, seal or fingerprint". Fingerprinting, signature and sealing are three parallel methods, and the contract will be established equally after fingerprinting. "I didn't see it clearly" and "I thought it was something else" are difficult to establish in court. If you don’t sign, you won’t be saddled with debts and responsibilities that don’t belong to you (Nationwide)
Level of Evidence: A
Source: National People's Congress (2020). Civil Code (Articles 465, 490, 509). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202006/t20200602_463888.shtml>

Remarks: "Do not sign for others, do not sign blank paper, and state the purpose of the ID copy" is an empirical practice, and there is no separate official document. Their purpose is the same: Don't let your signature be spelled into a legally binding contract that you have to accept. Electronic signatures and face-scanning confirmations will generally be recognized by the court as being signed by you yourself. If an acquaintance asks you to help him brush his face and sign for a loan, see Article 45 (Help him brush his face). For those who have signed a blank labor contract, see Section 19 and Article 25 (you must get back your share of the labor contract).

Case: The tenant signed and fingerprinted the blank contract handed over by the landlord, but the landlord later added a high penalty clause without authorization. Since the tenant had no evidence to prove his ignorance, the court ordered him to perform his obligations in accordance with the contract.

items.title: Write out an IOU when borrowing money. Before guarantying for someone, think clearly whether you are willing to pay it back for him
items.core: The IOU must be written in full: lender, borrower, amount, interest rate, term, repayment method, and signed by both parties. The money will be transferred, no cash will be given, and only when everything is written down can you sue. When guarantying for someone, look carefully for the word "jointly and severally". Generally, you have to wait until the creditor fails to pay the borrower's money before it's your turn, and you can ask for the joint and several payment directly from you.
body: Cost: No money. Use a piece of paper to write down the lender, borrower, amount, interest rate, term and repayment method, and both parties will sign. Money is transferred, leaving traces, and no cash is given.

Income: The loan contract should be in written form, and the content generally includes the type, currency, purpose, amount, interest rate, term and repayment method of the loan. Only when you have written it all can you sue. If the guarantee contract does not specify which method of guarantee shall be used, or if it is not written clearly, the general guarantee shall be considered. Guarantors of general guarantees can wait. The debtor must first file a lawsuit or arbitration, and then apply to enforce the borrower's property. If the payment is still not received after the execution, it will be your turn to pay it back for him. On the other hand, if you sign a "Joint and Several Liability Guarantee", you will not have this layer of protection. People who want debts can come to you directly (nationwide)
Level of Evidence: A
Source: National People's Congress (2020). Civil Code (Articles 668, 681, 686, 687). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202006/t20200602_463888.shtml>

Note: The court will not protect the part of the loaned money with interest exceeding 4 times LPR, see Section 7. It is a rule of thumb to write your ID number and indicate "loan" on the IOU. Whether there is the word "jointly and severally" on the guarantee letter will determine whether you will be behind the borrower or side by side with him for debt collection. Read it clearly before signing. It was said that you would be the guarantor, but what was actually signed was a loan contract. See Article 45 (you are the borrower, not the guarantor).

Case: Lao Zhou provided joint liability guarantee for a friend’s loan. After the friend ran away, the creditor directly sued Lao Zhou. The court ruled that Lao Zhou should repay the principal and interest on his behalf, and his salary account was frozen and debited in accordance with the law.

items.title: There is a time limit for rights protection: 3 years for civil litigation and 1 year for labor arbitration. It is enough for the other party to say "the statute of limitations has expired"
items.core: 3 years for civil litigation, starting from the day you know your rights have been damaged. After the expiration date, the court will not take the initiative to deal with it, but it is enough for the other party to say "the statute of limitations has expired" in court. The money is still there, but it will not be returned. Before the three years expire, a reminder message that leaves traces can cause the three years to be recalculated from scratch. Labor disputes are another set of cases, with a statute of limitations of 1 year for arbitration.
body: Cost: No money. Don’t just push for payment in your mind, use WeChat, text messages, emails or registered letters to leave traces.

Income: The Civil Code stipulates that "the statute of limitations for requesting the People's Court for protection of civil rights is three years." The starting point is "from the date when the rights holder knew or should have known that the rights were harmed and the obligor". It is calculated from the day when you know that you have suffered a loss and know who to contact. The maximum period shall not exceed 20 years from the date on which the rights were impaired. When the period expires, "the obligor may raise a defense for non-performance of the obligation." The court will not overturn the statute of limitations on its own, but it will be effective as soon as the other party mentions it in court. The money is still there, but it will never be returned. There are four things that will interrupt the statute of limitations, and once it is interrupted, the three years will be recalculated from the beginning. One is that you ask the person who owes you a debt to fulfill it. The second is that the other party agrees to perform. The third is to sue or apply for arbitration. The fourth is other situations with the same effect as these. The interruption must occur before the expiration of 3 years. If you call after the expiration date, the statute of limitations will not be recalculated. If it is agreed to repay in installments, the calculation will start from the day when the last installment is due. There are four categories of claims that are not subject to statute of limitations. The first is to stop infringement, remove obstacles, and eliminate dangers. The second is to get back your real estate and registered movables. The third is alimony, alimony, and alimony. The fourth is other situations stipulated by law. Labor disputes are another set: the statute of limitations for arbitration is 1 year, starting from the date when the person knew or should have known that the rights had been infringed. However, “If a dispute arises due to arrears of labor remuneration during the existence of the labor relationship, the employee’s application for arbitration is not subject to the limitation period for arbitration stipulated in paragraph 1 of this article; however, if the labor relationship is terminated, it shall be submitted within one year from the date of termination of the labor relationship” (National)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People’s Congress (2020). Civil Code (Articles 188, 189, 192, 193, 195, 196, 197). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202006/t20200602_463888.shtml>; National People’s Congress Standing Committee (2007). Labor Dispute Mediation and Arbitration Law (Article 27). <https://rsj.ankang.gov.cn/Content-2150407.html> (Reprinted by Ankang Human Resources and Social Security Bureau)

Note: This is probably the cheapest thing in the book. Before the three years expire, a reminder message that leaves traces can restart the three years. If you do nothing, you may lose your ability to win the case. An agreement in advance that "I will not issue a statute of limitations" does not count, nor does the agreement between the two parties to change the three years to a longer or shorter period. On the other hand, if the other party still agrees to repay after the deadline, they can no longer use the statute of limitations to refuse to repay. Those who have repaid it voluntarily cannot take it back. IOUs and guarantees are provided in Section 18 (IOUs and guarantees). The stage of being executed is shown in Article 20 (Being prosecuted and executed and reporting property truthfully). Overtime pay and untaken annual leave pay are subject to labor arbitration, see Section 19, Articles 1 and 2. The statute of limitations for double wages without a signed contract varies from place to place. See Section 19, Article 20 (Double wages).

Case: In 2020, a friend borrowed 50,000 yuan and failed to repay it. When the statute of limitations was about to expire, he sent a dated reminder message on WeChat and kept the screenshot. The lawsuit was filed three years later. The other party claimed that the statute of limitations had expired. The court determined that the statute of limitations had to be recalculated due to reminders and ordered full repayment.

items.title: If you are sued or executed, report your property truthfully and repay as much as you can, and do not transfer the house and money to relatives, friends or companies
items.core: Giving the house for free or pretending to transfer it to the company, or transferring the money to relatives and friends, so that the judgment cannot be executed, is a crime of resisting execution. The sentence for refusing to comply is not more than 3 years, and for particularly serious cases, the sentence is 3 to 7 years. Relatives and friends who even knowingly helped hide the money and transfer it were counted as accomplices, and the money was still recovered. Individuals who refuse to report or falsely report property may be fined up to 100,000 yuan and detained for up to 15 days.
body: Cost: No money. Report property as required by the court: what is there now and what was there in the year before the date of receipt of the execution notice. Pay back what you can first. If the debt is not paid, negotiate settlement and installments with the person applying for execution. The person applying for execution is the party demanding the debt.

Proceeds: Transferring property is an incriminating situation in itself. The Standing Committee of the National People's Congress has interpreted Article 313 of the Criminal Law. The explanation directly lists "the person subject to execution hiding, transferring, deliberately damaging property or transferring property for free, or transferring property at an obviously unreasonable low price, making the judgment or ruling unable to be executed" as "refuse to execute despite having the ability to execute, the circumstances are serious." Hiding money, transferring money, deliberately destroying your own things, giving them away for free, selling them cheaply, making the judgment impossible to enforce, all count. The 2024 interpretations of the two top courts (Supreme People's Court and Supreme People's Procuratorate) added ten more items. This includes disposing of one's own property rights through false settlements and false transfers. It also includes buying other people's property at obviously unreasonable high prices and guaranteeing other people's debts. These are all deliberate attempts to deprive oneself of assets that can be used to repay debts. The sentence for resisting execution is less than 3 years. If the circumstances are particularly serious, the sentence will be 3 to 7 years and a fine. Particularly serious cases refer to the following situations: using false litigation, false arbitration, and false notarization to impede execution. Crowds gathered to storm the execution site. Besieging, detaining, and beating enforcement officers. The person applying for execution committed suicide and harmed himself because of his refusal to execute. An outsider who is not a party to the case but who knowingly colludes with him and helps hide the money and transfer the property shall be punished as an accomplice (associate) of the crime of resisting execution. Property that has been illegally disposed of should be recovered (recovered) or ordered to be compensated in accordance with the law. If the transfer is carried out after the defendant receives the notice to respond and before the judgment takes effect, the same shall be counted. In civil matters, if the debt is given away for free or is transferred at an obviously unreasonable low price, the debtor can ask the court to cancel the transfer. If a person refuses to report or falsely reports property, the court may fine an individual up to 100,000 yuan. Can also be detained for up to 15 days (nationwide, interpretation by the two top courts starting from December 2024)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress Standing Committee (2002). Interpretation of Article 313 of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China. <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2002/content_61738.htm>; Supreme People's Court, Supreme People's Procuratorate (2024). Interpretation on Several Issues Concerning the Application of Law in Handling Refusal to Enforce Judgments and Adjudication of Criminal Cases (Fa Interpretation [2024] No. 13, Articles 3, 4, 5, 6, 8, 11, and 12). The release page of the Supreme People's Court, the full text is verified and reprinted from Guangzhou Prison, Guangdong Province. <https://www.court.gov.cn/fabu/xiangqing/447931.html>, <http://gzjy.gd.gov.cn/zxxx/content/post_4608108.html>; National People’s Congress Standing Committee (2015). Criminal Law Amendment (9) (Article 39, amending Criminal Law Article 313). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/201802/t20180205_364562.shtml>; National People’s Congress (2020). Civil Code (Articles 538, 539, 540). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202006/t20200602_463888.shtml>; National People’s Congress Standing Committee (2023 revision). Civil Procedure Law (Articles 114, 118, 252). Reprinted by the Guizhou Provincial Market Supervision Bureau: <https://amr.guizhou.gov.cn/zwgk/xxgkml/jcxxgk/zcfg/fl/202401/t20240129_83645867.html>

Note: The "putting the house under the name of the company as an employee dormitory and transferring all the money to relatives" circulated on the Internet is not a loophole, but a free gift and fake transfer named in the judicial interpretation. Relatives, friends, and companies who help you operate will be counted as friends, and the property that should be recovered will still be recovered. On the other hand, really having no money does not constitute this crime. To determine whether you "don't have money to pay back", you must first deduct the necessary expenses for yourself and the family you want to support. If you pay back part or all of the money before the Procuratorate prosecutes you, and the circumstances are minor, you may not be prosecuted. Those who return the case before the first-instance judgment may be given a lighter sentence or even be exempted from punishment. What to do after being included in the list or restricted from consumption, see Article 21 (Consumption Restricted or Listed as Untrustworthy). For how to recover after performance, see Section 7, Article 19 (How to come back after being on the default list).

Case: Boss Wang was sued for owing 800,000 yuan. After losing the lawsuit, he faked the sale of the house in his name to a relative and transferred the ownership, transferring the deposit to a friend's company. After the court found out, he was sentenced to two years for resisting law enforcement. His relatives and friends who helped transfer the property were also fined for being accomplices, and all the money was recovered.

items.title: If your consumption is restricted or you are included in the list of dishonest people, first find out which article you are included in, and apply for correction if you can correct it
items.core: First find out whether you are restricted in consumption or on the list of dishonest people. These are two different things. There are only six situations that can be included in the breach of trust list, and not all are counted as 2 years. If the deletion conditions are met, the court shall delete the name within 3 working days. Nine types of consumption are subject to high limits and prohibitions, including taking the G-prefixed high-speed rail. You can apply one at a time for things necessary for life or business.
body: Cost: No money. Go to the enforcement court to find out under which category you are included. Prepare proof that you have paid back the money and complied with the judgment (proof of performance), or prepare guarantee materials. The consumption necessary for life and business must be applied for one at a time. The difficulty is that you have to go back and forth and apply again and again.

Benefits: There are only six situations in which you are included in the list of dishonest people. One is that one has the ability to perform but refuses to perform. The second is to use forged evidence and threats of violence to hinder execution. The third is to avoid execution through false litigation, false arbitration, or concealment and transfer of property. The fourth is violation of the property reporting system. The fifth is violation of the consumption restriction order. Sixth, refusing to perform the settlement agreement without justifiable reasons. If a sufficient and effective guarantee has been provided, or the property seized, seized and frozen is sufficient to repay the debt, it shall not be included under the first item (refuse to perform despite being able to perform). If the person subject to execution is a minor, he shall not be included. If included due to the second to sixth circumstances, the period is 2 years. The first item "refusing to perform despite having the ability to perform" cannot be directly applied to this period. If the threat of violence is used to hinder execution, the circumstances are serious, or there are multiple acts of breach of trust, the period may be extended from 1 to 3 years. If there is no time limit, the court shall delete it within 3 working days if it has been performed, the settlement agreement has been performed, or the court has ruled to terminate the execution. If there is a time limit for inclusion, this set of conditions shall not apply and the court shall delete it within 3 working days after the expiry of the time limit. If you actively perform or correct untrustworthy behavior, you can also delete it in advance. Individuals who are restricted from consumption cannot engage in nine categories of high consumption, nor can they engage in consumption that is not necessary for life and work. One is to take second-class or above cabins by plane, train, soft sleeper, or ship. The second is high consumption in hotels, hotels, nightclubs and golf courses above star rating. The third is to buy real estate, or build, expand or high-end decorated houses. The fourth is to rent high-end office buildings, hotels, and apartments to work. The fifth is to buy vehicles that are not necessary for business operations. Sixth, travel and vacation. Seventh, their children attend high-fee private schools. Eighth, spend high premiums to buy insurance and financial products. 9. Take any seat on a G-EMU train, or a first-class or higher seat on other EMU trains. If you need to do one of these things for your life or business, you should apply to the court and get approval before you can do it. The court can lift the height limit if a reliable and effective guarantee is provided, or with the consent of the person applying for execution (nationwide)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Supreme People's Court (2017 revision). Several regulations on the publication of information on the list of dishonest persons subject to execution (Articles 1, 2, 3, 4, and 10). <https://www.court.gov.cn/fabu/xiangqing/37182.html>; Supreme People's Court (2015 revision). Several regulations on restricting high consumption and related consumption of persons subject to execution (Fa Interpretation [2015] No. 17, Articles 3, 8, and 9): "(9) Taking all seats on G-prefixed EMU trains, first-class or above seats on other EMU trains, and other consumption behaviors that are not necessary for life and work." <https://www.court.gov.cn/fabu/xiangqing/15046.html>

Remarks: Height restrictions are restrictions on high consumption. This regulation was promulgated in 2010 and revised in 2015 by Law Interpretation [2015] No. 17. The name was changed to "...and certain provisions related to consumption", and this article is written according to the revised current text. There are three important aspects to this change in 2015. It adds Category 9, and all high-speed rail seats count. It deleted the limitation of "paying with one's own property" and originally read "the following acts of paying with one's own property are prohibited." It also stipulates that if the unit's consumption is restricted, the actual controller will also be restricted. However, if the unit spends personal money for private consumption, it can apply to the enforcement court. List of untrustworthy persons and restriction of consumption are two different things. They may only be related to the same thing. How to come back after being deleted from the list, see Section 7, Article 19 (How to come back after being on the list of dishonest persons). The current text does not specify whether spouses and children can spend their own money without restrictions. If you encounter this, ask the enforcement court.

Case: After Lao Li was restricted from height, he failed to buy a high-speed rail ticket prefixed with G, only to find that he was also included in the list of dishonest people. He found out that the performance information was not updated and submitted the payment voucher to the court for correction. Within 3 working days, the record of breach of trust was deleted and the height limit was lifted.

items.title: If you are cheated in online shopping or second-hand transactions, first complain to the platform, then call the police, and then decide whether it is worth suing
items.core: Find the platform first. The platform has deposit and penalty rules, and the processing is fastest. Call the police again: Being defrauded of 3,000 yuan to more than 10,000 yuan is enough for fraud. The standards are different in each province. If the amount is not enough, the punishment will be public security. If you want to file a lawsuit, online shopping disputes can be filed in the court at the place of delivery. For small amounts, small claims litigation can be concluded within 2 months, and the case can be filed online.
body: Cost: Complaining and calling the police on the platform do not cost money. When suing, if the amount in dispute is less than 10,000 yuan, the acceptance fee is 50 yuan; if the lawsuit is simplified, mediated or the lawsuit is withdrawn, the fee will be halved. Case filing, court hearings, and execution each take at least half a day to a day. Online case filing can save you the trouble of doing errands. To save orders, chat records, transfer records and logistics orders. The hard part is not giving up halfway when you are going back and forth.

Profit: Fraud ranging from 3,000 yuan to more than 10,000 yuan constitutes a "relatively large amount" of fraud. Each province sets local standards within this range. In this category, the sentence is less than 3 years, plus a fine or only a fine. Those who do not meet criminal standards will be punished according to public security management: detained for 5 to 10 days, or fined not more than 2,000 yuan. If the circumstances are serious, they may be detained for 10 to 15 days and may be fined up to 3,000 yuan. Civilly, online shopping contract disputes can be litigated in the court at the place of delivery, without having to go to the seller's location. If the amount in dispute is less than 50% of the average annual salary of employees in the province in the previous year, small claims litigation will apply. The first instance of small claims litigation is final (the verdict will take effect once the verdict is reached and cannot be appealed). The case will be concluded within 2 months after filing, and the simplified procedure will take 3 months. Civil litigation can be conducted online and has the same effect as offline (National Civil Procedure Law from January 2024, Public Security Management Penalty Law from January 2026)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Supreme People's Court, Supreme People's Procuratorate (2011). Interpretation of several issues regarding the specific application of law in handling criminal cases of fraud (Fa Interpretation [2011] No. 7, Article 1). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/sfjs/201802/t20180201_363736.shtml>; National People’s Congress (1997). Criminal Law (Article 266). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/201802/t20180206_364975.shtml>; Standing Committee of the National People's Congress (2025). Public Security Administration Punishment Law (revised in 2025, Article 58). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202506/t20250627_699863.shtml>; National People’s Congress Standing Committee (2023 revision). Civil Procedure Law (Articles 16, 164, 165, 168). <https://fgw.sh.gov.cn/ys-syjf-zc-2.4.1-h5/20240408/073febdb2b04464390546232d4089f51.html> (Reprinted by Shanghai Development and Reform Commission); Supreme People’s Court (2022 revision). Interpretation on the application of the Civil Procedure Law (Article 20). <https://www.court.gov.cn/zixun/xiangqing/353651.html>; State Council (2006). Measures for the payment of litigation fees (State Council Order No. 481, Articles 13, 15, and 16). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2008-03/28/content_6929.htm>

Note: Whether it is worth it can be calculated as follows: multiply your after-tax hourly wage by the time it takes to get in, plus the court acceptance fee. Filing a case, holding court, and possibly applying for execution each take half a day to one day. Calculate it and compare it with the money you want to get back, then apply a discount and estimate whether you can actually get the money if you win. Whether to fight or not depends on this account. After the Public Security Administration Punishment Law was revised in 2025, all the article numbers have changed, and theft and fraud has been changed from Article 49 of the old law to Article 58. After the Civil Procedure Law is revised in 2023, small claims litigation will be in Article 165. Don't copy old information in either of these places. "Platform complaints are given priority" is based on experience: the platform has deposit and penalty rules and handles them the fastest. Legal Interpretation [2011] No. 7 does not have a document number on the official website of the Procuratorate. The document number needs to be verified with the original text page of the Supreme Court.

Case: Ms. Zhang purchased a fake bag online. She first complained to the platform and submitted photos of the fake goods. The platform froze the merchant’s deposit refund. The merchant still refused to admit it. After calling the police, she reported that the amount was not enough to defraud, so she filed a case online with the court at the place where the goods were received. She took a small claims lawsuit for two months and received compensation.

items.title: For large gifts in love and marriage, think carefully before handing them over. In principle, you will not get them back after you hand them over
items.core: Once the money is handed over, in principle, you will not get it back. Things sent out can only be withdrawn at will before they are transferred to the other party's name. After the transfer is completed, the transfer can only be withdrawn if the other party seriously harms you or your close relatives, fails to support you when it should, or fails to perform its agreed obligations. So before making a large transfer, think clearly whether it is a loan or a gift.
body: Cost: No money. Before making a large transfer, think about it: is this a loan or a gift? If it is a loan, write an IOU, and write "loan" in the transfer note. The difficulty lies in opening your mouth to say these words.

Income: Things given away can be revoked before they pass to the other party's name. The law calls this point the transfer of property rights. Once the transfer and transfer are completed, there are only three situations left to cancel it. One is that the party receiving the thing has seriously violated you or your close relatives. The second is that I don’t support you when I should. The third is failure to perform the obligations stipulated in the gift contract. Gifts given on memorable occasions such as holidays and birthdays are not considered betrothal gifts if they are of little value. Daily consumption expenses to express or enhance feelings are not considered betrothal gifts. These two categories do not return the betrothal gift when breaking up (nationwide)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress (2020). Civil Code (Articles 658, 663). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202006/t20200602_463888.shtml>; Supreme People's Court (2024). Provisions on Several Issues Concerning the Application of Law in the Trial of Cases Involving Betrothal Disputes (Fa Interpretation [2024] No. 1, Article 3). <https://www.court.gov.cn/fabu/xiangqing/423442.html>

Note: "Special amounts such as 520 and 1314 are usually recognized as gifts" is a common saying in practice. The official original text of the Supreme Court has not been found in this section and is not a conclusion. If you go to a notary office to notarize a gift, you cannot go back on it just by saying you regret it. Whether a transfer is considered a loan or a gift depends on the evidence in the end. The sentence "I will lend you this money first" in the chat history is much more useful than arguing afterward.

Case: During the relationship, Xiao Li transferred 500,000 yuan to his girlfriend to buy a house, with a note of "gift", and the house was transferred to his girlfriend's name. After the breakup, Xiao Li wanted to get it back, but the court found that the delivery was complete and there was no serious infringement, so it was a free gift and it was ruled not to be returned.

items.title: Transfer the bride price and make notes, and keep the chat records; you can get it back if you borrow money for marriage
items.core: Asking for property through marriage is prohibited by law, and the court supports the return. Those who have not registered, those who have registered but do not live together, or those who gave a bride price before marriage and made life difficult for the party who gave the money can request a return. Those who have registered and live together will generally not be refunded. Therefore, the bride price, three gold coins, and the correction fee are all transferred and the purpose is noted. Whoever gives the money will leave the evidence. The same applies to men and women.
body: Cost: Nothing. Betrothal gifts, three gold coins, and correction fees should all be transferred, and the purpose should be clearly stated in the notes. Say something good verbally, leave a trace in the chat record, or ask family members to be present to confirm.

Profit: The law prohibits the use of marriage to obtain property. If one party asks for property through marriage in the name of bride price, the other party demands return, and the court supports it. There are three situations in which you can request a refund. First, there was no marriage registration. The second is that they have registered but really do not live together. Third, the betrothal gift is given before the marriage, which makes life difficult for the party who contributed the money. Those who have registered and live together will generally not be returned. However, if the time of living together is short and the amount of the bride price is too high, the court will determine a return ratio. The ratio depends on how the money was actually spent, whether there was a dowry, whether there was a pregnancy, and whether there were any faults on both sides. Those who have not registered but are living together will also be dealt with on a proportional basis (nationwide, starting from February 2024)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress (2020). Civil Code (Article 1042). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202006/t20200602_463888.shtml>; Supreme People's Court (2024). Provisions on several issues concerning the application of law in the trial of cases involving bride price disputes (Fa Interpretation [2024] No. 1, Articles 2, 5, and 6). <https://www.court.gov.cn/fabu/xiangqing/423442.html>; Supreme People’s Court (2020). Interpretation (1) on the application of the marriage and family section of the Civil Code (Fa Interpretation [2020] No. 22, Article 5). <https://www.court.gov.cn/fabu/xiangqing/282071.html>; National People’s Congress Standing Committee (2023 revision). Civil Procedure Law (Articles 152, 164). <https://amr.guizhou.gov.cn/zwgk/xxgkml/jcxxgk/zcfg/fl/202401/t20240129_83645867.html> (Reprinted by Guizhou Provincial Market Supervision Bureau); State Council (2006). Measures for the payment of litigation fees (State Council Order No. 481, Articles 6 and 29). <https://www.gov.cn/ziliao/flfg/2006-12/29/content_483682.htm>

Note: Whether the betrothal gift is considered "excessive amount" depends on the per capita disposable income of the place where the giver is located and the situation of his family. There is no unified figure across the country. How much should be refunded is decided by the judge on a case-by-case basis. The party who gives money has the same rules as the party who receives money. Whoever gives money gets to keep evidence. A person who only holds a banquet but does not receive a marriage certificate is not legally considered a couple. See Section 10, Article 21 (even if a banquet is held, a marriage certificate must be obtained). If the other party refuses to retreat, they will go to court to sue. The ordinary first-instance procedure is required to be completed within 6 months, which can be extended, and the simplified procedure is 3 months. Attorney's fees are generally paid by oneself and are not included in the litigation costs awarded to the loser by the court.

Case: When Xiao Chen got engaged, he gave the woman a bride price of 180,000 yuan and three gold coins. They all transferred the money via bank transfer and noted the "bride gift" and "three gold coins". The chat records were also kept. The two broke up without registering. Xiao Chen sued based on this evidence, and the court ruled that the woman should return the bride price and three gold coins in full.

items.title: Don’t be afraid of property before marriage. Add your name to the house and contribute capital from your parents before writing it down clearly
items.core: The property before marriage is your personal property and will not become joint property just because you have been married for a long time. Husband and wife can agree in writing that the property before and after marriage will belong to each other. One thing to note: if you agree to add the other person's name to the house, you can still go back on it before the change is registered. After the registration, it will be the other person's. The party who hides money, transfers, squanders or forges debts during divorce may receive less or no share.
body: Cost: There is no cost to write a written property agreement yourself, and there is an additional fee to have it notarized. When parents contribute money, ask them to write a written statement. The whole thing took a few hours at a time. The difficulty lies in talking about money with family members.

Income: Pre-marital property is individual property and will not become community property just because of the length of marriage. Husband and wife can agree in writing that pre-marital property and post-marital income shall belong to each of them, jointly, or part of them jointly. This agreement shall be binding on both parties. If parents contribute money to buy a house before marriage, it is regarded as a gift to their children, unless it is clearly stated that it is for two people. If the parents contribute capital after marriage, it will be handled according to the agreement; if there is no agreement, it will be handled according to the principle of community property. An agreement before or during marriage that the property of one party is donated to the other party or becomes jointly owned by two people can be revoked before the change is registered. After registration, it becomes the other party's. During divorce, the party who hides, transfers, sells, or squanders joint property, or forges debts may receive a smaller share or no share (nationwide)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress (2020). Civil Code (Articles 1063, 1065, 1092). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202006/t20200602_463888.shtml>; Supreme People's Court (2020). Interpretation on the application of the marriage and family section of the Civil Code (1) (Fa Interpretation [2020] No. 22, Articles 29, 31, and 32). <https://www.court.gov.cn/fabu/xiangqing/282071.html>

Note: Property agreements are equally valid for both men and women. If you want to use it against your spouse's debt to an outsider, the prerequisite is that the creditor knows that you have this agreement. If he doesn't know, you can't control him. The agreement is valid even if it is not notarized. Notarization only saves you from having to worry about signatures and dates in the future. How to clearly indicate whether parents contribute money to buy a house as a loan or as a gift? See Section 10, Item 11 (Parents contribute money to buy a house).

Case: Xiao Wang owned a personal property before marriage. When he got married, he verbally agreed to add his wife’s name but never registered it. During the divorce, the wife requested to divide the house. The court determined that the property was still Xiao Wang's personal property. Since the name registration had not been completed, the wife had no right to divide it.

items.title: Check the marital status of the other party before getting married, and those who use marriage as a guise to defraud money will be prosecuted as fraud
items.core: Bigamy marriages are invalid. Those who still get married when they already have a spouse, or who still marry the other party knowing that they have a spouse, will be sentenced to less than 2 years. Those who defraud money under the guise of marriage will be prosecuted as fraud, and those who commit extremely large amounts will be sentenced to more than 10 years or life. Before registering, take a look at the marital status on the other party’s ID card and household registration book.
body: Cost: No money. Before registering, take a look at the other person's ID card and marital status in the household registration book. Large amounts of financial transactions will leave transfer records and chat records.

Benefit: A bigamous marriage is invalid. Those who commit bigamy even though they already have a spouse, or those who still marry the other party knowing that they have a spouse, will be sentenced to less than 2 years. Anyone who defrauds public or private property in a relatively large amount shall be sentenced to not more than 3 years and fined. If the amount is huge, the sentence is 3 to 10 years. If the amount is particularly huge, the sentence shall be more than 10 years or life, and shall be fined or property confiscated (nationwide)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress (2020). Civil Code (1051). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202006/t20200602_463888.shtml>; National People's Congress (1997). Criminal Law (Articles 258 and 266). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/201802/t20180206_364975.shtml>

Note: "Marriage fraud" itself is not a crime. Whether he can be charged with fraud depends on whether he wanted to keep the money for himself from the beginning and made up lies to defraud him of the money. The police would also need to file a case to investigate. Whether it is a "large amount" or not, the amount is determined by judicial interpretation and can be adjusted by various localities. This section has not verified it. The victims of marriage fraud are both male and female, and there are cases of being defrauded of betrothal gifts and dowries.

Case: Aqiang concealed his married status, held a wedding with Xiaoli and defrauded her of 200,000 in gift money. Bigamy was revealed during registration. After Xiaoli called the police, Aqiang was sentenced to 5 years for fraud and bigamy. The bride price was all returned to Xiaoli through recovery of stolen goods.

items.title: For door-to-door repairs, vehicle inspections, and decorations, ask for the price first before proceeding, and watch the whole process
items.core: Home appliance repairs must clearly state the charging standards, provide vouchers and invoices, and are not allowed to falsely report faults or replace parts indiscriminately. In serious cases, a fine of not more than 30,000 yuan may be imposed. All operators must clearly mark their prices and are not allowed to add prices beyond the listed prices. So before you start, ask about the price and the parts to be replaced. After the repair is completed, you will need the voucher and invoice, and keep the old parts. If you are overcharged, call 12315 first.
body: Cost: No money. Before taking action, ask about the charging standards and what parts need to be replaced, take a photo of the quotation, or ask the other party to send a text. After the repair is completed, you will need the maintenance voucher and invoice, and keep the old parts. I have to stand and watch for an hour or two. The difficulty is to keep staring the whole time and not move away.

Revenue: Home appliance repair operators must clearly state the charging standards, quality specifications, warranty period and complaint hotline for service items and accessories. Consumers must be given maintenance service vouchers and fee invoices, and truthfully fill in the repair items and details. No false listing, exaggeration, or falsification of maintenance items is allowed, no false reporting of faulty parts is allowed, and no parts with normal performance are deliberately replaced. If the circumstances are serious, a fine of not more than 30,000 yuan will be imposed. All operators must clearly mark their prices, and are not allowed to add prices beyond the marked prices, or charge any unmarked fees. Low-price deception, high-price settlement, and false discounts are price frauds. Operators must clearly indicate the service items, content, prices, and pricing methods in a conspicuous manner, and are not allowed to make false or misleading publicity (nationwide)
Level of Evidence: B

Source: Ministry of Commerce (2012). Administrative Measures for the Home Appliance Repair Service Industry (Ministry of Commerce Order No. 7, 2012, Articles 5, 7, 9, and 14). <http://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2012/content_2231695.htm>; State Administration for Market Regulation (2022). Regulations on clearly marked prices and prohibition of price fraud (Order No. 56 of the State Administration for Market Regulation) No. 5, 8 and 19). <http://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2022/content_5699926.htm>; State Council (2024). Regulations for the Implementation of the Consumer Rights Protection Law (State Council Order No. 778, Articles 9 and 10). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202403/content_6940159.htm>; Standing Committee of the National People's Congress (2013 amendment). Consumer Rights Protection Law (Articles 8 and 10): "Consumers have the right to require operators to provide...the content, specifications, fees and other relevant information of the service based on the different conditions of the goods or services" and "the right to refuse forced transactions by operators". <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=2c909fdd678bf17901678bf7670606ef> (National Laws and Regulations Database)

Note: If you are overcharged, call 12315 first. The penalty will be imposed by the commerce and market supervision departments. You do not need to file a lawsuit yourself. The reason for setting B level is that although the rules are official, there is no number on "how much you can save by watching from the sidelines" and it mainly depends on experience. Ask for prices, leave vouchers, and keep old copies. We do the same to everyone. Don't judge people by their appearance. The method for home appliances only covers the maintenance of home appliances. Vehicle inspection and decoration shall refer to the clearly stated price regulations and implementation regulations. The Consumer Rights Protection Law, which is a higher level than these regulations, also writes two of your rights. Article 8 says that you have the right to ask the operator to explain the content, specifications, and fees of the service. Article 10 says you have the right to refuse a forced transaction.

Case: Aunt Zhang’s air conditioner was not cooling. A maintenance man came to her home and said it would cost 2,000 yuan to replace the motherboard. She agreed without asking the price. Afterwards, it was discovered that the old motherboard was good. She kept the old parts and chat records and called 12315 to complain. After verification, the market supervision department ordered the repair shop to refund and impose a fine.

items.title: Don't be a "nominal legal person" and don't lend your ID card to others to register a company
items.core: The law presupposes that the legal representative is the person in charge. "I am just a name and don't know anything" is not a reason for exemption. If the legal representative causes damage to others while performing his duties, the company will pay compensation first. After the compensation is completed, it can go back to you who was at fault to recover compensation. If your name has been registered, the company law allows you to resign, and the company must appoint a new legal representative within 30 days.
body: Cost: No money. If someone asks you to "just keep your name and don't interfere," just refuse.

Income: The legal representative is the director or manager who actually executes the company's affairs. The law presupposes that you are the person in charge. If the legal representative causes damage to others while performing his duties, the company shall first compensate. After the compensation is completed, you can go back and seek compensation from the at-fault legal representative (get the money back). Directors and senior executives have a duty of loyalty and diligence to the company (being loyal to the company and doing things with all their heart). If the performance of one’s duties causes damage to others, and the person is intentionally or grossly negligent, he or she must pay the compensation himself. "Ignorance" is not a legal reason to avoid liability. Article 10 of the Company Law states: "If the legal representative resigns, the company shall determine a new legal representative within thirty days from the date of resignation of the legal representative." (National, starting from July 2024)
Level of Evidence: B
Source: National People's Congress Standing Committee (2023). Company Law (revised in 2023, Articles 10, 11, 180, and 191). <https://www.gov.cn/yaowen/liebiao/202312/content_6923395.htm>

Note: The original text of the Company Law only talks about who is responsible. The more common consequence of notifying the company is that when the company is enforced by the court, the legal representative will be restricted from spending too much, and tax and administrative penalties may also implicate you. These consequences arise from other laws and enforcement regulations. The original text of this section has not been verified, so it is graded B. If your name has been registered, the company law allows you to resign, and the company must appoint a new legal representative within 30 days. To borrow your name for a loan, see Article 45 (Help to show your face).

Case: Xiao Liu, a college student, lent his ID card to a friend to register a company as a nominal legal person, and the company's debt of 5 million was enforced. The court restricted Xiao Liu's high consumption because he was the legal representative. He quickly resigned in writing. He only lifted the high consumption limit after the company changed its registration within 30 days.

items.title: Do not carry things for strangers when entering or leaving the country, and do not collect unidentified packages on your behalf
items.core: The advice given by the Consular Department of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs to foreign citizens is: Do not carry luggage for others, especially contraband, or things you do not understand. All countries prohibit the entry of drugs. Your luggage is in your hands. You are the one who has to answer and declare when passing through customs. The same goes for domestic express delivery services, especially those that let you advance money and get a refund later.
body: Cost: No money. Just say no.

Income: The advice given by the Consular Department of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs to foreign citizens is "Please be sure to avoid carrying luggage items for others, especially prohibited items or items you do not understand." The same paragraph states that "all countries prohibit the entry of drugs, protected animal and plant products, etc." and requires you to "truthfully declare restricted items and cash amounts as required" and "truthfully answer inquiries from customs, immigration and other staff." If you can’t tell what’s in something you brought for someone else, you can’t declare it truthfully. The same is true at home. The Hubei Provincial Postal Administration's 2025 risk warning states that the main forms of fraud through express delivery include "collection of high-priced items", and also states that "anyone who requests to advance funds in the name of "paying orders" or "doing tasks" for express delivery is a fraud.
Level of Evidence: B

Source: Consular Department of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs (2026). What suggestions are there for Chinese citizens who are preparing to go abroad? (China Consular Service Network, July 13, 2026). <https://cs.mfa.gov.cn/zggmcgx/lsbhyxz/cjwd_149483/202607/t20260713_11981016.html>; Hubei Provincial Postal Administration (2025). Risk tips on preventing fraud through the use of delivery channels (March 25, 2025). <https://hb.spb.gov.cn/hubsyzglj/c100057/c100058/202503/17998076d1f74959b1d4378ddb9d3564.shtml>

Note: The official reminder pages of the General Administration of Customs and the Ministry of Public Security on this matter cannot be opened. The entry and exit section only refers to the page of the Consular Department of the Ministry of Foreign Affairs. Moreover, the original text only provides principles and not legal regulations, so it is rated B grade. You must also be careful when taking medicine abroad for others, see Section 21, Article 12 (Bringing Medicine Abroad).

Case: When Lao Zhou went abroad, he helped a stranger carry his suitcase through the customs. The customs found that there were drugs hidden in it. Lao Zhou was sentenced to 7 years for transporting drugs. He argued that he had "no knowledge" but could not prove it. He would have to bear legal responsibility if the luggage was in his hands.

items.title: You must keep a leash if you keep a dog: If something happens if you don’t keep a leash, you are not at fault (you will be compensated regardless of whether you are at fault), and you will be compensated to the end. Dogs must also be vaccinated against rabies on time and registered as dog owners
items.core: If a dog hurts someone, in principle, you have to compensate regardless of whether you are at fault. Only if you prove that the other party is intentional or has gross negligence can you pay less or no compensation. If there is no leash, the only one that can be mitigated is "the other party did it intentionally". If the circumstances are more serious, you may be detained. If a dog is not vaccinated against rabies as required, it will be ordered to make corrections and may also be fined. There is no excuse for injuring a person if a banned and aggressive dog hurts someone.
body: Cost: tens of yuan per rope. It also costs money to vaccinate your dog against rabies and register it, and the charges vary from place to place. The difficulty lies in remembering to leash your dog every time you go out, and remember to take your dog for injections when the time comes.

Benefit: If a domestic animal injures someone, the person who raised it or the person who was in charge of it at the time must pay compensation. The law calls for tort liability. Only if it can be proven that the injured person intentionally provoked the injury, or was at major fault, can the compensation be waived or reduced. For those who violate management regulations and fail to take safety measures, such as not holding the leash, only the "intention of the offended party" can be mitigated. If a violent dog that is prohibited from breeding hurts a person, there is no excuse for it. Article 89 of the "Public Security Administration Punishment Law" stipulates that anyone who fails to take safety measures for an animal and lets it hurt someone will be fined not more than 1,000 yuan. If the circumstances are serious, he will be detained for 5 to 10 days. Article 30 of the "Animal Epidemic Prevention Law" requires that dogs must be vaccinated against rabies regularly as required. Then get the immunity certificate issued by an animal diagnosis and treatment institution (such as a pet hospital) and go to the local area to register your dog. When taking your dog out, you must wear a dog tag and tie a dog leash according to regulations. Article 92 of the same law stipulates that if a dog is not vaccinated against rabies as required, the agricultural and rural departments shall order it to make corrections within a time limit. The fine may be up to 1,000 yuan. If you fail to change it within the time limit, you will be fined 1,000 to 5,000 yuan, and an animal diagnosis and treatment institution will be entrusted to handle it on your behalf. The cost will be borne by you
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress (2020). Civil Code. Full text reprinted by the Supreme People's Procuratorate. <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202006/t20200602_463888.shtml> Article 1,245: “If the raised animals cause damage to others, the animal keeper or manager shall bear tort liability; however, if it can be proved that the damage was caused intentionally or by gross negligence of the infringed party, the liability may be waived or reduced.” Article 1,246: “In violation of management regulations and failure to take safety measures for animals to cause damage to others, the animal keeper or manager shall bear tort liability. However, if it can be proved that the damage was caused intentionally by the infringed party, the liability can be reduced. Article 1247: "If dangerous animals such as dangerous dogs that are prohibited from breeding cause damage to others, the animal breeder or manager shall bear tort liability." Article 1249: If an abandoned or escaped animal causes damage during this period, the original breeder or manager shall bear the liability; National People's Congress Standing Committee (2025). Public Security Management Punishment Law (revised in 2025, implemented on 2026-01-01). National laws and regulations database. <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=ff80818197af9ccc0197b159c38a0408> Paragraph 3 of Article 89: "Whoever fails to take safety measures for animals, causing the animals to harm others, shall be fined not more than one thousand yuan; if the circumstances are serious, he shall be detained for not less than five days but not more than ten days."; Standing Committee of the National People's Congress (2021). Animal Epidemic Prevention Law (revised in 2021, effective on 2021-05-01). National Laws and Regulations Database. <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=ff8080817703add2017737395a973e31> Paragraph 1 of Article 30: “Entities and individuals raising dogs must regularly receive rabies vaccinations in accordance with regulations, and apply for registration with the local dog registration authority with the immunity certificate issued by the animal diagnosis and treatment institution.” Paragraph 2: “Those who take dogs out of the house shall comply with the regulations Wear dog tags and take measures such as tying dog leashes in accordance with regulations to prevent dogs from injuring people and spreading diseases." Paragraph 5: "Specific measures for epidemic prevention management of dog breeding shall be formulated by provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government." Article 92: "Agriculture and Agriculture shall be governed by local people's governments at or above the county level. If the village administrative department orders corrections within a time limit, a fine of not more than 1,000 yuan may be imposed; if corrections are made within the time limit, a fine of not less than 1,000 yuan but not more than 5,000 yuan shall be imposed, and the agricultural and rural administrative departments of the local people's governments at or above the county level shall entrust animal diagnosis and treatment institutions, harmless treatment sites, etc. to impose the penalty on their behalf. The necessary fees shall be borne by the illegal perpetrator." Applicable situation item (3): "The raised dogs are not regularly vaccinated against rabies in accordance with regulations."

Note: Compensation for dog bites includes medical expenses, lost work expenses, rabies vaccines and immune globulin. Even if you leave it alone, you won't be exempted from responsibility: if it hurts someone during abandonment or escape, it will still be counted as the original owner's property. The Animal Epidemic Prevention Law leaves it to provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government to determine specific measures for dog epidemic prevention. Where to register, how much to charge, and how often to give injections depends on local dog management regulations. What to do after being bitten, see Section 13, Article 13 (Bitten by a dog or cat).

Case: Zhou walked his dog without a leash, and the dog suddenly bit a passerby, causing stitches and lost work. Passers-by did not play with the dog, but Zhou still had to bear the medical expenses and lost work expenses. Because the dog was not registered and the vaccine had expired, the police ordered him to re-register, re-immunize and punished him.

items.title: If the other party drinks until they become unconscious or falls asleep, or may be under the age of 14, do not have sex
items.core: If the other party drinks until they become unconscious or falls asleep, there is no valid consent. Having sex at this time is considered rape according to the law, and the basic sentence is 3 to 10 years. The safest way is not to have a relationship, and leave the person with the other person's friends or family after the banquet is over. Age is determined in Section 9, Article 18 (Under 14 years of age).
body: Cost: No money. The price is stopping things right then and there. It's hard to stop on the spot.

Benefits: Article 236 of the Criminal Law: Anyone who rapes a woman by violence, coercion or other means shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than ten years. "Other means" are not limited to physical actions. The other party is unconscious and unable to effectively consent while asleep, which falls within these four words. If the circumstances of raping a woman are egregious, or if multiple women are raped, the offender shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than ten years, life imprisonment, or death. The same article also stipulates that anyone who rapes a young girl under the age of fourteen shall be treated as rape and shall be severely punished. How does a young girl qualify as Section 9, Article 18 (under 14 years old)? A law popularization article from the Xicheng District People's Procuratorate in Beijing stated that "sexually assaulting a woman after anesthetizing or making her drunk also constitutes the crime of rape." The key is "whether it went against the victim's true inner will", and whether the victim resisted at the time "is not the key". Article 237 of the "Criminal Law" governs forced indecency: Anyone who uses violence, coercion or other methods to force indecency on another person shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than five years or criminal detention (national)
Level of Evidence: B

Source: National People's Congress (1997). Criminal Law (Article 236). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/201802/t20180206_364975.shtml>; National People's Congress (Amended in 2020). Criminal Law (Article 237). <https://jtgl.beijing.gov.cn/jgj/jgxx/flfg/fl/11033925/index.html> (Reprinted and consolidated text by Beijing Public Security and Traffic Management Bureau); Beijing Xicheng District People’s Procuratorate (2018). Why are they no longer silent…. <https://www.bjjc.gov.cn/c/xicheng/xjjsl/320654084.jhtml>

Remarks: Give B because the law only says "other means". "Being drunk is also considered rape" comes from the procuratorate's law popularization article, not a judicial interpretation. The law on the crime of rape only mentions women. If a man is violated in this way, he will be prosecuted as a crime of forced indecency, so he cannot touch the other person regardless of whether he is a man or a woman. If you are the victim, what should you do first? See Section 13, Article 42 (after being sexually assaulted). When you drink yourself to death, you run the risk of being accused and blackmailed. If you are being blackmailed, see Article 32 of this section (call the police if the other party uses excuses to ask for money).

Case: Xiao Zhao sent Xiao Qian home who was drunk at a friend’s party, and they still had sex when Xiao Qian fell asleep and was unconscious. After Xiao Qian woke up, he called the police. The court found that it was against the woman's will, and Xiao Zhao was sentenced to 4 years for rape.

items.title: After you have sex and have naked chats, the other party calls the police, sends you photos, and tells your work to ask for money. He won’t give you a penny, and doesn’t delete a single record. He calls the police directly
items.core: and threatens you with money by saying “I’ll call the police” or “send the photos to your work”. This is extortion. Not a penny will be paid, not a single record will be deleted, and the police will be called on the spot. If the other party really sends the photo, it will infringe on your privacy. Those who extort more than 2,000 to 5,000 yuan will be sentenced to less than 3 years, and those who blackmail more than 30,000 to 100,000 will be sentenced to 3 to 10 years.
body: Cost: No money. Take screenshots of the other party's account number, chat history and payment code, and take your phone to the police station. The hard thing is to resist the thought of "paying the money first to make things right".

Income: Article 274 of the "Criminal Law": Whoever extorts public or private property for a relatively large amount or for multiple extortions shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention or surveillance, and shall also or solely be fined. Criminal detention is short-term detention, while control means no detention but restriction of freedom, and a fine or a fine alone or an additional fine or only a fine. If the amount is huge or there are other serious circumstances, the offender shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than ten years, and shall also be fined. If the amount is particularly huge or there are other particularly serious circumstances, the offender shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than ten years and shall also be fined. The two top officials also issued an explanation: "Interpretation on Several Issues Concerning the Application of Law in Handling Criminal Cases of Extortion" (Fa Interpretation [2013] No. 10, effective on April 27, 2013). The first article of this explanation sets three levels of amounts. Extortion of public and private property worth more than 2,000 yuan to 5,000 yuan is deemed to be "a relatively large amount." Anything from 30,000 yuan to more than 100,000 yuan is considered a "huge amount." If the amount exceeds RMB 300,000 to RMB 500,000, it will be deemed as “especially huge amount”. Article 3: Anyone who commits extortion more than three times within two years shall be deemed as "multiple extortion" (nationwide). Article 1032 of the Civil Code: No organization or individual may infringe on the privacy rights of others by spying, intruding, leaking, publicizing, etc. Article 1033 It is prohibited to intrude on the tranquility of private life through telephone calls, text messages, instant messaging tools, etc. So if the other party does send the photo, he has violated your privacy again, and it is not your fault. The original words of the Fujian Provincial Public Security Department’s reminder on similar cases are: “Be sure to keep the evidence, call 110 in time, and do not continue to transfer money.”
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People’s Congress (amended in 2020). Criminal Law (Article 274). <https://jtgl.beijing.gov.cn/jgj/jgxx/flfg/fl/11033925/index.html> (Reprinted and consolidated text by Beijing Municipal Public Security and Traffic Management Bureau); Supreme People’s Court and Supreme People’s Procuratorate (2013). Interpretation of Several Issues Concerning the Application of Law in Handling Criminal Cases of Extortion (Fa Interpretation [2013] No. 10). <https://www.court.gov.cn/zixun/xiangqing/5310.html>; National People’s Congress (2020). Civil Code (Articles 1032, 1033). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202006/t20200602_463888.shtml>; National People’s Congress (2020). Civil Code (Article 1195): "The right holder has the right to notify the network service provider to take necessary measures such as deletion, blocking, disconnection, etc. The notification shall include preliminary evidence of infringement and the true identity information of the right holder." "If necessary measures are not taken in a timely manner, the network user shall be jointly and severally liable for the extended part of the damage." <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=ff808081729d1efe01729d50b5c500bf> (National Laws and Regulations Database); Fujian Provincial Public Security Department (2024). Because of a "hookup" message, I incurred a debt of 230,000. <http://gat.fujian.gov.cn/ztzl/fjjffpzxrx/spjq/202403/t20240307_6410612.htm>; Shenzhen Public Security Bureau (2022). How does the "nude chat" fraud succeed step by step? . <https://ga.sz.gov.cn/JMHD/YWZSK/XJGL_ZS/content/post_9577428.html>; Beijing Anti-Fraud (2023). Preventing Nude Chat and Blackmail (Reprinted by Fujian Provincial Public Security Department). <https://gat.fujian.gov.cn/ztzl/fjjffpzxrx/dxal/202302/t20230210_6107918.htm>; Procuratorate Daily (2018). Reluctant to repent after being sentenced twice, exposing privacy and threatening netizens (reprinted from the website of the People’s Procuratorate of Gulou District, Xuzhou City). <https://xzgl.jsjc.gov.cn/jianwu/baxiang/201804/t20180409_420934.shtml>; Procuratorate Daily (2022). A man threatened 10 women to have sex with him by publishing nude photos, and big data screening "called the police"! (Website of the Supreme People's Procuratorate). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/zdgz/202212/t20221212_595435.shtml>

Note: The three levels of amounts are set by each province within the range given by judicial interpretations. Amounts above 2,000 to 5,000 yuan are considered “large amounts.” RMB 30,000 to over RMB 100,000 is considered a “huge amount”. RMB 300,000 to over RMB 500,000 is considered an “extremely huge amount.” Which number falls in your province depends on local standards. If the amount of extortion is not large three or more times within two years, it will be considered as "multiple times". Don't delete chat history, delete photos, cancel accounts, or block people by yourself. That means deleting your own evidence, see Article 5 of this section (ask a lawyer first before being subpoenaed, and do not delete records). If you are really investigated, these records will also be your self-evident materials. Don’t try to “negotiate installments” either. Shenzhen police have summarized the routine of nude chatting and blackmail. Scammers trick you into installing a so-called naked chat app, which is actually a Trojan horse that reads your address book. Then record the whole process and send the video to the group for money. Beijing police say that once you are willing to give money "privately", the scammer will ask for it endlessly. Using "tell your family that you like people of the same sex" to blackmail you for money is the same kind of blackmail. Someone in Yancheng, Jiangsu Province made an appointment to meet someone on a same-sex social media app. He used this trick again to get away with 14,500 yuan. He was charged after the victim reported the crime. He had been sentenced twice before for the same tactics. Taking nude photos to force someone to have sex will be prosecuted as rape. Someone in Xiangshan, Zhejiang Province, deceived many women into taking nude photos on social platforms, and then threatened them with publishing the nude photos. There were 10 victims identified. One of them called the police as soon as she received the threat. She and the other party had never met, and the prosecutor's office still treated it as attempted rape. The perpetrator was eventually charged with rape and forced indecency. So don’t send nude photos to people you meet online. On the other hand, if you are the victim and seek compensation from the infringing party, a high amount does not mean it is blackmail. For how to make a claim, please refer to Article 36 of this section (if you are the victim, you can make a claim). If the photo is really posted online, you can notify the platform to delete it. Article 1195 of the Civil Code stipulates that you have the right to notify the platform to delete, block, or disconnect links. The notification must include preliminary evidence of infringement and your true identity information. If the platform fails to handle the notice in a timely manner, it and the poster will jointly compensate for the extended damage.

Case: Xiao Li’s naked chat was recorded by the other party, and he threatened to send his address book if he didn’t pay 5,000 yuan. He didn't forward any of it, kept the threatening conversation and account information and called the police directly.
