The police caught the extortion gang along the way, and Xiao Li's privacy was not leaked.

items.title: If you are reported by someone who has fabricated facts, you can request to be held accountable: if the case warrants public security punishment, you may be detained for up to 5 days or fined; if the circumstances are serious, you may be detained for 5 to 10 days; if the case is serious enough, you may be sentenced to up to 3 years
items.core: It is illegal to fabricate facts and falsely accuse someone in order to want him to be held accountable. This will result in a detention of not more than 5 days or a fine of not more than 1,000 yuan. If the circumstances are more serious, the person will be detained for 5 to 10 days. What amounts to a crime is false accusation and frame-up, with a sentence of less than 3 years. But it doesn’t matter if you remember it wrongly or make a wrong accusation. If you want to hold the other party accountable, you have to prove that he intentionally framed the case.
body: Cost: No money. Go to the public security organ to report the crime and explain that the other party is fabricating it. The difficulty is to come up with something to prove that he made it up on purpose.

Income: Article 50 of the "Public Security Management Punishment Law" (revised on June 27, 2025, effective on January 1, 2026) governs false accusations. Anyone who fabricates facts and makes false accusations to frame others in an attempt to subject others to criminal prosecution or public security management penalties shall be punished. shall be detained for not more than five days, or fined not more than 1,000 yuan. If the circumstances are serious, the offender shall be detained for not less than five days but not more than ten days, and may also be fined not more than one thousand yuan. Article 243 of the Criminal Law governs the crime of false accusation and frame-up. Whoever fabricates facts and makes false accusations to frame others with the intention of subjecting others to criminal prosecution shall, if the circumstances are serious, be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years, criminal detention or public surveillance. Those who cause serious consequences shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years but not more than ten years. If a staff member of a state agency commits the crime mentioned in the preceding paragraph, he shall be severely punished. Severe punishment means that he shall be sentenced to a higher level of punishment in the same range of punishments. If the accusation is not intentional, but is false, or the report is untrue, the provisions of the first two paragraphs do not apply. If you remember wrongly or report wrongly, you will not be held accountable according to these two paragraphs (nationwide)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress Standing Committee (2025). Public Security Management Punishment Law (revised in 2025, Article 50). <https://gaj.beijing.gov.cn/wsgs/2024zcwj/zcfg/202506/t20250630_4134266.html> (Full text reproduced by Beijing Municipal Public Security Bureau); National People’s Congress (1997). Criminal Law (Article 243). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/201802/t20180206_364975.shtml>

Remarks: To pursue the other party, it is not enough to prove "I have not done it", but also to prove that he "fabricated facts" and "intentionally framed the case." The latter is much more difficult to prove and may not be possible if pursued. There are no public nationwide statistics on the filing and handling of false accusations, and they cannot be found in this book, so the incidence rate and gender distribution are not included. For evidence and relief after being accused, see Articles 34 and 35 of this section (insufficient evidence should lead to acquittal and compensation from the state).

Case: Because of competition, a colleague, Wang, fabricated a report to the Discipline Inspection Commission that Zhang had accepted bribes. Zhang took out his complete work log and surveillance to prove his innocence, and proved that Wang deliberately fabricated it. Wang was later detained for 7 days.

items.title: Insufficient evidence should originally lead to a verdict of not guilty, and forced confessions should be excluded; appeals and retrials are required upon verdict
items.core: The threshold for conviction is written in the Criminal Procedure Law: the evidence used to finalize the case must be verified to be true through legal procedures, and the evidence in the entire case must be comprehensive to eliminate reasonable doubt. Failure to do so should lead to acquittal. Confessions obtained through torture and testimony obtained through threats of violence should be excluded and cannot be used as the basis for judgment. After the judgment takes effect, you, your legal representative, and close relatives can still appeal.
body: Cost: The procedure itself costs nothing, but appeals and retrials are time-consuming. Usually you need to hire a lawyer, and the legal fees start at several thousand yuan. Those with financial difficulties may apply for legal aid, see Article 5 of this section (see a lawyer first if charged). It’s hard not to give up if you keep waiting round after round.

Income: Article 55 of the "Criminal Procedure Law": The evidence must be reliable and sufficient and meet these conditions - the evidence for the final case has been verified to be true through legal procedures, and the evidence in the entire case has eliminated reasonable doubts about the facts identified. To eliminate reasonable doubt means that when the evidence of the entire case is taken together, the facts found cannot leave any other reasonable possibility. Article 56: Confessions of criminal suspects and defendants collected by illegal methods such as torture, as well as witness testimonies and victim statements collected by illegal methods such as violence and threats, shall be excluded. If evidence that should be excluded is found during investigation, review for prosecution, or trial, it shall be excluded in accordance with the law and shall not be used as the basis for prosecution opinions, prosecution decisions, and judgments. Article 200, Item (3): If the evidence is insufficient and the defendant cannot be found guilty, a judgment of not guilty shall be made because the evidence is insufficient and the alleged crime cannot be established. Article 252 provides a way to appeal. The parties, their legal representatives, and close relatives may appeal to the People's Court or the People's Procuratorate against a legally effective judgment or ruling. However, appeals cannot stop the execution of judgments and rulings. Article 253 enumerates the circumstances under which the People's Court should conduct a new trial (nationwide)
Level of Evidence: A
Source: National People's Congress Standing Committee (2018). Criminal Procedure Law (2018 revision, Articles 55, 56, 200, 252, 253). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/zdgz/201810/t20181027_396818.shtml>

Note: These are the bottom lines stated in the system, and the results are not guaranteed. This book does not have verifiable official data on China’s acquittal rate and appeal-changed sentence rate in criminal cases, so it does not write about proportions or evaluate individual cases. There are three things you can do. First, retain a lawyer after the first interrogation, see Article 5 of this section (Requesting a lawyer first when accused). Second, read the transcript word for word before signing. Third, don’t admit things you haven’t done just to “get out early”. If you admit guilt and accept punishment, you can only get leniency, but you cannot avoid responsibility. If the statutory circumstances are met, the court shall conduct a new trial.

Case: Chen was accused of theft and only had a confession obtained through torture. The lawyer applied to exclude illegal evidence, but because there was no other physical evidence, the court found Chen not guilty. After the real murderer was caught, Chen applied for state compensation.

items.title: If you are detained and then withdraw the case, do not prosecute, or are acquitted, you can apply for state compensation, and the money will be calculated on a daily basis.
items.core: If you are detained illegally or for an extended period of time, or are arrested, but later withdraw the case, do not prosecute, or are acquitted, you can apply for state compensation. Compensation will be paid on a daily basis for the days of detention, starting from May 18, 2026, it will be 495.94 yuan per day. If the consequences are serious, a mental damage consolation payment will be given. No compensation will be given to those who committed a crime and did not prosecute because the circumstances were minor, and no compensation will be paid to those who have passed the prosecution period, are under age, or made false confessions.
body: Cost: No money. File an application for compensation with the authority that made the original detention, arrest, prosecution or judgment.

Income: Article 17 of the "State Compensation Law" lists several situations in which the victim has the right to obtain compensation. The first is detention: taking measures to detain citizens in violation of the provisions of the Criminal Procedure Law, or detaining citizens in accordance with the law but exceeding the legal time limit. After that, it is decided to withdraw the case, not to prosecute, or to acquit the person and terminate the pursuit of criminal responsibility. The second type is arrest: after taking measures to arrest a citizen, it is decided to withdraw the case, not to prosecute, or to acquit the person and terminate the pursuit of criminal responsibility. The third type is retrial: the case is retried according to trial supervision procedures and the acquittal is changed, and the original sentence has been executed. The trial supervision process is the process of re-trialing a judgment that has already taken effect. Article 33: If a citizen's personal freedom is violated, daily compensation shall be calculated based on the national average daily wages of employees in the previous year. Article 35: If a person suffers mental damage, the victim shall eliminate the impact, restore his reputation, and apologize within the scope of the infringement. If serious consequences are caused, the corresponding mental damage consolation shall be paid. Article 19 lists six situations in which the state will not compensate. One is that he intentionally made a false confession or fabricated other evidence of guilt, and was imprisoned or sentenced as a result. Second, people who are not criminally responsible according to Articles 17 and 18 of the Criminal Law are imprisoned. For example, the person is under the age of criminal responsibility, or the mentally ill person causes harm when he or she cannot identify or control his or her behavior. Third, people who are not held criminally responsible according to the Criminal Procedure Law are imprisoned. This includes cases where the circumstances are obviously minor and the harm is not great, and it is not considered a crime, where the statute of limitations for prosecution has expired, and where the suspect is dead. It also includes cases where the crime is minor and the procuratorate decides not to prosecute, which is often referred to as relative non-prosecution (also called discretionary non-prosecution). The same applies to minors who do not prosecute after the expiration of the conditional non-prosecution trial period and who do not prosecute after reaching a settlement with the victim. The fourth is the personal behavior of case handlers that has nothing to do with the exercise of their powers. The fifth is damage caused by intentional acts such as self-injury and self-mutilation. Sixth, other situations stipulated by law. Article 7 of the 2015 Judicial Interpretation of Criminal Compensation by the two top governments once again confirmed that the state will not compensate those who are not criminally responsible and those who are relatively free of prosecution. However, if a person is wrongfully sentenced to criminal detention, fixed-term imprisonment, or life imprisonment by the court after prosecution and has executed the sentence, he will still have to compensate for the period of continued detention after the judgment is finalized. Article 8 of the interpretation: If the case-handling agency refuses to pay compensation on the grounds that "you yourself made a false confession" or "you hurt yourself", the case-handling agency shall provide evidence. The Supreme People's Procuratorate issued a notice in May 2026. The Office for National Statistics published the 2025 figures on 15 May 2026. The national average annual salary for employees in urban non-private units is about 129,000 yuan (129,441 yuan). The average daily wage calculated based on this is 495.94 yuan. This number will be used when procuratorates at all levels make state compensation decisions starting from May 18, 2026. Compensation for infringement of citizens’ personal freedom is 495.94 yuan per day. The previous standard is 475.52 yuan per day, effective from May 2025 (nationwide)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress Standing Committee (amended in 2012). State Compensation Law (Articles 17, 19, 33, 35). <https://www.stats.gov.cn/gk/tjfg/xgfxfg/202503/t20250306_1958899.html> (Reprinted by the National Bureau of Statistics); Supreme People’s Procuratorate (2026). The Supreme People’s Procuratorate announced the latest compensation standards for violations of citizens’ personal freedom. <https://www.spp.gov.cn/xwfbh/wsfbh/202605/t20260519_727675.shtml>; Supreme People’s Court and Supreme People’s Procuratorate (2015). Interpretation of Several Issues Concerning the Application of Law in Handling Criminal Compensation Cases (Fa Interpretation [2015] No. 24, Articles 7 and 8). <https://www.court.gov.cn/zixun/xiangqing/16409.html>; National People’s Congress (2018). Criminal Procedure Law (2018 amendment, Articles 16, 177, 181, 284, 290). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/zdgz/201810/t20181027_396818.shtml>. Article 19 of the State Compensation Law and this interpretation refer to the articles of the 2012 Criminal Procedure Law (Article 15, Article 173 Paragraph 2, Article 273 Paragraph 2, and Article 279). After the amendment in 2018, they correspond to Article 16, Article 177 Paragraph 2, Article 284 Paragraph 2, and Article 290.

Note: This daily standard is 5 per year. The monthly average annual salary of urban non-private units in the previous year was updated with the release of the National Bureau of Statistics. When using it, check the figures for the current year and don’t apply this directly. When you get the decision not to prosecute, first look at the basis for it. If it says "no criminal facts" or "insufficient evidence", you can apply for compensation. It says "the crime was minor," or the statute of limitations for prosecution has expired. In principle, the days spent in jail cannot be compensated. If you are dissatisfied with the decision not to prosecute, you may appeal to the procuratorate within 7 days after receiving the decision. Mental damage consolation payments are determined by the case-handling agency on a case-by-case basis, and there is no unified formula. It is the agency (public security, procuratorate, or court) that decided to imprison you in the first place that should pay compensation. Go to them first. If you are not satisfied with its treatment, you can apply for compensation according to the procedures of the State Compensation Law. For the actual calculation, you can see the decision in Guo Li’s case in Article 36 of this section (you are the victim and you file a claim). Guo Li was imprisoned for 1826 days. Compensation will be calculated based on the standard of the year the decision was made, not the year the person was imprisoned. The national average daily wage of employees in 2016 was 258.89 yuan. The compensation for restricting personal freedom was about 473,000 yuan (472,733.14 yuan). In addition, about 165,000 yuan (165,450 yuan) will be awarded as solatium for mental damage. He applied for 88.88 million yuan in solitary compensation for mental damage over ten years, but the excess was not supported. You also need to know what cannot be compensated. The decision stated that the following items were not included in the scope of state compensation: lost wages, health compensation, property damage, lawyer fees, and living expenses subsidies in the detention center.

Case: Zhao was detained for 47 days on suspicion of theft, but the procuratorate later decided that there was insufficient evidence and did not prosecute. Zhao applied for state compensation from the agency responsible for compensation. The 47-day personal freedom compensation was calculated according to the new standard, and he received corresponding mental damage consolation payments due to consequences such as dismissal from the unit.

items.title: If you are a victim and claim compensation, go to 12315, sue or lawyer. Don't go to the other party's appointment alone, and don't tie "pay money" and "I won't expose" into one sentence
items.core: As a victim, if you claim compensation from the infringing party, you have a legal basis. It will not automatically turn into extortion just because the "asking price is high". But the price could be high: Guo Li was sentenced to five years in prison for extortion before being acquitted at a later trial. So go through the channels that leave traces, don’t go alone to the place designated by the other party to negotiate, and don’t tie “pay money” and “I won’t be exposed” into one condition and say it out loud.
body: Cost: Go to 12315 for free. If you go to court to sue, you must first pay a case acceptance fee, and if you appoint a lawyer, you must pay attorney fees. The entire interview was recorded. It's hard not to talk to the other person alone.

Income: Official case: After the relevant departments announced in 2008 that some batches of "Shi'en" brand milk powder contained melamine, the test result of Guo Li's daughter was "several point-like strong echoes can be seen in the central collecting system of both kidneys." Guo Li repeatedly claimed compensation from the seller and Shien Company, and exposed it to the media. In June 2009, the two parties reached an agreement and Shi En Company compensated 400,000 yuan. Guo Li issued written materials indicating that he would no longer pursue the lawsuit and waived his claim for compensation. After the company reported the case, Guo Li was sentenced to five years in prison for extortion by the Chao'an County People's Court. The Guangdong Provincial People's Procuratorate proposed a retrial proposal. It is recommended that "the existing evidence is insufficient to prove that Guo Li subjectively had the purpose of illegal possession." As the legal guardian, Guo Li "has the right to claim compensation from the milk powder manufacturer, and his claim has a legal basis." The recommendations also read, "Consumers have the right to expose and criticize behaviors that harm their legitimate rights and interests through mass media." On April 7, 2017, the Guangdong Provincial Higher People's Court acquitted Guo Li in a retrial. The reason is that "the original trial found that Guo Li used threats and coercion methods to forcibly obtain property for the purpose of illegal possession. The facts were unclear and the evidence was insufficient. The nature of Guo Li's behavior did not exceed the scope of civil disputes." Guo Li was detained for 1,826 days from July 23, 2009 to July 22, 2014 (Guangdong, retrial and sentence changed in 2017)
Level of Evidence: B

Source: Guangdong Provincial People’s Procuratorate (2017). The Guangdong Provincial Procuratorate recommended that Guo Li’s case be changed to not guilty. <http://www.gd.jcy.gov.cn/jcyw2/201704/t20170411_1975029.shtml> (Official website of Guangdong Provincial People’s Procuratorate); Guangdong Provincial Higher People’s Court Compensation Committee (2018). Guo Li applied for retrial and received compensation from the Guangdong Chaozhou Intermediate People’s Court for compensation ((2018) Guangdong Compensation Committee 11 No.). <https://www.gdcourts.gov.cn/caipanwenshuxuandeng/caipanwenshuxuandeng/content/post_1045709.html>; National People’s Congress Standing Committee (2023 revision). Civil Procedure Law (Articles 152 and 164). <https://amr.guizhou.gov.cn/zwgk/xxgkml/jcxxgk/zcfg/fl/202401/t20240129_83645867.html> (Reprinted by Guizhou Provincial Market Supervision Bureau); State Council (2006). Measures for the payment of litigation fees (State Council Order No. 481, Articles 6, 20, and 29). <https://www.gov.cn/ziliao/flfg/2006-12/29/content_483682.htm>

Remarks: Give B because this is just a case, not a proportion that can be generalized. It means two things at the same time: that the claim itself is legitimate, and that you can still be investigated by the police as a case. The lowest-risk option is to hand over the claim to a lawyer, or go directly to court to sue without having any personal contact with the other party. The case acceptance fee for prosecution shall be paid by the plaintiff in advance. The ordinary procedure of first instance shall be completed within 6 months according to regulations, which may be extended, and the simplified procedure shall be completed for 3 months. Attorney's fees are generally paid by oneself and are not included in the litigation costs awarded to the loser by the court. You should pay special attention when the other party invites you to go to his location for "interview and resolution". Reporting and filing of the case usually take place at the other party's location. Once the settlement agreement is signed, it will be followed, and then another high-value claim will be made after signing. This can most easily be interpreted as "blackmail." For what to do after a case is filed, see Articles 5, 34, and 35 of this section (see a lawyer first, be acquitted if there is insufficient evidence, and be compensated by the state). For the situation where the other party uses some excuse to demand money from you, see Article 32 of this section (the other party uses calling the police or sending photos to ask for money).

items.title: Being raped by the Internet: first turn on protection, first consolidate the evidence, and then choose between the platform, ban, and alarm
items.core: Do three things on the spot: open the platform's protection settings, use quick evidence collection to save the content, and then report from the quick entrance. You can then apply to the court for an injunction to let him stop first. You can also file a lawsuit in court yourself. If it is difficult to obtain evidence, you can ask the police for assistance. Those that cause serious consequences such as suicide and have a bad social impact can be prosecuted by the procuratorate instead.
body: Cost: No money. Spend more than ten minutes on the spot doing protection and collecting evidence. If you reach the stage of applying for an injunction or private prosecution, you will have to go to court and may need to hire a lawyer. The difficulty is to first store evidence when being scolded and not to retaliate.

Income: Article 15 of Law Fa [2023] No. 14 talks about prohibition. The right holder has evidence to prove that the perpetrator is committing or is about to commit an illegal act that infringes upon his or her personality rights. Failure to stop it in time will cause irreparable damage to its legitimate rights and interests. If the right holder applies in accordance with Article 997 of the Civil Code, the People's Court may issue an injunction against infringement of personality rights in accordance with the law. An injunction against personality rights infringement is a court order ordering the other party to stop first. Article 11 of the opinion talks about evidence collection. In private prosecution cases, "if the victim really has difficulty in providing evidence, he may request the public security organs to provide assistance." Public security organs should promptly identify the perpetrators and collect evidence and materials such as the spread and impact of the epidemic. Network service providers should provide necessary technical support. "If the public security organs assist in collecting evidence and meet the conditions for accepting a private prosecution case, the People's Court shall decide to open the case." If it cannot be collected, the public security organ shall explain in writing. A private prosecution case is a case in which the victim has to go to court to sue himself. Article 12 of the opinion lists five situations that should be recognized as "seriously endangering social order" as stated in Article 246, Paragraph 2, of the Criminal Law. First, it causes serious consequences such as mental disorder or suicide of the victim or his close relatives, and has a negative impact on society. Second, the general public is arbitrarily targeted. The large-scale dissemination of information triggers a large number of vulgar and malicious comments, and has a negative impact on society. The third is to insult and slander multiple people or spread it multiple times, and the impact on society is bad. Fourth, the organization and instigation of personnel spread in large numbers on multiple platforms, and the impact on society was bad. Five is others. Article 4 of the Opinion: Organize "human flesh searches" to illegally collect and release citizens' personal information to an unspecified majority of people. If the circumstances are serious, they will be convicted and punished for the crime of infringing on citizens' personal information. Article 23 of the "Cyber ​​Violence Information Governance Regulations" requires platforms to provide these protection options. You can block unfamiliar users or specific users. You can limit the visibility of information you post. Reprinting or commenting can be prohibited. You can only receive private messages from friends, or refuse to receive all private messages. Article 25 requires the provision of quick evidence collection functions. Article 26 requires the establishment of a quick complaint and reporting portal in a prominent location. Article 15 requires the platform to promptly report the case to the public security organs if it discovers suspected illegal crimes
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Supreme People's Court, Supreme People's Procuratorate, Ministry of Public Security (2023). Guiding Opinions on Punishing Online Violence Illegal Crimes in accordance with the Law (Fafa [2023] No. 14, Articles 4, 11, 12, 15). <https://www.court.gov.cn/zixun/xiangqing/412992.html>; National People’s Congress (2020). Civil Code (Article 997). Full text reproduced by the Supreme People’s Procuratorate <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202006/t20200602_463888.shtml>; Cyberspace Administration of China, Ministry of Public Security, Ministry of Culture and Tourism, and State Administration of Radio and Television (2024). Regulations on the governance of online violence information (Articles 15, 23, 25, and 26, effective on August 1, 2024). State Council Gazette <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/2024/issue_11526/202408/content_6969181.html>

Remarks: The order is "fast and cheap": the platform is the fastest and the cost is the lowest, confirm the evidence first, report first. The court is the slowest and most expensive, and it is the final decision whether to fight or not. You have to bear the process costs of all three paths yourself. You have to apply to the court for an injunction yourself. Private prosecution means going to court to file a case yourself and getting evidence yourself. If you want the procuratorate to take over and switch to public prosecution, you have to run into one of the five situations listed in Article 12 of Law Fa [2023] No. 14. If you can't get enough, you can only sue yourself. There are two things not to do. The first is not to curse. If you curse back, you will become the one punished in Article 16 of this section (Do not curse or spread rumors online). The second is not to delete the content in your account, that is the evidence. If you can't bear it, call 12356. See Section 1, Article 25. To request the Platform to delete your personal information, see Section 14 Clause 8. For those who helped strangers but were photographed and posted on the Internet, see [docs/Should you stop when you encounter strangers and get into trouble.md](../docs/Should you stop when you encounter strangers and get into trouble.md).

Case: The store owner was maliciously rumored by a photographer to "harass female customers", and his takeaway rating plummeted. She turned on platform protection, notarized and collected evidence, and applied to the court for a personal safety injunction. The police will punish the rumor mongers after verification.

items.title: The road of "buying insurance for people first and then taking action" is blocked by the law: you can't get a cent of the money, and the crime is intentional homicide and insurance fraud and punished concurrently
items.core: I bought him an insurance conditional on death behind the back of his adult family members, and the contract is invalid. If the policyholder intentionally causes the death of the insured, the insurance company will not pay compensation. If the policyholder intentionally kills the deceased, he or she will also lose the right to inheritance. The criminal law lists this kind of insurance policy fraud as a crime and is punished with several crimes including intentional homicide, up to the death penalty. Can't get any money.
body: Cost: No money.

Income: Article 34 of the Insurance Law: A contract that requires death as a condition for payment of insurance benefits shall be invalid without the consent of the insured and recognition of the insurance amount. The insured is the person insured. Parents insuring their minor children are not subject to this restriction. Article 39: The insured must obtain the consent of the insured when designating a beneficiary. The policyholder is the person who pays for the insurance, and the beneficiary is the person who receives the money after an accident. Article 43 deals with intentional harm to others. If the policy holder intentionally causes the death, disability or illness of the insured, the insurer shall not be liable for paying insurance benefits. If the policy holder has paid insurance premiums for more than two years, the cash value will be refunded to other rights holders. If a beneficiary intentionally causes death, disability, or illness of the insured, or if an intentional attempt to kill the insured fails, the beneficiary shall lose the right to benefit. Paragraph 2 of Article 27: If the policy holder or the insured intentionally causes an insured accident, the insurer has the right to terminate the contract and will not assume liability for compensation or payment, and will not refund the insurance premium except as provided in Article 43. Article 1125 of the Civil Code: Anyone who intentionally kills the deceased shall lose the right to inherit. Item 5 of Article 198, Paragraph 1, of the Criminal Law classifies "the policy holder or beneficiary who intentionally causes the death, disability or illness of the insured to defraud the insurance money" as insurance fraud. If the amount is relatively large, the penalty shall be not more than five years and a fine of RMB 10,000 to RMB 100,000. For large amounts, it lasts 5 to 10 years. Especially huge, aged over 10 years. Paragraph 2: If the behavior constitutes other crimes at the same time, the person shall be punished in accordance with the provisions of concurrent punishment for several crimes. Combining punishment for several crimes means that several crimes are combined together to calculate the penalty. Article 232: Anyone who intentionally kills someone shall be sentenced to death, life imprisonment, or fixed-term imprisonment of not less than ten years. The case is the case of Zhang Mousong in Xuancheng, Anhui. In the early morning of July 18, 2016, he drove his car into a pond and his wife drowned. Less than half a month before the incident, he took out 4 insurance policies for his wife, each worth 1 million yuan. He was captured on July 25. The court sentenced him to death with a suspended death penalty and a fine of 50,000 yuan for intentional homicide and insurance fraud.
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress Standing Committee (2015 revision). Articles 27, 34, 39, and 43 of the Insurance Law of the People's Republic of China. <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=2c909fdd678bf17901678bf7c4060811>; National People's Congress (2020). Article 1125 of the Civil Code of the People's Republic of China. <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=ff808081729d1efe01729d50b5c500bf>; Standing Committee of the National People's Congress. Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China (Consolidated text as amended by the Eleventh Amendment to the Criminal Law) Articles 198 and 232. <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=ff808181796a636a0179822a19640c92>; Anhui Provincial People’s Procuratorate reprinted in "Legal Daily" (2020-01-13). Killing his wife and defrauding her bail was involved in the case (A typical case of civil false litigation supervision by the Anhui Provincial People's Procuratorate). <http://www.ah.jcy.gov.cn/jczt/jjslhyqkjc/mtjj/202001/t20200113_2758841.shtml>

Note: The beneficiary of this article is yourself, and what you avoid is the death penalty or life imprisonment. The casualties and verdicts of the cases are taken from the original texts of typical cases published by the procuratorate. Details other than investigation methods are not included in the text. Insurance fraud that does not involve human life, such as faking accidents and exaggerating losses, is also a crime. Those who help testify are counted together, see Section 9, Article 21 (Fake accidents, exaggerate losses to defraud claims). Buying insurance for your family is normal. What you need to guard against is the idea of ​​"buying insurance and then doing it." The urge to hurt family members should be treated as an emergency. See Articles 14 and 15 of this section (having thoughts on your own and cruel words spoken by people around you)

Case: After Zhao insured his wife with a high amount of accident insurance, he planned to fake a car accident and kill his wife to get compensation. The police found suspicious points and arrested Zhao. The court convicted him of intentional homicide and insurance fraud and sentenced him to death.

items.title: If you call the police, you will need a receipt of acceptance on the spot. If you do not file a case, you must give a written notice: you can apply for reconsideration within 7 days, and you can apply for review within 7 days. The procuratorate can notify the public security to open the case.
items.core: If you call the police, you must get a receipt of acceptance on the spot. This is proof that you have reported the case. If the police decide not to file a case, they should give you a written notice of disapproval. If you are not satisfied, you can apply for reconsideration within 7 days; if you are still dissatisfied, you can apply for review within 7 days. You can also go to the procuratorate and ask it to supervise the public security in filing the case.
body: Cost: No money. Ask more on the spot and get the receipt. Then check the progress according to the date above. The difficulty lies in asking again and again.

Income: Article 171 of the "Procedural Regulations on the Handling of Criminal Cases by Public Security Organs" (as amended by Order No. 159 of the Ministry of Public Security) governs the receipt of case acceptance. The original text is: "When the public security organ accepts a case, it shall prepare a case acceptance registration form and a case acceptance receipt, and hand the case acceptance receipt to the person who submitted the case, the reporter, the accuser, and the informant." Article 174: “Public security organs shall promptly review the cases accepted or the criminal clues discovered.” Article 178 governs whether to file a case. After accepting the case and reviewing it, if it is believed that there are criminal facts that require criminal liability and it falls within one's own jurisdiction, the case must be filed. The filing of a case must be approved by the person in charge of the public security organ at or above the county level. Even if the case is not filed, you will be given a piece of paper: "If a case with an accuser is decided not to be filed, the public security organ shall prepare a notice of non-filing and serve it to the accuser within three days." Article 179 deals with what to do if you are dissatisfied. The original text is: "If the accuser is dissatisfied with the decision not to file a case, he may apply for reconsideration to the public security organ that made the decision within seven days after receiving the notice not to file the case; the public security organ shall make a decision within thirty days after receiving the reconsideration application." Then write: "If the accuser is dissatisfied with the reconsideration decision not to file a case, he may apply to the higher-level public security agency for review within seven days after receiving the reconsideration decision; the higher-level public security agency shall make a decision within thirty days after receiving the review application. If the higher-level public security agency revokes the decision not to file a case, the lower-level public security agency shall implement it." If the case is serious or complex, the time limit for reconsideration and review can be extended, but "it shall not exceed thirty days, and the applicant shall be notified in writing." Article 112 of the Criminal Procedure Law: If it is believed that there are criminal facts that require criminal liability, a case should be filed; if the case is not filed, "the accuser will be notified of the reasons for not filing the case. If the accuser is not convinced, he may apply for reconsideration." Article 113: "If the victim believes that the public security organ did not file a case for investigation when it should be filed for investigation, and lodges a complaint with the People's Procuratorate, the People's Procuratorate shall request the public security organ to explain the reasons for not filing the case. If the People's Procuratorate believes that the reason for not filing the case by the public security organ is untenable, it shall notify the public security organ to file the case, and the public security organ shall file the case after receiving the notification." Article 61 of the "Regulations on the Procedures for Handling Administrative Cases by Public Security Organs" also has the same requirement. Cases under the jurisdiction of this unit "should be investigated and handled immediately, a case acceptance registration form and a case acceptance receipt should be prepared, and the case acceptance receipt should be given to the reporter, accuser, whistleblower, and person who turned over the case." The time limit for handling public security cases "shall not exceed 30 days from the date of acceptance; if the case is serious or complex, it may be extended by 30 days with the approval of the higher-level public security agency." The appraisal period is not included in the time limit for handling the case. Article 9 of the "Regulations on Supervision of Public Security Organs" governs complaints against police officers. The original text is: "Inspection agencies should dispatch police in a timely manner for ongoing violations of laws and disciplines by public security organs and their people's police that are complained by the masses, deal with them on the spot in accordance with regulations, and promptly feed back the results to the complainant" (National)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress (2018). Criminal Procedure Law (revised in 2018, Articles 112 and 113). <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=ff8080816f135f46016f1d1b81b01351>; Ministry of Public Security (2020). Decision on amending the "Procedural Regulations on the Handling of Criminal Cases by Public Security Organs" (Ministry of Public Security Order No. 159) and the full text of the amendment. <http://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2020/content_5549884.htm>; Ministry of Public Security (revised in 2013/2019). Provisions on the procedures for handling administrative cases by public security organs (Ministry of Public Security Order No. 125, Revised Decision No. 149). <http://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2013/content_2321117.htm>, <http://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2018-12/31/content_5428593.htm>; State Council (2011). Regulations on Supervision of Public Security Organs (State Council Order No. 603, Article 9). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2011-09/08/content_6138.htm>

Note: The beneficiary is yourself. Reporting to the police may not necessarily result in the matter being handled, but there are clearly stated standards and deadlines for whether or not to handle the matter and how long it will take to handle the matter. It does not depend on the mood of the person who receives the police report that day. The three actions are recorded in order. ① Get the case acceptance receipt on the spot and write down the case number and acceptance unit. ② If there is no result after the expiration date, ask about the progress according to the above deadline and ask "Where is the case?" Don't ask "Why don't you care about me?" ③ After receiving the notice of disapproval of filing the case, first look at the reasons, reconsider within 7 days, and review again within 7 days. At the same time, you can file a case with the People's Procuratorate for supervision. The three approaches do not conflict. Security cases include fights and petty thefts. The case handling period is calculated from the day of acceptance and shall not exceed 30 days. If the case is serious and complex, it may be extended for another 30 days with the approval of the higher-level public security organ. The time spent doing the appraisal is not included. If the reception attitude is poor, the supervisor will complain, and the case itself will still be pursued according to the filing process. Picking up lost property and neighbor disputes are not criminal cases in the first place. The public security organs will handle the case as an administrative case or through mediation, or even just register and file it. Don’t interpret it as “if you report a crime, no one will take care of it.” For the payment stop process after being defrauded, see Article 2 of this section (call 110 immediately to request a payment stop). See Article 37 of this section for being exposed by the Internet (if you are exposed by the Internet, first consolidate the evidence and then find a way out)

Case: Zhou called the police over a car purchase dispute, but the police station only responded verbally and did not file a case. Zhou asked for a receipt of acceptance of the case and a written notice of disapproval of filing the case. He applied for reconsideration within 7 days and then reviewed it within 7 days. The procuratorate supervised the filing of the case.

items.title: Don't give money or cards to people who handle cases or law enforcement: Bribery yourself will be punished, and bribery of supervisory, law enforcement, and judicial personnel will be severely punished
items.core: "Spending some money to settle things" is an independent crime in the criminal law, and those who give money will also be sentenced. Those who commit bribery will be sentenced to less than 3 years, and for serious cases, they will be sentenced to 3 to 10 years. For particularly serious cases, they will be sentenced to more than 10 years or no time limit. Bribery of supervisory, administrative law enforcement, and judicial personnel is still strictly prohibited. If money is extorted and no illegitimate benefits are obtained, it does not count as bribery.
body: Cost: No money. Just don't do it.

Profit: Article 389 of the Criminal Law defines bribery: "Anyone who provides property to state functionaries for the purpose of seeking improper benefits is guilty of bribery." The same article also reads: "In economic transactions, anyone who violates state regulations and gives property to state workers in relatively large amounts, or who violates state regulations and gives kickbacks or fees in various names to state workers, will be punished as bribery." There is also an exception: "Those who have been blackmailed into giving property to state functionaries without obtaining any illegitimate benefits are not considered bribes." The sentencing is written in Article 390 of the Criminal Law (revised by the Twelfth Amendment to the Criminal Law, effective from March 1, 2024). The original text is: "Whoever commits the crime of bribery shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention, and shall also be fined; whoever seeks illegitimate benefits through bribery, and the circumstances are serious, or will cause heavy losses to national interests, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than three years and not more than 10 years, and shall also be fined; if the circumstances are particularly serious, or will cause particularly heavy losses to national interests, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than 10 years or life imprisonment, and shall also be fined or have property confiscated." There are seven serious situations that require serious punishment: "(1) Bribery multiple times or bribery to multiple people; (2) Bribery by state functionaries; (3) Bribery in national key projects or major projects; (4) Bribery to obtain position, promotion, adjustment; (5) Bribery for Supervision, administrative law enforcement, and judicial staff pay bribes; (6) Pay bribes and carry out illegal and criminal activities in the fields of ecological environment, finance, production safety, food and medicine, disaster prevention and relief, social security, education, medical care, etc.; (7) Use illegal proceeds for bribes." The last paragraph leaves an opening for exemptions for voluntary confessions: "A briber who voluntarily confesses to bribery before being prosecuted may be given a lighter or reduced punishment. Among them, those who commit relatively minor crimes, who play a key role in investigating breakthroughs and solving major cases, or who have performed major meritorious services, may be given a reduced or exempted punishment" (National)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Standing Committee of the National People's Congress. Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China (Consolidated text as amended by the 11th Amendment to the Criminal Law) Article 389. <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=ff808181796a636a0179822a19640c92>; Standing Committee of the National People's Congress (2023). Amendment to the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China (12) (Item 5, amending Article 390 of the Criminal Law; effective from March 1, 2024). <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=ff8081818c3ce31f018cb6a6bc412f55>

Note: The beneficiary is yourself. Don't expect to get away with a bribe. The other party has colleagues, accounts, monitoring and supervision. The things you sent were evidence when he was investigated, and they were also evidence of your own guilt, and this type of bribery is a serious one. If you really encounter the other party asking for benefits, follow the channels in Article 39 (call the police and ask for a receipt on the spot). Leave the receipt of case acceptance and documents and report it to the supervisory agency or disciplinary inspection and supervision agency. The exemption condition provided in Paragraph 3 of Article 389 of the Criminal Law is that "the person was blackmailed and did not obtain any improper benefits." Once you take this opportunity to get something you couldn't get otherwise, this condition does not hold. Red envelopes in the hospital belong to another set of rules, see Section 24, Article 11

Case: In order to obtain land at a low price, businessman Sun gave a 200,000 shopping card to the land director. The director handed over the clues. Sun was sentenced to 2 years for bribery. The director was sentenced for accepting bribes. Sun did not receive any improper benefits.

items.title: For phone calls and interviews that may turn out to be quarrels, start recording directly: you do not need to obtain the consent of the other party before participating in the conversation
items.core: Borrowing money, arrears, compensation, refunds, labor disputes, if you explain clearly on the phone but leave nothing behind, both parties may say different things after a few months. The conversation you participated in can be recorded, and you did not tell the other party in advance. This alone will not be used as evidence. What you can't do is eavesdrop, peek into other people's privacy, break into other people's homes and record them, or threaten them.
body: Cost: No money. Just open the call recording or recording software on your mobile phone. Record from beginning to end, keep the original files after recording, do not edit or overwrite.

Income: Article 66 of the Civil Procedure Law lists audio-visual materials and electronic data as evidence. Article 106 of the Judicial Interpretation of the Civil Procedure Law of the Supreme People's Court only excludes evidence obtained by three methods. These three types are: serious infringement of the legitimate rights and interests of others, violation of prohibitive provisions of the law, and serious violation of public order and good customs. "Not telling the other party in advance" does not fall into these three categories. Article 15 of the Evidence Regulations of the Supreme People's Court: When using audio or video recordings as evidence, their original carriers, such as the original mobile phone, must be deposited. Article 90: Audio-visual materials and electronic data containing doubtful points cannot be used alone to determine facts. A judge's article reprinted on the official website of the Supreme People's Court also said: The recording must be obtained legally, the content is true, not edited, and related to the case (nationwide)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress Standing Committee (amended in 2023, effective January 1, 2024). Civil Procedure Law (Article 66). Full text reprinted by Shanghai Development and Reform Commission <https://fgw.sh.gov.cn/ys-syjf-zc-2.4.1-h5/20240408/073febdb2b04464390546232d4089f51.html>; Supreme People’s Court (Second Amendment in 2022). Interpretation on the application of the Civil Procedure Law of the People’s Republic of China (Article 106). <https://www.court.gov.cn/fabu/xiangqing/353651.html>; Supreme People's Court (amended in 2019). Several regulations on evidence in civil litigation (Articles 14, 15, and 90). <https://www.court.gov.cn/zixun/xiangqing/212721.html>; Liu Danni (2023). The law in the movie "She Disappeared" (People's Court Newspaper, reprinted on the official website of the Supreme People's Court). <https://www.court.gov.cn/zixun/xiangqing/406032.html>

Note: The beneficiaries are yourself and your family. Try to match the people, things, money and time in the recording. Don't just ask "When will you give it to me?" You can ask naturally, "When are you going to pay back the 50,000 yuan I borrowed from you last year?" Give the recording to the court, arbitration committee or police for use, and do not post it online. Publicizing other people's words may lead to privacy and reputation disputes, see Article 16 of this section (Do not curse or spread rumors online). Having a recording does not mean you will win. The court will have to combine it with other evidence to see if it is true and whether it is relevant. The recording only addresses whether it can be proved. Whether or not a lawsuit will actually be filed and how long it will take have to be calculated separately. Please refer to Section 19, Article 8 for the materials that should be saved before leaving your job (save your salary slips and attendance before leaving your job). The above are all based on civil procedure rules. There are different regulations on how to use evidence in criminal and administrative cases.

Case: Sun lent 30,000 yuan to a colleague, with only a transfer record and a verbal promise. After the repayment deadline passed, he asked his colleagues on the phone to confirm the loan and repayment time, and recorded the loan himself. Later, colleagues denied it, and the court determined the fact of the loan based on the transfer and recording.

items.title: If something goes wrong at the scene, take a panoramic shot first, then the location, and finally the damage and injuries. Don’t delete the original pictures and videos.
items.core: Just take a close-up of a scratch on the car or an object on the ground. No one will know where it is after a few days. First take a panoramic shot, including intersections, house signs, cars, people and surroundings, then take a shot of each other's positions, and finally take a shot of the details. If you want to move something or a car, take pictures first if you can. Keep the original pictures and videos on your phone, don’t just save a copy that was transferred in the chat software.
body: Cost: No money. Use your mobile phone to take pictures for tens of seconds to several minutes. Make sure you are safe first, and do not delay rescuing people or handling the situation.

Income: Article 66 of the Civil Procedure Law lists physical evidence, audio-visual materials and electronic data as evidence. Article 14 of the Supreme People’s Court’s Evidence Regulations lists pictures, audios, and videos as electronic data. Article 15 requires the original electronic data to be handed over, and the original carrier to use video as evidence. Photos and videos can preserve the scene conditions that will change soon, and then compare them with alarm records, maintenance records, medical records, and witness statements. The order of "panorama, location, details" is an empirical practice and is not stipulated by law (nationwide)
Evidence level: C

Source: National People's Congress Standing Committee (amended in 2023, effective on January 1, 2024). Civil Procedure Law (Article 66). Full text reprinted by Shanghai Development and Reform Commission <https://fgw.sh.gov.cn/ys-syjf-zc-2.4.1-h5/20240408/073febdb2b04464390546232d4089f51.html>; Supreme People’s Court (amended in 2019). Several provisions on evidence in civil litigation (Articles 14 and 15). <https://www.court.gov.cn/zixun/xiangqing/212721.html>

Remarks: The beneficiaries are yourself and your family. The reason for giving C is because the order of shooting is just experience, and legal provisions only require that photos and videos can be used as evidence, and the originals must be submitted. If someone is injured, has a fire, has an air leak, or is in other danger, save them first, get out of the way first, and don't waste time taking pictures. Please refer to Article 1 of this section for what you should do at the scene of a traffic accident (stop the car first, rescue people, and call the police if there is a traffic accident).

Case: Two cars collided. Wu first took a panoramic video of the traffic lights, then the distance between the cars, and finally the details of the scratches, and saved the original image on his mobile phone. The other party was fully responsible, and these evidences helped Wu successfully obtain a claim.

items.title: If you have been domestically abused: call the police first and leave a police record, then go to the court to apply for a personal safety protection order. There is no need to divorce first and no fees are charged
items.core: According to data from many countries, more than one-third of women who are killed are killed by their partners, which is often the result of long-term domestic violence. Among women who were also beaten, those who were choked had a much higher risk of being killed later. So when I was beaten, I called the police and then went to court to apply for a protection order. The court usually responds within 72 hours.
body: Cost: Nothing. There is no legal fee or bond required to apply for a personal safety protection order. It takes time to call the police, examine injuries, and write an application. The hardest part is opening this up to family members.

Benefits: Let’s talk about risks first. Data from 66 countries combined (systematic review). An intimate partner was responsible for 38.6% of homicides of women and 6.3% of homicides of men. Such homicides are often the final step in long-term abuse, the authors say. Another study compared 506 homicides and attempted homicides, as well as 427 women who had been beaten but had not been beaten. Compared with those who had not been choked by a partner before, the odds ratio of attempted homicide was OR 6.70 (95% CI 3.91–11.49). The odds ratio for being killed was OR 7.48 (95% CI 4.53–12.35). The two outcomes of homicide and attempted homicide were rare, and the odds ratios and relative risks were similar. Let’s talk about the law. Victims and close relatives can call the police. Public security organs must dispatch police in a timely manner to stop domestic violence, investigate and collect evidence, and assist in medical treatment and injury examination. If the circumstances are relatively minor, the public security organ may issue a warning letter to the other party. If you suffer from domestic violence or face the real danger of domestic violence, you can apply to the court for a personal safety protection order. The court must make a ruling within 72 hours after accepting the application, and within 24 hours if the situation is urgent. A protection order can prohibit the other party from committing violence, prohibiting the other party from harassing, stalking, or contacting you and your close relatives, and can also allow the other party to move out of your residence. The protection order lasts for up to 6 months and can be extended before expiration. The application is not subject to divorce. The court considers that domestic violence "has a high probability" and can be used. If the other party violates the protection order, the court may impose a fine of up to 1,000 yuan and detain him or her for up to 15 days. If it constitutes a crime, it will be treated as a crime of refusing to execute the judgment or ruling. Frequent insults, threats, stalking, harassment, and starvation are also considered domestic violence.
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress Standing Committee (2015). Anti-Domestic Violence Law (Articles 2, 13, 15, 16, 19, 23, 28, 29, 30, 34). <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=2c909fdd678bf17901678bf7f9d60889>; Supreme People's Court (2022). Provisions on several issues concerning the application of law in handling personal safety protection order cases (Fa Interpretation [2022] No. 17, Articles 1, 3, 6, 10, and 12). <https://www.court.gov.cn/zixun/xiangqing/366021.html>; Supreme People’s Court (2016). Reply on relevant procedural issues in personal safety protection order cases (Fa Interpretation [2016] No. 15, Items 1 and 2). Full text reprinted by Pingyuan County People's Court <http://qdzy.sdcourt.gov.cn/dzpyfy/393141/393283/1461545/index.html>; Stöckl H et al. (2013). The global prevalence of intimate partner homicide: a systematic review. Lancet. <https://doi.org/10.1016/S0140-6736(13)61030-2>; Glass N et al (2008). Non-fatal strangulation is an important risk factor for homicide of women. Journal of Emergency Medicine. <https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jemermed.2007.02.065>

Note: The beneficiaries are mainly yourself and your family. The proportion of homicides is based on foreign data, and there are no public statistics of the same caliber in our country. Evidence should be collected: police records, warning letters, injury examination results, medical records, guarantee letters written by the other party, chat records and audio recordings can all be used. For recordings, see Section 41 (Recordings) of this Section. There is no need to hire a lawyer for a protection order, and the result is usually available within a few days. Divorce or compensation is another lawsuit. The ordinary first-instance procedure is stipulated to be completed within 6 months, and can be extended. The lawyer's fees are paid by yourself. Victims of domestic violence can seek legal aid, and the court can also postpone, reduce or waive legal fees. A protection order does not mean that personal safety is guaranteed. If there is immediate danger, call 110 first. If the victim is forced or intimidated and unable to apply by himself, close relatives, public security organs, women's federations, neighborhood committees, and village committees can apply on his behalf. If the victim is a friend or colleague, you can accompany him or her to call the police or the hospital. If you see someone being beaten at a stranger’s house, just call 110. Do not engage in hand-holding by yourself, for the reason see Section 13, Article 37 (caught a group of people fighting). How to write child support and visitation in divorce, see Section 10, Article 23 (Child support and visitation).

Case: The wife was beaten by her husband while drunk. She immediately called the police and obtained the police record. After examining her injuries, she applied to the court for a personal safety protection order. The court issued an injunction within 72 hours, and the husband was isolated and did not commit any further violence.

items.title: If a family member has a gambling debt, don’t rush to pay it off for him: Gambling debts are not protected by the law, and money borrowed for gambling is not considered a joint debt of the couple
items.core: The court does not protect money owed at the gambling table. The creditor knew that he borrowed money for gambling and then lent it to him, and the court did not protect the money. The money borrowed by one party for gambling cannot be counted as a debt repaid by the couple together. Without a trial, the court cannot make the party who did not lend the money bear responsibility for him.
body: Cost: No money. The difficulty lies in not being able to pay when creditors come to your door and family members cry and beg. If the creditor does sue, you have to respond.

Benefits: The Supreme People’s Court’s 2017 notice made four points. Debts owed by one party in illegal and criminal activities such as gambling and drug abuse are not protected by law. If the creditor knew or should have known that he lent money to gamble or take drugs and still lent it to him, he would not be protected by law. If one party borrows money in his own name and uses it to commit illegal crimes, the court will not support his request to be treated as a joint debt of the couple. Without going through trial procedures, the party who did not borrow the money cannot be required to bear civil liability (National, starting from 2017)
Level of Evidence: B

Source: Supreme People's Court (2017). Notice on Properly Trial Issues Related to Cases Involving Married Debts in accordance with the Law (Fa [2017] No. 48, Articles 2 and 4). <https://www.court.gov.cn/fabu/xiangqing/36982.html>

Remarks: To B It's because this is an internal notice from the court. There are no figures. Whether the creditor knows or not depends on the evidence. This notice was issued in accordance with the marriage law at that time. For how to determine the joint debt of husband and wife after the implementation of the Civil Code, see Section 10, Article 12 (Substantial borrowings by spouses). The creditor didn't know that he still had to repay the money he borrowed for gambling, but it was the borrower himself who repaid the money. To prove that the money was used for gambling, you must have transfer statements, gambling platform records, or police processing materials, which you can keep on a daily basis. If the creditor really goes to sue, the first-instance ordinary procedure is required to be completed within 6 months, which can be extended, and the simplified procedure can be completed for 3 months. Each lawyer's fee is payable by himself, and the losing party does not bear the responsibility. If a creditor comes to block or detain someone, please refer to Section 9, Article 15 (Not detaining someone if they demand debt), and call the police directly. If he himself has gambled to the point of wanting to die, see Section 1, Article 37 (If you gamble to the point where you borrow money and pay back the bet, you must play 12356 first). The beneficiaries are mainly spouses and immediate family members.

Case: The husband owes money due to gambling, and the creditor comes to force his wife to pay back the money. The wife found out that the loan was used for gambling and the creditor knew about it and refused to repay it. The creditor sued, and the court determined that the debt was not a joint debt and dismissed the claim.

items.title: An acquaintance asks you to "help you show your face and be a witness" to apply for a loan, or asks you to read a verification code. Don't agree: this is called an AB loan. You are the borrower, not the guarantor
items.core: The so-called "help you show your face and be a witness" actually means borrowing money from the bank in your name. You are the borrower, not the guarantor. After the money is transferred to an acquaintance, the bank will still ask you to repay it. The intermediary deceived you, but as long as the bank does not know about it, you cannot withdraw from this loan contract. A letter of "I'll pay it back" written to you by an acquaintance will not affect the bank.
body: Cost: No money. The difficulty lies in rejecting relatives and friends in person. The other party said, "I'm just a witness" and "you don't have to take responsibility," but they still refused. Do not hand over your mobile phone, ID card, or bank card to the intermediary, nor do you follow the intermediary's instructions to scan your face or sign your name. The verification code is for your own use only, and acquaintances will not read it if they ask for it.

Income: The 2022 risk warning from the Fujian Supervision Bureau of the State Administration of Financial Supervision talks about this routine. Customer A is not qualified enough and cannot get a loan. The agency said that they need to add a guarantor and ask A to find B with good qualifications. In actual practice, the intermediary uses B's identity information to apply for a loan and gives the money to A. The original text states that "the borrower is actually B", and B "didn't realize that he was the borrower and not the guarantor until he was called upon by the bank." A reminder from the Shandong Supervision Bureau in 2024 stated that the intermediary would promise B “not to bear any responsibility.” The intermediary will also teach B how to deal with the bank's pre-loan investigation in advance, and B will actually apply for the loan as the borrower. The Shanghai Putuo District Court announced a case in 2024. The salesperson takes B’s mobile phone to download the bank app and directly applies for a loan in B’s name. The money arrived in B's account, B transferred it to A, and A paid a handling fee of more than 80,000 yuan. A group of eight agents were sentenced to 10 months to four years for contract fraud. Even if the intermediary is sentenced, the loan will not become someone else's. Article 149 of the Civil Code states that if a third party commits fraud, the other party "knows or should know", and only then can the deceived party request revocation. The other party here is the bank, and the bank cannot withdraw it without knowing it. If it is possible to withdraw, a request must be made to the court within one year from the date of knowing that the person has been deceived (Article 152). The borrower must repay the money within the agreed period (Article 675). A contract binds only the person who signed it (Article 465). Transferring debts to others requires the consent of the bank (551). Therefore, the letter of commitment written by A cannot control the bank. The only way to get the money is to sue A himself. I did it for someone else without reading the contract, and the court recognized the contract. The Shizhong District Court of Neijiang City concluded a case in 2025: Jiang borrowed money from a small loan company but could not borrow it by himself. Behind Zhang's back, Zhang's son gave Jiang her identity information and asked her to be a co-borrower. During the loan process, Zhang was asked to swipe her face, but she did so without reading the contract. The court said she "should have foreseen the importance and legal consequences of facial recognition" and sentenced her and Jiang to have the remaining capital of more than 60,000 yuan. The Electronic Signature Law states that "a reliable electronic signature has the same legal effect as a handwritten signature or seal." The Anti-Telecommunications and Internet Fraud Law stipulates that no one "may provide assistance with real-name verification." Violators will be fined and, in serious cases, detained. The ordinary first-instance procedure is required to be completed within 6 months and can be extended. Lawyer fees are not included in the statutory litigation fees and must be paid by yourself (nationwide)
Level of Evidence: B

Source: Fujian Supervision Bureau of the State Administration of Financial Supervision (formerly Fujian Banking and Insurance Regulatory Bureau) (2022). Risk reminder on preventing new routines of non-performing loan intermediaries (September 14, 2022). <https://www.nfra.gov.cn/branch/fujian/view/pages/common/ItemDetail.html?docId=1072844&itemId=1104&generaltype=0>; Shandong Supervision Bureau of the State Administration of Financial Supervision (2024). Risk warning: Be wary of the risks of illegal loan intermediary AB loans (March 14, 2024). <https://www.nfra.gov.cn/branch/shandong/view/pages/common/ItemDetail.html?docId=1154326&itemId=1269&generaltype=0>; Shanghai Putuo District People’s Court (2024). Explain the law with cases: Can you still apply for a large loan if your credit is not good? Beware of the "AB loan" trap. <https://www.shpt.gov.cn/fyzx-fy/20240920/953017.html> (Reprinted from the Putuo District People's Government website of Shanghai); Tang Yifei (2025). It is necessary to criminally regulate "loan intermediary fraud". Theoretical Edition of Procuratorate Daily. <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/llyj/202506/t20250607_697711.shtml> (official website of the Supreme People's Procuratorate); National People's Congress (2020). Civil Code (Articles 149, 152, 465, 551, 675). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202006/t20200602_463888.shtml>; National People’s Congress Standing Committee (2023 revision). Civil Procedure Law (Article 152). <https://fgw.sh.gov.cn/ys-syjf-zc-2.4.1-h5/20240408/073febdb2b04464390546232d4089f51.html> (Reprinted by Shanghai Development and Reform Commission); State Council (2006). Measures for the payment of litigation fees (State Council Order No. 481, Article 6). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2008-03/28/content_6929.htm>; Sichuan Changan Net (sponsored by the Political and Legal Affairs Committee of the Sichuan Provincial Committee of the Communist Party of China, sourced from Sichuan Rule of Law News) (2025). A "face-swiping" operation cost her tens of thousands of yuan in loans. Court: The parties should foresee the importance and legal consequences of facial recognition (September 23, 2025). <https://www.sichuanpeace.gov.cn/azsf/20250923/2992615.html>; Intermediate People’s Court of Xinzhou City, Shanxi Province (reprinted from the People’s Court News) (2021). A woman was sued for repaying the money after she applied for a card loan (August 19, 2021). <https://sxxzzy.shanxify.gov.cn/article/detail/2021/08/id/6215123.shtml>; National People’s Congress Standing Committee (2019). Electronic Signature Law (2019 amendment, Articles 3, 13, 14, and 15). <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=ff8080816f135f46016f2163e4261aa1>; Standing Committee of the National People's Congress (2022). Anti-Telecommunications Network Fraud Law (Articles 31 and 44). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202209/t20220902_575631.shtml>

Note: The beneficiary is mainly yourself, and the person A who comes to you is mostly a family member or friend. A prosecutor general in Pudong, Shanghai wrote an article saying that B often complied with the loan even though he knew it was his own out of sympathy, and eventually became the target of collection by the bank. If you really want to help, first ask yourself what your status is in the contract. If it's a loan contract, don't sign it. If you are willing to guarantee, you can sign a guarantee contract as a guarantor. See Article 18 (Guarantee for others). If you have been given a loan, first call the police, then call the phone number on the official website of the lending bank to explain the situation, and keep all chat and transfer records. I have several loans in my name. To check your credit, please see Article 9 (Checking the Credit Report). Don’t follow what the intermediary tells you when asking for a loan before the bank. You may be responsible for any fraud. See Section 9, Article 6 (Packaging Materials Loan). Face scanning and electronic confirmation are generally considered signatures, see Article 17 (read the paper before signing). The court does not always sentence the person to restitution. The Guangzhou Internet Court decided a case in 2021. A woman reported the loss to the police on the spot after her ID card was stolen. The bank lost the case because they couldn't provide evidence that she had swiped her face. Therefore, if your ID card is lost, you should report the loss to the police immediately and keep the receipt. When an institution asks you to scan your face, you can ask for other methods. That is another matter. See Section 14, Article 9 (you do not have to agree to scan your face). See Article 28 (nominal legal person) for similar tricks of using your name to do things. Mobile phones and accounts cannot be lent to others, see Article 8 (Do not lend bank cards to others). The reason given to B is because the supervision only provided routines and cases, but no statistics on the number of people who were defrauded and the amount of money they were defrauded.

Case: An old classmate asked Zheng to help with face-swiping loans and said, "I am only a witness," and Zheng did so. The next month the bank called for payment and found out that he was the borrower. Zheng called the police and the intermediary was arrested but the bank still required him to repay the money.

items.title: Install locks on doors and windows, install a sensor light on the outside of the door, and actually lock it when you go out: these are the things you need to prevent burglaries. Installing an alarm alone is useless
items.core: British data shows that for homes with door locks and window locks, the chance of someone entering and stealing things is only one-twelfth of that of a home without any locks. Adding a sensor light outside the door brings the price down to more than one-thirtieth. Installing only an alarm and nothing else does not seem to prevent theft. This deals with theft, regardless of robbery where someone is at home.
body: Cost: The door lock needs to be locked with a key, the window is locked, and a sensor light is installed outside the door, usually tens to hundreds of yuan. Replacing an entire security door costs thousands of dollars. The difficulty lies in actually locking the doors and windows every time you go out, and remember to keep the windows open in the summer.

Profit: The Crime Survey in England and Wales asked 37,416 households what security features they had installed in their homes between 2008 and 2012. Then compare these homes with the homes that were stolen. Only 4.9% of the households had nothing installed, but they accounted for 36.6% of the households where things were broken into and stolen. The author calculates the "protection multiplier": the probability of being stolen is a fraction of that of a home with nothing installed. The door lock plus window lock is 12.54 times, and the chance of being stolen is reduced to about one in 12. The door lock here refers to a double lock or a "deadlock" (the lock tongue requires a key to retract). Door locks, window locks plus sensor lights or timer lights outside the door are 34.41 times. Add in the timer lights in the house and it's 49 times. Only install the same ones, about 3 times the door light and 2.8 times the door lock. You can't tell the difference with a single window lock. Installing five things is no better than installing the right three. If you install only an alarm and nothing else, the risk of being stolen is higher than if you install nothing else. If a fake alarm box is hung, the chances of someone trying to break in but not succeeding are higher. The lock only counts if it is actually locked. Burglaries involving breaking locks, smashing windows, and breaking door panels down fell from 31 to 7 per 1,000 households between 1993 and 2006/07. That's down 77%. The rate of people walking in without locking doors and windows has been 7 cases per 1,000 households (England and Wales)
Level of Evidence: B

Source: Tseloni A, Thompson R, Grove L, Tilley N, Farrell G (2017). The effectiveness of burglary security devices. Security Journal 30(2):646–664. <https://doi.org/10.1057/sj.2014.30>; Tilley N, Thompson R, Farrell G, Grove L, Tseloni A (2015). Do burglar alarms increase burglary risk? A counter-intuitive finding and possible explanations. Crime Prevention and Community Safety 17(1):1–19. Tseloni A, Farrell G, Thompson R, Evans E, Tilley N (2017). Domestic burglary drop and the security hypothesis. Crime Science 6:3. <https://doi.org/10.1186/s40163-017-0064-2>; State Administration for Market Regulation, National Standardization Administration (2022). GB 17565-2022 General technical conditions for anti-theft security doors. <https://openstd.samr.gov.cn/bzgk/gb/newGbInfo?hcno=A75C1C66CB989D0A40BFA7A262C93290>; National People’s Congress (2020). Civil Code (Article 715). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202006/t20200602_463888.shtml>

Remarks: Dispute: That half of the alarm has negative data. The same authors calculated using data from 1992 to 1996 that installing alarms at that time would have reduced the chances of being stolen. The author also said that this abnormal result should be treated with caution. One possibility is that people install alarms in homes that have been stolen. All numbers are from the UK, and they only compare households with and without installation. There is no group comparison, so I give it a B. These figures only deal with burglaries, there is no data to say that door locks can prevent burglaries. If you really encounter someone at home, retreat first and call the police. See Article 10 (if there is a conflict, call the police first but do not take action). When there is no way to retreat, see Article 11 (You can fight back against an insurmountable violation). If you are renting, please discuss with the landlord before changing the locks or adding window locks.
