The Civil Code stipulates that if a tenant adds or modifies the property without the landlord's consent, the landlord may request restoration to the original condition or compensation. There is a mandatory national standard GB 17565-2022 for anti-theft security doors, which will be implemented on January 1, 2024. You can take a look when buying. The beneficiaries are mainly yourself and your family.

Case: Ms. Li installed C-level door locks, window locks and sensor lights at home, and locked them when she went out. Another household in the same building only had an alarm installed and suffered a loss of 20,000 yuan from theft. Ms. Li's home was safe and sound.

sections.title: Legal red lines that are easy for ordinary people to step on

items.title: Do not forward disaster, epidemic, or police news in the group that is not known to be true or false, and do not use P-pictures or AI to create scene pictures
items.core: If you forward a disaster, epidemic, or police news that you know to be false, the penalty will be as severe as if you made it up yourself. It’s the same thing even if you didn’t make it up: Detention for 5 to 10 days, and a further fine of up to 1,000 yuan. Those who seriously disrupt social order will be sentenced to less than three years, and those who cause serious consequences will be sentenced to three to seven years. P pictures and fake scene pictures made by AI are considered self-made.
body: Cost: No money. Take a look before forwarding to see if it is an official announcement. If you're not sure, don't repost it, don't change the picture, or add "it's said". It was hard to resist the urge to be the first messenger.

Benefits: Anyone who intentionally spreads rumors, lies about dangers, epidemics, disasters, or police situations, and disrupts public order will be detained for 5 to 10 days. You can also be fined up to 1,000 yuan. For less severe cases, the offender may be detained for less than 5 days or fined less than 1,000 yuan. Those who fabricate false dangers, epidemics, disasters, or police reports and spread them online will be sentenced to less than 3 years. This is also true for people who knowingly spread the news to others knowing it is false. The premise is that the social order is seriously disrupted, which the law says is "seriously disrupting the social order." Those who cause serious consequences will be sentenced to 3 to 7 years (nationwide)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress Standing Committee (2025). Public Security Management Punishment Law (revised in 2025, Article 29). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202506/t20250627_699863.shtml>; National People's Congress Standing Committee (2015). Criminal Law Amendment (9) (Article 32, i.e., Criminal Law, Article 291-1, Paragraph 2). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/201802/t20180205_364562.shtml>; National People’s Congress (2020). Criminal Law (Amended in accordance with the Criminal Law Amendment (11), Article 291-1). <https://jtgl.beijing.gov.cn/jgj/jgxx/flfg/fl/11033925/index.html> (Reprinted by the Beijing Municipal Public Security and Traffic Management Bureau)

Note: I reposted it even though I knew it was fake. I made it up myself. The police used the same terms. "I just turned around" is not exempt. P-pictures and fake scene pictures generated by AI are also considered self-edited. In 2025, the Ministry of Public Security announced many batches of typical cases of online rumors involving disasters and dangerous situations. The website of the Ministry of Public Security was not open when this section was written, so no specific cases were cited.

Case: During the flood season, someone posted an old video with the text "Bridge Collapse" to a WeChat group. Li knew that the video had nothing to do with the local area but still forwarded it to multiple property owner groups, triggering residents to panic buying and call the police. The public security organs detained him and fined him for spreading false police information.

items.title: Do not post or repost pictures, emoticons and comments that insult heroes and martyrs, and do not make jokes about the national flag and national anthem
items.core: Insulting heroes and martyrs or denying the deeds of heroes and martyrs will result in a light sentence of 5 to 10 days of detention or a fine of 1,000 to 3,000 yuan, and a serious sentence of 10 to 15 days of detention. Those who insult the national flag or sing the national anthem crookedly in public will be detained for up to 15 days. Those in both categories of serious cases will be sentenced to less than 3 years. Someone posted two messages to 499 people on WeChat to slander Yuan Longping. He was sentenced to 6 months in prison without being detained but his movements were restricted.
body: Cost: No money. No comments, no changes to images, and no reposting of content involving heroes, national flags, national emblems, and national anthems. It's hard not to follow a joke when someone in the group picks up the joke.

Benefits: Those who infringe upon the names, likenesses, reputations and honors of heroes and martyrs by insulting or fabricating facts, thereby harming public interests, shall be punished as follows. Detention for 5 to 10 days or a fine of 1,000 to 3,000 yuan. It is also the category that blasphemes and denies the deeds and spirit of heroes and martyrs, produces and disseminates remarks, pictures, audio and video that glorifies the war of aggression, and disrupts public order. For more serious cases, the offender will be detained for 10 to 15 days and may be fined up to 5,000 yuan. If it reaches the "serious circumstances" level, it constitutes a crime and the sentence is less than 3 years. Those who insult the national flag and emblem in public, or change the lyrics and music of the national anthem, or sing the national anthem in a distorted and derogatory way, will also be sentenced to less than three years in serious cases. If the national flag and national anthem are not sufficient for sentencing, they shall be dealt with according to the National Flag Law and National Anthem Law. The National Flag Law states that "if the circumstances are relatively minor, the public security organs will impose a detention of not more than 15 days." The National Anthem Law states that "the public security organs shall issue a warning or detain a person for not more than fifteen days." Official case: Xiao sent 2 messages to slander and insult Yuan Longping in a WeChat group of 499 villagers and was sentenced to 6 months in prison. Control is a sentence that does not involve imprisonment, but restricts movement. Qiu used his Weibo account with more than 2.5 million followers to post two pieces of content that distorted the deeds of the border guards. He was sentenced to 8 months in prison and had to publicly apologize in national media (nationwide)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress Standing Committee (2025). Public Security Management Punishment Law (revised in 2025, Article 35). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202506/t20250627_699863.shtml>; National People’s Congress Standing Committee (2018). Law on the Protection of Heroes and Martyrs (Articles 22 and 26). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/gyssshmhsh/201912/t20191202_440079.shtml>; Standing Committee of the National People’s Congress (2020). Criminal Law Amendment (11) (Article 35, namely Article 299-1 of the Criminal Law). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/zdgz/202012/t20201227_503682.shtml>; National People’s Congress (2020). Criminal Law (Amended in accordance with the Criminal Law Amendment (Eleven), Article 299, Article 299-1). <https://jtgl.beijing.gov.cn/jgj/jgxx/flfg/fl/11033925/index.html>; Supreme People's Court (2022). Ten typical cases involving the protection of the rights and interests of heroes and martyrs (Case 2, Case 3). <https://www.court.gov.cn/zixun/xiangqing/382301.html>; National People's Congress Standing Committee (2020 (Amendment). National Flag Law (Article 23). <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=ff80808175265dd40175e4c1504b0f2e> (National Laws and Regulations Database); National People’s Congress Standing Committee (2017). National Anthem Law (Article 15). <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=2c909fdd678bf17901678bf85f470a2d> (National Laws and Regulations Database)

Note: This article of the Public Security Management Punishment Law was only added in the 2025 revision. Before then, such matters could only be handled under criminal law or through civil public interest litigation filed by the procuratorate. A WeChat group with several hundred people is considered a public event in the eyes of the court.

items.title: Close the content on overseas websites after reading them, do not take screenshots, repost them, move them into groups, or follow them in the comment area
items.core: These laws only punish the posting, not reading. If you forward it, add it to a group, and follow it in the comment area, it all counts as spreading when you are working on a case. Those who fall to the category of inciting subversion or inciting separatism will be sentenced to less than 5 years, and those who take the lead will be sentenced to more than 5 years. Terrorist and extremist books, audio and video are exceptions. Those who knowingly still have them in their hands and the circumstances are serious will be sentenced to less than 3 years.
body: Cost: No money. The page is closed and the matter is over. Do not archive, forward, or move to domestic platforms. You don’t need an account that can match your identity to post political content on overseas platforms for a long time. We will also not accept royalties or funding from overseas institutions, organizations, or individuals. It’s hard not to take screenshots or share when you see eye-catching content.

Benefits: Anyone who incites others to subvert state power and overthrow the socialist system by spreading rumors, slander or other means shall be sentenced to less than 5 years in prison. Those who take the lead (called "ringleaders" in the law) or those who commit serious crimes will be sentenced to more than 5 years in prison and up to 15 years in prison. Those who incite secession and undermine national unity shall receive the same sentence as above. Anyone who colludes with overseas institutions, organizations, or individuals to do these two things will be severely punished. If institutions, organizations or individuals at home and abroad provide money to fund other people's crimes, the person directly responsible will be sentenced to less than 5 years, and if the circumstances are serious, they will be sentenced to more than 5 years. Those who steal, spy on, bribe, or illegally provide state secrets or intelligence for overseas institutions, organizations, or personnel will be sentenced to 5 to 10 years. In this case, those with particularly serious circumstances will be sentenced to more than 10 years or life imprisonment, and those with less severe circumstances will be sentenced to less than 5 years. Crimes that endanger national security are subject to deprivation of political rights for one to five years. During these years, the right to vote and the qualifications to hold public office are revoked. Property can also be confiscated and personal property returned to the state. There are also provisions on administrative penalties. No individual or organization may use the Internet to engage in activities that endanger national security, honor and interests. Nor must they incite subversion of state power or overthrow the socialist system. No inciting to split the country or undermine national unity is allowed. Anyone who publishes or transmits this type of information will be punished in accordance with relevant laws and administrative regulations (nationwide). There is another category that is established without propagation. Those who knowingly hold something that promotes terrorism or extremism illegally are considered serious enough to be sentenced. Things here include books, audio and video materials or other items. The sentence is fixed-term imprisonment of up to 3 years, criminal detention (short-term detention), or control (no detention but restricted movement). A fine may also be imposed concurrently or solely. A fine may be imposed at the same time as the sentence, or only a fine may be imposed. The basis is Article 120-6 of the Criminal Code, which was added by the ninth amendment to the Criminal Code.
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress (1997). Criminal Law (Articles 45, 55, 56, 103, 105, 106, 107, 111, and 113, these articles have not been modified by amendments). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/201802/t20180206_364975.shtml>; National People's Congress Standing Committee (2025). Cybersecurity Law (Amended in 2025, effective on January 1, 2026, Article 13, Paragraph 2, Article 71, Item 1). <https://www.cac.gov.cn/2025-12/29/c_1768735112911946.htm>; National People’s Congress Standing Committee (2015). Amendment to the Criminal Law (9) (New Article 120-6). Full text reprinted by the National Bureau of Letters and Calls <https://www.gjxfj.gov.cn/gjxfj/fgwj/flfg/webinfo/2017/03/1601761496614423.htm>

Note: The laws quoted in this article punish inciting others, spreading information to others, and providing it to others. They are not included in it. Terrorist and extremist materials are exceptions specified in the law, and mere possession of them in one's own hands can lead to a conviction (Article 120-6). Therefore this category must not be archived. Once you see it, stop here: no screenshots and archives, no reposting, no comments, no pulling people to repost it. Retweeting and following in the comment area is considered spreading when handling a case, and "I just retweeted it" is not exempt from liability. Anyone who colludes with overseas institutions, organizations, or individuals will be severely punished. Don’t forward messages that you are not sure are true or false. See Article 1 of this section (Do not forward messages that you don’t know are true or false). How to punish circumvention tools themselves? See Section 11, Article 11. There is no real benefit from transferring this kind of content, but the price is prison time, deprivation of political rights and confiscation of property. This book does not have a verifiable verdict from official channels, so it is written only in accordance with the legal provisions and does not include any cases.

Case: After Wang saw an inflammatory article on an overseas website, he simply closed the page and did not deal with it; another person in the same group sent a screenshot of the article to hundreds of people, and also posted a promotional link in the comment area. The police filed a case against him for spreading illegal information.

items.title: Pornographic videos are your own to watch (except those involving minors), do not post them to groups, do not sell "resources", and do not create groups
items.core: You are not subject to the penalty clauses, but if they involve minors, they are prohibited by law from possessing them. If you post it to a group, it will be considered as dissemination. If you post it several times without writing down the terms, you will be detained for 10 to 15 days and fined up to 5,000 yuan. If the circumstances are serious, the sentence will be less than 2 years, and the worst sentence for selling "resources" to make money will be life. If you create a communication group with more than 30 people, it is a crime for the group founder, administrator, and those who mainly send messages to it.
body: Cost: No money. Don’t forward it, don’t save it in group files, and don’t act as the group leader or administrator of this kind of group.

Benefits: Those who spread obscene information online will be detained for 10 to 15 days and may be fined up to 5,000 yuan. I haven’t written this one yet, how many times will it be posted. The same law that punishes sending messages to harass others states that it must be "sent multiple times." For less severe cases, the offender may be detained for less than 5 days or fined 1,000 to 3,000 yuan. If the content involves minors, they will be severely punished. Those who spread obscene materials to the level of "serious circumstances" will be sentenced to less than 2 years. Those who sell or pass it on in order to make money shall be sentenced to less than 3 years and fined. Serious cases in this category are punishable by 3 to 10 years, and particularly serious cases are punishable by more than 10 years or life imprisonment. If you create a group mainly used to spread obscene electronic information and have more than 30 members, it will be treated as a crime. The same goes for serious consequences. Those who founded the group, those who acted as administrators, and those who mainly posted it were all convicted of spreading obscene materials (nationwide). There is also a law governing possession involving minors. Article 52 of the Law on the Protection of Minors states that "it is prohibited to produce, copy, publish, disseminate or possess obscene and pornographic materials and Internet information about minors." This law does not include separate penalties for this article
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress Standing Committee (2025). Public Security Management Punishment Law (revised in 2025, Article 50, Paragraph 1, Item 5, Article 80). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202506/t20250627_699863.shtml>; National People's Congress (2020). Criminal Law (Amended in accordance with the 11th Amendment to the Criminal Law, Articles 363 and 364). <https://jtgl.beijing.gov.cn/jgj/jgxx/flfg/fl/11033925/index.html>; Supreme People’s Court, Supreme People’s Procuratorate (2010). Interpretation of Several Issues Concerning the Specific Application of Laws in Handling Criminal Cases of Producing, Copying, Publishing, Selling, and Disseminating Obscene Electronic Information using the Internet, Mobile Communication Terminals, and Audio Stations (2) (Article 3). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/zdgz/201002/t20100204_25001.shtml>; Standing Committee of the National People's Congress (2024 Revision). Law on the Protection of Minors (Article 52). <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=ff8081818f197cf001905e567af635a0> (National Laws and Regulations Database)

Note: These two laws punish "communication", and I don't see it in the terms privately. Content involving minors is not included in this list, and even possession is prohibited under the Minors Protection Act. Posting it to a group means spreading it online. The article does not specify the number of times, so posting once is also included in the article. This is derived from the article. The exact number required for "serious circumstances" is stipulated by judicial interpretation. This section has not verified the specific number.

Case: Zhao sent several obscene videos to a WeChat group of more than 30 people, and invited friends to join the group to watch. Members of the group continued to upload videos, and Zhao, as the founder and main uploader of the group, was identified as distributing obscene materials and was criminally dealt with.

items.title: A "part-time job" requires you to use your own card to collect money, withdraw cash, and transfer funds, no matter how much you are offered.
items.core: This kind of part-time job can earn hundreds of dollars, and the price can be as light as a detention fine, or as heavy as a sentence, which can be recorded on the record. Someone brought a bank card to cooperate with the transfer and withdrawal and earned more than 500 yuan. The procuratorate did not prosecute him, but the police detained him for 10 days and fined him 1,000 yuan. Another person handed his own and other people's bank cards and mobile phone cards to a gang to collect money and withdraw cash. He was sentenced to 2 years and 3 months and fined 22,000 yuan.
body: Cost: No money. Give up this kind of work of "paying hundreds of dollars a day and taking your card to the bank".

Profits: Anyone who knowingly transfers, acquires, sells, or uses other methods to cover up money or property obtained from a crime shall be sentenced to less than 3 years and concurrently or solely fined (a fine may be imposed at the same time as the sentence, or may only be fined). Official case: Wang Moumou brought his ID card and a bank card as instructed, went to the designated location to cooperate with the transfer and withdrawal, and earned more than 500 yuan. The procuratorate did not prosecute him, but the police detained him for 10 days in accordance with the Anti-Telecommunications and Internet Fraud Law and fined him 1,000 yuan. Man Moumou gave his own and other people's bank cards and mobile phone cards to the gang for collection, transfer, and cash withdrawal. He was sentenced to 2 years and 3 months and fined 22,000 yuan (nationwide). The same goes for converting it into virtual currency and transferring it away. An Moumou and three others followed the instructions of the electronic fraud gang and used their own bank cards to collect money. They buy the money into virtual currency on the trading platform, then transfer it to the account designated by the other party, and get a commission in proportion. It was found that the victim was defrauded of more than 500,000 yuan. The three were sentenced to 2 years and 8 months to 3 years and 3 months respectively for covering up and concealing the proceeds of crime, and each was fined 30,000 to 40,000 yuan (Tongzhou, Beijing)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress (2020). Criminal Law (Amended in accordance with the Criminal Law Amendment (Eleven), Article 312). <https://jtgl.beijing.gov.cn/jgj/jgxx/flfg/fl/11033925/index.html>; Supreme People’s Procuratorate (2023). Typical cases of procuratorial organs punishing telecommunications network fraud and related crimes in accordance with the law (Case 9). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/xwfbh/wsfbt/202311/t20231130_635188.shtml>; Supreme People’s Court, Supreme People’s Procuratorate (2025). Typical cases of punishing crimes of covering up, concealing criminal proceeds, and proceeds of crime in accordance with the law (Case 1 and 5). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/xwfbh/wsfbt/202508/t20250825_704514.shtml>

Note: For the consequences of lending your bank card to others and helping others "run points", see Section 8, Article 8 (Lending bank cards to others). This article talks about withdrawing cash and transferring money by yourself. It is the same thing to convert the money into virtual currencies such as Tether and then transfer it out. If you lose money by buying coins yourself, why don’t you get it back? See Section 5, Article 45 (Don’t buy virtual currencies). "I don't know where the money came from" is not necessarily true when handling a case. When the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate commented on Man X's case, they stated that the court will look at the information you have access to, how the money is converted and transferred, and whether there are any abnormalities in transactions and accounts. Then combined with your experience and relationship with upstream, you can comprehensively judge whether you know it or not. The person who was not charged in the above case was also detained for 10 days.

items.title: Someone pulls you to get a loan for "packaging materials" and shares the benefits with you based on the loan amount, but does not do anything
items.core: Helps someone to get a loan for "packaging materials" and gets a share of the loan, which is treated as a fraud. There was a 126-member gang that packaged unemployed people as "high-quality customers" and fraudulently obtained loans of more than 30 million yuan at more than 80 bank branches. Those who came forward to sign received 30% of the loan amount as a commission. 76 of the 80 people who had been sentenced were sentenced to 1 year and 4 months to 6 years and 6 months. The debt belongs to whose name the money is loaned.
body: Cost: Nothing. Reject directly. Don’t lend your ID card and your credit record to others, don’t sign a loan contract you haven’t read, and don’t go to the bank to sign for someone else.

Profit: Obtain loans, bill acceptances, letters of credit, letters of guarantee, etc. from banks or other financial institutions through deception. Those who cause serious losses to banks or other financial institutions shall be sentenced to less than 3 years. A fine may also be imposed concurrently or solely. A fine may be imposed at the same time as the sentence, or only a fine may be imposed. Those who cause particularly heavy losses or have other particularly serious circumstances shall be sentenced to 3 to 7 years and fined. The starting point for police investigation is a direct economic loss of more than 500,000 yuan. It is a crime of loan fraud to use fabricated reasons for introducing capital projects, fake economic contracts, fake certification documents or fake property rights certificates to defraud someone from a loan without intending to repay it. If you defraud 50,000 yuan, a case will be filed, and you will be sentenced to less than 5 years and fined 20,000 to 200,000 yuan. If the amount is huge or there are other serious circumstances, the sentence will be 5 to 10 years. If the amount is particularly huge, the sentence will be 10 years or more or even life imprisonment. Anyone who forges, alters, or buys or sells official documents, certificates, or seals of state agencies will be sentenced to less than three years, and in serious cases, he will be sentenced to three to 10 years. Official case: A gang of 126 people packaged unemployed people as "high-quality customers" in 16 provinces and cities, and fraudulently obtained loans of more than 30 million yuan at more than 80 bank branches. "White households" who take out loans receive a commission of 30% of the loan amount. The prosecutor's office prosecuted 105 "white households". Of the 80 people sentenced in the first instance in 2026, 76 were sentenced to 1 year and 4 months to 6 years and 6 months and fined for loan fraud. Another four people were sentenced to several crimes including loan fraud and money laundering for withdrawing cash for the gang (the two crimes were counted together in prison terms). These four people received sentences ranging from 2 years and 4 months to 7 years and 6 months (national). The crime of fraudulently obtaining loans in this article shall be based on the text of the Criminal Law Amendment (11) from March 2021.
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress Standing Committee (2020). Criminal Law Amendment (Eleven) (Article 11, amending Criminal Law Article 175-1). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202012/t20201227_503700.shtml>; National People's Congress (1997). Criminal Law (Articles 88, 193, 280). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/201802/t20180206_364975.shtml>; Supreme People’s Procuratorate, Ministry of Public Security (2022). Provisions on the standards for filing and prosecution of criminal cases under the jurisdiction of public security organs (2) (Articles 22 and 45). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/xwfbh/wsfbt/202204/t20220429_555906.shtml>; Supreme People’s Procuratorate (2026). Money laundering behind the loan fraud assembly line (Procuratorial Daily). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/zdgz/202604/t20260428_726494.shtml>; National People’s Congress Standing Committee (2012). Exit and Entry Administration Law (Article 12). <https://www.nia.gov.cn/n741440/n741547/c1013311/content.html> (National Immigration Administration); National People’s Congress Standing Committee (2023 revision). Civil Procedure Law (Article 266). <https://amr.guizhou.gov.cn/zwgk/xxgkml/jcxxgk/zcfg/fl/202401/t20240129_83645867.html> (Reprinted by Guizhou Provincial Market Supervision Bureau)

Note: The sentence "I wanted to pay it back at the time" was not adopted in that case. The procuratorial organ found that these people had no jobs, no fixed assets, could not repay the debt at all, and had spent all the money they were allocated. Based on this, it was concluded that they had no intention of repaying the money in the first place. Those who take out money for a gang may also be charged with money laundering. Whoever's name the money is loaned to and who signed the contract is the borrower. Even if it does not constitute a crime, the debt and the records on your credit report are yours. Even if you take the money and run abroad, you won't be able to solve it: if you hide after the case is filed, you can still be pursued no matter how many years. Those who have not served their sentences and are being treated as criminal suspects or defendants are not allowed to leave the country. If the civil case is not settled, the court can prevent you from leaving the country; if the person subject to execution fails to perform, the court can also restrict you from leaving the country. For cash withdrawals and transfers on behalf of others, see Article 5 of this section ("part-time job" requires you to use your own card to collect money). For how to find out that someone has taken out a loan in your name, see Section 8, Article 9.

items.title: If you find a bank card and don’t withdraw the money, if you find a mobile phone or wallet, contact the owner or hand it over to the police, but don’t take it away
items.core: If you find something and keep it for yourself, if the amount reaches a “large amount” but refuse to hand it over, the sentence will be less than 2 years, and if the amount is huge, the sentence will be 2 to 5 years. Taking a found bank card to an ATM to withdraw money is even more serious. Even if you use someone else's credit card fraudulently, if the amount is larger, you will be sentenced to less than 5 years and fined 20,000 to 200,000 yuan. The police will directly file a case for withdrawing money, without the owner having to file a lawsuit himself.
body: Cost: No money, just a matter of minutes. Make a phone call to find the owner, or take the item to the police station.

Income: If you pick up something lost by someone else, return it to the owner, notify him in time to pick it up, or deliver it to the public security and other departments. If you keep things left by others for your own use and refuse to hand them over when the amount reaches a "large amount", it constitutes the crime of embezzlement and is sentenced to less than 2 years. For large amounts, the sentence is 2 to 5 years. Picking up someone else's credit card and using it at an ATM is considered "pretending to use someone else's credit card." “Credit card” in the Criminal Law refers to electronic payment cards issued by banks and other financial institutions, according to the 2004 interpretation of the Standing Committee of the National People’s Congress. It has all or part of the functions of consumer payment, credit loan, transfer settlement, cash deposit and withdrawal, etc. So ordinary bank cards that can deposit and withdraw cash are also included. Those that qualify as crimes will be treated as credit card fraud: those with larger amounts will be sentenced to less than 5 years and fined 20,000 to 200,000 yuan. If the amount is huge or there are other serious circumstances, the sentence will be 5 to 10 years and a fine of 50,000 to 500,000 yuan (national)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress (2020). Civil Code (Article 314). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202006/t20200602_463888.shtml>; National People's Congress (2020). Criminal Law (Amended according to the 11th Amendment to the Criminal Law, Articles 196 and 270). <https://jtgl.beijing.gov.cn/jgj/jgxx/flfg/fl/11033925/index.html>; Supreme People’s Procuratorate (2008). Reply on how to characterize the behavior of picking up other people’s credit cards and using them at automatic teller machines (ATMs). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/flfg/sfjs/201208/t20120830_47871.shtml>; Standing Committee of the National People's Congress (2004). Interpretation of the provisions on credit cards in the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China. <http://www.npc.gov.cn/zgrdw/npc/xinwen/lfgz/zxfl/2004-12/30/content_334756.htm>

Remarks: The crime of embezzlement is "handled only upon notification". The owner of the gain or loss goes to the court to sue himself, and the police do not take the initiative to take care of it. But using a found card to withdraw money is different. The owner does not need to file a lawsuit, the police will directly file a case. The specific amount of "larger amount" is determined by judicial interpretation and has not been verified in this section. After the item is delivered to the relevant department, the owner must pay storage fees when he comes to claim it (Article 317 of the Civil Code).

Case: Chen picked up a bank card and a note with a password, and then went to the ATM to withdraw 6,000 yuan. After the bank reported the case, the police directly filed a case. The court sentenced him to one year in prison for credit card fraud, suspended for one year, and imposed a fine and refund.

items.title: Use your real identity to receive discounts, do not buy virtual accounts to register small accounts in batches, and do not rely on loopholes to receive duplicate coupons
items.core: Use your real identity and one account to receive coupons once, and it is not within the scope of punishment. Registering fake users in batches, placing orders by yourself, and receiving more orders is considered a fraud. Those who defraud the starting point set by each province (3,000 to 10,000 yuan) will be sentenced to less than 3 years, and those who cheat 30,000 to 100,000 yuan will be sentenced to 3 to 10 years. A rider used a virtual account worth 0.1 yuan each to swipe coupons and cash out more than 90,000 yuan. Twelve people were sentenced in the same case.
body: Cost: No money. Give up working in the "Wool Mission Group". If you find a loophole in the platform, don't touch it. It’s hard not to think of discounts as income that can be copied in bulk.

Profit: If the amount is relatively large, the offender shall be sentenced to less than 3 years and may also be fined or fined (a fine may be imposed at the same time as the sentence is imposed, or only a fine may be imposed). If the amount is huge, or there are other serious circumstances, the sentence will be 3 to 10 years and a fine. If the amount is particularly huge, or there are other particularly serious circumstances, the offender shall be sentenced to more than 10 years or life imprisonment, and fined or property confiscated. For the three categories of large amount, huge amount, and extremely huge amount, each province sets local standards within the following ranges. The maximum is 3,000 yuan to more than 10,000 yuan. The huge amount is 30,000 yuan to more than 100,000 yuan, and the especially huge amount is more than 500,000 yuan. Those who teach methods to others or sell "tutorials" will be sentenced to less than 5 years for teaching criminal methods. If the circumstances are serious, they will be sentenced to 5 to 10 years. If the circumstances are particularly serious, they will be sentenced to more than 10 years or life imprisonment. Those who buy and sell mobile phone numbers and verification codes will be sentenced to less than 3 years for the crime of infringing on citizens' personal information, and 3 to 7 years for particularly serious crimes. The system of automatically switching accounts and network addresses in batches, as well as the code receiving platform for receiving SMS verification in batches, are expressly prohibited by Article 14 of the Anti-Telecommunications Network Fraud Law. Illegal buying, selling, renting, lending phone cards and Internet accounts, and helping others pass real-name verification are included in Article 31. Anyone who violates Article 14 will have all the money they earn confiscated, and will be fined 1 to 10 times the amount of money they earned. Those who make no money, or make less than 50,000 yuan, will be fined not more than 500,000 yuan, and in serious cases they may be detained for not more than 15 days. Those who violate Article 31 will also be fined 1 to 10 times. Those who make no money or make less than 20,000 yuan will be fined not more than 200,000 yuan. If the circumstances are serious, they will be detained for not more than 15 days. Those who participate in telecommunications network fraud and are not qualified for sentencing will be detained for 10 to 15 days. Any money earned will be confiscated and fined 1 to 10 times more. If you make no money or make less than 10,000 yuan, you will be fined up to 100,000 yuan. Official case one: Food delivery rider Liu Moumou bought a virtual mobile phone number for 0.1 yuan each and registered a new user on a certain platform. He received 29-15 off newcomer coupons to place an order, and then resold the goods to small shops to cash out. He also used virtual accounts to invite each other and receive bonuses ranging from 2 yuan to 20 yuan. He and rider Tan Moumou defrauded more than 90,000 yuan and more than 70,000 yuan respectively. The Shanghai Yangpu District Procuratorate indicted 12 people for fraud, and the court sentenced them to 3 years and 6 months to 3 months of detention. Official Case 2: Wang took advantage of the time difference between the online store's refund and the recovery of virtual lottery coins. He made 1,156 refunds and took away 224 items worth more than 249,000 yuan. He also cashed in on a second-hand platform. The court sentenced him to 3 years of probation for fraud and a fine of 30,000 yuan. During the trial, he returned the stolen goods and prepaid a fine, totaling 330,000 yuan. Official Case 3: A certain online ride-hailing platform’s new user coupons and driver subsidies were defrauded by false orders of “hailing a taxi and taking the order yourself”, involving more than 70 cities in 19 provinces, with an amount of more than 2 million yuan. The Procuratorate of Longcheng District, Chaoyang, Liaoning, prosecuted 163 people and all were found guilty. The principal criminals Huang and Cai were sentenced to three years and six months each for fraud, infringement of citizens' personal information, and teaching criminal methods (several crimes were counted together in prison terms). There are another 34 accomplices with minor circumstances. The procuratorate decided not to prosecute and still transferred them to the public security for administrative punishment (nationwide)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress (2020). Criminal Law (amended according to the Criminal Law Amendment (11), Article 253-1, Article 266, Article 295). <https://jtgl.beijing.gov.cn/jgj/jgxx/flfg/fl/11033925/index.html> (Reprinted by Beijing Municipal Public Security and Traffic Management Bureau); Supreme People's Court and Supreme People's Procuratorate (2011). Interpretation of Several Issues Concerning the Specific Application of Laws in Handling Criminal Cases of Fraud (Fa Interpretation [2011] No. 7, Article 1). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/sfjs/201802/t20180201_363736.shtml>; Standing Committee of the National People's Congress (2022). Anti-Telecommunications Internet Fraud Law (Articles 14, 31, 38, 42, and 44). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202209/t20220902_575631.shtml>; National People’s Congress (2020). Civil Code (Article 985). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202006/t20200602_463888.shtml>; Supreme People’s Procuratorate (2021). Targeting telecom network fraud | Criminals focus on the loopholes of the e-commerce economy (Procuratorate Daily). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/zdgz/202106/t20210607_520557.shtml>; Supreme People's Procuratorate (2025). Such "snatching" is suspected of fraud (Procuratorate Daily). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/zdgz/202508/t20250826_704625.shtml>; Supreme People’s Procuratorate (2024). Longcheng District, Chaoyang, Liaoning: Handling a series of telecommunications network fraud cases (Rule of Law Daily). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/zdgz/202401/t20240124_641099.shtml>; Look at the news (2026-08-25). A man bought more than 870 mobile phone numbers online to steal money from car companies and stole more than 400,000 yuan in electricity (reporter Chen Minjia). <https://www.kankanews.com/detail/80290xAJDw6> (Web Archive <https://web.archive.org/web/20261005044233/https://www.kankanews.com/detail/80290xAJDw6>)

Note: The boundary is not about "how much is collected", but whether there is any fabrication. Use your true identity to participate in activities, receive one account once, and use the coupons on yourself. That is the discount the platform gives you. In order to get more money, you register fake users, fabricate transactions, and conceal that you have already refunded money. This is to make the other party mistakenly hand over the items as if they are genuine, which is considered a fraud. The amount only determines how long the sentence will be. Some people have also reviewed the charging services of car companies. In August 2026, "Kankan News" reported that two people in Shanghai bought a large number of virtual mobile phone numbers and took turns tying them into sub-accounts of a new energy car company's App. Each account can be unbundled after charging twice with "charge now, pay later". No one pays the electricity bill, and the charging opportunity is sold to the truck driver. The Pudong New District Procuratorate believes this is fraud, not theft, and has approved the arrest. The case received only media coverage and no verdict or official notification. There are also consequences for being sentenced if the amount is not enough: the platform can ban your account, deduct discounts, and even require you to return money you don’t deserve. Those who participate in electronic fraud and do not commit crimes are also subject to detention and fines. "There is someone in the group who will help me and pay me according to the order" does not change the nature of your share. Teaching methods to others and reselling account numbers and mobile phone numbers are other crimes. Several crimes will be settled together. The beneficiary is yourself. For writing your own scripts and selling scripts, please refer to Section 11, Article 3. For selling cards and account numbers, please refer to Section 8, Article 8 (bank cards are lent to others) and Article 16 of this section (ID cards are not lent to others).

Case: Shanghai police uncovered a case of cheating on coupons on a food delivery platform. 12 defendants used virtual mobile phone numbers worth 0.1 yuan each to register accounts in batches, and took advantage of the platform’s “first order discount” rules to place orders to cash out. The amount involved was more than 90,000 yuan. The court sentenced the main criminal to 2 years in prison for fraud, and the remaining 11 people were sentenced to prison terms ranging from 6 months to 1 year, and all illegal gains were recovered.

items.title: Do not throw anything out of balconies or windows. Cigarette butts, garbage bags, and wine bottles are considered
items.core: Throwing things downstairs, as long as they may hurt people or break things, can be detained for up to 5 days or fined even if no one is hit. In serious cases, the person can be detained for 10 to 15 days. If you hit someone, you'll be charged with another crime: Someone threw a wine bottle and glass downstairs after drinking on the 21st floor, hitting a 13-year-old student and causing serious injuries. He was sentenced to 10 years in prison. Another person threw 8 bricks from the 32nd floor and killed one person. The death penalty was approved in 2024.
body: Cost: No money or time. Cigarette butts, garbage bags, and wine bottles are thrown into the trash can inside the house, not out of the window or balcony.

Benefits: Throwing objects from upstairs or other high places, as long as there is a risk of hurting people, damaging property or endangering public safety, you can be detained for up to 5 days, or fined up to 1,000 yuan. In serious cases, the offender may be detained for 10 to 15 days and may be fined up to 1,000 yuan. If the circumstances are serious enough to constitute the crime of throwing objects from high altitude, the person shall be sentenced to not more than one year, and concurrently or solely fined (a fine may be imposed together with the sentence, or only a fine may be imposed). Those who injure or kill someone will be punished with a more serious crime. Official case: After drinking on the 21st floor, Li Mouchen threw empty wine bottles and glasses into the playground downstairs, hitting a 13-year-old student and causing serious injuries of the second degree. He was sentenced to 10 years for endangering public safety in a dangerous manner. Zhou threw 8 bricks into the crowd from the 32nd floor, killing one person. The Supreme Court approved the death penalty in 2024 (nationwide)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress Standing Committee (2025). Public Security Management Punishment Law (revised in 2025, Article 43). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202506/t20250627_699863.shtml>; National People’s Congress Standing Committee (2020). Criminal Law Amendment (11) (Article 33, namely Criminal Law Article 291-2). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/zdgz/202012/t20201227_503682.shtml>; National People’s Congress (2020). Criminal Law (Amended in accordance with the Criminal Law Amendment (Eleven), Article 291-2). <https://jtgl.beijing.gov.cn/jgj/jgxx/flfg/fl/11033925/index.html>; Supreme People's Court (2024). Typical cases of punishing crimes endangering public security according to law (Case 1). <https://www.court.gov.cn/zixun/xiangqing/429522.html>; Supreme People's Court (2025). Exclusive interview with Li Yong, Vice President of the Supreme People's Court: Anyone who throws objects from high altitudes can be punished. <https://www.court.gov.cn/zixun/xiangqing/458381.html>

Note: People can be detained even if they do not hit anyone. The provision only requires "danger". The Civil Code also has a provision on civil compensation for objects thrown from high altitudes (Article 1,254). The original text was not available when writing this section, so there is no citation.

items.title: Do not buy imitation guns, steel ball guns, and air guns online, and do not buy "toy guns" from unknown sources
items.core: If the muzzle specific kinetic energy of steel ball guns and air guns purchased online reaches 1.8 Joules/square centimeter, they are classified as firearms. Holding a license without a license will result in a sentence of less than 3 years, and in serious cases, a sentence of 3 to 7 years. A couple sold "toy guns" and 18 of the 43 guns were identified as guns. They were not prosecuted because they could not prove their knowledge.
body: Cost: No money. If you want to shoot a gun, go to a regular shooting gallery.

Benefits: Those who possess or hide firearms without a license will be sentenced to less than 3 years, and in serious cases, they will be sentenced to 3 to 7 years. Non-standard guns that cannot shoot standard bullets will be recognized as firearms as long as the specific kinetic energy of the muzzle is greater than or equal to 1.8 Joules/cm2. Muzzle specific kinetic energy refers to the energy per square centimeter of the bullet when it exits the barrel. Many steel ball guns and air guns purchased online exceed this number. Starting from 2018, the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate have required that air guns with relatively low kinetic energy must be comprehensively evaluated before deciding whether to convict. The evaluation depends on the appearance, material, price, use, whether the person is informed, etc. Official case: Zhao and his wife were selling "toy guns" at the market and seized 43 guns, 18 of which were identified as meeting gun standards. Because there is insufficient evidence to prove that they knew it was a gun, no prosecution is based on doubtful evidence (National)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress (2020). Criminal Law (Amended according to the Criminal Law Amendment (11), Article 128). <https://jtgl.beijing.gov.cn/jgj/jgxx/flfg/fl/11033925/index.html>; Supreme People's Court, Supreme People's Procuratorate (2018). Reply on the Conviction and Sentencing of Criminal Cases Involving Compressed Gas-Powered Firearms and Airgun Lead Bullets (Fashi [2018] No. 8). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/xwfbh/wsfbt/201803/t20180328_372604.shtml>; Supreme People's Court (2018). Understanding and application of the "Reply". <https://www.court.gov.cn/zixun/xiangqing/88472.html>

Note: The key to not prosecuting that case was to determine that they were "unaware". It is difficult for adults to go online to buy steel ball guns and air guns, and then later say that they did not know they were guns. For penalties for carrying crossbows and controlled knives, see Article 26 of this section (do not buy sling sticks, stun guns, or daggers for self-defense).

items.title: If you buy a drone, register it with your real name first. You will not fly in airports, military zones and urban controlled airspace, and you will not breach the height limit.
items.core: If you fly without real-name registration, you will be fined no more than 200 yuan, and in serious cases, you will be fined 2,000 to 20,000 yuan. If you are not allowed to fly in controlled airspace, you will be fined up to 500 yuan. If the circumstances are serious, your drone will be confiscated and you will be fined another 1,000 to 10,000 yuan. For more serious cases, they can also be detained for 5 to 10 days. Someone paid to break the height limit and flew to nearly 3,000 meters to take pictures of clouds and post them online. He was detained for five days.
body: Cost: Real-name registration costs nothing and can be completed in a few minutes. Before each takeoff, use official channels to check whether the area you are flying to is controlled airspace.

Benefits: Anyone who flies without real-name registration will be ordered to make corrections and may also be fined up to 200 yuan. In serious cases, he will be fined 2,000 to 20,000 yuan. Anyone who flies micro, light or small drones in controlled airspace without permission will be ordered to stop flying and may also be fined up to 500 yuan. If the circumstances under this item are serious, the drone will be confiscated and a fine of 1,000 to 10,000 yuan will be imposed. Those who fly in violation of airspace management regulations and the circumstances are serious will be detained for 5 to 10 days. Official case: Li Moumou paid to break the height limit, flew the drone to nearly 3,000 meters to take pictures of clouds and published them, and was detained for 5 days. Zhang Moumou cracked height restrictions and no-fly zone restrictions for others more than 20 times and earned more than 15,000 yuan. He was convicted of providing programs and tools for intrusion and illegal control of computer information systems. Sentence of 6 months, suspended for 1 year, and fined (National, starting from January 2024)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: State Council, Central Military Commission (2023). Interim Regulations on the Management of Unmanned Aircraft Flights (National Order No. 761, 10, 19, 47, 51). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/content/202306/content_6888799.htm>; Standing Committee of the National People's Congress (2025). Public Security Management Punishment Law (revised in 2025, Article 46). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202506/t20250627_699863.shtml>; Hubei Provincial Public Security Department (2026). The Ministry of Public Security announced eight typical cases of illegal and criminal crackdowns on "black flying" of drones in accordance with the law (reprinted from People's Public Security News). <http://gat.hubei.gov.cn/bmdt/gayw/202602/t20260205_5870949.shtml>

Note: Micro and light UAVs do not need approval to fly in suitable airspace. Miniature fingertips weigh less than 0.25 kilograms. Flyable airspace is the place outside the controlled airspace, and most areas around airports, military facilities, and government agencies belong to controlled airspace. The original page of the Ministry of Public Security could not be opened when writing this section, so the reprint page of the Hubei Provincial Public Security Department is quoted.

items.title: Do not take secret photos of others, do not install cameras in rental houses, B&Bs, or hotel rooms
items.core: Those who secretly photograph, peep, or spread other people's privacy will be detained for not more than 5 days or fined not more than 1,000 yuan. If the circumstances are serious, they will be detained for 5 to 10 days. Those who use special secret photography equipment and cause serious consequences will be sentenced to less than 2 years. Two people installed equipment in three hotel rooms to take secret photos remotely and were sentenced to 1 year and 3 months and 1 year respectively. Photographing rooms where other people live is not allowed without permission.
body: Cost: No money or time. Do not secretly photograph others, and do not install cameras in rental houses, B&Bs, or hotel rooms.

Benefits: Anyone who peeps, secretly photographs, eavesdrops, or spreads other people's privacy will be detained for not more than 5 days, or fined not more than 1,000 yuan. For serious cases, the offender may be detained for 5 to 10 days and may be fined up to 1,000 yuan. Anyone who illegally uses special equipment for eavesdropping or photographing, causing serious consequences, shall be sentenced to less than 2 years. Special equipment for eavesdropping and photographing refers to equipment specially used for eavesdropping and photographing. Official case: Yan Mouping and Yan Moujian bought photo stealing equipment online and installed them in multiple rooms of three hotels to take remote photos. They were sentenced to 1 year and 3 months and 1 year respectively. Article 1033 of the Civil Code has another layer: Unless otherwise provided by law or with the express consent of the person, no one may "enter, photograph, or peek into other people's homes, hotel rooms and other private spaces", nor may they "film, peek at, eavesdrop on, or disclose other people's private activities" (National)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress Standing Committee (2025). Public Security Management Punishment Law (revised in 2025, Article 50). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202506/t20250627_699863.shtml>; National People's Congress (2020). Criminal Law (Amended in accordance with the Criminal Law Amendment (Eleven), Article 284). <https://jtgl.beijing.gov.cn/jgj/jgxx/flfg/fl/11033925/index.html>; Supreme People's Court (2024). Typical cases of illegal production, sale, use of eavesdropping and photographing equipment (Case 2). <https://www.court.gov.cn/shenpan/xiangqing/449581.html>; National People's Congress (2020). Civil Code (Articles 1032, 1033). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202006/t20200602_463888.shtml>

Note: Once the things secretly photographed are sold or disseminated, they will be treated as crimes such as producing and selling obscene materials for profit. In the same batch of cases, some were sentenced to 10 years. If you install surveillance cameras in your own home and only take pictures of your own home, everyone in your family will know about it. There is no prohibition in the regulations. This is based on the regulations. Photographing the rooms where tenants or tenants live, or filming other people’s private activities, is within the scope prohibited by the Civil Code.

items.title: You can play mahjong and poker, but you don’t need to tap, don’t act as a banker, don’t organize games to collect money, and don’t engage in online gambling.
items.core: Playing cards without trying to make money and with a small win or loss is not considered a gambling crime, and there is no penalty if the gambling capital does not meet the "larger" standard set by the local area. Anyone who provides conditions for gambling in order to make money, or participates in gambling or gambling with a large amount of money, shall be detained for not more than 5 days or fined not more than 1,000 yuan. Those who gather people to gamble in order to make money and make a living by gambling will be sentenced to less than 3 years, and those who open a casino will be sentenced to less than 5 years.
body: Cost: No money. Small amounts of entertainment among relatives and friends. Do not take commissions from the game, do not act as banker, and do not collect money from organizing games. It's hard not to take over when someone tries to make a move.

Income: Article 9 of the 2005 Interpretation of Gambling Criminal Cases between the Two Highs states that “entertainment activities with a small amount of financial gain or loss are not conducted for the purpose of profit” and “will not be punished as gambling.” Anyone who facilitates gambling in order to make money, or participates in gambling with large gambling capital, shall be detained for not more than 5 days, or fined not more than 1,000 yuan. How much is considered "large gambling capital" is determined by each locality. Serious cases may be detained for 10 to 15 days and fined 1,000 to 5,000 yuan. Those who gather people together to gamble in order to make money, or make a living by gambling, shall be sentenced to not more than 3 years and fined. Those who open casinos will be sentenced to less than 5 years and fined, and those who commit serious crimes will be sentenced to 5 to 10 years (national)
Level of Evidence: B

Source: National People's Congress Standing Committee (2025). Public Security Management Punishment Law (revised in 2025, Article 82). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202506/t20250627_699863.shtml>; National People's Congress (2020). Criminal Law (Amended in accordance with the Criminal Law Amendment (11), Article 303). <https://jtgl.beijing.gov.cn/jgj/jgxx/flfg/fl/11033925/index.html>; National People’s Congress Standing Committee (2020). Criminal Law Amendment (11) (Article 36, the prison term for opening a casino is increased to less than five years, and between five years and less than ten years). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/zdgz/202012/t20201227_503682.shtml>; Supreme People’s Court, Supreme People’s Procuratorate (2005). Interpretation on Several Issues Concerning the Specific Application of Law in Handling Criminal Cases of Gambling (Fa Interpretation [2005] No. 3, Article 9). <http://gongbao.court.gov.cn/Details/bbcd0735eb402996a074c3ca858898.html> (Official Gazette of the Supreme People's Court)

Note: There is no nationally unified figure for what constitutes "larger gambling capital". Each locality determines it by itself, so this is only rated B. Drawing commissions from the bureau and collecting bets on behalf of online gambling platforms, they are often regarded as operating a casino when handling cases. The relevant original text of the judicial interpretation has not been verified. No official case was found either.

Case: For the purpose of profit, Wang from Wenzhou, Zhejiang organized many people to gamble in the form of mahjong in his own chess and card room, and made a total of 12,000 yuan in profits. After receiving the call, the public security organs investigated and dealt with the case. Wang was criminally detained on suspicion of gathering people to gamble. Later, he was sentenced to 6 months in prison, suspended for 1 year, and fined for pleading guilty and returning illegal gains.

items.title: Do not eat game, buy or sell, do not keep protected animals as pets, and do not dig or trade wild orchids, thuja, or yews
items.core: If you eat nationally protected animals, your items will be confiscated and you will be fined 2 to 20 times the value. Those who buy, sell or transport precious and endangered animals will be sentenced to less than 5 years in prison, and in serious cases, 5 to 10 years. The sale and purchase of artificially bred pets with mature breeding technology and large-scale production is generally not considered a crime, except for those caught in the wild. Most of the wild orchids on the mountain are protected, and anyone who digs up three of them and wants to sell them will be sentenced to imprisonment.
body: Cost: No money. Only buy pets from legal sources and artificially bred species. I didn’t dig up the wild orchids I saw when I went up the mountain. I only bought orchids and yew potted plants grown artificially from flower market nurseries.

Benefit: If you eat a nationally protected wild animal, or buy it for the sake of eating, the food will be confiscated and you will be fined 2 to 20 times the value. Breeding wild animals under national key protection without a license will be confiscated and fined 1 to 10 times. Illegal acquisition, transportation, and sale of precious and endangered wild animals and their products under national key protection shall be sentenced to not more than 5 years and fined. In this case, serious cases will be sentenced to 5 to 10 years, and particularly serious cases will be sentenced to more than 10 years. Hunting, acquiring, transporting, and selling other terrestrial wild animals for food will be punished with a sentence of not more than 3 years in serious cases. Official case: Farmer Wang and three other people sold more than 40 artificially bred Fei's peony parrots (national second-level protected species) for a total price of less than 400 yuan. In 2021, the prosecutor's office decided not to prosecute. Starting from 2022, the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate have clarified that artificial breeding technology is mature and has reached a large scale, and those used for buying, selling and transporting pets will generally not be treated as crimes (nationwide). Wild plants have another crime. Illegal logging and destruction of nationally protected plants, or the acquisition, transportation, processing, and sale of these plants and products are all considered crimes. The sentence is not more than 3 years and a fine, and in serious cases the sentence is 3 to 7 years. The Supreme Court’s 2023 interpretation sets the threshold. One national first-level protected wild plant, two second-level protected wild plants, or a value of more than 20,000 yuan are enough to convict. Five first-level plants, 10 second-level plants, or a value of more than 200,000 yuan are considered serious cases. The person who buys it must know that it was obtained illegally. In the 2021 list, all species of Thuja and Taxus are Level 1. All species of the genus Orchid are second-grade, including spring orchid, cymbidium, and lotus petal orchid. Among the orchid genus, only the rabbit's ear orchid is not on the list, and the beautiful orchid and the Wenshan orchid are first-class. Digging it home and transplanting it is also considered illegal logging, and transplanting will be taken into consideration when sentencing. Artificially planted plants are not counted, except for ancient and valuable trees. Official case: A man from Nanzhao, Henan Province dug up three wild orchids on a hillside in 2022 and posted a video to sell them. He was sentenced to six months in prison, suspended for 10 months, and fined $3,000. A group of people in Suizhou, Hubei dug up more than 30,000 wild spring orchids and cymbidiums over two years. In 2025, one of them was sentenced to 1 year and 7 months, suspended for 2 years (nationwide)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress Standing Committee (2022). Wildlife Protection Law (revised in 2022, Articles 31, 51, and 53). <https://www.mee.gov.cn/ywgz/fgbz/fl/202302/t20230220_1016885.shtml> (Reprinted by the Ministry of Ecology and Environment); National People’s Congress (2020). Criminal Law (Amended in accordance with the Criminal Law Amendment (Eleven), Article 341). <https://jtgl.beijing.gov.cn/jgj/jgxx/flfg/fl/11033925/index.html>; National People’s Congress Standing Committee (2020). Criminal Law Amendment (11) (Article 41, i.e. Criminal Law 341, Paragraph 3). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/zdgz/202012/t20201227_503682.shtml>; Supreme People's Court, Supreme People's Procuratorate (2022). Interpretation of Several Issues Concerning the Application of Law in Handling Criminal Cases of Damage to Wildlife Resources (Fa Interpretation [2022] No. 12, Article 13). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/xwfbh/wsfbt/202204/t20220407_553506.shtml>; Supreme People’s Procuratorate (2023). Small parrot case and major people’s livelihood case. <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/zdgz/202302/t20230211_601023.shtml>; Supreme People's Procuratorate (2020). The "Two Highs" issued a reply clarifying the scope of precious trees or other plants under national key protection, and the understanding and application of illegal transplantation of plants under national key protection (including the original text and legal interpretation of Article 344 of the Criminal Law [2020] 2 Full text of the approval). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/xwfbh/wsfbt/202003/t20200320_456927.shtml>; Supreme People’s Court (2023). Interpretation of Several Issues Concerning the Application of Law in the Trial of Criminal Cases of Damage to Forest Resources (Fa Interpretation [2023] No. 8, Article 2). <https://www.court.gov.cn/zixun/xiangqing/408822.html>; National Forestry and Grassland Administration, Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs (2021). List of National Key Protected Wild Plants (Announcement No. 15 of 2021, Attachment). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2021-09/09/content_5636409.htm>; Procuratorate Daily (2023). Henan Nanzhao: Promote the establishment of a conservation mechanism for wild plants involved in the case. <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/dfjcdt/202307/t20230720_622083.shtml>; Procuratorate Daily (2025). Zengdu District, Suizhou, Hubei: Crack down on illegal digging and live broadcast of wild orchid grass sales. <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/zdgz/202505/t20250513_695459.shtml>

Note: "General crime of omission" only refers to the category of artificial breeding and keeping as pets. Those caught in the wild and of unknown origin are not applicable. Which animals are considered as national key protected animals shall be determined by the list. It's easier to check the catalog before buying than to have to explain things later. The same goes for plants, as long as they grow naturally in their native places. The bluegrass sold in the live broadcast room through "on-site mining" and "Xiashancao" is wild. Products such as Thuja root carvings and bracelets are also covered by this crime if they are knowingly bought and sold illegally.

items.title: If you want a debt, don’t detain or imprison them. If you don’t follow them to your home, you won’t let them go.
items.core: Even if the money is really owed to you, you can’t detain or imprison them: the law specifically states that doing so for the purpose of collecting debts will still be treated as illegal detention. Detention for 5 to 15 days if insufficient for sentencing and a fine. Those who constitute the crime of illegal detention will be sentenced to less than 3 years, those who seriously injure someone will be sentenced to 3 to 10 years, and those who kill someone will be sentenced to more than 10 years. Go to court to sue for debt.
body: Cost: No money. If the other party doesn't pay back the money they owe, go to court and sue. How to write an IOU, see Section 8, Article 18 (IOU). It's hard not to take action or follow the other party to his house when he refuses to pay.

Benefits: Those who illegally restrict other people's personal freedom, break into other people's homes without authorization, or illegally search other people's bodies will be detained for 10 to 15 days and fined 1,000 to 2,000 yuan. If the circumstances are less serious, they will be detained for 5 to 10 days and fined not more than 1,000 yuan. Illegal detention is punishable by imprisonment for up to three years, criminal detention (short-term detention), surveillance (no detention but restricted movement), or deprivation of political rights. Those who cause serious injuries will be sentenced to 3 to 10 years, and those who kill others will be sentenced to more than 10 years. Those who detain or imprison people in order to collect debts shall be punished according to the same set of regulations, even if the debt is real (nationwide)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress Standing Committee (2025). Public Security Management Punishment Law (revised in 2025, Article 47). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202506/t20250627_699863.shtml>; National People's Congress (2020). Criminal Law (Amended according to the Criminal Law Amendment (Eleven), Article 238). <https://jtgl.beijing.gov.cn/jgj/jgxx/flfg/fl/11033925/index.html>

Note: The sentence "He does owe me money" does not apply in this article. The law specifically states that detaining or imprisoning people for the purpose of collecting debts will be treated as illegal detention. There are several cases online in Chinese courts where people were imprisoned to collect legal debts and sentenced to 7 months to 1 year. The website was not open when this section was written, so there are no references.

Case: Due to a debt dispute between Hebei Zhang and Li, in order to force him to repay the money, he forcibly took Li to a rental house and kept him under guard for 20 hours. During this period, although he was verbally threatened, no beating was carried out. After Li's family reported the incident, the police rescued him. The court held that Zhang illegally detained others in order to obtain legal debts, which constituted the crime of illegal detention, and was sentenced to 8 months in prison.

items.title: Do not lend your ID card to others, do not use other people’s ID cards, and do not use other people’s ID cards to register, issue cards, or buy tickets
items.core: Lending, renting, or transferring your ID card to others will be warned and fined not more than 200 yuan. Anyone who uses someone else's ID card fraudulently, or obtains one through fraud, will be fined 200 to 1,000 yuan, or detained within 10 days. If you use fake IDs or steal other people's IDs when buying train tickets or staying in a hotel, where your real name is required, you will be sentenced to criminal detention or public surveillance if the circumstances are serious.
body: Cost: No money. If someone asks to borrow it, just refuse. If you want to give a copy, please indicate on the copy what the copy will only be used for.

Income: Anyone who rents, lends or transfers his or her resident ID card to others will be warned and fined not more than 200 yuan. Anyone who impersonates someone else's ID card, or uses an ID card obtained through fraud, will be fined 200 to 1,000 yuan, or detained for up to 10 days. Those who buy, sell, and use forged or altered ID cards are also in this category. In some cases, proof of identity is required according to national regulations. Those who forge, alter or steal other people's documents on these occasions will be sentenced if the circumstances are serious. Documents include ID card, passport, social security card, driver's license, etc. The penalty is criminal detention (short-term detention) or control (no detention but restricted movement), and a fine may be imposed concurrently or solely. The sentence may be accompanied by a fine, or it may only be a fine (nationwide)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress Standing Committee (2011). Resident Identity Card Law (amended in 2011, Articles 16 and 17). <https://jtgl.beijing.gov.cn/jgj/jgxx/flfg/fl/203777/index.html> (Reprinted by Beijing Municipal Public Security and Traffic Management Bureau); National People's Congress (2020). Criminal Law (Amended in accordance with the Criminal Law Amendment (Eleven), Article 280-1). <https://jtgl.beijing.gov.cn/jgj/jgxx/flfg/fl/11033925/index.html>; State Council (2002). Regulations on the Management of Internet Service Business Places (National Decree No. 363, Article 23). <http://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2002/content_61788.htm>

Note: If your ID card is borrowed, it may be used to register a company or apply for a bank card. The consequences of these two conditions are found in Section 8, Articles 28 and 8 (Do not act as a legal person in name and do not lend bank cards to others). Using someone else’s ID card to buy train tickets or stay in a hotel are “activities that require proof of identity” according to the law. No official case was found for this article. You can also use your own ID card to surf the Internet at an Internet cafe. Internet cafes must check registration ID cards, and keep registration contents and Internet access records for at least 60 days. The public security and cultural departments can make adjustments at any time. Whoever uses his or her ID card to access the Internet will be credited with what was done on the machine during that time.

Case: After Wang, a man from Jiangxi, picked up Chen’s ID card, he used his identity to check in at the hotel and apply for a mobile phone card for fraud. The public security organs followed the lead and arrested him. Wang was sentenced to administrative detention for 7 days and fined 500 yuan in accordance with the law for fraudulently using another person's ID card; his suspected fraud crime was dealt with in a separate case.

items.title: Cooperate when stopped or taken away by the police, do not push, hit, or grab the law enforcement recorder, and must endure even after drinking
items.core: If you obstruct law enforcement on the spot, you will be given a warning or a fine of not more than 500 yuan, and in serious cases, you will be detained for 5 to 10 days. Attacking the police is another level: biting, slapping, kicking, hugging, throwing things, causing minor injuries or more is considered a violent attack on the police, and the sentence is less than 3 years. Those who hit with a firearm, a controlled knife or a vehicle will be sentenced to 3 to 7 years. Ordinary resistance such as shaking hands or breaking away does not count.
body: Cost: No money. Don’t do anything on site. If you have any opinions, wait until later to raise them: make a complaint, apply for administrative reconsideration, or go to court to sue. It was difficult to hold back my temper during the few minutes I was stopped, especially when I was drunk.

Benefits: Anyone who obstructs state agency staff from performing their duties in accordance with the law shall be given a warning or fined not more than 500 yuan. In serious cases, the offender may be detained for 5 to 10 days and may be fined up to 1,000 yuan. If it is the people's police who obstruct, they will be severely punished. Violent attacks on people's police officers who are performing their duties in accordance with the law shall be sentenced to less than 3 years in prison. Those who seriously endanger the personal safety of police officers with guns, controlled knives or driving will be sentenced to 3 to 7 years. Bite, slap, kick, throw, and throw objects that cause more than minor injuries are considered "violent attacks." General resistance such as shaking hands, breaking free, and kicking legs does not count (nationwide)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress Standing Committee (2025). Public Security Administration Punishment Law (revised in 2025, Article 61). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202506/t20250627_699863.shtml>; National People's Congress Standing Committee (2020). Criminal Law Amendment (Eleven) (Article 31, i.e., Article 277, Paragraph 5 of the Criminal Law). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/zdgz/202012/t20201227_503682.shtml>; National People’s Congress (2020). Criminal Law (Amended in accordance with the Criminal Law Amendment (Eleven), Article 277). <https://jtgl.beijing.gov.cn/jgj/jgxx/flfg/fl/11033925/index.html>; Supreme People's Court, Supreme People's Procuratorate (2025). Interpretation on Several Issues Concerning the Application of Law in Handling Criminal Cases of Assault on Police (Gao Ji Fa Shi Zi [2025] No. 1, Articles 1, 8, and 12). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/xwfbh/wsfbt/202501/t20250116_679579.shtml>; Supreme People’s Procuratorate (2021). The crime of assaulting police officers was sentenced to one month in prison, and the procuratorate approved the arrest of 405 people. <https://www.spp.gov.cn/xwfbh/wsfbh/202105/t20210517_518308.shtml>

Note: The Supreme People’s Procuratorate reported in 2021 that in the first month after a separate conviction for assaulting a police officer, 405 people were arrested. Of the 42 cases in Jiangsu, 47.6% were caused by drunkenness and causing trouble. Twelve of the 16 cases in Hubei were just punching, kicking and biting. Attacking the auxiliary police officers will be treated as a crime of obstructing official duties. This article found no official case stating the circumstances of the individual case.

Case: When the traffic police in Nanjing, Jiangsu Province were investigating drunk driving, the driver Liu refused to cooperate with the breath test, pushed the traffic policeman and kicked over the law enforcement recorder, causing minor injuries to the policeman. The court sentenced Liu to 1 year in prison for violently attacking a police officer. In another case, Li only broke away from the police's control without causing any harm, and was fined 200 yuan for public security.

items.title: If the other party is under 14 years old, you cannot have sex. "She agrees" is not a reason
items.core: If the other party is under 14 years old, regardless of whether she agrees or not, he will be treated as a serious crime of rape. The basic sentence is 3 to 10 years. If the other party is under 12 years old, you will always be deemed to "should know". If someone is between 12 and 14 years old, it can be seen from her development, behavior, and clothing that she may be a young girl. If you still attack, it will be deemed that you are "knowingly". He said he really didn't know, and the court was very strict.
body: Cost: No money. If the age of the other party is uncertain, don’t have sex.

Benefits: Anyone who has sexual relations with a girl under the age of 14 will be treated as rape and severely punished, with a basic prison term of 3 to 10 years. The Supreme Court's stance is this: Anyone who uses force, coercion or other coercive means, regardless of whether they know the other person is a young girl, will be charged with rape. Without coercion, all persons under the age of 12 are deemed to "should know". Anyone between 12 and 14 years old, whose physical development, speech, behavior, clothing, etc. can tell that she is a young girl, and who still attacks the girl is deemed to be "knowingly". The exception of "really not aware" is strictly enforced (nationwide)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress (2020). Criminal Law (Amended in accordance with the Criminal Law Amendment (11), Article 236). <https://jtgl.beijing.gov.cn/jgj/jgxx/flfg/fl/11033925/index.html>; Supreme People's Court (2015). Reply on "Whether sexual relations with girls under the age of fourteen must be known to constitute a crime". <https://www.court.gov.cn/hudong/xiangqing/13363.html>

Note: The original text of the opinions of the two high-ranking authorities and the two ministries on handling criminal cases of sexual assault against minors, as well as the page of the Supreme People's Court's 2003 approval, could not be opened at the time of writing this section. Therefore, the standard for determining "knowingly" is based on the Supreme Court's online reply. The term in the law is "young girl".
