This article does not distinguish whether the person doing the violence is a man or a woman. How parents can teach their children to prevent sexual assault, see Section 30, Article 19 (Understanding the Private Parts of the Body).

Case: Xiaofang, a 13-year-old girl from Henan, met Zhao, a 21-year-old man, through the Internet. After the two met, Xiaofang made it clear that she was 13 years old, and Zhao still had a relationship with her. The court held that Zhao knew clearly that Xiaofang was under 14 years old. Even though the other party was "voluntary", it still constituted the crime of rape, and he was sentenced to 5 years in prison in accordance with the law.

items.title: Settling the account before beating someone: detention, compensation, and sentencing
items.core: Accounting for one attack: detention for 5 to 10 days, plus a fine of 500 to 1,000 yuan. Those with minor injuries are criminal cases with a sentence of less than 3 years, and those with serious injuries are sentenced to 3 to 10 years. Money is another factor: Someone broke three of the other party's ribs and settled for 113,000 yuan to avoid being sued. Another man broke the opponent's radius bone and was sentenced to 10 months without compensation.
body: Cost: No money or time. The hard part is those few seconds before taking action.

Benefits: Anyone who beats or intentionally injures someone will be detained for 5 to 10 days and fined 500 to 1,000 yuan. Anyone who gangs up to hit disabled, pregnant, elderly or children, beats them multiple times or beats several people at once will be detained for 10 to 15 days and fined 1,000 to 2,000 yuan. A minor injury is a crime of intentional injury, and the person is sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of less than 3 years, criminal detention (short-term detention), or control (not detained but with limited movement). Serious injuries result in a sentence of 3 to 10 years. Civil compensation is also required for medical expenses, lost wages (money earned from missing work), nursing expenses, transportation expenses, hospitalization food subsidies, and nutrition expenses. If someone is disabled, additional disability compensation will be paid. The calculation of disability compensation is based on the previous year's per capita disposable income of urban residents in the location of the court where the case is heard multiplied by 20 years. If the injured person is over 60 years old, one year will be deducted for each additional year, and if the injured person is over 75 years old, it will be calculated as 5 years. In 2022, procuratorial organs nationwide accepted more than 70,000 minor injury cases, most of which were caused by marital, family, neighborhood disputes or accidental incidents. Typical case from the Supreme People's Procuratorate: Lu broke three ribs of the other party (minor injury of the second degree) and paid 113,000 yuan to reach a settlement before being exempted from prosecution. Shi broke the opponent's radius bone (minor injury level 2), did not pay compensation, and was sentenced to ten months in prison (National, Public Security Management Punishment Law will take effect on January 1, 2026)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress Standing Committee (2025). Public Security Management Punishment Law (revised in 2025, 9th and 51st). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202506/t20250627_699863.shtml>; National People’s Congress (1997). Criminal Law (Article 234). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/201802/t20180206_364975.shtml>; Supreme People’s Court (Amended in 2022). Interpretation of Several Issues Concerning the Applicable Law in the Trial of Personal Injury Compensation Cases (Fa Interpretation [2022] No. 14, Articles 6 to 12 and 15). <https://www.court.gov.cn/zixun/xiangqing/357071.html>; Supreme People’s Procuratorate and Ministry of Public Security (2023). Guidance on properly handling minor injury cases in accordance with the law. <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/xwfbh/wsfbt/202303/t20230302_604352.shtml>; Supreme People’s Procuratorate (2023). Typical cases of procuratorial organs properly handling minor injury cases in accordance with the law. <https://www.spp.gov.cn/xwfbh/dxal/202303/t20230302_605116.shtml>

Remarks: How to avoid conflicts, why you suffer losses if you strike first, and where the boundaries of legitimate defense are, see Section 8, Article 10 (Conflict and legitimate defense). For accounts of attacking people in order to vent their anger, see Section 8, Items 12 to 14. For minor fights caused by civil disputes, the police can mediate. If the injury is minor, if you have negotiated compensation with the other party and actually compensated, you may be given a lighter sentence or even not sued, but the compensation will not be less. To what extent an injury is considered a minor injury is determined by appraisal standards and is not verified in this section. Lost work fees and nursing fees are calculated based on actual income and the number of days lost. There is no unified figure.

items.title: If a child cannot be raised after birth, there is only one legal way out: registration with the civil affairs department: collecting money to give the child to others may be charged with trafficking, while abandoning the child is considered a crime of abandonment.
items.core: There is a way out if the child cannot be raised, but there is only one legal one: go to the civil affairs department to apply for adoption registration. The adoption relationship is only established on the day of registration. Giving a child to someone else privately, especially for money, may turn the child into a crime of child trafficking, and the penalty is more than 5 years in prison. Abandoning a child and refusing to raise it, if the circumstances are serious, is the crime of abandonment, and the sentence is not more than 5 years.
body: Cost: No money. To apply for adoption registration at the civil affairs department at or above the county level, you need to submit documents and wait for review and adoption evaluation, which takes some time.

Profit: Article 240 of the Criminal Law: "Whoever abducts or traffics women or children shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than five years but not more than ten years, and shall also be fined." If there are aggravating circumstances, the offender shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than ten years or life imprisonment, and shall also be fined or have property confiscated. "If the circumstances are particularly serious, the death penalty will be imposed and property will be confiscated." Article 17 of the "Opinions on Punishing the Crime of Abducting and Trafficking in Women and Children According to the Law" talks about how to distinguish between selling one's own children and putting them up for adoption among the private sector. The judgment standard is "the key lies in whether the perpetrator has the purpose of illegal profit." That is to see if you want to make money from this. There are three situations that can be regarded as selling one's biological children and be convicted of abducting women and children. The first type is "those who use childbirth as an illegal means of profit and then sell their children after giving birth." The second type is "knowing that the other party does not have the purpose of raising children, or not considering whether the other party has the purpose of raising children at all, and "giving" the child to others in order to collect money." The third type is "giving" children to others in order to receive huge sums of money that are clearly not "nutrition fees" or "thank you fees." On the other hand, those who do not do it for the sake of making money, but are really forced to put up for adoption privately due to difficulties in life, and only receive a small amount of nutritional support as a thank you fee, are classified as private adoption and will not be convicted of trafficking. Let’s look at Article 261 of the Criminal Law again. "Anyone who refuses to provide support to an elderly, young, sick, or otherwise incapable of independent living who has the obligation to provide support, if the circumstances are serious, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than five years, criminal detention, or surveillance." Article 1094 of the Civil Code stipulates that there are only three types of people who can be adopted as foster parents: guardians of orphans, child welfare institutions, and biological parents who have special difficulties and are unable to raise their children. Article 1105: "Adoption shall be registered with the civil affairs department of the people's government at or above the county level. The adoption relationship is established from the date of registration"
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress (1997). Criminal Law (Articles 240, 261). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/201802/t20180206_364975.shtml>; Supreme People’s Court, Supreme People’s Procuratorate, Ministry of Public Security, Ministry of Justice (2010). Opinions on Punishing the Crime of Abducting and Trafficking of Women and Children in accordance with the Law (Fafa [2010] No. 7, Article 17). Official website of the Supreme People’s Court <https://www.court.gov.cn/fabu/xiangqing/977.html>; National People’s Congress (2020). Civil Code (Articles 1,094, 1,105). Full text of the adoption section reproduced by the Yancheng City People’s Government <https://xxgk.yczf.gov.cn/xzf/ycmzj/fdzdgknr/fgwj_41995/202112/t20211203_1506640.shtml>

Note: I won’t talk about whether I want to be born here or not. After the baby is born, follow this order to save trouble. The first step is to go to the hospital to give birth. See Section 27 for prenatal check-up and hospital delivery. A medical certificate of birth is a prerequisite for all subsequent procedures. The second step is to go directly to the civil affairs department at or above the county level if you want to place your child for adoption, do not go through an intermediary. Once money passes through hands, its nature may change. Within one year after giving birth, if you have "thoughts of harming yourself or your child", it will be treated as an emergency. For a list of hospital visits during pregnancy and immediately after delivery, see Section 27, Item 7. The 42-day postpartum review is also a postpartum depression screening, see Section 27, Item 16. If you are having suicidal thoughts call 12356, see Section 1 No. 25. There is no accompanying case for this article: official typical cases of abduction and trafficking of biological children. There is no case-by-case verification in this round, so only the article and the original text of the opinion are quoted.

items.title: Don’t fabricate accidents and exaggerate losses to defraud claims: This is a crime of insurance fraud. Those who testify for you, help you repair your car, and help you appraise the car are counted together
items.core: Fabricating accidents and exaggerating losses to defraud claims is a crime of insurance fraud. For larger amounts, the sentence is not more than 5 years, and a further fine of 10,000 to 100,000 yuan. The person who helped you testify, appraise, and evaluate your property deliberately produced false certificates and was convicted as an accomplice with you. The car repairman who has made an agreement with you to commit fraud together will be counted as a joint offender. In a case in Xuancheng, Anhui, eight people were sentenced to 2 to 4 years and fined 10,000 yuan each.
body: Cost: No money, no time, just don’t do it.

Income: Article 198 of the Criminal Law lists five situations. (1) The policyholder deliberately fabricates the subject of insurance and makes up an insurance object that does not exist at all. (2) The policy holder, the insured or the beneficiary fabricates false reasons for the insured accident, or exaggerates the extent of the loss. (3) Fabricating insurance accidents that have never occurred. (4) Insurance accidents in which property losses are intentionally caused by the policy holder or the insured. (5) The policy holder or beneficiary intentionally causes the death, disability or illness of the insured. If the amount is relatively large, the person shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than 5 years or criminal detention, and shall also be fined not less than 10,000 yuan but not more than 100,000 yuan. If the amount is huge or there are other serious circumstances, the penalty will be 5 to 10 years and a fine of 20,000 to 200,000 yuan. If the amount is particularly huge or there are other particularly serious circumstances, the penalty shall be not less than 10 years and a fine of 20,000 to 200,000 yuan or property confiscated. The last paragraph of this article deals with the people who help: appraisers, certifiers, and property appraisers of insurance accidents. If they deliberately issue false certification documents and create conditions for others to defraud insurance, they will be treated as accomplices in insurance fraud and will be convicted together with the person who defrauded insurance. The person who repairs the car is not one of these three types of people, but he has agreed with you to make counterfeit goods together, and he will be treated as a joint crime. Article 25 of the Criminal Law: "Joint crime refers to a deliberate crime committed by two or more people together." The Beijing Changping Court reported in 2021 that the motor vehicle insurance fraud cases concluded since 2019 "are dominated by joint crimes, and auto repair shops are the key industry for committing crimes." Article 27 of the Insurance Law: If an insured accident does not occur but falsely claims to have occurred, the insurance company has the right to terminate the contract without refunding the premium. If forged or altered certification materials are used, or false accident causes are fabricated, or the extent of losses is exaggerated, the insurance company will not compensate for the overstated portion. Those already compensated must be returned or compensated. Case: In the Zhang Mousong case in Xuancheng, Anhui, eight people including Wang Mouxin were sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment ranging from 4 to 2 years for insurance fraud, and were all fined 10,000 yuan. This case involves a false lawsuit. The insurance company assessed a loss of 20,000 yuan, and the party relied on a forged vehicle transfer agreement to obtain the right to file a lawsuit. The court awarded compensation of more than 70,000 yuan. This civil judgment, which had already taken effect, was revoked after retrial on September 26, 2019. The "Anti-Insurance Fraud Work Measures" require that both parties selling insurance policies and making payments (underwriting and claims settlement) must verify risk information. We should also explore the establishment of a multi-insurance industry anti-fraud information platform and anti-fraud intelligence center. These platforms centrally screen data suspected of fraud, and clues are submitted to industry associations, anti-fraud organizations and insurance agencies for verification. If you are suspected of committing a crime, report it to the public security organ in a timely manner. The State Administration of Financial Supervision and its dispatched agencies must establish and improve the connection mechanism between administrative law enforcement and criminal justice. The objects of connection are the public security organs, people's procuratorates, and people's courts (nationwide, issued on July 31, 2024)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Standing Committee of the National People's Congress. Article 198 of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China (consolidated text as amended by the Eleventh Amendment to the Criminal Law). <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=ff808181796a636a0179822a19640c92>; National People's Congress (1997). Criminal Law (Article 25, this article has not been modified by the amendment). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/201802/t20180206_364975.shtml>; Beijing Changping District People’s Court (2021-11-23). Changping Court reports on motor vehicle insurance fraud crimes (Beijing Court Network). <https://bjgy.bjcourt.gov.cn/article/detail/2021/11/id/6385519.shtml>; National People’s Congress Standing Committee (2015 revision). Article 27 of the Insurance Law of the People’s Republic of China. <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=2c909fdd678bf17901678bf7c4060811>; State Financial Supervision and Administration Bureau (2024). Notice on the issuance of the "Anti-Insurance Fraud Work Measures". <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/2024/issue_11586/202409/content_6975080.html>; The Anhui Provincial People’s Procuratorate reprinted the "Legal Daily" (2020-01-13). The case of killing his wife and cheating on her insurance was found. <http://www.ah.jcy.gov.cn/jczt/jjslhyqkjc/mtjj/202001/t20200113_2758841.shtml>

Note: The following practices that are thought to be harmless are all included in these five items. If you have a minor accident, go to the repair shop to "report a little more" and include the old injuries and damages into this time. If you have a collision with a friend and then report it, you will make up a story when there is no accident. How to buy car insurance, see Section 5, Article 26 (enough to buy all three insurances). If someone intentionally causes the death of a family member after insuring him or her, the law clearly states that he will be punished for several crimes. See Section 8, Article 38 (Insuring a Family Member). Medical insurance is another set of rules. Using a medical insurance card to buy health care products and cash out is insurance fraud, see the notes in Section 5, Article 13

items.title: Don’t sell your own organs, and don’t help others find donors: If you get a kidney for more than 20,000 yuan, and sell the same one for 200,000 yuan, the money will be confiscated and you will be fined 10 to 20 times the transaction amount.
items.core: Living organs can only be donated to spouses, direct blood relatives, or collateral blood relatives within three generations, and buying and selling them is illegal. In a case in Beijing, a person who sold a kidney only received more than 20,000 yuan, while the same kidney was sold to a patient for 180,000 to 220,000 yuan. The money sold will be confiscated, and a fine of 10 to 20 times the transaction amount will be imposed. The cost to the body after kidney removal is shown in Section 1, Item 35 (the remaining kidney does the work of two others).
body: Cost: No money, no time, just don’t do it.

Income: Article 5 of the "Regulations on Human Organ Donation and Transplantation": "No organization or individual may buy or sell human organs in any form, or engage in activities related to the buying and selling of human organs." Article 10: "No organization or individual may obtain living organs from citizens under the age of 18 for transplantation." Article 11: “Recipients of living organs are limited to the living organ donor’s spouse, direct blood relatives, or collateral blood relatives within three generations.” Article 37 stipulates the penalties for buying and selling human organs. Anyone who buys or sells human organs or engages in activities related to the sale of human organs shall be investigated and dealt with by the health department of the local people's government at or above the county level. Confiscate the illegal gains first and take away all the money from this transaction. The fine will be between 10 times and 20 times the transaction amount. If medical personnel participate, their practicing certificates will be revoked and they will be banned from engaging in medical and health services for life. If a crime is constituted, criminal liability will be pursued in accordance with the law (nationwide, effective from May 1, 2024, and the original "Regulations on Human Organ Transplantation" will be abolished at the same time). Article 234-1 of the Criminal Law: "Whoever organizes others to sell human organs shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than five years and shall also be fined; if the circumstances are serious, he shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than five years and shall be fined or his property shall be confiscated." There are three other situations, which are subject to conviction and punishment in accordance with Articles 234 and 232 of the Criminal Law. One is to remove his organs without his consent. The second is to remove organs from people under the age of 18. The third is forcing or deceiving others to donate organs. These types of crimes are treated as intentional injury and intentional homicide. Case 1: The case of Zheng Wei and 15 others was finalized by the Beijing No. 1 Intermediate People’s Court on August 20, 2014, involving 51 kidneys and a total amount of more than 10.34 million yuan. People who sell kidneys (donors) "only receive a reward ranging from 20,000 to 25,000 yuan." The price offered by the patient (recipient) who was waiting for a kidney "used to be 180,000 or 190,000 for a kidney, but later it was 210,000 or 220,000." The kidney removal site is a four-story building rented for 7,500 yuan per month. The head nurse of the gang confessed that the place was "dirty and messy, and there was no rescue equipment." Organizer Zheng Wei was sentenced to 12 years in prison for organizing the sale of human organs, and the remaining 14 people were sentenced to three and a half to nine years. Case 2: The case of "teenager selling kidney to buy iPhone" announced by the Supreme People's Procuratorate. 17-year-old Wang had his right kidney removed on the evening of April 28, 2011 in Chenzhou. The venue for the operation was provided by a contracted department in a hospital without transplant qualifications. When he was discharged from the hospital on May 2, he received 22,000 yuan. The recipient paid the agency 150,000 yuan and 10,000 US dollars, and the principal criminal made a profit of more than 56,000 yuan. Wang's postoperative renal insufficiency, "the injury constitutes serious injury and third-level disability"
Level of Evidence: A

Source: State Council (2023). Regulations on Human Organ Donation and Transplantation (State Council Order No. 767, Articles 5, 8, 10, 11, 23, 28, 29, and 37). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202312/content_6920196.htm>; Standing Committee of the National People's Congress. Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China (Consolidated text as amended by the Eleventh Amendment to the Criminal Law) Article 234-1. <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=ff808181796a636a0179822a19640c92>; Supreme People’s Procuratorate (2012-04-09). The case of “a teenager selling his kidney to buy an iPhone” was brought to court. <https://www.spp.gov.cn/gs/201204/t20120409_34342.shtml>; Reprinted on the official website of the Intermediate People’s Court of Langfang City, Hebei Province (2014-09-02). The final trial of the largest kidney trafficking case in the country. The organizer harvested 51 kidneys and made tens of millions of profits. <https://lfzy.hebeicourt.gov.cn/article/detail/2014/09/id/1430881.shtml>

Note: The beneficiary is yourself. On the surface, this transaction is "a one-time payment of 20,000 yuan", but in reality it is an organ in exchange for a mobile phone. The conclusion of the evaluation of the case of the boy selling his kidney was that he was seriously injured and had a third-degree disability, and he would not be able to recover after several months of rest. In that case, the prosecutor determined that the five defendants violated paragraph 2 of Article 234 of the Criminal Law and charged them with intentional injury. One of the reasons is that the medical staff cut out the right kidney without verifying whether the "donor" was a minor before the operation. The same thing happened again today, and the person responsible for the murder would be charged with selling human organs by an organization. Harvesting organs from persons under the age of 18 will still be convicted and punished as intentional injury in accordance with Article 234. The surgeries performed by rogue agencies are performed in rented houses or borrowed venues. The kidney removal site in the Beijing case did not even have rescue equipment. Legal living donations are made by hospitals with transplant qualifications and must first be reviewed by the hospital ethics committee. The doctor must explain the risks before surgery and sign an informed consent form, and the hospital must follow up after surgery (Articles 23, 28, and 29 of the Regulations). Black intermediaries have bypassed all these, and it is difficult to find someone to take responsibility if complications occur. This sentence is recommended by the author according to the regulations. If you really want to donate to your relatives, take the 11th path. According to Article 8 of the regulations, donation is voluntary and free of charge. Posthumous organ donation is free of charge and is not within the scope of this article. What price the body has to pay after removing one kidney, see Section 1, Item 35 (the remaining kidney does the work of two). When you are short of money and consider selling your organs, first look at the relief channels in Section 7 (unemployment insurance, temporary assistance, subsistence allowances). For the pitfalls of online loans and “packaging materials” loans, see Article 6 of this section.

Case: Beijing Chaoyang police once busted an illegal organ transplant intermediary gang. The donor received only 21,000 yuan from selling the kidney, and the intermediary charged the recipient 220,000 yuan. The court sentenced the principal to nine years in prison for organizing the sale of human organs, confiscated all illegal gains, and imposed a fine of 10 times the transaction amount; the donors were also held accountable for participating in the sale.

items.title: Don’t visit prostitutes: The default setting is to be detained for 10 to 15 days, not a fine.
items.core: If you are caught, you are not fined. The default sentence written in the law is detention for 10 to 15 days, and a further fine of up to 5,000 yuan can be imposed. Only if the circumstances are less serious, the offender will be detained for not more than 5 days or fined not more than 1,000 yuan. In addition, knowing that you have syphilis or gonorrhea and still going to prostitutes is a crime and you will be sentenced to less than 5 years in prison.
body: Cost: No money, no time, just don’t do it.

Income: Article 78 of the "Public Security Administration Punishment Law": Those who engage in prostitution or whoring shall be detained for not less than ten days but not more than fifteen days, and may be fined not more than five thousand yuan. If the circumstances are relatively minor, the offender shall be detained for not more than five days or fined not more than 1,000 yuan. Anyone soliciting prostitution in public places shall be detained for not more than five days or fined not more than 1,000 yuan. Article 79: Anyone who induces, harbors or introduces others to prostitution shall be detained for not less than ten days but not more than fifteen days, and may also be fined not more than five thousand yuan. If the circumstances are relatively minor, the offender shall be detained for not more than five days or fined not less than 1,000 yuan but not more than 2,000 yuan. Article 87: Personnel in the hotel industry, catering service industry, cultural entertainment industry, taxi industry and other units who tip off illegal and criminal perpetrators when the public security organs investigate and deal with prostitution and whoring activities, or provide conditions for the above-mentioned activities in other ways, shall be detained for not less than ten days but not more than fifteen days. Article 360 of the "Criminal Law" is the crime of spreading sexually transmitted diseases: Anyone who knowingly suffers from syphilis, gonorrhea or other serious venereal diseases who engages in prostitution or whoring shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than five years, criminal detention or surveillance, and shall also be fined (Nationally, the Public Security Management Punishment Law will take effect on January 1, 2026)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress Standing Committee (2025). Public Security Management Punishment Law (2025) Article 360 of the Criminal Law of the People's Republic of China (Consolidated text as amended by the Eleventh Amendment to the Criminal Law). <https://jtgl.beijing.gov.cn/jgj/jgxx/flfg/fl/11033925/index.html> (Reprinted by Beijing Municipal Public Security and Traffic Management Bureau); National People’s Congress Standing Committee (2015). Criminal Law Amendment (9) (Article 43, delete the second paragraph of Article 360 of the Criminal Law). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/201802/t20180205_364562.shtml>

Note: The detention here is administrative detention. People have to enter the detention center, not just leave after being punished. Those who introduce others and provide venues for others will be punished as severely as those who engage in prostitution themselves. This is what Article 79 deals with. People who work in hotels or KTVs and inform guests will also be detained for 10 to 15 days in accordance with Article 87. Article 360 ​​of the Criminal Law originally included a second paragraph, "the crime of soliciting underage girls," but it was deleted in the 2015 Criminal Law Amendment (9). Now this kind of thing is directly classified as rape and punished severely, see Article 18 of this section (the other party cannot have sex if the other party is under 14 years old). Signs such as "home health care" and "massage" do not change their nature and are determined based on what actually happened. For the risk of contracting STDs and HIV, see Section 1, Item 30 (Use a condom at all times during sex) and Section 13, Item 38 (Get your blocker medicine within 72 hours). See Section 22 for the entertainment venues themselves.

Case: Beijing police captured illegal persons Sun and Wang who were trading in a hotel in Dongcheng District. Although the two claimed to be "just friends," the evidence at the scene was conclusive. Because there was no evidence that they knew they were ill, the two were each sentenced to administrative detention for 12 days and fined 3,000 yuan in accordance with Article 66 of the Public Security Administration Punishment Law.

items.title: Chinese comics, moving movies and TV series, sharing network disk resources and pirated e-books without charging money are also infringements; hanging advertisements and charging membership fees may lead to a prison sentence
items.core: If someone else's work is translated and posted without permission, or posted online, it is also infringement without charging money. You will have to delete it and pay compensation. Just posting ads and collecting membership fees is just to make money. Earning 30,000 yuan, spreading to 500 channels, or having 1,000 members are enough to be sentenced, with the maximum sentence being 10 years. The boss of the Renren Film and Television subtitle group was sentenced to 3 years and 6 months.
body: Cost: No money. If you buy or download it, you can read it or flip through it yourself, but don't upload it online for everyone to see. We do not create resource sites or resource groups with advertisements or membership fees, nor do we sell network disk links. It’s hard not to be a porter when “everyone is spreading the word.”

Income: Let’s talk about civil affairs first. Among the rights granted to authors by copyright law is the right of translation, which is the right to transform a work from one language into another. There is also the right to information network dissemination, which is the right to put works online so that the public can see them anytime and anywhere. Translating someone else's work without permission is an infringement. Posting works online without permission is also an infringement. Those who infringe must stop infringement and compensate for losses. Only for personal study, research or appreciation, if you use other people's published works, you do not need permission or payment. The amount of compensation is calculated based on the actual loss of the right holder or the money you earn. If the calculation is unclear, the court will set the amount between 500 yuan and 5 million yuan. For intentional infringement and serious circumstances, the penalty may be 1 to 5 times. You will also be required to compensate for the reasonable expenses incurred by the rights holder to stop the infringement. Let’s talk about criminal matters. The premise of Article 217 of the Criminal Law is "for profit." In order to make money, putting other people's works online for public viewing without permission is considered a crime of copyright infringement. The sentence shall be not more than 3 years and a fine, or only a fine. If the amount is huge or the circumstances are particularly serious, the offender shall be sentenced to 3 to 10 years in prison and fined. What counts as making money: In addition to selling, posting paid advertisements on web pages counts, and using membership systems to collect registration fees or other fees also counts. The service fees, membership fees, and advertising fees collected are all illegal gains. The threshold for a crime is as follows. The illegal income is more than 30,000 yuan. The illegal business amount was more than 50,000 yuan. In the case of Renren Film and Television, the total income from membership fees, advertising fees and hard drive sales was calculated. Distribute more than 500 pieces (parts) of other people's works in total online. Downloaded more than 10,000 times, or clicked more than 100,000 times. Use the membership system to spread the word, with more than 1,000 registered members. Not all of the items are there, but there are two items that are more than halfway there, so that counts. If you reach 10 times these numbers, you will enter the 3 to 10 years bracket. Fines generally range from 1 to 10 times the illegal proceeds. Official Case 1: Liang Yongping and others downloaded unauthorized movies and TV series from overseas websites, organized people to translate them, subtitle them and then uploaded them. These films are placed on the "Renren Film and Television Subtitle Group" website and client for people to watch and download online. There are 32,824 unauthorized film and television works on the website, with more than 6.83 million members. From January 2018 to January 2021, it collected more than 2.7 million yuan in membership fees and more than 8.8 million yuan in advertising fees. I earned more than 1 million yuan by selling mobile hard drives with copies of movies and TV series. There is a "donation" QR code on the website, and you can get membership benefits by donating. The procuratorial organ determined that this was just collecting membership fees under a different name. On November 22, 2021, Liang Yongping was sentenced to 3 years and 6 months and fined 1.5 million yuan. The other 14 people were sentenced to one year, six months to three years, all suspended, and fined between 40,000 and 350,000 yuan. Official Case 2: Ke Moumou used crawler software to grab the broadcast addresses of more than 50,000 movies and TV series, and put them on his website and app for people to watch for free. He placed ads in the open screen position and collected money based on the impressions, earning more than 350,000 yuan. In 2023, he was sentenced to 3 years, suspended for 4 years, and fined 400,000 yuan. Official case three: Huang rented a server at his home and set up a music download forum. He uploaded more than 100,000 songs to 18 network drives and posted links on the forum. Members must recharge to exchange forum coins to get links and withdrawal codes. Members have recharged a total of more than 500,000 yuan. In 2023, he was sentenced to 3 years, suspended for 4 years, and fined 550,000 yuan (national, judicial interpretation effective April 26, 2025)
Level of Evidence: A

Note: The beneficiary is yourself. Buy and read it yourself, and read it yourself, within the scope allowed by the law. The line is "put it online for everyone to see." The subtitle group and the Chinese translation group do not charge money, which does not constitute the crime of copyright infringement, because this crime requires making money. However, civil infringement is still established, and the rights holder can request deletion or compensation. Not accepting money can be illegal in Japan. In February 2018, several Chinese citizens in Japan were arrested on suspicion of violating Japanese copyright laws. The Chinese Consulate General in Nagasaki later reminded: Translating, publishing, and disseminating works without authorization may be illegal even if it is not for profit. As soon as you put up advertisements, open memberships, and exchange "donations" for membership rights, you fall into the category of making money. In the Renren Film and Television case, the participation of people who only did translation and proofreading was low, and the police collected evidence based on witnesses. The Supreme People's Procuratorate stated in this case that those who started, distributed the money, and managed the platform must be strictly investigated. Accomplices who are hired to work can be given leniency, and those who are hired temporarily and the circumstances are minor may not be held criminally responsible. The old 2004, 2007, and 2020 intellectual property criminal judicial interpretations will be abolished as of April 26, 2025. The opinions of the three departments in 2011 have not been repealed by name. If there is any inconsistency with the new interpretation, the new interpretation shall prevail. For example, the click threshold was changed from 50,000 to 100,000. For another risk when writing fan fiction or making secondary creations for publication, see Article 25 of this section (Writing Fan Fiction). For selling other people’s pictures on goods, see Section 12, Article 21 (authorization is required for purchasing the pictures). What to do if you build your own platform and receive an infringement notice from the rights holder, see Section 26, Article 9 (Receiving an Infringement Notice). Making and selling crack patches and keygen machines, see Section 11, Article 20 (Crack Patches and Keygen Machines).

Case: In the "Renren Film and Television Subtitle Group" case, Liang Yongping organized the translation and dissemination of a large number of overseas film and television works without the rights holder's permission, and illegally made more than 1.6 million yuan through website advertising and membership fees. The court sentenced him to 3 years and 6 months in prison for copyright infringement, fined him 1.5 million yuan, and recovered all illegal gains.

items.title: When writing a fanfic or making a second creation to publish or sell for money, first obtain permission from the original work, or replace the borrowed character's name and relationship with your own.
items.core: Even if a fan only borrows a character's name, personality, and relationship, publishing it may still lead to infringement. Jiangnan's "The Boy Here" borrowed more than 60 characters from Jin Yong. In the second trial, he paid 1.68 million yuan plus 200,000 yuan in expenses, which he has already paid. The lawsuit lasted for nine years and was finally settled, with both verdicts no longer valid. How to count fans who write and play for free? The court said it needs to be analyzed in detail.
body: Cost: Nothing. Before publishing or selling the work for money, first negotiate with the rights holder of the original work for authorization. If we can't talk it over, we just replace the borrowed characters' names, personalities, and relationships with our own. Don’t use the name of the original work in the book title, subtitle and slogan.

Profit: Jiang Nan's novel "The Boy Here" uses the names of characters from Jin Yong's novels such as Guo Jing, Huang Rong, Qiao Feng, and Linghu Chong. The book tells the stories of these people on the university campus. When it was published in 2002, the subtitle was "The Condor Hero's College Career." By the time of the indictment, the book had gone through multiple editions and millions of copies. Jin Yong sued Jiangnan and the publisher in 2016, claiming 5 million yuan. The first instance held that it did not constitute copyright infringement. The reason is: apart from the specific plot, the names, relationships and personalities of the characters alone can hardly be regarded as protected specific expressions. However, the first instance found that Jiangnan used the fame of the original work to attract readers, which constituted unfair competition. Based on 30% of the historical royalties of 5.6 million yuan, the award was 1.68 million yuan, plus attorney fees of 200,000 yuan. The second instance was heard by the Guangzhou Intellectual Property Court, and the verdict was changed to constitute copyright infringement. The second review held that the plots of the two books were not substantially similar, that is, the plots were not copied. But the names, personalities, relationships and backgrounds of the "character group portrait" of more than 60 characters were all Jin Yong's choices and arrangements. This is an expression protected by copyright law, and Jiangnan has infringed upon the copyright of Jin Yong's four novels. The subtitle is deliberately linked to "The Legend of the Condor Heroes" and constitutes unfair competition. In the second trial, Jiangnan ordered the company to stop unfair competition, publish it in newspapers to eliminate the impact, and compensated 1.68 million yuan and reasonable expenses of 200,000 yuan. The two publishing and distribution companies are jointly and severally liable for 330,000 yuan, which means they have to compensate for this part together. The second instance did not rule to stop the infringement, but required future republications and 30% of the reprint royalties to be paid to the original copyright holder. After the second trial, both parties applied to the Guangdong Provincial Higher People's Court for a retrial. On September 19, 2025, the parties reached a settlement under the auspices of the Guangdong High Court. In the settlement, all parties agreed not to characterize the matter as "plagiarism." Jiang Nan admitted that he lacked knowledge of copyright law when creating and did not obtain Jin Yong's permission for adaptation in advance, which caused damage to Jin Yong. Jiangnan agreed not to republish the book in its original form. In future editions, original character names and related content from Jin Yong’s works will no longer be used. The parties confirmed that that subtitle constituted unfair competition. Jiangnan has already paid the compensation for the second trial. After the mediation letter is signed and received, the original first-instance and second-instance judgments will no longer have legal effect. The defendant in another case is Zhang Muye, the author of "Ghost Blowing the Lamp", whose pen name is Tian Xia Ba Chang. In 2006, he transferred all the property rights in the copyright of this novel to Shanghai Xuanting Entertainment Information Technology Co., Ltd. Later, he authorized the publication of a new book "Captain Touching the Gold", which used the names, relationships and tomb robbing rules of the characters in "Ghost Blowing the Lamp". The cover of the new book uses the movie poster of "The Secret of the Dragon", which is adapted from "Ghost Blowing the Lamp". Xuanting Company sued, claiming 20 million yuan. The Shanghai Pudong Court held that the new book has its own independent plot and does not constitute copyright infringement. However, the cover made readers mistakenly believe that this book was related to the original book "The Secret of the Dragon", which constituted false propaganda. The court ordered the two publishing and distribution companies to pay compensation of 900,000 yuan, of which the publishing house was jointly and severally liable for 600,000 yuan. The second instance upheld the verdict. Legally speaking, the right to adapt is the right to change a work and create an original new work. Anyone who uses a work through adaptation, translation, annotation, etc. without the permission of the copyright owner shall bear civil liability such as cessation of infringement and compensation for losses (nationwide)
Level of Evidence: B

Source: Guangzhou Intellectual Property Court (2023). What is the profound meaning of Jin Yong v. Jiangnan "The First Case of Fan Works" (reprinted from the first issue of "Legal and News" in July 2023). <https://www.gipc.gov.cn/front/content.action?id=7b7cb9a7b2cc45f286199fd427fc6b1f>; Guangdong Provincial Higher People's Court (2025). The copyright and unfair competition dispute case "Jin Yong v. Jiangnan" reached a settlement in Guangdong. <https://www.gdcourts.gov.cn/xwzx/fayuanxinmeiti/content/post_1843458.html>; National Copyright Administration (2020). 2019 The top ten typical copyright cases in Shanghai of the year are released (released by the Shanghai Copyright Bureau, Case 6: "Ghost Blowing the Lamp" Copyright Infringement and Unfair Competition Dispute Case). <https://www.ncac.gov.cn/xxfb/ywxx/202004/t20200430_47269.html>; National People's Congress Standing Committee (2020). Copyright Law (2020) Year revised, Article 3, Article 10, Paragraph 1, Item 14, Article 52, Item 6, Article 54). <http://www.npc.gov.cn/npc/c2/c30834/202011/t20201119_308796.html>

Note: The beneficiary is yourself. It’s rated B because the legal boundaries of doujinshi have not yet been determined. The two trials of this case came to different conclusions, and the case was finally settled through mediation, with both judgments no longer taking effect. When answering questions, the judge handling the matter from the Guangdong High Court said that the settlement agreement only binds the parties involved in this case. Whether a fan infringes an infringement or not "requires a detailed analysis of the specific circumstances and cannot be generalized." The order of judgment given by the judge is three steps. Let’s first look at whether the two works have the same abstract ideas or concrete expressions. Then look at whether these expressions are original to the original author. Finally, check whether it falls under fair use and non-infringement situations. Therefore, the risks of borrowing only one theme and setting are different from borrowing the names, personalities and relationships of characters in a complete set. Fans posted on the Internet for free, this book did not find any official case where the court made a ruling. There is no exception in copyright law that says “if you don’t charge money, it’s not an infringement.” The cost of the process needs to be taken into account: this case lasted 9 years from the prosecution in July 2016 to the settlement in September 2025. After the first trial, second trial and retrial review, Jin Yong himself died during the second trial. After the original author sells the copyright, he may still be sued by the buyer if he writes a sequel, as was the case with Tianxia Ba Sing. In a copyright lawsuit, the winning party’s reasonable expenses to stop the infringement can be counted as compensation. In this case, the 200,000 yuan spent on the first trial was attorney’s fees. For the risks of Chineseizing, porting, and sharing other people’s works, please see Article 24 of this section (Chinese comics, porting of movies and TV series).

Case: A writer used the names and relationships of characters in many of Jin Yong's works when he wrote novels and published and sold them. Jin Yong sued for infringement, and the court ordered compensation for economic losses and expenses. The lawsuit lasted nine years.

items.title: Don’t buy sticks, stun guns, daggers, and pepper spray to carry with you for self-defense. Putting them in the car counts as carrying them.
items.core: If controlled knives such as daggers and switchblade knives are found out of the house, they can be detained for up to 5 days. Take them into stations, shopping malls, buses, and detain them for 5 to 10 days. Police batons are only allowed to be held by police officers. Those held by individuals will be confiscated and may be detained. It is also easy to suffer losses if you really use it: someone was punched with his bare hands, and he stabbed him with a knife that was hidden in advance. He was sentenced to 4 years for being defensive.
body: Cost: Nothing. If you have already bought it, keep it at home and do not take it out or put it in the car. If you really encounter trouble, first retreat and call the police. If you can't hide, then fight back.

Benefits: Let’s first look at Article 38 of the Public Security Administration Punishment Law. Those who illegally carry crossbows, daggers and other state-regulated instruments shall be detained for not more than 5 days and may be fined not more than 1,000 yuan. If the circumstances are relatively minor, a warning or a fine of not more than 500 yuan may be imposed. Those who bring it into public places or public transportation will be detained for 5 to 10 days and may be fined up to 1,000 yuan. Article 130 of the Criminal Law is even more severe. Those who illegally carry controlled knives into public places or public transportation, endangering public safety, and the circumstances are serious, shall be sentenced to less than 3 years. Which knives are considered controlled knives? The Ministry of Public Security’s 2007 identification standards list five categories. The first type is a dagger: it has a handle, a blade grid and a blood groove, and the blade tip angle is less than 60 degrees. The second type is the triangular scraper. The third category is a spring knife with a self-locking device, commonly known as a spring knife. The fourth category is knives with a tip angle of less than 60 degrees and a blade length of more than 150 mm. The fifth category is knives with a tip angle greater than 60 degrees and a blade length exceeding 220 mm. Unedged martial arts and craft gift knives with rounded tips do not count. The baton is the police weapon. The People's Police Law stipulates that police weapons are only allowed to be possessed and used by police officers. If held by others, it will be confiscated, detained for not more than 15 days, or given a warning, and may be fined not more than 5 times the illegal income. The railway's banned list lists batons, tear gas, electric shock devices, and protective equipment as controlled devices. These items are not allowed to be carried with you when taking the train, nor are they allowed to be checked in. The forbidden list of road passenger transport also lists tear gas and electric shock devices as controlled devices, and they are not allowed to be carried on long-distance buses. Whether you can hold an electric shock device on a daily basis is a case announced by the Shanghai Procuratorate in 2013. Four people who sold stun devices to drivers at intersections were sentenced to prison terms ranging from one year to three months to six months for illegally buying and selling police equipment. The procuratorate cited two notices from the Ministry of Public Security. According to these two notices, "This type of electric shock device is a nationally controlled device and is also a type of police equipment." The procuratorate also stated that this type of electric shock device "is a prohibited item in the country, and individuals are prohibited from producing, selling and possessing it." The prosecutor also said that self-defense items such as high-concentration sprays are police equipment and cannot be purchased by ordinary citizens. They will be investigated if they are left in the car: someone driving through a checkpoint with a controlled knife will be seized by the police and administratively detained. For accounts that are really used, please refer to the guidance on self-defense. It lists "whether a murder weapon is used or prepared to use" as one of the circumstances that distinguishes defense from fighting. Official case: Yang had a quarrel with someone, and the other party threatened to seek revenge. He went home and hid two knives on his body. The other person came back and punched him in the face with his bare hands. He stabbed the other person in the chest and abdomen with a knife, and the other person died. The court found that he was defensive, but the other party only hit with bare hands. He stabbed the vital part, which was an excessive defense. He was sentenced to 4 years for intentional injury (National Public Security Management Punishment Law will come into effect on January 1, 2026)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress Standing Committee (2025). Regulations on the Use of Police Equipment and Weapons by the People's Police (Article 3). <http://jyglj.guizhou.gov.cn/szs/zwgk/xxgkml/zcwj/201808/t20180807_25452524.html> (Reprinted by Guizhou Provincial Prison Administration Bureau); National Railway Administration, Ministry of Public Security (2022). Announcement on the release of the "Catalogue of Prohibited, Restricted Carrying and Checked Items for Railway Passengers" (No. 1, 2022). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2022-05/31/content_5693212.htm>; Ministry of Transport and Ministry of Public Security (2021). Announcement on the publication of the "Catalogue of Prohibited, Restricted Carrying and Consignment of Items on Road Passenger Vehicles" (Transportation Regulations [2021] No. 2). <https://xxgk.mot.gov.cn/2020/xzgfxwj/202212/t20221207_3720480.html>; Shanghai People’s Procuratorate (2013). Four men were sentenced to prison for illegally selling stun devices. <https://www.sh.jcy.gov.cn/xwdt/yasf/4372.jhtml>; Jinjiang Municipal People’s Government (2022). Police Alert! Carrying these items may result in arrest! . <https://www.jinjiang.gov.cn/ztzl/jjgazl/jfts/202209/t20220913_2775463.htm>; Supreme People’s Court, Supreme People’s Procuratorate, Ministry of Public Security (2020). Guidance on the application of the legitimate defense system in accordance with the law (Fafa [2020] No. 31, Article 9). <https://www.court.gov.cn/zixun/xiangqing/251611.html>; Supreme People's Court (2020). Typical cases involving legitimate defense (Case 4). <https://www.court.gov.cn/zixun/xiangqing/251621.html>; Supreme People's Procuratorate (2018). Twelfth Batch of Guiding Cases (Procuratorate No. 45 Chen's Justifiable Defense Case). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/jczdal/201812/t20181219_402920.shtml>

Note: The beneficiary is yourself. If you bring a knife, self-defense does not automatically fail. In Case No. 45, student Chen was surrounded by nine people and took out a fruit knife to fight back. This was still considered self-defense. The procuratorate stated that what affects the determination is not whether or not they brought tools, but whether they had the intention to fight each other. The disadvantage falls in two places. First, the thing itself is illegal and will be punished if found. It has nothing to do with whether it is used or not. Secondly, if the knife is at hand, it can be easily stabbed out in the face of a punch or push. If the injury is serious or more, it may become an over-defense. The original text of the nationwide ban on stun devices and pepper spray has not been found. The original texts of the two notices issued by the Ministry of Public Security are mentioned in this book only in the cases of the Shanghai Municipal Procuratorate. Individuals are not allowed to possess electric shock devices. This is supported by this Procuratorate case. For pepper spray, only "high-concentration sprays" cannot be purchased according to the prosecutor. Whether the low-concentration pepper spray on the market counts, this book did not find a unified identification. You cannot take it with you on trains or long-distance buses. Whether the sticks sold online are considered police batons, this book has not found the original text of the national unified identification. "Putting it in the car counts as carrying it." The only cases found in this book were controlled knives in the car. If you really encounter trouble, read Section 8 and Article 10 first (if there is a conflict, call the police first but don’t take action). When there is no way to retreat, see Section 8, Article 11 (You can fight back against an insurmountable violation). Being cornered in the wilderness and asking for money, see Section 13, Article 36 (Being asked for money by strangers in the wilderness).

items.title: When fishing, no nets are set during closed fishing periods and areas, no fish are electrocuted, poisoned, or fried at any time, and there is no need to ban fishing gear.
items.core: Electrofishing, poisoning fish, or exploding fish in prohibited fishing areas or during prohibited fishing periods in inland waters are sufficient to meet the threshold for illegal fishing of aquatic products, with a maximum sentence of three years. Only if the beatings are small and the harm is obviously minor, prosecution may not be pursued. There is also a fine for electrofishing, usually less than 200,000 yuan, and you can also be fined for taking electrofishing tools into the water. Someone on the Yangtze River made a profit of 9,000 yuan by electrofishing and was sentenced to one year in prison.
body: Cost: Nothing. Before going into the water, check the no-fishing areas, no-fishing seasons and no-fishing areas announced by the local agriculture and rural departments. I don’t buy tools like electric fish machines and I don’t bring them to the water. If you want to fish, go to waters where fishing is allowed, or go to fishing grounds or fish ponds. The difficulty lies in not being able to resist following the example of others who have gained so much from electrofishing.

Profit: Article 340 of the Criminal Law: Anyone who catches aquatic products in a prohibited fishing area or season, or uses prohibited tools or methods, if the circumstances are serious, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than 3 years, criminal detention, control, or a fine. The 2022 judicial interpretations of the two top authorities clarified what constitutes "serious circumstances" in inland waters. One of the following categories is sufficient. Illegal fishing in inland waters of more than 500 kilograms or with a value of more than 10,000 yuan. Catching more than 50 kilograms or worth more than 1,000 yuan in an aquatic germplasm reserve. In prohibited fishing areas, methods such as electrofishing, poisoning fish, and fish frying are used to catch fish. Use this method to fish during closed fishing seasons. The same article also leaves a loophole: if the harm is determined to be obviously minor based on the quantity, value and tools used, prosecution may not be prosecuted or criminal punishment may be waived. Looking at the Fisheries Law again, it will be revised in 2025 and will come into effect on May 1, 2026. It prohibits fishing in violation of the regulations of closed fishing areas and closed fishing seasons, as well as fishing in violation of regulations. It prohibits fishing by means of bombing, poisoning, and electric fishing, as well as entering fishing waters with such devices. Fishing with prohibited fishing gear and nets with meshes smaller than the minimum size is also prohibited. The penalties are as follows: Those who electrocute fish, poison fish, or explode fish will have their tools, catches, and illegal income confiscated, and be fined not more than 200,000 yuan. In serious cases, fines range from RMB 200,000 to RMB 2 million. If you only bring electric fishing tools into fishing waters, the tools will be confiscated and you may be fined up to 100,000 yuan. Anyone who fishes in violation of the regulations of prohibited fishing areas or fishing seasons, or uses prohibited fishing gear, shall be fined not more than 200,000 yuan. Anyone who illegally fishes in a prohibited fishing area or during a prohibited fishing period will have their catch, illegal income and fishing gear confiscated, and may be fined up to 50,000 yuan. There is another layer to the Yangtze River: the Yangtze River Protection Law stipulates that productive fishing of natural fishery resources is completely prohibited in key water areas such as the main stream, important tributaries, and large river-connecting lakes. The ten-year fishing ban in the Yangtze River begins on January 1, 2021. Those who fish in prohibited waters will have their catch, illegal income, and fishing boats and fishing gear confiscated, and be fined RMB 10,000 to RMB 50,000. Those who use electric fish, poison fish, or fry fish will be fined 50,000 to 500,000 yuan. Official case: Li Xugen knew clearly that Jiajiang, the Yangtze River section of the Yangtze River, was a no-fishing zone, and drove a speedboat to use an inverter to electric fish. From January 2018 to April 2019, he electrofished more than 60 times and caught more than 900 kilograms of wild fish and sold them, making a profit of 9,000 yuan. He surrendered, returned his illegal gains, and released the first batch of fish fry. He was still sentenced to one year in prison for illegal fishing of aquatic products. According to the settlement agreement, he also had to publicly apologize in the provincial media and release fish fry worth 25,000 yuan and 22,500 yuan in two batches. In another Supreme Court guiding case, eight people used wire nets and homemade electric nets to fish thirty or forty times in the East Dongting Lake no-fishing zone. Their sentences ranged from 3 months of probation to 1 year and 1 month in prison. All illegal profits of 100,000 yuan will be recovered (National Fisheries Law will come into effect on May 1, 2026)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress (1997). Criminal Law (Article 340, this article has not been modified by the amendment). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/201802/t20180206_364975.shtml>; Supreme People's Court, Supreme People's Procuratorate (2022). Interpretation of Several Issues Concerning the Application of Laws in Handling Criminal Cases of Damage to Wildlife Resources (Fa Interpretation [2022] No. 12, Articles 3 and 9). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/xwfbh/wsfbt/202204/t20220407_553506.shtml>; National People’s Congress Standing Committee (revised in 2025). Fisheries Law (Articles 32, 44, 45, 77, 78). <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=e29e88f12bc041d48b8b9086c4a4ece7>; National People’s Congress Standing Committee (2020). Yangtze River Protection Law (Articles 53, 86). <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=ff80808175265dd40176a89126662863>; General Office of the State Council (2024). Opinions on Unswervingly Promoting the Ten-Year Ban on Fishing in the Yangtze River (Guobanfa [2024] No. 12). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202403/content_6940788.htm>; General Office of the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs (2024). Opinions on further strengthening the management of fishing in prohibited waters in the Yangtze River Basin (Agricultural Ban Changyu [2024] No. 5). <https://cjyzbgs.moa.gov.cn/tzgg/202412/t20241231_6468771.htm>; Supreme People's Court (2021). Typical cases of judicial protection of the ecological environment in the Yangtze River Basin (Case 1). <https://www.court.gov.cn/zixun/xiangqing/287891.html>; Supreme People's Court (2023). Guiding Case No. 213: Civil public interest litigation incidental to the crime of illegal fishing of aquatic products by eight persons including Huang Mouhui and Chen. <https://www.court.gov.cn/shenpan/xiangqing/418242.html>

Note: The beneficiary is yourself. The Fisheries Law states that sporadic fishing by individuals for entertainment is not considered a fishing operation and does not require a fishing license. However, fishing gear is still confiscated and fined when fishing in prohibited areas or during closed periods. There are no unified figures across the country as to whether fishing can be done in the Yangtze River's prohibited waters and how many poles and hooks one person can use. The 2024 opinions of the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs only require each locality to make its own regulations and designate no-fishing areas. Fishing is not allowed in the core areas of protected areas and important habitats for aquatic life. There are also nationwide restrictions on where you can fish in the prohibited waters of the Yangtze River: fish detectors and underwater cameras are not allowed, toxic baits and nest materials are not allowed, and fish caught are not allowed to be sold. Fishing methods such as "explosive hooks" and "string hooks" have been named and targeted. If you catch an obviously excessive amount of fish and sell it for money, you may be investigated as illegal fishing. So before you go, check the website or notice board of the local agricultural and rural department. The above criminal threshold only applies to inland waters, and there is another set of standards for the sea. Anyone who knowingly purchases or sells illegally caught fish will be treated as a crime of covering up or concealing criminal proceeds. Catching aquatic animals under national key protection will result in heavier penalties, see Article 14 of this section (do not eat wild game, do not buy or sell protected animals).

items.title: Do not light fires in forest areas and grasslands when visiting graves, burning wasteland, or having picnics, and start fires when seeing mountain fires 12119 or 119
items.core: If you light a fire in a fire prevention zone during the fire prevention period, you will be fined 300 to 5,000 yuan if it does not burn. Burning 2 hectares of forested land is enough to be prosecuted for fire, with a sentence of 3 to 7 years. If the circumstances are less serious, the sentence is less than 3 years. Someone went to a grave to burn paper and set fire to 39 hectares. He was sentenced to 1 year of probation and 2 years of probation. He also had to plant 32 hectares of forest back.
body: Cost: Nothing. Visiting graves was changed to offering flowers, weeding, and planting flowers, and paper money, incense candles, and firecrackers were no longer lit on the mountain. Do not set fire to weeds and straw in the ground. Bring food for picnics that don’t require an open flame, and bring cigarette butts down the mountain. The problem is that the elderly at home feel that visiting a grave without burning paper does not count.

Benefits: The forest and grassland fire prevention regulations will take effect on January 1, 2026, and the original forest fire prevention regulations and grassland fire prevention regulations will be abolished at the same time. Article 27 of the regulations: During the fire prevention period, it is prohibited to use fire outdoors in the fire prevention zone, and no one is allowed to discard fire in the fire prevention zone. In the event of high temperatures, drought, or strong winds, local governments may order a ban on all wild fires. Article 54: Anyone who uses fire outdoors in the fire prevention zone without approval during the fire prevention period shall be ordered to stop. The fine for individuals is 300 to 5,000 yuan, and the fine for units is 20,000 to 100,000 yuan. Article 34: Anyone who discovers a fire in a forest or grassland should call the police immediately. The Ministry of Emergency Management states that the national forest fire alarm number is 12119. If it is burned and meets the criteria for filing a case, it is a criminal case. Paragraph 2 of Article 115 of the Criminal Law is the crime of fire: if a fire is caused by negligence, the person shall be sentenced to 3 to 7 years. If the circumstances are less serious, he shall be sentenced to less than 3 years or criminal detention. Among the criteria for filing a case, there is one item directly related to wildfires. If the burned forest land reaches 2 hectares, or the sparse forest land, shrub land, immature forest land, or nursery land reaches 4 hectares, a case must be filed. One person died, three were seriously injured, a direct loss of 500,000 yuan, and 10 houses were burned down, which was enough to open a case. In a Xinhua News Agency article reprinted by the State Forestry and Grassland Administration, experts said that man-made causes such as sacrifices and agricultural fires accounted for more than 90% of the causes of fires. In historical data, the use of fire in sacrifices ranks first. Official Case 1: Xie Moujun visited graves and burned paper money in the Qilian Mountain National Nature Reserve in February 2021, igniting weeds and shrubs. The burned area was 39.2156 hectares, mostly natural shrub land. After the fire broke out, he called the police, put out the fire together, and voluntarily surrendered, which is regarded as surrender. He also replanted 9,420 Qinghai spruce trees elsewhere. Even so, he was sentenced to 1 year in prison, suspended for 2 years, for the fire. The court also ordered him to afforestation 32.05 hectares in three phases, and if he couldn't finish the work, he would pay according to the assessed amount. Official Case 2: Wang participated in folk activities in May 2022 and used a lighter to light "mulberry" supplies for sacrifices. He covered the fire with stones and left without confirming that it was extinguished. The fire ignited dry grass and burned 121.69 acres, causing a loss of approximately 469,000 yuan (accurate value: 468,578 yuan). He was sentenced to nine months in prison, suspended for one year and six months. He has to replant according to the plan, and if he cannot finish it, he will bear the restoration cost of 986,700 yuan (nationwide, the regulations will come into effect on January 1, 2026)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: State Council (2025). Forest and grassland fire prevention regulations (State Council Order No. 822, Articles 25, 27, 30, 34, 54, and 63). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202511/content_7049205.htm>; National People’s Congress (1997). Criminal Law (Article 115, paragraph 2, this paragraph has not been modified by the amendment). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/201802/t20180206_364975.shtml>; Supreme People’s Procuratorate, Ministry of Public Security (2008). Provisions on the standards for filing and prosecution of criminal cases under the jurisdiction of public security organs (1) (Article 1). <http://www.dongyang.gov.cn/art/2021/9/23/art_1229565353_59487311.html> (Reprinted by Dongyang Municipal People’s Government); Ministry of Emergency Management (2019). Little knowledge about forest fires. <https://www.mem.gov.cn/kp/zrzh/201904/t20190401_366181.shtml>; Emergency Management Department (2026-04-04). Heilongjiang Fire Rescue Mobile Corps launches special fire prevention operations during Qingming Festival. <https://www.mem.gov.cn/xw/jyll/202604/t20260404_599136.shtml>; Reprinted by the State Forestry and Grassland Administration from Xinhua News Agency (2025-03-26). How to prevent forest fires and how to escape and avoid dangers. Experts provide advice. <https://www.forestry.gov.cn/c/www/zhzs/616962.jhtml>; Supreme People's Court (2025). A typical case of the People's Court protecting the ecological environment of a nature reserve mainly composed of national parks (Case 4). <https://www.court.gov.cn/zixun/xiangqing/452491.html>; Supreme People's Court (2023). Typical case of ecological protection of the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau (Case 2). <https://www.court.gov.cn/zixun/xiangqing/398782.html>

Remarks: The beneficiary is yourself. Fire prevention zones and fire prevention periods are delineated and announced by local governments at or above the county level. They vary from place to place. Check the local announcement before going up the mountain. The Ministry of Emergency Management states that Tomb-Sweeping Day is a period with high incidence and high incidence of forest fires. Fines only apply to fire prevention periods and fire prevention zones. The crime of fire does not depend on these, as long as it accidentally burns and meets the criteria for filing a case, it will be considered. In both cases, probation was obtained after surrendering or taking the initiative to put out fires and replant seeds. The cost of repairing the forest is separate and may be much more than the fine. When calling the police, tell them clearly which county, township, village, which mountain they are in, how big the fire is, and then leave your phone number. You can also call 119. What is written in Xie Moujun’s case is that he took the initiative to call the fire rescue number after the fire. The fines quoted in many articles online are from two fire prevention regulations in 2008, which have been abolished as of 2026. When the fire is big, don't attack it by yourself. Hide in an open area without vegetation, a burned place or by a stream. Don't run with the wind.

Case: During the fire prevention period, villagers went to graves and burned paper in the forest area. Sparks ignited the forest and burned more than 30 hectares of forest land. They were sentenced to probation for the crime of fire and were required to replant trees to restore the ecology.

items.title: When taking public exams, postgraduate exams, driving license exams and vocational qualification exams, do not take the exam for others, do not find someone to take the exam for you, do not buy or sell answers, and do not help others organize cheating
items.core: It is a crime to find someone to take the exam for you or to take the exam for others. You may be sentenced to criminal detention and fined, and those who become civil servants by taking exams for others will be expelled from their jobs. Organizing cheating and selling answers, the maximum sentence is 7 years. The driver's license test also counts, and a driving school owner was sentenced to prison for organizing students to cheat. Those who do not commit a crime will have their scores invalidated and may be suspended or unable to take the exam again within a year.
body: Cost: No money. Don't believe in "guaranteed classes", "VIP channels" and groups that sell answers. Things that can send and receive information, such as mobile phones and headphones, are not allowed into the examination room. If you haven't passed the exam, prepare more. The difficulty is that when you are only a few minutes away from landing, someone offers you a price that will guarantee your survival.

Income: Article 284-1 of the Criminal Law governs four types of conduct, provided that it is "a national examination prescribed by law." Anyone who organizes cheating shall be sentenced to not more than three years or short-term imprisonment, and shall also or solely be fined. In serious cases, the sentence is 3 to 7 years. Providing cheating equipment or other assistance to the organizers will be judged in the same category. Selling answers and giving answers for cheating are also judged in the same category. Taking exams for others or asking others to take exams for oneself is a crime of substitute examination and shall be punished with criminal detention or public surveillance, and may also be punished with a fine. Which exams count? See the 2019 judicial interpretation of the two high schools. The college entrance examination, postgraduate entrance examination, self-study examination, adult college entrance examination, and central and local civil service examinations are counted. Qualification exams such as legal professional qualifications, teacher qualifications, certified public accountants, physician qualifications, and construction engineers also count. The Supreme Court 2024 stated that the driving license test also falls into this category. Organizing cheating in college entrance examinations, postgraduate entrance examinations, and kilometer examinations is directly regarded as "serious circumstances." Organizing more than 30 people or having illegal income of more than 300,000 yuan will also be counted. If a person is seized before the exam begins but has already obtained the answers to the test questions, the crime will still be considered a completed crime. Selling's incomplete and incomplete answers will not affect the conviction. If the circumstances of taking a substitute exam are relatively minor, a suspended sentence may be given, and if the circumstances are minor, the person may not be prosecuted. According to statistics from the Supreme Court, from November 2015 to April 2024, 11,146 people were sentenced for these three crimes. Those who have not committed a crime will be dealt with according to the rules of various examinations. Those who use equipment to receive answers and find someone to take the exam for them in the national education exam will have their scores invalid and may be suspended from taking the exam for 1 to 3 years. Those who take part in organized cheating during the civil service examination will be disqualified from the examination and will be recorded in the integrity files and long-term records. Those who are already employed will be dismissed or fired if found out. Anyone who cheats on the driver's license test will be disqualified from taking the test, the subjects that have been tested will be invalid, a fine of not more than 2,000 yuan will be imposed, and the driver will not be able to apply for a driver's license again within one year. If you take the driver's license test for someone else, your own driver's license will be canceled and you will not be able to apply for it again within 3 years. Official Case 1: Zhang Moujie’s gang used composite photos and fake ID cards to let “gunmen” take civil service and other national examinations for candidates 89 times. The three principal offenders were sentenced to 5 years to 5 years and 6 months. The 18 candidates who found the gunman were sentenced to 2 to 4 months in prison and fined 30,000 to 100,000 yuan for taking a substitute exam. People who became civil servants through substitute examinations were dismissed from their posts. Official case two: The owner of a driving school organized students to cheat in the driving test from 2017 to 2023. Methods include changing the test system data, asking coaches to take the exam for you, and giving students remote prompts using headphones. The boss was sentenced to 6 years and 6 months for bribery, and the remaining 23 people were sentenced to 6 months to 1 year and 10 months (nationwide)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Standing Committee of the National People's Congress (2015). Criminal Law Amendment (9) (Article 25, i.e., Article 284-1 of the Criminal Law). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/201802/t20180205_364562.shtml>; Supreme People’s Court, Supreme People’s Procuratorate (2019). Interpretation of several issues concerning the application of law in handling criminal cases such as cheating in organized examinations (Fa Interpretation [2019] No. 13, Articles 1, 2, 4, 5, 6, 7, 10, and 11). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/xwfbh/wsfbh/201909/t20190903_430901.shtml>; Supreme People's Court (2024). The Supreme People's Court issued typical cases of punishing organized examination cheating crimes in accordance with the law (Case 3, 4, and 5). <https://www.court.gov.cn/zixun/xiangqing/434401.html>; Ministry of Education (2012).
