Decision on amending the "Measures for Handling Violations of National Education Examination Violations" (Ministry of Education Order No. 33, Articles 9 and 12). <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2012/content_2169156.htm>; Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security (2016). Measures for handling violations of disciplines and violations in civil servant examination and recruitment (Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security Order No. 30, Articles 7, 8, and 15). <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2017/content_5208205.htm>; Ministry of Public Security (2025). Regulations on the application and use of motor vehicle driving licenses (Ministry of Public Security Order No. 172 revised and re-announced, Articles 15, 79, and 93). <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/2025/issue_11866/202502/content_7004031.html>

Note: The beneficiary is yourself. Simply peeking by yourself and listening to the answers with headphones is not classified as a crime in the law and will be handled according to the above examination rules. But if you transfer the purchased answers to your classmates, it becomes illegal to provide test questions and answers. In the second-level construction engineer's leaked question case, the answers were resold by candidates one after another, and someone posted them to a QQ group with more than 1,700 people. If a current student takes the exam or finds someone to take the exam for him, the examination agency will notify the school, and the school can expel the student. Unit recruitment and school final exams are not included in the "national examinations", but using eavesdropping equipment or creating a group to send cheating information can still be punished as other crimes. The person who made a fake ID card for the gunman in the first official case was sentenced to 3 years for forging identity documents. Regarding certificates, see Article 16 of this section (ID cards cannot be borrowed from others). Pay an intermediary to evaluate your professional title. See Section 23, Item 22 (Don’t hire an intermediary to evaluate your job title).

Case: When a candidate took the professional qualification examination, he asked someone to take the exam for him. Both parties were caught. The substitute and the person taking the exam were both sentenced to detention and fined. The person who was taken the exam also had his acquired professional qualifications revoked.

sections.title: Is it worthwhile to fall in love and get married?

items.title: Get to know more people instead of just one person: Whether two people are compatible or not cannot be predicted before meeting each other
items.core: Two speed dating studies asked people to fill out more than 100 mate selection questionnaires before meeting. The questionnaire can only calculate who is generally easy to like others and who is generally popular, but it cannot calculate whether the two people call each other. You won't know whether you're compatible until you meet each other, so you need to meet a few more people.
body: Cost: No money. Spend your time getting to know more people, don't dwell on the same person over and over again. It's hard not to fight to the death.

Benefits: In two speed-dating studies, participants filled out more than 100 self-report questionnaires (questionnaires in which they rate themselves) related to mate selection before meeting. The researchers used the random forest model (an algorithm for finding patterns) to calculate. These questionnaires can account for 4%–18% of the variance in calculating how likely a person is to like other people overall. Variance is the difference between people, and questionnaires can only account for a small part of it. It can also calculate “how popular a person is overall”, which can explain 7%–27%. But it cannot be calculated "whether there is a phone call between these two specific people", nor can it be calculated regardless of the combination of characteristics and preferences before the meeting. The same researchers conducted an earlier speed-dating experiment. Participants reported their ideal preferences before the meeting, such as whether they valued appearance or economic prospects. This preference does not predict their interest in a specific person in the field
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Joel S, Eastwick PW, Finkel EJ (2017). Is romantic desire predictable? Machine learning applied to initial romantic attraction. Psychological Science, 28(10), 1478-1489. revisited: do people know what they initially desire in a romantic partner? Journal of Personality and Social Psychology, 94(2), 245-264. <https://doi.org/10.1037/0022-3514.94.2.245>

Note: The two studies only stated that "you can't figure it out before you meet", but they didn't say "no matter how hard you try, it's useless." You can only know if you're compatible or not by meeting each other, so it's more cost-effective to spend your time getting to know a few more people and actually meet each one than to bet all on one person. The research subjects are all European and American college students. The marriage and love environment in China is different, so if you apply it to yourself, you have to give a discount

Case: In two lightning dating experiments, researchers asked participants to fill in a mate selection questionnaire containing more than 100 indicators in advance. The results showed that the questionnaire could only predict "who is generally popular" and "who is easy to like", but it could not accurately predict whether any two people would call each other. Many people who think they have "clear criteria" completely change their minds after meeting real people.

items.title: Stop after the other party clearly refuses. Continuing to pester is a security violation and is not "sincerity."
items.core: If the other party clearly refuses, but you repeatedly send messages and wait for someone, which interferes with the other party's normal life, it will be a security violation starting from January 2026. They may be detained for up to 5 days or fined up to 1,000 yuan. Detention for 5 to 10 days in more serious cases. The police can also order you to be prohibited from contacting the other party, and you will be detained for another 5 to 10 days if you violate it.
body: Cost: No money or time. It’s hard to hold back: stop sending messages, stop waiting for people.

Benefits: The Public Security Management Punishment Law, which will be implemented on January 1, 2026, lists pestering and following as separate items. The article reads: "Repeatedly sending obscene, insulting, threatening and other messages or using methods such as nuisance, pestering, stalking, etc. to interfere with the normal life of others." Such behavior shall be punishable by detention for not more than five days or a fine of not more than 1,000 yuan. If the circumstances are serious, the offender shall be detained for not less than five days but not more than ten days, and may also be fined not more than one thousand yuan. There is one more layer to this: with the approval of the person in charge of the public security organ, the perpetrator can be ordered to prohibit contact with the victim within a certain period of time. Anyone who violates the prohibition of contact shall be detained for not less than five days but not more than ten days.
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Standing Committee of the National People's Congress (2025 revision). Public Security Management Punishment Law (Article 50, Paragraph 1, Item 5, Paragraph 2, Article 136). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202506/t20250627_699863.shtml> (Reprinted by the Supreme People's Procuratorate)

Note: There is no research to support "will chasing the other party to the end", but the detention and no-contact orders are written in black and white. Such illegal records must be sealed and not provided or disclosed to general units and individuals, but relevant units may inquire according to national regulations. What the law looks at is whether you have repeatedly harassed, pestered, stalked, and interfered with the other person's normal life. It doesn't depend on what you think. The situation where the other party has made it clear that rejection continues is the most likely situation to be considered interference. This sentence is the author’s judgment.

Case: After the man was explicitly rejected by the woman, he still continued to send messages and wait at work to pester, interfering with the other party's normal life. The public security agency decided to impose a penalty of five days of administrative detention on him in accordance with the law.

items.title: To determine whether the other party is interested, look more at behavior than just "signals": who takes the initiative, who arranges, and who follows up
items.core: Strange men and women chat for about ten minutes before judging each other. The judgment of "the other person is not flirting" is relatively accurate, but it is difficult to tell whether the "other person is flirting". So don’t draw conclusions based on expressions and tone of voice in one chat. Those who are more fond of a person will take the initiative to send messages and make appointments later, but this relationship is weak.
body: Cost: It costs nothing and doesn’t take much time. The hard part is changing your habits: stop pondering the other person’s expressions and tone of voice, and instead record the facts.

Benefits: Two studies measured how accurately people recognized flirting. The first involved 52 pairs of opposite-sex strangers talking to each other for 10 to 12 minutes. After the conversation, each person reported whether they were flirting and whether they thought the other person was flirting. The result was that "interactions where flirting did not occur were judged more accurately, while interactions where flirting occurred were judged more poorly." The second item used 26 one-minute videos to judge by 261 bystanders, and the conclusions were consistent. People can more reliably tell "the other person is not flirting", but it is difficult to tell "the other person is flirting". The third study looked at behavior. It combines three speed dates for a total of 559 people, over 6600 dates, and follow-up. The more special a person's favorable impression of a certain person is when they meet, the more likely they will message or ask that person out later. The average correlation coefficient for this type of correlation is about 0.15 (weak correlation). This shows that interest will fall into actions such as proactive contact and appointments. However, this study did not use behavior, expression, or tone to compare who is more accurate.
Level of Evidence: B

Source: Hall JA, Xing C, Brooks S (2015). Accurately detecting flirting: error management theory, the traditional sexual script, and flirting base rate. Communication Research, 42(7), 939-958. <https://doi.org/10.1177/0093650214534972>; Perilloux C, Kurzban R (2015). Do men overperceive women's sexual interest? Psychological Science, 26(1), 70-77. <https://doi.org/10.1177/0956797614555727> (disputing party); Baxter A, Maxwell JA, Bales KL, Finkel EJ, Impett EA, Eastwick PW (2022). Initial impressions of compatibility and mate value predict later dating and romantic interest. PNAS, 119(45), e2206925119. <https://doi.org/10.1073/pnas.2206925119>

Note: Controversy. Other research suggests that it is not that men overestimate women's sexual intentions, but that women underestimate their intentions when filling out questionnaires. It remains to be seen who is the more accurate judge. Neither of the first two studies measured behavioral cues. The third study shows that good feelings will come from sending messages and meeting in person. However, there is no direct comparison between "behavior and tone of voice are more accurate than facial expressions". This is the author's inference. The author recommends checking whether the other party initiates the initiative, whether it is scheduled for next time, and whether it follows up even if you don’t push forward.

Case: During the blind date, the two had a good conversation. The woman took the initiative to find topics for many times, but never took the initiative to meet up or follow up with her afterwards. Based on this, the man judged that the woman only responded politely and did not develop a good impression.

items.title: Whether a relationship is good or not mainly depends on your own feelings in the relationship, not the conditions of the other party.
items.core: What best explains whether a relationship is good or not is your own feelings, not the other person's conditions. For example, do you think the other party takes you seriously or appreciates you? Do you argue much? Your own feelings are two to four times more powerful than what your partner says. But whether this relationship will get better or worse in the future is basically impossible to calculate in any questionnaire.
body: Cost: It costs nothing and doesn’t take much time. The difficulty lies in changing the perspective: putting away the mate selection list and looking at the process of getting along.

Income: Machine learning analysis of 29 laboratories and 43 longitudinal paired data. Longitudinal means following the same batch of partners. The top predictors of relationship quality all come from how the person feels about the relationship: perceived commitment, appreciation, sexual satisfaction, perceived satisfaction, and conflict. The strongest ones related to individuals are life satisfaction, negative emotions, depression, avoidant attachment, and anxious attachment. These terms regarding relationships explained up to 45% of the variance at the outset of the investigation. Variance refers to the difference in relationship quality between partners, and 45% of it is explained by these terms. A maximum of 18% was explained by the end of the study. And the predictive power of "self-reported items" is two to four times that of "partner-reported items." Adding individual differences and partner reports to self-reported relationship feelings did not add any additional predictive power. Whether a relationship gets better or worse during the study period is largely unpredictable using any set of self-report variables. The original text is "largely unpredictable from any combination of self-report variables"
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Joel S, Eastwick PW, Allison CJ, et al. (2020). Machine learning uncovers the most robust self-report predictors of relationship quality across 43 longitudinal couples studies. Proceedings of the National Academy of Sciences, 117(32), 19061-19071. <https://doi.org/10.1073/pnas.1917036117>

Note: Asking yourself how you feel is better than checking off the other person's list of conditions to determine whether a relationship is good now, but don't expect to predict how it will turn out in the future. For the account that connects the quality of your relationship with your health, see Article 17 of this section (treat the quality of your relationship as a health account).

Case: The boyfriend of a girl has a high income and good appearance, but he always denies her ideas in daily interactions. She feels depressed and tired for a long time, and finally feels that the relationship is not good and chooses to break up.

items.title: If you want to get closer, take turns answering a set of questions from the simplest to the more complex. Don’t learn to talk.
items.core: Two strangers took turns answering 36 questions, ranging from easy to difficult, and after 45 minutes were closer than those who had spent the same amount of time chatting. What is more effective than small talk is taking turns to answer and asking deeper questions layer by layer. This only means that they were closer at the time, but it does not mean that they will develop into a long-term relationship.
body: Cost: Nothing. It takes 45 minutes.

Benefit: Pair up two people who don't know each other and ask them to take turns answering three sets of progressively in-depth questions, a total of 36 questions. Questions ranged from "Who would you most like to treat to dinner?" to "When was the last time you cried in front of someone?" The feeling of closeness after 45 minutes was significantly higher than that of the control group who chatted for the same length of time. It was also higher than the average rating of college students in the study on their closest real-life relationships.
Level of Evidence: B

Source: Aron A, Melinat E, Aron EN, Vallone RD, Bator RJ (1997). The experimental generation of interpersonal closeness: a procedure and some preliminary findings. Personality and Social Psychology Bulletin, 23(4), 363-377. <https://doi.org/10.1177/0146167297234003>

Note: I have only done one experiment, with college students. It only tested the sense of closeness in a short period of time, but did not test whether it can develop into a long-term relationship. The sense of intimacy in the experiment comes from two people taking turns to talk about their true situation layer by layer. It does not rely on words, routines or one-sided performance. Therefore, a useful approach when chatting is "I will say something true, and I will also ask something equally profound." Both parties take turns.

Case: Two young people who had just met took turns answering thirty-six questions from the simplest to the deeper in a cafe. After forty-five minutes of in-depth chat, they felt obviously closer to each other, which was far better than a casual chat of the same length.

items.title: Long-distance relationships are no worse than those in the same city. The real hurdle is the first three months after moving in together.
items.core: Long-distance relationships are more stable during the separation period. Research suggests that the reason is that it is easy to think that the other person is better than the actual situation. The less you see the other person, the better you think. The real hurdle came after moving in together. According to the tracking data, about half of the long-distance couples ended up in the same city, and the other half ended during the separation period. Of the half who reunited, a third broke up within 3 months.
body: Cost: Travel expenses and time spent traveling back and forth. We meet less often than in the same city. The difficulty lies in not being able to see each other for a long time.

Benefits: Both studies found the same conclusion. Long-distance relationships are more stable than same-city relationships during separation. The reason is that in long-distance relationships, the degree of thinking that the other person is better than the actual person is significantly higher. The study measured idealization distortion, romantic love, relationship memories, and perceived agreement. And the less we meet, the more beautiful our thoughts become. But this kind of stability only exists when the two parties are still separated. Once they become in the same city, long-distance couples are more likely to break up. The study that tracked long-distance transfers found that about half of long-distance couples made it to the point of moving in together, and the other half ended up staying apart. Of the half who reunited, a third broke up within 3 months of the reunion. The changes mentioned by the participants after the reunion include: no room for autonomy, more knowledge of each other’s good and bad qualities, difficulty in arranging time, and more conflicts and jealousy. The longer the interval between meetings during separation and the stronger the idealization, the more unstable the reunion will be.
Level of Evidence: B

Source: Stafford L, Merolla AJ, Castle JD (2006). When long-distance dating partners become geographically close. Journal of Social and Personal Relationships, 23(6), 901-919. and stability in long-distance dating relationships. Journal of Social and Personal Relationships, 24(1), 37-54. <https://doi.org/10.1177/0265407507072578>; Dargie E et al. (2015). Journal of Sex & Marital Therapy, 41(2), 181-202. <https://doi.org/10.1080/0092623X.2013.864367> (The off-site study in the remarks)

Note: The object is the romantic relationship of American college students. Marriage is not included. The age is also earlier. Don’t use absolute proportions directly. Another study surveyed 717 people who lived in another city and 425 who lived in the same city. The quality difference between the two types of relationships is very small. Whether the relationship is good or not mainly depends on the respective situations of the two people and the relationship itself, not the distance. So when deciding whether to live in a different place, don't use "we must break up in a different place" as a reason. What needs to be prepared in advance is the few months after the reunion, when there will be less independent space, more understanding of each other, and more conflicts and jealousies.

Case: A couple had a stable relationship for two years in a different place. They moved together only two months ago. Due to differences in living habits and constant daily friction, conflicts broke out. They finally broke up in the third month in the same city.

items.title: First look at the registration data and then listen to the elders: What are the marriage and divorce rates?
items.core: In 2024, 6.106 million marriages were registered nationwide, a decrease of 20% from the previous year, and 3.513 million divorces were recorded. According to the Internet, the divorce rate is more than half. Divide these two numbers, it is about 57.5%. But divorced people and married people are not the same people, and it cannot be said that half of the marriages will divorce. The marriage rate in the communiqué is 4.3‰ and the divorce rate is 2.5‰, which are calculated by dividing them by the national population.
body: Cost: Nothing. Read the section on marriage registration in the annual bulletin of the Ministry of Civil Affairs for a few minutes.

Income: In 2024, 6.106 million couples were legally registered across the country, a decrease of 20.5% from the previous year, and the marriage rate was 4.3‰. In the same year, 3.513 million couples handled divorce procedures according to law, of which 2.622 million couples were registered by the civil affairs department and 891,000 couples were divorced by court judgment or mediation. The divorce rate is 2.5 per thousand. The communiqué states that the marriage (divorce) rate = the number of marriages (divorce) in the year / the average total population in the year × 1000‰. This is "rough". The denominator is the entire population, not the married population.
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Ministry of Civil Affairs (2025). 2024 Statistical Bulletin on the Development of Civil Affairs (5(2)1 Marriage Registration Services, Note 5), web version and PDF version. <https://www.mca.gov.cn/n1288/n1294/n1554/c1662004999980006190/content.html>, <https: //www.mca.gov.cn/gdnps/n2445/n2451/n2458/n2681/c1662004999980006189/attr/400985.pdf>

Note: The common "divorce rate above 50%" on the Internet is to divide the number of divorces in that year by the number of marriages in that year, 351.3 / 610.6 ≈ 57.5%. This is called "Li Jie Bi". The two numbers divided are not the same group of people, and there is no such indicator in the communiqué, so it cannot be read as "half of the marriages will divorce." To calculate the "probability of a marriage ending up", you have to keep an eye on people who get married in the same group and keep counting. Such official data was not found in this section.

Case: Elders said that half of all marriages today will lead to divorce. Young people checked the Ministry of Civil Affairs bulletin and found that the data calibers of marriage and divorce registrations are different and cannot be directly divided. This corrected the misconception.

items.title: Include the health benefits of marriage, but discount them based on observational data
items.core: Among older adults, married people have about a 12% lower risk of death than non-married people. Regardless of age, people who have never been married have a higher risk of death than married people, and the older they are, the smaller the difference. But this was just two things happening at the same time, and it was unclear whether marriage played a role or not. These figures basically come from Europe and the United States, and can only be used as a reference for domestic purposes.
body: Cost: No money or time. Just remember one thing: these numbers say that the mortality rate is lower among married people. They are two things happening at the same time. It is not clear whether being married makes you live longer.

Benefits: A meta-analysis for the elderly, summarizing and recalculating multiple studies, with a total of 53 comparison groups and more than 250,000 people. What is summarized are all cohort studies, which are only tracking records without group control. The RR of all-cause death among married people versus those who were not married was 0.88, 95% CI 0.85–0.91 (RR is relative risk, CI is confidence range), and the risk of death was about 12% lower. In the same item, 1.11 were widowed, 1.16 were divorced or separated, and 1.11 were single, which were about 11%, 16%, and 11% higher respectively. There is no difference between men and women. The most conservative estimate is RR 0.94, only about 6% lower. Another meta-analysis compared single (never married) versus married, using 95 articles and more than 500 million people. The resulting HR was 1.24 (1.19–1.30), with an approximately 24% higher risk of death at any one time. This is a ratio of instantaneous risks and does not equal a 24% higher probability of death over the same period. And the older you get, the smaller the gap becomes. There is also a meta-analysis split by gender, 21 studies, more than 7.89 million people: for both men and women, non-marriage occurs simultaneously with total death, cancer death, and cardiovascular death. The gap between cardiovascular death and total death was larger among men. Unmarried men are 31% more likely to die from stroke and 9% more likely to die from all causes than unmarried women
Level of evidence: A (controversial)

Source: Manzoli L, et al. (2007). Marital status and mortality in the elderly: a systematic review and meta-analysis. Soc Sci Med 64:77–94. <https://doi.org/10.1016/j.socscimed.2006.08.031>; Roelfs DJ, et al. (2011). The rising relative risk of mortality for singles: meta-analysis and meta-regression. Am J Epidemiol 174(4):379–389. <https://doi.org/10.1093/aje/kwr111>; Wang Y, et al. (2020). Sex differences in the association between marital status and the risk of cardiovascular, cancer, and all-cause mortality: a systematic review and meta-analysis of 7,881,040 individuals. Glob Health Res Policy 5:4. <https://doi.org/10.1186/s41256-020-00133-8>

Note: The controversy is that people who get married may have been selected. For example, people who are healthier are more likely to get married. This was deduced by the author based on the research design. None of the three collections calculated the proportion of selection. The three meta-analyses all used observational data from ready-made populations. They were only tracking records without group control. The author himself also wrote that there was publication bias or methodological limitations. Roelfs also found that the more rigorous the study, the smaller the calculated gap. These figures are mainly for European and American people, and can only be used as a domestic reference.

Case: Peking University research shows that the mortality rate of married people over 65 years old is 12% lower than that of people living alone, but the data comes from European and American tracking. Domestic community surveys also found that married people have better self-rated health, but it is difficult to rule out the influence of selection bias.

items.title: The time account is calculated as "unpaid labor", and you must discuss the division of labor before getting a certificate
items.core: The National Time Utilization Survey counts unpaid work such as housework and accompanying and caring for family members. Among those who did it on the same day, men averaged 1 hour and 52 minutes per day, while women averaged 3 hours and 29 minutes. The survey did not divide people into groups according to whether they are married or not, so there is no official figure on "How much more housework will there be if you are married?" This gender gap can only be used as an upper limit reference. The division of labor can be negotiated differently before receiving the certificate.
body: Cost: No money. Spend an hour or two before getting married to negotiate a clear division of unpaid work such as housework, taking care of the children, and whose work will be given, and then implement it according to the division of labor. The hard part is to talk about it, don't put it off.

Benefits: 2024 National Time Use Survey. Unpaid work is unpaid work such as housework, accompanying and caring for family members. Those who did this kind of work that day spent an average of 2 hours and 45 minutes per day, including 1 hour and 52 minutes for men and 3 hours and 29 minutes for women. The proportion of people who do this kind of work in a day is 67.5% for men and 83.9% for women. Residents' daily average of 1 hour and 17 minutes of housework, including only those who did it, was 1 hour and 59 minutes, 28 minutes less than in 2018. The average daily time spent accompanying and caring for family members is 30 minutes, and only counting those who do so is 1 hour and 46 minutes. The figures in 2018 are: 45 minutes for men and 2 hours and 6 minutes for women; 17 minutes for men and 53 minutes for women taking care of children
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National Bureau of Statistics (2024). Bulletin of the Third National Time Use Survey (No. 2, No. 3). <https://www.stats.gov.cn/sj/zxfb/202410/t20241031_1957216.html>, <https://www.stats.gov.cn/sj/zxfb/202410/t20241031_1957215.html>; National Bureau of Statistics (2019). 2018 2016 National Time Use Survey Bulletin. <https://www.stats.gov.cn/sj/zxfb/202302/t20230203_1900224.html>

Note: Both surveys were only grouped by gender, urban and rural areas, and age, and were not grouped by marriage or not. Therefore, there is no official figure on "How much more housework will there be after marriage". We can only use the gender gap as an upper limit reference. The figures are national averages, and the division of labor between the two of you can be completely different.

Case: A prospective couple sorted out housework and care burdens based on time usage survey data before receiving their certificates, and agreed to divide labor according to their respective areas of expertise to avoid conflicts arising from uneven contributions to unpaid labor after marriage.

items.title: The financial accounts for marriage must first be determined by the legal default rules, and then decide whether to make a written agreement
items.core: If you do not sign a written agreement, the legal default is that the wages and bonuses earned after marriage, business and investment income, and inherited or donated property will belong to both parties jointly. Prenuptial property, a will or a gift contract that states it is only for one party belongs to the individual. Two people can agree in writing that each will go his own way, and it will be binding upon signing. The party who has contributed more to raising children and caring for the elderly can claim compensation during divorce.
body: Cost: No money. Read through the articles on property in the marriage and family section of the Civil Code. If it is necessary for two people to sign a written property agreement, the law only requires it to be in writing and does not need to be notarized. The difficulty lies in talking about money in advance.

Income: Unless otherwise agreed, the default rule is: wages, bonuses, labor remuneration, production and operation investment income, intellectual property income, inherited or donated property earned after marriage shall be owned jointly by the husband and wife (Article 1062). Premarital property, personal injury compensation, property that is clearly owned by only one party in a will or gift contract, and daily necessities exclusively owned by one party are personal property (Article 1,063). The parties may agree in writing that the pre-marital and post-marital property shall be owned individually, jointly, or partially owned by each other and partially owned jointly. This agreement is legally binding on both parties (Article 1065). The party who bears more obligations due to raising children, caring for the elderly, or assisting the other party in work has the right to request compensation during divorce (Article 1088)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People’s Congress (2020). Civil Code of the People’s Republic of China (effective from January 1, 2021, Articles 1062, 1063, 1065, 1088). National Laws and Regulations Database <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?title=%E4%B8%AD%E5%8D%8E%E4%BA%BA%E6%B0%91%E5%85%B1%E5%92%8 C%E5%9B%BD%E6%B0%91%E6%B3%95%E5%85%B8&id=ff808081729d1efe01729d50b5c500bf>; The full text of the article can be found in the Gazette of the Supreme People's Court. <http://gongbao.court.gov.cn/Details/7f184078694d811fb3314f6af9accf.html>

Note: There are no official statistics on betrothal gifts, weddings, and wedding rooms, so no numbers are included in this article. Article 1088: The amount of compensation to be paid is up to the two of them to discuss first. If the negotiation fails, it will be determined by the court. There is no fixed formula. A written property agreement is useful for both parties: the party with the higher income can use it, and the party with a lot of unpaid work such as housework can also use it

Case: A couple did not make a property agreement before marriage. After the marriage, one party resigned to take care of the family. When they divorced, they required housework compensation according to the law. The court judged the other party to give corresponding compensation based on the payment situation.

items.title: Parents invest in buying a house, and clearly indicate whether it is a loan or a loan when transferring money
items.core: When parents buy a house before marriage, they will only give it to their children by default. If there is no agreement after marriage, the money contributed will be counted as the joint property of the husband and wife. Starting from February 2025, if one parent contributes in full after marriage and does not specify that it is only for his or her children, the house can be awarded to the investor's children during divorce. Whether the other party should compensate or not will be decided by the court. To calculate the loan, it must be written clearly and signed by both parties on the same day.
body: Cost: Nothing. On the day of investment, write a one-page explanation stating whether the money is donated or lent to whom, and both parents and children who contribute the money sign it. If it is about a loan, ask both husband and wife to sign it, and write the same sentence in the transfer notes.

Income: If parents contribute money to purchase a house for both parties before marriage, it is deemed as a personal gift to their children. Except for parents who expressly express the gift to both parties. If the capital is contributed after marriage, it shall be subject to the agreement if there is an agreement. If there is no agreement or the agreement is unclear, it shall be handled according to the principle of joint property of husband and wife. There will be one more from February 1, 2025. If one parent fully contributes the capital during the marriage, and the gift contract does not specify that it will only be given to his or her children, the court may rule that the house belongs to the investor's children during divorce and division. After the judgment is made, several circumstances will be considered to determine whether and how much compensation should be given to the other party. These items include the situation of living together and having children together, the fault of the divorce, the size of the contribution to the family, and the market price of the house at the time of divorce. If one parent contributes part of the capital, or both parents contribute capital, it will be awarded to one of the parents based on the source and proportion of the capital contribution, and reasonable compensation will be provided (nationwide)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Supreme People's Court (2020). Interpretation (1) on the application of the marriage and family section of the Civil Code (Fa Interpretation [2020] No. 22, Article 29). <https://www.court.gov.cn/fabu/xiangqing/282071.html>; Supreme People's Court (2025). Interpretation on the Application of the Marriage and Family Section of the Civil Code (II) (Fa Interpretation [2025] No. 1, Article 8). <https://www.court.gov.cn/zixun/xiangqing/452771.html>; National People's Congress (2020). Civil Code (Article 1062, Paragraph 1, Item 4). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202006/t20200602_463888.shtml>

Note: Writing clearly is useful for both parties. Parents who contribute money no longer have to rely on an IOU to keep their investment in the event of a divorce. After explanation (2) is implemented, who paid the money itself will be the basis for dividing the house, not just whose name is written in the house book. The party receiving the capital contribution does not have to wait until the divorce to know what the money counts. If you want to treat it as a loan, then it should be treated as a loan: both parties agree to borrow, agree on how to repay, write down the transfer, and leave a repayment record if necessary. If the same thing is missing, you will have to explain it to the court

Case: After the parents got married, they fully invested in buying a house for their children. When transferring the money, they did not specify that it would only be given to their own children. During the divorce, the court awarded the house to the investor’s children, and the other party received a small amount of compensation.

items.title: If one spouse borrows a large amount without signing or ratifying it, it will not automatically become your debt
items.core: The money borrowed by your spouse behind your back will not automatically become your debt as long as it obviously exceeds the daily expenses of the family, and you do not sign or acknowledge it after everything is fine. The debtor must prove that the money was used for living together or doing business together. But if the money for buying a house does turn into a house that you live together or share, the other party will often be able to prove this level.
body: Cost: No money. Don't sign "co-borrower" or "guarantor" on your spouse's IOU or guarantee letter. Also don't write words like "We will repay this money" in the chat, it may be regarded as you admitting the debt afterwards. It's hard not to answer when pressed.

Income: The money borrowed in the following situations is a joint debt of the husband and wife. One is signed by both husband and wife. The second is that one party ratifies the debt afterwards, which means that both parties acknowledge the debt afterwards. The third is that one party borrows it in his own name during the marriage for the daily needs of the family. Money borrowed by one party in his or her own name that obviously exceeds the family's daily expenses is not considered a joint debt of the couple. The exception is that the creditor (the party demanding the debt) can prove that the money is used for the husband and wife's joint life, joint production and operation, or it is an account recognized by both parties. The money spent to buy a house is obviously more than the daily needs of the family. The burden of proof lies with the party claiming the debt, and the debtor must provide evidence himself. But if the money does turn into a house that the husband and wife live together or share, the creditor can often prove that it is "used for the husband and wife's common life." So what really works is the step in Article 11 (when parents contribute money, state whether it is a loan or a gift) (National, starting from 2021)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress (2020). Civil Code (Article 1064). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202006/t20200602_463888.shtml>; Supreme People's Court (2020) (Second amendment in 2016). Provisions on Several Issues Concerning the Application of Law in the Trial of Private Loan Cases (Articles 15 and 16). <http://gongbao.court.gov.cn/Details/94b6623974526df7d2430a3c73f050.html> (Official Gazette of the Supreme People's Court)

Note: When dividing property during a divorce, if the other parent suddenly takes out a loan agreement signed only by the spouse, you must read it in two steps. The first step is to see if the loan actually happened. If you say that the money has not been paid at all and you can give a good reason, the court will make a judgment based on several things. It depends on the amount of the loan, how the money is paid, the financial capabilities of both parties, how they usually conduct transactions, whether there are any corresponding changes in property, and what the witnesses say. If the other party can only produce a transfer voucher, he still has to prove that the loan was established. The second step is to check whether it is a joint debt after the loan is established. General rules for IOUs and letters of guarantee are found in Section 8, Article 18

Case: The husband borrowed 500,000 yuan from a friend in his own name for gambling without informing his wife. The wife had no knowledge and did not sign to ratify it. The creditor sued and demanded that the couple repay the debt jointly. The court found that the debt obviously exceeded the family's daily expenses and was not used for living together, and ruled that the wife did not need to bear it.

items.title: To obtain the certificate, you only need your ID card and a signed statement. No account book is required, and no money is collected. The certificate is issued on the spot
items.core: From May 2025, you only need two things to obtain the certificate: your ID card and a signed statement. The statement states that I have no spouse, and I have no direct blood relationship or collateral blood relationship with the other party within three generations. There is no need to bring the household registration book with you, and there is no need to go back to the place of residence of one party to apply for it. There is no charge for registration, and certificates will be issued on the spot if conditions are met.
body: Cost: No money. Both must be present in person. It usually takes dozens of minutes to complete.

Income: The new marriage registration regulations that will be implemented on May 10, 2025, have changed the materials that mainland residents must submit for marriage. The article states that only two things need to be produced: "(1) My resident ID card; (2) A signed statement that I have no spouse and that I have no direct blood relationship or collateral blood relationship within three generations with the other party." Household registration book is no longer required. The registration authority is "the civil affairs department of the people's government at the county level or the township (town) people's government determined by the people's government of the province, autonomous region, or municipality directly under the Central Government in accordance with the principle of convenience for the people." The restriction on "going to the place of permanent residence of one party" in the old regulations has been removed. The regulations also state that "marriage registration agencies shall not charge fees for marriage registration." The regulations also state that “if the parties meet the conditions for marriage, they shall be registered on the spot and a marriage certificate shall be issued.” The regulations list four situations for which registration is not allowed: "(1) Those who have not reached the legal age for marriage; (2) It is not completely voluntary for both men and women; (3) One or both parties have a spouse; (4) Those who are direct blood relatives or collateral blood relatives within three generations"
Level of Evidence: A
Source: State Council (2025). Marriage Registration Regulations (National Decree No. 804, Articles 2, 6, 8, 9, and 10). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202504/content_7017752.htm>

Note: There are only four situations that the registration authority will not handle: the legal marriage age is not reached, both parties are not completely willing, one or both parties already have a spouse, and the two are direct blood relatives or collateral blood relatives within three generations. The only peripheral services that may be charged are photography and photocopying. The registration itself does not charge a penny. If you encounter "cost-based fees" or "expedited fees", you will directly refuse and complain. The 30-day cooling-off period for registration of divorce is set out in clause 15 of this section (Exit Costs). The consequences of holding a wedding without obtaining a certificate can be found in Article 21 of this section (getting a marriage certificate even if you have a banquet)

Case: A couple registered in different places, without a household registration book, can get a marriage certificate on the spot at the local Civil Affairs Bureau with only their ID cards and signed declaration of no spouse or close relatives. The whole process is free and there is no need to return to their place of origin.

items.title: Have a premarital examination before marriage, and tell the other party truthfully if you have a serious illness before registration
items.core: If you fail to tell the other party truthfully about a serious illness before registration, the other party can sue to annul the marriage, and the marriage must be filed within one year from the date he knew or should have known about it. Ordinary first-instance procedures are stipulated to be completed within 6 months, which can be extended, and the lawyer's fees are generally paid by oneself. Since 2003, premarital examination has not been a prerequisite for obtaining a license. It is voluntary whether you go or not. The cost depends on local policies and it takes half a day.
body: Cost: In most areas, it is free or reduced for people of appropriate age. The self-expense is only a few hundred yuan. It takes half a day.

Benefits: The legal consequences of concealment are clear. The new marriage registration regulations stipulate that "if one party suffers from a serious illness, he should truthfully inform the other party before the marriage registration; if he fails to truthfully inform the other party, the other party may apply to the People's Court to annul the marriage in accordance with the provisions of Article 1053 of the Civil Code." The country regards prenatal examination as the first step in the prevention and treatment of birth defects. The current goal is to maintain “premarital medical examination rates and pre-pregnancy eugenic health examination target population coverage at above 70% and 80% respectively.” The document also calls for “promoting the establishment of pre-marital medical examination institutions and marriage registration places nearby to facilitate the masses.” The document also promotes "one-stop" services for marriage registration, pre-marital medical examination, and fertility guidance. The Civil Code stipulates that if one party suffers from a serious illness, he or she must truthfully inform the person before the marriage registration. If the other party fails to tell the truth, the other party may apply to the People's Court to annul the marriage. A request for annulment of a marriage must be made within one year from the date when the person knows or should know the reasons for the annulment. To cancel the case, you have to go to court to litigate: the ordinary procedure of first instance is to be completed within 6 months according to regulations, and can be extended. The lawyer's fees are usually paid by yourself. Premarital examination is not a prerequisite for obtaining a certificate. In its reply to the CPPCC proposal in 2022, the Tai'an Municipal Health Commission stated: "While canceling the 'compulsory premarital examination' in the 2003 Marriage Registration Regulations, it clearly requires the marriage registration agency to handle marriage registration without attaching other obligations." There is no premarital examination certificate in the marriage registration materials listed in Article 8 of the current regulations.
Level of Evidence: B

Source: National People's Congress (2020). Civil Code (Article 1053). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202006/t20200602_463888.shtml>; State Council (2025). Marriage Registration Regulations (National Decree No. 804, Articles 8 and 12). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202504/content_7017752.htm>; General Office of the National Health Commission (2023). Birth Defects Prevention and Treatment Capacity Improvement Plan (2023-2027) (National Health Office Maternal and Child Development [2023] No. 9). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202308/content_6900320.htm>; National Health Commission and five other departments (2020). Notice on strengthening premarital health care (Guowei Maternal and Child Letter [2020] No. 205): "Actively advocate that all localities implement free premarital examinations based on actual conditions." <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2020-05/22/content_5513902.htm>; Tai'an Municipal Health Commission (2022). Reply to "Recommendations on the Management of Premarital Medical Examinations" (No. 188 of the First Session of the 14th CPPCC). <http://www.taian.gov.cn/art/2022/7/8/art_176934_24592.html>

Note: Since 2003, premarital examination has not been a required step to obtain a certificate. It is voluntary. But the article "Don't tell the truth if you have a serious illness" does give the other party the right to go to court to annul the marriage. It must be submitted within one year from the date of knowing or should have known. There is no uniform provision across the country that premarital examinations are free. The 2020 notice from five departments including the National Health Commission only stated “actively advocate for localities to implement free premarital examinations based on actual conditions.” Therefore, it is up to each locality to decide whether it is free and which items to check. Go to the one-stop window of the local maternal and child health care institution or marriage registration office to ask.

Case: The man concealed severe kidney disease before marriage, but the woman discovered it after marriage. The woman filed for annulment of the marriage within six months after learning about it, and the court found out the facts and annulled the marriage in accordance with the law. The man paid the compensation and attorney fees himself, and the voluntary premarital examination did not affect the judgment.

items.title: Calculate exit costs: There is a 30-day cooling-off period for divorce by agreement, and legal conditions for divorce by litigation
items.core: Divorce by agreement is not completed after signing: either party can withdraw within 30 days after submitting the application. After the expiry of the period, the two of them have to go to collect the divorce certificate in person within 30 days. If they don't go, it will be regarded as withdrawn. If the other party does not agree, they can only sue. The court will mediate first. If there are domestic violence, bigamy, or separation for more than two years, divorce should be ordered if mediation fails.
body: Cost: No money. Take some time to read it before getting married: If you want to withdraw, how long will it take and what procedures will be followed? It's hard to think about breaking up before getting married.

Income: Divorce by agreement requires a written divorce agreement and application in person at the marriage registration office (Article 1,076). Either party may withdraw within 30 days from the date the registration authority receives the application. Within 30 days after the expiration of the period, both parties must apply for the divorce certificate in person. Failure to apply will be deemed to be withdrawn (Article 1077). If one party disagrees and goes to litigation, the court should mediate first. If there are bigamy or cohabitation with others, domestic violence or abuse and abandonment, gambling and drug abuse, and separation for more than two years due to emotional discord, divorce will be granted if mediation fails. If the person has been separated for one year after being sentenced to inseparability, he shall be allowed to sue again (Article 1079). In 2024, there were 3.513 million divorces nationwide, of which 891,000 were through court judgment and mediation
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress (2020). Civil Code of the People's Republic of China (Articles 1076, 1077, 1079). <http://gongbao.court.gov.cn/Details/7f184078694d811fb3314f6af9accf.html>; Ministry of Civil Affairs (2020). Notice on the Implementation of the Marriage Registration Provisions in the Civil Code of the People's Republic of China (Minfa [2020] No. 116). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2020-12/04/content_5567010.htm>; Ministry of Civil Affairs (2025). 2024 Statistical Bulletin on the Development of Civil Affairs. The title is the same as Article 7 (What are the calibers of marriage rate and divorce rate)

Note: The cooling-off period only applies to divorce by agreement. Litigated divorce does not have a cooling-off period, but the process is longer. Litigation fees and attorney fees vary from place to place, so no figures are included in this article. The high cost of exit does not mean that you should not get married, but you should know this before getting married. For those who have children, please see Article 23 of this section (Child support and visitation) for how to write child support and visitation

Case: Within 30 days after the husband and wife applied for divorce by agreement, the man regretted withdrawing the application due to property division. The woman then filed for divorce. Because there was evidence of domestic violence and they had been separated for more than two years, the court sentenced the divorce according to law after mediation failed to produce any results, which took several months.

items.title: Keep a separate account for "Marrying for Elders" and do not mix it with your own accounts
items.core: The benefits for the elders, that is, peace of mind, face, and no need to rush, are real. But it doesn’t automatically translate into gains in your health or relationship quality. The time account, money account and exit cost are all borne by you. Divide the paper into two columns and write down which income belongs to you and which belongs to your elders. You can tell at a glance whether this account is worthwhile.
body: Cost: No money. Write in two columns on the paper. One column is which income from this marriage is your own, which can be calculated from the previous items in this section. The other column shows which benefits belong to the elders: peace of mind, face, and stop urging marriage. The difficulty lies in leaving the elders' column alone and not merging it into your own column.

Benefits: The benefits of elders are real. But it doesn’t automatically translate into gains in your health (No. 8) or relationship quality (No. 4, how you feel about a good relationship). The time account (Article 9), money account (Article 10 to 12) and exit costs (Article 15) are all borne by the parties. After keeping separate accounts, you can tell by yourself whether the cost-effectiveness of "marrying elders" is high or low
Evidence level: C
Source: author's experience, methodological suggestions; see the previous items in this section for data

Note: The column for elders can also be considered a very heavy sum, and it is up to you to decide how to weigh it. For a fill-in-the-blank list, see [docs/Is it a good deal to get married.md](../docs/Is it a good deal to get married.md)

Case: Xiao Ming got married to comfort his seriously ill grandfather. After the marriage, he calculated that peace of mind for his elders was a face gain, but he had to bear the cost of time, money and divorce alone. After recording it in two columns on the paper, he saw clearly that the account was not worthwhile.

items.title: Treat the quality of the relationship as a health account: quarrels are about the wrong person, don't curse, don't be sarcastic
items.core: The husband and wife who have a good relationship are in better health and have a lower risk of death. This correlation is not significant, and is about as large as the correlation between diet and health. In one experiment, couples who were always hostile when they quarreled had minor wounds that healed only 60% as fast as those of peaceful couples.
body: Cost: No money. When quarreling, just talk about the matter at hand. Don't curse, don't be sarcastic, and don't settle old scores. It's hard to keep your mouth shut when you're angry.

Benefits: 126 studies, more than 72,000 people combined (meta-analysis). Higher marital quality is associated with better health, with correlation coefficients r ranging from .07 to .21. A correlation coefficient of 0 is no relationship and 1 is perfect synchrony. The correlation with a lower risk of death was r = .11. Cardiovascular responses were smaller during arguments, r = -.13. The authors say these effects are small and about as large as those associated with health habits such as diet. In another crossover experiment, 42 healthy couples were each hospitalized twice for 24 hours. Have a supportive conversation at a time and discuss one divisive matter at a time. After the fight, the blister wounds created in the experiment healed more slowly. Couples who showed more hostility on both occasions had wounds that healed only 60 percent as fast as couples with low hostility. The morning after the quarrel, the inflammatory markers (IL-6, tumor necrosis factor) in their blood also increased even more.
Level of Evidence: B
Source: Robles TF, Slatcher RB, Trombello JM, McGinn MM (2014). Marital quality and health: a meta-analytic review. Psychological Bulletin. Psychiatry. <https://doi.org/10.1001/archpsyc.62.12.1377>

Remarks: Reason for setting B: Most of the summarized studies are just follow-up records without group control. So I can’t tell whether poor relationships make people sick, or whether poor health makes relationships worse. In some studies, the correlation remains after age and income are deducted. Robles' original article also stated that some of the results were subject to publication bias. Studies that have clearly compared men and women have basically found no differences between men and women. This section did not find any meta-analysis that directly compared the mortality rates of "poor relationship marriages" and "no marriages". Therefore, "a bad marriage is more harmful to the body than no marriage" can only be regarded as an inference. The wound experiment included only 42 couples. "Treat the situation rather than the person, don't curse or be sarcastic" is a method the author deduced from the "hostile behavior" in the experiment, and no research has directly compared it. If the quarrel is too severe and there is no change, the two of you go to couple therapy together. See Item 20 (Couple Therapy) in this section. If the quarrel becomes violent, or if the person is verbally abused or threatened for a long time, it is no longer a communication problem, but domestic violence. See Section 8, Article 43 (Being Domestic Violence). Think clearly about whether to leave. For exit costs, see Article 15 (Exit Costs) of this section.

Case: A couple often sarcastic about trivial matters. The wife has long-term insomnia and poor physical examination indicators. After receiving the guidance, he changed his mind to discussing matters instead of personal attacks. Half a year later, his sleep quality improved. Wound healing experiments also showed that recovery accelerated after hostility was reduced.

items.title: Same-sex couples should complete the power of attorney, guardianship and will while both of them are sober: Legally, you are not close relatives. If you don’t do it, you will have no right to sign or inherit.
items.core: Legally close relatives are spouses, parents, and children, and partners are not counted. Without documents, the other party will not be able to make decisions for him when one party is seriously ill. If one party dies, the other party is not the heir. If there is no will, you can only rely on him to support you or support him more to fight for a share. Each of the three documents governs a section: a power of attorney to take charge of the things specified, a guardianship by will when the person loses the ability to judge, and a will after death.
body: Cost: The guardianship and will must be handled at a notary office. Notary fees vary from place to place, starting from a few hundred yuan. It costs nothing to write your own handwritten will. It takes one or two half days before and after. It's difficult for two people to sit down and talk about illness and death.

Income: Close relatives listed in Article 1045 of the Civil Code are spouses, parents, children, brothers and sisters, grandparents, maternal grandparents, grandchildren, and maternal grandchildren. The legal heirs in Article 1127 are first the spouse, children, and parents, followed by the brothers, sisters, grandparents, and maternal grandparents. The partner is absent from both places. If you are not an heir and there is no will, you can only rely on Article 1131 to fight. This article states that people other than heirs who "rely on the support of the decedent" or people who "support more" the deceased "can be distributed an appropriate portion of the inheritance", and the amount of the distribution is determined by the judge. Article 1,219 deals with surgeries, special examinations, and special treatments. If it is impossible or inappropriate to explain to the patient, medical staff should explain it to the patient's "close relatives" and obtain consent. There are three ways to make it up. First, Article 33 allows adults and "other individuals willing to serve as guardians" to agree in advance in writing on a guardian. After the person loses or partially loses his capacity for civil conduct, this person becomes the guardian, and the guardian is the legal representative. Second, Article 165 stipulates that the written power of attorney must state the name of the agent, matters of agency, authority and term, and must be signed or sealed by the agent. When the entrustment shall be terminated, please refer to Article 173. It lists situations such as the agent's loss of capacity for civil conduct, the death of the agent or the person, etc. The loss of the person's capacity for civil conduct is not included. There are exceptions after my death, see Article 174. For example, if the agent does not know and should not know that the agent has passed away, or if the heirs approve, the things done by the agent are still valid. Third, Article 1133 allows the making of a will to gift personal property to individuals other than the legal heirs. An article by the Yichang Municipal Justice Bureau was posted on the Hubei Provincial Department of Justice website. The article states that same-sex couples can get a notarized custody agreement and designate the other party as their future guardian (nationwide)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress (2020). Civil Code (Articles 23, 33, 165, 173, 174, 1045, 1124, 1127, 1131, 1133 to 1140, 1142, 1219). <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=ff808081729d1efe01729d50b5c500bf> (National Laws and Regulations Database); Yichang Municipal Justice Bureau (2021). Notarization of Intentional Guardianship: The Notarization Road to the Rainbow. "Practice Collection" column of the Hubei Provincial Department of Justice website. <https://sft.hubei.gov.cn/fbjd/sjhc/202101/t20210108_3208602.shtml>

Note: The partner receives the inheritance as a "legatee", not an heir. After you know that there is this bequest, you must express your acceptance within 60 days. If you don't express it, you will give up. The partner himself and those who have an interest in him cannot be witnesses of the will. If several wills are made, the last one shall prevail, see Section 17, Article 2 (a will made later overturns one made earlier). Whether the guardian can directly sign the consent form for surgery varies from hospital to hospital, so ask the hospital you frequently visit in advance. If the family does not recognize these documents, they will file a lawsuit: the ordinary first-instance procedure is stipulated to be completed within 6 months, and can be extended, and the lawyer's fees will be paid by the family. Therefore, try to get the documents to a notary office as much as possible. The house bought together and the money saved together shall be agreed in writing based on the actual investment. What to do if guardianship is decided, see section 17(1) (Appointment of future guardian in writing). The beneficiaries are yourself and your partner.

Case: When Mr. Zhang, a same-sex partner in Shanghai, was seriously ill, his partner was unable to sign for surgery because he had not signed a guardianship agreement. The latter two made a new will and power of attorney, agreeing on medical decision-making rights to avoid subsequent inheritance disputes.

items.title: Don’t get married by concealing your sexual orientation, and don’t regard physical marriage as a way to save trouble: legally it is a real marriage, and you can only get divorce if you want to quit
items.core: Marrying by concealing your sexual orientation is not legally invalid and cannot be revoked. If you want to quit, you can only get divorce. Physical marriage is also a real marriage. The money earned after marriage is counted as joint property of the couple. Debts signed by the two people together and debts borrowed for daily household expenses are also counted as two people's. During a divorce, the party who was kept in the dark can ask for a larger share of property and compensation for mental losses, but it has not yet been decided whether the court will support it.
body: Cost: No money. The hard thing is to withstand the pressure from your family to get married, which may take many years.

Income: Article 1051 of the Civil Code stipulates that there are only three situations where a marriage is invalid: bigamy, kinship that prohibits marriage, and underage. Articles 1052 and 1053 stipulate that there are only two types of things that can be revoked: being forced to marry, and concealing a serious illness before marriage. Article 17 of the Interpretation (1) of the Marriage and Family Section stipulates that if a request is made to confirm the invalidity of a marriage for reasons other than these three, the court will reject it. So if you want to quit, you can only get divorced. A registered physical marriage is also a legal marriage. Article 1062 stipulates that wages, bonuses, labor remuneration, etc. after marriage are the joint property of husband and wife. Article 1064 stipulates that debts borrowed by two people under their joint signature and debts borrowed by one party for family daily life are joint debts of the husband and wife. For divorce damages, see Article 1091. The circumstances under which compensation is available are limited to bigamy, cohabitation with others, domestic violence, abuse and abandonment of family members, and "other major faults." Explanation (1) Article 2 limits “living with others” to cohabiting with “people of the opposite sex outside of marriage.” Therefore, same-sex relationships can only be contested based on "other major faults." Compensation includes compensation for mental damages, which must be submitted when the deceived party files for divorce. If the divorce cannot be separated, it will not be supported. After the implementation of the Civil Code, no such judgments were found published by the courts. During the old law period, an article published in 2013 on the website of the Jiangsu Provincial Higher People's Court discussed a case in which a wife sued for divorce because her husband concealed his homosexuality. The article lists two views. One believed that homosexuality was not among the legal faults at that time, and that excessive distribution of property and mental compensation should not be supported. The author agrees with another method: treat the party who was concealed as the "non-fault party", take care of her when dividing the property, and should also pay moral consolation money (National)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress (2020). Civil Code (Articles 1051 to 1054, 1062, 1064, 1079, 1087, 1091). <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=ff808081729d1efe01729d50b5c500bf> (National Laws and Regulations Database); Supreme People's Court (2020). Interpretation on the Application of the Marriage and Family Section of the Civil Code of the People's Republic of China (1) (Fa Interpretation [2020] No. 22, Articles 2, 17, 86 to 90). <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=ff80808177e75f880178006736f21aaf>; Zhu Laikuan, Wang Hongjuan (2013). Can damages be claimed for divorce due to homosexuality? Jiangsu Court Network. <http://www.jsfy.gov.cn/article/26621.html>

Note: There is only one analysis article on multiple property and mental compensation, but it does not write about how the case will be judged in the end, so whether you can get it depends on the specific court. Compared with the old law, the Civil Code has an additional item of "other major faults", which gives the party who has been concealed an opportunity to argue. The letter of the law itself is grade A. If both parties to a physical marriage have same-sex partners, the partners are not protected by the Marriage Law, and the property must be clearly stated separately, see Article 18 of this section (Same-sex couples must decide on guardianship and wills). Divorces involving physical marriages are also subject to a 30-day cooling-off period or a lawsuit. See Article 15 of this section (divorces by agreement have a 30-day cooling-off period). If you agree to give up compensation when you agree to divorce, it will not be supported if you sue later. The beneficiary is first the spouse who will be kept secret, and secondly yourself: after the concealment is discovered, divorce, property division, and child support will all be involved.

Case: Xiao Zhang, a homosexual, registered a physical marriage with a woman and purchased a house together after marriage. Two years later, the wife requested a divorce and divided half of the property and deposits. The court found that the marriage was legal and valid, and ruled that the joint property should be divided equally, and Xiao Zhang had to pay the corresponding discount.

items.title: The relationship is stuck in repeated quarrels and cold wars, and two people go to couples therapy together (except those with domestic violence): waiting in line will basically not make them better
items.core: The partners who have a stuck relationship have completed couples therapy together, and they are obviously much more satisfied with the relationship, and there is basically no change in just waiting in line. But the effects fade: By year 5 of one trial, about half were still significantly better, and about a quarter were separated or divorced. If there is domestic violence, these conclusions do not apply, so don’t do it together yet.
body: Cost: It costs money. Pay-per-use charges vary from place to place and hospital to hospital, so numbers are not included in this article. In the study, I usually went once a week, and one trial lasted about 8 months. The difficulty is that both of us have to go and insist on finishing.

Benefits: A 2020 meta-analysis compiled 58 studies, 2,092 couples. After couples therapy, the pre-to-post change in relationship satisfaction was g = 1.12 (confidence range 0.92–1.31), which the authors said was a large effect. g is the effect size, see README glossary. For partners assigned to wait in line, g = 0.12 (−0.04 to 0.29) over the same period, no significant improvement. The worse the relationship was at the beginning, the more it improved. A 2012 review found that couples therapy improved 70% of couples who received it. Another randomized trial looked at 134 couples with chronic, severe discord and did two kinds of behavioral couples therapy for about 8 months. Change in satisfaction at completion d = 0.90 and 0.71. By year 5, 50.0% and 45.9% of couples, respectively, were still significantly better for both practices. The obvious improvement here is called "clinically significant improvement" by the author. Meanwhile 25.7% and 27.9% were separated or divorced. Domestic violence will be charged separately. A 2016 meta-analysis stated that the conclusion only applies to mild to moderate situations where the two parties are involved in a conflict. Violence characterized by domination of the other party and serious harm is not included
Level of evidence: A (controversial)

Source: Roddy MK, Walsh LM, Rothman K, Hatch SG, Doss BD (2020). Meta-analysis of couple therapy: effects across outcomes, designs, timeframes, and other moderators. Journal of Consulting and Clinical Psychology, 88(7), 583-596. <https://doi.org/10.1037/ccp0000514>; Lebow JL, Chambers AL, Christensen A, Johnson SM (2012). Research on the treatment of couple distress. Journal of Marital and Family Therapy, 38(1), 145-168. <https://doi.org/10.1111/j.1752-0606.2011.00249.x>; Christensen A, Atkins DC, Baucom B, Yi J (2010). Marital status and satisfaction five years following a randomized clinical trial comparing traditional versus integrative behavioral couple therapy. Journal of Consulting and Clinical Psychology, 78(2), 225-235. <https://doi.org/10.1037/a0018132>; Rathgeber M, Bürkner PC, Schiller EM, Holling H (2019). The efficacy of emotionally focused couples therapy and behavioral couples therapy: a meta-analysis. Journal of Marital and Family Therapy, 45(3), 447-463. <https://doi.org/10.1111/jmft.12336> (disputing party); Shadish WR, Baldwin SA (2003). Meta-analysis of MFT interventions. Journal of Marital and Family Therapy, 29(4), 547-570. <https://doi.org/10.1111/j.1752-0606.2003.tb01694.x> (disputing party); Karakurt G, Whiting K, van Esch C, Bolen SD, Calabrese JR (2016). Couples therapy for intimate partner violence: a systematic review and meta-analysis. Journal of Marital and Family Therapy, 42(4), 567-583. <https://doi.org/10.1111/jmft.12178>; National People's Congress Standing Committee (2018 revision). Mental Health Law (Articles 23, 51). <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=2c909fdd678bf17901678bf7448a066d> (National Laws and Regulations Database)

Note: The controversy lies in how long the effect lasts. In another meta-analysis that included only randomized trials, g = 0.60 at the time of completion and 0.44 six months later. By 12 months only behavioral partner treatment had data, g = 0.06, barely preserved. Another review that compiled 20 meta-analyses said clinically meaningful effects occurred in 40 to 50 percent of people. "70% improvement" and "40 to 50% improvement obviously" use different standards, so don't compare them. The 5-year trial did not have a no-treatment control, so it is unclear whether divorces increased or decreased. The 2020 summary only included opposite-sex couples, and no domestic randomized trials were found. If you use it on yourself, you will get a discount. Where to go in China: The Mental Health Law stipulates that psychological treatment must be done in medical institutions, and psychological counselors are not allowed to do psychological treatment. You can go to the psychiatry or psychology department of the hospital and ask if there is couples therapy. When looking for an agency outside the hospital, first ask about their qualifications and training. If there is domestic violence, please don’t do it together. The 2016 meta-analysis stated that the conclusions only apply to mild to moderate situations where violence occurs due to conflict between two parties. Violence characterized by controlling the other party and causing serious harm is not included. People in the industry are also worried about retaliation if they go home after the talks. If you were beaten, please first read Section 8, Article 43 (Domestic Violence). For how to speak during a quarrel, see Article 17 of this section (the quarrel is about the person, not the person). To figure out whether to walk away, see Article 15 of this section (Exit costs). The beneficiaries are yourself and your spouse.

Case: After Couple A, who often had cold wars, received ten sessions of couples therapy, their communication became noticeably smoother. Couple B, who is in the same situation, just waits in line, and their relationship has not improved at all. Five years later, half of A's cases are still in good condition, and B's have separated. It can be seen that proactive intervention is better than waiting.

items.title: After holding a wedding and having a banquet, you also need to get a marriage certificate: If you do not register, you are not legally a couple. If the other party dies, you have no inheritance rights as a spouse.
items.core: After February 1994, if you only hold a wedding without getting a certificate, you are not legally a husband and wife, and you are only considered a cohabitant. If the other party dies, you cannot inherit the inheritance as your spouse. When you want to separate, the court will not treat you as a divorce. This can be solved by re-registering, and the effect can be calculated forward.
body: Cost: No money. The two of them went to the marriage registration office together for dozens of minutes.

Income: The Civil Code stipulates that "the completion of marriage registration shall establish the marriage relationship. If the marriage has not been registered, a supplementary registration shall be made." The interpretation of the Supreme Law divides people who are not registered but live in the name of husband and wife into two types. Those who meet the conditions for marriage before February 1, 1994 will be treated as a de facto marriage. After that, the court "should inform the person to apply for a new marriage registration." If the application is not reissued, it will be treated as a cohabitation relationship. If one party dies, the other party will inherit as a spouse, and this principle should also be followed. The spouse is the first-order heir, so the unregistered spouse cannot be included. For the cohabitation relationship itself, the court does not accept requests for "dissolution", but only disputes over property division and child custody. After re-registration, the validity of the marriage "starts when both parties meet the substantive requirements for marriage stipulated in the Civil Code." Children are not affected. "Children" in the inheritance section of the Civil Code indicates that children born out of wedlock are the first-order heirs like children born in wedlock
Level of Evidence: A
