Source: National People's Congress (2020). Civil Code (1049, 1127, 1131). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202006/t20200602_463888.shtml>; Supreme People's Court (2020). Interpretation on the application of the marriage and family section of the Civil Code (1) (Fa Interpretation [2020] No. 22, Articles 3, 6, 7 and 8). <https://www.court.gov.cn/fabu/xiangqing/282071.html>

Note: The other party has not received the certificate when he died. You are not the heir, but you will not get any points. The Civil Code stipulates that "appropriate inheritance may be distributed" to those who have "larger support" for the deceased. You have to fight with evidence yourself. If you can't reach an agreement, you'll have to file a lawsuit. The ordinary procedure of first instance is stipulated to be completed within 6 months, which can be extended. The lawyer's fees will be paid by himself, and the amount will be determined by the judge. So while both of you are here, go get it reissued first. The re-registration is the same as the first registration. Both people must be present in person. The materials are provided in Article 13 of this section (only ID cards are required to receive the certificate). The bride price can be requested to be returned when it is not registered, see Section 8, Article 24 (bride price can be transferred). The beneficiaries are yourself and your spouse.

Case: Mr. Li held a grand wedding but did not receive a certificate. His wife died in a car accident. His parents-in-law had exclusive possession of the inheritance. The court determined that the two were only in a cohabitation relationship and that Mr. Li had no right to inherit as a spouse. Although he later applied for re-registration, it could not be traced back due to his death.

items.title: Your spouse goes behind your back and uses the joint money to reward the anchor in large amounts and transfers it to people outside the marriage: you can ask for the division of joint property without getting divorced, and the money transferred to the person outside the marriage can be sued to get it back
items.core: If your spouse does not discuss with you and uses joint money to reward the anchor in large amounts, you can ask the court to divide the joint property without divorce. When divorcing, you can also let the other party get less or no points. For money transferred to someone outside the marriage, you can sue the person who received the money to return it. Even if the other party says they spent it, you still have to return it. But this requires a lawsuit, the lawyer's fees are paid by yourself, and the first trial takes several months.
body: Cost: A lawsuit. The attorney's fees are paid by oneself and are not included in the litigation fees that the losing party has to bear. The ordinary first-instance procedure is required to be completed within 6 months, which can be extended, and the simplified procedure is 3 months. You also have to find out the transfer records and reward records by yourself.

Income: The Civil Code stipulates that husband and wife "have equal rights to deal with common property." If one party in the marriage hides, transfers, sells, destroys, or squanders the joint property, the other party can request the court to divide the joint property without divorcing first. When dividing property in a divorce, the party doing so may receive less or no share. If it is discovered after the divorce, you can sue again and ask for another division. Interpretation (2), which will come into effect on February 1, 2025, stipulates two situations. Article 6: Rewards. If one party uses joint property to reward people on a live streaming platform without the consent of the other party, and the amount is obviously beyond the normal consumption level of the family, it is considered "squandering". The court must support the other party's request for a division within marriage, or for a smaller or no share of the rewarded party during divorce. Article 7: Control over persons outside marriage. One party gives away joint property to others for the purpose of bigamy, cohabitation with others, or other violations of the duty of loyalty. The other party claims that the gift is invalid, and the court must support it. After it becomes invalid, the person who got the money has to return it. At the same time, you can also request a division within marriage based on this, or let the other party get less or no division during divorce. In a typical case released by the Supreme Court at the same time, one party transferred 730,000 yuan to a person with an improper relationship over four years of marriage, and the other party returned 170,000 yuan. The court ordered the other party to return the 560,000 yuan actually received. The other party said that "part of the money has been consumed." The court did not support it (National)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress (2020). Civil Code (Articles 157, 1043, 1062, 1066, 1092). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202006/t20200602_463888.shtml>; Supreme People’s Court (2025). Interpretation on the Application of the Marriage and Family Section of the Civil Code (2) (Fa Interpretation [2025] No. 1, Articles 6 and 7). <https://www.court.gov.cn/zixun/xiangqing/452771.html>; Supreme People's Court (2025). Typical cases involving marriage and family disputes (Case 4: Donation contract dispute between Cui Moumou and Ye Moumou and Gao Moumou). <https://www.court.gov.cn/zixun/xiangqing/452761.html>; National People's Congress Standing Committee (2023 revised). Civil Procedure Law (Articles 152, 164). <https://amr.guizhou.gov.cn/zwgk/xxgkml/jcxxgk/zcfg/fl/202401/t20240129_83645867.html>; State Council (2006). Measures for the payment of litigation fees (State Council Order No. 481, Articles 6 and 29). <https://www.gov.cn/ziliao/flfg/2006-12/29/content_483682.htm>

Note: There is a threshold for the reward: without your consent, the amount obviously exceeds the general consumption level of the family and seriously damages common property. Occasionally small rewards are not enough. Explanation (2) The way to give rewards is to share property and small points. It is not stated that you can get it back from the anchor or the platform. If you transfer it to someone outside the marriage, you will get back the money actually received by the other party, and the part transferred by the other party to your spouse will be deducted. You need to prepare the evidence yourself: bank and payment software transactions, reward records, and chat records that can reveal the relationship between the two. Procedures for division of property and divorce are provided in Section 15 of this Section (Exit Costs). What kind of money counts as joint property is shown in Article 10 of this section (see the legal default rules for money accounts first). If a spouse borrows money from outside the country, see Article 12 of this section (large amount borrowed by one spouse). For tips on yourself, see Section 5, Item 8 (No tips for anchors). The beneficiary is yourself. On the other hand, if you are the person outside the marriage who received the money, the money you received will have to be refunded, and the money you spent will also need to be refunded.

Case: The wife discovered that her husband misappropriated the joint savings to reward the anchor 800,000 and transferred it to a third party. She sued for division of property before getting divorced, and sued a third party for return of the transfer. The court ruled that the reward was a waste of money, and the third party returned the full amount, which took half a year.

items.title: When a couple with minor children divorces, they should write in the divorce agreement who the child will live with, the amount of monthly support, and the method and time of visitation: the more specific it is, the less likely it will be a lawsuit after the divorce
items.core: The two people can discuss and write it into the agreement. If an agreement cannot be reached, the court will decide it. If you have a fixed income, the alimony is usually 20% to 30% of the monthly income of the person giving the money. If the other party doesn't give you the written money, you can sue to get it back. If the other party prevents you from seeing the child, the court can fine or detain him, but it will not force the child to see you.
body: Cost: Written into the agreement when you divorce, it costs nothing. The difficulty is that two people have to sit down and discuss details, such as when to pay every month, which account to pay to, which weekend to pick up the children, and how to divide the winter and summer vacations. If we can't reach an agreement, we will file a lawsuit. The divorce case processing fee ranges from 50 to 300 yuan per case. The attorney's fees are paid by oneself and are not included in the litigation fees that the losing party has to bear. The ordinary first-instance procedure is required to be completed within 6 months, which can be extended, and the simplified procedure is 3 months. If disputes arise over alimony or visitation after divorce, separate lawsuits will be filed.

Income: The Civil Code stipulates that the amount and duration of child support payments, as well as the method and time of visitation, must be agreed upon by both parties in advance. Failure to reach an agreement shall be determined by the court. Children under two years old should, in principle, stay with their mother. Those who are over two years old will be sentenced according to the "principle that is most beneficial to the minor children". When a child reaches eight years old, his or her own wishes must be respected. Starting from February 2025, if one party engages in domestic violence, gambling, drug abuse, cheating, cohabitation, or hiding children, the court will give priority to letting the other party take care of the children. The amount of child support depends on the child’s actual needs, the parents’ affordability and local living standards. For those with a fixed income, the payment is generally 20% to 30% of the total monthly income. If you have more than two children, the proportion can be increased, but generally it does not exceed 50% of the total monthly income. If you do not have a fixed income, this ratio will be based on the total income of the year or the average income of the same industry. For example, if the monthly income is 8,000 yuan, according to this ratio, the monthly income is 1,600 to 2,400 yuan (self-calculated). Child support is generally paid until the child turns 18. The amount is set in the agreement or judgment, and the child can still claim reasonable expenses beyond the original amount if necessary, such as illness or school expenses. The agreement is valid even if one party does not pay alimony. However, if the living standard of the parent taking care of the child has dropped significantly, or the necessary expenses for the child have increased significantly, the child can still ask the other parent to provide payment. After divorce, if the alimony is not paid according to the agreement, you can sue to recover the arrears. If the other party fails to perform after the court's judgment or mediation letter takes effect, it may apply for compulsory execution. For those who refuse to assist in visitation, the court can detain and fine them, but "cannot enforce the child's person or visitation behavior" (National)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress (2020). Civil Code (Articles 1084-1086). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202006/t20200602_463888.shtml>; Supreme People's Court (2020). Interpretation on the application of the marriage and family section of the Civil Code (1) (Fa Interpretation [2020] No. 22, Articles 44 to 53, 55, 58, 61, 65 to 68). <https://www.court.gov.cn/fabu/xiangqing/282071.html>; Supreme People's Court (2025). Interpretation on the Application of the Marriage and Family Section of the Civil Code (II) (Fa Interpretation [2025] No. 1, Articles 12, 14, 16, and 17). <https://www.court.gov.cn/zixun/xiangqing/452771.html>; National People’s Congress Standing Committee (2023 revision). Civil Procedure Law (Articles 114, 152, 164, 247). <https://amr.guizhou.gov.cn/zwgk/xxgkml/jcxxgk/zcfg/fl/202401/t20240129_83645867.html>; State Council (2006). Measures for the payment of litigation fees (State Council Order No. 481, Articles 6, 13, and 29). <https://www.gov.cn/ziliao/flfg/2006-12/29/content_483682.htm>

Note: 20% to 30% is the reference line determined by the court, not the lower limit of the agreement. Two people can discuss other numbers. When writing the agreement, clearly state the payment date, account, and payment date. Write down the day of the week, pick-up time, and holidays. You will only have proof afterwards. If a parent or relative snatches or hides a child, he or she may apply to the court for a personal safety protection order, see Section 8, Article 43 (Personal Safety Protection Order). The procedures for divorce and the cooling-off period are set out in Clause 15 of this Section (Exit Costs). The beneficiary is the child first, and yourself second.

Case: The divorce agreement between a Beijing couple stated that the child belongs to the mother, and the father pays 3,000 yuan per month until the age of 18, and visits all day every Saturday. Two years later, the father refused to pay child support, and the mother sued based on the agreement and was supported by the court.

sections.title: Red lines that programmers and technicians easily step on

items.title: Before you take action, ask: Will the manufacturer, platform, or company report the crime? If you are held accountable, find a criminal lawyer immediately
items.core: Before you take action, ask: Will the manufacturer, platform, or company report the crime? The case handling agency has the right to retrieve server logs, payment records, and group chat records. If you are really detained, you will have up to 37 days to decide whether to approve the arrest. You can hire a lawyer from the first questioning, and the lawyer can advise the procuratorate that the arrest should not be approved, or apply for bail.
body: Cost: No money. Before taking action, replace "can it be done technically" with another question: will the manufacturer, platform, or company report the crime? It's hard to resist the thought of "no one cares about this little thing", because the server logs, payment records, group chat records, and the case handling agency have the right to retrieve

Income: Any unit or individual who discovers the facts of a crime has the right to report it. If the case-handling agency believes that there are criminal facts, it should file a case. Courts, procuratorates and public security "have the right to collect and obtain evidence from relevant units and individuals," and relevant units and individuals must provide it truthfully. After being criminally detained, the police must apply for arrest approval (apply to the procuratorate for formal arrest) within 3 days. In exceptional circumstances, this may be extended by 1 to 4 days. In the case of wandering crimes (continuous crimes across places), the period can be extended to 30 days. The Procuratorate will take another 7 days to decide. A total of up to 37 days will be required to decide whether to arrest or not. When the procuratorate reviews and approves arrest, "if the defense lawyer makes a request, the defense lawyer's opinion should be heard." Lawyers also have the right to apply for changes in compulsory measures, such as changing detention to bail pending trial, and the case handling agency must respond within 3 days. You can retain a lawyer from the first interrogation or from the time coercive measures are taken (detention, arrest, etc.). The case is still under investigation by the police, so we can only entrust a lawyer. The lawyer requests a meeting and the detention center arranges it within 48 hours at the latest. If the person may be sentenced to a lighter punishment than imprisonment, such as surveillance or criminal detention, or if he is only sentenced to an additional penalty and not to the main penalty, he may be released on bail pending trial. To be released on bail pending trial means to pay a deposit or find a guarantor, and then go home and wait for the case to be handled. The maximum bail period is 12 months (national)
Evidence level: C
Source: National People’s Congress (2018). Criminal Procedure Law (2018 amendment, Articles 34, 39, 54, 67, 79, 88, 91, 97, 110, 112). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/zdgz/201810/t20181027_396818.shtml>

Note: These 37 days are counted from the time of detention until the procuratorate decides whether to approve the arrest, and are not the upper limit of detention. After the arrest, there is also the period of detention during the investigation, and then counting down. During these 37 days, all the lawyer can do is meet the person, submit an opinion to the procuratorate that "the arrest should not be approved", and apply for bail pending trial. The author's opinion is that if you wait until after the prosecution to find a lawyer, the stage of arrest has passed. The rest of the entries in this section are all about the same thing: whether the other party has a reason to report the crime.

Case: A person was detained due to an Internet dispute, and his family members hired a lawyer on the third day. The lawyer submitted an opinion to the procuratorate not to approve the arrest, and the client was released on bail pending trial on the 30th day. If you fail to hire a lawyer, you may face up to 37 days in detention.

items.title: Do not make or sell game plug-ins and assistance, including AI assistance that "only reads the screen and does not touch the memory", nor sell modified versions of software such as WeChat with added functions
items.core: Selling plug-ins to 20 people, or earning 5,000 yuan, is enough to serve a sentence of less than 3 years, and in particularly serious cases, a sentence of 3 to 7 years. Someone made a fluoroscopy and self-aiming plug-in and sold more than 80,000 yuan in 3 months. He was sentenced to 1 year of probation and a fine of 5,000 yuan. Someone used the server program to open a private server and collected more than 20 million yuan in recharge. The maximum sentence was 4 years and a fine of up to 10 million yuan.
body: Cost: No money. The price is giving up income from such orders and "gadgets". The difficulty is that the money comes quickly, and it’s hard to see who will pursue the case.

Profit: Provide programs and tools specifically used to invade and illegally control computer information systems. In serious cases, the person will be sentenced to less than 3 years, and may also be fined or fined. A concurrent penalty is a fine along with the sentence, and a single penalty is only a fine. In particularly serious cases, the sentence is 3 to 7 years and a fine. The threshold for "serious circumstances" is to provide tools to more than 20 people, or the illegal income is more than 5,000 yuan. Illegal income is the money earned from this matter. Intentionally circumventing or destroying the technical protection measures of the rights holders may also constitute the crime of copyright infringement, and be punished by a prison sentence of less than 3 years, and in serious cases, a prison sentence of 3 to 10 years. Official case: Wang and others manufacture and sell plug-ins, which achieve perspective and self-aim by reading and modifying game memory. It sold for more than 80,000 yuan in 3 months and made a profit of more than 30,000 yuan. Sentenced to 1 year suspended for 1 year and fined 5,000 yuan. A 1-year suspended sentence is a 1-year sentence but no jail time. If you don't commit another crime during this year, you don't have to go to jail. Xiang and others sold the "TZ" series of plug-ins, with sales of more than 200,000 yuan. Xiang was sentenced to 3 years suspended for 3 years and fined 20,000 yuan. Liu Moumou and others obtained the game server program, changed the parameters to open a private server, and received a recharge of more than 20 million yuan. Sentenced to 4 years to 2 years and 6 months and fined 10 million to 1.3 million yuan. Not just games. A company in Shanghai has made a flash package that allows WeChat on mobile phones to have dozens of functions such as automatic forwarding, likes, and group messaging. These phones were sold as “marketing phones” and 2,381 units were sold. In 2019, the Shanghai Xuhui Court fined the company 500,000 yuan for the crime of copyright infringement, and the person in charge was sentenced to 1 year and 6 months suspended for 1 year and 6 months (national)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress (2020). Criminal Law (amended according to the Criminal Law Amendment (11), Article 285, Paragraph 3, Article 217, Item 6). <https://jtgl.beijing.gov.cn/jgj/jgxx/flfg/fl/11033925/index.html>; Supreme People’s Court, Supreme People’s Procuratorate (2011). Interpretation of Several Issues Concerning the Application of Law in Handling Criminal Cases Endangering the Security of Computer Information Systems (Article 3). <https://ga.sz.gov.cn/ZWGK/ZCFG/ZCJD/content/post_1304363.html> (Reprinted by Shenzhen Public Security Bureau); Supreme People’s Procuratorate (2026). Shanghai Jing’an: Strictly punish the production and sale of illegal game plug-ins to protect a clean cyberspace. <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/zdgz/202608/t20260825_735480.shtml>; Supreme People’s Procuratorate (2021). Typical cases of procuratorial organs protecting intellectual property rights in 2020 (Case 5). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/xwfbh/wsfbt/202104/t20210425_516525.shtml>; National Copyright Administration (2020). Release of the top ten typical copyright cases in Shanghai in 2019 (released by the Shanghai Copyright Administration, Case 8: Copyright infringement cases by Shanghai Yugong Network Technology Co., Ltd. and others). <https://www.ncac.gov.cn/xxfb/ywxx/202004/t20200430_47269.html>

Note: Published plug-in cases are all about reading and writing game memory and bypassing anti-cheating. The assistance of "only taking screenshots and only simulating keystrokes" has not seen any official precedent. However, the ticket grabbing case in Article 3 illustrates that even if you do not touch the memory and just send a request, you can still be convicted of illegally obtaining data. In the end, whether or not it is a crime and which crime will be counted are determined by the case handling agency based on the materials submitted by the manufacturer when reporting the crime. The author does not have the final say. Selling 20 people is enough for "serious circumstances", which is a small amount.

items.title: If you don’t write or sell ticket-grabbing, flash-killing, order-brushing, or fleecing scripts, even if they are just “automatic button clicks”
items.core: The scripts don’t change the memory or crack, they just send requests faster than people, you can still be convicted and earn 5,000 yuan or cause the other party to lose 10,000 yuan. Someone used the purchased 12306 account to grab more than 200 tickets and earned more than 20,000 yuan. He was sentenced to 1 year and 6 months suspended for 1 year and 6 months and fined 5,000 yuan. A person who sold ticket-grabbing software in an online store was compensated 20,000 yuan on the grounds of unfair competition.
body: Cost: Does not cost money and does not take up time

Benefit: Intruding into a computer information system, or using other technical means to obtain the data inside, if the circumstances are serious, the person will be sentenced to less than 3 years, and may also be fined or alone, and if the circumstances are particularly serious, the person will be sentenced to 3 to 7 years. The threshold for "serious circumstances" is illegal gains of more than 5,000 yuan, or losses of more than 10,000 yuan. Official case: Someone used a plug-in to batch import the purchased 12306 accounts, and intensively submitted ticket purchase requests through multiple threads. He snatched more than 200 train tickets on his behalf and made a profit of more than 20,000 yuan. The court sentenced him to one year and six months suspended for one year and six months and fined him 5,000 yuan for illegally obtaining computer information system data. Zheng was found guilty of unfair competition for selling ticket-grabbing software for a certain ticket-selling app in an online store and was ordered to pay a compensation of 20,000 yuan (national)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People’s Congress (2020). Criminal Law (amended in accordance with the 11th Amendment to the Criminal Law, Article 285, Paragraph 2). <https://jtgl.beijing.gov.cn/jgj/jgxx/flfg/fl/11033925/index.html>; Supreme People’s Court, Supreme People’s Procuratorate (2011). Interpretation of Several Issues Concerning the Application of Law in Handling Criminal Cases Endangering the Security of Computer Information Systems (Article 1). <https://ga.sz.gov.cn/ZWGK/ZCFG/ZCJD/content/post_1304363.html>; Supreme People’s Procuratorate (2026). Shanghai Jing’an: Investigate the case of using plug-in software to rob train tickets in batches for profit. <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/dfjcdt/202607/t20260707_731426.shtml>; Supreme People's Court (2025). Typical intellectual property cases of the People's Court in 2024 (Case 7, Unfair Competition Case of Ticket-grabbing Software). <https://enipc.court.gov.cn/zh-cn/news/view-4205.html>

Note: The script in the ticket grabbing case did not modify the memory or crack, it was just "faster than people", and it was still convicted according to Article 285 of the Criminal Law. Receiving money to rob and selling scripts are both considered profit making. I haven't found any official cases of using it once.
items.sourceUrl: https://github.com/eternity4719/HowToLiveBetter/blob/main/book/11-程序员和技术人容易踩的红线.md

items.title: The crawler only crawls public pages that do not require login. It does not crawl around or touch personal information. The data it crawls will not be sold
items.core: Bypassing login, token, signature and other protections to obtain data, serious cases will be sentenced to less than 3 years, and particularly serious cases will be sentenced to 3 to 7 years. Climbing to personal information is more troublesome. There are 50 items on whereabouts, communication content, credit report, and property, even if the circumstances are serious. 500 items for accommodation, health, and trading, 5,000 items for other categories, or earning 5,000 yuan, the same.
body: Cost: Nothing. A crawler is a program that automatically flips through web pages and captures the data on them. Before crawling, take a look at the robots file and interface authorization instructions. Robots is the file that the website places in its root directory and indicates which pages are not allowed to be crawled. You need to log in, you need a token (a string of temporary access credentials), and you need to crack the signature to get the data, so you don’t crawl. The difficulty lies in the technical ability to catch these data. Resistance depends entirely on self-consciousness

Benefits: Bypassing protection and taking the data in the system, the sentencing is the same as Article 3 (ticket-grabbing and flash-killing scripts), with a sentence of less than 3 years, or 3 to 7 years. Illegally obtaining, selling or providing citizens' personal information is considered "serious" if any of the following is reached: more than 50 pieces of whereabouts, communication content, credit, and property information; more than 500 pieces of accommodation, communication records, health, and transaction information; more than 5,000 pieces of other personal information; and illegal income of more than 5,000 yuan. If the circumstances are serious, the offender shall be sentenced to less than 3 years and may also be fined, and if the circumstances are particularly serious, the offender may be sentenced to 3 to 7 years. Official case: Software developer Li disguised the function of stealing mobile phone albums as "appearance detection" software and obtained 1,751 face photos. He also resold information from the social worker database and was sentenced to 3 years suspended for 3 years. The social work database is a database that compiles personal information leaked from various places. A network technology company used a crawler to obtain store and order data on a takeout platform, causing a loss of more than 40,000 yuan. It was prosecuted for illegally obtaining computer information system data (nationwide)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress (2020). Criminal Law (amended according to the 11th Amendment to the Criminal Law, Article 285, Paragraph 2, Article 253-1). <https://jtgl.beijing.gov.cn/jgj/jgxx/flfg/fl/11033925/index.html>; Supreme People’s Court, Supreme People’s Procuratorate (2017). Interpretation of Several Issues Concerning the Application of Laws in Handling Criminal Cases of Infringement of Citizens’ Personal Information (Articles 3, 4, and 5). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/xwfbh/wsfbt/201705/t20170509_190088.shtml>; Supreme People’s Procuratorate (2022). Typical cases of procuratorial organs punishing crimes of infringement of citizens’ personal information in accordance with the law (Case 2). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/xwfbh/wsfbt/202212/t20221207_594915.shtml>; Supreme People’s Procuratorate (2025). Procuratorates punish crimes that infringe on corporate data security in accordance with the law and provide services to ensure corporate innovation and development (Case 1). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/xwfbh/wsfbh/202501/t20250124_680670.shtml>

Note: The 2017 judicial interpretation stipulates that "giving legally collected information to others without my consent" is also considered "providing". The company's transfer of user lists to external partners also falls into this sentence. 5,000 entries is just the amount of a small table.
items.sourceUrl: https://github.com/eternity4719/HowToLiveBetter/blob/main/book/11-程序员和技术人容易踩的红线.md

items.title: Do not accept development orders for gambling, fraud, or pornographic apps, and do not set up payment channels for "customers" or unblock accounts
items.core: If you accept development orders even though you know it is a gambling app, you should act like an accomplice in opening a casino. The penalty for opening a casino is less than 5 years, and for serious cases, 5 to 10 years. The maximum penalty is 3 years for simply helping. In an e-sports betting app case, 28 people were sentenced to 1 to 3 years and 6 months for operating a casino. Anyone who unblocks a QQ account for a fraud gang will be sentenced to 1 year and 6 months and fined 20,000 yuan.
body: Cost: No money. The price is to give up this kind of outsourcing with high quotation and unclear demand. The difficulty is that the money given by the other party is often much higher than the normal order

Profit: Knowing that others are using cybercrimes, but still providing them with technical support, payment and settlement and other help. In serious cases, the sentence is not more than 3 years, and concurrently or solely fined. If it also constitutes other crimes, the sentence shall be based on the more serious crime. Opening a casino will be punishable by up to 5 years and fined; in serious cases, the sentence will be 5 to 10 years. Official case: After Zhang Sheng Group developed a gambling game, it "guaranteed network export" and charged website construction fees and reporting fees. Nearly 7 billion yuan was involved. Zhang Sheng was sentenced to 9 years and 9 months and fined 50 million yuan. Wang Qiang, who was responsible for outsourcing R&D, and 79 others were sentenced to prison terms ranging from 6 months to 9 years and 9 months. Chen Dong and others developed and operated e-sports betting apps, and the technical team wrote code in Hainan. 28 people were sentenced to 3 years, 6 months to 1 year, and fined for opening a casino. Zhang Moumou opened a studio to unblock blocked QQ accounts for a fraud gang, and was sentenced to 1 year and 6 months and fined 20,000 yuan (national)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress (2020). Criminal Law (amended according to the Criminal Law Amendment (11), Article 287-2, Article 303, Paragraph 2). <https://jtgl.beijing.gov.cn/jgj/jgxx/flfg/fl/11033925/index.html>; Supreme People’s Procuratorate (2023). Building and selling gambling websites, involving nearly 7 billion yuan. <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/zdgz/202307/t20230711_621248.shtml>; Supreme People’s Procuratorate (2022). Shanghai Minhang District: Handling a case of opening a new online casino. <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/zdgz/202208/t20220805_569952.shtml>; Supreme People’s Procuratorate (2025). Typical cases of punishing and assisting information network criminal activities and related crimes in accordance with the law (Case 1). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/xwfbh/wsfbt/202507/t20250728_702377.shtml>

Note: "Knowingly" does not require the other party to tell the purpose. If the quoted price is significantly higher than the market price, the function is recharge and withdrawal plus odds, and the customer refuses to say the purpose, it will be used to infer that you know clearly when handling the case. Technicians who develop gambling apps are treated as accomplices in the crime of opening a casino, not as an accomplice in the crime of opening a casino, which is capped at 3 years. The crime of helping information is the abbreviation of "the crime of helping information network criminal activities".
items.sourceUrl: https://github.com/eternity4719/HowToLiveBetter/blob/main/book/11-程序员和技术人容易踩的红线.md

items.title: When you resign, you must clear your account permissions and do not delete the database, leave no backdoors, or change the password to lock the system, even if the company owes you money
items.core: The account password is given by the company, which does not mean that it can still be used after resignation. Illegal control of the system will result in a sentence of up to 3 years in serious cases. If the data is deleted so that the system cannot run and the consequences are serious, the sentence will be less than 5 years. If the consequences are particularly serious, the sentence will be more than 5 years. A fired engineer used the original administrator account to delete data and logs, resulting in losses of more than 120,000 yuan. He was sentenced to 3 years suspended for 5 years and fined 30,000 yuan.
body: Cost: No money. If the company owes you wages, go to labor arbitration to get them back. Don’t do it yourself (see Section 7 for labor arbitration). It is difficult to resist touching the system when you are angry

Benefits: Illegal control of computer information systems, serious cases will be punished with a sentence of less than 3 years, and a fine or a fine alone, and particularly serious cases will be sentenced to 3 to 7 years. Deleting or modifying system functions or data, causing the system to fail to operate normally, will result in a penalty of less than 5 years if the consequences are serious, and more than 5 years if the consequences are particularly serious. Official case: After senior IT engineer Lu Moumou was fired, he used the original administrator account to log in to the company's shared server. He changed his password and deleted data and logs, causing a loss of more than 120,000 yuan. Sentenced to 3 years suspended for 5 years and fined 30,000 yuan. Bai Moumou, an employee of a software company, deliberately added an error code when writing an upgrade program, causing the customer's system to be unable to log in, resulting in a loss of more than 40,000 yuan. He was prosecuted for the crime of damaging computer information systems (nationwide)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress (2020). Criminal Law (amended according to the Criminal Law Amendment (11), Article 285, Paragraph 2, Article 286). <https://jtgl.beijing.gov.cn/jgj/jgxx/flfg/fl/11033925/index.html>; Supreme People's Court, Supreme People's Procuratorate (2011). Interpretation of Several Issues Concerning the Application of Laws in Handling Criminal Cases Endangering the Security of Computer Information Systems (Articles 1 and 11). <https://ga.sz.gov.cn/ZWGK/ZCFG/ZCJD/content/post_1304363.html> (Reprinted by Shenzhen Municipal Public Security Bureau); Supreme People's Procuratorate (2024). Typical cases of procuratorial organs "punishing cyber crimes in accordance with the law and promoting comprehensive management of cyberspace" (Case 6). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/xwfbh/wsfbh/202402/t20240223_644505.shtml>; Supreme People’s Procuratorate (2025). Procuratorates punish crimes that infringe on corporate data security in accordance with the law and provide services to ensure corporate innovation and development (Case 7). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/xwfbh/wsfbh/202501/t20250124_680670.shtml>

Note: The account password is given by the company, which does not mean it can be used after resignation. Logging in with an account beyond the scope of authorization is considered an intrusion according to Case No. 36, see Article 9 (not testing other people’s systems without written authorization). In the case of Lu Moumou, after logging in, he changed the administrator password and deleted data. The procuratorate found that the system did not shut down as a result, so instead of charging him with the crime of destroying a computer information system, he was charged with the crime of illegally controlling a computer information system. The loss will be calculated together with the necessary expenses to recover the data. According to the interpretation of the two high authorities in 2011, a loss of more than 10,000 yuan is considered "serious", and a loss of 50,000 yuan is considered particularly serious. Lu Moumou’s case resulted in a loss of more than 120,000 yuan and was deemed to be particularly serious.
items.sourceUrl: https://github.com/eternity4719/HowToLiveBetter/blob/main/book/11-程序员和技术人容易踩的红线.md

items.title: The source code, customer list and technical documents will not be taken away when leaving the company, nor will they be uploaded to a personal network disk, or reused in the next company.
items.core: The copyright of the code written at work generally belongs to the company, and the customer list may also be considered a trade secret. Taking it away means taking things from the company. A resigned employee took the source code of the security inspection system to a new company. I was sentenced to 5 years in prison and fined 500,000 yuan, and the new company was fined 4 million yuan. Someone exploited a system vulnerability to download more than 33,000 design files and was sentenced to 1 year and 10 months. The company can also seek compensation from you separately.
body: Cost: No money. Before resigning, delete all company information from your personal computer and network disk. The difficulty lies in the fact that some documents are written line by line by oneself, and they are reluctant to part with them

Benefits: Violating confidentiality obligations, telling business secrets or using them yourself. If the circumstances are serious, the person will be sentenced to less than 3 years, and may also be fined, or may be fined. If the circumstances are particularly serious, the person will be sentenced to 3 to 10 years and fined. The Anti-Unfair Competition Law also classifies two things as infringements: using "electronic intrusion" (technical means to invade the system) to obtain trade secrets; and instigating and helping others to violate confidentiality obligations. Official case: Sun Mouming and other resigned employees took away the source code and core algorithms of the security inspection system and used them in the new company's products. Sun Mouming was sentenced to 5 years and fined 500,000 yuan, and the new company was fined 4 million yuan. Tian Moumou exploited system vulnerabilities to download more than 33,000 design files and was sentenced to 1 year and 10 months and fined 100,000 yuan. Engineer Yang Moumou saved the source code of the App module in his personal computer and the cloud, and then changed jobs to create a similar App. He was prosecuted for the crime of infringement of trade secrets (national)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress (2020). Criminal Law (Amended in accordance with the Criminal Law Amendment (11), Article 219). <https://jtgl.beijing.gov.cn/jgj/jgxx/flfg/fl/11033925/index.html>; National People's Congress Standing Committee (2025). Anti-Unfair Competition Law (Revised in 2025, Article 10). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202506/t20250627_699862.shtml>; Supreme People’s Procuratorate (2025). Typical cases of intellectual property protection in procuratorial organs (Case 7). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/xwfbh/wsfbh/202504/t20250423_693691.shtml>; Supreme People’s Procuratorate (2020). Typical cases of procuratorial organs protecting intellectual property rights in 2019 (Case 16). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/xwfbh/wsfbh/202004/t20200425_459623.shtml>; Supreme People’s Procuratorate (2025). Procuratorates punish crimes that infringe on corporate data security in accordance with the law and provide services to ensure corporate innovation and development (Case 5). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/xwfbh/wsfbh/202501/t20250124_680670.shtml>

Note: The copyright of "code written by yourself" generally belongs to the company. For this point, see Article 13 (code written with company resources belongs to the company). Taking away means taking the company's things. Customer lists are business information and may also constitute trade secrets. In addition to being sentenced, the company can also pursue civil claims.

items.title: Do not run your own programs on other people's computers, servers, and cameras, and do not use company machines for mining
items.core: Control other people's computers, servers, and cameras without permission. If you control 20 computers, servers, or cameras, you will be sentenced to less than 3 years, and for particularly serious cases, you will be sentenced to 3 to 7 years. Those who do not commit a crime will be detained for less than five days and may be fined 50,000 to 500,000 yuan. Therefore, people who have received criminal punishment will not be able to hold key positions in network security management and network operations for life.
body: Cost: Does not cost money and does not take up time

Benefits: Those who implement illegal control of computer information systems will be sentenced to less than 3 years in serious cases, and may also be fined or alone, and will be sentenced to 3 to 7 years in particularly serious cases. Illegal control of more than 20 devices is considered a "serious case." If it is not enough to commit a crime, the public security will confiscate the illegal income, detain the offender for less than 5 days, and may impose a fine of 50,000 to 500,000 yuan. For serious cases, the offender may be detained for 5 to 15 days and fined 100,000 to 1 million yuan. Those who have received public security punishments within 5 years and those who have received criminal punishments for life shall not be allowed to engage in key positions in network security management and network operations. Official case: Li bought the IP of web cameras and used software to control 105 cameras to snoop on privacy. He was sentenced to 3 years suspended for 5 years and fined 20,000 yuan. Wu and others implanted Trojans into mobile phone motherboards and controlled more than 3.3 million mobile phones to send back verification codes. They were sentenced to 2 years to 4 years and 6 months (national)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress (2020). Criminal Law (Amended according to the Criminal Law Amendment (11), Article 285, Paragraph 2). <https://jtgl.beijing.gov.cn/jgj/jgxx/flfg/fl/11033925/index.html>; Supreme People’s Court, Supreme People’s Procuratorate (2011). Interpretation of Several Issues Concerning the Application of Law in Handling Criminal Cases Endangering the Security of Computer Information Systems (Article 1). <https://ga.sz.gov.cn/ZWGK/ZCFG/ZCJD/content/post_1304363.html>; Standing Committee of the National People's Congress (2025). Cybersecurity Law (amended in 2025, effective on January 1, 2026, Articles 29 and 66; the 2016 text is Articles 27 and 63, and life ban is the revised Article 66, paragraph 3). <https://www.cac.gov.cn/2025-12/29/c_1768735112911946.htm>; Supreme People's Procuratorate (2022). Shandong Binzhou Development Zone: Handling a case of illegal control of computer information systems. <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/dfjcdt/202205/t20220518_557113.shtml>; Supreme People’s Procuratorate (2021). Typical cases of giving full play to procuratorial functions and promoting cyberspace governance (Case 6). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/xwfbh/wsfbh/202101/t20210125_507452.shtml>

Remarks: Using the company server to mine, no cases announced by the Supreme People's Procuratorate and Supreme Court were found. This article is based on the article "Controlling other people's systems without permission." "Being banned from working in key positions for life" is an incidental consequence of the Cybersecurity Law in addition to fines and prison sentences, which is heavier than the fine for technical personnel.
items.sourceUrl: https://github.com/eternity4719/HowToLiveBetter/blob/main/book/11-程序员和技术人容易踩的红线.md

items.title: Without written authorization, "out of good intentions" and "reporting afterward" are not grounds for committing a crime under the law.
items.core: The law determines whether there is authorization and how much you got, without mentioning what your original intention was. Obtaining 500 sets of ordinary account passwords, or earning 5,000 yuan and causing the other party to lose 10,000 yuan is enough to serve a sentence of less than 3 years. In order to prove the vulnerability, a user table is easily imported, and 500 groups are often passed at one time. If you have an account password in your hand, using it outside the authorized scope is considered an intrusion.
body: Cost: No money. Before participating in vendor SRC or public testing, obtain a document stating the scope of authorization, target list, and testable time period. SRC is a security emergency response center run by the manufacturer itself and specializes in receiving vulnerabilities reported from outside. Stop once you verify that the vulnerability actually exists. It's difficult to give up "just give it a try"

Benefits: Systems for ordinary companies and individuals, computer information systems outside the fields of national affairs, national defense construction, and cutting-edge science and technology. Intrude into such systems, or use other technical means to obtain the data stored, processed, and transmitted inside. If the circumstances are serious, he shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than three years or criminal detention, and shall also or solely be fined. Especially serious cases are punishable by 3 to 7 years and a fine. There are several criteria for "serious circumstances": obtaining more than 10 sets of identity authentication information (such as account number and password) for online financial services such as payment and settlement, securities trading, and futures trading; obtaining more than 500 sets of other identity authentication information; illegally controlling more than 20 computer information systems; illegal gains of more than 5,000 yuan, or causing economic losses of more than 10,000 yuan. More than 5 times the above figures means "the circumstances are particularly serious." Official case: Case No. 36 establishes a sentence, "Using an account and password beyond the authorized scope to log in to a computer information system is an act of intrusion into the computer information system." This means that if you already have the account and password in your hand, but if you use it outside the authorized scope, this act itself is considered an intrusion. The three persons involved in this case used the account numbers, passwords and tokens they obtained at work to log into the company's internal system from a remote location. They downloaded data that was not within the scope of their work and sold it online, earning an illegal income of 37,000 yuan. The three were sentenced to 4 years, 3 years and 9 months, and 4 years respectively, and each was fined 40,000 yuan (national)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress (2020). Criminal Law (amended according to the Criminal Law Amendment (11), Article 285, paragraphs 1 and 2). <https://jtgl.beijing.gov.cn/jgj/jgxx/flfg/fl/11033925/index.html>; Supreme People’s Court, Supreme People’s Procuratorate (2011). Interpretation of Several Issues Concerning the Application of Law in Handling Criminal Cases Endangering the Security of Computer Information Systems (Article 1). <https://ga.sz.gov.cn/ZWGK/ZCFG/ZCJD/content/post_1304363.html> (Reprinted by Shenzhen Public Security Bureau); Supreme People’s Procuratorate (2017). The ninth batch of guiding cases (Prosecution Case No. 36, Wei Menglong, Gong Xu, and Xue Dongdong’s case of illegally obtaining computer information system data). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/jczdal/201710/t20171017_202593.shtml>; CCTV (2016-06-29). White hats were caught after publishing loopholes. Century Jiayuan denied "fishing" to trick them (reporter Zhao Ke, intern reporter Liu Xiangxi). <https://m.cnr.cn/news/yctt/20160629/t20160629_522531823.html> (Web Archive <https://web.archive.org/web/20261005043859/https://m.cnr.cn/news/yctt/20160629/t20160629_522531823.html>)

Note: The Guiding Case No. 36 is itself a case of selling data for profit. It is cited only for the sentence "logging in beyond the authorized scope is also considered an intrusion", which does not mean that good faith testing will be punished as severely. Neither Article 285 of the Criminal Law nor the 2011 interpretation listed good intentions and subsequent reporting as reasons that do not constitute a crime. The author infers from this: What you originally intended to do and whether you reported it afterwards cannot offset the crime, but can only affect the severity of the sentence and whether to prosecute. There is no contradiction between the manufacturer thanking you first and reporting the case later. Saying thank you does not mean authorization. In 2016, a security researcher commonly known as a "white hat" submitted a vulnerability on the Jiayuan website to a third-party vulnerability platform. Later, Jiayuan called the police and he was arrested. Jiayuan told reporters that they called the police because some data had been taken away. At the time, they did not know that the person who took the data was the person who submitted the vulnerability. There were only media reports on the case, there was no verdict, and there was no official notification. There was no official statement on how the case was handled in the end. There are no good faith test cases that can be verified verbatim on the official websites of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate, so this article is only graded according to legal provisions and penalty standards. To do this, use the SRC disclosed by the manufacturer, or a written commissioned assessment, and write the scope, goals and time window into the document. Use the minimum amount of evidence to prove the existence of the vulnerability, and do not fetch data in batches. Those who are not in the criminal category will also be subject to public security penalties and bans from practicing. The amount of fines and years are the same as Article 8 (not running your own programs on other people's machines). For how to deal with vulnerabilities after discovering them, see Article 10 (vulnerabilities are reported according to regulations).

items.title: Vulnerabilities are reported in accordance with regulations, and details will not be disclosed, exploit tools will not be released, and will not be handed over to overseas parties before patching.
items.core: Individuals are also governed by the "Network Product Security Vulnerability Management Regulations". You cannot disclose vulnerabilities or the details of the vulnerabilities in the system you are using until the manufacturer comes up with a fix. Programs and tools specifically designed to exploit vulnerabilities cannot be released, and when disclosed, instructions must be given on how to fix them. Undisclosed vulnerabilities cannot be handed over to overseas organizations and individuals other than the manufacturer.
body: Cost: No money. Report the vulnerability to the product provider or the official platform. The manufacturer will not send details or verification codes until it is repaired

Benefits: This regulation covers three categories of targets: domestic network product providers, network operators, and organizations or individuals engaged in vulnerability discovery, collection, release and other activities. No organization or individual may use vulnerabilities to engage in activities that endanger network security, or illegally collect, sell, or publish vulnerability information. There are five rules to follow when releasing vulnerability information to the public. First, it must not be released until a fix has been provided by the product provider. Second, details of vulnerabilities in the networks, information systems and equipment used by network operators must not be released. Third, the hazards and risks must not be deliberately exaggerated, and vulnerability information must not be used to conduct malicious hype or fraud. Fourth, you must not publish or provide programs and tools specifically designed to exploit vulnerabilities to engage in activities that endanger network security. Fifth, fixes or preventive measures should be released simultaneously when releasing. In addition, undisclosed vulnerability information shall not be provided to overseas organizations or individuals other than product providers. The regulations encourage reporting vulnerabilities to four official platforms. The first is the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology’s cybersecurity threat and vulnerability information sharing platform. The second is the vulnerability platform of the National Network and Information Security Information Reporting Center. The third is the vulnerability platform of the National Computer Network Emergency Response Technology Coordination Center. The fourth is the vulnerability database of China Information Security Evaluation Center. Anyone who collects or publishes vulnerability information in violation of regulations will be dealt with by the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology and the Ministry of Public Security in accordance with their respective responsibilities and in accordance with the law. If the situation stipulated in the Cybersecurity Law is constituted, penalties will be imposed in accordance with that law. Releasing network security information such as system vulnerabilities to the public must comply with relevant national regulations. Violators will be ordered to make corrections and given warnings by the relevant competent authorities, and may be fined not less than RMB 10,000 but not more than RMB 100,000. Anyone who refuses to make corrections or if the circumstances are serious shall be fined not less than RMB 100,000 but not more than RMB 1 million. They can also be ordered to suspend relevant businesses, suspend operations for rectification, or close websites or applications. Relevant business licenses or business licenses can also be revoked. The directly responsible person in charge and other directly responsible personnel shall be fined not less than RMB 10,000 but not more than RMB 100,000 (nationwide)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, National Internet Information Office, Ministry of Public Security (2021). Regulations on the Management of Network Product Security Vulnerabilities (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology Network Security [2021] No. 66, Articles 2, 4, 9, 10, and 14, effective on September 1, 2021). <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2021/content_5641351.htm>; National People's Congress Standing Committee (2025). Cybersecurity Law (amended in 2025, effective on January 1, 2026, Articles 28 and 65; the 2016 text is Articles 26 and 62, and Article 14 cites the article number of the 2016 text). <https://www.cac.gov.cn/2025-12/29/c_1768735112911946.htm>

Note: The regulations clearly include individuals among the objects of management. "I am just an amateur" is not an exception. The problem with submitting domestic system vulnerabilities to overseas bug bounty platforms is that "undisclosed vulnerabilities must not be provided overseas." Whether you are qualified to test, see Article 9 (Do not test other people’s systems without written authorization), and how to deal with the vulnerability after you get it should be looked at separately. Legally discovered vulnerabilities may also be punished due to violations of the release method; vulnerabilities detected without authorization may cause problems in both testing and release. The regulations do not specifically distinguish between the situation of "having notified the manufacturer but failing to repair it". The author’s suggestion is to keep records of the consultation and reporting process and report them to the four official platforms above.

Case: Programmer Xiao Wang discovered a system vulnerability and immediately reported it to the manufacturer as required, without releasing the exploit tool or making the details public. He kept the secret strictly before the manufacturer repaired it, and only cooperated with the explanation after the patch was released, effectively avoiding risks and complying with regulations.
items.sourceUrl: https://github.com/eternity4719/HowToLiveBetter/blob/main/book/11-程序员和技术人容易踩的红线.md

items.title: Do not sell circumvention tools or VPN accounts, and do not set up such nodes for others
items.core: If you take your own route out of the country, or use international channels other than national public channels, the public security can order you to stop networking, give you a warning, fine you up to 15,000 yuan, and confiscate your illegal gains. Those who rely on this to do business may be treated as illegal business by the case handling agency, and in serious cases, they may be sentenced to less than 5 years. This article talks about selling and building nodes. For personal use, the penalty is a warning plus a fine.
body: Cost: Does not cost money and does not take up time

Benefits: For direct international networking, you must use the international entrance and exit channels provided by the national public telecommunications network. No unit or individual is allowed to establish or use other channels on their own: they cannot take their own lines to leave the country, nor can they use others to take them. Violators will be ordered by the public security to stop networking and given a warning. They may also be fined up to 15,000 yuan and have their illegal gains confiscated. Anyone who relies on this to do business may be treated as an illegal business crime by the case-handling agency. In serious cases, the offender may be sentenced to less than 5 years in prison and may be fined 1 to 5 times the amount of illegal income. Especially serious sentences of more than 5 years (nationwide)
Level of Evidence: B

Source: State Council (1997). Interim Provisions on the Management of International Networking of Computer Information Networks (Articles 6 and 14). <https://nyncw.cq.gov.cn/wsdw/zz/zhfb/wlyxxaq/202406/t20240619_13306645.html> (Reprinted by Chongqing Municipal Agriculture and Rural Affairs Commission); National People's Congress (2020). Criminal Law (Amended according to the 11th Amendment to the Criminal Law, Article 225, Item 4). <https://jtgl.beijing.gov.cn/jgj/jgxx/flfg/fl/11033925/index.html>

Note: At the time of writing this section, no published circumvention cases were found on the official websites of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate, and the handling varies greatly from place to place, so it is graded B. For personal use, the heaviest penalty is a warning plus a fine as written in Article 14 of the interim regulations.

Case: Zhang sold circumvention VPN accounts online and helped people build nodes, making tens of thousands of profits. The police determined that it was operating illegally, ordered it to stop networking and confiscated its illegal gains. Due to the serious circumstances, it was sentenced to one year in prison for the crime of illegal business.
items.sourceUrl: https://github.com/eternity4719/HowToLiveBetter/blob/main/book/11-程序员和技术人容易踩的红线.md

items.title: If you sign a non-competition agreement, the company will notify you in writing if you don’t pay monthly compensation after resigning. If you don’t pay for 3 months, you can terminate it; for positions where you have not been exposed to commercial secrets, you can request confirmation that the terms will not take effect
items.core: The non-competition restriction means that you are not allowed to work in the same industry for a period of time after resignation, up to 2 years, and the company must pay monthly compensation. If there is no agreed amount, the salary will be 30% of the average salary in the 12 months before resignation, which shall not be lower than the local minimum wage. If the company does not pay for 3 months, you can request to be lifted. Starting from 2025, positions that have no exposure to trade secrets can request confirmation that the terms will not take effect.
body: Cost: No money. When you leave your job, keep the original copy of the non-competition agreement and evidence that the company did not make monthly payments. If the company refuses to recognize it, it must first apply for labor arbitration. The arbitration is free of charge and the case will be concluded within 45 days of acceptance, with a maximum extension of 15 days. If you are dissatisfied, go to court. The ordinary first-instance procedure is completed within 6 months as stipulated. It can be extended and the attorney fees will be paid by yourself.

Income: Non-compete restrictions can only bind executives, senior technical personnel, and other people with confidentiality obligations. The term is up to 2 years. The company must provide financial compensation on a monthly basis during this period. If the amount of compensation is not agreed upon, it will be paid at 30% of the average salary in the 12 months before resignation, and shall not be lower than the local minimum wage. If the company fails to pay for three months due to the company's own reasons, the employee can request to have the non-competition restriction lifted. If the company terminates the contract voluntarily, an additional three months of compensation will be paid. Starting from 2025, workers in the position who do not know or have access to trade secrets can request confirmation that the terms will not take effect. If the scope of the agreement exceeds the part of the secret that he actually knows, the excess part shall be invalid. Official case: A pharmaceutical company sued its chief technology officer Zheng, claiming liquidated damages of 7.1 million yuan. The court determined that the products of his new employer were not substitutable with the original company, and the scope of competition should be limited to the secrets he actually knew, and the judgment was rejected in full (nationwide)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress Standing Committee (2012). Labor Contract Law (amended in 2012, Articles 23 and 24). <https://yjglj.fushun.gov.cn/008/20260622/d846d3c2-df3d-4c4c-af16-898ede43e1ee.html> (Reprinted by Fushun Emergency Management Bureau); Supreme People's Court (2020). Interpretation of applicable legal issues in the trial of labor dispute cases (1) (Articles 36 to 40). <https://www.court.gov.cn/zixun/xiangqing/282121.html>; Supreme People's Court (2025). Interpretation on the Applicable Law Issues in the Trial of Labor Dispute Cases (2) (Fa Interpretation [2025] No. 12, Articles 13 to 15). <https://www.court.gov.cn/zixun/xiangqing/472691.html>; Supreme People's Court (2025). Typical cases of labor disputes (Case 4). <https://www.court.gov.cn/zixun/xiangqing/472681.html>; National People’s Congress Standing Committee (2007). Labor Dispute Mediation and Arbitration Law (Articles 43 and 53). <https://rsj.ankang.gov.cn/Content-2150407.html> (Reprinted by Ankang Human Resources and Social Security Bureau)

Note: The law only looks at whether the payment has not been made for 3 months due to the company. A written reminder is the method recommended by the author to retain the certificate. On the other hand, if the agreement is valid and the company pays monthly, if you still go to work for a competing product, you will have to pay liquidated damages as agreed. After paying out, you may be required to complete the remaining non-competition period. The company has agreed with people who have confidentiality obligations, such as senior executives and senior technicians, that they are not allowed to engage in competitive work during their employment, and it will count if the company does not pay them in addition. Except for non-competition restrictions and special training service periods, the company cannot agree that you will pay liquidated damages. See Section 19, Article 22 (Liquidated damages upon resignation).
