For direct sales to consumers, unless the standard clearly allows for omission, the label must indicate the name, specifications, net content, production date, ingredients or ingredient list, producer's name, address, contact information, and shelf life. There are also product standard codes, storage conditions, common names of food additives used in national standards, and production license numbers. If laws, regulations or food safety standards require additional labeling, they must also be labeled. When selling bulk food, the name, production date or production batch number, and shelf life must also be marked on the containers and outer packaging. The name, address, contact information and other contents of the producer and operator must also be marked. If the prepackaged food produced or sold does not have labels, or the labels and instructions do not comply with the provisions of this law, the money earned will be confiscated together with the food. If the total amount of the goods calculated based on the selling price (the value of the goods) is less than 10,000 yuan, an additional fine of not less than 5,000 yuan but not more than 50,000 yuan will be imposed. If the value of the goods exceeds RMB 10,000, a fine of not less than 5 times but not more than 10 times the value of the goods will be imposed. In serious cases, production and business operations may be suspended until the license is withdrawn. If there are only minor flaws (defects) in labels and instructions that neither affect food safety nor cause misunderstanding by consumers, they will be ordered to correct them first. If you refuse to change your behavior, you will be fined no more than 2,000 yuan. The new version of "General Principles for Labeling of Prepackaged Foods" No. GB ​​7718-2025 was released on March 16, 2025. It will be implemented from March 16, 2027, with a two-year transition period. The new version also includes food that is prepackaged and sold by weight or number of pieces, but catering food, ready-made and ready-to-sell food, etc. are still not applicable. The new version requires a separate area on the packaging to display both the production date and the shelf life expiration date. Dates should use high-contrast, easy-to-read fonts and colors, and be arranged in the order of year-month-day (nationwide)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress Standing Committee (third amendment in 2025). Food Safety Law (Articles 67, 68, 125). <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=7b5a76d0461745a08d3f964916b87ef3>; Ministry of Health (2011). National Food Safety Standards General Principles for Prepackaged Food Labeling (GB 7718-2011, Articles 1, 2.1, 4.1, 4.3). <https://www.nhc.gov.cn/zwgkzt/psp/201106/51950/files/e84256474d1445919246b4a41a87f172.pdf>; National Health Commission (2025). "National Food Safety Standard General Principles for Labeling of Prepackaged Foods" (GB 7718-2025) Q&A (Second and Third Questions, Scope Changes and Inapplicability). <https://www.nhc.gov.cn/sps/c100087/202509/bc824a504ec34c27883da73f14c20d44.shtml>; National Health Commission, State Administration for Market Regulation (2025). Regarding the release of the "National Food Safety Standards General Principles for Prepackaged Food Labeling" (GB 7718-2025), etc. 50 Announcement of 9 national food safety standards and 9 amendments (No. 2, 2025). <https://jkw.lasa.gov.cn/wswyh/wjzl/202504/a90766908ef24869a74f7373bf42463f.shtml> (Full text of the announcement reprinted by Lhasa Municipal Health Commission); Supreme People's Court (2024). Interpretation of Several Issues Concerning the Applicable Law in the Trial of Food and Drug Punitive Damage Dispute Cases (Fashi [2024] No. 9, Articles 6 and 8). <http://gongbao.court.gov.cn/Details/bf531a70471f10d377788f28d3d8f8.html> (Binning of label defects and missing required items); Beijing Municipal Administration for Market Regulation (2026). Can't find the production date? Food labels need to "change their face"! These key points of the new regulations must be read. <https://scjgj.beijing.gov.cn/zwxx/scjgdt/202605/t20260507_4639154.html> (New requirements for implementation date, transition period and date display)

Note: There are two types of labeling problems, and the amount of fines and compensations will follow this division. One is minor problems, such as typos and irregular font sizes, which neither affect food safety nor cause misunderstanding. This kind of market supervision department will only let you change it, but if you refuse to change it will fine you less than 2,000 yuan, and the buyer will have to pay less than ten times. The other is that the subject is not marked according to the law, for example, the production date and shelf life are omitted and cannot be omitted. The judicial interpretation clearly stated that this was not a minor problem. Fines are calculated based on the value of the goods. If the amount is less than 10,000 yuan, the fine will be 5,000 yuan to 50,000 yuan. If the amount is more than 10,000 yuan, the fine will be 5 to 10 times the value of the goods. Moreover, the buyer can also ask you for compensation ten times the price of the food. If the price is less than one thousand yuan, it will be calculated as one thousand yuan (see Section 5, Article 31, Ten Times Compensation for Food). The current standards have provisions for omitting items for some foods and very small packages, which must be checked by product. GB 7718-2025 has not yet been officially implemented, and the expanded scope of the new version cannot be regarded as the current definition. The specific format shall be subject to the original text of the applicable standard.

Case: Aunt Li bought a bag of braised dried beans that had been packed in advance and marked "500 grams" at a community store. When she got home, she found that only the product name was printed but not the production date and ingredient list. After verification, the Market Supervision Bureau determined that the label of the pre-packaged food was missing, the value of the goods was 800 yuan, and a fine of 8,000 yuan was imposed according to law.

items.title: Ordinary foods are not allowed to say that they can cure diseases: labels, instructions, advertisements, and live-streaming speeches all count
items.core: The labels, instructions, and advertisements of ordinary foods cannot say that they can prevent and cure diseases. Except for advertisements in the three categories of medical care, medicine, and medical equipment, other advertisements are not allowed to claim that they can cure diseases, nor are they allowed to use words that sound like medicine. The fine is 1 to 3 times the advertising fee, and the fine is 100,000 to 200,000 yuan if the advertising fee is not included. In serious cases, the business license may be revoked.
body: Cost: No money. Go through the slogan, product details page and live broadcast. The hard thing is to resist saying things like "reduce the three highs" and "cure constipation".

Income: Food Safety Law: "Labels and instructions for food and food additives must not contain false content, and must not involve disease prevention or treatment functions. Producers and operators are responsible for the content of the labels and instructions they provide." "The content of food advertisements should be true and legal, and must not contain false content, or involve disease prevention or treatment functions. Food producers and operators are responsible for the authenticity and legality of food advertising content." This means that packaging, instructions, and advertisements cannot say that they can prevent and cure diseases. The seller is solely responsible for what is written. Those who brag about food and deceive consumers in advertisements will be punished according to the advertising law. There is also a prohibition in advertising law. "Except for advertisements for medical treatments, drugs, and medical devices, any other advertisements involving disease treatment functions are prohibited, and medical terms or terms that are likely to confuse the products being promoted with drugs or medical devices are prohibited." Except for advertisements in the three categories of medical treatment, medicines, and medical equipment, other advertisements are not allowed to say that they can cure diseases, nor are they allowed to use words that sound like medicine or medical equipment. Anyone who violates this provision will be ordered to stop advertising. The party that sent the advertisement (the advertiser) must also publicly clarify and eliminate the impact within the scope of the advertisement. A fine of not less than 1 time but not more than 3 times of the advertising cost will be imposed. If the advertising expenses cannot be calculated, or the reported amount is obviously low, a fine of not less than 100,000 yuan but not more than 200,000 yuan will be imposed. If the circumstances are serious, a fine of not less than 3 times but not more than 5 times of the advertising fee may be imposed, or a fine of not less than 200,000 yuan but not more than 1 million yuan. The business license can also be revoked, and the business will be impossible to do (nationwide)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress Standing Committee (third amendment in 2025). Food Safety Law (Articles 71, 73, 125, 140). <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=7b5a76d0461745a08d3f964916b87ef3>; National People’s Congress Standing Committee (revised in 2021). Advertising Law (Articles 17 and 58). <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=ff8081817ab231eb017abd6bd860052d>

Note: "Health functions" cannot be said about ordinary foods. The health functions that health food can claim can only come from the national catalogue, and the products must go through registration or filing. Ordinary foods do not have this procedure. How buyers identify this type of rhetoric, see Section 6, Item 10 (Don’t spend a lot of money on health care products to take care of your body). In addition to packaging and advertising, detail pages, live broadcast words, and Moments copywriting are also considered advertising content, and they leave traces when distributed.

Case: When a company was selling ordinary red dates in a live broadcast, the anchor claimed that the product could "supplement blood, cure anemia, and cure insomnia." After receiving the report, the Market Supervision Bureau determined that it had falsely advertised its disease treatment functions, and issued a fine of confiscating advertising fees and a fine of 200,000 yuan in accordance with the law.

items.title: There are criminal lines in the food industry: selling diseased and dead meat or exceeding the standard is enough, but adulteration with poisonous and harmful substances, regardless of the amount, the first level of punishment is less than five years
items.core: The first few lines are fined in money, but this one is about arresting people. Those who sell diseased meat, meat that fails inspections, or items containing heavy metals from agricultural and animal residues that seriously exceed standards will be sentenced to less than 3 years. As long as it is "sufficient" to cause severe poisoning, it is a crime, without actually eating it. Mixing toxic and harmful non-food ingredients into food will result in a prison sentence of less than 5 years in the lightest category, regardless of how much you sell it for.
body: Cost: No money. Follow Article 8 (when making food, first check which category you fall into): keep the quarantine certificate and purchase receipt, and only put things with approval numbers in the ingredient list.

Income: Article 143 of the Criminal Law governs this category. The food you make and sell does not meet food safety standards. As long as it is "sufficient to cause serious food poisoning accidents or other serious food-borne diseases", it is enough to be considered a crime. The offender shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than 3 years or criminal detention (short-term detention), and shall also be fined. If the person's health is seriously damaged or there are other serious circumstances, he shall be sentenced to not less than 3 years but not more than 7 years and fined. If the consequences are particularly serious, the offender shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than 7 years to life, fined or all property under his name confiscated. Article 144: Do not mix things. Anyone who mixes poisonous and harmful non-food ingredients into the food he makes or sells, or sells the food he knowingly mixes, shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than 5 years and fined. If the person's health is seriously damaged or there are other serious circumstances, he will be sentenced to not less than 5 years but not more than 10 years and fined. Those who eat people to death, or have other particularly serious circumstances, will be punished according to Article 141 (more than 10 years, life imprisonment, or death). The Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate issued an interpretation (the two high interpretations). It sets out what circumstances are considered "sufficient to cause serious food poisoning accidents or other serious foodborne illnesses." One is "containing pathogenic microorganisms, pesticide residues, veterinary drug residues, biotoxins, heavy metals and other pollutants that seriously exceed the standard limits." The second is "livestock, poultry, beasts, aquatic animal meat and their products that died of illness, the cause of death is unknown, or have failed inspection and quarantine." The third is "the production and sale of which are prohibited by the state for special needs such as disease prevention and control." The fourth is "the nutritional content of formula foods for special medical purposes and main and supplementary foods for infants and young children seriously does not meet food safety standards." Excessive use of additives or use in the wrong place, to the extent that it will cause the above-mentioned consequences, will also be criminalized according to Article 143. What counts as "toxic and harmful non-food raw materials" is not up to you. One category is substances that are prohibited by laws and regulations from being added to food. The other category is substances on the list announced by the relevant departments of the State Council, such as banned pesticides and drugs banned from use on edible animals. There is another situation that counts as "other serious circumstances" under Article 144. Made and sold for more than 100,000 yuan but less than 200,000 yuan. The locations are in primary and secondary school campuses, child care institutions, elderly care institutions and surrounding areas. The target of sale is minors and the elderly. Those who do not slaughter and sell pigs in designated slaughterhouses but own their own private slaughterhouses will be punished as illegal business operations if the circumstances are serious. If you earn more than 100,000 yuan, or earn more than 50,000 yuan, it will be considered a "serious case" (National)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress Standing Committee (revised in 2020). Criminal Law (Articles 141, 143, 144). <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=ff808181796a636a0179822a19640c92> (National Laws and Regulations Database); Supreme People’s Court, Supreme People’s Procuratorate (2021). Interpretation of Several Issues Concerning the Application of Laws in Handling Criminal Cases Endangering Food Safety (Legal Interpretation [2021] 24 No. 1, 2, 5, 7, 9, 17 and 18, effective from January 1, 2022). <https://scjg.hebei.gov.cn/info/79117> (Full text reproduced by Hebei Provincial Administration for Market Regulation), <https://sft.ln.gov.cn/sft/ywgz/zfflgw/xzy s/2525860BD0F843EFA7A3B7FDC330614E/index.shtml> (The full text was reproduced by the Liaoning Provincial Department of Justice, and the two copies were verified verbatim for consistency)

Remarks: The dividing line with the previous three is: whether food safety itself is violated. Failure to apply for a certificate, missing items on the label, and boasting about efficacy will result in a monetary penalty. Selling diseased meat, exceeding the standard, adding additives indiscriminately, and mixing non-food raw materials are subject to criminal proceedings. The most trouble-free line of defense is still the set of actions in item 8 (before making food, check which level you fall into). Meat only comes from designated slaughterhouses. Keep the quarantine certificate and meat quality inspection certificate for each batch. Ingredients only need to be checked for approval number. The so-called "cheaply processed meat" and "leftovers from nowhere" are the most common sources of food criminal cases. The page of the original source, the Gazette of the Supreme People's Court, returned 502 this round, so two provincial official reprints were quoted and verified verbatim with each other.

Case: Wang marinated dead chickens and sold them at the morning market, and the animal residue seriously exceeded the standard; Li mixed industrial dyes into the brine. The two were investigated before anyone had eaten it. Wang was sentenced to one and a half years in prison, and Li was sentenced to three years in prison for being adulterated with poisonous ingredients even though he only sold it for 200 yuan.

items.title: After receiving the license, you must declare truthfully on time. If you have no income, you must declare it. If you meet the conditions, you must declare zero.
items.core: If you have no tax to pay, you must declare it on time. Fill in the income, costs and expenses according to the facts. You cannot fill in all zeros just because you have no income. Failure to report will be ordered to make corrections within a time limit, and a fine of up to 2,000 yuan may be imposed. In serious cases, a fine of 2,000 to 10,000 yuan may be imposed. If you fail to report all taxes for three consecutive months, you will become an abnormal account and invoices will be deactivated.
body: Cost: No money. You can file monthly or quarterly returns in the electronic tax bureau in just a few minutes at a time. Hiring someone to do your accounting is another expense in the market. If you employ people, you must register for social security within 30 days from the date of establishment. The difficulty is that you have to remember to file on time even in the months when there is no business.

Benefit: "Taxpayers who have no tax payable during the tax period should also file tax returns in accordance with regulations.": You don't have to pay a cent of tax in this period, and you still have to file a tax return. The Tax Collection and Administration Law also requires truthful declarations in accordance with regulations. No income, no profit, and no taxes to pay are three different things. Even if there is no income, the rent, wages and other costs incurred must be reported truthfully in accordance with regulations. If you have tax-free income, you must also fill in the corresponding column, and it cannot be regarded as zero income. Whether zero declaration can be made depends on checking the conditions and filling out the forms for each tax category. Foshan Taxation’s Corporate Income Tax Filing Guidelines give an example: Only when financial statements have been submitted and the accumulated income, costs, and profits for the current period are all zero can the one-click zero declaration conditions be met. At this time, the number of employees, total assets, etc. still need to be filled in, and the entire table is not filled with zeros. Those who fail to report on time will be "ordered by the tax authorities to make corrections within a time limit and may be fined not more than 2,000 yuan; if the circumstances are serious, a fine of not less than 2,000 yuan but not more than 10,000 yuan may be imposed." If you fail to report and underpay the tax, the tax will be recovered, and a daily late payment fee will also be added, and a penalty of "not less than 50% but not more than five times" of the underpaid tax will be imposed. The late payment fee is 0.5% per day. "If a tax declaration has not been made for all tax categories for three consecutive months, the tax collection and management system will automatically identify it as an abnormal household and stop the use of its invoice collection book and invoices." If you don't report anything for three months, the system will automatically classify you as an abnormal account, and you will not be able to receive or issue invoices. After making a supplementary report and accepting the penalty, it will be automatically lifted. Units that employ people "should apply to the local social insurance agency for social insurance registration within thirty days from the date of establishment" (National)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: State Council (2002). Implementation Rules of the Tax Collection and Management Law (State Council Order No. 362, Articles 32, 34, and 75). <https://fgk.chinatax.gov.cn/zcfgk/c100010/c5195082/content.html>; National People’s Congress Standing Committee (2015). Tax Collection and Management Law (2015) Year revised, Articles 25, 32, 62, and 64). <https://fgk.chinatax.gov.cn/zcfgk/c100009/c5195081/content.html>; Foshan Taxation Bureau of the State Administration of Taxation (2025). Enterprise income tax - Declaration Guidelines - Audit and Collection (fill in the report: one-click zero declaration conditions, tax-free income reporting). <https://guangdong.chinatax.gov.cn/gdsw/fssw_nsrxt_kjxz/2025-10/09/content_145b9db929fb4054bcca80d26ab8a3ee.shtml>; State Administration of Taxation (2019). Announcement on Certain Matters on Tax Collection and Administration (State Administration of Taxation Announcement No. 2019) No. 48, Article 3). <https://fgk.chinatax.gov.cn/zcfgk/c100012/c5195194/content.html>; National People’s Congress Standing Committee (2018). Personal Income Tax Law (Amended in 2018, Article 12). <https://fgk.chinatax.gov.cn/zcfgk/c100009/c5193028/content.html> ; National People's Congress Standing Committee (2018). Social Insurance Law (2018 amendment, Article 57). <http://www.npc.gov.cn/zgrdw/npc/xinwen/2019-01/07/content_2070267.htm> ; National People's Congress Standing Committee (2018). Enterprise Income Tax Law (Amended in 2018, Article 54). <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=ff8080816f135f46016f2106acd11784> (National Laws and Regulations Database); Six departments including the State Administration for Market Regulation (2025). Guidelines for enterprise cancellation (revised in 2025) (Announcement No. 52 of 2025). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202512/content_7053238.htm>

Note: There is no need to register for tax separately after "multiple certificates in one". Use the unified social credit code on your business license to log in to the Electronic Taxation Bureau, confirm your registration information, and report what taxes you need to pay. Individual industrial and commercial households and sole proprietorships pay personal income tax on business income. First make a payment "within 15 days after the end of each month or quarter", and then "complete the settlement and settlement before March 31st of the following year when the income is obtained" (compute the general ledger throughout the year, and make up for any excess). A limited company pays corporate income tax, which is paid in advance on a monthly or quarterly basis. The annual general ledger is calculated "within five months from the end of the year", ending on May 31 of the following year. You have to declare even if you are not open, and you can only make a zero declaration if you meet the conditions. If you do not declare all taxes for three consecutive months, you will become an abnormal account and the invoices will be disabled. The 2025 enterprise cancellation guidelines state that before tax cancellation for an abnormal household, "the abnormal status must first be lifted and the tax return procedures must be completed." For how to cancel, see Article 23 of this section (exit according to the procedure if you lose money)

Case: Lao Zhao’s consulting company did not receive any business in the early days of its establishment, but he still logged into the Electronic Taxation Bureau on time every month and truthfully reported zero income. Because it has always adhered to compliance reporting, the company has not only not been fined, but subsequent invoicing and tax filing have also remained normal.

items.title: Invoices are only issued based on real transactions, and small-scale taxpayers use the full tax exemption amount
items.core: Small-scale taxpayers are those who are small and pay taxes according to the simplified method. Before the end of 2027, if it sells less than 100,000 a month and less than 300,000 a quarter, the value-added tax will be exempted. The original payment of 3% was reduced to 1% during the same period. On the other hand, if you find someone to issue an invoice and use it to deduct taxes, it will be a false invoice. The starting sentence is less than 3 years and a fine of 20,000 to 200,000.
body: Cost: No money. We don’t buy invoices, we don’t sell invoices, and we don’t “make invoices” for others. Issue invoices and file taxes based on actual business transactions.

Income: The group of small-scale taxpayers who pay taxes according to the simplified method are called small-scale taxpayers. The law states that "if sales do not reach the threshold, they are exempt from VAT." This line is called the starting point. From January 1, 2026 to December 31, 2027, the starting point is 100,000 yuan on a monthly basis and 300,000 yuan on a quarterly basis. The price per time or per day is 1,000 yuan. If you can’t sell this line, you don’t have to pay. During the same period of time, the payment originally made at 3% was reduced to 1%, except for the sale and rent of houses and the transfer of land use rights. On the other hand, issuing a special value-added tax invoice that does not have a real transaction, or other invoices that can be used for tax deduction, is a false issuance. The offender shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than 3 years or criminal detention, and shall be fined 20,000 to 200,000 yuan. It all counts if you open it for others, open it for yourself, let others open it for you, or introduce it to others. If the amount of tax involved is large, the sentence will be 3 to 10 years. For huge amounts, a sentence of more than 10 years or indefinitely (nationwide)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress Standing Committee (2024). Value-Added Tax Law (effective on January 1, 2026, Article 23). <https://fgk.chinatax.gov.cn/zcfgk/c100009/c5237365/content.html>; Ministry of Finance and State Administration of Taxation (2026). Announcement on the transition of preferential VAT policies after the implementation of the VAT Law (Ministry of Finance and State Administration of Taxation Announcement 2026 No. 10, Articles 1, 2, and 6). <https://fgk.chinatax.gov.cn/zcfgk/c102416/c5247434/content.html>; National People’s Congress (1997). Criminal Law (Article 205). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/201802/t20180206_364975.shtml>

Note: The Value-Added Tax Law will come into effect on January 1, 2026. The original two small-scale taxpayer relief announcements, No. 19 of 2023 and No. 1 of 2023, were subsequently stopped or abolished. The amount threshold has not changed, but the basis has been changed, and this article has been updated according to the new document. The original text page of the Criminal Law is from the 1997 edition, and Article 205 was later revised to increase the number of years of the sentence. Only the files that have been verified and have not been changed are listed here. The exemption is value-added tax, and income tax is calculated separately. "Finding someone to invoice to offset the cost" is false invoicing and is not tax saving.

Case: In order to pay less tax, a self-employed owner found someone to falsely issue several special value-added tax invoices for tax deduction without real transactions. After the incident was exposed, he was sentenced to one year in prison and fined 30,000 yuan by the court for falsely issuing invoices.

items.title: Anyone who claims to be the tax bureau and calls or sends messages urging you to pay taxes to a designated account is a scammer. You can only go to the electronic tax bureau and 12366 to file taxes
items.core: The tax department will not call you to ask for your bank card password, payment password or SMS verification code, nor will it give you an account to send the tax. If you really come to inspect the accounts, you must present the inspection notice and inspection certificate. When receiving such a call, hang up first and then call 12366 to verify. If you have already transferred money, please call 110 or 96110 immediately to stop the payment.
body: Cost: No money. If you receive calls or text messages about "tax spot checks", "account abnormalities", "failure to file taxes or fines", or if someone adds you as a friend, hang up first and don't reply. Call 12366 again, or call the landline number of the competent tax authority to verify.

Income: The original text of the reminder from the State Administration of Taxation: "The tax department will not ask for bank card passwords, payment passwords, account balances, and SMS verification codes related to bank card payments through WeChat mini programs, phone calls, text messages, etc." "Some criminals pretend to be tax cadres to contact taxpayers in the name of providing 'help with tax returns', 'agents for tax incentives', 'policy guidance', etc." To verify, call "12366 tax payment service hotline or the landline number of the competent tax authority." If you really come to check the accounts (audit), "you must present the inspection notice and inspection certificate." "Tax can only be paid through the electronic tax bureau or at the tax office. The tax department will not provide a designated account number." There is also an intermediary agency that handles taxes for others. "Those who use the name of tax authorities and tax personnel to extort taxpayers or withholding agents" will be fined according to the severity of the case. This is the case when under the guise of the tax bureau and tax cadres, people who pay taxes and the units that withhold and pay taxes are extorted. Anyone who pretends to be a state agency employee and commits fraud shall be detained for not less than 10 days but not more than 15 days, and may also be fined not more than 1,000 yuan. Those who are guilty of both fraud and pretense will be "convicted and punished according to the provisions with heavier penalties" (which one shall be punished more severely) (Nationwide)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: State Administration of Taxation (2025). The tax department reminds taxpayers to increase their awareness of prevention and be wary of Internet tax-related fraud. <https://www.chinatax.gov.cn/chinatax/n810219/n810724/c5243181/content.html> ; Yangzhou Municipal Taxation Bureau, State Administration of Taxation (2023). Yangzhou’s publicity piece on preventing tax-related fraud. <https://jiangsu.chinatax.gov.cn/art/2023/8/28/art_23038_432322.html> ; State Administration of Taxation (2025). Measures for the Administration of Tax-Related Professional Services (Trial) (State Administration of Taxation Order No. 58, Article 32, Item 7, Article 33). <https://fgk.chinatax.gov.cn/zcfgk/c100011/c5239044/content.html> ; Standing Committee of the National People's Congress (2025). Public Security Management Punishment Law (revised in 2025, effective on January 1, 2026, Article 62). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202506/t20250627_699863.shtml> ; Supreme People’s Court, Supreme People’s Procuratorate, and Ministry of Public Security (2016). Opinions on Several Issues Concerning the Application of Law in Handling Criminal Cases such as Telecom and Internet Fraud (Fafa [2016] No. 32). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/zdgz/201612/t20161221_176278.shtml>

Note: This type of scam targets newly registered self-employed individuals and small companies. The trick is "The system shows that you have not filed a tax return. If you don't process it today, you will be fined." Then they will direct you to their own official account or mini program and charge you a few hundred yuan at a time. The declaration was originally free and could be completed by myself in a few minutes. It is not illegal to find an agency on the market to do your accounting, but it is not a government department, and it will not use the name of the tax bureau to rush you. If you have already paid or transferred money, please call 110 or 96110 immediately to request a stop payment according to Section 8, Article 2 (Stop payment if you are deceived). Pretending to be a market supervision department and asking you to pay money for missing annual reports is the same trick, see Article 25 of this section (annual reports are free of charge)

Case: Ms. Wang received a call from someone claiming to be the tax bureau, saying that she had a tax refund and needed to click on the link and enter her bank card password. Ms. Wang did not believe her, she hung up the phone and dialed 12366 to verify. She successfully saw through the scam and saved her 50,000 yuan savings.

items.title: When receiving money, write "deposit" instead of "deposit", specify the amount of liquidated damages, and the account period will be reviewed when lending
items.core: The double rule applies only if you break the contract, the money will not be returned; if the other party breaks the contract, double the amount will be refunded to you. Any amount exceeding 20% ​​of the contract amount does not count. Written as "deposit", there is no such rule in law. Giving a repayment period is equivalent to lending your own money to the other party in vain. If the other party fails, it will be a bad debt.
body: Cost: No money. The word "deposit" is written in the contract, and the amount shall not exceed 20% of the total contract amount. Collect money first and then ship. Before agreeing to get the goods first and pay later (give a period for payment), check the other party first.

Profit: The deposit will not be counted until the money is actually handed over to the other party (established from the actual delivery). If the party who paid the deposit breaks the contract, the money will not be returned. If the party who received the deposit breaks the contract, the original amount will be refunded and the same amount will be compensated (double return). The portion exceeding 20% ​​of the total contract amount (subject amount of the main contract) will not be counted as a deposit. If the agreed liquidated damages are absurdly high or low compared to the actual losses, the court may adjust it downwards or upwards at the request of one party. If liquidated damages and deposits are both written into the contract, if there is a real breach of contract, you can only choose one and cannot take both (National, starting from 2021)
Level of Evidence: A
Source: National People's Congress (2020). Civil Code (Articles 585, 586, 587, 588). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202006/t20200602_463888.shtml>

Note: There is no set of rules for "deposit" in the Civil Code, and it is generally treated as an advance payment. This is a common saying in practice, and there is no verified case law in this section. If you pay a subscription deposit to buy a new house but later fail to sign a formal contract, there are special rules. See Section 15, Article 11 (Subscription Deposit). The account period is to lend your money to the other party without interest. If the other party fails, it will be a bad debt. Before giving an account period, go to the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System to check the other party's records to see if it has ever been sued.

Case: When a furniture factory signed a supply contract with a customer, it clearly stated that it received a "deposit" of 20,000 yuan. Later, the customer unilaterally broke the contract without reason. Since the contract was written in black and white as "deposit", the furniture factory confiscated the money in accordance with the law and successfully made up for part of the loss.

items.title: A written contract must be signed within the first month of employment, and social security registration must be completed within 30 days
items.core: If a person fails to sign a written contract after one month of working, starting from the second month, the salary will be doubled every month until one year has passed. Social security must be registered within 30 days of employment. If the employee fails to apply and does not change the registration within the time limit, he or she will be fined 1 to 3 times the social security premium. There is no such thing as "employees voluntarily giving up social security" in law.
body: Cost: The part of social security paid by the company has to be paid continuously. The proportion varies from place to place. There is no cost to sign the contract itself, just use the contract template from the local social security department.

Benefits: If a person has been working for a month but has not signed a written contract for less than a year, his salary will be doubled every month. Counting from the first day a person goes to work, he must register for social security within 30 days. Those who do not do so will be ordered to make corrections first. If the time limit is exceeded, a fine of 1 to 3 times the amount of social insurance premiums to be paid will be imposed, and the person handling the matter will be fined an additional 500 to 3,000 yuan. If social security is not paid on time or in full, an additional payment (late payment fee) of 50,000% will be added per day starting from the day the amount is owed. If you fail to pay after the deadline, you will be fined 1 to 3 times the amount owed. The unit must declare the application by itself and pay the amount in full on time. Only due to irresistible legal reasons such as natural disasters can one pay late or pay less. There is no "employee voluntarily abandons" item (nationwide)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress Standing Committee (2007). Labor Contract Law (Articles 10, 82). <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2007/content_711013.htm>; National People's Congress Standing Committee (2010). Social Insurance Law (2018 amendment, Articles 58, 60, 84, 86). <https://www.mohrss.gov.cn/xxgk2020/fdzdgknr/zcfg/fl/202011/t20201102_394629.html>

Note: The double salary is calculated from the second month to one year, and the longer it is delayed, the more expensive it will be. If employees who have not signed a contract or paid social security are injured at work or go to arbitration after leaving the company, they will have to make back payments, fines, and additional compensation. It often adds up to much more than the little money saved. How an employee wants double wages, see Section 19, Article 20 (Double wages).

Case: A start-up company hired a new employee, and the boss felt that he would not sign a contract or pay social security during the probation period. The employee resigned half a year later and took the company to court. The company was ordered to pay double the salary difference for five months because it failed to sign a written contract, and was also ordered to pay back social security.

items.title: Salaries must be paid in accordance with the contract and the law, and salary increases, loans, and bonuses must be written in writing
items.core: Salaries must be paid in full and on time in accordance with the contract and the law. If they owe money, the employee can go directly to the court to issue a payment order. Salary increases, bonuses, and advances are just words. If there is a real argument, the party that cannot produce evidence will suffer. If you lend your own money to an employee, it is not required by law to write it in writing, but it is best to write an IOU stating the amount, interest and when to pay it back.
body: Cost: No money. Make the salary clearly stated in the contract. For salary increases, bonuses, advances, and loans, all should be signed and left on a piece of paper. No verbal commitments. Nor do they pay the company's wages from their own pockets. The hard part is to follow this rule when talking to acquaintances.

Income: The content that must be stated in the labor contract includes how wages are paid and how social security is paid. The unit must pay wages in full and on time in accordance with the contract and national regulations. If the payment is delayed, the employee can apply directly to the court for a payment order (a reminder document issued by the court). The boss lends his own money to his employees. This is a loan contract. The original words of the Civil Code are: "A loan contract shall be in writing, except where there is a separate agreement on the loan between natural persons." When a boss personally lends money to an employee, it happens to be a loan between two natural persons, and the law does not force it to be in writing. The content of the contract "generally includes terms such as loan type, currency, purpose, amount, interest rate, term and repayment method." It is the author's suggestion to write an IOU based on these items. The bonuses promised verbally are not written in black and white, and if there is a real quarrel, the party that cannot provide evidence will suffer a loss (National)
Evidence level: C

Source: National People's Congress Standing Committee (2007). Labor Contract Law (Articles 17 and 30). <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2007/content_711013.htm>; National People's Congress (2020). Civil Code (Articles 469 and 668). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202006/t20200602_463888.shtml>

Note: It’s not that you don’t help people, but you have to follow the system even if you help people. Once favors outside the system become a routine, disputes will arise if you want to stop them. Personal loans and company accounts are mixed together. If the company loses money, the bad debts will fall on you. The legal part has been verified, and the suggestion itself is based on experience, so it is grade C.

Case: When Xiao Li joined the company, his boss verbally promised to pay him a three-month bonus at the end of the year, but he refused to pay it at the end of the year because of poor performance. Because Xiao Li did not have any written evidence, he was unable to provide evidence when applying for labor arbitration. In the end, he had no choice but to give up and suffered financial losses in vain.

items.title: Sell first and then build: Use pre-sales and small orders to verify that there are people buying it, and then invest money in production
items.core: An Italian study found that entrepreneurs who first formulate hypotheses and then test them with market feedback do better business. They were also more likely to change directions in time and not give up earlier. According to this idea, if no one is willing to pay in advance and no one is willing to place a small order, don't believe that "if you make it, someone will buy it".
body: Cost: tens to hundreds of yuan for a sample or a page. Then find dozens of real customers and ask them to prepay or place small orders. This is a few weeks slower than starting work directly. The hard thing is not to make the goods first.

Benefits: A randomized controlled trial that followed 116 Italian startups for approximately one year. A randomized controlled trial randomly divides people into two groups, only gives one group training, and then compares the results of the two groups. The result is: Entrepreneurs who are trained to make decisions based on “formulating hypotheses first and then rigorously testing them with market feedback” perform better. They are also more likely to turn around in time and switch to other plans, and the rate of giving up early is not higher. The author calls projects that look promising but actually cannot be done, false positive projects. The author's explanation is that this approach reduces the probability of continuing to throw money at such projects (Italy, published in 2020). Using pre-sales and small orders to verify is the specific approach given in this book based on this idea
Level of Evidence: B

Source: Camuffo A, Cordova A, Gambardella A, Spina C (2020). A Scientific Approach to Entrepreneurial Decision Making: Evidence from a Randomized Control Trial. Management Science 66(2):564-586. <https://doi.org/10.1287/mnsc.2018.3249>

Note: This is the only study with a small sample size and was done in Italy, so it is rated B. The title, source, and abstract were checked with Crossref and Semantic Scholar. Effect figures in the full text were not verified in this section. It comes down to the operation: no one is willing to pay in advance, no one is willing to place a small order, so don’t believe that “if you make it, someone will buy it.”

Case: A certain entrepreneurial team designed a new type of thermos cup. Instead of putting it into production directly, it first launched pre-sales online. Since they only received a very small number of orders, they gave up the design in time, avoiding a large inventory backlog and financial losses caused by blind mold production.

items.title: After the sample is made, go through the mass production list first, and then talk about starting work
items.core: The difference between one sample and a thousand pieces lies in where the money is. The yield rate determines the real cost, the minimum order quantity and billing period determine how much money you have to advance, and the inventory determines when the money will be returned. If the product is in the compulsory certification catalog, it cannot leave the factory and be sold without certification or the certification mark.
body: Cost: A few hundred yuan for a small batch trial production. Spend a few more hours and calculate the yield rate clearly, that is, how many of the 100 pieces can be sold. The supplier's minimum order quantity and billing period, how much inventory is required, packaging and logistics, certification and licensing, and trademarks must also be calculated one by one. The hard thing is resisting skipping this step and getting straight to work.

Income: The difference between one sample and a thousand pieces lies in where the money is invested. The yield rate determines the real cost. The yield rate is how many percent of the batch made is qualified and can be sold. The minimum amount the supplier requires you to order at one time (minimum order quantity), and how long it takes to receive the money after delivery (account period), these two determine how much money you have to advance. Inventory determines when the money comes back. Products included in the compulsory product certification catalog must first pass certification and have the certification mark marked on the product before they can leave the factory and be sold. Those who leave the factory for sale without certification will be punished according to certification and accreditation regulations. Catering and selling food require a food business license (national)
Evidence level: C

Source: General Administration of Quality Supervision, Inspection and Quarantine (2009). Compulsory Product Certification Management Regulations (General Administration of Quality Supervision, Inspection and Quarantine Order No. 117, Articles 2 and 49). <http://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2010/content_1533513.htm>; State Administration for Market Regulation (2023). Measures for the Administration of Food Business Licensing and Registration (State Administration for Market Regulation Order No. 78, Article 4). <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/2023/issue_10606/202307/content_6894763.html>

Note: The list itself is an empirical method, and the original text of the legal article has been verified. Before putting into production, first go to the trademark query system of the State Intellectual Property Office to check whether there are similar registrations, and then apply for your own trademark. For red lines that use other people’s trademarks and patterns, see Articles 20 and 21 (leave a receipt when purchasing goods, and the patterns must be made by yourself or authorized). The compulsory certification catalog shall be subject to the latest announcement by the State Administration for Market Regulation.

Case: A toy factory took doll samples and went directly to the foundry to produce a thousand pieces. As a result, all the products were returned because they failed to check the mass production certification requirements and the products lacked mandatory certification marks. As a result, hundreds of thousands of funds were backlogged. The lesson was very painful.

items.title: Purchase a batch and keep a batch of receipts and information about the previous company. If the purchase price is significantly lower than the market price, do not buy: the counterfeit goods purchased by the employees for the company will be considered as the company's crime and the boss will also be sentenced.
items.core: Selling fake goods and earning 30,000 yuan, or selling them for 50,000 yuan, is enough to be sentenced to less than 3 years in prison. Unsold goods will be counted if their value reaches three times the sales standard. "I didn't know it was fake" is not up to you: if the purchase price is obviously lower than the market price and you can't explain the reason, you can be deemed to have knowledge. Only by retaining the purchase contract, invoice, payment record and previous home information will you be able to avoid compensation.
body: Cost: No money. Keep the following items for each batch of goods: purchase contract, invoice, payment record, business license and authorization documents of the previous company. Set another internal rule: whoever buys the goods will sign for it. If the price is obviously lower than the market price, no goods will be bought. The hard thing is to let go of low-priced goods that look very profitable.

Profit: If you knowingly sell goods with counterfeit registered trademarks and earn enough money (illegal income) of 30,000 yuan, you reach the threshold for sentencing. The amount sold is enough for 50,000 yuan, the same. The sentence shall be not more than 3 years and a fine, or only a fine. Those who reach ten times this standard will be sentenced to 3 to 10 years and fined. It does not matter if the goods are still in the warehouse and have not been sold: if the value of the goods is more than three times the standard sales amount, it also constitutes a crime. "Knowingly" does not need to be admitted by yourself. The 2025 judicial interpretation of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate lists five situations that can directly determine that you have knowledge. Unless you can provide evidence that you really don't know. One is knowing that the registered trademark on the product has been altered, replaced or covered. The second is forging or altering the trademark registrant's authorization document, or knowing that the document has been forged or altered. The third is those who have received criminal or administrative penalties for selling counterfeit goods and are selling the same type again. Fourth, purchasing or selling goods at prices significantly lower than the market price without justifiable reasons. Fifth, after being discovered by administrative law enforcement agencies and judicial agencies, they transfer or destroy evidence such as infringing goods and accounting vouchers, or provide false certifications. If a company violates this article, "the unit shall be fined, and the person directly in charge and other directly responsible personnel" shall be punished according to the same article. The company is fined, and the person in charge of the decision and the person handling the matter are sentenced according to the same rules. Therefore, when a company violates this rule, even if the goods are brought in by employees, the person who made the final decision will be punished. In turn, the trademark law leaves a way out: when you sell it, you really don’t know that the product infringes on someone else’s registered trademark. “If you can prove that you obtained the product legally and stated the supplier, you will not be liable for compensation.” Whether you can be exempted from compensation depends entirely on whether you have a receipt and the previous owner's information. If you don't leave it, you won't be able to use this article (National Judicial Interpretation will come into effect on April 26, 2025)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress Standing Committee (2020). Criminal Law Amendment (11) (Items 17 and 24, namely Criminal Law Articles 214 and 220). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/zdgz/202012/t20201227_503682.shtml>; Supreme People’s Court, Supreme People’s Procuratorate (2025). Interpretation on Several Issues Concerning the Application of Law in Handling Criminal Cases of Intellectual Property Infringement (Fa Shi [2025] No. 5, effective from April 26, 2025). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/xwfbh/wsfbt/202504/t20250424_693977.shtml>; Standing Committee of the National People's Congress (2019). Trademark Law (amended in 2019, Articles 57 and 64; revised to Articles 72 and 78 on June 26, 2026, effective from January 1, 2027 Effective from today). <https://www.cnipa.gov.cn/art/2019/7/30/art_95_28179.html>, <https://www.cnipa.gov.cn/art/2026/6/26/art_95_206942.html>

Note: Cosmetics, alcohol, maternal and infant, digital, and clothing are categories with high incidence of such cases. The common point is that there is a huge price difference for the same product. Terms such as "channel goods", "last order" and "overseas tax exemption" cannot replace bills. In addition to the sentence, there is also an administrative penalty. If the infringement is determined to be established, the infringing goods and tools must be confiscated, and if the illegal business turnover is more than 50,000 yuan, a fine of not more than 5 times may be imposed. I discovered something was wrong after I had already purchased the product. I immediately stopped selling it, sealed it, and then contacted the brand or the market supervision department. Don't continue to sell, let alone destroy the goods and accounts. Destroying evidence just falls into the fifth situation of "it is presumed that you knew it was a fake" above. See Article 21 for using someone else’s pattern (either make the pattern yourself or buy a license). There is a trick specifically to deal with this: someone comes to your door and says that these pens or other small commodities are given to you for free, and you can sell them in the store and then divide the money. After a few days, someone will come to buy it, collect evidence on the spot, and then file a claim for infringement. The goods were given for free, and the three conditions required for deductibility happened to be missing: there was no purchase contract and payment record, the real supplier could not be named, and the price was obviously abnormal. None of the items "Lawfully obtained and stated provider" apply. Therefore, products that deliver goods to your door without giving a receipt and only leave a WeChat account will not be put on the shelves. If you really want to do consignment sales, sign a written consignment contract, leave a copy of the other party's ID card and business license, and write down who owns the goods and who is responsible for the infringement.

Case: A convenience store owner purchased brand-name cigarettes at a low price and kept invoices and transfer records. Half a year later, the Tobacco Bureau discovered the counterfeit goods. He proved his ignorance with complete receipts and was exempted from fines. The case was filed against him.

items.title: The patterns on products, packaging, tags and promotional pictures must be made by yourself or licensed. Changing the color and adding an icon are not considered "modified"
items.core: Changing the color, changing the background color, and adding your own icon on someone else's picture is still using someone else's work without permission. Copying other people's works of art to make money, earning 30,000 yuan, 50,000 yuan, or printing 500 copies constitutes a crime of copyright infringement and will be sentenced to less than 3 years. As for trademarks, "similarity to the point of confusion" itself is considered infringement.
body: Cost: Authorization of genuine photo gallery starts from tens of yuan per photo. Find someone to create an original design, which costs a few hundred to a few thousand yuan. For every picture used on a product, an authorization certificate and purchase record are kept. The hard part is not to use random pictures found online.

Income: The Copyright Law classifies "use of works by adaptation, translation, annotation, etc. without the permission of the copyright owner" and direct copying as infringements. Therefore, changing the color, changing the background color, or adding your own icon to the original image is still using someone else's work without permission. Here is the threshold for sentencing: In order to make money, one prints and sells (reproduces and distributes) works of art without the permission of the copyright holder of the work. The most sinful number is three. The money earned (illegal income) is enough to reach 30,000 yuan. Or the business can reach 50,000 yuan (the amount of illegal business). Or the total number of printed items is enough for 500 copies (sheets). If any one of these numbers is reached, it constitutes copyright infringement. The sentence shall be not more than 3 years and a fine, or only a fine. Those who meet the ten times standard will be sentenced to 3 to 10 years. If you only sell infringing goods printed by others and earn more than 50,000 yuan, or sell more than 100,000 yuan, you will be sentenced to less than 5 years for selling infringing copies. The same goes for trademarks. The following two types of trademarks that are “likely to cause confusion” are within the scope of infringement. One is to use a trademark similar to the registered trademark on the same product. The other is to use the same or similar trademark on similar goods. "Approximate" is an infringement situation expressly stated in the law. If someone else’s trademark is modified and reused, as long as it is likely to cause confusion, it will still be considered infringement (nationwide, judicial interpretation effective April 26, 2025)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People’s Congress Standing Committee (2020). Copyright Law (2020 amendment, Article 52, Paragraph 6, Article 53). <http://www.npc.gov.cn/npc/c2/c30834/202011/t20201119_308796.html>; National People’s Congress Standing Committee (2020). Criminal Law Amendment (11) (Articles 20 and 21, namely Articles 217 and 218 of the Criminal Law). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/zdgz/202012/t20201227_503682.shtml>; Supreme People’s Court, Supreme People’s Procuratorate (2025). Interpretation on Several Issues Concerning the Application of Law in Handling Criminal Cases of Intellectual Property Infringement (Fa Interpretation [2025] No. 5). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/xwfbh/wsfbt/202504/t20250424_693977.shtml>; National People’s Congress Standing Committee (2019). Trademark Law (revised in 2019, Article 57, Item 2; revised in 2026 to Article 72, Item 2). <https://www.cnipa.gov.cn/art/2019/7/30/art_95_28179.html>

Note: There are three places that are often stepped on. One is to print cartoon images and celebrity pictures found on the Internet on clothes, cups, and mobile phone cases. The second is fonts: Most commercial fonts must be licensed separately, and free preview does not mean free commercial use. Third, if the design draft made for the customer contains unauthorized materials, the responsibility still lies with the seller. To save trouble, use a commercially licensed image gallery and save the authorization page. Or ask the designer to clearly state in the contract where the materials come from and the scope of authorization. If anything goes wrong, the designer will be responsible. In addition to sentencing, there are also civil compensation and administrative fines: if the public interest is harmed, the illegal gains may be confiscated and fined 1 to 5 times the illegal business volume. Please refer to Article 19 for trademark inspection before production (samples must go through the mass production list first). On the other hand, if your pictures are used by others, you should protect your rights according to this set of rules. For the criminal line of uploading other people’s comics, movies, and TV dramas to the Internet, placing advertisements, and charging membership fees, see Section 9, Article 24 (Chinese-Chinese Comics, and Transferring Movies and TV Series).

Case: A Taobao store owner used a color-corrected cartoon picture as a details page. The sales volume just exceeded 60,000, and the copyright owner sued. The court ruled that the infringement was established, and he paid 80,000 yuan in compensation and removed all products from the shelves.

items.title: According to the regulations on the job, first think clearly about who is responsible for good intentions outside the regulations
items.core: Take a nurse as an example: the regulations state that if a patient is found to be in critical condition, the doctor must be notified immediately; if a medical order is found to be in violation of the regulations, the physician who issued the order must be informed. The same goes for other positions. First, see clearly where the "must report" in your own regulations is. In addition, if you voluntarily provide emergency rescue and injure the person being rescued, you do not have to pay compensation.
body: Cost: No money. When working, work according to the system, doctor's orders, and procedures. Do not make decisions for others outside of your own authority. Before you want to help, ask yourself: Who is responsible if something goes wrong. The hard thing is to resist the request to "be accommodating" on the spot.

Benefits: Taking nurses as an example, the job boundaries stated in regulations are as follows. If you find your condition is critical, notify your doctor immediately. In an emergency, necessary emergency rescue can be carried out first to rescue critically ill patients. If it is discovered that medical orders are illegal or violate technical standards for diagnosis and treatment, it must be reported to the doctor and, if necessary, reported to the head of the department. The Civil Code provides otherwise. If a person voluntarily provides emergency rescue and the person being rescued is injured as a result, the rescuer does not have to pay compensation (and does not bear civil liability) (Nationwide)
Level of Evidence: B

Source: State Council (2008). Regulations on Nurses (State Council Order No. 517, Article 17). <http://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2008-03/28/content_6169.htm>; State Council (2020). Regulations on Nurses (Revised in 2020, Article 17). <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=ff808081777d07c50177b8ed29bf3950> (National Laws and Regulations Database); National People’s Congress (2020). Civil Code (Article 184). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202006/t20200602_463888.shtml>

Remarks: Follow the regulations within the post, and emergency rescue is protected by law. For the rest, first clarify whose authority and responsibility are, and don’t use personal good intentions to replace institutional decisions. The Nursing Regulations were revised by State Council Order No. 726 in 2020. Only the registration articles were changed, and Article 17 remained unchanged. The original official text of the Physician Act concerning practicing according to diagnostic and treatment standards could not be opened this time, so it was not quoted.

Case: The nurse discovered that the dosage prescribed by the doctor was abnormal, and immediately reported it to the doctor to prevent the patient from overdosing. It was later proven that operating according to the procedures not only protected the patient but also protected himself.

items.title: If you lose money, exit according to the procedures: if you can easily cancel, cancel; if you are insolvent and go bankrupt, don't leave it alone
items.core: If you have no debts, wages, taxes and social security, all investors must write a commitment and announce it for 20 days. If there is no objection, you can simply cancel. Self-employed individuals do not need to announce it. If a company cannot pay its due debts and owes more than it owes, it can file for bankruptcy. If the company fails to file an annual report for two consecutive years, fails to change its status in the abnormal list, and cannot be contacted, its license will be revoked and the responsible legal representative will no longer be able to serve as a representative for three years.
body: Cost: Simple cancellation can be done by yourself: list it on the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System for 20 days. If you still have unpaid debts, you must first sort out the accounts, collect what should be collected, and repay what should be paid. This step is called liquidation. To file for bankruptcy, it takes several months. The difficult thing is that after losing money, you don’t want to face it and keep putting it off.

Income: There is nothing you owe others or anything others owe you, or they have all been paid off. No wages, no social security, no taxes are owed. All investors made written commitments. If you meet these conditions, post it for public notice and no one raises objections within 20 days, you can proceed to simple logout. Self-employed individuals do not need to make public announcements, and will be canceled directly if there is no objection from the relevant departments within 10 days. If a company cannot repay its due debts and owes more than it has on hand (it is insolvent), it can apply to the court for reorganization, reconciliation or bankruptcy liquidation. If the company has been dissolved but has not been liquidated, and owes more than it owes, the person responsible for liquidation should apply for bankruptcy liquidation. The consequences of leaving it alone are as follows: if the annual report is not published on time, it will be included in the list of operating irregularities. If the company fails to file an annual report for two consecutive years, fails to change its name on the list of abnormal business operations, and cannot be contacted at the registered address, its business license will be revoked. If the company's license is revoked and the legal representative bears personal responsibility, he or she shall no longer be the legal representative, director, supervisor, or senior executive of the company within three years. These 3 years are counted from the date of revocation. Those that have been included in the directory of abnormal operations cannot even be deregistered (nationwide)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: State Council (2021). Regulations on the Registration and Management of Market Entities (State Council Order No. 746, Articles 31, 32, and 33). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2021-08/24/content_5632964.htm>; six departments including the State Administration for Market Regulation (2025). Enterprise Cancellation Guidelines (Revised in 2025) (Announcement No. 52 of 2025). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202512/content_7053238.htm>; National People’s Congress Standing Committee (2006). Enterprise Bankruptcy Law (Articles 2 and 7). <http://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2006/content_413952.htm>; State Council (2024 revision). Interim Regulations on Enterprise Information Disclosure (State Council Order No. 777 No. 18 Amendment): "If an enterprise is included in the list of business abnormalities due to failure to submit annual reports as required for two consecutive years without correction, and cannot be contacted through the registered residence or business place, the business license shall be revoked by the market supervision and management department at or above the county level." (2024). Decision on amending and abolishing some administrative regulations (State Council Order No. 777). <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/2024/issue_11246/202403/content_6941844.html>; Regulations on the Registration and Management of Market Entities (Article 12, Item 4) and the Company Law (2023 As revised in 2017, Article 178, Paragraph 1, Item 4): Anyone who serves as the legal representative of an enterprise whose business license has been revoked due to violation of laws and bears personal responsibility shall not serve as the legal representative, director, supervisor, or senior manager within 3 years from the date of revoking the business license. <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2021-08/24/content_5632964.htm>; <https://www.gov.cn/yaowen/liebiao/202312/content_6923395.htm>

Note: Interim Regulations on Enterprise Information Disclosure, 2024, revised by State Council Order No. 777, May 1 It came into effect on that day and has not been changed since. Article 17 of the old version, "Enterprises that have been operating abnormally for three years or more and are included in the list of serious illegal enterprises" has been deleted. The current serious illegal and untrustworthy list covers companies that have committed fraud in their annual reports and committed serious crimes. Many opinions on the Internet are still old versions, so don’t copy them. When to submit the annual report and how to make up for omissions, see Article 25 of this section (filing the previous year’s annual report online from January 1 to June 30 each year). The personal bankruptcy system (including self-employed individuals) is currently being piloted in some areas. This section has not verified the original text, so it will not be included.

Case: The restaurant owner closed down his business after the epidemic and had no debts or wages. He simply canceled his business and announced his exit without objection within 20 days, saving the trouble of accounting fees and subsequent annual reports.

items.title: Before you spend money to hire someone to run an online store, go to store opening training, or do "no supply", first ask whether you will need to add more money later and where the sales will come from
items.core: This type of scam first collects a sum of money, and then gets you an "upgrade package", advance payment, and unfreeze money to let you add money again and again. The orders and profits in the background may have been made, but you cannot withdraw them when you want to withdraw them. Relying on fake orders to increase sales is illegal in itself, and agents who are caught will be punished.
body: Cost: No money. Before paying money, you need to get three things: a written contract, the full name of the other party's company, and the conditions for refunding the money. The money is only paid to the company named in the contract and is not transferred to the personal account. What was difficult was that when the other party posted a screenshot of "the student's monthly income exceeds 10,000 yuan," he refrained from handing over the money on the spot.

Income: The Guangdong Provincial Higher People’s Court sentenced an agency operation scam. 55 people including Jiang and Xu opened multiple companies in Guangzhou, Nanning and Hangzhou. The court found that they "knowingly did not have the ability and technical conditions to operate as an e-commerce agent." In the name of operating Taobao stores, they tricked 7,711 victims into purchasing and upgrading "service packages." A total of more than 52.994 million yuan was defrauded. The two first offenders were sentenced to 14 years and 13 years and 6 months respectively for fraud. The court said the scam was "tightly designed" and "multiple victims were repeatedly deceived." The Jiangsu Provincial Public Security Department broke down the "no supply" cross-border e-commerce scam into four steps in 2025. The first step is to post "zero basics" and "no need to stock up" information on social platforms. The second step is to add you as an "Operation Director" and let you download the designated platform. The third step is to get your first order soon after opening the store. The other party asks you to pay the cost price of the goods first, saying that the buyer's payment will be frozen on the platform and will be unfrozen after receiving the goods. Then a large number of orders are created in the background, allowing you to keep adding money. The fourth step is to say "Account Abnormal" and "System Maintenance" when you want to withdraw cash, and you will be asked to pay the unfreezing fee and handling fee. Ms. Zhang in the case successively deposited more than 900,000 yuan, but the website could not be opened three days later. Let’s look at brushing orders again. An agent operator organized fake group purchases to boost rankings for merchants. The market supervision department fined it 100,000 yuan, and the platform deducted a 50,000 yuan deposit. The court supported the platform in deducting the money. The Supreme People's Court listed it as a typical case in 2026. The original words were that "false transactions and fraudulent trading are behaviors expressly prohibited by law." The State Administration for Market Regulation also announced a case in 2025. A company was fined 530,000 yuan for selling "one-click moving" and "one-click dropshipping" software and crawling product information from other platforms onto the shelves. The General Administration reminds operators that they "are not allowed to commit illegal acts such as 'moving to shoplifting' or 'operating without supply of goods'." The way out lies in the Civil Code: If the contract was signed by the other party using fraudulent means, you can ask the court or arbitration institution to revoke it. This must be filed within 1 year from the day you learn you have been defrauded. After revocation, the money received by the other party should be returned (nationwide)
Level of Evidence: B

Source: Guangdong Provincial Higher People's Court (2023). Typical cases of Guangdong courts cracking down on telecommunications network fraud crimes (Case 3: Jiang, Xu and other 55 criminal group fraud cases). <https://www.gdcourts.gov.cn/gsxx/quanweifabu/anlihuicui/content/post_1388464.html>; Jiangsu Provincial Public Security Department (2025). Prevention Tips: Cross-border e-commerce without supply, beware of fraud! . <https://gat.jiangsu.gov.cn/art/2025/2/13/art_89956_11491354.html>; Supreme People's Court (2026). The Supreme People's Court issued a typical case of regulating platform operations in accordance with the law and protecting the legitimate rights and interests of consumers (Case 3: A certain generation of operators sued a certain platform for service contract disputes). <https://www.court.gov.cn/zixun/xiangqing/507691.html>; State Administration for Market Regulation (2025). The State Administration for Market Regulation announced five typical cases of unfair competition on the Internet (Case 1). <https://www.samr.gov.cn/xw/zj/art/2025/art_0d043840ec9445a689496bcf30c94820.html>; National People’s Congress (2020). Civil Code (Articles 148, 152, 157). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202006/t20200602_463888.shtml>

Remarks: Stop first when you see "zero foundation", "no need to stock up", "low investment, high return" and "guaranteed profit". If it asks you to advance payment to its designated platform, stop first. Before paying the money, go to the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System to check the other party’s license and penalty records. The contract clearly states the service content and how to get a refund if the service is not met. Keep chat records, contracts and transfer screenshots. If you have already transferred money, call 110 or 96110 immediately to request a stop payment. See Section 8, Article 2 (Stop payment if you are deceived). If the other party has indeed done the work, but the results are poor, it is probably a contract dispute and requires negotiation, complaint or prosecution. To revoke a contract, you need to go to court. The ordinary procedure of first instance is to be completed within 6 months as stipulated. It can be extended. You have to pay for the lawyer's fees. If the judgment is reached, the other party may have run away long ago. If you collect money under the banner of joining, please first check and file according to Article 5 (check with the Ministry of Commerce for filing before joining). The main beneficiary is yourself.

Case: Ms. Li paid RMB 20,000 in operating fees, and the background showed that the monthly profit exceeded RMB 10,000. When withdrawing cash, she was told that she needed to pay an additional RMB 50,000 in unfreezing fees. She called the police, who caught the gang and recovered some of their losses.

items.title: Those who open a company or are self-employed must file the previous year's annual report online from January 1 to June 30 every year. Even if there is no business, the annual report is free of charge
items.core: Those who open a company or are self-employed must file the previous year's annual report online in the first half of each year. Self-employed individuals can also submit paper copies. If you don’t report it, you will be placed on the business abnormality list. You can apply for removal after making a supplementary report. There is no charge for the annual report. Those who call and tell you that you have omitted to report and ask you to go to a mini program or official account to pay for it are scammers. You should first check the publicity system yourself. The principal perpetrator of such deception was sentenced to more than 10 years in prison.
body: Cost: No money. Log in to the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System and fill in the report yourself, once a year. Self-employed individuals can also submit paper copies. Submitting the annual report to the market supervision department and filing tax returns with the tax bureau on a monthly and quarterly basis are two different things. Filing a tax does not mean filing an annual report. The hard thing is that it only happens once a year and it’s easy to forget.

Income: The company must "submit the previous year's annual report to the market supervision and management department through the national enterprise credit information disclosure system from January 1 to June 30 of each year, and make it public to the public." Those who fail to report after the deadline will be included in the list of business abnormalities and "administrative penalties will be imposed in accordance with the law." The list of business abnormalities is posted on the public notice system and anyone can check it. In situations such as government procurement and project bidding, companies on the list will be restricted or banned. Self-employed individuals are also required to submit their annual report for the previous year from January 1 to June 30 of each year, which can be submitted online or in paper form. Self-employed businesses that have just started business in the current year will start reporting from the next year. Self-employed individuals can choose whether to publish the contents of the annual report, but if they do not report it, they will still be included in the directory of business abnormalities.
