If you are included in the directory because you have not filed an annual report, you can apply to the market supervision department at the place of registration for removal if you make up for the years you did not file. If a company fails to report for two consecutive years, fails to change its listing in the directory, and cannot be contacted at the registered address, its business license will be revoked. The company's annual report must be disclosed to the public. If a self-employed person chooses not to disclose the content, the system will also announce that it has "submitted its annual report." Therefore, you can check whether you have reported it or not, and whether it is in the directory. You can check it by yourself on the public notice system. The State Administration for Market Regulation has warned of a scam. Someone called "pretending to be a market supervisor" and told you that you had not submitted your application after the due date and that you had been included in the list of operating irregularities. Then "guide the search for the so-called mini program or official account", allowing you to entrust the agent and pay the money. The General Administration’s statement is that “there is no charge for annual reports.” Submitting annual reports and removing from the list of abnormal operating operations “must be done through official channels such as the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System.” The court has already sentenced such cases on the basis of fraud. Anhui Jingde Court concluded one case. A company that acts as a registered agent asked the operator to "deliberately conceal his identity", making the individual business owner think that the other person was from the market supervision department. The operator then directs the person to a third-party applet and charges a "manual declaration material fee" of 98 to 398 yuan. They defrauded 10,099 self-employed people across the country, totaling more than 3.19 million yuan. The three principals were convicted of fraud and were sentenced to 10 years and 6 months to 10 years and 8 months. In a case concluded by the Nanhu District Court in Jiaxing, the mini program actually said "free submission" in small letters. The court still convicted the operator of fraud on the grounds that the operator "deliberately concealed the actual situation such as the operator's ability to handle online transactions, and fabricated lies about large fines." Nine people were sentenced to 8 months to 4 years in this case (nationwide)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: State Council (revised in 2024). Interim Regulations on Enterprise Information Disclosure (Revised by State Council Order No. 777, Articles 8, 18, and 19). <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=ff8081819c46fcc5019cd18fc6e9557d> (National Laws and Regulations Database); State Administration for Market Regulation (2025). Decision on amending the "Annual Reporting Measures for Individual Industrial and Commercial Households" and other four regulations (Order No. 108 of the State Administration for Market Regulation No. 3, 5, 8, 10, 13, and 16 of the re-announced Annual Reporting Measures for Individual Industrial and Commercial Households, and Articles 6 and 11 of the Measures for the Management of Abnormal Business Operation Lists. <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/2026/issue_12546/202602/content_7057451.html>; State Administration for Market Regulation (2023). @All business entities, these are all fake (reprinted dynamically by the Chinese government website department, originally published by the WeChat public account of the "Shishuoxinyu" of the State Administration for Market Regulation). <https://www.gov.cn/lianbo/bumen/202311/content_6917465.htm>; State Administration for Market Regulation (2024). The State Administration for Market Regulation issued a reminder: There is no charge for annual reports, so do not be deceived (reprinted by the Binzhou Municipal Administration for Market Regulation). <http://amr.binzhou.gov.cn/art/2024/12/16/art_164869_10306521.html>; People’s Court of Jingde County, Anhui Province (2025). Case of defrauding individual industrial and commercial households by pretending to be market supervisors and defrauding individual industrial and commercial households with annual review declaration fees (reprinted by Wuxi Market Supervision Administration). <https://scjgj.wuxi.gov.cn/doc/2025/03/20/4524579.shtml>; Nanhu District People’s Court of Jiaxing City (2024). Does a corporate annual report cost? Don’t fall into the trap of “annual report fraud”. <http://nhcourt.gov.cn/art/2024/7/23/art_1217290_58718476.html>

Note: When you receive a call saying that you have omitted to file an annual report, hang up first and log in to the publicity system to check it yourself, or call the market supervision department at the place of registration to ask. Don’t click on links in text messages, and don’t go to the mini programs or official accounts provided by the other party to pay. It’s the same scam as the one that impersonates the tax bureau, see Article 14 of this section (anyone who claims that the tax bureau is urging you to pay and file a tax return is a scammer). If you have already transferred money, please call 110 or 96110 immediately to request a stop payment. The annual reporting measures for individual industrial and commercial households and the management measures for the list of abnormal business operations will be revised twice in 2025. The current version will be effective from December 25, 2025. Annual reports and tax returns are separate matters. Please refer to Article 12 of this section (declaring taxes truthfully on time) for how to file taxes. Both must be done on time. After the company's license is revoked, the responsible legal representative can no longer serve as the legal representative within 3 years. See Article 23 of this section (exit according to procedures if you lose money). If you don't plan to do it again, just follow that article to cancel. Don't be held back by not filing an annual report. The main beneficiary is yourself.

Case: The shop owner received the text message 'Payment is required for omissions in the annual report'. He logged into the National Enterprise Credit Information Publicity System to conduct a self-examination and found that the report had been completed. He saw through the scam and reported the scam number.

items.title: When looking for people to raise money to start a business, only ask relatives, friends and employees for face-to-face interviews. Do not openly recruit people to invest money in your circle of friends or groups, and do not let relatives and friends recruit people for you
items.core: Only ask relatives, friends and original employees to borrow money and pool shares, and do not let them recruit outsiders for you. It is not illegal in itself. What is illegal is publicity, collecting money from unknown people, and then promising to repay principal and interest or give something in return. Receiving 1 million yuan, or receiving money from 150 people, is enough for a sentence, starting at less than 3 years. If the money is used for serious business and is returned in full before prosecution, criminal punishment will be waived.
body: Cost: No money. To borrow money, attract people to buy shares, only find relatives, friends and employees you know, and interview them one by one. No posting in Moments, no posting in groups, no printing flyers, no promotion meetings. Relatives and friends say, "I'll help you and then ask someone else," and they have to stop you on the spot. The difficulty is that when you are short of money, "getting a few more people" seems to be the fastest way to get the money.

Income: Article 176 of the Criminal Law governs "illegal absorption of public deposits or disguised absorption of public deposits, disrupting financial order." The offender shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than 3 years or short-term detention, and shall also be fined, or shall be fined only. If the amount is huge or there are other serious circumstances, the sentence will be 3 to 10 years. If the amount is particularly huge or there are other particularly serious circumstances, the sentence will be more than 10 years. The judicial interpretation of the Supreme People's Court states that the four conditions must be met at the same time. One is collecting money without legal permission from relevant departments, or using the shell of a legitimate business operation. The second is to publicize it to the public through the Internet, media, promotion meetings, leaflets, mobile phone messages, etc. The third is to promise to repay principal and interest or give returns within a certain period of time using money, physical objects, equity, etc. The fourth is to collect money from unspecified people in society. The same article goes on to say: "Absorbing funds from relatives, friends or for specific targets within the company without publicity to the public does not constitute illegal absorption or disguised absorption of public deposits." However, the opinions of the National High School and the First Ministry of Finance draw two exceptions, and it is still considered collecting money from the public. The first is when collecting money from relatives, friends or employees, knowing that they are collecting money from unknown people on your behalf, but leaving it alone. The second is to collect money by first recruiting outsiders as employees and then collecting money from them. There are three lines that are sufficient for sentencing, and one of them counts: taking more than 1 million yuan, taking more than 150 people, or causing people to directly lose more than 500,000 yuan. Those who have collected more than 5 million yuan, hired more than 500 people, or caused losses of more than 2.5 million yuan will be entered into the 3 to 10 years bracket. The amount is calculated based on the full amount of money received. The money is mainly used for normal production and operations, and if all the money collected can be returned before prosecution, criminal punishment can be exempted. If the circumstances are obviously minor and the harm is not great, they shall not be treated as crimes. It doesn't go as far as a prison sentence, but there are also administrative penalties. The local department responsible for handling illegal fund-raising shall be fined 20% to 1 times the amount of funds raised. If the unit raises funds, the legal representative and the person directly responsible "will be given a warning and a fine of not less than 500,000 yuan but not more than 5 million yuan" (National Judicial Interpretation will come into effect on March 1, 2022)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress Standing Committee (2020). Criminal Law Amendment (11) (Item 12, namely Criminal Law Article 176). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/zdgz/202012/t20201227_503682.shtml>; Supreme People's Court (2022 revision). Interpretation of several issues regarding the specific application of law in the trial of criminal cases of illegal fund-raising (Fa Interpretation [2022] Amendment No. 5, Articles 1, 3, 4, and 6). <https://www.court.gov.cn/fabu/xiangqing/346901.html>; Supreme People’s Court, Supreme People’s Procuratorate, and Ministry of Public Security (2014). Opinions on Several Issues Concerning the Application of Law in Handling Criminal Cases of Illegal Fund-raising (Points 2 and 3). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/zdgz/201404/t20140401_70180.shtml>; State Council (2021). Regulations on Preventing and Handling Illegal Fund-raising (State Council Order No. 737, Articles 2, 19, 25, and 30). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2021-02/10/content_5586632.htm>

Note: Once it is determined to be illegal fund-raising, relatives and friends who lend you money will also suffer. Article 25 of the regulations stipulates that losses incurred by participating in illegal fund-raising shall be borne by the person who contributed the money. Article 19 of the regulations also names a common form of doing business: when selling things, providing services, or investing in projects, collecting money by promising money, equity, or physical returns. The store sells stored-value cards and membership cards with the promise of rebates and dividends, and charges them from unknown customers, which falls into this category. When you are short of money, a more stable way is to find a bank loan, or convert the money into shares and write it into the partnership agreement, see Article 28 (Partnership Agreement). How to prevent money contributors, see Section 5, Item 6 ("high returns", "guaranteed capital", "steady profits"). How to prevent the elderly, see Section 17, Article 5 (don’t touch “investment for retirement”). The beneficiary is mainly yourself, followed by relatives and friends who lend you money.

Case: The bakery owner only raised funds from relatives, friends and old employees to expand the store. Since there was no publicity and no promise of fixed returns, it was legal even if 30 people participated, and the operation went smoothly and dividends were distributed on time.

items.title: When renting a shop to open a shop, check whether this room can be used to open your shop before signing the contract: all the owners of the same building must agree to change the residence to a shop, and a new restaurant with oil fumes cannot be opened in a residential building
items.core: To change the residence to a shop, all other owners of the same building must agree. Owners of other buildings who can prove that they are affected are also considered. If your neighbor sues you for restoration to the original status quo and compensation, the court will support it. Residential buildings and commercial and residential buildings without dedicated flues are not allowed to open new restaurants with oil fumes. If they are found, you will be asked to change them first. If the store is not corrected, the store will be closed, and a fine of 10,000 to 100,000 yuan will be imposed. The decoration money and deposit may just be spent.
body: Cost: No money. Before you sign a lease, put down a deposit, and make renovations, take a few hours to ask three questions. One is the purpose on the property certificate, whether it is residential or commercial. The second is whether the building is purely residential, commercial or residential, or an independent shop. Is there anyone living upstairs? The third is if you open a restaurant, check if there is a special flue, and then go to the local market supervision department to ask if you can apply for a food business license. The difficulty is that when landlords and agents say, "No problem, the last one has opened it," they still have to check it themselves.

Income: Article 279 of the Civil Code: "If an owner changes a residence into a commercial building, in addition to complying with laws, regulations and management regulations, it must obtain the unanimous consent of interested owners." The judicial interpretation of the Supreme People's Court goes into more detail. Other owners in the same building are considered "interested owners." Owners of buildings with the same small difference will have to prove that their home value or quality of life has been affected. If the changes were made without their unanimous consent, the court should support their request to stop, restore the original status, or compensate for losses. The court did not support the argument that "the majority of owners agreed". The Ecological Environment Code will come into effect on August 15, 2026, and the Air Pollution Prevention and Control Law will be abolished at the same time. Article 250 of the Code prohibits the construction, reconstruction, and expansion of catering service projects that produce oily smoke, odor, and waste gas in Category III places. One is residential buildings. The second is a commercial and residential complex that does not have a dedicated flue. The third is the commercial floors adjacent to the residential floors in the commercial and residential complex. Those who violate the rules will be ordered to make corrections first. Those who refuse to make corrections will be ordered to close down and fined RMB 10,000 to RMB 100,000. The Code also requires local governments to indicate prohibitive requirements for catering location selection during the registration process. When applying for a food business license, the location must be suitable for the variety and quantity of food being operated, and must be kept at a specified distance from toxic and harmful places and other sources of pollution. Conversely, if the house itself does not comply with the mandatory provisions of laws and administrative regulations on use conditions, you can terminate the lease contract. The premise is that the inability to use is not caused by you (National)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress (2020). Civil Code (Articles 279, 724). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202006/t20200602_463888.shtml>; Supreme People's Court (2020 revision). Interpretation of Several Issues Concerning the Application of Law in the Trial of Cases concerning Disputes over Differential Ownership of Buildings (Articles 10 and 11). <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=ff808181799df6140179b092ef2d2af9> (National Laws and Regulations Database); National People’s Congress (2026). Ecological Environment Code (Articles 250, 1132, 1242, August 15, 2026) Effective from today). <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=96630961659b4d87a65b7b1c595097fa> (National Laws and Regulations Database); State Administration for Market Regulation (2023). Food Business Licensing and Registration Management Measures (State Administration for Market Regulation Order No. 78, Article 12). <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/2023/issue_10606/202307/content_6894763.html>

Note: "The last store opened it" does not mean that it can be opened. It may be that no one has ever complained, or it may have been opened before the law was implemented. There may also be other restrictions in the management agreement, so ask the property owner for a copy before signing. If the house is not allowed to be used in this way and the lease is terminated to get back the deposit and renovation losses, the landlord will have to file a lawsuit if he refuses. The ordinary procedure of first instance is stipulated to be completed within 6 months, which can be extended, and the lawyer's fees will be paid by himself. Therefore, it is easier to write "If you fail to obtain the certificate and are ordered to close, you can terminate the contract and refund the deposit" into the lease. For which licenses you need to apply for, see Article 7 (Businesses that require licenses) and Article 8 (Before making food, you should first check which category you fall into). The main beneficiary is yourself.

Case: Ms. Wang rented a first-floor apartment to open a barbecue restaurant without checking the regulations. After it opened, neighbors complained collectively, and the environmental protection department ordered it to shut down. The renovation deposit was fully compensated, resulting in a loss of nearly 200,000 yuan.

items.title: Several people open a store together, and before opening, write down a written agreement on investment, distribution of money, who has the final say, who gets the salary, and how to exit
items.core: If you don’t write an agreement, the law will set the rules for you. Decisions must be made unanimously, and the profit is divided according to the actual money each person has paid. The person who looks after the store every day will not receive a salary by default. If there is no agreed term for the partnership, anyone can give the others a reasonable notice in advance and then withdraw. If you want to change these, you can only write them into the agreement in advance.
body: Cost: No money. Several partners sat down to talk once or twice, wrote down a dozen items clearly, and signed each of them. You can find a sample partnership agreement online and fill it out item by item according to the ten items listed in the Partnership Enterprise Law. The difficulty is that among acquaintances, they feel that "talking about money hurts feelings" and are embarrassed to speak up.

Income: Article 4 of the Partnership Enterprise Law states that a partnership agreement shall be concluded in writing by all partners through consensus. Article 18 lists ten items to be included in the agreement. Among them are the method, amount and payment period of capital contribution, the method of profit distribution and loss sharing, and who will perform the partnership affairs. There are also joining and exiting a partnership, how to resolve disputes, dissolution and liquidation, and liability for breach of contract. If there is no partnership, but only a partnership of several people, the partnership contract of the Civil Code shall apply. For things that are not written in the contract, there are several default rules in the Civil Code. Decisions on partnership matters require the unanimous consent of all partners, unless otherwise stipulated in the partnership contract. Partners who perform partnership affairs cannot demand remuneration for doing so, unless otherwise agreed in the partnership contract. Profits and losses are divided according to the contract. If there is no agreement, negotiate first. If the negotiation fails, the share will be divided according to the proportion of the actual capital contribution. I can't tell the ratio, it's an average score. Partners are jointly and severally liable for the debts of the partnership, and if they overpay, they can seek repayment from others. If there is no agreed term for the partnership, it is considered an indefinite partnership, and the partners can terminate it at any time as long as they notify the others a reasonable period of time in advance. If a partnership is established and the partnership term is not agreed upon, the partners can withdraw from the partnership by giving 30 days' notice to the others. The agreement cannot stipulate that all profits will be distributed only to some people, or that some people will bear all the losses (National)
Evidence level: C

Source: National People's Congress Standing Committee (2006). Partnership Enterprise Law (revised in 2006, Articles 4, 18, 33, and 46). <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=2c909fdd678bf17901678bf63dce034d> (National Laws and Regulations Database); National People's Congress (2020). Civil Code (Articles 967, 970, 971, 972, 973, 976). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202006/t20200602_463888.shtml>

Note: The most common quarrel is how to divide the money and efforts. One pays to do nothing, and the other does not pay to look after the store every day. The one who looks after the store according to the default rules gets a small share and does not get paid. Therefore, the salary or shares contributed must be clearly stated. The agreement is between the partners only. For debts owed to external parties, the general partners still have to pay to the end, see Article 3 (Select the right entity before opening). For the red thread of attracting more people to invest money, see Article 26 (Finding people to chip in to start a business). The original text of the legal regulations has been verified. "Writing an agreement can reduce quarrels" is based on experience and there is no statistics, so it is rated C. The beneficiaries are you and your partners.

Case: Two friends opened a flower shop together and verbally agreed to share equally. Because there was no written agreement, the party who kept the store every day was rejected for wages. The court ruled that he would not be paid according to the default rule, and the two turned against each other.

items.title: If someone falls to the ground, screams, or is not breathing normally, press the chest hard immediately and ask someone else to call 120 and call for an AED.
items.core: Cardiac arrest often occurs at home. If someone performs compressions in time, the rate of being discharged alive is higher. If you don’t respond when you shout, if you press the button when you are not breathing normally, and if you breathe occasionally, it is not considered normal breathing. Stack your hands and press your chest hard, and ask someone else to call 120 and find an AED.
body: Cost: No money. Red Cross or hospital cardiopulmonary resuscitation classes can last from half a day to a day, and one course of study can last for many years. You can do it even if you haven’t learned it before: Stack your hands and place them at the midpoint of the line connecting the two nipples, and press down hard about 2 times per second without stopping.

Benefits: 79 studies, 142,740 people combined (meta-analysis). A total of only 7.6% of people whose heart stops outside the hospital (out-of-hospital cardiac arrest) are discharged alive. Presence of CPR is associated with higher survival to hospital discharge. After stratifying by original survival rates across studies, survival to hospital discharge ranged from 3.9% to 16.1% among those who received present-day cardiopulmonary resuscitation. These two numbers come from different layers and cannot be regarded as changes before and after pressing. 53% of the cases were witnessed by someone nearby, and only 32% were actually given compressions by someone present. China BASIC-OHCA registered 38,227 emergency admissions. 30,282 (79.2%) of these cardiac arrests occurred at home. Among this group of people, the compression rate of those present was 20.3%, and 1.2% were discharged alive. The sequence is compressions first, then the second person calls and gets the AED. After the machine is turned on, follow its voice. Whether you press or not depends on whether you are breathing normally. The International Red Cross's 2025 First Aid Guidelines state that in the first few minutes after the heartbeat stops, a person may still gasp erratically and laboriously, or gasp loudly. This is not considered normal breathing. If you are not sure whether it is normal or not, just treat it as abnormal. If breathing is abnormal, including wheezing, irregular breathing and no breathing, cardiopulmonary resuscitation should be performed immediately
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Sasson C et al (2010). Predictors of survival from out-of-hospital cardiac arrest: a systematic review and meta-analysis. Circulation: Cardiovascular Quality and Outcomes. <https://doi.org/10.1161/CIRCOUTCOMES.109.889576> ; Zheng J et al. (2023). Incidence, process of care, and outcomes of out-of-hospital cardiac arrest in China: a prospective study of the BASIC-OHCA registry. The Lancet Public Health. 2025, page 154: "If the person is breathing abnormally (gasping, taking irregular breaths or not breathing), start CPR immediately"; Page 161: "In the first few minutes after cardiac arrest, a person may have agonal breathing (an irregular and labored breathing pattern, or gasping noisily). This type of breathing is not normal. If there is any doubt about whether breathing is normal, assume it is not". <https://www.ifrc.org/sites/default/files/2026-03/IFRC%20International%20First%20Aid,%20Resuscitation%20and%20Education%20Guidelines%202025.pdf> ; National People's Congress (2020). Civil Code (Article 184). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202006/t20200602_463888.shtml>

Note: Children under 1 year old have different techniques and need to insufflate, see Article 44 of this section (Infant Cardiopulmonary Resuscitation). Don’t pinch people first, don’t find family members first, don’t take videos first. Don't be afraid to use force just because you're afraid of breaking your ribs. Article 184 of the Civil Code states: If a person voluntarily performs emergency rescue and injures the recipient, the rescuer shall not bear civil liability.

Case: The old man suddenly fell to the ground in the living room without breathing. His son immediately pressed his chest, and his wife called 120 and got an AED. After defibrillation, the old man regained consciousness and was sent to the hospital for rescue.

items.title: When an old man falls or someone falls to the ground, squat down and call him or call 120. Don't rush to help the person up. It is also legal in China for strangers to walk away. If you stop, don't move.
items.core: This method is mainly used on the elderly and acquaintances. Squat down and call him first to see if he is breathing normally. If he does not respond to the call, if he is not breathing normally, follow step 1 (press the chest hard). Don't hold him even if he's breathing normally. He may have suffered a stroke or fainted before falling. Holding him hard will aggravate the condition. Asked him if he remembered how he fell. His back hurt and it looked like he had a broken bone. He refused to move and called 120 on the spot.
body: Cost: No money. Squat down and ask, make a phone call, a few minutes. The hard thing is to resist reaching out for support. There is an additional calculation for strangers: calling 120 will leave your number, you may be called back, or you may be asked once. I was really targeted by my family, and the lawsuit started within a few months. And even if you win in the end, you still have to pay for the attorney fees yourself.

Benefits: The Ministry of Health's "Technical Guidelines for Fall Intervention in the Elderly" states two sentences. One sentence is "Falls are the number one cause of injury and death among people over 65 years old in our country." Another sentence is "If you find an elderly person has fallen, don't rush to help him up. You should deal with it according to the situation." If you are unconscious, call the emergency number immediately. If you are vomiting, turn your head to one side and clear your mouth and nose. If breathing and heartbeat stop, perform chest compressions immediately. "If you need to move it, you should ensure it is stable and lie down as flatly as possible." If he is conscious, first ask him if he has any memory of the fall. "If he cannot remember, it may be due to syncope or cerebrovascular accident." If you have a severe headache, a crooked mouth, difficulty speaking, or weakness in your hands and feet, "helping the elderly person immediately may aggravate cerebral hemorrhage or cerebral ischemia and worsen the condition." If there are signs of fractures, back pain, or incontinence of urine or feces, "if you don't have relevant professional knowledge, don't move it casually." In any of the above cases, you should call the emergency number immediately. If the elderly person wants to stand up on his own, you can help him to stand up slowly, "sit or lie down, rest and observe, and then leave only after confirming that there is no obstruction." When it comes to "fear of being blackmailed," this is what the law stipulates. Article 90 of the "Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on the Application of the Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China" contains two sentences. The first sentence is "The parties concerned shall provide evidence to prove the facts on which their claims are based." The second sentence is "before a judgment is made, if a party fails to provide evidence or the evidence is insufficient to prove its factual claims, the party who bears the burden of proof shall bear the adverse consequences." The original text of Article 1198 of the Civil Code is: "Operators and managers of hotels, shopping malls, banks, stations, airports, sports venues, entertainment venues and other business venues, public places or organizers of mass activities who fail to fulfill their safety guarantee obligations and cause harm to others shall bear tort liability." Article 184 of the Civil Code: "If the recipient is harmed due to the voluntary implementation of emergency rescue, the rescuer shall not bear civil liability." The Supreme People's Court announced a typical case. The pharmacy operator crushed the man's ribs while performing CPR on a man in cardiac arrest. The recipient was hospitalized for 18 days and claimed more than $9,000. The court ruled that the rescuer did not bear civil liability
Level of Evidence: B

Source: Ministry of Health (2011). Technical Guidelines for Intervention of Falls in the Elderly ("Treatment of Falls in the Elderly"). For the full text PDF, see the Guangdong Provincial Center for Disease Control and Prevention <http://cdcp.gd.gov.cn/gcdcdfiles/editor/uploadfile/20111027094832117.pdf>. For the full text of the on-site treatment section, see Guinan County People's Government for reprinting. <https://www.guinan.gov.cn/lnb/zc1__zwgk/zc/aztfl/qt/content_27609778>; National People’s Congress (2020). Civil Code (Articles 183 and 184). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202006/t20200602_463888.shtml>; Supreme People's Court (2023). Typical cases of the People's Court focusing on fairness and efficiency in implementing socialist core values (Case 13, Qi XX v. Sun XX Health Rights Dispute, People's Court of Kangping County, Liaoning Province). <https://www.court.gov.cn/zixun/xiangqing/408162.html>; Supreme People's Court (second amendment in 2022, effective on April 10, 2022). Interpretation on the application of the "Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China" (Article 90). <https://www.court.gov.cn/zixun/xiangqing/353651.html>; Article 1198 of the Civil Code is reproduced in full by the Supreme People's Procuratorate; the Standing Committee of the National People's Congress (amended in 2023, effective on January 1, 2024). Civil Procedure Law (Articles 152 and 164). The full text is reproduced by the Shanghai Development and Reform Commission <https://fgw.sh.gov.cn/ys-syjf-zc-2.4.1-h5/20240408/073febdb2b04464390546232d4089f51.html>; State Council (2006). Measures for the payment of litigation fees (State Council Order No. 481, Articles 6 and 29). <https://www.gov.cn/ziliao/flfg/2006-12/29/content_483682.htm>; Standing Committee of the National People's Congress (2025). Public Security Management Punishment Law (revised in 2025, effective from January 1, 2026, Article 26, Item 1, Article 50, Item 5). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202506/t20250627_699863.shtml>; German Federal Ministry of Justice. Strafgesetzbuch (StGB) § 323c Unterlassene Hilfeleistung; Behinderung von hilfeleistenden Personen. <https://www.gesetze-im-internet.de/stgb/__323c.html>

Remarks: B is set because the guide only tells how to deal with it, and there is no number on "how many fewer people will die if you follow the instructions." Article 184: What is exempted is damage caused during the process of rescuing people. The premise is that you are voluntary and the situation is urgent. It doesn't care about "putting people into private cars and sending them to the hospital on their own initiative". It would be safer to wait for 120. Don't hang up after calling 120, and do as the dispatcher on the line says. This set of judgments is first used by the elderly and acquaintances of the family. If you were someone you didn't know on the street, it wouldn't be illegal to walk away, and it would be the easiest thing to do: Chinese law doesn't stipulate that you have to save someone. It's not necessarily the case when you go abroad. For example, in Germany, if you encounter an accident or danger and do not help when you can help but will not put yourself in great danger, it is a crime in itself. The maximum penalty is 1 year or a fine. If the person is abroad, the calculation will be based on local laws. The bills to be paid when you stop have to be calculated step by step: time, leaving a number, being found by family members, being sued in court, causing trouble at work, being photographed and posted on the Internet. For details, see [docs/Should you stop when you encounter a stranger and get into trouble.md](../docs/Should you stop when you encounter a stranger and get into trouble.md). If you really decide to stop, the only thing you must do is **don't lift** with your hands. The reason is medical, not legal: hard support may aggravate cerebral hemorrhage or spinal injury. There is one exception: if you run the place, manage it, or organize the event, you may be held responsible for walking away. The safety protection obligations stipulated in Article 1198 of the Civil Code require you to take responsibility for the safety of people in the venue. Fall prevention itself is covered in Section 1, Item 13 (Balance and Leg Strengthening). Delayed symptoms after an elderly person knocks his head too much are shown in Article 10 of this section. Money after rescuing an injured person is provided in Article 39 of this section. See Section 8, Article 16 on how to file a report to the police if you are raped online.

Case: A stranger suddenly fell to the ground in the community. Xiao Zhou, who was passing by, did not help him. He only squatted down to call him, checked his breathing and called 120. After Grandma Wang from the opposite door fell, her daughter also squatted down to ask her and confirmed that she was not breathing normally before pressing her chest. If she was breathing, she would wait for rescue in place without moving.

items.title: If your mouth suddenly becomes crooked, one arm feels weak, and you cannot speak clearly, call 120 immediately. Do not wait or drive there by yourself
items.core: If you suddenly have a crooked mouth, feel weak in one arm, or cannot speak clearly, call 120 immediately. If a stroke can be treated with medication to open the blood vessels, the sooner it is treated, the greater the chance of recovery. If it exceeds 4.5 hours or the onset time is unknown, do not give up first aid. Let the doctor judge. Note the time of onset, and emergency personnel will send the person to a hospital that can dissolve thrombolysis.
body: Cost: No money. Three actions can be understood after just one look: make him smile, raise his hands, and say a complete sentence.

Benefits: Combined individual data from 9 randomized trials of intravenous thrombolysis and 6756 patients with acute ischemic stroke (meta-analysis). Ischemic stroke is a stroke caused by blood vessel blockage. Intravenous thrombolysis is the administration of medicine to open the blocked blood vessels. The study looked at the presence or absence of significant disability (modified Rankin score 0–1) after 3 to 6 months. Thrombolysis with alteplase within 3 hours of onset of illness was associated with an odds ratio of 1.75, 95% CI 1.35–2.27 (confidence range). The actual proportions were 32.9% for drug users and 23.1% for controls, a difference of 9.8 percentage points. The odds ratio is not a ratio of probabilities and cannot be read as 1.75 times the probability of recovery. Dragging out 3 to 4.5 hours, the odds ratio was 1.26 (1.05–1.51). Over 4.5 hours it was 1.15 (0.95–1.40), and this study found no statistically clear difference. This does not mean that treatment cannot be performed beyond 4.5 hours. The American Heart Association and American Stroke Association 2026 guidelines support extending the thrombolysis window for some patients. Patients with an unknown onset of illness or onset within 4.5 to 9 hours may still be candidates for thrombolysis after screening with specialized imaging studies. Whether you can take medicine should be evaluated by a doctor. The sooner you get medical treatment, the better. The 2017 pre-hospital emergency response consensus of the Emergency Medicine Branch of the Chinese Stroke Society requires that emergency personnel "transport patients with suspected stroke to the nearest certified stroke center or a hospital that can perform intravenous thrombolysis and/or endovascular treatment as soon as possible" and "notify the receiving hospital in advance before the patient with suspected stroke arrives at the hospital." The consensus also states that patients with acute stroke may have impaired breathing due to "aspiration" and other reasons. The consensus recommends teaching the public to use "Stroke 1-2-0" to recognize stroke: "1. Look - 1. The face is asymmetrical and the corners of the mouth are crooked; 2. Check - 2 arms are raised parallel and unilaterally weak; 0. Listen to the language, the speech is unclear and the expression is difficult. If you have any of the above sudden symptoms, call the emergency hotline 120 immediately." When emergency personnel ask for medical history, "asking the time of onset of symptoms is most important"
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Emberson J, Lees KR, Lyden P, et al. (2014). Effect of treatment delay, age, and stroke severity on the effects of intravenous thrombolysis with alteplase for acute ischaemic stroke: a meta-analysis of individual patient data from randomized trials. Lancet, 384(9958), 1929-1935. <https://doi.org/10.1016/S0140-6736(14)60584-5>; Chinese Stroke Society Emergency Medicine Branch (2017). Expert consensus on pre-hospital first aid for stroke. Chinese Journal of Emergency Medicine, 26(10), 1107-1114. <http://www.cem.org.cn/rhtml/20171002/index.htm>; Prabhakaran S et al (2026). 2026 Guideline for the Early Management of Patients With Acute Ischemic Stroke. Stroke. <https://doi.org/10.1161/STR.0000000000000513>; American Heart Association (2026). Top Things to Know: 2026 Guideline for the Early Management of Patients With AIS, point 3. <https://professional.heart.org/en/science-news/2026-guideline-for-the-early-management-of-patients-with-acute-ischemic-stroke/top-things-to-know>

Note: The earlier thrombolysis is, the more effective it is, but first aid cannot be given up just because it exceeds 4.5 hours. The reason for calling 120 instead of driving yourself is because according to the consensus on pre-hospital first aid, emergency personnel need to send the person to a hospital that can provide thrombolysis, and they must notify the hospital in advance to prepare. Note the exact time the symptoms started, which your doctor will use to evaluate opportunities for treatment. Don't give water or medicine. This is what the author deduced from the consensus of "aspiration": stroke patients may choke. Don’t wait to “take a break and have a look.”

Case: The uncle suddenly had a crooked mouth and weakness in his right hand while eating. My wife immediately called 120 and wrote down the time. The ambulance was sent directly to the thrombolysis hospital. The symptoms were relieved within one hour after taking the medicine, without leaving any sequelae.

items.title: If you suddenly feel dizzy, unsteady on your feet, see things in pairs, have a black eye, or can’t reach the tip of your nose with your finger, just press 120 for stroke
items.core: If you only look at the three items of “face crooked, raise hands, speak”, more than 10% of strokes will be missed, because some strokes neither crooked the mouth nor paralyzed the hands at the beginning. Factoring in unsteadiness, double vision, or missing a piece, the number of misses drops to 4.4%. Suddenly the world was spinning and I couldn't stand, I couldn't see things in two places, and I couldn't reach the tip of my nose with my finger. I still dialed 120 and wrote down the time.
body: Cost: No money. In addition to the three actions of "face crooked, raise hands, speak" (No. 3, suddenly crooked mouth, unable to speak clearly), add two more. One is to ask him to stand up straight and close his eyes to see if he is shaking, and then ask him if there are any double images or if there is any missing piece. The other one is to point his finger at the tip of his nose when he is in doubt, close his eyes and point again.

Benefits: The University of Kentucky Stroke Center reviewed the records of 736 acute ischemic strokes (strokes caused by blockage of blood vessels) in 2014. Among them, 14.1% of the patients had no symptoms of facial distortion, arm weakness, and slurred speech (FAST) at the time of onset. When "unsteady walking, weak legs, and visual symptoms" are also included in the screening, the missed rate dropped from 14.1% to 4.4%. Two hospitals in the United States reviewed the emergency medical records of 465 cases of ischemic stroke, and 22% were initially missed. Blockage of a blood vessel supplying blood to the back of the brain (posterior circulation stroke) is initially missed in 37% of cases and only 16% in the front. People who were dizzy were more likely to be missed, with an odds ratio of 1.99 compared to people who were not dizzy. For those with nausea and vomiting, the odds ratio was 4.02. Among the signs of stroke listed in the International Red Cross's 2025 First Aid Guidelines are "sudden difficulty seeing in one or both eyes" and "sudden difficulty walking, dizziness, loss of balance or coordination"
Level of Evidence: B

Source: Aroor S, Singh R, Goldstein LB (2017). BE-FAST (Balance, Eyes, Face, Arm, Speech, Time): Reducing the Proportion of Strokes Missed Using the FAST Mnemonic. Stroke, 48(2), 479-481. <https://doi.org/10.1161/STROKEAHA.116.015169>; Arch AE, Weisman DC, Coca S, et al. (2016). Missed Ischemic Stroke Diagnosis in the Emergency Department by Emergency Medicine and Neurology Services. Stroke, 47(3), 668-673: "Thirty-seven percent of posterior strokes were initially misdiagnosed compared with 16% of anterior strokes". <https://doi.org/10.1161/strokeaha.115.010613>; International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies (2025). International First Aid, Resuscitation and Education Guidelines 2025, pp. 366–367: "Sudden trouble in seeing with one or both eyes" "Sudden trouble walking or experiencing dizziness, loss of balance or coordination". <https://www.ifrc.org/sites/default/files/2026-03/IFRC%20International%20First%20Aid,%20Resuscitation% 20and%20Education%20Guidelines%202025.pdf>

Note: The blood vessels in the back of the brain are blocked (posterior circulation stroke), and the mouth is often not twisted or the hands are paralyzed, but the world is spinning, the walking is unsteady, and the eyes are in pairs, so it is most likely to be missed. Inability to point and nose accurately, or unable to stand with eyes closed, are what Red Cross guidelines call "problems with balance or coordination." But there is no action that can reverse the rule of stroke: Call 120 if it appears suddenly and does not relieve, and note the exact time of onset. The study in Kentucky only looked at the medical records of one hospital, and the author himself stated that it needs to be verified again

Case: My aunt suddenly suffered from dizziness, could not stand steady, and saw double vision. My son and daughter did not treat it as 'ordinary dizziness', so they called 120 for a stroke. The doctor diagnosed cerebellar infarction, and he was rushed to the hospital in time to avoid paralysis.

items.title: One eye suddenly blackened out like a curtain. Even if it healed on its own in a few minutes, he went to the emergency room as a stroke that same day
items.core: One eye suddenly lost sight. It may be that the blood vessels under the eye were blocked. The longer the blockage, the less retina can be saved. It is also a type of stroke. It only takes a few minutes to recover, but you need to seek medical attention immediately. Minor strokes and transient ischemia were changed to same-day assessment and treatment, and further strokes within 90 days dropped from 10.3% to 2.1%. Go directly to the emergency room, don't wait until the next day.
body: Cost: No money. Emergency evaluation and vascular examination can take up half a day to a full day.

Benefit: The American Heart Association's 2021 scientific statement on central retinal artery occlusion (blockage of the main blood vessel under the eye) states: "Acute central retinal artery occlusion is an emergency." The treatment system should identify them as emergencies and prioritize them. The longer the blood loss is, the less retina can be saved. The Oxford EXPRESS study looked at two types of patients: minor strokes, and cerebral ischemia (medically called transient ischemic attacks) in which symptoms get better on their own. This group of patients was later changed to same-day assessment and treatment started on the same day. After the change, the proportion of recurrent strokes within 90 days dropped from 10.3% (32/310) to 2.1% (6/281). The abstract of the scientific statement also states that central retinal artery occlusion is a type of acute ischemic stroke and a predictor of subsequent cerebrovascular and cardiovascular events. The British National Health Service (NHS) lists "blurred vision or loss of vision in one or both eyes" as a symptom of stroke, and states that if the symptoms stop on their own after a while, you should seek medical attention immediately. If you have had stroke symptoms in the past 24 hours and have stopped, you should also call emergency services
Level of Evidence: B

Source: Mac Grory B, Schrag M, Biousse V, et al. (2021). Management of Central Retinal Artery Occlusion: A Scientific Statement From the American Heart Association. Stroke, 52(6), e282-e294: "Central retinal artery occlusion (CRAO) is a form of acute ischemic stroke that Causes visual loss and is a harbinger of further cerebrovascular and cardiovascular events". <https://doi.org/10.1161/STR.0000000000000366>; NHS. Symptoms of a stroke: "blurred vision or loss of sight in 1 or both eyes" "medical help straight away" "you've had signs of a stroke within the last 24 hours even if they've now stopped". <https://www.nhs.uk/conditions/stroke/symptoms/> ; Rothwell PM, Giles MF, Chandratheva A, et al. (2007). Effect of urgent treatment of transient ischaemic attack and minor stroke on early recurrent stroke (EXPRESS study): a prospective population-based sequential comparison. Lancet, 370(9596), 1432-1442. <https://doi.org/10.1016/S0140-6736(07)61448-2>

Note: B is set because EXPRESS is not a randomized trial. It compares the two periods before and after the same group of people changed their practices. Other conditions may have changed between the two periods. This part is inseparable. If the vision goes dark for a few minutes and then recovers on its own, it can easily be dismissed as "tired" or "low blood sugar". The NHS states that you should seek medical attention immediately even if your symptoms stop on their own. If the EXPRESS patients were not treated on the day of treatment, 10.3% had another stroke within 90 days. If you suddenly lose sight in one eye, you should take it seriously even if it doesn't hurt or become red. Don’t wait to see the eye clinic the next day, go directly to the emergency room of a hospital with a stroke center.

Case: 58-year-old Aunt Li suddenly felt like a black curtain was drawn over her right eye while cooking. She recovered after 5 minutes. She did not wait for the next day, but went to the emergency room to have her fundus and cerebral blood vessels checked that day, and was diagnosed with retinal artery occlusion. Her vision recovered after thrombolysis, and she did not have another stroke within 90 days.

items.title: One eye was swollen, painful, and red. There was a rainbow in the light when I looked at it. I also had a headache, nausea, and made me vomit. I went to the eye emergency department that day.
items.core: This may be an acute attack of glaucoma. The water in the eye cannot be drained out, and the intraocular pressure rises, crushing the optic nerve connected to the brain. The longer it takes from onset to lowering intraocular pressure, the greater the possibility of visual field defects. A patient in a Korean hospital was left with a defect in half of his eyes after one year. These symptoms suddenly appeared and I went to the emergency room the same day.
body: Cost: No money. The emergency ophthalmology department took up half a day to measure intraocular pressure and check the anterior chamber.

Income: An eye hospital in Wuhan compared patients with acute primary angle-closure glaucoma for two periods of time. There were 54 people with 64 eyes in the 76 days of lockdown in 2020, and 46 people with 51 eyes in the same period in 2021. The demographic characteristics of the two groups are similar. The time from symptom onset to treatment was 241.84±211.95 hours in the lockdown group and 121.53±96.12 hours in the control group (P=0.001). IOP at presentation was 52.63±12.45 mmHg vs. 45.16±9.79 mmHg (P=0.001). The proportion of blindness was 21.87% versus 7.84%. Glaucomatous optic neuropathy was detected in 20/64 eyes (31.25%) versus 7/51 eyes (13.73%) (P=0.03). A hospital in South Korea reviewed 50 eyes that had a single episode and subsequently had lenses removed. Twenty-five (50%) were left with varying degrees of visual field loss after one year. The longer the period from the onset of symptoms to the reduction of intraocular pressure, the greater the possibility of leaving a defect (P=0.005). Another prospective study had 43 people with shallow anterior chambers lie prone for 1 hour in a dark room. The intraocular pressure of both eyes was significantly increased (P<0.01). The median value of the eye usually used increased by 3.60 mmHg, and that of the other eye increased by 2.70 mmHg (P<0.05). The NHS states that glaucoma sometimes attacks suddenly. Symptoms include severe eye pain, redness, rainbow-colored circles around bright lights, blurred vision, nausea and vomiting, and headache. If it suddenly occurs, call the emergency department or go to the emergency room. It usually occurs when the fluid in the eye cannot be drained out, the intraocular pressure increases, and the optic nerve that connects the eye to the brain is crushed. People at higher risk are those over 50, those who have a parent or sibling with glaucoma, Asians, and those with nearsightedness, farsightedness or diabetes. Zhongshan Eye Center has treated 243 patients with angle-closure glaucoma aged 40 and under from 2012 to 2019.
Level of Evidence: B

Source: Zhou L, Wu S, Wang Y, Bao X, Peng T, Luo W, Ortega-Usobiaga J (2022). Clinical presentation of acute primary angle closure during the COVID-19 epidemic lockdown. Frontiers in Medicine, 9, 1078237. <https://doi.org/10.3389/fmed.2022.1078237> ; Sung MS, Kim HJ, Park SW (2023). Predictors of long-term visual field outcome after an episode of acute primary angle closure. Clinical & Experimental Ophthalmology, 51(4), 291-299. <https://doi.org/10.1111/ceo.14206> ; Wang J, Wang J, Ng TK, Huang C (2025). Asymmetric intraocular pressure changes in dominant and contralateral eyes: the dark room prone provocative test. Seminars in Ophthalmology, 40(4), 325-331. <https://doi.org/10.1080/08820538.2024.2443972>; NHS. (nausea) and being sick, a headache" "This happens when the fluid in your eye cannot drain as it should". <https://www.nhs.uk/conditions/glaucoma/> ; Lin SF, Xiao H, Chen LM, et al. (2022). [Clinical features of young inpatients with angle-closure glaucoma]. Chinese Journal of Ophthalmology, 58(1), 28-34. <https://doi.org/10.3760/cma.j.cn112142-20210301-00104>

Note: There are two reasons for setting B. First, the two groups in Wuhan were compared through old medical records. The lockdown itself also brought about other differences, which are inseparable from the "delay" aspect. Second, the Korean group only had 50 eyes and was also retrospective. The trigger is not about looking at a screen. In that prospective study, people with a shallow anterior chamber had increased intraocular pressure after lying down in a dark room for an hour. High-risk groups include those listed by the NHS: over 50s, someone in the family who has had it, and long-sightedness. Young people can also get it. Among the patients under 40 years old at Zhongshan Ophthalmology Department, more than 60% are caused by other eye diseases (secondary). When an attack occurs, you will have headache, nausea and vomiting. Don’t just treat it as gastroenteritis or migraine. First check whether the eyes are red or painful, and whether there are rainbow circles in the lights. It is another thing to be unable to see in one eye without pain or redness, see No. 5 (one eye suddenly blackens). Whether anti-blue light glasses are useful, see Section 6, Article 16 (Anti-blue light glasses).

Case: 62-year-old Uncle Zhang’s right eye was swollen, painful and red in the evening. There was a rainbow circle when he looked at the light, and he felt nauseous and vomiting. He immediately went to the eye emergency department and his intraocular pressure was measured to be as high as 52. He was immediately given intraocular pressure-lowering drugs and laser treatment. Two hours later, the intraocular pressure dropped and there was no visual field defect.

items.title: If there is pain, tightness, and tightness in the chest that does not relieve for more than 15 minutes, or if the pain causes cold sweat, nausea, or breathlessness, call 120. Do not carry it or drive by yourself
items.core: If there is pain, tightness, or tightness on the chest that does not relieve for more than 15 minutes, call 120. If the pain is severe, you break out in a cold sweat, or you can't breathe, you should be beaten after the pain lasts for a few minutes. For patients whose blood vessels were opened within 55 minutes of arriving at the hospital, 2.8% died within 30 days. 9.7% over 55 minutes. Don't drive yourself to the hospital.
body: Cost: No money.

Benefits: Israel conducted a national acute coronary syndrome survey. The analysis was conducted on patients with ST-segment elevation myocardial infarction, a type of myocardial infarction. It is calculated from the time between entering the hospital and using a balloon to open the blocked blood vessel (balloon dilatation). Interval ≤55 minutes, 5/178 (2.8%) died within 30 days. Interval >55 minutes, 15/155 (9.7%) died within 30 days. The National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (NICE) chest pain guidelines list symptoms suggestive of acute coronary syndrome: pain in the chest or arms, back, or jaw for more than 15 minutes; chest pain accompanied by nausea and vomiting, heavy sweating, and breathlessness. The International Red Cross's 2025 first aid guidelines say that if the pain is severe, you can't breathe, your face is white, gray and clammy, you should call first aid immediately, "even if it only hurts for a few minutes." Myocardial infarction may also cause pain in the chin, upper abdomen, and between the two shoulder blades. Symptoms may not be obvious in women, the elderly and people with diabetes
Level of Evidence: B

Source: Karkabi B, Meir G, Zafrir B, et al. (2021). Door-to-balloon time and mortality in patients with ST-elevation myocardial infarction. European Heart Journal - Quality of Care and Clinical Outcomes. <https://doi.org/10.1093/ehjqcco/qcaa037>; NICE (2010, Updated 2016). Recent-onset chest pain of suspected cardiac origin: assessment and diagnosis (CG95), Article 1.2.1.3: "pain in the chest and/or other areas (for example, the arms, back or jaw) lasting longer than 15 minutes" "chest pain associated with nausea and vomiting, marked sweating, breathlessness, or particularly a combination of these". <https://www.nice.org.uk/guidance/cg95/chapter/Recommendations>; International Federation of Red Cross and Red Crescent Societies (2025). International First Aid, Resuscitation and Education Guidelines 2025, pp. 357–358: "Access EMS even if the pain has only lasted a couple of minutes" "Symptoms may be more subtle or uncommon in some populations, such as people who are female, elderly or have diabetes". <https://www.ifrc.org/sites/default/files/2026-03/IFRC%20International%20First%20Aid,%20Resuscitation%20and%20Education%20Guidelines%202025.pdf>; NHS. Heart attack: "Do not drive yourself to A&E". <https://www.nhs.uk/conditions/heart-attack/symptoms/>

Note: The Israeli study compared the period of delay after entering the hospital, not the period from onset to hospital. But the principle is the same, the sooner the blood vessels are opened, the better. The pain may be in the upper abdomen, back, or jaw. Women, the elderly, and people with diabetes may not have obvious symptoms, just shortness of breath or discomfort. 15 minutes is the limit that NICE gives doctors, and it does not ask you to wait: if the pain is severe, you are sweating, or you are short of breath, you can give it a shot in a few minutes. NHS instructions do not drive yourself to the emergency department

Case: 55-year-old Wang felt as if a big stone was pressing on his chest during dinner, which lasted for 20 minutes. He broke out in cold sweats and was out of breath. He asked his wife to call 120 instead of driving. The ambulance arrived at the hospital in 40 minutes, the balloon was dilated within 55 minutes, and everything was fine after a review 30 days later.

items.title: For sudden severe pain like being torn apart, moving from the chest to the back and waist, call 120 and say "like being torn apart"
items.core: For sudden severe pain like being torn apart in the chest, back or stomach, call 120 and simply say "like being torn apart". For type A dissection without surgery and taking medicine alone, the in-hospital mortality rate is 58%. Typical signs are often absent, and it is up to the doctor to think of it first. There is a big difference in blood pressure between the two arms, and I can't feel the pulse on one side, so I tell him.
body: Cost: No money.

Benefits: The International Registry of Acute Aortic Dissection (IRAD) included 464 cases from 12 centers. Aortic dissection is a disease that causes severe tearing pain in the chest and back. Among the first symptoms reported by patients, the most common is sudden onset of severe, sharp pain. However, the symptoms are varied, and typical signs such as no pulse on one side appear in only 15.1% of people. Overall in-hospital mortality was 27.4%. For patients with type A dissection who do not undergo surgery and only take medicine, the mortality rate is 58%. The registry study concluded that typical manifestations are often absent and "a high clinical index of suspicion is necessary." The American Heart Association and American College of Cardiology 2022 Aortic Disease Guidelines use a scoring chart to determine the likelihood of dissection. High-risk situations include connective tissue diseases such as Marfan syndrome, family history of aortic disease, and known thoracic aortic aneurysms. High-risk pain is chest, back or abdominal pain that comes on suddenly, is very severe, and feels like tearing. High-risk signs are that you can't feel a pulse on one side, or that the systolic blood pressure (high pressure) is much different between the two arms. The guidelines also state that poor blood pressure control is a known risk factor for aortic rupture and dissection
Level of Evidence: B

Source: Hagan PG, Nienaber CA, Isselbacher EM, et al. (2000). The International Registry of Acute Aortic Dissection (IRAD): new insights into an old disease. JAMA, 283(7), 897-903: "Acute aortic dissection presents with a wide range of manifestations, and classic findings are often absent. A high clinical index of suspicion is necessary". <https://doi.org/10.1001/jama.283.7.897>; Isselbacher EM, Preventza O, Hamilton Black J, et al. (2022). 2022 ACC/AHA Guideline for the Diagnosis and Management of Aortic Disease. Circulation, 146(24), e334-e482, Table 24 (ADD-RS): "Marfan syndrome or other connective tissue disease" "Family history of aortic disease" "Ripping or tearing in quality" "Pulse deficit or systolic blood pressure differential"; "Uncontrolled hypertension is a known risk factor for aortic rupture and dissection". <https://doi.org/10.1161/CIR.0000000000001106>

Note: When you go to the hospital, you should take the initiative to say, "It looks like a tear, and the pain is going down." This will make the doctor think of dissection and do a contrast-enhanced CT. Myocardial infarction is commonly treated with anticoagulant and thrombolytic drugs that make the blood clot. The author concludes that the use of such drugs on dissections will aggravate bleeding, so the doctor must first rule out the dissection. There is a big difference in blood pressure between the two arms and the pulse cannot be felt on one side, which is a warning. Those with poorly controlled blood pressure, those with Marfan syndrome, and those with aortic disease in their family are at higher risk. Also don’t drive by yourself, don’t endure it until the next day

Case: 48-year-old Mr. Chen suddenly felt as if his chest was being torn open, and pain spread to his back and waist. When he called 120, he simply said, "It's like being torn apart," and told the operator that the blood pressure in his left arm could not be measured. Type A dissection was confirmed by CT scan at the hospital, and the situation was relieved after emergency surgery.

items.title: If you suddenly get the “worst headache of your life”, the pain will be the worst within an hour, go to the emergency department immediately for a head CT scan
items.core: For severe headaches that are extremely painful within an hour, about 6% of them are caused by ruptured blood vessels on the surface of the brain, so go to the emergency room immediately. If you are over 40 years old, have neck pain or stiffness, or if someone sees you fainting, the doctor will investigate. Getting sick during activities, exploding instantly, and being unable to lower your neck forward are also considered. Most of the people who checked were fine, but in the study, according to these few checks, no bleeding was found.
body: Cost: The emergency room visit itself costs nothing. A head CT in the emergency room costs several hundred yuan.

Benefits: 10 emergency departments in Canada conducted a prospective cohort study on 2,131 cases of "severe headaches that reached their worst pain within one hour." The criteria were set in advance and then tracked and recorded. Of those, 132 (6.2%) were subarachnoid hemorrhages (broken blood vessels on the surface of the brain). The study identified bleeding. The first basis was bleeding seen on head CT ("subarachnoid blood on computed tomography scan"), and the second basis was abnormal cerebrospinal fluid extracted by lumbar puncture. There are six rules for Ottawa SAH: 40 years and older, neck pain or stiffness, and being seen fainting. The other three are seizures during activity, sudden explosion seizures, and limited forward bending of the neck during a physical examination by the doctor. Check if any of the conditions apply. This rule singled out all those who bleed, with a sensitivity of 100%, 95% CI 97.2%–100.0% (confidence range). The trade-off is that it rules out only 15.3% of those without bleeding (specificity 15.3%)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Perry JJ, Stiell IG, Sivilotti MLA, et al. (2013). Clinical decision rules to rule out subarachnoid hemorrhage for acute headache. JAMA, 310(12), 1248-1255: "Subarachnoid hemorrhage, defined as (1) subarachnoid blood on computed tomography scan; (2) xanthochromia in cerebrospinal fluid; or (3) red blood cells in the final tube of cerebrospinal fluid, with positive angiography findings". <https://doi.org/10.1001/jama.2013.278018>

Note: What matters is not "how much it hurts", but "how quickly it hurts the most". A headache that explodes within a few seconds to a minute is a danger signal, but a migraine that slowly gets worse is not. If it is accompanied by vomiting, stiff neck, sensitivity to light, or brief syncope, it should be taken seriously. The specificity is only 15.3%, which means that the vast majority of people who check according to this check will be fine. But if it is missed, there may be bleeding again, so it is worth checking. Do not take a painkiller and then go to sleep

Case: 45-year-old Ms. Liu suddenly had a "exploding" headache while moving heavy objects. The pain was the worst within an hour and her neck became stiff. She immediately went to the emergency department for a head CT scan, which revealed subarachnoid hemorrhage. The aneurysm was promptly clipped and there was no further bleeding.

items.title: After an old man kowtows his head, he will become unsteady, sluggish, drowsy, or weak on one side in two to three weeks to a few months. Get a head CT scan
items.core: After an old man kowtows, blood usually does not accumulate until the third week. The bumps are often minor, and more than half of the patients cannot tell that they have been injured. The recurrence rate of this disease after surgery can reach 33%, and the mortality rate can reach 32%. I found that the old man was suddenly confused, walked unsteadily, always wanted to sleep, and had no strength in one hand. I first went back and asked if he had fallen over his head in the past two or three months, and then went for a CT scan.
body: Cost: Two to three hundred yuan for a head CT.

Income: The Neurosurgery Branch of the Chinese Medical Association and others have released the "Chinese Expert Consensus on Drug Treatment of Chronic Subdural Hematoma". Chronic subdural hematoma is a pool of blood that slowly accumulates between the meninges. The professional term is a chronic mass caused by blood accumulation between the arachnoid mater and dura mater. It "usually develops in the third week after traumatic brain injury" and is more common in older people. The recurrence rate after surgery can reach 33%, and the mortality rate can reach 32%. Only 24% of patients over 90 years old did well overall. Systematic review: Globally, there are 3.39 to 39.1 new cases per 100,000 people per year, which can triple with age and can triple over the age of 80 years. The most common causes are trauma and falls, followed by long-term alcohol abuse, use of medicines that prevent blood clotting (anticoagulation), and violent injuries. Geriatric Medicine Review: Clinical manifestations "typically include confusion, cognitive decline, gait disturbance, or somnolence and may resemble other geriatric syndromes." This review also said that the increasing number of cases is related to the fact that more people are taking anticoagulants and antiplatelet drugs (aspirin, clopidogrel, etc.) and that the elderly are more likely to fall. Another literature review noted that there is a lag between injury and symptoms, and that injuries are usually minor and therefore often overlooked. More than 50% of patients denied injury
Level of Evidence: B

Source: Zhang J et al (2021). Expert consensus on drug treatment of chronic subdural hematoma. Chinese Neurosurgical Journal, 7(1), 47. <https://doi.org/10.1186/s41016-021-00263-z> ; Dziho A et al (2025). Global prevalence and incidence of chronic subdural hematoma. hematoma: A systematic review. Brain and Spine, 5, 105893. <https://doi.org/10.1016/j.bas.2025.105893> ; Mathon B, Shotar E (2026). Diagnostic and therapeutic management of chronic subdural hematoma in elderly patients. Gériatrie et Psychologie Neuropsychiatrie du Vieillissement, 24(1), 30-41. <https://doi.org/10.1684/pnv.2026.1274> ; Iliescu IA, Constantinescu AI (2015). Clinical evolutional aspects of chronic subdural haematomas - literature review. Journal of Medicine and Life, 8(Spec Issue), 26-33: "the brain injury, usually minor" "patients deny the existence of a trauma in over 50% of the cases". <https://europepmc.org/article/MED/26361507>

Note: The collision is often just a small bump, and more than half of the elderly cannot say that they have been injured. So when my family found out that "I have suddenly become confused recently, I feel shaky when I walk, I always feel sleepy, and I have no strength in one hand," I first went back and asked if I had fallen or bumped my head in the past two or three months, and then went for a CT scan. It behaves like other geriatric diseases and should not be directly attributed to "Alzheimer's disease" or "the sequelae of the last stroke". Elderly people who take aspirin, clopidogrel, warfarin or new oral anticoagulants are at higher risk, as are long-term heavy drinkers. To prevent falls, see Section 1, Item 13 (Balance and Leg Strengthening). Memory is getting worse year by year and it is not caused by kowtow. See Section 17, Article 13 (Memory Clinic).

Case: 78-year-old Grandma Zhao slipped in the kitchen three months ago and hit the back of her head, but she didn’t care at the time. In the past two weeks, she had a wobbly walk, was slow to wake up, and had no strength in her right hand. Her son remembered the fall and took her for a head CT, which revealed chronic subdural hematoma. After drilling and drainage, she was able to walk on her own.

items.title: If one leg suddenly becomes swollen, tight, and painful when pressed, seek medical attention as soon as possible; if there is sudden outness of breath or chest pain, call immediately 120
items.core: If one leg suddenly becomes swollen and painful, go to the hospital as soon as possible. Coupled with the sudden shortness of breath and chest pain, and calling 120 directly, 17.4% of people diagnosed with pulmonary embolism died from various causes within 3 months. If you sit in a car or fly for more than 4 hours, the risk roughly doubles. Get up and walk every once in a while. If you are worried about blood clots, ask your doctor whether you should wear compression stockings before departure.
body: Cost: An ultrasound of the blood vessels in the legs (lower limb venous ultrasound) costs one to two hundred yuan.

Benefits: The International Collaborative Pulmonary Embolism Registry (ICOPER) included 2454 patients with confirmed acute pulmonary embolism from 52 hospitals in 7 countries. Pulmonary embolism is a blood clot blocking the pulmonary artery. The 3-month mortality rate from any cause in this cohort was 17.4% (426/2454). The World Health Organization's WRIGHT Project: Traveling for more than four hours in a row "approximately doubles" the risk of blood clots developing in veins and traveling to the lungs (venous thromboembolism). But the probability of it being passed on to one person is still very low, "about one in 6,000" if they sit still for more than 4 hours. The WHO also states that people who have questions about prevention should ask their doctor before traveling. The symptoms of deep vein thrombosis listed by the British National Health Service (NHS) are pain in one leg and swelling in the other leg. If you suspect it is the case, make an appointment with the doctor as soon as possible. The doctor will arrange to go to the hospital for an ultrasound within 24 hours. If you have leg pain, swollen legs, shortness of breath or chest pain, call the emergency call. The NHS also recommends that when traveling by plane, train or car for more than 4 hours, wear loose-fitting clothing, drink plenty of fluids, avoid alcohol, and get up and walk when you can. Cochrane in 2021 compiled a list of 12 randomized trials involving passengers on flights of more than five hours. People who wore graded compression stockings had fewer asymptomatic, test-detected deep vein thrombosis: odds ratio OR 0.10, 95% CI 0.04 to 0.25 (confidence range). This outcome is rare, and the odds ratio and relative risk are similar. 50 people were found out of 2637 people, 3 people were wearing socks and 47 people were not wearing socks. No one in these trials died, had a pulmonary embolism, or developed symptomatic blood clots. So it’s not clear yet whether compression stockings can prevent these really bad outcomes.
Level of Evidence: B

Source: Goldhaber SZ, Visani L, De Rosa M (1999). Acute pulmonary embolism: clinical outcomes in the International Cooperative Pulmonary Embolism Registry (ICOPER). Lancet, 353(9162), 1386-1389. <https://doi.org/10.1016/S0140-6736(98)07534-5> ; WHO (2007). Study results released on travel and blood clots: "Individuals with questions regarding prevention of VTE should consult their physicians before traveling". <https://www.who.int/news/item/29-06-2007-study-results-released-on-travel-and-blood-clots> ; NHS. (rarely both legs), usually in the calf or thigh" "swelling in 1 leg (rarely both legs)" "Ask for an urgent GP appointment or get help from NHS 111 if: you think you have DVT (deep vein thrombosis)" "Call 999 or go to A&E if: You have symptoms of DVT (deep vein thrombosis), such as pain and swelling, and: feel short of breath" "have chest pain" "you should be referred to hospital within 24 hours for an ultrasound scan" "If you're traveling for 4 hours or more by plane, train or car" "wearing loose clothing" "drinking plenty of water" "avoiding alcohol" "walking around when possible". <https://www.nhs.uk/conditions/deep-vein-thrombosis-dvt/> ; Clarke MJ, Broderick C, Hopewell S, Juszczak E, Eisinga A (2021). Compression stockings for preventing deep vein thrombosis in airline passengers. Cochrane Database of Systematic Reviews, 4, CD004002. <https://doi.org/10.1002/14651858.CD004002.pub4>

Note: If both legs are swollen together, it is mostly a problem with the heart, liver, kidney or venous function. One leg suddenly becomes swollen and thicker than the other, which is a typical sign of deep vein thrombosis.容易出事的是长途坐车坐飞机、手术或骨折后卧床、打石膏、怀孕生产前后、肿瘤、吃口服避孕药。 Pulmonary embolism occurs when a blood clot breaks off and blocks the pulmonary artery: sudden breathlessness, chest pain when taking a deep breath, rapid heartbeat, dizziness, and coughing up blood (hemoptysis). At this point, just hit 120. 17.4% is the mortality rate of confirmed pulmonary embolism cases. It’s not that “there is such a big risk because your legs are swollen.” Don’t scare yourself with this number. The WHO study did not examine how to prevent it. It only mentioned that when sitting, move your ankles up and down and move your calves. Don't wear tight clothes on the road. If you have any questions, ask your doctor before setting off. There are also high-risk passengers in the test of compression stockings, but only small blood clots without symptoms are detected, so if you want to wear them, you should ask your doctor first if you have high-risk factors.

Case: 32-year-old Xiao Zhou’s left calf became swollen, painful and tight after flying for 12 hours. He thought it was due to sitting for a long time and ignored him. When I got off the plane, I suddenly felt out of breath and had chest pain. I called 120 immediately. A CT pulmonary angiography confirmed the diagnosis of pulmonary embolism. After thrombolysis, my breathing became stable and there was no recurrence within three months.

items.title: If there is heavy bleeding, first press the wound firmly with your hands. If your limbs cannot be pressed, apply a tourniquet and apply 120 at the same time.
items.core: First press firmly with your hands or clothing, and at the same time let someone else apply 120. If the limbs cannot be compressed, a tourniquet is applied, and the neck and trunk can only be compressed. Among the wounded on the battlefield, 90% of those who had a tourniquet applied before shock survived, while only 10% of those who had a tourniquet applied after shock survived. The five who should not have had a tourniquet applied all died. Tie the tourniquet above the wound, twist it until the bleeding stops, note the time, don't loosen it yourself, and wait for the emergency personnel to arrive.
body: Cost: A spinning tourniquet ranges from tens to more than a hundred yuan, and should be kept in the car and first aid kit. Learn to "prick above the wound, twist until the bleeding stops, and record the time" for a few minutes.

Benefits: 1,026 cases of vascular injuries to the extremities were admitted to 11 Level I trauma centers in Texas over 6 years. A tourniquet was applied before hospital presentation in 181 of these cases (17.6%).
