This practice is first used by family members, but it is more commonly used by friends and colleagues who drink together. People who drink together also have a legal obligation to look after them. The Taixing Court in Jiangsu Province ruled on a case: two people knew clearly that the person sitting at the same table was drunk, but did not notify his family or send him home. He fell into the river and drowned in the early morning. The two men were responsible for 7% and 3% respectively, and the total compensation was 104,000 yuan (accurately 103,887 yuan). Supreme Court Guiding Case No. 227 also states that if the drinker fails to fulfill his duty of reminder and care, he or she must share the compensation based on fault. So when the show is over, leave the person in the hands of his family, or keep him there until he wakes up. If you see a drunk stranger on the roadside, just call 120. Don’t lift him. For the reason, see Article 2 of this section (don’t rush to help him up). Being drunk is prone to hypothermia. How to keep warm is described in Article 28 (Hyperthermia) of this section. If you take cephalosporin and metronidazole and then drink alcohol, please see Section 34, Article 11 (Do not drink alcohol while taking cephalosporin and metronidazole). Do not allow drunk people to take baths or saunas. See Section 22, Article 11 (Do not take baths or saunas after drinking alcohol).

Case: At a party, a colleague was drunk and fell unconscious. His friend laid him on his side and stayed with him, not letting him sleep alone. In the middle of the night, my colleague's breathing slowed down and he was convulsing. A friend immediately called 120. The doctor said he was suffering from alcohol poisoning and aspiration of vomitus. Because he was sent to the hospital in time, his colleague was out of danger.

items.title: If a finger or toe is cut off, apply pressure to the wound to stop the bleeding. Wrap the severed part with wet gauze and put it in a sealed bag. Put the bag in ice water and go to a hospital with hand surgery.
items.core: First, put pressure on the wound with your hands to stop the bleeding and give 120. Wrap the broken part with wet clean gauze, put it into a sealed bag, and then put the bag into ice water. Do not touch the ice directly or soak it in water directly. If you are not cold, you can only wait about 4 to 6 hours for a severed finger. More than 80% of the fingers that are reattached can survive.
body: Cost: Nothing. Keep a pack of clean gauze and several sealable plastic bags at home. What's difficult is that in a panic, you have to worry about others before you worry about the broken finger, and you still have to resist burying the broken finger directly in the ice or soaking it in water.

Profit: The U.S. National Library of Medicine's MedlinePlus first aid page reads: Apply direct pressure to the wound with your hand to stop bleeding and elevate the wound. A tourniquet can be applied for life-threatening bleeding. Keep the broken part and follow the person. If the cross section is dirty, rinse it lightly first. Wrap it in a clean damp cloth, put it in a sealed plastic bag, and put the bag in ice water. Don't put it in water or ice without bagging it, and don't put it directly on ice. Do not use dry ice as it may cause frostbite or broken fingers. If you don't have cold water, try not to let it get too hot. If it's cold, the amputated finger can wait longer, but if it's not cold, "it only takes about 4 to 6 hours" to reattach it. Don't think that the broken part is too small to be worth keeping. Don't push back broken parts or bones. The American Academy of Orthopedic Surgeons' page on fingertip separation agrees, and says it's best to go to a hospital that has a hand surgeon on staff at all times. Taken together, 31 studies showed that 86.8% of people who had their severed fingers reattached survived (1,976 successes and 300 failures). Of the 1,087 people who had reimplantation, 82.9% went back to work. In another pooled analysis of 12 studies, the survival rate for replanted fingers was 85.3%. There was also a pooled analysis of 12 studies, 3645 people. If the amputated finger is ischemic for more than 8 hours before surgery, it is more likely to become necrotic after being reattached. and less than 8 hours, odds ratio OR 2.25, 95% CI 1.43 to 3.54 (confidence range)
Level of Evidence: B

Source: MedlinePlus (2024). Traumatic amputation: "Wrap the severed part in a clean, damp cloth, place it in a sealed plastic bag and place the bag in an ice water bath" "Do not put the body part directly in water or ice without using a plastic bag" "Do not put the severed part directly on ice" "Without cooling, the severed part is only good for reattachment for about 4 to 6 hours". <https://medlineplus.gov/ency/article/000006.htm>; American Academy of Orthopedic Surgeons. Fingertip Injuries and Amputations: "Do not allow the amputated part to be in direct contact with ice" "Go immediately to the emergency room, preferably at a hospital that has hand specialists immediately available". <https://orthoinfo.aaos.org/en/diseases--conditions/fingertip-injuries-and-amputations>; Treger D et al. (2026). Return-to-Work After Attempted Digit Replantation: A Systematic Review of 31 Studies. HAND. <https://doi.org/10.1177/15589447241279445>; Stone N et al. (2021). Comparing digital replantation versus revision amputation patient reported outcomes for traumatic digital amputations of the hand: A systematic review and meta-analysis. Microsurgery. <https://doi.org/10.3389/fsurg.2026.1795247>

Note: B is set because preservation methods come from consensus in guidelines and textbooks, and survival rates come from studies that only follow records. No controlled trials comparing different preservation methods were found. Determining "hit" income is based on judgment: you are protecting your fingers, not your life. Whether it can be picked up and whether it is worth picking up depends on the doctor's assessment of the injury. Crushed and torn pieces are more difficult to pick up than neatly cut pieces. MedlinePlus also reminds that saving a life is more important than saving a broken finger. Stop the bleeding first and then take care of the broken finger. If the blood pressure cannot be controlled, please refer to Article 12 of this section on how to apply a tourniquet (for heavy bleeding, first press the wound firmly with your hands). Cutting vegetables at home, pinching your hands between doors, and using power tools can all cause your fingers to be cut off. For protection when using an angle grinder, see Section 1, Item 42 (install the protective cover before using the angle grinder). The main beneficiaries are yourself and your family members, especially those who frequently use power tools and do physical work.

Case: Mr. Zhao, a carpenter, cut off his index finger while sawing wood. He first pressed the wound with a clean cloth to stop the bleeding. The worker wrapped the severed finger in wet gauze and put it in a sealed bag, then put it in ice water. 120 sent him to a hospital with hand surgery. The replantation operation was completed 5 hours later. The severed finger was successfully reattached and recovered well.

items.title: If the permanent tooth (the tooth that grows after the replacement of teeth) is knocked out completely, hold the crown and flush it. Put it back if you can. If it can't be put back, soak it in milk and go to the dentist immediately; don't put the deciduous teeth back.
items.core: Hold the crown and don't touch the root of the tooth. If it's dirty, rinse it gently with milk or saline. Put it back when it can be put back in place, and bite on a clean cloth. If you can't put it back, soak it in milk and see your dentist immediately. Don't wrap it in a paper towel and leave it dry. For those that were put back on the spot, about 20% of the cases where the tooth roots and bones later grew together, and over 80% of those that were left dry for more than an hour. Don’t put the baby teeth back.
body: Cost: Nothing. Milk and saline are available at home or in convenience stores, and the cost of dental care is extra. The difficulty is to have the courage to insert the fallen teeth back into the gums by yourself, and to distinguish on the spot whether the fallen teeth are deciduous teeth or permanent teeth.

Benefit: The NHS dental trauma page says: Hold the crown, the white part exposed outside the gums, and don't touch the root. If your teeth are dirty, rinse them gently with milk, saline or saliva. Try to put it back into its original socket on the gum. Once it fits in, gently bite down on a piece of clean cloth to hold it in place, and see your dentist as soon as possible. If you can't put it back, soak it in milk or saliva. Do not replace baby teeth as this will damage the permanent teeth that are growing underneath. Even if you can’t find a knocked out tooth, you still need to make a dental emergency appointment. The International Society of Dental Traumatology's "Save Your Tooth" poster follows the same steps: find the tooth, hold the crown, plug the sink and rinse with cold tap water. Then choose one of three: put it back in place, soak it in a glass of milk or saline, or hold it between your cheeks and gums. Finally go to the dentist right away. The dental trauma database of Copenhagen University Hospital in Denmark selected 145 permanent teeth that were knocked out and then replaced by 116 people, followed from 7 months to 23 years. What we look at is the risk of the tooth root and alveolar bone growing together (osseous adhesion). After the tooth root grows together, the tooth root will be slowly absorbed. 17.2% were put back on the spot, 55.3% were soaked in saliva or saline and put back again, and 85.7% were left dry for more than 1 hour. The hospital had also followed a batch of 400 teeth earlier, which were reanalyzed in 2020. For children whose teeth have not yet fully grown, the risk of adhesion is 33.9% if left dry for less than 20 minutes and 60.0% if left dry for more than 60 minutes. For teeth with full roots, the ratio increased from 59.4% to 86.4%. Both sets are estimates going back 900 days. A 1995 study of 400 teeth also found that if they were soaked in tap water for more than 20 minutes, tooth root resorption would occur. During follow-up, 30% of these 400 teeth were eventually extracted
Level of Evidence: B

Source: NHS. Knocked-out tooth (reviewed on 2025-02-06): "Hold the tooth by the white bit that sticks out of the gum (the crown) – do not touch the root" "If the tooth is dirty, rinse it gently in milk, saline or saliva" "Do not put a baby tooth back in as it could damage the tooth growing underneath" "If you cannot put the tooth back in, you can put it in either milk or saliva". <https://www.nhs.uk/conditions/knocked-out-tooth/>; International Association of Dental Traumatology. Save your tooth (poster). <https://iadt-dentaltrauma.org/guidelines-and-resources/save-a-tooth-poster/>; Gul A et al (2024). Risk of ankylosis of avulsed teeth immediately replanted or stored under favorable storage conditions before replantation: A long-term clinical study. Dental Traumatology. <https://doi.org/10.1111/edt.12898>; Lauridsen E et al (2020). Risk of ankylosis of 400 avulsed and replanted human teeth in relation to length of dry storage: A re-evaluation of a long-term clinical study. Dental Traumatology. <https://doi.org/10.1111/edt.12520>; Andreasen JO et al (1995). Replantation of 400 avulsed permanent incisors. 1. Diagnosis of healing complications. Endodontics & Dental Traumatology. <https://doi.org/10.1111/j.1600-9657.1995.tb00461.x>; Andreasen JO et al (1995). Replantation of 400 avulsed permanent incisors. 4. Factors related to periodontal ligament healing. Endodontics & Dental Traumatology. <https://doi.org/10.1111/j.1600-9657.1995.tb00464.x>

Remarks: Set B because the numbers come from a study that only tracked records in one hospital, without group control. Determining the profit as "mid" depends on judgment: the teeth are saved, not lives, and the end point is root adhesion, not direct tooth loss. Researchers also said that some teeth that have been left dry for more than an hour are still free of adhesions, so don’t throw them away if it’s too late and take them to the dentist as usual. Just use tap water for rinsing, don't soak your teeth in the water. The main ones who benefit are their own children, but it also applies to adults who fall, play ball, or hit their mouths while riding a bicycle. The NHS says that you can wear removable dentures first for teeth that cannot be saved, and then consider bridges or dental implants after they have grown in. How to inquire about the cost of dental implants? Please refer to Section 24, Article 12 (ask about the lump sum price before placing dental implants).

Case: A child knocked out a permanent tooth while playing basketball. The parents held the crown of the tooth, rinsed it lightly with milk, and put it back into the tooth socket. They asked him to bite the gauze and rushed to the dental department. The doctor reviewed and said that the root of the tooth was preserved, and the child was fixed for observation.

items.title: If your stool turns black, sticks to the toilet bowl, and has a tar-like appearance, go to the emergency department on the same day. If you feel dizzy, sweats, or vomits blood, call 120
items.core: If your stool turns black, sticks to the toilet bowl, and smells bad, it is usually due to bleeding in the esophagus, stomach, or duodenum. Go to the emergency room on the same day. People who only have black stool and no vomiting blood are more likely to linger. Those who were dragged away had lower hemoglobin and needed more blood transfusions. If you feel dizzy, break out in a cold sweat, faint, or vomit blood or something like coffee grounds, don’t drive yourself, call 120.
body: Cost: Registration and blood drawing range from tens to one or two hundred yuan. Gastroscopy costs several hundred yuan. Go to the emergency room while you are still conscious, don't wait for a clinic number. If you feel dizzy, break out in a cold sweat, or vomit blood, do not drive by yourself.

Income: Six hospitals successively registered patients with upper gastrointestinal bleeding who came to the emergency department, a total of 2,944 people. Upper gastrointestinal tract refers to bleeding in the esophagus, stomach or duodenum. 36% (1068 people) arrived within 6 hours of onset of symptoms. 20% (576 people) took 48 hours to arrive. People who develop melena are less likely to go to the hospital within 6 hours. Odds ratio OR 0.22 (95% CI 0.18–0.28). The study concluded that people with only black stools and no vomiting of blood will linger. People who arrive late have lower hemoglobin and are more likely to need a blood transfusion. Of those who arrived within 6 hours, 27% required a blood transfusion (286 people). Of those who arrived more than 6 hours later, 42% required a blood transfusion (791 people). Of the 1,068 people who arrived within 6 hours, 80, or 7%, died within 30 days. Of those who arrived more than six hours later, 121, or 6%, died. Almost the same on both sides. The difference in hemostatic treatment was similar, 18% vs. 20%. 2977 inpatients with nonvariceal upper gastrointestinal bleeding were admitted to 8 hospitals in China. Peptic ulcer accounted for 73.26%. Peptic ulcer is a gastric ulcer or duodenal ulcer. Death during hospitalization was 1.71% (51/2977). 0.73% of deaths among those under 60 years of age. Over 80 years old it is 8.21%. When the high pressure drops to above 70 and below 100 mmHg, the adjusted risk of death is higher. Odds ratio OR 2.67 (95% CI 1.041–6.866). High pressure is systolic blood pressure. According to the 2018 Hangzhou Guidelines, in the presence of vomiting blood and melena, the diagnosis of acute upper gastrointestinal bleeding can basically be established. When there is heavy bleeding and fast intestinal peristalsis, bloody stool may also be passed out. Iron, bismuth and animal blood can also stain stool black. Bismuth tablets are stomach medicines containing bismuth. It takes 24 to 72 hours for the hematocrit to reflect how much was lost during this hemorrhage. Hematocrit is the proportion of red blood cells in the blood. If the person is confused, has a pulse exceeding 100 beats per minute, or a high pressure below 90 mmHg, the guidelines recommend going to the emergency room. The same goes for having clammy hands and feet, or having been vomiting or pulling blood. The British National Health Service (NHS) writes that if there is blood in the stool, or it is black, sticky and smelly, you should call the emergency call or go to the emergency room. Same goes for vomiting blood, or spitting out something that looks like coffee grounds. Don't drive yourself. The NHS page on vomiting blood states that if you have vomited blood and feel dizzy or dizzy, or your skin is cold, wet, or white, you should call an emergency number or go to the emergency room. The NHS also writes that the two most common causes of gastric ulcers are Helicobacter pylori and regular use of painkillers such as ibuprofen.
Level of Evidence: B

Source: Laine L, Laursen SB, Dalton HR, Ngu JH, Schultz M, Stanley AJ (2017). Relationship of time to presentation after onset of upper GI bleeding with patient characteristics and outcomes: a prospective study. Gastrointestinal Endoscopy, 86(6), 1028-1037. <https://doi.org/10.1016/j.gie.2017.03.1549>; Lu M, Sun G, Zhang XM, et al. (2018). Peptic Ulcer Is the Most Common Cause of Non-Variceal Upper-Gastrointestinal Bleeding (NVUGIB) in China. Medical Science Monitor, 24, 7119-7129. <https://doi.org/10.12659/MSM.909560>; Chinese Journal of Internal Medicine Editorial Board et al. (2019). Guidelines for the diagnosis and treatment of acute non-variceal upper gastrointestinal bleeding (2018, Hangzhou). Chinese Journal of Internal Medicine, 58(3), 173-180. <https://doi.org/10.3760/cma.j.issn.0578-1426.2019.03.005>; NHS. Stomach ulcer: "Call 999 or go to A&E if: you're vomiting bright red blood or your vomit looks like ground coffee" "your poo has blood in it, or is black, sticky and very smelly" "Do not drive to A&E". The main causes of gastric ulcer: "infection with helicobacter pylori (H pylori) bacteria" "regular use of anti-inflammatory painkillers (NSAIDs), such as ibuprofen". <https://www.nhs.uk/conditions/stomach-ulcer/>; NHS. Vomiting blood: "Call 999 or go to A&E if: You or your child are vomiting blood (or have vomited blood) and" "feel faint or dizzy" "have cold, clammy, pale skin" "have black poo". <https://www.nhs.uk/symptoms/vomiting-blood/>

Note: The number B is determined because the number comes from tracking records and diagnosis and treatment guidelines. No one is divided into two groups: "Go now" and "Wait at home." The death rate within 30 days is about the same for people who arrive within 6 hours and those who arrive later, so the income is not determined based on the number of people who die less. Late arrivals required more blood transfusions, 42% versus 27%. Blood transfusion was a surrogate endpoint, and benefit was recorded as "small." Still have to go the same day. You can't tell at home whether you will suddenly faint. The elderly and those with already low blood pressure are more at risk. The number of hospitalization deaths is shown in the income column. In the first 1 to 3 days after bleeding, the hematocrit may not drop. A normal blood routine cannot be regarded as nothing. If you are taking iron or bismuth-containing stomach medicine, or have just eaten a large amount of animal blood, and your stool turns black, you should say something when you go. These things can also stain your stool black. If you're not sure, go ahead and don't take it for granted. After the bleeding stops, how to check for Helicobacter pylori and how to eradicate it, see Section 1, Item 23 (Check for Helicobacter pylori). If you have acid reflux, buy omeprazole instead of going to the doctor. See Section 34, Item 6 (If you have black stool, go directly to the hospital). The main person who benefits is yourself. If an elderly person in the family has such a bowel movement, their children will have to take it to him on the same day.

Case: Mr. Zhang passed black stools that were sticky to the toilet for two days in a row. He also felt dizzy and broke into cold sweats. His family did not allow him to drive and directly called 120 and sent him to the emergency department. The examination revealed bleeding gastric ulcers, and he was given a blood transfusion that day to stop the bleeding.

items.title: E-mail, payment, and social accounts all have two-step verification. First, use the pop-up window on your mobile phone to confirm, followed by the SMS verification code
items.core: Two-step verification means that in addition to the password when logging in, you have to confirm again whether you are the person you are. By using a method that pops up a window on your phone and you click to confirm, more than 90% of phishing accounts have been blocked. SMS verification codes are easier to deceive than pop-up windows. By relying on the old method of answering "Where did you log in last time?" and "What is the backup email address?", only 10% of phishing accounts are blocked.
body: Cost: No money. Each account is set up once and takes two to three minutes.

Revenue: Google counted 350,000 actual attempts to steal accounts (also called account hijacking). One type relies on device verification, such as a pop-up window on your phone asking you to confirm, or inserting a security key. This category blocked "more than 94% of phishing-based hijacking attempts and 100% of automated hijacking attempts." Phishing refers to tricking you into entering passwords on fake websites, and automation refers to machines testing leaked passwords in batches. The other type is to verify by answering questions, such as asking where you logged in last time and what your backup email address is. This category "blocks as few as 10% of phishing hijacks and 73% of automated hijacks." For verification on the same device, the SMS verification code is weaker than the pop-up window on the mobile phone. Phishers answered 4% of SMS verification codes correctly, while only 1% were fooled by pop-ups. In targeted attacks targeting a specific person, only 76% of text messages and 90% of pop-ups were blocked.
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Doerfler P, Thomas K, Marincenko M, et al. (2019). Evaluating Login Challenges as a Defense Against Account Takeover. The World Wide Web Conference (WWW '19). <https://doi.org/10.1145/3308558.3313481>

Note: The same study also found that this type of verification sometimes excludes the person. 52% of real users did not log in the first time, but 97% did in the end. Turn on this function for your email first, because most other accounts can use their email to retrieve their passwords. The verification code is for your own use only. If you register the code or scan your face for others, you will be charged with something. See Section 8, Item 45 (read the verification code).

Case: Ms. Zhang received a phishing email disguised as a bank, clicked on the link and entered her account password. Since her email had turned on two-step verification and she prioritized using pop-up windows on her phone to confirm, when she found the pop-up prompts for abnormal login, she immediately refused and changed her password. Afterwards, the security department detected that the attack could bypass accounts that only used SMS verification codes or password security questions. Ms. Zhang successfully avoided financial losses by enabling a more secure verification method.

items.title: The email password must be unique and not repeated on any website.
items.core: Passwords stolen from other websites can be used to log into your mailbox directly. Once someone logs into the email address, all accounts whose passwords can be retrieved using the email address will be lost along with it. Therefore, you need to have a separate password for your email address and never use it elsewhere.
body: Cost: Nothing. Use a password manager so you don’t have to remember it yourself. The hard part is breaking the old habit of using one password everywhere.

Benefits: Use the account numbers and passwords leaked elsewhere and try to log in one by one. This is called credential stuffing, and your email will also be tried in this way. Once someone logs into the email address, all accounts used to retrieve passwords will be lost together. The U.S. Cybersecurity and Infrastructure Security Agency recommends using a different strong password for each account, at least 16 characters, and storing it in a password manager.
Evidence level: C
Source: US CISA. Use Strong Passwords. <https://www.cisa.gov/secure-our-world/use-strong-passwords>

Note: If you can’t remember, use the password manager that comes with your browser. It remembers the password for each website for you, which is much stronger than using the same password everywhere. Don’t store passwords in WeChat collections or notes

Case: Xiao Li often used a password to register for forums and emails. After the forum was leaked, someone used the same password to log into the email and changed it to retrieve the information. Later, he changed his email address to a strong independent password, and leaks from other websites did not affect his email address.

items.title: Set a lock screen password on your phone and a PIN code on your SIM card
items.core: The SIM card is the small card in your phone, which is used to receive SMS verification codes. If your phone is lost, the person who finds it may pull out the card, insert it into another phone to receive the verification code, and then reset your account one by one. Set a PIN code for the card. If you change the card to another mobile phone, you will have to enter this code as soon as you turn on the phone, and the road will be broken.
body: Cost: Nothing. Just set the lock screen password and PIN code once each.

Benefits: After the phone is lost, the fastest way for someone to find it is to insert the SIM card into another phone and receive your SMS verification code. With the verification code, he can reset your accounts one by one. A PIN code is set on the SIM card. If you switch to another phone and turn it on, you will have to enter the password first. The person who finds it will not be able to use it to receive the verification code. The Ministry of Industry and Information Technology reported a true incident in October 2020. After the user's mobile phone was stolen, he failed to report the loss of his phone card in time, giving criminals time to take advantage of the situation. Criminals used "mobile phone number plus verification code" to log in to a government app and obtained the user's ID number and other information. They then changed their cell phone service password. The user later reported the card as lost, and they used tricks to deceive the telecom customer service and remove the card. Finally, he took advantage of the "password retrieval" loophole in the online loan platform to reset the payment password and defrauded the online loan funds. The Ministry of Industry and Information Technology used this incident to remind users to set SIM card passwords in time and report the loss of their mobile phones as soon as possible. As for the lock screen password, the Federal Communications Commission's recommendation is to set a strong password for your phone to restrict others from using it. When your phone is lost or stolen, it can prevent others from misusing it and incurring charges, and it can also prevent your personal data from being misappropriated.
Evidence level: C

Source: Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (2020). Ministry of Industry and Information Technology reminds! Strengthen awareness of personal information protection. Reprinted by China Government Network, Gongxin WeChat News, 2020-10-22. <https://app.www.gov.cn/govdata/gov/202010/22/464049/article.html>; US FCC. Protect Your Smart Device. <https://www.fcc.gov/consumers/guides/protect-your-mobile-device>

Note: The PIN code is set in the "SIM Card Lock" item in the phone settings. The factory initialization code is usually 1234 or 0000. If you enter the wrong number three times in a row, you have to use the PUK code given by the operator to unlock it. So after setting it up, write down this code on paper. The reason for the C rating is that the two sources are official reminders, plus one case, and no research has been done to calculate how much money can be saved by setting up a PIN code. What to do first if you lose your phone, see item 4 (what to do in this order if you lose your phone)

Case: Ms. Wang lost her mobile phone on the subway. The person who found it took out the SIM card and inserted it into the old mobile phone to receive the verification code, but gave up because she had to enter the PIN code to turn on the phone. She subsequently replaced her card and changed her payment password, but no funds were lost.

items.title: If your phone is lost, follow this order: report the loss of SIM card, remotely lock, change password, call the police, freeze bank card
items.core: Sequence is more important than quick hands. The first step is to report the loss of the SIM card, and the lifeline of the verification code will be cut off. Then remotely lock the phone, use the computer to change the email address and payment password, then call the police to get a receipt, and finally freeze the bank card depending on the situation. If you don’t have your phone with you, you can borrow someone else’s phone and call the operator’s customer service to report the loss.
body: Cost: Nothing. It takes ten minutes to do the whole set.

Benefit: Order is more important than speed. The first step is to report the loss of your SIM card. Others will not be able to receive your verification code. The second step is to remotely lock the phone and clear the contents of the phone. The third step is to change the email address and payment password from the computer. Step 4: Call the police and get a receipt. Finally freeze the bank card if necessary. The Federal Communications Commission’s tip is the same: Even if you think you just lost it, lock it remotely. If it is stolen, report it to the police immediately, report the model number and IMEI serial number (the identification number of the mobile phone), and inform the operator immediately
Evidence level: C

Source: US FCC. Protect Your Smart Device. <https://www.fcc.gov/consumers/guides/protect-your-mobile-device>; the sequence of steps is based on the author’s experience; for a replacement ID card, see Section 7, and for fake loans, see Section 8 about credit reporting.

Note: Write down the customer service numbers of the three operators in advance: China Mobile 10086, China Unicom 10010, and China Telecom 10000. Also note which city your mobile phone number is in. Customer service will ask. You can call customer service to report a loss just like using someone else’s mobile phone.

Case: Xiao Chen’s mobile phone was stolen while he was eating. He borrowed the clerk’s phone number to call the operator to report the loss of the SIM card, then used a computer to remotely lock the screen and change the email password, and then called the police to get a receipt. The bank froze the card number that day, but there was no sign of the card being stolen.

items.title: If the card is stolen, first report it as lost and frozen, then call the police, and then ask the bank to compensate: It is the bank's responsibility to prove that "you swiped it yourself"
items.core: If the card is stolen, you must first produce evidence such as alarm records and loss report records. The bank said that this amount was swiped by you yourself, and the bank has to obtain evidence. If it cannot produce it, it will have to compensate you. The premise is that you report the loss and freeze it as soon as you discover it. If you delay not reporting the loss, you will have to bear the additional losses yourself.
body: Cost: No money. If you find any unusual movement on your card, report it as lost or freeze it immediately. Keep alarm records, loss reports, and transaction notifications from the bank. If the card is still with you, make a small inquiry or deposit or withdrawal nearby, and leave a record to prove that the card was really in your possession when something went wrong. The hard thing is to refrain from arguing with customer service and report the loss first.

Benefit: The provisions of the Supreme Law separate "who gets the evidence". If you say this is counterfeit card fraud or online fraud, you need to get evidence first. Counterfeit card fraud means that the card has been copied and used to swipe. These can be used to prove: legal documents that have taken effect, where the real card was when the bank card transaction was made, and where the transaction occurred. There are also account transaction details, transaction notifications, alarm records, loss report records, etc. **On the other hand, if the card-issuing bank or non-bank payment institution (third-party payment) says that the payment was made by the cardholder himself or with his authorization, they must provide evidence**. After you notify the bank, if the bank fails to verify it in time, or fails to provide or save transaction documents and surveillance videos in time, and the evidence cannot be obtained as a result, the bank will bear the consequences of not being able to produce the evidence. After the recognition is established: Debit card (debit card) cardholders can request the card-issuing bank to pay you the principal and interest of the stolen deposits and compensate for the loss. Credit card holders can request a refund of the deducted principal, interest, and liquidated damages of the overdraft, as well as compensation for losses; if the bank in turn asks you to repay the overdraft, the court will not support it. You can also request the card-issuing bank to promptly revoke the corresponding bad credit record (nationwide, effective from May 25, 2021)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Supreme People's Court (2021). Provisions on Several Issues in the Trial of Bank Card Civil Disputes Cases (Articles 4, 5, 7, 14, and 15). <https://www.court.gov.cn/fabu/xiangqing/304771.html>

Note: There are two situations for which you are responsible. First, if you did not keep your bank cards, passwords, and verification codes properly, you are at fault (the original text is "you are at fault for not fulfilling your obligation to keep them properly"), and you are responsible for your fault. Therefore, the password will not be told to others, and the verification code will not be forwarded to others (see Article 1, for second-step verification, use the mobile phone pop-up window to confirm first). The second is not reporting the loss in time, allowing the loss to continue to expand, and you have to bear the extra part. So the first step is always to report the loss and freeze it. Don’t argue with customer service first. This set of rules also applies to third-party payment institutions. Its promotional materials say "compensation in advance", and the promise must be specific and clear, so it can pay in advance as required. You were deceived into transferring the money on your own, so you have to use another method, see Section 8, Article 2 (if you find out you have been deceived, call 110 or 96110 immediately to ask for a stop payment).

Case: Aunt Liu received two unfamiliar consumer text messages at night, and immediately called the bank customer service to report the loss, freeze it, call the police, and save the receipt. The bank initially said it was done by itself, but could not find any evidence by accessing records, and eventually paid out two losses.

items.title: Check the login devices and authorized applications of your account every once in a while, and clear out the ones that are not used
items.core: "Login devices" refer to those mobile phones and computers that can still use your account. If a device you don't recognize pops up in the list, or software you haven't used for a long time is still connected to your account, change your password first, and then log out of all logins. Also take a look at your mailbox to see if there is any automatic forwarding that you haven't set up.
body: Cost: No money. Watch for a few minutes at a time. The hard thing is that no one reminds you, so you have to remember to see it yourself.

Income: List of login devices in the account. Remember the mobile phones and computers that can still use this account. Authorized application list, remember other software that you allow to log in with this account. Unfamiliar devices in the list and third-party software that have long been out of use are the easiest traces to find. The UK's National Cyber ​​Security Center lists "log-in and login attempts from unfamiliar locations or at unusual times" as signs that an account has been compromised and should be investigated. It also said that criminals often set a forwarding rule in their mailbox, so that every email sent to you will be automatically copied to him, so that he can use it to reset your password. The processing sequence it gives is: first check for unknown forwarding rules, then change the password, and then log out of all devices and applications from the account. After you log out, if others want to use your account again, they will have to enter a new password. The U.S. Federal Trade Commission also recommends logging out of all devices after getting your account back and deleting forwarding rules that were not set by you
Evidence level: C

Source: UK NCSC. Recovering a hacked account. <https://www.ncsc.gov.uk/guidance/recovering-a-hacked-account>; US FTC. How To Recover Your Hacked Email or Social Media Account. <https://consumer.ftc.gov/articles/how-recover-your-hacked-email-or-social-media-account>; Both are guides for dealing with account accidents. "Take the initiative to check it every once in a while" is the author's experience

Note: WeChat, Alipay, email, Apple account and Android account all have this entrance. If you find a device you don’t recognize, change your password first, and then click Logout to log in all. This is the order given by the British National Cyber ​​Security Center. Level C is given because both sources are official operating guides, and there is no research to calculate how much less money will be lost by regular inspections

Case: Xiao Zhou checked the WeChat and email login devices quarterly and found that an unfamiliar Android machine and an old computer were still online. He immediately changed the password and logged out of all devices, and canceled three unused authorized applications. After that, he did not receive any abnormal login reminders.

items.title: Don't click "Agree All" just to use the App: it is not necessary information, and you cannot deny the service if you don't agree.
items.core: The App wants your information. If it is not necessary to provide this service, and you don't agree to give it, it cannot deny you use. What it can collect is only what is needed. Maps require your location, but flashlight requires your address book, which is not the case.
body: Cost: No money. The hard part is resisting clicking “Agree All.”

Income: There are two clear provisions in the law. First, the provision of products or services shall not be refused on the grounds that the individual does not agree or withdraws consent; unless the processing of such information is necessary to provide services. The second is that collection should be limited to the minimum scope to achieve the purpose of processing, and only those that can be collected
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress Standing Committee (2021). Personal Information Protection Law. China National People's Congress. <http://www.npc.gov.cn/npc/c2/c30834/202108/t20210820_313088.html>: Article 6 "The collection of personal information shall be limited to the minimum scope to achieve the purpose of processing, and shall not excessively collect personal information"; Article 16 "Personal information processors shall not process the personal information on the basis that the individual does not consent." Refusal to provide products or services on the grounds of personal information or withdrawal of consent; unless the processing of personal information is necessary to provide products or services"; Article 15 "Where personal information is processed based on individual consent, the individual has the right to withdraw his consent. Personal information processors should provide a convenient way to withdraw consent"

Note: The judgment standard is whether the information is necessary to provide the service. The map is necessary for location, but the flashlight is not for the address book. After the app is installed, first go to the application permissions page in the phone settings and turn off unnecessary permissions. When it is actually used, choose to allow it only this time.

Case: When installing the flashlight app, a pop-up window asking for address book permission was displayed. Xiao Wang refused, but the app could still illuminate normally, and there was no pop-up window asking for this permission.

items.title: You have the right to view, copy, correct and delete your personal information. If you are refused, you can sue
items.core: You have the right to ask the company to let you view, copy, correct and delete your information. If the service is stopped, the retention period has expired, or you withdraw your consent, the company should have deleted it itself. If it rejects you, it must explain the reasons; if it refuses to do so, you can directly go to court to sue it. Canceling an account and deleting information are two different things. After logging out, you have to delete it separately.
body: Cost: Nothing. Only if the other party refuses to do anything, you need to file a complaint or sue. A real lawsuit will only take a few months to start, and you will have to pay for the legal fees yourself, so it is more cost-effective to file a complaint first. The difficulty is that you have to push repeatedly when the other party is dragging you.

Benefits: There are several situations in which companies should take the initiative to delete data: the service has been stopped, the agreed retention period has expired, you have withdrawn your consent, the original purpose of collection has been achieved, etc. It has not been deleted, you can ask it to be deleted. If it refuses you to exercise these rights, it must explain its reasons. You can file a lawsuit directly with the court
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress Standing Committee (2021). Personal Information Protection Law. China National People's Congress. <http://www.npc.gov.cn/npc/c2/c30834/202108/t20210820_313088.html>: Article 45 “Individuals have the right to consult and copy their personal information from the processor Personal information... If an individual requests to access or copy his or her personal information, the personal information processor shall provide it in a timely manner"; Article 46 Right of Correction and Supplement; Article 47 lists five situations that should be actively deleted, including "(1) The purpose of processing has been achieved, cannot be achieved, or the processing is not to be achieved. "(2) The personal information processor stops providing products or services, or the retention period has expired" "(3) The individual withdraws consent", "If the personal information processor has not deleted it, the individual has the right to request deletion"; Article 50 "The personal information processor shall establish Convenient application acceptance and processing mechanism for individuals to exercise their rights. If an individual's request to exercise their rights is rejected, the reasons should be stated. "Individuals can file a lawsuit with the People's Court in accordance with the law."

Note: Cancellation of the account and deletion of personal information are two different things. After cancellation, a separate request for deletion must be made. Before changing your phone or selling your old phone, log out and unbind all accounts on the old phone, and then restore the factory settings. The law gives you the right to delete things after the fact. It cannot take back things that have been leaked for you.

Case: Xiao Zhao still received marketing text messages after canceling his old shopping account. He applied to the platform customer service to delete his mobile phone number and address but was rejected. He saved the chat records and sued, and the court required the platform to delete the information and specify the processing period.

items.title: You don’t have to agree to swipe your face: if there are other ways, you can’t just let you swipe your face. If you don’t agree, you have to give you other methods.
items.core: As long as there are other ways to accomplish the same thing, the other party can’t just let you swipe your face. If you don't agree to face-swiping, it has to give you a method such as swiping a card, password or ID card, and it can't force you by saying "then you won't be able to do business." No one is allowed to install facial recognition equipment in hotel rooms, public bathrooms, locker rooms, and restrooms.
body: Cost: No money. When asked to scan your face, ask "Is there any other verification method?" If the other party says it doesn't have one, ask it to provide one. The hard part is asking in person.

Benefits: The Measures for the Security Management of Face Recognition Technology Applications state: "If other non-face recognition technology methods exist to achieve the same purpose or meet equivalent business requirements, face recognition technology shall not be used as the only verification method. If an individual does not agree to identity verification through facial information, other reasonable and convenient methods shall be provided." The method also states It states: "No organization or individual may mislead, defraud, or coerce individuals to accept facial recognition technology to verify their identity on the grounds of conducting business or improving service quality." If facial information is processed according to your consent, "individual consent must be obtained voluntarily and clearly with full knowledge": If you are asked about this matter alone, it will only count if you nod alone. You have the right to withdraw your consent, and the processor must provide a convenient way to withdraw it. When processing the facial information of minors under the age of fourteen, the consent of parents or other guardians must be obtained. Facial recognition equipment installed in public places "should be necessary to maintain public safety" and prominent warning signs should be set up. No organization or individual is allowed to install it inside private spaces in public places such as hotel rooms, public bathrooms, public locker rooms, and public restrooms. Facial information should be stored in the facial recognition device and shall not be transmitted externally through the Internet. There are two exceptions: laws and administrative regulations provide otherwise, or separate consent is obtained (nationwide, effective from June 1, 2025)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Cyberspace Administration of China, Ministry of Public Security (2025). Measures for the Security Management of Facial Recognition Technology Applications (Order No. 19, Articles 10, 12, 13, and 15, effective from June 1, 2025). <https://www.cac.gov.cn/2025-03/21/c_1744174262156096.htm>

Note: The most common ones you encounter are community access control, rental platforms, gyms, and hotels that ask you to record your face. When the other party says, "The system only supports facial recognition," read the original words of the method to him. The original words are: "If other non-face recognition technology methods exist to achieve the same purpose or meet equivalent business requirements, face recognition technology shall not be used as the only verification method." Then ask it to provide methods such as card swiping, password or ID card. If it still refuses, report it to the local cyberspace department. If the state has other regulations for identity verification through facial recognition, such as in some financial and government affairs scenarios, those regulations should be followed. The biggest difference between a face and a password is that it cannot be changed after being leaked, so it deserves to be more cautious than a password. Units that have stored facial information of more than 100,000 people must file a record with the provincial-level cybersecurity and informatization department within 30 working days. This is also a way to judge whether the other party is legitimate or not. The right to access, correct and delete your personal information is provided in Article 8. It is another thing for someone to borrow your face to apply for their own loan. See Section 8, Item 45 (Help to show your face).

Case: When Mr. Wang checked into a hotel, the front desk required him to pass facial recognition before checking in. He made it clear that he did not agree with facial recognition and asked to use his ID card to register. The hotel initially refused on the grounds of "system regulations", but Mr. Wang argued hard based on the Personal Information Protection Act. In the end, the hotel handled manual check-in for him. Afterwards, the local market supervision department stated that it is illegal to force facial recognition when the identity can be verified through other methods.

items.title: Don’t hand over codes, keys and private information to unknown “AI relay stations”. This is especially true when letting AI execute commands automatically
items.core: The transfer station is sandwiched between you and the model manufacturer. It can see and change the content you send and the answers you receive back. A study tested more than 400 relay stations, 9 of which inserted malicious code into the commands to be executed, and 17 of which had tampered with the cloud service keys that the researchers deliberately put in. If AI is allowed to automatically execute commands, modified commands may cause the computer to be loaded with malicious code.
body: Cost: Official direct connections are usually more expensive than transfer stations, and recharging is not as convenient. The difficulty is that the transfer station is cheap, and several models can be adjusted at one entrance

Benefits: The Ministry of National Security issued a risk warning in June 2026. Some transfer stations will leave the data submitted by users on the server, and some will intercept it privately and sell it to other large model manufacturers for training. Some have hidden backdoors to plant malicious code into user devices, steal account keys and cloud credentials, and even install remote control programs. It is recommended to use a platform with official direct connection and formal authorization, rather than a platform with unknown sources, no operating qualifications, and no security guarantee. When using it, first desensitize personal privacy and project information, manage the key well, and change it regularly. If you encounter abnormal deductions, unreasonable account bans, or data anomalies, immediately deactivate, change the key, check for viruses, and retain evidence. Researchers from the University of California, Santa Barbara and other institutions made a measurement in 2026. They bought 28 paid transfer stations from Taobao, Xianyu and overseas online stores, and collected 400 free transfer stations from the public community. As a result, 1 paid and 8 free ones inject malicious code into the returned tool calls. Tool calls are commands that AI tells your computer to execute, such as installing software packages. There are two others who will pick the right time to attack. The example given in the paper is to only attack fully automated sessions. 17 used Amazon cloud service keys that were deliberately put in by researchers. One person transferred the money in the researcher’s Ethereum wallet. There was only a small amount of money in the wallet, and the loss was less than $50. The modification method demonstrated in the paper is very subtle: replace requests in the installation command with reqeusts, which has a similar spelling. It cannot be seen at a glance (nationwide)
Level of Evidence: B

Source: Ministry of National Security (2026). "AI transfer station", risks must be guarded against. <https://www.szzg.gov.cn/2026/xwzx/szkx/202606/t20260608_5331487.htm> (The official website of the Digital China Construction Summit reproduces the WeChat official account of the Ministry of National Security); Liu H, Shou C, Wen H, Chen Y, Fang RJ, Feng Y. (2026). Your Agent Is Mine: Measuring Malicious Intermediary Attacks on the LLM Supply Chain. arXiv:2604.08407. <https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.08407>

Remarks: Level B because there is only one study and it is a preprint (a version made public before official publication). Most of the transfer stations tested are free, and there are only 28 paid transfer stations. It is impossible to calculate how many transfer stations have problems. Some media put the theft as $500,000, but the original article said it was less than $50. The magnitude of the gain is determined to be medium based on the consequences: the losses caused by stolen keys and codes are very different, and there is no amount to be arbitraged in the study. If you have used a transfer station with unknown origin, go to the model manufacturer to invalidate and regenerate the used keys, and replace the keys for the cloud service and code warehouse together. When passing through the transfer station, do not let the AI ​​automatically execute the command. The command will take a look before letting you go. There is a criminal risk to the party operating a transit station, see Section 11, Article 19 (AI Transit Stations). The beneficiary is yourself.

Case: A developer uses an "AI transfer station" to call a large model service and pastes the code snippet containing the cloud service key into it to request optimization. Since the transfer station was monitored by the security agency to tamper with the returned execution commands, the researcher discovered during subsequent inspection that the test key he had deliberately placed had been stolen and attempted to be used to access cloud resources. Fortunately, the key was discovered and revoked in time to avoid greater losses. Experts remind you not to hand over sensitive information to unknown transfer stations.

items.title: Check how many phone cards and bank cards you have in your name once a year, and cancel them if you find they were not issued by you
items.core: Some people will use other people's ID cards to apply for phone cards to cheat, but I often don't know. There is now a free official inquiry, which can check how many phone cards you have in your name, how many App accounts are linked to your mobile phone number, and which UnionPay cards you have. If you find something you don’t recognize, check with the operator or bank and cancel it.
body: Cost: No money. The phone card can be checked in the "Industrial Information WeChat News" official account or the Alipay "One-Card Check" applet, and the bank card can be checked in the "One-click Card Check" of the UnionPay App. Please fill in the form for a few minutes each, and the results will be notified to you via text message within a day or two. The difficult thing is that no one reminds me to remember to check it once a year.

Income: The Anti-Telecommunications Internet Fraud Law states that the telecommunications authorities must "provide convenient channels for users to inquire about their phone card information." The People's Bank of China and other departments must "provide customers with convenient channels for checking their bank accounts and payment accounts." The national mobile phone card "One Card Universal Check" guided by the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology will be launched on September 14, 2021. With your ID card, you can check the number of phone cards in your name and the operator they belong to. It was launched because when fighting against telecommunications fraud, it was discovered that some of the phone cards involved were issued using other people's identities. The user himself does not know this, and his personal credit may also be affected. Results sent by 10699000 text messages in 48 hours. If the quantity does not match, go to the operator to find out the details. After authorization, you can verify, divest, close or cancel the account. In July 2022, "One Pass Verification 2.0" will be launched. With the mobile phone number and the last six digits of the ID number, you can check how many Internet accounts are associated with this number. At that time, we supported Tencent, Alibaba, Baidu, Kuaishou, Douyin, JD.com, Meituan and other companies, but the results were only given in quantity. For the bank card half, China UnionPay will open the "one-click card check" of UnionPay to all provinces and cities in China on June 29, 2022. Just select the bank you want to check and submit through identity verification. The report is generated within 24 hours. The card information in the report is desensitized and automatically deleted after 7 days (nationwide)
Evidence level: C

Source: Standing Committee of the National People's Congress (2022). Anti-Telecommunications Network Fraud Law (Articles 10 and 16). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202209/t20220902_575631.shtml>; People's Daily Online (2021). The Ministry of Industry and Information Technology launches the "One Card Inquiry" service: you can check the number of phone cards under the user's name. Reprinted on the China Government Website, 2021-09-15. <http://app.www.gov.cn/govdata/gov/202109/15/475868/article.html>; <https://gxt.fujian.gov.cn/zwgk/xw/jxyw/202207/t20220722_5958108.htm>; China UnionPay (2022). The "one-click card check" function of UnionPay APP is open to all provinces and cities in the country. <https://cn.unionpay.com/upowhtml/cn/templates/newInfo-nosub/7885004da382485e8bde5a0ba000fdd3/20220629145824.html>

Note: "One-click card check" only checks UnionPay cards. UnionPay explained at the time that cards without mobile phone numbers and expired ID cards could not be checked. The records of the card-issuing bank shall prevail, so failure to check does not mean that they are not there. Loans and credit cards issued under false pretenses require a credit report, see Section 8, Item 9 (Credit Report). One-Card Check 2.0 displays numbers with many associated accounts. Unbind them before changing or suspending the number. See Article 12 (before changing the mobile phone number and not using the old number). Lending or selling your own cards to others is another matter, see Section 8, Article 8 (Do not use bank cards or mobile phone cards). The reason for the C rating is that the sources are all official service descriptions, and there is no research to calculate how much less loss can be saved by checking. The magnitude of the income is judged to be medium. The beneficiary is yourself.

Case: When Mr. Chen was applying for broadband, he was told that he already had four phone cards in his name. He checked with the official inquiry portal and found that a foreign card was not issued by himself. He took his ID card to the business office to verify and cancel it to avoid further fraudulent use.

items.title: Before you change your mobile phone number and no longer use the old one, first link your bank, payment and social account accounts to the new one. Don’t let the old number be down due to arrears.
items.core: After the mobile phone number is canceled, the operator can reissue it to others in a minimum of 90 days. The account you haven't changed is still connected to this number. A verification code will be sent to the new account's mobile phone. He may log in to your account with the verification code. Therefore, before changing the number, first change the account number and the mobile phone number reserved by the bank to the new number.
body: Cost: No money. You need to change the mobile phone number associated with each account. The mobile phone number reserved by the bank needs to be changed by the bank. If there are many commonly used accounts, it may take an hour or two. The difficulty is that it is easy to miss, and unpopular accounts cannot be remembered.

Revenue: Telecommunications service specifications state that "the minimum period for freezing a mobile phone number is 90 days," which refers to the time after the number is deregistered and reactivated. After 90 days of logout, this account may be issued to a new user. The Ministry of Industry and Information Technology’s Telecom Service Quality Notice for the First Quarter of 2025 reminds users that they can use the “secondary number renewal” service in the apps of three operators. Get an account used by someone else, use it to unbind the account and register the bound Internet account before opening your own account. The announcement in the second quarter of 2026 stated that this service has covered 258 commonly used Internet applications, and applications for unbundling applications have exceeded 850 million times. The new account is mainly used to unbind it, which means that the account of the previous account owner is still connected to this account. In 2024, the customer service staff of the three major operators were interviewed by the People’s Post and Telecommunications. They said that after the number is canceled, new users can still use the SMS verification code to log in to the account registered by the old user. They reminded that before changing or canceling the number, unbind Alipay, WeChat and other applications, and promptly modify the mobile phone number reserved by the bank card (nationwide)
Evidence level: C

Source: Ministry of Information Industry (2005). Telecommunications Service Specifications (Ministry of Information Industry Order No. 36, Appendix 2, Item 2.1.7). <https://www.miit.gov.cn/zwgk/zcwj/flfg/art/2020/art_0cff75e226764dc7b811cd4e954415c5.html>; Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (2025). Notice on the quality of telecommunications services in the first quarter of 2025 (Information Management Letter of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology [2025] 85 No.). <https://www.miit.gov.cn/jgsj/xgj/fwjd/art/2025/art_1bcadc32bf8141a8b616db8eaadba2e9.html>; Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (2026). Notice on the quality of telecommunications services in the second quarter of 2026 (Information Management Letter of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology [2026] 258 No.). Reprinted by the Communications Administration Bureau of the Inner Mongolia Autonomous Region. <https://nmca.miit.gov.cn/xwdt/xydt/art/2026/art_2f6af9120a064a6784557cdefbf1c5be.html>; Li Yue (2024). The three major operators remind users: Be sure to unbind your mobile phone number before changing or canceling it. People's Post and Telecommunications, reprinted by the Cyberspace Administration of the Tibet Autonomous Region Party Committee, 2024-04-08. <https://wxb.xzdw.gov.cn/wlaq/aqdt/202404/t20240408_456634.html> (Web Archive <https://web.archive.org/web/20250414055537/https://wxb.xzdw.gov.cn/wlaq/aqdt/202404/t20240408_456634.html>)

Remarks: First use One-Card Check 2.0 to see how many accounts are associated with the old account, see Article 11 (how many phone cards are there under the name). Change your bank and payment accounts first, then change your social accounts, and log out any accounts you no longer need. Don’t stop your account immediately after making the change. Leave it for a month or two to receive any missed verification code text messages. This is the author's experience. The fact that the new account owner can log in with the verification code comes from the operator's customer service statement in media reports. There is no official notification or judgment. For what to do after someone logs in to your account, see Article 6 (Login to the device). If you want to change your phone or sell your old phone, you need to log out of your account and restore the factory settings. Please write this in the notes in Article 8 (Delete your personal information). It is rated as C grade because there is no research to calculate how much less loss can be achieved by changing the binding. The magnitude of the income is judged to be medium. The beneficiary is yourself.

Case: Xiao Sun changed her account and shut down her old one. Three months later, the owner of the new account used the verification code to log in to her unlinked takeout account and placed two orders. After she modified her bank and social account to reserve her mobile phone, similar logins never appeared again.

items.title: The amount of the deposit, return time and deduction circumstances when renting a house must be written into the contract
items.core: The amount of the deposit, when it will be returned, and under what circumstances it can be deducted, must be written into the contract before signing. If there is a situation that is not written in the contract and the landlord does not have a legitimate reason, he cannot deduct your deposit when you cancel the lease.
body: Cost: No money. Take an extra ten minutes when signing the contract. The difficulty lies in raising it in front of the landlord

Benefit: The administrative regulations are very clear: "If the lessor collects a deposit, it should stipulate in the housing lease contract the amount of the deposit, the return time, and the circumstances for deduction of the deposit. Except for the circumstances stipulated in the housing lease contract, the lessor shall not deduct the deposit without justifiable reasons." Three things must be written into the contract: how much the deposit is to be charged, when it will be refunded, and under what circumstances it can be deducted. In situations that are not written in the contract, the landlord cannot deduct your money without justifiable reasons
Level of Evidence: A
Source: State Council (2025). Housing Rental Regulations (National Decree No. 812, effective on September 15, 2025) (Article 10). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202507/content_7032956.htm>

Note: Take photos and videos with the landlord on the day you check out. The readings of the water meter, electricity meter, and gas meter were all taken, as well as the walls and floors. If the deposit has been withheld for no reason, first complain to the housing rental management department. For small claims lawsuits where the amount is not large, see Section 8, Article 22 (Calculation of whether it is worth suing). Whether a rented shop space can be opened and whether a catering business can obtain a license, please refer to Section 12, Article 27 (Renting a shop space to open a shop).

Case: When Xiao He rented a house, it was written into the contract that the deposit of 3,000 yuan, which would be returned within seven days after check-out, and the natural wear and tear of the wall would not be deducted. When the landlord wanted to deduct the cleaning fee when checking out, he showed the terms of the contract and the landlord returned the deposit in full on the same day.

items.title: If you are cut off from water and electricity, have your locks changed, or come to your home and threaten to evict you, call the police first and keep a certificate: laws and regulations prohibit these methods to force you to vacate your house
items.core: The landlord cannot force you to terminate the contract or move out by cutting off water and electricity, changing locks, or coming to your home and threatening you. This is expressly prohibited by laws and regulations. If you encounter someone, call the police first and leave the evidence. Don't take matters into your own hands and confront the other person.
body: Cost: No money. Just call the police and it will be done on the spot

Benefits: The administrative regulations are very clear: "The lessor shall not use violence, threats or other illegal methods to force the tenant to terminate the housing lease contract or vacate the rental housing." To vacate means to let you move out. If you encounter this kind of situation, call the police first and keep the evidence. Don’t fight it yourself
Level of Evidence: A
Source: State Council (2025). Housing Rental Regulations (National Order No. 812, effective on September 15, 2025) (Article 12). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202507/content_7032956.htm>

Note: The purpose of calling the police is to leave a record of the incident, which can be used as evidence when claiming compensation for losses in the future. At the same time, notify the housing rental management department. If the landlord refuses to compensate, he will have to sue in court. The ordinary procedure of first instance is stipulated to be completed within 6 months, which can be extended, and the lawyer's fees will be paid by himself. If the amount is small, a small claims lawsuit will be filed and the case will be concluded within 2 months. See Section 8, Article 22 (Calculation of whether it is worth suing).

Case: The landlord cut off water and electricity without authorization and changed the locks in order to force the tenant to move out. The tenant exercised restraint and immediately called the police, recording the incident on his mobile phone to retain evidence of the incident. The police came out to stop the landlord's behavior. The tenant sued to defend his rights based on the alarm records and videos, and was eventually compensated and successfully stayed until the contract expired.

items.title: Intermediaries are not allowed to collect and pay rent and deposits on their behalf, and the money must be paid directly to the landlord
items.core: According to regulations, rents and deposits cannot be collected and paid by intermediaries, and the money must be paid directly to the landlord. The more money passes through the hands of an intermediary, the more chance it will get away with it. Before making payment, check whether the payee is the name on the title certificate.
body: Cost: No money. Verify the payee before paying, a few minutes. The difficulty lies in resisting the intermediary's argument that you transfer money to it

Benefits: Administrative regulations list "collecting and paying rent and deposits on behalf of real estate agencies" as prohibited activities for real estate agencies. Intermediaries cannot collect your rent and deposit on behalf of the landlord. As soon as money passes through the hands of an intermediary, there is one more opportunity for the money to be stolen and escaped
Level of Evidence: A
Source: State Council (2025). Housing Rental Regulations (National Decree No. 812, effective on September 15, 2025) (Article 25). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202507/content_7032956.htm>

Note: Before payment, check whether the payee is the name on the property ownership certificate. If it is not yours, ask clearly and leave a written authorization. The intermediary can only charge the matchmaking service fee

Case: The intermediary asked the tenant to transfer money on the grounds of paying the rent. The tenant checked that the payee was not the landlord on the property ownership certificate, refused to transfer the money, and insisted on paying directly to the landlord himself. Soon the agent ran away with the money, and the tenant gave the money directly to the landlord, successfully avoiding the risk of losing both money and house.

items.title: When renting a long-term apartment, check its capital supervision account first, don't try to be cheap by paying a one-time payment for a year
items.core: If you pay a one-time payment for a year, you will only get a small discount. Once the company runs away, your deposit and prepaid rent that have not yet expired may be lost together. It's even worse if the rental loan is tied up: the apartment is gone, but you still have to repay the loan every month. Before signing a contract, check to see if it has published a capital supervision account.
body: Cost: No money. It takes more than ten minutes to check

Benefits: Administrative regulations require housing rental companies that operate sublease operations to "set up housing rental fund supervision accounts and disclose them to the public." Sublease operation means that the enterprise rents the entire property from the landlord and then subleases it to you. The discount you get by paying a one-time payment for a year is not worth the risk of losing the deposit and remaining rent when the company runs away. If you sign a rental loan at the same time, the risk is greater
Level of Evidence: A
Source: State Council (2025). Housing Leasing Regulations (National Order No. 812, effective on September 15, 2025) (Article 19). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202507/content_7032956.htm>

Note: Check whether there is a tied loan when signing the contract. If the installment app gives a year's worth of money to the apartment in one lump sum and you repay the loan monthly, then if the apartment runs away, you still have to pay it back. This kind of contract does not need to be signed

Case: Long-term rental apartments launch annual payment discounts. Before signing the contract, the tenant verified that the apartment had not published a fund supervision account, refused to make annual payments, and insisted on monthly payments. Three months later, the apartment exploded and the tenant ran away. The tenant who paid annually suffered heavy losses and had to bear the rent loan. The tenant avoided losses by paying monthly.

items.title: If the house is sold during the lease period, the lease will continue to be valid, and there is no need to move
items.core: If the house is sold during the lease period, your lease will still be valid. The new landlord will let you live under the original contract until it expires. No need to move or renegotiate the price. The premise is that you have lived there legally and kept all the evidence of the contract, transfer records, and check-in time.
body: Cost: No money

Benefit: There is an article in the Civil Code called "Sales do not violate leasing." The original words of the law are: If the ownership of the leased property changes during the period of possession of the lessee in accordance with the lease contract, the validity of the lease contract will not be affected. If the owner of the house changes during the lease period, the signed lease will still be valid. The new landlord must let you live according to the original contract until the expiration date
Level of Evidence: A
Source: National People's Congress (2020). Civil Code (Article 725). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202006/t20200602_463888.shtml>

Note: The premise is that you have moved in legally. The law says that you will occupy it according to the lease contract. Keep evidence of the contract, transfer records, and check-in time. There are two exceptions: if the house has been mortgaged before being rented out and later auctioned off to pay off the debt, or if the house has been sealed up by the court before being rented out. See Article 6 (Check the property ownership certificate and mortgage situation)

Case: The landlord sold the house with half a year left on the lease. The new landlord came to ask the tenant to move out immediately. The tenant produced the lease contract and rent transfer records, and refused to move out based on the fact that the transaction did not break the lease. The new landlord has no choice but to abide by the original lease and allow the tenant to stay until the contract expires.

items.title: Check the property ownership certificate and mortgage situation before signing the rental contract. All funds will be transferred and the purpose will be noted.
items.core: Before signing the contract, ask the landlord to produce his ID card and property ownership certificate. Then take your ID card to the real estate registration agency to check whether the house is mortgaged and whether it has been sealed up. This can even be done without a signed contract. If a house that was mortgaged or sealed before being rented was auctioned and the owner changed, you cannot ask to continue to live in it. All money is transferred, remark the purpose, and leave a receipt.
body: Cost: No money. Bring your ID card to the real estate registration agency and check it for half an hour. The difficulty lies in asking the landlord to produce the property ownership certificate in person

Benefits: Before signing the contract, the landlord must show you proof of identity and real estate ownership certificate. If there is no property ownership certificate, other materials proving the right to rent the property must be provided. The landlord also needs to cooperate with you to inquire and verify the information about the apartment. This is an obligation imposed on the lessor by administrative regulations. If you haven't signed a contract yet, bring your ID card to the real estate registration agency in the city or county where the house is located, and you can check a few things. What can be checked include: basic information about the house, whether there are co-owners, whether there is a mortgage or residence registration, and whether it has been sealed up. After signing the contract, you can check the registration results with the lease contract. This step is important because there are two exceptions to the "sales and leases" rule. If the house was mortgaged to the bank before it was rented out and was later auctioned off to pay off the debt, you cannot ask the new owner to let you live in it according to the original contract. The same is true if the house has been sealed by the court before being rented out. During the court auction, if the lease interferes with the prior mortgage, the court will remove the lease before auctioning. On the other hand, if the property is rented to you first and you move in, but the landlord mortgages it later, the mortgage will not affect your lease. If the house is seized or the ownership is disputed, making it impossible for you to live in it, you can terminate the contract. If someone else asserts their rights and makes it impossible for you to live in the property, you can ask to pay less or no rent. Transfer all the money and note "the monthly rent of such-and-such house" is the author's experience: if there is a dispute, it can prove that you paid and what you paid
Level of Evidence: A

Source: State Council (2025). Housing Rental Regulations (National Decree No. 812, September 15, 2025 Effective on the same day) (Article 9, Paragraph 1: "Produce the tenant's identification materials, the real estate ownership certificate of the house to be rented, or other materials proving that he has the legal right to rent, and cooperate with the lessee to inquire and verify relevant information about the house to be rented in accordance with the law"). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202507/content_7032956.htm>; Ministry of Natural Resources (2024 revision).
