Interim Measures for Inquiry of Real Estate Registration Data (8, 19, 20, 21). <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/2024/issue_11506/202408/content_6966482.html>; Ministry of Natural Resources (2025). Decision on Amending the "Interim Measures for Inquiry of Real Estate Registration Information" (Order No. 18 of the Ministry of Natural Resources) No. 21, item 3 is changed to "Whether there is mortgage registration, notice registration, objection registration or residence right registration on the real estate"). <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/2026/issue_12546/202602/content_7057456.html>; National People's Congress (2020). Civil Code (Articles 405, 723, 724, 725). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202006/t20200602_463888.shtml>; Supreme People's Court (2020). Decision on revising the "Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Application of the Trade Union Law of the People's Republic of China" and other 27 civil judicial interpretations (Fa Interpretation [2020] No. 17, Article 21, No. 6 The original Article 20 of the Interpretation of the Urban House Leasing Contract has been revised. The order of the articles has been adjusted to Article 14: "(1) A mortgage has been established before the house is rented, and the ownership of the house changes due to the mortgagee realizing the mortgage; (2) The house has been seized by the people's court in accordance with the law before being rented out."). <https://www.court.gov.cn/fabu/xiangqing/282621.html>; Supreme People's Court (2004). Regulations on the auction and sale of property during civil execution by the People’s Court (Fa Interpretation [2004] No. 16, Paragraph 2 of Article 31; Fa Interpretation [2020] No. 21 deletes Articles 5 to 7 and becomes Paragraph 2 of Article 28). <https://www.court.gov.cn/shenpan/xiangqing/713.html>; Supreme People’s Court (2020). Decision on amending the "Regulations of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the People's Court's Seizure of Railway Transport Goods" and other 18 execution-related judicial interpretations (Fa Shi [2020] No. 21). <https://www.court.gov.cn/fabu/xiangqing/282661.html>; For notes on evidence retention and transfer, please see Article 8 for the same reason. Section 2 about the bride price and the IOU

Note: Among the few things that can be checked before signing the contract, it does not include who the property owner is. Therefore, the name on the property ownership certificate must match the landlord’s ID card in person. Ask the landlord to be present in person when signing the contract. If he is unable to come, a power of attorney will be required. If the second landlord subleases to you, you must have the written consent of the original landlord. If the landlord refuses to recognize the rights to terminate the contract and pay less rent, he will have to go to court to sue. Ordinary first-instance procedures are stipulated to be completed within 6 months, which can be extended, and the lawyer's fees are generally paid by oneself. The purpose of transfer notes is not directly stipulated by regulations, but is based on the author’s experience. You can also check in this way before signing a contract for buying a second-hand house. After signing the contract, you must also go through advance notice registration, see Article 14 (advance registration).

Case: The tenant checked the documents before signing the contract and found that the house had been mortgaged but still decided to rent it. The tenant transferred the entire rent deposit to a bank and noted the purpose. Half a year later, the landlord stopped paying for the property and the house was foreclosed on. The tenant successfully defended his rights with clear transfer vouchers and contracts, retained his right to live in the house and got his deposit back.

items.title: If an intermediary is asked to collect the payment for a second-hand house, it must use the special deposit account for transaction funds opened by the intermediary in the bank.
items.core: If the intermediary collects the payment for the house, it must use its special account opened in the bank according to regulations. This account is subject to supervision, and money cannot be transferred into the intermediary's own account, nor can it be transferred to the individual broker.
body: Cost: No money. The difficulty is that if you insist on using a special account, you may have to argue with the intermediary a few times

Benefits: The regulations are very clear: if it is agreed that the real estate agency will collect and pay transaction funds on its behalf, it should transfer them through its special deposit account for customer transaction settlement funds opened in the bank. The house payment goes into a supervised special account, not the intermediary’s own account, nor a broker’s private account
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security (2011). Real Estate Brokerage Management Measures (Order No. 8, 2016 No. 29 Amendment to the Order) Article 24: "If the parties to a real estate transaction agree that a real estate brokerage agency will collect and pay transaction funds, the transaction funds shall be transferred through the special deposit account for customer transaction settlement funds opened by the real estate brokerage agency in a bank." Article 18 "Real estate brokerage services implement a clear pricing system... real estate brokerage service items and service contents shall be marked in a conspicuous position on the business premises , charging standards"; Article 19 "If two or more real estate brokerage agencies cooperate to carry out the same real estate brokerage business, they can only charge commission according to one business, and may not increase fees from the client"; Article 17 Agency loans, agency real estate registration and other services "should explain the service content, charging standards, etc. to the client, and sign a separate contract with the client's consent." <http://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2011/content_1918920.htm>

Note: The house payment is hundreds of thousands to several million, which is the largest single amount in this book. Do not use WeChat to transfer it to the agent. There are two other common types of overcharging. First, if two intermediaries jointly make the same order, they can only receive one commission. The second is to handle loans and transfers on behalf of others. This is another service, and a separate contract must be signed and the fees must be informed in advance. All payments will be made by transfer and the purpose will be noted, see Article 6 (check the title certificate and mortgage situation before signing). Where the money for buying off-plan property is transferred, see Article 10 (Pre-sale Fund Supervision Account).

Case: The agent provides the agent’s private card when collecting the down payment for a second-hand house. The buyer refused to transfer the money and insisted on remitting it to the special account for transaction funds opened by the intermediary in the bank. Later, the broker took away the down payments of many customers and ran away. The buyers avoided huge losses by insisting on using supervised accounts.

items.title: Don’t rent a partitioned room: the smallest rental unit is the originally designed room, and the kitchen, bathroom, and balcony are not allowed to be occupied
items.core: According to regulations, the smallest rental unit is the originally designed room. The kitchen, bathroom, balcony and underground storage room cannot be occupied. In addition, during the lease term, the landlord cannot increase the rent just by saying so.
body: Cost: No money. The price is the same budget, either live farther away or live smaller

Benefits: The regulations are very clear. The smallest rental unit is the original designed room, and one room cannot be divided into several rooms for rent. The per capita rental building area shall not be lower than the local minimum standards. Kitchens, bathrooms, balconies and underground storage rooms may not be rented out for human habitation. The lessor is also not allowed to unilaterally increase the rent during the lease period. If Article 8 is violated, the competent department shall order the lessor to make corrections within a time limit. If the lessor fails to make corrections within the time limit, a fine of 5,000 yuan to 30,000 yuan may be imposed
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development (2010). Measures for the Administration of Commercial Housing Leasing (Order No. 6 No.) Article 8: "When renting a house, the originally designed room shall be the minimum rental unit, and the per capita rented building area shall not be less than the minimum standard stipulated by the local people's government. Kitchens, bathrooms, balconies and underground storage rooms shall not be rented out for people to live in." Article 9: "The lessor shall perform the maintenance obligations of the house in accordance with the contract and ensure the safety of the house and indoor facilities... During the period of the house leasing contract, the lessor shall not unilaterally increase the rent level at will." 22 Article: "Anyone who violates the provisions of Article 8 of these Measures shall be ordered to make corrections within a time limit by the construction (real estate) competent department of the people's government of the municipality, city or county. If the correction is not made within the time limit, a fine of not less than 5,000 yuan but not more than 30,000 yuan may be imposed." <http://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2011/content_1845070.htm>

Note: Illegal partitions are investigated and punished, and the lessor is fined. But correction requires tearing down the partition, and the tenants living inside can only move out. This is derived from this regulation. Deposits and rent paid often cannot be returned. This is the author's experience. Safety is also poor: partition walls often block escape routes, and many people living in one house share the same electrical wire. When looking at a house, pay attention to three points: whether the walls were built later, whether there are windows in the room, and whether the electric meter strap can carry so many people.

Case: The tenant rented a partition room with a converted balcony to save money. Half a month after moving in, the street fire inspection determined that the property was in violation and required the property to be cleared. Tenants were forced to move in a hurry, and the landlord refused to return the deposit. Not only did the tenants not save money, but they also lost their deposits and spent more time looking for housing.

items.title: If you want to move to the countryside with an urban registered permanent residence, you should only rent a farm house, and do not buy homestead land or a house on the homestead land.
items.core: Those with an urban registered permanent residence cannot go to the countryside to buy homestead land, farmer's houses or "small property rights houses". National documents explicitly prohibit this. The villagers said, "Just write a contract," but that didn't work either. If you want to live in the countryside for a long time, you sign a lease contract for up to 20 years at a time and renew it when it expires.
body: Cost: No money. The price is that you will not own the house, and the lease period is up to 20 years at a time. When it expires, you have to renegotiate with the landlord.

Benefits: The document from the General Office of the State Council clearly states: “Urban residents are not allowed to go to rural areas to purchase homesteads, farmer’s houses or ‘small property rights houses’.” The same document also stipulates that after farmers have sold or rented out their houses, their application for homestead land will not be approved. In 2019, a document from the Central Agricultural Office and the Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs said it again: "Urban residents are strictly prohibited from purchasing residential land in rural areas." The same document gave a legal way: urban residents can rent farmhouses to live in or operate. The term of the lease contract shall not exceed twenty years, and both parties may agree otherwise
Level of Evidence: A

Source: General Office of the State Council (2007). Notice on Strict Implementation of Laws and Policies on Rural Collective Construction Land (Guobanfa [2007] No. 71). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2008-03/28/content_2395.htm>; Office of the Central Rural Work Leading Group, Ministry of Agriculture and Rural Affairs (2019). Notice on Further Strengthening the Management of Rural Homestead Sites (Zhongnongfa [2019] No. 11) Parts 5 and 6. <https://www.moa.gov.cn/govpublic/NCJJTZ/201909/t20190920_6328397.htm>

Note: Homestead land is the land allocated by the village to villagers to build houses, and can only be allocated to villagers. When renting a farm house, sign a written contract with the farmer who rents it out, specifying the lease term, rent, whether it can be renovated or renovated, and how the renovation money will be calculated when it is due. The document stipulates that the lease term shall not exceed 20 years. Do not sign a contract such as "lease for 50 years" or "lease for 70 years", and do not pay the rent for many years at once. The document also prohibits people from going to the countryside to use residential land to build villas, compounds and private halls, and they are not allowed to pay for "joint construction" with villagers.

Case: Citizens with urban household registration want to live in the countryside for a long time, and villagers can sell houses with small property rights and write a contract. The citizens refused to buy and signed a legal 20-year farm house lease contract. Later, illegal construction was renovated in the local area, and the privately sold house was forcibly demolished. The buyer lost all his money and house, but the citizen lived in compliance with the regulations and lived in peace of mind.

items.title: When buying an off-plan house, first check the pre-sale license. The deposit, down payment and loan will only be entered into the pre-sale fund supervision account specified in the contract
items.core: An off-plan house is a house that is sold before it is built. Without a pre-sale license, developers cannot sell or receive deposits. According to regulations, all the down payment and loan you pay must be put into the supervision account, and supervision will not be released until the house can be delivered. If the money is transferred to other accounts, it will not be covered by this layer of protection.
body: Cost: No money. Take a look at the pre-sale license before signing and check the account before paying, just a few minutes. The difficulty is that when the salesperson asks you to transfer it to another account, you must insist not to transfer it

Income: Off-plan housing is called commercial housing pre-sale in the regulations, and the developer sells the house under construction to you first. In August 2026, the Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, the Ministry of Natural Resources and the State Administration of Financial Supervision issued a document stipulating: "The down payment, personal housing loan and other home purchase funds paid by home buyers should all be deposited in the capital supervision account." Supervision will be lifted only after the house is completed and accepted, and the water, electricity, and heat are delivered. The developer must state in the purchase contract the rights and responsibilities of depositing the purchase funds into the supervision account. If the developer breaches the contract and fails to deliver the property on time, you can terminate the contract as stipulated in the contract. The developer must refund money according to the contract and bear liability for breach of contract. The People's Bank of China and the State Administration of Financial Supervision also stipulated that personal housing loans for purchasing pre-sale houses should be paid directly by banks into the project's pre-sale fund supervision account. Documents from the three departments in 2022 have stated that deposits, down payments and mortgage loans "should all be deposited directly into the supervision account." For properties that have not obtained pre-sale permission, developers are not allowed to pre-sell, nor are they allowed to collect deposits through subscription, booking, queuing, or issuing VIP cards. A pre-sale contract signed without a pre-sale license will be deemed invalid by the court. If the license is supplemented before prosecution, it can be deemed valid. If money is paid to a place other than the supervision account, it is not covered by this set of supervision. The same 2026 document also stipulates that developers can receive a "small deposit" after receiving a construction permit for properties sold as existing homes. The deposit is supervised by the housing fund supervision agency and is deposited in the "deposit supervision account" opened by the project sponsoring bank. The supervision will be released after the house meets the delivery conditions
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, Ministry of Natural Resources, State Administration of Financial Supervision (2026). Notice on improving the commercial housing sales system (Jianfang Regulations [2026] No. 3, Part 1, Item (2) (3), Part 2, Item (3)). <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/2026/issue_13026/202610/content_7082773.html>; People's Bank of China, State Administration of Financial Supervision (2026). Opinions on reforming and improving real estate credit management to promote the construction of a new model of real estate development (Yinfa [2026] No. 171, Article 22). <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/2026/issue_13026/202610/content_7082770.html>; General Office of the China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission, General Office of the Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, General Office of the People's Bank of China (2022). Notice on the work related to the issuance of letters of guarantee by commercial banks to replace pre-sale regulatory funds (Chinese Banking Regulatory Commission [2022] No. 104, Article 2). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2022-11/14/content_5726954.htm>; Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development (2010). Notice on issues related to further strengthening the supervision of the real estate market and improving the pre-sale system for commercial housing (Jianfang [2010] No. 53, Part 1, Item (1), Part 2, Item (9)). <http://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2010/content_1629136.htm>; Supreme People's Court (2020 revised). Interpretation of several issues concerning the application of law in the trial of commercial housing sales contract disputes (Amended Text of Fashi [2020] No. 17, Article 2). <https://www.court.gov.cn/fabu/xiangqing/282621.html>

Remarks: For properties that have obtained construction project planning permits before August 28, 2026, pre-sale conditions and fund supervision shall be subject to the original regulations of each locality. The down payment and loan must go into an escrow account, which is required by both the 2010 and 2022 documents. For properties sold as existing houses, if the developer collects a small deposit during the construction period, the new regulations require that the deposit be deposited into a deposit supervision account. The name and account number of the supervised account shall be as written in the house purchase contract, and should be checked before payment. If the contract is deemed invalid and the developer does not refund the money, you will have to go to court to sue. Ordinary first-instance procedures are stipulated to be completed within 6 months, which can be extended, and the lawyer's fees are generally paid by oneself. How to pay for a second-hand house, see Article 7 (Special Deposit Account for Transaction Funds).

Case: Xiao Li verified the pre-sale license when buying a house off-plan, and transferred all the down payment and loan into the pre-sale fund supervision account according to the contract. Later, the developer's debt dispute led to the freezing of ordinary accounts and the suspension of the project. However, because the money was in the supervision account, the building was funded and resumed construction and delivery, and Xiao Li took possession of the house on time.

items.title: I paid a subscription deposit or down payment to buy a new house, but a formal contract was not signed, or the loan was not approved (for example, policies tightened after the contract was signed, banks stopped lending) and it is not your fault, so I asked the developer to refund the money
items.core: I paid a subscription deposit but did not sign a formal contract, or the loan was not approved, first find out who is to blame. The reason is neither yours nor the developer's. The developer will refund the deposit or the refund plus interest. After the signing of the contract, policies tightened and banks stopped lending. Generally, neither party can blame it. Your credit report is overdue and your income is not enough. If it’s your fault, you may not get your deposit back.
body: Cost: No money. Read two more clauses when signing the subscription letter and formal contract. If the developer does not refund, he will go to court to sue

Benefit: The judicial interpretation of the Supreme Court states: The developer has received a deposit through subscription, ordering, and reservation. If a formal sales contract is not signed due to one party's reasons, it will be handled according to the deposit rules. The deposit rules are: if the party paying the deposit breaches the contract, the deposit will not be refunded; if the party receiving the deposit breaches the contract, double the amount will be refunded. See Section 12, Article 15 (receive money and write deposit). If the signing is not completed due to reasons beyond the fault of both parties, "the seller should return the deposit to the buyer." Another one talks about loans. The sales contract stipulates that payment will be made with a loan. If the loan contract is not signed or the sales contract cannot be performed due to one party's reasons, the other party can terminate the contract and demand compensation. If the loan contract is not signed due to reasons beyond the fault of both parties, both parties can terminate the contract. The developer must return the principal and interest of the purchase money received, or return the deposit. It is not the fault of both parties. The law only contains principles. The following is an example given by the author. After signing the contract, the local government tightened its housing loan policy and banks stopped lending. Generally, neither party can blame it. It's your fault that your credit report is overdue and your income flow is insufficient. The real estate procedures were incomplete and the banks refused to lend money to the project, which was blamed on the developer. These two articles only apply to commercial housing purchased from developers and do not apply to second-hand housing
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Supreme People's Court (2020 revision). Interpretation of Several Issues Concerning the Applicable Law in the Trial of Commercial Housing Sales Contract Disputes (Articles 1, 4, 5, and 19). <https://www.court.gov.cn/fabu/xiangqing/282621.html>; National People's Congress (2020). Civil Code (Articles 586, 587). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202006/t20200602_463888.shtml>

Note: What counts as "not to blame both parties" will be determined by the court in the event of a dispute. Therefore, the formal contract must state that payment will be made with a loan, and it is best to also state what will happen if the loan is not approved. If the main content of the sales contract has been written in the subscription letter and the developer has collected the house payment, the court will regard it as a formal sales contract, and it will not be considered "not signed" at this time. If the developer doesn't refund the money, he will go to court to sue. The first-instance ordinary procedure is required to be completed within 6 months, which can be extended. The simplified procedure is 3 months, and the lawyer's fees are generally paid by yourself.

Case: After a home buyer paid a down payment, the mortgage policy tightened, and the bank stopped lending and could not sign a contract. The homebuyer collects the policy documents and proof of loan denial and demands a refund on the grounds that neither party is at fault. After verification, the developer terminated the contract and fully refunded the deposit, down payment and interest.

items.title: Before buying a new house and signing a contract, read clearly how the area error will be handled. Take photos and keep the promises on the building brochure, advertisements and sand tables
items.core: If the contract does not agree otherwise, if the difference between the registered area after handover and the contract is within 3%, the actual amount will be refunded or compensated. If the difference exceeds 3%, you can check out and the developer will refund the money plus interest within 30 days. The advertisement is very specific about the houses and supporting facilities in the community, and it also affects your commitment to buy or not. Even if it is not written into the contract, it counts.
body: Cost: No money. Read two more clauses before signing the contract, and take a screenshot as you go

Benefits: The regulations of the Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development state that if the price is based on area, the contract must clearly state how to deal with errors in area. If it is not written in the contract, please follow the following provisions. "If the absolute value of the area error ratio is within 3% (inclusive), the house price will be settled based on the actual value." Above 3%, you have the right to check out. If you check out, the developer must refund the paid price within 30 days from the day you request it, and pay interest at the same time. If you do not check out and the registered area is larger than the contracted area, you will have to pay for the part within 3%, and the part exceeding 3% will be borne by the developer, and the property rights will belong to you. If the registered area is smaller than the contracted area, some developers will refund you if the area is within 3%, and some developers will refund you double the amount if it exceeds 3%. Regarding advertising, the judicial interpretation of the Supreme People's Court states: Sales advertisements and promotional materials are generally just an invitation for negotiation and do not count as a contract. However, if the developer is specific about the houses and supporting facilities within the scope of the development plan, and it has a major impact on whether you sign or not and the price of the property, it will be considered the content of the contract. "Even if the description and promise are not included in the commercial housing sales contract, they should still be part of the contract." If violated, you will be liable for breach of contract
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Ministry of Construction (2001). Measures for the Administration of Commercial Housing Sales (Ministry of Construction Order No. 88, Articles 18, 19, and 20). <http://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2002/content_70143.htm>; Supreme People's Court (2020 revision). Interpretation of Several Issues Concerning the Applicable Law in the Trial of Commercial Housing Sales Contract Disputes (Article 3). <https://www.court.gov.cn/fabu/xiangqing/282621.html>

Note: 3% is the default method when there is no agreement in the contract. Anything else written in the contract shall be governed by the contract, so when signing the contract, check to see whether that clause broadens the scope. For off-plan properties priced on a per-unit basis, the contract must be accompanied by a floor plan stating the error range of the dimensions. This article on advertising only covers the development of houses and facilities within the planned scope, and things outside the planned scope are not included in this article. When the judicial interpretation was revised in 2020, the original area error provision was deleted, and the current basis is this Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development regulation. The developer refuses to admit it and will sue in court. Ordinary first-instance procedures are stipulated to be completed within 6 months, which can be extended, and the lawyer's fees are generally paid by oneself.

Case: When purchasing a house, the sales office promised to build a constant-temperature swimming pool, and the buyer took a photo as a certificate. When closing the house, we found that the swimming pool had become a green belt and its area had shrunk by 4%. Home buyers can safeguard their rights with photo evidence and the terms of check-out if the area error exceeds 3%. The developer reluctantly agreed to terminate the contract and refund all the house payment and interest.

items.title: When you buy a new house and the developer is late in delivering the house or applying for the certificate, you should first send a written reminder to retain evidence, and then demand liquidated damages according to the contract
items.core: The developer is late in handing over the house, and you should first urge it in writing. If the developer fails to hand over the house within three months, you can check out. If there is no liquidated damages in the contract, you will be compensated based on the rent of similar houses in the same location. If you can't get the property ownership certificate due to the developer's fault, you will have to pay compensation. You can still check out if you delay the deadline for obtaining the certificate for more than one year. If the developer urges you to express your opinion, you must make a reservation within 3 months; if the developer does not urge you, you must make a reservation within one year from the day you know you can check out.
body: Cost: No money. Write a written reminder, send it by courier and leave a note. If you really want to check out or make a claim, you will most likely have to file a lawsuit

Benefits: The judicial interpretation of the Supreme Court states: If the developer fails to deliver the property within 3 months after being urged to do so, you can terminate the contract, unless otherwise stipulated in the contract. The right to terminate the contract has a time limit. If the developer urges you to express your opinion, you must decide within 3 months. If the developer doesn't urge you, you have to use it within one year from the day you know or should know that you can cancel it. If it expires, it will be gone. The contract did not stipulate liquidated damages, nor how compensation would be calculated. Late delivery would be calculated based on the rent of similar houses in the same location during the overdue period. Because of the developer's fault, if you haven't obtained the property ownership certificate by the following deadline, the developer will be liable for breach of contract. There are three types of deadlines: the certificate application period specified in the contract; 90 days from the day of handover for off-plan properties; and 90 days from the day of signing the contract for existing properties. If the contract does not stipulate liquidated damages, it will be calculated based on the total amount of money you have paid for the house, and refer to the overdue loan interest standards stipulated by the People's Bank of China. If the registration period is over and it exceeds one year because of the developer, you can terminate the contract and demand compensation. If the agreed liquidated damages are too high and the developer requests a reduction, the court shall adjust the amount by 30% of the actual loss
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Supreme People's Court (2020 revision). Interpretation of Several Issues Concerning the Applicable Law in the Trial of Commercial Housing Sales Contract Disputes (11, 12, 13, 14, 15, 20, 21). <https://www.court.gov.cn/fabu/xiangqing/282621.html>; National People's Congress (2020). Civil Code (Article 563). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202006/t20200602_463888.shtml>

Remarks: The reminder should be in writing and sent by courier to the developer's address written in the contract, and keep the receipt and signature record. The judicial interpretation only says "after urging" and does not stipulate the form. It is the author's experience to expedite the process in writing. If the contract stipulates liquidated damages for house delivery, it shall be calculated according to the contract first. After checking out, the loan contract can also be terminated together. The developer will refund the loan to the bank and refund you the house payment and interest. If the developer refuses to admit it, he will go to court to sue. Ordinary first-instance procedures are stipulated to be completed within 6 months, which can be extended, and the lawyer's fees are generally paid by oneself.

Case: The developer has not yet delivered the new house when it is due. The home buyer sends a written reminder letter via EMS and keeps the receipt. If the house was not handed over after three months, the buyer sued for termination of the contract based on the evidence of demand and the contract. The court supported the appeal and ordered the developer to return the money and pay liquidated damages.

items.title: Before signing a contract to buy a house, check whether it has been seized or mortgaged. After signing the contract, go to the real estate registration agency for advance notice registration
items.core: Bring your ID card to the real estate registration agency before signing the contract to check whether the house has been mortgaged or sealed, and whether it has been registered to others first. The contract stipulates that advance notice registration should be done immediately after signing. After the application is completed, if the seller sells or re-mortgages without your consent, the registration agency will not handle it. You have to go through the transfer process within 90 days after you can officially transfer the ownership. After the advance notice, the registration will become invalid.
body: Cost: Bring your ID card for half an hour to check before signing the contract. After signing the contract, bring the materials to the registration agency with the seller and pay the registration fee according to local standards

Income: The Civil Code states: After signing a house purchase agreement, in order to ensure that you will get the house in the future, you can apply to the registration agency for advance notice registration as agreed. "After the notice is registered, if the real estate is disposed of without the consent of the right holder of the notice registration, it will not have any real rights effect." There is a time limit for notice registration. If the contract is terminated, or if formal registration is not applied within 90 days from the date when formal registration is available, the notice registration will become invalid. The implementation details of the Ministry of Natural Resources leave it to the registration agency: both pre-sale of commercial houses and the purchase and sale of second-hand houses can be handled. During the notice registration period, if the seller applies for registration of this apartment without your written consent, the registration agency will not handle it. If you buy off-plan, if the developer fails to apply with you as agreed, you can apply unilaterally. What can be checked before signing the contract: If you are interested in buying or selling, you can check with your ID card whether there is a mortgage, notice registration, objection registration, and whether it has been sealed up. Online signing and filing cannot control the validity of the contract. The Judicial Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court states that the failure to register a pre-sale contract will not affect the validity of the contract, except when the parties agree that the registration will take effect
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress (2020). Civil Code (221). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202006/t20200602_463888.shtml>; Ministry of Natural Resources (2024 revised). Implementation Rules of the Interim Regulations on Real Estate Registration (Articles 85 and 86). <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/2024/issue_11506/202408/content_6966482.html>; Ministry of Natural Resources (2024 revision). Interim Measures for Inquiry of Real Estate Registration Data (Article 21). <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/2024/issue_11506/202408/content_6966482.html>; Ministry of Natural Resources (2025). Decision on amending the "Interim Measures for Inquiry of Real Estate Registration Information" (Ministry of Natural Resources Order No. 18). <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/2026/issue_12546/202602/content_7057456.html>; Supreme People’s Court (2020 revision). Interpretation of Several Issues Concerning the Applicable Law in the Trial of Commercial Housing Sales Contract Disputes (Articles 6 and 7). <https://www.court.gov.cn/fabu/xiangqing/282621.html>

Remarks: For how to check before signing and what to bring, see Article 6 (check the property ownership certificate and mortgage situation before signing). When the contract is not signed, it is impossible to find out who the property owner is. The name on the property ownership certificate must be matched with the seller's ID card in person. The notice registration requires prior agreement between both parties, so it should be included in the sales contract. The seller maliciously colluded with others, signed another contract and handed over the house. You can request confirmation that that contract is invalid. But this requires a lawsuit. The ordinary first-instance procedure is stipulated to be completed within 6 months, which can be extended. The lawyer's fees are generally paid by oneself. After registration of advance notice, the seller cannot transfer the property to others without your consent, and there is no need to litigate the matter afterwards.

Case: Ms. Li bought a second-hand house. Before signing the contract, she went to the real estate registration agency to check as recommended and found that the property had been mortgaged. She asked the seller to release the mortgage before paying the deposit, and agreed in the contract to conduct advance notice registration. As a result, the seller did not dare to sell the house to anyone else, and the transfer was completed smoothly.

items.title: If you are carrying a floating rate mortgage, and the interest rate is higher than the newly issued mortgage, go to the bank to negotiate an interest rate reduction or apply for a replacement
items.core: The mortgage interest rate is a few points added or subtracted from the loan market quoted interest rate. This point is originally signed and remains unchanged. You will be allowed to discuss changes with the bank starting from 2024. Your interest rate is higher than the new mortgage loans nationwide. You can negotiate with the bank to lower it, or apply for a new loan to replace the old one. For a loan of 1 million yuan for 30 years, the interest rate is half a percentage point lower, and the interest is about 100,000 yuan less.
body: Cost: No money. Call the bank customer service number or apply in mobile banking, which takes dozens of minutes at a time. Banks may not necessarily agree

Benefits: The People's Bank of China's announcement in 2024 allows borrowers and borrowers to negotiate changes in the percentage points added to the mortgage interest rate based on the LPR. LPR is the loan market quote rate, and the mortgage interest rate is based on it plus or minus points. The person in charge of the People's Bank of China answered a reporter's question and said that the original point increase range in the contract was fixed throughout the loan period, but this time it has been changed. In August 2026, the People's Bank of China and the State Administration of Financial Supervision further wrote in a document: When the interest rates of floating-rate mortgages that have been issued deviate to a certain extent from the interest rates of new mortgages issued nationwide, "borrowers can negotiate with banking financial institutions to change the interest rate agreed in the contract, or apply for a new floating-rate personal housing loan to replace the existing loan. The method should be chosen by the borrower." The amount of the new loan cannot be greater than the remaining principal on the original loan. How much you can save, here is an example of how you can calculate it based on the equal principal and interest formula. For a loan of 1 million yuan for 30 years, the monthly payment is about 4,774 yuan when the annual interest rate is 4.0%, and about 4,490 yuan when the annual interest rate is 3.5%. The monthly payment is about 284 yuan less, and the interest payment in 30 years is about 100,000 yuan less
Level of Evidence: A

Source: People's Bank of China, State Administration of Financial Supervision (2026). Opinions on reforming and improving real estate credit management to promote the construction of a new real estate development model (Yinfa [2026] No. 171, Article 24). <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/2026/issue_13026/202610/content_7082770.html>; People's Bank of China (2024). Relevant persons in charge of the People's Bank of China answer reporters' questions on issues related to improving the interest rate pricing mechanism for commercial personal housing loans (Introduction to the People's Bank of China Announcement [2024] No. 11). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/202409/content_6977671.htm>

Note: The extent of deviation can only be discussed. The document does not specify the specific amount. Please refer to the announcement of your lending bank. This section governs floating-rate mortgages issued by banks. If the bank does not agree to the reduction and you have spare money, you can compare according to the algorithm in Section 5, Item 28 (early repayment of mortgage loan). You cannot borrow more for replacement, and the new loan cannot exceed the remaining principal of the old loan.

Case: Mr. Wang’s mortgage interest rate was 5.8%, which was much higher than the newly issued mortgage interest rate at that time. He took the loan contract to the bank to negotiate and applied for an interest rate reduction, which was eventually reduced to 4.3%. Over the past 30 years, he has saved a total of about 150,000 yuan in interest.

items.title: If you need a loan to buy your first home, first use a housing provident fund loan. If the amount is insufficient, add a commercial loan as a combination loan. Don’t just use all commercial loans.
items.core: The interest rate for a provident fund loan for a first home that is more than 5 years old is 2.6%, and the interest rate for new bank mortgages in June 2026 is about 3.1%. For a loan of 1 million yuan and a term of 30 years, the interest paid by the all-purpose provident fund is about 96,000 yuan less than that of the all-purpose commercial loan. There is an upper limit on the amount of money that can be borrowed from the provident fund. If it is not enough, you can use commercial loans to make up for it. This is called a combination loan.
body: Cost: No money. You need to make one or two more trips to the provident fund center or the trustee bank, as the loan may be released a few days later than if you were just doing a commercial loan. The premise is that you have paid provident fund for a period of time

Income: The People's Bank of China issued a document on May 7, 2025 to lower the provident fund loan interest rate, which will be implemented from May 8. The interest rate for a first provident fund loan for more than 5 years is 2.6%, and for a first-time provident fund loan for less than 5 years (inclusive) it is 2.1%. The second set shall not be less than 3.075% for more than 5 years, and shall not be less than 2.525% for less than 5 years. As of October 2026, this remains the most recent adjustment. Commercial mortgage interest rates are determined by plus or minus points from LPR, which is the loan market quote rate. On September 20, 2026, the 5-year+ LPR was 3.5%. The People's Bank of China's monetary policy implementation report for the second quarter of 2026 stated that in June "the interest rate for newly issued personal housing loans was approximately 3.1%." How much you can save, here is an example of how you can calculate it based on the equal principal and interest formula. For a loan of 1 million yuan for 30 years, the monthly payment is about 4,003 yuan when the interest rate is 2.6% and about 4,270 yuan when the interest rate is 3.1%. The monthly payment is about 267 yuan less, and the interest payment in 30 years is about 96,000 yuan less. The limit is only enough to borrow 600,000 yuan of provident fund, and the other 400,000 yuan is a commercial loan, which is more cost-effective than all commercial loans. That’s about 160 yuan less per month, and about 58,000 yuan less in interest over 30 years. The lower limit of the provident fund interest rate for the second home is 3.075%, which is similar to the 3.1% for commercial loans. It does not save much money
Level of Evidence: A

Source: People's Bank of China (2025). Notice on lowering the interest rate of personal housing provident fund loans (May 7, 2025). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202505/content_7022708.htm>; People's Bank of China (2025). Same as above (original text from the official website of the People's Bank of China). <https://www.pbc.gov.cn/zhengwugongkai/4081330/4406346/4693549/2025120618351696797/index.html>; The National Interbank Funding Center is authorized by the People's Bank of China (2026). Loan Prime Rate (LPR), announced on 2026-09-20 for more than 5 years 3.50%. <https://www.chinamoney.com.cn/chinese/bklpr/>; People’s Bank of China (2026). China’s Monetary Policy Implementation Report for the Second Quarter of 2026. <https://www.pbc.gov.cn/zhengcehuobisi/125207/125227/125957/2026nhbzczxbg/2026081218435062865/index.html>; State Council (2026). Regulations on the Administration of Housing Provident Fund (State Council Order No. 844, re-announced after the third revision, 2026 Effective from September 20; Article 9 (3) "Determines the maximum loan amount of the housing provident fund", Article 26 "Employees who contribute to the housing provident fund may apply to the housing provident fund management center for a housing provident fund loan when purchasing, constructing, renovating or overhauling their own homes" "A decision on whether to grant a loan or not shall be made within 10 days from the date of acceptance of the application", Article 27). <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/2026/issue_12946/202608/content_7079363.html>; Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development, Ministry of Finance, and People's Bank of China (2014). Notice on the development of housing provident fund personal housing loan business (Jianjin [2014] No. 148, reprinted by Beijing Housing Provident Fund Management Center). <https://gjj.beijing.gov.cn/web/zwgk61/_300587/_300688/375516/index.html>; Beijing Municipal Housing and Urban-Rural Development Commission, Beijing Municipal Planning and Natural Resources Commission, and Beijing Housing Provident Fund Management Center (2026). Notice on further optimizing and adjusting the city’s real estate policies (Jingjianfa [2026] No. 400, Part 3). <https://gjj.beijing.gov.cn/web/zwgk61/2024zcwj/436433464/436433467/744089355/index.html>; Guangzhou Housing Provident Fund Management Center (2026). Personal Housing Provident Fund Loan Service Guide (General Provident Fund Loan), Parts 10 to 12. <https://gjj.gz.gov.cn/bsfw/qtfw/content/post_5748060.html>

Note: There are four thresholds for providing provident fund loans. You must first pay enough provident fund. Documents from the Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development and other three departments in 2014 stated that only those who have paid in full for more than 6 months can apply, and those who have paid in other places can be combined. The amount and number of years vary from place to place, and the maximum amount is set by the local provident fund management committee. For example, a person in Beijing can deposit up to 1.2 million yuan for a first home, and can get a loan of 200,000 yuan per year of deposit. The maximum amount per person in Guangzhou is 1 million yuan, the term does not exceed 30 years, and the age of the second-hand house plus the loan period does not exceed 50 years. If you buy a second-hand house, the price will be calculated based on the lower one between the online signing price and the appraised price. If the appraised price is lower, there will be fewer loans. Finally, there are a lot of procedures. The regulations require the provident fund center to issue a conclusion within 10 days after accepting the application, and then apply for mortgage registration. The author's experience is that loan disbursement is slower than commercial loans. If the seller is eager to collect money, he should agree to use the provident fund loan before signing the contract. The down payment ratio of a combination loan must meet the requirements of both the provident fund and the commercial loan. The balance of the provident fund can also be withdrawn to repay the loan, see Section 5, Article 3 (the provident fund is not only used to buy a house). If you have already taken out a commercial loan, you can approach the bank to negotiate for an interest rate reduction. See Article 15 of this section (Negotiating an interest rate reduction).

Case: Mr. Liu needs a loan of 1 million yuan with a term of 30 years to purchase his first home. He originally planned to use all commercial loans, but after learning that the provident fund loan interest rate was lower, he first applied for a provident fund loan with a higher amount, and used commercial loans to form a portfolio loan for the remaining part. Calculated based on the interest rates at that time, the total interest on the Quanyong commercial loan was about 560,000 yuan, while the total interest on the portfolio loan was about 460,000 yuan. Over 30 years, nearly 100,000 yuan in interest was saved, which greatly reduced the repayment pressure.

items.title: If you live in a community and are forced to pay property fees by a water, power, heating, or gas cutoff, you should complain to the local real estate authority; if you owe property fees, the property owner can only urge you, sue, or apply for arbitration
items.core: The property cannot force you to pay property fees by cutting off water, power, heating, or gas. If you encounter a complaint to the local real estate authority. The property has provided services as agreed. You cannot use "never used" as a reason for not paying. If you don't pay, you can sue the property. You don’t have to hand over the part that you charge too much or charge repeatedly without permission. If you do, you can get it back.
body: Cost: No money. It takes dozens of minutes to make a phone call or write a complaint. If the property does not change and you want it to compensate for losses, you have to go to court to sue

Income: Article 944 of the Civil Code has three meanings. The original words of the first layer are: "Property service providers shall not use methods such as stopping power supply, water supply, heat supply, gas supply, etc. to urge the payment of property fees." Second layer: The property has provided services as agreed, and the owner cannot refuse to pay on the grounds that he "has not accepted or does not need to accept" the services. Level 3: If the owner fails to pay overdue, the property management company can urge you to pay within a reasonable period of time. If the property is not paid by the time limit, the property owner may sue or apply for arbitration. The property management regulations also state that if an owner fails to pay property fees overdue, the owners committee will urge you to pay them within a time limit. If the payment is overdue, the property service company may sue the court. Complaints should be made to the real estate administrative departments of local governments at or above the county level. Regulations require them to handle owners’ complaints promptly. The judicial interpretation of the Supreme People's Court states that if a property management company expands the scope of charges without authorization, raises charging standards, or charges repeatedly, you can use this as a defense. Any illegal fees that have been paid can be requested to be refunded
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress (2020). Civil Code (Article 944; Articles 654, 656). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202006/t20200602_463888.shtml>; State Council (2018 Third Revision). Property Management Regulations (Articles 5, 44, 48, and 64). <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=ff8080816f3cbb3c016f40daebf30779>; Supreme People’s Court (2020). Decision on amending 27 civil judicial interpretations including the "Interpretation of the Supreme People's Court on Several Issues Concerning the Application of the Trade Union Law of the People's Republic of China in Civil Trial Work" (Legal Interpretation [2020] 17 No. 14, Article 5 of the Interpretation on Property Service Disputes has been revised, and the order of the articles has been adjusted to Article 2: "If the property service provider violates the property service contract or the provisions of laws, regulations, and departmental rules, expands the scope of charges, raises charging standards, or makes repeated charges without authorization, and the owner raises a defense on the grounds of illegal charging, the people's court shall support it. If the owner requests the property service provider to refund the illegal fees that it has collected, the people's court shall support it."). <https://www.court.gov.cn/fabu/xiangqing/282621.html>

Note: What is prohibited by law is that property owners use water and power outages as a means to collect property fees. What is owed is the water, electricity, and gas bills themselves, and the situation is different. If you still fail to pay within a reasonable period after being reminded by the power supply unit, the power supply can be suspended according to the procedures prescribed by the state, and you must be notified in advance. For water supply, gas supply, and heating supply, please refer to this article. The regulations also stipulate that water supply, power supply, gas supply, heating and other units must charge end users. If your property's water and power outages cause you losses, and you want it to compensate you, you have to go to court to sue. The first-instance ordinary procedure is required to be completed within 6 months, which can be extended. The simplified procedure is 3 months, and the lawyer's fees are generally paid by yourself. If the landlord cuts off water and electricity and is forced to move out of a rented house, see Article 2 (cutoff of water and electricity, change of locks). Income is determined based on judgment: property fees range from several hundred to several thousand yuan a year, and there is no unified statistics on losses caused by heating and water outages.

Case: Mr. Zhao refused to pay the property fee because he was dissatisfied with the property service, and the property management company took him to court. The court ruled that Mr. Zhao needs to pay back property fees. Another residential property had its water supply cut off without authorization due to non-payment by the owner. After the owner complained to the real estate authority, the property was ordered to immediately restore water supply.

items.title: Inspect the house on the spot when you buy a new house and write down the problems in the handover record. If there are water leaks or water and electricity pipeline problems, ask the developer to repair them within the warranty period of the "Residential Quality Guarantee"
items.core: The developer will give you a "Residential Quality Guarantee" when you hand over the house. The legal minimum warranty period for the construction unit is 5 years for bathrooms, roofs, and exterior wall leaks, and 2 years for water and electricity pipelines and decoration, all calculated from completion acceptance. The warranty period given to you by the developer cannot be shorter than the remaining warranty period of the construction unit. If it is not repaired during the warranty period or is delayed, you can find someone to repair it yourself, and the developer will pay for it.
body: Cost: No money. On the day of closing, spend an extra two or three hours looking at the walls, floors, doors, windows, water and electricity in each room, and take photos to keep the record. Asking someone to help with the home inspection will cost extra money

Benefits: Ministry of Housing and Urban-Rural Development regulations state that when selling commercial housing, the developer must provide the buyer with a "Residential Quality Guarantee" and a "Residential Instruction Manual." The developer is responsible for the quality warranty of the house sold, and the warranty period starts from the day of delivery. The warranty period for commercial housing shall not be less than the remaining period of the quality warranty issued by the construction unit to the developer. If there is a quality problem within the scope of the warranty during the warranty period, the developer must repair it and compensate for the losses caused. The developer is not responsible for damage caused by force majeure or improper use. The minimum warranty period of the construction unit is determined by the regulations of the State Council and starts from the day when the completion acceptance is passed. Roof waterproofing, bathrooms, rooms and exterior walls with waterproofing requirements are waterproof for 5 years. The heating and cooling system has 2 heating periods and cooling periods. Electrical lines, plumbing, equipment installation and renovation work, is 2 years. The foundation and main structure have a reasonable service life specified in the design documents. The judicial interpretation of the Supreme Court states that the developer shall bear the responsibility for repairs during the warranty period. "If the seller refuses to repair or delays repairs within a reasonable period, the buyer may repair it himself or entrust others to repair it. The repair costs and other losses caused during the repair period shall be borne by the seller." If the quality of the house seriously affects normal living and use, you can terminate the contract and demand compensation. If the quality of the main structure is indeed unqualified after verification, the contract can also be terminated and compensation can be demanded. It is the author's experience to inspect each room on the day of closing, write down problems in the closing record and take photos. Improper use is not covered by the warranty, so it is difficult for the developer to say that problems noted when handing over the house were caused by your decoration
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Ministry of Construction (2001). Measures for the Administration of Sales of Commercial Housing (Ministry of Construction Order No. 88, Articles 32 and 33). <http://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2002/content_70143.htm>; State Council (2019 Revised). Construction Project Quality Management Regulations (Article 40). <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=ff8080816f3cbb3c016f410b40e11333>; Ministry of Construction (2000). Housing Construction Project Quality Warranty Measures (Ministry of Construction Order No. 80, Articles 7, 8, and 17). <http://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2001/content_60677.htm>; Supreme People's Court (2020 revision). Interpretation of Several Issues Concerning the Application of Law in the Trial of Commercial Housing Sales Contract Disputes (Articles 9 and 10). <https://www.court.gov.cn/fabu/xiangqing/282621.html>

Note: The scope and period of the warranty must be agreed upon by the developer in the contract, and the contract and the "Residential Quality Guarantee" shall prevail. If it is longer than the legal limit, then it will be longer. The sales management measures also mention the provisions of the 1998 quality assurance system. The original text of the minimum warranty period set by it has not been obtained, so the number is not included here. If a problem occurs during the warranty period, please notify the developer in writing first and keep a record. This is the author’s experience. If the developer refuses to repair or acknowledge the problem, he will have to sue in court. The first-instance ordinary procedure is required to be completed within 6 months, which can be extended. The simplified procedure is 3 months, and the lawyer's fees are generally paid by yourself. Area does not match advertised promise, see Article 12 (Area Error). Late handover of housing and late application for certificates, please see Article 13 (Late handover of housing). The income is determined based on judgment: the cost of repairs varies greatly by house and problem, and there is no unified statistics.

Case: When Mr. Chen took delivery of his new house, he found a leak in the bathroom and wrote it into the handover record on the spot. The developer delayed repairs, so he spent 8,000 yuan on repairs himself. Because it was still within the 5-year warranty period, he sued based on the records and quality assurance letter, and the court ultimately ordered the developer to reimburse the maintenance fees.

sections.title: How to live after suffering from a chronic disease

items.title: Take the full amount of medicine as directed by the doctor, and don’t stop just when you feel better.
items.core: People who take the medicine as much as the doctor says are less likely to die than people who take the medicine intermittently. This difference needs to be discounted. Even people who take enough fake medicines have lower mortality rates, which shows that part of the benefit comes from "people who can insist on taking medicines are more health-conscious."
body: Cost: It does not cost money, but it saves money on treating complications in the future. Taking medicine every day only takes up a few minutes, and it is difficult to take it all day long.

Benefit: 21 studies, 46,847 people combined (meta-analysis): People who took as many medications as prescribed died less often than those who took them on and off. Odds ratio 0.56, 95% CI 0.50–0.63 (confidence range). Looking only at treatments with proven efficacy, odds ratio 0.55 (0.49–0.62)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Simpson SH, Eurich DT, Majumdar SR, et al. (2006). A meta-analysis of the association between adherence to drug therapy and mortality. BMJ, 333(7557), 15. <https://doi.org/10.1136/bmj.38875.675486.55>

Note: Controversy. This is also the number in this book that needs to be read at a discount. In the same meta-analysis, people who took all the placebos (fake medicines) had lower mortality rates (0.56, 0.43–0.74). This shows that a considerable part of the benefits come from "people who can insist on taking medicine are more health-conscious." The author calls this mixed factor the healthy adherent effect. Self-discontinuation of tuberculosis medication can cause bacteria to become drug-resistant, see Section 1, Article 49 (Designated Tuberculosis Hospitals).

Case: Ms. Liu suffered from bacterial vaginosis, and the doctor prescribed antibiotics for 7 days. The symptoms disappeared after 3 days of taking the medication, and she stopped taking the medication on her own. As a result, the disease recurred after a week, and the bacteria developed drug resistance, making treatment more difficult. Later, she took the full course of treatment as prescribed by the doctor and was completely cured.

items.title: First apply for outpatient chronic disease identification and then register in another place. Hypertension, diabetes, radiotherapy and chemotherapy, dialysis, and anti-rejection can be settled directly in another place.
items.core: Hypertension, diabetes, outpatient radiotherapy and chemotherapy for malignant tumors, uremic dialysis, and anti-rejection after organ transplantation. These five types of outpatient visits can basically be directly covered by medical insurance. There is no need to advance the money yourself first and then go back to the insured place for reimbursement. However, it is necessary to first apply for outpatient chronic disease identification in the insured place, and then register for medical treatment in other places. It only works if you do both.
body: Cost: Nothing. Before departure, register for medical treatment in another place on the medical insurance app, and you can do it on your mobile phone.

Benefits: Documents from the National Medical Insurance Administration say this step has been achieved. The original words are "Basically realize the direct settlement of outpatient chronic disease expenses across provinces and counties, including hypertension, diabetes, outpatient radiotherapy and chemotherapy for malignant tumors, uremic dialysis, and anti-rejection treatment after organ transplantation." “County accessible” means that it can be done at the county level. The document also adds 5 new types based on these 5 types.
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Office of the National Medical Insurance Administration, General Office of the Ministry of Finance (2024). Notice on the steady and orderly expansion of the scope of chronic and special diseases for inter-provincial direct settlement outpatient clinics (Medical Insurance Banfa [2024] No. 19). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202409/content_6974467.htm>

Note: The premise is that two things must be done: first get outpatient chronic disease identification in the insured place, and then make a record for medical treatment in another place. The progress of the new five new diseases varies from place to place, and is subject to the announcement by the local medical insurance department. The hospital does not have the negotiated medicine for use, see Section 24, Article 13 (Dual-channel designated pharmacies).

Case: Uncle Zhang has diabetes and goes to live with his daughter in Shanghai. He first applied for outpatient chronic disease identification in the insured place, and then registered for medical treatment in other places. When you go to a clinic in Shanghai to get medicine, you can directly swipe your medical insurance card to settle the bill. There is no need to pay in advance and then go back to the insured place for reimbursement, which saves time and worry.

items.title: Perform re-examinations at intervals prescribed by the doctor, and mark each time's indications in the same book.
items.core: Chronic diseases look at changes over a period of time, not a single value. Just by measuring your blood pressure at home, you won't see that your blood pressure has dropped. Bring the readings to the doctor and let the doctor adjust the medicine accordingly, so that the blood pressure can be lowered more. When changing hospitals, the hospital generally should not let you redo the examination results marked with the mutual recognition mark.
body: Cost: tens to hundreds of dollars per inspection. It takes a while to go to the hospital and wait for the results. The difficulty is that you have to go every once in a while, and it’s easy to put it off again and again.

Benefits: Chronic diseases depend on how the values ​​change over a period of time. Just looking at them once is not enough. There was a meta-analysis of hypertension that combined raw data from 7138 people in 15 randomized trials. Compared with those who went to the doctor as usual, those who took their own blood pressure at home had an average change in office systolic blood pressure of −3.2 mmHg after 12 months (95% CI −4.9 to −1.6, confidence range). If you only measure it yourself without taking other measures, you will not see the effect: −1.0 mmHg (−3.3 to 1.2, the difference may be due to chance). The package that supported the most dropped 6.1 mmHg (3.2 to 9.0). Supporting support refers to doctors, pharmacists or patients themselves dispensing medicine according to readings, plus health education and lifestyle guidance. The author's conclusion is that measuring blood pressure alone cannot lower blood pressure, but it must be combined with adjusting medication based on the readings. These numbers are blood pressure and do not directly look at death. When changing hospitals, the regulations of the National Health Commission and other four departments stipulate that if the existing examination and test results provided by the patient meet the mutual recognition conditions and meet the needs of diagnosis and treatment, the hospital and the doctor shall not repeat the examination and testing. Report forms that can be mutually recognized are marked with the "HR" mark, such as "National HR"
Level of Evidence: B

Source: Tucker KL, Sheppard JP, Stevens R, et al. (2017). Self-monitoring of blood pressure in hypertension: A systematic review and individual patient data meta-analysis. PLoS Medicine, 14(9), e1002389. <https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pmed.1002389>; National Health Commission, National Medical Insurance Administration, State Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine, and Health Bureau of the Logistics Support Department of the Central Military Commission (2022). Notice on the issuance of mutual recognition management measures for inspection and test results of medical institutions (National Health Commission [2022] No. 6), Articles 13, 17, and 19. <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2022-02/19/content_5674575.htm>

Note: Only grade B is given because the direct evidence is only for hypertension, and the end point is only blood pressure, not death. Whether there are any benefits to "marking your fingers in a notebook" itself, I haven't found any research looking at health outcomes. Remember at least four things each time: date, indicator value, medicine you were taking at that time, and dosage of medicine. You can also use your mobile phone to take pictures of the test sheets, but they should be placed in the same place, don’t put them here and there. There are exceptions to mutual recognition: the hospital can recheck if the condition changes, the results change quickly, before blood transfusion during surgery, or during emergency rescue. How to copy and retain medical records and images, see Section 24, Article 5 (keep a copy of medical records, examination reports and images by yourself)

Case: Aunt Chen has suffered from high blood pressure for many years. She used to only measure her blood pressure when she was dizzy and never record it. The doctor suggested that she take measurements at a fixed time every day and write them down in the same book. After three months of persistence, she brought her record book for a follow-up visit, and the doctor adjusted the medication plan based on blood pressure fluctuations. Half a year later, her blood pressure control was significantly stable. The director of the cardiology department said that continuous recording can better reflect the true condition than a single measurement, which can help with precise treatment and reduce the risk of complications.

items.title: Don’t stop regular treatment just to try folk remedies and health products
items.core: For cancers that can be cured, the risk of death for people who only use alternative therapies and do not receive regular treatment is 2.5 times higher than those who receive regular treatment. People who use complementary therapies along with treatment are more likely to refuse surgery, chemotherapy, and radiation, and this is where the excess deaths come from. Some herbs (such as Hypericum perforatum) can also weaken the effect of anti-rejection drugs and anticoagulants. If you want to take them, ask your doctor first.
body: Cost: No money, and you save money on health care products. Doesn't take up time. The difficulty lies in being able to withstand when others repeatedly urge you to try.

Benefits: There are two studies in the US cancer registry data, looking at patients with breast, prostate, lung and colorectal cancers that have not metastasized and are otherwise treatable. The first one looks at people who only use alternative therapies, surgery, radiotherapy, chemotherapy and endocrine therapy. Their risk of death was 2.5 times higher than that of condition-matched regularly treated patients (hazard ratio HR 2.50, 95% CI 1.88–3.27, approximately 150% higher risk). It was 5.68 times (3.22–10.04) for breast cancer, 2.17 times (1.42–3.32) for lung cancer, and 4.57 times (1.66–12.61) for colorectal cancer. The second item looks at people who use complementary therapies while receiving regular treatment. They declined surgery 7.0% versus 0.1% and chemotherapy 34.1% versus 3.2%. Refusal to radiotherapy was 53.0% versus 2.3%, and refusal of endocrine therapy was 33.7% versus 2.8%. The 5-year survival rate was 82.2% versus 86.6%, with a 2.08-fold risk of death (hazard ratio HR 2.08, 1.50–2.90, approximately twice the risk). After delay and refusal of treatment were taken into account, there was no relationship between complementary therapies per se and death (hazard ratio HR 1.39, 0.83–2.33). The authors concluded that excess deaths resulted from refusal of formal treatment. The State Administration for Market Regulation requires health food labels to state: "Health foods are not medicines and cannot replace medicines to treat diseases." The National Center for Complementary and Integrative Health (NCCIH) states that Hypericum perforatum (also known as St. John's wort) can reduce the effects of many medications. These include cyclosporine, which prevents organ transplant rejection, and the anticoagulant warfarin
Level of Evidence: B

Source: Johnson SB, Park HS, Gross CP, Yu JB (2018). Use of Alternative Medicine for Cancer and Its Impact on Survival. Journal of the National Cancer Institute, 110(1), 121-124. <https://doi.org/10.1093/jnci/djx145>; Johnson SB, Park HS, Gross CP, Yu JB (2018). Complementary Medicine, Refusal of Conventional Cancer Therapy, and Survival Among Patients With Curable Cancers. JAMA Oncology, 4(10), 1375-1381. <https://doi.org/10.1001/jamaoncol.2018.2487>; State Administration for Market Regulation (2019). The State Administration for Market Regulation held a special press conference on the "Guidelines for Labeling and Warning Phrases of Health Foods" and the "Administrative Measures for the Catalog of Health Food Raw Materials and Health Function Catalogs". <https://www.samr.gov.cn/tssps/sjdt/tpxw/art/2023/art_4b658b824b1b4b0ba57c09a56cc93aad.html>; National Center for Complementary and Integrative Health (2025). St. John's Wort. <https://www.nccih.nih.gov/health/st-johns-wort>

Note: For B grade only. Both studies only looked at cancer and were tracked from registry data. There was no group control. People who choose alternative therapies may also be different in other aspects. For information on discontinuing medication for diseases such as hypertension and diabetes, see Article 1 (take the full amount of medication as directed by the doctor). If you want to try supplements, tell your primary care doctor first. Whether you need to spend money to buy health supplements, see Section 6, Article 10 (Health supplements, ointments, tonics)

Case: After Ms. Zhou was diagnosed with breast cancer, she stopped chemotherapy after listening to folk remedies and only took health care products and herbal medicines. A follow-up examination six months later revealed that the tumor had spread, and doctors said that the treatment increased her risk of death by 2.5 times. If formal treatment had been received, the cure rate could have been 90%.

items.title: For chronic diseases that are stable, medicines can be prescribed for 12 weeks at a time in community hospitals.
items.core: People whose condition is stable and have not changed their medications can be prescribed medications for up to 12 weeks at a time at community health service centers. Save half a day of queuing up to and from major hospitals to register every month.
body: Cost: Nothing. Go to the community health service center and ask if you can get a long-term prescription. It's a matter of one sentence.

Benefits: You don’t have to go to and from big hospitals to queue up to get medicine every month. In the same insured area (also called a coordinating area), the reimbursement ratio of primary-level hospitals is in principle about 10 percentage points higher than that of higher-level hospitals.
Level of Evidence: A

Source: General Office of the State Council (2026). Several measures to accelerate the construction of a hierarchical diagnosis and treatment system. <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202604/content_7065031.htm>: "For eligible patients with chronic diseases, primary medical and health institutions can issue long-term prescriptions for no more than 12 weeks of medication at a time."; the same article "In principle, the hospitalization reimbursement ratio of medical and health institutions in the region will be gradually increased 1 "There is a gap of about 0 percentage points", and requires higher-level hospitals to open chronic disease outpatient clinics for common diseases such as hypertension, diabetes, and chronic obstructive pulmonary disease at the grassroots level; in the same article, "Tertiary hospitals should focus on acute, critical, and difficult and complex diseases, strengthen referral consultation and inpatient services, and gradually reduce common disease follow-up visits and general outpatient clinics for chronic diseases with clear diagnoses and stable conditions." "And extend the general outpatient clinics of expert teams to grassroots medical and health institutions."

Note: "Eligible" is determined by a doctor, and generally refers to people who have a clear diagnosis and a stable medication regimen. The medicine is still the same medicine, but what you save is the half-day trip once a month and the registration fee. If the grassroots level does not have the medicine you want, you can ask if there is any shortage of medicine registration and delivery. The same document also requires tertiary hospitals to gradually reduce the number of general outpatient clinics for such chronic diseases, and extend the general outpatient clinics of expert teams to the community. Therefore, if we still regard large hospitals as prescribing centers, it will become increasingly difficult to register in the future. If your kind of medicine is not available in the community, or if you need a specialist to watch and prepare the medicine, you can go to the hospital where the diagnosis was made for an online follow-up consultation and prescribe the medicine. See Section 24, Article 14 (Online follow-up consultation at an Internet hospital).

Case: Uncle Sun has high blood pressure and his condition is stable. It used to take half a day to queue up at a large hospital to prescribe medicine every month. Since signing the contract at the community health service center, I can prescribe 12 weeks of medicine at a time.
