He now goes to the community hospital every three months, saving a lot of time in queues.

items.title: Before signing up for a family doctor in the community, ask clearly which ones are covered by medical insurance and which ones are self-pay.
items.core: The basic service package signed is covered by medical insurance according to regulations. All the money for the personalized service package must be paid for by yourself. When someone sells an "upgrade package", first ask whether it is a basic package or a personalized package, whether it is registered, and how much it costs per year.
body: Cost: Nothing. Just ask one more question before signing the contract, it only takes a minute.

Income: The basic service package is paid by medical insurance as required. All the money for the personalized service package is paid for by yourself, and this kind of package must be registered with the county-level health department.
Level of Evidence: A

Source: General Office of the State Council (2026). Several measures to accelerate the construction of a hierarchical diagnosis and treatment system. <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202604/content_7065031.htm>: "Strengthen the linkage between grassroots outpatient payment and contracted service policies, and the basic service package will be included in medical insurance payment according to regulations; personalized service packages will be registered by contracted grassroots medical and health institutions with the county-level health department in accordance with procedures, and the fees will be paid by individuals."

Note: The value of the contract itself lies in the fact that someone will follow you for a long time, not in how many projects are packaged. When someone sells an "upgrade package", they first ask three questions: Is it a basic package or a personalized package? Is it registered? How much does it cost per year?

Case: When Aunt Wu signed up for a family doctor in the community, the staff recommended paying 200 yuan for a "personalized service package". She remembered the suggestion and after asking, she learned that it was a self-funded project and had not been filed. After she refused, she only signed up for the basic service package. Later she learned that the basic package included medical insurance.

items.title: If you are diagnosed with diabetes, have your eyes checked once, and then at intervals prescribed by your doctor; check your feet once a year
items.core: Diabetes hurts the eyes and feet, and you can barely feel it until it gets so bad that you can't see it and becomes rotten. If detected early, it can still be cured. A dilated fundus examination is performed when type 2 diabetes is diagnosed, while for type 1 diabetes, the examination is started 5 years after the onset of the disease. If you have been checked once or twice and everything is fine and your blood sugar is within the standard, you can relax it to once a year or two. Have your feet checked once a year.
body: Cost: A dilated fundus examination costs tens to hundreds of dollars. Foot examinations are usually included in the outpatient clinic at no additional cost. The difficulty is that you should remember to check it even when your eyes and feet are not uncomfortable.

Benefit: Damage to the fundus of the eyes due to diabetes is called retinopathy, and damage to the feet is called diabetic foot. Both of these are barely noticeable until something goes wrong. If detected early, it can still be cured. It's too late until you can't see or your feet are rotten.
Level of Evidence: A

Source: American Diabetes Association (2026). Diabetes Care Standards 2026 Chapter 12 Retinopathy, Neuropathy, and Foot Care. Diabetes Care: "People with type 2 diabetes should have an initial dilated and comprehensive eye examination by an ophthalmologist or optometrist at the time of the diabetes diagnosis." "Adults with type 1 diabetes should have an initial dilated and comprehensive eye examination by an ophthalmologist or optometrist 5 years after the onset of diabetes." "If there is no evidence of retinopathy from one or more annual eye exams and glycemic indicators are within the goal range, then screening every 1–2 years may be considered." "Perform a comprehensive foot evaluation at least annually to identify risk factors for ulcers and amputations."<https://doi.org/10.2337/dc26-S012>

Note: Type 2 diabetes should be checked when diagnosed, while type 1 should be checked 5 years after onset. The difference is that Type 2 has often been quietly high for several years. If you have been checked once or twice and everything is fine and your blood sugar is within standard, you can relax the frequency to once every 1 to 2 years. People who feel dull in their feet should take a look at the soles of their feet every day, or use a mirror to look at them. Kidneys should also be checked every year, see item 13 (urinary albumin to creatinine ratio).

Case: When Mr. Zheng was diagnosed with type 2 diabetes, he immediately did a dilated fundus examination and found minor lesions. The patient's condition stabilized after timely laser treatment. The doctor asked him to check his feet once a year. Later, he found an early-stage foot ulcer. Because of the early detection, he avoided the risk of amputation.

items.title: If you have kidney stones, drink water to 2.5-3 liters a day and reduce salt to less than 6 grams
items.core: For people who develop calcium stones for the first time and cannot find out the cause, if they do nothing, about a quarter of them will grow again in five years. For people who drink more water and increase their urine output to at least 2 liters per day, only more than 10% of the patients will relapse within five years, which is more than half the rate. UK guidelines give 2.5 to 3 liters of water a day and no more than 6g of salt.
body: Cost: No money. Make it a habit to drink water at all times. On days when you sweat a lot, you have to drink more. It’s hard to remember it every day.

Benefits: A 5-year, randomized controlled trial of 199 patients with first-time calcium stones for no known cause (also called idiopathic calcium stones). One group drank more water to reach at least 2 liters of urine per day, and the other group received no intervention. Among those who relapsed within 5 years, 12/99 (12.1%) in the group who drank more water and 27/100 (27.0%) in the group without intervention, P=0.008. The smaller the P value, the more it indicates that the difference between the two groups is not a coincidence. Mean time to recurrence: 38.7±13.2 months vs. 25.1±16.4 months, P=0.016. The 24-hour urine output measured at the beginning was significantly lower in patients with stones than in those without stones: 1,057±238 mL vs. 1,401±562 mL in men (P<0.0001), and 990±230 mL vs. 1,239±440 mL in women (P<0.001). NICE guideline NG118 1.8.1 recommends that adults drink 2.5 to 3 liters of water per day and children and adolescents drink 1 to 2 liters according to their age. Add some fresh lemon juice to the water, do not drink carbonated drinks, and adults should not exceed 6 grams of salt per day. Article 1.7.1 of the same NICE guidance recommends that adults who have had kidney or ureteral stones consider a stone composition analysis. For recurrences and if more than half of the stones are calcium oxalate, it is recommended in Article 1.8.3 to consider adding potassium citrate. NICE concluded that 24-hour urine testing found no evidence and made no recommendations. The European Association of Urology (EAU) stone guidelines are written differently: every stone patient must undergo reliable stone composition analysis. People who have relapsed are at high risk and must have two 24-hour urine samples for specialized metabolic tests. It gives a general prevention goal of drinking 2.5 to 3 liters of water per day and urinary output of 2 to 2.5 liters per day
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Bao Y, Tu X, Wei Q (2020). Water for preventing urinary stones (the intervention goal for the included study Borghi 1996 was a urine output of at least 2 L/day). Cochrane Database of Systematic Reviews, 2, CD004292. <https://pmc.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/articles/PMC7012319/>; Borghi L, Meschi T, Amato F, Briganti A, Novarini A, Giannini A (1996). Urinary volume, water and recurrences in idiopathic calcium nephrolithiasis: a 5-year randomized prospective study. The Journal of Urology, 155(3), 839-843. <https://doi.org/10.1016/s0022-5347(01)66321-3>; National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (2019). Renal and ureteric stones: assessment and management. NICE guideline NG118, clauses 1.7.1, 1.8.1, 1.8.3. <https://www.nice.org.uk/guidance/ng118/chapter/Recommendations>; European Association of Urology (2026). EAU Guidelines on Urolithiasis, Chapter 4 Metabolic Evaluation and Recurrence Prevention (Section 4.1, 4.1.2, Table 4.5). <https://uroweb.org/guidelines/urolithiasis/chapter/metabolic-evaluation-and-recurrence-prevention> (For the list of high-risk stone patients, see Table 3.3 of the same guideline: <https://uroweb.org/guidelines/urolithiasis/chapter/guidelines>)

Remarks: Recurrence is reduced by about 55%, and it does not cost money. The method of calculating cost-effectiveness according to the book is the most cost-effective method in this section. What you need to keep an eye on is the 24-hour urine output. The European guideline targets 2 to 2.5 liters per day, not how much you drink. People who sweat a lot or work in hot environments need to drink more. That trial looked at patients with a first episode of idiopathic calcium stones. There is more than one component of stones, and uric acid stones, infectious stones, and cystine stones each have their own countermeasures. Doing a stone composition analysis is recommended by both British and European guidelines. For people who have relapsed, the European guidelines also require a 24-hour urine test before deciding whether to add medication. The British guidelines believe that the evidence for this test is insufficient. Don’t give up calcium to prevent stone formation, see Section 6, No. 21. If you have severe waist and abdominal cramping during an attack, you need to go to the hospital. It cannot be washed away by drinking more water. There are other things to check for painless hematuria, see Section 1, Article 27

Case: Mr. Qian had kidney stones and followed the advice to drink 3 liters of water a day and reduce his salt intake to 5 grams. After one year of persistence, the urine output reached 2.5 liters, and no new stones were found during the follow-up examination. Before, he had a recurrence almost every year, which cost him nearly 10,000 yuan.

items.title: If you develop tophi after being diagnosed with gout, see bone defects on images, or have attacks more than 2 times a year, take uric acid-lowering drugs for a long time to keep the blood uric acid below 360 µmol/L and maintain it
items.core: If you develop tophi, bones have gnawed defects, or have attacks 2 times a year. If the condition is more than 10 times, you should take uric acid-lowering drugs for a long time to reduce uric acid to below 360 µmol/L. For those who have few attacks, discuss with your doctor whether to take it or not. There are nurses who adjust the dosage of medicine based on laboratory test results. After two years, 95% of them meet the standard, while only 30% of them see the doctor as usual. After the disease was under control, the medication was discontinued. Within five years, most of the symptoms recurred, and the number of taboos was limited.
body: Cost: Allopurinol costs from a few yuan to dozens of yuan per month. At the beginning, blood uric acid should be checked every few weeks to adjust the dosage of medication, and once it stabilizes, it should be checked every few months. You will also be taking a seizure-preventing medicine for the first 3 to 6 months. The difficulty is that I have to keep eating even when there is no pain.

Benefits: A controlled trial with 517 adults who had experienced seizures within the past 12 months, randomized to two groups. One group is led by a nurse, who explains clearly what the disease is to the patient, and then adjusts the uric acid to the target according to the target. The other group saw their general practitioner as usual. Proportion of serum uric acid falling to <360 µmol/L (6 mg/dL) at 2 years, 95% vs. 30%. The probability of reaching the target was approximately 3.18 times that of the conventional group (relative risk RR 3.18, 95% CI 2.42–4.18, this interval is the credible range of the number), P<0.0001. The secondary indicators of attack frequency, tophi, and quality of life in the second year were also better than those of the conventional group. Each additional year of quality-adjusted life gained costs £5,066. A follow-up study was also conducted in the same trial. 438 people sent questionnaires and 82% were returned. Both groups self-reported the number of episodes in the previous 12 months. The median score for the attainment group was 0 times (the middle half fell into 0–0 times). The conventional group was 1 time (0–3), P<0.001. The range in parentheses is called the interquartile range. The proportion of people still taking urate-lowering drugs was 1.19 times higher in the standard group than in the conventional group (adjusted relative risk RR 1.19, 1.09–1.30). The American College of Rheumatology's 2020 gout guidelines strongly recommend three types of people to start uric acid-lowering treatment: those with tophi under the skin, those with gout gnawing bone defects on imaging examinations, and those with ≥ 2 attacks per year. For those who have had more than one attack but less than twice a year, the guidelines provide conditional recommendations. Conditional recommendations must be discussed between the doctor and the patient. For first-time attacks, it is conditionally not recommended to take it immediately. Exceptions are those with stage 3 or above chronic kidney disease, blood uric acid >9 mg/dL, or urinary tract stones. These are conditionally recommended. The method is to continuously monitor serum uric acid and adjust the dose according to the results until the target is reached, with the target <6 mg/dL. Allopurinol is the first choice, and it is also the first choice for people with stage 3 and above chronic kidney disease. The starting dose is ≤100 mg/day. Anti-inflammatory preventive medication should be given at the same time when starting, and should be taken for at least 3 to 6 months. The same guidance also cites a series of case observations. These patients discontinued medication after long-term good control, and their serum uric acid remained <7 mg/dL after discontinuation of medication. Among them, only 13% (27/211) had not experienced a single attack during the 5-year follow-up period. In terms of diet, people who restrict or abstain from alcohol have blood uric acid 1.6 mg/dL lower than those who do not restrict it. One serving of beer increases blood uric acid by 0.16 mg/dL. Healthy diet, Mediterranean diet, DASH diet had smaller effects. There is disagreement as to which urate-lowering drug is preferred. The American College of Rheumatology guidelines strongly recommend allopurinol as the first choice because it is effective at adequate doses, well tolerated, safe, and inexpensive. It also conditionally recommends: If people taking febuxostat have a history of cardiovascular disease or have new cardiovascular events, they should switch to other drugs if they are available. This recommendation is consistent with the FDA’s boxed warning for febuxostat. One basis is the CARES trial, in which 6,190 gout patients with cardiovascular disease were randomized to febuxostat or allopurinol. The risk of all-cause death was 1.22 times greater in the febuxostat group than in the allopurinol group (hazard ratio HR 1.22, 95% CI 1.01–1.47, approximately 22% greater risk). Cardiovascular death was 1.34 times higher (1.03–1.73, approximately 34% higher). The European FAST trial concluded differently. It included 6128 patients over 60 years of age with cardiovascular risk factors, and febuxostat was associated with no more major cardiovascular events than allopurinol (hazard ratio HR 0.85, 0.70–1.03). Deaths were 7.2% in the febuxostat group and 8.6% in the allopurinol group. For people who take drugs that promote uric acid excretion from the kidneys, the American College of Rheumatology conditionally does not recommend alkalizing urine because there is no evidence that it is effective and the certainty of the evidence is very low. It also asks these people to drink more water. People with known kidney stones or stage 3 or higher chronic kidney disease should not take these medications. The same guideline writes that the HLA-B\*5801 genotype is most common in people of Han, Korean, and Thai ancestry, accounting for 7.4%, African Americans 3.8%, and whites and Hispanics 0.7% each. Asians and African Americans who take allopurinol are three times more likely to develop allopurinol hypersensitivity syndrome than white people. The guideline conditionally recommends that these two groups of people check HLA-B\*5801 before taking allopurinol, and the certainty of the evidence is very low.
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Doherty M, Jenkins W, Richardson H, et al. (2018). Efficacy and cost-effectiveness of nurse-led care involving education and engagement of patients and a treat-to-target urate-lowering strategy versus usual care for gout: a randomized controlled trial. Lancet, 392(10156), 1403-1412. <https://doi.org/10.1016/S0140-6736(18)32158-5>;Abhishek A, Jenkins W, La-Crette J, Fernandes G, Doherty M (2020). Nurse-led care is preferred over GP-led care of gout and improves gout outcomes: results of Nottingham Gout Treatment Trial follow-up study. Rheumatology, 59(3), 575-579. <https://doi.org/10.1093/rheumatology/kez333>; FitzGerald JD, Dalbeth N, Mikuls T, et al. (2020). 2020 American College of Rheumatology Guideline for the Management of Gout. Arthritis Care & Research, 72(6), 744-760: "Strong recommendations included initiation of ULT for all patients with tophaceous gout, radiographic damage due to gout, or frequent gout flares” “For patients who have previously experienced >1 flare but have infrequent flares (<2/year), we conditionally recommend initiating ULT over no ULT” WB, Saag KG, Becker MA, et al.; CARES Investigators (2018). Cardiovascular Safety of Febuxostat or Allopurinol in Patients with Gout. New England Journal of Medicine, 378(13), 1200-1210. <https://doi.org/10.1056/NEJMoa1710895>; Mackenzie IS, Ford I, Nuki G, et al.; FAST Study Group (2020). Long-term cardiovascular safety of febuxostat compared with allopurinol in patients with gout (FAST): a multicentre, prospective, randomized, open-label, non-inferiority trial. Lancet, 396(10264), 1745-1757. <https://doi.org/10.1016/S0140-6736(20)32234-0>; Endocrinology Branch of the Chinese Medical Association (2020). Chinese Guidelines for the Diagnosis and Treatment of Hyperuricemia and Gout (2019). Chinese Journal of Endocrinology and Metabolism, 36(1), 1-13. <https://doi.org/10.3760/cma.j.issn.1000-6699.2020.01.001>

Note: Controversy: Which drug to use to lower uric acid, different countries have different guidelines. American guidelines prefer allopurinol, and people with cardiovascular disease should avoid taking febuxostat if they can. However, the European FAST trial did not find that febuxostat is more dangerous. You can also buy benzbromarone in China, which is a drug that promotes uric acid excretion. The Chinese Medical Association’s guidelines (2019 version and 2024 updated version) provide separate recommendations for drug selection and alkalinization of urine. Should you add sodium bicarbonate to alkalize your urine when taking benzbromarone? American guidelines believe there is no evidence and should be based on the doctor's advice. Drinking more water will not save you. **It is worth checking HLA-B\*5801** before using allopurinol for Han Chinese. It is an innate genetic model that regulates immune response, and the result of one test remains unchanged for life. People with this gene account for 7.4% of Han, Korean, and Thai people, and only 0.7% of whites and Hispanics. Asians and African Americans are three times more likely than whites to develop allopurinol hypersensitivity syndrome after taking allopurinol. In severe cases, this disease can cause large areas of skin to peel off and can be fatal. The American College of Rheumatology's 2020 gout guidelines recommend that these two groups of people consider checking before taking medication. **Reducing uric acid at the beginning is more likely to induce attacks**, so the guidelines clearly require taking an anti-inflammatory preventive drug for the first 3 to 6 months. "Taking uric acid-lowering drugs made it more painful, so I stopped" is a common failure method in this matter. What you should do when you feel pain is to add anti-inflammatory drugs as prescribed by your doctor, not stop uric acid-lowering drugs. Each company writes the standard value differently: <6 mg/dL is equivalent to about 360 µmol/L. China’s test orders mostly use µmol/L. It is another thing to have high uric acid levels on physical examination but never have an attack, see Section 6, No. 19. Sugary drinks and alcohol see Section 2, Items 7, 19 (no sugary drinks, less or no alcohol). Eating a large amount of meat and seafood in one meal or drinking alcohol can trigger an attack. See Article 10 (Don’t eat a large amount of meat and seafood in one meal when having barbecues or dinner parties)

Case: Ms. Feng has gout attacks three times a year and has tophi. The doctor asked her to take uric acid-lowering drugs for a long time to lower her blood uric acid to below 360. She insisted on taking the medicine and had regular check-ups. Two years later, her uric acid reached the target, her tophi shrank, and her joints no longer hurt.

items.title: Those who have suffered from gout, do not eat a large amount of meat and seafood in one meal when having barbecues or dinner parties, and drink less alcohol
items.core: For people who have suffered from gout, the more purines they eat in the past two days, the more likely they are to attack. The one that eats the most is the most susceptible, and the same is true for taking uric acid-lowering drugs. It is also more likely to occur if you drink two to four glasses of wine the day before, including beer, liquor, and wine.
body: Cost: No money. When having barbecues or dinner parties, order less meat skewers and seafood, and drink less alcohol. It’s hard to control yourself at the dinner table.

Benefits: A study followed 633 gout patients online for 1 year, comparing each person's two days before an attack with two days without an attack (a case-crossover study). Purine is a component in food that turns into uric acid in the body. Divide the total amount of purine eaten in two days into five levels from least to most. The more you eat, the more likely you are to have an attack. and the lowest gear ratio, the odds ratios of onset in the last four gears were 1.17, 1.38, 2.21, and 4.76 respectively (OR, P for trend <0.001). Counting only purines from animal sources, the odds ratios were 1.42, 1.34, 1.77, and 2.41. Counting only those of plant origin, they are 1.12, 0.99, 1.32, and 1.39. The results were the same when looked at separately by gender, whether they drank alcohol, whether they took diuretics, allopurinol, anti-inflammatory analgesics, and colchicine. Another study by the same researchers looked at what 724 gout patients drank in the 24 hours before a gout attack. Compared with no drinkers, the odds ratios were 1.36 (95% CI 1.00–1.88, confidence range) for more than 1 to 2 drinks and 1.51 (1.09–2.09) for more than 2 to 4 drinks. Wine, beer, and spirits have each been linked to seizures. For those who have never suffered from gout, look at another follow-up study: 47,150 men in the United States were followed for 12 years, only recorded and not divided into groups. The highest meat-eating quintile was approximately 41% more likely to develop gout than the lowest quintile (relative risk RR 1.41, 1.07–1.86). Seafood is about 51% higher (1.51, 1.17–1.95). Those who consumed the most dairy products were about 44% lower (0.56, 0.42–0.74). There is no relationship between vegetables rich in purines and the total amount of protein. Among the same people, drinking an extra 12-ounce beer per day was associated with a 49% higher chance of developing gout (relative risk 1.49, 1.32–1.70). One drink per day of hard liquor is about 15% higher (1.15, 1.04–1.28). No statistical difference was seen with wine (1.04, 0.88–1.22)
Level of Evidence: B

Source: Zhang Y, Chen C, Choi H, Chaisson C, Hunter D, Niu J, Neogi T (2012). Purine-rich foods intake and recurrent gout attacks. Annals of the Rheumatic Diseases, 71(9), 1448-1453. <https://doi.org/10.1136/annrheumdis-2011-201215>; Neogi T, Chen C, Niu J, Chaisson C, Hunter DJ, Zhang Y (2014). Alcohol quantity and type on risk of recurrent gout attacks: an internet-based case-crossover study. The American Journal of Medicine, 127(4), 311-318. <https://doi.org/10.1016/j.amjmed.2013.12.019>; Choi HK, Atkinson K, Karlson EW, Willett W, Curhan G (2004). Purine-rich foods, dairy and protein intake, and the risk of gout in men. New England Journal of Medicine, 350(11), 1093-1103. <https://doi.org/10.1056/NEJMoa035700>; Choi HK, Atkinson K, Karlson EW, Willett W, Curhan G (2004). Alcohol intake and risk of incident gout in men: a prospective study. Lancet, 363(9417), 1277-1281. <https://doi.org/10.1016/S0140-6736(04)16000-5>; Major TJ, Topless RK, Dalbeth N, Merriman TR (2018). Evaluation of the diet wide contribution to serum urate levels: meta-analysis of population based cohorts. BMJ, 363, k3951. <https://doi.org/10.1136/bmj.k3951>

Note: Mainly written for people who have had attacks. For people who have never suffered from gout, what they eat has less impact on uric acid than most people think. Among 16,760 white adults without gout in the United States, dietary habits could explain no more than 0.3% of the difference in blood uric acid, and common genetic differences could explain 23.9%. So there are people around me who developed gout after eating barbecue and drinking beer. Diet is one of the triggers, and physical fitness accounts for more. The study looked at the amount of meat, seafood and wine eaten, regardless of whether it was grilled or not, and the cold dishes and seafood were counted equally with beer. All three studies only tracked and recorded without grouping. The patients themselves reported online what they ate during the attack. The subjects were all Americans. No data on Chinese people was found. The number of dairy products is only a tracking record. There is no test to prove that drinking more milk can prevent gout. Eating less cannot replace uric acid-lowering drugs. Relying on taboos can only reduce uric acid levels. See Article 9 (if gout is diagnosed, take uric acid-lowering drugs for a long time). For the calculation of the mortality rate of processed meat and alcohol, see Section 2, Item 18 (Eat less processed meat) and Section 2, Item 19 (Drink less or no alcohol)

Case: Lao Chen suffered from gout. He had two plates of kebabs and a pot of clams at a dinner party on Friday, and drank three bottles of beer. Although he was taking uric acid-lowering medicine, his big toe became red, swollen and painful in the middle of the night, and his uric acid was significantly elevated in the emergency department.

items.title: If you are found to be positive for hepatitis B surface antigen, do a liver B-ultrasound plus alpha-fetoprotein every six months, and decide whether to take antiviral drugs according to the doctor's evaluation. Don't stop on your own if you take them.
items.core: People with hepatitis B virus had B-ultrasound and alpha-fetoprotein checked every six months. In the Shanghai experiment, the number of people who died of liver cancer was reduced by nearly 40%. The more viruses in the blood, the more likely you will get liver cancer in the future. People with severe liver fibrosis and cirrhosis who take antiviral drugs can reduce liver cancer by about half. Most medicines need to be taken for a long time, and the virus will easily rebound if you stop taking them.
body: Cost: Go to the hepatology department or infectious disease department every six months, have blood drawn and do a B-ultrasound. The cost varies from place to place. For those who want to take antiviral drugs, the National Medical Insurance Bureau said that after the centralized procurement of entecavir, the drug cost will be reduced to more than 100 yuan a year. The difficulty is that even when you don’t feel anything, you still have to go for check-ups on time, and you have to keep taking the medicine.

Benefits: A randomized trial in Shanghai involving 18,816 people aged 35 to 59, all infected with hepatitis B virus or with a history of chronic hepatitis. The screening group was invited to have alpha-fetoprotein and B-ultrasound checked every 6 months, while the control group was not screened. Alpha-fetoprotein is an indicator measured in blood tests and is often elevated in patients with liver cancer. Thirty-two people died of liver cancer in the screening group and 54 people in the control group. Liver cancer mortality was 83.2 versus 131.5 per 100,000 people. The screening group was 0.63 times (95% CI 0.41–0.98, confidence range), approximately 37% lower than the control group. 46.5% of liver cancers detected in the screening group were resected, compared with 7.5% in the control group. In a follow-up study in Taiwan, 3,653 surface antigen-positive people aged 30 to 65 were followed for an average of 11.4 years. They were only recorded and not grouped. The more viruses there are in the blood at the time of enrollment, the more likely they will develop liver cancer later. Viral loads below 300 copies per milliliter were associated with 108 cases of liver cancer per 100,000 person-years. Above 1 million copies per milliliter, there were 1,152 cases. The cumulative proportions of liver cancer were 1.3% and 14.9% respectively. After deducting gender, age, smoking, drinking, transaminase and liver cirrhosis, the rule that more viruses means more liver cancer still holds. A randomized group trial in Asia included 651 chronic hepatitis B patients with severe liver fibrosis or cirrhosis. One group took lamivudine, and the other took a placebo, for a median of 32.4 months. For liver cancer, the risk was about half lower (hazard ratio HR 0.49, P=0.047), 3.9% versus 7.4%. Exacerbations were 7.8% versus 17.7% (hazard ratio HR 0.45, approximately 55% lower risk). The 2022 version of the guidelines of the Chinese Medical Association states that patients with chronic hepatitis B virus infection should undergo abdominal B-ultrasound and alpha-fetoprotein test every 6 months to screen for liver cancer. At least every 3 to 6 months for those at high risk. For carriers who do not need to take medicine temporarily, blood routine, liver function, viral indicators, alpha-fetoprotein, and B-ultrasound should be checked every 6 to 12 months. Once you meet the medication requirements, start treatment immediately. If the virus is found in the blood, antiviral treatment is recommended for those over 30 years old, regardless of whether the transaminase is high or not. The same applies if someone in your family has cirrhosis or liver cancer due to hepatitis B. The oral drugs recommended by the guidelines are entecavir and tenofovir. The guidelines state that most people need to take medicine for a long time, and the rate of virus rebound after stopping the medicine is high
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Zhang BH, Yang BH, Tang ZY (2004). Randomized controlled trial of screening for hepatocellular carcinoma. Journal of Cancer Research and Clinical Oncology, 130(7), 417-422. <https://doi.org/10.1007/s00432-004-0552-0>; Chen CJ, Yang HI, Su J, et al.; REVEAL-HBV Study Group (2006). Risk of hepatocellular carcinoma across a biological gradient of serum hepatitis B virus DNA level. JAMA, 295(1), 65-73. <https://doi.org/10.1001/jama.295.1.65>; Liaw YF, Sung JJ, Chow WC, et al.; Cirrhosis Asian Lamivudine Multicentre Study Group (2004). Lamivudine for patients with chronic hepatitis B and advanced liver disease. New England Journal of Medicine, 351(15), 1521-1531. <https://doi.org/10.1056/NEJMoa033364>; Chinese Medical Association Hepatology Branch, Chinese Medical Association Infectious Disease Branch (2022). Guidelines for the prevention and treatment of chronic hepatitis B (2022 edition). Chinese Journal of Hepatology, 30(12), 1309-1331. <https://doi.org/10.3760/cma.j.cn501113-20221204-00607>; English version of the same guideline: You H, Wang F, Li T, et al. (2023). Guidelines for the Prevention and Treatment of Chronic Hepatitis B (version 2022). Journal of Clinical and Translational Hepatology, 11(6), 1425-1442. <https://doi.org/10.14218/JCTH.2023.00320>; Wun YT, Dickinson JA (2003). Alpha-fetoprotein and/or liver ultrasonography for liver cancer screening in patients with chronic hepatitis B. Cochrane Database of Systematic Reviews, CD002799. <https://doi.org/10.1002/14651858.CD002799> (opposition); Aghoram R, Cai P, Dickinson JA (2012). Alpha-foetoprotein and/or liver ultrasonography for screening of hepatocellular carcinoma in patients with chronic hepatitis B. Cochrane Database of Systematic Reviews, CD002799.pub2. <https://doi.org/10.1002/14651858.CD002799.pub2> (opposition); National Medical Insurance Administration (2025). China’s medical insurance benefits people’s livelihood Taking small steps to achieve long-term goals (7): Standardization, institutionalization and normalization of centralized medical procurement: "Entecavir, the first-line drug for hepatitis B treatment, used to cost patients about 5,000 yuan a year... After centralized procurement, the annual cost of entecavir has dropped to more than 100 yuan." <https://www.nhsa.gov.cn/art/2025/12/29/art_14_19172.html>

Note: Controversy: Some people disagree with the conclusion of the Shanghai experiment. Cochrane's 2003 review was recalculated using its own algorithm. The calculated difference in liver cancer death was not significant (odds ratio OR 0.81, 0.54–1.22). The updated version in 2012 stated that the trial had a high risk of bias, and the numbers reported in several reports were inconsistent, making it impossible to draw conclusions. Therefore, the "check every six months" relies on this controversial test and the guidelines of various countries. Lamivudine is an old drug, and 49% of people in the trial developed drug-resistant mutations. Now the guidelines recommend entecavir. Whether you need to take medicine and whether you can stop it depends on the amount of virus, transaminases, degree of liver fibrosis and family history, which will be decided by the doctor. People who are not yet infected should be tested and vaccinated. See Section 1, Article 14 (Two and a half tests for hepatitis B). Hepatitis C is another disease, see Section 1, Item 45 (Hepatitis C Antibodies). Drinking alcohol damages the liver, see Section 2, Article 19 (Drink less or no alcohol). The main beneficiary is yourself.

Case: Uncle Liu’s physical examination revealed that hepatitis B surface antigen was positive. After that, he underwent liver B-ultrasound and alpha-fetoprotein every six months. After the doctor evaluated him, he was put on long-term antiviral treatment. He took it regularly. Three years of follow-up examination showed no signs of liver cancer, and the virus did not rebound.

items.title: If you are diagnosed with COPD, ask the doctor or pharmacist to watch you use the inhalant in person during the follow-up visit; if you have been hospitalized due to acute exacerbation, go to pulmonary rehabilitation after discharge
items.core: Only about 30% of people who use inhalants do it correctly, and some mistakes will prevent the medicine from being absorbed into the lungs. Patients who made critical errors were about twice as likely to be hospitalized or visit the emergency room for exacerbations. After hospitalization for an acute exacerbation, pulmonary rehabilitation is performed, and significantly fewer patients are hospitalized again, and the quality of life and walking ability will be better. Whether there will be fewer deaths is yet to be seen.
body: Cost: There is no extra cost to see how to use the inhalant. Bring the medicine with you to the follow-up visit and use it in person for a few minutes. Pulmonary rehabilitation involves exercise training with someone, plus explanations on medication and self-management. It requires several visits according to the plan, and the cost varies from place to place. The difficulty is that I feel weak after being discharged from the hospital, but I still have to keep practicing.

Benefits: A nationwide sample survey in China, 50,991 adults over the age of 20 had lung function tests. The proportion with COPD was 8.6% (95% CI 7.5–9.9, confidence range), equivalent to approximately 99.9 million people. For those over 40 it was 13.7%. Among COPD patients, only 12.0% have had pulmonary function tests done before. One analysis compiled 144 studies in which 54,354 patients were observed using inhalers in person by trained people. The technique was completely correct 31% of the time, 41% was barely adequate, and 31% was poor. There is no improvement between the first 20 years and the last 20 years. For those who use push-type sprays, 45% of cases cannot match the pressure and inhalation. 44% did not inhale quickly or deeply enough, and 46% did not hold their breath after inhaling. A French survey only recorded, without grouping, doctors saw 2,935 COPD patients using inhalers. More than half of the operations were faulty. Key errors that prevent medication from being inhaled ranged from 15.4% to 46.9% across various inhalation devices. Among patients who were hospitalized or visited the emergency department due to exacerbation in the past 3 months, 3.3% of patients made no errors and 6.9% made critical errors (odds ratio OR 1.86, 1.14–3.04). The summary of GOLD's 2023 report states that doctors and patients should be taught to use inhalation devices correctly and should be checked regularly during follow-up visits. It also recommends that patients with COPD get influenza, pneumococcal and other vaccines according to local regulations. A 2016 Cochrane review compiled 20 randomized trials with 1477 people. The comparison is between pulmonary rehabilitation after an acute exacerbation of COPD and normal care without rehabilitation. 8 studies, 810 people readmitted. Rehabilitation was associated with fewer readmissions (odds ratio OR 0.44, 95% CI 0.21–0.91), moderate quality evidence. But the results vary widely across studies. Six studies, 670 people looked at death, odds ratio OR 0.68 (0.28–1.67), the difference may be due to chance, the quality of the evidence is low. The quality of life was improved beyond what patients could detect, and the quality of the evidence was high. On average, walking distance in 6 minutes is 62 meters longer (38–86 meters), high-quality evidence
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Wang C, Xu J, Yang L, et al.; China Pulmonary Health Study Group (2018). Prevalence and risk factors of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease in China (the China Pulmonary Health [CPH] study): a national cross-sectional study. Lancet, 391(10131), 1706-1717. <https://doi.org/10.1016/S0140-6736(18)30841-9>; Sanchis J, Gich I, Pedersen S; ADMIT (2016). Systematic Review of Errors in Inhaler Use: Has Patient Technique Improved Over Time? Chest, 150(2), 394-406. <https://doi.org/10.1016/j.chest.2016.03.041>; Molimard M, Raherison C, Lignot S, et al. (2017). Chronic obstructive pulmonary disease exacerbation and inhaler device handling: real-life assessment of 2935 patients. European Respiratory Journal, 49(2), 1601794. <https://doi.org/10.1183/13993003.01794-2016>; Agustí A, Celli BR, Criner GJ, et al. (2023). Global Initiative for Chronic Obstructive Lung Disease 2023 Report: GOLD Executive Summary. European Respiratory Journal, 61(4), 2300239. <https://doi.org/10.1183/13993003.00239-2023>;Puhan MA, Gimeno-Santos E, Cates CJ, Troosters T (2016). Pulmonary rehabilitation following exacerbations of chronic obstructive pulmonary disease. Cochrane Database of Systematic Reviews, 12, CD005305. <https://doi.org/10.1002/14651858.CD005305.pub4>; Greening NJ, Williams JE, Hussain SF, et al. (2014). An early rehabilitation intervention to enhance recovery during hospital admission for an exacerbation of chronic respiratory disease: randomized controlled trial. BMJ, 349, g4315. <https://doi.org/10.1136/bmj.g4315> (opposition)

Note: Controversy: There are different opinions on when pulmonary rehabilitation should begin. In a British randomized trial, exercise initiated within 48 hours of admission was associated with no reduction in readmission one year later (hazard ratio HR 1.1). There were more deaths (odds ratio OR 1.74, 95% CI 1.05–2.88). A summary of GOLD's 2023 report said the effects were unclear starting within the first 4 weeks after hospital discharge. So what you need to do is to stabilize your condition after discharge and follow the doctor's instructions. Don't practice more by yourself during the acute period of hospitalization. The Cochrane review also stated that the newly included studies had smaller effects than those in earlier years. The two items regarding inhalants are surveys that only record and do not group into groups. There is no experiment that directly proves that "revisiting during follow-up visits" can reduce hospitalizations. The specific technique is different for each device, please refer to the instructions and the doctor's demonstration. See Section 1, Section 20 (Influenza Vaccine) for influenza vaccine and Section 1, Section 22 (Pneumococcal Vaccine) for pneumococcal vaccine. If you are still smoking, quit smoking first. See Section 2, Item 3 (Don’t just rely on tolerance to quit smoking, get medicine first). The main beneficiary is yourself.

Case: During Li Bo's follow-up consultation for COPD, the pharmacist asked him to use inhalants in person, but found that he did not exhale first and held his breath too short after inhaling. After correcting his technique, he did not have to go to the emergency room due to acute exacerbation in half a year, and he became more stable when climbing stairs.

items.title: Those with diabetes (type 1 starting from 5 years of disease duration) should have their urine albumin to creatinine ratio and blood creatinine checked once a year. Those with high blood pressure should also check to detect chronic kidney disease early.
items.core: Only 10% of Chinese adults with chronic kidney disease know they have the disease. Type 2 diabetes patients can be diagnosed early by testing their urine and blood once a year, and the same can be done for type 1 diabetes starting after 5 years. For those who are found to have high urinary protein, taking dapagliflozin can reduce the risk of kidney function deterioration, dialysis or death by approximately 40%. The risk of death is about 30% lower.
body: Cost: Take a urine test to check the urinary albumin to creatinine ratio, then draw blood to check the creatinine, and ask the doctor to prescribe it together during the follow-up visit. The difficulty is that you should remember to check it even when your kidneys are not uncomfortable.

Benefits: China's national chronic disease surveillance from 2018 to 2019, 176,874 adults had blood and urine tests. About 8.2% of people suffer from chronic kidney disease, equivalent to about 82 million people. 73.3% of these are still in early stages 1 to 2. Only 10.0% knew they were sick. Another survey looked at 9,672 patients with type 2 diabetes at 45 hospitals across the country, and 31% had chronic kidney disease. Among these 2,997 people, only 27% had been diagnosed with kidney disease before. KDIGO's 2024 kidney disease guidelines say people at risk should have both their urine albumin and their glomerular filtration rate (how much blood the kidneys can filter per minute) checked. The highest priority is for patients with hypertension, diabetes and cardiovascular disease. The American Diabetes Association's 2026 standards state that patients with type 2 diabetes should have their urinary albumin to creatinine ratio and estimated glomerular filtration rate checked at least annually, regardless of how they are treated. The same goes for those with type 1 disease lasting more than 5 years. For those with diabetes combined with hypertension and moderately elevated urinary albumin (30 to 299 mg/g), it is recommended to use prolin or sartan antihypertensive drugs. After it is found out, medicine will be available. A randomized group trial included 4304 patients with chronic kidney disease, glomerular filtration rate between 25 and 75, and urinary albumin-to-creatinine ratio 200 to 5000. Over a median of 2.4 years, 9.2% of the dapagliflozin group lost more than half of their kidney function, developed end-stage renal disease, or died of kidney disease or cardiovascular disease. In the placebo group it was 14.5%. Hazard ratio HR 0.61 (95% CI 0.51–0.72), approximately 39% lower risk. Death 4.7% vs 6.8%, hazard ratio HR 0.69 (0.53–0.88), approximately 31% lower risk. Whether you have diabetes or not, the effect is about the same
Level of Evidence: B

Source: Wang L, Xu al. (2024). Prevalence and Risk Factors of Chronic Kidney Disease in Patients With Type 2 Diabetes in China: Cross-Sectional Study. JMIR Public Health and Surveillance, 10, e54429. <https://doi.org/10.2196/54429>; Kidney Disease: Improving Global Outcomes (KDIGO) CKD Work Group (2024). KDIGO 2024 Clinical Practice Guideline for the Evaluation and Management of Chronic Kidney Disease. Kidney International, 105(4S), S117-S314, Practice Point 1.1.1.1, 1.1.1.2. <https://doi.org/10.1016/j.kint.2023.10.018>; American Diabetes Association (2026). Standards of Diagnosis and Treatment of Diabetes 2026·Chapter 11 Chronic kidney disease and risk management. Diabetes Care, 49(Suppl 1), S246-S260, Recommendations 11.1a, 11.6a. <https://doi.org/10.2337/dc26-S011>; Heerspink HJL, Stefánsson BV, Correa-Rotter R, et al. (2020). Dapagliflozin in Patients with Chronic Kidney Disease. New England Journal of Medicine, 383(15), 1436-1446. <https://doi.org/10.1056/NEJMoa2024816>

Note: Only grade B is given because there is no randomized trial to directly compare whether "annual inspection" itself can reduce deaths. The fewer deaths come from people who have already been diagnosed with high proteinuria and are taking medicine. Therefore, the magnitude of the return is judged to be medium based on judgment, and it is not as large as the death drop. One high result is not considered a confirmed diagnosis, and KDIGO requires a re-examination for confirmation. The guidelines do not specify a fixed interval for how often patients with high blood pressure should be checked. Just follow what the doctor says. What medicine to take is decided by the doctor, don’t buy it yourself. The fundus of the eyes and feet should be checked for diabetes, see Article 7 (a fundus check). For those diagnosed with chronic kidney disease, please see Section 34, Item 14 (Poor kidney function) about buying painkillers and eating star fruit. The main beneficiary is yourself.

Case: Aunt Zhang has type 2 diabetes and high blood pressure. The urinary albumin to creatinine ratio and blood creatinine are checked every year as directed by the doctor. Last year, the urine protein was high, and the doctor added dapagliflozin and controlled blood pressure. This year, the kidney function is still stable.

items.title: Those who have undergone surgery and chemotherapy for colon cancer should participate in a guided exercise program and continue to practice for three years.
items.core: After surgery and chemotherapy for colon cancer, people who participated in a supervised exercise program for three years had about a 28 percent lower risk of recurrence, new cancer, or death. The risk of death was about 37% lower. About 90% of those who are still alive after eight years have practiced, and about 83% have only received promotional materials. People who practice have more injuries to their muscles and joints.
body: Cost: Exercise like walking costs nothing. Go to the hospital's rehabilitation department or exercise prescription clinic for physical fitness assessment and prescribe an exercise plan. Registration fees and examination fees will be charged separately. Please hire a personal trainer. Spend a few more hours exercising every week for another three years. People who practice have more injuries to their muscles and joints.

Benefits: A randomized, 55-center trial (CHALLENGE) involving 889 patients with colon cancer. All of them had completed surgery and adjuvant chemotherapy, were in high-risk stage II or stage III, and had no metastasis at the time of enrollment. Enrollment occurred 2 to 6 months after completion of chemotherapy and exercise was less than 150 minutes per week before enrollment. 445 people participated in the three-year exercise program and 444 received only health promotion materials. In the first 6 months of the exercise program, you will meet with the sports instructor every two weeks to discuss how to stick to it, and you will also practice under the watch of the instructor. Change to in-person or phone calls for 6 to 12 months, then minimal support through year 3. The goal is to get 10 more metabolic equivalent hours (a unit of exercise measurement) per week than before, including moderate-intensity exercise. The plan predicts that most people will choose to walk. At one year, the exercise group engaged in 15.6 more metabolic equivalent hours of leisure-time physical activity per week, compared with 5.1 more in the control group. Median follow-up was 7.9 years. The risk of recurrence, new cancer, or death was approximately 28% lower in the exercise group than in the control group, with a hazard ratio HR 0.72 (95% CI 0.55–0.94). Those who had not experienced any of these incidents in 5 years were 80.3% vs. 73.9%. The risk of death was approximately 37% lower, hazard ratio HR 0.63 (0.43–0.94). Alive at 8 years, 90.3% vs. 83.2%. Musculoskeletal adverse events, 18.5% vs. 11.5%. The cost analysis of the same trial was based on Canada's publicly funded medical care. The exercise program cost CAD 2,917 per person initially, but with fewer recurrences, the total cost over 5 years was CAD 1,589 less per person.
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Courneya KS, Vardy JL, O'Callaghan CJ, et al.; CHALLENGE Investigators (2025). Structured Exercise after Adjuvant Chemotherapy for Colon Cancer. New England Journal of Medicine, 393(1), 13-25. <https://doi.org/10.1056/NEJMoa2502760>; ClinicalTrials.gov NCT00819208. Colon Health and Life-Long Exercise Change Trial. <https://clinicaltrials.gov/study/NCT00819208>; Courneya KS, Vardy JL, O'Callaghan CJ, et al. (2016). Effects of a Structured Exercise Program on Physical Activity and Fitness in Colon Cancer Survivors: One Year Feasibility Results from the CHALLENGE Trial. Cancer Epidemiology, Biomarkers & Prevention, 25(6), 969-977. <https://doi.org/10.1158/1055-9965.EPI-15-1267>; Chan KKW, Chu RWK, Cheung MC, et al.; CHALLENGE Investigators (2026). Structured Exercise Program After Adjuvant Chemotherapy for Colon Cancer: A Cost-Utility Analysis of the CHALLENGE Trial. Journal of Clinical Oncology, 44(22), 2130-2139. <https://doi.org/10.1200/JCO-26-00765>

Note: The trial only accepts colon cancer, not rectal cancer, and only accepts people who have undergone clean surgery, completed chemotherapy, and have no metastasis. Therefore, it cannot be directly applied to other cancers and terminal patients. The primary outcome was recurrence, new cancer, or death. Total deaths was a secondary outcome, which the authors said was "consistent with living longer" and did not treat it as conclusive. There is no ready-made similar program in China, so you can ask the oncology department or rehabilitation medicine department to prescribe exercise. A physical fitness assessment was conducted before training began, and everyone in the trial took an exercise test before joining the group. How to calculate the amount of walking, see Section 2, Item 11 (7000–8000 steps per day). Strength training is provided in Section 2, Item 16 (Strength Training). The main beneficiary is yourself.

Case: Mr. Zhao participated in guided exercise at the end of post-operative chemotherapy for colon cancer, including brisk walking and strength training three times a week for three years. No recurrence was found during the reexamination, and physical fitness recovered significantly. There was only occasional muscle soreness, which improved after adjusting the intensity.

sections.title: There is an elderly person at home

items.title: While the elderly person is awake, designate his future guardian in writing
items.core: While the elderly person is still clear-headed, spend a few hundred dollars to go to the notary office to get a written document stating who will be his guardian in the future. Without this document, when the elderly are no longer able to make their own decisions, they will follow the order set by the law: spouse first, then parents and children, then other close relatives. If the family fights over this matter, the neighborhood committee, village committee, civil affairs department or court will make the appointment.
body: Cost: Go to the notary office to get one, a few hundred yuan. One conversation with the old man will settle the matter. The difficulty lies in opening the mouth: having to talk face to face about the day when he will no longer be able to control himself

Benefits: The Civil Code stipulates that adults who are clear-headed and able to make their own decisions (the law calls them "adults with full capacity for civil conduct") can discuss with others in advance who will be their guardians in the future. The object of negotiation can be close relatives or other individuals or organizations willing to act as guardians. We agreed to "identify my guardian in writing." In the future, if he is no longer able to make decisions, or can only make part of the decisions (the law calls it "loss or partial loss of capacity for civil conduct"), the person named in the contract will be in charge. Without this document, the guardianship shall be in accordance with the order of Article 28 of the Civil Code: spouse, parents, children, other close relatives, and then other willing individuals or organizations with the consent of the neighborhood committee, village committee or civil affairs department. Article 31 of the Civil Code stipulates that if there is a dispute over who should be the guardian, the neighborhood committee, village committee or civil affairs department shall appoint the guardian. Those who are dissatisfied may apply to the court for appointment, or they may apply directly to the court
Level of Evidence: A
Source: National People's Congress (2020). Civil Code (Articles 28, 31, 33). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202006/t20200602_463888.shtml>

Note: This document is called guardianship, which means the person you designate in advance. This person is ranked first in the legal order of custody. If the elderly live alone, have children in other places, or have complicated relationships at home, they need to do it in advance. It is recommended to go to a notary office for notarization

Case: Aunt Chen’s father is eighty years old but has a clear mind. He went to the notary office in advance to designate her as the guardian in writing. Later, her father suffered a stroke and became demented, and the children did not fight for custody. She quickly signed for treatment and care arrangements.

items.title: After making a will, remember that the one made later will overturn the one made first, and the notarized will will no longer take priority
items.core: The law recognizes six types of wills, each of which has procedures that must be completed. The kind that is handwritten by yourself, you need to write it by hand from beginning to end, sign your name, and write down the year, month and day. If several copies are made and the contents conflict with each other, the last copy will be counted. Starting from 2021, the notarized copy will no longer automatically be ranked first.
body: Cost: Write a will by hand at no cost. Get it notarized by a notary public, which costs several hundred to thousands of dollars. The difficulty lies in opening the mouth: discussing posthumous affairs with family members

Benefits: The Civil Code recognizes six forms of wills: handwritten, written by someone else, printed, audio and video, oral, and notarized. Each has its own formal requirements that must be fulfilled (the law calls them "formal requirements"). For the type written in one's own hand, Article 1134 of the Civil Code requires that it be "written in the testator's own hand, signed, and marked with the year, month, and day." If several copies are made and the contents conflict with each other, the last copy shall prevail. Starting from 2021, the notarized copy will no longer automatically be ranked first
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress (2020). Civil Code (Articles 1134 to 1142). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202006/t20200602_463888.shtml>; Supreme People's Court (2020). Interpretation on the Application of the Succession Section of the Civil Code of the People's Republic of China (1) (Fa Interpretation [2020] No. 23, Article 24). <https://www.court.gov.cn/fabu/xiangqing/282091.html>

Note: A handwritten will must be handwritten from beginning to end, signed, and clearly marked with the year, month, and day. A printed will must be witnessed by two or more witnesses. The testator and witnesses must sign each page and write the year, month and day. Heirs, people who are written into the will to distribute things, and people who have an interest in them cannot be witnesses. The interested parties named in the judicial interpretation are creditors, debtors and business partners of these people. Whether close relatives such as their spouses and children are counted is not directly stated in the law or judicial interpretation. The author recommends not asking them to serve as witnesses to avoid being disputed in the future. If the form is wrong, the entire document will be invalid. This is the most common failure point. After the person leaves, whether the inheritance of small deposits and houses needs to be notarized, see Section 25, Article 12 (do not default to notarization first when handling inheritance).

Case: Uncle Zhou first made a will to give the house to his son, and two years later wrote a will in his own hand to his daughter, indicating the month, day and signature. After his death, the court handled the will based on his self-written will, and the notarized one no longer took priority.

items.title: Put the elderly's money in a separate account, and set a rule of double confirmation for large expenditures
items.core: People who deceive the elderly often give small gifts and greetings first, so as to build up enough trust, and then defraud the elderly out of large sums of money. Scammers also often tell you "don't tell anyone." Make a rule in advance: If you spend more than a certain amount, you must tell someone first. In this way, family members will know before spending money, and the decision to spend money will be postponed.
body: Cost: No money. Just discuss it with your family and decide on an amount. The difficulty is how to speak, don’t let the elderly think that you are guarding against him

Benefits: The Supreme People’s Procuratorate released typical cases of pension fraud in 2022. It said that this type of crime first uses small favors and family care to defraud trust, and then uses false propaganda and promises of high returns to defraud large amounts of property. In one case, a company selling fake collectibles sent employees to clean the elderly, chat with them, and even "make love" to them. When selling goods, I put the items in black bags and sealed them, and told the old man not to open them, so as not to let the old man's family find out. The company collected more than 1.92 million yuan, and the boss was sentenced to 7 years and 6 months in prison for fund-raising fraud. The Beijing Local Financial Administration Bureau reminds the elderly in 2023 not to believe the scammers who say "don't tell anyone." When you are undecided, consult with your family, children, and trusted neighbors and friends. Ask your family for their opinions before investing. The Federal Trade Commission tallied up the total number of people over 60 who reported being scammed. About $600 million in 2020, rising to about $2.4 billion in 2024. The increase was mainly in cases where a single loss exceeded $100,000. Making an appointment in advance to "talk to someone first if the expenditure exceeds the amount" is equivalent to letting family members know about it before spending money, and also delays the decision
Level of Evidence: B

Source: Supreme People's Procuratorate (2022). The Supreme People's Procuratorate releases typical cases of combating pension fraud crimes (Xu Mouyan's fund-raising fraud case and answers to reporters' questions). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/xwfbh/wsfbt/202206/t20220617_560010.shtml>; Beijing Local Financial Supervision and Administration Bureau (2023). Revealing new tricks designed to defraud the elderly, raising awareness of fraud prevention, and guarding the "money bag". <https://jrj.beijing.gov.cn/jrxcjy/jraq/ffffjzxkt/202311/t20231127_3310210.html>; Federal Trade Commission (2025). FTC Issues Annual Report to Congress on Agency's Actions to Protect Older Adults (Protecting Older Consumers, 2024-2025). <https://www.ftc.gov/news-events/news/press-releases/2025/12/ftc-issues-annual-report-congress-agencys-actions-protect-older-adults>

Note: There is no research on how families who follow this rule are less likely to be cheated. Give it a B because the scam routine and "discuss with your family more" came from the prosecutors and financial regulatory authorities. The nature of the basis is the same as that of Article 6 (housing for retirement). People are more likely to be persuaded when they are excited, see point 4 (I want to go back and discuss it with my family). General anti-fraud rules are provided in Sections 8 and 13. Don’t talk about this as “because you’re afraid of being cheated.” It is easier for the elderly to accept it if it is said that "the family's money is kept in a unified account". Don't leave all the elderly person's money to their children for safekeeping, as that will lead to another type of dispute

Case: Uncle Sun deposited his pension money in a separate card and agreed with his family to call first if it exceeds 5,000 yuan. A health care products salesman urged him to pay 20,000 yuan to buy a "cash back card". He first asked his daughter, but her daughter checked and stopped her, but the money was not transferred.

items.title: Prepare an excuse for the elderly person that can be spoken at any time: "I want to go back and discuss it with my family."
items.core: Sales and fraud rely on on-site pressure, asking you to pay before you have time to think. Once people's emotions are aroused, they will want to buy the things in the exaggerated advertisements. Old people want to buy more than young people. Discuss with the old man in advance, "I want to go back and discuss it with my family." He could speak out at any time. He could step down on the spot and go home to calm down before deciding.
body: Cost: No money. It only takes a few minutes to talk to the old man

Benefits: Sales and fraud both rely on on-site pressure. The Federal Trade Commission's Scam Prevention Guide says scammers want you to act before you have a chance to think. When you call, they will ask you to hang up so you can't verify. The guideline suggests that before doing anything, tell someone, be it a friend, family member or neighbor. If you tell someone, it may turn out to be a scam. The original China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission’s 2021 risk warning also recommended that elderly people discuss with their families before buying financial products. One experiment looked at 116 people aged 65 to 85 and 115 people aged 30 to 40. The researchers first used a winning or losing game to arouse the emotions of some people, and then let them watch exaggerated and false advertisements. People whose emotions are really aroused are more likely to want to buy what is advertised. Regardless of whether they are excited or not, the elderly want to buy more than the young people. The author recommends waiting until your emotions calm down before making any decisions about spending money. Another experiment looked at people, mostly older, who had been defrauded of money by mail scams in the past. For those who were not warned in advance, nearly half of the people who received simulated sales scam calls immediately agreed. For those who called two to four weeks in advance to remind them, there were obviously fewer people who agreed immediately. Discuss in advance "I want to go back and discuss with my family" so that the elderly can have steps to go down without having to make a decision on the spot
Level of Evidence: B

Source: Federal Trade Commission (2023). How To Avoid a Scam. (3rd issue of 2018). <https://dfjrjgj.hunan.gov.cn/dfjrjgj/yhlj/202106/t20210608_19450856.html> (Reprinted by Hunan Provincial Local Financial Supervision and Administration Bureau); Kircanski K, Notthoff N, DeLiema M, et al. (2018). Emotional arousal may increase susceptibility to fraud in older and younger adults. Psychology and Aging, 33(2), 325-337. <https://doi.org/10.1037/pag0000228>; Scheibe S, Notthoff N, Menkin J, et al. (2014). Forewarning reduces fraud susceptibility in vulnerable consumers. Basic and Applied Social Psychology, 36(3), 272-279. <https://doi.org/10.1080/01973533.2014.903844>

Note: The reason for B is that neither experiment measured the sentence itself. One test is whether you want to buy when you are emotional, and the other test is whether the warning in advance is effective. There is no research on how much less people are deceived than the elderly who have been prepared with this sentence. Used together with Article 3 (the elderly’s money is placed in a separate account). Fall prevention modifications were also made at home, see Section 1. This sentence is to leave a step for the old man so that he does not have to push hard on the spot, not to guard against him. When surrounded by sales pitches, the hardest thing is to say no in front of a room full of people, which is even harder than judging whether it is true or not.

Case: During a community event, the salesperson urged Grandma Wu to pay a deposit on the spot to buy a physiotherapy mattress. She replied as promised, "I want to go back and discuss it with my family." After leaving the venue, she checked with her son and found that the propaganda was exaggerated, so she didn't buy it.

items.title: Don't touch any "investment pension" that asks the elderly to pay money first: applying for a card, buying a bed, buying a retirement apartment, living in retirement care, and buying senior products are all the same illegal fund-raising
items.core: Retirement care projects that ask the elderly to pay money first and promise returns are all the same set of scams. Common ones include applying for a card, buying a bed, buying a senior apartment, traveling for senior care, and holding meetings to sell senior products. According to regulations, this kind of money loss can only be recognized by yourself. Someone stole 136 million yuan by booking a bed in a retirement apartment, cheating more than 2,100 people.
body: Cost: No money. Read the following titles to the old man for a few minutes. In the future, I will reject them directly: I won’t go to the class, I won’t visit, I won’t leave my phone number. The difficulty is that if the old man has been there several times and is familiar with the person, it will not be easy to persuade him to come back

Benefit: The Ministry of Civil Affairs has listed five forms of expression. It is more reliable to recognize the name than the person. The first type is under the guise of an elderly care service organization: it has no entity, temporarily rents a venue, and claims to have signed a cooperation agreement with the elderly care institution to "make a ploy." The second type is in the name of providing "elderly care services": selling "VIP cards", "membership cards" and "prepaid cards", and asking people to pay "elderly care service fees" in advance. The promised service clearly exceeds its own bed supply capacity. The third type is in the name of investing in “retirement projects”. Common projects include investing in health care and retirement bases and selling fictitious retirement apartments. There are also long-term rental beds for the elderly and "time bank" mutual aid for the elderly. The pretense is return-on-cost sales, sale-leaseback, and agreed-upon repurchase. The fourth type is in the name of selling "senior products": product repurchase, consignment and sales, consumer rebates, free physical examinations, gifts, conference marketing, health lectures, and expert free clinics. The fifth type is in the name of enjoying "residence care": low-price or free travel, stored value rebates, and points retirement care. The money cannot be recovered, it is stated in the regulations. Article 25 of the Regulations on Preventing and Dealing with Illegal Fund-raising stipulates that "losses suffered due to participation in illegal fund-raising shall be borne by the fund-raising participants themselves." The money lost can only be claimed by oneself. In the officially reported case, Dai and others illegally raised 136 million yuan in the name of booking beds in a retirement apartment, and more than 2,100 people were victims. Dai Mouping was sentenced to 15 years in prison for fund-raising fraud and fined 400,000 yuan. Cao Mouming raised funds and defrauded 13.207 billion yuan in the name of investing in the elderly care industry, involving more than 110,000 people. Cao Mouming was sentenced to life imprisonment, deprived of political rights for life, and confiscated all personal property. It is a crime of fraud to sell health products. Ni Mourong used free banquets, gifts, and private transportation to attract the elderly to attend classes. The lecturer used "false characters, false cases, and false high prices" to fabricate the anti-cancer effects. The elderly were tricked into buying "dihydroquercetin" at dozens of times the cost price. The sales amount was more than 620,000 yuan. Ni Mourong was sentenced to 10 years and 3 months and fined 120,000 yuan (nationwide, the regulations will come into effect on May 1, 2021)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Ministry of Civil Affairs (2023). Risk warning about illegal fund-raising in the field of elderly care services. <https://www.gov.cn/lianbo/bumen/202306/content_6886556.htm> (published on the Chinese government website); Ministry of Civil Affairs, China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission (2021). Risk warning on illegal fund-raising in the elderly care field. <https://www.mca.gov.cn/n152/n164/c36171/content.html>; State Council (2021). Regulations on Preventing and Handling Illegal Fund-raising (State Council Order No. 737, Articles 2, 25, and 30). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2021-02/10/content_5586632.htm>; Supreme People’s Procuratorate (2022). Typical cases of procuratorial organs cracking down on pension fraud crimes. <https://www.spp.gov.cn/xwfbh/wsfbt/202206/t20220617_560010.shtml>; Supreme People's Court (2025). Punishing typical cases of fraud crimes involving people's livelihood in accordance with the law (Case 5 Ni Mourong Fraud Case). <https://www.court.gov.cn/zixun/xiangqing/482861.html>

Note: The judgment does not depend on "this company looks legitimate", but on "whether it asked you to pay money in advance and whether it promised to repay you." Elderly care institutions are supposed to sell services. If they talk about investment, rebates, or return of capital, don't believe them. It is not illegal per se, and it is difficult to stop the elderly being taken to attend classes, travel, and receive free clinics. What can be stopped is the step of paying, which is used in conjunction with the double confirmation rule in Article 3. Once you have paid the money, please immediately call 110 or 96110 to request a stop payment according to Section 8, Article 2. At the same time, report to the local department responsible for handling illegal fund-raising. House-based pension insurance is another approach, see Article 6 (housing reverse mortgage pension insurance). For the upper limit of deposits, membership fees and collection accounts required by formal nursing homes, see Article 11 (deposits cannot exceed 12 months of bed fees). If you are taken into a shopping store to buy something in a low-price group, see Section 5, Article 50 (Being taken into a shopping store in a group).

Case: Aunt Zhou heard about "high interest rebates for booking a bed" at a senior care apartment exhibition, and paid 200,000 yuan to apply for a card, without telling her children. Half a year later, the company closed down and she could no longer pay the bills, so she called the police. Most of the money she invested was never recovered.

items.title: Except for the insurance company's reverse mortgage pension insurance, don't touch any other "house-based pension insurance" and never mortgage your house to buy financial services
items.core: There is only one formal type of house-based pension insurance, which is the insurance company's reverse mortgage pension insurance, and it is still being piloted. The scammer’s idea of ​​“housing for retirement” has nothing to do with it. He is tricking the elderly into mortgaging their house and then using the borrowed money to buy the financial management products he recommends. Some people don't even know that their house is mortgaged. In the end, the house is gone and they still have to bear the loan.
body: Cost: No money. The property certificate of your home will not be handed over to anyone who comes to you in the name of "housing for retirement". All mortgage, guarantee, and loan agreements must be read over by your children before signing. The difficulty is that the people who come to the door are often very enthusiastic and have made many trips, and the elderly are too embarrassed to refuse

Benefits: The Consumer Protection Bureau of the China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission has clearly stated the true and false. There is only one formal housing-based pension insurance, which is called "senior housing reverse mortgage pension insurance." Elderly people who have full legal property rights in their homes mortgage their properties to insurance companies. The house is still yours to live in, use, and collect rent for yourself. To sell or dispose of the property, the consent of the mortgagee (insurance company) is required. The old man receives the pension according to the agreed conditions until his death. This business is still in the pilot stage, and there are relatively few people doing it. The "housing for retirement" mentioned by the criminals is "completely unrelated" to the country's trial of housing reverse mortgage pension insurance. It is "a means to build publicity for illegal fund-raising activities under the guise of national policies." Its operation is to trick the elderly into applying for real estate mortgages, and then use the borrowed money to buy the financial products it recommends. "It is often a Ponzi scheme of 'repaying old with new'." The original text of the consequences reads, "Some participants did not even know that their properties were mortgaged, and eventually lost their houses and were still burdened with loans." The prompt also gives a line to look at the rate of return. The original words are: "If a financial product promises a return rate of more than 6%, there will be a question mark. If it exceeds 8%, it will be very dangerous. If it exceeds 10%, you will be prepared to lose all your principal. "Capital guaranteed and high return" is a financial fraud." The same reminder also requires that "treat the contract signing process with caution and do not sign blank contracts" (National, June 2021)
Level of Evidence: B

Source: Consumer Rights Protection Bureau of China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission (2021). Risk reminder on being wary of financial fraud of "investment for retirement" and "housing for retirement" (third issue of 2021). <https://dfjrjgj.hunan.gov.cn/dfjrjgj/yhlj/202106/t20210608_19450856.html> (Reprinted by Hunan Provincial Local Financial Supervision and Administration Bureau); Ministry of Civil Affairs, China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission (2021). Risk warning about illegal fund-raising in the field of elderly care (the fourth form of expression: illegal fund-raising in the name of claiming "housing for elderly care"). <https://www.mca.gov.cn/n152/n164/c36171/content.html>

Note: The grade B is given because these statements are based on the risk warnings and empirical judgments of the regulatory authorities, not research data. The three lines of 6%, 8%, and 10% are regulatory reference lines for consumers, not standards set by law. The China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission has been merged into the State Financial Supervision and Administration Bureau. The original release page cannot be opened. Here is the reprinted page of the provincial financial regulatory bureau. The second reason for losing money in financial management is that after the house is mortgaged, the old man still owes a loan, and the loss is far greater than the principal. See Section 8, Item 17 for general rules on signatures and blank contracts, and Section 8, Item 2 for how to stop payment after being cheated.

Case: Uncle Ma was persuaded by the "House for Retirement" intermediary to mortgage his house for 800,000 yuan and resell it to buy a designated financial management company. After the agent lost contact and the financial management failed to deliver, the loan still needed to be repaid and the house was executed.

items.title: If the elderly at home are bedridden for a long time or are severely disabled, go to the medical insurance department in the insured place to apply for long-term care insurance; it is not only issued to the elderly
items.core: Long-term care insurance pays for nursing services and generally does not pay directly in cash. If someone in your family is severely disabled and the disability lasts for more than six months, you should go to the medical insurance department in the insured place to apply. There is no minimum payment line for nursing fees. Employees who participate in the insurance will pay about 70%, and those who participate in urban and rural residents will pay about 50%. Bed fees and food expenses are not covered. There is no age threshold for the document, and young people with severe disabilities can also apply.
