body: Cost: Go to the medical insurance department in the insured place to submit an application. Do another disability level assessment. If you pass the first assessment, the assessment fee will be paid by the fund and you don’t have to pay it yourself

Benefits: There is no deductible for long-term care services that meet the regulations. The deductible is that you have to advance a certain amount before you start bidding, so there is no need to advance here. If you participate in the insurance according to the unit's employee policy, about 70% will be reimbursed by the fund. About 50% are insured according to the policy for unemployed urban and rural residents. The maximum amount of money that can be reported in a year (the maximum annual payment limit) shall not exceed 50% of the per capita disposable income of urban and rural residents in the local coordinated area in the previous year. Those who can enjoy the benefits are those who participate in insurance and pay premiums in accordance with regulations, whose disability generally lasts for more than 6 months, and who pass the assessment after application. In the initial stage, severe disability will be protected first. The document does not set an age threshold. Those under the age of 18 who are unemployed will participate in the insurance with their parents, and those who meet the conditions will enjoy treatment according to the standards of urban and rural residents. The fund mainly pays to nursing institutions and caregivers. In principle, it does not directly make payments to disabled people. Expenses such as institutional bed fees and meals that are not considered nursing care will not be paid by the fund
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Eight departments including the National Medical Insurance Administration (2026). Notice on the issuance of the "Implementation Plan for Accelerating the Establishment of a Long-term Care Insurance System". <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202603/content_7063915.htm>: The protection targets are "disabled persons who have paid insurance premiums in accordance with regulations and have been disabled for a long time (generally more than 6 months), and have been assessed and identified upon application." "In the initial stage of the system, severely disabled people are protected"; "There is no minimum payment standard for benefits. For long-term care services that meet the requirements, if you are insured according to the insurance policy for unemployed urban and rural residents, the fund payment ratio is about 50%; for those insured according to the unit employee insurance policy, the fund payment ratio is about 70%, and retirees enjoy unit employee participation. "Insurance benefits"; "The annual maximum payment limit of the insured person fund shall not exceed 50% of the per capita disposable income of urban and rural residents in the coordinated area in the previous year"; "Except for special groups such as newborns, for those who did not participate in the insurance for the first time when the local long-term care insurance system was launched, and who participated in the insurance again after interrupting payment, a waiting period for benefits should be established... Benefits are fixed In principle, the fixed waiting period is set at 6 months"; "The fund will not pay for institutional bed fees, meal fees and other non-nursing service fees, as well as medical expenses that should be paid by medical insurance." "In principle, cash will not be directly distributed to disabled people." Also see the "Opinions on Accelerating the Establishment of a Long-term Care Insurance System" by the General Office of the CPC Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council. <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/2026/issue_12666/202604/content_7065119.html>

Note: The disability must be "long-lasting (generally more than 6 months)", and hospitalization for several weeks is not enough to qualify for the application. Those who were not insured when the local system was launched, but were insured later, or those who were insured after discontinuing contributions, will have a waiting period before enjoying benefits, which is in principle 6 months. Long-term care insurance does not pay for expenses such as bed fees and food expenses that are not considered nursing care. Long-term care insurance will not pay for medical expenses that should be paid by medical insurance. Those who are already receiving work-related injury living care allowance will not enjoy it again. This amount and the nursing subsidy included in the two subsidies for persons with disabilities are two sets of procedures and two amounts of money and do not conflict. See Section 7, Article 8 (Two Subsidies). Reimbursement rates are skewed for care at home and in the community, and it is not necessary to be admitted to an institution. This system has been implemented in batches in various places, and the disability assessment standards are also different. First call 12393 or the phone number of the medical insurance agency in the insured area to ask whether the local insurance has been started and how to make an appointment for the assessment. Don’t give up even if you don’t pass the assessment. You can apply again after your disability becomes more severe.

Case: Sixty-five-year-old Uncle Zhao has been severely disabled in bed for half a year. His family went to the local medical insurance to apply for long-term care insurance. A 40-year-old patient with spinal cord injury in the same ward also applied successfully, and the employee nursing fee was 70% and the resident fee was 50%.

items.title: There are people in the family who have been bedridden for a long time and regard pressure sores as their number one enemy: use an electric air mattress, turn over regularly, and check the protruding bones every day
items.core: Old people who have pressure sores before surgery for hip fractures are more likely to die within 30 days, but this does not mean that preventing pressure sores will result in fewer deaths. Changing to an electric air mattress reduces the number of new pressure sores by about 60%. In the ICU, sensors are used to remind people to turn over and turn in place on time, which reduces the risk by about 70%. Check the sacrococcyx, heels, hips, shoulders and back every day. If you find redness that persists, see a nurse or doctor that day.
body: Cost: Home electric alternating pressure air bed, starting from a few hundred yuan. It only takes a few minutes to turn over. The difficulty is that it has to be turned every two or three hours, and it does not stop at night. It cannot be carried by one person

Income: 19,520 hip fracture surgery patients (US NSQIP 2016 to 2019). People who had pressure ulcers before surgery were more likely to die within 30 days. This association held after accounting for other factors (odds ratio OR 1.2, P = 0.004). These people were also more likely to have other problems, with the odds ratios being: deep vein thrombosis OR 1.59, pneumonia OR 1.39, and unplanned readmission OR 1.43. The average hospital stay was also 0.4 days longer. 324 hospitalized older adults (mean 86 years) were followed for a median of 18 months. Pressure ulcers alone predicted long-term mortality (hazard ratio HR 1.500, 95% CI 1.059 to 2.126, P=0.020). Prediction alone means that it can predict by itself after eliminating other factors. Both of these two measures only see people with pressure ulcers in worse conditions later on, which does not mean that preventing pressure ulcers will reduce the mortality rate. Sixty-five randomized trials were counted together (network meta-analysis). The comparison is between an electric active airflow support surface and a standard hospital mattress (standard hospital bed support surface). Electric active airflow support surfaces are a type of electric air bed. People who used it had lower rates of pressure ulcers (relative risk RR 0.42, 95% CI 0.29 to 0.63, moderate certainty). The electric hybrid airflow support surface is RR 0.22 (0.07 to 0.66). Cochrane review of 11 trials 4462 people (updated 2026). The difference between turning every 2 hours and turning every 4 hours was unclear (RR 1.05, 95% CI 0.79 to 1.39, very low certainty). Comparisons between other turning intervals are also highly uncertain. In a trial of 1,226 ICU patients, wearable sensors were used to provide real-time reminders and visual warnings, making the 2-hour cycle a reality. Pressure ulcer incidence was lower than usual care (RR 0.28, 95% CI 0.10 to 0.75, moderate certainty). In a trial of 116 people, the incidence of pressure ulcers was higher in the prone (lying down) group than in the supine (lying flat) group (RR 4.55, 95% CI 2.31 to 8.98)
Level of Evidence: B

Source: Porter SB, Pla R, Chow JH, et al. (2022). Preoperative Pressure Ulcers, Mortality, and Complications in Older Hip Fracture Surgery Patients. JAAOS Global Research & Reviews, 6(11). <https://doi.org/10.5435/JAAOSGlobal-D-22-00117>; Ottaviani S, Rondanina E, Longo E, et al (2026). Impact of pressure ulcers and frailty on long-term mortality: a prospective cohort study of hospitalized older adults. European Geriatric Medicine, 17(2), 665-672. <https://doi.org/10.1007/s41999-025-01331-8>; Shi C, Dumville JC, Cullum N (2018). Support surfaces for pressure ulcer prevention: A network meta-analysis. PLoS ONE, 13(2), e0192707. <https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0192707>; Latimer SL, Chaboyer WP, Probst S, et al (2026). Repositioning for pressure injury prevention in adults. Cochrane Database of Systematic Reviews, 6, CD009958. <https://doi.org/10.1002/14651858.CD009958.pub4>

Note: There are three reasons for giving B. First, the two studies on mortality only found that "people with pressure ulcers are worse off later on." This does not mean that "preventing pressure ulcers will reduce the mortality rate." Second, the conclusions of several randomized trials on turning over intervals are very unreliable. Third, the evidence for air mattresses is stronger, but the comparison in the study was with hospital bed mattresses. When applied to household mattresses, it would be an extrapolation. Check the sacrococcyx, heels, hips, shoulders and back every day to see if there is any "redness that does not fade when pressed". This is a routine nursing practice and there is no separate documentation. For the care services that can be covered by long-term care insurance, see Article 7 of this section. If one leg suddenly becomes swollen, treat it as deep vein thrombosis, see Section 13, Item 11. For those who are bedridden for a long time due to a fall or serious injury, see Section 1, Article 34

Case: Aunt Zhang was in bed after hip fracture surgery. Her family members put on an electric air mattress, turned over every two hours, and checked her sacrococcyx and heels every day. On the fifth day, they found that the red mark on the heel had not faded. They asked a nurse to deal with it that day, but it did not enlarge again.

items.title: If the old man’s cataract has affected his vision, go to the ophthalmologist for evaluation and surgery; if he has both eyes, don’t delay the second eye for too long
items.core: For women over 70 years old, if they have cataract surgery on the first eye as soon as possible, the number of falls in a year will be reduced by about 34%, but the number of falls is still the same. The second eye test showed no significant difference, but more people were hospitalized for falls between surgeries than before, so don't wait too long. Elderly people who had surgery were less likely to suffer a hip fracture within a year, about 2 fewer per 1,000 people.
body: Cost: Accompany the elderly to an eye examination first, and the doctor will judge whether it should be done. One operation is performed on one eye. Many hospitals perform it as a day surgery, and you can go home the same day. If there are cataracts in both eyes, the procedure will be done in two sessions. How much you have to pay depends on which kind of intraocular lens (artificial lens) you choose to put in your eyes, and how local medical insurance covers it. Ask them before the operation.

Benefits: A randomized trial of 306 women over 70 years old with cataracts. Half had their first eye operated on in about four weeks, and the other half waited the usual 12 months. People who had surgery as soon as possible had about 34 percent fewer falls over the course of a year. The original value was the ratio of fall rates 0.66, with a confidence range 95% CI 0.45 to 0.96. Among those who had fallen at least once, 49% in the surgery group and 45% in the waiting group were no less. For those who had fallen more than twice, 18% were in the surgery group and 25% were in the waiting group. Four fractures occurred in the surgery group (3%) and 12 in the waiting group (8%). The trial, which was included in a Cochrane review, concluded that surgery on the first eye in women reduced the number of falls, but surgery on the second eye did not. The randomized trial of Second Eye looked at 239 women over the age of 70. Fall rates were 32% lower in the surgical group, but the difference may be due to chance (fall rate ratio 0.68, 95% CI 0.39 to 1.19). There were 1,113,640 cataract patients over the age of 65 in the US Medicare 5% sample (2002 to 2009). This study is just a follow-up record and there is no group control. Those who had surgery had fewer hip fractures at one year (odds ratio OR 0.84, 95% CI 0.81 to 0.87). This outcome is rare, and the odds ratio and relative risk are similar. The absolute difference is 0.20 percentage points, or about 2 fewer cases per 1,000 people. In Western Australia's population-wide hospitalization records, the number of hospitalizations due to fall injuries during the period between two surgeries was 2.14 times higher than before surgery. In another Australian follow-up study, the number of falls dropped the most after the second eye surgery. There is no group control for these two items. The hospitalization item is a before and after comparison, which cannot be separated from the impact of surgery and the impact of aging.
Level of Evidence: B

Source: Harwood RH, Foss AJ, Osborn F, Gregson RM, Zaman A, Masud T (2005). Falls and health status in elderly women following first eye cataract surgery: a randomized controlled trial. British Journal of Ophthalmology, 89(1), 53-59. <https://doi.org/10.1136/bjo.2004.049478>; Foss AJ, Harwood RH, Osborn F, Gregson RM, Zaman A, Masud T (2006). Falls and health status in elderly women following second eye cataract surgery: a randomized controlled trial. Age and Ageing, 35(1), 66-71. <https://doi.org/10.1093/ageing/afj005> ; Gillespie LD, Robertson MC, Gillespie WJ, et al. (2012). Interventions for preventing falls in older people living in the community. Cochrane Database of Systematic Reviews, 9, CD007146. <https://doi.org/10.1002/14651858.CD007146.pub3> ; Tseng VL, Yu F, Lum F, Coleman AL (2012). Risk of fractures following cataract surgery in Medicare beneficiaries. JAMA, 308(5), 493-501. <https://doi.org/10.1001/jama.2012.9014> ; Desapriya E, Subzwari S, Scime-Beltrano G, et al. (2010). Vision improvement and reduction in falls after expedited cataract surgery: systematic review and metaanalysis. Journal of Cataract and Refractive Surgery, 36(1), 13-19. <https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jcrs.2009.07.032> ; Meuleners LB, Lee AH, Ng JQ, Morlet N, Fraser ML (2012). First eye cataract surgery and hospitalization from injuries due to a fall: a population-based study. Journal of the American Geriatrics Society, 60(9), 1730-1733. <https://doi.org/10.1111/j.1532-5415.2012.04098.x> ; Meuleners LB, Fraser ML, Ng J, Morlet N (2014). The impact of first- and second-eye cataract surgery on injurious falls that require hospitalisation: a whole-population study. Age and Ageing, 43(3), 341-346. <https://doi.org/10.1093/ageing/aft177> ; Keay L, Ho KC, Rogers K, et al. (2022). The incidence of falls after first and second eye cataract surgery: a longitudinal cohort study. Medical Journal of Australia, 217(2), 94-99. <https://doi.org/10.5694/mja2.51611> ; National Health Commission (2022). "The 14th Five-Year Plan" National Eye Health Plan (2021-2025). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2022-01/17/content_5668951.htm>

Remarks: Controversy: Taking the two randomized trials together, the number of people who have fallen has not been significantly reduced (odds ratio OR 0.81, 95% CI 0.55 to 1.17). In Western Australia's population-wide hospitalization records, there were 27% more hospitalizations due to falls and injuries in the year after the first eye surgery. In the period between surgeries, such hospitalizations were 2.14 times higher than before surgery. This type of before-and-after comparison compares the effects of surgery to the effects of aging. In another Australian follow-up study, the number of falls dropped the most after the second eye surgery. So if you have cataracts in both eyes, don’t wait too long on the second one. During the period between the two surgeries, you need to be extra careful when walking and going up and down stairs. Cochrane also included a trial that helped the elderly deal with vision problems, and the number of falls increased by about 57%. The surgery is about seeing clearly, and to prevent wrestling, you have to rely on Section 1, Article 13 (Balance and Leg Strength). Whether bones can withstand being broken, see Section 1, Item 39 (Bone Density Examination) and Section 1, Item 40 (Medicine if osteoporosis is detected). The National Eye Health Plan states that cataract surgery has been widely carried out in counties, and it is not necessary to go to hospitals in big cities. The beneficiaries are mainly your parents and grandparents.

Case: Uncle Li had cataracts and could not see the steps clearly, and he once sprained his ankle in the community. After the ophthalmological evaluation, the right eye was examined first. One month later, I could see clearly at night, and I didn’t stumble again for three months. During the reexamination, the doctor arranged for the left eye and did not wait until the vision was clear.

items.title: When the elderly at home walk their dogs, hold the leash in the palm of your hand and do not wrap it around your hand. Shorten the leash and train the dog to hold it until it does not rush forward.
items.core: In the United States, people over 65 years old broke their bones while walking their dogs. In 2004, about 1,700 people and in 2017, about 4,400 people. Eighty percent are women, and nearly 30% are hospitalized, with hip fractures being the most common by individual site. About three-quarters of the patients with hand injuries caused by dog ​​ropes in a hand surgery clinic were caused by the rope wrapping around their hands and being pulled by the dog. Therefore, the rope is held in the palm of the hand, shortened, and the dog is trained not to rush forward.
body: Cost: It costs nothing to hold the rope and shorten the rope. Just walk with the elderly and teach them once. It takes time to train a dog not to rush forward. You can teach it yourself or hire a dog trainer. It costs money to hire a dog trainer, and the prices vary widely from place to place. The difficulty is that the old man is used to using retractable ropes and wrapping the rope around his wrists, so he needs to change.

Benefits: U.S. emergency department surveillance data provides a national estimate of the number of people over 65 who have broken bones after walking with their dogs. There were about 1,671 people in 2004 and about 4,396 people in 2017, a statistically significant increase. 78.6% of those with fractures were women, and 28.7% were hospitalized. In terms of individual parts, the hip accounts for 17.3%. In terms of major categories, upper limbs accounted for the most, accounting for 52.1%. Another national emergency department data looked at 2001 to 2018. The number of dog leash-related injuries is estimated to be approximately 360,000 (356,746 to be precise). Among them, 193,483 people were injured by dogs, and 136,767 people were tripped or entangled in ropes. The number of injuries per million people rose from 25.4 to 105.5. A hand surgery clinic saw 443 patients with hand injuries from dog leashes over a 5-year period. About three-quarters of the injuries were caused by hands or fingers being entangled in ropes or being pulled by dogs (337 people who wrote abstracts, 75.9%). Approximately one fifth required surgery (96, 21.6%). According to statistics from the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention, from 2001 to 2006, approximately 86,629 falls and injuries were caused by cats and dogs each year. 88.0% of these were related to dogs. Of dog-related falls, 26% occurred while walking the dog, and 21.2% were pushed or pulled down by the dog
Level of Evidence: B

Source: Pirruccio K, Yoon YM, Ahn J (2019). Fractures in Elderly Americans Associated With Walking Leashed Dogs. JAMA Surgery, 154(5), 458-459. <https://doi.org/10.1001/jamasurg.2019.0061>; Forrester MB (2020). Dog leash-related injuries treated at emergency departments. American Journal of Emergency Medicine, 38(9), 1782-1786. <https://doi.org/10.1016/j.ajem.2020.05.082>; Plusch K, Givner D, Wiafe B, Lutsky K, Beredjiklian P (2026). Hand and Wrist Dog-Leash Injuries in the Outpatient Setting: A Review of 443 Cases. Hand, 21(4), 582-586. <https://doi.org/10.1177/15589447241299128>; CDC (2009). Nonfatal fall-related injuries associated with dogs and cats — United States, 2001-2006. MMWR, 58(11), 277-281. Rosa R, Buckley RE (2024). Leash-related injuries associated with dog walking: an understudied risk for dog owners? Journal of the American Veterinary Medical Association, 262(7), 973-978. <https://doi.org/10.2460/javma.23.11.0608>

Note: Hold the rope in the palm of your hand and do not wrap it around your hand. This is the advice given by the doctor at the hand surgery clinic. They wrote that this protects the fingers and wrists, preventing the dog from knocking the person down when it lunges. They also suggested that the rope should be shortened: if the rope is short, the dog will not be able to reach the speed and the pull will be light; if the rope is long, it will easily wrap around things and cause people to trip. When the telescopic rope is extended, it becomes a long rope. However, there is no study that specifically compares telescopic ropes and ordinary ropes, which are more likely to fall. A 2024 review stated that there is no data on the type of rope used when injured. Training a dog on a leash not to rush forward is mentioned by the US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention and the author of the article on fractures. The fractured article also suggested that elderly people who are considering getting a dog choose a smaller dog. There is no research and calculation on how much these practices can reduce falls, so the magnitude of the benefits is judged to be small. Whether bones can withstand being broken, see Section 1, Item 39 (Bone Density Examination) and Section 1, Item 40 (Medicine if osteoporosis is detected). For daily balance training, see Section 1, Item 13 (Balance and Leg Strength). Whether walking the dog can be regarded as exercise, see Section 2, Article 44 (walking the dog counts as walking distance). The beneficiaries are mainly your parents and grandparents.

Case: When Grandma Wang was walking her puppy, she wrapped the rope around her wrist, and the dog staggered when she was pulled. Later, she changed to holding a short rope in the palm of her hand and practicing "stop" before going out; once a dog chased a cat and yanked hard, but she was not brought down.

items.title: If you want to send an elderly person to live in a nursing home, you must first check whether it has been registered with the civil affairs department and signed a written agreement; the deposit must be up to 12 months of bed fees, which must be deposited into a special bank account
items.core: Regular nursing homes must register with the civil affairs department and sign a written agreement with you. The deposit is charged up to 12 months for bed space and the service fee is charged up to 12 months in advance. The deposit and membership fee must be paid into a special account opened in the bank. If you exceed the upper limit, ask you to transfer to a private account, and only give you a receipt but not an invoice, don't hand it in yet.
body: Cost: No money. Before signing a contract, call the local county-level civil affairs department or ask the nursing home to produce a registration receipt. Check the agreement, charge sheet and collection account again, half a day is enough. The problem is that in nursing homes where beds are tight, family members are embarrassed to find fault with the contract.

Benefits: The Ministry of Civil Affairs’ Measures for the Management of Elderly Care Institutions stipulates that a nursing home institution must register with the Civil Affairs Department within 10 working days after admitting an elderly person. If the materials are complete, the civil affairs department will issue a filing receipt. Elderly care institutions must sign a service agreement with the elderly or their agent, specifying the level of care, charging standards, refunds, and liability for breach of contract. Anyone who fails to sign an agreement will be ordered by the civil affairs department to make corrections and given a warning. In serious cases, a fine of not more than 30,000 yuan will be imposed. A 2024 document from seven departments, including the Ministry of Civil Affairs, set a cap on advance fees. Elderly care service fees are collected in advance for up to 12 months. The deposit is up to 12 times the elderly person’s monthly bed fee. The deposit can only be used to refund fees, advance the elderly’s emergency medical expenses, offset arrears and compensate. Public and privately owned nursing homes are not allowed to charge membership fees. Nursing homes that have not yet been built or cannot accommodate the elderly are not allowed to charge membership fees. All deposits and membership fees must be deposited into a special deposit account held by a third party in the bank, and personal accounts are not allowed to be used for collection. An invoice must be issued after the money has been collected, and receipts are not allowed in lieu. If the contract is terminated before the elderly person moves in, the nursing home must promptly refund the money received in advance. For those who have already checked in, the part that has been consumed will be deducted, and the remaining balance will be refunded in one go according to the original channel in principle. This document will be effective from October 1, 2024, and each province can set stricter regulations. The 2025 depository guidelines require that after the nursing home submits a refund application, the depository bank shall refund the money in one go through the original channel on the same day or the next day at the latest
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Ministry of Civil Affairs (2020). Management Measures for Nursing Homes (Ministry of Civil Affairs Order No. 66, Articles 10, 12, 16, and 46). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2020-09/19/content_5544761.htm>; Seven departments including the Ministry of Civil Affairs, the National Development and Reform Commission, and the Ministry of Public Security (2024). Guiding Opinions on Strengthening the Supervision of Advance Fees in Nursing Homes (Minfa [2024] No. 19, Articles 4, 5, 6, 8, and 9). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202405/content_6950308.htm>; General Office of the Ministry of Civil Affairs and General Office of the State Administration of Financial Supervision (2025). Notice on the issuance of the "Guidelines for the Depository Work of Prepaid Fees in Elderly Care Institutions" (Minbanfa [2025] No. 9). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202511/content_7049045.htm>; State Administration for Market Regulation. Contract model text library (model text of service contracts for elderly care institutions in various provinces, such as Gansu Province 2024 version). <https://htsfwb.samr.gov.cn/View?id=8377c6f9-b7f8-4cb4-a218-0e5b65de5cce>

Note: Each province can set the deposit limit and service fee advance collection period shorter. Check the provincial regulations before signing a contract. The agreement can be signed according to the model service contract for elderly care institutions issued by the provincial civil affairs and market supervision departments, which can be found in the contract model text database of the State Administration for Market Regulation. Registration is done after taking in the elderly. Newly opened nursing homes may still be filing, so you can ask them when they will be registered. There is no agreement on a refund, and the path given by the document is negotiation, mediation, complaint, arbitration, or litigation. There is no charge for filing a complaint with the civil affairs department responsible for supervision. If the case goes to court, the ordinary first-instance procedure shall be completed within 6 months according to regulations, and may be extended. The lawyer's fees shall be paid by the person himself. Promising to return the principal, pay interest, and give returns when collecting money is no longer a normal advance charge. See Article 5 (Investment for Retirement). The beneficiaries are mainly your parents and grandparents. The advance fee cap is written as of October 2026.

Case: Ms. Chen looked for a nursing home for her disabled father, and found out that the nursing home had civil affairs registration and signed a written agreement. The other party asked for an 18-month deposit and transfer to a private account. She refused to switch homes, and the fees were later paid into a special bank account.

items.title: If the parents of an only child are hospitalized, check the provincial regulations to see if there is any nursing leave for the children. If so, apply in writing to the unit with the hospitalization certificate
items.core: Some provinces provide nursing leave for only children to take care of their hospitalized parents. The number of days varies from province to province. No less than 20 days per year in Henan, no more than 10 days in Fujian, and no more than 15 days in Guangdong. Henan states that attendance will be counted, and Fujian states that wages and benefits remain unchanged. If the employer refuses to give or deducts money, Fujian and Guangdong indicate that you can contact the human resources and social security department.
body: Cost: No money. It takes more than ten minutes to search the two regulations of this province on the national laws and regulations database. Then take the hospitalization certificate and submit a written application to the unit. The difficulty is that the unit doesn't want to give it, so it has to be fake for fear of offending the leader.

Benefits: Each province writes care leave into different local regulations. Henan Provincial Regulations on the Protection of the Rights and Interests of the Elderly stipulates that the unit where the child works must provide nursing leave to an elderly person who has received an honorable certificate for the parents of an only child during hospitalization. The total number of nursing leave days shall be no less than 20 days per year, and the period shall be regarded as attendance. Fujian Provincial Regulations on the Protection of the Rights and Interests of the Elderly stipulates that when the parents of an only child are over 60 years old and are sick and hospitalized, the employer must provide time for their children to take care of them. The total nursing time shall not exceed 10 days per year, and the salary and benefits will remain unchanged. If the unit fails to pay wages and benefits during the nursing period, the human resources and social security department or relevant departments will order payment within a time limit. The Population and Family Planning Regulations of Guangdong Province govern couples registered in the province who voluntarily have only one child during those years when the country advocates one child per couple. If they are over 60 years old, their employer will grant their children 5 days of care leave every year. If you are sick and hospitalized, the total stay shall not exceed 15 days per year. If a unit fails to implement the holidays stipulated in the regulations, the human resources and social security department at or above the county level shall order it to make corrections. The legal liability chapter of Henan's regulations does not mention what to do if the unit does not grant nursing leave
Level of Evidence: B

Source: Henan Provincial People's Congress Standing Committee (2018). Henan Provincial Regulations on the Protection of the Rights and Interests of the Elderly (Article 29). <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=2c90e5ba65c68cf70165d0eed8020053>; Fujian Provincial People's Congress (2017). Regulations on the Protection of the Rights and Interests of the Elderly in Fujian Province (Articles 27, 70). <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=4028abcc61277793016128072d0848f4>; Guangdong Provincial People’s Congress Standing Committee (2021). Guangdong Provincial Population and Family Planning Regulations (Ninth Amendment in 2021, Article 36, Item 5, Article 45). <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=ff8081817fb1209d017fb5c92e623844>

Remarks: Check the methods stipulated by the province: Search "Provincial Name + Regulations on the Protection of the Rights and Interests of the Elderly" and "Provincial Name + Population and Family Planning Regulations" in the national laws and regulations database (flk.npc.gov.cn). Read both, only the one marked "valid". If the province doesn’t write it down, search the city’s regulations. All provinces only provide benefits to only children, and most children with brothers and sisters are not included in the provisions. If the employer refuses to give you leave or deducts your wages, you can first call 12333 or go to the Labor Supervision Bureau of the Human Resources and Social Security Bureau to complain. There is no charge. To get back the money you have deducted, you can also apply for labor arbitration. There is no fee. The case will be concluded within 45 days after acceptance, and it can be extended for up to 15 days. The provisions in Henan say "not less than" 20 days, while those in Fujian and Guangdong say "not more than". Even if the units in the latter two provinces give less, it is not considered a violation. I gave B because the number of days and conditions are determined by each province. The beneficiaries are your parents, and the money falls on you. The number of days in the three provinces is based on regulations as of October 2026 and may be revised in the future.

Case: Xiao Zhou's father was hospitalized for surgery. She found out that the only child care leave in the province was 15 days, so she applied in writing with a hospitalization certificate. After the unit approved it, she stayed with him for two weeks, and her salary was paid without any annual leave.

items.title: The old man's memory is getting worse and worse, and he is beginning to delay his life. Take him to the hospital's memory clinic or neurology department for a check-up. First, rule out possible causes such as depression, medication, and difficulty hearing and seeing.
items.core: If your memory is getting worse, it does not necessarily mean you are old and confused. First check to see if there are any rectifiable reasons such as depression, incorrect medication, or difficulty hearing or seeing clearly. But very few can be truly cured, and less than 1% of dementia cases are truly cured. Checking early also has another use: while the old man can still make his own decisions, he can decide who will take care of his money and medical care in the future.
body: Cost: A visit to a memory clinic or neurology department for cognitive testing, blood drawing, and urine testing, which takes half a day to a day. Fees are based on local charging standards, and medical insurance is reported in accordance with regulations. The difficulty lies in the fact that the old man refuses to admit that he is confused and is unwilling to go.

Income: The British NICE's Dementia Guidelines (NG97) require that when dementia is suspected, first ask about the medical history, ask the person, and ask family members who are familiar with him. We also need to do a physical examination, draw blood and urine to rule out reversible causes, and then do a cognitive test. The guide lists four categories that should be checked first: delirium (sudden bouts of confusion), depression, poor vision and hearing, and heavy burden of anticholinergic drugs. Those who are still suspected of having dementia are excluded and transferred to specialists such as memory clinics for diagnosis. A 2003 meta-analysis compiled 39 studies in which 5,620 people were diagnosed with dementia. Alzheimer's disease accounted for 56.3% and vascular 20.3%. The reasons are likely to be reversed in 9% of cases, and only 0.6% are actually improved: 0.29% are partially improved, and 0.31% are completely improved. The same NICE guidance requires that advance arrangements be discussed with patients and families as early as possible. Things to discuss include authorizing others to manage his health, money, and his wishes for future care. The 2024 action plan of 15 departments including the National Health Commission requires promoting the preliminary screening of cognitive function for people over 65 years old and encouraging hospitals to set up memory clinics
Level of Evidence: B

Source: National Institute for Health and Care Excellence (2018). Dementia: assessment, management and support for people living with dementia and their carers (NG97, recommendations 1.1.12, 1.2.1, 1.2.2, 1.2.6). <https://www.nice.org.uk/guidance/ng97/chapter/Recommendations>; Clarfield AM (2003). The decreasing prevalence of reversible dementias: an updated meta-analysis. Archives of Internal Medicine, 163(18), 2219-2229. <https://doi.org/10.1001/archinte.163.18.2219>; National Health Commission and other 15 departments (2024). National Action Plan to Address Alzheimer’s Dementia (2024-2030). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202501/content_6996231.htm>

Note: The benefits are certain to be small, because very few cases can be reversed after detection, and there is no research to prove that early detection can make people live longer. The reason for giving B is because the troubleshooting method comes from the guide, and the numbers only show the proportion that can be reversed. The studies included in that meta-analysis were as of 2002, and the current rate may be even lower. If the medicine you take is confusing, don't stop taking it on your own. Take the medicine box with you and ask your doctor. It is another thing to become sluggish and unsteady in walking for a few weeks after knocking your head. See Section 13, Item 10 (Get a head CT after knocking your head). Hearing aids for hearing loss, see Section 33, Article 17 (Hearing Aids). While you're still awake, take care of Article 1 (appointing a future guardian in writing) and Article 2 (will). If you can no longer manage your own affairs, you must apply to the court for recognition. See Section 33, Article 18 (Application to the Court for Recognition). The beneficiaries are mainly your parents and grandparents.

Case: Mr. Liu took his mother who often forgot to turn off the fire and made miscalculations when buying groceries to the memory clinic. The effects of sedatives were found out and adjusted, but the memory was still poor. When the mother was awake, she made arrangements for future money management and medical treatment.

sections.title: Is it cost-effective to raise a child?

items.title: First, count what you can receive: the national childcare subsidy is 3,600 yuan per child per year, paid until the age of 3; the special additional personal income tax deduction is 2,000 yuan per child per month
items.core: Children under 3 years old can receive 3,600 yuan per year in childcare subsidies without paying taxes. Those born before 2025 will be calculated based on the remaining months. In addition, from the time the child is born until the end of full-time schooling, each child can deduct 2,000 yuan from his or her parents’ taxable income each month. If one party fully deducts the tax, the tax rate of 3% will be reduced by 720 yuan a year, and the tax rate of 10% will be reduced by 2,400 yuan.
body: Cost: No money. Apply for the subsidy at the place of your child’s registered permanent residence and it will be done in one trip. For personal tax deduction, you can fill it out on the mobile phone "Personal Income Tax" App, or you can give it to the unit to fill in.

Income: The plan issued by the General Office of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China and the General Office of the State Council stipulates that starting from January 1, 2025, subsidies will be provided to infants and young children under 3 years old until they reach 3 years old. The standard is "3,600 yuan per child per year." For those born before January 1, 2025 and less than 3 years old, the calculation will be based on the number of months of subsidy. It is up to one of the child's parents or other guardians to apply. This subsidy is "exempt from personal income tax." When identifying assistance such as subsistence allowances, it "is not included in family or personal income." 3,600 yuan is the "national basic standard", and "the funds required for local bid raising shall be borne by the local finance itself." The plan also stipulates that "governments below the county level shall not issue child care subsidy policies or standards on their own." If the provincial or municipal government wants to introduce other child care subsidy policies or raise standards, it must report them to the higher-level competent authority for filing. On the personal income tax side, the State Council has set up a deduction for care of infants under 3 years old in 2022. In 2023, it will be increased together with the children’s education deduction. From January 1, 2023, it will be 2,000 yuan per child per month. The children’s education deduction covers the period from when a child turns 3 years old to when he or she enters elementary school, and also covers full-time academic education, from elementary school to doctoral degree. Parents "can choose to have one of them deduct 100% of the deduction standard, or they can choose to have both parties deduct 50% of the deduction standard." The choice cannot be changed within one year. Self-calculation example: A child will be deducted 2,000 yuan per year multiplied by 12 months, a total of 24,000 yuan. If one party fully deducts the tax, this person will pay 720 yuan less if the tax rate is in the 3% bracket, and 2,400 yuan less if the tax rate is in the 10% bracket. Each of the two people will deduct half, each deducting 12,000 yuan. The 3% bracket will pay 360 yuan less, and the 10% bracket will pay 1,200 yuan less. The tax rate bracket is calculated based on the annual taxable income: 3% for the amount not exceeding 36,000 yuan, and 10% for the amount exceeding 36,000 yuan to 144,000 yuan
Level of Evidence: A

Source: General Office of the CPC Central Committee, General Office of the State Council (2025). Implementation Plan for the Childcare Subsidy System. <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/2025/issue_12206/202508/content_7035435.html>; State Council (2022). Notice of the State Council on the establishment of special additional deductions for personal income tax on care of infants under 3 years old (Guofa [2022] No. 8, Articles 1 and 2). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2022-03/28/content_5682013.htm>; State Council (2023). Notice of the State Council on increasing the standards for special additional deductions related to personal income tax (Guofa [2023] No. 13, Articles 1, 2, and 5). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202308/content_6901207.htm>; State Council (2018). Interim Measures for Special Additional Deductions for Individual Income Tax (Guofa [2018] No. 41, Articles 5 and 6). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2018-12/22/content_5351181.htm>; State Administration of Taxation (2023). Announcement on the implementation of the policy of increasing the standard of special additional deductions for personal income tax (State Administration of Taxation Announcement No. 14 of 2023, Article 3). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202309/content_6901454.htm>; Standing Committee of the National People's Congress (2018). Personal Income Tax Law of the People's Republic of China (Article 6, Table 1 of Personal Income Tax Rates). <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=2c909fdd678bf17901678bf724bd0609>

Note: This is a unified basic standard across the country. The plan allows governments at the provincial and municipal levels to raise standards or issue additional child care subsidy policies, but governments below the county level cannot issue them on their own. Whether it is available locally and how to get it depends on the province's implementation plan. The total of 10,800 yuan in three years is only a very small part of the cost of raising a child. Don’t use it as the basis for whether or not to have a child. If personal tax deductions are not filled in at ordinary times, they can be made up at the end of the year. See Section 5, Article 2 (Individual Tax Final Calculation). People whose taxable income for the whole year is zero will not pay less even if tax deductions are made. If you cross a different bracket after deductions, the amount you pay less falls between the calculated numbers of the two brackets. If both parents pay taxes, the one with the higher tax rate will deduct the whole amount, so the family pays less and pays more

Case: After Ms. Zhao gave birth to her second child, she applied for an annual child care subsidy of 3,600 yuan in her place of residence, and asked her employer to declare a monthly personal tax deduction of 2,000 yuan per child. According to the 10% tax rate, she paid 2,400 yuan less a year, and the subsidy was also received.

items.title: Maternity leave is 98 days, and maternity allowances are paid by the maternity insurance fund based on the average monthly salary of employees in the previous year; the man's paternity leave and the couple's childcare leave are taken according to provincial regulations
items.core: Maternity leave is at least 98 days for the birth of a child, and in the case of dystocia and multiple births, maternity leave will be paid by the maternity insurance fund during this period. If your employer does not provide you with maternity insurance, it will issue it itself. The man’s paternity leave and the couple’s parental leave are subject to provincial regulations. Beijing provides 15 days of paternity leave and 5 working days of parental leave per year for each child before the child is 3 years old.
body: Cost: No money. The unit will declare it, you don’t have to do it yourself

Benefits: The number of maternity leave days is stipulated by the State Council. "Female employees are entitled to 98 days of maternity leave when giving birth, including 15 days before childbirth; in the case of difficult labor, an additional 15 days of maternity leave; in the case of multiple births, an additional 15 days of maternity leave will be provided for each additional baby." The money received during maternity leave is called maternity allowance. For those who have participated in maternity insurance, "the maternity insurance fund will pay according to the employer's average monthly salary of employees in the previous year." If you are not insured, the employer will pay you according to your salary before maternity leave. The man's paternity leave and the couple's parental leave are stipulated by the population and family planning regulations of each province. Beijing: The woman will receive an additional 60 days of extended maternity leave, and the man will receive an additional 15 days of paternity leave. Before the child reaches 3 years old, the couple "each enjoys five working days of parental leave per year", and their salary cannot be reduced during the leave. Shanghai: The woman is entitled to an additional 60 days of maternity leave, and the male spouse is entitled to 10 days of paternity leave. Before the child reaches 3 years old, "both parties can enjoy five days of parental leave each year", and the salary will be based on normal attendance. Guangdong: The woman is entitled to 80 days of bonus leave and the man is entitled to 15 days of paternity leave. For children under 3 years old, each parent is entitled to 10 days of parental leave per year, and wages will be paid during the leave. Sichuan 2025 version: The woman’s maternity leave is extended to 90 days, and the man’s nursing leave is extended to 30 days. If the child is under 3 years old, the couple will each have 10 working days of parental leave per year, and the leave period will be deemed to be in attendance. In 2024, the General Office of the State Council requires all localities to ensure that "maternity leave, maternity incentive leave, paternity leave, childcare leave and other maternity leave are fully implemented"
Level of Evidence: A

Source: State Council (2012). Special Provisions on Labor Protection of Female Employees (National Decree No. 619, Articles 7 and 8). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2012-05/07/content_6584.htm>; Beijing Municipal People’s Congress Standing Committee (2021). Beijing Population and Family Planning Regulations (amended on November 26, 2021, Article 19). <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=ff8081817d99878a017db82d98345523>; Standing Committee of Shanghai Municipal People’s Congress (2021). Shanghai Population and Family Planning Regulations (Amended on November 25, 2021, Article 31). <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=ff8081817f3b9178017f4f90542e04f4>; Standing Committee of the Guangdong Provincial People’s Congress (2021). Guangdong Provincial Population and Family Planning Regulations (amended on December 1, 2021, Article 30). <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=ff8081817fb1209d017fb5c92e623844>; Standing Committee of the Sichuan Provincial People’s Congress (2025). Sichuan Provincial Population and Family Planning Regulations (announced on November 28, 2025, Article 24). <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=ff8081819aedd63e019b2b65f9852f95>; General Office of the State Council (2024). Several measures on accelerating the improvement of the fertility support policy system and promoting the construction of a fertility-friendly society (Guobanfa [2024] No. 48). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202410/content_6983486.htm>

Note: 98 days is the minimum standard set by the country. The regulations of the above four provinces all add an additional 60 to 90 days of maternity bonus leave, which adds up to 158 to 188 days. How much to add in other provinces depends on the regulations of the province. Which party pays the salary during the incentive leave period varies from province to province. To check the regulations of this province, go to the national laws and regulations database (flk.npc.gov.cn) and search for "province name plus population and family planning regulations" and look at the version marked "valid". Paternity leave is called nursing leave in some provinces, and some parental leave is calculated based on working days and some based on natural days. The number of days in the above four provinces is written according to the regulations as of October 2026, and may be revised in the future.

Case: Ms. Sun gave birth to a child in Beijing, and her employer paid maternity insurance. She took 98 days of maternity leave, and the maternity allowance was based on the unit's average salary in the previous year; her husband took 15 days of paternity leave, and they each took 5 days of parental leave before the child turned three.

items.title: Know this: You are not allowed to reduce your salary or fire you because of pregnancy, childbirth, or breastfeeding
items.core: It is illegal for your employer to reduce your salary or fire you because you are pregnant, have a baby, or breast-feeding. If your child is under one year old, you have 1 hour of breastfeeding time every day. Your employer cannot arrange for you to work overtime or night shifts. Anyone who violates this requirement will be fined 1,000 to 5,000 yuan per person. How the claim goes See Section 19.
body: Cost: No money

Income: The State Council stipulates: "Employers may not reduce wages, dismissal, or terminate labor or employment contracts of female employees due to pregnancy, childbirth, or breastfeeding." During these three periods, the employer cannot reduce your money, nor can it fire you or terminate your contract. Breastfeeding for infants under 1 year old is allowed 1 hour of breastfeeding time every day. The unit is also not allowed to arrange for you to extend your working hours or arrange night shifts. Violations such as working overtime and working night shifts while breastfeeding will result in a fine of not less than 1,000 yuan but not more than 5,000 yuan per person. There are no fines in this provision for salary reduction and dismissal. Those who are illegally dismissed can go to labor arbitration to request reinstatement or compensation
Level of Evidence: A

Source: State Council (2012). Special Provisions on Labor Protection of Female Employees (National Decree No. 619, Articles 5, 9, and 13). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2012-05/07/content_6584.htm>

Remarks: I was really fired illegally. See Section 19 for the compensation path. The focus of evidence collection is written notices of job transfers and salary reductions and chat records. These two things must be kept well

Case: Ms. Wu, who was pregnant, had her salary cut by her employer and was forced to work night shifts. She kept her attendance and salary slips, and complained to the human resources and social security department with a hospital certificate. The company restored her original salary and the night shift arrangement was cancelled.

items.title: The time account for raising children is calculated based on "whose time is taken up", not "whether it is hard or not"
items.core: Convert the number of hours you take care of your children every day and the number of times you are woken up at night into time. Multiply that by the hourly wage of the person doing the work. The calculated amount is generally much greater than the cost of milk powder and diapers. Therefore, it is best to discuss the division of labor before giving birth.
body: Cost: No money, just time. Before the child is 3 years old, he is occupied almost all day. The difficulty is that it happens every day, and you can’t grit your teeth and let it go in a few days

Benefit: Convert the time spent taking care of the children every day and the number of times you are woken up at night into hours. Multiply that by the hourly rate of the person doing the work. The resulting figure is usually much greater than the cost of formula and diapers. Although no one pays for the work of taking care of, cooking, and waking up at night, it is still recorded as a cost. The algorithm is the same as that used to calculate the chores in Section 10. Discuss the division of labor first, and then decide whether to have children or not
Evidence level: C
Source: Author's experience, no direct documentation; see Section 10 for caliber

Remarks: Numbers do not have to be calculated accurately. What is useful is for two people to discuss the division of labor in front of the same table before the birth, so as not to argue again after the birth. If you go back to work after having a baby and your employer transfers your job or reduces your salary, how to express your position is shown in Section 19, Article 23 (Do not agree to the job transfer or salary reduction)

Case: After the child was born, he frequently woke up at night. Mr. Wang calculated the time account based on his wife’s loss of leave and his own hourly wage, and found that she was occupied for more than 60 hours per month. After that, he took over the night feeding regularly, and the division of labor was no longer just about who was more tired.

items.title: The money account is divided into three sections: 0 to 3 years old, compulsory education, and after compulsory education
items.core: The money for 0 to 3 years old is mainly spent on how to take care of the child: by oneself, by the elderly, or by asking someone to take care of the child. From elementary school to junior high school, I mainly spend time on housing and extracurricular activities. From now on, it will mainly be spent on the road to higher education. The three levels of flowers are completely different, and mixing them together will only add up to a scary total.
body: Cost: There is no fixed number of how much it will cost. Different cities and different methods of transportation vary widely. The difficulty is that you have to calm down and calculate the three accounts separately, and you can't take a number based on your feelings

Income: The most important thing for children aged 0 to 3 is the way of care: take care of them by yourself, take care of the elderly, or ask someone to take care of them. The bulk of the compulsory education stage (primary school to junior high school) is housing and extracurricular expenditures. The bulk after this is the path to higher education. Where these three amounts of money are spent are completely different. If you mix them together, you will only get a scary total
Evidence level: C
Source: Author's experience, no direct documentation

Note: First, include the money that you can definitely get, such as childcare subsidies, maternity benefits, and medical insurance reimbursements, and then see how much is left behind. Don't make your decision based on the "how many thousands it costs to raise a child" circulated on the Internet. The caliber of such figures is unclear, and you don't know what it counts and what it omits

Case: Xiao Chen and his wife were originally frightened by the fact that "it costs millions to raise a baby". Later, they listed separately the child care for children from 0 to 3 years old, extracurricular housing for elementary and junior high school students, and further education. They found that the first three years were the most expensive, so they prepared the custody fees first.

items.title: Birth for elders, birth for marriage, and birth for retirement, keep an account for each
items.core: Others want you to have a child, this can be one of your considerations. But the time and money are charged to your own account. "Raising children for old age" needs to be calculated separately, because it is a bet on another person's financial ability and willingness twenty years from now. Also write down the consequences of not giving birth and compare both sides.
body: Cost: No money, all it costs is a serious conversation. The difficulty is to get the words out of the way without going around

Benefit: The idea is the same as in Section 10. The expectations of others can be a consideration for you. But the cost should be recorded in your own account, not theirs. "Raising children for old age" should be calculated separately because it assumes the financial ability and willingness of another person twenty years later
Evidence level: C
Source: author's experience, no direct documentation; see Section 10 for similar analysis
Remarks: Also write down the "consequences of not having children" and compare them with the "consequences of giving birth"

Case: When Ms. Zhou and her husband discussed having a second child, they wrote down their parents' efforts to give birth, the pressure on their marriage, and their pension bets, and then wrote about the consequences of not having a child. After comparison, they found that the finances and care were borne by themselves, and they decided not to have a child first.

items.title: If you plan to have children a few years later, first calculate the woman's age: 40 The chances of getting pregnant naturally before and after the age of 40, and the success rate of in vitro fertilization are both significantly declining
items.core: The older a woman is, the harder it is for her to get pregnant naturally. The chance of getting pregnant every month in her early 40s is only about half of that in her early 30s. The proportion of miscarriages after pregnancy also increases, reaching about one-third between the ages of 40 and 44. There is no way to make up for it through in vitro fertilization. Only about 5% of each embryo transferred at the age of 43 or 44 can give birth to a child.
body: Cost: No money, all it costs is a serious conversation. The difficulty is to put the arrangements for having a baby together with work and buying a house. You can't just push it back

Benefits: Natural pregnancy is based on a follow-up study in the United States, which looked at women aged 30 to 44 who had no history of infertility and were just starting to prepare for pregnancy. Compared with 30 and 31-year-olds, the odds of pregnancy per month were approximately 53% lower for those aged 40 and 41 (odds ratio 0.47, 95% CI 0.28–0.78), and approximately 59% lower for those aged 42 to 44 years (0.39, 0.16–0.93). 38 and 39 years old are about 30% lower (0.70, 0.48–1.01), and the credibility range just touches “no difference”. There is no difference between 32, 33 years old and 30, 31 years old. Women who have never been pregnant are less likely to become pregnant at every age. In a similar study from Denmark, the odds for women aged 35 to 40 were 0.77 compared with those aged 20 to 24. The effect of male age was much smaller, 0.95 for men aged 35 to 39 years. Abortion looks at Norwegian registration data for about 420,000 pregnancies from 2009 to 2013: the proportion of abortions was lowest among those aged 25 to 29, at 9.8%. 10.8% for those 30 to 34 years old, 16.7% for those 35 to 39 years old, 32.2% for those 40 to 44 years old, and 53.6% for those over 45 years old. The chromosomes of the embryos were tested on 15,169 test tube embryos at a fertility center in the United States. Chromosomal abnormalities increase steadily with age from age 26 onwards. Among people aged 26 to 37 who undergo in vitro fertilization, 2% to 6% of the cultured embryos will have chromosomal abnormalities, 33% of those aged 42 and 53% of those aged 44 will have chromosomal abnormalities. The success rate of in vitro fertilization looks at preliminary statistics from the British Fertility Regulatory Agency in 2022. For those who use their own eggs and fresh embryos to transfer, the proportion of children born per embryo transferred: 35% for those aged 18 to 34, 26% for those aged 35 to 37, 18% for those aged 38 or 39, 10% for those aged 40 to 42, and 5% for those aged 43 or 44. Domestic regulations: The Ministry of Health's 2003 "Human Assisted Reproductive Technology Specifications" states that "the implementation of human assisted reproductive technology is prohibited for couples and single women who do not comply with the national population and family planning laws and regulations." The General Office of the State Council requires all localities to include appropriate assisted reproductive technology projects in the scope of medical insurance reimbursement in 2024. The National Medical Insurance Administration said in July 2025 that 31 provinces across the country and the Xinjiang Corps have fully included assisted reproductive technology in reimbursement, and more than 1 million people will enjoy the benefits in 2024
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Steiner AZ, Jukic AM (2016). Impact of female age and nulligravidity on fecundity in an older reproductive age cohort. Fertility and Sterility 105(6):1584-1588. <https://doi.org/10.1016/j.fertnstert.2016.02.028>; Rothman KJ et al (2013). Volitional determinants and age-related decline in fecundability: a general population prospective cohort study in Denmark. Fertility and Sterility 99(7):1958-1964. <https://doi.org/10.1016/j.fertnstert.2013.02.040>; Magnus MC et al (2019). Role of maternal age and pregnancy history in risk of miscarriage: prospective register based study. BMJ 364:l869 (Table 1). <https://doi.org/10.1136/bmj.l869>; Franasiak JM et al. (2014). The nature of aneuploidy with increasing age of the female partner: a review of 15,169 consecutive trophectoderm biopsies evaluated with comprehensive chromosomal screening. Fertility and Sterility 101(3):656-663. <https://doi.org/10.1016/j.fertnstert.2013.11.004>; Human Fertilisation and Embryology Authority (2024). Fertility treatment 2022: preliminary trends and figures. <https://www.hfea.gov.uk/about-us/publications/research-and-data/fertility-treatment-2022-preliminary-trends-and-figures/>; Department of Health (2003). Specifications for Human Assisted Reproductive Technology (Attachment No. 176 of the Ministry of Health and Education [2003], 3. Code of Conduct for Implementing Technical Personnel No. 13). <https://www.nhc.gov.cn/wjw/gfxwj/200309/8da11b0f3edb49cbbe5dea1dc18794a9/files/1733388793099_97897.doc>; General Office of the State Council (2024). Several measures on accelerating the improvement of the maternity support policy system and promoting the construction of a maternity-friendly society (Guobanfa [2024] No. 48). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202410/content_6983486.htm>; State Council Information Office (2025). The State Council Information Office held a press conference on the childcare subsidy system and maternity support measures (the person in charge of the Benefit and Security Department of the National Medical Insurance Administration answered questions). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/202507/content_7034595.htm>

Note: I do not advocate who should be born earlier or later. I only put the age item out and look at it together with the money account in Article 5 and the time account in Article 4. These are averages for a large group of people, and they vary greatly from one individual to another. If you want to know your own situation, go to the reproductive department of the hospital and ask. Single women cannot get assisted reproductive technology in regular domestic hospitals. Which items and amounts are covered by IVF medical insurance vary from province to province, so go to the local medical insurance bureau to ask. When deciding what to do after having a child, start from Section 27, Article 1 (Folic Acid Supplementation)

Case: 38-year-old Ms. Lin focused on her career and postponed childbirth. After one year of pregnancy preparation, she failed. She went to the hospital for a check-up and found that her ovarian function had declined. After three attempts at in vitro fertilization, the doctor admitted that her age had significantly reduced the success rate, and she regretted not planning earlier.

items.title: Overtime pay is calculated in three levels: 1.5 times, 2 times, and 3 times. If you don’t pay, you will complain to the labor inspection. If you don’t pay after the due date, you will have to pay an additional 50% to 100%.
items.core: If you work overtime on a regular basis, you will be paid at 1.5 times your salary. If you work overtime on holidays and you are not allowed to make up for it, you will be paid 2 times the salary. Work rates on statutory holidays such as New Year's Day, Spring Festival, Labor Day, and National Day are tripled, and the law does not include the option of compensatory time off. If the company doesn't give it, they go to the labor inspection department to complain. If you fail to pay after being ordered to pay within a time limit, your employer will have to pay an additional half to one time of the amount owed.
body: Cost: No money. I usually keep a copy of my clock-in records, shift schedules, and overtime approval slips, and I also keep screenshots of news about assignments from leaders in the work group. The difficulty is remembering to save every month.

Benefits: The labor law states that no more than 8 hours per day and no more than 44 hours per week on average. The working time regulations of the State Council further clarify: under the standard working hour system, working hours are 8 hours per day and 40 hours per week. If other working hour systems are implemented with approval, they shall be implemented in accordance with corresponding regulations. Normal overtime work shall generally not exceed 1 hour per day. If you have special reasons to work more, it should not exceed 3 hours a day, and the total number of hours in a month should not exceed 36 hours. Overtime pay is divided into three levels. If you are usually arranged to extend your working hours, you will be paid no less than 150% of your salary. If you are scheduled to work on a rest day but cannot arrange compensatory time off, the rate shall not be less than 200%. If you are scheduled to work on statutory holidays, the rate shall not be less than 300%. For statutory holidays, there is no option in the law to “take compensatory leave”. If the unit arranges overtime work but does not pay overtime pay, the labor administration department will order it to pay the overtime within a time limit. If it fails to pay after the deadline, it will be ordered to pay an additional compensation of not less than 50% but not more than 100% of the amount due to the workers (nationwide) in addition to the arrears. For the legal holidays, see Article 2 of the State Council’s holiday regulations: 1 day for New Year’s Day, 4 days for Spring Festival, 1 day for Qingming Festival, 2 days for Labor Day, 1 day for Dragon Boat Festival, 1 day for Mid-Autumn Festival, and 3 days for National Day. Article 7 of the Holiday Measures allows for "unified holidays and days off" to combine these days and weekends into a longer holiday
Level of Evidence: A

Source: State Council (revised in 1995). State Council's regulations on employee working hours (Articles 3 and 5); Ministry of Labor's implementation measures for the "State Council's regulations on employee working hours" (Articles 3 and 5). <https://www.beijing.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengcefagui/qtwj/201710/t20171009_780941.html>; National People’s Congress Standing Committee (2018). Labor Law (Second Amendment in 2018, Articles 36, 41, 43, and 44). <https://www.samr.gov.cn/zw/zfxxgk/fdzdgknr/bgt/art/2023/art_d9aa750028b14b99a776cb93726a360d.html> (published by the State Administration for Market Regulation); National People’s Congress Standing Committee (2007). Labor Contract Law (Article 85, Item 3). <http://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2007/content_711013.htm>; State Council (2024). National Holidays and Memorial Day Holiday Measures (revised by State Council Order No. 795, effective from January 1, 2025, Articles 2 and 7). <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/2024/issue_11726/202411/content_6989774.html>

Note: Rest days and statutory holidays must be counted separately. The only statutory holidays throughout the year are New Year's Day, Spring Festival, Labor Day, National Day and other statutory holidays. Among the days of consecutive days that do not fall on the holidays listed in the holiday regulations, the consecutive holidays will be calculated as rest days: those who can make up for the leave can be arranged to make up for it, and those who cannot make up for it will be given 200%. This is derived from Article 2 of the Holiday Measures and Article 44 of the Labor Law. "The company requires approval for overtime work" and "I stayed here voluntarily." These two sentences do not mean that the company can withhold payment, but it will make it more difficult for you to provide evidence, so you must keep records of job assignments and approvals. If a company wants to implement two special working time arrangements, the comprehensive calculated working time system and the irregular working time system, it must first obtain approval from the labor administrative department, and it does not have the final say itself. The statute of limitations for arbitration of disputes is set out in Section 8, Article 19.

Case: Programmer Xiao Zhang was arranged to work overtime for 3 days during the National Day holiday, and the company only paid normal wages. He kept the attendance record and complained to the labor inspection. The company was ordered to pay three times the salary and pay an additional 50% compensation for overdue wages.

items.title: Annual leave is calculated based on accumulated service length of 5, 10, or 15 days, and any unused leave will be discounted at 300% of the daily wage
items.core: Annual leave will be given after 12 consecutive months of service, and the service length is calculated based on the sum of all units. There are 5 days per year for 1 year and up to 10 years, 10 days for 10 years and up, and 15 days for 20 years and up. If the unit cannot arrange it and you insist on it, you will be paid three times the daily wage for those days. Once you sign the "Voluntarily Give Up Annual Leave" form, all you have left is your normal salary.
body: Cost: No money. Add up the number of years you have worked in all units, and the social security payment records are proof. It’s difficult not to sign the “voluntary surrender of annual leave” form when the company submits it.

Benefits: Annual leave will be given after working continuously for 12 months. The number of days is determined based on **accumulated** working hours, and the years worked in all units are added up. A period of 1 year but less than 10 years is 5 days; a period of 10 years but less than 20 years is 10 days; a period of 20 years is 15 days. National statutory holidays and rest days are not included in the number of annual leave days. If the employer is unable to arrange the leave due to work needs and has obtained your consent, the employee will be paid annual leave wages at 300% of the employee's daily wage income for the days that should be taken. This 300% already includes the share that should have been given on a normal working day, so the actual extra amount you get is 200%. Daily salary = monthly salary ÷ 21.75. The monthly salary is calculated based on the salary for the 12 months before the payment is made, and the monthly average is calculated after deducting overtime pay. If you just joined the company that year, the calculation will be based on the remaining calendar days in the company. When you leave your job, your salary will be calculated and settled based on how long you have worked in that year. Any excess leave will not be deducted back. If the employer neither arranges time off nor pays the employee, he will be ordered to make corrections within a time limit. If there is no change after the deadline, in addition to the annual leave salary, an additional compensation of the same amount will be paid (nationwide, effective from January 1, 2008)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: State Council (2007). Regulations on Paid Annual Leave for Employees (State Council Order No. 514, Articles 2, 3, 4, 5, and 7). <http://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2008/content_859865.htm>; Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security (2008). Implementation Measures for Paid Annual Leave for Enterprise Employees (Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security Order No. 1, Articles 3, 4, 5, 10, 11, 12, and 15). <http://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2009/content_1265995.htm>

Note: The accumulated working hours must be added up across units. Those who have changed jobs should not be counted according to the length of service in the current unit. **Only if the employee “will not take leave due to his own reasons and submits in writing”, the company can only pay normal salary**, so the form of “voluntarily giving up annual leave” is not signed. If you take personal leave for more than 20 days in total and your employer does not deduct your salary, you will not be entitled to annual leave that year. Those with more than the corresponding number of months of sick leave are not entitled to it: 2 months for those with less than 10 years of service, 3 months for 10 to 20 years of service, and 4 months for those with more than 20 years of service. Family leave, wedding and funeral leave, maternity leave and paid periods of work-related injury are not included in annual leave.

Case: Ms. Wang has a total of 12 years of service. She only took 5 days of annual leave this year. When she resigned, she requested that the untaken 5 days be counted. The company paid compensation at 300% of the daily wage, and she received two months more income than normal work.

items.title: The probation period has a legal upper limit, the salary must not be less than 80%, and it can only be agreed once
items.core: If the contract is signed for more than 3 months but less than 1 year, the probation period can be up to 1 month. The maximum limit is 2 months if the contract is for more than 1 year but less than 3 years, and the maximum is 6 months if the contract is for more than 3 years. The same company can only try you once. It is illegal to transfer you to another position after you become a regular employee. The salary during the probation period cannot be less than 80% of the minimum salary for the same position or the salary agreed in the contract, nor can it be less than the local minimum wage.
body: Cost: No money. Take a few minutes before signing to review the term in the contract and the length of the probation period.

Benefits: If the contract is signed for more than 3 months but less than 1 year, the probation period shall not exceed 1 month. If the contract is for more than 1 year but less than 3 years, it shall not exceed 2 months. Contracts with a term of more than 3 years and indefinite-term contracts with no expiration date shall not exceed 6 months. A probation period is not allowed for contracts that are limited to completing one job, or contracts that are less than three months in total. "The same employer and the same employee can only agree on a probation period once." The same company can only probation the same person once. If the contract only states a probation period, this probation period does not hold, and this period is the labor contract term. The salary during the probation period "should not be lower than the lowest wage for the same position in the unit or 80% of the salary agreed in the labor contract, and shall not be lower than the minimum wage standard in the location of the employer." If the probation period exceeds the statutory length and the person actually performs the work, the unit will have to pay another compensation. Calculate the period beyond your probation based on your monthly salary standard after the probation period expires. If an employer wants to terminate the contract during the probation period, it can only do so under the circumstances listed in the law, and must explain the reasons to the employee (nationwide)
Level of Evidence: A
Source: National People's Congress Standing Committee (2007). Labor Contract Law (Articles 19, 20, 21, and 83). <http://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2007/content_711013.htm>

Remarks: The three most common illegal practices. First, the contract was only for 1 year, but there was a 3-month trial period. The second is to transfer positions after becoming a full-time employee and undergo another probation period. The third is "no social security payment during the probation period."
