Social security obligations are calculated from the first day of work and have nothing to do with whether or not the employee is on probation. The employer's obligations are set out in Section 12, Article 16. Being fired during the probation period does not mean that you will not get a penny. It depends on whether the reasons given by the unit are the ones allowed by law for dismissal. Those who are illegally terminated shall be counted as 2N according to Article 6.

Case: Xiao Li signed a 2-year contract with the company, but was agreed to a 3-month trial period and a 20% discount on salary. He provided the contract and salary slip to the arbitration committee. In the end, the company shortened the probation period and paid the difference, as well as compensation.

items.title: If you are laid off, you will be paid first. N: One month's salary for every full year, half a month for less than six months
items.core: The financial compensation to be given by the company when being laid off is calculated as follows: one month's salary for one year of service, one year for every half year but less than one year, and half a month for less than half a year. The monthly salary here is the average of the 12 months before departure, and bonuses, allowances, and subsidies are all taken into account. If the salary is higher than 3 times the local average monthly salary in the previous year, the salary will be capped at 3 times, and the maximum number of years is 12 years.
body: Cost: No money. Take a calculator and calculate it once, ten minutes.

Income: The legal economic compensation in the labor contract is the amount of money that the employer should pay when you are laid off. People often call it N. The algorithm is: "One month's salary is paid for every full year... If it is more than six months but less than one year, it is calculated as one year; if it is less than six months, half a month's salary is paid to the worker." If the monthly salary is three times higher than the local average monthly salary of employees in the previous year, it will be calculated as three times the cap, and the length of service will only be counted up to twelve years
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress Standing Committee (2007). Labor Contract Law of the People's Republic of China (effective on January 1, 2008) (Article 47). <http://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2007/content_711013.htm>

Note: Monthly salary refers to the average salary in the twelve months before the labor contract is terminated. Bonuses, allowances and subsidies are all included, not just basic salary. This is the easiest point to be underestimated by companies. Whether you need to pay personal income tax on this money, please see Article 18 of this section (Individual Tax on Compensation)

Case: Master Zhang has worked in the factory for 7 years and 4 months, with an average monthly salary of 8,000 yuan. When the factory laid off workers, they were compensated based on 7.5 months' wages. He checked and found that the bonus was not included, so he was given a replacement of 12,000 yuan after arbitration.

items.title: If the company fires you because you are unable to work after illness, incompetence, or the situation has changed drastically, if the company does not give 30 days' notice in advance, you will have to pay an extra month's salary
items.core: If the company fires you because you are unable to work after illness, cannot do the job, or the situation has changed significantly, a 30-day written notice must be given in advance. If there is no notice, an additional month's salary will be given in addition to N, which is often referred to as N+1. When negotiating, list this month separately and don't let the company include it in the N.
body: Cost: No money.

Benefits: The Labor Contract Law stipulates that there are two ways for an employer to terminate the labor contract according to this article. One is to "notify the worker in writing thirty days in advance." The other is that "the labor contract can be terminated after paying an additional month's salary to the employee." If I want you to leave immediately, I have to pay an extra month's salary. This extra month is commonly known as payment in lieu of notice, and is an additional sum in addition to N. This month is calculated based on your salary in the previous month, and N is calculated based on the average salary in the 12 months before resignation. The two bases are different
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress Standing Committee (2007). Labor Contract Law of the People's Republic of China (effective on January 1, 2008) (Articles 36, 39, 40, 41, 46, 47, 87). <http://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2007/content_711013.htm>; State Council (2008). Article 20 of the Implementation Regulations of the Labor Contract Law (State Council Order No. 535): "If an employer chooses to pay an additional month's salary to the employee to terminate the labor contract in accordance with the provisions of Article 40 of the Labor Contract Law, the additional salary paid shall be determined based on the employee's salary standard for the previous month." <http://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2008/content_1107604.htm>

Note: This month only appears in the three situations in Article 40 of the Labor Contract Law. Those who are sick or injured not due to work will not be able to do their original work after the medical treatment period expires, nor will they be able to do other work arranged. Those who cannot do their job will still be unable to do it after training or transfer. The objective situation at the time of signing the contract has changed significantly and the parties cannot reach an agreement through negotiation. There is no other situation like this month. Economic layoffs (Article 41) only require the company to explain the situation to the union or all employees 30 days in advance. If the company proposes to terminate the contract through negotiation between the two parties, N will be given. If you commit serious disciplinary violations, you will be fired without compensation. The company illegally terminated the company and gave 2N. For those belonging to the three categories in Article 40, calculate N and 1 separately during negotiations, and do not let the company include the extra month in N

Case: Mr. Chen was fired due to the company's business adjustment, and the company only gave N compensation without prior notice. He argued the terms of the labor contract law, and finally the company paid an extra month's salary in lieu of notice.

items.title: If the company terminates the contract illegally, the compensation shall be twice the economic compensation standard
items.core: If the company terminates the contract illegally, the compensation shall be doubled according to the economic compensation standard, which is often referred to as 2N. Whether it is an illegal termination depends on the specific circumstances. Find legal aid or a lawyer to find out first, and then decide whether to talk to the company or go to arbitration.
body: Cost: No money. It takes several months to go to arbitration. The difficulty lies in the fact that you have to keep following the process over the past few months and not give up midway.

Benefits: The Labor Contract Law stipulates that if the employer violates the provisions of this law to terminate or terminate the labor contract, it "shall pay compensation to the employee in accordance with twice the economic compensation standard stipulated in Article 47 of this law." The algorithm is to first calculate one share according to the standard of economic compensation, and then double it for you
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Standing Committee of the National People's Congress (2007). Labor Contract Law of the People's Republic of China (effective on January 1, 2008) (Article 87). <http://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2007/content_711013.htm>

Remarks: This is commonly known as 2N. What constitutes an illegal discharge depends on the specific circumstances. Consult legal aid or a lawyer first, and then decide whether to negotiate or go to arbitration. See Section 7 for the path.

Case: Ms. Zhao, who was 7 months pregnant, was fired by the company on the grounds of "incompetence". After consulting a lawyer, she applied for arbitration and it was determined that the company had illegally terminated the company. She eventually received 2N compensation in total of 160,000 yuan.

items.title: Don't sign "Voluntary Resignation for Personal Reasons", that sign will not have an N.
items.core: Sign to acknowledge "Voluntary Resignation for Personal Reasons." Economic compensation and unemployment insurance benefits are usually lost together. If you propose to resign yourself, you will not be compensated under any of the circumstances, except for the company's faults such as wage arrears and failure to pay social security. There is no need to sign on the same day, just calm down overnight.
body: Cost: No money. The difficulty is to withstand the pressure of signing on the spot.

Benefits: The Labor Contract Law limits the circumstances in which financial compensation should be given to those categories listed in the law. If the workers themselves propose to leave, they are not included, unless it is due to legal faults such as wage arrears and non-payment of social security by the company. After signing a "voluntary resignation", economic compensation and unemployment insurance benefits are usually lost together
Level of Evidence: B

Source: National People's Congress Standing Committee (2007). Labor Contract Law of the People's Republic of China (effective on January 1, 2008) (Articles 38, 46). <http://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2007/content_711013.htm>

Note: A common saying used by companies is "Sign first to go through the process, and the compensation will be paid separately." The agreement must be written on the spot, otherwise it will not be signed. There will be no legal consequences if you don't sign on the day. Let's calm down for a night.

Case: The department supervisor forced Mr. Sun to sign a "resignation for personal reasons" document. He went home and checked the legal regulations and refused to sign. The company finally canceled the payment of N+3 compensation according to negotiation, and he maintained his eligibility to apply for unemployment benefits.

items.title: Save salary slips, attendance, labor contracts, social security records and chat records before resigning
items.core: Disputes such as dismissal and wage deduction are subject to proof by the unit, but overtime requires you to prove it first, and the unit's salary records only need to be kept for two years. Once the computer and account are handed back, these materials will no longer be available. You have salary slips, attendance records, social security records and original chat records in your hand. Only when the unit refuses to accept the account will you have something to take away.
body: Cost: No money. Spend half an hour stocking up on materials. Remember to save before leaving.

Benefits: Once your computer and account are returned, these materials will no longer be available. Labor disputes are based on the principle of "whoever makes the claim must provide evidence": you need to provide evidence for the matter you raise. If the evidence is in the hands of the unit, the unit must produce it. If it does not, the unit will bear the adverse consequences. If you cannot get the materials in the hands of the employer during the arbitration, the arbitration tribunal can require the employer to hand them over within a limited time. In disputes over dismissal, dismissal, contract termination, salary reduction, and calculation of working years, the employer bears the burden of proof. Overtime pay is different. You must first prove that you have actually worked overtime. If you can prove that the overtime records are in the hands of the employer and the employer fails to hand them over, the employer will bear the adverse consequences. Units are only obliged to keep wage payment records for more than two years. When paying wages, the unit will also give you a personal salary list. When you do not sign a written contract, salary payment records, social security payment records, and work certificates can all be used to prove that you have a labor relationship with your unit. Recruitment registration forms, attendance records, and testimonials from other employees can also be used. Chat records are legally considered electronic data and can be used as evidence. Originals must be submitted when submitting evidence, and those printed directly from the original records are also considered originals. The Shanghai Procuratorate handled a case. A worker asked for the difference in minimum wage for ten years, but the first and second trials only recognized the last two years before leaving his job. The court reasoned that units only need to keep records for two years, and for the first eight years workers are required to provide evidence on their own. He had ten years of salary slips and bank statements in his hand, but his employer did not recognize the salary slips as genuine. In August 2024, he applied for prosecutorial supervision. After the procuratorate protested, the employer paid 19,000 yuan through mediation. He sued when the company laid off employees in 2021, and it has been about three years since he applied for supervision (nationwide)
Level of Evidence: B

Source: National People's Congress Standing Committee (2007). Labor Dispute Mediation and Arbitration Law (Articles 6 and 39). <https://rsj.ankang.gov.cn/Content-2150407.html> (Reprinted by Ankang Human Resources and Social Security Bureau); Supreme People's Court (2020). Interpretation on the applicable legal issues in the trial of labor dispute cases (1) (Fa Interpretation [2019] No. 26, Articles 42 and 44). <https://www.court.gov.cn/fabu/xiangqing/282121.html>; Supreme People’s Court (2019). Several provisions on evidence in civil litigation (Fa Interpretation [2019] No. 19, Articles 14 and 15). <https://www.court.gov.cn/zixun/xiangqing/212721.html>; Ministry of Labor (1994). Interim Provisions on Wage Payment (Article 6), quoted in "Policy Help You Ask" of Heilongjiang Provincial People's Government. <https://www.hlj.gov.cn/hlj/c116413/202402/c00_31712524.shtml>; Ministry of Labor and Social Security (2005). Notice on matters related to the establishment of labor relations (Ministry of Labor and Social Security [2005] No. 12), cited in the "Policy Help You Ask" of the Heilongjiang Provincial People's Government. <https://hlj.gov.cn/hlj/c116413/202408/c00_31757488.shtml>; Guo Yonghui, Bian Wanru (2025). Who should bear the burden of proving wages paid beyond two years? Procuratorate Daily. <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/llyj/202508/t20250806_703164.shtml> (published on the website of the Supreme People’s Procuratorate); see Section 7 for the rights protection path

Note: What is saved is your own labor relations materials. Do not take away the company's source code, customer list, and technical documents. Please see Section 11 for the risks of taking them away. Don’t just take screenshots of chat history, keep the original records on your phone and don’t delete them. It is best to save salary slips and bank statements every month. You can settle old accounts after leaving your job for many years. The unit no longer needs to keep records from two years ago. The case in Shanghai could be overturned only by the procuratorate's protest, but most people would not be able to get to this point. When leaving, you must ask your employer for a certificate of resignation. See Article 17 (Certificate of Resignation) in this section.

Case: When Ms. Zhou was fired, the company denied the fact that she had worked overtime all year round. She took out the saved attendance records and screenshots of overtime approval chats. The arbitration committee accepted the evidence and sentenced the company to pay overtime pay of 28,000 yuan.

items.title: Before entering a position with dust, noise, or chemicals, check whether hazards are mentioned in the contract; three occupational health examinations will be arranged and paid for by the employer
items.core: When signing a contract, the employer must truthfully write down in the contract the occupational hazards of the position, how to protect them, and the benefits provided. If I keep it secret from you, you can refuse to do this job, but your employer cannot fire you because of it. Three occupational health examinations before taking up the job, while on the job and when leaving the job shall be arranged and paid for by the unit. If you fail to undergo an off-duty physical examination, your employer cannot terminate your contract.
body: Cost: No money. When signing the contract, read the "Notification of Occupational Disease Hazards" section one by one. Keep a copy of each physical examination report for yourself. The difficulty lies in asking questions in person and getting the materials in person.

Benefits: The Occupational Disease Prevention and Control Law stipulates that when signing a labor contract, the unit must make four things clear. These four things are: what occupational hazards may arise from doing this job, what consequences will there be, how to protect yourself, and what kind of benefits will you receive. The original text of the law is "Inform workers truthfully and state it in the labor contract, and no concealment or deception is allowed." After the contract is signed, if you are assigned to do harmful tasks that are not specified in the contract, you must be told the truth again and discuss changing the terms of the contract with you. If the employer fails to do so, "employers have the right to refuse to engage in operations that involve occupational disease hazards, and the employer shall not terminate the labor contract with the employee because of this." There are three physical examinations in total: before starting work, during work, and when leaving work. "The cost of the occupational health examination shall be borne by the employer." The money will be paid by the employer, and the results must be reported to you in writing. For those who have not undergone a pre-job physical examination, the unit shall not assign them to work that exposes them to occupational hazards. People whose physical condition is not suitable for this type of work (those with occupational taboos) are not allowed to do these taboo jobs. If health damage related to this job is found, the person will be removed from the original position and properly placed. **"The labor contract concluded with an employee who has not undergone a pre-departure occupational health examination shall not be terminated or terminated"**. When you leave your job, you "have the right to request a copy of your occupational health surveillance file, and the employer shall provide it truthfully and free of charge, and sign the copy provided." The unit must faithfully make a copy of this occupational health surveillance file for you free of charge, and stamp the copy (nationwide)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress Standing Committee (2018). Occupational Disease Prevention and Control Law (amended in 2018, Articles 33, 35, and 36). <https://www.beijing.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengcefagui/qtwj/201711/t20171104_779851.html> (Reprinted by the Beijing Municipal People's Government)

Note: You can roughly judge whether the company is legitimate or not by asking three questions during the interview: whether there are occupational hazards in this position, whether it is written in the contract, and who pays for the pre-job physical examination. If you can't answer or say "do it first and then talk", you have to weigh the risk yourself. The off-duty physical examination is most easily ignored: if you don’t do the off-duty physical examination, the employer cannot terminate or terminate the labor contract with you. This physical examination is also a key material for applying for occupational disease diagnosis in the future. The same is true for the copy of the file, so you must get it before leaving. Occupational diseases themselves are treated as work-related injuries, and the benefits are as set out in Article 11 onwards.

Case: When Mr. Wu applied for a spray painting job, the contract did not indicate chemical hazards. He developed dizziness after taking up the job and was found to be poisoned by benzene. The company was ordered to bear all medical expenses and pay for off-duty physical examinations.

items.title: Many damages caused by dust, noise, and chemical poisons are irreversible (such as pneumoconiosis, noise deafness): protective equipment must be provided by the unit, and jobs without protective measures can be refused
items.core: Pneumoconiosis, noise deafness, and chemical eye burns are legal occupational diseases. If the lungs and hearing are damaged, they cannot be cured. You have the right to know the hazards of your job, and you have the right to ask your employer to provide protective facilities and supplies. You don't have to do any work without protection. If your employer cuts your salary or fires you because of this, it won't count.
body: Cost: No money. The difficulty lies in having to wear anti-particulate masks, earplugs, and goggles all the time, and also refusing to work without protection, at the cost of being said by colleagues that "there is too much to do."

Benefits: From August 1, 2025, the number of statutory occupational diseases will be 135 in 12 categories, including 4 open clauses. The first category is occupational pneumoconiosis. There are silicosis, coal workers' pneumoconiosis, graphite pneumoconiosis, carbon black pneumoconiosis, asbestosis, and talc pneumoconiosis. There is also cement pneumoconiosis, mica pneumoconiosis, potter's pneumoconiosis, aluminum pneumoconiosis, welder's pneumoconiosis, caster's pneumoconiosis, plus an open clause. Occupational ear, nose, throat and oral diseases include noise deafness and blast deafness. Occupational eye diseases include chemical eye burns and electrooptic ophthalmia. The damage from pneumoconiosis and noise deafness is permanent. The National Institute for Occupational Safety and Health (NIOSH) says silicosis is permanent lung damage that gets progressively worse and has no known cure. A Lancet review said that after patients are no longer exposed to dust, lung function will still worsen as the disease progresses. The U.S. Occupational Safety and Health Administration (OSHA) says that hearing loss caused by noise is permanent and cannot be corrected by surgery or medication. The law gives four rights that can be moved out on the spot. The first is to know what occupational hazards exist in this workplace, what consequences they will cause, and what protective measures should be taken. The second is to require units to provide qualified protective facilities and personal protective equipment and improve working conditions. The third is to criticize, report and accuse practices that violate laws and regulations on the prevention and control of occupational diseases, as well as practices that endanger life and health. The fourth is to "refuse illegal instructions and forced operations without occupational disease protection measures." You don't have to do illegal instructions and work without protective measures. And "any action that reduces wages, benefits and other benefits or terminates or terminates the labor contract concluded with an employee because he or she exercises legitimate rights in accordance with the law shall be invalid." Cutting your salary, reducing your benefits, or firing you because you have used these rights will not count (nationwide)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National Health Commission, Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security, National Bureau of Disease Control and Prevention, All-China Federation of Trade Unions (2024). Classification and Catalog of Occupational Diseases (implemented from August 1, 2025). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202412/content_6992843.htm>; The new version of the catalog has 135 categories in 12 categories, see the National Health Commission (2024). The new catalog adjusts occupational diseases to 12 categories and 135 categories. <https://www.gov.cn/lianbo/bumen/202412/content_6992838.htm>; Standing Committee of the National People’s Congress (2018). Law on the Prevention and Control of Occupational Diseases (Article 39). <https://www.beijing.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengcefagui/qtwj/201711/t20171104_779851.html> (Reprinted by Beijing Municipal People's Government); National Institute for Occupational Safety and Health (2026). Silica Symptoms and Medical Monitoring: "permanent lung damage called silicosis. It is a progressive, debilitating, and sometimes disease" "There is no known cure for silicosis". <https://www.cdc.gov/niosh/silica/symptoms/index.html>; Leung CC, Yu IT, Chen W (2012). Silicosis. Lancet, 379(9830), 2008-2018: "Impairment of lung function increases with disease progression, even after the patient is no longer exposed". <https://doi.org/10.1016/S0140-6736(12)60235-9>; Occupational Safety and Health Administration. Occupational Noise Exposure: "permanent hearing loss that cannot be corrected through surgery or with medicine". <https://www.osha.gov/noise>

Note: Masks must be recognized correctly, and particulate masks must be worn in dusty positions. This is the author's experience. The noise workplace does not issue earplugs, so I buy them myself. They only cost a few yuan a pair. If you lose your hearing, you cannot replace them. "Work for two years and save enough money and leave" is not true in pneumoconiosis. Silicosis will continue to worsen after no longer being exposed to dust. Therefore, off-duty physical examination is particularly important (see Article 9, three occupational health examinations are arranged and paid for by the employer). The new version of the catalog also adds two new categories. One category is occupational musculoskeletal diseases, including carpal tunnel syndrome, which is limited to manufacturing workers who repeatedly use their wrists or work hard for a long time. The other category is occupational mental and behavioral disorders, including post-traumatic stress disorder. It is limited to people's police, medical and health personnel, fire rescue and other emergency rescue personnel involved in emergency response. See Section 13.21 for on-site treatment of chemical spills. How to treat post-traumatic stress disorder, see Section 29, Item 14 (Trauma-focused psychotherapy).

Case: Stone factory worker Lao Zheng found that the dust concentration in the workshop exceeded the standard but there was no protective equipment. He refused to work and reported it to the safety supervision department. The company was ordered to stop work for rectification and reissue protective equipment. Lao Zheng's hearing was not damaged.

items.title: If you are injured at work or you are hit on the way to and from get off work, the first thing you need to do is to identify the work-related injury. If your employer does not report it, you should report it yourself
items.core: Injury caused by work while at work is considered a work-related injury. If you are hit on the way to and from get off work and the main responsibility is not yours, it will also be counted. However, without identification of work-related injuries, medical expenses, wages paid during the period of recuperation, and disability benefits will all be lost. Units should declare within 30 days. If the unit does not report it, you, your family members, or the trade union can report it yourself to the social security administrative department within one year.
body: Cost: No money, just a trip to the social security administration department. You need to bring three materials: work injury identification application form, labor relationship certificate, and medical diagnosis certificate.

Income: Without identification of work-related injuries, medical expenses, wages paid during the period of recuperation (salary during the layoff period), and disability benefits are all lost. If the unit fails to declare for more than 30 days, the work-related injury benefits that should be paid during this period shall be paid by the unit itself
Level of Evidence: A

Source: State Council (revised in 2010). Work-related Injury Insurance Regulations (State Council Decree No. 586 No.) Article 14 lists seven types of "work-related injuries that should be recognized as work-related injuries", including "(6) Injured by traffic accidents or urban rail transit, passenger ferry, or train accidents that are not the main responsibility of the individual on the way to and from get off work"; Article 17 "The employer shall within 30 days from the date of the accident injury or the date of being diagnosed or identified as an occupational disease. , submit an application for work-related injury identification to the coordinating regional social insurance administrative department. ""If the employer fails to submit an application for work-related injury identification in accordance with the provisions of the preceding paragraph, the work-injured employee or his close relatives or trade union organizations may, within 1 year from the date of the accident injury or the date of being diagnosed or identified as an occupational disease, directly apply to the coordinating regional social insurance agency where the employer is located. The government department submits an application for work-related injury identification. ""The employer fails to submit an application for work-related injury identification within the time limit specified in the first paragraph of this article. During this period, the employer shall bear the relevant expenses such as work-related injury benefits that comply with the provisions of these regulations." Bear the burden of proof"; Article 20 "A decision on work-related injury identification shall be made within 60 days from the date of acceptance of the application for work-related injury identification"; Article 55, "Those who are not satisfied with the decision not to accept the application for work-related injury identification" or "are dissatisfied with the conclusion of work-related injury identification", "may apply for administrative reconsideration in accordance with the law, or may file an administrative lawsuit with the People's Court in accordance with the law." <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2011/content_1778064.htm>; Supreme People's Court (2014). Provisions on Several Issues Concerning the Trial of Administrative Cases on Work-related Injury Insurance (Legal Interpretation [2014] 9 No.) Article 7: "If the application period for work-related injury identification is exceeded due to reasons that do not belong to the employee or his close relatives, the delayed time will not be counted in the application period for work-related injury identification." The listed situations are "(1) Force majeure; (2) Restriction of personal freedom; (3) Reasons attributed to the employer; (4) The registration system of the social insurance administrative department is imperfect; (5) The parties apply for arbitration or initiate civil litigation as to whether there is a labor relationship." <https://www.court.gov.cn/fabu/xiangqing/6775.html>

Note: Take it seriously in 1 year, don’t delay. However, time delayed due to no fault of your own will not be counted in one year. There are five types of reasons: force majeure, restriction of personal freedom, reasons attributable to the employer, and imperfect registration system of the social security department. The fifth method is to apply for arbitration or litigate to confirm the labor relationship. Therefore, if the employer delays the application or delays the application until it is overdue, you can still apply and bring the evidence of the employer's delay. If the social security department refuses to accept the application, or if you are dissatisfied with the conclusion, you can apply for administrative review or file a lawsuit directly. If the employer says it is not considered a work-related injury, the employer must prove it. But you should also keep materials for yourself: photos of the day of the accident, contact information of colleagues, medical records, and attendance. Article 16 of the regulations lists three situations of non-recognition: intentional crime, drunkenness or drug abuse, self-mutilation or suicide. Article 15: There is another "deemed work-related injury": death due to sudden illness during working hours and at the workplace, or death within 48 hours after rescue efforts failed.

Case: Delivery boy Xiao Liu was hit and fractured while delivering food on a rainy day, and the traffic police determined that he was fully responsible. The company delayed declaring a work-related injury, so he collected the accident certification and medical records to apply for certification, and was eventually compensated for medical expenses and disability benefits.

items.title: Don’t believe that “it’s considered a work-related injury if you stay at work”: if you feel unwell, call 120 first, instead of rushing to check in
items.core: Rushing to the company if you feel unwell may not necessarily allow you to get more money. To be regarded as a work-related injury, it requires that the person becomes ill during working hours and at his or her job. Those who become ill on the road and fail to report to work are not considered to be injured in the first place. Rescue operations lasting more than 48 hours will not be counted. If you delay medical treatment in order to make ends meet, your chances of survival will be reduced.
body: Cost: No money.

Benefits: It is deemed that the claimant died of a sudden illness "during working hours and at the workplace", or died within 48 hours after rescue failed. If you delay medical treatment in order to meet these two conditions, you will be compensated for your chance of survival, and the compensation in exchange may not be obtained
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Article 15, Paragraph 1, Item (1) of the Work Injury Insurance Regulations: "During working hours and at work, death from sudden illness or death at 48 "Those who die within hours after resuscitation fails" are deemed to be work-related injuries; Article 14 (6) only classifies "those who are injured by traffic accidents or urban rail transit, passenger ferries, or train accidents that are not the main responsibility of the person" on the way to and from get off work as work-related injuries, and sudden illness on the way is not included. <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2011/content_1778064.htm>

Note: Two conditions must be met at the same time: during working hours and at work. It does not apply to those who fell ill on the road and did not arrive at work. If you are sent home or to the hospital after getting sick on the job and die within 48 hours after resuscitation fails, it may still be applicable. What matters is where the person was when he got sick, not where he died in the end. The short video talks about this as "you will make money as long as you support the company", which is exactly the opposite direction. What can change the outcome is whether you go to the hospital within a few dozen minutes after the onset of the disease. The other 48 hours is a hard line, and rescue operations exceeding 48 hours are not counted.

Case: A 42-year-old programmer suddenly felt chest tightness at home. He forced himself to drive and rushed to the company to check in for a work-related injury. As a result, he fainted at the intersection. Passersby called 120 to send him to the hospital. Although he was rescued, the doctor said that the best time for treatment was delayed.

items.title: If your employer does not pay you work-related injury insurance, you will still receive work-related injury benefits, and the company will pay you in full according to the same standards.
items.core: If your company does not pay you work-related injury insurance, you will still receive work-related injury benefits. It's just that the employer will pay the full amount according to the same items and standards, no penny less. Failure to participate in insurance will impose penalties on the unit: it will be ordered to pay back, a late payment fee of 0.05% will be charged on a daily basis, and a fine of 1 to 3 times the amount of overdue payment will be imposed if it is overdue. "The company did not purchase work-related injury insurance, so it cannot compensate" is a lie.
body: Cost: No money. If the employer refuses to accept the claim, they will have to go to arbitration or even file a lawsuit, which will take a few months to start. The difficulty is that we have to keep up with it in these few months.

Income: The regulations clearly state that if a unit does not provide its employees with work-related injury insurance, if an employee is injured at work, the unit will pay the money according to the items and standards stipulated in the regulations. Which payments should be made and how much each payment should be made are exactly the same as those who have paid for the insurance, except that the unit pays it out of its own pocket
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Paragraph 2 of Article 62 of the Work Injury Insurance Regulations: “If an employee of an employer who is required to participate in work injury insurance in accordance with the provisions of these regulations but has not participated in work injury insurance is injured at work, the employee shall be responsible for the work injury insurance. The employer shall pay fees in accordance with the work-related injury insurance benefit items and standards stipulated in these Regulations. Paragraph 1 of the same article: Order to participate and make additional payments within a time limit. "A late payment fee of 0.05% will be charged on a daily basis from the date of default. If payment is still not made within the time limit, a fine of not less than 1 time but not more than 3 times of the overdue amount will be imposed." <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2011/content_1778064.htm>

Note: "The company did not buy you work-related injury insurance, so it cannot compensate you" is the most common lie in this kind of thing. If you are not insured, your employer will impose additional penalties, and your benefits will not be reduced.

Case: Xiao Li, a factory operator, injured his right hand with a machine. The company failed to pay work-related injury insurance and refused to compensate. Xiao Li applied for labor arbitration, and it was ruled that the employer should pay full medical expenses and disability subsidies totaling 280,000 yuan based on work-related injury standards. The employer was also required to pay late fees.

items.title: After the injury is stable, go for a labor ability appraisal, and the disability level will be directly converted into money
items.core: After the injury is stable, go for a labor ability appraisal, and the disability level will be directly converted into money. The one-time disability benefit is calculated based on the individual's salary, and is 18 months for Level 5, 16 months for Level 6, and 13 months for Level 7. 11 months for Level 8, 9 months for Level 9, and 7 months for Level 10. Don’t sign a “one-time settlement” agreement before the appraisal results come out.
body: Cost: No money. You have to wait for a while to go through the process of labor ability appraisal.

Benefit: The one-time disability benefit is converted into several months' salary according to the disability level and is paid in one lump sum. The personal salary is 18 months for Level 5, 16 months for Level 6, and 13 months for Level 7. My salary for Level 8: 11 months, Level 9: 9 months, Level 10: 7 months
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Work-related Injury Insurance Regulations Article 21 "If the injury is relatively stable after treatment and the disability remains, affecting the ability to work, a work ability appraisal shall be carried out"; Article 22 "Labor dysfunction is divided into ten disability levels, the most severe is Level 1, and the lightest is Level 10"; Article 36 Level 5 and Level 6 benefits (one-time disability subsidy 18/16 Months of personal salary, retaining the labor relationship, and the unit will arrange appropriate work; if it is difficult to arrange work, the unit will pay 70%/60% of the personal salary as disability allowance on a monthly basis); Article 37 seventh to tenth grade treatment (13/11/9/7 months of personal salary). <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2011/content_1778064.htm>

Note: Levels 5 and 6 retain labor relations, and appropriate work arrangements will be made by the unit. If it is difficult to arrange work, the employer will provide disability allowance on a monthly basis. For people at levels seven to ten, when the contract expires or they request to terminate it, they will receive two additional sums of money. The one-time work-related injury medical subsidy is provided by the fund, and the one-time disability employment subsidy is provided by the unit, and the amount is determined by the province. Don’t sign a “one-time settlement” agreement before the appraisal results come out. Assistive devices such as prostheses and wheelchairs due to work-related injuries must first be confirmed by the Work Capacity Appraisal Committee, see Section 33, Article 7 (go to the county-level Disabled Persons' Federation for inquiries).

Case: Lao Zhang, a construction worker, suffered a broken toe. After the injury stabilized, he was diagnosed with a ninth-level disability. Based on the appraisal conclusion, he claimed for compensation from his employer and received a one-time disability subsidy of 9 months' salary totaling 63,000 yuan. Since he signed a compensation agreement, he did not make any additional claims.

items.title: Three types of payments for work-related deaths should be distinguished: funeral benefits, dependent relatives’ pensions, and one-time work-related death benefits
items.core: Deaths due to work-related deaths are three payments, don’t just talk about one of them. The funeral subsidy is 6 months' average monthly salary of local employees in the previous year. The dependent relative pension is paid monthly based on the salary of the deceased, 40% per month for the spouse, and 30% per month for each other relative. The one-time work-related death benefit is 20 times the per capita disposable income of urban residents nationwide in the previous year, the only amount in the country.
body: Cost: No money, just go through a set of procedures.

Income: The money for death due to work is divided into three payments. The first payment is the funeral subsidy, the amount is 6 months’ average monthly salary of employees in the previous year in the insured area (coordinating area). The second payment is a dependent relative pension, which is paid monthly based on the salary of the deceased, 40% per month for the spouse, and 30% per month for each other relative. The third payment is a one-time work-related death benefit, the amount of which is 20 times the per capita disposable income of urban residents nationwide in the previous year. There is only this number in the whole country, regardless of region. For work-related deaths in 2026, the amount will be approximately 1.13 million yuan (accurately 1,130,040 yuan). The algorithm is the national per capita disposable income of urban residents of 56,502 yuan in the previous year multiplied by 20.
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Article 39 of the Work Injury Insurance Regulations: "(1) The funeral subsidy shall be the average monthly salary of employees in the previous year in the coordinating area for 6 months; (2) The dependent relatives' pension shall be paid in accordance with a certain proportion of the employee's own salary. The employee who died on the job provided the main source of livelihood during his lifetime and was unable to work. The standard is: 40% per month for spouses, 30% per month for each other relative, and an additional 10% per month for the elderly or orphans. (3) The one-time work-related death benefit standard is 20 times the per capita disposable income of urban residents in the previous year. <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2011/content_1778064.htm>; National Bureau of Statistics (2026). Residents’ income and consumption expenditure in 2025. <https://www.stats.gov.cn/sj/zxfbhjd/202601/t20260119_1962321.html>

Note: The one-time work-related death benefit is unified across the country, and the amount is updated every year with the data released by the National Bureau of Statistics. When discussing compensation, we do not accept the argument that "the standards here are low".

Case: Xiao Chen, a courier, died in a car accident while delivering food. His family applied for recognition of work-related death. In addition to the funeral subsidy, he also received monthly dependent relatives' pension and a one-time work-related death subsidy of 985,000 yuan, totaling more than one million yuan.

items.title: If you have been bullied, insulted, or made things difficult for a long time in your workplace, don’t take it hard: write down the evidence first, and then file a complaint, call the police, or arbitrate according to the nature
items.core: People who are bullied in the workplace have about a 60% higher risk of heart disease or stroke later on. The more they are bullied, the higher the risk. People who are bullied are also more likely to have suicidal thoughts years later.
body: Cost: No money. Take time to record: date, people present, the other party’s original words, and keep screenshots of the chat and original emails. It can take several months to go through arbitration and litigate. Changing jobs is the most expensive, and it’s up to you to decide whether to leave or not.

Benefits: Health, three cohorts in Sweden and Denmark combined, 79,201 working adults aged 18 to 65 years. None of them had cardiovascular disease initially and were followed for an average of 12.4 years. 9% said they had been bullied at work in the past year. The risk of cardiovascular disease (coronary heart disease and cerebrovascular disease) was approximately 59% higher in those who were bullied (hazard ratio HR 1.59, 95% CI 1.28–1.98). The risk was approximately 25% higher among those who experienced violence in the workplace (hazard ratio HR 1.25, 1.12–1.40). In both cases, the more encounters, the higher the risk. A nationwide random sample follow-up survey in Norway included 1,846 employed people, who were tested three times every two to three years. Those who were bullied were more likely to have suicidal thoughts later on, compared with others, odds ratio OR 2.05, 95% CI 1.08–3.89. Conversely, people who had suicidal thoughts first were not more likely to be bullied later. Legally speaking, there is no law specifically governing "workplace bullying" in our country, and it must be dealt with according to specific behaviors. If a unit insults, corporally punishes, beats, illegally searches or detains workers, it will be subject to administrative penalties, compensation for damage caused, and criminal liability if a crime is constituted. If your employer uses violence or threats to force you to work, you can terminate the contract immediately without prior notice, and you can also receive financial compensation. Units must take measures to prevent and stop people who take advantage of their authority and superior-subordinate relationships to commit sexual harassment. Victims can demand civil liability from the harasser. Labor arbitration cases will be concluded within 45 days from the date of acceptance. For complex cases, the case may be extended for up to 15 days.
Level of Evidence: B

Source: Xu T et al (2019). Workplace bullying and workplace violence as risk factors for cardiovascular disease: a multi-cohort study. European Heart Journal. Study. American Journal of Public Health. <https://doi.org/10.2105/AJPH.2015.302855>; National People's Congress Standing Committee (2007). Labor Contract Law (Article 38, Paragraph 2, Article 46, Article 88). <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2007/content_711013.htm>; National People's Congress (2020). Civil Code (Article 1010). Full text reprinted by the Supreme People's Procuratorate <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202006/t20200602_463888.shtml>; National People's Congress Standing Committee (revised in 2022). Law on the Protection of Women's Rights and Interests (Article 25). <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=ff808181841257210184281512de0eec>; Standing Committee of the National People's Congress (2007). Labor Dispute Mediation and Arbitration Law (Article 43). Full text reproduced by Ankang Municipal Human Resources and Social Security Bureau <https://rsj.ankang.gov.cn/Content-2150407.html>

Remarks: Reason for setting B: The health figures come from tracking records, not group experiments. "Being bullied" was reported by myself. There are four steps you can take first. The first step is to record from today. For recording, see Section 8, Article 41 (Recording). The second step is to report the matter in writing through the unit’s internal channels and leave a record of the matter. The third step is to call the police if you are beaten, imprisoned, or humiliated in public. Step 4: If you are forced to leave because of unpaid wages or non-payment of social security, you should follow Article 7 (Voluntary Resignation without signing a signature) and Article 8 (Save Evidence Before Resignation) of this section. For how to calculate economic compensation, see Article 4 of this section (N will be calculated first if laid off). Simple neglect, exclusion, and making things difficult, most of them can't comply with any law. The only options are internal complaints, transfers, and job changes. Arbitration can last up to 60 days from acceptance. The first instance of a lawsuit is required to be heard within 6 months, which can be extended. The lawyer's fees will be paid by yourself. If you can no longer hold on, call 12356 first. See Section 1, Article 25 (12356). I don’t advocate resigning as soon as you get angry. The cost of changing jobs is up to you.

Case: A female employee was publicly insulted and deliberately made things difficult for her by her supervisor for a long time. She used her mobile phone to record and save WeChat chat records, and complained to the company's labor union to no avail. She finally applied for labor arbitration based on evidence, and was awarded compensation for mental damage and terminated her labor contract.

items.title: When you resign, ask your employer for a resignation certificate, stating the contract period, date of resignation, position and working years.
items.core: Whether you are fired, the contract expires, or you resign yourself, your employer must give you a resignation certificate when you resign, and transfer your files and social security within 15 days. The certificate should include the contract period, date of resignation, position and how many years you have worked at this company. You need it to register as unemployed. If the employer refuses to pay, the labor department will order you to make corrections, and you will have to compensate for the losses you suffer.
body: Cost: No money. Ask for it in person before leaving, or send a written message to ask for it, leaving a record of the request. The difficulty lies in having to open this mouth when the relationship is at loggerheads. If the employer refuses to pay, they will complain or apply for arbitration, which can take anywhere from dozens of days to several months.

Income: The Labor Contract Law stipulates that the unit must issue a certificate when rescinding or terminating the labor contract. The law does not matter who proposed it, including whether the contract is not renewed when it expires, you resign yourself, or you are fired. The unit will also complete the transfer procedures for your files and social insurance relations within 15 days. The Implementing Regulations stipulate that four things must be written on the certificate: the labor contract period, the date of rescission or termination, the job position, and the number of years of service in the unit. Unemployment insurance regulations stipulate that after employees lose their jobs, they must take this certificate issued by their unit and go to the social security agency to register for unemployment in a timely manner. Unemployment insurance benefits are calculated from the day of unemployment registration. If the unit fails to provide written certification, the labor administrative department shall order it to make corrections. If it causes you any damage, your employer will have to compensate you. The law also stipulates that if a new unit recruits someone who has not terminated the contract with the original unit and causes losses to the original unit, the new unit must bear joint liability for compensation. The resignation certificate is the written proof that you have terminated the contract with your original employer (nationwide)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress Standing Committee (2012 revision). Labor Contract Law (Articles 50, 89, 91). <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=2c909fdd678bf17901678bf74d7106b3>; State Council (2008). Regulations for the Implementation of the Labor Contract Law (State Council Order No. 535, Article 24). <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=ff8080816f3cbb3c016f40927caf049c>; State Council (1999). Unemployment Insurance Regulations (State Council Order No. 258, Article 16). <https://xzfg.moj.gov.cn/front/law/detail?LawID=517>; Standing Committee of the National People's Congress (2007). Labor Dispute Mediation and Arbitration Law (Articles 2, 27, 43, and 53). <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=2c909fdd678bf17901678bf64f28039d>; State Council (2004). Regulations on Labor and Social Security Supervision (State Council Order No. 423, Article 17). <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2004/content_63042.htm>; State Council (2006). Measures for the payment of litigation fees (State Council Order No. 481, Articles 6, 13, and 29). <https://www.gov.cn/ziliao/flfg/2006-12/29/content_483682.htm>

Note: The law does not link the issuance of certificates with work handover. Financial compensation will be paid after the handover is completed. The work unit delayed and refused to give it, and sent a written message first and then asked for it again. If you still don’t get paid, call 12333 or go to the Labor Supervision Bureau of the Human Resources and Social Security Bureau to complain. There is no charge for filing a complaint, and the investigation will be completed within 60 working days after the case is filed. For complex cases, it can be extended for an additional 30 working days. If your employer wants to compensate for losses, you can go to labor arbitration, which is free of charge and must be applied for within one year. The case shall be concluded within 45 days after the arbitration is accepted, with a maximum extension of 15 days. You need to provide evidence to prove the loss yourself, such as being delayed in unemployment registration or being rejected by a new employer because there is no proof. If you are dissatisfied with the ruling and go to court, the ordinary first-instance procedure is required to be completed within 6 months, and can be extended. The labor dispute acceptance fee charged by the court is 10 yuan per case. The lawyer's fees are not included in the litigation costs and must be paid by yourself. There is no reason for resignation among the four things required by the regulations. The certificate says "Voluntary resignation for personal reasons" but this is not the case. I raised it on the spot and the reason is shown in Article 7 of this section (do not sign the voluntary resignation). How to receive unemployment insurance benefits, see Section 7, Article 1 (Unemployment Insurance Benefits).

Case: Ms. Zhao decided to resign after her labor contract with the company expired, but the company only asked her to fill out a resignation application and did not issue a formal resignation certificate. She realized the seriousness of the problem when she was rejected when she went to register for unemployment. After complaining to the labor inspection department, the company was ordered to issue a replacement certificate of resignation, stating the contract period, position, date of resignation, and years of service. Lawyers remind that the resignation certificate is a required legal document. If the employer refuses to issue it, you can protect your rights according to law.

items.title: When receiving severance compensation, first check your personal income tax: the tax is exempted within 3 times the average salary of local employees in the previous year. The excess is calculated separately and is not included in the salary of the current year.
items.core: Because of the one-time compensation received after terminating the labor contract, the portion within 3 times the average salary of local employees in the previous year will not be subject to personal income tax. The excess amount is taxed separately and is not added to the current year's salary. If your employer deducts the entire amount from your salary for the current month, you should first ask your employer for clarification, and then call 12366 to ask the tax bureau.
body: Cost: Nothing. Check the average salary of local employees last year, and then take a few minutes to check how the unit deducted taxes. The declaration details of each income can be found in the Personal Income Tax App.

Income: The Ministry of Finance and the State Administration of Taxation have a document that governs the one-time compensation income received by individuals and employers when the labor relationship is terminated. This income includes economic compensation, living allowance and other subsidies. Among them, the part that is less than 3 times the average salary of local employees in the previous year is exempt from personal income tax. The portion exceeding 3 times will not be incorporated into the comprehensive income of the year, and will be taxed separately at the comprehensive income tax rate. In this table, the annual tax rate is 3% for the portion within 36,000 yuan, and 10% for the portion from 36,000 yuan to 144,000 yuan. Step up to 45%. For example, the average salary of local employees last year was 100,000 yuan, three times that is 300,000 yuan. After receiving 360,000 yuan in compensation, only the excess 60,000 yuan was taxed, which was 3,480 yuan. If the entire sum of 360,000 yuan is calculated based on this table, it would be 58,080 yuan. This article will be implemented from January 1, 2019, with no deadline (nationwide)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Ministry of Finance, State Administration of Taxation (2018). Notice on the transition of preferential policies after the revision of the Personal Income Tax Law (Caishui [2018] No. 164, Article 5 (1), Article 8, and Article 9). <https://fgk.chinatax.gov.cn/zcfgk/c102416/c5202364/content.html> (State Administration of Taxation Policies and Regulations Database); Ministry of Finance and State Administration of Taxation (2023). Announcement on the continuation of the annual one-time bonus personal income tax policy (No. 30, 2023). <https://fgk.chinatax.gov.cn/zcfgk/c102416/c5211524/content.html> (State Administration of Taxation Policies and Regulations Database); National People’s Congress Standing Committee (2018 revision). Personal Income Tax Law (Articles 3 and 9, Table 1 of Personal Income Tax Rates). <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=2c909fdd678bf17901678bf724bd0609>

Note: In the same document, the deadline for the annual one-time bonus was written, which was later extended to December 31, 2027. There is no deadline for compensation for terminating labor relations, and it does not follow the bonus. The document only names economic compensation, living allowances and other subsidies, but does not separately name notice payment and compensation for illegal termination. If you are not sure whether these two payments count, call 12366 and ask the local tax bureau. The number used for "local average salary of employees last year" also depends on the local tax bureau. For how to calculate the compensation itself, see Article 4 (N is calculated first if the case is dismissed), Article 5 (Failure to give 30 days’ notice in advance) and Article 6 (Compensation for illegal termination) of this section. There are different calculations for the one-time subsidy for early retirement and internal retirement, and this rule does not apply.

Case: Supervisor Lao Zhou was laid off and received a compensation of 450,000 yuan. The portion within 3 times the average salary of local employees in the previous year was tax-free. The unit will incorporate the full amount into the monthly salary withholding personal tax. Lao Zhou appealed to the tax authorities based on his separation agreement and successfully refunded the overpaid tax.

items.title: When you change jobs in another city, transfer the pension and medical insurance relationship to the new insured place, and the payment years will continue to accumulate. Do not cancel the insurance.
items.core: When you change jobs in another city, your pension and medical insurance relationships will generally follow you, and the number of years you paid in the past will continue to increase. If you have not reached the pension age, you cannot surrender the insurance and withdraw the money. If medical insurance is cut off for more than 3 months, you may have to wait up to 6 months for reimbursement in a new place, so don’t be idle for too long.
body: Cost: Nothing. After enrolling in the insurance in the new place and paying the premium, the new unit or you can apply for transfer by going to the window or online. You have to wait dozens of working days for elderly care, and about 15 working days for medical insurance.

Income: The Social Insurance Law stipulates that if you change employment in another place (officially, it means crossing a coordinating area), the pension relationship will be transferred with you, and the payment years will be calculated cumulatively. The same goes for employee medical insurance. The relationship follows the person and the years are calculated cumulatively. Upon retirement, pensions are calculated in segments and paid uniformly. Transfer of pension relationships across provinces shall be handled in accordance with the transfer and continuation measures forwarded by the General Office of the State Council. Those who have not reached the age of receiving benefits are not allowed to terminate the pension relationship or handle surrender. The Social Security Law also states that personal accounts are not allowed to be withdrawn in advance. All the money in the personal account including principal and interest was transferred away. The part paid by the employer is called the overall fund, and is transferred to 12% of your actual salary paid in each year after 1998. When you receive a pension, it is calculated based on your contribution salary in each year, your contribution years and the average salary in each year in the place where you receive it. The procedure is to apply in writing to the new place of insurance by your employer or yourself after you have signed up for insurance in the new place and paid the premium. The new insured place will be reviewed within 15 working days, and the transfer will be completed within 15 working days after the original insured place receives the acceptance letter. After the new insured place receives the relationship and funds, the process will be completed within 15 working days. According to the 2020 inter-provincial clearance list, this matter will be implemented across provinces before the end of the year. You just need to apply to the place of transfer, and there is no need to go back to the place of transfer. The employee medical insurance must be terminated in the original insured place and insured in the new place before applying for transfer. You can apply online on the National Medical Insurance Service Platform or go to the window. Transfers will be made within 10 working days to the original insured place, and transfers will be transferred to the new insured place within 5 working days, and the personal account balance will be transferred together. If the payment was stopped within 3 months before the transfer, there will be no waiting period after making up the payment according to the new local regulations. The payment will be reimbursed in the same month, and the period in between can also be reimbursed retroactively. If the payment is suspended for more than 3 months, the waiting period shall be determined according to local regulations, and in principle shall not exceed 6 months (nationwide)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress Standing Committee (2010, 2018 revised). Social Insurance Law (Articles 14, 19, 32). <https://www.gov.cn/guoqing/2021-10/29/content_5647616.htm>; Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security, Ministry of Finance (2009). Interim Measures for the Transfer and Continuation of Basic Pension Insurance Relationships for Urban Enterprise Employees (Forwarded by Guobanfa [2009] No. 66, Articles 2, 3, 4, 5, 6, 7, 8, and 11). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2009-12/29/content_8104.htm>; General Office of the State Council (2020). Guiding Opinions on Accelerating the "Trans-provincial Service" of Government Services (Guobanfa [2020] No. 35, Attachment Item 7). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2020-09/29/content_5548125.htm>; Office of the National Medical Insurance Administration, General Office of the Ministry of Finance (2021). Interim Measures for the Transfer and Continuation of Basic Medical Insurance Relationships (Medical Insurance Banfa [2021] No. 43, Articles 5, 6, 8, 9, 11, 12, and 13). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2021-11/28/content_5653856.htm>; National Medical Insurance Administration (2021). Policy interpretation of the "Interim Measures for the Transfer and Continuation of Basic Medical Insurance Relationships" (National Medical Insurance Service Platform website fuwu.nhsa.gov.cn). <http://www.gov.cn/zhengce/2021-11/28/content_5653855.htm>

Note: If you move across provinces, it is not the province where you have your registered permanent residence, and if a man is over 50 years old and a woman is over 40 years old, the pension relationship will remain in the original insured place. Only a temporary account will be opened in the new place to record all contributions from the unit and individuals. Here are the rules for where to collect your pension when you retire. If the relationship is in the province where the household registration is located, it shall be obtained in the place of household registration. If you are not in the place of household registration but have paid for 10 years in total in the place of residence, you can collect it locally. If the payment is less than 10 years old, it will be transferred back to the place where the payment was made for more than 10 years. Those who are less than 10 years old in each place will be classified into the household registration area. The average salary used to calculate pensions is different depending on where you receive it. How to transfer between provinces and cities? It is up to each province to decide its own method and ask the local social security agency. People who are already receiving pensions will no longer have their relationships transferred. How to calculate the number of years after suspension of payment and what qualifications require continuous payment? Please refer to Section 7, Article 18 (Cessation of Social Security Payment). For those who do not join an employer and pay social security by themselves, see Section 31, Article 11 (Flexible Employment).

Case: Xiao Lin changed jobs from Beijing to Shanghai, handled the transfer and renewal of pension and medical insurance relationships in a timely manner, and calculated the cumulative payment period. Because I only stopped paying for one month, I was able to enjoy normal medical insurance reimbursement the next month after arriving in Shanghai, which did not affect my hospitalization.

items.title: If your employer has not signed a written labor contract with you after one month of employment, you can demand double your salary starting from the second month, up to 11 months; if you have not signed it after one year, you will be considered to have signed an open-term contract.
items.core: If your employer has not signed a written contract with you after working for one month, you will be given an extra salary every month starting from the second month, up to 11 more months. If you don't sign it after one year, you will be deemed to have signed a contract with no expiration date. The employer hands you the contract and you sign it. If you delay signing it intentionally, you won't get the money.
body: Cost: Nothing. Always keep evidence of your work: salary slips, attendance, work badges, and work group chat records. If the unit refuses to accept it, it will apply for labor arbitration. The arbitration is free of charge and the case will be concluded within 45 days of acceptance, with a maximum extension of 15 days. If you are dissatisfied, you can still go to court. The ordinary first-instance procedure is stipulated to be completed within 6 months, and can be extended. The lawyer's fees will be paid by yourself. The difficulty is that if you are still working in this company, you have to withstand the pressure when asking for money.

Benefits: The Labor Contract Law stipulates that a written labor contract must be signed to establish a labor relationship. If you do not sign on the day you start work, you must sign it within one month from the day you start work. If you have been working for more than a month and have not signed the contract for less than a year, your employer will pay you double your salary every month. The implementation regulations specify the starting and ending time: from the second day after working for one month to the day before the contract is re-signed. If you have not signed a contract after working for one year, double salary will be calculated until the day before the first year, up to 11 months. From the day one year expires, the two parties will be deemed to have signed an unfixed-term labor contract, and the unit must sign a replacement immediately. An open-ended contract is a contract with no agreed expiry date. The judicial interpretation of the Supreme Court that will be implemented in September 2025 stipulates that double wages will be calculated on a monthly basis, and if the salary is less than one month, it will be calculated on the basis of actual working days. If the employer can prove that the failure to sign was due to force majeure, or that you failed to sign intentionally or due to gross negligence, you do not need to pay. Within the first month of working, if the employer notifies you in writing to sign but you fail to sign, the employer may terminate the labor relationship with a written notification. At this time, the employer will not give you any financial compensation, but will only pay you the salary for the days you worked. If the period already counted as an open-term contract is doubled, the court will not support it (National)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Standing Committee of the National People's Congress (2012 revision). Labor Contract Law (Articles 10, 14, 82). <https://fgk.chinatax.gov.cn/zcfgk/c100009/c5193025/content.html> (Reprinted from the Policy and Regulation Database of the State Administration of Taxation); State Council (2008). Regulations on the Implementation of the Labor Contract Law (State Council Order No. 535) No. 5, 6 and 7). <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2008/content_1107604.htm>; Supreme People's Court (2025). Note: The Supreme Court has not set a national standard for how long the extra salary must be claimed. A statute of limitations rule was written in the 2023 consultation draft, and there was no reservation in the explanation officially announced in 2025. Beijing’s argument is that the additional one shall be subject to a one-year arbitration statute of limitations. Work backwards one year from the day you made the request, calculated on a daily basis. The algorithm is not exactly the same everywhere, but the longer you delay, the fewer months you can get back. Therefore, apply for arbitration as soon as possible while you are still employed or after leaving your job. The general rules on the statute of limitations for arbitration are found in Section 8, Article 19 (Limited time limit for enforcement of rights). If the contract is signed back to the first day of work, Beijing generally no longer supports double wages. Unless you can prove that the re-signing is not voluntary on your part. To look at this from the employer's side, see Section 12, Article 16 (Employer must sign a written contract within the first month).

Case: College student Xiao Wu joined a new media company, but the company never signed a written contract. After working for five months, he applied for arbitration. Based on his salary flow and attendance records, he was compensated for the double salary difference during the period before the contract was signed, totaling 25,000 yuan.

items.title: If your employer does not pay or pays less than the social security insurance, you should first file a complaint and ask it to make up the payment; if you want to resign and receive financial compensation, you must state in your resignation notice that the reason is that the employer failed to pay social security in accordance with the law.
items.core: If your employer doesn't pay you social security or doesn't pay enough, you can complain and have it make up for it, and you'll also have to pay a late fee. If it is not paid to you, you can also notify the employer in writing to terminate the contract and demand financial compensation. The notice must state that the reason is that the employer failed to pay social security in accordance with the law. If it is stated as personal reasons, you will not be able to get it. The agreement that "employees voluntarily give up social security" does not count.
body: Cost: Nothing. First check your social security payment records, take screenshots or print them and save them. If you want to pay back, call 12333 or go to the Labor Supervision Bureau of the Human Resources and Social Security Bureau to file a complaint. If you want financial compensation, go to labor arbitration. There is no charge. The case will be concluded within 45 days, and it can be postponed for up to 15 days. If you are dissatisfied, go to court. The ordinary first-instance procedure is stipulated to be completed within 6 months. It can be extended and the lawyer's fees will be paid by yourself. The difficulty lies in finding another income first after resigning.

Income: The Social Insurance Law stipulates that units must declare their own returns and pay social insurance in full and on time. Except for statutory reasons such as force majeure, payment cannot be postponed or reduced. If your employer infringes on your social security rights and interests, you can ask the social security administrative department or the social security fee collection agency to handle it in accordance with the law. If the unit fails to pay in full and on time, the collection agency will order it to make up the amount within a time limit, and a late payment fee of 0.05% will be charged every day starting from the day the amount is owed. If you fail to pay after the deadline, you will be fined 1 to 3 times the amount in arrears. Among the matters under the supervision of labor and social security supervision, there is the situation of units participating in social security and paying social insurance premiums. The investigation will be completed within 60 working days after the case is filed. For complex cases, it can be extended for another 30 working days. The Labor Contract Law stipulates that if the employer fails to pay social security for you in accordance with the law, you can terminate the labor contract and the employer must pay financial compensation. If you give 30 days' notice and resign on your own, your employer does not need to provide you with financial compensation. Therefore, it must be stated in the notice that it was terminated because the employer failed to pay social security in accordance with the law. The judicial interpretation of the Supreme People's Court that will take effect in September 2025 states that any agreement between your employer and you not to pay social security, or your own promise not to pay, is invalid. If your employer fails to pay social security in accordance with the law, and you terminate the contract accordingly and require financial compensation, the court will support it in accordance with the law. If your employer fails to apply for social security for you, and the social security agency cannot re-apply for it, causing you to fail to receive benefits, you can ask your employer to compensate you for the loss. This is a labor dispute accepted by the court (nationwide)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People’s Congress Standing Committee (2010, 2018 revised). Social Insurance Law (Articles 58, 60, 63, 82, 83, 86). <https://www.gov.cn/guoqing/2021-10/29/content_5647616.htm>; National People’s Congress Standing Committee (2012 Amendment).
