Interpretation on the Applicable Legal Issues in the Trial of Labor Dispute Cases (II) (Fa Interpretation [2025] No. 12, Article 19). <https://www.court.gov.cn/zixun/xiangqing/472691.html>; Beijing Higher People’s Court, Beijing Labor and Personnel Dispute Arbitration Commission (2024). Answers on the Trial of Labor Dispute Cases (1) (Beijing Gao Fa Fa [2024] No. 534, Question 1, Question 71, Question 72). <https://www.beijing.gov.cn/zhengce/fygfxwj/202405/t20240530_3699652.html>; Standing Committee of the National People's Congress (2007). Labor Dispute Mediation and Arbitration Law (Articles 43 and 53). <https://rsj.ankang.gov.cn/Content-2150407.html> (Reprinted by Ankang Human Resources and Social Security Bureau); State Council (2006). Measures for the Payment of Litigation Fees (State Council Order No. 481, Articles 6 and 13). <https://www.gov.cn/ziliao/flfg/2006-12/29/content_483682.htm>

Note: If you want to pay back, take the complaint route. The Beijing High People's Court and the Arbitration Commission say that simply asking for back payment does not constitute a labor dispute and requires the labor administration department to be contacted. Don’t delay in filing a complaint: If the illegal behavior is not discovered within 2 years and no one complains, the labor and social security department will no longer investigate and deal with it. If you still owe money and have not paid it, the two years will be counted from the day when the payment stopped. Whether paying less than the basic amount counts as "failure to pay in accordance with the law" and whether you can receive financial compensation accordingly, the Supreme Court has not written. Beijing only listed two types of coverage: no social security account was established within one year before the cancellation, or the insurance coverage was incomplete. There is no unified national explanation for the underpayment of the base amount. Please ask the local arbitration committee first. If your employer previously converted the social security money into cash and paid it back to you later, it can ask you to return the money. If a work-related injury occurred when work-related injury insurance was not paid, see Article 13 of this section (work-related injury insurance was not paid for you). How to calculate the number of years after the suspension of payment, see Section 7, Article 18 (Cessation of Social Security Payment).

Case: Employee Xiao Zhao discovered that the company only paid social security based on the minimum base. After many communications to no avail, he mailed a written resignation notice, clearly stating that the company did not pay social security in full in accordance with the law. Subsequently, he applied for arbitration and received a financial compensation of 48,000 yuan.

items.title: When the company wants you to pay liquidated damages when you resign, first let’s see which one it is: only the service period of special training and non-competition restrictions can stipulate liquidated damages, and the law does not allow stipulations on other items
items.core: The contract says "you will lose money if you leave early." The law only allows it in two situations: the company pays to send you for professional technical training, or non-competition restrictions. If there is special training, the compensation cannot exceed the training fee, and it will be calculated based on the unfinished service period.
body: Cost: No money. It will take a few minutes to read through the labor contract, training agreement, and non-competition agreement. If the company deducts wages to offset liquidated damages, it will have to go to labor arbitration to get it back. There is no fee for arbitration and the case will be concluded within 45 days, with an extension of up to 15 days. If you are dissatisfied, go to court. The ordinary first-instance procedure is stipulated to be completed within 6 months. It can be extended and the lawyer's fees will be paid by yourself.

Income: The Labor Contract Law stipulates that, except for the service period of special training and non-competition restrictions, the unit shall not agree that the employee shall bear liquidated damages. The first is that the unit pays for special training, sends you to receive professional technical training, and can agree on a service period with you. If you leave early in violation of the service period, you will pay liquidated damages as agreed. The liquidated damages shall not exceed the training expenses paid by the unit. What the unit can actually ask for shall not exceed the allocated training expenses for the unfinished portion of the service period. For example, the training fee is 30,000 yuan, the service period is 3 years, and the maximum cost is 10,000 yuan after working for 2 years. Training expenses must be documented, including training fees, travel expenses during the training period and other direct expenses incurred due to training. If you terminate the contract and leave in accordance with the law due to faults such as non-payment of social security and unpaid wages by the employer, it will not be considered a violation of the service period, and the employer shall not impose liquidated damages. The second type is non-compete, the rules are found in Section 11, Article 12 (Competition Agreement). In addition, contract clauses that exempt the unit from its legal responsibilities and exclude the rights of workers are invalid (nationwide)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress Standing Committee (2012 revision). Labor Contract Law (Articles 22, 23, 25, 26, 37, 90). <https://fgk.chinatax.gov.cn/zcfgk/c100009/c5193025/content.html> (Reprinted from the Policy and Regulation Database of the State Administration of Taxation); State Council (2008). Regulations on the Implementation of the Labor Contract Law (State Council Order No. 535, Articles 16, 17, and 26). <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2008/content_1107604.htm>; Supreme People's Court (2025). Interpretation on the Applicable Legal Issues in the Trial of Labor Dispute Cases (2) (Fa Interpretation [2025] No. 12, Article 12). <https://www.court.gov.cn/zixun/xiangqing/472691.html>; Beijing Higher People’s Court, Beijing Labor and Personnel Dispute Arbitration Commission (2024). Answers on the trial of labor dispute cases (1) (Jinggao Fafa [2024] No. 534, Question 82). <https://www.beijing.gov.cn/zhengce/fygfxwj/202405/t20240530_3699652.html>; National People’s Congress Standing Committee (2007). Labor Dispute Mediation and Arbitration Law (Articles 43 and 53). <https://rsj.ankang.gov.cn/Content-2150407.html> (Reprinted by Ankang Human Resources and Social Security Bureau); State Council (2006). Measures for the payment of litigation fees (State Council Order No. 481, Articles 6 and 13). <https://www.gov.cn/ziliao/flfg/2006-12/29/content_483682.htm>

Note: Liquidated damages are not allowed, which does not mean that you will not have to pay any compensation if you leave. If you leave without 30 days' written notice in advance, or violate confidentiality or non-competition agreements, causing losses to the unit, you will have to compensate for the losses. How much the loss is, the unit needs to provide evidence. If your employer gives you special benefits such as household registration and agrees on a service period, and you leave early, the court can award you compensation. The amount of compensation depends on the actual loss, the fault of both parties, and how long you have been doing it. Beijing's standard is that liquidated damages are not supported if the employer helps you register an account, but if you violate good faith and cause losses to the employer, you will still have to pay compensation. If the employee is terminated by the employer for serious disciplinary violations, serious dereliction of duty, or being held criminally responsible, liquidated damages during the service period will still be paid. If the service period has not expired when the contract expires, the contract will be extended until the service period expires, unless otherwise agreed by both parties. How to get the deducted wages back? See Section 7, Article 2 (if you are owed wages, file a complaint with the labor inspection first). The determination of income is based on judgment: the amount of liquidated damages is written in each contract, and there is no unified amount.

Case: Xiao Li's contract stated "10,000 yuan compensation for early resignation." He changed jobs after working for one year, and the company claimed compensation. The arbitration committee found that the company did not send him for special training and that there was no competition restriction. It determined that the liquidated damages clause was illegal and invalid, and Xiao Li did not need to pay any compensation.

items.title: The company wants to transfer your position or reduce your salary. If you don't agree, just put it in writing on the spot. Don't keep silent and work according to the new arrangement for more than a month
items.core: Changing positions and changing wages is a change in the contract. Both parties must discuss and agree, and it must be written down. But if you kept silent and worked at the new position and new salary for more than a month, the court will generally not invalidate the change because you did not sign a written document. If you disagree, you can put it in writing on the spot, send an email, and keep a record.
body: Cost: No money. After receiving the notice of job transfer or salary reduction, send an email or submit a written opinion stating your disagreement, and keep a record for a few minutes. The difficulty is that people still work in this company and have to withstand the pressure of falling out in person. If your employer fires you or deducts your money because of this, you will have to go to labor arbitration. The arbitration is free of charge and the case will be concluded within 45 days of acceptance, with a maximum extension of 15 days. If you are dissatisfied, go to court. The ordinary first-instance procedure is stipulated to be completed within 6 months. It can be extended and the lawyer's fees will be paid by yourself.

Income: The Labor Contract Law stipulates that the content of the labor contract can be changed only if the unit and the employee reach consensus through consultation. Changes must be made in writing. There is another judicial interpretation of the Supreme Court. If both parties agree to verbally change the contract and then actually work according to the new content for more than a month, the change will still be effective. At this time, if you use "no written form" to say that the change is invalid, the court will not support it. The premise is that the changed content is not illegal or against public order and good customs. When talking about the form of a contract, the Civil Code states that "data messages that can tangibly express the content contained in electronic data exchange, email, etc., and can be retrieved at any time for investigation, are deemed to be in writing." This is the caliber of the Beijing High Court and the Beijing Arbitration Commission. If the position is not written in the contract or is unclear, and the unit has legitimate reasons and reasonably adjusts the positions based on business needs, it will be counted as independent employment by the unit. Whether it is reasonable or not depends on four things: whether it is necessary for business purposes, whether the purpose is legitimate, whether you are qualified for the new position, and whether the salary and benefits have deteriorated. The contract clearly states the position but does not specify how to transfer it. If the employer transfers the position on its own, it is a breach of contract, and the salary difference must be repaid based on the salary of the original position. The contract states the work location as "nationwide" or "Beijing" in a broad range, which means the agreement is unclear. The location where you actually work shall prevail. The unit is not allowed to change this location without justifiable reasons. If the unit fails to pay wages in full and on time, you can terminate the labor contract and the unit must pay financial compensation (nationwide; the Beijing standard is only applicable in Beijing)
Level of Evidence: B

Source: National People’s Congress Standing Committee (2012 revision). Note: The reason for setting B: "If you do it without saying a word, you will be deemed to have agreed." The law does not directly state this. It is deduced from Article 43 of the Judicial Interpretation and the caliber of local adjudication. There is no uniform standard for "reasonable job reassignment" across the country. What is listed above is Beijing's standard. After raising objections in writing, it is best to arrive at work as usual and write down your reservations, because if you refuse to show up, you may be dismissed by your employer for absenteeism. The job transfer was later found to be unreasonable. The dismissal was an illegal termination and was calculated in accordance with Article 6 of this section (compensation for illegal termination). If it is found to be reasonable, you will not get the money. If the objective situation at the time of signing the contract has changed significantly and the changes cannot be made through negotiation with you, the unit may terminate the contract. At this time, money must be paid in accordance with Article 5 of this section (without 30 days’ notice). How to claim the underpaid wages after a salary reduction? See Section 7, Article 2 (if you are owed wages, file a complaint with the labor inspection first). Income determination is based on judgment: the amount of salary reduction varies from company to company, and there is no unified number.

Case: Sales Director A Ming was unilaterally transferred by the company and his salary was reduced. He sent an email on the same day to express his disagreement in writing and continued to work in his original position. After the company stopped paying wages, he applied for arbitration based on his emails and attendance records, and the court ruled that the company should pay him back wages.

items.title: For those who are dispatched to work in other companies, their wages must be calculated according to the same method as regular workers in similar positions. If the unit where they work suffers damage, both companies will compensate together
items.core: The contract of dispatched workers is signed with the dispatching company, and the unit where they work every day also has legal obligations. Wages must be calculated according to the same method as those in similar positions at that unit, and overtime pay and performance bonuses must also be paid by it. If there is damage to that unit, both companies will pay for it together, and you can ask either one of them for compensation. During the months when there is no work after being returned, the dispatch company must also pay the minimum wage.
body: Cost: No money. It takes a few minutes to dig out the labor contract and see which company it is stamped with. Then ask the dispatch company about the wages and social security stated in the dispatch agreement. It is obliged to tell you. If there is a real dispute, please go to labor arbitration. There is no charge. The case will be settled within 45 days after acceptance, and the maximum extension will be 15 days. If you are dissatisfied, go to court. The ordinary first-instance procedure is stipulated to be completed within 6 months. It can be extended and the lawyer's fees will be paid by yourself.

Income: The Labor Contract Law stipulates that the labor dispatch company is your employer and must sign a fixed-term contract with you for more than 2 years and pay you monthly wages. During the period when they are not sent out to work, they are paid monthly according to the local minimum wage. The dispatch company must tell you the contents of the dispatch agreement and must not deduct the wages paid to you by the unit (legally called the employer). Neither company is allowed to charge you. Dispatched persons have the right to receive equal pay for equal work as employees of the employing unit. Employers must use the same labor remuneration distribution method for similar positions. If there are no similar positions, the salary will be determined based on the local equivalent or similar positions. Employers must pay overtime pay, performance bonuses, provide job-related benefits, and must not discriminate against dispatched workers. For those who are employed continuously, wages must be adjusted normally. Dispatch can only be used for temporary, auxiliary or alternative positions. Temporary positions refer to positions that last no more than 6 months. The number of dispatched workers by an employer shall not exceed 10% of the total number of employees. If an employer causes damage to dispatched workers, the dispatch company and the employer shall bear joint liability for compensation. Joint and several means that you can ask one of them for full compensation, or you can ask both. If you have a labor dispute with any one of them, both parties will be co-parties to the arbitration. If the employer is injured due to work, the dispatch company shall apply for work-related injury recognition and assume the liability for work-related injury insurance, and the employer shall assist in the investigation. The employer can only return you under certain statutory circumstances. In the name of contracting or outsourcing, if people are actually employed by dispatch, they will also be handled according to dispatch regulations (national, interim regulations will be effective from March 1, 2014)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress Standing Committee (2012 revision). Labor Contract Law (Articles 58, 60, 62, 63, 66, 92). <https://fgk.chinatax.gov.cn/zcfgk/c100009/c5193025/content.html> (Reprinted from the Policy and Regulation Database of the State Administration of Taxation); Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security (2014). Interim Provisions on Labor Dispatch (Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security Order No. 22, Articles 3, 4, 8, 9, 10, 12, 15, 17, and 27). <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2014/content_2667613.htm>; Standing Committee of the National People's Congress (2007). Labor Dispute Mediation and Arbitration Law (Articles 22 and 43). <https://rsj.ankang.gov.cn/Content-2150407.html> (Reprinted by Ankang Human Resources and Social Security Bureau); National People's Congress (2020). Civil Code (Article 178). Full text reprinted by the Supreme People's Procuratorate <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202006/t20200602_463888.shtml>; State Council (2006). Measures for the payment of litigation fees (State Council Order No. 481, Articles 6 and 13). <https://www.gov.cn/ziliao/flfg/2006-12/29/content_483682.htm>

Note: Equal pay for equal work refers to whether the same distribution method is used for similar positions. There is no guarantee that everyone will receive the same amount. After being returned, if the dispatch company lowers the conditions of the original contract and sends you again. If you do not agree, the dispatch company shall not terminate the contract accordingly. If the dispatch company cancels or terminates the contract with you due to legal circumstances, it will give you financial compensation. For the calculation, see Article 4 of this section (N will be settled first if laid off). If you are injured at the employer, first ask the dispatch company to report the work-related injury. It does not require you to report it yourself, see Article 11 of this section (determination of work-related injuries). If wages are deducted or owed, see Section 7, Article 2 (if you are owed wages, file a complaint with the labor inspection first). The determination of income is based on judgment: the difference between equal pay for equal work and the magnitude of the damage vary from person to person, and there is no unified number.

Case: Xiao Liu, a dispatch employee, injured his foot when the employer was carrying goods. The employer and the dispatch company blamed each other. Xiao Liu took the two companies to court at the same time. The court ruled that both parties were jointly and severally liable for compensation and were compensated for medical expenses and lost wages.

items.title: You need to get your own copy of the labor contract; if you have signed a blank or incomplete contract, a written message will be sent to the company on the same day asking the company to fill it out and give you a copy, and leave a record of "it was blank when signing"
items.core: The company and you must each get a copy of the labor contract. If the necessary content such as full salary and term is not written, the company will be ordered to make corrections. If you sign a blank contract and no evidence can be produced, the court may recognize the one filled out by the employer later. Therefore, after signing, your employer will fill it out and give you one copy, and leave a record of whether it was blank when signing.
body: Cost: No money. Before signing, read the contract from beginning to end. Do not sign if the units name, term, position, and salary columns are empty. If you have already signed, send a WeChat message or email to the person in charge on the same day. Please indicate which columns are blank when signing, and ask your employer to fill them in and give you a copy. If your employer refuses to pay, call 12333 or go to the Labor Supervision Bureau of the Human Resources and Social Security Bureau to complain. The investigation will be completed within 60 working days after the case is filed, and for complex cases, it will be extended for another 30 working days. If you are in trouble and have to lose money, go to labor arbitration. Apply within 1 year. There is no charge. The case will be settled within 45 days after acceptance, and the maximum extension is 15 days. If you are dissatisfied, go to court. The ordinary first-instance procedure is stipulated to be completed within 6 months. It can be extended and the lawyer's fees will be paid by yourself. The difficulty is that you have to ask for a contract when you first join the company.

Benefits: The Labor Contract Law stipulates that the contract must be signed or sealed by both parties before it becomes effective. The unit and the worker each receive one copy of the text. There are nine clauses that must be stated in the contract. Among them are the name of the unit, contract period, work content and location, working hours, labor remuneration, social insurance, and labor protection. If the text given by the unit does not contain all the necessary provisions, or if the text is not handed over to the worker, the labor administration department will order it to make corrections. Any damage caused to workers must be compensated. The conclusion of labor contracts between units and workers is originally a matter under the supervision of labor and social security supervision. If the contract is not clear about wages and labor conditions, it can be renegotiated. If negotiation fails, the collective contract shall apply. If there is no collective contract or the collective contract does not stipulate wages, equal pay for equal work shall be provided. A contract signed by someone against their true intention by means of fraud, coercion, or taking advantage of others' danger shall be invalid or partially invalid and shall be confirmed by arbitration or the court. Workers Daily reported on a case in Korla, Xinjiang. A hotel sales manager said the salary in the contract was lower than what was negotiated during the interview. He said that he only signed his name when signing the contract, and the hotel filled in the rest later. The court applied for an appraisal to see if the filled-in content and the signature were formed at the same time. He gave up the appraisal, so he had to bear the adverse consequences. The court held that he was an adult who could make his own decisions (legally called a person with full capacity for civil conduct) and should be responsible for his signature. The court determined that the contract was not invalid and that all the wages he claimed were not supported. The Beijing Daxing Court heard a case with the opposite result. Twenty shuttle drivers said they had signed blank contracts and had no contracts in their hands. When signing, the employer asked them to sign on a pile of documents but did not let them read the contents. The contract terms issued by the unit were all handwritten. The drivers joined the company at different times and signed contracts at different times, but the termination date was all listed as the same day. This day happens to be the day when the cooperation between the unit and the customer ends. The court found that it was more credible for drivers to say that they signed contracts with a blank period. The company could not prove that the termination date was a true agreement at the time, so the court determined that it constituted an illegal termination and required compensation for illegal termination. The second instance upheld the original verdict. For disputes arising from decisions such as dismissal, dismissal, termination of contract, or salary reduction, the unit bears the burden of proof (nationwide; the two cases only represent local determinations)
Level of Evidence: B

Source: National People's Congress Standing Committee (revised in 2012). Labor Contract Law (Articles 16, 17, 18, 26, and 81). <https://fgk.chinatax.gov.cn/zcfgk/c100009/c5193025/content.html> (Reprinted from the Policy and Regulation Database of the State Administration of Taxation); State Council (2004). Regulations on Labor and Social Security Supervision (State Council Order No. 423, Articles 11 and 17). <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2004/content_63042.htm>; Supreme People's Court (2020). Interpretation on the applicable legal issues in the trial of labor dispute cases (1) (Fa Interpretation [2020] No. 26, Article 44). <https://www.court.gov.cn/fabu/xiangqing/282121.html>; National People's Congress Standing Committee (2007). Labor Dispute Mediation and Arbitration Law (Articles 27, 43, and 53). <https://rsj.ankang.gov.cn/Content-2150407.html> (Reprinted by Ankang Human Resources and Social Security Bureau); State Council (2006). Measures for the Payment of Litigation Fees (State Council Order No. 481, Articles 6 and 13). <https://www.gov.cn/ziliao/flfg/2006-12/29/content_483682.htm>; Workers Daily-China Engineering Network (2021-12-09). There are many "pitfalls" in blank contracts, and employee wages are "halved" (reporter Wu Duosi, correspondent Ma Anni). <https://www.workercn.cn/c/2021-12-09/6847921.shtml> (Web Archive <https://web.archive.org/web/20261107004636/https://www.workercn.cn/c/2021-12-09/6847921.shtml>); Beijing Huairou District Justice Bureau (2025). [Explaining the law through cases] Twenty drivers "collectively refused to sign"? Court: Blank contracts and malicious dismissals cannot escape liability (Daxing Court hearing, published on the Huairou District People's Government website). <https://www.bjhr.gov.cn/zt/qwpf/yasf/202509/t20250912_4200995.html>

Note: For the general rule not to sign on blank paper, see Section 8, Article 17 (read the paper before signing). The judge in the Daxing case reminded the employer to fill in all the key terms before signing. The judge also reminded that if you are asked to sign a large pile of documents at one time, read each document carefully before signing. Reason for deciding B: How to determine after signing a blank contract? There are no special provisions in the law. It depends on arbitration and the court to make judgments based on evidence on a case-by-case basis. The results of the above two cases are exactly the opposite. The difference lies in whether the workers have evidence and whether there are any flaws in the unit's claims. The Korla case was only reported by the Workers' Daily, but there was no original text of the verdict. Whether signing a blank contract can be counted as not signing a written contract and requiring twice the salary, there is no national standard. If the salary filled in by the employer is lower than the actual agreement, it must be proven by salary flow, attendance, and chat records. For the storage method, please refer to Article 8 of this section (Storing Evidence Before Resignation). If your employer has never signed a written contract for you, please refer to Article 20 of this section (double salary). For calculation of money based on illegal termination, see Article 6 of this section (Compensation for illegal termination). The general rules on the statute of limitations for arbitration are found in Section 8, Article 19 (Limited time limit for enforcement of rights). The determination of income depends on judgment: how much loss can be caused by the terms filled in later is different from company to company, and there is no unified number.

Case: Xiao Sun, a graduate, was asked to sign a blank contract when he joined the company. He took a photo of the contract that day and asked HR on WeChat to fill in the salary and deadline and give him a copy. Half a year later, the company cut his salary. He used WeChat records and photos to prove the contents of the contract, and the arbitration was upheld.

sections.title: How to take care of a newborn baby

items.title: Let infants sleep on their backs, on a hard surface, in the same room, on different beds, and without putting any soft objects on the bed
items.core: When the child is still an infant, let him lie face up and sleep on a hard surface that is not tilted. Slanted cradle and baby chair cannot be used as a bed. Adults and children sleep in the same room but not the same bed. Do not put soft things such as pillows, quilts, bed guards, and stuffed toys on the bed. Approximately 3,500 infants die from sleep-related causes each year in the United States alone.
body: Cost: No money. It costs several hundred yuan to replace the mattress with a hard one. The hard part is to resist what your elders say and keep doing this

Benefits: About 3,500 babies die from sleep-related causes in the United States every year. These include sudden infant death syndrome, unknown cause of death and accidental suffocation in bed. The American Academy of Pediatrics' safe sleeping environment is to "sit on your back; use a firm, non-inclined sleep surface; share a room with a different bed; avoid soft bedding and overheating." There are several other things you can do to reduce your risk: breastfeeding, keeping your child away from nicotine and alcohol, getting your vaccinations on time, and using a pacifier
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Moon RY, Carlin RF, Hand I, Task Force on Sudden Infant Death Syndrome and the Committee on Fetus and Newborn (2022). Sleep-Related Infant Deaths: Updated 2022 Recommendations for Reducing Infant Deaths in the Sleep Environment. Pediatrics, 150(1), e2022057990. <https://doi.org/10.1542/peds.2022-057990>

Note: "Don't put any soft things on the bed" means no pillows, quilts, bed guards, plush toys, or shaped pillows. The nursing pillow, which looks very safe, is not included either. Sloping cradles and baby chairs cannot be used as sleeping places. In this section, this matter has the biggest difference, and it is also the most important to withstand the pressure of the elders

Case: New parents put stuffed toys and thick quilts on the crib, and the child's face was buried in the soft objects when sleeping. After seeing the popular science, they cleared the bed surface and placed the baby on a hard bed on his back, in the same room but on a different bed. After that, the baby breathed smoothly and there was no risk of suffocation.

items.title: Get the first shot of hepatitis B vaccine within 24 hours after birth
items.core: The first shot of hepatitis B vaccine should be given to the child within 24 hours after birth. About 95% of people infected with hepatitis B during infancy and early childhood develop chronic hepatitis. Most people who are infected after adulthood will recover on their own, so the earlier this shot is given, the more effective it will be. If the mother is hepatitis B surface antigen positive, the child must also receive hepatitis B immune globulin within 12 hours of birth.
body: Cost: No money. Hepatitis B vaccine is part of the immunization program and is originally free. The child is vaccinated in the hospital on the day he is born, no need to run away

Benefits: The World Health Organization says: "All babies should be vaccinated against hepatitis B as soon as possible after birth (within 24 hours)." The reason is that "about 95% of infections in infancy and early childhood will develop into chronic hepatitis." Most infections in adulthood resolve on their own (without treatment). The WHO's actual words are that "less than 5%" of infections become chronic in adulthood. The National Health Commission's specifications for mother-to-child transmission require that children born to mothers who are positive for hepatitis B surface antigen "receive the first dose of hepatitis B vaccine as soon as possible within 12 hours after birth, and at the same time, 100 international units of hepatitis B immune globulin"
Level of Evidence: A

Source: World Health Organization. Hepatitis B fact sheet. <https://www.who.int/news-room/fact-sheets/detail/hepatitis-b>; General Office of the National Health Commission (2020). Standards for preventing mother-to-child transmission of AIDS, syphilis and hepatitis B (2020 edition). <https://wjw.xinjiang.gov.cn/hfpc/zhgl6/202012/08b7de496f0b40e586d4b99d00cf79c4.shtml> (Reprinted by the Health Commission of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region)

Note: The mother’s hepatitis B surface antigen is positive, and the child must also receive an injection of hepatitis B immune globulin after birth. This matter should be checked clearly during the prenatal check-up. Don’t wait until after the birth to ask. To check for hepatitis B during the mother's prenatal check-up, see Section 27, Article 3 (AIDS, syphilis, and hepatitis B)

Case: The mother was positive for hepatitis B surface antigen. Within 12 hours after the child was born, doctors and nurses gave the baby hepatitis B vaccine and immune globulin. The mother insisted on completing the full course of vaccination. During the 7-month check-up, the child was positive for hepatitis B surface antibody and was not infected with hepatitis B virus.

items.title: According to the national immunization plan, all the vaccines that should be given are free of charge. If you miss it, only the unfinished doses will be made up
items.core: The vaccines in the national immunization plan are free of charge, and the vaccination unit cannot charge money. Vaccination certificates must be checked when children enter day care and school. Those who have missed vaccinations will usually be found out and made up. If you miss a few doses, you only need to make up for the unfinished doses. You don’t have to start over from the beginning, and you can continue to take doses if the manufacturer changes.
body: Cost: No money. The law states that "vaccination units shall not charge any fees for administering the immunization program vaccines." You should go to the vaccination clinic several times according to your age. Keep the vaccination certificate and don’t lose it

Benefits: When children enter daycare or school, daycare institutions and schools must check the vaccination certificate. If it is found that the immunization plan vaccines have not been vaccinated according to regulations, the vaccination unit must be reported, and the guardian must be cooperated to supervise the re-vaccination. Therefore, missed vaccinations will usually be discovered when the vaccination certificate is checked at day care or school. The 2026 version of the procedure is now being implemented. Human papillomavirus (HPV) vaccine has been included in the national immunization program. The starting age for DTP vaccination was changed from 3 months to 2 months. There are 5 doses in total, one dose each at 2 months, 4 months, 6 months, 18 months and 6 years old. School-age children in Tibet, Qinghai, Xinjiang and the Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps will also be routinely vaccinated against Japanese encephalitis from March 2026. Several vaccines can be administered on the same day: all vaccines in the current national immunization program can be administered at the same time according to the immunization schedule or the catch-up principle. Two or more vaccines should be injected at different sites. "It is strictly prohibited to mix two or more vaccines into the same syringe for vaccination." If they are not administered on the same day, the interval between two or more live attenuated vaccines should be no less than 28 days. There is no restriction on the interval between inactivated vaccines, oral live attenuated vaccines and other vaccines. The principle of catch-up vaccination for those under 18 years of age is to catch up as soon as possible. "Only the unfinished doses need to be catch-up, and there is no need to restart the entire vaccination course." The same vaccine can be continued if the manufacturer is changed (National, 2026 version of the procedure)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Standing Committee of the National People's Congress (2019). Vaccine Management Law (Articles 48 and 49). <https://www.samr.gov.cn/zw/zfxxgk/fdzdgknr/fgs/art/2023/art_dde03480953841a5912c864dc29003d0.html> (Reprinted from the website of the State Administration for Market Regulation); National Administration for Disease Control and Prevention, National Health Commission (2026). "National Immunization Program Vaccine Childhood Immunization Procedures and Instructions (2026 Edition)" Interpretation Questions and Answers. <https://www.ndcpa.gov.cn/jbkzzx/c100013/common/content/content_2073002930292035584.html>

Note: The most common misunderstanding is "the child's physical condition is not good, so don't vaccinate first." The official statement is: so-called "allergic constitutions", family members with allergies, or children who have been allergic to food or drugs in the past are not reasons for not being vaccinated. Atopic dermatitis (eczema), urticaria, allergic rhinitis, and bronchial asthma can be treated normally as long as the condition is stable. You can also take it if you are taking anti-allergy medicine or taking inhaled hormones. Physiological jaundice and breast milk jaundice of newborns can also be treated normally. There are only two types of things that really cannot be taken: if you have had an acute severe allergic reaction after taking the same vaccine before, or if you are severely allergic to a known ingredient in the vaccine. Children with immune deficiencies, as well as children who are undergoing chemotherapy, radiotherapy, or taking immunosuppressants, need to be evaluated individually and go to the vaccination clinic to explain the situation before making a decision. For the first shot of hepatitis B, see Article 2. Self-paid non-immunization program vaccines will incur additional vaccine fees and vaccination service fees, which have nothing to do with the free mentioned in this article.

Case: The baby missed the 6-month-old meningitis vaccine due to illness. The mother took him to the vaccination clinic to get the unvaccinated dose without re-injecting the first injection. When the child was admitted to the nursery, all the vaccination certificates passed and the child successfully entered the kindergarten.

items.title: Only feed breast milk for the first 6 months, not even water. From 6 months onwards, add complementary foods and continue breast milk
items.core: Start feeding the child within the first hour after birth. For the first 6 months, I only fed breast milk, not even water. Complementary food should be added from the age of 6 months, and animal foods rich in iron should be provided every day, and breast milk should be fed until 2 years old or longer. If breast milk is not enough or cannot be fed, use formula milk.
body: Cost: No money, but also save money on milk powder. It takes time, and breastfeeding takes up a lot every day. The difficulty is that you have to keep breastfeeding, and you can’t stop breastfeeding for the first 6 months

Benefits: The World Health Organization’s recommendation is to “start breastfeeding within the first hour after birth.” "Exclusive breastfeeding, that is, no other food or fluids, including water," for the first 6 months. Then "start introducing safe and adequate complementary foods from 6 months of age, while continuing to breastfeed until 2 years of age or older." The National Health Commission’s service guidelines also advocate exclusive breastfeeding from 0 to 6 months of age. This guideline also requires that "daily complementary foods must contain iron-rich animal foods" starting from the age of 6 months
Level of Evidence: A

Source: World Health Organization. Breastfeeding. <https://www.who.int/health-topics/breastfeeding>; General Office of the National Health Commission (2024). Infant and Young Child Nutritional Feeding Assessment Service Guidelines (Trial) (National Health Office Maternal and Child Letter [2024] No. 452). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202502/content_7002872.htm>

Note: If you don’t have enough breast milk, or your body doesn’t allow feeding, just use formula milk, don’t feel guilty. The difference between breastfeeding and formula feeding is far smaller than the one about safe sleep. This is the author's judgment. The frequency of supplementary food is according to the service guideline of the National Health Commission: 1 to 2 times a day for 6 to 8 months old, and 2 to 3 times a day for 9 to 12 months old. Daily complementary foods should be chosen from seven categories of food, no less than four categories. When a child has severe eczema or is allergic to eggs, see whether to avoid peanuts. See Article 12 in this section (Don’t avoid peanuts). For mothers who are vegetarians and want to feed their children vegetarian diets, see Article 14 of this section (if you are a vegetarian, take vitamin B12 supplements every day).

Case: The mother fed her baby breast milk one hour after giving birth. She didn’t feed her a drop of water for the first 6 months. She added iron-containing rice cereal and meat paste after 6 months, and continued breastfeeding at the same time. The baby’s height and weight were normal and she rarely got sick.

items.title: Use water above 70°C to prepare milk powder. This is especially true for premature babies, low birth weight and babies under 2 months old. Let it cool before feeding, and throw away the leftovers.
items.core: Milk powder is not sterile and may carry a type of bacteria. 40% to 80% of newborns will die if infected. Pour hot water first and wait until the temperature drops to about 73.8 ℃ before adding milk powder. In most cases, this bacteria can be killed to less than one hundred thousandth of the original number. Hot water will reduce the vitamin C, but the tested milk powder is still of sufficient standard. Rinse and let cool before feeding, and throw away the leftovers.
body: Cost: Nothing. Wait a few minutes each time to let the milk cool down. The difficulty is that when your child cries from hunger, you have to wait for the water temperature to drop before flushing.

Benefits: Milk powder is not sterile and may contain Cronobacter sakazakii. Case fatality rates after neonatal infection have been reported to be 40% to 80%. Experimental research shows: first pour hot water into the bottle, wait until the water temperature drops to about 73.8 ℃, then add milk powder. In most cases, the milk temperature will still be above 70 ℃. This can reduce the bacteria by more than 5 logarithms to less than one hundred thousandth of its original size. The cost of hot water is vitamin C. The WHO and the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations held an expert meeting in 2006. The data seen at the meeting was: when washed with boiling water, only vitamin C was significantly reduced, and the four types of milk powder were reduced by 5.6% to 65.6%. Vitamin C is already added to milk powder when it leaves the factory. The kind that has been reduced the most still contains 9.0 mg per 100 kcal after brewing, which is higher than the lower limit of 8 mg in the international Codex Alimentarius standard. The meeting only saw this study, so no conclusions could be drawn on it. Which children are most at risk: Infants 2 months of age and younger are most at risk from infection, with premature and immunocompromised infants also at higher risk, according to the review by Silano et al. They advocate using 70°C water, "especially when feeding premature and low birth weight babies."
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Beary MA, Daly SE, Baker J, Snyder AB (2025). Assessing Hot Water Reconstitution Instructions and Labeling of Powdered Infant Formula to Ensure Cronobacter spp. Reduction. Journal of Food Protection, 88(9), 100571. <https://doi.org/10.1016/j.jfp.2025.100571>; Sima WG, Legesse T, Girma S, et al. (2025). Emerging microbial risks: Cronobacter sakazakii in powdered infant formula for infants under six months of age in Ethiopia. BMC Microbiology, 26, 307. <https://doi.org/10.1186/s12866-025-04380-y>; World Health Organization & FAO (2007). Safe preparation, storage and handling of powdered infant formula: guidelines. <https://www.who.int/publications/i/item/9789241595414>; Bundesinstitut für Risikobewertung (2022). Recommendations for the hygienic preparation of powdered infant formula. Updated BfR Opinion No. 009/2022. <https://doi.org/10.17590/20220510-104706>; Agostoni C, Axelsson I, Goulet O, et al. (2004). Preparation and handling of powdered infant formula: a commentary by the ESPGHAN Committee on Nutrition. Journal of Pediatric Gastroenterology and Nutrition, 39(4), 320-322. <https://doi.org/10.1097/00005176-200410000-00002>; Silano M, Paganin P, Davanzo R (2016). Time for the 70 °C water precautionary option in the home dilution of powdered infant formula. Italian Journal of Pediatrics, 42, 17. <https://doi.org/10.1186/s13052-016-0228-9>; Losio MN, Pavoni E, Finazzi G, et al. (2018). Preparation of Powdered Infant Formula: Could Product's Safety Be Improved? Journal of Pediatric Gastroenterology and Nutrition, 67(4), 543-546. <https://doi.org/10.1097/MPG.0000000000002100>

Note: Controversy: The opinion of the German Federal Institute for Risk Assessment in 2022 is that full-term healthy children can be flushed with water between 20 and 50 ℃. It mentioned that most manufacturers also write 40 to 50°C on their cans. The reason is that 70°C water cools down quickly when poured into the bottle, and the actual number of bacteria killed is not as calculated. Hot water will also lose some nutrients, and feeding the baby without cooling it will burn the child. In 2004, the European Society of Pediatric Gastroenterology and Hepatology Nutrition also disapproved of using boiling water for fear of destroying vitamins and probiotics added to milk powder. The WHO and the Food and Agriculture Organization of the United Nations still recommend above 70°C. Premature babies, those with a birth weight of less than 2500 grams, those under 2 months old, and those with poor immunity are at the highest risk. They should drink at 70°C, or ask their doctor. This German opinion believes that if full-term healthy children drink according to the temperature on the can, the risk of infection is extremely low. The 70°C threshold comes from public health guidance. The exact words of Beary et al. are “Public health guidance for caregivers of high-risk infants recommends that formula be prepared with water heated to at least 70°C (158°F) to inactivate microorganisms.” Don't use water that has been in a thermos for a day. Don’t leave prepared milk at room temperature, waiting for the next meal.

Case: After the premature baby was born, the mother used hot water above 70℃ to prepare milk powder, let it cool to body temperature before feeding it, and threw away the leftovers immediately. The baby did not develop sepsis during the hospitalization and was discharged successfully.

items.title: Do not feed honey to children under 1 year old
items.core: Do not feed honey to children under 1 year old. Honey water, honey mixed into food supplements, and cakes containing honey all count. Honey may contain bacteria that cause botulism. The flora in adults' stomachs can suppress it, but babies cannot.
body: Cost: No money

Benefits: The U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention says "Do not feed honey to children under 1 year old" because "honey may contain bacteria that cause botulism." Adult gut flora can suppress this spore (the dormant state of this bacteria), but babies cannot
Level of Evidence: A
Source: US CDC. Preventing Botulism. <https://www.cdc.gov/botulism/prevention/index.html>
Note: Things that cannot be fed include honey water, complementary foods mixed with honey, and cakes containing honey.

Case: Grandma wanted to feed a 10-month-old baby with honey to moisten his throat. The mother firmly refused and fed him warm water instead. The baby did not show symptoms of botulism. After he was 1 year old, the mother gradually gave him a small amount of honey.

items.title: Vitamin K shot at birth is a must
items.core: There is very little vitamin K stored in the body of newborns. If they are not supplemented, they may bleed. The kind that appears later is often bleeding in the brain. This prophylaxis is not universal in Tashkent, where 478 per 100,000 births suffer from this type of bleeding. If you take precautions, you can probably reduce your weight by more than 78%. If you give birth at home or in an informal institution, you should take the initiative to ask if you have been vaccinated.
body: Cost: 0 yuan to dozens of yuan. This amount is usually included in the cost of hospital delivery and does not need to be paid separately.

Benefit: Newborns store very little vitamin K in their bodies. Vitamin K deficiency bleeding may occur without supplementation, and the late onset type often presents as intracranial hemorrhage (bleeding in the brain). The consensus recommendation in Belgium is “1 or 2 mg of vitamin K once intramuscularly at birth.” In areas where prevention is not systematically provided, the incidence of vitamin K deficiency bleeding is 478 per 100,000 people. This number comes from 42,000 births in Tashkent. The authors estimate that prevention could reduce the incidence rate by "more than 78.5%."
Level of Evidence: B

Source: Fiesack S, Smits A, Rayyan M, et al. (2021). Nutrients, 13(11), 4109. <https://doi.org/10.3390/nu13114109>; Tursunov D, Yoshida Y, Yrysov K, et al. (2018). Nagoya Journal of Medical Science, 80(1), 11. <https://doi.org/10.18999/nagjms.80.1.11>

Note: When you give birth to a child in a regular hospital in China, the hospital will usually give this injection routinely. This is the author's experience, and I have not found any official regulations that are uniform across the country. Before leaving the hospital, read the discharge summary or ask a question. Those who were born at home or in informal institutions must take the initiative to confirm. The injection mentioned here is injected into the muscle. The Belgian consensus calls oral administration a "lesser alternative" and is only used when parents refuse injections: 2 mg at birth, and 1 to 2 mg per week for breastfed mothers for 3 months

Case: The baby was born at home, and the mother took the initiative to ask the doctor to give a vitamin K injection. After timely supplementation, the child did not suffer from serious symptoms such as intracranial hemorrhage, and everything was normal during the 3-month physical examination.

items.title: If a baby under 3 months old has a temperature of 38°C, go directly to the hospital without observation at home.
items.core: If your child is less than 3 months old and his body temperature reaches 38°C, go directly to the hospital. Do not observe at home, and do not give antipyretics first and then wait and see. The American Academy of Pediatrics has specifically formulated methods for handling febrile babies who appear to be in good spirits, so "looking good" cannot be used as a reason to wait at home. British guidelines also count children under 3 months old with a fever of 38°C as being at high risk for severe illness.
body: Cost: Several hundred yuan for registration and inspection

Benefits: The American Academy of Pediatrics has specific guidelines for full-term infants aged 8 to 60 days who appear to be doing okay. This guideline defines fever as “body temperature ≥38.0°C”. It is divided into three levels according to 8 to 21 days of age, 22 to 28 days of age, and 29 to 60 days of age, each with a processing path. Infants younger than 8 days of age are not covered by this guideline. UK NICE fever guidelines apply to children under 5 years of age. It states that children under 3 months old with a body temperature of 38°C or above belong to the "high-risk group for serious diseases."
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Pantell RH, Roberts KB, Adams WG, et al. (2021). Evaluation and Management of Well-Appearing Febrile Infants 8 to 60 Days Old. Pediatrics, 148(2), e2021052228. <https://doi.org/10.1542/peds.2021-052228>; NICE (2019, 2021 update). Fever in under 5s: assessment and initial management (NG143), 1.2.12. <https://www.nice.org.uk/guidance/ng143/chapter/Recommendations>

Note: In children of this age, serious bacterial infections may only present with fever. Therefore, looking "in good spirits" cannot be used as a reason to observe at home. Don’t give yourself antipyretics first and then wait and see.

Case: The 2-month-old baby's temperature was 38.2°C at night and he seemed to be in good spirits. However, his mother took him directly to the hospital. It was found that he had a urinary tract infection. Antibiotics were used in time and it did not develop into sepsis.

items.title: No matter how tired or angry you are, never shake the baby
items.core: The baby's head is large and the neck is weak. Shaking him hard could cause bleeding in his brain and eyes, which could kill him or leave him with a lifelong disability. Gently rocking when coaxing you to sleep does not count, what is dangerous is uncontrollable violent shaking. When the fire is almost gone, put the child back in the crib, walk away for a few minutes, and let him cry for a while, which is safer than holding him and rocking him.
body: Cost: Nothing. The difficulty lies in stopping when you are too tired and angry

Benefits: The baby has a large head and weak neck muscles. Violent shaking can cause intracranial hemorrhages and retinal hemorrhages (bleeding in the brain and eyes), which can be fatal or leave lifelong disabilities. The gentle rocking when coaxing you to sleep does not count, the dangerous thing is the violent shaking out of control. Medically speaking, injuries caused by shaking and impact are called "abusive head trauma." It is the leading cause of death from head trauma in children under 2 years of age. In the United States, it killed nearly 2,250 children under the age of 5 from 1999 to 2014
Level of Evidence: B

Source: Spies EL, Klevens J (2016). Fatal Abusive Head Trauma Among Children Aged <5 Years — United States, 1999–2014. MMWR 65(20):505-509. <https://doi.org/10.15585/mmwr.mm6520a1>; Choudhary AK et al (2018). Consensus statement on abusive head trauma in infants and young children. Pediatric Radiology 48(8):1048-1065. <https://doi.org/10.1007/s00247-018-4149-1>

Note: At the moment when you really want to lose control, put your child back in the crib and walk away for a few minutes. It is much safer to let him cry for a while than to hold him in your hands and rock him. People who are raising children alone and don’t get enough sleep for a long time should remember this the most. How to deal with your own emotions, see Section 3

Case: The father was so annoyed by the crying baby that he lost control and shook it a few times. He was very frightened afterwards. When he felt irritated, he put the baby back in the crib and walked away for a few minutes. There was no shaking again. The baby showed no signs of cerebral hemorrhage.

items.title: Regardless of the brand of diapers, there are three things to look at: whether they fit well, whether they are changed frequently, and whether they have been notified of random inspections.
items.core: No official organization has ranked "which brand is best." There are only two things that can be checked: the product quality sampling inspection report of the State Administration for Market Regulation, and the investigation of specific incidents by the regulatory authorities. Expensive does not mean safe, and imported does not mean qualified. First buy a small package and try it for a week to see if your child has red buttocks or strangulation marks, and then stock up if it suits you.
body: Cost: It ranges from two to three hundred to several thousand yuan per month, depending on which grade you choose.

Income: No official organization has published a ranking of "which brand is the best", so this book does not recommend brands. There are only two types of information that can be verified. The first category is the product quality inspection notification from the State Administration for Market Regulation. The other type is the investigation of specific incidents by regulatory authorities. After the "formamide issue in infant diapers" attracted attention in June 2026, the State Administration for Market Regulation took the lead in setting up a joint investigation team to verify
Evidence level: C

Source: State Administration for Market Regulation (2026-06-22). The State Administration for Market Regulation took the lead in setting up a joint investigation team to check the "formamide issue in infant diapers": "In response to the "formamide issue in infant diapers" reported by the media, the State Administration for Market Regulation, the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, the National Health Commission, and the National Administration of Disease Control and Prevention attached great importance to it and established a joint investigation team to verify the issues related to formamide in infant diapers and handle them in accordance with the law. The relevant situation will be announced in a timely manner." <https://www.samr.gov.cn/xw/zj/art/2026/art_78c0425db7604b27bd7a3f36ba319975.html>; Reprinted from the Chinese Government website. <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/202606/content_7072931.htm>; NHS. Nappy rash (reviewed on 2026-08-28). <https://www.nhs.uk/baby/caring-for-a-newborn/nappy-rash/>

Note: When the joint investigation team was established, it only said that "the relevant situation will be announced in a timely manner." As of September 30, 2026, the conclusion of this investigation has not been found on the official website of the State Administration for Market Regulation and in recent national supervisory spot inspection notices. How to actually buy it: Expensive does not mean safe, and imported does not mean qualified. First buy a small package and try it for a week to see if your child has red buttocks or strangulation marks, and then stock up if it suits you. These sentences are based on the author's experience. According to the British NHS, the common causes of red buttocks are covering urine and feces on the skin for too long, not changing frequently enough, and diapers rubbing the skin. Some non-absorbent and non-breathable diapers can also cause it. The NHS also recommends that nappies should fit well and not be too tight. Please refer to Section 5 for the method of reporting random inspections.

Case: My mother bought expensive imported diapers, and the baby's buttocks were red. Later, she changed them to ordinary brands in small packages for trial use. Pay attention to changing them frequently, and checked the brand's sampling inspection qualification records. The baby's buttocks recovered quickly.

items.title: For large items, consider them in the order of "borrow, buy second-hand, buy new", don't buy them all at once; buy new mattresses, check second-hand safety seats before using them
items.core: Strollers, quilts, and toys will be used for a short period of time, so borrow them first. If they cannot be borrowed, buy them second-hand, and then buy new ones last. Second-hand safety seats must be confirmed that they have not been involved in serious car accidents, have not been recalled, and have all parts. If you cannot confirm, don’t use it. In a Scottish study, people who slept on mattresses that had been used by other children had a higher risk of sudden death, but it was unclear whether the mattress was to blame. It’s best to buy new mattresses.
body: Cost: No extra money, savings usually measured in thousands of dollars. It’s hard to resist not getting everything together at once

Benefits: Strollers, cribs, quilts, and toys have a short useful life, and the supply on the second-hand market far exceeds demand. Second-hand goods must maintain three safety boundaries. The first one is the safety seat. The National Highway Traffic Safety Administration recommends that seats that have been involved in moderate or severe car accidents should be replaced and never used again. A minor collision is considered a minor collision if all five conditions are met, and the seat can be reused. The five items are: the car can drive away by itself, the door closest to the seat is not broken, no one in the car is injured, the air bag does not deploy, and there is no visible damage on the seat. Second-hand seats must confirm five items before they can be used. The five items are: it has not been involved in any serious car accidents, the production date and model are on the label, it has not been recalled, the parts are complete, and the manual is still there. The production date and model are used to check recalls and check whether the seat is too old. The second item is the mattress. There was a study in Scotland that compared babies who died suddenly with healthy babies of the same age and looked back at what kind of mattress they slept on. Sleeping on another child's mattress was associated with a higher risk of sudden infant death syndrome (odds ratio OR 3.07, 95% CI 1.51–6.22). It’s 4.78 when the mattress comes from someone else’s house, and 1.64 when it comes from your own, which isn’t really a difference. The authors say the available evidence is insufficient to determine whether the mattress itself is to blame. The third item is the crib. The United States will implement new mandatory standards for cribs from June 28, 2011, and second-hand cribs must also comply. The traditional side guardrail that can be moved up and down has been eliminated. The U.S. Consumer Product Safety Commission said that old beds have to be dismantled and tested to know whether they are qualified or not, so they can't provide any self-inspection methods. Between November 2007 and April 2010, 147 deaths related to standard-size cribs were reported in the United States. Thirty-five of the cases were related to structural problems with the beds, and 18 were related to malfunctions with the lowering side rails. Loose screws were responsible for at least 10 deaths. U.S. law classifies recumbent baby carrycots as prohibited items, regardless of the year they were produced, and they will be included in regulatory regulations in 2023 (U.S., U.K.)
Evidence level: C

Source: The part about saving money is based on the author’s experience, no direct literature; US NHTSA. Car Seat Use After a Crash. <https://www.nhtsa.gov/car-seats-and-booster-seats/car-seat-use-after-crash>; US NHTSA. Used Car Seat Safety Checklist. <https://www.nhtsa.gov/car-seats-and-booster-seats/used-car-seat-safety-checklist>; Tappin D, Brooke H, Ecob R, Gibson A (2002). Used infant mattresses and sudden infant death syndrome in Scotland: case-control study. BMJ, 325(7371), 1007. <https://doi.org/10.1136/bmj.325.7371.1007>; Blair P, Fleming P, Smith I (1997). Case-control study of sudden infant death syndrome in Scotland. Income level or bed sharing would confound any effect of previous use of mattress. BMJ, 315(7111), 812. <https://doi.org/10.1136/bmj.315.7111.812a>; US Consumer Product Safety Commission (2010). Safety Standards for Full-Size Baby Cribs and Non-Full-Size Baby Cribs; Final Rule. Federal Register 2010-32178. US Consumer Product Safety Commission (2023). Ban of Inclined Sleepers for Infants. Federal Register 2023-17350. <https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2023/08/16/2023-17350/ban-of-inclined-sleepers-for-infants>; See Section 5 for impulse spending

Note: The level of evidence is still C because there is no literature on the money-saving half. The three security borders each have their origins, but they are all from the United States and the United Kingdom. There is no official official reminder on second-hand cribs and second-hand safety seats in China. There were objections to the mattress study: In 1997, academics wrote in saying that household income and co-sleeping confounded the effects of second-hand mattresses. Why use a safety seat when riding in a car? See Section 1, Article 10 (Safety Seat). For information on how the baby sleeps and what to put on the bed, see item 1 of this section (sleeping on the back). This book does not recommend or disapprove of confinement clubs, early childhood education classes, and infant swimming pools. But they are a lot of money that can be spent or not, and the 24-hour cooling-off period mentioned in Section 5 applies

Case: My mother borrowed the stroller and quilt from a colleague. She used the second-hand safety seat after checking that it had no accident and recall records. She bought a new mattress and saved money. The baby sleeps safely and comfortably.

items.title: If your child has severe eczema or egg allergy, don't avoid peanuts. Add them early as directed by your doctor, but never feed them whole
items.core: In the trial, babies with severe eczema or egg allergy started eating peanuts regularly between 4 and 11 months old. Skin tests initially showed no reaction, but by the age of 5, 1.9% of those who had eaten peanuts were allergic and 13.7% of those who had avoided it. The skin test showed some reaction, with 10.6% of those eating and 35.3% hiding. Take your child to see a doctor before adding it, and never feed whole peanuts.
body: Cost: A few dozen yuan for a jar of peanut butter. Feed a few times a week, just do it as you go. Before joining, you should take your child to see a doctor for an evaluation.

Benefits: UK LEAP randomized trial. 640 infants were enrolled if they had severe eczema, egg allergy, or both. 4 to 11 months of age at enrollment. Randomly divided into two groups, one group regularly ate peanut products and one group completely avoided it, and the peanut allergy rate was observed by 60 months of age. Among the 530 people with negative peanut skin test at the time of enrollment, 13.7% in the avoidance group and 1.9% in the eating group were allergic (P<0.001). Among the 98 people who had weakly positive skin tests at the time of enrollment, 35.3% were in the avoidance group and 10.6% were in the eating group (P=0.004). There were no differences in serious adverse events between the two groups.
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Du Toit G, Roberts G, Sayre PH, et al (2015). Randomized trial of peanut consumption in infants at risk for peanut allergy. New England Journal of Medicine, 372(9), 803-813. <https://doi.org/10.1056/NEJMoa1414850>; General Office of the National Health Commission (2020). Core information on infant and young child feeding health education. <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2020-08/01/content_5531915.htm>; Perkin MR et al (2016). Randomized Trial of Introduction of Allergenic Foods in Breast-Fed Infants. New England Journal of Medicine, 374(18), 1733-1743. <https://doi.org/10.1056/NEJMoa1514210> (The general infant test EAT in the notes)

Note: The ** form can only be peanut butter diluted or peanut powder mixed into complementary food, and whole peanuts must not be given. **The core feeding information of the National Health Commission is very clear: "Whole peanuts, nuts, jelly and other foods can easily be inhaled into the trachea and cause suffocation, and infants and young children should avoid eating them." What to do if the baby is choked? For those under 1 year old, see Section 13, Article 43 (the baby is choked and unable to cry); for those over 1 year old, see Section 13, Article 26 (for someone who is choked and unable to speak). It's only suitable for high-risk kids: those with severe eczema, or those who are already allergic to eggs. **You must see a doctor for evaluation before adding, do not try it at home**: A skin test was performed on each child before enrollment in the LEAP trial. Children with skin test reactions greater than 4 mm were excluded from the trial and were not allowed to eat. The evidence for children in general is much weaker. In another trial of 1,162 normally breastfed infants, calculated by group, 5.6% of the early-introduction group and 7.1% of the conventional group had food allergies. The difference was not significant (P=0.32); it was significant only among the children who actually achieved it (2.4% vs. 7.3%). This algorithm tends to overstate the effect. The author himself said that the effectiveness cannot be proven by group calculation, but it also shows that it is safe to introduce it early. China's official feeding documents currently do not say whether to introduce or avoid allergenic foods early, so this article is based on international test evidence. Please also pay attention to the timing: LEAP starts at 4 months of age, while in China, complementary food is introduced after 6 months of age. See Article 4 of this section (only breast milk is given for the first 6 months). At what age and how to start treatment for high-risk children, follow the doctor's advice.

Case: The baby has severe eczema. After evaluation, the doctor recommended adding peanuts from 6 months old. The mother diluted the peanut butter and fed it regularly. By the time she was 5 years old, the skin test was negative and she was not allergic to peanuts.

items.title: Keep an eye on several signs of neonatal jaundice: if it becomes jaundice within 24 hours after birth, if it becomes yellowish within 24 hours of birth, if it cannot be woken up and does not feed, go to the emergency room of the hospital immediately on the same day; if it becomes more and more yellow and if the stool becomes white, go for a check-up as soon as possible
items.core: More than 80% of newborns will be a little yellow. If the baby becomes yellow less than 24 hours after birth, or if the baby becomes bloated at the same time and is more drowsy than usual, unable to wake up, not feeding, or the body becomes soft or hard, you should go to the hospital immediately. If the stool becomes more and more yellow after 24 hours, or the color of the stool becomes white, you should also get checked as soon as possible. White stool may be a sign of biliary atresia. Too high bilirubin can damage the brain and leave a lifelong disability.
body: Cost: Register and add bilirubin test, within a few hundred yuan. If you need blue light, it usually takes about two days in the hospital. It’s hard to make this trip even when the baby looks fine

Benefits: The American Academy of Pediatrics’ 2022 guidelines say that “more than 80% of newborns will have some degree of jaundice.” Too high bilirubin can cause acute bilirubin encephalopathy and kernicterus. The guidelines say kernicterus is a "permanently disabling neurological disease." Its manifestations include cerebral palsy with involuntary twisting of hands and feet, inability to see upward, hypoplasia of enamel in deciduous teeth, and hearing loss. The guidelines list "presence of jaundice within 24 hours of birth" as a risk factor for developing severe jaundice. The British National Health Service (NHS) has two levels of advice for parents. The first step is to call the emergency phone or go directly to the emergency room. At this level, the child has jaundice and is drowsier than usual or unable to wake up, does not feed, has a soft or hard body, and has twitching. Children with jaundice less than 24 hours after birth are also included in this category. The second step is to make an appointment with a doctor as soon as possible. This stage is when the baby is more than 24 hours old, the jaundice is not getting better or is getting worse, the urine is dark yellow or brown, or the stool is light cream color. Globally, it is estimated that about 480,000 newborns suffered from Rh hemolytic disease (caused by blood group incompatibility between mother and child) or very severe hyperbilirubinemia in 2010. 24% of these children died and 13% developed kernicterus. More than 83% of children who survive kernicterus are left with one or more disabilities. White stools may be due to biliary atresia, a disease that requires Kasai surgery within 60 days for significantly better treatment results. Since 2004, Taiwan has printed stool color charts into every newborn's child health handbook. The proportion of patients undergoing surgery within 60 days increased from 60% in 2004 to 74.3% in 2005. In another nationwide study in Taiwan, after the implementation of color comparison cards, the mortality rate of children with biliary atresia dropped from 26.2% to 15.9%. This is a before-and-after comparison, not a group trial
Level of Evidence: B

Source: Kemper AR, Newman TB, Slaughter JL, et al. (2022). Clinical Practice Guideline Revision: Management of Hyperbilirubinemia in the Newborn Infant 35 or More Weeks of Gestation. Pediatrics, 150(3), e2022058859. <https://doi.org/10.1542/peds.2022-058859>; NHS. Jaundice in babies (reviewed on 2026-03-24). <https://www.nhs.uk/conditions/jaundice-newborn/>; NICE (2010, revised 2023). Jaundice in newborn babies under 28 days (CG98), 1.2.6, 1.7.1. <https://www.nice.org.uk/guidance/cg98/chapter/Recommendations>; Bhutani VK, Zipursky A, Blencowe H, et al. (2013). Neonatal hyperbilirubinemia and Rhesus disease of the newborn: incidence and impairment estimates for 2010 at regional and global levels. Pediatric Research, 74(Suppl) 1), 86-100. <https://doi.org/10.1038/pr.2013.208>; Hsiao CH, Chang MH, Chen HL, et al. (2008). Universal screening for biliary atresia using an infant stool color card in Taiwan. Hepatology, 47(4), 1233-1240. <https://doi.org/10.1002/hep.22182>; Lee M, Chen SC, Yang HY, et al. (2016). Infant Stool Color Card Screening Helps Reduce the Hospitalization Rate and Mortality of Biliary Atresia: A 14-Year Nationwide Cohort Study in Taiwan. Medicine, 95(12), e3166. <https://doi.org/10.1097/MD.0000000000003166>; National Health and Family Planning Commission (2017). National Basic Public Health Service Standards (Third Edition), Health Management Service Standards for Children Aged 0-6. <https://www.nhc.gov.cn/ewebeditor/uploadfile/2017/04/20170417104506514.pdf>

Note: Blue light (light therapy) uses special light on the child's skin to change the bilirubin into a form that is easily excreted. Don’t sunbathe at home instead: The American Academy of Pediatrics says sunbathing is difficult to do safely without getting burned, so it’s not recommended as a treatment. Do not feed water or glucose solution to reduce yellowing. This guideline clearly does not recommend it. You can't tell how high the bilirubin is by looking at the depth of yellow with the naked eye. The British NICE guidelines state that you should not rely solely on your naked eyes. If you are not sure, go for a test. Children born before 38 weeks, whose older siblings have been exposed to blue light, and who do not receive enough breast milk are more likely to develop severe yellowing. The re-examination is carried out in accordance with the national basic public health service standards: within 1 week after discharge, medical staff will visit the patient's home. 28 to 30 days after birth, go to the community health service center or township health center for follow-up. I had to look for jaundice both times. When I was discharged from the hospital, the doctor made another appointment for a review of bilirubin, so I went as scheduled. If a full-term baby is jaundiced for more than 14 days, and a premature baby is more than 21 days old, NICE guidelines require a check of conjugated bilirubin and whether the stool is white. Jaundice itself does not delay vaccination, see Article 3 (Vaccines) of this section. Newborn screening is provided in Section 27, Item 13 (Heel Blood Screening).

Case: The baby was only 20 hours old. The mother found that he was golden all over, refused to wake up no matter how hard he was shaken, and immediately called the doctor. A blood test showed that the bilirubin was 348umol/L. He immediately performed a blood transfusion and treated with transfusion, and the situation was over. No brain damage was left.

items.title: If you are on a vegetarian diet during pregnancy or breastfeeding, take vitamin B12 supplements or eat fortified foods; your child's complementary foods must include animal foods, and if you must go vegan, consult a doctor first
items.core: Vitamin B12 is almost only found in meat, eggs, and milk. Those who eat a vegan diet must rely on fortified foods or supplements. If the mother eats a vegetarian diet and does not take supplements, the breastfed child will easily become deficient. Children often have problems when they are 4 to 8 months old: they do not grow up and develop behind, and if the delay lasts for a long time, the nerve damage may not be repaired. Children's complementary foods should include animal foods every day.
body: Cost: A bottle of vitamin B12 supplement costs tens of yuan, and you need to take one pill every day. It doesn’t cost much to add eggs, meat, and fish to children’s complementary foods. The difficulty is that when the whole family believes that being vegetarian is healthier, they have to change their minds

Gains: The CDC reported two children in 2003. Both were raised breastfed by vegetarian mothers. Both were deficient in vitamin B12, and both were stunted and developmentally delayed. The mother of her first child has been vegan for 7 years. The child was hospitalized when he was 15 months old and was diagnosed with severe anemia. A brain MRI showed global brain atrophy. The child improved after B12 supplementation, but by 32 months, speech and language were still lagging behind. The report states that the most common cause of B12 deficiency in infants and young children is a lack of it in the mother's diet. Breastfed babies usually develop symptoms between 4 and 8 months of age. If the deficiency lasts for a long time, some children will be left with irreversible neurological damage. The severity depends on how severe the deficiency is and how long it lasts. The only reliable sources that do not rely on fortification are animal foods: meat, dairy, and eggs. Most of the B12 found naturally in plants is not used by the human body. Cereals, soy milk, and nutritional yeast fortified with B12 can be used as stable sources.
