What you can do is: when choosing a skill, check whether it has corresponding national occupational standards and level channels. Only skills with channels can get salary increases based on levels later. There are no "skills" that are graded and have no industry entry threshold. You can only find a job on your own after learning

Case: Sister Li, who wanted to change careers, checked the directory of the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security before signing up, and found that there are national occupational standards for "nursing caregivers" and they are divided into five levels to one level. After she obtained the senior certificate, the local policy stipulated that the salary of senior workers should be no less than the intermediate level. Based on her grade, she successfully joined a confinement nanny company, and her basic salary was directly increased by 2,000.

items.title: Don't take "high wages online" as a shortage of people. Check the local in-demand occupation directory (training demand directory, job shortage ranking) and subsidy directory
items.core: The training subsidies for which types of jobs are more generous in various places are determined according to the degree of urgent need and training costs, so the amount of subsidies can tell whether there is a shortage of people in the local area. What is said online about "how much is the monthly salary for a certain type of work" is mostly the price listed on recruitment platforms or personal self-reports. What you see are mostly people who make money, and they don’t include working hours, commuting, occupational diseases, and off-peak seasons.
body: Cost: No money. Check two local documents.

Benefit: The subsidy amount itself is the official pricing of "which types of jobs are in short supply." The policy requires "improving a differentiated subsidy mechanism determined based on the urgent shortage of occupations (types of work), training costs, etc.," and each locality determines the scope of local subsidized vocational skills training projects accordingly. Therefore, the difference in subsidy amounts for the same type of work in different cities directly reflects the local shortage. The same opinion also requires that local human resources and social security departments "accelerate the study and determination of the guidance catalog for vocational skills training needs in sub-industry areas, publish it regularly and adjust it dynamically"
Evidence level: C

Source: State Council Leading Group for Employment Promotion and Labor Protection (2025). Guidance on carrying out large-scale vocational skills improvement training actions. <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202507/content_7032222.htm>; National Bureau of Statistics (2026). The average annual salary of employees in urban units in 2025: "The average annual salary of employees in enterprises above designated size is 106,080 yuan, including 210,016 yuan for middle-level and above management personnel, 155,491 yuan for professional and technical personnel, 94,936 yuan for office staff and related personnel, 79,857 yuan for social production service and life service personnel, and 80,739 yuan for production, manufacturing and related personnel." <https://www.stats.gov.cn/sj/zxfb/202605/t20260515_1963707.html>; Employment Training Technical Guidance Center of the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security (2023). Ranking of the 100 "most lacking jobs" in which national recruitment is greater than job hunting in the fourth quarter of 2022 (China Employment Network). <https://chinajob.mohrss.gov.cn/c/2023-01-30/367442.shtml>

Note: The official salary by occupation is only divided into five major categories of positions, and there is no specific type of work. Figures from the National Bureau of Statistics for 2025 are that the average annual salary for enterprises above designated size is about 106,000 yuan (accurate value: 106,080 yuan). The middle-level and above management personnel are about 210,000 yuan (accurate value is 210,016 yuan), professional and technical personnel are about 155,000 yuan (accurate value is 155,491 yuan), service personnel are 94,936 yuan, production and manufacturing personnel are 80,739 yuan, and social production and life service personnel are 79,857 yuan. The Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security's "Ranking of the 100 Most Unemployed Occupations" can be found on the China Employment Network. The latest issue is in the fourth quarter of 2022. The ranking is compiled based on recruitment and job search data from public employment service agencies in 102 cities across the country. "How much is the monthly income for a certain type of job" circulated on the Internet almost all comes from the listing price on recruitment platforms or personal self-reports. Most of the people you can see are the people who make money, and that doesn't include working hours, commuting, occupational diseases, and off-peak seasons. To see the real demand, go to the official website of the local Social Security Bureau to check the subsidy catalog, and then check the job demand rankings of public employment service agencies. Finally, go to actual construction sites, factories, and stores and ask working people

Case: Xiao Wang saw on the Internet that "a drone pilot can earn 30,000 yuan a month." He checked the local directory and found that the subsidy was only 300 yuan and there was no shortage mark. He turned to the city's Bureau of Human Resources and Social Security's job shortage rankings and chose an "electrician" with a subsidy of RMB 2,000. After joining the job, he found that although the listed price was low, the working hours were stable, making him more reliable than a pilot.

items.title: For the same money and time, give priority to short-cycle projects that can be directly employed
items.core: The policy encourages "short-term and fast" training that can lead to short-term employment, as well as micro-majors in vocational schools. When choosing a project, just look at one thing: Is there a specific position you can submit your resume to after completing your studies? If you study for a year and a half and then "acquire more experience" after graduation, the actual time spent far exceeds the price tag. Write down the exit conditions before starting work: stop before you find a job after learning a certain level.
body: Cost: You have to pay tuition for short-term courses, which is not much money. It takes a while. The difficulty is to stop according to the promised conditions when you have learned halfway and haven’t seen results yet.

Benefits: The policy caliber is consistent with this: support "private training institutions to carry out market-oriented high-quality vocational skills training projects and "short-term, fast" vocational skills training projects that can achieve employment in the short term." At the same time, we promote vocational colleges to "focus on the knowledge and skills that are urgently needed in the job market... and open micro-majors and vocational ability training courses"
Evidence level: C

Source: State Council Leading Group for Employment Promotion and Labor Protection (2025). Guidance on carrying out large-scale vocational skills improvement training actions. <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202507/content_7032222.htm>

Note: There is only one criterion for judging: after completing the course, is there a specific position for which you can apply for a resume. The actual cost of a program that takes a year and a half to "accumulate experience" after graduation is much higher than the listed price. The exit conditions mentioned in Section 4 also apply: write down clearly before starting work, "I will stop before I find a job after learning to a certain extent."

Case: Zhang Wei, who was unemployed, gave up the two-year "chef class" and chose the community's free "home-cooking short-term training" project. He set a stop-loss point: If he didn't find a job as a kitchen helper after one month of studying, he would change careers. As a result, within three weeks, he applied for a job as a waiter in a fast food restaurant and started working directly to get paid.

items.title: After studying, close the book and test it yourself. Don’t go back and reread
items.core: It is more effective to close the book and test yourself once than to read it again after finishing it. Small tests were added to the class, and the improvement in grades was moderate. When ranking the ten commonly used study methods, self-assessment ranks at the highest level. After reading a section, write down the main points silently, and then read it back.
body: Cost: No money and no increase in total time. Change the time that was originally used for re-reading to closing the book and writing or solving questions. The difficulty is that the self-assessment exposes what I didn’t remember on the spot, which feels more uncomfortable than re-reading.

Benefit: Meta-analysis of 222 independent studies, 48,478 students: In-class testing improves student academic performance, with a medium effect size (g = 0.499). The effect size is affected by several conditions: what learning method was used in the control group, whether the test format was consistent with the final exam, whether the materials matched, and whether corrective feedback was given. There are also how many times the test was repeated, where and when it was administered, how long the intervention lasted, and what experimental design was used. Another review that evaluated ten common learning methods one by one rated "practice testing" and "distributed practice" as high utility. The reason is that they are effective for learners of different ages and abilities, and have been verified in various assessment forms and real education scenarios.
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Yang C, Luo L, Vadillo MA, Yu R, Shanks DR (2021). Testing (quizzing) boosts classroom learning: A systematic and meta-analytic review. Psychological Bulletin, 147(4), 399–435. <https://doi.org/10.1037/bul0000309>; Dunlosky J, Rawson KA, Marsh EJ, Nathan MJ, Willingham DT (2013). Improving Students' Learning With Effective Learning Techniques: Promising Directions From Cognitive and Educational Psychology. Psychological Science in the Public Interest, 14(1), 4–58. <https://doi.org/10.1177/1529100612453266>

Note: The self-assessment is to force things out of the mind and is not scored. Method: After reading a section, close the book and write down the key points silently, then turn back to correct them. Corrective feedback is more effective, so after correcting the answer, you need to see where the mistake was. The benefit magnitude is recorded as "large" and is judged based on effect size and rating. These two pieces of evidence measure grades, not hours, so they do not meet the time-saving threshold. Self-assessment and item 15 (spread the same time over several days) are the two highest rated items in the same review and work together.

Case: A student preparing for the postgraduate examination originally read the professional course textbooks two or three times a day, with average results. Later, he changed to closing the book and dictating key points after each chapter, asking and answering questions, and then flipping through the book to check. After a month, his simulation test scores improved significantly and his memory became stronger.

items.title: Spread the same time over several days, don’t study it all at once
items.core: Spread the same time over several days, and remember it better than studying it all at once. There is also a practical rule: as long as you want to remember, the review interval should be as long as possible. The farther you go in the exam, the longer the interval, but the study does not give a general number for the specific number of days.
body: Cost: No money and the total time remains the same. What has changed is the arrangement: the same 3 hours, divided into three days of 1 hour each. The difficulty lies in starting a few days in advance and not leaving it until the last night.

Benefits: A meta-analysis of 184 articles, 317 experiments, and 839 evaluations of the effects of distributed practice. It compares two things: studying together versus studying several times apart (the spacing effect), and short versus long gaps (the delay effect). The conclusion is that the review interval and "how long to remember" jointly determine the retention rate of the final test: the longer the retention time, the longer the review interval that can bring about the best retention rate. Another review that evaluated ten common learning methods one by one rated distributed practice as high utility.
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Cepeda NJ, Pashler H, Vul E, Wixted JT, Rohrer D (2006). Distributed practice in verbal recall tasks: A review and quantitative synthesis. Psychological Bulletin, 132(3), 354–380. <https://doi.org/10.1037/0033-2909.132.3.354>; Dunlosky J, Rawson KA, Marsh EJ, Nathan MJ, Willingham DT (2013). Improving Students' Learning With Effective Learning Techniques. Psychological Science in the Public Interest, 14(1), 4–58. <https://doi.org/10.1177/1529100612453266>

Remarks: and 14 It is best to use stacking strips (closed book self-test): spread the self-test itself over several days. Most of the materials in Cepeda's meta-analysis were about word list memory, and no universal number of days was given for the optimal interval for complex content. "The farther you go in the exam, the longer the interval" is the rule given in the original article, and there is no specific schedule. The problem with surprises the night before an exam is not that they are useless on the spot, but that they are forgotten quickly.

Case: Chen Chen, who is preparing for the exam, split the "Elementary Accounting Practice" into four parts and reviewed it in four days instead of staying up all night before the exam. She also extended the review interval by "mock exam one week after the exam". As a result, the memory retention rate of the broken time was much higher than that of previous assaults, and it passed smoothly.

items.title: Don’t regard highlighting, reading repeatedly, and writing summaries as the main learning methods
items.core: The most commonly used methods by students are highlighting and reading repeatedly, but in the ranking of the ten commonly used learning methods, these two are at the lowest level. Writing abstracts, memorizing key words, and imagining pictures to illustrate the text are also at the lowest level. They are not completely useless, but the conditions under which they work are too narrow. It would be more cost-effective to replace them with self-tests in the same amount of time.
body: Cost: No money, but time saving. The difficulty lies in the fact that these are the easiest to do and also give the best feeling of "I am learning".

Benefit: A review of ten commonly used learning methods, rated according to "whether the effect can be generalized across learning conditions, student characteristics, materials, and assessment formats." The highest rated categories were practice tests and distributed exercises. Rated as the medium level are detailed questioning, self-explanation, and interleaved practice. The five categories rated at the lowest level are: writing summaries, highlighting (or underlining), key word memorization, imagining the text with pictures, and repeated reading. The review states: Most students say they use repeated reading and highlighting, but these two methods cannot steadily improve their grades. The review suggested that other methods should be replaced, such as using practice tests instead of repeated readings.
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Dunlosky J, Rawson KA, Marsh EJ, Nathan MJ, Willingham DT (2013). Improving Students' Learning With Effective Learning Techniques: Promising Directions From Cognitive and Educational Psychology. Psychological Science in the Public Interest, 14(1), 4–58. <https://doi.org/10.1177/1529100612453266>

Note: It does not mean that underlining is not allowed. Underlining can be used to "mark out which areas you want to test yourself on later." The problem is that underlining itself is regarded as learning. The review also shows that the lowest level is not equal to zero, but the conditions for it to work are narrow and more research is needed. For alternative actions, see Item 14 (close the book and test yourself) and Item 15 (spread the same time over several days).

Case: Xiao Lin, a sophomore, is used to marking out the textbooks and reading his notes over and over again. He thinks he studies very hard, but his final grades are mediocre. Later, he changed the time for focusing on key points to self-assessment with a combined book. With the same study time, he mastered the knowledge points more solidly and his grades improved a lot.

items.title: Mix up several types of questions and do twenty of them in a row
items.core: Do a bunch of questions of the same type in a row and do it smoothly on the spot. If you practice several types of questions randomly, the long-term effect will be better, which is of medium magnitude. But this method requires materials: materials such as recognizing painters' styles and looking at pictures are most effective. The math questions are smaller, and memorizing words is not as good as practicing in chunks.
body: Cost: Nothing. Change the exercise book from doing the questions in order to shuffling them. The difficulty is that the accuracy rate on the spot is even lower if you practice in a mixed way, which feels like a step back.

Benefits: A multilevel meta-analysis including 59 studies, 238 effect sizes, and 158 samples. The overall effect of interleaved practice relative to blocked practice was moderate (Hedges' g = 0.42). In terms of materials, painting is the best (g = 0.67), and other visual materials are also better. The effect size was smaller for the math task (g = 0.34). The overall effect of explanatory text and taste material was not significant. In the vocabulary category, it is better to practice in chunks (g = −0.39). Regression analysis shows that the more similar the categories are, the more dissimilar they are within the same category, and the more complex the materials, the greater the benefits of interleaving.
Level of Evidence: A
Source: Brunmair M, Richter T (2019). Similarity matters: A meta-analysis of interleaved learning and its moderators. Psychological Bulletin, 145(11), 1029–1052. <https://doi.org/10.1037/bul0000209>

Remarks: No. 16 The review cited by Article (Don’t Treat Focusing as the Main Learning Method) rated interleaved practice as a mid-range exercise because there wasn’t enough research at the time. Taken together, there is a mixture of content that requires "recognizing which category it is and which method to use", such as math question types, cases, and applicable laws. The content that needs to be memorized is divided into chunks, such as vocabulary and noun explanations.

Case: A painting student practiced identifying the style of a painter. He started practicing only true and false questions on the same type of works for a week in a row. The accuracy rate was very high, but he made mistakes when changing questions. Later, he mixed and mixed questions from different painters and different periods to practice. Although he found it difficult on the spot, the long-term memory effect was obviously better.

items.title: Don’t choose learning based on the "I am a visual type, he is an auditory type"
items.core: Many people believe that everyone has their own learning style, such as visual or auditory, and only by teaching according to style can you learn well. There are very few studies that have seriously examined this, almost none supporting it, and a few finding the opposite. People do have preferences, but there is no evidence that you will learn better if you take classes according to your preferences, without spending money on style assessments.
body: Cost: No money. I just no longer choose materials and courses based on this category, and I no longer spend money on style assessments.

Benefits: A review of the evidence commissioned to assess learning styles points out that to prove that "teaching by learning styles" is effective, students must first be grouped according to style, and then each group of students must be randomly assigned to different teaching methods. Finally, take the same test. The criterion for effectiveness is the presence of a specific interaction: the teachings that are most effective for one style are not the most effective for another style. The review concluded that few such interactions were found. Although there is a lot of literature on learning styles, there are very few studies that have used qualified experimental designs, and several of the results are directly contrary to the "matching hypothesis". The author therefore believes that the existing evidence is insufficient to support the use of learning style assessment in educational practice.
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Pashler H, McDaniel M, Rohrer D, Bjork R (2008). Learning Styles: Concepts and Evidence. Psychological Science in the Public Interest, 9(3), 105–119. <https://doi.org/10.1111/j.1539-6053.2009.01038.x>

Note: The review also states that this does not mean that all versions of learning style theory have been tested and rejected, and many have not been tested at all. What you need to avoid is spending money on style assessments and choosing training courses based on style. For the criteria for selecting training, see Article 9 (Government subsidy channels are given priority for training) and Article 13 (Short-cycle projects that can be directly employed are given priority).

Case: Xiao Liu, who considers herself an "auditory type", originally only listened to the lectures and did not do the questions. After seeing the research, she forced herself to study according to the "text + questions" method. She found that she could understand it faster if she changed the method, and her final grades rose instead of falling, saving her the money she originally planned to spend on audio lessons and assessments.

items.title: Test yourself based on how you want to memorize the content. Don’t memorize it just once.
items.core: Close the book and test yourself. The benefits don’t stop at the few words you memorized. Counting 192 comparisons and more than 10,000 people, it is also effective for questions with different question types, application questions and reasoning questions, and the range is medium to small. But there are two situations where the effect is weakest: swapping questions and answers, and content that has only been seen in books and has never been tested.
body: Cost: No money and no extra time. What has changed is just the practice method: replace "memorize it as it is" with "test yourself based on how you will use it in the future." The difficulty lies in figuring out how these things will be used in the future.

Benefits: A meta-analysis pooled over 40 years of research, including 67 published and unpublished articles, 122 experiments, 192 transfer effect sizes, and a total population of 10,382 people. Compared with the "watch it again but not take the test" control, the learning brought about by the practice test does transfer to other situations, with an effect size of d=0.40 (95% CI 0.31 to 0.50). The situations where transfer is strongest are: changing test types, testing application questions and reasoning questions, medical diagnosis questions, and testing clue words with similar meanings. The weakest types of transfer are: swapping stimuli and responses, materials that have been seen but not tested when you are a beginner, and example questions. There are three moderator factors that strongly influence whether forward transfer will occur. They are whether the answering forms during practice and test are consistent, whether there have been retrieval exercises with detailed feedback, and whether the answers to the first test were correct. The authors also corrected for publication bias using two methods. The effect size of the moderator is only slightly affected, but the intercept estimate is significantly depressed: when none of the above conditions are met, positive transfer is often not seen
Level of Evidence: A
Source: Pan SC, Rickard TC (2018). Transfer of test-enhanced learning: meta-analytic review and synthesis. Psychological Bulletin, 144(7), 710-756. <https://doi.org/10.1037/bul0000151>

Note: The word "memorize" usually confuses two things: going over the material again (reading it repeatedly and highlighting the key points), and closing the book and actively recalling it. The former category had the lowest rating in the review that ranked the ten learning methods. If you want to see the rating itself, see Article 16 (don’t regard highlighting, repeated reading, and writing summaries as the main learning methods). What you need to do is the latter category: close the book and take the initiative to recall, see item 14 for details (self-test with the book closed), and do it over several days, see item 15 (spread over several days). The method is to first think clearly about how to use it in the future: whether to select it on the paper or to judge it on the spot, and then test yourself according to that format. It is also worth taking the test in reverse order, because in this meta-analysis, the transfer in the opposite direction is the weakest, and you need to practice in both directions.

Case: Xiao Zhao, who memorized words, reviewed according to the real test method, and changed the "word definition" to "reading and filling in the blanks" self-test. She simulates interviewer questions to practice speaking, rather than memorizing paraphrases. In the end, my score on the applied questions improved significantly, because I was practicing for future usage.

items.title: When evaluating professional titles, first find out which series and level you are in, and then find application channels according to the nature of the unit
items.core: Professional titles are divided into 27 series across the country, and each series is divided into junior, intermediate, and senior. Generally, you have to go up one level at a time. Those who work in the unit will be reported to the unit after review and publicity. If you are in a private enterprise, you can go to a professional title declaration acceptance service point, or find a talent agency or industry association to apply. Freelancers submit their applications for review by local social sector organizations.
body: Cost: No money. It takes about half an hour to check the province’s declaration notice for the current year.

Income: There are 27 professional title series across the country, such as economics, engineering, health, and publishing. Professional titles are divided into three levels: senior, intermediate and junior. Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security Order No. 40 applies to enterprises, institutions, social groups, individual economic organizations, and also applies to freelancers. Applicants generally have to declare step by step. Your unit must review the materials and publicize them within the unit. The publicity period shall be no less than 5 working days. For private enterprises and freelancers, personnel agencies can review, announce, and recommend for you. All localities should set up professional title application acceptance service points in science and technology parks, high-tech zones and other places. Applications can also be accepted through talent agency service agencies, industry associations, chambers of commerce, and societies. Qualified freelancers will participate in the review organized by the local social sector department based on their jurisdiction. For materials that can be verified online, you are not required to issue additional certificates. If the materials are incomplete, the reviewer will tell you what is missing all at once. People in private enterprises generally declare at the location where their labor relations are located. Those who are assigned to work in other places for one consecutive year can declare at the place of assignment. Retirees cannot declare. If a staff member of a public institution is punished with a demerit or above, he or she cannot declare the punishment during the period of punishment (nationwide)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security Order No. 40 (2019). Interim Provisions on Professional Title Review Management. <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2019/content_5437137.htm>: Article 2, Article 13, Article 14, Article 15, Article 16, Article 17, Article 18; General Office of the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security (2020). Notice on further improving professional title work in private enterprises. <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2020-03/03/content_5486340.htm>: "Established in entrepreneurial incubation bases, high-tech development zones, science and technology parks and other places where professional and technical talents are densely populated Professional title application acceptance service points, or through talent intermediary service agencies, industrial and commercial federations, industry associations, chambers of commerce, societies and other social organizations accept professional title applications for professional and technical personnel from private enterprises. "If professional and technical personnel from private enterprises are assigned to work abroad for more than one year, they may apply for professional title review at the place of assignment in accordance with relevant regulations." Xinhua News Agency (2024). Professional title review has reached its peak, how to check information? What's new? <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/202410/content_6978917.htm>: "my country has a total of 27 professional title series in economics, engineering, health, publishing, etc." "Eligible freelancers can apply to participate in the professional title review organized by the local social sector according to the territorial principle"; General Office of the CPC Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council (2016). Opinions on deepening the reform of the professional title system. <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2017/content_5163445.htm>: "Thesis will not be used as a restrictive condition for evaluating applied talents." "There are no unified requirements for foreign language and computer application proficiency examinations for professional titles." "Highly skilled talents who meet the conditions can participate in the evaluation of professional and technical talents in the engineering series." "Civil servants are not allowed to participate in the evaluation of professional and technical talents in the engineering series."

Note: There is no unified list across the country of what materials to prepare. Each series and each province issues an application notice every year, and the list of materials, application time and performance conditions are all written in it. So the first step is to find the notice for that year on the official website of the provincial Department of Human Resources and Social Security. Thesis is no longer required: the 2016 reform opinions require that thesis not be regarded as a hard threshold for applied talents, and there are no unified requirements for foreign language and computer examinations for professional titles. There is also a way for skilled workers: qualified highly skilled talents can participate in the professional title review of the engineering series. Civil servants cannot participate in professional title evaluation.

Case: Ms. Wang works in a private technology company and wants to apply for an intermediate professional title. She first found out that she belonged to the engineering technology series, then went to the local professional title application service point for consultation, prepared materials as required and submitted them through a talent agency. Finally, she was successfully evaluated and avoided many detours.

items.title: Junior and intermediate professional titles such as accounting are obtained through the national unified examination. You must first compare your academic qualifications and working experience to register
items.core: Some series of junior and intermediate professional titles are obtained through examinations. If you pass the examination, they will not be reviewed separately. Accounting is like this: an assistant accountant must have a high school degree or above, and an accountant must have a bachelor's degree of accounting for four years and a college degree of five years. Those who have obtained certain professional qualifications may also be directly counted as having corresponding professional titles.
body: Cost: The registration fee is paid according to the standards of each province. Preparing for the exam takes up several months of your spare time.

Benefits: The 2016 reform opinions stipulate that majors for which junior and intermediate professional titles are subject to a national unified examination will no longer undergo corresponding review or recognition. In fields where professional titles and professional qualifications are closely related, obtaining professional qualifications can be regarded as having the corresponding professional title, and can also be used as a condition for applying for a higher level. Take accounting for example. A unified nationwide examination is administered for assistant accountants and accountants. The senior accountant examination and review are combined, and senior accountants are generally only reviewed. The application conditions are as follows. Assistant accountant: high school diploma or above, including technical secondary school, vocational high school, and technical school. Accountant: Doctoral degree; or master's degree, with 1 year of experience; or second bachelor's degree, graduate class, with 2 years of experience; or bachelor's degree, with 4 years of experience; or junior college, with 5 years of experience. Those with a master's degree in accounting or a doctorate in accounting can be exempted from taking the "Financial Management" exam (National)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: General Office of the CPC Central Committee, General Office of the State Council (2016). Opinions on deepening the reform of the professional title system. <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2017/content_5163445.htm>: "Professional and technical talents who have obtained professional qualifications can be deemed to have the corresponding series and level of professional titles, and can be used as a condition for applying for a higher-level professional title. Majors that are subject to national unified examinations for junior and intermediate professional titles will no longer be subject to corresponding professional title evaluation or recognition."; Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security, Ministry of Finance (2019). Guidance on deepening the reform of the professional title system for accounting personnel. <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2019-09/27/content_5433803.htm>: "Assistant accountants and accountants implement a national unified accounting professional technical qualification examination" "Senior accountants adopt a combination of examination and review, and senior accountants generally adopt an review method" "Civil servants who meet the conditions can participate in the accounting professional technical qualification examination, but are not allowed to participate in the professional title review of accounting personnel"; Ministry of Finance, etc. (2024). Notice on the work related to the connection between accounting professional degrees and accounting professional technical qualifications. <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202405/content_6952602.htm>

Note: Whether your series is an examination, an assessment, or a combination of assessment and assessment, please refer to the "Guiding Opinions on Deepening the Reform of the ×× Professional Title System" in this series. The Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security and various industry authorities have issued them in series, and they can be found in the policy document database of the Chinese Government website. The registration time and subjects for the examination shall be subject to the examination announcement of that year. Civil servants can take accounting exams, but they cannot take part in accounting professional title reviews.

Case: Xiao Sun, who has a college degree and is studying accounting, compared the application conditions and found that he needed to work for 5 years before he could take the intermediate exam. She first passed the junior accountant exam and earned her seniority while working as a cashier. In the fifth year, she immediately signed up for the intermediate level. She didn't have to wait for a year in vain like her colleagues because she didn't have enough years.

items.title: Don’t hire an agency for evaluation, don’t hire essay ghostwriters, and don’t falsify materials: the professional title will be revoked upon verification, and the integrity file will be kept for 3 years
items.core: Professional titles obtained by using fake materials, ghostwriting papers, or plagiarized results will be revoked upon verification. A record of breach of trust will be recorded for 3 years, and the person will be included in the national credit platform. If the commitment letter signed when applying is false, you will not be able to apply again within 3 years. The human resources and social security department also specializes in investigating and punishing false propaganda, fake reviews and fake certificates made by intermediaries.
body: Cost: No money. It’s hard to resist the “spend your money” ads.

Benefits: Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security Order No. 40 stipulates that those who provide false materials, plagiarize other people’s works and academic achievements, or use other improper means to obtain professional titles will have their professional titles revoked. At the same time, it will be recorded in the professional title review integrity archives and included in the national credit information sharing platform, with a recording period of 3 years. The 2024 regulatory measures name several types of violations committed by applicants: false promises and falsified information, falsified essay writing, falsified performance, and intercession and greeting. You must sign a personal commitment letter when applying. If the commitment is untrue, you will not be allowed to apply within 3 years. The human resources and social security departments, together with the public security, Internet information, and market supervision, will investigate and deal with intermediary fake websites, false propaganda, contract traps, fake reviews, and fake certificates. If the circumstances are serious and suspected of a crime, they will be transferred to the relevant authorities for processing (nationwide)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security Order No. 40 (2019). Interim Provisions on the Management of Professional Title Review. <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2019/content_5437137.htm>: Article 39; Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security (2024). Interim Measures on the Management of Professional Title Review. <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202408/content_6969436.htm>: Articles 5, 15, 17, and 27; General Office of the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security (2022). Notice on further improving professional title evaluation work. <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2022-12/24/content_5733407.htm>: "For unregistered professional title review committees, the review results will not be included in the national professional title review information query and verification system"; Xinhua News Agency (2024). Professional title review has reached its peak, how to check information? What's new? <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/202410/content_6978917.htm>: "You can log in through various channels such as www.12333.gov.cn web page, mobile 12333 client, human resources and social security department website, "Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security" WeChat official account"; Supreme People's Court, Supreme People's Procuratorate (2019). Interpretation of Several Issues Concerning the Application of Law in Handling Criminal Cases such as Cheating in Organized Examinations (Fa Interpretation [2019] No. 13, Article 1). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/xwfbh/wsfbh/201909/t20190903_430901.shtml>: "National Unified Legal Professional Qualification Examination, National Teacher Qualification Examination, National Unified Certified Public Accountant Examination, Accounting Professional and Technical Qualification Examination... and other professional and technical qualification examinations"

Note: There is a way to distinguish the true from the false: formally reviewed professional titles can be found on the National Professional Title Review Information Inquiry Platform. The entrances are the 12333 website, 12333 mobile client and the official website of the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security. Those evaluated by the review committee that have not been registered cannot be found in this system. Therefore, if you promise that it is "guaranteed", "you don't have to participate in person", and "it can be used even if the certificate cannot be found", it can basically be determined that there is something wrong. The main beneficiary is himself, and the magnitude of the income is determined based on "avoiding the revocation of professional titles and a three-year record of dishonesty." The Accounting Professional Technical Qualification Examination is on the list of "national examinations prescribed by law" listed in the Judicial Interpretation. It is a crime to find someone to take the exam for you, sell the answers, or organize cheating in this type of exam. Simply buying the answers and peeking at them is not classified as a crime in the law and will be handled according to the disciplinary regulations of the exam. See Section 9, Article 29 (Do not hire someone to take the exam for you).

Case: Engineer Lao Zhou received a text message saying "Professional title guaranteed, essay writing service", but he ignored it. The colleague next door spent money to find an agency, but was found to have falsified materials. Not only was his newly obtained engineer title revoked, but he was also recorded in the integrity file for three years, completely ruining his promotion that year.

items.title: Getting a professional title does not mean a salary increase: first ask whether the unit evaluates and hires based on the proportion of positions, or whether employees are not necessarily hired if they are evaluated
items.core: Professional titles are the basis for hiring, assessment, and promotion, but evaluation and hiring are two different things. Public institutions that implement post management generally evaluate employees within the proportion of posts. Units that do not implement position management can separate evaluation and employment. Those who are evaluated may not be given the corresponding position and salary. After changing units or locations, professional titles may need to be re-evaluated or confirmed.
body: Cost: No money. Just ask the unit's human resources department.

Benefits: Article 2 of Order No. 40 of the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security: The results of professional title evaluation are an important basis for the recruitment, assessment, and promotion of professional and technical talents. The 2016 reform opinions stipulate that public institutions that fully implement post management generally conduct professional title reviews within the proportion of the post structure. Units that do not implement job management, as well as highly versatile series and emerging occupations, can be evaluated and hired separately. When professional and technical talents move across regions and units, professional titles shall be re-evaluated or confirmed according to management authority, unless otherwise specified by the state (nationwide)
Level of Evidence: B

Source: Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security Order No. 40 (2019). Interim Provisions on the Management of Professional Title Review. <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2019/content_5437137.htm>: Article 2, Article 29; General Office of the CPC Central Committee, General Office of the State Council (2016). Opinions on deepening the reform of the professional title system. <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2017/content_5163445.htm>: "For public institutions that fully implement job management and where the academic and technical levels of professional and technical personnel are closely related to job responsibilities, professional title evaluations should generally be carried out within the proportion of the job structure. For units that do not implement job management, as well as professional title series and emerging occupations that are highly versatile and widely distributed in various social organizations, separate evaluation and employment methods can be used."

Remarks: Evidence level determination B, because the document only talks about how to connect the evaluation and employment, and there is no nationally unified figure for "how much the evaluation will increase." What you can do is: in public institutions and state-owned enterprises, first ask the personnel department about the job vacancies and appointment rules of the unit. In a private company, first ask the boss whether he recognizes the certificate and whether he will pay more.

Case: Teacher Li was awarded the title of senior teacher, but the school position is full, so he can only get his original salary "separate from evaluation and employment". Instead of waiting, she went to a private school for an interview. The other party directly set her salary based on her senior professional title. Only then did she understand: being rated does not mean being hired. Changing units is the key to fulfillment.

items.title: Should you continue studying for a master's degree after graduating from a bachelor's degree? First, calculate the tuition fees and the two or three years of lost salary, and then see whether the major you study will earn more. Those who are already working can study part-time, and the certificate has the same effect as full-time.
items.core: If you study for a master's degree, you have to pay tuition and earn two or three years less salary. The latter is usually the bulk. A British study looked at graduates from 20 to 30 years ago and subtracted differences in family and undergraduate grades. Women with a master's degree earn about 2% more and men earn about 2% less by age 35, with wide variations across majors. Those who work can study part-time, and the certificate has the same validity as full-time study, but there is no national scholarship.
body: Cost: Nothing. It takes about an hour or two to check the admissions brochure and tuition fees, and then do some calculations based on the job opportunities at hand.

Benefits: Let’s look at expenses first. The 2013 national opinion stipulates that the tuition fee for a full-time academic master’s degree shall in principle not exceed 8,000 yuan per year. Full-time professional master's degrees are subject to the original fee policy and are not subject to this upper limit, and are often much more expensive. Full-time postgraduate students within the enrollment plan can receive national postgraduate scholarships, and the annual master's scholarship is no less than 6,000 yuan. The specific standards are determined by each locality. Let’s look at the returns. Research published by the UK Department for Education in 2020 used national student status and tax records to track people who graduated from undergraduate degrees from the mid-1990s to the mid-2000s. The study netted out differences in family background and undergraduate grades to look at earnings at age 35. The original text is "we estimate returns of 2% (women) and -2% (men) for masters": Women with a master's degree earn about 2% more than those with a bachelor's degree, while men earn about 2% less. Majors vary greatly. Women who study for a master's degree in law, economics, and management earn about 20% more, while those who study for a master's degree in art, English, and philosophy earn more than 10% less. Returns to master's degrees are significantly negative for men in most majors, but are still significantly positive for law, economics, management, and engineering. Those who are already working can take the part-time master's degree exam and study while working. A notice from the Ministry of Education in 2016 stipulated that part-time and full-time students should take the same exam and be trained according to the same standards. The two academic degree certificates "have the same legal status and the same validity", and the learning method will be indicated on the diploma. National scholarships are only available to full-time graduate students within the enrollment plan, and are not available to part-time graduate students. In 2019, five departments including the Ministry of Education issued notices. Civil service recruitment, open recruitment by public institutions and state-owned enterprises must provide equal employment opportunities to graduate students with different learning styles. These recruitments shall not set application conditions that are irrelevant to the job requirements. The Ministry of Education's employment notice for 2021 graduates states that recruitment announcements by party and government agencies, public institutions and state-owned enterprises must not use learning methods as restrictive conditions. The notice for the class of 2022 also states that all types of campus recruitment must not be restricted in this way.
Level of Evidence: B

Source: Ministry of Finance, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Education (2013). Opinions on improving the investment mechanism for postgraduate education (Caijiao [2013] No. 19). <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2013/content_2404719.htm>: "In principle, the current tuition fee for full-time academic degree graduate students is no more than 8,000 yuan per year for each master's student. , the annual fee for doctoral students shall not exceed 10,000 yuan. Full-time professional degree graduate students and graduate students who have already implemented the fee policy according to regulations shall temporarily implement the original fee policy. "The subsidy standard for doctoral students shall not be less than 10,000 yuan per student per year, and the subsidy standard for master's students shall not be less than 6,000 yuan per student per year."; Britton J, Buscha F, Dickson M, van der Erve L, Vignoles A, Walker I, Waltmann B, Zhu Y (2020). The earnings returns to postgraduate degrees in the UK. Department for Education. Notice on coordinating the management of full-time and part-time graduate students (Teaching and Research Department [2016] No. 2). <http://www.moe.gov.cn/srcsite/A22/moe_826/201609/t20160914_281117.html>: "A corresponding graduation certificate indicating the learning method will be issued in accordance with relevant national regulations" "Full-time The same examination enrollment policy and training standards are applied to part-time graduate students, and their academic degree certificates have the same legal status and the same validity." Cai Jiao [2013] No. 19, ibid.: "The scope of the national graduate student scholarship covers all full-time graduate students within the national graduate enrollment plan." Five departments including the General Office of the Ministry of Education (2019). Notice on further improving the employment of part-time graduate students (Teaching and Research Department Letter [2019] No. 1). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2020-02/05/content_5490220.htm>: "Recruitment of civil servants at all levels, public recruitment by public institutions and state-owned enterprises must reasonably formulate recruitment conditions based on job needs, provide equal employment opportunities to graduate students with different education forms, and shall not set application qualifications unrelated to job requirements"; Ministry of Education (2020). Notice on the employment and entrepreneurship work for 2021 national general college graduates (Teaching [2020] No. 5). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2020-12/01/content_5566303.htm>: "Graduation institutions, overseas (overseas) study experience, and learning methods (full-time and part-time) shall not be used as restrictive conditions in recruitment announcements and actual operations"; Ministry of Education (2021). Notice on the employment and entrepreneurship work for the 2022 national general college graduates (Teaching [2021] No. 5). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2021-11/21/content_5652326.htm>: "In various campus recruitment activities, relevant discriminatory clauses that violate national regulations must not be set, and graduation institutions and learning methods (full-time and part-time) must not be used as restrictive conditions"; Ministry of Education (2024). Article 77 of the 2025 National Postgraduate Admissions Management Regulations (Teaching [2024] No. 4). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202410/content_6978684.htm>: "The admissions regulations should publish the application conditions, learning methods, academic system, tuition standards, scholarships, graduation employment, accommodation conditions, and training campuses for each major of the unit in accordance with relevant regulations. In principle, the admissions unit recruits part-time postgraduate students with on-the-job orientation."

Note: Controversy. The returns for a master's degree calculated by previous British studies have always been positive. The author of this study believes that his data is more detailed and cleaner. The author also admits that differences such as motivation and career preferences cannot be discounted. The data only covers the age of 35 and uses people who graduated 20 or 30 years ago. There is no domestic figure that also deducts individual differences, so it can only be used as a reference. The level of evidence is therefore assigned B. The method of calculating the accounts is the same as Article 6 of this section (study or work). Match the salary you earn less in two or three years to the salary you earn more every year in the future. Some job recruitment announcements directly state that a master's degree is required, such as in universities, scientific research institutes and some state-owned enterprises. At this time, the academic qualification threshold itself is the reward and must be calculated separately. The documents for part-time students were department notices, and they did not include any penalties or who to complain to in case of violation. What it cares about is how the recruitment announcement is written, but it has no control over who the company selects in the end. There are clear restrictions on campus recruitment, but there is no clear text governing learning methods in social recruitment in private companies. The enrollment management regulations for 2025 state that in principle, part-time students will only recruit people who are working and have returned to their original units after graduation. Tuition fees, scholarships and accommodation are written into the admissions regulations by the school. What to do with household registration and files? The national documents found in this book do not have unified regulations. Please read the brochure clearly and ask the school before signing up.

Case: A programmer who has been working for three years is considering studying for a master's degree. After calculation, he found that the tuition fee plus the salary earned in two years is a large sum. He checked the data and found that the salary increase for a master's degree in computer science was limited, so he chose to study part-time and study while working. The certificate validity is the same as that of a full-time program, so there is no loss of income.

items.title: Should you continue studying for a Ph.D. after graduating from a master’s degree? The target position clearly requires a Ph.D., so consider the psychological burden before studying.
items.core: A British study deducted the differences between family and undergraduate grades. At age 35, a PhD student earns about 8% more than a woman with an undergraduate degree, while a man earns about 9% less. The psychological burden of studying for a PhD is also heavy. About one-quarter of doctoral students from various countries have obvious symptoms of depression, and about one-sixth have obvious symptoms of anxiety. So first check whether the target job is not open to candidates with a PhD degree, and then decide whether to study or not.
body: Cost: Nothing. Check the academic requirements in the recruitment announcement of the target unit, and then talk to two or three Ph.D. students.

Benefits: The 2020 study by the UK Department of Education quoted in Article 24 of this section (Studying a Master's degree) also includes a PhD. The original text is "8% (women) and -9% (men) for PhDs": After deducting the differences in family background and undergraduate grades, at the age of 35, PhD students earn about 8% more than women with undergraduate degrees only, and men earn about 9% less. The research also found that having a PhD reduced the likelihood of being unemployed and earning less than £30,000 a year, as well as lowering the likelihood of earning more than £40,000 a year. There are huge differences between disciplines. The returns for a PhD in mathematics are particularly low, while a PhD in psychology has one of the highest returns. Regarding the psychological burden during PhD studies, see a summary analysis in 2021. Among 16 studies and 23,469 doctoral students, a total of approximately 24% (95% CI 18%–31%, confidence range) had significant depressive symptoms. Among 15,626 doctoral students in 9 studies, approximately 17% (12%–23%) had significant anxiety symptoms. There was considerable variation between studies (I² approximately 98%). Domestic Tuition Fees According to 2013 Opinions: In principle, the tuition fees for full-time academic degree and doctoral degrees shall not exceed 10,000 yuan per year. National scholarships will increase starting from the spring semester of 2017: 15,000 yuan per year for doctoral students at central universities and no less than 13,000 yuan per year for local universities. The funding targets are full-time doctoral students within the national graduate enrollment plan, except those with fixed salary income. Scientific research institutes and other training institutions shall follow suit.
Level of Evidence: B

Source: Britton J, Buscha F, Dickson M, van der Erve L, Vignoles A, Walker I, Waltmann B, Zhu Y (2020). The earnings returns to postgraduate degrees in the UK. Department for Education. <https://assets.publishing.service.gov.uk/media/5f609e478fa8f5106d1563cc/PG_LEO_report_FINAL.pdf>; EN, Kimura T, Kiang MV, et al. (2021). Systematic review and meta-analysis of depression, anxiety, and suicidal ideation among Ph.D. students. Scientific Reports, 11, 14370. <https://doi.org/10.1038/s41598-021-93687-7>; Liu H, Gao Y, Tuerxun N, Cabirou L (2026). More than Depression: Doctoral Students' Mental Health in China: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis. Behavioral Sciences, 16, 1355. <https://doi.org/10.3390/bs16081355>; Ministry of Finance, National Development and Reform Commission, and Ministry of Education (2013). Opinions on improving the investment mechanism for graduate education (Finance and Education [2013] No. 19). <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2013/content_2404719.htm>; Ministry of Finance and Ministry of Education (2017). Notice on further improving the national scholarship funding standards for doctoral students (Financial Science and Education [2017] No. 5). <https://www.xszz.edu.cn/n39/n54/c6711/content.html>

Note: Controversy. The figures for depression and anxiety only combine the proportions from surveys in various countries. There is no comparison with peers, and the scales used are also different. Therefore, it shows that such symptoms are common among doctoral students, but it does not mean that they are caused by doctoral studies. A summary of domestic Chinese studies found that there is not much difference in psychological symptoms between doctoral students and master's students, but they are both higher than the national norm and youth norm. The income figures have the same limitations as Article 24 of this section (Studying a Master's degree) and can only be used as a reference. Recruitment announcements for teaching positions in universities, scientific research institutes and some R&D positions often state that a doctorate is required. If you want to take this path, you should first read through the announcements of the target unit in recent years. If you feel depressed for more than two weeks while reading, do the things in Section 3, Item 18 (Things to do first when you feel depressed) first. Call 12356 if you are having suicidal thoughts, see Section 1, Item 25 (Call 12356 if you are depressed or having suicidal thoughts).

Case: Xiao Wu, who graduated with a master's degree, received an offer to study for a Ph.D., but the target college counselor position only required a master's degree. He made a calculation: Not only would he have no income after studying for a Ph.D. for three years, but he might also face the risk of depression. In the end, he gave up studying for a Ph.D. and went to college to find a job, and found that the qualifications accumulated by working for three years earlier were more practical than academic qualifications.

items.title: Common diseases are first treated in the community, and then referred step by step at the grassroots level, and then the hospitalization deductible is calculated.
items.core: Go to the community first, and then transfer from the community to a large hospital for hospitalization. The amount of money you paid first can continue to be calculated, and you don’t have to pay it all over again. Specifically, it is determined by each location. Sichuan only makes up the difference between the deductibles of the two companies. For those who are transferred from a large hospital to the community and continue to live in the community, the same illness will not be counted again during this period.
body: Cost: Nothing. You need to go to the community first. It's hard to resist not directly calling the expert account.

Benefit: For insured patients who are referred step by step at the grassroots level, the hospitalization deductible at the higher-level hospital can be calculated continuously. The deductible is the amount you pay first every time you are hospitalized, and only when you have paid enough, you start to pay for it through medical insurance. The State Office document does not specify how to calculate the continuous calculation, which is determined by each locality. Sichuan's approach is to only make up the difference between the deductibles of the two hospitals: the county hospital of traditional Chinese medicine has a deductible of 600 yuan, and if you transfer to the county people's hospital (deductible of 800 yuan), you only need to pay an additional 200 yuan. For inpatients transferred from higher-level hospitals back to grassroots hospitals, there will no longer be a separate deductible for the same disease cycle
Level of Evidence: A

Source: General Office of the State Council (2026). Several measures to accelerate the construction of a hierarchical diagnosis and treatment system. <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202604/content_7065031.htm>: "For insured patients who are referred step by step by primary medical and health institutions in the coordinated area, the hospitalization deductibles of higher-level hospitals can be calculated continuously; for inpatients who are transferred from higher-level hospitals to primary medical and health institutions, there will no longer be another hospitalization deductible in the same disease cycle."; Sichuan Provincial Medical Security Bureau (2025). Letter regarding the response to Recommendation No. 14041026 of the Fourth Session of the 14th Provincial People’s Congress. <https://ylbzj.sc.gov.cn/scsybj/nc010414/2025/3/19/fea6f0a5f8ba416abf7ed17541afdc7a.shtml>: "Yilong The minimum payment line of the County People's Hospital is 800 yuan, and the minimum payment line of the Yilong County Traditional Chinese Medicine Hospital is 600 yuan. If the Yilong County Traditional Chinese Medicine Hospital transfers to the Yilong County People's Hospital, you only need to pay the difference of 200 yuan. "

Note: Referral rules are formulated by each province, city and medical consortium. Please ask the community before going. Don’t go to big hospitals to prescribe medicine for chronic diseases in the stable stage, because the number of general outpatient clinics in big hospitals will gradually decrease. The community can prescribe medicines for up to 12 weeks at a time, see section 16, clause 5 (Community prescribing for up to 12 weeks at a time).

Case: Uncle Li’s hypertension was first diagnosed at the community health service center, and he was later transferred to a tertiary hospital due to complications due to complications. The community deductible has been paid out of pocket. After transferring to another hospital, I only made up the difference between the deductibles of the two hospitals. I did not repay the full amount, and the calculation was not recalculated when I returned to the community to extend my stay.

items.title: In the same coordinating area (medical insurance participating area), the lower the hospital level, the higher the reimbursement ratio, with a gap of about 10 percentage points
items.core: According to the document requirements, for the same hospitalization fee, the lower the hospital level, the higher the reimbursement ratio. All localities need to move up the scale, with a difference of about ten percentage points for each higher level. For example, for a hospitalization fee of 10,000 yuan, the reimbursement is reduced from 80% to 70%, and the out-of-pocket expense is reduced from 2,000 yuan to 3,000 yuan. The newly added medical insurance funds are also tilted toward the grassroots.
body: Cost: No money. It's hard not to run to a big hospital.

Income: The document requires localities to increase the hospitalization reimbursement levels of different levels of medical institutions. In principle, the difference will be about 10 percentage points step by step. Based on this gap, every time the same hospitalization fee goes to a first-level hospital, the extra money you pay is about 10% of the reimbursable expense. For example, for a reimbursable hospitalization fee of 10,000 yuan, the reimbursement ratio dropped from 80% to 70%, and the out-of-pocket expense dropped from 2,000 yuan to 3,000 yuan. The extra 1,000 yuan is 10% of the total cost, but it is half more than what I originally paid. The actual proportions vary from place to place, and the minimum payment line and cap line will also cause the difference to change. This is just an indication based on the 10 percentage points in the document. The annual new medical insurance fund also tilts towards the grassroots
Level of Evidence: A

Source: General Office of the State Council (2026). Several measures to accelerate the construction of a hierarchical diagnosis and treatment system. <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202604/content_7065031.htm>: "According to local conditions, the hospitalization reimbursement levels of insured persons at different levels of medical and health institutions should be appropriately increased, and in principle, medical treatment in the region should be coordinated The gap in the hospitalization reimbursement ratio of health institutions is gradually widened by about 10 percentage points. "Where conditions permit, the outpatient reimbursement levels of insured persons at different levels of medical and health institutions can be expanded as appropriate according to the hierarchical diagnosis and treatment guidance."

Note: For the same hospitalization fee, the difference between primary and tertiary hospitals may be several thousand yuan. Don’t go to higher hospitals for diseases that can be handled at the grassroots level. Not all diseases must be treated in the community.

Case: A certain city’s medical insurance window settled accounts for insured residents: for the same hospitalization fee of 10,000 yuan, the third-level hospital reimbursed about 70% of the cost and paid 3,000 yuan out-of-pocket; the county-level hospital reimbursed about 80% and paid 2,000 yuan out-of-pocket, and the grassroots hospital paid 1,000 yuan less.

items.title: If you want to go to a large hospital, go to the grassroots referral center or the hospital's referral center, don't look for the number dealers
items.core: The leading large hospital in a close medical consortium (several hospitals and communities are tied together) should set aside some numbers and beds specifically for people transferred from the grassroots level. The hospital will also need to set up a referral center or designate a fixed department to handle referrals, with full coverage by 2027. Not being able to register does not mean that there is no way, and there is no need to go to the dealer.
body: Cost: No money. There is one more referral procedure to go through.

Income: The leading hospital in a close medical consortium must reserve a certain proportion of numbers and beds for grassroots hospitals, and receive patients referred by grassroots hospitals in a timely manner. A close medical consortium is a group of institutions that are tied together to collaborate with several hospitals and community health agencies. This kind of organization in the county is called a county medical community, and ten departments including the National Health Commission will require it to achieve "unified management of people, money and property" in 2023. Therefore, when you transfer from the community, you will have a separate number and bed, so you won't be crowded with people in the lobby trying to get a number. Medical institutions must set up referral centers or designated fixed departments to achieve full coverage by 2027
Level of Evidence: A

Source: General Office of the State Council (2026). Several measures to accelerate the construction of a hierarchical diagnosis and treatment system. <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202604/content_7065031.htm>: "The leading hospital should reserve a certain proportion of numbers and beds for primary medical and health institutions, and receive referrals from primary care institutions in a timely manner. Patients. "Medical institutions should strengthen the unified management of referral services, set up referral centers or designate fixed departments to undertake patient referral services, and achieve full coverage by 2027." The first sentence of these two sentences is "A close medical alliance should facilitate the referral of patients after the first diagnosis in primary medical and health institutions."; National Health Commission, etc. 10 Department (2023). Guidance on comprehensively promoting the construction of a close-knit county medical and health community (Guowei Grassroots Development [2023] No. 41). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202312/content_6923447.htm>: "Basically build a county-wide medical community with reasonable layout, unified management of people, property, and resources, clear rights and responsibilities, efficient operation, division of labor and collaboration, continuous services, and information sharing."

Note: The reserved number source is reserved for referral patients. If you cannot get a number, you can go to the referral. If you can't find the referral center, call the hospital's service number and ask.

Case: Ms. Wang wanted to register as a specialist in a major hospital, but the APP showed that it was full. She contacted the family doctor who signed the contract, submitted an application through the medical alliance referral center, and got the appointment number three days later, without looking for an account dealer or staying up late to grab an appointment.

items.title: Before seeking medical treatment across provinces, ask locally. In principle, the necessity must be evaluated by a deputy chief physician or above
items.core: Whether you want to go to other places for medical treatment should, in principle, be evaluated by a doctor above the deputy chief physician in a second or third-level hospital. The amount of reimbursement for temporary outing for medical treatment will be different from that at the same level hospital in the insured area. It depends on the local regulations. It is better to ask locally before departure than to find out that the remuneration is less after arriving in another place.
body: Cost: No money. Ask a few questions before you go.

Benefits: The necessity of medical treatment in different places across coordinating regions and provinces shall, in principle, be evaluated by deputy chief physicians and above from second- and third-level hospitals. Crossing the co-ordination area means crossing one's own medical insurance coverage area. Whether it is necessary to go out of town to see if it is necessary should, in principle, be made by a doctor of sufficient rank. The reimbursement level for people who temporarily go out for medical treatment across provinces should be reasonably different from that of institutions at the same level in the insured area. For the same medical treatment abroad, the reimbursement will be less than at home
Level of Evidence: A

Source: General Office of the State Council (2026). Several measures to speed up the construction of a hierarchical diagnosis and treatment system. <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202604/content_7065031.htm>: "In principle, the deputy chief physician and above in second- and third-level hospitals will evaluate the necessity of patients seeking medical treatment in other places across coordinating regions and provinces." "Further strengthen the direct settlement management service for medical treatment in other places, and maintain a reasonable difference between the reimbursement level for people who temporarily go out for medical treatment across provinces and the reimbursement level of medical institutions at the same level in insured areas."

Note: "Temporarily going out for medical treatment" and "long-term living in another place" are two different filings, with different reimbursement levels. How to register and which types of diseases can be settled directly? See Section 16. Don't go to other places first and then think about reimbursement later.

Case: Mr. Zhang suffers from a rare skin disease and plans to go to Beijing for medical treatment. Before departure, he first went to the city hospital for evaluation by the deputy chief physician and consulted at the medical insurance window. It was confirmed that the reimbursement rate for temporary outings was 15% lower than the local rate, so he brought more budget to avoid the embarrassment of shrinking reimbursement.

items.title: Every time you see a doctor, keep a copy of the medical records, examination reports and images for yourself
items.core: It is the right given by law to you to check and copy your own medical records. Outpatient medical records, hospitalization records, laboratory test orders, images, surgical and anesthesia records, pathology data, and expense lists can all be copied. The hospital has to designate a special department or personnel to handle the case and can only charge a cost-based fee. Changing hospitals, looking for another doctor to see me again, applying for commercial insurance, and really having disputes all rely on this pile of materials.
body: Cost: No money. Hospitals can charge a cost-based fee for photocopying in accordance with regulations, and the charging standards must be made public. The difficulty lies in remembering to make a copy every time after seeing a doctor.

Benefits: Regulations clearly list access and copying of medical records as patients’ rights. The scope covers all information such as outpatient medical records, hospitalization records, laboratory tests, medical images, surgical and anesthesia records, pathology data, and medical expenses. Changing hospitals, finding a second doctor for another visit, applying for commercial insurance, and really having a dispute all rely on these
Level of Evidence: A

Source: State Council (2018). Regulations on the Prevention and Handling of Medical Disputes (State Council Order No. 701 No.) Article 16: "Patients have the right to inspect and copy their outpatient medical records, hospitalization records, temperature sheets, medical orders, laboratory tests (test reports), medical imaging examination data, special examination consent forms, surgical consent forms, surgical and anesthesia records, pathology data, nursing records, medical expenses and all other information that belongs to medical records specified by the health authority of the State Council." "If a patient requests to copy medical record information, the medical institution shall provide copying services and stamp the copied medical record information with a certification mark... Work can be charged This fee and charging standards should be made public. ""If a patient dies, his or her close relatives may access and copy medical record information in accordance with the provisions of these regulations." Article 15 "No unit or individual may tamper with, forge, conceal, destroy or seize medical record information." <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2018-08/31/content_5318057.htm>; National Health and Family Planning Commission, State Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine (2013). Regulations on the Management of Medical Records in Medical Institutions (2013 Edition): Medical institutions "should designate departments or full-time (part-time) personnel to be responsible for accepting applications for copying medical record information." Copying must be done in the presence of the applicant and stamped with a certification stamp. <http://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2014/content_2600084.htm>

Note: Copies are accepted by the department designated by the hospital, and there is no need to ask a doctor. The list to be copied should be read directly according to Article 16 of the "Regulations on the Prevention and Handling of Medical Disputes". First, there are outpatient medical records, hospitalization records, temperature sheets, doctor's orders, laboratory tests, and imaging data. Then there are surgical and anesthesia records, pathology data, nursing records, and medical expense lists. After getting it, save it in a folder in chronological order. The most important ones are the discharge summary, surgical records, pathology reports and key images. Previous indicators of chronic diseases are marked in the same book, see Section 16.

Case: Mr. Chen underwent CT and blood tests in two hospitals respectively. He went to the medical records room with his ID card and copied all the reports and video CDs, paying only a small fee for the production.
