Later, when the patient was transferred to another hospital, the new doctor directly referred the old information, eliminating the need for repeated examinations and smoothing the reimbursement from commercial insurance.

items.title: If you have any questions about the diagnosis and treatment, you can ask for the medical records to be sealed on the spot. Both parties should be present, draw up a list, and each have a copy.
items.core: If you have any questions about the treatment, you can ask for the medical records to be sealed. The sealing requires both the doctor and the patient to be present, make a list, sign and seal it, and each take a copy. If the medical record has not been completed, the part that has been completed should be sealed first. If it is suspected that there is a problem with infusion, blood transfusion, injection, or medication, the bag of liquid, the medicine, and the infusion set must be sealed together.
body: Cost: No money. Make a sealing request to the hospital and wait for both doctors and patients to arrive to complete the procedures. It was difficult to say this in front of the doctor.

Income: The regulations stipulate that "if a medical dispute occurs and medical records need to be sealed or unsealed, this should be done in the presence of both the doctor and the patient." What is sealed can be the original or a copy, which will be kept by the medical institution. If the medical record is not yet completed and needs to be sealed, the completed part will be sealed first, and then the completed part will be sealed. Medical institutions should prepare a sealing list for sealed medical records, and both doctors and patients should sign or seal it, each keeping one copy. If infusion, blood transfusion, injection, medication, etc. are suspected to cause adverse consequences, both doctors and patients should jointly seal and unseal the physical objects on site. If inspection is required, both parties shall jointly entrust an institution with inspection qualifications. If both parties are unable to jointly entrust, the appointment shall be made by the health department of the county-level people's government where the medical institution is located. If blood transfusion is suspected of causing adverse consequences and the blood needs to be sealed, the medical institution shall notify the blood station to send personnel to the scene. There is another hard restriction: "No unit or individual may tamper with, forge, conceal, destroy or seize medical records." If the dispute has been resolved after sealing, or no further request for resolution has been made for three years, the medical institution can unseal it on its own (national, effective from October 1, 2018)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: State Council (2018). Regulations on the Prevention and Handling of Medical Disputes (State Council Order No. 701, Articles 15, 24, and 25). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2018-08/31/content_5318057.htm>

Note: Sealing and copying are two different things. Copying is something you should do on a daily basis, see Article 5 (keep a copy of your medical records and images). Sealing is to fix the evidence when a dispute occurs and prevent subsequent writing and modification. If you suspect that there is a problem with infusion, blood transfusion, or medication, in addition to the medical records, you must also seal the bag of liquid, the medicine, and the infusion set together, and do not let anyone take them away and throw them away. Medical institutions should publish the resolution methods, procedures and contact information for medical disputes in a prominent location, and set up a unified complaint management department. Contact the department in advance, not the doctor on duty.

Case: Ms. Zhao had an abnormal reaction after the infusion, and she immediately requested that the medical records be sealed. Both doctors and patients are present together, make a list, sign and seal, each holds one copy, and seal it together with the remaining medicinal solutions and infusion sets. During later identification, these complete materials became key evidence.

items.title: For serious injuries and illnesses, go straight to the emergency pre-examination and triage desk, do not queue at the registration window
items.core: Emergency treatment is not on a first-come, first-served basis, and is divided into four levels according to the severity of the condition. The place for grading is the pre-examination triage desk at the emergency entrance, not the registration window. Let’s report the most dangerous ones first: heavy bleeding, out of breath, unconsciousness, chest pain like a heart attack, unbearable pain.
body: Cost: No money. After entering, walk a few steps to find the pre-screening triage desk. Explain the most terrible symptom in one sentence.

Income: The National Health Commission’s 2024 version of emergency medicine quality control indicators stipulates that emergency pre-examination and triage should “divide patients into four levels according to the severity of their condition.” "Level I is a critical patient who needs immediate treatment." "Level II patients are acute and severe patients, and evaluation and treatment are often performed at the same time." "Level III patients are emergency patients who require diagnosis and treatment within a short period of time." "Level IV patients are non-emergency or sub-acute patients and are treated sequentially in the general medical treatment area." Pre-examination and triage means that a specialist will evaluate the severity of the patient's condition before entering the emergency room and determine the order of treatment. Beijing’s implementation standards provide response requirements at all levels. Level 1 "Carry out immediate assessment and treatment, and arrange for the patient to enter the resuscitation room or emergency room." Level 2 "monitor vital signs immediately, receive treatment within 10 minutes, and arrange for the patient to enter the emergency room." Level 3 "Prioritize diagnosis and treatment before level 4 patients, and arrange patients to wait in the general diagnosis and treatment area; if the waiting time is more than 30 minutes, they need to be re-evaluated." Level 4 "Sequential treatment, unless the condition changes, the waiting time will be longer; if the waiting time is more than 4 hours, it can be re-evaluated." In the Beijing standards, level 1 manual assessment indicators include "acute disturbance of consciousness." Level 2 includes "active or severe blood loss", "severe dyspnea", "chest pain similar to cardiac factors" and "severe pain from all causes (7 to 10 points)". Triage should "adhere to the principle of priority for emergency and critical care", and a pre-examination triage area should be set up in a prominent position at the entrance of the emergency department (the fourth-level standard is the national standard, and the response time is the Beijing standard)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: General Office of the National Health Commission (2024). Notice on the issuance of emergency medicine and other six professional medical quality control indicators (2024 version) (National Health Office Medical Affairs Letter [2024] No. 150) Attachment 1. Indicator 4 "Emergency grade triage implementation rate". <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202405/content_6951260.htm>; Beijing Municipal Health Commission (2019). Beijing's work plan for strengthening emergency pre-examination, triage and grading and its annex "Beijing Hospital Emergency Pre-examination and Triage Grading Standards (Trial)": "Adhere to the principle of giving priority to emergency treatment. According to the severity of the patient's condition, follow the principle of from severe to light, from rapid changes to relatively stable conditions. , Reasonably arrange the order of patient visits. ""Set up an emergency pre-examination triage area at a prominent location at the entrance of the emergency department." "Pre-hospital medical emergency doctors should conduct preliminary grading of patients according to relevant standards, and promptly notify the emergency department of the hospital to be prepared for patients with level 1 and 2." <http://wjw.beijing.gov.cn/zwgk_20040/ylws/201912/t20191216_1242338.html>

Note: The four levels are unified across the country. How long it takes for each level to be processed is determined by each province and city. The Beijing version is a version that can be verified word for word. The rating looks at indicators and symptoms such as heartbeat, blood pressure, and blood oxygen. Pain level is also one of them. If the pain reaches 7 to 10 points, it can be rated as level 2. Level 1 hard indicators include the following. One is that the heart rate is greater than 180 beats/minute, or less than 40 beats/minute. The second is that the systolic blood pressure is lower than 70 mmHg. Systolic blood pressure is the high pressure in blood pressure. Third, blood oxygen is lower than 80%. The fourth is shock, definite myocardial infarction, and acute disturbance of consciousness. If you feel that the triage has underestimated you, add the most dangerous symptom. If your condition changes while waiting for treatment, please return to the triage desk immediately for re-evaluation. Call 120 when it’s really critical (see Section 13). Beijing's plan requires pre-hospital emergency doctors to initially grade the patient according to standards, and to promptly notify the emergency department of the hospital to be sent to be ready for treatment if the patient is grade 1 or 2.

Case: Uncle Liu suddenly had chest pain and was sent to the emergency room by his family. Instead of queuing up at the registration window, they went straight to the pre-examination triage desk. The nurse quickly assessed the patient as having high-risk chest pain and immediately arranged for an electrocardiogram and rescue, which bought valuable time for thrombolysis for myocardial infarction.

items.title: If you don’t bring any money, no documents, and you can’t tell who you are, you have to go to the emergency room first.
items.core: The state has a disease emergency relief fund, which is dedicated to paying first-aid expenses for two types of people: those whose identities cannot be found out, and those who cannot afford to pay. The hospital cannot refuse or delay rescue, and the emergency center cannot not provide emergency services because of money issues. So don’t bear it at home just because you don’t have money, and don’t be afraid of not calling an ambulance because you’re in arrears. This money is only for first aid. If you are hospitalized later, you will still have to use medical insurance and medical assistance.
body: Cost: No money.

Benefits: The disease emergency assistance system is targeted at "patients who suffer from acute or serious injuries and illnesses in China and need first aid but whose identity is unclear or who are unable to pay the corresponding fees." The fund pays two types of expenses: "emergency expenses incurred by patients whose identities cannot be identified" and "emergency expenses owed by patients whose identities are clear but unable to pay." The document also states that "medical institutions at all levels and all types of medical institutions and their staff must promptly and effectively rescue patients with acute, severe and critical injuries, and must not refuse, shirk or delay treatment for any reason." There are also regulations for pre-hospital first aid: the national pre-hospital medical emergency call number is "120". Emergency centers (stations) "may not refuse, shirk or delay pre-hospital medical emergency services due to command and dispatch reasons", nor "refute or delay pre-hospital medical emergency services due to cost issues". Transfers follow the principles of "proximity, urgency, meeting professional needs, and taking into account the patient's wishes" (National, starting from 2013)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: General Office of the State Council (2013). Guiding Opinions on Establishing a Disease Emergency Relief System (Guobanfa [2013] No. 15). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2013-03/01/content_6069.htm>; National Health and Family Planning Commission (2014). Pre-hospital Medical Emergency Management Measures (Order No. 3, Articles 13, 22, 23, and 25). <http://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2014/content_2580977.htm>

Note: The fund only pays for the "first aid expenses", and treatment is done first. Afterwards, the medical institution applies to the fund, instead of you going to the window to collect money. Those with medical insurance will go to medical insurance first as usual. The application process and limits vary from province to province. In the transfer principle, "nearest and most urgent" comes before "patient's wishes", so the ambulance may not necessarily send you to the hospital you designate. In critical cases, the hospital that can handle the situation nearest will be used. If the amount you pay later is still too heavy, you can seek medical assistance. See Section 7, Article 10 (Medical Assistance).

Case: A migrant worker suddenly passed out on the roadside with no money and no documents. After passers-by called 120, the emergency center dispatched vehicles as usual and the hospital opened a green channel for rescue. The follow-up expenses were paid through the disease emergency relief fund, and the family members completed the medical insurance connection according to the policy after arriving.

items.title: The disability assessment should be done after the treatment is completed or the clinical treatment effect is stable
items.core: The amount of compensation depends mainly on the level of the assessment. The level of the assessment depends on how much functional disability is left after the treatment is completed. The standard states that it should be done after the treatment is completed or the clinical treatment effect is stable. It does not meet this requirement to evaluate the bones before they are fully grown. Ordinary fractures that heal and do not affect function are generally not rated.
body: Cost: The appraisal fee ranges from a few hundred to two thousand yuan, and is generally paid by the party making the application. It is up to the doctor to wait for the treatment to end or the clinical effect to be stable. How long to wait depends on the condition of the injury. The difficulty is that you want to settle down quickly before the injury heals, so you have to hold back.

Benefits: The appraisal principle of "Classification of Human Injury and Disability Degrees" is that "the degree of tissue and organ loss and/or dysfunction should be objectively evaluated based on the consequences or outcome of injury treatment." The standard stipulates that the timing of identification "should be carried out after the treatment of the primary injury and its related complications has been completed or the clinical treatment effect has stabilized." The standard "divides the degree of human disability into 10 levels, from level one (human body disability rate 100%) to level ten (human body disability rate 10%), with a 10% difference in disability rate for each level." The basis for judgment is "the structural damage and dysfunction of human tissue and organs and their dependence on medical treatment and nursing, with due consideration to the impact of social interactions and psychological factors caused by disability." There are several clauses related to fractures in Level 10. One is "compression fracture of a vertebral body (compression degree reaches 1/3) or comminuted fracture." The second is "fractures in more than two places of the pelvis or comminuted fractures and malunion." The third is "a loss of more than 25% of the function of any major joint of the limbs (except the ankle joint)." Disabilities of the same location and nature shall not be counted twice. If there are two or more disabilities, the grade should be clearly stated (nationwide, effective from January 1, 2017)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Supreme People's Court, Supreme People's Procuratorate, Ministry of Public Security, Ministry of National Security, Ministry of Justice (2016). Announcement on the release of "Classification of Human Injury and Disability Degrees" (released on April 18, 2016, effective on January 1, 2017), Standard No. Articles 4.1, 4.2, 4.3, 4.4, 4.5, 5.10.6, and 6.2. <https://www.moj.gov.cn/pub/sfbgw/zwxxgk/fdzdgknr/fdzdgknrtzwj/201908/P020210316701681025917.pdf>

Note: The three sets of disability assessments are not universal, don’t get confused. For injuries caused by injuries, traffic accidents and other personal injuries, the "Human Body Injury Disability Grading" determined by the forensic appraisal is used to calculate disability compensation (see Section 9). For work-related injuries, work ability assessment uses another set of ten disability levels, which govern work-related injury benefits (see Section 19). If you want to enjoy the policy benefits for people with disabilities, you must apply for a disability certificate (see Article 10, Disability Certificate). Before the appraisal, prepare all the medical records, surgical records, and reexamination images (see Article 5, keep a copy of the medical records and images yourself). There is no standard for whether the grade of premature treatment is low or high. It is deduced from the principle of "based on the consequences or outcome of injury treatment": the evaluation of premature treatment is based on the condition at that time, and the functions that have not yet been restored may get better or worse later. When this injury is mixed with an existing ailment, the appraisal opinion will also state how much the injury contributes to the disability. This column directly affects how much money will be lost.

Case: Xiao Zhou suffered a fracture in his leg after a car accident. He was in a hurry to get a disability appraisal 2 months after the operation. The accreditation agency refused on the grounds that the treatment was not completed. A review one year later showed that the fracture healed well and there was no functional impairment. The evaluation result was that the patient was not disabled, and he avoided spending money in vain.

items.title: If you are indeed left with functional impairment after treatment, go to the county-level Disabled Persons' Federation in your place of residence to apply for a Disabled Person's Certificate
items.core: The Disabled Person's Certificate is the threshold for receiving disability benefits, not proof of injury. It is divided into seven categories: vision, hearing, speech, physical, intelligence, spirit and multiple categories, with levels one to four for each category. The process is application, acceptance, evaluation by designated agencies, publicity, review and approval, and issuance of certificates. It is valid for ten years and will be replaced free of charge upon expiration. If you have any objection to the assessment conclusion, you may apply for re-assessment.
body: Cost: There is no production fee for the certificate itself. In principle, you have to pay the assessment fee and photo fee yourself. If you have difficulty, you can apply for exemption. Bring your ID card, household registration booklet and three two-inch white-background photos to the county-level Disabled Persons' Federation at your place of residence. After passing the assessment, it will be announced in the village (community) for 5 working days, and the review by the Disabled Persons' Federation will be completed within 10 working days. The difficulty lies in having to make these trips and wait for this period of time.

Benefits: The Disability Certificate "is a legal certificate for identifying disabled people, their type of disability, and level of disability. It is an important basis for disabled people to enjoy preferential policies of the state and local governments in accordance with the law." The assessment standard is the national standard "Disability Classification and Grading of Disabled Persons" (GB/T 26341-2010). The application for certificates shall be subject to voluntary and local management. People with seven types of disabilities, including vision, hearing, speech, physical, intellectual, mental and multiple disabilities, can apply. The disability levels range from level one to level four. The county-level Disabled Persons' Federation is responsible for application acceptance and issuance, based on the assessment conclusions made by provincial-level designated hospitals or professional institutions. If the assessment conclusion meets the standards, it will be announced in the village (community) for five working days, and the county-level Disabled Persons' Federation will "complete the review within ten working days." "There is no production fee for applying for a disability certificate." The assessment and photo fees "are in principle borne by the applicant himself; local finance may provide subsidies where conditions permit, and applicants with special difficulties should coordinate with relevant departments to provide exemptions." The certificate is valid for ten years and can be renewed free of charge upon expiration. If the disability category or level changes, you can apply for re-evaluation. If you have any objection to the assessment conclusion, you can apply to the prefecture-level Disabled Persons' Federation for re-assessment within ten working days. If there are still objections, the provincial-level Disability Assessment Expert Committee will make the final conclusion (nationwide, effective from January 1, 2018)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: China Disabled Persons' Federation, National Health and Family Planning Commission (2017). Measures of the People's Republic of China for the Management of Disability Certificates (issued on May 27, 2017, effective on January 1, 2018; Articles 2, 3, 5, 7, 9, 17, 19, 22, and 25). <https://www.bdpf.org.cn/cms68/web1459/subject/n1/n1459/n1508/n1509/n1512/c68465/content.html>

Note: Please settle the account first whether you want to handle it or not. The certificate itself does not issue money directly. It is followed by two subsidies for disabled people: living allowances for disabled people in subsistence allowance families, and nursing subsidies for first- and second-level people who require long-term care, see Section 7, Article 8 (two subsidies). The certificate also connects to various discounts on rehabilitation, assistive devices, taxes, employment and transportation. These standards vary greatly from province to province. Check the official website of the local Disabled Persons' Federation first before deciding whether to take this trip. It is three sets of things, including the judicial appraisal of the disability level and the work-related injury appraisal of working ability, and they are not substitutes for each other (see Article 9, the disability appraisal must wait until the treatment is completed). The pass is for personal use only and cannot be borrowed. Those whose disability status no longer meets the standards will be canceled and are not allowed to reapply within one year after cancellation. Multiple disabilities are rated according to the most severe one.

Case: Master Wu lost his left thumb due to a work-related injury. After treatment, he went to the county Disabled Persons' Federation to apply for a disability certificate. He submitted his medical records and images, and went to the designated institution to be assessed as limb level four. After publicity and review, he received the certificate. After that, he received a monthly nursing subsidy for severely disabled people.

items.title: Thank the doctor who saved your life with a letter of thanks, a banner, and a satisfaction rating. Don’t use red envelopes: the rules prohibit property, not gratitude.
items.core: You cannot buy priority by putting money in advance. It is prohibited to exchange patient resources, beds, scarce medicines, and surgical arrangements for benefits. If you want to thank the doctor who saved your life afterwards, you can thank him, but don't give him a red envelope of tobacco or alcohol. If he accepts it, it is against the rules. If you want to express your gratitude, you can carefully fill out a satisfaction evaluation, or write a thank-you letter by name or send a banner.
body: Cost: No money. Write a thank you letter, or fill it out on the satisfaction platform for ten minutes.

Income: Item 7 of the "Nine Principles for the Integrity of Medical Institutional Staff" (National Health Commission [2021] No. 41): "Maintain the order of diagnosis and treatment and do not undermine the fairness of medical treatment. Adhere to the principle of equality and jointly build a fair medical environment. It is strictly prohibited to use medical resources such as number sources, bed sources, scarce medicines and consumables, or diagnosis and treatment arrangements such as examinations and surgeries to accept benefits and harm the public and private interests." Item 8: "Build a harmonious relationship together and do not accept "red envelopes" from patients. Adhere to medical ethics and strict self-discipline." The same item also states that "it is strictly prohibited to solicit or accept gifts, gratuities, consumer cards, securities, equity, other financial products and other property from patients and their relatives and friends." The same goes for meals and entertainment paid for by the patient: "It is strictly prohibited to participate in banquets or travel, fitness, entertainment and other activities arranged, organized or paid for by the patient." The document also requires medical institutions to implement their main responsibilities, conduct supervision and "resolutely investigate and deal with violations." Satisfaction evaluation is included in the performance appraisal of tertiary public hospitals. The basis is the "Opinions of the General Office of the State Council on Strengthening the Performance Appraisal of Tertiary Public Hospitals" (Guobanfa [2019] No. 4). The document states: “The performance evaluation indicator system for tertiary public hospitals consists of four indicators including medical quality, operational efficiency, sustainable development, and satisfaction evaluation.” The document also states: "Hospital satisfaction consists of two parts: patient satisfaction and medical staff satisfaction...". It goes on to say that "we should measure the patient's sense of gain and the enthusiasm of medical staff through the satisfaction evaluation of outpatients, inpatients and medical staff." This set of evaluations also has a national unified platform: "The state establishes a public hospital satisfaction management system...". The timetable is: "Before the end of March 2019, all tertiary public hospitals across the country will be included in the National Health Commission Satisfaction Survey Platform. All localities must apply the National Health Commission Satisfaction Survey Platform and incorporate the survey results into the performance evaluation of tertiary public hospitals." Hospitals must also handle complaints. The basis is Article 2 of the "Measures for the Management of Complaints of Medical Institutions" (National Health Commission Order No. 3, effective in 2019). Complaint management refers to patients “putting forward opinions, suggestions or complaint requests” regarding medical service behavior, medical management, medical quality and safety, etc. The hospital is responsible for investigation, processing and feedback. "Medical institutions at level 2 and above should set up a doctor-patient relations office or a designated department (hereinafter collectively referred to as the complaint management department) to be responsible for unified complaint management." The responsibilities of the complaint management department include “accepting complaints in a unified manner, investigating and verifying complaints, proposing handling opinions, and responding to patients in a timely manner.” Medical institutions “should encourage staff to proactively collect patients’ opinions and suggestions on medical services, medical quality and safety, etc.” (National)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National Health Commission, National Medical Insurance Administration, State Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine (2021). Notice on Issuing Nine Guidelines for Integrity for Staff in Medical Institutions (Guo Wei Yi Fa [2021] No. 41). State Council Gazette <http://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2022/content_5678098.htm>; General Office of the State Council (2019). Opinions on strengthening the performance appraisal of tertiary public hospitals (Guobanfa [2019] No. 4). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2019-01/30/content_5362266.htm>; National Health Commission (2019). Measures for the Management of Complaints of Medical Institutions (Order No. 3). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2019-10/08/content_5436976.htm>

Note: The beneficiary is yourself and the person who saved you. It's human nature to want to thank someone after an all-night rescue operation. It's okay to thank someone, but the only thing that needs to be changed is the form. Red envelopes, cigarettes and alcohol transfer the risk to the other party. Letters of thanks, banners and satisfaction evaluations are methods recognized by the system. If you have given it away and the other party pushes it back, don't take it as a sign of disrespect or putting on airs. That is what he must do according to regulations. In addition, two things should be clearly distinguished: giving red envelopes to doctors is under the control of industry discipline and hospitals, and giving property to case handling and law enforcement personnel is a crime of bribery in the criminal law. The two things are not of the same magnitude. The latter is found in Section 8, Article 40. It is generally accepted to write a thank you letter and send it to Jinqi Hospital, but "it will be recorded in personal and department records" is a rule of thumb and there is no document requirement. There is a documented basis for the inclusion of satisfaction survey results into the performance appraisal of tertiary public hospitals. If you have any questions about the diagnosis and treatment itself, ask to seal the medical records on the spot (see Article 6 of this section, seal medical records), and keep the medical records and images (Article 5, keep a copy of the medical records and images yourself)

Case: Mr. Sun wanted to thank the surgeon after his heart surgery, but when no one was around, he stuffed a red envelope and it was returned. He carefully filled out the hospital satisfaction evaluation, wrote a thank-you note, and even presented a banner. The doctor solemnly accepted it, and Corey posted a thank-you note on the bulletin board.

items.title: Before getting a dental implant, ask what items are included in the lump sum price, and give priority to institutions that promise to participate in price management. Don’t believe low-price advertisements
items.core: After the intensive price reduction of dental implants in 2023, the overall cost of a conventional dental implant has dropped from an average of 15,000 yuan to 6,000 to 7,000 yuan. In principle, the service fee for a single implant in a tertiary public hospital does not exceed 4,500 yuan, and implants and crowns are charged separately. Dental implants, dentures, and orthodontics are not covered by medical insurance, but dental treatment items are generally covered everywhere.
body: Cost: No money. Before seeing a dentist, check the list of institutions on the official account of the National Medical Insurance Administration and ask about the prices in person, which takes about ten minutes.

Benefits: The National Medical Insurance Administration announced in January 2024 that the cost of a routine single tooth implant consists of three parts. The first part is the medical service fee, which is collected on a lump sum basis. The scope of the lump sum includes "diagnosis fees, biochemical tests and imaging examination fees, implant placement fees, dental crown placement fees, scanning design modeling fees for the entire process of implantation, excluding tooth extraction, periodontal scaling, root canal treatment, bone grafting, and soft tissue transplantation." "In principle, the medical service charge for a single conventional dental implant in tertiary public hospitals in various regions shall not exceed 4,500 yuan." Economically developed areas can relax up to 20% according to the 2022 special management notice. The second part is implants, which will be purchased nationwide in January 2023. “The selected price range is 548 yuan to 1,855 yuan, with an average price of more than 900 yuan.” The Sichuan Provincial Medical Insurance Bureau, which took the lead, announced that the median purchase price of imported high-priced brands has dropped from 5,000 yuan to about 1,850 yuan, and that of the brands with the largest consumption has dropped from about 1,500 yuan to about 770 yuan. The third part is dental crowns, "the price range is 100 yuan to 656 yuan, with an average price of more than 300 yuan." The National Medical Insurance Administration's press conference in the second half of 2023 stated that all local control measures were implemented at the end of April and early May, and "the overall cost of dental implants dropped from an average of 15,000 yuan to about 6,000-7,000 yuan." Not covered by medical insurance: A 1999 document from the Ministry of Labor and Social Security and other departments listed "dentures" (dentures) and "non-functional cosmetic and orthopedic surgeries" as being excluded from basic medical insurance. In its reply to the CPPCC proposal in 2019, the National Medical Insurance Administration stated that "cosmetic medical treatment items (including tooth loss restoration, correction, etc.) are not included in the payment scope of the medical insurance fund. However, dental treatment items are not excluded at the national level and are generally included in the scope of medical insurance payment in various places" (National, as of October 2026)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National Medical Insurance Administration (2024). Announcement on the release of the “List of Medical Institutions Committed to Participating in Oral Implant Price Management” and other information (January 12, 2024). <https://www.nhsa.gov.cn/art/2024/1/12/art_109_11954.html>; National Medical Insurance Administration (2022). Notice on carrying out special management of oral implant medical service charges and consumable prices (Medical Insurance Issue [2022] 27 No. 4 and 6). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2022-09/08/content_5709065.htm>; National Medical Insurance Administration (2023). National Medical Insurance Administration held a regular press conference for the second half of 2023 (September 22, 2023). <https://www.nhsa.gov.cn/art/2023/9/22/art_14_11321.html>; Sichuan Provincial Medical Security Bureau (2023). Results of the proposed centralized bulk purchase of oral implant systems (January 11, 2023). <https://ylbzj.sc.gov.cn/scsybj/nc020100/2023/1/11/ac5565c7e0454890be086a2bc41f9acd.shtml>; Ministry of Labor and Social Security, etc. (1999). Notice on the issuance of opinions on the management of diagnosis and treatment items, scope of medical service facilities and payment standards of the basic medical insurance for urban employees (Ministry of Labor and Social Security [1999] No. 22, Attachment 1). <https://policy.mofcom.gov.cn/claw/clawContent.shtml?id=39317>; National Medical Security Administration (2019). Letter of reply to Proposal No. 4043 of the Second Session of the 13th National Committee of the Chinese People’s Political Consultative Conference. <https://www.nhsa.gov.cn/art/2019/12/3/art_26_2096.html>

Note: The 4,500 yuan line only applies to public hospitals. Private institutions set their own prices, but a special governance notice requires them not to induce patients with false or misleading "subsidies" or "low prices." The advertised low prices are often just for the implants. Items that are not included in the package, such as tooth extraction and bone grafting, are where the price increases. So before signing, you should get a list with the price of each item clearly stated. The list of institutions committed to participating in price governance will be announced by the National Medical Insurance Administration on its official WeChat account. It is not necessary to have a missing tooth or two. Fixed dentures and removable dentures are also repair methods. The price has not changed accordingly. Ask the doctor which one is suitable for you. There is no unified statement across the country as to whether the personal account of employee medical insurance can pay for dental implants. Ask the local medical insurance department; how to use the personal account for family members, see Section 5, Article 13 (Family Assistance). Why you should go to the dentist for missing teeth? See Section 2, Item 10 (Going to the dentist for missing teeth). The revenue level is set as medium: the price reduction is brought about by the policy. What the reader can save at this step is mainly the lump sum price increase and the part of the high-priced institution, which is several thousand yuan per pill

Case: Aunt Liu saw an advertisement from a dental clinic saying "Dental Implants cost 2,980 yuan". After arriving at the hospital, she was charged additional fees for bone grafting, dental crowns, etc. She turned to a public hospital that promised price management and found out that the lump sum price included implants, dental crowns and surgical fees. In the end, the total cost of one tooth was 6,500 yuan, with no hidden costs.

items.title: If the hospital says that the national medical insurance negotiated medicine is out of stock and will not be admitted to the hospital, let the doctor write a prescription and go to the medical insurance "dual-channel" designated drug store to buy it, and it will still be reimbursed according to regulations
items.core: The hospital says that a certain nationally negotiated medicine is out of stock and does not enter the hospital, which does not mean that the medicine cannot be reimbursed. This drug is sold through the province's "dual channel". Doctors can prescribe it as usual and can be bought at a "dual channel" designated pharmacy. The reimbursement policy is the same as buying it in a hospital. According to national documents, hospitals cannot use the total amount of medical insurance and the proportion of medicines as reasons for delaying the payment.
body: Cost: No money. Ask the doctor to write a prescription and then go to the designated pharmacy. In some places, a drug qualification certification is required first.

Income: Negotiated drugs are drugs that are put into the medical insurance catalog after price negotiation between the National Medical Insurance Bureau and pharmaceutical companies. The National Medical Insurance Administration’s 2021 policy interpretation states that the catalog is adjusted once a year and becomes “advanced medical insurance, then entering the hospital”, so some negotiated drugs are “difficult to enter the hospital”. To this end, the National Medical Insurance Administration and the National Health Commission issued Medical Insurance Fa [2021] No. 28. The document states that the "dual channel" is a mechanism for supplying negotiated drugs "through two channels: designated medical institutions and designated retail pharmacies" and "simultaneously incorporated into the medical insurance payment mechanism." For drugs included in the "dual channel", "a unified payment policy will be implemented in designated medical institutions and designated retail pharmacies." The reimbursement rules are the same when buying at a pharmacy or at a hospital. Which drugs are included will in principle be determined by the provincial medical insurance department. Which pharmacies are included, the medical insurance department must "promptly disclose to the public in a timely manner." Prescriptions are transferred to pharmacies through the prescription circulation center in the medical insurance system, which requires "ensuring smooth circulation of electronic prescriptions." Medical Insurance Letter [2021] No. 182 in September of the same year requires that negotiated drugs that hospitals cannot temporarily distribute must "increase drug accessibility through "dual channels" and other channels." The negotiated drugs for reasonable use are listed separately and are not included in the assessment of the proportion of drugs admitted to the hospital. The document also states that "limitations on the total amount of medical insurance, limits on the number of drug lists in medical institutions, drug proportions, etc. shall not be used as reasons to affect the implementation of negotiated drugs." At that time, it was also required that each prefecture-level city should have at least one "dual-channel" retail pharmacy by the end of November 2021. The notice on the 2025 version of the National Medical Insurance Drug Catalog (Milbao Fa [2025] No. 33) reiterates this sentence "It shall not be based on...". The notice also stated that in principle, drugs that have been negotiated cannot be transferred out of the "dual channel" just because they are converted into regular catalog drugs. Designated pharmacies that dispense "dual-channel" medicines "are required to transfer such prescriptions through electronic prescription centers." The new version of the catalog will be implemented from January 1, 2026 (nationwide, as of October 2026)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National Medical Insurance Administration, National Health Commission (2021). Guidance on establishing and improving the “dual-channel” management mechanism for national medical insurance negotiation drugs (Milbao Fa [2021] No. 28, Articles 1, 2, 4, 5, and 6). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2021-05/10/content_5605595.htm>; National Medical Insurance Administration (2021). Policy Interpretation of "Guiding Opinions on Establishing and Improving the "Dual Channel" Management Mechanism for Drugs Negotiated by National Medical Insurance". <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/2021-05/10/content_5605596.htm>; National Medical Insurance Administration, National Health Commission (2021). Notice on adapting to the normalization of national medical insurance negotiations and continuing to do a good job in the implementation of negotiated drugs (Medical Insurance Letter [2021] No. 182, Articles 2, 3, and 5). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2021-09/11/content_5636762.htm>; National Medical Insurance Administration, Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security (2025). Notice on the issuance of the "National Basic Medical Insurance, Maternity Insurance and Work Injury Insurance Drug Catalog" and the "Commercial Health Insurance Innovative Drug Catalog" (2025) (Medical Insurance Issue [2025] 33 No., Part 1). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202512/content_7050533.htm>

Note: The method is divided into four steps. The first step is to ask the doctor whether the drug is a "dual-channel" drug in the province and whether it can be prescribed. Prescriptions are generally made electronically through the medical insurance system. The second step is to check which pharmacies can buy it. The provincial medical insurance bureaus will publish lists of drugs and pharmacies, and you can also call the local medical insurance department. The National Medical Insurance Service Platform App opened a query for negotiating drug dispensing agencies in 2021. The third step is to bring your medical insurance card or electronic medical insurance voucher to buy. Pharmacies need to verify that the person prescribing and taking the medication are the same person. The fourth step is to ask about the reimbursement ratio, whether it counts as outpatient chronic disease, and whether it can be paid separately. These are determined by each locality. Not every negotiated drug has entered the "dual channel", and those that have not entered can only be purchased at the hospital. Is it possible to pay directly for purchases abroad? The document only says "progress steadily", so ask before departure. For how to identify and settle outpatient chronic diseases, please refer to Section 16, Article 2 (Recognition of Outpatient Chronic Diseases). The magnitude of the benefit is determined to be large based on judgment: no national documents have been found that indicate how much a single patient can claim. However, the policy interpretation said that the focus of inclusion in the "dual channel" is drugs with "high clinical value, urgent need, and high cost." Calculated based on the course of treatment, the difference between out-of-pocket expenses and reimbursement is estimated to be in the order of 10,000 yuan. The beneficiaries are mainly yourself and your family

Case: Ms. Zhou suffered from lung cancer, and the medical insurance negotiation medicine prescribed by the doctor was out of stock in the hospital. She took the prescription and went to the "dual-channel" designated pharmacy of the medical insurance to buy medicine. The reimbursement rate was the same as that of the inpatient pharmacy. She did not spend extra money or interrupt treatment.

items.title: For chronic diseases that have been diagnosed in the hospital and the condition is stable, if you want to renew the prescription, you can go to the Internet hospital of this hospital for online follow-up consultation and prescription. The first time you see this disease cannot be seen online
items.core: For chronic diseases that have been diagnosed in the hospital and the condition is stable, the same kind of medicine needs to be prescribed. You can go to the original hospital for online follow-up consultation, and the medicine can be sent to your home. If the local medical insurance is included, you can directly use the medical insurance to settle the bill. When you see this disease for the first time, or if your condition changes, the doctor must ask you to go to the hospital to see you in person.
body: Cost: No money. You need to find the hospital’s Internet hospital entrance on your mobile phone and perform real-name authentication once. The examination fees for online follow-up consultations in public hospitals are charged as ordinary outpatient clinics. The delivery fee for home delivery of medicine will be paid by yourself and will not be covered by medical insurance.

Benefit: What you save is the time spent traveling to and from the hospital and queuing for registration. The "Internet Diagnosis and Treatment Management Measures (Trial)" stipulates that only follow-up consultations for some common and chronic diseases can be viewed online. The premise is that you have been diagnosed clearly in a physical hospital, and the doctor has your medical records and can follow up with the same diagnosis. The regulations state that "Internet diagnosis and treatment activities are not allowed for first-time patients." If your condition changes and you need to be checked by a doctor in person, the hospital will immediately stop online diagnosis and treatment and guide you to a physical hospital. Online prescriptions must have a physician's electronic signature. After review by the pharmacist, a third party can be entrusted to deliver the medicine to your home. Specially managed drugs such as narcotic drugs and psychotropic drugs cannot be prescribed online. Prescribing medication online to children under 6 years old must be accompanied by a guardian and a doctor with relevant expertise. For medical insurance reimbursement, please refer to the National Medical Insurance Administration’s 2020 Medical Insurance Document [2020] No. 45. It said that for follow-up consultations and prescriptions at the "Internet +" designated hospitals in the coordinating area, the examination fees and drug fees can be paid according to local medical insurance regulations. The part you pay yourself can be paid from the employee medical insurance personal account according to regulations. The cost of delivering medicines is not covered by medical insurance. All localities can start with outpatient chronic diseases and gradually expand the scope of payment. Local medical insurance agencies must publish the list of such designated hospitals to the public. Document No. 47 of the Medical Insurance Development Council [2019] stipulates that Internet follow-up consultations in public hospitals, regardless of which level of doctor visit, will be charged at the price of ordinary outpatient examinations (nationally, as of October 2026)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National Health Commission, State Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine (2018). Notice on the issuance of three documents including the Internet Diagnosis and Treatment Management Measures (Trial) (National Health Insurance Development [2018] 25 No.; Articles 2, 16, 18, and 19 of the "Internet Diagnosis and Treatment Management Measures (Trial)", Articles 19 and 20 of the "Internet Hospital Management Measures (Trial)"). <http://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2019/content_5358684.htm>: "Internet diagnosis and treatment activities shall not be carried out for first-time patients."; National Medical Security Administration (2020). Guiding Opinions on Actively Promoting Medical Insurance Payment for “Internet +” Medical Services (Milbaofa [2020] No. 45, Item (3) (4) (5)). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2020-11/03/content_5556883.htm>: "Insured persons receive "Internet +" medical services at designated points in this coordinating area Examination fees and drug fees incurred by medical institutions for follow-up visits and prescriptions can be paid in accordance with the unified regional medical insurance regulations. Among them, the expenses borne by individuals can be paid from the employee’s personal medical insurance account according to regulations. The cost of providing drug distribution services is not included in the scope of medical insurance payment.”; National Medical Insurance Bureau. (2019). Guiding Opinions on Improving “Internet +” Medical Service Prices and Medical Insurance Payment Policies (Milbaofa [2019] No. 47, “Refining Price Policies Based on the Characteristics of Various Services” item). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2019-08/30/content_5456428.htm>: "Public medical institutions carry out Internet follow-up consultations, and services are provided by medical staff of different levels, all charged at the price of general outpatient consultation items"

Note: First ask the attending doctor whether the disease can be reviewed online, and then go to the hospital's official account or app to find the entrance to the Internet hospital. Look for the Internet hospital opened by the hospital where you were diagnosed. Whether you can use medical insurance settlement is determined by each locality. Check the designated list published by the local medical insurance department, or call to ask. For those who participate in insurance in other places, the document only says "explore" for online direct settlement in other places, so ask first before using. If your condition is stable and your medicine is available in the community, it can be prescribed for 12 weeks at a time in the community. See Section 16, Article 5 (drugs that can be prescribed in the community for 12 weeks at a time). If this kind of medicine is not available in the community, or if a specialist is required to dispense the medicine, online follow-up consultation is more suitable. The income level is set as medium, which is based on judgment: it takes about half a day to go to a large hospital to prescribe medicine every month, which works out to about one hour per week. The main beneficiaries are yourself and your family. Elderly people with inconvenient legs and feet can save the most.

Case: Aunt Li has been diagnosed with high blood pressure in the city hospital for many years. Her blood pressure is stable, but she still takes the original two medicines. She uploaded her medical records through the hospital's Internet hospital, prescribed a prescription after video follow-up, settled her medical insurance, and had the medicine delivered to her home within three days.

items.title: When you are hospitalized, you need to get a list of expenses item by item. Ask for self-pay items that are not covered by medical insurance before agreeing. If you are not right, complain to the hospital about the price. If it doesn't work, report it to the medical insurance department.
items.core: When you are hospitalized, you can ask for a list of expenses, which contains the unit price, quantity and date of each medicine and each examination. For medicines and examinations not covered by medical insurance, except emergency rescue, the hospital must first obtain your or your family’s consent. If you find that you have been charged repeatedly or that you have been charged for items that were not performed, you should first call the hospital’s price complaint phone number. If the hospital refuses to acknowledge the charge, you will then report it to the medical insurance department.
body: Cost: No money. During hospitalization, the list should be made every few days, and it should take more than ten minutes to review it. It's hard to put down the shame and ask the doctors and nurses.

Income: The "Regulations on the Supervision and Administration of the Use of Medical Security Funds" stipulates that designated hospitals must "truthfully issue expense receipts and relevant information to insured persons." The insured also has the right to require the hospital to issue truthful reports. Hospitals are not allowed to conduct excessive examinations, double charges, exceed standard charges, or break down project charges. Medicines and services outside the scope of payment by the medical insurance fund, except emergency care and rescue, must obtain the consent of the insured person or close relatives or guardians. Anyone who violates these articles will be ordered to make corrections by the medical insurance department. If it causes losses to the medical insurance fund, it will be ordered to be refunded and a fine of 1 to 2 times the amount of the loss will be imposed. If you use items not covered by medical insurance without consent and refuse to make corrections, you will be fined 10,000 to 50,000 yuan. The National Health Commission's 2019 "Regulations on the Management of Internal Price Behavior in Medical Institutions" requires hospitals to establish a fee list system, including an electronic list. When the patient needs it, the hospital will print it out. The list should indicate the names and codes of the items, medicines, and consumables, as well as the unit price, unit of account, date of use, quantity, and amount. Charges based on disease type and DRG (disease group payment package) are not included in this requirement. The hospital should publish the telephone number for price consultation and complaints in a conspicuous position, implement the first-inquirer responsibility system for complaints, and the person receiving the complaints should write down the content and handling results. Report to the medical insurance department through the website, phone number, fax, and mailing address published by it. You can remain anonymous, and personal information reported by your real name must be kept confidential. If verified to be true, the whistleblower will be rewarded in accordance with national regulations (nationwide, as of October 2026)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: State Council (2021). Regulations on the Supervision and Administration of the Use of Medical Security Funds (State Council Order No. 735, Articles 15, 17, 35, 38, and 39). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2021-02/19/content_5587668.htm>: "Except for emergency situations, rescue and other special circumstances, providing medical services beyond the scope of payment of the medical security fund must obtain the consent of the insured person or his close relatives or guardians." "Insured persons have the right to require designated medical institutions to truthfully issue expense receipts and relevant information."; National Health Commission, State Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine (2019). Notice on the issuance of regulations on the management of price behavior within medical institutions (Guowei Finance Fa [2019] No. 64, Articles 15, 16, and 18). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2020-01/02/content_5466052.htm>: "Medical institutions should establish an expense list (including electronic list) system to provide patients with expense lists for medical services, drugs, medical consumables, etc. (except for disease types and DRGs) in various forms, and provide printing services when patients need it."; National Medical Security Administration (2022). Interim Measures for Handling Reports on Supervision and Management of Use of Medical Security Funds (National Medical Security Administration Order No. 5, Articles 6, 7, 8, 16, 21, and 25). <http://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2022/content_5687509.htm>

Note: Reports to the medical insurance department are in charge of illegal use of medical insurance funds by hospitals. The regulations are about ordering corrections, refunding medical insurance funds and fines, but not about refunding the overcharged part to you. If you want to get back the extra money you paid, you mainly need to rely on the hospital to correct the charges, so first go to the hospital's price complaint window and keep the list and communication records. It costs a few hundred yuan to go to court to file a lawsuit. The ordinary first-instance procedure is stipulated to be completed within 6 months, which can be extended. The lawyer's fees are paid by yourself, which is probably not cost-effective. When reporting, you should write down specific clues: which item on the list, which day, and how many times it was collected. If you just want to inquire about the reimbursement policy, calling the medical insurance consultation phone number is not considered a report. If you don't understand something, ask the nurse's station or the inpatient department first. It's not necessarily an arbitrary charge. Medicines that are not covered by medical insurance do not necessarily mean you should not take them. Ask how much it costs per day and whether there are any substitute medicines that can be covered before signing. When you are discharged from hospital, a master list is required and kept together with the medical records, see Article 5 (Keep a copy of the medical records and images by yourself). The benefit magnitude is set as medium, which is based on judgment: I have not found the official amount of overpayment for a single patient. According to the threshold of this book, it is considered to be a few hundred to several thousand yuan. The main beneficiaries are yourself and your family, and it is especially important to reconcile accounts for the elderly in the hospital

Case: Mr. Wang accompanied his father to the hospital. He asked the nurse station for a list of expenses every day and found that the ECG monitoring was double billed. He first called the hospital to complain about the price, and after checking, the hospital refunded the overcharged 180 yuan.

sections.title: What to do after the person is gone

items.title: If the person disappears at home or outside, first distinguish between normal death and abnormal death: if it is an accident, the cause of death is unknown, or you are living alone, call the police immediately, and do not touch the body or the scene
items.core: If you leave accidentally or do not know how to leave, it will be handled by the police and if it has not been treated by a hospital, the police will issue a death certificate. The scene was disturbed, things could not be explained clearly, and the evidence was difficult to obtain. If I can't get this piece of paper, the cremation, account cancellation, and insurance claim settlement will all be stuck. If you have been living alone for a long time before being discovered, and you can’t tell which type it is, call 110 first and wait for the police to complete the investigation before issuing a certificate.
body: Cost: No money. Just make a phone call.

Income: Paragraph 2 of Article 8 of the Household Registration Regulations: "If a citizen dies due to an accident or the cause of death is unknown, the head of the household or the person who discovered the death shall immediately report to the local public security station or the township or town people's committee." It means: If there is an accident, or you don’t know how the person disappeared, the head of the household and the person who found the person should report it to the police station or township government immediately. Article 23 of the Funeral Management Regulations: "If a natural person dies normally, the medical and health institution shall issue a death certificate in a timely manner. For the deceased who is involved in abnormal death cases (incidents) that are handled by the public security organs in accordance with the law and have not been treated by medical and health institutions, the public security organs shall issue a death certificate." Meaning: If the person dies due to a normal illness, the medical institution that treated him or her will issue a death certificate. Those who have not been treated by a hospital but are handled by the police will be opened by the police. Once the scene has been touched, it is neither clear nor easy to explain. Cremation, account cancellation, and insurance claims are all stuck on this piece of paper
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress Standing Committee (1958). Household Registration Regulations of the People's Republic of China (Article 8). <http://www.gd.gov.cn/zwgk/wjk/zcfgk/content/mpost_2531969.html> (published on the portal website of the Guangdong Provincial People's Government); State Council (2026). Funeral Management Regulations (State Council Order No. 824, effective from March 30, 2026, Article 23). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202601/content_7054169.htm>

Note: Those who have been ill for a long time and die at home are considered normal deaths. You can find the institution that treated him before his death to issue a certificate, or you can find a community health service center or township health center in the area where you live. The death certificate is issued by the person who treated the patient, see Article 2 (Death Certificate). If you can't tell which one it is, treat it as abnormal and call 110 first. The police will still be able to issue a certificate after arriving at the scene to investigate. If you clean up the scene first and then call the police, no one will be able to help you. Do not move the body yourself, wash and change him, and do not take away the medicine bottles and notes.

Case: Uncle Zhang, who lived alone, did not go out for three days. When his neighbor knocked on the door and no one answered, he called the police. The kitchen items were not moved when the family members arrived. After the police inspected the scene, the police issued a death certificate and the funeral arrangements were handled.

items.title: The death certificate is the key to everything that follows: whoever treats the patient will issue the death certificate. If a normal death occurs at home, the community health service agency will issue it within one day.
items.core: If the patient is in the hospital, the death certificate will be issued by the hospital in charge of treatment. If you are walking normally at home, find a community health service agency or township health center in the area where you live. If the death is normal and the cause of death is clear, it will be issued within one day. You will need to use it when canceling your account, cremating, collecting provident funds, collecting social security benefits, settling claims, and handling inheritances. Make a few copies of it before you get it.
body: Cost: No money.

Income: The "Population and Death Information Registration and Management Standards (Trial)" states: If someone dies in a medical and health institution, it will be issued by the "medical and health institution responsible for treatment." If he leaves in a hospital or health center, it will be issued by the one in charge of treatment. For those who die normally at home or in other places, the certificate "will be issued by the community health service agency or township (street) health center in the jurisdiction." The certificate will be issued by the community health service center, township or street health center in the area where you live. If the death is judged as abnormal by the public security and judicial organs, the death shall be handled by the public security and judicial departments in accordance with current regulations and procedures. In 2026, the five departments announced that "the paper version of the Death Certificate has the same legal effect as the electronic certificate," and the electronic version is equally valid as the paper version. For normal deaths with a clear cause of death, the certificate must be issued within one day after the death. If the certificate is lost, you can apply for a reissue from the original issuing agency. If the basic information is incorrect, you can apply for re-issuance with the materials
Level of Evidence: A

Source: General Office of the National Health and Family Planning Commission (2014). Population and Death Information Registration Management Standards (Trial) (National Health Office Planning Issue [2014] No. 68, Article 9). <https://mzj.sz.gov.cn/szmz/pc/zwgk/jcxxgk/zcfg/byfw/content/post_2952215.html> (Forwarded by Shenzhen Civil Affairs Bureau); National Health Commission, Ministry of Public Security, Ministry of Civil Affairs, State Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine, and National Administration of Disease Control and Prevention (2026). Notice on strengthening the registration of medical certificate information of residents and the management of electronic licenses (National Health Planning Issue [2026] No. 5). <https://wjw.fujian.gov.cn/xxgk/fgwj/gjwj/202602/t20260228_7102810.htm> (Forwarded by the Fujian Provincial Health Commission)

Remarks: Use it for everything including household cancellation, cremation, collecting provident fund, collecting social security benefits, settling insurance claims, and handling inheritance. Once you get it, make a few copies and apply for electronic certificates together. You only have one chance to get a reissue, so don’t lose the original. If there are any errors in your name or ID number, you must change them on the spot, because you will not find out until you apply for inheritance, and you will have to run through each window again.

Case: Aunt Zhao’s father died at home at night. After the doctor confirmed that the death was normal, she submitted her household registration book and ID card to the community health service agency where she lived. She received the death certificate the next day and successfully completed the cremation procedures.

items.title: The body can only be picked up, stored, and cremated by funeral parlors. Hospital morgues do not handle funerals, and storage generally does not exceed 3 days
items.core: The pick-up, storage, embalming, plastic surgery, and cremation can only be done by funeral parlors. The hospital morgue does not hold funerals, and at most the body is placed temporarily. Funeral homes generally store the items for no more than 3 days. If you want to keep them for a few more days, you will need to apply for an extension. Cremation requires a death certificate and cremation confirmation. The cremation certificate given after the cremation is also used for inheritance and claim settlement.
body: Cost: No money.

Income: Article 25 of the Funeral Management Regulations: "The transportation, storage, embalming, plastic surgery, and cremation services of the remains are exclusively provided by the funeral home." No one else can do these things. Article 24: "Morgues of medical and health institutions are not allowed to be outsourced, nor are they allowed to provide funeral services. They can provide convenient services for the temporary storage of remains." The hospital morgue can only be used temporarily and cannot accommodate funerals. Article 27: "Funeral parlors generally store remains for no more than three days. If storage needs to be extended, the bereaved family or the party transferring the remains should go through the extended storage procedures at the funeral parlor." If you want a few more days, go to the funeral home to apply for an extension. Article 28: "The funeral home shall cremate the remains based on the death certificate and cremation confirmation, and issue a cremation certificate." Both materials are indispensable, and you will be given a cremation certificate after the cremation. Article 29: "In areas where cremation is practiced, the remains should be cremated on the spot and in the nearest funeral parlor." Cremation should be done in a funeral parlor closest to the place where the person died
Level of Evidence: A

Source: State Council (2026). Funeral Management Regulations (State Council Order No. 824, effective from March 30, 2026, Articles 8, 9, 24, 25, 27, 28, 29). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202601/content_7054169.htm>

Note: Most of the "one-stop service" who come together after a death in the hospital are not from the funeral home. The pickup itself is a basic item and is priced, see Article 6 (Basic Item List). Keep the cremation certificate and use it for inheritance, insurance, and relocation of ashes. Whether cremation or burial is practiced locally is determined by the provincial government. The funeral customs of ethnic minorities are protected by Article 9 of the Regulations. If the person is buried when he should be cremated, or if the person is buried or repairs a grave outside the cemetery or ecological burial area, the civil affairs department will order him to make corrections within a time limit (change it back within a time limit).

Case: After my mother died in the hospital, the family did not find a private vehicle, but contacted the funeral home to pick her up. The body was temporarily stored in the morgue for one day, cremated with the death certificate, and the cremation certificate was collected for claim settlement.

items.title: If there is any objection to the cause of death, an autopsy must be submitted and performed within 48 hours, and the medical record shall be sealed at the same time
items.core: If there is any objection to the cause of death, the autopsy must be performed within 48 hours after the death. If the hospital has the conditions for freezing, it can be extended to 7 days. The autopsy requires close relatives to sign and agree. If they do not agree or it is delayed, the responsibility for the unclear cause of death lies with this party. When requesting an autopsy, he requested that the medical records be sealed. Once the body is cremated, an autopsy can no longer be performed.
body: Cost: No money. The hard thing is to remember to mention it at that time.

Benefits: The time limit for autopsy is written in Article 26 of the Regulations on the Prevention and Handling of Medical Disputes. The original text is: "When a patient dies and both doctors and patients disagree on the cause of death, an autopsy should be conducted within 48 hours after the patient's death; if the conditions for freezing the body are met, it can be extended to 7 days." Therefore, if you want to find out the cause of death, you must conduct an autopsy within 48 hours after the death. If the hospital has freezing conditions, the maximum time limit is 7 days. The same article also states: "An autopsy must be performed with the consent and signature of the close relatives of the deceased. If the person refuses to sign, it will be deemed that the close relatives of the deceased have not agreed to the autopsy." If the family members do not sign, it will be deemed as their disagreement. It also reads: "If you disagree with or delay the autopsy beyond the prescribed time, affecting the determination of the cause of death, the party who disagreed or delayed will bear the responsibility." Whoever disagrees or delays the decision will be held responsible if the cause of death cannot be found out later. Article 24: Sealing and unsealing medical records “should be carried out in the presence of both doctors and patients.” Both you and the hospital must be present when medical records are sealed and unsealed
Level of Evidence: A

Source: State Council (2018). Regulations on the Prevention and Handling of Medical Disputes (State Council Order No. 701, Articles 24 and 26). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/content/2018-08/31/content_5318057.htm>

Note: If you say "I felt it was wrong at the beginning" after this time limit, the responsibility will fall on the party who delayed it. Once the body is cremated, there is no possibility of an autopsy, so this should be settled before contacting the funeral home. See Section 24 for how to seal medical records.

Case: Mr. Chen’s father died suddenly after surgery. His family members suspected that there was something wrong with the medication. They requested an autopsy in writing and signed it on the same day, and also requested that the medical records be sealed. The body has not yet been cremated, and an autopsy report a week later clarified the cause of death.

items.title: There is a legal time limit for canceling the household registration of a deceased person: in cities, it must be canceled before burial, in rural areas, within one month
items.core: In cities, the household registration must be canceled before burial, and in rural areas, it must be canceled within one month. Bring the death certificate and household registration book to the police station. If you put it off, inheritance and transfer of ownership, receiving benefits, and surrendering insurance will all be stuck in the household registration status.
body: Cost: No money. Take the death certificate and household registration book with you and go to the police station.

Income: Paragraph 1 of Article 8 of the Household Registration Regulations: "When a citizen dies, before the burial in cities or within one month in rural areas, the household head, relatives, dependents or neighbors shall report the death registration to the household registration authority and cancel the household registration. If a citizen dies in the place of temporary residence, the household registration authority in the place of temporary residence shall notify the household registration authority in the place of permanent residence to cancel the household registration." This means: in cities it should be done before the burial, in rural areas it should be done within a month. The head of the household, relatives, dependents or neighbors can go to the household registration authority (police station) to report the death and cancel the household registration. If a person leaves while temporarily living in another place, the police station at the place of temporary residence will notify the police station at the place of household registration to cancel the household registration
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Standing Committee of the National People's Congress (1958). Regulations of the People's Republic of China on Household Registration (Article 8). <http://www.gd.gov.cn/zwgk/wjk/zcfgk/content/mpost_2531969.html> (Published on the portal website of the Guangdong Provincial People's Government)

Note: The household registration is always hanging, and the inheritance and transfer, receiving benefits, and surrender will be stuck. These windows all depend on the household registration status. If the pension is still paid, it is false and will be returned sooner or later. When you go to the police station, ask clearly: how to stop social security and medical insurance benefits, and how to apply for funeral subsidies. For that amount of money, see Article 9 (provident fund balance, social security benefits).

Case: After Uncle Liu passed away in the countryside, his son took care of the funeral and took the death certificate and household registration book to the police station on the 20th day to cancel the account. The household registration status was updated in a timely manner, and I was able to receive funeral benefits and apply for inheritance without any problems.

items.title: Funeral services are divided into basic projects and non-basic projects. Basic projects have a list, and fees are set according to law
items.core: Remains transportation, storage, farewell, cremation, ashes storage, and ecological burial are all in the country's basic project list. There are also spaces for burial provided by public institutions. The prices of these projects are determined according to regulations, and other services must also be included in the list, and no separate projects are allowed to collect money. Before setting off, ask clearly which items count as basic items and what the local standards are, and then talk about anything else.
body: Cost: Nothing. Take a few minutes to review your list before you go.

Income: Body transportation, body storage, body farewell, body cremation, ashes storage, and ecological burial are all in the country's basic project list. Burial spaces for ashes provided by government-run funeral services are also on the list. The charging standards for these items are set in accordance with the law, and the prices are determined according to regulations. The funeral home does not have the final say. The list of non-basic items is determined by the civil affairs departments at or above the districted city level (civil affairs departments at or above the prefecture-level city)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: State Council (2026). Funeral Management Regulations (State Council Order No. 824, revised and adopted at the 72nd executive meeting of the State Council on November 14, 2025, "effective from March 30, 2026"). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202601/content_7054169.htm> Article 5: "Funeral services are divided into basic items and non-basic items. The charging policy is formulated by the development and reform department and the financial department of the State Council in conjunction with the civil affairs and other departments of the State Council." "The state formulates a list of basic funeral service items, including body reception, body storage, body farewell, body cremation, ashes storage, and ecological burial. and the burial of ashes provided by government-organized funeral service agencies are included in the list"; Article 50 "Funeral services are subject to list management and dynamic adjustment, and it is prohibited to establish items and charge fees outside the list."

Note: Provinces, autonomous regions, and municipalities directly under the Central Government can add items on the basis of the national list. First ask clearly which items are basic items and what the local charging standards are, and then talk about the rest. The price of basic items is determined according to regulations. If you choose anything other than basic items, you should also look at the list and charging standards.
