Distinguish between these two categories, and only the part that is overcharged will have something to say. There is nothing wrong with wanting to manage the funeral affairs of your loved ones in a dignified manner. I do not advise you to be simple. It is up to you to decide where to spend your money.

Case: Before Ms. Zhou held her father’s funeral, she first requested a list of basic items from the funeral home and confirmed that transportation, storage, farewell and cremation were all on the list. The prices were based on local standards and no items were temporarily added.

items.title: If you encounter forced tying, adding a price to the price, or splitting one item into several charges, write it down to complain
items.core: The price violations listed in the regulations include: not showing a price list, adding money in addition to the price, bundling and forcibly selling funeral supplies, and forcing you to accept other companies' paid services. Breaking one item into several charges can also be regarded as a disguised price increase. Ask for the price list on the spot and keep the charge receipts and chat records, so you can complain later. If you want to check prices, contact the market supervision department; if you are looking for funeral services, contact the civil affairs department.
body: Cost: No money. The difficult thing is to still be willing to be serious at that moment.

Income: The regulations list five types of price violations, four of which are described below. Not listing a price list and charging more than the listed price is an unclear price or an increase in price beyond the listed price. If you don't buy this, you won't get that. It's a forced sale with bundled or unreasonable conditions attached. Forcing you to pay for another company's services is forcing or forcing you to accept third-party paid services in disguise. Charging more money under a different name is a disguised increase in charging standards. It is also prohibited to "disaggregate items, expand the scope of charging, and other forms of disguised increase in charging standards." Splitting a service into several separate charges, or expanding the scope of charges outwards, are prohibited
Level of Evidence: A

Source: State Council (2026). Funeral Management Regulations (State Council Order No. 824, revised and adopted at the 72nd Executive Meeting of the State Council on November 14, 2025, "effective as of March 30, 2026"). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202601/content_7054169.htm> Article 42: "Funeral service agencies shall not violate relevant regulations by setting up fee items without authorization, or by decomposing items, expanding the scope of charges, etc. to increase fee standards in disguised form." The price violations listed in Article 43 include "(1) Failure to clearly mark prices in accordance with regulations, or adding prices in addition to the marked prices, or charging unmarked fees" and "(3) Using bundling, attaching unreasonable conditions or unreasonable restrictions, etc., to force or covertly force the sale of funeral supplies, provide funeral services, etc. "(4) Force or covertly force the bereaved to accept paid services from third parties, or use relevant service outlets to repeatedly charge fees"; Article 51 requires the civil affairs department and the government service convenience hotline to establish an information sharing supervision mechanism. "The funeral service issues reported by the bereaved shall be handled in a timely manner in conjunction with the relevant departments and the results shall be notified to the bereaved."

Note: The investigation and prosecution of price violations belongs to the market supervision department, and the funeral services themselves belong to the civil affairs department. Ask for a price list on the spot, keep the charge receipts and chat records, and make a complaint later.

Case: When Mr. Wu held his mother’s funeral, the funeral home required a designated urn before allowing time for cremation. He asked for the price list on the spot, took pictures of the bill and the conversation, and after complaining, the market regulator ordered him to return it.

items.title: Intermediaries such as funeral agencies, supplies purchasing agents, and planning hosts must be registered with the county-level civil affairs department
items.core: Intermediaries such as funeral agencies, supplies purchasing agencies, planning hosts, and information consultation agencies must be registered with the county-level civil affairs departments. Those who have not registered will not enter the funeral service information system of the civil affairs department. You can check by yourself. It varies from place to place. The most reliable thing is to call the county-level civil affairs department. Anyone who uses deception to arbitrarily charge people or resell the deceased's information will be dealt with according to law.
body: Cost: No money. Ask if you have filed a record.

Income: Unregistered intermediaries are not included in the funeral service information system managed by the civil affairs department. Those who use deceptive means to charge illegal fees, induce arrogance, force people to accept services, or resell the deceased's information will be dealt with according to law. It will also be marked in the system and disclosed to the public, so that everyone can see
Level of Evidence: A

Source: State Council (2026). Funeral Management Regulations (State Council Order No. 824, revised and adopted at the 72nd Executive Meeting of the State Council on November 14, 2025, "effective as of March 30, 2026"). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202601/content_7054169.htm> Article 41: "Except for funeral service agencies, organizations and individuals engaged in funeral service agencies, supplies purchasing, planning and hosting, information consultation and other funeral-related service activities shall register with the civil affairs department of the county-level people's government." Illegal charging, inducement, forced service, reselling of the deceased’s information and other behaviors that damage the rights and interests of the bereaved shall be dealt with in accordance with the law, and shall be marked in the funeral service information system and disclosed to the public.”

Note: Online funeral scanning platforms are also subject to management. Article 45 of the regulations does not allow it to induce consumption, nor does it allow it to illegally handle the deceased’s information.

Case: Aunt Zheng wanted to ask someone to handle the funeral procedures on her behalf, but the other party could not explain the filing status. She called the county-level civil affairs department and found out that the agency had not registered, so she found an agency that had registered and signed a service contract.

items.title: The money scattered in various places must be withdrawn one by one: the provident fund balance, social security benefits, and work-related injury benefits
items.core: The provident fund balance and the money left in the pension insurance personal account can be withdrawn by the heirs. If the provident fund is not in the bank account, it is easy to leak. If a person participating in the enterprise employee pension insurance dies due to illness or non-work-related reasons, the family members will receive funeral subsidies and pensions. Pension 3 to 24 months for blondes, minimum 9 months for retired. If someone dies on the job, there will be three additional payments for work-related injuries.
body: Cost: No money, but you have to run a few windows. Prepare death certificates and kinship certificates before going.

Income: The balance of the housing provident fund account (the money left in his provident fund account), the heirs and legatees can withdraw it. A legatee is the person to whom something is left in the will. If someone dies on the job, there are three other payments: funeral allowance, dependent relative's pension, and one-time death on the job benefit. The money left in the personal pension insurance account can be inherited according to the Social Insurance Law. If a person participating in employee pension insurance dies due to illness or non-work-related reasons, his family members can also receive funeral subsidies and pensions, which are collectively referred to as survivor benefits. The standards for enterprise employees are calculated according to a nationally unified formula. The funeral subsidy is twice the monthly per capita disposable income of urban residents in the province in the previous year. The pension is also based on this monthly per capita income and is paid for 3 to 24 months according to the payment period. 3 months for less than 5 years, 6 months for 5 to 10 years, 9 months for 10 to 15 years, and 1 month for each additional year over 15 years, up to a maximum of 24 months. For those who have retired, the pension will be reduced by 1 month for every 1 year, with a minimum of 9 months
Level of Evidence: A

Source: State Council (2026). The last paragraph of Article 24 of the Regulations on the Administration of Housing Provident Fund (revised by State Council Order No. 844, effective from September 20, 2026). <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/2026/issue_12946/202608/content_7079363.html>: “If an employee dies or is declared dead, the employee shall The employee’s heirs and legatees can withdraw the balance in the employee’s housing provident fund account; if there is no heir or legatee, the balance in the employee’s housing provident fund account shall be included in the appreciation income of the housing provident fund.” The three benefits of Article 39 of the Work Injury Insurance Regulations are shown in Article 3. Section 19. <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2011/content_1778064.htm>; National People’s Congress Standing Committee (2018 amendment). Social Insurance Law (Articles 14 and 17): “In the event of the death of an individual, the balance of the personal account can be inherited.” “If an individual who participates in the basic pension insurance dies due to illness or non-work, his or her survivors can receive funeral subsidies and pensions.” <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=ff8080816f135f46016f210989b9179a> (National Laws and Regulations Database); Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security, Ministry of Finance (2021). Interim Measures for Survivors’ Benefits of Basic Pension Insurance for Enterprise Employees (Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security [2021] No. 18, September 1, 2021 Effective from the date of publication, Articles 4 and 5), the original document has not been published publicly, and the provisions are in accordance with the Administrative Reconsideration Decision of the People’s Government of Huadu District, Guangzhou City (Huadu Prefectural Government [2022] 226 (No.) verbatim quotation check: "The standard of funeral subsidy is calculated based on twice the monthly per capita disposable income of urban residents in the province when the insured person died..." "If the payment period is less than 5 years, the number of payment months is 3 months... If the payment period is more than 30 years, it is calculated based on 30 years, and the maximum number of payment months is 24 months." <https://www.huadu.gov.cn/xxgk/xzfy/content/post_8672730.html>; Fujian Provincial Department of Human Resources and Social Security. Frequently Asked Questions: "The basic pension will be reduced by one month for every year, and the minimum number of payment months is 9 months." "If the cumulative payment years are less than 5 years, the standard of survivors' benefits (including funeral subsidies and pensions) shall not exceed the sum of their personal contributions." <http://rst.fujian.gov.cn/wz/cjwt/czzgly/202311/t20231113_6294929.htm>

Note: The provident fund is most often forgotten because it is not in the bank account and will not automatically be distributed to the estate. The remaining money in the personal pension insurance account and the benefits for survivors are calculated and distributed separately, and must be processed together at the social security handling window in the place where you participate in the insurance. The materials required vary from place to place. If the payment period is less than 5 years, the total benefits of the survivor shall not exceed the amount paid by himself. This set of formulas comes from the pension insurance methods for enterprise employees. For the survivor benefits of pension insurance for government agencies, institutions, and urban and rural residents, go to the window and ask. The funeral expenses and pension were paid into his bank account. For the method of withdrawal, see Article 12 (deposits can be withdrawn directly from the bank). The formal requirements for wills and succession are found in section 17. If you plan to give up the inheritance to avoid debts, do not withdraw the money yet. See Article 11 (Written Statement to Give Up the Inheritance).

Case: After my father passed away, my family only checked the bank card at first. Later, I brought my death certificate and kinship materials to the provident fund center and social security window to apply, withdraw the balance of the provident fund and receive funeral subsidies and pensions.

items.title: Close relatives can request to view, copy, correct, or delete the account number and personal information of the deceased.
items.core: After a person passes away, close relatives can request the platform to view, copy, correct, or delete the deceased's personal information for their own legitimate and legitimate interests. If the platform refuses, it must explain the reasons. You can also go to court and sue. There is an exception: he had other arrangements during his lifetime, such as setting up an account heir and leaving a clear intention to follow his arrangements.
body: Cost: Nothing. Only if the platform does not cooperate will you need to file a complaint or sue.

Benefit: The law clearly states: When a natural person dies, close relatives can exercise their rights to view, copy, correct, delete, etc. the relevant personal information of the deceased for their own legitimate and legitimate interests. Close relatives can ask the platform to read their information, make a copy, correct errors, or delete it. Article 50 requires platforms to establish a convenient application acceptance and processing mechanism. "If an individual's request to exercise rights is rejected, the reasons shall be stated." If the platform refuses, "the individual can file a lawsuit with the People's Court in accordance with the law."
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress Standing Committee (2021). Personal Information Protection Law. China National People's Congress. <http://www.npc.gov.cn/npc/c2/c30834/202108/t20210820_313088.html> Article 49: "When a natural person dies, his close relatives may, for their own legitimate and legitimate interests, exercise the rights to access, copy, correct, delete, etc. stipulated in this chapter on the deceased's relevant personal information, unless the deceased has other arrangements before his death."; Article 50 "Personal information processors should establish a convenient application acceptance and processing mechanism for individuals to exercise their rights. If they refuse an individual's request to exercise their rights, they should explain the reasons." "Individuals may file lawsuits in the People's Court in accordance with the law."

Note: There is a sentence in the law "unless the deceased has other arrangements during his lifetime." If he has set up an account heir before his death, or left a clear will, the one he left will be used. So it’s worth writing down where your account numbers and passwords go while you’re awake, see Section 17. Canceling your account and deleting your personal information are two different things, see Section 14.

Case: After the death of his mother, his son needed her old mobile phone number bill to handle insurance claims. He submitted an application for a copy of the kinship certificate to the platform. When the platform refused, he explained the reasons and provided a copy of the bill after completing the materials.

items.title: If a relative dies and leaves a debt, the heir will only use the inheritance to repay it; if you don’t want to bear the debt, you can declare in writing to give up the inheritance before dividing the inheritance.
items.core: The debt will still be there after the person leaves, but heirs such as children and spouses will only use the inherited inheritance to repay it, and if it is not enough, they do not have to pay it out themselves. If the spouses sign together or borrow for daily household expenses, it is considered a joint debt between the spouses, and the spouse himself must repay it. If you don’t want to be involved in this debt, just write a written statement to give up the inheritance before dividing the inheritance, and you will also get rid of the inheritance. If you don't say anything, you will accept the inheritance.
body: Cost: There is no cost to write a written statement. The real price is that the house, savings and other inheritances are also given up. If you accept an inheritance, your creditor may sue you and you will have to respond and provide information on how much the inheritance is worth.

Income: Article 1161 of the Civil Code: "The heir shall repay the taxes and debts that the deceased shall pay in accordance with the law to the extent of the actual value of the estate received. The excess of the actual value of the estate shall not be subject to this limit if the heir voluntarily repays it." It means: You only use the inheritance you receive to repay the taxes and debts he owes. You don’t have to pay back the excess, unless you are willing to pay it back. Paragraph 2 of the same article: "If an heir renounces inheritance, he will not be liable for the taxes and debts that the deceased should pay according to law." Spouses should also read Article 1064 of the Civil Code: "Debts borne by a joint signature of both spouses or by one spouse's subsequent ratification, as well as debts borne by one spouse in his or her own name for the daily needs of the family during the marriage, are joint debts of the spouses." If the debt is borrowed by both parties and is used for daily household expenses, the spouse himself is the debtor and cannot avoid giving up the inheritance. Article 1159 of the Civil Code states that before the inheritance is distributed, the taxes and debts owed must first be paid. Article 1124 of the Civil Code: Those who renounce inheritance must "express their renunciation of inheritance in writing before the estate is disposed of; if there is no expression, it shall be deemed as acceptance of inheritance." Interpretation of the Supreme Law's Inheritance Section (1) Article 33: The written statement shall be handed over to the estate administrator or other heirs. Article 35 of this interpretation: If you give up the inheritance after the inheritance is divided, what you give up is not the inheritance rights, but the property that has been acquired. Article 1145 of the Civil Code: The heirs may nominate the administrator of the estate, and those who are not nominated will be appointed as well. Article 1147 of the Civil Code: The estate administrator must inventory the estate, make an inventory of the estate, and handle his claims and debts. In the case of Yuzhou, Henan, the borrower died of illness in March 2023, and the children did not give up the inheritance in writing. In May 2023, the court ruled that the children should repay the principal and interest of 95,000 yuan within the actual value of the inheritance. The children said that they could not calculate the value of the company they inherited, and the judgment could not be enforced. Accounts and cars under the children's names have been frozen and seized, and people have also been included in the list of restricted high-spending people. The settlement was delayed until February 2025, and 90,000 yuan was paid. In a Chongqing case, the borrower owed a loan of 400,000 yuan and died of illness before repaying the principal and interest. The heirs declared that they would give up the inheritance. But his spouse and daughter have already withdrawn the basic pension insurance and occupational annuity that are counted as his inheritance. The prosecutor's office determined that the two did not expressly give up and were deemed to have accepted the inheritance. In November 2025, the spouses and the creditor reconciled and paid off. This type of debt ranges from ten thousand yuan to hundreds of thousands yuan, so the income is determined to be large.
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress (2020). Civil Code of the People's Republic of China (Articles 1064, 1124, 1145, 1147, 1153, 1159, 1161). <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=ff808081729d1efe01729d50b5c500bf>; Supreme People's Court (2020). Interpretation on the application of the successor part of the Civil Code of the People's Republic of China (1) (Fa Interpretation [2020] No. 23, Articles 32, 33, and 35). <https://www.court.gov.cn/fabu/xiangqing/282091.html>; National People's Congress Standing Committee (2023 revision). Civil Procedure Law (Articles 152, 164). <https://fgw.sh.gov.cn/ys-syjf-zc-2.4.1-h5/20240408/073febdb2b04464390546232d4089f51.html> (Reprinted by Shanghai Municipal Development and Reform Commission); State Council (2006). Measures for the payment of litigation fees (State Council Order No. 481, Articles 6 and 29). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2008-03/28/content_6929.htm>; Song Wentao (People's Procuratorate of Yuzhou City, Henan Province) (2025-05-23). Live a bright life and protect the beauty | The borrower dies suddenly, and the debt owed is not a "headless account". Procuratorate Daily, published on the website of the Supreme People's Procuratorate. <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/zdgz/202505/t20250523_696425.shtml>; Chongqing Municipal People’s Procuratorate (2026-05-23). [Case Note on Civil Code] Deng Chuan: When inheriting an inheritance, debts must also be paid off within the limit of the inheritance received. <http://www.cq.jcy.gov.cn/jcdt/202605/t20260523_7740396.shtml>

Note: The beneficiaries are mainly yourself, your spouse and your children. Spouses are calculated separately. If two people sign a loan together and borrow it for daily household expenses, it is considered a joint debt of the husband and wife. At this time, the spouse himself is the debtor, and there is no way to avoid giving up the inheritance. When dividing the inheritance, half of the joint property of the husband and wife must be distributed to the spouse first, and the rest is the inheritance. If you are planning to give up, don’t withdraw the money from his account yet. The provident fund balance and pension insurance personal account balance mentioned in Article 9 of this section (provident fund balance, social security benefits) are money that can only be withdrawn by heirs. In the Chongqing case, they took the money and then gave it up. If giving up inheritance will make you unable to fulfill your legal obligations of support and support, the giving up will be invalid. When debt collection comes to your door, you must first provide evidence such as an IOU and a contract, so that the other party can find the estate administrator or sue. Don’t sign a repayment commitment for the portion that exceeds the inheritance, because if you are willing to repay it, the law will recognize it. If you are really sued, the ordinary first-instance procedure is required to be completed within 6 months from the filing of the case, and can be extended. The summary procedure is 3 months. Attorney's fees are not included in the litigation fees borne by the losing party, so you have to pay for the lawyer yourself. Keep the inheritance list, the value of the house and the deposit, and rely on them to calculate how much you should repay during execution. Why is it unreasonable to use death to pay debts? See Section 29, Article 13 (Don’t use death to pay debts).

Case: The father died of illness and left a debt of 800,000 yuan, and the son received a deposit of 500,000 yuan as the heir. He used all the 500,000 yuan to repay the debt, and the remaining 300,000 yuan would not be repaid with his own money. He also made a written statement giving up the inheritance rights of other inheritances before dividing the inheritance.

items.title: When handling inheritance after the death of a family member, don’t default to notarization first: deposits within 50,000 yuan in a bank can be withdrawn directly from the bank, and all heirs should go to the real estate registration agency to apply for the house together.
items.core: If the total deposits of the deceased person in a bank do not exceed 50,000 yuan, the spouse, children, and parents can withdraw the money by bringing the documents without notarization. To withdraw it all at once, cancel the account after withdrawing it. The house does not require notarization. All heirs can go to the real estate registration agency together to get it. Notarization costs money. Taking Fuzhou and Xiamen as examples, the house fee is based on the area. In principle, the maximum fee for a house is 10,000 yuan.
body: Cost: Nothing. Banks with deposits have to run one by one. When applying for a house, all heirs must be invited and come to the registration window on the same day. If some people refuse to come or disagree with how to divide the money, this road will not work. The only option is to go to notarization or litigate.

Income: On the deposit side, Document No. 18 of the China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission and the People’s Bank of China in 2021 stipulates that notarization is no longer required for eligible small-amount deposits. There are three conditions. First, the total account balance in the same bank does not exceed 10,000 yuan, and the bank can increase it by itself, up to a maximum of 50,000 yuan. Second, the applicant is a spouse, child, parent, or heir or legatee designated in the notarized will. The third is to withdraw it all at once and cancel the account after withdrawing it. Spouses, children, and parents must submit four types of materials: death certificate, household registration book, marriage certificate, birth certificate and other related materials, their own identity documents, and a signed letter of commitment. Golden Regulation [2024] No. 6 stipulates that starting from June 1, 2024, the limit will be increased to 50,000 yuan. Rural small and medium-sized banks can delay implementation until December 31, 2025. Gold accumulation products, treasury bonds and financial management products sold by banks can also be withdrawn in this way after maturity or redemption, and the money will be included in the 50,000 yuan. The funeral expenses and pensions credited to his account are not included in the 50,000 yuan, and spouses, children, and parents can also withdraw according to this set of materials. At this end of the house, Article 14 of the Implementing Rules of the Interim Regulations on Real Estate Registration: When applying for registration of inheritance or bequest, "the death certificate, will or all legal heirs' agreement on the distribution of real estate and the kinship relationship materials with the decedent should be submitted. Notarized materials or effective legal documents may also be submitted." Notarization is only optional. In 2016, the Ministry of Justice issued a document repealing the 1991 joint notice requiring strengthened notarization of property registration. Fuzhou Real Estate Registration and Trading Center explains what to do if you don’t submit notarized documents. All legal heirs or legatees must go to the registration agency to check the materials together and sign a recognizance letter (a written statement guaranteeing the authenticity of the materials). The fee depends on Fujian standards: it does not involve inheritance notarization of real estate, and the fee is 0.8% for the portion within 200,000 yuan, with a minimum of 300 yuan. Property charges are based on area. In Fuzhou and Xiamen, the price does not exceed 70 yuan per square meter. In principle, the price for a single unit does not exceed 10,000 yuan. According to this standard, the notary fee for a 50,000 yuan deposit is 400 yuan, and a 90-square-meter house in Fuzhou costs up to 6,300 yuan. The savings are hundreds to thousands of yuan, and the income is set at
Level of Evidence: A

Source: General Office of the China Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission, General Office of the People's Bank of China (2021). Notice on simplifying matters related to the withdrawal of small deposits of deceased depositors (Chinese Banking and Insurance Regulatory Commission [2021] No. 18, Articles 1, 2, 4, 5, and 12). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2021-02/04/content_5584887.htm>; State Financial Supervision and Administration, People's Bank of China (2024). Notice on optimizing the relevant requirements for small deposit withdrawals by deceased depositors (Jingui [2024] No. 6, Articles 1, 2, 4, 5, and 8). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202404/content_6947875.htm>; Ministry of Natural Resources (2024 revision). Implementation Rules of the Interim Regulations on Real Estate Registration (Article 14). <https://bdcdj.fuzhou.gov.cn/zwgk/fgwj/202406/t20240618_4844825.htm> (Published by Fuzhou Real Estate Registration and Trading Center); Ministry of Justice (2016). Notice on the abolition of the "Joint Notice of the Ministry of Justice and the Ministry of Construction on Strengthening Notarization in Real Estate Registration Management" (Si Fa Tong [2016] No. 63). <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2017/content_5174534.htm>; Fuzhou Real Estate Registration and Trading Center (2019). Real estate inheritance registration cannot be directly handled based on a will alone. <https://bdcdj.fuzhou.gov.cn/jdhy/zcjd/201902/t20190203_2757732.htm>; Jin'an District Justice Bureau, Fuzhou City (2024). How much does it cost to notarize inheritance rights? (Introduction to Fujian Development and Reform Service Price [2021] No. 533). <https://www.fzja.gov.cn/xjwz/hdjl/hdzsk/sfj/gzgl/202309/t20230919_4676656.htm>

Note: 50,000 yuan is calculated separately for each bank, and each of the three banks has 4 Ten thousand yuan, three families can take it like this. Those exceeding 50,000 yuan are not included in these two notices. Before going, ask the bank what materials it requires. It does not apply if the depositor or applicant is a compatriot from Hong Kong, Macao and Taiwan, a foreigner, or someone who has settled abroad. There is only one notarized will, and the transfer of ownership cannot be done directly. All legal heirs must still be present for confirmation. If you plan to give up the inheritance to avoid debts, don’t withdraw the money yet. See Article 11 (Written Statement of Giving Up the Inheritance). When the first-order heir withdraws money, he can also ask for his account details for the six months before his death and after his death. To check other personal information, see Section 10 (Account and Personal Information). If the heirs have differences and cannot reach an agreement, they will sue. The ordinary procedure of first instance is stipulated to be completed within 6 months, which can be extended, and the lawyer's fees will be paid by himself. Notarization fees vary from province to province and are subject to the documents issued by the local development and reform and judicial departments. The 50,000 yuan limit is until October 2026, subject to the latest notice from the State Administration of Financial Supervision and the People’s Bank of China.

Case: After the mother passed away, the children went to the bank with the death certificate and other materials, directly withdrew her 48,000 yuan deposit in the bank and canceled the account; then all the heirs went to the real estate registration center together to handle the transfer procedures for the house under the mother's name, without notarization in the entire process.

items.title: The platform should not collect the money yourself and then transfer it to the seller. Let the money be settled directly through a licensed payment institution
items.core: The buyer's money is first deposited in your account, and you transfer it to the seller. This is a payment business. Doing this business requires approval from the People's Bank of China and a real investment of 100 million yuan. If you work without approval, you will be shut down, the money you earn will be taken away, and you will be fined. The boss and manager will be fined separately. In serious cases, you may be sentenced to prison. There is only one safe way: don’t let the money go into your account.
body: Cost: No money. It takes some time to accept a product from a licensed payment institution. A licensed payment institution is a company that has obtained a payment license from the central bank. Using its account splitting or guaranteed transaction function, the buyer's money is paid directly to the seller without entering the platform's own account

Income: The payment business mentioned in the regulations is "the transfer of monetary funds based on the electronic payment instructions submitted by the payee or payer." To put it bluntly, it means transferring money for others according to their instructions. To do this business, "it must be approved by the People's Bank of China and obtain a payment business license." The minimum registered capital is 100 million yuan, and it is paid-in monetary capital. This 100 million yuan requires real money to be deposited into the company account. "Anyone who establishes a non-bank payment institution or engages in payment business in disguised form without approval in accordance with the law shall be banned by the People's Bank of China in accordance with the law and the illegal income shall be confiscated." Anyone who does this without approval will be shut down immediately and the money earned will be taken away. If the illegal income exceeds 500,000 yuan, a further fine of 1 to 5 times the illegal income will be imposed. If there is no illegal income or the amount is less than 500,000 yuan, a fine of 500,000 to 2 million yuan will be imposed. The legal representative and those directly responsible shall be fined an additional 100,000 to 500,000 yuan. The criminal law also counts "illegal engagement in fund payment and settlement business" as illegal business. If the circumstances are serious, the sentence will be less than 5 years, and if the circumstances are particularly serious, the sentence will be more than 5 years. What counts as "serious circumstances" has been drawn in the explanations of the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate. This line is when the illegal business amount is more than 5 million yuan, or the illegal income is more than 100,000 yuan. This set of criminal amount standards will come into effect on February 1, 2019. The previous "Regulations on the Supervision and Administration of Non-bank Payment Institutions" will be implemented from May 1, 2024 (nationwide)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: State Council (2023). Regulations on the Supervision and Administration of Non-bank Payment Institutions (State Council Order No. 768, Articles 2, 6, 8, 27, and 47). <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/2024/issue_11086/202401/content_6924970.html> ; People's Bank of China (2024). Implementation Rules of the Regulations on the Supervision and Administration of Non-bank Payment Institutions (People's Bank of China Order [2024] No. 4, Article 68). <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/2024/issue_11546/202408/content_6970979.html> ; National People's Congress (1997). Criminal Law (Article 225, Item 3). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/201802/t20180206_364975.shtml> ; Supreme People's Court, Supreme People's Procuratorate (2019). Interpretations on Several Issues Concerning the Application of Laws in Handling Criminal Cases of Illegal Fund Payment and Settlement Business and Illegal Foreign Exchange Trading (Articles 1, 3, and 4). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/xwfbh/wsfbt/201901/t20190131_407161.shtml>

Note: Designing the money not to enter your account is the only safe way. In the market, this kind of collection and payment is called "Erqing", but this term is not included in official documents. The term used in the implementation details is "engaging in payment business in disguise", which means transferring money for others according to the user's instructions without approval. The explanation from the Supreme People's Court and the Supreme People's Procuratorate specifically listed three types of behavior: making up fake transactions to cash out, using unit accounts to cash out, and using checks to cash out. The fourth item also writes about "other situations of illegally engaging in fund payment and settlement business." It is not only the first three categories that may constitute a crime. It did not name the platform for collection and payment, but criminal risks cannot be ruled out just because it was not named. Whether a specific arrangement constitutes a crime must be judged according to the law and interpretation, and cannot be generalized.

Case: An e-commerce platform collected the buyer's payment on its own and then transferred it to the seller, and was investigated and punished by the regulatory authorities. The platform was ordered to stop its illegal payment business, confiscate illegal gains and impose fines, and the person in charge was also fined. The platform then switched to using licensed payment institutions for direct settlement.

items.title: Most fee-based websites require a license. Those that sell their own goods and do not allow others to enter do not need one. Those that facilitate transactions require another type of license. Free ones only need to be registered.
items.core: Most websites that charge users for money must first apply for a value-added telecommunications business license. This certificate cannot be obtained by individuals. Guangdong Provincial Communications Administration’s reply: Those who only sell goods on their own websites or apps and do not allow others to open stores do not need to apply. It is not necessary for those who only open WeChat, Alipay mini programs or online stores. If you charge money to open a station without completing the necessary procedures, your income will be confiscated and fined, or the station will be shut down in serious cases.
body: Cost: Registration costs nothing. A value-added telecommunications business license costs money, and it governs "whether a website that charges users money can be opened." To apply for this certificate, you must first have a company. If it only operates within the province, the registered capital shall be no less than 1 million yuan. For cross-provincial operations, the amount shall not be less than 10 million yuan. The review period is 60 days, and the certificate is valid for 5 years

Income: The original words of the regulations are "The state implements a licensing system for commercial Internet information services; it implements a filing system for non-commercial Internet information services. Those who have not obtained a license or failed to complete the filing procedures are not allowed to engage in Internet information services." Those who charge money must first obtain a license, and those who do not charge money must first register. Without both, you cannot open a website. What is business? The regulations say it is "service activities such as providing information or web page production to Internet users for a fee through the Internet." Simply put, it means collecting money from users. The type of transaction matching is called online data processing and transaction processing business, referred to as EDI in the industry. The regulations define it as "the business of using various data and transaction/transaction processing application platforms connected to public communication networks or the Internet to provide users with online data processing and transaction/transaction processing services through public communication networks or the Internet." It also "includes transaction processing operations, electronic data interchange operations and network/electronic device data processing operations." It means that the website processes data online for users, or matches and processes transactions for buyers and sellers. If you operate without a license or operate outside the scope, your illegal gains will be confiscated and you will be fined 3 to 5 times the illegal gains. Operating beyond the scope means that you apply for a certificate but do things beyond the scope of what is written on the certificate. If there is no illegal income or the illegal income is less than 50,000 yuan, a fine of 100,000 to 1 million yuan will be imposed. If the circumstances are serious, the website will be ordered to be shut down (nationwide). Collecting money does not mean that you must apply for a certificate. A Q&A issued by the Guangdong Provincial Communications Administration in October 2025 stated that according to the requirements of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, the following three types do not need to apply for this certificate. The first type is when a company “directly sells its own or other companies’ goods or services in a self-operated manner” on its own website or app, and no other units or individuals are involved in opening a store. Second, companies only publish their own information on their own websites and apps, and do not provide a platform for others to publish information. The third type is that companies only rely on small programs, public accounts, video accounts, and online stores on platforms such as WeChat and Alipay to do business, "and have no other independent operating platforms." On the other hand, as long as you let others settle in and open a store, or let users send messages to you, you are not among these three types
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Guangdong Provincial Communications Administration (2025). Frequently Asked Questions about applying for a value-added telecommunications business license (October 17, 2025, item 1). <https://gdca.miit.gov.cn/bsfw/bszn/jyxk/tzgg/art/2025/art_6bcbfa4f041247868c0de08e765b33e9.html> ; State Council (2000). Measures for the Administration of Internet Information Services (State Council Order No. 292, December 6, 2024 (Second revision of 2020, Articles 3, 4, 7 and 19). <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2011/content_1860864.htm>; State Council (2024). Decision on amending and abolishing some administrative regulations (State Council Order No. 797, Item 18). <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/2025/issue_11786/202501/content_6997034.html> ; State Council (2000). Telecommunications Regulations (Second Revision in 2016, Articles 7, 9, 13, and 69). <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2016/content_5139478.htm> ; Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (2017). Measures for the Administration of Telecommunications Business Licenses (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology Order No. 42, Articles 6, 9, 11, and 14). <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2017/content_5240090.htm>

Note: Whether what you want to do is EDI, please check it yourself with the definition in the "Telecommunications Business Classification Catalog". There is no official statement stating that "e-commerce platforms with matching and fund processing must obtain an EDI license." The service guide of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology only states that "apply for the corresponding telecommunications business license according to the business definition." So whether you should do it or not, you can only make your own judgment based on the definition. Another point: This certificate cannot be obtained by an individual. The applicant must be a company established in accordance with the law. The three situations in which self-operation does not require a certificate are from the Q&A of the Guangdong Provincial Communications Administration Bureau. The Q&A stated that it was in compliance with the requirements of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology, but the same public text was not found in other provinces. If you're not sure, call the local communications bureau first. This Q&A also reminds you that you do not need to find an agency to apply for a license. You only need to submit materials to the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology's "Telecommunications Business Market Integrated Management Information System". There is no official fee.

Case: A company built its own website to provide membership services for a fee to users, and was required by the Communications Administration to apply for an ICP license. Because the company did not meet the conditions and was unable to handle it, the charging function was eventually shut down; and a self-operated sales website did not need to apply for a license because it did not allow third parties to enter.

items.title: Live broadcast requires an Internet Culture Business License. Private audio-visual programs are basically unavailable
items.core: Live broadcast and game commentary require an Internet Culture Business License issued by the provincial cultural department. The scope of business must indicate online performances. The result will be issued within 20 days after acceptance, and the security will be kept for 3 years. Videos that have been played will be retained for 60 days. If you open your business without a license, you will be stopped, given a warning, and fined no more than 30,000 yuan. If you continue to do so, you will be blacklisted.
body: Cost: The Internet Culture Business License is commonly known as the Internet Culture Certificate. It governs "whether you can make money from online performances such as live broadcasts and game commentary." It will be approved by the provincial cultural administrative department. The result will be given within 20 days after acceptance. It will be valid for 3 years and must be renewed 30 days before expiration. Audio-visual program licensing governs "whether programs can be broadcast online." It requires applicants to be wholly state-owned or state-controlled entities

Income: Units that perform online performances must first apply for a license. The original words of the regulations are: "In accordance with the "Interim Provisions on the Management of Internet Culture," an application should be made to the provincial cultural administrative department to obtain an "Internet Culture Business License." The business scope of the license should clearly include online performances." Those who play games for people to see and explain to others also follow this set of regulations. The original words of the regulations are "managed with reference to these measures." All video data of online performances must be kept for at least 60 days. You must keep the broadcast videos for 60 days. Anyone who engages in commercial Internet cultural activities without approval will be ordered to stop, given a warning, and fined not more than 30,000 yuan. If you keep shouting, you will be blacklisted in the cultural market. Broadcasting programs online is another license, "you should obtain an "Information Network Audio-Visual Program Dissemination License"." The applicant must "have legal personality and be a wholly state-owned or state-controlled unit." It must be a wholly state-owned or state-controlled unit. Private companies are basically unable to obtain it. If you do it without this certificate, you will be warned, ordered to make corrections, and may be fined up to 30,000 yuan. If the circumstances are serious, they will be punished in accordance with the Radio and Television Management Regulations (national)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Ministry of Culture (2016). Measures for the Management of Online Performance Business Activities (Wenshifa [2016] No. 33, Articles 2, 4, 6, 13, and 20). <https://zwgk.mct.gov.cn/zfxxgkml/scgl/202012/t20201206_918194.html> ; Ministry of Culture (2011). Interim Provisions on Internet Culture Management (Ministry of Culture Order No. 51, revised by Ministry of Culture Order No. 57 in 2017, Articles 7, 8, 9, 16, 21, and 28). <https://zwgk.mct.gov.cn/zfxxgkml/zcfg/bmgz/202012/t20201204_905340.html> ; State Administration of Radio, Film and Television, Ministry of Information Industry (2007). Regulations on the Management of Internet Audiovisual Program Services (Order No. 56, revised in 2015, Articles 2, 7, 8, and 24). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/2022-08/23/content_5722664.htm> ; Cyberspace Administration of China and seven other departments (2021). Guiding Opinions on Strengthening the Standardization and Management of Online Live Broadcasting (State Council Information Office [2021] No. 3, Item 9). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2021-02/10/content_5586472.htm>

Remarks: Which business is equipped with which certificate, which document of the seven departments is written most clearly. Platforms that make money through live broadcasts require an internet license and ICP filing. ICP filing is the procedure for a website to register with the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology. Those who broadcast programs online must watch a hearing or complete registration. Those who publish news need an Internet News Information Service License. In addition, the "Interim Provisions on the Management of Internet Culture" forwarded by the Chinese Government website in 2025 published the original text that was not revised in 2011. References must be based on the current text of the Ministry of Culture and Tourism

Case: A game live broadcast platform started broadcasting without obtaining an Internet culture business license and was inspected by the cultural law enforcement department. Platforms were ordered to stop live streaming, given warnings and fined. Afterwards, the platform quickly applied for a license and retained the live video for 60 days as required.

items.title: Servers must be registered before they are placed in the country. Apps and mini-programs must also be registered before they are put on the shelves. Access providers must hold their own value-added telecommunications licenses
items.core: Servers are placed in the country and they must be registered before opening a website. It does not cost any money. It usually takes a few days to a few weeks. If you fail to register, you will be ordered to make corrections and fined 10,000 yuan. If you do not make corrections, the station will be closed. Apps and mini programs must also be registered first. If you are not registered, app stores and mini program platforms are not allowed to put them on the shelves.
body: Cost: Registration costs nothing. It is submitted to the service provider along with the server, which usually takes a few days to a few weeks. The registration of apps and mini-programs must be submitted through the service provider or app store, and it will be completed within 20 working days after all the materials are collected. It only takes ten minutes to check whether the service provider is qualified

Benefits: The original words of the regulations are "No non-commercial Internet information services are allowed within the territory of the People's Republic of China without filing." Websites that do not charge users money must register first as long as they are placed within the country. Those who fail to register will be ordered to make corrections within a time limit and fined an additional 10,000 yuan. If you refuse to make corrections, the website will be closed. The service provider that helps you connect the server to the Internet is also subject to regulation: it "may not provide Internet access services to unregistered organizations or individuals engaged in non-commercial Internet information services." The same goes for the service provider who collects your money. The regulations say that such service providers "are not allowed to provide access or charge collection services to entities or individuals that have not obtained an operating license in accordance with the law or have completed registration procedures for non-commercial Internet information services." This means that regular service providers are not allowed to accept sites that do not have a license or registration. Furthermore, computer room hosting and cloud hosting are called Internet data center business in regulations, and broadband access is called Internet access service business. These two items require licenses themselves, and the service provider must first obtain a license. If the registration number is not marked on the homepage of the website, it will be ordered to make corrections and fined 5,000 yuan to 50,000 yuan. Apps and mini-programs will also need to be registered starting from September 2023. The notice from the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology stated that App sponsors that provide services within the country "are not allowed to engage in APP Internet information services if they fail to complete the registration procedures." Distribution platforms include mini program platforms. The notice requires app stores, mini-program platforms, and mobile phone manufacturers to "not provide network access, distribution, preset and other services for apps that have not completed the registration procedures." The Provincial Communications Administration Bureau receives complete and accurate materials and "should file them within 20 working days." The registration number must be marked in a prominent position on the App. The Anti-Telecommunications Internet Fraud Law also states that the establishment of an App "should go through licensing or filing procedures with the telecommunications authorities in accordance with relevant national regulations" (National)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Ministry of Information Industry (2005). Measures for the Registration and Management of Non-commercial Internet Information Services (Ministry of Information Industry Order No. 33, revised by Ministry of Industry and Information Technology Order No. 68 in 2024, Articles 5, 13, 18, and 22). <https://www.miit.gov.cn/gyhxxhb/jgsj/cyzcyfgs/bmgz/xxtxl/art/2024/art_84a0cfa0ebd049bbbe751dca9a008e56.html> ; Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (2017). Measures for the Administration of Telecommunications Business Licenses (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology Order No. 42, Articles 20 and 24). <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2017/content_5240090.htm> ; Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (2015). Telecommunications Business Classification Catalog (2015 Edition, B11, B14, B21, B25). <https://www.miit.gov.cn/zwgk/zcwj/wjfb/tg/art/2020/art_e98406cd89844f7e92ea1bcf3b5301e0.html> ; Ministry of Industry and Information Technology (2023). Notice on Carrying out the Registration of Mobile Internet Applications (Ministry of Industry and Information Technology Information Management [2023] 105 No. 1, 7, 8 and 9 of Part 2, Item 2 of Part 3). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202308/content_6897341.htm>; Standing Committee of the National People's Congress (2022). Anti-Telecommunications Network Fraud Law (Article 23). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202209/t20220902_575631.shtml>

Note: Check whether the service provider has a certificate before negotiating the price. For verification, use the Telecommunications Business Market Comprehensive Management Information System of the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology tsm.miit.gov.cn, and search by the company's full name or certificate number. To check the website for registration, use beian.miit.gov.cn. Without a correspondingly licensed "computer room", you wouldn't even know who to appeal to on the day of the accident. If the website has already been registered, the App registration only requires the information of the App, and there is no need to refill the sponsor's identity. Putting the website's machine overseas can indeed circumvent the website registration, but apps that want to be listed in domestic app stores cannot circumvent this. If the user is in China and the money is in China, none of the obligations written in Articles 5 to 10 of this section will be missing, and there is also an additional layer of costs for data export

Case: A startup company placed its server in China and launched its website without filing. It was ordered to make corrections and fined by the Communications Administration Bureau. The company immediately completed the registration process; later when developing the app, it also completed the registration procedures before it was officially launched on the app store.

items.title: If you want users to come up to sell things, the platform must verify the registration, submit information, and retain it for three years
items.core: If you want others to sell things on your platform, you must first verify the seller's identity, address, contact information, and license, and then register and file. After setting up the file, go back and review it at least every six months. The seller must report to the market supervision, the tax status should be reported to the tax every quarter, and the commodity and transaction records should be kept for three years. If you omit one item, you will be ordered to make corrections first. If you fail to make corrections, you will be fined RMB 20,000 to RMB 100,000.
body: Cost: No money. It is necessary to verify the seller's qualifications in the background and create a registration file. Tax-related information is reported every quarter, and transaction data is retained for three years. The difficulty is that it is a year-round job, and it cannot be done once and done

Benefits: The law has certain requirements for the platform. The original words are "Operators who apply to enter the platform to sell goods or provide services should be required to submit their identity, address, contact information, administrative license and other true information, conduct verification and registration, establish registration files, and regularly verify and update them." Before entering the market, the seller must hand over his identity, address, contact information and the license he should apply for. You have to check it once, register and create a file, and then go back and check it again after a period of time. How long is "regular"? The departmental regulations go into more detail, “verification and update at least every six months.” You must also submit the identity information of the operators on the platform to the market supervision department. Taxation must also be reported. The original words are "in accordance with the provisions of tax collection and management laws and administrative regulations, the identity information of operators within the platform and tax-related information shall be submitted to the tax department." Therefore, the identity of the seller must be reported to market supervision, and the seller’s identity and tax status must be reported to the tax. Product and service information and transaction information are "stored for no less than three years from the date of completion of the transaction." Counting from the date of completion of a transaction, the data is retained for at least three years. Anyone who fails to do any of the above will be ordered to make corrections within a time limit. Failure to make corrections within the time limit will result in a fine of RMB 20,000 to RMB 100,000. If the circumstances are serious, the company may be ordered to suspend business for rectification and may be fined RMB 100,000 to RMB 500,000. Tax-related information must be submitted "within the month following the end of the quarter" and must be reported within the month following the end of each quarter. Those who fail to report on time will have the same penalties (nationwide)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress Standing Committee (2018). E-commerce Law (Articles 10, 27, 28, 31, 80). <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=2c909fdd678bf17901678bf8af050b81>; State Administration for Market Regulation (2021). Measures for the Supervision and Administration of Online Transactions (State Administration for Market Regulation Order No. 37, Articles 8, 24, 25, and 31). <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2021/content_5602020.htm>; State Council (2025). Regulations on the submission of tax-related information by Internet platform companies (State Council Order No. 810, Articles 2, 3, 4, and 10). <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/2025/issue_12146/202507/content_7030983.html> ; State Administration of Taxation (2025). Announcement on matters related to the submission of tax-related information by Internet platform companies (State Administration of Taxation Announcement No. 15 of 2025). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202506/content_7029727.htm>

Note: Sellers themselves must also register as market entities. The law lists several things that do not need to be done: "Individuals selling self-produced agricultural and sideline products and cottage industry products, individuals using their own skills to engage in convenience labor activities and sporadic small-amount transaction activities that do not require permission according to law." There is a specific number for "sporadic small amounts". Article 8 of the Measures for the Supervision and Administration of Online Transactions stipulates that the annual transaction volume is 100,000 yuan. There are still two things to do on the platform: mark registered and unregistered sellers respectively, and not delete consumer reviews

Case: An e-commerce platform allowed merchants to sell goods, but their identity was only verified once and then not reviewed again, and tax information was not submitted. After inspection, the market supervision department ordered corrections, and the platform subsequently established a semi-annual verification system and supplementally reported relevant transaction data.

items.title: You have to control the content posted by users: review mechanism, reporting portal, stop uploading immediately and report if any violation is found
items.core: The platform must be responsible for managing what users post, and there must be systems in place for registration, review of posts, review of comments, daily inspections, and handling of incidents. Place the reporting portal in a prominent place on the page. When you see illegal information, stop spreading it immediately, keep records, and report it to the competent authorities. Those who fail to do so may be fined 50,000 to 500,000 yuan, or more in serious cases.
body: Cost: It costs money to hire people to review, which is the largest long-term expense of the platform. The reporting portal and records of each handling must leave traces. The difficulty is that it has to be watched every day, and something may happen if it stops for one day

Benefits: The regulations say that the platform "should fulfill the main responsibility of information content management", and the content posted by users is managed by the platform itself. Specifically, it is necessary to "improve systems such as user registration, account management, information release review, post and comment review, ecological management of pages and pages, real-time inspections, emergency response and online rumors, black industry chain information disposal, etc." From registration, posting, commenting, to daily inspections and incident handling, every step must have written rules. "A convenient complaint reporting portal should be set up in a prominent location," and the reporting button should be placed where users can see and click it at a glance. If illegal information is discovered, "disposal measures should be taken immediately in accordance with the law, relevant records should be kept, and reports should be reported to the relevant competent authorities." The cybersecurity law is more specific. The original words are: "If information is discovered that is prohibited from being released or transmitted by laws or administrative regulations, the transmission of the information should be stopped immediately, disposal measures such as elimination should be taken to prevent the spread of the information, relevant records should be kept, and reports should be reported to the relevant competent authorities." Those who fail to do so will be ordered to make corrections, given warnings, and notified, and may be fined an additional 50,000 to 500,000 yuan. Those who refuse to make corrections or if the circumstances are serious will be fined 500,000 to 2 million yuan. They may also be ordered to suspend business for rectification, close websites or applications, or have their license or business license revoked. Those directly responsible will be fined an additional 50,000 to 200,000 yuan (nationwide)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Cyberspace Administration of China (2019). Provisions on Ecological Governance of Internet Information Content (Cyberspace Affairs Office Order No. 5, Articles 8, 9, 10, 16, and 37). <http://www.cac.gov.cn/2019-12/20/c_1578375159509309.htm>; National People's Congress Standing Committee (2025). Cybersecurity Law (amended in 2025, effective on January 1, 2026, Articles 49 and 69). <https://www.cac.gov.cn/2025-12/29/c_1768735112911946.htm>; State Council (2000). Measures for the Administration of Internet Information Services (Articles 15, 16, and 23). <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2011/content_1860864.htm>

Note: You don’t need to think of the review rules yourself, just copy them. Which nine types of content are not allowed to be posted are clearly listed in Article 15 of the Internet Information Services Management Measures. There are three more things for those who do live broadcasts: "Establish a live broadcast content review platform" and be able to interrupt an ongoing live broadcast at any time. The law calls this "immediate blocking." Live content and logs must also be saved for 60 days. Video materials for online performances must also be no less than 60 days old

Case: A community website was investigated and punished by the cyberspace department because illegal information posted by users was not dealt with in a timely manner. After the platform was fined, it added a reporting portal to the page and established a content review and daily inspection system. Once illegal information appears, it will stop spreading and report it.

items.title: Providing information release and instant messaging services must require users to provide their real identity information
items.core: If your website can post or chat, you must ask for the user's real identity information when activating the service. If you don't give it to him, you can't let him use it. The rule of the live broadcast is that the real name is stored in the background, and it is up to him to decide what nickname is displayed on the page, and he can verify it with his mobile phone number. Those who do not give their real names will be ordered to make corrections first. Those who do not change will be fined 50,000 to 500,000 yuan, and the station may also be closed.
body: Cost: A real-name verification channel is required, and this type of channel is charged on a per-use basis. The product is designed according to "real name in the backend, voluntary in the frontend": the real name is stored in the backend, and the nickname is displayed on the page

Revenue: The original words of the law are "Network operators handle network access and domain name registration services for users, handle fixed-line, mobile phone and other network access procedures, or provide users with information release, instant messaging and other services. When signing an agreement with the user or confirming the provision of services, the user should be required to provide real identity information. If the user does not provide real identity information, the network operator shall not provide related services." If you don’t ask for a real name, or if the user doesn’t give you a real identity and you still let him use it, you will be ordered to correct it. Those who refuse to make corrections or if the circumstances are serious will be fined 50,000 to 500,000 yuan. They may also be ordered to suspend relevant business, suspend operations for rectification, close websites or applications, and revoke licenses or business licenses. Those directly responsible will be fined an additional 10,000 to 100,000 yuan. The live broadcast service follows the principle of "real-name at the backend and voluntary at the frontend" and provides "real identity information authentication based on mobile phone numbers and other methods." This means that the user's real name is stored in the background of the platform, and the nickname displayed on the page is determined by the user himself, and verification is based on methods such as mobile phone number. The requirements for live streaming are more stringent and are "based on real identity information authentication such as identity document information and unified social credit codes." The unified social credit code is the serial number on the business license (nationwide)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress Standing Committee (2025). Cybersecurity Law (amended in 2025, effective on January 1, 2026, Articles 26 and 64; the 2016 text is Articles 24 and 61). <https://www.cac.gov.cn/2025-12/29/c_1768735112911946.htm> ; Cyberspace Administration of China (2016). Regulations on the Management of Internet Live Broadcast Services (Articles 12 and 16). <https://www.cac.gov.cn/2016-11/04/c_1119847629.htm> ; Seven departments including the State Cyberspace Administration of China (2021). Measures for the Management of Online Live Broadcast Marketing (Trial) (State Information Office Document [2021] No. 5, Article 8). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2021-04/23/content_5601682.htm>

Note: The bar numbers have been changed. The Cybersecurity Law will be revised in 2025 and will come into effect on January 1, 2026. The real-name provision was moved from Article 24 to Article 26, and the penalty was moved from Article 61 to Article 64. The text of the provision has not changed. If the material in your hand still refers to the old account number, you need to change it

Case: A forum provides posting and private message chat functions, but does not require real identity information when registering. After being ordered to make corrections, the platform added real-name verification of mobile phone numbers when users opened services, retained real information in the background, and nicknames can still be displayed on the page.

items.title: No live broadcasts are allowed for people under the age of 16, and rewards are processed according to age groups
items.core: People under the age of 16 cannot register a live broadcast account with you. If you are over 16 years old, your identity will be verified and your parent or other guardian’s consent is required. Rewards are divided into three levels: those under 8 years old are not allowed to reward, those between 8 and 16 years old require guardian consent, and those over 16 years old require guardian consent or verification of income. If a child carries the reward money behind his back and the guardian comes to ask for it, the court will order it to be returned.
body: Cost: No money. Add a process to each of the two steps of registration and payment: first determine the age, and then confirm the consent of the guardian

Revenue: The original words of the law are "Online live broadcast service providers shall not provide online live broadcast publisher account registration services to minors under the age of 16; when providing online live broadcast publisher account registration services to minors over the age of 16, their identity information must be authenticated and the consent of their parents or other guardians must be obtained." The regulations also require "the establishment of a dynamic verification mechanism for the real identity information of online live broadcast publishers." You must be able to review the identity of the person who started the broadcast at any time. In addition, it is necessary to "reasonably limit the single consumption amount and single-day cumulative consumption amount of minors of different ages when using its services", and set single and single-day spending caps for minors based on their age. Tips are now divided into three levels: "Tipping services are not allowed to minors under the age of eight. To provide tipping services to minors between the ages of eight and 16, the consent of their guardians should be obtained. To provide tipping services to minors over the age of 16, the consent of their guardians or to verify their income certification documents should be obtained." There is another article: If a person with limited capacity for civil conduct rewards someone without the consent of the guardian, and the guardian comes to ask for money, the court should support it and the money can be returned. Persons with limited capacity for civil conduct refer to minors who are not legally able to make their own decisions (nationally)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress Standing Committee (2020). Protection of Minors (Articles 74 and 76). <https://www.cac.gov.cn/2020-10/22/c_1604928959588622.htm>; State Council (2023). Regulations on the Internet Protection of Minors (State Council Order No. 766, Articles 31 and 44). <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/2023/issue_10806/202311/content_6913813.html>; Secretariat of the Cyberspace Administration of China (2026). Notice on strengthening the standardized management of online live streaming rewards (Item 7). <https://www.cac.gov.cn/2026-04/13/c_1777815804150225.htm> ; Supreme People's Court (2020). Guiding Opinions on Properly Trialing Certain Issues in Civil Cases Involving the New Coronavirus Epidemic in accordance with the Law (2) (Fafa [2020] No. 17, Article 9). <https://www.court.gov.cn/fabu/xiangqing/230181.html>

Note: If there is a refund dispute, it will be handled in the direction that is most beneficial to the minor. The story of this incident has been changed. The opinions of the four departments in 2022 and the notice of the State Administration of Radio, Film and Television in 2020 stated that minors are not allowed to reward. The new notice in April 2026 changed the age brackets to 8-year-olds and 16-year-olds, but it did not state that the first two were invalid, and the official did not say how the two would be connected. Therefore, the sentence "Minors are prohibited from tipping" is now inaccurate

Case: A live broadcast platform did not prevent a 15-year-old boy from registering to start broadcasting, and he used his mother’s mobile phone to reward him with 20,000 yuan. After the mother found out, she asked the platform to refund the money. The court found that the reward was without the consent of the guardian and ordered the platform to refund all the money.

items.title: When receiving an infringement notice, you must handle it in a timely manner. If there is no follow-up statement within 15 days after forwarding the statement, it will be restored
items.core: When someone sends an infringement notice and attaches preliminary evidence, you must promptly delete, block, or disconnect the thing, and at the same time forward the notice to the seller. If you don't put it off, you will have to compensate the seller for the extra loss. The seller files a defense, and you transfer the defense to the other party and wait 15 days. The other party neither complained nor sued, so the things were restored.
body: Cost: No money. It is necessary to establish a fixed process: receive the notification, forward it to the seller, receive the seller’s defense, and publish the results. Keep a record of every step

Benefit: The rights holder "has the right to notify the e-commerce platform operator to take necessary measures such as deletion, blocking, disconnection, termination of transactions and services. The notification should include preliminary evidence of infringement." The rights holder is the owner of trademarks, copyrights, and patents. A mere statement is not enough, preliminary evidence must be attached. After receiving the notice, the platform "should take necessary measures in a timely manner and forward the notice to the operators on the platform; if necessary measures are not taken in a timely manner, the platform operators shall bear joint and several liability for the expanded part of the damage." If you delay and do not deal with it, you will have to compensate the seller for any additional losses. After the seller pleads his case, the platform "if the platform does not receive notice of complaint or prosecution within fifteen days after the transfer statement reaches the intellectual property right holder, it shall promptly terminate the measures taken." This means forwarding the seller’s defense to the rights holder and waiting for 15 days. The other party neither complained nor sued, so they restored the deleted and removed items. If the platform knows or should know that there is infringement but fails to deal with it, it will bear joint and several liability with the infringer. The intellectual property department can also order you to make corrections within a time limit. If you fail to make corrections within the time limit, you will be fined 50,000 to 500,000 yuan. If the circumstances are serious, you will be fined 500,000 to 2 million yuan. Conversely, "Those who maliciously issue wrong notifications and cause losses to operators on the platform shall bear double the liability for compensation" (National)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress Standing Committee (2018). E-commerce Law (Articles 42, 43, 44, 45, 84). <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=2c909fdd678bf17901678bf8af050b81>; National People's Congress (2020). Civil Code (Articles 1195, 1196, 1197). <https://www.court.gov.cn/zixun/xiangqing/233181.html>

Note: If you are not an e-commerce platform, but just a general website, then follow the notice and deletion rules of the Civil Code. The difference lies in how long you have to wait after the other party makes a plea: the E-commerce Law gives a clear 15 days, while the Civil Code only states a "reasonable period." In addition, it is an express requirement of Article 44 of the E-commerce Law to publish the received notice, the seller’s defense, and your handling results. If the platform itself organizes the uploading of pirated copies, or if it knows it is infringing but still ignores it, the rule of "deleting it upon notification" cannot protect it. See Section 9, Article 24 (Chinese comics, transfer of movies and TV dramas)

Case: After the brand sent an infringement notice to the shopping platform, the platform failed to delete the product link in time, resulting in increased losses. The platform was ordered to jointly compensate the seller for the expanded portion. Later, after receiving the complaint, the platform forwarded the statement and waited for 15 days. The link would be restored if there were no complaints after the period expired.

items.title: Don’t leave user information overseas casually. There are legal conditions and thresholds for exiting the country
