items.core: Transmitting the information of domestic users to machines overseas is called exiting, and the same applies to placing servers overseas. Generally, you need to pass the security assessment of the network information department, or undergo certification and sign a standard contract. If the total number of people in the year is less than 100,000 and does not contain sensitive information, these three items are exempted. It is also necessary to tell the user who will collect it overseas and what to use it for, and obtain his consent separately.
body: Cost: No money. The easiest way is to keep user data within the country. If it really needs to be transferred overseas, follow a standard contract or go through certification

Benefits: Handing over domestic user information to an overseas company or storing it on an overseas machine is legally called providing personal information overseas, and one of the four conditions "should be met". The first is to pass the security assessment organized by the network information department. The second is to obtain personal information protection certification from a professional organization. The third is to sign with the overseas recipient according to the standard contract formulated by the cybersecurity and informatization department. The fourth is other conditions stipulated by laws and administrative regulations. At the same time, you need to tell the user the following: the name of the overseas recipient, contact information, purpose of processing, method of processing, type of personal information, and how he can exercise his rights. Moreover, it is necessary to "obtain the individual's separate consent" and specifically ask the user about this matter once. The specific thresholds are divided into groups based on the cumulative number of people. Ordinary enterprises are called data processors other than critical information infrastructure operators in regulations. This type of enterprise has an exemption line. The original words are "Since January 1 of that year, the personal information of less than 100,000 people has been provided overseas (excluding sensitive personal information)." If you fail to reach this line, you will be exempted from applying for assessment, entering into a standard contract, and undergoing certification. If there are more than 100,000 people but less than 1 million, a standard contract must be concluded or certification must be passed. Those with more than 1 million people, or those with sensitive personal information of more than 10,000 people, should apply for a security assessment (nationwide, starting from March 2024)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People’s Congress Standing Committee (2021). Personal Information Protection Law (Articles 38, 39, and 40). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202108/t20210820_527244.shtml>; Cyberspace Administration of China (2024). Regulations on promoting and regulating the cross-border flow of data (Cyberspace Affairs Commission Order No. 16, Articles 3, 4, 5, 7, and 8). <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/2024/issue_11366/202405/content_6954192.html> ; Cyberspace Administration of China (2022). Measures for the Security Assessment of Data Exit (Cyberspace Affairs Office Order No. 16). No. 11, Article 4). <https://www.cac.gov.cn/2022-07/07/c_1658811536396503.htm>

Note: Putting the server overseas does not mean "the data does not leave the country." A user registers within the country and you transfer his information to a machine outside the country. This is an outbound transaction. There is a category that does not require security assessment, certification, and standard contracts: cross-border shopping, cross-border shipping, and booking air tickets and hotels. These are things that must be communicated "in order to enter into and perform a contract to which an individual is a party." Also pay attention to how the number of people is calculated: calculated based on "cumulative since January 1st of the current year", not counting twelve months from today

Case: An App transmitted user mobile phone number, location and other information to an overseas server for analysis without conducting a security assessment or informing the user. The network information department requested rectification, and the app subsequently stopped data transmission, signed a new standard contract, and obtained user consent separately.

items.title: When choosing a server, first see if you can tolerate the downtime, then see if there is anyone to operate and maintain it, and finally compare prices
items.core: The difference between the three levels is not the price, but what you had on hand on the day of the accident. Large factories have registration channels, and their qualifications are made public. If something breaks, there are announcements and compensation clauses, and people can be found. Small service providers are half the price, but when it is overbooked, gone, or blocked by the upstream, you don’t even know who to contact. For a static website without user data, a VPS of several dozen yuan is enough.
body: Cost: Cloud hosts from mainstream cloud vendors cost hundreds to thousands of yuan per month. VPS from small service providers starts at tens of yuan per month. VPS is a small virtual server. Dedicated server hosting starts at several thousand yuan per year, and you have to buy the hardware yourself

Benefits: The difference between the three levels is not in price, but in what you have on hand on the day of the accident. Mainstream cloud vendors have registration channels, their qualifications are public, there are announcements when failures occur, there are compensation clauses in contracts, and people can be found if problems arise. The price of a small service provider can be half lower, but when it is overbooked, gone, or blocked by the upstream, you have no one to appeal to. So before negotiating the price, go to the Ministry of Industry and Information Technology system to check whether it has a value-added telecommunications business license. Dedicated server hosting only makes sense if two conditions are true: the bandwidth or hardware costs are significantly cheaper, and you have someone to do the operation and maintenance yourself. How to choose: For a static website without user data, the cheapest VPS is enough. If there are user registrations and transactions, choose a cloud host with elastic expansion and snapshot backup, and store the backup in at least two places
Evidence level: C

Source: Author's experience, no direct documentation; see Section 4 of this section for legal requirements for service provider qualifications and filing, see Section 11, Section 16 for log retention and level protection obligations

Note: The above is an empirical judgment, without documentary evidence. There’s only one thing you can really check: the service provider’s license. If you want to save money, save on configuration and bandwidth, not on qualifications

Case: Xiao Zhang, an e-commerce businessman, chose a small service provider with an annual fee of several hundred yuan to save money. During a big sale, the server crashed and no one responded to the work order. He moved to a large factory overnight and activated the registration channel. Although he spent tens of thousands, he kept the store and did not lose core customers.

items.title: If user information on the website or app is leaked (or tampered with, or lost), remedy it immediately and notify the user and the competent authority. If you are attacked, report it to the public security
items.core: If user information is leaked, tampered with, or lost, or it may happen, remedy it immediately and notify the competent authority and affected users. If you fail to report the violation, you will be ordered to make corrections first. If you fail to make corrections, you will be fined not more than 1 million yuan, and in serious cases, not more than 50 million yuan. If the user is harmed as a result, he will have to pay compensation if he cannot prove that he was not at fault. Those who are protected, handled according to the plan and reported in a timely manner may be given a lighter sentence or not be held accountable depending on the circumstances.
body: Cost: No money. It is necessary to write a plan in advance for handling the incident: who will make the decision, which hole will be blocked first, and how to notify the user. The difficulty is that the instinct at the moment of the incident is to cover it up and not let users know

Benefits: The original words of the Personal Information Protection Law are "If personal information leakage, tampering, or loss occurs or may occur, personal information processors should immediately take remedial measures and notify the departments and individuals who perform personal information protection responsibilities." Three things should be written in the notice: what type of information was leaked, the reason and possible harm; what remediation you have done, what the user can do to mitigate the harm; your contact information. If your remedy can indeed avoid harm, you do not need to notify users. However, if the competent authorities believe that it may cause harm, they have the right to require you to notify them. The Network Data Security Management Regulations say notifications can be made by “telephone calls, text messages, instant messaging tools, emails or announcements, etc.” If any suspected criminal clues are found during disposal, the case must be reported to the public security organs and national security organs. Those who fail to perform these obligations will be ordered to make corrections, give warnings, and have their illegal gains confiscated. Apps that violate the law can be ordered to suspend or terminate their services. Those who refuse to make corrections will be fined up to 1 million yuan, and the person directly responsible will be fined 10,000 to 100,000 yuan. If the circumstances are serious, the fine may be no more than 50 million yuan or less than 5% of the previous year's turnover, and the person in charge may be fined no more than 100,000 yuan to 1 million yuan. Civilly, if the user is harmed as a result, you "should bear tort liability such as damages if you cannot prove that you are not at fault." Large-scale leaks must be reported on time. According to the Cyberspace Administration of China’s regulations, the leakage of personal information of more than 1 million people is considered a “major cybersecurity incident.” Generally, websites and apps must report such incidents to the cybersecurity department of the province where they are located, "no more than 4 hours later." One of the channels is the 12387 hotline. A summary report must be submitted within 30 days after the disposal is completed. If late reporting, omission, false reporting or concealment of reporting results in major harmful consequences, severe penalties will be imposed. On the other hand, if reasonable and necessary protection has been taken, handled according to the plan, and reported in a timely manner, "the case may be given a lighter sentence or not be held accountable depending on the circumstances" (National, reporting measures will be effective from November 2025)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress Standing Committee (2021). Personal Information Protection Law (Articles 57, 66, and 69). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/202108/t20210820_527244.shtml> ; Standing Committee of the National People's Congress (2025). Cybersecurity Law (amended in 2025, effective on January 1, 2026, Articles 27, 44, and 71; the 2016 text is Articles 25 and 42). <https://www.cac.gov.cn/2025-12/29/c_1768735112911946.htm> ; State Council (2024). Network Data Security Management Regulations (State Council Order No. 790, Article 11). <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/2024/issue_11646/202410/content_6980863.html> ; Cyberspace Administration of China (2025). National Cybersecurity Incident Reporting Management Measures (Articles 4, 8, 9, 10, and 11, attachment "Guidelines for Classification of Cybersecurity Incidents"). <https://www.cac.gov.cn/2025-09/15/c_1759583017717009.htm>

Note: If a small website leaks hundreds or thousands of people, it must be remedied and notified in accordance with the Personal Information Protection Act, but it will not meet the 4-hour reporting threshold. When notifying users, be specific about what you can do: which password to change, and be wary of calls pretending to be customer service. Keep enough logs for 6 months. Only when something goes wrong can you find out where the leak came from. See Section 11, Article 16 (Keeping logs based on graded protection requirements). How to prevent users from being leaked, please see Section 14

Case: After an online education platform discovered that a user’s mobile phone number was leaked, it immediately repaired the vulnerability and reported it, and simultaneously notified the user to change their password. Because of proactive remediation, the competent authorities will give lighter penalties; if concealed and caught, you will face high fines.

items.title: Those who sell automatic renewal memberships must remind users in a conspicuous way before activating and every time they deduct money. The cancellation entrance must be easy to find
items.core: Those who sell automatic renewal memberships must remind users in a conspicuous way before activating and every time they deduct money. During the membership period, there must be an entrance that can be canceled or changed at any time, so that it is easier to find a better place, and unreasonable fees are not allowed. If you deduct money without warning, you can be fined 1 to 5 times the illegal income, and if there is no illegal income, the fine is not more than 300,000 yuan.
body: Cost: No money. Write the automatic renewal clearly on the activation page, send a separate reminder before each deduction, and put a button in the personal center that can be canceled at any time. The difficulty is that some users will cancel easily after receiving the reminder

Income: The original words of the Internet Transaction Supervision and Management Measures are that if services are provided by means of automatic extension, automatic renewal, etc., "should be brought to the attention of consumers in a conspicuous manner before consumers accept the service and before the date of automatic extension, automatic renewal, etc., and consumers shall make their own choices." During the service period, it must also "provide consumers with obvious and simple options to cancel or change at any time, and must not charge unreasonable fees." The Implementing Regulations of the Consumer Rights Protection Law also have the same reminder requirements. Those who fail to remind will be punished according to the implementation regulations: ordered to make corrections, warned, confiscated illegal income, and fined 1 to 5 times the illegal income. If there is no illegal income, a fine of not more than 300,000 yuan will be imposed. If the circumstances are serious, the company shall be ordered to suspend business for rectification and the business license shall be revoked. Those who fail to facilitate the cancellation of the entrance will be ordered to make corrections within a time limit and may be fined up to 30,000 yuan (nationwide)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: State Administration for Market Regulation (2021, 2025 revision). Measures for the Supervision and Administration of Online Transactions (General Administration Order No. 37, Articles 18 and 41). <https://www.samr.gov.cn/zw/zfxxgk/fdzdgknr/fgs/art/2025/art_4b47c79b8d994a42bba4835997688faa.html> ; State Council (2024). Regulations for the Implementation of the Consumer Rights Protection Law (State Council Order No. 778, Article 10, Paragraph 2, Article 50). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202403/content_6940159.htm>

Note: The regulations do not specify what the "significant manner" looks like. A safe approach is to send a separate reminder before deducting money each time, and keep a record of the sending, so that you can provide evidence when you are complained. For how to turn off automatic renewal on the user's side, see Section 5, Article 1 (Turn off all automatic renewals)

Case: Ms. Li found that a video APP automatically renewed without reminding her in advance, and the cancellation entrance was hidden in the fifth-level menu, so she complained to the Consumers Association. After verification, the platform confiscated illegal gains and fined them, while optimizing the reminder and cancellation process.

items.title: Start taking 0.4 mg of folic acid every day when preparing to become pregnant, and continue taking it until 3 months into the first trimester
items.core: Take one folic acid pill every day before and after pregnancy, and the probability of the child developing neural tube defects can be reduced by approximately 70%. The national supplement program requires taking it from 3 months before pregnancy to 3 months in the first trimester. Neural tube defects are birth defects such as anencephaly and spina bifida. For people who have already given birth to one such child, the probability of having another child with problems is about one-third of the original.
body: Cost: tens of yuan per bottle. Rural women don’t have to spend money because the country’s free folic acid supplement program will provide them. Take one pill a day, it’s hard to remember it every day

Benefit: The Cochrane systematic review combined 5 trials and 6708 births, and the quality of the evidence was rated as high. Taking folic acid supplements every day before and after pregnancy reduces the relative risk of fetal neural tube defects by approximately 70%, RR 0.31 (95% CI 0.17 to 0.58, confidence range). For those who had already given birth to a child with a neural tube defect, the relative risk of having another child with the problem fell to about one-third, RR 0.34 (95% CI 0.18 to 0.64). There was no difference in effect between doses of 0.4 mg and higher by population group. There is no difference in the effect of taking folic acid alone or taking multivitamins. The Ministry of Health's 2010 folic acid supplement project management plan states that rural women who are preparing to become pregnant will be given free folic acid to "take from 3 months before pregnancy to 3 months in the first trimester." The folic acid tablets given are 0.4 mg. The Centers for Disease Control and Prevention says neural tube defects occur in the first weeks of pregnancy, often before you know you're pregnant
Level of Evidence: A

Source: De-Regil LM, Peña-Rosas JP, Fernández-Gaxiola AC, Rayco-Solon P (2015). Effects and safety of periconceptional oral folate supplementation for preventing birth defects. Cochrane Database of Systematic Reviews, (12), CD007950. <https://doi.org/10.1002/14651858.CD007950.pub3>; General Office of the Ministry of Health (2010). 2010 Management Plan for Folic Acid Supplementation to Prevent Neural Tube Defects. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. About Folic Acid. <https://www.cdc.gov/folic-acid/about/index.html>

Note: The key is to "start eating before pregnancy." Neural tube defects appear in the first few weeks of pregnancy, so by the time you take a pregnancy test, it may already be too late. So if you plan to have a child, follow the domestic program and start eating 3 months in advance. In the same summary study, folic acid has no clear effect on cleft lip and palate, congenital heart disease, or miscarriage. Don’t expect it to cure anything else. Pregnant women who are vegetarians should also take vitamin B12 supplements every day, see Section 20, Item 14 (if they are vegetarians, they should take vitamin B12 supplements every day). Still wondering when the baby was born, please refer to Section 18, Article 7 (Having a baby a few years later) for age.

Case: Ms. Chen, who is preparing for pregnancy, insists on taking 0.4 mg of folic acid every day from 3 months before pregnancy to 3 months in the first trimester. Pregnancy examination showed that the fetal neural tube developed normally, and she successfully gave birth to a healthy baby. The whole family was very pleased.

items.title: Go to the community health service center to create a "Mother and Child Health Handbook" before 13 weeks of pregnancy and use up the free prenatal check-up quota
items.core: At least five prenatal check-ups during pregnancy, plus postpartum home visits and 42-day postpartum check-ups, the money will be paid by the state. The way to get it is to go to the community to create a "Mother and Child Health Handbook" before 13 weeks of pregnancy. If you don't build it, you will miss out on these free opportunities.
body: Cost: Free, this is a national basic public health service project. How many trips should be made according to the gestational age

Benefits: "National Basic Public Health Service Standards (Third Edition)" includes maternal health management services. Pregnant women who are resident in the jurisdiction can do this. 1 health checkup in the first trimester, 2 times in the second trimester, 2 times in the third trimester, 1 postpartum visit, and 1 health checkup 42 days after delivery. Before 13 weeks of pregnancy, you need to register and have your first prenatal check-up. The two second trimester periods are at 16 to 20 weeks of gestation and 21 to 24 weeks of gestation. The two times in the third trimester are at 28 to 36 weeks and 37 to 40 weeks respectively. The local service list also includes the first complete set of laboratory tests and postpartum depression screening
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National Health and Family Planning Commission (2017). National Basic Public Health Service Standards (Third Edition). <https://www.nhc.gov.cn/ewebeditor/uploadfile/2017/04/20170417104506514.pdf>; Jingjiang Municipal People's Government. National basic public health service project - Maternal health management services (local service list public). <https://www.jingjiang.gov.cn/xxgk/zdlyxxgk/wsjk/art/2023/art_383017a2e7794892bc772bfbe042f379.html>

Note: These 5 times are the lower limit for free prenatal check-ups, not all prenatal check-ups. The hospital will add ultrasound, blood sugar, and fetal heart rate monitoring according to the situation, and you have to pay for these yourself. The earlier the registration is established, the sooner the pregnancy risk classification can be made. Pregnancy risk grading is to classify pregnant women according to the level of risk. Only when they are found to be high-risk can they be transferred to a hospital that can handle them as soon as possible. If people live in other districts, they will be registered according to their current place of residence and do not need to return to their place of residence

Case: Ms. Wang, who was 10 weeks pregnant, went to the community health service center to create a "Mother and Child Health Handbook". As a result, she enjoyed 5 free prenatal checkups and postpartum visits, saved nearly 3,000 yuan, and also found and intervened in time for gestational diabetes.

items.title: AIDS, syphilis, and hepatitis B will be checked out at the first prenatal check-up, and if AIDS is detected, free treatment will be provided
items.core: AIDS, syphilis, and hepatitis B will be checked out at the first prenatal check-up. There is no need to pay for the initial HIV screening. It's not a dead end if we really find out. If AIDS is detected, the state will provide free treatment and counseling. If syphilis is detected, treat it with penicillin as soon as possible. If hepatitis B is detected, the child should be vaccinated and immune globulin given as soon as he is born to prevent the disease from being passed from mother to child.
body: Cost: AIDS consultation and initial screening tests are free according to regulations. Syphilis and hepatitis B are not free in the national documents. Ask the hospital whether they charge for prenatal check-ups

Benefits: Mother-to-child transmission means that the disease is passed from mother to child. There are requirements in the "Working Standards for the Prevention of Mother-to-Child Transmission of AIDS, Syphilis and Hepatitis B (2020 Edition)". During the first prenatal check-up, the hospital must provide relevant information, "provide appropriate and standardized testing, and provide follow-up consultation based on the results." Those who have not been identified before delivery will in principle be treated as infected. Standards require that pregnant women diagnosed with syphilis "be given standardized penicillin treatment as early as possible" and that their children be given preventive penicillin treatment immediately after birth. For pregnant and lying-in women who are positive for hepatitis B surface antigen, antiviral treatment will be given after informed consent. Testing positive is not a dead end. Article 23 of the "Regulations on the Prevention and Treatment of AIDS" stipulates that "free consultation and preliminary screening testing" will be provided to those who voluntarily accept AIDS counseling and testing. Article 44 stipulates that "treatment and consultation to prevent mother-to-child transmission of AIDS will be provided free of charge" to pregnant women infected with the HIV virus. Article 43 requires the provision of services such as prevention (preventing the spread of the disease to children), treatment, postpartum visits, infant follow-up and testing. If the mother is positive for hepatitis B surface antigen, the newborn must receive hepatitis B vaccine and hepatitis B immunoglobulin at birth (see Section 20, Article 2)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: General Office of the National Health Commission (2020). Standards for preventing mother-to-child transmission of AIDS, syphilis and hepatitis B (2020 edition). <https://wjw.xinjiang.gov.cn/hfpc/zhgl6/202012/08b7de496f0b40e586d4b99d00cf79c4.shtml> (Reprinted by the Health Commission of the Xinjiang Uygur Autonomous Region); State Council (2006). Regulations on the Prevention and Treatment of AIDS (Articles 23, 43, and 44). <https://wjw.beijing.gov.cn/zwgk_20040/zcwj2022/flfg/202304/t20230408_2992986.html> (Reprinted by Beijing Municipal Health Commission)

Note: The earlier these three items are checked, the more useful they are, because both blocking and treatment take time. Article 3 of the AIDS Prevention and Treatment Regulations also states that "no unit or individual may discriminate against people living with HIV, AIDS patients and their families." The legitimate rights and interests of getting married, finding a job, seeing a doctor, and going to school are protected by law. See Section 1 for routine prevention and detection. For post-exposure interruption after high-risk behaviors, see Section 13

Case: Pregnant Ms. Liu did Aimee B screening for her first prenatal check-up and was diagnosed with AIDS. She immediately received free treatment from the state, and the child was immediately blocked after birth. The child is currently healthy, and her own viral load has been controlled to the point where it is undetectable.

items.title: Don’t smoke a cigarette or drink during the entire pregnancy, and don’t smoke in the house at home
items.core: Smoking during pregnancy increases the risk of premature birth, small birth, cleft lip and palate, and doubles the risk of abnormal bleeding during pregnancy and delivery. Pregnant women who smoke, or whose children smoke after birth, are at higher risk of sudden infant death. It’s never too late to quit. There is no known safe amount of alcohol during pregnancy, and you should avoid drinking during your entire pregnancy.
body: Cost: No money, and you can also save money on tobacco and alcohol. It’s difficult to get people who live with you to quit smoking too

Benefits: According to the US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention: Smoking during pregnancy can cause children to “be born full term or be too small” and “may be born prematurely.” It "doubles the risk of abnormal bleeding during pregnancy and delivery." It increases the risk of birth defects such as cleft lip and cleft palate. It can also "damage the fetus's developing lungs and brain, and the damage can last into childhood." Babies born to mothers who smoked during pregnancy, and babies exposed to smoke after birth, are at higher risk for sudden infant death syndrome. The official advice is "It is best to quit smoking before pregnancy, but if you are already pregnant, quitting is still useful." "It is never too late to quit." When it comes to alcohol, the U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention says there is "no known safe amount of alcohol consumption" during pregnancy, and there is no time during pregnancy when drinking is safe. A child's brain develops throughout pregnancy and may be affected at any time when alcohol is exposed
Level of Evidence: A
Source: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. About Alcohol Use During Pregnancy. <https://www.cdc.gov/alcohol-pregnancy/about/index.html>

Note: Second-hand smoke that a pregnant woman inhales when others smoke in the house counts as well to the fetus. Therefore, family members who live together should not smoke in the house. The same goes for alcohol: No amount of alcohol is known to be safe, and the easiest thing to do during pregnancy is not to drink at all. For the effects of tobacco and alcohol on adults, see Section 2

Case: Pregnant Ms. Zhao gave up the habit of half a pack of cigarettes a day and let her husband smoke outdoors. All indicators during the pregnancy examination were normal, and the child was born at full term with a normal weight, thus avoiding the risk of premature birth and low birth weight.

items.title: Those with high risk factors for preeclampsia should start taking one low-dose aspirin per day as directed by your doctor after 12 weeks of pregnancy
items.core: Preeclampsia is a type of hypertension during pregnancy. People who have had a previous pregnancy, are pregnant with multiple fetuses, have chronic high blood pressure, have diabetes before pregnancy, have kidney disease or autoimmune diseases are at high risk. High-risk women who take low-dose aspirin every day as directed by their doctor starting from 12 weeks of pregnancy can reduce the risk of preeclampsia by about 15%, and the risk of premature birth and child death before and after delivery by about 20%. Don't let others eat it themselves.
body: Cost: dozens of yuan. Take the medicine as directed by the doctor every day until you give birth. The difficulty lies in not forgetting it every day

Benefits: The U.S. Preventive Services Task Force gives a level B recommendation: For people at high risk of preeclampsia, start taking low-dose aspirin (81 mg/day) after 12 weeks of pregnancy to prevent it. Preeclampsia is a high blood pressure disorder in pregnancy. Combining multiple studies, the results are as follows, and the 95% CI is the credible range. Preeclampsia RR 0.85 (95% CI 0.75 to 0.95, 16 studies), approximately 15% lower. Prematurity RR 0.80 (95% CI 0.67 to 0.95, 13 studies), approximately 20% lower. The RR 0.79 (95% CI 0.66 to 0.96, 11 studies) was about 21% lower for perinatal death; perinatal death is death in the period before and after childbirth. Small for gestational age/intrauterine growth restriction RR 0.82 (95% CI 0.68 to 0.99, 16 studies), about 18% lower; refers to the fetus growing smaller than the same gestational age
Level of Evidence: A

Source: US Preventive Services Task Force (2021). Aspirin Use to Prevent Prevent Preeclampsia and Related Morbidity and Mortality: Preventive Medication. <https://www.uspreventiveservicestaskforce.org/uspstf/recommendation/low-dose-aspirin-use-for-the-prevention-of-morbidity-and-mortality-from-preeclampsia-preventive-medication>

Note: High-risk individuals include: preeclampsia in the previous child, twins or multiple pregnancy, and chronic hypertension. There are also types 1 or 2 diabetes before pregnancy, kidney disease, and autoimmune diseases such as systemic lupus erythematosus and antiphospholipid syndrome. Don’t eat anything that doesn’t fall into these categories. This medicine requires a prescription from a doctor. During the prenatal check-up, the medical history must be clearly stated and the doctor can make a decision. Most of the products sold in China are 100 mg enteric-coated tablets. Take them as directed by your doctor

Case: Ms. Zhou, who had chronic hypertension, took low-dose aspirin every day as directed by her doctor after 12 weeks of pregnancy. The blood pressure was stable throughout the pregnancy, no preeclampsia occurred, the child was born at full term, and the mother and daughter were safe.

items.title: Do a gestational diabetes screening at 24 weeks of pregnancy and later. Don’t be bothered by drinking sugar water.
items.core: Gestational diabetes is high blood sugar that occurs after pregnancy. After 24 weeks of pregnancy, you can check it out by spending half a morning drinking sugar water and drawing blood several times. If you don't check or ignore it, the risk of fetal overgrowth, dystocia, surgery, preeclampsia and neonatal hypoglycemia will increase.
body: Cost: tens to more than one hundred yuan. You have to go on an empty stomach and draw blood several times, which takes up half the morning.

Benefits: Level B recommendation from the U.S. Preventive Services Task Force: Screen for gestational diabetes at 24 weeks and beyond in pregnant women who are asymptomatic (not aware of discomfort). Gestational diabetes is high blood sugar that occurs after pregnancy. If there is only one screening, this time it will be done at 24 weeks of pregnancy and beyond. Is screening before 24 weeks of gestation good or bad? The task force concluded that the available evidence is insufficient to judge the benefits and harms (level I). Ignoring gestational diabetes increases the risk of macrosomia (an overgrown fetus), difficult labor, cesarean section, preeclampsia, and neonatal hypoglycemia.
Level of Evidence: A

Source: US Preventive Services Task Force (2021). Gestational Diabetes: Screening. <https://www.uspreventiveservicestaskforce.org/uspstf/recommendation/gestational-diabetes-screening>; Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. Gestational Diabetes. <https://www.cdc.gov/diabetes/about/gestational-diabetes.html>

Note: According to the U.S. Preventive Services Task Force, after being diagnosed, you usually start with exercise, diet adjustment, and blood sugar testing. If blood sugar cannot be controlled, insulin or oral medications will be used. Don't skip this one just because you're afraid of being diagnosed and needing injections. Check your blood sugar after giving birth: About half of people who have gestational diabetes will later develop type 2 diabetes, the Centers for Disease Control and Prevention says

Case: Ms. Wu was screened for gestational diabetes when she was 24 weeks pregnant. After the diagnosis, through diet control and exercise management, her blood sugar returned to normal, avoiding an overlarge fetus and cesarean section, and finally gave birth to a healthy baby.

items.title: Memorize this list of "go to the hospital immediately", including pregnancy and one year after delivery.
items.core: If any of the following occurs, go to the hospital immediately. Don't wait at home for one night, even within one year after delivery. Headaches are bad or getting worse, vision changes, fever reaches 38°C, hands or face become severely swollen. Shortness of breath, chest pain or fast heartbeat, severe stomach pain that does not relieve, fetal movement has stopped or decreased significantly. Vaginal bleeding or discharge, swelling and pain in an arm or leg, thoughts of harming yourself or your child.
body: Cost: Nothing. Take five minutes to remember, and it’s a good idea to let the people you live with know as well.

Benefits: The U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention lists the following emergency warning signs during pregnancy: headache that keeps getting worse or getting worse, dizziness or fainting, changes in vision, and body temperature reaching 38°C or higher; severe swelling of the hands or face, thoughts of hurting oneself or the child, difficulty breathing, chest pain, or fast heartbeat; severe nausea and vomiting, severe abdominal pain that does not relieve, fetal movement has stopped or significantly decreased during pregnancy; vaginal bleeding or fluid discharge during pregnancy, vaginal bleeding or abnormal discharge after delivery; one arm or leg is severely swollen, red, or painful. These problems may occur within one year after delivery, and they are not "all right after the confinement period."
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. Hear Her — Urgent Maternal Warning Signs. <https://www.cdc.gov/hearher/maternal-warning-signs/index.html>; World Health Organization. Maternal mortality fact sheet. <https://www.who.int/news-room/fact-sheets/detail/maternal-mortality>

Note: The purpose of this list is to separate "bear it any longer" from "must leave immediately". Headache, difficulty seeing, and upper abdominal pain point to preeclampsia (hypertensive disease during pregnancy). One calf is swollen and painful, pointing to deep vein thrombosis (see Section 13). According to the World Health Organization, postpartum hemorrhage can take the life of a healthy woman within a few hours. If any of these symptoms appear, go directly to the hospital instead of waiting at home overnight.

Case: Six months after giving birth, Ms. Zheng suddenly had a severe headache and blurred vision. After remembering the list, she immediately sought medical treatment and was diagnosed with postpartum preeclampsia. Because she was rushed to the hospital in time, she recovered quickly and avoided more serious complications.

items.title: If your water breaks, lie flat on your back, elevate your buttocks, perform 120 degree injections, and do not move around or take a shower.
items.core: When your water breaks, you don’t slowly pack up your things and set out again. The correct approach is to lie down on the spot, raise your buttocks, and hit 120. If you stand and move around, the amniotic fluid will flow faster, and the umbilical cord may be washed down. That's an emergency that can kill a child.
body: Cost: No money

Income: Disposal measures given by the Beijing Municipal Health Commission: After discovering that the water has broken, "immediately find a place to lie down to prevent the amniotic fluid from flowing out", "do not move around randomly", and "call 120 immediately for emergency help". While waiting for the bus, I informed my family members to bring their things and meet them at the hospital. Popular science from medical institutions further explains why: amniotic fluid drains faster when a person is standing, and the fetus's umbilical cord may fall out. This is called umbilical cord prolapse, which is an emergency that endangers the fetus. So you have to lie down and raise your buttocks. You can lie on your left side.
Level of Evidence: B

Source: Beijing Municipal Health Commission. Weekly first aid topic: What should expectant mothers do if their amniotic fluid breaks prematurely? <https://wjw.beijing.gov.cn/bmfw_20143/jkzs/jzjj/202001/t20200115_1575632.html>; Beijing Shunyi District Maternal and Child Health Hospital. What should I do if my water breaks at home in late pregnancy? <https://www.bch-syfy.cn/Html/News/Articles/9453.html>

Note: The three signs of imminent labor are regular contractions, redness, and water breaking. Water breaking is the one that requires "lying down on the spot and calling a taxi." This is summarized by the author based on the two popular sciences above. According to popular science from Shunyi District Maternal and Child Health Hospital, getting out of bed, walking, sitting, and squatting will make amniotic fluid flow faster and increase the risk of umbilical cord prolapse. So don’t take a shower, don’t squat on the toilet, and don’t drive by yourself after your water breaks. Note the time your water broke and the color of your amniotic fluid, and tell your doctor. The amniotic fluid is light green, yellow-green or even brown, indicating that there may be meconium (fetal stool) mixed in it. If you feel that there is a cord-like thing hanging down in your vagina, it may be umbilical cord prolapse. Call 120 immediately, lie down and raise your buttocks. If the fetal movement is obviously different from usual, you should also tell the doctor

Case: Ms. Sun, who was 38 weeks pregnant, suddenly had her water break. She immediately lay down and raised her buttocks, and her husband called 120. After the ambulance arrived, she was safely sent to the hospital, avoiding the danger of umbilical cord prolapse, and finally gave birth smoothly.

items.title: If you want a painless delivery, just say so. It does not increase the risk of cesarean section.
items.core: Painless delivery involves injecting an anesthetic into the waist to suppress the pain of childbirth. It works better than other pain relief methods and doesn't make you more likely to get stabbed. "The pain-free backache will last a lifetime" is also unfounded. Now it has a separate charging item to make hospitals more willing to do it.
body: Cost: several hundred to more than one thousand yuan, prices vary from place to place. You should ask the hospital and anesthesiology department in advance whether they can do it. It’s hard to mention it yourself

Benefits: A Cochrane systematic review concluded that epidural analgesia is more effective than methods without epidurals in reducing labor pain and improving maternal satisfaction with analgesia. Painless delivery uses epidural analgesia. The same article also said, "Epidural analgesia has no impact on the risk of cesarean section or long-term low back pain." The increase in instrumental deliveries (using instruments to take out the baby) is no longer seen in studies conducted after 2005. Starting from 2024, the National Medical Insurance Administration’s obstetric medical service price project guidelines will include “labor analgesia”, “doula delivery” and “family accompaniment” as separate items. The reason is that there was no independent price item originally, and the enthusiasm of hospitals to provide labor analgesia was suppressed.
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Anim-Somuah M, Smyth RMD, Cyna AM, Cuthbert A (2018). Epidural versus non-epidural or no analgesia for pain management in labor. Cochrane Database of Systematic Reviews, (5), CD000331. <https://doi.org/10.1002/14651858.CD000331.pub4>; National Health Service (2024). Reconstructing Obstetric Service Price Project to Help Build a Fertility-Friendly Society. <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/202406/content_6957553.htm>

Remarks: "Painless surgery will cause back pain for a lifetime" and "Painless surgery will cause difficult labor and require surgery." These two most widely circulated statements have no basis. Cochrane put epidural analgesia together with other pain relief methods and concluded that it had no impact on the risk of caesarean section or long-term low back pain. The real side effects are these: low blood pressure, fever, weak legs, inability to urinate, and the first and second stages of labor are longer, and oxytocin is more likely to be used. It's up to you whether you do it or not, but don't give up because of rumors. Whether it can be done depends on whether there is an anesthesiologist on site 24 hours a day. Ask during the prenatal check-up

Case: Ms. He, who was afraid of pain, asked the doctor for painless delivery before giving birth. The pain was significantly reduced after lumbar anesthesia. She gave birth to her baby successfully and had no back pain after delivery. She was very satisfied with the painless delivery.

items.title: Don’t ask for a cesarean section without medical indication, and don’t choose a date to have the surgery
items.core: According to the World Health Organization, after the proportion of cesarean section in a place exceeds 10%, there is no evidence that the deaths of mothers and newborns will continue to decrease. What needs to be dissected must be dissected. Placenta previa and placenta accreta are more common in people who have had a caesarean section become pregnant again. It's not worth it to choose a date and worry about the pain.
body: Cost: No money. Hard to stand up to what family members say

Benefits: World Health Organization 2015 statement: As the caesarean section rate in a population rises to about 10%, maternal and neonatal deaths fall. Beyond 10%, there is no evidence of further improvement in mortality. The World Health Organization also emphasizes that every effort should be made to provide caesarean sections to women in need, rather than to meet a specific rate. Another summary compared cesarean section with vaginal delivery. Placenta previa, placenta accreta, placental abruption and stillbirth were more common in pregnancies after cesarean section. These are from follow-up studies, and the authors say they cannot be relied upon to conclude that caesarean section was the cause
Level of Evidence: A

Source: World Health Organization (2015). WHO Statement on Caesarean Section Rates (WHO/RHR/15.02). <https://www.who.int/publications/i/item/WHO-RHR-15.02>; Keag OE, Norman JE, Stock SJ (2018). cesarean delivery for mother, baby, and subsequent pregnancies: Systematic review and meta-analysis. PLoS Medicine, 15(1), e1002494. <https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pmed.1002494>

Note: When medically necessary, cesarean section is a life-saving operation. Just do it, don't force it. What should be avoided is medically unnecessary surgery, such as fear of pain, picking auspicious times, and calculating the age of children going to school. A cesarean section is a major abdominal surgery. A summary compares cesarean section and vaginal birth to see what happens if you get pregnant again after cesarean section. The odds ratios were OR 1.74 for placenta previa, OR 2.95 for placenta accreta, OR 1.38 for placental abruption, and OR 1.27 for stillbirth. This directly affects whether you want to have a second child. In turn, people who had a cesarean section had less urinary leakage and pelvic organ prolapse in the future. These are all from the study of follow-up records. The author said that it cannot be concluded that it is caused by cesarean section

Case: In the obstetrics clinic, a pregnant woman who was 39 weeks pregnant, with the fetus in a cephalic position and a normal prenatal examination wanted to choose an auspicious day and request a cesarean section. The doctor explained that there is no medical indication as it will increase the risk of bleeding, infection and future placenta, and it is recommended to prepare for natural delivery.

items.title: Confirm the maternity insurance enrollment status before pregnancy, and the spouse who is not employed can also claim maternity medical expenses
items.core: The employer has paid maternity insurance, and the medical expenses for the child and the allowance during maternity leave are all paid out of this fund. If your spouse is unemployed, you can also claim medical expenses. You have to ask in advance whether the number of months of insurance coverage is enough and whether students who live abroad need to register first.
body: Cost: No money. Make a social security or medical insurance consultation call

Benefits: Article 54 of the "Social Insurance Law": If the employer has paid maternity insurance premiums, its employees shall enjoy maternity insurance benefits. The spouse of an employee who is not working shall enjoy maternity medical expenses in accordance with national regulations, and the required funds shall be paid from the maternity insurance fund. If the company pays maternity insurance, the employee can enjoy the benefits, and the medical expenses for the child of the employee’s spouse who is not working can also be paid from this fund. Maternity insurance benefits are divided into two parts: one is maternity medical expenses, which are the medical expenses for giving birth to a child; the other is maternity allowance, which is the money paid to you during maternity leave. Article 56 lists three situations under which maternity benefits can be received: female employees enjoy maternity leave after giving birth, enjoy family planning surgery leave, and other situations stipulated by laws and regulations. Maternity allowance is "calculated and paid based on the average monthly salary of employees in the employer where the employee works in the previous year." It is calculated based on the average monthly salary of employees in your unit last year, not your own salary
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Standing Committee of the National People's Congress (2010). Social Insurance Law of the People's Republic of China (Articles 54 and 56). <https://guangdong.chinatax.gov.cn/gdsw/qysw_gkwj/2020-02/12/content_8e8c485d0db34b989531f3ba57cec5a9.shtml> (Reprinted by the Guangdong Provincial Taxation Bureau of the State Administration of Taxation)

Note: There are two things to ask the local medical insurance department in advance. The first is whether the number of consecutive months of insurance is enough and whether there is a minimum number of months required. Second, if the child was born in a place other than the insured place, should he register the childbirth in another place first? How to claim the unregistered expenses? These two regulations vary from place to place. There is no local verification here. It is the author's experience to ask in advance. How to calculate the number of maternity leave days and maternity allowances? See Section 18, Article 2

Case: After getting pregnant, Xiao Zhou discovered that her company had not paid maternity insurance. After checking the policy, she successfully reimbursed her prenatal care expenses using her status as an unemployed spouse, saving nearly 10,000 yuan.

items.title: Get the "Medical Birth Certificate" before leaving the hospital. Think of your name in advance and don't make typos.
items.core: This certificate is a prerequisite for registering a household registration, enrolling in insurance, and going to school. If you give birth in a hospital, you should collect it from the institution that delivered the baby. Those who were not born in a midwifery institution must first undergo a paternity test before they can receive it. For the characters in the name, first confirm that the household registration system can type it.
body: Cost: No money. The discharge procedures were easily completed

Benefits: Article 23 of the "Maternal and Infant Health Care Law": Medical health care institutions and personnel engaged in home delivery shall, in accordance with the regulations of the health administration department of the State Council, issue a uniform medical certificate of birth of the newborn. This card is a prerequisite for everything that follows: registering a household registration, enrolling in insurance, applying for a medical insurance card, and entering kindergarten. The Opinions of the General Office of the State Council on solving the problem of household registration for people without household registration in 2015 stated: If a child is born in a midwifery institution, he or she must apply for a "Medical Birth Certificate" from the midwifery institution. If a baby is born outside a midwifery institution, he must first obtain a paternity test certificate issued by a qualified testing agency, and then apply for it from an agency entrusted by the county-level health department
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National People's Congress Standing Committee (1994, revised in 2017). Maternal and Infant Health Care Law of the People's Republic of China (Article 23). <https://www.gov.cn/guoqing/2021-10/29/content_5647619.htm>; General Office of the State Council (2015). Opinions on solving the problem of household registration for people without household registration (Guobanfa [2015] No. 96). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2016-01/14/content_10595.htm>

Remarks: Check the parents’ names, ID numbers and children’s names word for word before filling in. The name must be typed in characters that can be typed in the household registration system. Uncommon characters will be very troublesome in the future. Name changes and certificate changes require reissuance or renewal, which is much more troublesome than checking on the spot. Keep the ID card separately when you get it. It is as important as the household registration book and ID card.

Case: Xiao Li applied for a birth certificate before his wife gave birth. Because he confirmed the name in advance to avoid re-application due to handwriting errors, the child was successfully insured and registered.
tags: Popular group=pregnancy, infants and young children

items.title: Don’t refuse newborn heel blood screening and hearing screening
items.core: A heel prick and a hearing test can detect hypothyroidism, phenylketonuria and hearing impairment when the child looks completely normal. By the time the symptoms show up, the mental damage done by hypothyroidism and phenylketonuria cannot be replenished. Hearing aids can be worn as soon as hearing impairment is detected.
body: Cost: Free in most areas, or dozens of yuan. Some expansions are funded out of your own pocket. A heel prick for blood after the child is born

Benefit: Article 3 of the "Measures for the Management of Newborn Disease Screening": "National newborn disease screening diseases include congenital hypothyroidism, phenylketonuria and other newborn genetic metabolic diseases and hearing impairment." No abnormalities can be seen in the early stages of these diseases. Among them, hypothyroidism and phenylketonuria have irreversible intellectual damage by the time symptoms become apparent. Early detection and early intervention are very effective. The methods are to supplement thyroid hormone, drink special formula milk, wear hearing aids or install cochlear implants. Article 10 stipulates that if the screening result is positive, the institution shall promptly notify the guardian to confirm the diagnosis
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Ministry of Health (2009). Measures for the Management of Newborn Disease Screening (Ministry of Health Order No. 64, Articles 3, 10, and 11). <http://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2009/content_1371363.htm>

Remarks: Article 11 of the Measures requires that before screening, the items, conditions, methods, sensitivity (how much can be detected) and costs must be truthfully informed to the guardian and signed to agree. So you'll get an informed consent form. Before signing, check clearly: which diseases are prescribed by the state and which are self-paid extras. A positive initial screening test does not mean a confirmed diagnosis. According to Article 10 of the regulations, the institution will notify you to take your child for a confirmed diagnosis. Don’t collapse at this step. Those who fail the initial hearing screening should follow the notice and re-screen. Don’t judge on your own that “if the child can hear, it’s fine.”
Case: After the baby was born, Xiao Chen insisted on completing heel blood and hearing screenings, early detection of thyroid problems and timely treatment to avoid intellectual damage.
tags: Popular group=pregnancy, infants and young children

items.title: Get the birth medical certificate to apply for resident medical insurance for the child, don’t wait for the settlement.
items.core: You can get the birth certificate to enroll the child online, no need to wait for the settlement. If you sign up, you can reimburse the hospitalization fee on the spot when you are discharged from the hospital. The hospitalization fee for a newborn is not low, and there is a big difference between insured and uninsured.
body: Cost: Pay the resident medical insurance premium once a year, a few hundred yuan

Benefit: According to the Chinese government website in 2024: "Newborns can participate in insurance online with a birth medical certificate" without having to settle down first. "Newborns can be reimbursed for medical expenses directly after they are discharged from the hospital." The previous practice was that you could only participate in the insurance after you settled down, and the hospitalization expenses had to be paid in full first and then reimbursed later. The average processing time for insurance premiums has also been reduced from 28.7 working days at the beginning of the year to 6.4 working days
Level of Evidence: A

Source: China Government Network (2024). Regular briefing on the State Council’s policy on improving the long-term mechanism for basic medical insurance participation. <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/202409/content_6973567.htm>

Note: Premature birth, jaundice, blue light exposure, and neonatal pneumonia are common reasons for hospitalization of newborns, which can easily cost tens of thousands of yuan. There is a big difference between insured and uninsured. The regulations on "how many days after birth to enroll in insurance, and you can enjoy benefits from the day of birth" are not exactly the same in various places. The specific implementation shall be subject to the instructions of the local medical insurance department. It is easiest to call 12393 to ask before leaving the hospital

Case: Xiao Zhao immediately applied for resident medical insurance for his child after receiving the birth certificate, and the hospitalization expenses were directly reimbursed, saving an advance payment of 20,000 yuan and reducing financial pressure.
tags: Popular group=pregnancy, infants and young children

items.title: Go to the police station to declare birth registration within one month after the child is born
items.core: You must declare your household registration within one month after the birth, and you must also go to the birth hospital or the vaccination unit at the place of residence to apply for a vaccination certificate. The two things should be done separately. You must get vaccinated on time even if you haven't settled in. You can't wait until your household registration is completed.
body: Cost: No money. Go to the household registration window at the police station

Income: Article 7 of the "Household Registration Regulations": "Within one month after the birth of an infant, the head of the household, relatives, caregivers or neighbors shall declare birth registration to the household registration authority at the place of the infant's permanent residence." This is a time limit set by law, not a suggestion. Settlement and vaccination are handled separately. The "Vaccine Management Law" requires that within one month after the child is born, the child must go to the vaccination unit or birth hospital to apply for a vaccination certificate. These units shall not refuse to handle the application. Vaccination is managed according to the place of residence, and there is no need to settle down first. Children who have not settled down must be vaccinated in time according to the immunization procedures
Level of Evidence: A

Source: State Council (1958). Household Registration Regulations of the People's Republic of China (Article 7). <http://www.gd.gov.cn/zwgk/wjk/zcfgk/content/post_2531969.html> (Reprinted by the People's Government of Guangdong Province); General Office of the State Council (2015). Opinions on solving the problem of household registration for people without household registration (Guobanfa [2015] No. 96). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2016-01/14/content_10595.htm>; National People’s Congress Standing Committee (2019). Vaccine Administration Law of the People’s Republic of China (Articles 6 and 47). <https://www.samr.gov.cn/zw/zfxxgk/fdzdgknr/fgs/art/2023/art_dde03480953841a5912c864dc29003d0.html>

Remarks: Bring these: medical certificate of birth, parents’ ID cards and household registers, and marriage certificate. The specific list is subject to the requirements of the local police station. The opinions of the General Office of the State Council in 2015 stated that "it is voluntary to settle down with your father and mother." You can choose to settle down with your father or your mother. The school districts and insured places on the two sides may be different. Think carefully before going, as it will be troublesome to change. Children born out of wedlock can also settle down: the same opinion states that they can apply with the medical certificate of birth, the household registration booklet of one parent and the statement of birth out of wedlock. Those who settle down with their father must also submit a paternity test certificate from a qualified appraisal agency

Case: 20 days after Xiao Wang’s child was born, he not only applied for household registration, but also completed vaccinations in the community to ensure that the child received immune protection on time.
tags: Popular group=pregnancy, infants and young children

items.title: Don't skip the re-examination 42 days after delivery, it is also a screening for postpartum depression in some places
items.core: This re-examination is free of charge. According to the service list published by the locality, it includes blood routine, leucorrhea routine and a postpartum depression screening. Major problems may occur within a year after delivery. Don’t think that you are safe after confinement.
body: Cost: Free, it is a basic public health service. It takes half a day. The difficulty lies in being too lazy to move just after confinement

Benefit: In the maternal health management of the "National Basic Public Health Service Standards (Third Edition)", there is one postpartum visit and one 42-day postpartum health examination. The local service list includes laboratory tests (blood routine, leucorrhea routine) and a postpartum depression screening. The National Health Commission's 2020 special service work plan for depression prevention and treatment requires pilot areas to "include maternal depression screening into routine pregnancy check-ups and postpartum visit processes." Therefore, whether you can screen for depression after childbirth depends on whether this is done locally. Serious complications can occur up to a year after delivery. In the list of "go to the hospital immediately" in Article 7, "the idea of harming yourself or your child", "postpartum vaginal bleeding or abnormal discharge", "severe swelling and pain in one limb" are all postpartum
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National Health and Family Planning Commission (2017). National Basic Public Health Service Standards (Third Edition). <https://www.nhc.gov.cn/ewebeditor/uploadfile/2017/04/20170417104506514.pdf>; Jingjiang Municipal People’s Government. National Basic Public Health Service Project—Maternal Health Management Services (local service list public). <https://www.jingjiang.gov.cn/xxgk/zdlyxxgk/wsjk/art/2023/art_383017a2e7794892bc772bfbe042f379.html>; General Office of the National Health Commission (2020). Notice on exploring the development of special services for the prevention and treatment of depression and Alzheimer's disease (State Health Office Disease Control and Prevention Letter [2020] No. 726). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2020-09/11/content_5542555.htm>

Note: Postpartum depression is not hypocritical, and it cannot be solved by family members' advice to "think better". It has specialized screening questionnaires, treatment, and recovery. See Section 1 for what to do if you have suicidal thoughts. See Section 9, Article 20 for legal solutions when the child is born and cannot be raised. This review will also check how the wound is growing, how the uterus is recovering, and whether the pelvic floor function is good. The contraceptive plan is also discussed this time: not menstruating after childbirth does not mean that you will not get pregnant
Case: 42 days after delivery, Xiao Liu’s participation review revealed a slight tendency to depression, which improved after timely intervention and avoided worsening of symptoms.

items.title: You don’t have to give away the cat when you are pregnant, replace the cat litter with someone else to shovel it every day, cook the meat carefully, and wear gloves when touching soil
items.core: Toxoplasma gondii is a parasite. If you contract it for the first time during pregnancy, you may have a miscarriage, and your child may suffer eye and brain damage. Having a cat at home does not make you more susceptible to the disease, and cats do not need to be given away. What you need to be more careful about is eating undercooked meat, touching soil without washing your hands, and just replacing the cat litter with someone else shoveling it every day.
body: Cost: No money. The cat litter is given to family members to shovel every day. If you can only shovel by yourself, buy a box of disposable gloves. The difficulty is that meat must be fully cooked, and half-rare steaks and mutton cannot be eaten

Benefits: The U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention says that if you are infected with Toxoplasma gondii for the first time shortly before pregnancy or during pregnancy, it may be passed to the fetus. Most infected children are born without symptoms and may grow up to be blind or intellectually disabled. A small number of children are born with severe eye or brain damage. The UK's National Health Service (NHS) says infections during pregnancy can lead to miscarriage. The Toxoplasma testing center in Lyon, France, counted 603 pregnant women diagnosed with infection during pregnancy, most of whom had taken antiparasitic drugs. The overall proportion passed to the fetus was 29% (95% CI 25 to 33, confidence range). About 6% of infections at 13 weeks of gestation are passed to the fetus, and about 72% of infections at 36 weeks of gestation. The earlier the infection occurs, the more likely the child will develop symptoms. The risk of a child developing symptoms early is highest, about 10%, if infected between 24 and 30 weeks of pregnancy. Pregnant women with and without new infections during pregnancy were compared in six European cities. Having a cat in the home OR 1.0 (95% CI 0.7 to 1.5), no difference. Cleaning the litter box yourself was associated with OR 1.3 (95% CI 0.8 to 2.1), and the difference may be due to chance. The odds ratio for eating undercooked lamb was OR 3.13 (95% CI 1.4 to 7.2). OR for soil contact 1.81 (95% CI 1.2 to 2.7). Both are associated with more infections. Across cities, 30 to 63 percent of infections were attributed to undercooked or cured meat, and 6 to 17 percent to contaminated meat. The U.S. Centers for Disease Control and Prevention advises pregnant women: Let others change the cat litter. Wear disposable gloves if no one is changing them, and wash your hands with soap and water after changing them. Change cat litter every day because it takes 1 to 5 days for Toxoplasma gondii in cat feces to be infective to humans. Do not get a new cat during pregnancy, and do not adopt or pet stray cats, especially kittens. Keep the cat in the house and only feed it cat food or cooked food, not raw meat. Popular science from the Chinese Center for Disease Control and Prevention also says that cleaning the litter box should be done by the expectant father as much as possible, and taking precautions during pregnancy can keep the cat by his side. The NHS states that you will not be infected with Toxoplasmosis by touching or raising cats
Level of Evidence: B

Source: Centers for Disease Control and Prevention. Toxoplasmosis: Risk Factors. <https://www.cdc.gov/toxoplasmosis/risk-factors/index.html>; <https://www.cdc.gov/toxoplasmosis/prevention/index.html>; NHS. Toxoplasmosis. <https://www.nhs.uk/conditions/toxoplasmosis/>; Chinese Center for Disease Control and Prevention (2025). Is Toxoplasmosis infection during pregnancy caused by "cat suckers"? <https://www.chinacdc.cn/jkkp/crb/qtcr/202501/t20250103_303681.html>; Cook AJ, Gilbert RE, Buffolano W, et al. (2000). Sources of toxoplasma infection in pregnant women: European multicentre case-control study. BMJ, 321(7254), 142-147. <https://doi.org/10.1136/bmj.321.7254.142>; Dunn D, Wallon M, Peyron F, Petersen E, Peckham C, Gilbert R (1999). Mother-to-child transmission of toxoplasmosis: risk estimates for clinical counseling. Lancet, 353(9167), 1829-1833. <https://doi.org/10.1016/s0140-6736(98)08220-8>

Note: Cats generally shed Toxoplasma gondii in their feces only for a few weeks after first infection. Adult cats that have been infected before may shed even smaller amounts again. Cats kept indoors and not eating raw meat have less chance of getting infected. Even if you don’t keep a cat at home, you can still be infected. The sources are undercooked meat, unwashed fruits and vegetables, soil and raw water contaminated by cat feces. So do these things. Make the meat fully cooked, and wash the knives, chopping boards and hands used to cut raw meat. Rinse fruits and vegetables with running water. Wear gloves when planting flowers and turning soil, and wash your hands afterwards. The NHS also warns against eating raw cured meats such as salami and Parma ham, and not drinking unpasteurized goat's milk. That European study didn't look at lettuce and unwashed vegetables, and 14 to 49 percent of infections had no source. If you want to check for Toxoplasma gondii antibodies, ask your prenatal doctor. B was chosen because the risks of cats and meat only had numbers from one study, and that was recalled in hindsight. The method comes from official organizations, and there is no study to calculate how many infections can be reduced by following it. The income is determined as "medium" based on judgment, and the reasons are in the verification records. The benefits fall on you and your child

Case: Xiao Zhang did not give away the cat during pregnancy, and asked her family to shovel cat litter every day. She avoided handling raw meat and gardening, and had regular prenatal check-ups. The child was born healthy.

items.title: During the flu season during pregnancy, get a shot of inactivated influenza vaccine. You can get it at any stage of pregnancy, don’t use nasal spray
items.core: Pregnant women are more likely to be hospitalized if they get the flu than those who are not pregnant. Taking a flu vaccine during pregnancy can reduce hospitalization due to influenza by about 40%. In the first 6 months of life, children are about half as likely to be diagnosed with influenza and 70% less likely to be hospitalized for influenza. I haven’t seen that injections increase the number of miscarriages, stillbirths, and malformations.
body: Cost: At your own expense, one shot ranges from tens to more than a hundred yuan. Go to a community vaccination clinic. The difficulty is choosing one whose instructions don’t list pregnant women as contraindicated

Benefits: The World Health Organization’s 2022 position paper summarizes existing research. Pregnant women with influenza were more likely to be hospitalized than those who were not pregnant, odds ratio OR 6.8 (95% CI 6–7.7, confidence range). A trial in Bangladesh randomly divided 340 pregnant women into two groups. One group received inactivated influenza vaccine, and the other group received pneumococcal vaccine as a control, and the children were followed up to 24 weeks after birth. Among children who received the influenza vaccine, 6 children were diagnosed with influenza and 16 controls, with a vaccine efficacy of 63% (95% CI 5–85). Mothers themselves were 36% less likely to have fever plus respiratory illness (95% CI 4–57). Two trials in South Africa used placebos, and neither doctors nor pregnant women knew which shot was given. Among pregnant women without HIV infection, confirmed influenza decreased from 3.6% to 1.8%, with an efficacy of 50.4% (95% CI 14.5–71.2). their children decreased from 3.6% to 1.9%, power 48.8% (95% CI 11.6–70.4). Combining the 4 trials and 3 observational studies, the risk of influenza diagnosis in children within 6 months was approximately 48% (95% CI 33–59). Four observational studies looked at children being hospitalized with confirmed influenza, which was about 72% lower (95% CI 39–87). Another review, combining only two trials, found that confirmed influenza was 34% lower (95% CI 15–50). But there is no difference in "influenza-like illness" in children. Influenza-like illness means that there is no test and the symptoms are just like the flu. Pregnant women's own hospitalizations looked at medical records from four countries from 2010 to 2016. Hospitalization with confirmed influenza was approximately 40% (95% CI 12–59) less likely to have been vaccinated. In terms of safety, one review included 40 studies. The odds ratio aOR for vaccinated stillbirths was 0.84 (0.65–1.08) and for congenital malformations 1.03 (0.99–1.07). Both differences are within the margin of error. Premature birth 0.87 (0.78–0.96), less vaccinated. The United States examined three flu seasons from 2012 to 2015. Vaccination within 28 days before miscarriage was associated with aOR 0.9 (0.6–1.5), no association. The Chinese Center for Disease Control and Prevention’s 2026-2027 annual guidelines list pregnant women as a priority group for vaccination. It says vaccination at any stage of pregnancy protects babies up to 6 months old, with better results in the third trimester. Pregnant women are prohibited from receiving live attenuated vaccines
Level of Evidence: A

Source: World Health Organization (2022). Vaccines against influenza: WHO position paper – May 2022. Weekly Epidemiological Record, 97(19), 185-208. <https://iris.who.int/server/api/core/bitstreams/420b8e49-9f16-461d-a5d8-263069778432/content>; Zaman K, Roy E, Arifeen SE, et al. (2008). Effectiveness of maternal influenza immunization in mothers and infants. New England Journal of Medicine, 359(15), 1555-1564. <https://doi.org/10.1056/NEJMoa0708630>; Madhi SA, Cutland CL, Kuwanda L, et al. (2014). Influenza vaccination of pregnant women and protection of their infants. New England Journal of Medicine, 371(10), 918-931. <https://doi.org/10.1056/NEJMoa1401480>; Nunes MC, Madhi SA (2018). Influenza vaccination during pregnancy for prevention of influenza confirmed illness in the infants: A systematic review and meta-analysis. Human Vaccines & Immunotherapeutics, 14(3), 758-766. <https://doi.org/10.1080/21645515.2017.1345385>; Jarvis JR, Dorey RB, Warricker FDM, Alwan NA, Jones CE (2020). The effectiveness of influenza vaccination in pregnancy in relation to child health outcomes: Systematic review and meta-analysis. Vaccine, 38(7), 1601-1613. <https://doi.org/10.1016/j.vaccine.2019.12.056>; Thompson MG, Kwong JC, Regan AK, et al. (2019). Influenza Vaccine Effectiveness in Preventing Influenza-associated Hospitalizations During Pregnancy: A Multi-country Retrospective Test Negative Design Study, 2010-2016. Clinical Infectious Diseases, 68(9), 1444-1453. <https://doi.org/10.1093/cid/ciy737>; Giles ML, Krishnaswamy S, Macartney K, Cheng A (2019). The safety of inactivated influenza vaccines in pregnancy for birth outcomes: a systematic review. Human Vaccines & Immunotherapeutics, 15(3), 687-699. <https://doi.org/10.1080/21645515.2018.1540807>; Donahue JG, Kieke BA, King JP, et al. (2019). Inactivated influenza vaccine and spontaneous abortion in the Vaccine Safety Datalink in 2012-13, 2013-14, and 2014-15. Vaccine, 37(44), 6673-6681. <https://doi.org/10.1016/j.vaccine.2019.09.035>; Donahue JG, Kieke BA, King JP, et al. (2017). Association of spontaneous abortion with receipt of inactivated influenza vaccine containing H1N1pdm09 in 2010-11 and 2011-12. Vaccine, 35(40), 5314-5322. <https://doi.org/10.1016/j.vaccine.2017.06.069> (Contrary research in remarks); Chinese Center for Disease Control and Prevention (2026). Technical Guidelines for Influenza Vaccine Vaccination in China (2026-2027). <https://www.chinacdc.cn/jkyj/mygh02/jswj2026/202609/t20260902_1839739.html>

Remarks: Dispute. A 2017 US study found that people who received a flu vaccine within 28 days before a miscarriage had more miscarriages (aOR 2.0, 1.1–3.6). The higher rates were only seen among people who had also received an H1N1-containing vaccine in the previous season. The author himself says this does not prove cause and effect. The same group of people checked for the next three flu seasons and did not see this connection again, so countries still say that vaccination can be done at any stage of pregnancy. Some domestic influenza vaccine instructions also list pregnant women as contraindications. The guide recommends choosing one that does not list contraindications for pregnant women in the instructions, and telling the vaccination doctor that you are pregnant before taking the shot. Only inactivated vaccines are given for injection. The live attenuated vaccine sprayed into the nose is only available to those aged 3 to 17 in China, and pregnant women are not allowed to receive it. It’s best to get it done before your local flu season starts, which is usually September to October. If you miss it, you can still refill it throughout the flu season. Children under 6 months old cannot receive the flu vaccine, so this shot during pregnancy is the main protection for the child in the first few months of life. Family members and people with children who live together are also priority groups for vaccination. For instructions on adults getting the flu vaccine themselves, see Section 1, Item 20 (Influenza Vaccine). There is no mortality figure in the benefit column. The benefit magnitude is based on confirmed influenza and hospitalization. The reasons are in the verification records. The benefits fall on you and your baby

Case: Xiao Yang, who was pregnant during the flu season, received an inactivated vaccine early in her pregnancy and did not suffer from influenza during pregnancy, nor did her child become infected within 6 months after birth.

items.title: Lie on your side when sleeping after 28 weeks of pregnancy, either left or right side. Do not sleep on your back
items.core: Lie on your back to sleep after 28 weeks of pregnancy. The risk of your child dying in the belly is significantly higher than sleeping on your side. The left side is the same as the right side, just choose whichever is more comfortable. If you wake up in the middle of the night and find yourself lying on your back, don't panic, just roll over to your side and go back to sleep. This result is based on hindsight and is still controversial.
body: Cost: No money. The difficulty is that people who are used to sleeping on their backs have to change their positions

Benefits: Stillbirth here refers to the death of the child in the belly after 28 weeks of pregnancy. A summary combines raw data from five studies. Four were in New Zealand, Australia, the UK and one was an international survey online. A total of 851 pregnant women with stillbirths and 2257 pregnant women with normal children served as controls. The study was done by asking them afterwards how they had fallen asleep recently. and sleeping on the left side, the odds ratio for stillbirth for sleeping on the back was aOR 2.63 (95% CI 1.72–4.04, confidence range). Stillbirth is a rare outcome, and the odds ratio and relative risk are similar, with the risk approximately 2.6 times. The aOR for falling asleep on the right side was 1.04 (0.83–1.31), which was no different from the left side.
