The correlation is similar for children with small children, obese pregnant women, and smokers. The authors estimate that if pregnant women after 28 weeks of gestation slept on their sides, stillbirths at this stage would be reduced by about 5.8% (3.2%–9.2%). The British National Health Service (NHS) lists "don't sleep on your back after 28 weeks of pregnancy" as one of the practices to reduce the risk of stillbirth. It also says that don’t worry if you wake up and find yourself lying on your back, just turn over to your side and go to sleep again
Level of Evidence: B

Source: Cronin RS, Li M, Thompson JMD, et al. (2019). An Individual Participant Data Meta-analysis of Maternal Going-to-Sleep Position, Interactions with Fetal Vulnerability, and the Risk of Late Stillbirth. EClinicalMedicine, 10, 49-57. <https://doi.org/10.1016/j.eclinm.2019.03.014>; Silver RM, Hunter S, Reddy UM, et al. (2019). Prospective Evaluation of Maternal Sleep Position Through 30 Weeks of Gestation and Adverse Pregnancy Outcomes. Obstetrics and Gynecology, 134(4), 667-676. <https://doi.org/10.1097/AOG.0000000000003458> (Contra-side research in remarks); NHS. Stillbirth. <https://www.nhs.uk/conditions/stillbirth/>

Remarks: Controversy. The numbers above are all based on hindsight. Pregnant women who have lost their babies may not remember it accurately, and the author himself admits this. There were also no randomized trials. A US study asked 8,706 pregnant women with their first child about their sleeping position before looking at the results. By 30 weeks of gestation, sleeping on your back or not on your left side was not associated with stillbirth, small baby, or gestational hypertension (aOR 0.99, 0.89–1.11). But it only sees 30 weeks of pregnancy, and sleeping positions in the following weeks are not recorded. There is no harm in sleeping on your side for free, so this is still recommended in the UK. Stillbirth itself is rare, with rates of late stillbirth ranging from 1.3 to 8.8 per 1000 births in high-income countries. The income is determined to be "large" based on the odds ratio of 2.63 for mechanical sets. The reason is in the verification record. The benefit falls on the child

Case: After 30 weeks of pregnancy, Xiao Chen developed the habit of sleeping on her side. Even if she woke up in the middle of the night and found herself lying on her back, she would immediately adjust and eventually gave birth to a healthy baby.

items.title: Contraception is necessary when you resume intercourse after giving birth. Breastfeeding does not mean contraception. If you want to have another child, wait at least 18 months before getting pregnant. The WHO recommends at least two years.
items.core: You can get pregnant again 3 weeks after giving birth. The same goes for breastfeeding and no menstruation. Breastfeeding can only be blocked if pure breast milk, no menstruation, and the child is less than 6 months old are all taken up. If you get pregnant again less than six months after giving birth, the risk of your next baby being born prematurely is higher. The World Health Organization recommends waiting at least two years after giving birth before conceiving again.
body: Cost: A box of condoms costs tens of yuan. You have to go to the hospital for IUD and subcutaneous implantation, and the prices vary from place to place. The difficulty is that I am so busy after giving birth that I can’t take care of this matter.

Benefits: The British National Health Service (NHS) says that you can become pregnant again 3 weeks after giving birth, and the same applies if you are breastfeeding or have missed your period. Unless you want to have it again right away, use birth control every time you have sex. Relying on breast-feeding for contraception is called lactational amenorrhea, and it requires three things to be met at the same time: only breastfeeding, menstruation has not come, and the child is less than 6 months old. If you follow the rules, you can block more than 99% of them. Not so strict, about 2 out of every 100 people get pregnant within 6 months. If any of the following occurs, you need to find another way: after the child is 6 months old, he starts to add milk powder or use a pacifier, he has menstruation (a small amount of bleeding also counts), he stops feeding at night, and the frequency of feeding becomes less. One review combined 67 studies, netting out maternal age and family background. The period between the last birth and the next pregnancy is 18 to 23 months. For those less than 6 months old, the odds ratio for preterm birth was OR 1.40 (95% CI 1.24–1.58, confidence range). The child's birth weight was 1.61 (1.39–1.86) low, and the child was 1.26 (1.18–1.33) smaller than the same gestational age. Those with an interval of 6 to 17 months and those with an interval of more than 59 months are also on the higher side. A Canadian study looked at more than 148,000 pregnancies, comparing those 6 months apart to those 18 months apart. Mothers older than 35 years were about 2.4 times more likely to die or become seriously ill 0.62% versus 0.26%, relative risk aRR 2.39 (2.03–2.80). There was no difference among mothers aged 20 to 34 years (0.92, 0.83–1.02). Children aged 20 to 34 years were more likely to be stillborn, stillborn, or very preterm or very preterm, 2.0% versus 1.4%, aRR 1.42 (1.36–1.47). The World Health Organization's 2005 expert meeting recommended waiting at least 24 months after giving birth before trying to conceive another child. Experts at the conference unanimously agreed that pregnancy before 18 months is to be avoided. Wait at least 6 months after a miscarriage or induced abortion
Level of Evidence: B

Source: NHS. Sex and contraception after birth. <https://www.nhs.uk/baby/support-and-services/sex-and-contraception-after-birth/>; NHS. Natural family planning. <https://www.nhs.uk/contraception/methods-of-contraception/natural-family-planning/>; Conde-Agudelo A, Rosas-Bermúdez A, Kafury-Goeta AC (2006). Birth spacing and risk of adverse perinatal outcomes: a meta-analysis. JAMA, 295(15), 1809. <https://doi.org/10.1001/jama.295.15.1809>; Schummers L, Hutcheon JA, Hernandez-Diaz S, et al. (2018). Association of Short Interpregnancy Interval With Pregnancy Outcomes According to Maternal Age. JAMA Internal Medicine, 178(12), 1661. <https://doi.org/10.1001/jamainternmed.2018.4696>; World Health Organization (2007). Report of a WHO Technical Consultation on Birth Spacing, Geneva, 13–15 June 2005 (WHO/RHR/07.1). <https://www.who.int/publications/i/item/WHO-RHR-07.1>; Ball SJ, Pereira G, Jacoby P, de Klerk N, Stanley FJ (2014). Re-evaluation of link between interpregnancy interval and adverse birth outcomes: retrospective cohort study matching two intervals per mother. BMJ, 349, g4333. <https://doi.org/10.1136/bmj.g4333> (Opposite research in remarks)

Note: Controversy. There are different opinions on how long is enough. One group of experts from the World Health Organization advocated 18 months, and another group advocated 27 months. The 24 months was a compromise between the two sides. The NHS says at least 12 months apart. An Australian study compared the two intervals between 40,441 mothers and found different conclusions. No difference was seen for preterm birth separated by 0 to 5 months, OR 1.07 (0.86–1.34), and for low birth weight, 1.03 (0.79–1.34). Converting the ratio between different mothers, the odds of prematurity are 1.41. Therefore, part of the risk of short intervals may come from the mother's own condition. Contraception itself is not controversial, only how long it takes. According to the NHS, condoms and subcutaneous implants can be used immediately after giving birth, and the same goes for breastfeeding. Breastfeeding people should generally wait until at least 6 weeks postpartum to take combined contraceptive pills. Which one to use? Discuss it with your doctor at the 42-day postpartum check-up. See Article 16 (42-day postpartum check-up). The income is determined as "medium" based on judgment, and the reasons are in the verification records. The benefits fall on you and your next child

Case: When Xiao Wu resumed sexual intercourse 2 months after delivery, she insisted on contraception. Although her menstruation had not resumed and she was breastfeeding, she still avoided the risk of unwanted pregnancy.

sections.title: Don't ruin your body just for appearance

items.title: Don’t use extreme dieting, fasting or vomiting to control your weight. If you want to lose weight, lose weight from the side of exercise.
items.core: People with anorexia nervosa are approximately 5.9 times more likely to die than their peers. There are 5.1 deaths per 1,000 people per year, about one-fifth of which are suicides. People who diet are more likely to develop eating disorders: following students from 44 middle schools for three years, girls who dieted heavily were 18 times more likely to develop the disorder than those who didn't. If you want to control your weight, exercise more and don't eat less until you get hungry.
body: Cost: Nothing. In turn, you save money on buying weight loss products.

Yield: 36 studies combined. The anorexia nervosa cohort was followed for a cumulative 166,642 person-years (the total number of years each person was followed). Their standardized death ratio was 5.86, meaning they were about 5.9 times more likely to die than their peers. 5.1 deaths per 1,000 person-years is 5.1 deaths per 1,000 people per year. About 1/5 of the people who die die by suicide. The standardized mortality ratio was 1.93 for bulimia and 1.92 for other eating disorders, or each about 1.9 times that of peers. Another study was conducted in 44 secondary schools in Victoria, Australia, following 14–15-year-old students for 3 years, and the same group of students were examined for 6 waves. The number of new eating disorders among girls was 21.8/1000 person-years, that is, 21.8 new cases per 1000 girls per year. Girls who dieted severely were 18 times more likely to develop the disease than those who did not diet, and those who were moderate dieters were five times more likely to develop the disease. Then correct for past dieting and mental symptoms, subtracting the effects of "having been on a diet before" and "already having mental symptoms". After deductions, BMI (weight divided by height squared), physical activity and gender no longer predicted new eating disorders. The authors concluded that "among adolescents who use exercise rather than food restriction to control weight appear to be associated with a lower risk of developing eating disorders."
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Arcelus J et al. (2011). Mortality rates in patients with anorexia nervosa and other eating disorders. A meta-analysis of 36 studies. Arch Gen Psychiatry. <https://doi.org/10.1136/bmj.318.7186.765>

Note: The "severe dieting" mentioned here refers to long-term efforts to eat far less than what the body needs. It does not mean skipping a meal or skipping midnight snacks. If you have induced vomiting, blame yourself after overeating, or cannot stop weighing yourself repeatedly, go to a psychiatric department or the clinical psychology department of a general hospital. This is a disease with standardized treatments, not a problem of willpower. For the relationship between BMI and mortality, see Section 2, Article 32. That article talks about long-term weight ranges, not weight loss methods.

Case: Xiao Lin, a student, dieted excessively in order to lose weight, and later developed an eating disorder. After seeking medical treatment, he changed to regular exercise, and his weight dropped healthily and his body and mind improved.

items.title: Before giving injections, sutures, or surgeries, check two things: whether there is "medical cosmetology" on the institution's license, and whether the person doing the surgery is the attending physician.
items.core: If needles, knives, or medical instruments are used that break the skin or enter the body, they are considered medical treatment. It can only be done in institutions that have "medical cosmetology" written on the license, and the person doing it must be a registered medical practitioner. Not beauty salons, studios, hotel rooms. It is illegal for a person without medical qualifications to practice medicine. If someone seriously injures someone, he will be sentenced to 3 to 10 years, and if he causes death, he will be sentenced to more than 10 years.
body: Cost: Nothing. It only takes a few minutes to check these two certificates. The institution should hang the "Medical Institution Practice License" in the lobby. The doctor's qualifications can be checked in the health department's Practicing Physician Query.

Benefits: Article 2 of the "Measures for the Administration of Medical Cosmetology Services" defines medical cosmetology. The original text is "the use of surgery, drugs, medical equipment and other traumatic or invasive medical technology methods to repair and reshape the human appearance and the shape of various parts of the human body." To put it bluntly, as long as the skin is broken, the needle is inserted, and it enters the body, it is considered a medical treatment. Articles 8 and 24 require that the "Medical Institution Practice License" must be obtained first and the medical beauty diagnosis and treatment subjects must be approved by the registration authority before they can be carried out. If the license does not say "medical cosmetology", you can't do it. Article 11 requires the attending physician (the doctor who performs the procedure) to be qualified and registered as a medical practitioner. Those who want to do cosmetic surgery must have more than 6 years of clinical work experience in related professions, more than 5 years of cosmetic dentistry, and more than 3 years each of cosmetic traditional Chinese medicine and cosmetic dermatology. Article 20 requires that the indications, contraindications (what situations are suitable and what situations cannot be done), medical risks and precautions be informed in writing before taking action, and a signed consent must be obtained. Article 336 of the Criminal Law governs the illegal practice of medicine. Illegal medical practice means people without medical qualifications give injections, operate under the knife, or treat patients. If the circumstances are serious, the offender shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not more than 3 years, criminal detention or public surveillance, and shall also or solely be fined. Anyone who seriously damages the patient's health shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than 3 years but not more than 10 years and a fine. Anyone who causes the death of a patient shall be sentenced to fixed-term imprisonment of not less than 10 years and a fine
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Ministry of Health (2002). Measures for the Administration of Medical Cosmetology Services (Ministry of Health Order No. 19, Articles 2, 8, 11, 16, 20, 24). <http://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2003/content_62198.htm>; National People's Congress (1997). Criminal Law (Article 336). <https://www.spp.gov.cn/spp/fl/201802/t20180206_364975.shtml>

Note: Article 16 of the same measure also stipulates that medical beauty projects can only be done in beauty medical institutions, or in hospitals or clinics with medical beauty departments. Therefore, door-to-door injections and private operations in a studio are already illegal just by looking at the location. Article 20 states that if minors, who are not yet able to make their own decisions, want cosmetic surgery, they must obtain the consent of their guardians and the signature of their parents. Facials, massages, and manicures belong to lifestyle beauty and are not governed by this set of rules. But as long as needles and knives are used, it is considered medical beauty.

Case: Before Xiao He performed double eyelid surgery, he verified the license of the medical beauty institution and the qualifications of the doctor. After confirming compliance, the operation was performed with good results and no complications.

items.title: For facial fillers, avoid the dorsum of the nose and the entire nose, between the eyebrows, forehead, and nasolabial folds. Don’t go for informal injections to save money.
items.core: More than half of the people who became blind after filling injections used filler injections on the nose, followed by the glabella, forehead and nasolabial folds, and more than 80% used hyaluronic acid. Only 20% of blind people have completely recovered their vision, more than 10% have partial recovery, and nearly 20% have suffered brain damage. At present, there is no rescue method that is stable and effective, so these parts should be avoided in advance.
body: Cost: Nothing. Just change the location of the injection, or don't do it at all.

Income: Summarize cases reported in journals around the world. From January 2015 to September 2018, there were 48 new cases of partial or complete vision loss after injection fillers. The most common site of accidents was the nose, accounting for 56.3%. Next are the glabella at 27.1%, the forehead at 18.8%, and the nasolabial folds (the nasolabial folds) at 14.6%. The filler in 81.3% of cases was hyaluronic acid, which is hyaluronic acid. Skin changes occurred in 43.8%. 18.8% developed central nervous system complications (brain problems). Vision was fully restored in 10 cases (20.8%), partially restored in 8 cases (16.7%), and the remaining cases were not restored. The author concluded that treatment methods vary greatly from one treatment provider to another, and no treatment has been proven to be consistently effective.
Level of Evidence: B
Source: Beleznay K et al. (2019). Update on Avoiding and Treating Blindness From Fillers: A Recent Review of the World Literature. Aesthet Surg J. <https://doi.org/10.1093/asj/sjz053>

Note: These numbers are based on cases reported in journals. It only contains the number of accidents, not the total number of injections. Therefore, we cannot calculate "the probability of blindness after receiving an injection." We can only see which parts are prone to accidents and cannot be saved afterwards. This is why the evidence is graded B. The risk reduction practices of formal institutions are already routine. First check how the blood vessels go under the place to be incised. Use a blunt needle instead of a sharp needle. Push a small amount while withdrawing the needle, and prepare hyaluronidase in advance. Everything requires a trained doctor, which is why you shouldn’t look for informal channels. Before doing this, please check according to Article 2 of this section (check the institution license and attending physician).

Case: Xiao Zhou purchased hyaluronic acid rhinoplasty in a group of friends. Within ten minutes after the procedure, his eyesight turned black and he was sent to the emergency room. The doctor determined that it was a blood vessel embolism. Although he regained his vision, it left visual field defects.

items.title: Don’t buy diet pills, slimming coffee, slimming candies, and enzyme plums (so-called enzyme-soaked plums) that promise to “lose weight quickly”
items.core: These products are often found to contain sibutramine, which was originally a weight-loss drug and was discontinued in China in 2010. Overweight people over 55 years old with heart disease or diabetes who have eaten for more than three years have a 30% higher risk of non-fatal myocardial infarction and a 36% higher risk of stroke. Only lost 1.7kg more. When the test came out, you had already eaten it.
body: Cost: No money. In turn, you save money on buying these products. The hard thing is accepting that there is no such thing as "losing pounds a week."

Benefit: The SCOUT trial enrolled 9,804 people. They were all over 55, overweight or obese, and had cardiovascular disease or type 2 diabetes. These people were randomly divided into two groups: those who took medication and those who did not take medication. They were treated for an average of 3.4 years. The primary endpoint was a predetermined number of bad events: nonfatal myocardial infarction, nonfatal stroke (stroke), recovery from cardiac arrest, and cardiovascular death. The incidence of these events is 11.4% vs 10.0%. With a hazard ratio HR 1.16 (95% CI 1.03–1.31, P=0.02), people taking the medication had about a 16% higher risk of having an accident. The true value falls roughly between high 3% and high 31%. Nonfatal myocardial infarction 4.1% vs 3.2%, hazard ratio HR 1.28 (1.04–1.57), approximately 28% higher risk. Nonfatal stroke 2.6% vs 1.9%, HR 1.36 (1.04–1.77), approximately 36% higher risk. There was no increase in cardiovascular deaths and all-cause deaths, which are the sum of all causes. After the draw, the sibutramine group lost an average of 1.7 kg more weight. Based on the safety assessment, the former State Food and Drug Administration believed that "the risks of weight loss treatment outweigh the benefits." In October 2010, it was notified to stop the production, sale, and use of sibutramine preparations and APIs. Both sibutramine and phenolphthalein are prohibited from being added to food, including health foods
Level of Evidence: A

Source: James WPT et al. (2010). Effect of sibutramine on cardiovascular outcomes in overweight and obese subjects. NEJM. <https://doi.org/10.1056/NEJMoa1003114>; Tianjin Municipal Market Supervision and Administration Commission. Be wary of the illegal addition of "sibutramine hydrochloride" and "phenolphthalein" to some foods. <https://scjg.tj.gov.cn/tjsscjdglwyh_52651/hdpt/cjwtyxfts/202007/t20200720_2972549.html>

Note: SCOUT recruits high-risk groups with existing heart disease or diabetes. This experiment does not prove that healthy young people will have the same accidents after eating it. But precisely because it was unclear who was at high risk, regulators simply delisted it. Another ingredient that is often added secretly is phenolphthalein. It is originally a laxative. Taking too much for a long time will disrupt the electrolytes in the body and induce arrhythmia. How to judge: serious weight loss drugs are prescription drugs, and the approval number can be found in pharmacies and hospitals. Products sold under the banners of "coffee", "candy", "plums" and "meal replacement" and promising to lose a few pounds a week should not have medicinal effects by definition. If they have medicinal effects, it means something has been added. The original text of the discontinuation of sibutramine is Notice No. 432 [2010] of the State Food and Drug Administration, which was posted on the website of the State Food and Drug Administration. The quotation here is the paraphrase page of the Tianjin Municipal Market Supervision Department. The two sentences "risks outweigh benefits" and "stop production, sales and use in October 2010" can be checked verbatim there.

Case: Ms. Wang purchased "Seven Days Slimming Coffee" online. After drinking it for two weeks, she suffered from palpitations, insomnia, and elevated blood pressure. She still had chest tightness after stopping the medication. A random inspection of the same batch found sibutramine, and the weight only dropped two kilograms.

items.title: Don’t use anabolic steroids ("muscle-building shots" and "oral pills") to grow muscles
items.core: Men who test positive for doping in the gym have a significantly higher risk of death than their peers, and they visit the hospital more than twice as often each year. Acne, gynecomastia, erectile dysfunction, at least one in ten people who take medication will suffer from it. This type of drug is a prescription drug in China, and selling it to you without a prescription is itself illegal.
body: Cost: No money, but also save money on medicine. The hard part is accepting that muscles grow slowly.

Benefits: Denmark went back through the files and matched age controls for each person taking the medication. The drug users were 545 men who tested positive for androgenic steroids in gym doping tests from 2006-01-03 to 2018-03-01, and 5,450 controls were matched. It was double-checked with 644 refusers and 6,440 controls. Results: The hazard ratio for death among users was HR 3.0 (95% CI 1.3–7.0), with the true value broadly ranging from 1.3 to 7. The median number of hospitalizations or doctor visits per year was 0.81 vs 0.36 (P<0.0001). The median is the number that half of the people have more than and half have less than. This P value indicates that this difference is highly unlikely to be due to chance. Acne (pimples), gynecomastia, and erectile dysfunction each affect more than 10% of users, that is, at least one in ten people who take the medicine is affected, and they are all significantly higher than the control (P<0.0001). The results of the reviewed batch were consistent. Article 7 of the Anti-Doping Regulations: The state implements strict management of prohibited substances listed in the doping catalog, and no unit or individual is allowed to illegally produce, sell, import or export. The same regulation stipulates that anabolic agents and peptide hormones are subject to prescription drug management, that is, they can only be purchased with a doctor's prescription. Anabolic agents are the name of these drugs in the regulations
Level of Evidence: A
Source: Horwitz H et al. (2019). Health consequences of androgenic anabolic steroid use. J Intern Med. No. 398, Articles 7 and 9). <http://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2004/content_63129.htm>

Note: Controversy: This is a study that follows a group of people to see the results, not a randomized group trial. People who use drugs may be more risky in other ways, and the risk ratio of 3.0 cannot be attributed entirely to drugs. The true value could be as low as 1.3 or as high as 7.0, a wide range. However, "acne, gynecomastia, and erectile dysfunction each affect more than 10% of people" are side effects that can be seen with the eyes, and are less affected by this deviation. This type of drug is written as "anabolic agent" in the regulations. When you see these four words, it is what it means. Ordinary protein powder and creatine are not included in this article. The trouble is that products that "claim to build muscle very quickly" may have added ingredients. The judgment method is the same as for weight loss products (Item 4, do not buy weight loss drugs that promise to lose weight quickly): serious drugs are prescription drugs, and the approval number can be checked. It's sold under the name of "mass-building powder" or "nutritional product" and promises to be effective within a few weeks. If it's really effective, it's just something added.

Case: Fitness enthusiast Xiao Chen bought "muscle-building injections" from a coach for three months while preparing for a competition. The acne on his face worsened and his breasts were swollen and painful. A physical examination revealed abnormal blood lipids, and he was forced to stop training for treatment.

items.title: If you want to take weight-loss drugs or injections such as semaglutide, go to the hospital to get a prescription, increase the dosage and review as arranged by the doctor. Don't buy them from online stores that ship without a prescription, and don't go to beauty salons to take them
items.core: Prescription drugs must be sold with a prescription, and online sales must have real prescriptions and real names. Online stores that ship products without consultation and beauty salons that provide door-to-door injections often have unknown origins and no one is responsible for the dosage and contraindications. After stopping the bariatric injection for a year, about two-thirds of the weight lost will come back, so it needs to be treated as a long-term treatment.
body: Cost: One registration, plus one round trip. A few dozen yuan and half a day. Those who take weight loss injections will have to go back for a follow-up checkup at the time scheduled by the doctor. The cost of the medicine is calculated separately, and the weight will probably go back after stopping the injection, so the cost should be calculated based on long-term medication.

Income: The "Measures for the Supervision and Administration of the Quality of Drug Operation and Use" stipulate that drug retail enterprises must comply with the classification management system for prescription drugs and over-the-counter drugs. This system divides medicines into two categories: one must be bought with a doctor's prescription, and the other can be bought by oneself. Pharmacies must sell prescription drugs based on prescriptions in accordance with regulations, and keep prescriptions for no less than five years. Pharmacists or other pharmaceutical technicians should put up a sign to inform them when they are not on duty that prescription drugs are not allowed to be sold without their review. Prescription drugs are not allowed to be sold on the shelves and cannot be placed on the shelves for customers to pick up. Article 9 of the "Measures for the Supervision and Administration of Drug Online Sales" stipulates that those who sell prescription drugs to individuals through the Internet must ensure that the source of the prescription is authentic and reliable and implement a real-name system. Article 10 requires that risk warning information be highlighted under each drug display page. Before passing the prescription review, instructions shall not be displayed and purchase services shall not be provided. The prescription has not been reviewed and there should not even be a buy button on the page. Article 8 stipulates that drugs subject to special management by the state shall not be sold online. Such drugs include vaccines, blood products, narcotic drugs, psychotropic drugs, medical toxic drugs, radioactive drugs, and pharmaceutical precursor chemicals. The National Health Commission's "Obesity Diagnosis and Treatment Guidelines (2024 Edition)" states that five domestic drugs have been approved by the State Food and Drug Administration for weight loss in adults with primary obesity. The five are orlistat, liraglutide, benaglutide, semaglutide and tilpotide. The same guidelines consider a BMI of 24 to less than 28 to be overweight, and a BMI of 28 and above to be obese. Only consider taking medication if you are overweight and have related diseases such as hyperglycemia, hypertension, dyslipidemia, and fatty liver, or are already obese. The premise is that the weight cannot be reduced by changing the lifestyle, so medicine is added on this basis. The guidelines require a full assessment of the condition and contraindications before medication, and regular follow-up under the guidance of a professional physician during medication. Semaglutide starts at 0.25 mg weekly with maintenance doses of 2.4 mg or 1.7 mg. Tilpotide starts at 2.5 mg per week and reaches a maximum of 15 mg. If the weight loss is less than 5%, the guideline recommends discontinuing the drug. What happens after stopping the drug depends on three tests. The STEP 1 extension study followed 327 people, and semaglutide resulted in an average weight loss of 17.3% over 68 weeks. One year after discontinuation, the recovery was 11.6 percentage points, leaving a net weight loss of only 5.6%. The authors concluded that two-thirds of the previously lost weight was regained, and most cardiometabolic markers returned to near their starting points. STEP 4 draws 803 people who have played for 20 weeks and have lost an average of 10.6%. Those who took the next shot lost another 7.9% in weight after 48 weeks, and those who switched to the placebo gained back 6.9%. In SURMOUNT-4, 670 people took tilpotide for 36 weeks, with an average weight loss of 20.9%. After that, the drug dropped another 5.5%, and the placebo shot rose back to 14.0%. The Yinchuan Market Supervision Bureau issued a risk warning in July 2026. It is reminded that most of the Internet celebrity "slimming injections" and "slimming pens" on the market are packaged, smuggled, and counterfeit medicines of unknown origin. Injecting yourself after online shopping or purchasing on behalf of others can easily cause severe allergies, acute pancreatitis, organ damage and wound infection. Medical beauty projects such as injections can only be done in institutions with medical beauty qualifications. Home-based injections and private injections in beauty salons are not legal. See Article 2 of this section (Check two things before injections, thread embedding, and surgery)
Level of Evidence: B

Source: State Administration for Market Regulation (2023). Measures for the Supervision and Administration of Drug Distribution and Use Quality (General Administration Order No. 84). <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/2023/issue_10846/202311/content_6917322.html>; State Administration for Market Regulation (2022). Measures for the Supervision and Administration of Drug Online Sales (General Administration Order No. 58) No., Articles 8 to 10). <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2022/content_5717002.htm>; General Office of the National Health Commission (2024). Notice on the issuance of the Guidelines for the Diagnosis and Treatment of Obesity (2024 Edition) (Part 3 of the Annex "10. Drug Treatment"). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202410/content_6981734.htm>; Wilding JPH et al. (2022). Weight regain and cardiometabolic effects after withdrawal of semaglutide: The STEP 1 trial extension. Diabetes Obes Metab. <https://doi.org/10.1111/dom.14725>; Rubino D et al. (2021). Effect of Continued Weekly Subcutaneous Semaglutide vs Placebo on Weight Loss Maintenance in Adults With Overweight or Obesity: The STEP 4 Randomized Clinical Trial. JAMA. <https://doi.org/10.1001/jama.2021.3224>; Aronne LJ et al. (2024). Reduction in Adults With Obesity: The SURMOUNT-4 Randomized Clinical Trial. JAMA. <https://doi.org/10.1001/jama.2023.24945>; Yinchuan Municipal Administration for Market Regulation (2026). Risk warning of medical aesthetic consumption and "weight loss miracle drug" from the market supervision department. <https://scjg.yinchuan.gov.cn/zxdt/tzgg/202607/t20260703_5281032.html>

Remarks: The legal provisions can be checked word for word, and the figures for drug withdrawal and recovery also come from experiments conducted by lottery groups. But no one has done a quantitative study on "how many fewer things will happen if you take it as prescribed than if you buy it yourself", so it is graded B as "difficult to quantify". STEP 1 In the extension study, not only the medicine was stopped, but also the diet and exercise guidance was stopped, and only some of the people in the original trial were followed. The steroids and sex hormones mentioned in Articles 5 and 7 of this section also follow the same set of rules. When it is time to rely on medicine to lose weight, the doctor will first look at the body mass index, whether there are other diseases in the body, and whether there are any conditions that cannot take medicine, and then decide whether to eat or not and what kind to eat. This judgment cannot be bought.

Case: Ms. Li took semaglutide according to the "slimming package" at the beauty salon. No one asked about her allergy history. She took a large dose for the first time and was hospitalized for vomiting and dehydration. Later, she was transferred to the endocrinology department for review according to the prescription.

items.title: Sex hormone drugs should only be used under the premise of being prescribed by a doctor and reviewed regularly. Do not buy them online and do not increase the dosage yourself
items.core: We do not discuss whether you should use them, only how to use them. Transgender women who take estrogen are significantly more likely to develop blood clots in their blood vessels than their peers, about 4 more per 1,000 people in two years and about 17 more in eight years. This kind of risk needs to be monitored regularly. If you buy medicine online and adjust the dosage yourself, no one will check for you.
body: Cost: Regular registration, plus blood reexamination. A few hundred yuan a year takes up several half-days.

Benefits: Researchers tracked a group of people from the electronic medical records of Kaiser Permanente, a medical group. Of these, 2,842 are transgender women and 2,118 are transgender men. Average follow-up was 4.0 years vs. 3.6 years. Each person was matched with approximately 10 times as many cisgender controls by year of birth, race, site of presentation, and time of enrollment, for a total of 48,686 cisgender men and 48,775 cisgender women. Trans women have more venous thromboembolism (a blood clot blocking a blood vessel) than controls. and cisgender men, 4.1 cases per 1000 at 2 years (95% CI 1.6–6.7). It was 16.7 cases (6.4–27.5) at 8 years. Calculated, among 1,000 people, there are 4.1 more cases in two years and 16.7 more cases in eight years. and cisgender women, the numbers were 3.4 (1.1–5.6) and 13.7 (4.1–22.7). Ischemic stroke (a type of stroke that blocks a blood vessel) and myocardial infarction were generally similar in each group. But the difference between venous thrombosis and ischemic stroke was more pronounced among transgender women who started hormone therapy only during the follow-up period. There is not enough evidence for trans men to draw any conclusions. The authors concluded that "these results may suggest the need for long-term vigilance against the vascular side effects of estrogen in cross-sex hormones"
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Getahun D et al. (2018). Cross-sex Hormones and Acute Cardiovascular Events in Transgender Persons: A Cohort Study. Ann Intern Med. <https://doi.org/10.7326/M17-2785>; State Administration for Market Regulation (2022). Measures for the Supervision and Administration of Drug Online Sales (General Administration Order No. 58, Article 9). <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2022/content_5717002.htm>

Note: The researchers themselves stated the shortcomings of this study: How many people bought their own medicines outside the hospital system, they could not find out. Therefore, the line "whether medication is taken or not" cannot be drawn clearly. This in turn shows that medication should be included in regular follow-up visits. This study only looks at the occurrence and development of blood vessels, and does not answer whether hormone therapy should be used or what are the benefits of using it. That is another set of evidence. This is true for all uses of sex hormones, including birth control pills, menopausal hormone therapy, and testosterone supplements. For those who shop online, adjust dosage according to online posts, and never check blood clots and liver and kidney indicators, the risk lies in "no one is watching", not in the reason for taking the medicine. The formal way in China is to go to the endocrinology department or corresponding specialist of a regular medical institution for evaluation, prescription, and review.

Case: Xiaolin, a transgender woman, purchased estrogen online and increased the amount of estrogen on her own. She failed to check her coagulation and liver function for half a year. After her calf swelled and ache, blood clots were found in her lower limbs. She received emergency anticoagulation and was forced to suspend hormone treatment.

items.title: If you "feel ugly" to the point where you repeatedly look in the mirror and want to change it, do a body image assessment before discussing surgery
items.core: About 15% of people who go to plastic surgery have body dysmorphic disorder, which magnifies defects that are basically invisible to others to the point of affecting their lives. About 13% of the people who go to the dermatology department are women, and more than 70% of them are women. Make an appointment first to see if this is the case for you, and then decide whether to have surgery.
body: Cost: A visit to a psychiatry or clinical psychology department costs tens of yuan. The hard part is making this trip before the surgery appointment.

Income: Find all 33 studies according to the rules and then add them up. Among plastic surgery patients, the prevalence of body dysmorphic disorder (an enlargement of defects that are basically invisible to others that affects life) is 15.04%, and various studies range from 2.21% to 56.67%. In terms of numbers, about 15 out of every 100 people who undergo plastic surgery meet the criteria, and the number ranges from 2 to 57 based on individual studies. The average age of this group of people is 34.54±12.41 years old, the latter number fluctuates, and 74.38% are women. Dermatology visits were 12.65%, ranging from 4.52%–35.16% across studies, mean age 27.79±9.03 years, and 76.09% female. The authors recommend that plastic surgeons and dermatologists proactively assess and identify high-risk individuals and arrange for joint management among several departments. Another study asked 200 patients with body dysmorphic disorder. 71.0% had sought non-psychiatric treatment such as dermatology and plastic surgery, and 64.0% had received it. The authors conclude that such treatments "rarely improve" body dysmorphic disorder and appear to be ineffective
Level of Evidence: B

Source: Ribeiro RVE (2017). Prevalence of Body Dysmorphic Disorder in Plastic Surgery and Dermatology Patients: A Systematic Review with Meta-Analysis. Aesthetic Plast Surg. <https://doi.org/10.1007/s00266-017-0869-0>; Crerand CE, Phillips KA, Menard W, Fay C (2005). Nonpsychiatric medical treatment of body dysmorphic disorder. Psychosomatics, 46(6), 549-555. <https://doi.org/10.1176/appi.psy.46.6.549>; NHS. Body dysmorphic disorder (BDD). <https://www.nhs.uk/mental-health/conditions/body-dysmorphia/>

Note: The proportion measured in various studies ranges from 2.21% to 56.67%, which is a huge difference. The reason is that the questionnaires used and the populations surveyed are different. Therefore, we can only read "This proportion is not low and it is worth screening first." We cannot regard 15.04% as an accurate number. This is why the B grade is recorded. At this rate, most people who go to plastic surgery do not have body dysmorphic disorder. This article is aimed at the small group of people who are "repeated, persistent, and have affected their work and social life." Surgery and skin treatment can rarely make them better. The following clues are listed by the British NHS: spending a lot of time comparing one's appearance with others, always looking in the mirror or simply avoiding the mirror, spending a lot of effort to cover a certain part, and picking at the skin to make it "smooth". It affects work, social interactions and relationships.

Case: Xiao He, a college student, looked in the mirror for two hours every day and repeatedly asked for double eyelid surgery. He was diagnosed with body dysmorphic disorder by a psychological department. He received psychological treatment first and postponed the surgery before returning to life.

items.title: To straighten your teeth, you need to see an orthodontically qualified doctor for a face-to-face examination and regular follow-up consultations. Do not buy braces online and wear them at home.
items.core: Transparent braces are a Class II medical device in China. The instructions require that they be worn under the guidance of a doctor with orthodontic qualifications and have regular follow-up visits. The U.S. Food and Drug Administration says it has not approved braces sold directly to individuals without a prescription from a dentist. If no one checks you in person, your bite may become crooked, your teeth may move out of place, you may experience pain, or you may even lose your teeth.
body: Cost: It costs more for registration and follow-up consultation than online shopping, and you have to go to the clinic every once in a while. The difficulty lies in the fact that the course of treatment usually lasts for one or two years, and follow-up visits are required.

Income: The 2022 "Guiding Principles for Registration Review of Bracketless Aligners" by the Medical Device Technical Evaluation Center of the State Food and Drug Administration states that this kind of braces "has a management category of Class II." It requires that the instructions state that "during the treatment process, the device must be worn under the guidance of a physician with professional orthodontic qualifications" and "requirements for eating, brushing teeth and regular follow-up visits." Product names "It is not recommended to contain fictitious and hypothetical conceptual names such as "invisible"." The U.S. Food and Drug Administration (FDA) says: "The FDA has not authorized clear aligners that are sold directly to consumers without a prescription and supervision by a dentist or orthodontist." This means that it has not approved any clear aligners that are sold directly to individuals without a prescription and supervision by a dentist or orthodontist. The FDA also said: “In-person examination by a dentist or orthodontist can help lower the risks of uneven bite, unintended tooth movement, pain, and tooth loss.” In-person examination by a dentist can help lower the risks of uneven bite, unintended tooth movement, pain, and tooth loss. Only by regular follow-up visits after you start wearing them can you confirm that your teeth are moving safely as planned. Both are regulatory documents and do not give the proportion of incidents
Evidence level: C

Source: Medical Device Technical Review Center of the State Food and Drug Administration (2022). Guidelines for registration review of bracketless braces (No. 41, 2022). <https://www.cmde.org.cn/flfg/zdyz/zdyzwbk/20230103095116100.html>; General Office of the National Health Commission, etc. (2023). Notice on Further Promoting Oral Medical Services and Security Management (National Health Office Medical Administration [2023] No. 11, Part 5, Item 2). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202309/content_6903786.htm>; U.S. Food and Drug Administration (2026). Clear Dental Aligners (page 2026) Updated September 9). <https://www.fda.gov/medical-devices/dental-devices/clear-dental-aligners>

Note: The magnitude of the benefit is set as small because the proportion of accidents has not been found and can only be judged based on the consequences. Domestic drug regulatory and health authorities have not found any risk warnings for "buying braces online and wearing them at home", so this article mainly relies on registration requirements and the FDA's statement. Orthodontics is a medical practice. To perform medical cosmetic dental correction, the institution's license must have corresponding subjects, and the doctor who performs the procedure must be qualified. See Article 2 of this Section (Institutional License, Attending Physician) for the investigation method. Four departments including the National Health Commission issued oral medical notices in 2023. Anyone who fails to obtain a practice license or clinic registration certificate or hires non-health technicians to perform dental care will be "severely punished in accordance with laws and regulations," the notice requires. Orthodontics are not covered by medical insurance, see Section 24, Article 12 (ask about the lump sum price before dental implants)

Case: Xiao Zhao bought clear braces online and wore them himself. No one took a picture for evaluation. Half a year later, his front teeth became loose and the bite was misaligned. The orthodontic examination said that the teeth needed to be extracted again for correction, which would take an extra year.

items.title: When buying freckle whitening cream, go to the State Food and Drug Administration website to check the "National Cosmetic Special Character" number on the package. Do not use freckle cream sold by micro-businesses and prepared by beauty salons
items.core: Freckle whitening cream must be registered with the State Food and Drug Administration first, and can only be sold after obtaining the "National Cosmetic Special Character" number. Spot inspections have found freckle creams with mercury exceeding the legal limit by thousands of times. The packaging has a national cosmetics number printed on it, but the manufacturer has never produced that batch of goods. Mercury absorbed into the body from the face may damage the kidneys. Most cases can be cured by discontinuation of use and treatment, but treatment may take several months to two years.
body: Cost: No money, just a few minutes to check the number. The hard thing is not to buy the ones that acquaintances and micro-businessmen promote the most.

Income: Article 16 of the "Cosmetics Supervision and Administration Regulations" lists freckle-removing and whitening cosmetics as special cosmetics. Article 17 stipulates that special cosmetics can only be produced and imported after being registered by the drug regulatory department of the State Council. Article 36 requires the special cosmetics registration certificate number to be marked on the label. Article 20 requires registration information to be disclosed to the public, so the number can be found on the State Food and Drug Administration website. Article 62 of the "Cosmetic Registration and Filing Management Measures" stipulates that the number of domestically produced products is "Guozhuang Special Character" plus the year and serial number, and the number of imported products is "Guozhuang Special Character". The State Food and Drug Administration’s Notice No. 14 of 2026 announced two batches of anti-freckle cream, in which mercury was detected at 4938 mg/kg and 9281 mg/kg respectively. The limit listed in the attachment of the notice is not to exceed 1 mg/kg, which was exceeded by several thousand times in these two batches. They were bought in two small cosmetics stores in Sichuan and Anhui, and the special national cosmetics numbers were printed on the packages. The labeled manufacturer raised objections, and after review, the Guangdong Provincial Food and Drug Administration determined that this company had never produced this batch of goods. A review compiled 30 cases reported in journals of nephrotic syndrome, a condition in which large amounts of protein are leaked in the urine, after using mercury-containing skin whitening creams. The 30 people were all Asian women, mostly between 18 and 52 years old. The time from the onset of use to onset of symptoms ranges from 1 to 60 months, with half of the population within 5 months. Renal punctures mostly showed minimal change disease (67%) or membranous nephropathy (23%), two glomerular diseases. Very few symptoms improved on their own within a month and a half after stopping use. In several recorded cases, it took 1 to 9 months for patients taking mercury-removing drugs to turn negative for proteinuria, with a median of 2 months. The three cases without mercury removal drugs were all over 12 months old. A hospital in Beijing treated 288 people with mercury poisoning from 2014 to 2019, 84 (29.27%) of whom were related to cosmetics. The main source of poisoning in women is cosmetics. Among the 18 patients with nephrotic syndrome who were followed up, 15 had their urinary protein and albumin return to normal after an average of 22.67 months. Not all mercury in these 18 people came from cosmetics
Level of Evidence: B

Source: State Council (2020). Regulations on the Supervision and Administration of Cosmetics (State Council Order No. 727, Articles 16, 17, 20, 36, 42, and 60). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2020-06/29/content_5522593.htm>; State Administration for Market Regulation (2021). Measures for the management of cosmetics registration and filing (General Administration Order No. 35, Article 62). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2021-01/12/content_5579239.htm>; State Food and Drug Administration (2026). State Food and Drug Administration’s Notice on the Detection of Prohibited Raw Materials in 25 Batches of Cosmetics (No. 14, 2026) and its attachments. Chan TYK, Chan APL, Tang HL (2020). Nephrotic syndrome caused by exposures to skin-lightening cosmetic products containing inorganic mercury. Clin Toxicol. <https://doi.org/10.1080/15563650.2019.1639724>; Yawei S et al. (2021). Epidemiology, clinical presentation, treatment, and follow-up of chronic mercury poisoning in China: a retrospective analysis. BMC Pharmacol Toxicol. <https://doi.org/10.1186/s40360-021-00493-y>

Note: The two batch description numbers above can also be used fraudulently. Therefore, when checking the serial number, you should check whether the product name, manufacturer and packaging are correct. It is best to buy from the official brand store or regular shopping mall. Article 42 of the regulations stipulates that beauty salons must abide by the rules of cosmetic operators when using cosmetics on customers. Item 5 of Article 60 prohibits operators from preparing cosmetics without authorization, and the "academy-line freckle cream" prepared by a beauty salon itself is illegal. I have been using a freckle cream of unknown origin for a long time, so I stopped using it and took the product to the hospital to check for urinary mercury and protein. In that review, 6 people had normal blood mercury, and 24 people who had urine mercury checked were all above the upper limit of normal. The cases are reported one by one. It is impossible to calculate the proportion of people who use mercury-containing creams that will damage their kidneys, so it is recorded as grade B. The magnitude of the benefit is defined as medium based on the consequences: nephrotic syndrome can be cured in most cases, but it takes several months to two years to cure.

Case: Aunt Liu used the anti-freckle cream purchased through Wechat for two months, but her face became white but she suffered from fatigue and edema, and her urine test was abnormal. The Food and Drug Administration checked the serial number and found that the product contained mercury that exceeded the legal limit by thousands of times.

items.title: Don’t be alone in the days after your loved one passes away. If you have heart disease, high blood pressure, or diabetes, take medicine as usual. If you feel pain in your chest, call 120
items.core: The probability of myocardial infarction is 21.1 times higher than usual on the first day after the death of a loved one, and then it gets lower day by day. Among people aged 60 to 89, the rate of heart attack or stroke within 30 days after the death of a partner was 0.16%, compared with 0.08% for non-widowed peers. If you feel chest pain, out of breath, or weakness in one arm or leg, call 120 immediately.
body: Cost: No money. Don't be alone these days, and take your medicine as usual.

Income: 1985 patients with acute myocardial infarction, compare the same person with himself at different time periods before and after the onset of the disease. Of these, 270 (13.6%) had lost a significant other within 6 months before onset, and 19 within 1 day of MI. The rate of acute myocardial infarction increased 21.1-fold within 24 hours after the death of a significant other (95% CI 13.1–34.1, true multiplier approximately between 13 and 34). It has been declining day by day since then. Putting this into actual numbers: For every 1,394 people with a 5% risk of MI over ten years who have recently lost a loved one, there is one more case in a week. For every 320 people with a 20% risk, there is one more case a week. Another British study compared 30,447 widowed people aged 60 to 89 years with 83,588 matched controls. Among those who had myocardial infarction or stroke within 30 days after being widowed, 50 people (0.16%) were on the widowed side. 67 (0.08%) on the control side. The incidence rate ratio IRR is 2.20 (1.52–3.15), that is, the probability of an accident is approximately 2.2 times that of the control. Among them, myocardial infarction was 2.14 (1.20–3.81), about 2.1 times. Stroke 2.40 (1.22–4.71), approximately 2.4 times. It weakens after 30 days. Two types of diseases were also seen within 90 days. One type is non-myocardial infarction acute coronary syndrome (the type where there is an acute problem with the blood supply to the heart, but not enough to cause a myocardial infarction), with an IRR of 2.20 (1.12–4.29). One type is pulmonary embolism (blood clots blocking the blood vessels in the lungs), with an IRR of 2.37 (1.18–4.75). How to recognize these diseases? The British National Health Service (NHS) lists the signals to call emergency services immediately. Myocardial infarction is a pain in the chest that feels like being pressed or squeezed. The pain may spread to the arms, neck, jaw, and the patient may be short of breath. Stroke is one side of the face drooping, one arm or side of the body is numb, numb, and slurred speech
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Mostofsky E, et al. (2012). Risk of acute myocardial infarction after the death of a significant person in one's life: the Determinants of Myocardial Infarction Onset Study. Circulation. <https://doi.org/10.1161/CIRCULATIONAHA.111.061770>; Carey IM, et al. (2014). Increased risk of acute cardiovascular events after partner bereavement: a matched cohort study. JAMA Internal Medicine. <https://doi.org/10.1001/jamainternmed.2013.14558>; NHS. Heart attack: symptoms. <https://www.nhs.uk/conditions/heart-attack/symptoms/>; NHS. Symptoms of a stroke. <https://www.nhs.uk/conditions/stroke/symptoms/>

Note: People with high blood pressure and diabetes should take medicine as usual. This is the author's judgment. Neither study compared taking medication with not taking medication. The 21.1 times item only calculated the excess number of patients based on the risk of myocardial infarction. Leave the medicine box to others, don't rely on yourself to remember it. Don't drive long distances these days. Don’t rely on drinking to get through it. See verse 2 for the account of drinking. How to recognize myocardial infarction and stroke, and how to call a car to see Section 13. Both studies looked back at population data, and it was unclear how many people were at risk of developing the disease in the first place. But the two items refer to the same direction and time period. No one can hand over the pill box and you are destined to be alone in the house these days. See Article 6 of this section.

Case: Lao Zhou was sitting alone in the mourning hall on the day his father passed away. He had high blood pressure but missed taking medicine. He had chest pain and cold sweats at night. When his family found out, they called 120 and sent him to the hospital for a diagnosis of acute myocardial infarction.

items.title: In the week after you are informed of the diagnosis of a serious illness, don’t go get the report alone, leave decisions other than treatment until later
items.core: In the first week after receiving a cancer diagnosis, the probability of suicide is 12.6 times that of people who have not been diagnosed, and the probability of dying from cardiovascular disease is 5.6 times. By the first year, the risk of suicide dropped to 3.1 times, and was more pronounced for more difficult-to-treat cancers. So take someone with you on the day you get the report, and don’t be alone when you go home. Leave things like resigning and selling your house until the next clinic visit.
body: Cost: No money. Find someone to go with you to get the report. Put off big decisions other than treatment for a few days.

Benefits: The Swedish national archive tracks more than 6.07 million people (6,073,240 individuals) from 1991 to 2006. The relative risk of suicide in the first week after diagnosis was 12.6 (95% CI 8.6–17.8), or approximately 12.6 times higher, compared with those without a cancer diagnosis. The true multiple is roughly between 8.6 and 17.8. The incidence rate this week is 2.50/1000 person-years, that is, 2.5 cases per 1000 people per year. By the first year it drops to 3.1 (2.7–3.5, 0.60/1000 person-years), about 3.1 times. Cardiovascular death in the first week 5.6 (5.2–5.9, 116.80/1000 person-years), approximately 5.6 times. 3.3 in the first 4 weeks (3.1–3.4, 65.81/1000 person-years). The increased risk declined rapidly within the first year after diagnosis. The more difficult the cancer is to treat and the lower the probability of survival, the more obvious the cancer will rise. Comparing the same group of patients with themselves at different time periods, the conclusions are consistent
Level of Evidence: A
Source: Fang F, et al. (2012). Suicide and cardiovascular death after a cancer diagnosis. New England Journal of Medicine. <https://doi.org/10.1056/NEJMoa1110307>

Remarks: This is the data of cancer patients. Switching to other major diagnoses, there is no original text with the same weight. There are actually very few accidents: the suicide rate in the first week is 2.50/1,000 person-years, that is, 2.5 cases per 1,000 people per year. I write it down not to scare people, but to show that someone needs to be by my side during the "those days when I first learned about it". Long-term management, reimbursement and review after diagnosis are covered in Sections 16 and 24. If you can’t find someone to accompany you, see Article 6 of this section (replace “that person” with a list of neighbors and communities).

Case: Mr. Chen received the lung cancer report alone and decided to resign and sell his house on the spot. After returning home, he had insomnia all night. After his daughter accompanied him for a follow-up consultation, treatment and living arrangements were handled separately.

items.title: After losing your job, fix your schedule, medical insurance, and job hunting first. Don’t stay at home all day.
items.core: Compared with those who are employed, unemployed people have about a 60% higher risk of death later on. The risk is more obvious for men and younger people, with the highest risk in the first ten years. Studies that consider lifestyle habits such as smoking and drinking have found weaker associations, but this cannot be used to say how much risk can be eliminated by changing habits. First go through unemployment registration and receive unemployment insurance benefits.
body: Cost: No money. First go through unemployment registration and receive unemployment insurance benefits, and then schedule your job search into a fixed schedule. The difficulty lies in getting up on time when no one is urging you.

Benefits: 42 studies, 235 mortality risk estimates, over 20 million people combined. After deducting the effects of age and other conditions, the average hazard ratio HR for death from all causes among the unemployed is 1.63. Compared with those who are employed, the risk of death is about 60% higher. Males are higher than females. The impact is obvious on people in the early and middle stages of their careers, but less so in the later stages of their careers. Risk is highest during the first 10 years of tracking and declines thereafter. In studies that included healthy behaviors such as smoking and drinking, the average hazard ratio HR was 24% lower than in studies that did not control for these behaviors. This is a comparison between different subsets of studies, not that the extra portion reduces the risk of death by 24%. Nor does it tell how much the individual's risk will decrease if he or she changes his or her lifestyle habits.
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Roelfs DJ, et al. (2011). Losing life and livelihood: a systematic review and meta-analysis of unemployment and all-cause mortality. Social Science & Medicine. <https://doi.org/10.1016/j.socscimed.2011.01.005>

Note: This is a study looking back at population data, and the direction of cause and effect cannot be distinguished. People with poor health are also more likely to be unemployed. In studies that include lifestyle habits, the average HR is 24% lower, which cannot be regarded as the effect of personal behavioral changes. Fixing your schedule, renewing your medical insurance, and not staying at home all day are the author's experience and have not been calculated separately in the study. What can you get if you are unemployed, where can you get it, and how to renew social security, please see Section 7. How much compensation should you get if you are fired? Please refer to Section 19 for voluntary resignation.

Case: After Xiao Wu was laid off, he slept until noon every day, played games behind closed doors, stopped paying for his medical insurance and missed unemployment registration. After being reminded by the community, he fixed his schedule and registered, and the interview resumed two weeks later.

items.title: If a loved one dies by suicide, accident or homicide, don’t expect to bear it, take the initiative to seek professional help
items.core: People whose spouses die by suicide are about 80% (male) and 70% (female) more likely to be diagnosed with a mental disorder within five years than the average person. It is also 70% to twice as high as those whose spouses died of other causes. Such bereaved people are more likely to feel alienated and ashamed. This is exactly the reason to take the initiative to find someone, don't wait for yourself to get better.
body: Cost: Call 12356 for free. If you need to see a doctor, the psychological clinic fee is the same as ordinary outpatient services. The difficulty lies in finding someone by yourself.

Benefits: The Danish National Archives tracked 6.7 million adults from 1980 to 2014, for a total of more than 136 million person-years (all persons were tracked combined). The risk of newly diagnosed mental disorder among those who were widowed due to spouse's suicide within 5 years was compared with the general population. The incidence rate ratio for men was 1.8 (95% CI 1.6–2.0), which is about 80% higher. Women 1.7 (1.6–1.8), that is, about 70% taller. Compared with people who were widowed due to other causes of death, the IRR was 1.7 (1.5–1.9) for men and 2.0 (1.9–2.2) for women, that is, 70% to twice as high. This group also had higher rates of suicidal behavior, mortality, and need for municipal assistance. Physical diseases such as liver cirrhosis and sleep disorders also increase the risk. Another 57 studies were summarized item by item and not combined. Bereavement due to suicide is related to the following four things. First, the risk of partner suicide increases. Second, the risk of parents being admitted to a psychiatric hospital increases after their children commit suicide. Third, the suicide risk of mothers increases after their adult children commit suicide. Fourth, the risk of depression in children increases after their parents commit suicide. People bereaved by suicide are more likely to report feeling alienated and ashamed than those bereaved by other violent deaths. There is also a review that looks at sudden and violent bereavement, including loss in disaster and war. Post-traumatic stress disorder, depression, and prolonged grief disorder are all more common after a loved one is gone, and recovery is slower than after a loved one dies. It’s just that the prevalence rates measured in various studies are very different
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Erlangsen A, et al. (2017). Association Between Spousal Suicide and Mental, Physical, and Social Health Outcomes: A Longitudinal and Nationwide Register-Based Study. JAMA Psychiatry. <https://doi.org/10.1001/jamapsychiatry.2017.0226>; Pitman A, et al. (2014). Effects of suicide bereavement on mental health and suicide risk. The Lancet Psychiatry. Kristensen P et al. (2012). Bereavement and mental health after sudden and violent losses: a review. Psychiatry. <https://doi.org/10.1521/psyc.2012.75.1.76> (The review in the remarks)

Remarks: Sudden and violent death refers to accidents, murders, and disasters. Rates of post-traumatic stress disorder, depression and grief stuck are all higher after such deaths than after deaths from illness. Recovery is also slower. If you still have nightmares, flashbacks, and avoidance after a month, see Article 14 of this section (trauma-focused psychotherapy). For information on what to do if you have suicidal thoughts, see Section 1, Article 25.

Case: After her husband died in a car accident, Ms. Zhao always felt that her colleagues were talking about her behind her back. She woke up at night and was ashamed to speak. Depression was screened for depression three months later during grief counseling and treatment was initiated.

items.title: In the first six months after being widowed, leave three meals, sleep, medicine for chronic diseases and review to a fixed person to keep an eye on
items.core: In less than half a year after being widowed, the probability of death is about 40% higher than that of people who have not been widowed. Half a year later it dropped to about 1.5%. Men get promoted more, while women see no difference in one summary, and the risk is about 15% higher in another. What should be done is to assign medicines, meals and reexaminations to a specific person, and don't expect yourself to remember them.
body: Cost: No money. Find a specific person, be it a child, sibling, or friend, and ask that person to visit or call you regularly. The difficulty lies in opening one's mouth to confide the matter.

Income: 15 studies registered first and followed later, 2,263,888 people combined. The relative risk of death when widowed for less than 6 months was RR 1.41 (95% CI 1.26–1.57), that is, the probability of death was about 40% higher than that of those who were not widowed. Six months later it was 1.14 (1.10–1.18), down to about one and a half percent. Male RR 1.23 (1.18–1.28), about 23% higher. Women 1.04 (1.00–1.08, not statistically significant, i.e. the difference could just be a coincidence). No significant difference was seen between those younger than 65 years old and those older than 65 years old. Another analysis combined 123 publications, 1,377 risk estimates, and more than 500 million people. After flattening the differences in conditions, the hazard ratio HR was 1.23 (1.19–1.28), which means that the overall risk of death was about 23% higher. Men are also higher than women. Men 1.27 (1.19–1.35), 27% higher. Women 1.15 (1.08–1.22), 1.5 percent higher
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Moon JR, et al. (2011). Widowhood and mortality: a meta-analysis. PLoS ONE. <https://doi.org/10.1371/journal.pone.0023465>; Shor E, et al. and meta-regression. Demography. <https://doi.org/10.1007/s13524-012-0096-x>

Note: This is a study looking back at population data, and other factors cannot be removed when mixed in. Couples’ lifestyles and illnesses are inherently similar. "The first half of the year is much higher than the later years" is the first summary calculated based on the period of widowhood. The second part was not divided according to the time of widowhood, but only according to how long the study was followed. The combined HR for studies with only 6 months was 1.58 (1.32–1.88) and for studies with 16 to 20 years it was 1.22 (1.02–1.47). Based on this, the authors believe that the risk is highest in the first few years after widowhood, but also note that most studies do not start tracking newly widowed spouses. The two parts are going in the same direction, so it’s worth treating the first six months as a window of care. Men are at higher risk and are less likely to ask for help. If there is a widowed elderly person in the family, the accounts, guardianship and will should be sorted out according to Section 17. If you can’t find such a person (living alone, losing your child, or having children gone), leave this matter to the community and mobile phones, see Article 6 of this section.

Case: After Aunt Li was widowed, her daughter packed her antihypertensive medicine into a morning and evening medicine box and watched her take it through WeChat videos every day. She asked for leave every Wednesday to accompany her to the community for blood pressure checks. In half a year, her mother did not miss a single medicine, her blood pressure was stable, and she no longer suffered from insomnia all night when someone talked to her at night.

items.title: If you have no relatives or friends, replace "the person staring at you" with three things: neighbors who can enter your home, a visiting list in the community, and emergency contacts on your mobile phone
items.core: When you have no relatives or friends, you should take care of two things: someone will find you if something goes wrong, and take your medicine and meals on time. Write down a list for taking medicine and eating, and set an alarm clock. Don’t rely on memory. Some people have found that they rely on three things: a spare key in the neighbor's hand, an emergency contact person set in the mobile phone, and a visiting and caring list in the community. This list covers elderly people living alone and empty nesters. You can ask at the neighborhood committee.
body: Cost: Nothing. The difficulty is to take the initiative and say to the neighbors and neighborhood committee, "I live alone and something happened at home."

Revenue: 44,573 outpatients, all at risk or with a history of atherothrombosis (a condition in which plaque builds up in blood vessels and is easily blocked by blood clots). They were registered by doctors from many countries and tracked in the international project REACH. They were enrolled from December 2003 to December 2004 and followed for 4 years. Of these, 8,594 (19%) live alone. The combined 4-year death rate from all causes was 14.1% for those who lived alone and 11.1% for those who lived together. Cardiovascular death 8.6% vs. 6.8%. Both log-rank P<0.01, the difference is unlikely to be due to chance. The gap was different across age groups (interaction P = 0.03). For ages 45 to 65, the mortality rate for those living alone versus those living together was 7.7% versus 5.7%. After adjusting for other conditions, the hazard ratio was HR 1.24 (95% CI 1.01–1.51), which means the risk of death was approximately 24% higher. For those aged 66 to 80 years, it was 13.2% vs. 12.3%, HR 1.12 (1.01–1.26), and the risk was about 10% higher. For those over 80 years old, it was 24.6% vs. 28.4%, HR 0.92 (0.79–1.06), but no increase was found. The 2022 opinions of ten departments including the Ministry of Civil Affairs stipulate that visiting care services must be carried out. The target is the elderly living alone, empty nesters, left behind, disabled, severely disabled, and families with special family planning needs. The service method is "regular door-to-door visits, telephone video, and remote monitoring." With the assistance of the township (subdistrict) thorough investigation and the village (resident) committee, basic information and "willingness to accept visiting care services" will be grasped and incorporated into grassroots grid management (with dedicated personnel to monitor by area). By the end of 2025, "ensure that the monthly visit rate for the elderly with special difficulties reaches 100%" and "disabled elderly people with special difficulties will be visited and cared for at least once a month." The document also advocates that families be equipped with smart call systems, smart electricity and water meters, health monitoring products, and elderly care monitoring devices. "Once monitoring abnormalities occur, they can provide timely warnings and simultaneously send prompt messages to emergency contacts." When service personnel find an emergency problem, they "should help dial the emergency hotline as soon as possible"
Level of Evidence: B

Source: Udell JA, et al. (2012). Living alone and cardiovascular risk in outpatients at risk of or with atherothrombosis. Archives of Internal Medicine. <https://doi.org/10.1001/archinternmed.2012.2782>; Ministry of Civil Affairs and other ten departments (2022). Guiding Opinions on Carrying out Visiting and Care Services for the Elderly with Special Needs (Minfa [2022] No. 73). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2022-10/13/content_5718017.htm>

Note: What to do with the three things. 1. Give the spare key or the temporary password of the door lock to a neighbor or the property owner, and tell him "I am alone these days." No friendship is required, just someone needs to know you are in the house. Second, go to the community committee and explain that you live alone and ask if you can be put on the visitation and care list. Elderly people who live alone, have empty nests, or have lost their only child are the official service targets. By the way, I would like to ask if there are free smart pagers and smart water meters installed locally. Third, set up emergency contacts and medical emergency cards on your mobile phone, and do not mute or turn off the phone these days. There are two reasons for B. First, the association between living alone and mortality comes from studies looking back at population data. It cannot remove the converse explanation of "people with poor health and poor conditions are more likely to live alone." The original article also wrote that this result needs to be confirmed. Second, the document on visitation and care only covers the elderly. There is no special system for those under 60 years old. All you can count on is an item in another document. It requires grid workers and social workers to "timely detect risks of psychological crises such as family changes, unemployment, and school dropout" (see Article 11 of this section, asking for someone to accompany you to talk and call 12356). Why "there is someone in the house" is valuable, see Section 13, No. 1 (chest compression). Of cardiac arrests that occurred outside the hospital, 79.2% occurred at home. Among those who had someone nearby doing compressions, 16.1% were discharged alive, while only 3.9% were discharged alive. Having no one in the room means you are in the lower bracket. Two other handy things. To organize a funeral, you have to visit the funeral parlor, community health service agency, public security, and provident fund (see Section 25). Arrange it as a fixed schedule to go out once a day, and the outing arrangements for these days are ready. The hotline can be called repeatedly, not just once (see Article 11 of this section, ask for someone to accompany you when calling 12356). "Living alone" itself is also a long-term risk factor. The odds ratio of death for living alone is 1.32, see Section 22, Item 9 (Regarding regular meetings with people as a health expense). But here we only focus on the present few days, and the long-term account will be calculated separately.

Case: Uncle Zhang, who lives alone, gives his spare key to Xiao Zhao from across the street. He takes a look at it every morning when Xiao Zhao knocks on the door at seven o'clock in the morning to deliver milk; a community grid member visits his door every Wednesday, and he has set up an emergency contact with his nephew on his mobile phone. One day, Xiao Zhao felt dizzy and fell down. When Xiao Zhao walked in and found out, he called 120 and promptly handled the situation and turned the danger into safety.

items.title: After the death of a parent, tell the child the truth and let him attend the farewell
items.core: Children who lost their father or mother before the age of 18 are about 50% more likely to die later than children who have never experienced this. About 80% of parents died of accidents or suicide, and about 30% of parents died of illness. The American Academy of Pediatrics recommends telling children the truth about what happened and supporting children in attending funerals and farewells.
body: Cost: No money. The difficulty is that I am also feeling uncomfortable, and I have to explain it clearly to my children.
