Measures for the Management of Student Financial Aid Funds (Financial Science and Education [2019] 19 No. 5, Article 5; years of financial aid for enlistment: "If you have completed the specified years of study before joining the army, it will be the number of years for tuition compensation or national student loan reimbursement; after retiring and returning to school, you will continue to complete the specified remaining years of study, which will be the number of years of tuition exemption." For graduates, "the number of years of tuition compensation or national student loan reimbursement shall be calculated according to the corresponding academic system stipulated by the state"). <http://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2019/content_5421553.htm>; Standing Committee of the National People's Congress (2020). Law on the Protection of Veterans (Articles 34 and 35). <http://www.mod.gov.cn/gfbw/fgwx/flfg/16048597.html> (published by the Ministry of National Defense); General Office of the Ministry of Education (2025). About doing a good job Notice of the 2026 Retired College Soldiers Special Master’s Degree Enrollment Plan (Teaching Hall [2025] No. 8). <http://www.moe.gov.cn/srcsite/A15/moe_778/s3261/202512/t20251211_1423174.html>; Ministry of Veterans Affairs (2022). Retired Soldiers Education and Training Policy 23 Article: "Starting from the enrollment in 2022, higher vocational (junior college) graduates and current students (including college freshmen) are drafted into the army. Those who have completed higher vocational (junior college) studies after retirement can apply for junior college upgrading and are exempt from taking the cultural examinations" (according to the Teaching Office [2021] No. 8). <https://www.mva.gov.cn/sy/xx/bnxx/202201/t20220107_55052.html>; Ministry of Education (2026). 2027 National Postgraduate Admissions Management Regulations (Teaching [2026] No. 2, Articles 22, 24, and 25), published on the Research and Recruitment Network. <https://yz.chsi.com.cn/kyzx/jybzc/202609/20260924/2293971511.html>; Ministry of Education (2024). 2025 National Postgraduate Admissions Management Regulations (Teaching [2024] No. 4, Article 22). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202410/content_6978684.htm>

Note: There are two more channels. The first is the exemption from taking cultural courses for junior college to undergraduate: junior college students who serve in the military and complete junior college after retirement can apply for exemption from the examination for junior college to junior college, and the school will select the best after taking a vocational skills test. This article will be implemented from enrollment in 2022. For specific measures, please refer to the province’s notice of that year. The second is to add 10 points to the preliminary examination of the postgraduate entrance examination: retired college students and soldiers who take the postgraduate examination within 3 years after retiring will have an additional 10 points to their total preliminary examination score. If you sign up for the special plan, you won’t get any extra points, and you can’t enjoy both at the same time. Those who have achieved second-class meritorious service or above can apply for exemption from the preliminary examination for postgraduate study. The list of schools recruiting special programs changes every year, and in 2025 there are 523 schools. The tuition fee standard has been adjusted twice: in 2019 it was 8000/12000, in the autumn of 2023 it was changed to 16000/20000, and in the autumn of 2024 it was changed to 20000/25000. The Department of Veterans Affairs’ 2022 summary is still the original version, so don’t copy it.

Case: Xiao Zhou, a sophomore student, applied for retaining his student status before joining the army and returned to school after retiring. The school provided him with tuition compensation of up to 20,000 yuan per year, and he signed up for the special program for retired college students when he took the postgraduate entrance examination.

items.title: There are only six situations where the government will arrange a job after retirement; you must report to work within 30 days of self-employment
items.core: "Soldier package allocation" is no longer a common situation. Currently, there are only six situations in which the government arranges work, and compulsory soldiers serve for two years before retiring. Most of them are not among these six situations. The category of work that is not arranged by the government is called self-employment, and it has a hard deadline: you must report for duty within 30 days after retiring from active service. If it exceeds 30 days without justifiable reasons, you will be deemed to have given up the resettlement benefits.
body: Cost: No money. Bring your retirement certificate and go to the Veterans Affairs Department at the place of resettlement.

Income: Article 25 of the "Regulations on the Resettlement of Veterans" lists six situations, and the people's government of the resettlement place will arrange the work. The original text is: "(1) Sergeants who have served in active service for 12 years or more; (2) individuals who have received medals and honorary titles during active service; (3) individuals who have received third-class military merit, second-class merit or above during active service; (4) individuals who have received first-class commendations during active service; (5) individuals who have been disabled due to combat and have been assessed as having a disability level of 5 to 8; (6) children of martyrs." The regulations also read: "The people's government of the resettlement place shall complete the task of arranging the work of retired sergeants and conscripts within 6 months of receiving them." Employers "should sign with them a medium- to long-term employment contract or labor contract of no less than three years in accordance with regulations. Among them, if an enterprise accepts retired sergeants with more than 10 years of military service, it shall sign an unfixed-term labor contract with them." An indefinite term means that there is no expiration date written in the contract. While the job is being arranged, "living allowance will be paid monthly according to the local monthly minimum wage standard." It’s not because of your own reasons that you failed to take up the job according to the regulations. “According to the standard of no less than 80% of the average salary of people with the same conditions in the unit, living expenses will be paid monthly until you take up the job.” Circumstances in which job placement is not allowed include being expelled from the Communist Party of China and receiving criminal punishment. For the period of self-employment, please refer to Article 51: "Self-employed retired sergeants and conscripts should report to the competent department of retired military affairs of the people's government of the place of resettlement within 30 days from the date of being approved to withdraw from active service. Failure to report in accordance with the prescribed time for more than 30 days without justifiable reasons shall be deemed to have given up resettlement benefits." (National, effective from September 1, 2024)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: State Council, Central Military Commission (2024). Regulations on the Placement of Veterans (State Council and Central Military Commission Order No. 787, promulgated on July 29, 2024, effective on September 1, 2024; Articles 25, 31, 32, 35, 51, and 75). <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/2024/issue_11526/202408/content_6969192.html>; National People’s Congress Standing Committee (2020). Law on the Security of Veterans (Articles 13, 14, and 15). <http://www.mod.gov.cn/gfbw/fgwx/flfg/16048597.html> (published by the Ministry of National Defense)

Note: On the same day that this regulation came into effect, the 2011 "Regulations on the Placement of Veterans" (State Council, Central Military Commission Order No. 608) was abolished. A large number of guides on the Internet still refer to the old regulations, but the condition description has changed. The old version reads "a reward of second-class merit or above in peacetime or a reward of third-class merit or above in wartime." The 30-day period only applies to the self-employed category, and other placement methods are to report "according to the prescribed time". A veteran's preferential treatment certificate will be issued when you register, and the subsequent retirement benefits, employment and entrepreneurship support, and education subsidies will all be connected from here.

Case: After Xiao Li retired from service for two years, he thought that an employer would accept him. After returning to the county, he waited for notification and did not go to the Veterans Affairs Department for more than 30 days. Due to overdue service without justifiable reasons, he was told that the self-employment placement benefits were deemed to have been given up.

items.title: Three accounts after retirement: one-time retirement payment, military service length, and a tax deduction of 20,000 yuan per year for self-employment
items.core: Three accounts after retirement. The first payment is a one-time retirement payment for self-employment, which will be paid based on the number of years of active service. Additional payments will be given to those who have made meritorious service. The second payment is calculated based on military service length, and the years of payment are calculated together with before joining the army and after retirement. The third payment is tax: if you open your own shop and do business, you can pay less tax according to the limit of 20,000 yuan every year for three years, and the limit can be increased by up to 20%.
body: Cost: No money. When you retire, the military will transfer your social security relationship and money. You go to the social security agency (the window for handling social security) at the resettlement place to apply for the connection.

Income: The first one is to read the "Regulations on the Placement of Veterans". It reads: "For self-employed retired sergeants and conscripts, a one-time retirement payment will be issued based on their years of active service." Who will pay the money: "It will be specially arranged by the central finance, and the specific standards will be determined by the department in charge of retired military affairs of the State Council, the political work department of the Central Military Commission, and the financial department of the State Council... and will be adjusted in due course." The proportion of additional issuance is divided into five levels. Obtaining medals and honorary titles will increase by 25%, and first-class military merit or first-class commendation will increase by 20%. 15% for second-class military merit, first-class merit or second-class commendation. Third-class military merit or second-class merit is 10%, fourth-class military merit or third-class merit is 5%. The regulations also read: "Retired military personnel who are not employed in time can apply for unemployment insurance benefits from the human resources and social security department in the place where their registered permanent residence is located in accordance with the law. The years of active service are deemed to be the years of insurance payment, except for retired military personnel who are placed in retirement or support arrangements." The deemed payment period means that if you haven’t paid any money in the past few years, it will still be counted as having paid. The second item is the "Retired Soldiers' Security Law": "The number of years that veterans have served in active service is calculated as length of service, and the cumulative number of years of service in their unit after retirement is calculated." The length of service is the number of years you have been working. The years of service and the number of years after retirement are added up. The law also states that the years of active service and the years of pension, medical and unemployment payment before enlistment and after retirement are "combined and calculated in accordance with the law." "Retired sergeants and conscripts' active service experience is deemed to be grassroots work experience." "Military Personnel Insurance Law": "The number of years a military member has served in active service is regarded as the number of years of payment for the basic medical insurance for employees, and is calculated together with the number of years of payment for the basic medical insurance for employees before joining the army and after retirement from active service." For the third payment, please refer to Announcement No. 14 of 2023 by the Ministry of Finance, the State Administration of Taxation, and the Ministry of Veterans Affairs. The announcement describes the situation of self-employed retired soldiers engaged in self-employment: "Within 3 years (36 months, the same below), the actual value-added tax, urban maintenance and construction tax, education surcharge, local education surcharge and personal income tax that should be deducted in sequence is based on a limit of 20,000 yuan per household per year. The limit standard can be increased by up to 20%." Deduction means subtracting from the various types of taxes that should be paid in the current year in order until it is reduced to the limit. It is not money paid to you. “The quota standard for enterprise recruitment is 6,000 yuan per person per year, which can be increased by up to 50%.” The implementation period is from January 1, 2023 to December 31, 2027. Those who have expired for less than 3 years can continue to enjoy it until expiration (nationwide)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: State Council, Central Military Commission (2024). Regulations on the Placement of Veterans (State Council, Central Military Commission Order No. 787, Articles 21, 22, 74, 81, and 85). <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/2024/issue_11526/202408/content_6969192.html>; Ministry of Veterans Affairs (2020). Ten questions about one-time retirement payment (reprinted from "China Veterans" Issue 10, 2020): "Basic standards. Soldiers will be awarded 4,500 yuan for each year of active service." "Retirement payment standards will be adjusted in due course." <https://www.mva.gov.cn/sy/zzxc/202011/t20201113_43153.html>; Guizhou Provincial Department of Veterans Affairs (2024). One-time additional retirement pension, important changes! : "The current standard is: Soldiers will receive 4,500 yuan for each year of active service." <http://tyjrswt.guizhou.gov.cn/zfxxgk/fdzdgknr/zdlyxx_5621158/tyaz_5621161/202408/t20240809_85367194.html>; People's Government of Muping District, Yantai City (2025). The reply quoted the "Notice of Yantai Municipal Veterans Affairs Bureau and Yantai Municipal Finance Bureau on Adjusting the One-time Economic Subsidy Standard for Self-Employed Retired Soldiers": "Those who retire from active service in 2024 will receive a subsidy of 6,000 yuan for each year of service." <https://www.muping.gov.cn/art/2025/11/10/art_105032_2960250.html>; National People's Congress Standing Committee (2020). Law on the Security of Veterans (Articles 42, 44, and 50). <http://www.mod.gov.cn/gfbw/fgwx/flfg/16048597.html> (published by the Ministry of National Defense); National People’s Congress Standing Committee (2012). Military Personnel Insurance Law (Articles 16 and 23). <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=2c909fdd678bf17901678bf73e160645> (National Laws and Regulations Database); Ministry of Finance, State Administration of Taxation, and Ministry of Veterans Affairs (2023). Announcement on tax policies to further support the entrepreneurship and employment of self-employed retired soldiers (No. 14, 2023). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202308/content_6896456.htm>

Note: The regulations only state that the amount will be determined by the competent authority. The official figure that can be found is "4,500 yuan will be paid for each year of active service" in the 2020 article on the official website of the Department of Veterans Affairs. The same article also says "timely adjustment." The additional issuance ratio in that article is no longer consistent with the current regulations, and the regulations must prevail. The Guizhou Provincial Department of Veterans Affairs published an article in August 2024. Under the new regulations, it still states that "the current standard is: soldiers will be paid 4,500 yuan for every year of active service." 4,500 yuan is the standard listed in this provincial publication. No official documents were found for the current national standards, so the statement of the local Veterans Affairs Department at the time of retirement shall prevail. Also, don’t confuse local “one-time financial subsidies” with it. That is another amount of money determined and distributed by each locality. For example, those who retire in Yantai in 2024 will receive a subsidy of 6,000 yuan for each year of service. Most of the new numbers on the guide have no source, and some just mix the two figures together. During the compulsory military service, the family can also receive another family allowance. The Military Service Law only says, "Standards are set by local people's governments, and fixed subsidies are provided by the central government." The specific amount depends on the county-level people's government that approved your enlistment. The amount of tax is the maximum amount of tax you can pay each year, not the money that is given to you. Users will be dissatisfied if the business does not start, so the income level of the entire article is only set as "medium". The "Regulations on Promotion of Employment and Entrepreneurship of Veterans", which will be implemented on August 1, 2026, adds an additional article: Vocational qualification certificates for skilled personnel obtained during service will be valid nationwide after retirement.

Case: A soldier who has served for 8 years chooses to be self-employed and receives a one-time retirement payment based on the number of years; after joining a company, the 8 years of military service are incorporated into the working age and pension payment years; later when he opens a small restaurant, the tax deduction is based on the annual limit of 20,000 yuan for the first three years.

items.title: If you want to enter the system, there is more than one way to take the civil service examination: if you have worked in grassroots service projects for two years, you can apply for the 10% annual targeted examination plan
items.core: If you want to enter the system, there is not only one way to take the civil service examination. If you have completed grassroots service projects such as "Three Supports and One Support" for two years and passed the assessment, you can apply for the targeted examination plan only for these people. Each province has to spend about 10% of its civil service examination plan to recruit these people every year. If you take the postgraduate entrance examination within three years, 10 points will be added to the total score of the preliminary examination. The price is that I received financial subsidies in the past two years.
body: Cost: No money. The price is to serve at the grassroots level in the township for two years. I have received financial subsidies in these two years, not market wages. The difficulty is to endure these two years.

Income: The fourth round of "Three Supports and One Assistance" plan notice states that "the service period is two years." It also reads: "Each province (autonomous region, municipality) should allocate about 10% of the civil service examination plan every year for targeted recruitment of personnel serving grassroots projects such as the 'Three Supports and One Support' program. When grassroots public institutions in each province (autonomous region, city), county, township, and township openly recruit, they should allocate a certain number or proportion of positions based on the actual situation in the region, and carry out special recruitment for those who have passed the 'Three Supports and One Support' service period... There is no need to agree on a probation period after employment." Targeted admissions and special recruitment means that these places are only available to those who have worked on grassroots service projects, and others cannot apply. The same notice also states: "Those who have passed the "Three Supports and One Support" program at the end of the term and have taken the national master's degree admissions examination within three years will have 10 points added to the total score of the preliminary examination, and will be given priority for admission under the same conditions... Graduates of higher vocational (technical colleges) who have expired and passed the assessment can be admitted to the undergraduate program for adult higher education without taking the examination." Admission without examination means that you don't need to take another exam and can go directly to study for junior college or bachelor's degree. The notice also reads: "Those who have no work experience before participating in the "Three Supports and One Support" program and who have passed the assessment can equally enjoy the relevant policies for fresh graduates within two years when they participate in the examination (recruitment) of agencies and enterprises and institutions, start their own businesses, settle down, and enter higher education. The "Three Supports and One Support" personnel's service years at the grassroots level are calculated as seniority, and their working time is calculated from the date they report to the grassroots level." The central financial subsidy standard is 30,000 yuan per person per year in the western region, 24,000 yuan in the central region, and 12,000 yuan in the eastern region. The opinion of the General Office of the CPC Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council reads: "Personnel who have no work experience before participating in grassroots service projects can equally enjoy the relevant policies for fresh college graduates in terms of participation in the examination (recruitment) of government agencies and institutions, employment recruitment by various enterprises, self-employment, settlement, and further education within 2 years after their service period expires and they pass the assessment." The opinion also states: "When hiring civil servants in agencies at or above the provincial level, except for special positions, in accordance with relevant regulations, they will all be recruited from those with more than 2 years of grass-roots work experience." The other way is the Western Plan. It is "jointly organized and implemented by the Central Committee of the Communist Youth League, the Ministry of Education, the Ministry of Finance, and the Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security." It recruits fresh college graduates or postgraduate students to "engage in voluntary services at grassroots levels in western China for 1-3 years" (nationwide)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China, Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security and other ten departments (2021). Notice on the implementation of the fourth round of the "Three Supports and One Support" plan for college graduates (Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security [2021] No. 32, Articles 7, 8, 9, 11, 12, and 13). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2021-06/04/content_5615404.htm>; General Office of the CPC Central Committee and General Office of the State Council (2017). Opinions on further guiding and encouraging college graduates to work at the grassroots level (Articles 5, 16, and 18). <http://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2017/content_5171278.htm>; National College Student Volunteer Service Western Plan Project Management Office (2026). 2026-2027 College Student Volunteer Service Western Plan Recruitment Agreement. <http://xibu.youth.cn/tzgg/202604/t20260423_16623558.htm>

Note: The fourth round of the three-support and one-support plan covers 2021 to 2025. This time I did not find the fifth round documents and the 2026 annual notice. Please check the recruitment announcement for that year before registering. In 2025, the central government will support the recruitment of 34,430 people. The original text of the implementation plan of the Western Plan cannot be found online, and the policy section of the official website cannot open the content. Discounts after its expiration will be based on the documents issued by the General Office of the CPC Central Committee and the General Office of the State Council governing all grassroots service projects. I received financial subsidies in the past two years, not market wages. This price must be calculated together with the targeted examination two years later. How to identify graduates as fresh graduates and what to check before signing for a job, please see Article 17 of this section ("Fresh Graduates").

Case: After graduating, Xiao Chen participated in the "Three Supports and One Support" program, served in the township for two years and passed the examination. During the provincial examination, he only applied for targeted positions for grassroots project personnel, and was eventually admitted to a county-level unit. Later, ten points were added to the preliminary examination for the postgraduate entrance examination.

items.title: Special post teachers who have completed their three-year service period, passed the assessment and are willing to stay, should be admitted to the staff in a timely manner
items.core: Special post teachers are scheduled to serve for three years, and those who have passed the assessment and are willing to stay must be admitted to the staff in a timely manner. The 2025 notice generally requires applicants to have a bachelor's degree or above, mainly in the normal education category, be no more than 32 years old, and have a corresponding teacher qualification certificate. The salary and conditions are the same as those of local teachers. Please check the provincial announcement for that year before registering.
body: Cost: No money. The price is to teach in a rural compulsory education school for three years, and you must first obtain a teaching qualification certificate before entering. The hard thing is to be able to stay for these three years.

Income: The recruitment conditions written in the 2025 special post plan notice are: "Generally, a bachelor's degree or above is required, mainly in teacher training." "Age not exceeding 32 years old." The 2024 notice originally stated that students should be no more than 30 years old, and primary schools can recruit teachers to junior colleges appropriately; this old set of conditions cannot continue to be used when applying. You must also have the corresponding teacher qualification certificate. The 2024 notice also states: "Volunteers who have participated in the "College Student Volunteer Service West Plan" and have teaching experience, and graduates of normal colleges who have participated in internship teaching for more than half a year will be given priority for admission under the same conditions." "Support and encourage qualified retired military personnel to teach in primary and secondary schools, and the age limit for retired military personnel can be relaxed accordingly by taking into account factors such as years of service." The original text of the 2024 notice on benefits and inclusion is: "Starting from January 1, 2024, the salary subsidy standard for special post teachers will be increased. The central government will increase the annual per capita salary subsidy from 35,200 yuan to 38,800 yuan in the central region, and from 38,200 yuan to 41,800 yuan in the western region." "Under the same conditions, they will enjoy the same treatment as teachers in local public schools in terms of salary, professional title evaluation, merit evaluation, annual assessment, etc." "It is guaranteed that teachers on special posts who have completed their three-year service period, passed the assessment and are willing to stay on will be admitted to the staff in a timely manner and confirmed in their positions. Relevant personnel and salary relations and other transfer work will be done well. Seniority and teaching experience will be calculated continuously, and probationary periods will no longer be implemented." The 2025 notice continues to clarify: the central wage subsidy is 38,800 yuan per capita per year in the central region and 41,800 yuan in the western region. The 2025 notice also states that those who pass the assessment at the end of the three-year period and are willing to stay will be admitted in a timely manner. The objects of the age relaxation in 2025 are written as qualified outstanding retired soldiers and outstanding retired athletes, and cannot be judged only by the quotations in 2024 (nationwide)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: General Office of the Ministry of Education, General Office of the Ministry of Finance (2025). Notice on the implementation of the plan for special posts for school teachers in the rural compulsory education stage in 2025 (Teacher Office [2025] No. 1, 1 (3), 2 (3) (4)). <http://www.moe.gov.cn/srcsite/A10/s6991/202505/t20250523_1191696.html>; General Office of the Ministry of Education and the General Office of the Ministry of Finance (2024). Notice on the implementation of the plan for special posts for school teachers in the rural compulsory education stage in 2024 (Teaching Office [2024] No. 1). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202405/content_6950803.htm>

Note: The benefit level is set as "large" because joining the workforce upon expiration is equivalent to getting a long-term job, which is worth far more than 10,000 yuan. The Ministry of Education has published a notice for 2025, and the age requirement has been relaxed to 32 years old. For outstanding retired military personnel and outstanding retired athletes who meet the conditions, the age limit can also be relaxed accordingly according to the notice. The specific positions, subsidy standards and ages are subject to the notice of the year and the province’s implementation plan. The central government sets the general framework and the details are determined by the provinces. The teacher qualification certificate must be obtained first and cannot be applied for after joining the job.

Case: Xiao Liu, who graduated from a normal college, went to the county junior middle school to teach mathematics through the special post plan. After three years, she passed the assessment and applied to stay in the job. The county accepted her into the workforce in accordance with the policy, and her salary was paid at the same level as the local teachers.

items.title: Firefighters and military civilians are the other two open recruitment opportunities, and the threshold is lower than that of the public examination
items.core: The provisions of these two paths do not include the threshold of "college college or above." Firefighters are required to recruit people between the ages of 18 and 22 with a high school education or above. The age limit can be relaxed to 24 for those with a college degree or above and retired soldiers. The military civilian regulations stipulate that applicants must be at least 18 years old and have academic qualifications, and the maximum age for first-time recruitment in entry-level positions is 35 years old. The common price is political assessment and physical exam removal.
body: Cost: No money. From registration to recruitment, it takes several months to go through physical examination, political assessment, physical fitness test, psychological test and interview. It's difficult to defeat people in these levels one by one.

Benefits: Firefighters read the "Recruitment Methods for Firefighters in the National Comprehensive Fire Rescue Team". The fifth basic condition includes "age between 18 years old and below 22 years old" and "high school education or above." Article 6 "For personnel with a college degree or above, retired soldiers of the People's Liberation Army and the Armed Police Force, full-time government firefighters and full-time government forestry firefighters with more than 2 years of practical experience in fire fighting and rescue, the age can be relaxed to 24 years old; for special professionals urgently needed for firefighting and rescue work, the age can be further relaxed with the approval of the Ministry of Emergency Management, and in principle it shall not exceed 28 years old." Article 7 "Firefighters are openly recruited from the public, mainly from the permanent population of the provincial administrative region, and may also be recruited from other provinces as needed." The recruitment procedures written in Article 9 are "publicity and mobilization, organization registration, qualification review, physical examination, political assessment, physical fitness test and job adaptability test, psychological test and interview, public announcement, and recruitment." For military civilian personnel, please refer to Article 18 of the "Regulations on Civilian Personnel of the Chinese People's Liberation Army": "The military implements a civilian personnel recruitment and employment system that combines open recruitment, direct introduction, and special recruitment." These are three lines: recruiting through public examinations, directly introducing ready-made talents, and recruiting specifically for specific groups of people. The basic conditions in Article 9 of the regulations include "being 18 years of age or older", "complying with the political conditions for the recruitment and employment of civilian personnel in the military" and "meeting the educational level, professional level and work ability required for the position". Article 19 states that the maximum age for first-time recruitment of lower-level positions is 35 years old. The regulations also state that "civilian positions should give priority to the recruitment of qualified retired military personnel" (National)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security, Ministry of Emergency Management (2021). National Comprehensive Fire Rescue Team Recruitment Methods for Firefighters (Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security [2021] No. 58, Articles 5, 6, 7, and 9). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2021-08/27/content_5633684.htm>; State Council and Central Military Commission (2022). Regulations on Civilian Personnel of the Chinese People's Liberation Army (Second Revision, State Council and Central Military Commission Order No. 757, effective on January 1, 2023; Articles 9, 18, 19, and 20). <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=ff808181857bca5e01859ee5a6c06d62> (National Laws and Regulations Database)

Note: The "Regulations on the Promotion of Employment and Entrepreneurship of Veterans" that will be implemented on August 1, 2026 stipulates two additional things. First, a certain proportion must be allocated to the recruitment of firefighters, specifically recruiting retired sergeants and conscripts. Second, when recruiting auxiliary police officers (auxiliary police officers), priority should be given to recruiting retired military personnel under the same conditions. The annual quotas, positions and specific conditions for these two paths are subject to the announcement of that year. This book only describes the fixed thresholds in the method. Firefighters are a position in the disciplined forces, so think through the occupational risks before entering.

Case: Xiao Wang, a 22-year-old high school student, saw that the age limit for firefighter recruitment was relaxed. Those with a college degree can reach 24 years old. He applied several times, but was rejected due to strict physical or political assessments, and was eventually transferred to a military civilian position with a low threshold.

items.title: Academic qualifications are not a one-and-done deal: self-study exams are not limited to age and education level. Adult college entrance examinations and the Open University can be supplemented. Academic qualifications can only be found on Xuexin.com, and "exam-free guarantee" academic qualification improvement classes can be applied for.
items.core: If you are eighteen years old and have not completed your studies, there are three formal channels: self-study exams, adult college entrance examinations, and the Open University. Self-study exams are not limited to age or original academic qualifications, but full-time students cannot apply. The graduation certificate will only count if it can be checked on the Xuexin website. Once checked, the school cannot change it. Don't pay anyone who says "you don't have to study" or "you are guaranteed to pass the exam without taking the exam".
body: Cost: Registration fee and textbook fee are several hundred yuan per year. The price is long-term self-study, or taking classes on the side. The shortest time to study for a bachelor's degree without full-time work (study while working) is two and a half years. The difficulty lies in persisting for a long time.

Income: For self-study exams, please refer to the "Interim Regulations on Self-Study Examinations for Higher Education". Article 3: "Citizens of the People's Republic of China, regardless of gender, age, nationality, race or education level, may participate in self-study examinations for higher education in accordance with the provisions of these regulations." Article 20: "Students in full-time schools of all levels and types are not allowed to apply." Article 25 states the three conditions for obtaining a diploma: completing all courses and passing the exam, completing the graduation thesis or practical tasks, and passing the ideological and moral evaluation. Once you have done all of this, you will receive your diploma. This article also says, "Those who have obtained a junior college (basic subject) or undergraduate diploma will have their academic qualifications recognized by the state." Article 32 states the salary and benefits of diploma holders: "After non-employed personnel are hired, they will be the same as similar graduates from ordinary colleges and universities." Article 21 of the "Higher Education Law" "The state implements a self-study examination system for higher education. Those who pass the examination will be issued corresponding academic certificates or other academic certificates." For the adult college entrance examination, please refer to the "2025 National Admissions Measures for Adult Colleges and Universities". The registration targets are "employees and other members of society other than students in various high and secondary schools with nationally recognized academic qualifications." "Candidates who apply for junior college or junior college must have graduated from a senior secondary education school or have equivalent academic qualifications. Candidates who apply for junior college must have obtained...a junior college diploma, undergraduate certificate or above." "The minimum study time for off-the-job students is: four years for undergraduates and two years for junior college and junior college. The minimum study time for non-off-the-job students is: five years for junior college and two and a half years for junior college and junior college." Off-the-job means leaving work and studying at school full-time, while non-off-the-job means not leaving work and studying while working. For the Open University, please read the "Opinions of the Ministry of Education on Running a Successful Open University". It reads: "The Open University implements registration. Students who complete courses and obtain corresponding credits can obtain course certificates. Students who complete the prescribed credits and meet relevant requirements can obtain corresponding academic and non-academic certificates. Those who meet the degree-granting conditions should be awarded the corresponding degree" (National). For the authenticity of academic qualifications, please refer to the Ministry of Education’s “Electronic Registration Methods for Students’ Student Status and Academic Qualifications in Colleges and Universities”. Article 2 states that electronic registration is required for self-study graduation certificates. Article 5: Xuexin.com "is the only website for checking the electronic registration information of students' status and academic qualifications in colleges and universities." Article 19: After academic qualifications are registered and online inquiries are provided, "the school shall not change the certificate content and registration information." The red line for enrollment promotion depends on the 2021 notices from five departments including the Ministry of Education. Advertisements for academic continuing education "are not allowed to contain false and illegal content such as "no need to study" or "no need to attend classes". There must also be no explicit or implicit guarantees on educational effectiveness such as "quick certificate collection," "guaranteed passing without taking the test," or "refund if you fail to take the test." Institutions such as vocational colleges and training schools cannot issue academic qualifications, and advertisements must not confuse them with universities that can issue academic qualifications.
Level of Evidence: A

Source: State Council (1988, revised in 2014). Interim Regulations on Higher Education Self-Study Examinations (Articles 3, 20, 25, and 32). <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=ff8080816f3cbb3c016f415d64e5236d> (National Laws and Regulations Database); National People’s Congress Standing Committee (2018). Higher Education Law (Article 21). <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=ff8080816f135f46016f20df64ec16c5> (National Laws and Regulations Database); General Office of the Ministry of Education (2025). Notice on the National Adult College Enrollment Work in 2025 (Teaching Hall [2025] No. 6) and the attachment "2025" National Admissions Measures for Adult Colleges and Universities in 2016. <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202509/content_7040877.htm>; Ministry of Education (2016). Opinions on Running Open Universities (Jiaozhengcheng [2016] No. 2). <http://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2016/content_5067956.htm>; Ministry of Education (2007). Notice on further improving the management of various types of enrollment in colleges and universities (Jiaofa [2007] No. 13): "The enrollment plan for general junior college to bachelor's degree shall be arranged according to a proportion of no more than 5% of the general vocational (junior college) graduates of that year." <https://web.archive.org/web/20261008091350/http://www.moe.gov.cn/s78/A03/s7050/201006/t20100607_88782.html> (The original page has been offline, the link is to the web archive on October 8, 2026); Ministry of Education (2014). Notice on the issuance of the "Measures for the Electronic Registration of Student Status and Academic Qualifications of Higher Education Institutions" (Teaching [2014] No. 11, Articles 2, 5, and 19). <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2015/content_2806021.htm>; Five departments including the General Office of the Ministry of Education (2021). Notice on strengthening the management of advertisements for higher education continuing education (Teaching Office Letter [2021] No. 21). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2021-10/14/content_5642410.htm>; China Government Network (2020). This year, 189,000 master’s students will be enrolled, and 322,000 will be promoted from associate to bachelor’s degree—employment support for graduates. Vice Minister of Education Weng Tiehui: “Expand the scale of associate’s degree to bachelor’s degree in ordinary colleges and universities, and strive to increase the number of 322,000 people year-on-year.” <http://www.gov.cn/zhengce/2020-02/29/content_5484774.htm>; Fujian Provincial Education Examination Authority (2026). When forwarding, it is quoted as "Notice of the Department of College Students of the Ministry of Education on the Enrollment of the 2026 Junior College-to-Bachelor's Examination for General Colleges and Universities (Teaching Department Letter [2025] No. 53)". <https://www.eeafj.cn/gkzsb/20260310/14437.html>

Note: There is also a general junior college-to-bachelor program for recent full-time college graduates. The document publicly available at the national level is a 2007 notice from the Ministry of Education, which stated that the junior college to bachelor's degree program should not exceed 5% of that year's junior college graduates. Starting from 2020, the Ministry of Education has expanded the scale of junior college-to-bachelor degree programs, and plans to increase the number of students by 322,000 year-on-year that year. 5% This line is still not executed, and no clear text has been found. The specific arrangements for each year are issued by the Department of College Students of the Ministry of Education. For example, in 2026, the letter from the Department of Teaching and Learning [2025] No. 53. This letter will not be released to the public, and the document number can only be seen in the documents forwarded by the provinces. The enrollment targets are determined by each province. Basically, only current full-time junior college graduates of the province are accepted, so the main text does not include its conditions. Starting from the autumn of 2025, continuing education for higher education will no longer be called "correspondence education" or "amateur education", but will be uniformly called "non-off-duty education". Continuing education for higher education is a type of education that adults can complete later. Be careful with promotions that still use the old name. Supplementing academic qualifications and "what skills are cost-effective to learn" are two different things. See Section 23 for the latter. See Section 23, Article 8 for "quick certificates" and copycat certificates purchased with money.

Case: A 32-year-old technical secondary school graduate obtained a college certificate through self-study, and supplemented his bachelor's degree with the adult college entrance examination. Before applying, he checked with the examination institute and Xuexin.com, and the graduation certificate can be checked; a colleague paid for the "exam-free pass", but couldn't find the certificate when he got it, and refused to accept the job search.

items.title: Not joining a work unit means you have flexible employment: you must participate in pension and medical insurance at the place of employment. Household registration restrictions have been liberalized, and some megacities are gradually liberalizing them
items.core: Not joining a work unit does not mean that there is no such thing as social security, but there is no one to pay half of it for you. The document requires all localities to relax household registration restrictions for flexible employment personnel to participate in insurance in the place of employment, and individual megacities can gradually relax the restrictions. So don’t understand “freedom” as not having to worry about social security. If you stop paying, your pension and medical insurance reimbursement will be calculated according to the rules of stopping paying.
body: Cost: You have to pay the full amount of pension and medical care yourself. Calculated according to the local payment base, it is thousands of yuan per month. The payment base is the base number used to calculate premiums. This is the most easily missed fixed expense in flexible employment, and it is difficult to pay it on time every month.

Income: To apply for insurance, please refer to the "Guiding Opinions on Protecting Labor Security Rights and Interests of Workers in New Employment Forms". It reads: "All localities must relax the household registration restrictions for flexible employees to participate in basic pension and basic medical insurance in the place of employment. It is difficult for some very large cities to achieve this in one step. They must combine local realities and actively create conditions to gradually relax. Organize the flexible employment of employees who do not participate in basic pension and basic medical insurance for employees. Employed personnel shall participate in the basic pension insurance and basic medical insurance for urban and rural residents in accordance with regulations, and ensure that all employees are covered. Enterprises are urged to participate in social insurance in accordance with the law. Enterprises must guide and support workers in new employment forms that do not fully meet the conditions for establishing labor relations to participate in corresponding social insurance according to their own circumstances. The same document divides employment into three categories: "If the conditions for establishing a labor relationship are met, the enterprise shall conclude a labor contract with the workers in accordance with the law. If the conditions for establishing a labor relationship are not completely met but the enterprise conducts labor management of the workers...it guides the enterprise to enter into a written agreement with the workers...Individuals rely on the platform to independently carry out business activities, engage in freelance work, etc., and adjust the rights and obligations of both parties in accordance with civil laws" (National, starting from 2021)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security and other eight departments (2021). Guiding opinions on safeguarding the labor security rights and interests of workers in new employment forms (Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security [2021] No. 56, Articles 2 and 8). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2021-07/23/content_5626761.htm>; General Office of the State Council (2020). Opinions on supporting multiple channels for flexible employment (Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security [2021] No. 27). No.). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2020-07/31/content_5531613.htm>

Note: The original article said that household registration restrictions were "relaxed" and left a gap for megacities, not "has been canceled nationwide." To what extent you want to be liberalized, ask the city where you want to insure. The magnitude of the income is set as "large" because what is lost when the payment is stopped is the pension and medical benefits themselves, which are worth far more than 10,000 yuan. But the cost is real, with full self-payment of thousands of yuan per month. For how to make up for social security contributions after suspension and how to accumulate years, please see Section 7, Article 18 (Cessation of Social Security Payments). How to transfer the pension and medical insurance relationship after changing cities, see Section 19, Article 19 (Transfer of pension and medical insurance relationship to the new insured place). For the level of self-paid employee pension and how many years it takes to pay back the cost, see Section 5, Article 46 (Self-paid employee pension insurance). In addition, those who sell agricultural and sideline products and daily necessities at places and times designated by the government, or use their own skills to do convenience work that does not require permission according to law, do not need to apply for a business license. This article is written in the State Council Issue [2020] No. 27.

Case: Xiao Li resigned from his employer to work in design, thinking that he would not have to pay social security if he was free. Two years later, I fell ill and was hospitalized. I found that my medical insurance had been cut off and could not be reimbursed, so I quickly applied for new insurance at my place of employment according to my flexible employment status.

items.title: For those who deliver food, hire rides online, or haul freight within a city, the platform will pay you the occupational injury insurance fee per order (pilot), and you don’t have to pay
items.core: For those who deliver food, ride hailing online, or haul freight across the city, the platform will pay the occupational injury insurance fee for you on a per-order basis. You won’t have to pay a penny yourself, and you will be insured for each order you receive. This is still a pilot project. Before accepting an order, check whether your province and platform are within the scope. If you have already established a labor relationship with the platform, you can use work-related injury insurance instead of this method.
body: Cost: No cost, the money will be paid by the platform. What you need to do is check whether the platform you accept orders from is in the pilot program. There are two ways: Look for "Occupational Injury Protection" on the App's protection or rights page, or call the provincial Human Resources and Social Security Bureau and ask if the platform reports it.

Income: For this protection, please refer to the "Measures for Occupational Injury Protection for Personnel in New Employment Formations (Trial)". Article 2 reads: "Platform enterprises shall participate in occupational injury protection for persons in new employment forms in accordance with the provisions of these Measures... For persons in new employment forms who register and receive orders through the platform, provide travel, instant delivery, intra-city freight and other labor and receive compensation or income in the name of the platform enterprise, they shall pay occupational injury insurance fees to ensure that every order and every person must be insured. For workers subject to the provisions of the Work Injury Insurance Regulations, enterprises shall participate in work injury insurance in accordance with the law, and these Measures shall not apply." Article 9: "During the trial period, the travel industry will be charged 0.01 yuan per order; the instant delivery industry will be charged 0.07 yuan and 0.25 yuan per order; the intra-city freight industry will be charged 0.18 yuan per order." How to expand the pilot, look at this paragraph: "From July 1, 2025, on the basis of the 7 provinces and 7 platform enterprises that have been piloted... 10 provinces including Tianjin, Hebei, Liaoning, Zhejiang, Anhui, Fujian, Shandong, Hubei, Guangxi, and Ningxia will be added... In 2026, the occupational injury protection pilot will be promoted nationwide 31 Implemented by provinces and Xinjiang Production and Construction Corps; platform enterprises in the three industries of travel, instant distribution and intra-city freight will be included in the scope of the occupational injury protection pilot" (pilot, expanded year by year)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security and nine other departments (2025). Notice on expanding the pilot of occupational injury protection for personnel in new employment forms (Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security [2025] No. 24) and the attachment "Measures for Occupational Injury Protection for Personnel in New Employment Forms (Trial)" Articles 2 and 9. <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202507/content_7031656.htm>

Note: This is still a pilot project and is not a formal system across the country. Before accepting an order, confirm whether your province and platform are within the scope. If not, the only layer left is to buy your own commercial insurance. Another document, "Guiding Opinions on Safeguarding Labor Security Rights and Interests of Workers in New Employment Forms," ​​also puts forward several requirements. The remuneration paid by the platform to people who work normally should not be lower than the local minimum wage, and must be paid in full and on time, without deductions or unreasonable arrears. Reasonable remuneration must also be paid on statutory holidays. The document number of this document is Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security [2021] No. 56, which is also cited in the article on flexible employment, see Article 11. Do this beforehand, don't keep it secret from the site first. You must also participate in medical insurance and pension insurance yourself. See Article 11 for flexible employment insurance.

Case: Lao Wang runs a takeout business in a pilot city, and the platform pays occupational injury insurance premiums for each order. When he fell while delivering food, he was compensated for his medical expenses without spending a penny, which proved that he was protected without paying any fees.

items.title: On the day you apply for the college entrance examination, you can basically lock in two paths: public-funded normal school students and directed medical students (the number is determined by the province), the price is at least 6 years of performance
items.core: In both paths, the state will pay for you first, and you will work in the designated place for at least 6 years according to the agreement after graduation. Publicly funded normal college students are only recruited from the six normal universities directly under the Ministry of Education and are admitted in advance. Oriented medical students must sign a tripartite agreement before receiving their admission notice. If you break the contract, you will have to refund your money, pay liquidated damages, and have your credit history recorded, so think carefully about whether you can accept it in the next 6 years before applying for a job.
body: Cost: You don’t have to pay for tuition and accommodation, and you can also get living expenses subsidies. The price is that you will not be able to freely choose a job for 6 years after graduation. If you default, you will have to refund your money, pay liquidated damages, and have your credit record added. The difficulty is that I can't change places in these 6 years.

Benefits: Publicly funded normal school students should read the "Implementation Measures for Publicly Funded Education for Normal University Students Directly Affiliated to the Ministry of Education" (2024, the 2018 measures will be abolished at the same time). Article 2: The central government will bear the tuition fees, accommodation fees and living expenses subsidies for students while they are in school. Article 3: The focus is on training in prefectures (cities, states, leagues) and below outside the provincial capital cities in the central and western regions. It also states that "you are not allowed to teach in municipalities directly under the Central Government, cities under separate state planning, or in the main urban areas of provincial capital cities (except for the five autonomous regions, land border provinces, Hainan Province, Guizhou Province, and Qinghai Province)." Article 9: After graduation, students will generally return to teach in primary and secondary schools in the designated areas (cities, prefectures, leagues) in the province where the students are from, and "promise to engage in primary and secondary education for more than 6 years." Those who work in urban schools "should serve as teachers in rural compulsory education schools for at least one year." Article 13: If the contract is not performed or the time limit for performance is insufficient, the party shall bear liability according to the agreement. One of the consequences is that "defaults will be included in credit records and shared with the national credit information sharing platform in a timely manner, and default-related materials will be included in personal personnel files." Another sentence is, "Before the performance of the contract is completed, you will not be allowed to teach outside the designated place (city, state, league), and you will not be recruited (employed) as other public servants. After the performance of the contract is completed, the relevant credit will be restored." Before the service period stipulated in the agreement is completed, you cannot apply for other public positions; your credit record will not be restored until the service period is completed. Article 6: Those who are not suitable for teaching after admission will have their public education fees refunded within one year of admission and will be adjusted to a non-teaching major. Article 14: Those who fail to obtain a master's degree certificate in education and a teacher qualification certificate within the prescribed study period will be treated as a breach of contract, and the fees will be refunded and liquidated damages will be paid. Article 21: All localities shall meet the establishment required for public-funded normal school students to teach in primary and secondary schools within the total existing public establishment. Article 12 states that prefectures and cities organize employing schools to carry out special recruitment of public-funded normal college students, "through two-way selection and other methods to effectively confirm the teaching school and position for each graduating public-funded normal college student." Rural order orientation free medical students see another notification. After admission and before receiving the admission notice, an agreement must be signed with the county-level health and human resources department where the training school and targeted employment are located. The agreement requires "a commitment to serve in targeted rural primary medical and health institutions for 6 years after graduation." To fulfill a contract is to complete the work at the designated place according to the agreement. Regarding preparation, the notice states that the provincial health department "should actively seek support from the establishment department of local institutions and properly solve the employment placement problem of targeted medical graduates within the total local establishment and in accordance with prescribed procedures." Those who report to the central and western regions will be specially recruited by the county and "go through the employment formalities for formal staff of public institutions." After fulfilling the contract and reporting for employment, you must participate in three years of standardized training for general professional residents, referred to as standardized training. Regular training is the stage where you continue to practice your skills according to unified standards in the hospital after graduation. During the training period, the original personnel and salary relationships will remain unchanged. Breach records are included in personal personnel files and serve as the basis for integrity evaluation in public recruitment (recruitment) of administrative institutions such as medical and health institutions, standardized training and recruitment of residents, and graduate student admissions. Those who maliciously breach the contract will be publicized nationwide through the "Credit China" website, and joint punishment for breach of trust will be implemented. The defaulted training years will not be included in the service period. If fees and liquidated damages are not refunded in accordance with the agreement, the county-level health administration department will recover them through legal channels (nationwide)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: General Office of the State Council (2024). Notice on forwarding the "Implementation Measures for Publicly Funded Education for Normal University Students Directly Affiliated to the Ministry of Education" (Guobanfa [2024] No. 27, 2, 3, 6, 9, 12, 13, 14, 21) from the Ministry of Education and other departments. <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202406/content_6957261.htm>; National Health Commission, Central Office of the General Staff, National Development and Reform Commission, Ministry of Education, Ministry of Finance, Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security, State Administration of Traditional Chinese Medicine (2019). Notice on the employment placement and contract performance management of rural order-oriented and free training medical students. <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2019-11/13/content_5451684.htm>

Remarks: In 2024, the measure changed the public-funded normal school students to "undergraduate study connection" (undergraduate students continue to study for a master's degree in education). The old method in 2018 has been abolished, and the "teaching directly after graduating from a bachelor's degree" that is still circulated on the Internet is an old saying. If an agreement has been signed before the method is released, the original agreement will apply. "Having a staff" does not mean "just go in and forget about it": the staff must be allocated from the existing total, and the specific positions are specially recruited by the prefecture-level and city-organized employment schools, and you and the school choose each other. Regarding the preparation of targeted medical students, the document only states that they must strive for and properly solve the problem. Each province has different practices. Please read the provincial documents before filling in your application. It is possible for targeted medical students to leave after their service period expires. The document states that "at the end of their service period, consent should be given to those who choose their own careers." Those who have already defaulted can also have their default records erased. The price is to work for at least 6 more years according to the original agreement or to other rural grassroots institutions in the province, and the fees and liquidated damages paid will not be refunded. Medical students also need to count the three years of regular training, and the entire cycle is longer than that of normal schools. Each province also has its own plans for publicly funded normal students and targeted medical students. The conditions are determined by the province. Before filling in your application, please read the enrollment documents of the province for that year.

Case: Xiao Chen took the college entrance examination and took the public-funded normal college entrance examination. Tuition was free but he signed a 6-year agreement. After graduation, she was assigned to a township middle school, and the monthly salary was not high. She often regretted that she chose this shortcut without clearly seeing the cost of fulfilling the contract.

items.title: If you want to work abroad, first check whether the company is qualified to operate foreign labor cooperation: it is not allowed to collect a deposit from you
items.core: The law does not control you when it comes to working abroad, but the company that organizes you to go out. Only enterprises that have obtained the qualification certificate for foreign labor cooperation and have registered can do this. When you hear "get a tourist visa first and then transfer to a work visa", this sentence itself means that the other party is breaking the law. The company is also not allowed to collect a deposit from you for any reason, or ask you to use your property as security.
body: Cost: No money. Before departure, spend ten minutes to check the company's qualifications and read through the two contracts.

Income: Article 5 of the "Regulations on the Administration of Foreign Labor Cooperation": To engage in foreign labor cooperation, one must obtain business qualifications with the approval of the provincial or districted municipal commerce department. This business qualification is the foreign labor cooperation business qualification certificate. Without it, you cannot organize people to work abroad. Article 7: The list of business qualification certificates shall be reported to the commerce department of the State Council and notified to Chinese embassies and consulates abroad. This article also states, “No foreign labor cooperation operation qualification certificate shall be obtained and registered in accordance with the law.” Article 8: "No unit or individual may organize laborers to work abroad in the name of business, tourism, study abroad, etc." Article 9: Enterprises shall deposit a "foreign labor cooperation risk disposal reserve fund of no less than 3 million yuan" in a designated bank within 5 working days from the date of registration, and the deposit list shall be announced to the public. Article 10: The reserve fund is used to pay for refundable service fees, labor remuneration and legal compensation losses that the enterprise refuses to bear or is unable to bear. It is also used for "expenses required for workers to return home or receive emergency assistance due to emergencies." Article 11: Labor personnel shall not be organized to go abroad to engage in work related to gambling or pornographic activities. Article 12: Those who have not arranged training are not allowed to go abroad. Article 13: Personal accident insurance shall be purchased for laborers while working abroad. Articles 21 and 23: Written contracts must be concluded with foreign employers and laborers respectively. Without such contracts, employees are not allowed to go abroad. Article 25: "Deposits shall not be collected from laborers or laborers be required to provide property guarantees in any name." Article 26: The contract shall be reported to the competent commercial department for filing within 10 working days from the date of conclusion of the contract. Article 29: If the actual rights and interests of the labor service personnel are inconsistent with the contract, the enterprise shall assist in claiming compensation; if the due compensation is not obtained, the enterprise shall have the right to require the enterprise to bear compensation liability. Article 31: If the security situation in the relevant country or region makes it difficult to guarantee personal safety, enterprises shall not organize labor personnel to go there. Article 37: The competent commerce department shall establish a bad credit record and announcement system. The penalties are listed below. Article 39: Those who are not qualified to engage in foreign labor cooperation will be investigated and punished, and those who constitute a crime will be held criminally responsible. Article 40: Anyone who organizes trips abroad, lends qualifications, or organizes gambling and pornography-related work in the name of business, tourism, or studying abroad will have his business qualification certificate revoked. Article 43: Anyone who fails to sign a contract, conceals information, or provides false information to organize a trip abroad shall be fined not less than RMB 100,000 but not more than RMB 200,000. The main person in charge shall also be fined not less than RMB 20,000 but not more than RMB 50,000 (nationally)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: State Council (2012). Regulations on the Administration of Foreign Labor Cooperation (State Council Order No. 620, Articles 5, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 21, 23, 25, 26, 29, 31, 37, 39, 40, 43). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2012-06/11/content_1091.htm>

Note: The compliance process is as follows: the company first signs a written labor cooperation contract with the foreign employer, and then signs a written service contract or labor contract with you. The contract must state the work content, duration, remuneration, working hours, vacations, social security and personal safety risks. Within 10 working days after signing, the company must report to the competent commercial department for filing. The company must also arrange for you to receive training on skills, safety precautions, foreign languages ​​and local legal customs, and buy you personal accident insurance while working abroad. The other party won't let you see the contract, requires a deposit, and urges you to leave first and complete the formalities later. This is the kind of company you should avoid. Overseas high-paying recruitment scams and electronic fraud zones are in Section 21, Article 5, and safety reminders and 12308 to check before departure are in Section 21, which will not be repeated. The regulations do not set an educational level or age threshold for people who want to work. The threshold is based on the company's qualifications and whether the country where they work will grant permission. The company can only sign contracts with enterprises or institutions approved by that country, and cannot sign contracts with foreign individuals. The reserve fund is used by the competent department when the company defaults on its debts, and you cannot withdraw it yourself. Therefore, if something goes wrong, you must first file a complaint with the commercial department. Article 20 gives you this right to complain. If more than 100 people are sent to the same country or region, accompanying management personnel must be arranged and reported to the embassy or consulate for record. Projects with few people do not have this level of protection, and you need to keep contracts and transfer records yourself.

Case: Xiao Zhang applied for overseas labor service, and the agency asked him to pay a deposit of 20,000 to apply for a tourist visa to work visa. He verified that the company had no business qualifications and was acting illegally, so he called the police to recover the money and avoid being defrauded out of the country.

items.title: If you work remotely for an overseas company at home, the money will be counted as domestic income according to the tax law: you must file your own personal income tax, and if the foreign exchange collected exceeds the annual limit, you will go to "employee compensation"
items.core: The money is counted as domestic or overseas, depending on where you work, not where the money comes in. If a person works for an overseas company in China, his domestic income will be counted and he must pay personal tax in China. If an overseas company has no establishment in China, no one will withhold the tax for you, so you have to report the tax yourself. If you exchange currency within 50,000 US dollars per year, please present your ID card. The excess amount will be treated as "employee compensation" and you must submit an employment contract and income certificate.
body: Cost: No money. Final settlement and payment are made once a year, from March 1st to June 30th of the following year. When the remittance collection exceeds the annual total, an employment contract and income certificate must be prepared. The difficulty is that you have to remember to pay this tax yourself.

Income: Whether this money is counted as domestic income, please refer to Article 3 of the "Implementation Regulations of the Personal Income Tax Law" (State Council Order No. 707, effective from January 1, 2019). It reads: "Unless otherwise stipulated by the finance and taxation authorities of the State Council, the following income, regardless of whether the place of payment is within China, is income from within China: (1) Income obtained from providing labor services within China due to employment, employment, performance of contracts, etc." Article 6 of the same regulation defines two tax items. One is wages and salaries: "Wages and salary income refer to wages, salaries, bonuses, year-end salary increases, labor dividends, allowances, subsidies and other income related to employment or employment that an individual receives as a result of his or her employment or employment." The other is labor remuneration: "Income from labor remuneration refers to the income obtained by individuals from performing labor services, including income from design, decoration, installation, drawing, laboratory testing, testing, medical treatment, law, accounting, consulting, lecturing, translation, review, calligraphy and painting, sculpture, film and television, audio recording, video recording, performances, performances, advertising, exhibitions, technical services, introduction services, brokerage services, agency services and other services." Article 6 of the "Individual Income Tax Law" states how to calculate taxable income: "The comprehensive income of a resident individual shall be the balance after deducting RMB 60,000 in expenses, special deductions, special additional deductions and other deductions determined in accordance with the law from the income in each tax year." The same article also states that "Income from labor remuneration, author's remuneration, and royalties shall be the balance after deducting 20% ​​of the expenses from the income." The sentence "20% reduction" only lists these three items, and wages and salaries are not included. Therefore, wages and salaries are included in the income in full, and the taxes calculated for the two tax items are different. Article 9: "For personal income tax, the income earner is the taxpayer, and the unit or individual who pays the income is the withholding agent." Article 10: "Under any of the following circumstances, taxpayers shall file tax returns in accordance with the law: ... (2) There is no withholding agent for taxable income; ... (4) Foreign income is obtained." Article 11: "When a resident individual obtains comprehensive income, personal income tax is calculated on an annual basis...If it is necessary to make final settlement, the final settlement shall be made between March 1st and June 30th of the following year when the income is obtained." Qianhui came to read the "Personal Foreign Exchange Management Measures" (People's Bank of China Order [2006] No. 3, effective February 1, 2007). Article 9: "The annual total amount of personal foreign exchange settlement and domestic personal foreign exchange purchase shall be managed. If the annual total is within the annual total, it shall be handled at the bank with the person's valid identity document; if it exceeds the annual total, the current account shall be handled at the bank with the person's valid identity document and relevant certificates of transaction volume and other materials." Article 7: "Banks and individuals shall abide by the relevant provisions of these Measures when handling personal foreign exchange business, and shall not evade limit supervision through spin-offs or other methods, nor may they use false commercial documents or vouchers to evade authenticity management." Article 2 of the "Implementation Rules of Individual Foreign Exchange Management Measures" (Huifa [2007] No. 1): "The annual total amount of individual foreign exchange settlement and domestic individual foreign exchange purchase shall be managed. The annual total amount shall be the equivalent of US$50,000 per person per year." Article 10: "If the non-operating foreign exchange settlement under the current account of domestic individuals exceeds the annual total, it shall be handled at the bank with the person's valid identity document and the following supporting materials: ... (7) Employee compensation: employment contract and income certificate" (National)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: State Council (2018). Regulations for the Implementation of the Individual Income Tax Law of the People's Republic of China (State Council Order No. 707, Articles 3 and 6). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2018-12/22/content_5351177.htm>; Standing Committee of the National People's Congress (2018). Individual Income Tax Law of the People's Republic of China (2018 The seventh amendment of 2018, Articles 6, 9, 10 and 11). <http://www.npc.gov.cn/zgrdw/npc/xinwen/2018-09/05/content_2060671.htm>; State Administration of Taxation Policy and Regulation Database. Individual Income Tax Law of the People's Republic of China (Article 6). <https://fgk.chinatax.gov.cn/zcfgk/c100009/c5193028/content.html>; People's Bank of China (2006).
