Individual Foreign Exchange Management Measures (People's Bank of China Order [2006] No. 3, Articles 7 and 9). <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2007/content_786257.htm>; State Administration of Foreign Exchange (2007). Implementation Rules of Individual Foreign Exchange Administration Measures (Huifa [2007] No. 1, Articles 2 and 10). <https://www.safe.gov.cn/safe/2007/0105/22509.html>

Note: Which tax category is calculated depends on the relationship between you and the other party. What is signed is an employment contract, and the work is arranged by the other party, and wages are calculated. If you take on the work according to the project and deliver the results yourself, it will be counted as labor remuneration. The two calculated taxes are different, so you need to find out which one you are in before filing. When the money is remitted, if the annual value is less than 50,000 U.S. dollars, you can settle the exchange at the bank with your ID card; for the excess, you must submit the employment contract and income certificate to the bank. Don’t find someone to split the collection in order to bypass the limit. The above is a situation where the person is within the country and does not leave the country. It is another matter to actually go abroad to work for an overseas employer. See Article 14 of this section (if you want to work abroad, first check whether the company is qualified for foreign labor cooperation). The following four items have not yet been written in this book. They all may have actual costs, but there is currently no basis for verbatim verification. The first is whether this income needs to pay value-added tax and whether it needs to be invoiced on behalf of others. The second is whether you need to apply for a business license or register as a self-employed person if you want to do this for a long time. The third is whether you can claim rights from overseas employers in accordance with labor laws, such as annual leave, overtime pay, and termination compensation. The fourth is data export and confidentiality

Case: A designer works at home in Chengdu to design for a Singaporean company, and the remuneration is remitted from abroad on a monthly basis. If a person provides labor services in the country, she shall declare her domestic income in the annual accounting; when the exchange exceeds the convenient limit of US$50,000, she shall submit a contract and income certificate based on employee remuneration.

items.title: If you don’t work for your own company, start with a guaranteed loan for starting a business: up to 300,000 for an individual, half of the interest will be subsidized by the government
items.core: If you belong to key groups such as college graduates, retired soldiers, and unemployed people, start borrowing money with this loan that has a fiscal discount. An individual can borrow up to 300,000 yuan for a maximum period of 3 years, and the finance department will pay half of the interest for you. You and your spouse cannot have other loans in your name when applying. Mortgage loans, car loans, student loans and consumer loans under 50,000 yuan are not counted.
body: Cost: Consultation is free. First go to the human resources and social security department for qualification review, then go to the guarantee agency and the handling bank (the bank that lends the loan) to go through the procedures. The difficulty is that the borrowed money will eventually have to be repaid.

Income: Individual application conditions are written in Article 6 of the "Measures for the Management of Special Funds for Inclusive Financial Development" (Caijin [2023] No. 75). The first condition is to belong to key employment groups. The document lists registered urban unemployed persons, persons with employment difficulties (including disabled persons), retired military personnel, and persons released from prison. There are also college graduates (including university student village officials and students who have returned from studying abroad), employees of enterprises that have resolved excess production capacity, and the unemployed. There are also migrant workers who have returned to their hometowns to start businesses, online merchants, people who have been lifted out of poverty, and farmers who have started their own businesses in rural areas. The second condition is that there cannot be any other loans in the name: "Except for student loans, micro-credit for people who have been lifted out of poverty, housing loans, car loans, and small consumer loans under 50,000 yuan (including credit card purchases), when the applicant submits the application for a business guaranteed loan, the applicant and his spouse have no other loans." Article 9: "For qualified entrepreneurial guaranteed loans, the financial department will provide a fiscal discount of 50% of the actual interest rate of the loan. In principle, the financial department will not provide interest discounts for extended or overdue entrepreneurial guaranteed loans." Interest discount means that the government will pay half of the interest for you. Extension means extending it after it expires, and overdue means it has been overdue and has not been paid back. In these two cases, the finance department will no longer help you. Article 10: In principle, counter-guarantee will be canceled for entrepreneurial guaranteed loans of less than 100,000 yuan applied by individuals, and there is no need to find another person or provide property to the guarantee agency as guarantee. Article 11: Personal entrepreneurial guaranteed loans included in the scope of award and subsidy support “amount shall not exceed 300,000 yuan, and the loan term shall not exceed 3 years.” For partnerships, the amount can be increased appropriately, up to a maximum of 110% of the total individual quota limit. The upper limit of loan interest rates supported by incentives and subsidies is divided into three levels: LPR+50BPs in the eastern region, LPR+150BPs in the central and western regions, and LPR+250BPs in poverty alleviation areas. LPR is the bank loan market quoted interest rate, and BPs is the unit of measurement for interest rates. The more you add, the higher the interest. Those who are "active in repaying loans, have strong ability to promote employment, and have good entrepreneurial projects" can continue to apply after expiration, and the cumulative number of applications shall not exceed 3 times. Article 8: The applicant first applies to the local human resources and social security department for qualification review, and then submits the application to the guarantee agency and handling bank. Article 12: With the consent of the provincial people's government, localities can expand the scope of support, increase the amount and interest discount rate (national)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Ministry of Finance (2023). Notice on the issuance of the "Measures for the Management of Special Funds for Inclusive Financial Development" (Caijin [2023] No. 75, Articles 6, 8, 9, 10, 11, and 12). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202309/content_6903691.htm>

Note: The finance department will pay half of the interest for you, and it will not change the fact that "the borrowed money must be paid back". The position of this book in Section 12, Item 1 has not changed: when starting a business, only use the money you can afford to lose, leave your family assets intact, and do not sign personal guarantees for company loans, let alone your spouse. If you have decided to borrow, this kind of policy loan has the lowest interest rate. Don't touch consumer loans and private loans. The quota and scope of application can be adjusted upward in each province. The actual amount that can be approved shall be subject to the statement of the local social affairs department that year. During the 2020 epidemic, the notice of "the maximum individual limit of 200,000" was a temporary document. Now let's look at this method. Whether to open a store as a self-employed person or a company, licenses, tax filing and exit, see Section 12. For training subsidies, social security subsidies and employment apprenticeships during unemployment, see Section 7, Article 13 (Vocational Training Subsidies).

Case: Xiao Liu is unemployed and wants to open a small store but lacks start-up capital. He applied for a secured loan of RMB 300,000 to start a business, with half of the fiscal interest discount. Since he had no other loans, he was quickly approved, and a year later the store was back on track.

items.title: If you want to take the civil service examination within two years after graduation, before signing a job or transferring files, check the recruitment announcement and how to identify "fresh graduates": the national examination requires files and household registration to be left in school or a talent service agency
items.core: Many positions in the national examination mainly recruit fresh graduates. Those who have not confirmed their work unit, files and household registration within two years of graduation and still remain in the school or talent service agency are also considered fresh graduates. Different provinces have different opinions. In Fujian, if you sign a contract and pay social security, it will still be counted. So before signing a job or transferring files, check the announcement of the exam you want to take.
body: Cost: No money. Before signing up for an employer, spend half an hour looking up the announcements for the exams you want to take. The difficulty is that different places have different opinions, so we have to investigate each case.

Income: The National Examination 2027 recruitment announcement states that “institutions directly under the central government at the municipal (prefecture) level and below mainly recruit recent college graduates.” Question 3 of the application guide for the same year specifically answers whether previous students are considered fresh students. The original text is: "Graduates from general colleges and universities enrolled in a unified national system who have not confirmed their employment units when they leave school and during the career selection period (the state stipulates that the career selection period is two years), but whose household registration, files, and organizational relationships are still retained in the original school where they graduated, or who are retained in the graduate employment authorities at all levels (graduate employment guidance service centers), talent exchange service agencies at all levels, and public employment service agencies at all levels, can be treated as recent college graduates." The career selection period is the two years after graduation when you are looking for a job. Therefore, the national examination must meet two things at the same time: the work unit has not been confirmed within two years, and the files, household registration and organizational relationships have not been transferred to the employer. The provincial examinations are determined by the province itself. Fujian's 2023 notice reads: "The signing of employment agreements, labor contracts, social security payments, etc. by fresh graduates in that year will not affect their identity as fresh graduates; graduates from the previous year who have work experience and social security payment records can apply for fresh graduate positions." This article governs civil servants, public institutions, state-owned enterprises and central enterprises in Fujian. Chongqing’s 2025 notice writes the two exams separately. Civil servants in Chongqing should copy the original sentence from the National Examination. For public institutions and state-owned enterprises in Chongqing, as long as they have not been hired for a position within the establishment within two years, "the signing of their employment contract (agreement), work experience, social security payment, etc. will not affect their application" (nationwide, each province determines separately)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: National Civil Service Bureau (2026). Announcement of the 2027 Civil Service Examination Recruitment by the Central Government and its Directly Affiliated Agencies, and the Application Guide for the same year (No. 3, 11, 21, 48 Question), reprinted on the Tongren Municipal People's Government website. <https://www.trs.gov.cn/xwzx/tzgg/zkxx/202610/t20261013_90984626.html>; National Civil Service Bureau (2025). Application Guide for Civil Servants Recruited in the 2026 Examination of Central Agencies and Their Directly Affiliated Agencies (same text as Question 3), reprinted on the Beijing Municipal People's Government website. <https://www.beijing.gov.cn/fuwu/bmfw/sy/jrts/202510/t20251014_4222424.html>; Four departments including the Organization Department of the Fujian Provincial Committee of the Communist Party of China (2023). Notice on employment-related policies for fresh college graduates (Minren Shewen [2023] No. 84, Article 1). <https://rst.fujian.gov.cn/zw/zfxxgk/zfxxgkml/zyywgz/zynljs/202307/t20230706_6201113.htm>; Four departments including the Organization Department of the Chongqing Municipal Committee of the Communist Party of China (2025). Notice on Matters Related to the Employment of College Graduates (Trial) (Yu Renshe Gui [2025] No. 5, Articles 1, 2, and 3). <https://rlsbj.cq.gov.cn/zwgk_182/zfxxgkml/zcwj_145360/jfxzgfxwj/202504/t20250418_14533212.html>; Organization Department of the Central Committee of the Communist Party of China (2019). Regulations on the Recruitment of Civil Servants (Article 4). <https://www.12371.cn/2020/01/08/ARTI1578447606460158.shtml> (Published on the Communist Party Member Network)

Note: The National Examination Guide does not mention whether signing a labor contract and paying social security will count as "implementing the work unit." If you are not sure, call the consultation phone number of the recruitment agency listed in the recruitment brochure. Question 21 of the guide asks candidates to contact the recruitment agency directly. It is often said on the Internet that "if you pay social security, you are not considered a fresh graduate." This is the caliber of some exams and is not a unified rule across the country. The two quotations in Fujian and Chongqing cited above are just examples. Each province may change them every year. The announcements of the year you want to take the exam shall prevail. Those who participate in grassroots service projects such as Three Supports and One Support can also apply for graduate positions within two years of expiration. See Article 7 of this section (Grassroots Service Projects). The same application guide also states that this exam does not specify any tutorial books, nor does it organize or entrust any organization or individual to hold any tutorial classes. Article 4 of the "Regulations on the Recruitment of Civil Servants" states that the recruitment of civil servants shall adopt the methods of "open examination, strict inspection, equal competition, and merit-based admission." Therefore, if someone accepts money and promises "internal indicators" or "includes inclusion in compilation," it should be reported to the police as a scam. See Section 8, Article 3 (hard anti-fraud rules). The caliber of the national examination is based on the 2027 annual announcement as of October 2026, and the announcement of that year will also be followed every year in the future.

Case: Xiao Li signed a contract with a private company and paid social security a year after graduation. It was only when he transferred his files that he remembered about the national examination. After checking the announcement, I found that those who had moved out of their profile account were not considered fresh graduates, and they missed out on many positions that were only for fresh graduates.

items.title: Before paying tuition, check whether the school is on the list of certified institutions of the Overseas Service Center
items.core: If you need to use this diploma to study abroad, find a job, or take exams when you return to your country, you can apply for certification from the Study Abroad Service Center of the Ministry of Education. It publishes a list of schools that have been accredited in the past five years. Being on the list does not guarantee that you will be accepted, and not being on the list does not necessarily mean that you will not be accepted. Check before paying tuition, and ask more if it is not on the list.
body: Cost: No money. Enter the name of the school once in the "Certified School Inquiry" of the Study Abroad Service Center, and the search will be done in a few minutes

Benefits: Article 1 of the "Measures for Certification of Overseas (Overseas) Academic Degrees" of the China (Ministry of Education) Study Abroad Service Center states that certification is to "meet the needs of applicants for further studies, employment, examinations, etc." Article 2 states that certification is done "based on the applicant's independent application." The Service Center has a search portal for accredited schools. You can search by school name. Its instructions for use state that the list is of foreign certification institutions involved in applications that have passed certification in the past five years. "It is only for reference by overseas students and does not serve as a guarantee or basis for any certification." The notice also states that the scope of acceptance is "not limited to the institutions displayed in this query function." Each application is evaluated individually. Whether the school is legal and whether it has the qualifications to issue certificates is only one of the considerations. The list is updated annually. The 2025 update removed 270 schools that had not issued accreditation in the past five years. In addition, the Ministry of Education’s Education Foreign Supervision Information Network also publishes regulatory information on Sino-foreign cooperative education and overseas education
Level of Evidence: A

Source: China (Ministry of Education) Study Abroad Service Center. Accredited Institutions Inquiry (including instructions for use). <http://yxcx.cscse.edu.cn/>; China (Ministry of Education) Study Abroad Service Center (2023). Measures for the Certification of Overseas (Overseas) Academic Degrees (Articles 1 and 2). <http://zwfw.cscse.edu.cn/zwfw/lxfwzxwsfwdt2020/xlxwrz32/409891/rzbf/2026042823373762003/index.html>; Ministry of Education Education Foreign-Related Supervision Information Network. <https://jsj.moe.gov.cn/>

Note: The agency's claim that it is "recognized by the Ministry of Education" does not count. The results you check online shall prevail. The list will change. Those who were on the list when entering school may not be there when they graduate, so they should be reviewed every year while studying. There is also a certification and registration system for Sino-foreign cooperative education projects. Those who entered school after 2008 can check their registration serial number on the Foreign Supervision Information Network with their name and ID number.

Case: Before the student paid the tuition for his master's degree, he found on the official website of the International Service Center that the school recommended by the agency had very few certification records in the past five years. He immediately inquired and changed his application to a school on the list. Later, when I returned to my country to take public exams, I needed certification, and my diploma successfully passed the review.

items.title: The lawsuit focusing on the new F-1 regulations in the United States: "Up to four years, departure within 30 days after reading" was originally scheduled to take effect on September 15, 2026. It was suspended by the court the day before, and it is still "until reading is completed"
items.core: The United States originally wanted to change F-1 to a maximum of four years, and departure within 30 days after reading. A federal court put it on hold the day before it took effect. So the old rules are still there: study as long as you want, and you have 60 days to prepare to leave. Suspension is not abolition, the government can still appeal, and the rules can change at any time.
body: Cost: No money. Copy the project end date on your I-20 into your calendar to provide a 90-day reminder. I-20 is the certificate of study abroad qualification issued by the school. In addition, check the notice from the school’s International Student Office once every semester to see if there are any new developments in this lawsuit

Benefits: The Department of Homeland Security announced a rule on July 17, 2026, which was originally scheduled to take effect on September 15, 2026. The content is that F-1 students will no longer enter the country "until they complete their studies", but will enter the country for a fixed period, up to four years. At the end of the period, they must apply for an extension. After completing your studies or internship, you will only have 30 days to prepare to leave the country. On September 14, 2026, Judge Saylor of the Federal District Court for the District of Massachusetts stayed the entry into force of this rule pursuant to Section 705 of the Administrative Procedure Act. Suspension governs the whole country and governs the entire rule. The court did not strike down the rule, and the motion to strike down was denied but allowed to be brought up at a later date. The case is still ongoing. According to the court's order, people with F, J, and I visas can still enter the country "until they complete their studies." The 60-day departure grace period remains as usual, and there is no need to apply for an extension
Level of Evidence: A

Source: DHS (2026). Establishing a Fixed Time Period of Admission and an Extension of Stay Procedure for Nonimmigrant Academic Students, Exchange Visitors (announced on 2026-07-17, originally scheduled to take effect on 2026-09-15). Presidents' Alliance on Higher Education and Immigration v. U.S. Department of Homeland Security, No. 1:26-cv-13799-FDS (D. Mass. Sept. 14, 2026), Court Docket. <https://www.courtlistener.com/docket/74661796/presidents-alliance-on-higher-education-and-immigration-v-united-states/>; Yale Office of International Students & Scholars (2026-09-14). Important Update: Court Action on the D/S Rule. <https://oiss.yale.edu/news/important-update-court-action-on-the-ds-rule>; AILA (2026). One Day Before Taking Effect, Federal Court Postpones the F, J, and I Fixed Admission Period Rule. <https://www.aila.org/blog/think-immigration-one-day-before-taking-effect-federal-court-postpones-the-f-j-and-i-fixed-admission-period-rule>; 8 CFR 214.2(f). <https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-8/chapter-I/subchapter-B/part-214/section-214.2>

Note: This article is valid until September 25, 2026. The government could appeal to the First Circuit Court of Appeals, or the Department of Homeland Security could change the rules and reissue them. So for those who will study for several years, don’t assume that the old rules will remain unchanged. The court set a date of October 2, 2026, for another hearing to hear progress reports from both parties, and to read the school’s notice after that day. If the new regulations take effect in the future, if you want an extension, you will have to apply for an extension before the expiration date, and it will not be automatically renewed. Under the old rules, if you stop studying in advance, the departure period will be different from that of those who finish studying, so you should first ask the school's international student office. J visa is in the same rules, but the details are different from F-1. Please check according to your own visa category.

Case: Xiaoqian holds an F-1 status to study. He was originally worried that he would have to leave the country after four years under the new regulations in 2026. Sees the court's suspension came into effect. He finished the course according to the old rules and still had 60 days to find a job. He was relieved.

items.title: When studying and working abroad, first check the upper limit of working hours in the United States, Canada, Britain and Australia. Semester, holiday and work type should be calculated separately
items.core: Check the working hours according to country, work type and semester. Up to 20 hours per week for on-campus and approved off-campus part-time semesters in the US, and 20 or 10 hours per week for eligible courses in the UK. Maximum of 24 hours per week off-campus during Canadian terms and 48 hours per fortnight during Australian terms. There are different rules for holidays, internships and overseas remote work, and the same upper limit cannot be applied.
body: Cost: No money. Write down your working hours on a weekly basis. The difficulty is that employers will say "if you work a few more hours, no one will check", you can't believe this

Benefits: For F-1 students in the United States, on-campus work must not exceed 20 hours per week during the semester. Off-campus part-time employment approved under paragraph (f)(9) of the regulations is also limited to a maximum of 20 hours per week during the semester. Qualifying leave may be taken full-time. Curriculum internships, CPT and other work are also implemented according to the internship category and approved scope. The above upper limit cannot be applied to all off-campus work. For UK student visas, working hours also depend on whether the school and course meet regulations. Sponsored by a higher education institution with a record of compliance, 20 hours per week during semester for full-time degree and above courses. Full-time, below-degree courses guaranteed by this type of institution, 10 hours per week. Short-term exchange programs at overseas universities that meet the regulations are also available for 20 hours per week during the semester. Other courses, including part-time courses, do not allow part-time work. You are generally not allowed to be self-employed (work for yourself), nor are you allowed to work as a professional athlete or in the entertainment industry. The basis is that part of the British immigration rules that governs students, Appendix Student ST26.1, ST26.5, ST26.8. Eligible students in Canada can work off-campus up to 24 hours per week during the normal semester, and the hours for multiple off-campus jobs are combined. The basis is section 186(v) of the Canadian Immigration Regulations Implementing Regulations IRPR. During normal holidays arranged by the school, you can work full-time if you meet the conditions. Working remotely for an employer outside of Canada does not count against this 24-hour limit but is still subject to study permit conditions. For eligibility during the final semester and program transition period, see Article 4 (Full-time, Leave of Absence, and Transfer). Australian student visa, up to 48 hours per fortnight during course. Research masters, PhDs and their families are exempt from this restriction
Level of Evidence: A

Source: 8 CFR 214.2(f)(9), (10). <https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-8/chapter-I/subchapter-B/part-214/section-214.2>; UK Home Office. Immigration Rules Appendix Student (ST26.1, ST26.5, ST26.8). <https://www.gov.uk/guidance/immigration-rules/immigration-rules-appendix-student>; IRCC. Work off campus as an international student. <https://www.ircc.canada.ca/english/helpcentre/answer.asp?qnum=499>; Australian Government Department of Home Affairs. Student visa (subclass 500). <https://immi.homeaffairs.gov.au/visas/getting-a-visa/visa-listing/student-500>

Note: The working conditions of this article will be effective on October 21, 2026. Reviewed daily. Off-campus work in the United States requires prior approval based on category. If you need to apply for permission from the Immigration Bureau, you cannot start work while the I-765 is still being processed. Curriculum internship CPT is authorized by the designated person in charge of the school and endorsed on the I-20. Not all off-campus work requires an I-765. The old license in Canada was printed with 20 hours per week. As long as the conditions are still met, it can actually be 24 hours, subject to the current regulations. Normal vacation refers to the vacation arranged by the school, not the suspension of classes on its own. The scope of restrictions on self-employment in the UK includes taking on private jobs, opening online shops, and doing freelance work. Specific exceptions to the transfer period must be checked against official UK rules.

Case: Xiao Sun was studying in the United States and worked part-time outside the school for more than 20 hours a week during the semester. He was warned for violating the rules. She checked the regulations and dared to schedule more shifts during holidays to avoid visa problems.

items.title: Before reducing your study abroad status to part-time, taking a leave of absence, dropping out of school, or transferring to another school, check your eligibility for part-time work and exceptions
items.core: Whether you can work part-time while studying abroad should be checked based on the host country and your student status. When you are approved to take a leave of absence from school or transfer to another school but are not studying in Canada, you cannot use your study permit to work outside the school. However, you can still work if you meet the conditions by taking a small number of courses in the last semester, completing the old project and then connecting to the new project. Even if the visa has not expired, it cannot replace the qualification check.
body: Cost: No money. Before suspending classes, taking a leave of absence, or changing schools, first go to the school's international student office and ask about your identity status

Benefits: When you work in Canada according to the qualifications attached to your study permit, you are not allowed to work off-campus during the approved leave of absence. Those who are not studying during the transfer period are not allowed to work outside the school until they resume their studies. However, there is an exception in the last semester: if you change to part-time because you do not need a full course load to complete the course, and you have been full-time before, you can still work outside the school. All other working conditions must also be met. The gap period between completing the old project and studying for the new project, and a set of conditions for full-time employment, must be met at the same time. I have met the qualifications for off-campus work while studying in the past. Hold a valid study permit, or have applied for an extension before expiration. Have received written confirmation of completion of the program from the original school, as well as an admission letter from the designated learning institution for the new full-time program. Designated Learning Institutions are referred to as DLIs. The new project must begin within 150 calendar days of receipt of confirmation of completion of the old project. This is different from transferring to another school and suspending classes before completing your studies. You cannot start working just based on "new admissions." Eligibility for on-campus employment in the United States requires F-1 students to have Active status in SEVIS. SEVIS is the identity filing system for international students in the United States. Active is valid only if you are currently studying. Students must also meet the academic requirements to maintain status, and ask the school to check whether they meet the exception before reducing classes. Work permits in the UK are granted based on school and course type. Part-time courses are not allowed to work.
Level of Evidence: A

Source: IRCC. Work off campus as an international student. <https://www.canada.ca/en/immigration-refugees-citizenship/services/study-canada/work/work-off-campus.html>; U.S. Department of Homeland Security, Study in the States. Working in the United States. <https://studyinthestates.dhs.gov/students/work/working-in-the-united-states>; U.S. ICE SEVP, SEVIS Help Hub. Terminate a Student. Student (ST26.1). <https://www.gov.uk/guidance/immigration-rules/immigration-rules-appendix-student>

Note: The academic pressure is high. Before you want to reduce classes, ask clearly: How much reduction will be considered as full-time. This one will cause trouble earlier than working part-time. In the United States, if your SEVIS record is terminated by a school for violating status regulations, there is no grace period. You must either apply for restoration of status or leave the country immediately. Those who are approved to withdraw from school early will have a 15-day departure period. The rules of the other three countries are different, please check the page of the immigration bureau of the country where you are located. Don’t wait for an official letter from the school before taking action.

Case: Xiao Zhou transferred to another school in Canada. During his break, he thought he could work if his study permit was valid. After working part-time, I was investigated and found out that I could not work off-campus if I had transferred to another school and not enrolled in school, which almost affected my subsequent study permit.

items.title: United States: You must report a new address within 10 days after moving
items.core: If you change your place of residence in the United States, the law requires you to notify the Immigration Bureau within 10 days. Failure to report is no small matter. Firstly, it is illegal in itself, and secondly, you may not receive the letter sent to you by the Immigration Bureau.
body: Cost: No money. Submit an address change online in ten minutes

Benefits: US Federal Immigration Regulations 8 CFR 265.1 stipulates that foreigners who are required to register by law must report a change of address within 10 days. Report to USCIS (U.S. Citizenship and Immigration Services) in the manner required by it, reporting both the change of address and the new address
Level of Evidence: A

Source: 8 CFR 265.1. <https://www.uscis.gov/ar-11>; UK Government. Report a change of circumstances if you have a visa or expired BRP. <https://www.gov.uk/change-circumstances-visa-brp>; Australian Government Department of Home Affairs. See your visa conditions (Student visa subclass 500). <https://immi.homeaffairs.gov.au/visas/already-have-a-visa/check-visa-details-and-conditions/see-your-visa-conditions?product=500>

Note: After reporting to the Immigration Bureau, the school’s SEVIS record (your international student identity file) must be updated separately. If you hold a visa or residence card in the UK, you must report if your situation changes. If your address changes, you must change it in your UKVI account. The Australian student visa carries condition No. 8533, which is called "inform the school of your address". The same regulations were not found in Canada this time. The deadlines and methods vary from country to country. Please refer to the website of the Immigration Bureau of your country.

Case: Xiao Wu moved to an apartment while studying in the United States and forgot to report the new address within 10 days. The letter from the Immigration Bureau was lost when sent to the old address, and I almost missed an important notice. I hurriedly reported it and updated the information online.

items.title: Before departure and while studying, take a look at the Ministry of Education’s study abroad warning
items.core: The Ministry of Education will issue a warning specifically for a certain country or region, saying that the recent public security or policies there are unfavorable to Chinese international students. This is an official publicly released risk warning, which can be found in black and white, and is more reliable than the intermediary’s statement. It doesn’t cost anything to take a look.
body: Cost: No money. Read it once before departure and once every semester thereafter

Benefits: The Ministry of Education issues a study abroad warning through the Education Foreign Supervision Information Network. A total of 4 numbers were issued in 2025. Reminder No. 1: The higher education bill passed by relevant states in the United States contains negative provisions related to China (2025-04-09). No. 2 and No. 3 twice reminded that the Philippines has frequent cases against Chinese citizens and a poor study environment (2025-07-18, 2025-08-30). Reminder No. 4: The security situation in Japan and the study-abroad environment are not good. It is recommended to plan carefully to study in Japan (2025-11-16)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Ministry of Education’s Education Foreign Supervision Information Network. Early Warning Information. <https://jsj.moe.gov.cn/>; The Ministry of Education issued the No. 4 Study Abroad Early Warning in 2025. <https://jsj.moe.gov.cn/n2/2/2/2060.shtml>; No. 1. <https://jsj.moe.gov.cn/n2/2/2/2001.shtml>

Note: The warning is not a ban, nor does it mean you cannot go. It gives you an official basis for weighing local risks. The warning list changes with the situation, and this section will not be updated for a long time. The current page on the website shall prevail. See Section 21 for personal safety and consular protection abroad.

Case: Xiao Zhou was going to study for a master's degree in a certain country. Before departure, he searched on the official website of the Ministry of Education and saw the country's recent security warning against Chinese students. He postponed his trip, rebooked his dormitory, avoided the local bag snatching period targeting Asians, and landed safely.

items.title: Australia: OSHC must cover the entire journey and cannot be interrupted in the middle. If you cannot take out the insurance upon landing, you may be refused entry
items.core: Australia has written international student medical insurance into the visa conditions. Unless exemptions are met, it is not available or not. The insurance must cover the entire period of stay, and there must be no gap in between when renewing or changing the policy. If you cannot produce proof of insurance when entering the country, you may be refused entry on the spot. Family members who come to accompany you to study must also have this insurance.
body: Cost: several thousand to tens of thousands of RMB. Buy it in one go according to the duration of the visa, and buy it for several years after studying

Benefits: The Australian Ministry of Home Affairs stipulates that student visa applicants and their family members must buy Overseas Student Health Insurance (OSHC), and they must cover the entire stay in Australia without interruption. Insurance must be provided by an insurance agency recognized in Australia. Excludes those that qualify for exemptions. There must be no gap between the new insurance and the insurance for the previous visa. If you cannot show proof of insurance when entering the country, you may be refused entry. If you enter earlier than the start time of the course, the insurance start date should be written on the day you actually arrive in Australia
Level of Evidence: A
Source: Australian Government Department of Home Affairs. Student visa (subclass 500). <https://immi.homeaffairs.gov.au/visas/getting-a-visa/visa-listing/student-500>

Remarks: If the school is acting as an agent, you must ask clearly for the name of the insurance company, policy start and end dates, and policy number. These are required in the visa application. Buying short will cause problems with renewal. It is better to buy and keep more after graduation.

Case: Xiao Li changed his OSHC policy when renewing his Australian study permit. The start date of the new policy was two days later than the expiry date of the old policy. When entering the country, the customs system found a gap, and he was taken to a secondary inspection. He purchased insurance on the spot to cover the gap before being released.

items.title: UK: In addition to the visa fee, there is an annual medical surcharge, which is 776 pounds per year for students. It is paid in one lump sum when applying
items.core: The money you have to pay to go to the UK is more than the visa fee. You also need to pay a medical surcharge in advance based on the number of years of your visa. Only after paying it can you use the British National Medical Service. A two-year visa is a one-time payment of £1,552. In addition to the visa fee, this amount must be paid in one lump sum before departure, so don’t miss it in your budget.
body: Cost: Visa fee £558. The medical surcharge is £776 per year. Both are paid in one lump sum when applying

Benefit: The cost of a UK student visa is £558. This number applies when applying outside the UK, extending or converting within the UK. There is also a medical surcharge, which must be paid in order to use the British National Medical Service. It must be paid in advance when applying based on the number of years of the visa. The fee for the student and his dependents is £776 per year, for example, a 2-year visa is £1,552. Applicants in other categories are £1035 per annum. If the visa is for more than 6 months and less than 1 year, it will be charged for a full year
Level of Evidence: A

Source: UK Government. Student visa. <https://www.gov.uk/student-visa>; UK Government. Pay for UK healthcare as part of your immigration application. <https://www.gov.uk/healthcare-immigration-application>

Note: The amount and exchange rate will change, and the calculation is based on the current figures on the two pages in the source. Those who are studying a degree program and are over 18 years old can generally stay for a maximum of 5 years, and those who are studying below a degree are 2 years. Estimate how much surcharge will be paid based on this number of years.

Case: When a student applied for a two-year British student visa, the budget only included tuition fees and visa fees, and the system also required a one-time payment of a medical surcharge of GBP 1,552. The application will continue only after the payment is paid. After arriving in the UK, you can use the NHS with your visa, and you do not have to pay the full fee for each medical visit.

items.title: Allow time for certification before returning to your country: it takes 10 to 20 working days for certification to stay in the server
items.core: If you want to use your foreign academic qualifications when you return to your country, you must first get your academic degree certified. The review alone will take 10 to 20 working days, plus the time for preparing materials. There are deadlines for autumn recruitment, public examination registration, and settlement. Don’t wait until you need to use it.
body: Cost: Apply online and pay online. Preparation of materials plus review is calculated based on working days, plus or minus one month

Income: Overseas (overseas) academic degree certification is handled in the online service hall of the China (Ministry of Education) Study Abroad Service Center. The process is four steps: registration and real-name authentication, online submission of application and materials, online payment, and other evaluation and review. The published lead time for certification is 10 to 20 business days. Working days do not include weekends and holidays. This period is the time used by the Overseas Service Center for review
Level of Evidence: A
Source: China (Ministry of Education) Study Abroad Service Center. Online Service Hall·Academic Degree Certification. <http://zwfw.cscse.edu.cn/>

Remarks: The materials to be submitted include the following: diploma certificate, passport or pass, residence card or visa endorsement, ID photo, authorization statement. The entry and exit records during your stay abroad are retrieved by the system itself, so don’t lose your visa pages while you are abroad. Announcements will also be posted on the website of the International Student Service Center, stating which certification certificates will be invalidated and which schools’ certification applications will be suspended. Before applying, check to see if your school is involved.

Case: An international student returned to China in December to participate in school recruitment. After submitting the certification, he found out that the review would take 10 to 20 working days, and it took several more days to supplement the materials. He missed the online application deadline; the student applied for it one month in advance to catch up with the registration and subsequent settlement.

items.title: Search the name of the school in the announcement of the International Service Center before registering. Schools that have been subject to "enhanced review" will have to wait at least 60 working days for certification
items.core: The International Service Center will name a group of foreign colleges and universities, conduct separate strengthening reviews of their academic certification, and will also suspend the acceptance of certification applications from individual schools. It is much easier to search the school name before registering than to appeal afterward.
body: Cost: No money. Before registering, search the school name in the notices and announcements of the Study Abroad Service Center.

Benefits: The China (Ministry of Education) Study Abroad Service Center has been issuing announcements to strengthen the certification review of the academic degree certification of some foreign institutions (the diplomas of these schools will be checked separately). The latest one is No. 9 (2025-10-28), naming 4 schools. During the enhanced review period, the accreditation applications of these schools will "in principle take no less than 60 working days from the date of submission of the accreditation application (inclusive)". The basis is Article 28 of the "Measures for the Certification of Overseas (Overseas) Academic Degrees": If the certification data is abnormal, or if clues are received reflecting problems, etc., the Overseas Chinese Service Center can initiate a strengthened review, require applicants, schools, etc. to assist in providing materials, and extend the certification period. In May 2025, the Foreign Service Center also issued an announcement to "re-strengthen the certification review" to three schools. The Service Center also issued an announcement suspending the acceptance of accreditation applications from individual overseas institutions. The anti-fraud reminder in August 2025 states: "Any organization or individual claiming "certification included", "internal channel certification", "epidemic supplementary enrollment", "expedited certification", etc., is false propaganda."
Level of Evidence: A

Source: China (Ministry of Education) Study Abroad Service Center. Announcement on Strengthening Certification Review of Academic Degree Certification of Some Foreign Institutions (9) (2025-10-28). <https://www.cscse.edu.cn/cscse/sy/tzgg/2025102809225023345/index.html>; China (Ministry of Education) Study Abroad Service Center (2025-08-29). Important tips on guarding against fraud through the use of foreign (overseas) academic degree certification. <https://www.cscse.edu.cn/cscse/sy/tzgg/2025082913242989351/index.html>; China (Ministry of Education) Study Abroad Service Center (2023). Measures for the Certification of Foreign (Overseas) Academic Degrees (Article 28). <http://zwfw.cscse.edu.cn/zwfw/lxfwzxwsfwdt2020/xlxwrz32/409891/rzbf/2026042823373762003/index.html>; China (Ministry of Education) Study Abroad Service Center. Notices and Announcements. <https://www.cscse.edu.cn/cscse/sy/tzgg/index.html>

Remarks: "Strengthened review" means more checks and a longer period, which does not mean that the certification will not be guaranteed. Anyone who promises "certification included" and "expedited internal channels" is false advertising according to the prompts of the service center. If you hire someone to write papers or take online classes across the border, your academic qualifications will be invalidated and your visa record may also be affected if found out.

Case: Before Xiao Wang registered, he searched for his intended school in the announcement of the Service Center and found that it was on the "strengthened review" list and it would take 60 working days for certification. He decisively changed his application to another school with normal accreditation, and half a year later he successfully obtained academic certification.

items.title: United States: For those who do OPT after graduation, record the number of days without work. The total number cannot exceed 90 days. The total number of days for STEM extensions cannot exceed 150 days
items.core: OPT is the United States’ permission for F-1 students to work as internships after graduation. During this period, your identity is supported by having a job. Status may be terminated after 90 days without work. If you get a STEM extension, the total period cannot exceed 150 days. If you don't have an employer registered in the school system, you don't have a job.
body: Cost: Nothing. Write down the start and end dates of each non-working day. After finding a job, immediately report the employer information to the school. The difficulty is that when you have trouble finding a job, the number of days will go up day by day.

Benefits: U.S. federal immigration regulations 8 CFR 214.2(f)(10)(ii)(E) provide that during the post-graduation OPT period, status is dependent on employment. The cumulative number of days without work may not exceed 90 days. If you get a 24-month STEM extension, the total OPT period must not exceed 150 days, including the period before the extension. The official description of the US Student Exchange Program (SEVP) states: If there is no employer information in the SEVIS record, it will be counted as not having a job. After a cumulative total of 90 days, the SEVP officer may manually terminate the student's status. SEVIS is the U.S. international student identity filing system. The application time is according to the USCIS page: you can apply starting 90 days before graduation and 60 days after graduation at the latest. After the school enters the recommendation in SEVIS, it must be submitted within 30 days.
Level of Evidence: A

Source: 8 CFR 214.2(f)(10)(ii)(E), (f)(11)(i)(B). <https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-8/chapter-I/subchapter-B/part-214/section-214.2>; U.S. ICE SEVP, SEVIS Help Hub. F-1 Optional Practical Training (OPT). <https://studyinthestates.dhs.gov/sevis-help-hub/student-records/fm-student-employment/f-1-optional-practical-training-opt>; USCIS. Optional Practical Training (OPT) for F-1 Students. <https://www.uscis.gov/working-in-the-united-states/students-and-exchange-visitors/optional-practical-training-opt-for-f-1-students>; DHS (2026). Optional Practical Training Fees (proposed rule published 2026-10-08). <https://www.federalregister.gov/documents/2026/10/08/2026-20660/optional-practical-training-fees>

Note: This article is valid until October 14, 2026. The rules of OPT are changing, and there are two things to keep an eye on. First, the suspended new rule in Article 2 (the lawsuit over the new F-1 rule) changed the "application within 60 days after graduation" to 30 days. What is currently displayed on the eCFR website is the text of the new regulations, so the safest way is to submit the application before graduation. Second, the Department of Homeland Security proposed on October 8, 2026, a fee for OPT. The first OPT is US$70,000, and each subsequent period is US$30,000. This is just a proposal, and comments are being solicited until November 9, 2026, and have not taken effect. If you plan to stay and work in the United States after studying, you should include this possible amount of money before paying tuition, and check again before submitting your application.

Case: Xiao Liu changed jobs during OPT, but the new employer did not enter the school system in time, and he did not record the number of days. When I remembered, I had already been unemployed for 88 days. I quickly registered and found a new employer, so I didn’t trigger the 90-day red line and have my status terminated.

items.title: Canada: Before applying for a study permit, you must first obtain a provincial certification letter (PAL/TAL) through the school. Master's and doctoral students in public universities will not need it starting from 2026.
items.core: When going to Canada to study, most people need to submit a provincial certification letter when applying for a study permit, which proves that you have occupied the study abroad quota in that province. This letter cannot be submitted later. If you apply again after your study permit is approved or rejected, or if you transfer to another school, you have to get it again. Those studying for master's or doctoral degrees in public universities do not need to.
body: Cost: No extra money, just apply to the school that admitted you. In most cases, you have to accept admission and pay part or all of the tuition before the school can help you.

Benefits: Immigration and Refugee Canada (IRCC) says that the letter of certification is issued by the province or territory where you are going to study. It proves that you have been assigned a study abroad place there. It must be attached to most visa applications and must be submitted together with the application, not as an afterthought. Not required for students in kindergarten through 12th grade. From January 1, 2026, those studying master’s and doctoral degree programs in public institutions will not need to do so. If you go to study in Quebec, you must submit a Certificate of Acceptance (CAQ) issued by the Province of Quebec. Exchange students who do not pay tuition, students who are renewing their visas at the same school and at the same stage of study, and several other special circumstances are not required. Those who do not need to pay must attach proof of exemption when applying. The certification letter is generally only valid for the year of issue, or until December 31, 2026 for those issued in 2026. It doesn’t matter if it is valid when you apply for your study permit, and it doesn’t matter if it expires when school starts. If you apply again after your study permit is approved or rejected, you must obtain a new certification letter. Starting from January 22, 2025, transfer students will also need to get a new
Level of Evidence: A

Source: IRCC. Provincial attestation letter or territorial attestation letter (page modified on 2026-09-02). Modified on 2026-10-06). <https://www.canada.ca/en/immigration-refugees-citizenship/services/study-canada/study-permit/get-documents.html>

Note: This article is valid until October 14, 2026. Canada's study abroad quota is re-determined every year, and the exemption list has been changed several times. Please check the page in the source column of your pre-application photo again. Before exchanging the tuition exchange certification letter, ask the school how much the tuition fee will be refunded if the study permit is rejected. For the upper limit of working hours while studying in Canada, see Article 3 (Hours of Working).

Case: When Xiao Zhao applied for a Canadian study permit, he found out that the school did not issue him a PAL. He thought he could make up for it later, but the application was returned. He waited for the school to reissue it before applying for a visa. He waited for four more months in vain and missed the scheduled autumn enrollment.

sections.title: How to live after being disabled

items.title: If you suddenly have a severe headache and sweating after spinal cord injury, please sit upright, loosen your clothes, and call 120 at the same time.
items.core: People with spinal cord injuries have a section of their body's alarm circuit broken. My bladder is full and my clothes are tight. I may not feel it, but my blood pressure will shoot up. Signs are a sudden severe headache and sweating. At this time, first help the person sit upright, loosen the tight clothes, check whether he is holding back urine, and call 120 at the same time.
body: Cost: Nothing. Three actions, completed in dozens of seconds.

Benefit: This attack is called autonomic dysreflexia. A systematic review searched four databases: Medline, CINAHL, EMBASE and PsycINFO, and included 31 studies, 6 of which were randomized controlled trials. The review stated that the non-pharmacological treatment of an attack is three steps: placing the patient in an upright position, loosening tight clothing, and removing the triggering stimulus. These three steps are based on clinical consensus and physiological data and are Level 5 evidence. The text of the review states that such attacks are more common in injuries involving thoracic segments 6 and above, with the most common trigger being irritation of the bladder or bowel. Stimulation below the injury level triggers a large amount of sympathetic nerve discharge, blood pressure rises sharply, and the sensation below the injury level is partially or completely lost. Symptoms include severe headache, profuse sweating above the level of the injury, or no symptoms at all. Left untreated it can lead to intracranial hemorrhage, seizures and even death. No studies have specifically measured the effects of sitting up during an attack, but resting blood pressure drops significantly when people with spinal cord injuries switch from lying down to sitting up or leaning. Antihypertensive drugs should only be used if blood pressure is persistently elevated, with level 1 evidence for prazosin and level 2 evidence for nifedipine and prostaglandin E2. The review also stated that strategies to prevent attacks mainly target the two common triggers of urogenital system and surgery, and most of them are only supported by level 4 and 5 evidence.
Level of Evidence: B

Source: Krassioukov A, Warburton DE, Teasell R, Eng JJ; Spinal Cord Injury Rehabilitation Evidence Research Team (2009). A systematic review of the management of autonomic dysreflexia after spinal cord injury. Archives of Physical Medicine and Rehabilitation, 90(4):682-695. <https://doi.org/10.1016/j.apmr.2008.10.017>

Note: B is set because there are no randomized controlled trials behind those three field actions, only consensus and physiological reasoning. The review itself says that most of these approaches are only supported by uncontrolled studies. The period of medication is the doctor's business. Do not give antihypertensive medication at home. Having someone lie flat on their back can increase blood pressure, so help sit upright. Family members and caregivers must also know these three steps. Don't brush it off as a common headache.

Case: Aunt Zhang was taking care of her paraplegic husband. One day he suddenly had a severe headache and was sweating profusely. She immediately helped him sit upright, unbuttoned his collar and belt, and found that the urine bag was full. She called 120 at the same time. After he was sent to the hospital, he was diagnosed with abnormal autonomic reflex and managed to escape in time.

items.title: The first ten years after spinal cord injury is a period of high risk for suicide. Don’t think of it as something you can just do if you want to.
items.core: Long-term follow-up at two spinal cord injury centers in the UK found that suicide rates in this group were five times higher than in the general population. More than 90% of suicides occur within the first ten years after injury. For people whose cause of injury is suicide, the risk is even higher.
body: Cost: Nothing. Make a call or hang up.

Benefits: The study followed 2304 patients with traumatic spinal cord injury who were newly admitted to the hospital from 1991 to 2010, survived the first year after injury, and had neurological deficits at discharge through the end of 2014. In 63 of these cases (2.7%) the cause of injury was a suicide attempt itself. A total of 533 deaths occurred by the end of follow-up, 4.2% of which were due to suicide, with 91% of suicides occurring in the first ten years after injury. The age-standardized suicide mortality rate was 62.5 per 100,000 people per year (95% CI 36.4–88.6, confidence range), five times the rate in the general population in England and Wales in 2014 (12.2 per 100,000 people). For those injured due to suicide attempts, compared with other causes of injury, the odds ratio for death was 4.32 (P<0.001), and the odds ratio for suicide was 9.46 (P<0.001)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Savic G, DeVivo MJ, Frankel HL, Jamous MA, Soni BM, Charlifue S (2018). Suicide and traumatic spinal cord injury - a cohort study. Spinal cohort study Cord, 56(1):2-6. <https://doi.org/10.1038/sc.2017.98>

Note: This study only looked at spinal cord injuries, and it is an extrapolation to cover other causes of disability such as blindness, amputation, and burns. What it can explain is the time window: the risk does not pass after discharge, but needs to be monitored for ten years. Asking someone to accompany you to speak and call 12356, see Section 29, Article 11 (12356). Don’t stockpile sleeping pills and pesticides at home, see Section 1, Item 25 (Suicidal Thoughts). If the grief and emotions are still stuck in place for half a year, go to a psychiatrist or clinical psychology department to register. See Section 29, Item 8 (Grief has passed half a year).

Case: In the fifth year since Xiao Chen suffered spinal cord injury in a car accident, his family has been paying attention to his mood. Once he said "living is boring", his family did not take it seriously and immediately contacted the psychology department and insisted on follow-up intervention to help him get through that high-risk period.

items.title: Hospitalization for mental disorders is based on the principle of voluntariness. There are only two situations where hospitalization can be done without the consent of the person
items.core: The family or the employer cannot leave a person in a mental hospital for hospitalization. The law only recognizes two situations, and it must be diagnosed as a serious mental disorder first: hurting oneself or being in danger, and endangering others or being in danger. The first type requires the consent of the guardian before it can be collected. If you have objections to the second type, you can request another diagnosis within three days, and then you can also commission an appraisal yourself.
body: Cost: No money. Remember these two situations and be able to speak them out when needed.

Benefits: Article 30 of the "Mental Health Law" states that "inpatient treatment of mental disorders is subject to the principle of voluntariness." Only if the diagnosis conclusion and condition assessment show that the patient is a patient with a severe mental disorder and has one of the following conditions, hospitalization should be implemented. The first type is "those who have committed acts that harm themselves, or are in danger of harming themselves." The second type is "behavior that endangers the safety of others has occurred, or there is a danger of endangering the safety of others." Article 31: In the first situation, the medical institution will only implement hospitalization with the consent of the guardian. If the guardian does not agree, it shall not be implemented. Article 32: If the second situation falls and the person or guardian has objections, he or she may request a re-diagnosis, which shall be made within three days from the date of receipt of the diagnosis conclusion, and shall be made by a psychiatric practitioner other than the two initial diagnosis physicians; if there is still objection to the re-diagnosis conclusion, an identification institution that has obtained professional qualifications in accordance with the law may independently entrust a medical identification institution for mental disorders to conduct medical identification of mental disorders. Article 35: If the re-diagnosis conclusion or appraisal report shows that the patient cannot be determined to be a patient with a severe mental disorder, or the patient does not require hospitalization, medical institutions shall not provide hospitalization treatment. Article 78: Anyone who intentionally sends a patient without a mental disorder to a medical institution for treatment as a patient with a mental disorder shall be liable for compensation in accordance with the law (nationwide, effective from May 1, 2013, revised in 2018)
Level of Evidence: A
Source: Mental Health Law of the People's Republic of China (amended in 2018, Articles 30, 31, 32, 35, and 78). <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=2c909fdd678bf17901678bf7448a066d>

Note: On the other hand, no one can be sent to the hospital. Article 28 stipulates that if a patient with a suspected mental disorder has committed an act that harms himself or endangers the safety of others, or is in danger of doing so, his close relatives, his/her unit, and the local public security organ should immediately take measures to stop him and send him to a medical institution for diagnosis of mental disorder. Medical institutions shall not refuse to make a diagnosis after receiving a referral. Therefore, "sending for diagnosis" and "staying for hospitalization" are two different gates. The former is lower and the latter is higher. Article 75 lists the responsibilities of medical institutions. Those who violate regulations by implementing restraint and isolation or diagnosing patients without mental disorders as patients with mental disorders will be punished or even have their practicing certificates revoked. What to do when someone around you has the urge to hurt others, see Section 8.

Case: Lao Zhang’s family wanted to send him to a mental hospital, but he was only mildly depressed and did not hurt himself or others, so he did not meet the legal conditions for involuntary hospitalization. The hospital refused to admit her and recommended outpatient follow-up. The family later accepted this plan.

items.title: The person who takes care of the disabled person in his family for a long time needs someone to keep an eye on his body
items.core: It is not hypocritical for a caregiver to be exhausted. An American study followed more than 800 elderly people for four years. The risk of death among those who reported mental distress while caring for their disabled spouse was about 60% higher than those who did not care for them. People who cared but did not find it strenuous did not experience this increase. So what we need to focus on is not the care itself, but the long-term stress.
body: Cost: No money. Separate some of the care work and do a physical examination yourself.

Benefits: The study was a prospective population-based cohort, conducted from 1993 to 1998, with an average follow-up of 4.5 years, in four communities in the United States. 392 caregivers and 427 noncaregivers, aged 66 to 96 years, all lived with a spouse. 103 (12.6%) died within four years. After adjusting for sociodemographic factors, pre-existing conditions and subclinical cardiovascular disease, those who reported mental or emotional distress while caring had a 63% higher risk of death than non-caregiving controls (relative risk RR 1.63, 95% CI 1.00–2.65, confidence range). Adjusted mortality was not increased for those who cared for but did not report strain (RR 1.08, 95% CI 0.61–1.90) and for those who did not care for a disabled spouse (RR 1.37, 95% CI 0.73–2.58)
Level of Evidence: A
Source: Schulz R, Beach SR (1999). Caregiving as a risk factor for mortality: the Caregiver Health Effects Study. JAMA, 282(23):2215-2219. <https://doi.org/10.1001/jama.282.23.2215>

Note: Dispute: The lower limit of the credibility range of this study is exactly at 1.00, and the possibility of "no difference" has not been completely ruled out. The population is American elderly people living with their spouses, and the care recipients are disabled elderly spouses. It is an extrapolation to apply it to people caring for young disabled family members. What it can tell is the direction: those who are struggling are at higher risk. The care work that can be divided should be divided as much as possible. For day care and day care services, ask the local Disabled Persons' Federation and the civil affairs. Do not stop taking medication for the caregiver's own chronic disease, see Section 16, Item 1 (Take the full amount of medication as directed by the doctor). The beneficiary is yourself.

Case: Uncle Wang has taken care of his disabled wife for six years and never feels tired. His daughter discovered that he had lost weight suddenly and often suffered from insomnia. She took him for a physical examination and found that he had high blood pressure and a tendency to depression. His indicators slowly recovered after his children took over some of the care.

items.title: For those who sit in wheelchairs for a long time, replace the seat cushion with a decompression type and check the ischium and coccyx every day
items.core: The elderly in nursing homes who use decompression cushions have significantly fewer pressure ulcers on the ischium than those who use ordinary segmented sponge cushions, but there is no difference when counting the coccyx together. In the test, everyone was first equipped with a wheelchair that fit them well, so the wheelchair itself should also be matched to the person's size, and don't just buy a universal model. The UK National Health Service also recommends checking your skin every day for symptoms of pressure ulcers.
body: Cost: A few hundred yuan to thousands of yuan for a pressure relief cushion. Read it once a day for one minute.

Benefits: This randomized clinical trial was conducted in 12 nursing homes, enrolling 232 residents aged 65 and older from 2004 to 2008 who were in a wheelchair for more than 6 hours per day and had a Braden score of 18 or less. Everyone was first equipped with a suitable wheelchair and then randomly divided into two groups. One group had a skin-protective cushion (air, viscous fluid and foam, or gel and foam), and one group had a 7.6 cm thick segmented foam cushion. Follow-up was performed for 6 months or until pressure ulcer development. There were 8 cases (6.7%) of pressure ulcers at the ischial tuberosity in the segmented foam group and 1 case (0.9%) in the skin-protective cushion group, P=0.04. Taking the ischial and sacrococcygeal pressure ulcers together, there were 21 cases (17.6%) in the segmented foam group and 12 cases (10.6%) in the skin-protective cushion group, P = 0.14, and no difference was made. Looking at your skin every day is based on the UK National Health Service (NHS) pressure ulcer prevention advice for people who care at home. There are two inside: Use specially designed mattresses and cushions, and check your skin every day for symptoms of pressure ulcers
Level of Evidence: B

Source: Brienza D, Kelsey S, Karg P, et al. (2010). A randomized clinical trial on preventing pressure ulcers with wheelchair seat cushions. Journal of the American Geriatrics Society, 58(12):2308-2314. <https://doi.org/10.1111/j.1532-5415.2010.03168.x>; NHS. Pressure ulcers (pressure sores): "use specially designed mattresses and cushions" "check your skin every day for symptoms of a pressure ulcer". <https://www.nhs.uk/conditions/pressure-sores/> (accessed November 4, 2026)

Note: There are two reasons for setting B. First, the sample size was only 232 people, the P value of 0.04 for the primary endpoint was just over the line, and the secondary endpoint made no difference. Second, the crowd is elderly residents in nursing homes, so applying it to young wheelchair users is an extrapolation. In the test, everyone was first equipped with a wheelchair that fit well, so "fit" and "cushion" work together. Don't just change the cushion. Pressure ulcer protection during prolonged bed rest, air mattresses and regular turning, see Section 17, Item 8 (Pressure ulcers). How to apply for subsidies for basic assistive devices, see Article 7 of this section (go to the county-level Disabled Persons’ Federation for details).

Case: Aunt Liu, who has been in a wheelchair for more than ten years, changed the pressure-reducing cushion and asked her family to look at her ischium and coccyx every day. After half a year, the skin on the previously repeatedly red and swollen areas no longer broke out. She said this was much more effective than home remedies.

items.title: Don’t buy treatments and devices that “can cure paralysis, blindness, or deafness”
items.core: The advertising law is nonsense. Advertisements for medical treatments, drugs, and medical devices are not allowed to guarantee curative effect, are not allowed to talk about cure rates and effectiveness, and are not allowed to have spokespersons recommend or certify them. Therefore, words such as "Stand up after three courses of treatment" and "How many people have recovered" are illegal advertisements in themselves, and there is no need to study the principles they talk about. Advertisements other than medical treatment, medicines, and medical equipment are not allowed to mention medical treatment.
body: Cost: Not spending money, but saving money. The difficulty is that the family members hold on to hope and cannot persuade him.

Revenue: Article 16 of the "Advertising Law" stipulates that advertisements for medical treatments, drugs, and medical devices shall not contain the following content: "(1) assertions or guarantees expressing efficacy and safety; (2) explanations of cure rates or effectiveness; (3) comparisons with the efficacy and safety of other drugs, medical devices, or other medical institutions; (4) use of advertising spokespersons for recommendations and certifications." Article 17 stipulates that, except for advertisements for medical treatments, drugs, and medical devices, "any other advertisements involving disease treatment functions are prohibited, and medical terms or terms that are likely to confuse the products being promoted with drugs or medical devices are prohibited." Article 4 stipulates that advertisements shall not contain false or misleading content, and shall not deceive or mislead consumers. Advertisers shall be responsible for the authenticity of advertising content (National, revised in 2021)
Level of Evidence: A
Source: Advertising Law of the People's Republic of China (amended in 2021, Articles 4, 16, and 17). <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=ff8081817ab231eb017abd6bd860052d>

Note: There is only one way to judge: see if it dares to say enough. The rehabilitation department of a regular hospital will not promise that you can stand up after a few courses of treatment. If you encounter this kind of propaganda, report it to 12315 or the local market supervision department. The formula for health care products is the same, see Section 6, Item 10 (Health Care Products). If you have already purchased and want to refund, follow the methods of online shopping and prepaid consumption. See Section 5, Article 29 (Online Shopping Platform Rules). The beneficiaries are yourself and your family.

Case: Xiao Zhou’s father was paralyzed. He almost spent 50,000 yuan when he saw an advertisement for “Stand Up in Three Courses of Treatment”. He carefully checked it out and found that the advertising law prohibits guarantees of curative effect, which is illegal in itself, so he didn't buy it, and later spent the money on formal rehabilitation.

items.title: After getting the Disability Certificate, go to the county-level Disabled Persons' Federation to ask all the things you can apply for
items.core: The Disability Certificate itself does not pay money, but you need to apply for several benefits based on it. These benefits are independent of each other. You have to apply for each one yourself, and they will not come to your door automatically. When I go to the Disabled Persons' Federation for the first time, I ask about the items on the list one by one, which is easier than running back and forth several times.
body: Cost: No money. Go to the county-level Disabled Persons' Federation and ask questions all morning. There is more than one department to run from.

Income: There are at least six benefits on the certificate, each with its own origin. For living allowances for disabled people with difficulties and nursing subsidies for severely disabled people, see Section 7, Article 8 (two subsidies). For rehabilitation assistance for disabled children, see Article 8 (Rehabilitation Assistance) of this section. Subsidies for basic assistive devices are based on Article 26 of the Regulations on Disability Prevention and Rehabilitation of Disabled Persons. Subsidies for home accessibility modifications, see Section 9 of this section (Ramp grab bars and bathroom modifications). For proportional employment and employment services, see Article 10 of this section (Proactive Statement of Certification). For personal income tax reductions, see Article 11 of this section (Personal income tax reductions). Article 26 of the "Regulations on Disability Prevention and Rehabilitation of Disabled Persons" also states that the state provides basic rehabilitation services to urban and rural poor disabled people and severely disabled people through the implementation of key rehabilitation projects, and "subsidizes the configuration of basic assistive devices in accordance with relevant national regulations." Article 20 stipulates that relevant departments of people's governments at or above the county level and Disabled Persons' Federations shall use community resources to set up rehabilitation sites or purchase services to carry out community rehabilitation work such as rehabilitation guidance, daily living ability training, rehabilitation care, assistive device configuration, information consultation and referral (national, effective from July 1, 2017). Article 21 of the same regulation stipulates that when providing rehabilitation services, a needs assessment must be conducted first, and then a personalized plan can be determined based on the assessment results. A document issued by the State Council in 2016 stated that “where conditions permit, subsidies can be provided to the basic rehabilitation assistive devices for urban and rural poor disabled people and severely disabled people.” The three-year action plan for 2026 by the Ministry of Civil Affairs and other departments states that it is necessary to "standardize and strengthen the subsidy system for basic assistive device adaptation services for disabled people." Those who are disabled due to work-related injuries take another route. The "Measures for the Management of the Configuration of Assistive Devices for Work Injury Insurance" govern prostheses, orthotics, prosthetic eyes, dentures and wheelchairs. It stipulates that candidates must be confirmed by the Labor Ability Appraisal Committee before being assigned. The costs of installation, maintenance and training shall be paid by the work-related injury insurance fund as required. The handling agency will not pay for those who have not confirmed that they are allocated by themselves or are allocated by non-agreed institutions
Level of Evidence: A

Source: State Council (2017). Regulations on Disability Prevention and Rehabilitation of Disabled Persons (Articles 20, 21, and 26). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2017-02/27/content_5171308.htm>; State Council (2016). Several opinions on accelerating the development of the rehabilitation assistive device industry (Guofa [2016] No. 60). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2016-10/27/content_5125001.htm>; Ministry of Civil Affairs et al. (2026).
