Three-year Action Plan for Expanding Capacity and Improving Quality of the Rehabilitation Assistive Device Industry (2026-2028) (Minhan [2026] No. 48). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/202607/content_7075249.htm>; Ministry of Human Resources and Social Security, Ministry of Civil Affairs, and National Health and Family Planning Commission Order No. 27 (2016). Measures for the Management of the Configuration of Assistive Devices for Work-related Injury Insurance (Articles 2, 15, and 24). <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2016/content_5074060.htm>

Note: For the process of applying for the certificate itself, see Section 24, Article 10 (Disability Certificate). For wheelchairs, prosthetics, hearing aids, etc., first ask about the evaluation and allocation process for subsidies before buying them. The set of work-related injuries clearly stipulates that you must first confirm and then allocate. If you allocate yourself first, you will not be reported. The identification of work-related injuries and assessment of work ability are provided in Section 19, Article 14 (Evaluation of Work Capacity). Regarding subsidies for assistive devices, the State Council document states that they are “available in certain places where conditions permit.” Therefore, it is up to the localities to determine whether they are available and how much they are to be paid. The following are the author’s experiences: when asked, write down the name of each item, go home and check the original documents by name on the official website of the local Disabled Persons’ Federation and the government website. Don’t just listen to what is said at the counter. Asking once will not solve the problem once and for all. If you ask again every other year, the policy will change.

Case: Li Shu had just received his disability certificate. He went to the County Disabled Persons' Federation according to the list to inquire about subsidies, nursing fees, employment support, etc. He filled out three forms on the spot and received the severe nursing subsidy that month without making a second trip.

items.title: If your child is under 7 years old and is disabled or autistic, go to the county-level Disabled Persons' Federation to apply for rehabilitation assistance
items.core: The state has established a rehabilitation assistance system for disabled children and autistic children aged 0 to 6, which covers surgery, assistive devices and rehabilitation training. Assistance targets families in need first, and age and family economic conditions can be relaxed if local financial resources permit. Assistance is provided until the age of 6 according to regulations. Don't delay it until it's time to go to school. Organizations must choose from the designated list of the Disabled Persons' Federation.
body: Cost: No money. Submit an application to the county-level Disabled Persons' Federation and then choose one of the designated institutions.

Income: The "Opinions of the State Council on Establishing a Rehabilitation and Assistance System for Disabled Children" states that the assistance targets are children with vision, hearing, speech, physical, intellectual and other disabilities and autistic children aged 0-6 who meet the conditions. It includes disabled children from urban and rural minimum living security families, registered poor families, disabled children taken in and raised by child welfare institutions, disabled orphans, disabled children supported by extremely poor people, and other disabled children from families with financial difficulties. The specific identification methods for other families with financial difficulties shall be formulated by the local people's governments at or above the county level. The document also states that "in areas where conditions permit, the age range for rehabilitation assistance for disabled children can be expanded, and restrictions on the financial conditions of families receiving assistance can also be relaxed." Funding guarantee standards are determined by local people's governments at or above the county level based on local financial conditions, number of guarantee objects, disability categories, etc., and a dynamic adjustment mechanism is established. The application should be submitted to the county-level Disabled Persons' Federation where the child's household registration is located (where the residence permit is issued). If approved, the guardian will independently choose a designated rehabilitation institution. Designated rehabilitation institutions are “selected and determined in accordance with the principle of open merit selection” by the local Disabled Persons’ Federation at or above the county level in conjunction with the health, education, civil affairs and other departments. Expenses incurred at designated institutions shall be settled directly by the financial department and institutions. "For expenses incurred in receiving rehabilitation services at non-designated rehabilitation institutions after review and approval by the county-level Disabled Persons' Federation, the county-level Disabled Persons' Federation shall negotiate with the financial department at the same level to clarify the settlement method." The document requires provincial people's governments to introduce local systems and supporting policies by the end of September 2018. The basis for the upper level is Article 26 of the "Regulations on Disability Prevention and Rehabilitation of Disabled Persons": The state establishes a rehabilitation and assistance system for children with disabilities, "gradually realizing that children with disabilities such as vision, hearing, speech, limbs, and intelligence, and children with autism aged 0-6 years old will receive free surgery, assistive device configuration, rehabilitation training and other services" (National, starting from 2018)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: State Council (2018). Opinions on the establishment of a rehabilitation and assistance system for children with disabilities (Guofa [2018] No. 20). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2018-07/10/content_5305296.htm>; State Council (2017). Regulations on Disability Prevention and Rehabilitation of Disabled Persons (Article 26). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2017-02/27/content_5171308.htm>

Note: Assistance projects and standards are determined by local governments at or above the county level. First check the province's rehabilitation assistance methods for disabled children on the official website of the local Disabled Persons' Federation. The designated institutions are selected by the Disabled Persons' Federation together with relevant departments, and the list is requested from the Disabled Persons' Federation. The document requires the Disabled Persons' Federation to work with relevant departments to strengthen the supervision of entry and exit of designated rehabilitation institutions, establish a regular inspection and comprehensive evaluation mechanism, and establish a blacklist system. If you want to go to an institution that is not on the list, you must first get approval from the county-level Disabled Persons' Federation, and how the money will be paid is determined by the local area. I went there on my own without permission, and there is no provision for settlement in the document. The beneficiaries are your children, who belong to the second bracket. Institutions that promise to "cover it" shall be dealt with according to Article 6 of this section (can cure paralysis).

Case: The mother of a two-year-old autistic boy filled out an application for rehabilitation assistance at the County Disabled Persons' Federation, selected a designated institution, and received free training five times a week. After half a year, the child was able to speak short sentences, catching up with the critical period before the age of 6.

items.title: For the renovation of ramps, handrails and bathrooms at home, you can apply for subsidies from the government at or above the county level. Please ask the local Disabled Persons' Federation first.
items.core: The "Accessible Environment Construction Law" contains a provision: Governments at or above the county level shall support and guide the renovation of family barrier-free facilities. Appropriate subsidies should be provided to qualified families with disabilities and the elderly. How much to supplement and what to change is determined by each locality. First go to the local Disabled Persons' Federation to ask.
body: Cost: There is no cost to apply. Most renovations themselves are subsidized, and you may have to pay part of it yourself. Go to the Disabled Persons' Federation and the streets.

Income: Article 19 of the "Accessible Environment Construction Law": "People's governments at or above the county level shall support and guide the renovation of household barrier-free facilities. Appropriate subsidies shall be provided to families with qualified disabled people and the elderly." Article 18 stipulates that for existing residential buildings, residential areas, public buildings, public places, transportation facilities, urban and rural roads, etc. that do not meet the construction standards for barrier-free facilities, people's governments at or above the county level shall formulate targeted barrier-free facility renovation plans and organize their implementation based on actual conditions. Article 22: "The state supports the installation of elevators or other barrier-free facilities in existing multi-story residential buildings in old urban communities to provide convenience for disabled people and the elderly." The same article stipulates that people's governments at or above the county level and their relevant departments must "play the role of community grassroots organizations" to promote the installation of elevators in existing multi-story residential buildings. Article 62 stipulates that any organization or individual has the right to submit opinions and suggestions on strengthening and improving the construction of barrier-free environments to the relevant government departments, and to make complaints and reports on violations of this law; the competent departments "should promptly handle and respond to complaints and reports" upon receipt. Article 63 stipulates that for behavior that violates the provisions of this law and harms public interests, the People's Procuratorate may make procuratorial suggestions or initiate public interest litigation (nationwide, effective from September 1, 2023)
Level of Evidence: B
Source: Accessible Environment Construction Law of the People's Republic of China (Articles 18, 19, 22, 62, and 63). <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=ff80818188d7430b0189018493370940>

Note: The reason for setting B is because the law only states that "appropriate subsidies shall be provided." The amount of subsidy and who is considered eligible are all left to the local government. There is no unified national figure. First, check "barrier-free renovation of families with severe disabilities" on the official website of the local Disabled Persons' Federation. Installing elevators in communities is another way. Article 22 requires the government and relevant departments to use community grassroots organizations to promote it, and first ask the streets and communities. If the barrier-free facilities in public places are not up to standard, you can complain to the competent authority according to Article 62, and they will give you a reply.

Case: Aunt Zhang’s bathroom did not have handrails. She took her disability certificate to the county Disabled Persons’ Federation to inquire about barrier-free modifications. After filling out the form, the government subsidized 3,000 yuan and installed non-slip handrails and a shower chair. Now she does not need to hold the wall while bathing.

items.title: When looking for a job, take the initiative to state that you hold a disability certificate, and the company can offset a certain amount of money by recruiting you
items.core: The proportion of disabled people recruited by an employer shall not be less than 1.5% of the total number of employees, and shall be determined by each province. If it is not reached, the security fund will be paid based on the difference in headcount. One head will be calculated based on the average salary of the unit last year, and a 50% or 10% discount will be given by the end of 2027. Enterprises with less than 30 employees will be exempted from payment. Therefore, recruiting you will actually save money. Make sure you state your certificate clearly during the interview.
body: Cost: No money. Say one more thing during the interview. The difficulty lies in speaking.

Income: Article 8 of the "Regulations on the Employment of Disabled Persons": "The proportion of employment arrangements for disabled persons by an employer shall not be less than 1.5% of the total number of employees of the unit. The specific proportion shall be stipulated by the people's government of the province, autonomous region, and municipality directly under the Central Government according to the actual situation of the region." Article 9: If the proportion stipulated by the local provincial people's government is not reached, the employment security fund for disabled persons shall be paid. Article 8 of the "Measures for the Administration of the Collection and Use of Employment Security Funds for Disabled Persons" provides the formula: "The annual payment amount of the security fund = (the number of active employees of the employer in the previous year × the employment ratio for disabled persons prescribed by the people's government of the local province, autonomous region, or municipality directly under the Central Government - the number of persons with disabilities actually employed by the employer in the previous year) × the average annual salary of the employed employees of the employer in the previous year." Article 16: Within 3 years from the date of industrial and commercial registration, small and micro enterprises that do not reach the prescribed proportion of employment for disabled people and have less than 20 employees (inclusive) will be exempted from security funds. Article 7: Only when an employer enrolls disabled persons as on-staff personnel, or signs a labor contract of more than one year with disabled persons within the employment age group, with actual wages not lower than the local minimum wage, and full payment of social insurance premiums, "can it be counted in the number of disabled persons employed by the employer." Arranging employment for one person holding a first- or second-level disability certificate shall be calculated as arranging two people. Ministry of Finance Announcement No. 8 of 2023 also stipulates that from January 1, 2023 to December 31, 2027, if the arrangement ratio reaches 1% but does not meet the provincial ratio, 50% of the amount due shall be paid; if it is less than 1%, 90% shall be paid; "Enterprises with less than 30 employees (inclusive) will continue to be exempt from the employment security fund for persons with disabilities." Article 36 of the "Law on the Protection of Disabled Persons" stipulates that the state shall provide tax incentives in accordance with the law to employers that arrange employment of disabled persons at or above the prescribed ratio or that arrange employment of disabled persons in a centralized manner (nationally, the Regulations on the Employment of Disabled Persons shall come into effect on May 1, 2007)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: State Council (2007). Regulations on the Employment of Disabled Persons (Articles 8 and 9). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2008-03/28/content_6646.htm>; Ministry of Finance, State Administration of Taxation, China Disabled Persons' Federation (2015). Measures for the Administration of the Collection and Use of Employment Security Funds for Disabled Persons (Caishui [2015] No. 72, Articles 6, 7, 8, and 16). <http://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2015-09/15/content_5650063.htm>; Ministry of Finance (2023). Announcement on the continuation of the preferential policy for employment security funds for persons with disabilities (Ministry of Finance Announcement No. 8 of 2023). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2023-03/28/content_5748750.htm>; Law of the People's Republic of China on the Protection of Disabled Persons (Article 36). <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=ff8080816f135f46016f1d134c88132b>

Note: Enterprises with less than 30 employees will be exempted from paying security deposits until the end of 2027. This reason is not valid for them, so don’t count on it. The security deposit reduction and exemption policy has been adjusted over the years. How to calculate it after 2027 will be subject to the announcement of the Ministry of Finance at that time. In addition, proportional employment requires real employment: signing a contract for more than one year, paying no less than the minimum wage, and paying social security in full to be counted in the number of people assigned. For the identification of persons with employment difficulties and social security subsidies, see Section 7, Article 12 (Persons with Employment Difficulties). Vocational training subsidies are provided in Section 7, Article 13 (Vocational Training Subsidies). The beneficiary is yourself.

Case: Xiao Wang, who was physically disabled, took the initiative to show his disability certificate during the interview. The boss calculated that recruiting him would offset his security deposit. He hired him on the spot and transferred his work station. The company saved money and he also received a stable income.

items.title: The personal income tax of disabled people can be reduced. How much can be reduced? Call the Provincial Taxation Bureau and ask the Provincial Taxation Bureau
items.core: The Personal Income Tax Law states that the income of disabled people can be reduced from personal tax. However, the law leaves it up to the provincial governments to determine how much and for how long the reduction will be, so each province is different. The method is to call the 12366 tax service hotline and ask the provincial tax bureau, or look for exemptions and exemptions in the personal income tax app.
body: Cost: No money. Check one item when declaring, or submit the filing materials once.

Income: Article 5 of the "Personal Income Tax Law": "Personal income tax may be reduced under any of the following circumstances. The specific range and period shall be stipulated by the people's government of the province, autonomous region, or municipality directly under the Central Government, and shall be reported to the Standing Committee of the People's Congress at the same level for the record: (1) Disabled, orphaned Income of the elderly and martyrs; (2) Those who suffer heavy losses due to natural disasters. "Article 36 of the "Law on the Protection of Disabled Persons" also stipulates that the state shall provide tax incentives to disabled persons engaged in self-employment in accordance with the law and exempt them from administrative fees (National Individual Income Tax Law). Effective from January 1, 2019)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Individual Income Tax Law of the People's Republic of China (Amended in 2018, Article 5). <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=2c909fdd678bf17901678bf724bd0609>; Law of the People's Republic of China on the Protection of Disabled Persons (Article 36). <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=ff8080816f135f46016f1d134c88132b>

Note: The determination of "small" in the amount of income is based on judgment, because the law itself does not give a number, and each province decides how much to reduce. Once done, it can be used for a long time, so it is worth running. The specific amount of reduction in your province depends on the regulations of the provincial government and the announcement of the provincial tax bureau. The comparison table for online transfer may be expired. If you open a small shop by yourself, administrative fees will be exempted according to Article 36 of the "Law on the Protection of Disabled Persons", and you will be required to ask for it when applying for a license.

Case: Lao Chen called 12366 to inquire about the individual income tax reduction for persons with disabilities. He submitted the disability certificate and income certificate in accordance with provincial policies. The income tax on the salary slip for that month was reduced by more than 200. He said that the call was worth it.

items.title: Guide dogs can be brought into public places and public transportation, and blind people can ride city buses for free
items.core: The law states that public places and public transportation must provide convenience for disabled people with guide dogs, hearing dogs, and assistance dogs. Blind people can take city buses, subways and ferries for free with valid IDs, and disabled people can bring necessary assistive devices with them for free. Say these two things when you are pulled over, and if it doesn't work, file a complaint.
body: Cost: No money. When you are stopped, you have to ask for the law and you may have to stand in a stalemate for a while.

Income: Article 46 of the "Accessible Environment Construction Law": "Public place management units, transportation facilities and public transportation operating units shall provide convenience for disabled people to bring guide dogs, hearing dogs, assistance dogs and other service dogs." Paragraph 2 of the same article stipulates that disabled people who bring service dogs to and from public places and take public transportation "should comply with relevant national regulations, wear visible identification equipment for service dogs, and take necessary protective measures." Article 68 stipulates that if departments and units with public service responsibilities fail to provide barrier-free social services in accordance with the law, the people's government at the same level or the superior department shall order them to make corrections within a time limit; if corrections are not made within the time limit, the directly responsible person in charge and other directly responsible personnel shall be punished in accordance with the law. Article 35 stipulates that government service convenience hotlines and emergency call systems for police assistance, fire emergency, traffic accidents, medical emergencies, etc., shall gradually have barrier-free functions such as voice, large characters, Braille, and one-click calling. Article 62 stipulates that any organization or individual has the right to complain or report violations of this law, and the competent authorities should promptly handle and respond to them. Article 50 of the "Law on the Protection of Disabled Persons": "Blind people with valid certificates can ride city buses, trams, subways, ferries and other public transportation for free. Books for the blind are mailed free of charge." The same article also stipulates that people's governments at or above the county level should provide conveniences and discounts for disabled people to take public transportation, and disabled people can carry necessary assistive devices for free (National Barrier-free Environment Construction Law will come into effect on September 1, 2023)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Barrier-free Environment Construction Law of the People's Republic of China (Article 35, 46, 62, and 68). <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=ff80818188d7430b0189018493370940>; Law of the People's Republic of China on the Protection of Disabled Persons (Article 50). <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=ff8080816f135f46016f1d134c88132b>

Note: The law says "providing convenience" and there is no fine. Article 68 only orders corrections and punishes the responsible persons, so the other party may not necessarily give in immediately when there is a stalemate on site. Saving a screenshot of the law in your mobile phone is more effective than memorizing the law number. This is the author’s experience. If the matter cannot be resolved on the spot, file a complaint according to Article 62, and the competent authority must respond. The law also requires service dogs to wear visible identification equipment, take protective measures, and prepare them before going out. Before taking a train or a plane, call customer service to ask about the requirements for service dogs. Go to the local Disabled Persons' Federation to find out which "valid documents" are required for free rides.

Case: Blind man Green took his guide dog on the bus and was stopped by the driver. He showed his ID and stated the legal provisions. The driver let him go and he took the bus to the park for free, and the dog lay quietly at his feet.

items.title: Disabled persons taking the college entrance examination can apply for reasonable accommodation, and the examination time for Braille papers will be increased by half.
items.core: Candidates with disabilities who take the college entrance examination can apply for Braille papers, large print papers, free foreign language listening, separate examination rooms, wearing hearing aids and wheelchairs, and the examination time can also be extended. These will not be given automatically, and a written application must be submitted according to the time specified by the province, accompanied by a second-generation or above disability certificate. If you are not satisfied with the result, you can apply to the Provincial Department of Education for review.
body: Cost: Nothing. A written application must be submitted within the time specified by the province and must be confirmed on site.

Benefits: Article 5 of the "Regulations on the Administration of the National Unified Examination for the Enrollment of General Colleges and Universities by Disabled Persons" lists twelve reasonable accommodations. This includes providing current Braille test papers, large-print test papers, or ordinary test papers for candidates with visual disabilities; exempting candidates with hearing disabilities from foreign language listening tests; allowing candidates with visual disabilities to carry Braille pens, Braille handwriting tablets, and Braille typewriters without storage functions. Electronic vision aids, blind canes, optical magnifying glasses and other auxiliary devices without storage function; hearing-impaired candidates are allowed to bring hearing aids and cochlear implants; candidates with mobility impairments are allowed to use wheelchairs and walkers, and those with special needs can bring their own special tables and chairs. The extent of the extended time is written in Article 5, Item 6: "The examination time for visually impaired candidates who use Braille test papers will be extended by 50% on the basis of the total examination time specified in the subject; the examination time for visually impaired candidates who use large font test papers or ordinary test papers, and candidates who are unable to write normally or have no upper limbs due to cerebral palsy or other diseases, etc., will extend the examination time by 30% based on the total examination time specified for the subject." In addition, there are priority access to test centers and examination rooms, separate standardized examination rooms, guidance assistants and sign language interpreters, etc. Article 7 stipulates the application procedure: Candidates submit a formal written application at the time, place, and method specified by the provincial education examination agency, and provide their second-generation or above disability certificate; the expert group will confirm and comprehensively evaluate the application on site, and the provincial education examination agency will issue a "Notice". Article 8 stipulates that candidates who have objections to the "Notice" may submit a written review application to the provincial education administrative department. Article 9 stipulates that if foreign language listening is exempted, the foreign language score will be calculated according to "written test score × total score of foreign language subject/total score of written test part". Article 18 stipulates that if persons with disabilities need reasonable accommodation to participate in educational examinations in other countries, they may refer to these regulations (National, promulgated and implemented on April 7, 2017)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Ministry of Education, China Disabled Persons' Federation (2017). Provisions on the Management of National Unified Examinations for Disabled Persons to Participate in General Colleges and Universities (Teaching [2017] No. 4, Articles 5, 7, 8, 9, and 18). <http://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2017-04/12/content_5650060.htm>

Note: The application time is determined by each province and is written in the college entrance examination registration method for that year. If you miss it, it will be lost. Therefore, in the first semester of high school, you need to go to the official website of the Provincial Education Examination Agency to confirm the time. Article 18 also stipulates that national education examinations such as postgraduate examinations and adult college entrance examinations can also be applied for by reference. Regarding what schools are not allowed to refuse during the schooling period, see Article 14 of this section (Schools are not allowed to refuse students). The beneficiary is yourself or your children.

Case: Xiao Liu, a visually impaired candidate, submitted a Braille paper application as required by the province before the college entrance examination, along with a disability certificate. He received a Braille paper and an extension of time before the exam. After he finished answering the paper, he said it was enough.

items.title: Schools are not allowed to refuse children with disabilities who apply for admission; for those who cannot make it to school, the Education Bureau will arrange for home-based tutoring
items.core: Kindergartens and various schools shall not refuse admission to qualified children with disabilities, and the same applies to ordinary vocational schools. If a child needs special care and cannot go to school, the county education bureau will arrange for home tutoring or distance learning, and he or she will still have a student status. Enrollment and transfer are first evaluated and made recommendations by the Education Bureau’s expert committee, and the school does not have the final say.
body: Cost: Nothing. You have to submit an application and may need to go through an evaluation. When the school refuses, it has to go up to the Education Bureau.

Benefits: Article 7 of the "Regulations on the Education of Disabled Persons": "Preschool education institutions, schools of all levels and types, and other educational institutions shall implement education for persons with disabilities in accordance with these Regulations and the provisions of relevant national laws and regulations; disabled persons who meet the conditions stipulated in laws and regulations shall not refuse to enroll." Article 29: "Ordinary vocational schools shall not refuse to enroll students who meet the requirements of laws and regulations." General vocational training institutions should actively recruit disabled people who meet the admission standards set by the state. The regulations also stipulate that if disabled children and teenagers of school age need special care and cannot attend school, the education administrative department of the county-level people's government will make overall arrangements and implement compulsory education through home-based teaching or distance education, and include it in student status management. Article 20 stipulates that the education administrative department of the county-level people's government shall, in conjunction with the health administrative department, the civil affairs department, and the Disabled Persons' Federation, establish an expert committee for the education of persons with disabilities composed of experts in education, psychology, rehabilitation, social work, etc., who will evaluate the physical condition, the ability to receive education, and the ability to adapt to school study and life, and make recommendations for admission and transfer; the evaluation results belong to the privacy of the child, and relevant units and staff have the obligation to keep confidential. Article 23 stipulates that students with disabilities who study in regular classes in ordinary schools can apply the curriculum plans, curriculum standards and teaching materials of ordinary compulsory education, but their learning requirements can be moderately flexible. Article 52 stipulates that persons with disabilities who need necessary support and reasonable accommodation to participate in national education examinations may apply (national, effective from May 1, 2017)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: State Council (2017). Regulations on the Education of Disabled Persons (Article 7, Article 20, Article 23, Article 29, Article 52). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2017-02/23/content_5170264.htm>

Note: The school’s verbal statement that “we don’t have the conditions here” does not count. If you want it to give a written reply, go to the county-level education bureau with the written reply. The evaluation was carried out by an expert committee commissioned by the Education Bureau. The sentence in Article 23, "Learning requirements can be moderately flexible" is very useful. It can be cited when schools use grades as a reason to persuade students to withdraw. How to provide evidence of a child being bullied at school and what procedures the school must follow, see Section 30, Article 3 (School Bullying). Reasonable accommodations for the College Entrance Examination are provided in Section 13 (Reasonable Accommodations) of this Section. The beneficiaries are your children.

Case: When a girl with cerebral palsy reached school age, an ordinary primary school refused to admit her on the grounds that she could not take care of her. The parents approached the county education bureau, and after evaluation by an expert committee, they arranged for home-based tutoring. The child had a student status, and the teacher came twice a week.

items.title: You can still take the driver's license test if your right lower limb or both lower limbs are missing. The permitted driving type is called C5.
items.core: People who have lost their right lower limb or both lower limbs and cannot move them, but who can sit firmly on their own and have adequate upper limb conditions, can take the driver's license for an automatic transmission car for persons with disabilities, code-named C5. Those who are missing one hand and have enough conditions on the other hand can also apply. Individuals with visual impairment and hearing impairment in one eye can take the test. The physical examination must be done at a specialized hospital recognized by the province.
body: Cost: Tuition is about the same as a regular driver’s license, several thousand dollars in most places. The car needs to be converted to manual control. Get a physical check-up every three years.

Benefit: Appendix 1 of the "Regulations on Application and Use of Motor Vehicle Driving License" lists the physical conditions in detail. Item 8: "If the right lower limb or both lower limbs are missing or have lost motor functions but are able to sit and stand independently, and the upper limbs meet the requirements of Item 5 of this item, they can apply for a motor vehicle driving license for the approved type of small automatic passenger vehicles for disabled people. If one palm is missing, the thumb of the other hand is intact, and two other fingers are intact, the upper limbs and finger movement functions are normal, and the lower limbs meet the requirements of Item 6 of this item, they can apply for a motor vehicle driving license for the approved type of small automatic passenger vehicles for disabled people." Item 6: Those whose left lower limb alone is missing or loses motor function but whose right lower limb is normal can apply for permission to drive a small automatic transmission car. Vision item: "Those with single-eye visual impairment, good naked vision or corrected visual acuity of 5.0 or above on the logarithmic visual acuity chart, and a horizontal visual field of 150 degrees" can apply for permitted driving types of small cars, small automatic cars, low-speed trucks, three-wheeled cars, and small automatic passenger cars for the disabled. Hearing item: Those who have hearing impairment but can identify the direction of sound sources by wearing hearing aids can apply for permission to drive small cars and small automatic cars, and should wear hearing aids when driving. Article 85 stipulates that the physical condition certificate submitted when applying for a driving license for a small automatic passenger vehicle for persons with disabilities shall be issued by a specialized medical institution recognized by the provincial health administrative department. People holding this approved driving type must undergo a physical examination every three years and submit a certificate of physical condition within thirty days after the end of the scoring period. Article 78 stipulates that when driving, special signs for motor vehicles for disabled persons shall be installed on the vehicle body in accordance with regulations. Item 9 of Article 79, Paragraph 1, stipulates that if a person who drives a small automatic passenger vehicle for persons with disabilities "fails to submit proof of physical condition within one year after the end of three scoring periods", the vehicle management office shall cancel the driver's license (National, Ministry of Public Security Order No. 172 Amendment, effective January 1, 2025). Article 23, Paragraph 1, Item 5 of the "Motor Vehicle Registration Regulations" stipulates that when small or micro automatic passenger vehicles are equipped with, dismantled or replaced operating auxiliary devices for physically disabled persons, the owner of the motor vehicle shall apply for change filing to the vehicle management office at the place of registration within 30 days after the change. Article 24 stipulates that when applying, you must submit your identity certificate, driving license, motor vehicle safety technical inspection certificate and operating auxiliary device installation certificate, and submit the motor vehicle for inspection (Ministry of Public Security Order No. 164)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Ministry of Public Security Order No. 172. Regulations on the application and use of motor vehicle driving licenses (Articles 78, 79, 85, Attachment 1). <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/2025/issue_11866/202502/content_7004031.html>; Ministry of Public Security Order No. 164. Motor vehicle registration regulations (Articles 23, 24). <https://www.gov.cn/gongbao/content/2022/content_5682413.htm>; Road Traffic Safety Law of the People's Republic of China (amended in 2021, Article 58, Article 119). <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=ff8081817ab231eb017abd617ef70519>

Note: Another road with a much lower threshold is the motorized wheelchair for people with disabilities. Article 119 of the "Road Traffic Safety Law" stipulates that motorized wheelchairs for disabled people whose design speed, empty vehicle quality, and external dimensions meet national standards are classified as non-motor vehicles, so they do not need a driver's license; Article 58 stipulates that the maximum speed of motorized wheelchairs for disabled people when traveling in non-motorized lanes shall not exceed 15 kilometers per hour. C5 cars need to be equipped with control auxiliary devices for physically disabled people. After installation, they need to obtain a certificate of compliance with the installation and go to the vehicle management office to file the change within 30 days. If you do not submit proof of physical condition within one year after the three scoring periods, your driver's license will be cancelled.

Case: Xiao Zhao, who lost his right leg due to a work-related injury, passed the medical examination at the provincial hospital and passed the C5 driver's license test. He bought a modified automatic transmission car and now can drive to work by himself without having to rely on people to transport him to and from work.

items.title: Rehabilitation is done in formal institutions with rehabilitation medicine departments, and the intensity of listening to the therapist is not as strong as possible (the evidence comes from stroke)
items.core: After a stroke, more people are still alive and living at home in a stroke unit with organized care after a stroke. But don’t overdo it yourself. If you practice earlier, more frequently, and more within 24 hours after a stroke, the results will be worse three months later. How much and when to practice depends on the advice of the rehabilitation department and therapist.
body: Cost: Several hundred dollars per day for inpatient rehabilitation, and the out-of-pocket portion varies from place to place. Time is calculated on a monthly basis. I have to practice every day, which is very boring.

Benefits: Cochrane systematic review included 29 trials with 5902 participants comparing structured inpatient stroke unit care with other care modalities. The review described the stroke unit as one where team members use standard practices to deal with common problems after stroke and provide coordinated, multidisciplinary care. At the last follow-up (median 1 year), the odds ratio for an adverse outcome (death, disability, or need for institutional care) was 0.77 (95% CI 0.69–0.87, confidence range), for death was 0.76 (95% CI 0.66–0.88), and for death or dependence was 0.75 (95% CI 0.66–0.85), the quality of the evidence was moderate. Converted to absolute numbers, for every 100 people receiving care from a stroke unit, 2 more people live, 6 more people live at home, and 6 more people are able to live independently. On the other hand, the AVERT trial randomly assigned 2104 patients in 56 acute stroke units in 5 countries and compared "usual care" with "usual care plus ultra-early vigorous activity." Among those with good outcome (modified Rankin scale 0-2 points) at three months, 480 people (46%) in the ultra-early group and 525 people (50%) in the conventional group had an adjusted odds ratio of 0.73 (95% CI 0.59–0.90, P=0.004). Deaths were 88 versus 72, making no difference (odds ratio 1.34, 95% CI 0.93–1.93, P=0.113)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Langhorne P, Ramachandra S; Stroke Unit Trialists' Collaboration (2020). Organized inpatient (stroke unit) care for stroke: network meta-analysis. Cochrane Database of Systematic Reviews, 4: CD000197. <https://doi.org/10.1002/14651858.CD000197.pub4>; AVERT Trial Collaboration group (2015). Efficacy and safety of very early mobilization within 24 h of stroke onset (AVERT): a randomized controlled trial. Lancet, 386(9988):46-55. <https://doi.org/10.1016/S0140-6736(15)60690-0>

Note: Controversy: Both of these pieces of evidence come from stroke, and are extrapolated to other causes of disability such as spinal cord injury, amputation, and burns. AVERT means that "the earlier, the stronger" is not true, it does not mean that "early activities are useless". In the experiment, most people in both groups got out of bed within 24 hours. The difference was in frequency and total amount. When choosing an institution, check whether it has a Department of Rehabilitation Medicine and whether it has full-time rehabilitation therapists and occupational therapists. Don’t just look at the word “rehabilitation” on the sign. This is derived from multidisciplinary team care in stroke units. For how to transfer between primary and tertiary hospitals and how to calculate the deductible, see Section 24, Article 1 (Level-by-Level Referral). Community rehabilitation and assistive device configuration are provided in Article 7 of this section (go to the county-level Disabled Persons’ Federation for details).

Case: Six months after his stroke, Lao Zhou was admitted to a hospital with a rehabilitation department. The therapist determined the amount of training according to his tolerance and did not let him get up early to train vigorously. A year later, he could walk with crutches and lived at home without being hospitalized again.

items.title: If you have hearing loss, get a hearing aid. The reason for getting it is to hear, not to prevent dementia
items.core: The saying "wearing a hearing aid can prevent dementia" is not currently established. A three-year trial involving nearly a thousand people showed no overall difference. The difference was only seen among those who were already at higher risk for cognitive decline. Therefore, the reason for wearing hearing aids is to be able to hear now, talk to people, and hear cars when crossing the street, not to protect your brain decades from now.
body: Cost: Hearing aids range from several thousand to tens of thousands of yuan, most of which have to be paid for at your own expense. It requires fitting and debugging several times.

Benefits: The ACHIEVE trial was conducted in 4 communities across the United States and included 977 people aged 70 to 84 years with untreated hearing loss and no significant cognitive impairment. They were randomly divided into two groups, one group received hearing intervention (hearing consultation and hearing aid fitting), and the other group received health education control, with follow-up visits every 6 months. The primary endpoint was change in global cognitive scores at 3 years. In the main analysis combining the two source populations, there was no significant difference between the two groups: hearing intervention group −0.200 (95% CI −0.256 to −0.144), control group −0.202 (95% CI −0.258 to −0.145), difference 0.002 (95% CI −0.077 to 0.081), P=0.96. A prespecified sensitivity analysis showed that the intervention effect differed between the two source populations (P=0.010 for interaction). Participants from that long-term observational study of cardiovascular health were older, had more risk factors for cognitive decline, and had lower baseline cognitive scores. Among this group of 238 people, cognitive decline at 3 years was 48% less in the hearing intervention group (difference 0.191, 95% CI 0.022–0.360, P=0.027). Among the other 739 newly recruited healthy volunteers, there was no significant difference between the two groups (difference −0.061, 95% CI −0.151 to 0.028, P=0.18). The researchers concluded that hearing intervention may reduce cognitive change over 3 years in those at higher risk for cognitive decline, but not in those at lower risk. The trial reported no serious adverse events attributable to the study
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Lin FR, Pike JR, Albert MS, et al.; ACHIEVE Collaborative Research Group (2023). Hearing intervention versus health education control to reduce cognitive decline in older adults with hearing loss in the USA (ACHIEVE): a multicentre, randomized controlled trial. Lancet, 402(10404):786-797. <https://doi.org/10.1016/S0140-6736(23)01406-X>

Note: Controversy: The statement that "hearing aids reduced cognitive decline by nearly half" comes from a subgroup of 238 people in this trial, not its main result. The main result is that there is no difference between the two groups. "Getting hearing aids" and "preventing dementia" should be looked at separately: the former should be done, and the latter should not be used as a reason. Candidates with hearing disabilities can be exempted from foreign language listening in the college entrance examination, see Article 13 (Reasonable Accommodation) of this section. People with hearing impairment should wear hearing aids when driving, see Article 15 (C5) of this section.

Case: 65-year-old Aunt Chen has hearing loss. Her daughter persuaded her to get a hearing aid. She was worried about the risk of dementia. The doctor said the reason was that she could hear better. After the hearing aid, she could chat with her granddaughter and feel relieved when crossing the road.

items.title: If an adult is said to be "unable to mind his or her own affairs", he or she must apply to the court for recognition. The family member's decision does not count.
items.core: Only the court can determine whether an adult has "no capacity for civil conduct" or "restricted capacity for civil conduct." Families, work units, and neighborhood committees cannot have the final say on their own. Interested parties or relevant organizations must apply to the court. On the other hand, if the intelligence or mental health has recovered, you can also apply for recognition that he has regained his behavioral capacity.
body: Cost: Apply to the court not to pay the case acceptance fee. If an appraisal is required, the appraisal fee is charged separately and is generally paid by the applicant. The law requires that the review be completed within 30 days, and the appraisal will take even longer.

Income: Article 21 of the "Civil Code": "Adults who cannot fully identify their own behavior are persons without capacity for civil conduct and are represented by their legal representatives to perform civil legal acts." Article 22: "Adults who are unable to fully identify their own behavior are persons with limited capacity for civil conduct. When performing civil legal acts, they are represented by their legal representatives or with the consent or ratification of their legal representatives; however, they can independently carry out civil legal acts for pure gain or civil acts that are appropriate to their intellectual and mental health conditions. Legal acts. "Article 24: "For an adult who is unable to identify or cannot fully identify his own behavior, his or her interested parties or relevant organizations may apply to the People's Court to determine that the adult is a person without capacity for civil conduct or a person with limited capacity for civil conduct." The same article also stipulates that after being identified, upon application by the person, an interested party, or a relevant organization, the People's Court may determine that the adult has been restored to a person with limited capacity for civil conduct or a person with full capacity for civil conduct based on the recovery of his intelligence and mental health. Relevant organizations include: residents’ committees, village committees, schools, medical institutions, women’s federations, disabled people’s federations, legally established elderly organizations, civil affairs departments, etc. Article 23 stipulates that the guardian of a person without capacity for civil conduct or a person with limited capacity for civil conduct is his legal representative (national, effective from January 1, 2021). The procedures are written in the Special Procedures Chapter of the Civil Procedure Law. Article 198: The application should be submitted to the basic people's court where the citizen resides. "The application should state the facts and basis that the citizen has no capacity for civil conduct or has limited capacity for civil conduct." Article 199: "After the people's court accepts the application, it shall, if necessary, conduct an appraisal of the citizen who is requested to be determined as having no capacity for civil conduct or with limited capacity for civil conduct." Article 187: Cases under special procedures "should be concluded within 30 days from the date of filing the case or within 30 days from the expiration of the announcement period." If there are special circumstances that require an extension, it must be approved by the president of this court. Article 8 of the "Measures for the Payment of Litigation Fees": For cases heard in accordance with the special procedures stipulated in the Civil Procedure Law, case acceptance fees shall not be paid. Article 12: The People's Court shall, in accordance with the principle of "whoever makes the claim, shall bear the expenses", decide to pay the expenses directly to the relevant institutions by the parties involved in the litigation.
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Civil Code of the People's Republic of China (Articles 21, 22, 23, 24, and 171). <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=ff808081729d1efe01729d50b5c500bf>; Civil Procedure Law of the People's Republic of China (amended in 2023, Articles 187, 198, and 199). <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=ff8081818a21dc13018b425303b7086d>; State Council Order No. 481. Measures for the payment of litigation fees (Articles 8 and 12). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2008-03/28/content_6929.htm>

Note: The application goes through the special procedures of the court. The statutory trial period is 30 days, which is shorter than ordinary civil cases, but it will take additional time to do the appraisal. The application must state the facts and basis, and the hospital’s diagnosis certificate must generally be attached. This is the author’s experience. The court should conduct an appraisal when necessary. The appraisal fee is generally paid by the applicant on the basis of "whoever claims the claim shall bear it". If you sign for someone and dispose of his property without going through this procedure and without being a legal representative, according to Article 171 of the Civil Code, it will not be effective against him without ratification, and the house may have to be returned if it is sold. This is deduced by the author from the legal provisions. One more thing to remember: limiting civil capacity does not mean being unable to do anything. Things that are in line with his intelligence and mental state, and things that are purely beneficial, he can do himself, don't do everything for him. How does the guardian decide on Article 19 of this Section (Guardian).

Case: After the father suffered a stroke, his children said that he could not take care of things and sold his house without permission. The old man sued. The court found that he had limited capacity for civil conduct, appointed his daughter as the guardian, and the money for the sale of the house was recovered.

items.title: The guardian of an adult is appointed according to the legal order; if the ward hurts someone else, the guardian shall pay compensation.
items.core: After an adult becomes incapacitated, guardians come in order: spouse, parents and children, other close relatives, and finally other people or organizations with the consent of the neighborhood committee, etc. If there is a dispute, it shall be designated by the neighborhood committee, village committee or civil affairs department. If you are not satisfied, go to court. A future guardian may be appointed in writing while awake. If the ward hurts someone else, he or she will first compensate with his own money, and the guardian will make up if the amount is insufficient.
body: Cost: No money. Disputes must be resolved at the neighborhood committee, village committee, civil affairs department or court.

Income: Article 28 of the Civil Code: For adults who have no capacity for civil conduct or have limited capacity for civil conduct, the following persons with guardianship capacity shall serve as guardians in order: "(1) Spouse; (2) Parents and children; (3) Other close relatives; (4) Other individuals or organizations willing to serve as guardians, but subject to The residents' committee, villagers' committee or civil affairs department of the place where the ward is domiciled agrees. "Article 31: If there is a dispute over the determination of the guardian, the residents' committee, villagers' committee or civil affairs department of the place where the ward is domiciled shall appoint the guardian. Those who are dissatisfied with the designation may apply to the People's Court for designation, or they may apply directly to the People's Court. When making the appointment, "the true wishes of the ward should be respected and the principle that is most beneficial to the ward should be followed." If the rights and interests are unprotected before designation, the residents' committee, village committee, relevant organizations prescribed by law or the civil affairs department shall serve as the temporary guardian. Article 33: "Adults with full capacity for civil conduct may consult in advance with their close relatives, other individuals or organizations who are willing to serve as guardians, and determine their guardians in writing." Article 1188: "If a person without capacity for civil conduct or a person with limited capacity for civil conduct causes damage to others, the guardian shall bear tort liability. If the guardian fulfills his guardianship duties, his tort liability may be reduced." If there is property, the compensation fee shall be paid from his own property, and the guardian shall compensate for the shortfall. Article 1189: If a guardian entrusts guardianship duties to others, the guardian shall still bear tort liability, and the trustee shall bear corresponding liability if he is at fault (national, effective from January 1, 2021)
Level of Evidence: A
Source: Civil Code of the People's Republic of China (Articles 28, 31, 33, 1188, 1189). <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=ff808081729d1efe01729d50b5c500bf>

Note: Article 33 is voluntary guardianship. Choosing the person in writing while the person is awake can save most of the disputes later. For details on how to write it, see Section 17, Article 1 (Intentional Guardianship). Be careful when it comes to compensation: if you leave the person in the care of a foster care institution or relative, the responsibility still lies with the guardian, and the trustee will only bear corresponding liability if he or she is at fault. So it makes sense to buy a guardian liability insurance for your ward. Article 78 of the Mental Health Law also stipulates that if a guardian abandons a patient or fails to perform guardianship duties and causes damage, he shall be liable for compensation in accordance with the law.

Case: A middle-aged man suddenly suffered a cerebral hemorrhage and became a vegetative state. His spouse and parents competed to be the guardian. The neighborhood committee designated his spouse as the guardian, but the parents refused to accept the lawsuit and went to court. The court upheld the appointment in accordance with the legal order. If the ward hurts someone later, he will first use his savings to pay compensation, and the guardian will make up the shortfall.

items.title: If you are rejected, not promoted, or paid less because of your disability, you can file a lawsuit, but you must first calculate the cost of the process
items.core: The law prohibits discrimination against persons with disabilities in recruitment, regularization, promotion, job title evaluation, remuneration, and social security. You can complain to the competent authorities or go to court. But if you win the lawsuit, the other party will not pay your attorney fees. So make a complaint first, apply for legal aid at the same time, and then consider filing a lawsuit.
body: Cost: Legal fees range from several thousand to tens of thousands of yuan, paid by yourself. The ordinary first-instance procedure is required to be completed within 6 months and can be extended. Keep the evidence yourself.

Income: Article 3 of the "Law on the Protection of Disabled Persons": "Discrimination on the basis of disability is prohibited. Insulting and infringing upon persons with disabilities is prohibited." Article 38: "Discrimination against persons with disabilities shall not be allowed in the recruitment, regularization, promotion, professional title evaluation, labor remuneration, living welfare, rest and leave, social insurance, etc. of employees." The same article also stipulates that the units where disabled employees work shall provide appropriate working conditions and labor protection based on the characteristics of disabled employees, and transform labor places, labor equipment, and living facilities according to actual needs. Article 64: "Anyone who violates the provisions of this Law and discriminates against persons with disabilities in the recruitment of employees shall be ordered to make corrections by the relevant competent authorities; disabled workers may file a lawsuit with the People's Court in accordance with the law." Article 4 of the "Employment Regulations for Disabled Persons": "Discrimination against persons with disabilities in employment is prohibited." Article 13: Employers shall not discriminate against employees with disabilities in terms of promotion, promotion, assessment of professional titles, remuneration, social insurance, living benefits, etc. Article 42 of the "Legal Aid Law" stipulates that applicants who have materials proving that they belong to "special groups such as minors, the elderly, and disabled people without a fixed source of livelihood" will be exempted from verification of financial difficulties. Article 45 stipulates that legal aid institutions that provide legal aid services to the elderly and disabled people shall provide barrier-free facilities, equipment and services based on actual conditions (nationwide)
Level of Evidence: A

Source: Law of the People's Republic of China on the Protection of Disabled Persons (Articles 3, 38, and 64). <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=ff8080816f135f46016f1d134c88132b>; State Council (2007). Regulations on the Employment of Disabled Persons (Articles 4 and 13). <https://www.gov.cn/zhengce/zhengceku/2008-03/28/content_6646.htm>; Legal Aid Law of the People's Republic of China (Articles 42 and 45). <https://flk.npc.gov.cn/detail?id=ff8081817b6472a3017b6577820f0061>

Note: Process costs must be calculated first. The ordinary procedure of first instance shall be completed within 6 months and may be extended; the simplified procedure shall be completed within 3 months. Attorney's fees are not included in the litigation fees listed in Article 6 of the "Measures for the Payment of Litigation Fees", and the "loser's burden" in Article 29 does not include attorney's fees. Therefore, there are two low-cost ways to take first: complain to the human resources and social security department or the Disabled Persons' Federation, and the competent department will order correction; and apply for legal aid at the same time. Only those who have materials proving that they are disabled persons with no fixed source of livelihood or other legal circumstances will be exempted from verification of financial difficulties in accordance with Article 42. Obtaining evidence is the most difficult level. When an interview is rejected, the other party rarely leaves a written reason. They can record or leave chat records if they can. Those who have already joined the company will be subject to labor dispute arbitration. Please refer to Section 19, Article 8 (Retention of Certificates Before Resignation) for the time limit for retention of certificates and the statute of limitations. The beneficiary is yourself.

Case: Xiao Li, a physically disabled person, met the performance standards during his probationary period but was not promoted to a regular employee. After many unsuccessful communications, he complained to the Disabled Persons' Federation and applied for legal aid. The Disabled Persons' Federation intervened to coordinate with the company to make up for the regular salary and social security. Because the evidence was complete, he received reasonable compensation without litigation.

items.title: If you are unable to urinate after a spinal cord injury, the urination method should be determined with your doctor. Do not leave a urinary catheter inserted for a long time. Check your kidneys and bladder regularly throughout your life.
items.core: If you are unable to urinate after a spinal cord injury, you must rely on methods such as urinary catheterization to empty the bladder. In the UK, which has been tracking data for seventy years, more than 10% of deaths are caused by the genitourinary system. For people who have had urinary catheters inserted for a long time, the rate of complications is about twice as high as for those who regularly catheterize themselves. No matter which method is used, kidneys and bladder should be checked regularly throughout life.
body: Cost: Catheterize yourself regularly, four to six times a day, for a few minutes each time, and you have to buy catheters all the time. Re-examination is done every one to two years, and the patient should be consulted by the urology department or rehabilitation department. The difficulty lies in doing it every day and not stopping it for decades.

Benefits: 5483 patients with traumatic spinal cord injury were examined at two UK spinal cord injury centres. They were injured between 1943 and 2010, all survived the first year after injury, and were followed up until the end of 2014. A total of 2,322 people died, 2,170 of whom had a confirmed cause of death. The top causes of death were respiratory system in 29.3%, circulatory system in 26.7%, tumors in 13.9%, and genitourinary system in 11.5%. After deducting the age difference, the mortality rate of genitourinary system is higher than that of the general population. It has been declining in recent years, but it is still high. Another U.S. study looked at the medical records of 316 patients with traumatic spinal cord injuries, followed for an average of 18.3 years after injury, grouped by urination pattern. Among those who experienced complications, 53.5% were in the long-term transurethral indwelling catheter group, 27.2% in the clean intermittent catheterization group, 32.4% in the spontaneous urination group, and 44.4% in the suprapubic fistula group. Complications include infection, stones, urethral injury, and imaging abnormalities. This is just a comparison of medical records, there is no randomization. The 2026 guidelines of the European Society of Urology state that transurethral indwelling urinary catheters have many complications and a high risk of urinary tract infection, and should be avoided if possible. The same goes for a suprapubic fistula, albeit to a lesser degree. The guidelines also state that long-term follow-up should be done throughout life to check the risk of urinary tract damage and kidney failure. In most cases, the interval between reexaminations does not exceed one to two years. People at high risk should have an ultrasound about once every six months, and a physical examination and urine test every year. Section 3.4.2.e of the Guidelines states that intermittent catheterization and indwelling urinary catheterization are standard practices for people who cannot empty their bladders, and it is recommended that the doctor and the individual make a decision together. Among people with spinal cord injury, intermittent catheterization is associated with worse quality of life scores than indwelling catheters, especially those with more than four urinary tract infections a year. In one observational study, 42.1% of people who used intermittent catheterization discontinued it within 12 months, mainly due to inconvenience, leakage, and increased infections. Guidelines state that silicone catheters are better because they are less prone to scaling and latex allergies are common in patients with neurological diseases. Section 3.5.1 lists the most common signs of urinary tract infection in such patients: fever, new or worsening urinary leakage, increased cramping, fatigue, cloudy and smelly urine, renal or bladder pain, and autonomic dysreflexia
Level of Evidence: B

Source: Savic G, DeVivo MJ, Frankel HL, Jamous MA, Soni BM, Charlifue S (2017). Causes of death after traumatic spinal cord injury - a 70-year British study. Spinal Cord, 55(10):891-897. <https://doi.org/10.1038/sc.2017.64>; Weld KJ, Dmochowski RR (2000). Effect of bladder management on urological complications in spinal cord injured patients. Journal of Urology, 163(3):768-772. <https://doi.org/10.1016/s0022-5347(05)67800-7>; European Association of Urology (2026). EAU Guidelines on Neuro-Urology (sections 3.3.8, 3.4.2.e, 3.5.1, 3.7). <https://uroweb.org/guidelines/neuro-urology/chapter/the-guideline>

Note: Controversy: The same guideline lists both intermittent catheterization and indwelling urinary catheter as standard practices, requiring doctors to decide together with the individual. Among people with spinal cord injury, intermittent catheterization had worse quality-of-life scores, especially those with more than four urinary tract infections a year. More than 40% of people who use intermittent catheterization stop using it within a year. Therefore, if your hands are inconvenient and there is no one to help you at home, indwelling urinary catheter can be a reasonable choice. This is what the author deduced from the above points. For indwelling urinary catheters, the guidelines recommend using silicone tubes. Don't make your own decisions, and don't just plug it in and then not review it for a few years. New leakage of urine, cloudy and smelly urine, worsening cramps, and fever may be a urinary tract infection and should be seen. Overfilling the bladder can induce autonomic dysreflexia, see item 1 in this section (sudden severe headache). The original text of the domestic neurogenic bladder guideline was not available and was not cited. The beneficiary is yourself.

Case: Mr. Zhang with spinal cord injury had a long-term indwelling urinary catheter. Two years later, he had recurrent urinary tract infections and decreased kidney function. On the doctor's advice, I switched to regular clean intermittent catheterization, and checked my kidneys and bladder every six months. Now the frequency of infections has greatly reduced, and my kidney function has stabilized and has not worsened.

sections.title: Don’t get into trouble by taking the medicines you always have at home

items.title: Before taking two cold medicines or painkillers at the same time, read the ingredient list first. Acetaminophen can only be one type. If you take too much and don’t feel uncomfortable, go to the hospital on the same day.
items.core: Many cold medicines contain acetaminophen. If you take two boxes together, you are taking a double dose. Excessive dosage will damage the liver. In the United States, nearly 30% of patients with acute liver failure caused by it died before liver transplantation. Domestic instructions recommend taking up to 2 grams a day, and the United States also reminds not to drink more than 3 glasses of wine a day when taking the medicine. If you eat too much and don't feel uncomfortable, you should go to the hospital immediately. The sooner you take the antidote, the better.
body: Cost: Nothing. Take a minute or two to glance at the ingredient list on every box of pills.

Benefits: 22 hospitals in the United States registered 662 cases of acute liver failure over a 6-year period. Acetaminophen was responsible for 275 of these cases (42%), with the median dose swallowed being 24 grams. Of these 275 people, 131 (48%) ate too much accidentally, not on purpose. Among those who accidentally ate too much, 38% took two or more medicines containing this ingredient at the same time. Of these 275 people, 27% died before waiting for a liver transplant, and 8% underwent a liver transplant. In 2020, the State Food and Drug Administration requires over-the-counter drug instructions to state that excessive use can cause severe liver damage, and it is recommended that the maximum dose per day should not exceed 2 grams. The instructions also state that it is best to avoid co-administration with drugs containing acetaminophen or other antipyretic and analgesics. U.S. regulations require such over-the-counter drugs to state in the first warning that they may harm the liver in three ways: exceeding the maximum daily dose, taking it with other acetaminophen-containing drugs, and drinking more than three drinks a day while taking the drug. The same announcement from the Food and Drug Administration also requires that the instructions for sustained-release preparations state that adults or children who overdose should seek medical attention immediately regardless of whether they feel uncomfortable or not. For information on dosage forms, see MedlinePlus Medication Instructions from the U.S. National Library of Medicine: If you exceed the recommended dose, "even if the person does not have any symptoms" (even if there are no symptoms at all), you should seek medical attention immediately. The antidote is called N-acetylcysteine, and the instructions state that it should be used as soon as possible. The effect is satisfactory if used within 12 hours, and the effect is less effective after 24 hours. A multicenter study in the United States from 1976 to 1985 followed 2,540 overdose patients on this antidote. Among patients who were judged to have liver damage based on blood drug concentration, 6.1% developed liver damage if they started taking the drug within 10 hours. Liver damage occurred in 26.4% of those who started taking it 10 to 24 hours later. If started within 8 hours after overdose, the drug will have a protective effect no matter how high the blood concentration is.
Level of Evidence: B

Source: Larson AM, Polson J, Fontana RJ, et al.; Acute Liver Failure Study Group (2005). Acetaminophen-induced acute liver failure: results of a United States multicenter, prospective study. Hepatology, 42(6):1364-1372. <https://doi.org/10.1002/hep.20948>; Announcement of the State Food and Drug Administration on revising the instructions for acetaminophen immediate-release and sustained-release preparations (No. 15, 2020) and Annex 1 "Revision Requirements for Prescription Instructions for Acetaminophen Idle-Release Preparations", Annex 2 "Revision Requirements for Over-the-Counter Inserts for Acetaminophen Identary-Release Preparations", and Annex 3 "Revision Requirements for Inserts for Acetaminophen Sustained-Release Preparations" (reprinted by the Hunan Provincial Food and Drug Administration). <http://mpa.hunan.gov.cn/mpa/xxgk/tzgg/wjtz/202003/t20200311_11809335.html>; 21 CFR 201.326(a)(1)(iii)(A) Liver warning. <https://www.ecfr.gov/current/title-21/chapter-I/subchapter-C/part-201/subpart-G/section-201.326>; Smilkstein MJ, Knapp GL, Kulig KW, Rumack BH (1988). Efficacy of oral N-acetylcysteine in the treatment of acetaminophen overdose: analysis of the national multicenter study (1976 to 1985). New England Journal of Medicine, 319(24):1557-1562. <https://doi.org/10.1056/NEJM198812153192401>; MedlinePlus. Acetaminophen (In case of emergency/overdose). <https://medlineplus.gov/druginfo/meds/a681004.html>

Note: Acetaminophen is also called paracetamol. The common names of compound cold medicines contain the word "aminophenol", such as aminophenol, pseudoanesthetic, and acetaminophen, which contain this ingredient. If you are not sure, you will show several boxes of medicine to the pharmacist in the drugstore. The reason for setting B is that the set of figures in the United States are case registrations and there is no control group. It is impossible to calculate how many incidents can be avoided by looking at the ingredient list. The "big" benefit is determined based on the consequences: nearly 30% of patients with acute liver failure die directly. The number of antidotes, the sooner the better, comes from a multi-center observation without randomization and is only compared with past cases.

Case: Xiao Zhou took compound cold medicine and another analgesic tablet at the same time after catching a cold. Both boxes contained acetaminophen, which was a cumulative overdose that day. Although he didn't feel any discomfort at night, he still went to the hospital to check his liver function as instructed in the instructions. The doctor prescribed antidote as soon as possible to avoid worsening of liver damage.

items.title: Aspirin, nimesulide and metamizole should not be used in children with fever, and cold medicines containing metamizole should not be given to minors. Liquid antipyretics should be measured in the amount provided in the medicine box
items.core: Aspirin is related to Reye's syndrome, a disease that damages the brain and liver. About 30% of the sick children monitored in the United States died. Nimesulide is contraindicated in children under 12 years of age, and metamizole is contraindicated in children under 18 years of age. The amount of liquid antipyretic medicine comes in the medicine box, and the size of the spoons at home is very different. The concentration of drops and oral liquid may be different. In the United States, the difference is 3 times. If the dosage form is changed, the dosage in milliliters will still be the same.
body: Cost: No money. When buying fever reducers, take a look at the generic name and ingredient list.

Benefit: Reye's syndrome causes encephalopathy and hepatic steatosis, often following influenza or chickenpox. During national surveillance in the United States from 1981 to 1997, 1,207 cases were reported in persons under 18 years of age. Salicylic acid, a component of drugs like aspirin, was detected in the blood of 82% of sick children. The overall case fatality rate is 31%. Warnings about salicylates began in 1980. There were 555 cases reported that year, the peak, and since 1987 there have been no more than 36 cases per year. The State Food and Drug Administration stipulated in 2011 that oral preparations of nimesulide are prohibited from being used in children under 12 years of age. In 2020, the State Food and Drug Administration stipulated that metamizole tablets are prohibited from being used by children under the age of 18. Compound Qinghao Metamizole Tablets, Chongganling Tablets and Chongganling Capsules containing metamizole are also prohibited for use under 18 years of age. When it comes to measuring medication, look at the numbers in the United States. The U.S. Food and Drug Administration stated in 2011 that acetaminophen drops for infants are 80 mg per 0.8 ml and oral solution for older children is 160 mg per 5 ml. Based on these two figures, for the same 1 ml, the dosage of drops is about 3 times that of oral liquid. The U.S. Food and Drug Administration says that the coexistence of two concentrations can easily lead to confusion, which could lead to children accidentally overeating. Measuring tools for different products must not be mixed. A Greek study measured 71 teaspoons and 49 tablespoons from 25 households, with volumes ranging from 2.5 ml to 7.3 ml when filled with water. In an emergency study in the United States, 42.5% of parents who used teaspoons or tablespoons for dosage measured incorrectly. Parents who only used milliliters made the wrong measurement 27.6% of the time. Adjusted odds ratio OR 2.3, 95% CI 1.2–4.4.
Level of Evidence: B

Source: Belay ED, Bresee JS, Holman RC, Khan AS, Shahriari A, Schonberger LB (1999). Reye's syndrome in the United States from 1981 through 1997. New England Journal of Medicine, 340(18):1377-1382. <https://doi.org/10.1056/NEJM199905063401801>; Notice on strengthening the management of the use of nimesulide oral preparations (State Food and Drug Administration [2011] No. 209). <https://www.nmpa.gov.cn/xxgk/fgwj/gzwj/gzwjyp/20110515145101552.html>; Announcement of the State Food and Drug Administration on revising the instructions for metamizole related varieties (No. 34, 2020) and attachments 1 to 3. U.S. Food and Drug Administration. Questions and Answers – Important change in concentration for over-the-counter (OTC) liquid acetaminophen marketed for infants.
